cards.audioText:
UAL919, we’ve just been struck by lightning and we’ll have to go back to the ramp to check our electrics and make sure there is no damage on the fuselage.
Q: What will the crew do?
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航919，我们刚刚遭受雷击，我们接下来需要返回停机坪检查电子设备，确保机身没有受损伤。
问：机组成员将做什么？
choices: Make sure the systems are ok.
Make sure if anyone is struck.
Make sure air frame is not electrified.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Make sure the systems are ok.

cards.audioText:
CES5152 returned to the airport after taking off from Beijing, because a passenger was found not on board while the luggage was on the airplane.
Q: What happened to CES5152?
cards.audioTextZh:
东方5152从北京起飞后返回机场，原因是一名乘客不在飞机上，但是他的行李在。
问：东方5152发生了什么事？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. One passenger was lost.

cards.audioText:
They said that most passengers of the 737-400 were held up due to a woman getting stuck in the aircraft door while trying to exit the plane.
Q: What had happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
他们说波音734-400上的大部分乘客都困在飞机上，原因是一名女士在试图下飞机时被客舱门夹住。
问：发生了什么事？
choices: A passenger was jammed on board.
The door of the plane was broken.
A woman could not get off the plane.
A woman was stuck in the seat.
choicesZh: 一名乘客夹在了飞机上
一名女士夹在了座椅上。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A passenger was jammed on board.

cards.audioText:
CCA981, we are standing on the stop way, executing emergency evacuation, request emergency services.
Q: What will the crew need?
cards.audioTextZh:
国航981，我们在停止端，正进行紧急撤离，请求紧急服务。
问：机组需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. All of the other choices.

cards.audioText:
BAW564, stop and hold position. A B737 has taken a wrong turn and is blocking the taxiway.
Q: Why was the pilot instructed to stop?
cards.audioTextZh:
英航564，停止并原地等待，一架波音737转弯错误，阻塞了滑行道。
问：为什么给飞行员发送了停止指令？
choices: Because the crew has taken a wrong turning.
Because another traffic has taken a wrong turning.
Because BAW 564 has blocked the way of 737.
Because BAW 564 has taken the wrong way.
choicesZh: 因为另一架飞机转弯错误。
因为英航564挡了波音737的路。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Because another traffic has taken a wrong turning.

cards.audioText:
Each pilot in command of an aircraft is during the flight time responsible for the safety of the passengers, crew-members, cargo, and aircraft.
Q: What is the captain's responsibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行期间，每位操纵飞机的飞行员都要对所有乘客、机组人员、机上货物和飞机的安全负责。问：机长的职责是什么？
choices: To be in charge of the aircraft.
To be responsible for the passengers.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To ensure the safety.

cards.audioText:
UAL156, we have only one green, we'll try manual extension.
Q: What is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航156，我们只有一个绿灯亮，我们将尝试手动放下起落架。问: 出现了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Landing gear jammed.

cards.audioText:
Although there was a stall warning, the pilot made a normal touch-down and brought the aircraft to a halt on a down-slope field.
Q: What does this statement imply?
cards.audioTextZh: 尽管出现失速告警，但是飞行员还是成功让飞机正常接地，并且把飞机停在一个下坡地段。问：这段陈述暗含了什么信息？
choices: The aircraft landed but with stall warning.
The aircraft didn't stop after landing.
choicesZh: 飞机出现失速告警，但成功着陆
飞机在着陆后没有停下来
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The aircraft landed but with stall warning.

cards.audioText:
UAL 919, flight level 250 not available due traffic. Alternative is flight level 230.
Question: Which flight level might be used?
cards.audioTextZh:
UAL 919，由于交通原因，飞行高度层250不可用。可选飞行高度层为230。
问题：可能使用哪个飞行高度层？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 230

cards.audioText:
All stations, London Control, fuel dumping in progress, DC 8, dumping on radial 240 of Forest VOR, ranging from14 to 20 nm, avoid operations below dumping track.
Question: What’s happening?
cards.audioTextZh:
所有电台，伦敦管制区，正在进行放油。一架DC-8正在Forest甚高频全向信标（VOR）240度径向线上、距台14至20海里范围内放油，请避免在放油航迹下方运行。
问题：正在发生什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A DC 8 is dumping fuel
choices: All aircraft are avoiding fuel dumping
All aircraft are flying below dumping area
A DC 8 is flying below dumping area
choicesZh: 所有航空器都在避开放油
所有航空器都在放油区下方飞行
一架DC-8正在放油区下方飞行

cards.audioText:
A controller informed SIA 223 that the taxi route was A5 and A, and the active runway was 36R. The pilot should follow the taxi clearance to Runway 36R.
Question: Which word should be used to express the pilot’s response?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员通知SIA 223，滑行路线为A5和A，使用跑道为36R。飞行员应按照滑行许可滑行至36R跑道。
问题：飞行员应使用哪个词来表达回应？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Wilco

cards.audioText:
BAW 125, go around, I say again, go around, unknown traffic is crossing the runway.
Question: Why must BAW 125 go around?
cards.audioTextZh:
BAW 125，复飞，我再说一遍，复飞，有不明航空器正在穿越跑道。
问题：BAW 125为什么必须复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Another aircraft is crossing the runway
choices: It can not cross the runway
Another aircraft is crossing the runway
The crew wants to know who is crossing the runway
The crew wants to cross the runway
choicesZh: 另一架航空器正在穿越跑道
机组想知道是谁在穿越跑道

cards.audioText:
CSN 3527, We’ve returned due to bird strike. Engine No 3 is overheating. Our position is 15nm from LKO at 3900m.
Question: What is the pilot’s intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
CSN 3527，我们因鸟击返航。3号发动机过热。我们的位置在LKO外15海里、高度3900米。
问题：飞行员的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Return to departing airport

cards.audioText:
AFR 526, takeoff aborted due engine failure. We are on the stopway. We just managed to stop short of the ILS antennas. Everybody on board seems to be all right. We’ll just need coaches to take the passengers back to the terminal.
Question: Where is the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
AFR 526，由于发动机故障中断起飞。我们停在停止道上，刚好在ILS天线前停住。机上所有人看起来都没事。我们只需要客车把乘客送回航站楼。
问题：飞机在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Out of the runway

cards.audioText:
P: Panpan, panpan, panpan, Wuhan approach, request priority landing. A passenger claimed he has bird flu. I am not sure. But it scared the passengers. The attendants are trying to comfort other passengers, but I am afraid the situation could soon get out of control.
Question: Why is the situation going be out of control?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：PAN PAN，PAN PAN，PAN PAN，武汉进近，请求优先着陆。一名乘客声称自己患有禽流感，我不能确定。但这吓到了其他乘客。乘务员正设法安抚其他乘客，但我担心局面很快会失控。
问题：局面为什么可能失控？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Someone on board has some fatal infectious disease
choices: Someone on board has some fatal infectious disease
A dangerous bird is on board
choicesZh: 机上有人患有致命传染病

cards.audioText:
Ground, GWL 901, main undercarriage is bogged and unable to taxi. Would you send a tug and get us back to the stand.
Question: What is GWL 901’s problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
地面，GWL 901，主起落架陷住，无法滑行。能否派一辆牵引车把我们拖回停机位？
问题：GWL 901出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Main gear failure

cards.audioText:
Ground, ACA 432 is ready to go, but the tow bar has broken, can we delay the pushback a few minutes?
Question: What is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
地面，ACA 432已准备好出发，但牵引杆断了，我们可以把推出延迟几分钟吗？
问题：出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. ACA 432 has a tow bar problem
choices: ACA 432 is a few minutes late
ACA 432 has a tow bar problem

cards.audioText:
GWL 567, request return to the airport, I have a high temperature indication in the wheel well on my ECAM.
Question: Why does the flight crew request to come back?
cards.audioTextZh:
GWL 567，请求返场，我的ECAM上显示轮舱温度过高。
问题：飞行机组为什么请求返场？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Undercarriage overheating

cards.audioText:
UAL 334, we can not accept Runway 27 with such a tailwind. We wish to change to Runway 09.
Question: Which runway will the crew use to take off?
cards.audioTextZh:
UAL 334，顺风这么大，我们不能接受27跑道。我们希望改用09跑道。
问题：机组将使用哪条跑道起飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Runway 09

cards.audioText:
The Captain is the commander on board but this doesn't mean he can't listen to other's advice. This is an important rule.
Q: For a captain, what is the proper attitude towards advice?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长是飞机上的总指挥，但是，这并不意味着他不听从别人的意见，这是一项非常重要的规定。
问：对于机长而言，面对建议的正确态度是？
choices: Command others to listen to him.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Welcome other's advice.

cards.audioText:
A lot of cabin and flight crews are afraid to approach the captain about a safety concern for fear of how he'll react.
Q: Why are cabin crews afraid to approach the captain?
cards.audioTextZh:
出于安全考虑，很多机组成员和乘务员害都怕接近机长，因为他们担心机长会如何回应。
问：机组成员为什么害怕接近机长？
choices: They are unsure of the captain's response.
choicesZh: 他们不确定机长会如何回应。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They are unsure of the captain's response.

cards.audioText:
If you are busy and ATC is constantly changing your speed, altitude, heading and frequencies. It can be distracting and frustrating.
Q: What is the main idea of the sentence?
cards.audioTextZh:
如果你现在很忙，而管制员又经常让你改变速度、高度、航向和频率，这会让人分心，感到沮丧。
问：这段话的主要意思是什么？
choices: It is not easy to focus on one thing.
choicesZh: 专注于一件事并非易事。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. It is not easy to focus on one thing.

cards.audioText:
After crossing the taxiway, the captain turned around and found that the entire aircraft was on fire. Fire engines were rushing to the scene.
Q: What did the captain see?
cards.audioTextZh:
穿过滑行道后，机长回头发现整个飞机失火了，消防车飞速赶到现场。
问：机长看到了什么？
choices: The aircraft was crossing the runway.
The aircraft was crossing the taxiway.
The aircraft was in a dangerous situation.
The aircraft has passed the taxiway.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The aircraft was in a dangerous situation.

cards.audioText:
The flight crew was told to abort the takeoff because the Airport radar system detected a target at the departure end of runway 25.
Q: What was the flight crew told?
cards.audioTextZh:
机组成员被告知中断起飞，原因是机场雷达系统在跑道25的离场尽头发现了一个目标航空器。
问：飞行机组被告知了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Made a rejected takeoff.

cards.audioText:
If you look at the weather chart, you might see a low-pressure area with precipitation approaching Xi’an.
Q: What kind of weather is expected near Xi’an?
cards.audioTextZh:
如果你看气象图，你可能会看到有一片降水的低压区域正在接近西安。
问：西安附近可能会出现什么天气？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Rain.

cards.audioText:
P: On landing, I noticed the landing gear had a little shimmy. M: Okay, we will check it. The ... is good, ... in the center, the gear is not locked down properly.
Question: What was the problem with the nose gear on landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：着陆时，我注意到起落架有些摆振。机务：好的，我们会检查。……状态正常，……位于中心，起落架没有正确锁定在放下位。
问题：着陆时前起落架出现了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. A little shaking

cards.audioText:
Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking. We will begin descent in approximately five minutes and will land in 30 minutes from now, at local time six twenty.
Question: When does the captain estimate the aircraft will land?
cards.audioTextZh:
女士们、先生们，这里是机长广播。我们将在大约5分钟后开始下降，并于30分钟后、当地时间6点20分着陆。
问题：机长预计飞机什么时候着陆？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. In 30 minutes.

cards.audioText:
The pilot gave incorrect readback and switched the radio frequency before being corrected. As a result, the aircraft crossed the active runway without clearance.
Question: Why wasn't the readback corrected?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员给出错误复诵，并在被纠正前转换了无线电频率。结果，飞机未经许可穿越了使用中的跑道。
问：为什么复诵没有被纠正？
choices: The controller didn't notice the error.
The pilot switched to another frequency.
choicesZh: 管制员没有注意到错误
飞行员转到了另一个频率
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The pilot switched to another frequency.

cards.audioText:
Last week, while we were taxiing onto the runway, we got a low hydraulic quantity warning. After confirming that we were losing fluid, we stopped and called for a tug. Unfortunately, we had to wait nearly one hour before it came, and it was two hours later when we changed aircraft and took off.
Question: How did they get back to the gate?
cards.audioTextZh:
上周，我们正滑入跑道时出现液压油量低警告。确认液压油正在泄漏后，我们停下并呼叫了牵引车。不幸的是，牵引车将近1小时后才到；等我们更换飞机并起飞时，已经过去了2小时。
问题：他们是怎样返回登机口的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They used a tug.
choices: They went back on one engine.

cards.audioText:
P: New York Departure, good morning, CCA 818, climbing through 3000 feet, heading 220, direct VINE.
Question: What is the current heading for CCA 818?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：纽约离场，早上好，CCA 818，正在爬升通过3000英尺，航向220，直飞VINE。
问题：CCA 818当前的航向是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 220

cards.audioText:
Because an airplane is heavier than air, the wings must do something to the surrounding air to make the air support the weight of the airplane.
Question: What is the man mainly talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
由于飞机比空气重，机翼必须对空气施加作用，使空气能够支撑飞机。
问题：这名男子主要在谈论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Lift.

cards.audioText:
There are many types of fire extinguishers, such as water, dry foam and BTM, BCF fire extinguishers are used in the cockpit.
Q: What types of fire extinguisher are used in the cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh:
有很多类型的灭火器，比如，水，干粉和BTM灭火器，BCF灭火器一般在驾驶舱使用。
问：在驾驶舱使用的灭火器是什么类型的灭火器？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. BCF.

cards.audioText:
M1: According to the current law, those who take dangerous goods onto an airplane have to be detained for 5 to 15 days. M2: That's serious.
Question: How long will a person be detained for carrying forbidden goods?
cards.audioTextZh:
说话人1：根据现行法律，携带危险品登机的人将被拘留5至15天。说话人2：后果很严重。
问题：携带违禁品的人会被拘留多长时间？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. at least 5 days

cards.audioText:
P1: John, do you know there is a word that ATC will use to inform the pilot that the last clearance has been changed and the new clearance supersedes the preceding clearance? P2: Ah, yes, there is.
Question: What word should be used in this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
说话人1：John，你知道空中交通管制会用哪个词来通知飞行员上一项许可已被更改、新许可取代原许可吗？说话人2：啊，知道，有这个词。
问题：这种情况下应该使用哪个词？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Reclear

cards.audioText:
The airspeed indicator is marked nautical miles per hour, called knots for short, knots are measured as a speed based on nautical or sea miles, aviation uses both nautical or statute miles for distance and speed.
Question: Which of the following is not mentioned?
cards.audioTextZh:
空速表以海里每小时为单位进行标示，简称为“节”。节是以海里为基础的速度单位。航空中，距离和速度会使用海里或法定英里。
问题：下列哪一项没有被提到？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Mach number.

cards.audioText:
Crew Resource Management, formerly known as cockpit resource management, is a process using all available resources such as equipment, procedures, and people to achieve a safe and efficient operation of flight.
Question: According to the statement, what is the goal of CRM?
cards.audioTextZh:
机组资源管理（CRM）以前称为驾驶舱资源管理，是利用设备、程序和人员等所有可用资源，实现安全、高效飞行运行的过程。
问题：根据这段陈述，CRM的目标是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To achieve a safe and efficient flight.
choices: To make best use of the equipment.
To achieve a safe and efficient flight.

cards.audioText:
Wake turbulence refers to rotating air masses generated behind the wingtips of large jet aircraft. It begins on rotation and ends when the nose gear touches down.
Question: Which of the following concerning wake turbulence is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
尾流湍流是指大型喷气式飞机翼尖后方产生的旋转气团。它始于抬轮，止于前起落架接地。
问：下列关于尾流湍流的说法哪项正确？
choices: It disappears when all the gears touch down.
It goes with all the phases of flight.
It only occurs during take off.
It ends when the aircraft touches down.
choicesZh: 所有起落架接地时它消失。
它伴随飞行的所有阶段
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. It disappears when all the gears touch down.

cards.audioText:
The controller, who had only five months' experience on the job, was not aware of the collision course and did not take any corrective action.
Question: Why did the controller not take any corrective action?
cards.audioTextZh:
这名管制员只有5个月的岗位经验，没有意识到两机处于相撞航迹上，因此没有采取任何纠正措施。
问题：管制员为什么没有采取纠正措施？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. He was not aware of the situation.
choices: He was not aware of the situation.
The traffic was not on a collision course.
He did not have TCAS equipment.
choicesZh: 他没有意识到当时的情况
两架航空器并不处于相撞航迹上
他没有机载防撞系统设备

cards.audioText:
The airline couldn't find a replacement aircraft, so the flight was canceled. The passengers then had to be booked into a hotel until they could be put onto a new flight.
Question: Why were the passengers booked into a hotel?
cards.audioTextZh:
航空公司找不到替代飞机，因此取消了航班。乘客只得被安排入住酒店，直到能够改乘新的航班。
问题：这些乘客为什么被安排入住酒店？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Their flight was canceled.

cards.audioText:
All Stations, Wuhan Ground, Information G is valid, surface wind is now 220 degrees at 5m/s.
Question: What has changed in information G?
cards.audioTextZh:
所有电台，武汉地面，G通播有效，当前地面风为220度、5米/秒。
问题：G通播中的什么信息发生了变化？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Wind.

cards.audioText:
The light signal from the tower shows the flashing green means "Return for landing and
cleared to taxi" while steady green means to be "Cleared to land".
Question: What does the flashing green light signal from the control tower mean to an aircraft in flight?
cards.audioTextZh:
来自塔台的灯光信号显示，闪烁绿灯表示“返场着陆，可以滑行”，而稳定绿灯表示“可以着陆”。
问：塔台的闪烁绿灯信号对飞行中的飞机意味着什么？
choices: Return for landing and cleared to taxi.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Return for landing and cleared to taxi.

cards.audioText:
You are at Runway 16L, cleared for immediate takeoff, ahead you see a RJ taxiing toward your runway from a parallel Runway 16R.
Question: What is the RJ supposed to do when it reaches 16L, your runway?
cards.audioTextZh:
你位于16L跑道，已获准立即起飞。你看到前方有一架支线飞机正从平行的16R跑道方向朝你的16L跑道滑行。
问题：这架支线飞机到达你的16L跑道时应该怎么做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Hold short of 16 L.
choices: Line up and wait on 16 L.

cards.audioText:
When evidence of fuel leak is found on the starboard wing, the pilots must ask mechanic staff to check the aircraft fuel system.
Question: According to the statement, which system of the aircraft must be checked?
cards.audioTextZh:
当在右翼发现燃油泄漏迹象时，飞行员必须请机务人员检查飞机燃油系统。
问：根据该陈述，飞机的哪个系统必须被检查？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Fuel system.

cards.audioText:
Climbing in ETOPS and extended range twin engine operation of flight requires understanding of operational procedure, critical fuel reserve, altitude capability, cruising range performance and weather conditions.
Question: Which of the following is not mentioned in the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
执行ETOPS延程双发运行，需要了解运行程序、临界燃油储备、高度能力、巡航航程性能和天气条件。
问题：下列哪一项没有在陈述中提到？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Bird activities.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, NWA 14, declaring an emergency, we have a fire in No. 1 engine, we need to return to the airport Runway 28L.
Question: What are they requesting?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，NWA 14，宣布紧急情况。我们的1号发动机着火，需要返回机场并在28L跑道着陆。
问题：他们正在请求什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. they want to land on R/W 28 L
choices: they want to land on R/W 28 L
they want to retract the gear

cards.audioText:
The flight crew should always have the seat set to a suitable position so that they can take immediate control of the aircraft.
Question: Why must the seats of the flight crews be set in a proper position?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行机组应始终将座椅调至合适位置，以便能立即操纵飞机。
问：飞行机组的座椅为何必须调至合适位置？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Take immediate control.

cards.audioText:
The major refueling hazard is the possible combustion of the fuel by a spark that causes fumes to ignite. The most probable cause of a spark is static electricity discharged between the refueling equipment and the aircraft.
Question: What may cause a spark when refueling?
cards.audioTextZh:
加油作业的主要危险是燃油可能被点燃。最可能出现的火花来自加油设备与飞机之间释放的静电。
问题：加油时什么可能产生火花？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Static electricity

cards.audioText:
The weather at destination was below minima, the captain made a decision to fly to the alternate airport, which was not far away from the military airport.
Question: Which airport did the captain decide to fly to?
cards.audioTextZh:
目的地天气低于最低标准，机长决定飞往备降机场，该机场离军用机场不远。
问：机长决定飞往哪个机场？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To the alternate airport.

cards.audioText:
The airplane which is well balanced on the initial departure can be seriously imbalanced after one or two stops with passengers and cargo loaded or unloaded shift.
Question: what causes an imbalance?
cards.audioTextZh:
初始离场时平衡良好的飞机，在一两次经停、旅客和货物装卸移位后，可能会严重失衡。
问：什么会导致失衡？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Change of the basic load.

cards.audioText:
Emergency frequency 243.0 is guarded by military aircraft, military towers, most civil towers and radar facilities.
Q: Which of the following does not guard emergency frequency 243.0?
cards.audioTextZh:
紧急频率243.0被军用飞机、军用塔台以及大多数的民用塔台和雷达设备监守。
问：以下哪个不监守紧急频率243.0？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Civil aircraft.

cards.audioText:
To scan other aircraft is very important to avoid mid-air collision, especially flying in VFR.
Question: What is the use to scan the sky for other aircraft, especially while flying under VFR?
cards.audioTextZh:
目视搜索其他航空器对于避免空中相撞非常重要，尤其是在按目视飞行规则（VFR）飞行时。
问题：特别是在按VFR飞行时，目视搜索空中其他航空器有什么作用？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To prevent collisions in the air.
choices: To prevent collisions in the air.
To look for other aircraft clearly.
choicesZh: 清楚地寻找其他航空器

cards.audioText:
P: The rudder pedal pressure is not sufficient in the flight. We suspected that there must be leakage in the hydraulic system. M: We will put auxiliary pump on to sort it out.
Question: What should be done to find the problem in the hydraulic system?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：飞行中方向舵脚蹬压力不足。我们怀疑液压系统一定存在泄漏。机务：我们会接通辅助泵来排查问题。
问题：为查明液压系统的问题，应采取什么措施？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Turn on the auxiliary pump
choices: Turn on the auxiliary gear box

cards.audioText:
There seems to be an error in the flight plan. The departure time is entered in local time instead of UTC.
Question: According to the statement, what mistake has been made?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行计划似乎有一处错误：离场时间填写的是当地时间，而不是协调世界时（UTC）。
问题：根据这段陈述，出现了什么错误？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The departure time was not entered correctly.
choices: The aircraft departed at wrong time.
The departure time should be entered in local time.
The departure time was not entered correctly.
choicesZh: 航空器在错误时间离场
离场时间应填写当地时间

cards.audioText:
Checklists are used to verify that critical (= significant/important) items affecting safety have been completed.
Question: What kind of items will be checked in checklists?
cards.audioTextZh:
检查单只用于核实影响安全的关键项目是否已经完成。
问题：检查单会检查哪类项目？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Significant items

cards.audioText:
Captain: Have you checked the load sheet? First officer: Yes, but I have just found an error in the fuel quantity. Captain: Then you should correct it before you give it back.
Question: What does the captain advise the first officer to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长：你检查过载重表了吗？副驾驶：检查过，但我刚发现燃油量有一处错误。机长：那么，你应该在交回去之前把错误更正。
问题：机长建议副驾驶做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Solve the load sheet problem.
choices: Give it back to the ground personnel.
choicesZh: 把载重表交回地面人员

cards.audioText:
An aircraft should be separated from an aircraft dumping fuel by at least 10 nautical miles horizontally and should not fly behind the aircraft dumping fuel.
Question: What is the separation between the two aircraft during fuel dumping?
cards.audioTextZh:
航空器与正在放油的航空器之间应至少保持10海里的水平间隔，并且不得在放油航空器后方飞行。
问题：放油期间两架航空器之间应保持多大间隔？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 10 nm horizontal

cards.audioText:
When wind direction is changing, it is given as a range, such as variable from 270 to 330 degrees.
Question: How large is the range from 270 to 330 degrees?
cards.audioTextZh:
风向不断变化时，会用一个范围表示，例如在270度至330度之间变化。
问题：270度至330度的变化范围是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 60 degrees

cards.audioText:
The pilot is vacating the runway. His takeoff was aborted due to engine failure, and he tells the controller that he can taxi back under his own power.
Question: What is the pilot's intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员正在脱离跑道。他因发动机故障中断了起飞，并告诉管制员可以依靠自身动力滑行返回。
问题：飞行员的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To taxi back under his own power.
choices: To taxi back under his own power.
choicesZh: 请求空中交通管制指令
依靠自身动力滑行返回

cards.audioText:
Their flight wasn't leaving on time because they were held up at the gate. They couldn't be pushed back until the visibility improved.
Question: What is the probable reason for the delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
他们的航班未能按时离场，因为飞机被滞留在登机口。能见度改善前，飞机无法推出。
问题：延误最可能是什么原因造成的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Thick fog.

cards.audioText:
As you work towards an instrument rating, you learn to control the aircraft precisely, navigate by radio aids, deal with air traffic control, and make instrument approaches.
Question: Which of the following is not mentioned?
cards.audioTextZh:
在接受仪表等级训练时，你会学习精确操纵飞机、使用无线电导航设备导航、与空中交通管制沟通以及实施仪表进近。
问题：下列哪一项没有被提到？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To make visual approaches.
choices: To navigate by the radio aids.
choicesZh: 使用无线电导航设备导航

cards.audioText:
M1: Crew Resource Management is a process using all available resources, such as equipment, procedures, and people, to achieve a safe and efficient flight operation. M2: You are right.
Question: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
说话人1：机组资源管理是利用设备、程序和人员等所有可用资源，实现安全、高效飞行运行的过程。说话人2：你说得对。
问题：他们在谈论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. CRM

cards.audioText:
Ladies and gentlemen, due to favorable weather, we expect to arrive about an hour earlier than scheduled.
Question: When do they expect to arrive?
cards.audioTextZh:
女士们、先生们，由于天气状况有利，我们预计将比计划时间提前大约1小时到达。
问题：他们预计什么时候到达？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. About an hour earlier.

cards.audioText:
The greater the weight of an aircraft, the more wake turbulence it tends to generate, particularly when it affects an aircraft with a shorter wingspan than that of the generating aircraft.
Question: What phenomenon does this statement refer to?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机重量越大，就越容易产生尾流颠簸；当受影响航空器的翼展小于产生尾流的飞机时，这种影响尤其明显。
问题：这段陈述指的是哪一种现象？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Wake turbulence

cards.audioText:
AC215, unknown fast-moving traffic 11 o’clock, 10 miles, crossing left to right.
Q: Where is the unknown traffic?
cards.audioTextZh:
加航215，快速移动的不明航空器位于11点方向，10英里，正从左到右穿越。
问：不明航空器在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 11 o'clock position

cards.audioText:
Clear ice is found between 0 and minus 10 degrees, mixed and clear ice between minus 10 and minus 15 degrees, and rime ice between minus 15 and minus 20 degrees.
Question: What type of ice is usually found between 0 and minus 10 degrees?
cards.audioTextZh:
0至零下10度之间通常形成明冰；零下10至零下15度之间形成混合冰和明冰；零下15至零下20度之间形成雾凇冰。
问题：0至零下10度之间通常会形成哪种冰？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Clear ice.

cards.audioText:
SIA 413 is inbound to Beijing Capital, but there is fog at the airport and the RVR is below the landing limits, so the aircraft has to hold for an improvement in visibility.
Question: Why is SIA 413 holding?
cards.audioTextZh:
SIA 413正飞往北京首都机场，但机场有雾，跑道视程（RVR）低于着陆标准，因此飞机必须等待能见度改善。
问题：SIA 413为什么等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Because the RVR are below limits
choices: Because the ILS is out of service.
Because the aircraft has to dump fuel.
Because the aircraft has to burn off fuel
Because the RVR are below limits
choicesZh: 因为仪表着陆系统停用
因为跑道视程低于标准

cards.audioText:
According to the FAR, the minimum equipment required for flight in a Terminal Control Area is a two-way radio, a transponder, and VOR.
Question: What is the minimum equipment required to operate in a Terminal Control Area?
cards.audioTextZh:
根据美国联邦航空条例，在终端管制区飞行所需的最低设备包括双向无线电、应答机和VOR设备。
问题：在终端管制区运行所需的最低设备是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Two-way radio, transponder and VOR
choicesZh: 两部无线电和甚高频设备

cards.audioText:
The most common altimeter error is also the easiest to correct. It often occurs when you fail to keep the altimeter set to the local altimeter setting.
Question: Which of the following can result in common altimeter errors?
cards.audioTextZh:
最常见的高度表误差也最容易纠正。这种误差通常发生在没有把高度表持续调至当地高度表拨正值时。
问题：下列哪一项会导致常见的高度表误差？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Wrong altimeter setting

cards.audioText:
That flight has a problem. If they can't get the landing gear down, they have to go around.
Question: What will they have to do if they cannot get the landing gear down?
cards.audioTextZh:
那个航班遇到了问题。如果无法放下起落架，他们就必须复飞。
问题：如果无法放下起落架，他们必须怎么做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. follow the missed approach procedure

cards.audioText:
We normally classify runways into non-instrument runways and instrument runways, and these runways can be further classified as precision and non-precision. One of the most important associated areas of a precision runway is the stopway, which is mainly used for rejected takeoff.
Question: According to what you have heard, what is the stopway mainly used for?
cards.audioTextZh:
我们通常把跑道分为非仪表跑道和仪表跑道，还可进一步分为精密和非精密类型。精密跑道最重要的相关区域之一是停止道，主要用于中断起飞。
问题：根据所听内容，停止道主要用于什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Abandoned takeoff

cards.audioText:
P: Approach, good morning, CCA 512, descending through FL200, squawking 4123.
Question: What is the squawk code of CCA 512?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：进近，早上好，CCA 512，正在下降通过FL200，应答机编码4123。
问题：CCA 512的应答机编码是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 4123

cards.audioText:
The aircraft flew over the touchdown zone and landed halfway down the runway. It braked heavily and vacated the runway onto taxiway A4.
Question: Where did the aircraft land?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机飞越接地区后，在跑道中段才接地。随后飞机大力刹车，并脱离跑道进入A4滑行道。
问题：飞机在哪里接地？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Half way down the runway.
choices: At the end of the runway.

cards.audioText:
Leading-edge slats can be deployed during both landing and takeoff. They increase wing camber, area, and mean aerodynamic chord, which increases lift and decreases stall speed.
Question: What is the statement referring to?
cards.audioTextZh:
前缘缝翼可在起飞和着陆期间放出。它们增大机翼弯度、面积和平均气动弦长，从而增加升力并降低失速速度。
问题：这段陈述指的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. High lift devices

cards.audioText:
This is an uncontrolled airfield. Everyone flying in and around the airspace looks out for one another, and information is passed among pilots.
Question: How is information passed in the airspace?
cards.audioTextZh:
这是一个无管制机场。在该空域内及其周边飞行的人员相互观察避让，信息由飞行员彼此传递。
问题：该空域内的信息是怎样传递的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. From pilots to pilots.
choicesZh: 从空中交通管制传给机场
从空中交通管制传给飞行员

cards.audioText:
While you can minimize barometric altimeter errors, you cannot entirely eliminate the common inaccuracies caused by non-standard atmospheric conditions.
Q: Which of the following concerning barometric altimeter errors is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
尽管你可以减低气压高度表的读数错误，但是你却不能完全消除因非标准大气条件引起的常见误差。
问：关于气压高度计错误，以下哪个说法是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Errors cannot be removed completely.

cards.audioText:
The flight was delayed because 3 passengers were late. Then the tug was 10 minutes late, and the aircraft had to wait 15 minutes due to flow control.
Question: How many passengers were late?
cards.audioTextZh:
航班因3名乘客迟到而延误，随后牵引车又晚到10分钟；由于流量控制，飞机还必须等待15分钟。
问题：有多少名乘客迟到？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 3

cards.audioText:
Dublin at 0830: wind 280 degrees at 12 knots, visibility 10 kilometers or more, cloud scattered at 2200 feet, temperature 12, dew point 6, QNH 1002, no significant change.
Question: What is the temperature-dew point spread?
cards.audioTextZh:
都柏林，时间0830；风向280度、风速12节；能见度10公里以上；2200英尺有疏云；温度12度，露点6度；QNH 1002；无显著变化。
问题：温度与露点之差是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 6

cards.audioText:
The aircraft had a problem. All passengers were seated in the last rows, so the crew asked the passengers to change seats.
Question: Why did the crew take this action?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机出现了问题，而且所有乘客都坐在最后几排，因此机组要求乘客调整座位。
问题：机组为什么采取这一措施？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To balance the seating arrangement.

cards.audioText:
In a swept-wing aircraft, the aircraft structural limit with one flap down and the paired flap up is lower.
Question: What type of aircraft is mentioned in the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
对于后掠翼飞机，当一侧襟翼放下而另一侧对应襟翼仍收起时，飞机的结构限制更低。
问题：这段陈述提到的是哪种飞机？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Swept wing aircraft

cards.audioText:
With the help of two cabin crew members, 35 passengers evacuated the aircraft on the right side, including 8 from the right wing.
Question: How many passengers evacuated the aircraft on the right side?
cards.audioTextZh:
在2名客舱乘务员的帮助下，35名乘客从飞机右侧撤离，其中8人经右翼撤离。
问题：有多少名乘客从飞机右侧撤离？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 35

cards.audioText:
The modern radar systems are so sensitive that they can allow the pilots to land completely blind in perfect safety.
Q: Why can the pilot make a completely blind landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
现代化雷达系统已足够精确，可以确保飞行员在安全的条件下完全盲降。
问：为什么飞行员可以实现完全盲降？
choicesZh: 得益于现代化雷达系统。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of modern radar systems.

cards.audioText:
M1: Could you check with Shanghai Center to give us a higher altitude? We need to get out of turbulence. M2: OK, I will contact the controller to see if they can give us FL350.
Question: Why does the flight crew want to change altitude?
cards.audioTextZh:
男1：你能否向上海区调询问，给我们一个更高的高度？我们需要脱离颠簸区。男2：好的，我会联系管制员，看能否给我们FL350。
问题：机组为什么想改变高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To avoid turbulent air.
choices: To start to descend to Shanghai.

cards.audioText:
The airspeed indicator, altimeter and vertical speed indicator all use static pressure, but only the airspeed indicator uses pitot pressure.
Question: Which of the following uses both static and pitot pressure?
cards.audioTextZh:
空速表、高度表和升降速度表都使用静压，但只有空速表还使用皮托管压力。
问题：以下哪种仪表同时使用静压和皮托管压力？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. airspeed indicator

cards.audioText:
In preflight planning, an accurate estimate of time en route must be made to establish fuel requirements for the flight.
Question: Why must accurate en route time be calculated?
cards.audioTextZh:
进行飞行前计划时，必须准确估算航路飞行时间，以确定该航班的燃油需求。
问题：为什么必须准确计算航路飞行时间？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To calculate the fuel quantity.

cards.audioText:
An RJ is cleared to line up and be ready for immediate takeoff following a departing B747, and incoming traffic is on short final. Wind conditions are calm, and the weather is dry and clear.
Question: Why is the departing traffic important to the captain of the RJ?
cards.audioTextZh:
一架支线客机获准进跑道对正，并准备在一架离场B747之后立即起飞；进场航空器正在短五边。当前静风，天气干燥晴朗。
问题：为什么前方离场航空器对这架支线客机的机长很重要？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Wake turbulence.

cards.audioText:
When the pilot hears a resolution advisory (RA), he is only 30 seconds away from collision, so there isn't enough time to advise ATC. The first priority is to take action.
Question: What's the first thing a pilot should do after getting an RA?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员收到决断咨询（RA）时，距离可能相撞只剩约30秒，因此没有足够时间先通知空中交通管制，首要任务是立即采取避让行动。
问题：飞行员收到RA后首先应该做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. follow the advisory
choicesZh: 目视识别另一架航空器
执行空中交通管制指令

cards.audioText:
P: Xi'an Control, CES 2512, TCAS descent completed, 7800m resumed.
Question: What does the pilot mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：西安区调，CES 2512，TCAS下降机动已完成，已恢复7800米。
问题：飞行员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Climbed to 7800 m.
choicesZh: 开始执行机载防撞系统下降机动
完成机载防撞系统爬升

cards.audioText:

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Attitude indicator.

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Weight.

cards.audioTextZh:
地面和停机坪管制员负责滑行道和停机坪上交通的顺畅、有序。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Ramp and taxiways

cards.audioText:
runway incursions do occur in daytime as well as at night, in good, as well as in low visibility conditions.

cards.audioTextZh:
跑道入侵既会在白天发生，也会在夜间发生；既会在能见度良好的情况下发生，也会在能见度低的情况下发生。

cards.audioTextZh:
不正确或不充分的许可，例如塔台与地面管制员之间的协调不当、使用非标准术语、管制员未检测到飞行员复诵错误，都有可能导致灾难。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Poor situational awareness of the pilots

飞行员复诵错误未被发现

cards.audioText:
The analysis of ground incidents reported during the period from 1987 to 2000 reveals a total of 18 fatalities and 149 injuries, of which 55 were serious.

cards.audioTextZh:
对1987年至2000年期间报告的地面事故进行分析后发现，共有18人死亡、149人受伤，其中55人重伤。
问题：1987年至2003年期间的地面事故中有多少人死亡？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 18

cards.audioText:
GCD, one aircraft on runway vacating. Land at your discretion. Surface wind 260, 6 KTS.

cards.audioTextZh:
GCD，有一架飞机正在脱离跑道。可自行决定着陆。地面风向260度，风速6节。

由于风的原因无法着陆

NWA 345号航班，在北交叉点保持飞行高度层60，入航航迹256度，左转，出航时间1分钟。

cards.audioText:

cards.audioTextZh:
为了节省滑行时间，在起落航线进行飞行训练时，飞行员可能会选择进行连续起降（即触地复飞）。也就是说，飞机着陆后继续滑行，不停机就起飞。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To save taxiing time.
choices: To fly in the traffic circuit.

cards.audioText:
Dispatchers can sometimes take a large role in information gathering, flight planning, weight and balance, and fuel loading.

cards.audioTextZh:
调度员有时在信息收集、飞行计划制定、重量和平衡计算以及燃油加载等方面发挥着重要作用。
问题：以下哪一项未被提及为调度员的任务？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Maintenance of the aircraft.

cards.audioText:
According to AIM, the pilot should file an IFR flight plan at least four hours before departure. However, it is common for many professional pilots to file just 45 minutes before departure.
Question: when should the pilot file an IFR flight planned?
cards.audioTextZh:
根据《航空信息手册》（AIM），飞行员应在起飞前至少四小时提交仪表飞行规则（IFR）飞行计划。然而，许多职业飞行员通常会在起飞前45分钟才提交飞行计划。
问题：飞行员应该在什么时候提交仪表飞行规则（IFR）飞行计划？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 4 hours before departure.

cards.audioText:
Proper planning and preparation of a flight sometimes begins days before a flight.
Question: when may the planning and preparation of a flight begin?
cards.audioTextZh:
对一次飞行进行恰当的规划和准备有时在飞行前几天就开始了。
问题：对一次飞行的规划和准备可能在什么时候开始？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Some days before the flight.

cards.audioText:
Computers have made the weather gathering process much easier in recent years.

cards.audioTextZh:
近年来，计算机使得天气信息收集过程变得容易得多。
问题：计算机使得什么变得更容易了？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Information gathering process.

cards.audioText:
Before the takeoff roll is started, the auto brake system of the aircraft, if available, is set to the RTO mode. The auto brake system will automatically apply maximum brakes if the throttle is reduced to idle or reverse thrust during the takeoff roll below V1.
Question: what will the auto brake System be set to before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
当开始起飞滑跑时，如果飞机配备自动刹车系统，应将其设置为中断起飞（RTO）模式。如果在起飞滑跑过程中，速度低于中断起飞速度（V1）时将油门减小至慢车或使用反推，自动刹车系统将自动施加最大刹车力。
问题：起飞前自动刹车系统应设置为什么模式？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Rejected takeoff mode.

cards.audioText:
Ground, DAN 432, ready to go, but the tow bar has broken. Is it OK if we are a few minutes late?
Question: What is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
地面（管制），DAN 432，准备就绪，但牵引杆断了。我们晚几分钟出发可以吗？
问题：出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. DAN 432 has a tow bar problem.
choices: DAN 432 is a few minutes late.
DAN 432 has a tow bar problem.

cards.audioText:
KLM 991, BlueYard approach, we've just received an anonymous call saying there's a bomb on board your aircraft. Come back immediately to BlueYard airport.
Question: what happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
KLM 991航班，蓝场进近管制，我们刚刚接到一个匿名电话，称你的飞机上有一枚炸弹。请立即返回蓝场机场。

航空旅行的快速增长和需求意味着在未来，航空事故将会增加，而不是减少。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Aviation accidents will increase.
choices: Aviation accidents will keep the same.
choicesZh: 航空事故数量将保持不变

Before booking a flight, a lot of people want to know if the airline they are going to fly with is a safe one.

cards.audioTextZh:
在预订航班之前，很多人想知道他们即将搭乘的航空公司是否安全。
问题：人们在预订航班之前想知道什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. If the airplane is a safe one.
choices: If the airplane is going to fly.
If the airplane is a safe one.
If the airplane will be booked.

cards.audioTextZh:
每架飞机都应该有一份书面的绕机检查清单。这份清单应涵盖各项检查、各项设备的修复情况、发动机、飞机的整体状况以及飞行操纵系统的灵活性等方面，还包括对飞机整体状况的大致检查。
问题：绕机检查不包括什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Air-ground sensors.
choicesZh: 飞行操纵系统的灵活性

cards.audioTextZh:
当在设有运行控制塔台的机场运行时，飞行员在滑行进入现用跑道之前必须联系塔台并获得起飞许可。
问题：飞行员在滑行进入跑道之前必须从塔台获得什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Takeoff clearance.

不建议紧跟在另一架飞机，尤其是大型重载飞机的后面立即起飞，因为会产生尾流紊流。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A belly landing.

cards.audioText:
Proper scanning techniques are essential to a safe takeoff and climb, not only for maintaining attitude and direction, but also for collision avoidance in the airport area.
Question: what is essential to a safe takeoff and climb according to the speaker?
cards.audioTextZh:
恰当的扫视技巧对于安全起飞和爬升至关重要，这不仅有助于保持飞行姿态和方向，还有助于在机场区域避免碰撞。
问题：根据讲话者所说，对于安全起飞和爬升来说，什么是至关重要的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Proper scanning techniques.

cards.audioText:

cards.audioTextZh:
一旦飞机达到V1速度（决断速度），并且飞行员已决定继续起飞，他必须摒弃在紧急情况下中止起飞的所有念头。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. When the airplane passes V1.

In aviation, V-speeds or velocity speeds are standard terms used to define airspeeds important or useful to the operation of aircraft. The actual speed for initiating takeoff is known as Vr.

cards.audioTextZh:
在航空领域，V速（即速度值）是用于定义对飞机操作重要或有用的空速的标准术语。用于启动起飞的实际速度被称为Vr。

choices: Speed at which the aircraft's nose wheel leaves the ground.
choicesZh: 飞机前轮离地时的速度

cards.audioText:

cards.audioTextZh:
在任何进近着陆过程中，飞机四边的位置判断是飞行员所做的最重要的判断之一。
问题：在进近着陆过程中，飞行员所做的最重要的判断之一可能是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The placement of the base leg.
choices: The placement of the final leg.
The placement of the base leg.
The judgement of the approach speed.

cards.audioText:

通常情况下，起落架应放下，并且应在到达四边之前完成着陆前检查。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Before reaching the base leg.

cards.audioTextZh:
当一架飞机需要穿越或加入航路时，其申请应提供以下信息：飞机识别信息和机型、位置和航向、飞行高度和飞行条件、穿越位置以及申请的穿越高度、预计的穿越位置。
问题：在申请穿越或加入航路时，哪些信息不需要报告？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Crossing heading.
choices: Crossing level, estimating time for crossing position.
choicesZh: 穿越高度和预计穿越位置的时间

cards.audioText:
The flight recorder records information about the performance of an aircraft in flight, or about conditions encountered in flight. It may record airspeed, outside air temperature, vertical acceleration, engine RPM, manifold pressure, and other pertinent Variables for a given flight.
Question: which of the following data cannot be recorded?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行记录器记录飞机在飞行中的性能信息，或者飞行中遇到的情况信息。它可以记录空速、外界空气温度、垂直加速度、发动机每分钟转数、进气管压力以及给定飞行的其他相关变量。
问题：以下哪种数据是无法记录的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. True airspeed.
choicesZh: 每分钟转数和进气管压力

cards.audioText:
EAL 546, Airbus 300, green system fails due system leakage. I am not sure whether I can extend my landing gear. Request emergency assistance when landing.
Question: Why does the pilot ask for the emergency assistance on landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
EAL 546，空客300，绿色系统因系统泄漏而失效。我不确定能否放下起落架。着陆时请求紧急援助。
问题：为什么飞行员在着陆时请求紧急援助？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There is a system failure.
choices: He believes the landing gear can be extended.
He sees a green light on.
choicesZh: 他认为起落架能够放下

cards.audioText:

KLM 567，请求返回机场，因为在发动机指示和机组告警系统（ECAM）上显示轮舱温度过高。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Undercarriage overheating.

MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, HGB 303，左发动机着火，应急滑梯已放出，请求消防服务和急救。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Localizer and glide path.

cards.audioText:

cards.audioTextZh:
在转向最后进近时，飞机应处于足够高于机场海拔的高度，以便进行足够长距离的最后进近，使飞行员能够准确估计着陆点。
问题：在转向最后进近时，飞机应高于什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Airport elevation.

cards.audioText:

cards.audioText:

Question: What is the objective of a good final approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
一次良好的最后进近的目标是以一定的角度和空速下降，使飞机能够到达预期的接地点。
问题：一次良好的最后进近的目标是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To make the airplane reach a desired touchdown point.
choices: To make the airplane descend with a desired speed.
To make the airplane at a desired angle.
To make the airplane reach a desired touchdown point.
To permit the airplane to descend with desired power setting.
choicesZh: 让飞机以预定速度下降
让飞机到达预定接地点
让飞机以预定功率设置下降

cards.audioText:
The touchdown should be made with engine idling, and the airplane at minimum controllable airspeed.
Question: what airspeed should an airplane have when making a touchdown?
cards.audioTextZh:
着陆时发动机应处于慢车状态，且飞机应处于最低可控空速。
问题：飞机着陆时应处于怎样的空速状态？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Minimum controllable airspeed.

cards.audioText:
Many factors can contribute to a missed approach, such as air traffic control requirements, unexpected appearance of hazards on the runway, wind shear and mechanical failure.
Question: which of the following is not mentioned as the factors contribute into a missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
许多因素会导致复飞，比如空中交通管制要求、跑道上意外出现的危险情况、风切变以及机械故障。
问题：以下哪一项没有被提及为导致复飞的因素？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Wake turbulence.

cards.audioText:
Approaches are classified as either precision or non-precision, depending on the accuracy and capabilities of the navigational aids used.
Question: By what can approaches be classified as precision or non-precision?
cards.audioTextZh:
进近被分为精密进近和非精密进近，分类依据是所使用的导航设备的精度和性能。
问题：进近根据什么被分为精密进近和非精密进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Navigational aids.

cards.audioText:
When the flaps are lowered, the airspeed will decrease unless the power is increased or pitch attitude lowered.
Question: what will the airspeed become when the flaps are lowered?
cards.audioTextZh:
当襟翼放下时，如果不增加动力或降低俯仰姿态，空速将会降低。
问题：当襟翼放下时，空速会怎样变化？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The airspeed will decrease.
choices: The airspeed will be the same.
The airspeed will be below the optimum speed.

cards.audioText:
The landing distance as required by the regulations is that distance needed to land and come to a complete stop from a point 50 feet above the threshold to the end of the runway.
Question: what is the landing distance?
cards.audioTextZh:
法规所要求的着陆距离是指从跑道入口上方50英尺的位置开始直到跑道末端，飞机着陆并完全停下所需要的距离。
问题：什么是着陆距离？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The distance required to land and come to a complete stop from a point 50 feet above the threshold to the end of the runway.
choices: The distance required to land and come to a complete stop from a point 50 feet above the threshold to the end of the runway.
The length of the runway from 50 feet above the threshold to the end.
The distance required to land and come to a complete stop from 50 feet above touchdown point.
The length of the runway to land and come to a complete stop for an airplane.
choicesZh: 从跑道入口上方50英尺处开始，着陆并完全停住所需的距离
从跑道入口上方50英尺处至跑道末端的跑道长度
从接地点上方50英尺处开始，着陆并完全停住所需的距离
飞机着陆并完全停住所需的跑道长度

cards.audioText:
A standard holding pattern uses right hand turns, and takes approximately four minutes to complete.
Question: how much time does it take to complete a standard holding pattern?
cards.audioTextZh:
标准等待航线采用右转弯，大约需要四分钟来完成。
问题：完成一个标准等待航线需要多长时间？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 4 minutes.

cards.audioText:
Unstable atmospheric conditions such as extreme turbulence, severe wind gusts, sudden loss gain of airspeed as much as 40 to 50 knots, thunderstorms with extremely heavy rains, hail, icing and lightning may Exist at any altitude.
Question: which of the following is not mentioned in the passage?
cards.audioTextZh:
不稳定的大气状况，比如极度颠簸、强阵风、空速突然增减达40到50节、伴有特大暴雨的雷暴、冰雹、结冰以及闪电，可能在任何高度出现。
问题：以下哪项在文中未被提及？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Wake turbulence at takeoff and landing phase.
choices: Sudden airspeed changes between 40 and 50 knots.
Thunderstorms exist at low and high altitude.
Wake turbulence at takeoff and landing phase.
choicesZh: 起飞和着陆阶段的尾流颠簸

cards.audioText:
Heavy aircraft are not to be given clearance or instructions that would require the use of more than normal power for taxiing or for entry onto the runway. Heavy aircraft, when at the holding point, are not to be cleared for an immediate takeoff.
Question: which category of aircraft can be cleared to take off immediately?
cards.audioTextZh:
重型飞机不应被给予需要使用超过正常功率进行滑行或进入跑道的许可或指令。重型飞机在等待点时，不应被给予立即起飞的许可。
问题：哪类飞机可以被给予立即起飞的许可？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Medium and small.

cards.audioText:
All stations, Hong Kong Approach, cancel distress, resume own navigation.
Q: What does this message mean to the pilots?
cards.audioTextZh:
全体注意，香港进近，取消遇险信号，恢复自主领航。
问：这条消息对飞行员来说是什么意思？
choices: Distress information is on the air
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Resume normal communication

cards.audioText:
The primary use of a holding pattern is delaying aircraft that have arrived at their destination, but cannot land yet, because of traffic congestion, poor weather, or runway unavailability.
Question: which of the following is not mentioned as the reason for making a holding pattern?
cards.audioTextZh:
等待航线的主要作用是让已经抵达目的地但由于交通拥堵、恶劣天气或跑道不可用而还不能降落的飞机进行延误等待。
问题：以下哪一项没有被提及为采用等待航线的原因？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Speed limit.

cards.audioText:
In a controlled field, the ATC may instruct the pilot to go around, if there is an aircraft, vehicle or object on the runway or some other unsafe condition, such as a poor weather condition.
Question: which of the following is not mentioned as the reason to carry out a go around?
cards.audioTextZh:
在受管制的机场，如果跑道上有飞机、车辆或物体，或者存在其他不安全状况，比如恶劣的天气状况，空中交通管制（ATC）可能会指示飞行员复飞。
问题：以下哪一项没有被提及为进行复飞的原因？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. No landing clearance.
choices: Vehicle has not cleared the runway.

cards.audioText:
Since a go around may cause passengers to become anxious, if a second go around is performed, many airline policies advise pilots at that point to divert to another airport rather than attempt landing a third time.
Question: What do airline policies suggest to do after a second go around is performed?
cards.audioTextZh:
由于复飞可能会导致乘客感到焦虑，因此如果进行了第二次复飞，许多航空公司的政策建议飞行员此时改航至另一个机场，而不是尝试第三次降落。
问题：在进行了第二次复飞后，航空公司的政策建议怎么做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Divert to another airport to land.
choices: Divert to another airport to land.

cards.audioText:
In a teardrop entry, the aircraft flies to the holding fix, turns into the protected area, flies for one minute, and then turns back inbound, proceeds to the fix, and continues from there.
Question: how long would the aircraft fly into the protected area in a teardrop entry?
cards.audioTextZh:
在偏置进入等待航线时，飞机飞到等待定位点，转向进入保护区，飞行一分钟，然后转向朝内飞行，前往定位点，并从那里继续飞行。
问题：在偏置进入等待航线时，飞机飞入保护区会飞行多长时间？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 1 minutes.

cards.audioText:
To maintain good control, the approach and turbulence air with gusty crosswind may require the use of partial flaps.
Question: what may be required to use for an approach and turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh:
为了保持良好的操控性，在进近过程中遇到伴有阵风的侧风以及紊流时，可能需要使用部分襟翼。
问题：在进近过程中遇到紊流时可能需要使用什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Partial flaps.

cards.audioText:
The meteorological department always provides the flight crew with the latest weather information such as clear air turbulence, icing and volcanic ash to ensure safety.
Q: Which weather condition is not mentioned in the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
气象部门总是为飞行员提供最新的天气信息以确保安全，如晴空乱流、积冰和火山灰。
问：上述叙述中未提到哪种天气状况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Hailstorm

cards.audioText:
You have a traffic, 10:00, 6 miles, heading 150, Boeing 747, 2000 feet above.
Question: What is the position of intruding aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
你前方有飞行冲突，在10点钟方向，距离6英里，航向150，机型波音747，在你上方2000英尺处。
问题：入侵飞机的位置在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 10 o'clock 6 miles heading 150 two thousand feet above.
choices: 1 o'clock 10 miles heading 150 two thousand feet above.
10 o'clock 6 miles heading 150 two thousand feet above.
10 o'clock 15 miles heading 60 one thousand feet above.
6 o'clock 15 miles heading 150 one thousand feet above.
choicesZh: 1点钟方向、10海里、航向150、上方2000英尺
10点钟方向、6海里、航向150、上方2000英尺
10点钟方向、15海里、航向60、上方1000英尺
6点钟方向、15海里、航向150、上方1000英尺

cards.audioText:
One airport may have several holding patterns, depending on where aircraft arrive from, or which runway is in use, or because of vertical airspace limitations.
Question: which of the following is not mentioned as a factor to determine a holding pattern?
cards.audioTextZh:
一个机场可能有几种等待航线，这取决于飞机来自哪里，或者正在使用哪条跑道，又或者是因为垂直空域的限制。
问题：以下哪一项没有被提及为确定等待航线的因素？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Aircraft speed.

cards.audioText:
Aircraft flying in holding pattern is an inefficient and costly usage of time and fuel, so measures are taken to limit the amount of holding necessary.
Question: what measure should be taken to limit the amount of holding?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机处于等待航线是对时间和燃油的低效且高成本的使用，所以需要采取措施来限制必要的等待时间。
问题：应该采取什么措施来限制等待时间呢？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because flying in holding pattern is an insufficient usage of time and fuel.
choices: Because flying in the holding pattern is unsafe.
Because flying in holding pattern is a waste of time.
Because flying in holding pattern is an insufficient usage of time and fuel.
Because flying in holding pattern is an efficient usage of time and fuel.
choicesZh: 因为在等待航线飞行不安全
因为在等待航线飞行浪费时间
因为在等待航线飞行不能有效利用时间和燃油
因为在等待航线飞行能有效利用时间和燃油

cards.audioText:
A forced landing is the situation when the aircraft is forced to make a landing due to technical problems, medical problems or weather conditions. Landing as soon as possible is a priority, no matter where.
Question: which of the following is not mentioned as a reason to make a forced landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
迫降是指由于技术问题、医疗问题或天气状况，飞机被迫进行降落的情况。无论在哪里，尽快降落是首要任务。
问题：以下哪一项没有被提及为进行迫降的原因？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Terrorist attack.

cards.audioText:
CSN 3041, we've just been caught in severe turbulence. About fifteen passengers have been hurt.
Question: what happened to CSN 3041?
cards.audioTextZh:
CSN 3041，我们刚刚遭遇了严重的乱流。大约15名乘客受伤了。
问题：CSN 3041发生了什么事？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. they have experienced severe turbulence
choices: they have run into moderate turbulence.
they have been caught in severe icing.

cards.audioText:
KLM 341, continue approach. Previous aircraft report windshear in the last 300 feet of the final approach.
Question: what is reported by previous aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
KLM 341，继续进近。前机报告在最后进近的最后300英尺处有风切变。
问题：前机报告了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Windshear in the final approach
choices: Windshield cracked in the final approach
severe icing in the final approach
severe turbulence in the final approach
choicesZh: 最后进近时挡风玻璃破裂
最后进近时出现风切变
最后进近时出现严重结冰
最后进近时出现严重颠簸

cards.audioText:
NWA 552, we have undercarriage trouble. We'd like to go around.
Question: what problem does the crew have?
cards.audioTextZh:
NWA 552，我们起落架有故障。我们要复飞。
问题：机组人员遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. landing gear problem

cards.audioText:
CSN 302, Hong Kong delivery, clear to Bekol course, FL160, cross Bekol course, FL130 or above.
Question: which statement is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
CSN 302，香港放行，许可沿反航道飞行，飞行高度层160，穿越反航道时，飞行高度层需达到130或以上。
问题：以下哪个陈述是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. CSN 302 should cross Bekol at FL130 or above
choices: CSN 302 should cross Bekol below FL130
CSN 302 should cross Bekol at FL130 or below
CSN 302 should cross Bekol at FL130 or above
CSN 302 should cross Bekol at below FL160

cards.audioText:
NWA 281, we have an electrical failure. We intend to return to the airport, but we have to down 40 tons of fuel first.
Question: what is the crew intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
NWA 281，我们遭遇了电气故障。我们打算返回机场，但我们得先排放40吨燃油。
问题：机组的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. dump fuel and return to the airport.
choices: dump fuel and return to the airport.

cards.audioText:
JAL 651, we have had a flat tire on the nose gear. Engines are shut down, and request a tug.
Question: which of the following statements is not true?
cards.audioTextZh:
JAL 651，我们前起落架爆胎了。发动机已关闭，请求一辆拖车。
问题：以下哪个陈述是不正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The aircraft skids off the taxiway.
choices: There is a flat tyre on the nose gear.
The crew cannot taxi the aircraft with its own power.
The aircraft skids off the taxiway.
choicesZh: 机组无法依靠自身动力滑行

cards.audioText:
JAL 781, stop descent immediately. I say again, stop descent immediately. Unknown traffic approaching you from below.
Question: Why is JAL 781 instructed to stop descent?
cards.audioTextZh:
JAL 781，立刻停止下降。我再说一遍，立刻停止下降。有不明航空器从下方朝你飞来。
问题：为什么JAL 781被指示停止下降？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due conflicting traffic.

cards.audioText:
CCA 982, hold at PM at 6000 meters, expect further clearance at 16. Landing delays at Beijing 20 minutes.
Question: Why is CCA 982 instructed to hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
CCA 982，在PM保持6000米高度等待，预计16点（获得）进一步的许可。在北京降落将延误20分钟。
问题：为什么CCA 982被指示进行等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Due landing delay.

cards.audioText:
Wuhan Control, this is CCA 4106. Our fuel endurance is only 50 minutes. We'd like to refuel at Wuhan.
Question: What does a crew intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
武汉管制，这里是CCA 4106。我们的燃油续航时间仅剩50分钟。我们想在武汉加油。
问题：机组人员打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To land at Wuhan for refuelling.
choices: To divert to Wuhan for refuelling.
To land at Wuhan for refuelling.

cards.audioText:
Wuhan Control, CSN 3108. It looks like our windshields iced over. Does the met confirm severe icing in the area?
Question: what does a pilot mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
武汉管制，这里是CSN 3108。我们的挡风玻璃好像结冰了。气象部门确认该区域有严重结冰情况吗？
问题：飞行员（说这话）是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They were not informed of icing condition.
choices: They were not informed of icing condition.
choicesZh: 他们没有收到结冰情况通知

cards.audioText:
Control, CCA 4106 encountered severe turbulence. Two passengers severely injured, request divert to Wuhan.
Question: what did CCA 4106 encounter?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制，CCA 4106遭遇严重乱流。两名乘客重伤，请求备降武汉。
问题：CCA 4106遇到了什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Severe turbulence.

cards.audioText:
MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan approach, NWA 808, smoke in the cockpit, request vector to Wuhan for landing.
Question: why did the crew declare MAYDAY?
cards.audioTextZh:
MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, 武汉进近，NWA 808，驾驶舱内冒烟，请求引导飞往武汉降落。
问题：机组为什么发出遇险呼叫（“MAYDAY”）？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Smoke in the cockpit.
choicesZh: 驾驶舱内发生非法干扰

cards.audioText:
ACA 503, Wuhan approach, continue TCAS descent, and maintain 2400 meters. It may be an airship that caused your TCAS RA.
Question: what can we learn from the controller's transmission?
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 503，武汉进近，继续按照空中交通防撞系统（TCAS）指示下降，保持高度2400米。可能是有一架飞艇导致了你的空中交通防撞系统（TCAS）发出相关指令（告警）。
问题：从管制员的通话中我们能了解到什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. ACA is TCAS descending.
choicesZh: ACA正在执行机载防撞系统爬升
ACA正在执行机载防撞系统下降
机载防撞系统交通咨询正在响起

cards.audioText:
All stations, Windshear warning. Arriving Boeing 737 reported moderate windshear on approach Runway 36R at 2120. Height of windshear layer 120 meters.
Question: who reported windshear?
cards.audioTextZh:
全体注意，风切变警告。进近的波音737报告，在当地时间21点20分，36右跑道进近时遭遇中度风切变。风切变层高度为120米。
问题：谁报告了风切变情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The arriving B737.

cards.audioText:
CES 5321, go around immediately. Continue present heading, climb and maintain 550 meters. A 340 disabled on runway with tire failure.
Question: why does the controller instruct the pilot to pull up immediately?
cards.audioTextZh:
CES 5321，立即复飞。继续保持当前航向，上升并保持高度550米。有一架空客340因轮胎故障停在跑道上。
问题：管制员为什么指示飞行员立即拉起（复飞）？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The preceding aircraft is unable the runway.
choices: The preceding aircraft is unable the runway.
The runway is covered with debris.
The severe thunderstorm is approaching thr runway.

cards.audioText:
Wuhan Approach, SAS 996, we are having difficulties retracting the landing gear due to hydraulic failure after takeoff. Request coming back and checking.
Question: what's the crew's intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
武汉进近，SAS 996，我们在起飞后由于液压系统故障，起落架无法收起，请求返航并进行检查。
问题：机组的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To turn around for checking.
choices: To join the holding pattern for checking.
choicesZh: 加入等待航线进行检查

cards.audioText:
BOV 361, wind shear alert. Previous 757 reported severe wind shear, gained 25 knots between 800 and 400 feet, followed by loss of 30 knots between 600 and 200 feet.
Question: what is the height range of speed increase?
cards.audioTextZh:
BOV 361，风切变警报。前序757航班报告遭遇严重风切变，在800英尺至400英尺高度间空速增加25节，随后在600英尺至200英尺高度间空速损失30节。
问题：空速增加的高度范围是多少？

cards.audioText:
CSN 3347, descend to circuit altitude six hundred meters on QNH one zero zero niner, join right hand downwind runway two seven. You are number two in traffic.
Question: What will China Southern tree tree four seven do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
CSN 3347，下降至本场高度600米（修正海压1009），加入右三边跑道27。你第二个落地
问题：CSN 3347接下来将执行什么操作？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Join the traffic circuit.

cards.audioText:
PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, KAL 9082, I have a passenger with serious asthma on board, and he is having difficulty breathing, and is in a very critical condition.
Question: what happened on board?
cards.audioTextZh:
PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN武汉管制，KAL 9082，机上有一名严重哮喘乘客，目前呼吸困难，情况危急。
问题：机上发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. One passenger had trouble in breathing.
choices: One passenger had a heart attack.
One passenger had trouble in breathing.
One passenger was about to give birth.

cards.audioText:
Accurate navigation is crucial in air traffic control as it ensures that aircraft are separated by a safe distance. This helps prevent mid-air collisions and allows for a smooth and safe flow of air traffic.
Question: What is the importance of accurate navigation in air traffic control?
cards.audioTextZh:
准确的导航在空中交通管制中至关重要，因为它能确保飞机之间保持安全距离。这有助于防止空中相撞，并保障空中交通顺畅、安全地运行。
问：空中交通管制中，准确导航的重要性是什么？
choices: It ensures that aircraft are separated by a safe distance.
It makes the airport terminals look more organized.
It helps in selling more tickets.
It has no real importance in air traffic control.
choicesZh: 它确保飞机之间保持安全距离。
它使机场航站楼看起来更加井然有序。
它有助于销售更多机票。
它在空中交通管制中没有实际重要性。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. It ensures that aircraft are separated by a safe distance.

cards.audioText:
A common cause of oxygen system malfunction is a leak in the oxygen tubing or fittings. Even a small leak can lead to a loss of oxygen pressure and an insufficient supply when needed.
Question: What is a common cause of oxygen system malfunction?
cards.audioTextZh:
氧气系统故障的一个常见原因是氧气管路或接头处泄漏。即使是微小泄漏也可能导致氧气压力下降，并在需要时供氧不足。
问：氧气系统故障的常见原因是什么？
choices: A leak in the oxygen tubing or fittings.
choicesZh: 氧气管路或接头处泄漏
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. A leak in the oxygen tubing or fittings.

cards.audioText:
The flight management and guidance system provides predictions of flight time, mileage, speed, economy profiles and altitude.
Question: Which of the following is not mentioned?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行管理和引导系统提供飞行时间、里程、速度、经济剖面和高度的预测。
问：以下哪项未被提及？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Aircraft attitude.

cards.audioText:
Factors that determine the maximum takeoff weight for an airplane include runway length, wind, flap position, runway braking action, pressure altitude and temperature.
Question: According to the statement, what factor is not mentioned?
cards.audioTextZh:
决定飞机最大起飞重量的因素包括跑道长度、风、襟翼位置、跑道刹车效应、气压高度和温度。
问：根据该陈述，哪个因素未被提及？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Runway slope.

cards.audioText:
If an aircraft is being hijacked or illegally interfered with, the pilot can alert ATC about that fact by setting the transponder to code 7500.
Question: When can pilots set transponder code to code 7500?
cards.audioTextZh:
如果飞机遭到劫持或非法干扰，飞行员可通过将应答机设置为7500编码来向空中交通管制（ATC）通报该情况。
问：飞行员何时可以将应答机编码设为7500？
choices: A distress or urgency situation exists.
The aircraft has experienced radio failure.
The pilot wants to make a rapid descent.
choicesZh: 存在遇险或紧急情况时
飞机遇到无线电失效时
飞行员想要快速下降时
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Someone hijacks the aircraft.

cards.audioText:
Flight 630 rejected takeoff at low speed due to a rabbit on the runway but could not avoid hitting the rabbit with the nose gear. The aircraft returned to the apron.
Question: Why did Flight 630 reject takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
630航班因跑道上有兔子而在低速时中断起飞，但未能避免前起落架撞到兔子。飞机返回了停机坪。
问：630航班为何中断起飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Rabbit on the runway.

cards.audioText:
On March 30, 2022, Flight 205 went around due to unsafe left main gear indication, then the aircraft positioned for a low approach to runway 13R after go around.
Question: Why did Flight 205 go around?
cards.audioTextZh:
2022年3月30日，205航班因左主起落架指示不安全而复飞，随后飞机在复飞后调整位置，对13R跑道进行低空通场。
问：205航班为何复飞？
choices: Due to unsafe landing gear indication.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Due to unsafe landing gear indication.

cards.audioText:
Controlled Flight into Terrain occurs when an airworthy aircraft under the complete control of the pilot is inadvertently flown into terrain, water, or an obstacle.
Question: What is the speaker talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
当一架适航的飞机在飞行员的完全控制下，无意中飞入地形、水面或障碍物时，即发生可控飞行撞地。
问：说话者在谈论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. CFIT

cards.audioText:
M1: According to the current law, those who take dangerous goods onto the airplane have to be held 5 to 15 days.
M2: That's serious.
Question: How long will the person be held with forbidden goods?
cards.audioTextZh:
M1: 根据现行法律，将危险品带上飞机的人必须被拘留5至15天。
M2: 这很严重。
问题：携带违禁品的人会被拘留多长时间？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. at least 5 days

cards.audioText:
The aircraft should be separated from the aircraft dumping fuel by at least 10 nm horizontal but not behind the aircraft dumping fuel.
Q: What is the separation between two aircraft while fuel dumping?
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机需要与另一架正在放油的飞机保持至少10海里的水平间隔，但不能处于放油飞机之后。问：在放油过程中，两架飞机的间隔是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 10 nm horizontal.

cards.audioText:
The greater weight of the aircraft, the more it tends to generate turbulence, particularly when it will affect aircraft has shorter wingspan than that of general aircraft.
Question: What phenomena does this statement refer to?
cards.audioTextZh:
航空器重量越大，越容易产生湍流；当受影响航空器的翼展短于一般航空器时，影响尤为明显。
问题：这段陈述指的是什么现象？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Wake turbulence

cards.audioText:
In the swept wing aircraft, the aircraft strength limit of flaps down for paired flaps up is lower.
Question: What type of aircraft is mentioned in the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
对于后掠翼航空器，一侧襟翼放下、配对襟翼收起时，航空器的结构强度限制较低。
问题：这段陈述提到了哪种航空器？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Swept wing aircraft

cards.audioText:
On February 1, 2025, when ACA 8901 was on final approach to Chicago's Runway 09L, the crew received aft lavatory fire alarm, declared PANPAN and continued for a safe landing.
Question: Why did ACA8901declare urgency?
cards.audioTextZh:
2025年2月1日，ACA 8901在芝加哥Runway 09L最后进近时，机组收到后部洗手间火警，宣布PANPAN，并继续安全着陆。
问题：ACA 8901为什么宣布紧急状态？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due rear toilet fire warning.

cards.audioText:
The pilot reported encountering strong crosswinds during the final approach. The aircraft deviated from the centerline, and they decided to execute a missed approach.
Question: What was the main reason for the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员报告在最后进近期间遭遇强侧风。航空器偏离中线，因此机组决定实施复飞。
问题：复飞的主要原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Strong crosswinds causing deviation from the centerline
choices: Strong crosswinds causing deviation from the centerline

cards.audioText:
The air traffic controller noticed that another aircraft entered the runway without clearance just as the first aircraft was on short final. The controller immediately instructed the landing aircraft to go around.
Question: Why was the missed approach initiated?
cards.audioTextZh:
第一架航空器正在短五边时，空中交通管制员注意到另一架航空器未经许可进入跑道。管制员立即指示着陆航空器复飞。
问题：为什么实施复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. An unauthorized aircraft on the runway.
choices: The landing gear wasn't fully extended.
An unauthorized aircraft on the runway.
choicesZh: 有航空器未经许可进入跑道

cards.audioText:
During the approach, the glide slope indicator suddenly became unreliable. The pilots couldn't determine the correct descent rate and opted for a missed approach.
Question: What caused the pilots to execute a missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
进近期间，下滑道指示突然变得不可靠。飞行员无法确定正确的下降率，因此选择复飞。
问题：什么原因导致飞行员实施复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Unreliable glide slope indicator
choices: Loss of communication with the tower
A bird strike on the windshield

cards.audioText:
The aircraft was approaching the runway, but the runway was still occupied by a slow-moving vehicle that hadn't cleared in time. The tower instructed the aircraft to perform a missed approach.
Question: What is the reason for missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
航空器正在接近跑道，但一辆缓慢行驶的车辆仍占用跑道，未能及时脱离。塔台指示航空器复飞。
问题：复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The runway was occupied by a vehicle.
choices: The runway was occupied by a vehicle.
There was icing on the wings.

cards.audioText:
The pilots received a TCAS (Traffic Collision Avoidance System) resolution advisory to climb immediately due to an approaching aircraft at an unsafe distance. They initiated a missed approach as a result.
Question: What prompted the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
由于另一架航空器正在以不安全的距离接近，飞行员收到TCAS（空中防撞系统）立即爬升的决断咨询。因此，他们实施了复飞。
问题：什么原因促使航空器复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. TCAS advisory to climb due to traffic
choices: TCAS advisory to climb due to traffic
A problem with the landing brakes
choicesZh: 因冲突航空器收到机载防撞系统爬升咨询

cards.audioText:
The weather conditions deteriorated rapidly near the runway. The visibility dropped below the minimum required for landing, so the crew executed a missed approach.
Question: Why did the aircraft go around?
cards.audioTextZh:
跑道附近的天气状况迅速恶化。能见度降至着陆所需最低标准以下，因此机组实施了复飞。
问题：航空器为什么复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The visibility fell below landing limits.
choices: The visibility fell below landing limits.
choicesZh: 能见度降至着陆最低标准以下

cards.audioText:
On final approach, the pilots realized they had misconfigured the flaps and spoilers, which would have affected the landing performance. They chose to perform a missed approach to correct the settings.
Question: What led to the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
最后进近时，飞行员意识到襟翼和扰流板构型设置错误，这会影响着陆性能。他们选择复飞以纠正设置。
问题：什么原因导致复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Incorrect flap and spoiler configuration
choices: A flat tire on landing gear
choicesZh: 襟翼和扰流板构型错误

cards.audioText:
The aircraft was too high on the glide path during the approach. Despite attempts to correct, they couldn't get it right and had to execute a missed approach to avoid a hard landing.
Question: What was the cause of the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
进近期间，航空器在下滑道上偏高。尽管尝试修正，飞行员仍无法使其恢复正确状态，只得实施复飞以避免重着陆。
问题：复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The aircraft was too high on the glide path.
choices: The aircraft was too high on the glide path.
The throttle got stuck at full power.
The cabin crew reported a security issue.
choicesZh: 航空器在下滑道上偏高
挡风玻璃雨刷停止工作
客舱机组报告安保问题

cards.audioText:
A flock of birds was seen in the approach path, and the pilots feared a potential bird strike. They decided to go around.
Question: What made the pilots execute a missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
进近航路上出现了一群鸟，飞行员担心可能发生鸟击，因此决定复飞。
问题：什么原因使飞行员实施复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Fear of bird strike due to a flock of birds in the approach path
choices: Fear of bird strike due to a flock of birds in the approach path
The autopilot was not responding to commands.
The fuel gauge showed an incorrect reading.
The airport's radar system was down.
choicesZh: 进近航路有鸟群，担心发生鸟击

cards.audioText:
The pilots lost visual reference with the runway due to sudden fog formation just before touchdown. They initiated a missed approach.
Question: Why was a missed approach necessary?
cards.audioTextZh:
就在接地前，突然形成的雾使飞行员失去了跑道目视参考。他们随即实施了复飞。
问题：为什么必须复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Sudden fog caused loss of visual reference to the runway.
choices: Sudden fog caused loss of visual reference to the runway.
The landing gear warning light came on.
The electrical system had a power surge.
choicesZh: 突发浓雾导致失去跑道目视参考

cards.audioText:
At many airports, the large aircraft are generally parked nose-in to the terminal in order to save parking space.
Question: How are the aircraft parked?
cards.audioTextZh:
在许多机场，大型航空器通常机头朝向航站楼停放，以节省停机空间。
问题：航空器以什么朝向停放？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Facing the terminal.

cards.audioText:
A: Mr. Li. Do you know if there is a word that pilot will use when he wishes to change the course or the destination while he is flying?
B: Yes there is.
Question: What is word that a pilot will use?
cards.audioTextZh:
A: 李先生，你知道飞行员在飞行中希望改变航线或目的地时会使用哪个词吗？
B: 是的，有这样一个词。
问题：飞行员会使用哪个词？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Divert.

cards.audioText:
A: In order to save taxiing time in the traffic circuit flight training, pilot may land the aircraft, continue rolling and take off without stopping.
B: This flight training is often done in the small airport.
Question: What is the flight training?
cards.audioTextZh:
A: 为了在起落航线飞行训练中节省滑行时间，飞行员可以使航空器着陆后继续滑跑，并在不停车的情况下再次起飞。
B: 这种飞行训练经常在小型机场进行。
问题：这是什么飞行训练？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Touch and go.

cards.audioText:
A: Mr Wang, this new equipment will record any transmissions from the cockpit
B: Yes. It also records cockpit area conversations. All inputs are recorded on a 30-minute continuous-loop tape
Question: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
A: 王先生，这套新设备会记录驾驶舱发出的任何通话。
B: 是的，它还会记录驾驶舱区域内的谈话。所有输入内容都记录在一盘30分钟连续循环磁带上。
问题：他们正在谈论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Cockpit voice recorder.

cards.audioText:
Ice formation slightly changes the shape of the wings and propellers. By doing this, it increases drag and weight and decreases thrust and lift.
Question: How does ice formation affect an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
结冰会轻微改变机翼和螺旋桨的形状，从而增加阻力和重量，并降低推力和升力。
问题：结冰会如何影响航空器？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Increase drag and reduce lift

cards.audioText:
Thunderstorms usually contain many severe weather hazards such as lightning, hail, turbulence, gusty surface winds and even tornadoes.
Question: What hazard cannot be found with the thunderstorm?
cards.audioTextZh:
雷暴通常包含多种严重天气危险，例如闪电、冰雹、湍流、阵性地面风，甚至龙卷风。
问题：哪种危险不会伴随雷暴出现？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Wake turbulence

cards.audioText:
Captain: Hi, I cannot adjust my seat to the right position.
M: Let me have a check. Oh, its control lever is too tight.
Question: What was wrong with the seat?
cards.audioTextZh:
Captain: 你好，我无法将座椅调到正确位置。
M: 让我检查一下。哦，它的操纵杆太紧了。
问题：座椅出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Its control lever was too tight.
choices: Its seat lock pins did not fit.
Its control lever was too tight.

cards.audioText:
During walk-around inspection, the captain found there was oil leakage on the actuator of left elevator and the company mechanic was called in to check it.
Question: Why was the company mechanic called in?
cards.audioTextZh:
绕机检查期间，机长发现左升降舵作动筒漏油，因此叫来了航空公司的机务人员进行检查。
问题：为什么叫来航空公司的机务人员？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Oil leakage on the actuator of left elevator.
choices: Fuel leakage on the starboard engine.
Oil leakage in the landing gear bay.
Oil leakage on the actuator of left elevator.
Fuel leakage on the starboard wing.

cards.audioText:
A: What should we pay more attention to when taxiing in low visibility?
B: Of vital importance is the need for pilots to notify the controller when difficulties are encountered or at the first indication of becoming disoriented.
Question: When should the pilot turn to the controller?
cards.audioTextZh:
A: 在低能见度条件下滑行时，我们应当更加注意什么？
B: 至关重要的是，飞行员在遇到困难或刚出现迷失方向的迹象时，应立即通知管制员。
问题：飞行员应在什么时候向管制员求助？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. When finding lost

cards.audioText:
When a go-around is executed, the first step is to apply takeoff power and begin a climb to ensure safe altitude is regained before any further actions like retraction of landing gear or flaps are performed.
Question: what is the first action required according to standard operating procedures?
cards.audioTextZh:
实施复飞时，第一步是使用起飞功率并开始爬升，确保恢复到安全高度后，再进行收起落架或襟翼等后续操作。
问题：根据标准操作程序，首先需要采取什么行动？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Apply takeoff power and initiate a climb.
choices: Apply takeoff power and initiate a climb.
Contact ground control for taxi instructions.
choicesZh: 使用起飞功率并开始爬升
联系地面管制获取滑行指令

cards.audioText:
A crosswind exceeding acceptable limits during landing can compromise the aircraft's stability and safety, making a go-around necessary to avoid a potential accident.
Question: Which of the following conditions would most likely require a pilot to perform a go-around?
cards.audioTextZh:
着陆期间，侧风超过可接受限制会危及航空器的稳定性和安全，因此有必要复飞以避免潜在事故。
问题：以下哪种情况最可能要求飞行员实施复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Crosswind above 20 knots during landing.

cards.audioText:
Flaps should be gradually retracted, not set to maximum during a go-around. Full flaps may increase drag and reduce climb performance.
Question: Which of the following is NOT a correct step during a go-around?
cards.audioTextZh:
复飞期间应逐渐收起襟翼，而不是将襟翼设到最大位置。全襟翼可能增加阻力并降低爬升性能。
问题：以下哪一项不是复飞期间的正确操作步骤？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Set flaps to the maximum setting.
choices: Set flaps to the maximum setting.
Climb at the appropriate angle to clear obstacles.
choicesZh: 以适当角度爬升越过障碍物

cards.audioText:
The standard phrase used to indicate a go-around is 'going around', which alerts air traffic control and other nearby aircraft of the decision.
Question: In aviation terminology, which radio call sign indicates a pilot initiating a go-around?
cards.audioTextZh:
表示复飞的标准用语是“going around”，用于向空中交通管制和附近其他航空器通报这一决定。
问题：在航空术语中，飞行员开始复飞时使用哪个无线电通话用语？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Going around.

cards.audioText:
A low and unstable approach necessitates a go-around to ensure the aircraft reaches a safe and controlled state for a subsequent landing.
Question: How should a pilot respond if the aircraft is too low on final approach and not in a stable position to land?
cards.audioTextZh:
低且不稳定的进近需要实施复飞，以确保航空器恢复到安全、可控的状态，再进行后续着陆。
问题：如果航空器在最后进近时高度过低且未处于稳定着陆状态，飞行员应当如何处置？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Initiate a go-around to regain altitude and stability.
choices: Continue the descent and attempt to adjust speed.
Land anyway and correct the situation on the runway.
Initiate a go-around to regain altitude and stability.
Reduce engine power to conserve fuel.
choicesZh: 继续下降并尝试调整速度
仍然着陆并在跑道上修正
实施复飞以恢复高度和稳定状态
减小发动机功率以节省燃油

cards.audioText:
A runway not vacated poses a serious safety hazard, making a go-around the safest option to avoid a potential collision.
Question: According to the statement, Which of the following is the reason to perform a go-around?
cards.audioTextZh:
跑道尚未腾空会构成严重安全危险，因此复飞是避免潜在碰撞的最安全选择。
问题：根据这段陈述，以下哪一项是实施复飞的原因？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. An aircraft has not vacated the runway.
choices: An aircraft has not vacated the runway.
The pilot prefers to save fuel.
The passenger wants to delay landing.
choicesZh: 有航空器尚未脱离跑道

cards.audioText:
A climb gradient between 5% to 7% is typically sufficient to clear obstacles and re-establish a stable climb after a go-around.
Question: What is the typical climb gradient expected during a go-around?
cards.audioTextZh:
5%至7%的爬升梯度通常足以越过障碍物，并在复飞后重新建立稳定爬升。
问题：复飞期间通常预期的爬升梯度是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 5% to 7%.

cards.audioText:
Reconfiguring the aircraft (for example adjusting flaps, speed) and ensuring a stable approach is essential for a successful second landing attempt.
Question: After completing a go-around, how does a pilot typically proceed with the next approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
重新设置航空器构型，例如调整襟翼和速度，并确保进近稳定，是第二次着陆尝试成功的关键。
问题：完成复飞后，飞行员通常如何进行下一次进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Reconfigure the aircraft and conduct a stabilized approach.
choices: Immediately attempt a second landing without rechecking instruments.
Reconfigure the aircraft and conduct a stabilized approach.
Ascend to cruising altitude and divert to another airport.
Land on a different runway to avoid repeating the same mistake.
choicesZh: 不复查仪表，立即尝试第二次着陆
重新设置航空器构型并实施稳定进近
爬升至巡航高度并改航另一机场
在不同跑道着陆以避免重复同一错误

cards.audioText:
The go-around is a critical safety maneuver that allows pilots to abort a landing if the approach does not meet safety standards, such as unstable approaches or runway incursions.
Question: What is the primary purpose of a go-around procedure in aviation?
cards.audioTextZh:
复飞是一项关键安全机动。当进近不符合安全标准时，例如进近不稳定或发生跑道侵入，飞行员可以中止着陆。
问题：航空中复飞程序的主要目的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To ensure flight safety when landing conditions are unsafe.
choices: To save fuel by avoiding a full landing.
To ensure flight safety when landing conditions are unsafe.
To comply with air traffic control regulations.
choicesZh: 避免完整着陆以节省燃油
着陆条件不安全时确保飞行安全
遵守空中交通管制规定

cards.audioText:
The co-pilot, also known as the first officer, is an essential crew member who shares responsibilities with the captain. They assist in piloting the aircraft, monitor systems, and make decisions when necessary.
Question: which of the following is a key responsibility of the co-pilot during the flight?
cards.audioTextZh:
副驾驶也称第一副驾驶，是与机长共同承担职责的重要机组成员。他们协助驾驶航空器、监控系统，并在必要时作出决策。
问题：以下哪一项是副驾驶在飞行期间的一项关键职责？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To serve as a secondary decision-maker and support the captain in flight operations.
choices: To serve as a secondary decision-maker and support the captain in flight operations.
To take full control of the aircraft if the passengers request it.
To handle all communication with ground staff at destination airports.
To clean the cockpit during long-haul flights.
choicesZh: 作为第二决策者并在飞行运行中协助机长
乘客提出要求时完全接管航空器
负责与目的地机场地面人员的全部通信
长途飞行期间清洁驾驶舱

cards.audioText:
Ramp service teams are responsible for handling all physical loading and unloading activities related to the aircraft. This ensures that the aircraft is ready for departure and that all cargo and baggage are safely and efficiently transferred.
Question: What is one of the main responsibilities of the ramp service team?
cards.audioTextZh:
机坪服务团队负责与航空器有关的所有实物装卸活动。这可确保航空器做好离场准备，并使所有货物和行李安全、高效地转运。
问题：机坪服务团队的主要职责之一是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To load and unload cargo, baggage, and fuel onto the aircraft.
choices: To greet arriving passengers and offer assistance with their luggage.
To load and unload cargo, baggage, and fuel onto the aircraft.
To manage the check-in process at the airport terminal.
To operate the aircraft engines for pre-flight testing.
choicesZh: 迎接到达旅客并帮助处理行李
为航空器装卸货物、行李和燃油
操作航空器发动机进行飞行前测试

cards.audioText:
Maintenance technicians are critical to flight safety. Their role involves inspecting and repairing the aircraft to ensure it meets all regulatory and operational standards before departure.
Question: Which of the following is a primary responsibility of the maintenance technician before a flight departs?
cards.audioTextZh:
维修技术人员对飞行安全至关重要。他们负责检查和修理航空器，确保航空器在离场前符合所有法规和运行标准。
问题：航空器离场前，维修技术人员的一项主要职责是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To ensure the aircraft is in a safe and operational condition for flight.
choices: To clean the interior of the aircraft for aesthetic purposes.
