A: The rudder pedal’s pressure is not sufficient when apply. We suspect it must be leakage in the hydraulic system.
B: We will put an auxiliary hydraulic pump on the system and sort they out.
Q: What should be done to find the problem in the hydraulic system?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：操作方向舵踏板时压力不足。我们怀疑一定是液压系统出现泄漏。
B：我们会在系统上放置辅助液压泵并找出问题。
问：找出液压系统的问题应该怎样做？
choices: Turn on the auxiliary gear box
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Turn on the auxiliary pump

cards.audioText:
BAW141 avoid taxing over broken surface. It is likely to cause bumps.
Q: What does the speaker mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
英航141，在滑行中避免滑入受损路面，否则很容易引起颠簸。
问：说话人的意思是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The surface is damaged.

cards.audioText:
New York Departure, good morning, CCA818, climbing 3000 feet, heading 220, direct to ave.
Q: What is the current heading for CCA818?
cards.audioTextZh:
纽约离场，早上好，国航818，上升到3000英尺，航向220，直飞
问：国航818当前的航向是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 220

cards.audioText:
Checklists are used only to verify that the critical items affecting safety have been accomplished.
Q: What kind of items will be checked in checklists?
cards.audioTextZh:
检查单只用于确认完成了影响飞行安全的重要项目。
问：在检查单中，需要检查的是什么项目？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Significant items.

cards.audioText:
Shortly after the engine lost power, its speed decreased to about 1000-1100RPM. The pilot pushed the throttle forward but obtained no response from the engine.
Q: What is the reason for no response from the engine?
cards.audioTextZh:
发动机损失功率后不久，速度降低到1000到1100RPM。飞行员推进推力，但是发动机没有任何反应。
问：为什么发动机没有反应？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The engine lost power

cards.audioText:
CES554, turn right heading 350, R30 route unavailable due military operations, call you back.
Q: Why did the controller ask the pilot to change the heading?
cards.audioTextZh:
东方554，右转航向350，R30航路由于军事活动不可用，稍后回复。
问：管制员为什么让飞行员改变航向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Due air force flight.

cards.audioText:
QFA564, we got a suspected cholera patient on board. Request necessary services on landing.
Q: What might be needed on landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
澳航564，飞机上有一名疑似霍乱患者，请求着陆之后相关必要服务。
问：着陆之后可能需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An ambulance.

cards.audioText:
AFR315, FL310 is not available at the moment, the alternative is FL350 advise.
Q: Which statement is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
法航315，高度层310当前不可用，建议使用高度层350。
问：以下哪个陈诉是真的？
choices: FL310 and FL350 are not available.
choicesZh: 高度层310和高度层350不可用。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. FL350 is now available.

cards.audioText:
CCA101 due to traffic congestion, make 360 turn left at your present position.
Q: What is the aircraft expected to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 国航101，由于航空器拥堵，在当前位置左转360。问：飞机接下来将怎么做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To lose time

cards.audioText:
As you worked towards the instrument rating, you are learning to control the airplane more precisely, to navigate by radio aids, to deal with air traffic control and to make instrument approaches.
Q: Which of the following is not mentioned?
cards.audioTextZh: 在仪表飞行阶段，你将学习如何更加精确地操纵飞机，如何使用无线电辅助导航，如何与空中交通管制交流以及如何进行仪表进近。问：以下没有被提及的是？
choices: To navigate by the radio aids.
choicesZh: 与空中交通管制员交流。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To make visual approaches.

cards.audioText:
The airplane stalled on takeoff because there was an error on the loading sheet and the aircraft was not loaded properly.
Q: What caused the aircraft to become unstable and stall?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机在起飞时失速，原因是舱单存在错误，飞机没有正确配载。
问：什么原因导致飞机不稳定和失速？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A weight and balance problem.

cards.audioText:
CSN3321, don't park your aircraft here, the nose of the aircraft should be facing away from the hanger.
Q: What does the speaker mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
南方3342，不要把飞机停在这儿，飞机机头应当背对着机库。
问：说话人的意思是？
choices: The aircraft parked in a wrong position.
The aircraft was outside the ramp.
The aircraft parked in the hanger.
The aircraft was in a correct position.
choicesZh: 飞机停在了正确的位置。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The aircraft parked in a wrong position.

cards.audioText:
CCA101 Heavy, cleared to land RW19R, do overtake the RG on your right, confirm you have them in sight.
Q: Where is the other aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
国航101，重型，可以落地，跑道19右，赶上位于右侧的巴西航空，确认你看到了航空器。
问：另一个航空器在哪？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Ahead and on the right.

cards.audioText:
Ailerons, the control surfaces at the outboard ends of wing control roll, pitch is controlled by the elevator and yaw is controlled by the rudder.
Q: Which of the following is not mentioned?
cards.audioTextZh:
副翼是机翼侧的外端操纵面，飞机俯仰由升降舵控制，方向舵控制偏航。
问：以下没有提及的是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Throttles.

cards.audioText:
BAW721, RVR runway 27, touch down 200m, midpoint 300m, stop end 1000m.
Q: What type of problem will the landing aircraft have?
cards.audioTextZh:
英航7421，跑道27视距，接地点200米，中间段300米，停止端1000米。
问：着陆的飞行器遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Poor visibility

cards.audioText:
Their flight won't leave on time because they are being held at the gate. They can't push back until the visibility improves.
Q: What's the probable reason for the delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机没有按时离场，因为飞机一直被困在停机位。他们无法在能见度提高前推出。
问：延误的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Thick fog.

cards.audioText:
This is your captain speaking, the weather in Manila is clear with light westerly wind.
Q: Which one of the following describes the weather in Manila?
cards.audioTextZh:
这是机长广播，马尼拉天气晴朗，伴有轻微西风。
问：以下哪个是关于马尼拉天气的描述？
choicesZh: 风向280，40米每秒，能见度10公里。
风向280，40米每秒，能见度1公里。
风向280，10米每秒，能见度1公里。
风向280，5米每秒，能见度10公里。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Wind 280/5. Visibility 10km.

cards.audioText:
Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking, we have closed the doors and about to push back. Please turn off all electronic equipment.
Q: Which of the following can passengers use?
cards.audioTextZh:
女士们，先生们，这里是机长广播，客舱门已经关闭，飞机准备滑出，请关闭所有的电子设备。
问：乘客可以使用以下哪个？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A book

cards.audioText:
CSN210, at time 50 a departing Boeing757 reporting wind shear at 800 feet, airspeed loss 20 knots, strong right drift.
Q: What danger might the pilot encounter?
cards.audioTextZh:
南方5632，在50分的时候一架离场的波音757报告在800英尺遇到风切变，速度损失20节，造成很强的右偏航。
问：飞行员可能会遭遇什么危险？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Sudden loss of airspeed.

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW808, radar can't observe you due to ground clutter, will advise you when contact regained, resume own navigation to Penton intersection.
Q: What happened at that moment?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制：英航808，由于地面杂乱，雷达无法看到你，等重新取得联络后通知你，恢复自主导航至Penton交叉点。
问：目前发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Radar contact lost.

cards.audioText:
KLM 345, we have a low oil pressure light on, request a tug to get us back to the stand.
Question: Which system do you think is faulty?
cards.audioTextZh:
荷航345，我们低油压灯亮，请求拖车将我们拖回机坪。
问：你认为哪个系统出故障了？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Hydraulic system

cards.audioText:
Approach, Gulf air 889, number 2 engine has partially disintegrated, request return for landing.
Question: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
进近，海湾889，2号发动机部分脱落，请求返场着陆。
问：发生什么了？
choices: One of the engines has failed.
Part of one engine has departed from the engine.
One of the auto throttles is disengaged.
Part of the airframe is damaged.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Part of one engine has departed from the engine.

cards.audioText:
UAL 345, negative to take off due to pack 1 and 2 problem, cabin temperature high, request taxi back to the stand.
Question: Which system of the aircraft might be wrong?
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航345，由于组件1和组件2故障，不能起飞，客舱温度高，请求滑回机坪。
问：飞机的哪个系统有可能故障？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Conditioning system

cards.audioText:
Ground, BAW 748, we won’t be able to start up until 45 due to a delay in catering delivery. Does that change anything?
Question: What delayed the flight?
cards.audioTextZh:
地面。英航748，由于餐食配送延误，在45分前无法开车，这会引起任何变化吗？
问：什么导致了飞延误？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Food loading

cards.audioText:
Control, Delta 443, several passengers have lost consciousness because a number of oxygen masks didn’t drop.
Question: What happened on board?
cards.audioTextZh:
区调，达美443，由于氧气面罩未脱落，一些乘客失去意识。
问：机上发生了什么？
choices: A number of passengers were in a critical condition.
A number of passengers didn’t know how to breathe.
choicesZh: 一些乘客不知道如何呼吸
许多乘客的氧气面罩不见了
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A number of passengers were in a critical condition.

cards.audioText:
Alaska 567, I got a passenger very drunk on board and he threatens to hijack the aircraft. Coming back to SeaTac.
Question: What is the reason for return?
cards.audioTextZh:
阿拉斯加567，机上一名乘客醉酒，他威胁称将会劫机。正返航西塔科。
问：返航的原因是什么？
choices: The passenger is too drunk to be on board.
The controller was threatened of being hijacked.
Someone threatened to hijack a passenger.
A passenger threatened to hijack the flight.
choicesZh: 乘客醉酒，不能待在飞机上
一名乘客威胁劫持飞机
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A passenger threatened to hijack the flight.

cards.audioText:
The captain should check the maintenance log before departure, to ensure a valid maintenance release in force is satisfactory for the flight.
Q: What does the phrase “in force” mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长应在起飞前检查维修日志，以确保现行的维修放行是适航的。
问:“现行的”是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. In use.

cards.audioText:
The trained flight crew uses normal procedures to ensure the airplane condition is acceptable for flight.
Q: What is not the function of normal procedure performance?
cards.audioTextZh:
训练有素的机组人员使用正常程序，以确保飞机的状况是可接受的。
问：什么不是正常程序的功能？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Plan the aircraft condition.

cards.audioText:
The highest features in the vicinity of each flight leg will either below the desired altitude or run away from the line of the flight.
Q: what does the sentence mean?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行各边附近的最高地形要么低于所需的高度，要么远离飞行航线。
choices: Flight route must be clear of obstacles.
Flight route must be below the flight line.
Flight route must be in the vicinity.
Flight route must have highest features.
choicesZh: 航路必须低于飞行航线。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Flight route must be clear of obstacles.

cards.audioText:
Cockpit to Ground, negative start-up. There are some water-drops dripping from the overhead electronic panel. No idea where they are from. We need to carry out a check.
Q: Why can't the pilots start up?
cards.audioTextZh: 驾舱呼叫地面，不能开车，头顶上方的电子面板有水滴落下，但无法确定水滴来源，我们需要执行检查。问：飞行员不能开车的原因是？
choices: There might be some unknown problems in the cockpit.
The water drainage valve needs checking.
He cannot drink water in the cockpit.
choicesZh: 驾驶舱可能存在原因不明的问题。
头顶上方的电子面板落下。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There might be some unknown problems in the cockpit.

cards.audioText:
ICAO category ⅢA limitations are: a decision height of 0 feet and RVR of 200m.
Q: What are the limitations of a Category ⅢA approach?
cards.audioTextZh: ICAO3类A进近的限制是：决断高度0英尺和跑道视程200米。问：ICAO3类A进近的限制是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. RVR 200 meters

cards.audioText:
There are 3 flight crew members, 9 flight attendants and 235 passengers on board the Airbus.
Q: How many crew members are there on board the Airbus?
cards.audioTextZh: 在空客飞机上，有3名飞行人员，9名乘务人员和235名乘客。问：空客飞机上有多少机组成员？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 12

cards.audioText:
An aircraft is flying from Beijing to Paris, when it reaches its maximum cruising level, the cabin is pressurized to 8000ft, this requires the pressure differential of 8 to 9 psi.
Q: In this statement, what is the 8 to 9 psi?
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机由北京飞往巴黎，当飞机到达最大巡航高度，机舱增压到8000英尺。这需要8到9磅每平方英寸的压差。问：在表述中，8到9磅每平方英寸指的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Differential pressure

cards.audioText:
Air China 785, behind departing Air France 74, cross RW14L behind, turn right on Charlie, hold short of RW 14R.
Q: What are they going to do when they reach Runway 14L?
cards.audioTextZh: 国航785，法航74离场后，从后面穿越跑道14左，在C点右转，在跑道14右外等待。问：当他们到达跑道14左后将会？
choices: Cross the RW behind Air France 74.
choicesZh: 右转，然后在14左跑道上调头。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Cross the RW behind Air France 74.

cards.audioText:
Turn left 30 degrees, when you complete the turn, expect traffic at your 2 o’clock, climbing at 1000ft below.
Q: When will the traffic be at 2 o’clock?
cards.audioTextZh: 左转30度，转弯完成后，估计航空器在你2点钟方向， 1000英尺以下，正在爬升。问：什么时候冲突航空器在2点钟方向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After the turn.

cards.audioText:
NW898, cleared to Beijing via A1 at 6000m, we can for departure, squawk 5501, uh, correction, standby squawk.
Q: What transponder code should NW898 set?
cards.audioTextZh: 西北898，可以经由6000米的A1飞往北京，可以离场，应答机编码5501，嗯，更正，应答机编码稍等。问：西北898应当设置的应答机编码是多少？
choicesZh: 应答机编码现在不可知。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Squawk not available yet.

cards.audioText:
Nickel-cadmium (Ni-Cd) batteries are frequently used in turbo propeller aircraft.
Q: According to the statement, what type of aircraft is more likely to have a Ni-Cd battery?
cards.audioTextZh: 在涡轮螺旋桨发动机中，经常使用Nickel-cadmium（镍镉电池）或者NiCd battery（镍镉电池）。问：根据表述，什么样的飞机最有可能使用NiCd battery（镍镉电池）？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Aircraft with a propeller.

cards.audioText:
Pilots are urged in their own interests to request assistance from emergency services as soon as there is any doubt about the safe conduct of their flight.
Q: When should pilots request assistance from emergency services?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员一旦对他们的飞行安全行为有任何疑问，应敦促他们出于自身需要，寻求紧急服务的协助。问：飞行员什么时候应该寻求紧急服务的协助？
choices: When they are urged to do so.
When they have no interest in handling the flight.
When they could handle the situation.
When they are not sure of the flight safety.
choicesZh: 当他们被敦促这么做时。
当他们对操纵飞行不感兴趣时。
当他们可以应对当前情形时。
当他们对飞行安全不确定时。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. When they are not sure of the flight safety.

cards.audioText:
When flying an approach in a strong gusty headwind, Vref should be adjusted by half the headwind and full gust speed.
Q: In windy conditions, how much should Vref be adjusted by during an approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 当在强阵逆风的情况下进近时，应以逆风量一半和全阵风速率调整基准速度。问：在有风条件下，在进近阶段，应如何调整基准速度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Half headwind and full gust.

cards.audioText:
CCA982, 22 kilometers from touchdown, turn right heading 330, cleared for ILS runway 36L, report established.
Q: Which of the following information is not true?
cards.audioTextZh: 国航982，离接地点22公里，右转航向330，可以ILS进近，跑道36左，建立后报。问：以下那条信息是错误的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Cleared for IGS runway 36L.

cards.audioText:
Ladies and gentleman, due to favorable weather, we expect to arrive about an hour ahead of schedule.
Q: When do they expect to arrive?
cards.audioTextZh: 女士们，先生们，由于天气良好，我们有望比计划提前一个小时左右到达。问：他们有望什么时候到达？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. About an hour earlier.

cards.audioText:
BAW505, your slot time is 1250, correction 1205, start up at your own discretion.
Q: When is the aircraft expected to depart?
cards.audioTextZh:
英航505，你的离场时间是12:50，更正，12:05，请自行开车。
问：飞机计划的离场时间是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 12:05

cards.audioText:
This is an uncontrolled airfield where everybody flying in and around the airspace looks out for each other and passes the information among pilots.
Q: How is the information passed in the airspace?
cards.audioTextZh:
这是个无人管制机场，飞进机场和经过该机场空域的人彼此相互关注，信息在飞行员之间传递。
问：在该空域，信息是如何进行传递的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. From pilots to pilots.

cards.audioText:
Singapore Airlines 413 is inbound to Beijing capital, but there is fog at the airport and the RVRs are below the limits for landing, so the aircraft must hold for an improvement in visibility.
Q: Why is Singapore Airlines 413 holding?
cards.audioTextZh:
新航413飞往北京首都，但是机场有雾，跑道视距低于着陆限制，因此，飞机需要等待能见度提升。
问：新航413等待的原因是？
choices: Because the ILS is out of service
Because the aircraft has to dump fuel
Because the aircraft has to burn off fuel
Because the RVRs are below limits
choicesZh: 因为飞机需要消耗燃油。
因为跑道视距低于限制。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Because the RVRs are below limits

cards.audioText:
Flight 152 from Beijing was supposed to arrive at 10 o’clock, but it has been delayed for at least an hour.
Q: When was the flight supposed to arrive?
cards.audioTextZh:
从北京起飞的152航班原计划在10点到达，但是现在至少延误了1个多小时。
问：航班原计划什么时候到达？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 10:00

cards.audioText:
Mayday Mayday Mayday, BAW141, B747, we have a total electrical failure, request emergency landing, currently 10km west of Taiyuan, passing 7800m, heading 120.
Q: What problem does BAW141 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，英航141，波音747，我们遭遇全部电气系统失效，请求紧急着陆，目前在太原以西10公里，通过7800米，航向120。
问：英航141遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Electrical failure.

cards.audioText:
Ailerons, the control surface at the outboard ends of wing control roll, pitches controlled by elevator and rudder controls yaw.
Q: Which of the following is not mentioned?
cards.audioTextZh:
副翼，机翼外端控制滚转的控制面，升降舵控制的俯仰和方向舵控制的偏航。
问：以下没有提及的是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Throttles.

cards.audioText:
When the wind direction is changing, the heading is given as a range, such variable from 270 to 330.
Q: How much is the range from 270 to 330 degrees?
cards.audioTextZh:
当风向改变的时候，会给出一定的航向范围，例如：从270到330。
问：从270到330的范围是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 60 degrees.

cards.audioText:
The wind is at 040 at 20kts, gusting to 30kts.
Q: Which direction is the wind coming from?
cards.audioTextZh:
风向040，20节，阵风30节。
问：风从什么方向来？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. From the Northeast

cards.audioText:
UAL889, when clear crossing traffic, turn left heading 050, confirm your level at 1500m.
Q: When should they make the turn?
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航889，远离正在穿越的航空器后，左转航向050，证实你的高度在1500米。
问：他们应在什么时候转弯？
choicesZh: 为了避开正在穿越的航空器。
当远离穿越的航空器时。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. when clear of crossing traffic

cards.audioText:
United321, caution, unmanned balloon over right turning base of runway 36 and 32, altitude 300m moving north bound at 40km/h.
Q: Why should United 321 keep a good look out?
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航321，注意，一个无人操纵的气球正转向跑道36和32右的四边，高度300米，正以40公里每小时的速度向北部运动。
问：为什么美联航321需要密切关注飞机外部？
choices: There is a balloon near the runway.
He is 40 KM per hour too fast.
He is turning base for R/W36.
choicesZh: 他速度40公里每小时，速度过快。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There is a balloon near the runway.

cards.audioText:
Dublin at 0830, wind 280 at 12 knots, visibility 10 kilometers plus clouds scattered at 2200 feet, temperature 12, dew point 6, QNH1002, no SIG.
Q: What is the temperature dew point spread?
cards.audioTextZh:
都柏林时间08:30，风向280，12节，能见度10公里，在2200英尺有疏云，温度12度，露点6度，修正海压1002，无重大变化。
问：露点差是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 6.

cards.audioText:
Flight 152 from Beijing was supposed to arrive an hour ago and it is already 10 o'clock.
Q: When was the flight supposed to arrive?
cards.audioTextZh:
从飞机来的152航班原计划于1小时前到达，但是现在已经10:00了。
问：航班原计划什么时候到达？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 9:00

cards.audioText:
The vortex circulation is outward, upward and around the wingtips when viewing from either ahead or behind the aircraft.
Q: How does the vortex circulate?
cards.audioTextZh:
从飞机前方和后方看，翼尖涡流的旋转方向都是向外、向上的。
问：翼尖涡流的旋转方向是怎样的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. outward and upward.

cards.audioText:
During routine maintenance, the mechanic found the damaged fan blades, turbine blades and compressor blades.
Q: Which part or parts of the aircraft were damaged?
cards.audioTextZh:
例行维修期间，机务人员发现了受损的风扇叶片，涡轮叶片和压缩机叶片。
问：受损的是飞机的那个部件？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The Engine.

cards.audioText:
Traffic will be at your 1 o'clock, restricted to 12000 feet once you completed the turn.
Q: When will the traffic be at 1 o'clock?
cards.audioTextZh:
航空器将在你的1点钟方向，转弯结束后，限定在12000英尺。
问：航空器什么时候在1点钟方向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After completing the turn.

cards.audioText:
Approach, good morning CCA512, descending FL200, squawking 4123.
Q: What is the squawk code of Air China 512?
cards.audioTextZh:
进近，早上好，国航512，下降到高度层200，应答机编码4123。
问：国航512的应答机编码是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 4123.

cards.audioText:
Air Canada 503, taxi with caution. The previous pilot report there are ice ruts and ridges on the taxiway.
Q: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
加航503，谨慎滑行，前机飞行员报告在滑行道上有冰屑和冰脊。
问：管制员让飞行员做什么？
choices: To report the condition of the previous traffic.
To move the ice from the runway.
To taxi on the taxiway carefully.
choicesZh: 报告前面航空器的状况。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To taxi on the taxiway carefully.

cards.audioText:
United 655 hold short of T5, give way to airbus taxing in for parking.
Q: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航655，在等待点T5外等待，给正在滑向机坪的空客飞机让路。
问：管制员让飞行员做什么？
choices: To hold at a holding point.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To hold at a holding point.

cards.audioText:
If significant engine vibration occurs due to ice accumulation on the blades, the engine should be accelerated to 70% in one minimum for approximately 15 seconds.
Q: What causes the vibration?
cards.audioTextZh:
如果因为积冰堆积在发动机叶片从而导致发动机出现严重振动，发动机应当在一分钟以内加速至70%，并保持大约15秒。
问：什么引起了发动机振动？
choicesZh: 积冰生成在发动机叶片之后。
积冰堆积在发动机叶片。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Ice building on the blade.

cards.audioText:
BAW725, hold short at runway 35L, you are No.2 for departure after the blue Boeing737.
Q: Where is BAW725 expected to be?
cards.audioTextZh:
英航725，在跑道35左外等待，在离场的蓝色波音737后面，你是第二个。
问：英航725的位置应该在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Holding position.

cards.audioText:
SIA146 clear taxi runway 10 via V1 and V2, be advised low visibility procedures are enforce. RVR runway 10, 250m, midpoint 220, stop end 200m.
Q: What is the midpoint RVR on runway 10?
cards.audioTextZh:
新航146，可以经由滑行道V1和V2滑行至跑道10，告知执行低能见度程序，跑道10视距250米，中间段220米，停止端200米。
问：跑道10的中间段视距是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 220 meters.

cards.audioText:
Your flight is at FL350 and you are experiencing turbulence. You'd like to climb higher to FL390 but it isn’t available.
Q: Look at the following four flight levels, which level should you request?
cards.audioTextZh:
你当前位于高度层350，正遭遇颠簸，你希望继续爬升至高度层390，但是该高度层不可用。
问：以下四个高度层中，你应该申请的高度层是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. FL 370.

cards.audioText:
A localizer signal provides course guidance throughout descent path to the runway threshold from a distance of 18NM from the antenna site.
Q: What type of approach does the statement refer to?
cards.audioTextZh:
定位信标信号通过基站天线提供整个降落路径到跑道入口18海里的航线引导。
问：表述中提到的进近方式是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. ILS.

cards.audioText:
Clear ice is usually found between 0° and -10°, mixed and clear ice between -10° and -15° and rime ice between -15°C and -20℃.
Q: What type of ice is usually found between 0° to -10°?
cards.audioTextZh:
明冰一般出现在0度到-10度之间，混合冰一般出现在-10度到-15度之间，霜冰一般出现在-15度到-20度之间。
问：0度到-10度之间一般出现什么冰？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Clear ice.

cards.audioText:
Due to bad weather and later departure, their flight did not arrive until after midnight. As a result, the connecting passengers missed their flights and had been booked into a hotel.
Q: Why were the passengers booked into a hotel?
cards.audioTextZh:
因为恶劣天气和起飞时间晚，航班半夜才到达，结果，需中转的乘客错过了他们的航班，并被安排住进了酒店。
问：乘客为什么被安排住进酒店？
choices: They complained because of the delay.
choicesZh: 他们的转机航班被取消。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They missed their connecting flights.

cards.audioText:
United 889, expected lower altitude assignment after climbing traffic ahead has passed. Confirm your Level at 11500 meters.
Q: What altitude does the controller think United 889 is at right now?
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航889，前方爬升航班通过后，下降到更低的高度，确认你目前高度在11500米。
问：管制员认为美联航889目前的高度是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Maintaining 11,500 m.

cards.audioText:
The terrorists from CCA1301 threatened to blow up the aircraft if they don’t comply with their demands.
Q: What squawk code should the crew set in this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
来自国航1301的恐怖分子威胁说，如果不遵守他们的要求，他们将炸毁飞机。
问：在这种情况下，机组人员应该设置什么应答码？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 7500

cards.audioText:
After an emergency landing this morning, the runway was foamed and closed at the moment, it has been cleaned up and would be reopened in a short time.
Q: Why was the runway closed?
cards.audioTextZh:
今早紧急迫降后，跑道上喷洒了泡沫并关闭，现已清理完毕，将于短期内重新开放。
问：跑道为什么关闭？
choices: It would be opened in a longer time.
choicesZh: 它将在更长的时间内开放
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. It was foamed.

cards.audioText:
The aircraft CCA1308 will have to dump fuel because of landing weight requirements dictated by structural limitations of their aircraft.
Q: What will the pilot of CCA1308 do?
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1308将不得不放油，因为飞机的结构限制决定了着陆重量要求。
问：国航1308将怎么做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Make fuel jettison.

cards.audioText:
Once the evidence of fuel leakage is found on starboard wing, the pilot must require the mechanical staff to check the aircraft fuel system.
Q: Which system of the aircraft should be checked by the mechanical staff?
cards.audioTextZh:
一旦发现右翼上有燃油泄漏的证据，飞行员必须请求机务人员检查飞机燃油系统。
问：机务人员需要检查的系统是哪一个？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. fuel system

cards.audioText:
We've just received the instruction from our airline to divert to Pudong and pick up additional flight.
Question: What caused the diversion?
cards.audioTextZh:
我们刚刚接到航空公司的指示，要我们备降浦东，再接一个航班。
问：备降的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Airlines' instruction.

cards.audioText:
The fuel selector valves are used to select fuel from various tanks which normally contain four positions: LEFT, RIGHT, BOTH, and OFF.
Question: What are the four normal positions of a fuel selector valve?
cards.audioTextZh:
燃油选择活门用于从各个油箱中选择燃油，通常包含四个位置：左、右、双和关。
问：燃油选择活门的四个正常位置是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. LEFT, RIGHT, BOTH, and OFF.

cards.audioText:
Ice, snow and fog must be removed before a flight because they can seriously affect
takeoff distance and climb out performance.
Question: What type of weather conditions are described in the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
冰雪和雾必须在飞行前清除，因为它们会严重影响起飞距离和爬升性能。
问：该陈述描述的是哪种天气状况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Winter weather.

cards.audioText:
The ailerons perform the same function on the ground as do in the air. That is to change the lift and drag on the wings.
Question: What is the function of the ailerons?
cards.audioTextZh:
副翼在地面上执行的功能与在空中相同，即改变机翼上的升力和阻力。
问：副翼的功能是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Alter the lift and drag.

cards.audioText:
The landing gear and full flaps should be extended to provide maximum drag so that the descent as quickly as possible can be made without exceeding the speed.
Question: What flight maneuver is indicated in this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
起落架和全襟翼应放下以提供最大阻力，以便在不超速的情况下尽可能快地下降。
问：这种情况指示的是什么飞行操作？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Rapid descent.

cards.audioText:
Ailerons at outboard ends of wings is controlling roll, pitch control by the elevator, and rudder controls yaw.
Question: Which of the following is not mentioned?
cards.audioTextZh:
副翼位于机翼外侧端，控制滚转；升降舵控制俯仰；方向舵控制偏航。
问：以下哪项未被提及？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Throttles

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, HDA305, we cannot extend the nose gear due to a hydraulic problem. Request making a low pass for a visual check.
C: HDA305, make a low pass not below 45m over the runway 36.
Q: What is the level for low pass?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，港龙305，由于液压系统故障，我们无法释放前起落架，请求低空通常进行目视检查。
管制员：港龙305，在跑道36上空做低空通场，高度不低于45米。
问：低空通场的高度是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. All of the other choices.

cards.audioText:
P: CCA101, we are now 4800 meters, passing WZF, information E received.
C: CCA101, radar contact, descend to 3000 meters, turn right heading 040, radar vectoring ILS approach runway 36R.
Q: What are the controller’s instructions on new altitude, flight heading, and runway in use?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：国航101，目前高度4800米，通过WZF，收到通播E。
管制员：国航101，雷达识别，下降到3000米，右转航向040，雷达引导ILS进近，跑道36右。
问：管制员新指令中的新高度，航向，使用跑道是什么？

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141 continue on the inner, at M join the outer, cross Three One Left at K. P: OK, by the inner and M outer and KA, cross Three One Left, BAW 141.
Question: what is the controllers taxiing instructions?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 141，继续沿内侧滑行，在M点切入外侧滑行道，在K点穿越31左跑道。
飞行员：好的，沿内侧滑行，经M外侧和K点，穿越31左跑道，BAW 141。
问题：管制员的滑行指令是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K
choices: K to inner, outer, cross 31L at M
Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K
M to outer, inner, cross 31L at K
M to inner, outer, cross 31L at K
choicesZh: 经K到内侧和外侧滑行道，在M点穿越31L跑道
沿内侧滑行道，经M到外侧滑行道，在K点穿越31L跑道
经M到外侧和内侧滑行道，在K点穿越31L跑道
经M到内侧和外侧滑行道，在K点穿越31L跑道

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, BAW782, we have a fast-moving traffic in front of us. It looks like a fighter from here. We don't have it on our TCAS, have you observed it?
C: We didn't see it on our radar either, probably a fighter without a transponder or not using transponder.
Q: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
武汉区调，英航782，我们前方有一架快速移动的航空器，从这儿看起来像是一架战斗机，我们在TCAS上没有看到它，你们观察到它了吗？
管制员：我们在雷达上也没有看到它，或许是一架没有发射机或者不使用发射机的战斗机。
问：他们在讨论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Conflicting aircraft.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, JAL785, TCAS descending, we have a fast-moving traffic on my TCAS indication. I am following the TCAS RA instructions to avoid the conflicting traffic.
C: JAL785, I just saw it on my radar. It must be a fighter according to its speed. Report TCAS altitude resumed.
Q: What did the aircraft encounter?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：管制，日航785，按TCAS下降中，在我们的TCAS上显示有一架快速移动的航空器，我们正按照TCAS决策咨询避让冲突航空器。
管制员：日航785，我刚刚在雷达上看到了它，根据其速度，一定是一架战斗机。恢复TCAS高度后报。
问：航空器遇到了什么？
choices: An altitude loss on the airborne radar.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An intruder.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CCA4106, ZF-1D, 3,600m, can I expedite climbing to 6,600m? I am a little behind the schedule.
C: CCA4106, negative for the moment due traffic. Climb and maintain 5,400m.
Q: What is the pilot's intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉区调，国航4106，离场程序ZF-1D，高度3600米，我可以加速爬升至6600米吗？我比计划时间有点晚了。
管制员：国航4106，目前由于航空器，不可以，爬升到5400米保持。
问：飞行员的意图是什么？
choices: He would like to catch up time.
He would climb to 5,400m due the schedule.
He cannot climb to 6,600m due traffic.
choicesZh: 由于计划时间，他想爬升至5400米。
由于航空器，他无法爬升至6600米。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. He would like to catch up time.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Approach, NWA303, maintaining 5100 meters. Estimating LKG 11, information F received.
CTL: NWA303, Wuhan Approach, the latest information is G, please check it. Report passing LKG
PIL: Wuhan Approach, NWA303, wilco.
Q: What should the pilot do after ATC issues the instructions?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉进近，美西北303，保持5100米。预计到达LKG时间11分，通播F收到。
管：美西北303，武汉进近，最新通播G，请核对。过LKG报告。
飞：武汉进近，美西北303，照办。
问：ATC发布指令后，飞行员应做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Verify the ATIS

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN3308, I have to go back to the apron and I need medical assistance upon my arrival. The flight attendant reported that a woman on board has miscarried and needs a doctor.
C: CSN3308, right turn ahead at intersection E5. I will inform those concerned.
Q: What happened on board?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，南方3308，我需要返回停机坪，同时在到达后需要医疗援助。乘务员报告称机上有名女士流产了，需要医生。
管制员：南方3308，在前方E5交叉口右转，我将通知相关人员。
问：飞机上发生了什么？
choices: A flight attendant was going to give birth to a child.
A pregnant woman was in danger.
A flight attendant reported something wrong with undercarriage.
choicesZh: 一名乘务员要生孩子了。
乘务员报告飞机起落架出问题。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. A pregnant woman was in danger.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, BAW238, we are not sure our landing gear is down or not.
C: BAW238, your landing gear seems to be completely extended.
P: Wuhan Tower, BAW238, request landing clearance and emergency services.
C: Roger, you’re number 1. Previous pilot reported wind shear at 600m 4km, final runway 36R.
P: Roger, number 1 to land, BAW238.
Q: What precaution should the pilot make according to the ATC?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员；塔台，英航238，我们不确定起落架是否放下。
管制员：英航238，你的起落架看起来已经完全放下。
飞行员：武汉塔台，英航238，请求着陆许可和紧急援助。
管制员：收到，你是第一个，之前飞行员报告在跑道36右的五边4公里，高度600米处有风切变。
飞行员：收到，第一个着陆，英航238。
问：根据管制员信息，飞行员应该做什么防范措施？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Wind shear on final.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CCA4016, we are ready to join R343.
C: CCA4016, join R343 over KG at 4800m before 35.
P: Roger, I will join R343 as instructed, CCA4016.
Q: What items are contained in the control's instructions?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉区调，国航4016，我们已经准备好加入R343航路。
管制员：国航4016，过KG点，高度4800米，在35分之前加入R343航路。
飞行员：收到，我将按指令加入R343航路，国航4016。
问:管制员的指令中包含了哪些项目？
choicesZh: 空中航线，航路点，应答机编码。
航路点，时间，高度层，空中航线。
航路点，时间，高度层，空中航线，速度。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Waypoint, time, level, airway.

cards.audioText:
C: SIA223, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
P: Approach, SIA223, we prefer a visual approach to runway 18L; this will save time.
C: Negative, the visibility is too low, you have to make a precision approach, and the glidepath of runway 18L is inoperative.
P: Roger, ILS approach runway 36R.
Q: What is the request for SIA223?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：新航223，预计盲降进近，跑道36右。
飞行员：进近，新加坡223，我们更喜欢目视进近，跑道18左，这样会节省点时间。
管制员：不同意，能见度过低，你必须做精密进近，同时，跑道18左的下滑道目前不工作。
飞行员：收到，盲降进近，跑道36右。
问：新航223请求了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Visual approach runway 18L.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, D303, maintaining 5100 meters. Estimating LKO at 11, information F received.
C. D303 Wuhan Approach, the latest information is G, please check. Report passing LKO.
P: Wuhan Approach, D303, I will check it now and report passing LKO.
Q: What should the pilot do after ATC issues the instructions?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，D303，保持高度5100米，预计到达LKO11分，通播F。
管制员：D303，武汉进近，最新通播是G，请确认，过LKO点报。
飞行员：武汉进近，D303，我即刻确认，过LKO点报。
问：管制员发布指令后，飞行员应该做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Verify the ATIS.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, BAW141, we have to taxi back to the terminal because our EGT is too high, close to the limit.
C: BAW141, can you manage to taxi under your own power?
P: I'd better shut down the engine and wait for a tug.
C: BAW141, wait there and I will contact a tug driver. A tug will reach you soon.
Q: What is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，英航141，我们需要滑回航站楼，因为我们发动机的排气温度过高，快接近极限温度了。
管制员：英航141，你可以自行滑回吗？
飞行员：我最好关闭发动机，然后等拖车来。
管制员：英航141，原地等待，我将联系拖车司机，拖车马上就到。
问：飞机出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The engine temperature is high.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, CES 5402, YIH at 22, 9,800 m, estimating ENH at time 40. CTL: CES 5402, maintain present level and heading, report crossing ENH.
Question: What is the pilot doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：管制，CES 5402，22分过YIH，高度9800米，预计40分到达ENH。管制员：CES 5402，保持当前高度和航向，飞越ENH时报告。
问题：飞行员正在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Making a position report
choices: Request clearance to the next point
choicesZh: 请求前往下一报告点的许可

cards.audioText:
P: Control, SIA 105, request holding instructions. C: SIA 105, Control, cleared to hold over WG, maintain 8,400 meters, inbound track 106 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time one and one-half minutes, expect further clearance in 10 minutes.
Question: What is the inbound track of the holding pattern?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：管制，SIA 105，请求等待指令。管制员：SIA 105，管制，许可在WG上空等待，保持8400米，向台航迹106度，左等待，背台飞行时间一分半，预计10分钟后发布进一步许可。
问题：等待航线的向台航迹是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 106 degrees

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, SIA 205, 45km southwest of LKO at 8,900m, estimating LKO at time13, request clearance to cross airway R343 at LKO. C: SIA 205, Wuhan Control, cleared to cross R343 at LKO at time13 or before, maintain 8,900m.
Question: When should the pilot cross the route?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉管制，SIA 205，位于LKO西南45公里、高度8900米，预计13分到达LKO，请求许可在LKO穿越R343航路。管制员：SIA 205，武汉管制，许可在13分或之前于LKO穿越R343，保持8900米。
问题：飞行员应在什么时候穿越该航路？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. No later than 13

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, SIA 303, we have just been struck by lightning, the right outboard aileron was damaged. C: SIA 303, make sure there’s no other damage to the aircraft. P: I am checking now. I will inform you later. P: Wuhan Control, SIA 303, we have hydraulic problem. The rudder is jammed
Question: What failures did SIA 303 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉管制，SIA 303，我们刚遭到雷击，右侧外副翼受损。管制员：SIA 303，确认飞机没有其他损伤。飞行员：我正在检查，稍后通知你。飞行员：武汉管制，SIA 303，我们的液压系统有问题，方向舵卡住了。
问题：SIA 303发生了哪些故障？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. All of above

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Control, NWA 808, emergency descend due to rapid depressurization. Now, 8,400 m descending to 4,200 m. Request priority landing at your field. C: NWA 808, Wuhan Control, roger Mayday. Descend to 3,900 m. P: Descend to 3,900 m. NWA 808. C: All stations, emergency descent in progress from 8,400 m over HZ, all aircraft below 8,100 m in the vicinity of HZ leave this area to the east immediately and contact 123.15.
Question: Which aircraft will change the frequency?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，管制，NWA 808，由于快速失压紧急下降。现高度8400米，正在下降至4200米。请求在你方机场优先着陆。管制员：NWA 808，武汉管制，收到MAYDAY。下降至3900米。飞行员：下降至3900米，NWA 808。管制员：所有电台，HZ上空正在从8400米实施紧急下降，HZ附近8100米以下的所有航空器立即向东离开该区域，并联系123.15。
问题：哪些航空器将改变频率？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Aircraft below 8,100 m near HZ
choices: Aircraft in the vicinity of HZ

cards.audioText:
C: DAL 541, Wuhan Ground, your departure has to be delayed due to the weather. P: Wuhan Ground, how long is the delay? C: DAL 541, wait till the wind calms down a little. I will call you back when it drops to 10 knots or less.
Question: When will the controller contact the pilot again?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：DAL 541，武汉地面，由于天气原因，你的离场必须延误。飞行员：武汉地面，要延误多久？管制员：DAL 541，等风稍微减弱一些。风速降到10节或以下时，我会再次呼叫你。
问题：管制员什么时候会再次联系飞行员？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. All of above

cards.audioText:
GND: Wuhan approach, CCA 101 leaving 2100m descending 900m. ATC: CCA 101 maintain 900m proceed direct to the ILS outer marker and uh weather is uh sky partially obscured, wind calm, fog, and smoke, altimeter 1011, runway one zero, visual RVR less than 300 m.
Question: Which of the following is correct according to the conversation above?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，CCA 101离开2100米，下降至900米。管制员：CCA 101，保持900米，直飞ILS外指点标。天气情况为：天空部分被遮蔽、静风、有雾和烟；高度表拨正值1011；使用10跑道；目视跑道视程（RVR）低于300米。
问题：根据以上通话，下列哪一项是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. QNH 1011

cards.audioText:
CTL: SIA996, taxi via taxiway E4 to holding point runway 36 right.
PIL: E4 to 36 right, SIA996.
CTL: SIA996, stop immediately and hold your position. I say again, stop now. One of the ground personnel just reported that they saw a little boy or something climbing into your main gear wheel well. Stop now.
Q: Why did the controller ask the pilot to stop?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：新航996，通过滑行道E4，在跑道36右外等待点等待。
飞行员：E4到36右，新航996。
管制员：新航996，马上停下，原地等待，我再说一遍，马上停下，一名地面人员报告称看到一个小男孩还是别的东西爬进了你们的主起落架轮舱。
问：为什么管制员让飞行员停下？
choices: Something wrong with the main gear wheel well.
Something wrong with nose gear wheel well.
The aircraft has run over one of the ground personnel.
A boy got into the main landing gear bay.
choicesZh: 主起落架轮舱出问题了。
前起落架轮舱出问题了。
飞机从一名地面人员身上压过去了。
一个男孩进入了飞机主起落架轮舱。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A boy got into the main landing gear bay.

cards.audioText:
P: London Control, BAW 403, we lost pitch control. We need a very long final. Request fire service assistance upon landing, position 14 miles from threshold, 4000ft, heading 250. C: BAW 403, London, continue this heading for the moment. We will position you to a long straight-in approach in a few minutes.
Question: What did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：伦敦管制，BAW 403，我们失去了俯仰操纵能力，需要一个很长的最后进近。请求着陆时提供消防救援。当前位置距跑道入口14海里，高度4000英尺，航向250。管制员：BAW 403，伦敦管制，暂时保持此航向，几分钟后我们将引导你建立长距离直线进近。
问题：飞行员提出了什么请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A long distance final

cards.audioText:
P: SIA 3478, request low approach for visual check of the landing gear. C: SIA 3478, cleared low approach Runway 28 not below 400ft above threshold elevation, report final. P: Cleared low approach Runway 28 not below 400ft above threshold elevation, wilco, SIA 3478.
Question: Why does SIA 3478 request a low approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：SIA 3478，请求低空进近，以便目视检查起落架。管制员：SIA 3478，许可对28号跑道实施低空进近，通过跑道入口时不得低于跑道入口标高以上400英尺，报告最后进近。飞行员：许可对28号跑道实施低空进近，通过跑道入口时不得低于跑道入口标高以上400英尺，照办，SIA 3478。
问题：SIA 3478为什么请求低空进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Possible undercarriage problem

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, QFA 332, we are approaching the holding point. C: QFA 332, taxi into position and hold. Caution wake turbulence of the departing aircraft. Stand by for departure. P: Taxi into position and hold.
Question: What should the pilot be careful about?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，QFA 332，我们正在接近等待点。管制员：QFA 332，进跑道对正并等待。注意前方离场航空器的尾流，等待起飞。飞行员：进跑道对正并等待。
问题：飞行员应该注意什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Wake turbulence of departure aircraft
choicesZh: 离场航空器的尾流颠簸
离场航空器的微弱颠簸

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CSN 319, request descent. C: CSN 319, descend and maintain 4800m, rate of descent 2500ft per minute. P: descend and maintain 4800m, rate of descent 2500ft per minute, CSN 319.
Question: What information is not contained?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉管制，CSN 319，请求下降。管制员：CSN 319，下降并保持4800米，下降率每分钟2500英尺。飞行员：下降并保持4800米，下降率每分钟2500英尺，CSN 319。
问题：通话中没有包含哪项信息？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Climb rate.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 1365, Beijing Control, climb to and maintain 11000m. P: Request cruising level 9800m. Forecast weather is more favorable at this level, CCA 1365. C: Roger, CCA 1365, climb to and maintain 9800m, final level.
Question: Why has CCA 1365 requested a lower level?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 1365，北京管制，爬升并保持11000米。飞行员：请求巡航高度9800米，预报显示该高度的天气更有利，CCA 1365。管制员：收到，CCA 1365，爬升并保持9800米，作为最终高度。
问题：CCA 1365为什么请求较低的高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To save fuel or time.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 342, unknown traffic 10 o'clock 6 miles crossing left to right, height unknown, fast moving, if not sight, turn left heading 270. P: turn left heading 270, BAW 342. C: BAW 342, clear of traffic, resume own navigation, direct to LARIX. P: Wilco, BAW 342.
Question: Why did BAW 342 turn left?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 342，不明航空器在你10点钟方向、距离6海里，正从左向右穿越，高度不明，速度很快。如未目视该航空器，左转航向270。飞行员：左转航向270，BAW 342。管制员：BAW 342，已避开冲突航空器，恢复自主领航，直飞LARIX。飞行员：照办，BAW 342。
问题：BAW 342为什么左转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Danger of collision with another aircraft.
choices: Danger of collision with the ground.
Danger of collision with another aircraft.
choicesZh: 有与另一架航空器相撞的危险

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Tower, CSN 316, maintaining 1200m on the localizer Runway 36L. C: CSN 316, continue approach, traffic two o'clock landing Runway 36R, report traffic in sight. P: continue approach, wilco, CSN 316.
Question: What's the landing runway for the traffic at 2 o'clock?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉塔台，CSN 316，在36L跑道航向道上保持1200米。管制员：CSN 316，继续进近，2点钟方向有航空器在36R跑道着陆，目视该航空器时报告。飞行员：继续进近，照办，CSN 316。
问题：2点钟方向的航空器在哪条跑道着陆？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Runway 36R.

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Beijing Control, SIA442, Boeing777, fire in the rear toilet, descending 3600m, request emergency landing at Beijing airport, position 50 miles west of Beijing, heading 060.
C: SIA442, roger mayday, break, break, all stations on 126.3, stop transmitting, mayday.
Q: What is the position of SIA442?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，北京区调，新航442，波音777，后方厕所起火，下降到3600米，请求在北京机场紧急着陆，目前在北京以西50英里，航向060。
管制员：新航442，收到Mayday，断开，断开，所有各台停止发话，有遇险活动。
问：新航442的位置在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 50 miles west of Beijing.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 330, Beijing Control, radio check. You did not report over LADEX as instructed. CSN 330, Beijing Control. CSN 330, if you copy, squawk ident. CSN 330, transmitting on 121.5.
Question: What is happening between the air traffic controller and the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 330，北京区调，无线电检查。你飞越LADEX时没有按指令报告。CSN 330，北京区调。CSN 330，如能听到，请按应答机识别键。CSN 330，正在121.5频率上发射。
问题：空中交通管制员与飞行员之间发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio contact has been lost.

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Departure, KRU 2633, we have smoke coming from the back of the cabin, request level off at Flight Level 180 and return to land. C: KRU 2633, roger MAYDAY, climb and maintain Flight Level 180, you are Number one to land.
Question: What happened to the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，离场管制，KRU 2633，我们客舱后部有烟雾，请求在FL180改平并返场着陆。管制员：KRU 2633，收到MAYDAY，爬升并保持FL180，你是着陆第一顺位。
问题：飞机发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Smoke coming out from the rear cabin.
choices: Smoke coming out from the rear cabin.
Smoke coming out from the front cabin.
Smoke coming out from the avionics bay.
Smoke coming out from the rear toilet.

cards.audioText:
P: Approach, KLM 332, over TM18, estimating DA26, descending to 2400 meters on QNH. C: KLM 332, direct to DA, and hold at DA as published, due runway incursion accident. Expect approach clearance at 55.
Question: Why was KLM 332 instructed to hold at DA?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：进近管制，KLM 332，飞越TM18，预计26分钟到达DA，按QNH下降至2400米。
管制员：KLM 332，直飞DA，并按公布程序在DA等待，因跑道侵入事故。预计55分钟提供进近许可。
问题：为什么KLM 332被指示在DA等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due ground accident.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, ACA 342, port engine EGT exceeds limitation, suspect bird ingestion, request priority landing. C: ACA 342, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach, Runway 36R, you are number one.
Question: Why did the controller give Air Canada landing priority?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，ACA 342，左发排气温度（EGT）超过限制，怀疑吸入鸟类，请求优先着陆。
管制员（C）：ACA 342，右转航向330，允许仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近，36右跑道，你第一。
问题：管制员为何给予加拿大航空优先着陆？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Port engine overheat.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, BAW 132, 600 meters climbing. C: BAW 132, radar contact, follow LKO-1 departure. Climb to and maintain 2700 meters, expedite climb until passing 1500 meters. Report passing 2100 meters.
Question: what level did ATC clear BAW 132 to climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，BAW 132，高度600米，正在爬升。
管制员（C）：BAW 132，雷达已识别，沿LKO-1 离场程序飞行。爬升至并保持2700米，在通过1500米前加速爬升。通过2100米时报告。
问题：空管批准BAW 132爬升到什么高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 2700m.

cards.audioText:
P: SF594, over MEL 2000 ft, landing gear down, but maybe not locked. We intend to make a low pass near the tower to have the undercarriage checked. C: SF594, make a low pass at 2000 ft, heading 200, north of tower.
Question: what do the crew intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：SF594，飞过MEL， 2000英尺，起落架已放下，但可能未锁定。我们打算在塔台附近低空通场，以便检查起落架。
管制员（C）：SF594，以200度航向在塔台以北2000英尺处低空通场。
问题：机组人员打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Check the landing gear by making a low pass.
choices: Try to extend the landing gear.
Try to lock the landing gear.
Check the landing gear by making a low pass.
Check the landing gear at the present position.
choicesZh: 通过低空通场检查起落架
在当前位置检查起落架

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan approach, CCA 101, request return to your airport. Dense smoke reported in the rear cargo hold. C: CCA 101, Roger MAYDAY, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 1200 meters on QNH. Radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R.
Question: Why did CCA 101 return?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY（遇险紧急），武汉进近，CCA 101，请求返回机场。据报后货舱有浓烟。
管制员（C）：CCA 101，收到遇险信号，左转航向090，按QNH（场面气压）下降并保持1200米。雷达引导至36右跑道仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近。
问题：CCA 101为何返航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due dense smoke in rear cargo hold.
choices: Due dense smoke in avionics bay.
Due dense smoke in rear cargo hold.
choicesZh: 由于航空电子设备舱内有浓烟

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, JAL 728, the tow bar has bent during push back. We are waiting for them to get another one. C: JAL 728, report when ready to push. But if you take a little bit long time, we have to allocate you a new slot time.
Question: What will happen if the aircraft cannot be pushed back quickly?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：地面，JAL 728，在推出过程中牵引杆断了。我们正在等他们拿另一根来。
管制员（C）：JAL 728，准备好推出时报告。但如果你们耗时较长，我们将不得不给你们重新安排一个离场时间。
问题：如果飞机不能很快推出，会发生什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They will be delayed for departure.
choices: They will be delayed for departure.
They will have to wait for a new tow bar.
They will have to go back to stand.
choicesZh: 他们必须等待新的拖把

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, SAS 996, we've just skidded off taxiway C, and we can't seem to get back onto the paving. Left gear appears to be stuck in the mud. Can you send a tug around? C: SAS 996, standby. Ground handling say there'll be no available tug until 1115.
Question: why does the pilot need a tug?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：地勤，SAS 996，我们刚刚滑出了C滑行道，而且似乎无法回到滑行道的路面上。左侧起落架好像陷在泥里了。能派一辆牵引车过来吗？

cards.audioText:
JAL 309, encountered strong wind shear on final, Runway 21, gained 30 knots between 500 feet and tree hundred feet, followed by a loss of 35 knots between tree hundred feet and surface.

JAL 309，在Runway 21最后进近时遭遇强风切变，在500 feet至300 feet之间增速30 knots，随后在300 feet至地面之间减速35 knots。
问题：报告的风切变高度范围是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Between 500 feet and the surface.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, GBD, we can't remove the warning of takeoff configuration, there must be something wrong, we have to taxi back for check.
C: GBD, taxi via taxiway C and P to Gate 2, caution, there is an aircraft skidded off the taxiway near the intersection.

cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，GBD，我们无法消除起飞构型警告，肯定存在问题，必须滑行返回检查。

问题：GBD遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They cannot reset the warning of takeoff configuration.
choices: They cannot reset the warning of landing configuration.
They cannot reset the warning of takeoff configuration.
They have something wrong with the takeoff configuration.
They have something wrong with the undercarriage and flaps.
choicesZh: 他们无法复位着陆构型警告
他们无法复位起飞构型警告
他们的起飞构型存在问题
他们的起落架和襟翼存在问题

cards.audioText:
P: Hongkong Approach, CSN 303, we have been struck by lightning, rear fuselage damaged, right elevator lost, request priority landing and radar vector to final approach.
C: CSN 303, you are No.1 radar will assist you until landing.
Question: Which part of aircraft is damaged?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 香港进近，CSN 303，我们遭到雷击，后机身受损，右升降舵丢失，请求优先着陆并雷达引导至最后进近。
C: CSN 303，你是No. 1，雷达将协助你直至着陆。
问题：航空器哪个部位受损？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Rear fuselage

cards.audioText:
P: AFR 015, request offset to the right of course to detour the buildup present heading 180C: AFR 015, negative to the right due prohibited area, turn left 30 degrees track out 15 miles, to take you well clear of the hazardous weather.
Question: Why was not a right turn allowed?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: AFR 015，请求向航路右侧偏置以绕过积云堆积区，当前航向180。
C: AFR 015，由于右侧有禁区，不同意向右偏置。左转30度，偏航15 miles，使你完全避开危险天气。
问题：为什么不允许向右转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Due to forbidden area.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CSN 345.
C: CSN 345, go ahead.
P: There seems to be a bush fire just to the right of our position about 40 miles.

C: 位置已记录，谢谢，CSN 345。
问题：武汉管制为什么需要CSN 345的准确位置？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The flight had noticed a bush fire.
choices: The flight had made a position report.
The flight found a crash site
The flight had a cabin fire
The flight had noticed a bush fire.

该航班发现了一处坠机地点
该航班发现了丛林火灾

cards.audioText:

Because there was a broken tug on Runway 36.

cards.audioText:

P: 驾驶舱出现起飞构型警告，CSN 3286。
问题：CSN 3286为什么中断起飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due to takeoff configuration warning.

cards.audioText:
P: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Departure, American 2562, we need to return to Phoenix, we have low oil quantity in one of our engines.

They have low oil quantity in one of the engines.
They have low fuel quantity in one of the engines.
They have low fluid quantity in one of the engines.

cards.audioText:

C: ACA 1199，塔台，风向200度、风速10 knots、阵风17 knots，注意尾流，跟随B787，许可在Runway 24L着陆。
P: 许可在Runway 24L着陆，ACA 1199。
P: 我们正在复飞，ACA 1199。
C: ACA 1199，沿跑道航向，保持3000，需要任何协助吗？
P: 不需要，最后进近时有一名乘客跑进洗手间，所以我们无法着陆，ACA 1199。
问题：ACA 1199复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because they had a passenger that ran into the toilet on final.
choices: Because they encountered wake turbulence from Boeing 787.
Because they encountered strong crosswind on final.
Because they had a passenger that ran into the toilet on final.
Because they made an unstable approach on final.

因为他们在五边遭遇强侧风
因为一名乘客在五边时跑进洗手间
因为他们在五边进近不稳定

cards.audioText:

他们遇到电气系统问题

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. CCA 4307 reported a big white balloon from its left to right.
choices: CCA 4307 reported a big white balloon from its left to right.
CCA 4307 requested right turn to avoid the reported balloon.
The controller has seen the reported balloon on the radar.
The controller didn't approve CCA 4307's request to turn left.

CCA 4307请求右转避让所报告的气球
管制员已在雷达上看到所报告的气球
管制员未批准CCA 4307左转的请求

问题：JAL 783发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. JAL 783 encountered unlawful interference.

Other passengers attacked the male passenger.

其他乘客袭击了该男性乘客

Because they lost visual reference at minima.
Because they lost control of the passengers.
choicesZh: 因为他们与空管失去无线电联系
因为他们在最低标准处失去目视参考
因为他们无法控制乘客

cards.audioText:

P: Do you have alternate runway?
C: Runway 27L is available. Expect 15 minutes delay.
P: CA1, we will accept a little delay.
C: CA1, hold at present position, I can't approve it yet, opposite traffic on T.
Question: Which of the statements is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CA1，进入跑道等待。
P: Runway 14R上有一大群鸟。
C: CA1，那里一直都有鸟。
P: 有其他跑道吗？
C: Runway 27L可用，预计延误15分钟。
P: CA1，我们可以接受短暂延误。
C: CA1，在当前位置等待，我暂时无法批准，滑行道T上有对头航空器。
问题：以下哪项陈述正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The crew requests a different runway.
choices: The birds will be moved out of the way.
The delay is too long, so they accept the clearance.
The crew requests a different runway.
choicesZh: 延误时间太长，因此他们接受该许可
机组请求使用另一条跑道

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, ACA 3428 has intercepted an distress call from CCA 3256, I say again, CCA 3256, double engine failure, forced landing, current position 10 miles east of LAMOT, Over.
C: ACA 3248, roger your relayed MAYDAY for CCA 3256.
Question: What do you learn from the exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，ACA 3428截获了CCA 3256的遇险呼叫。我再说一遍，CCA 3256，双发失效，迫降，当前位置在LAMOT以东10 miles，完毕。
C: ACA 3248，已收到你转报的CCA 3256 MAYDAY。
问题：从这段通话中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Air China has an emergency.
choices: Air Canada has two engines failed
choicesZh: 加拿大航空遇到紧急情况
中国国际航空遇到紧急情况
加拿大航空有两台发动机失效

cards.audioText:
P1: Take the next right.
P2: Are you sure, this is the runway. We must missed the turn. Tell Ground, we are holding for instruction.
C: CCA0011just... call you, you missed Tango, you may proceed down 5L, which is not active, turn left on E, turn right on S to the runway, turn not miss S, or you will be on active runway.
Question: What did the crew do wrong?
cards.audioTextZh:
P1: 在下一个路口右转。
P2: 你确定吗？这是跑道。我们一定错过了转弯处。告诉地面，我们正在等待指示。
C: CCA 0011，刚才……呼叫你，你错过了T。你可以沿未启用的Runway 5L继续前行，左转进入E，再右转进入S前往跑道。不要错过S，否则你将进入使用中的跑道。
问题：机组做错了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. They missed the turn onto Tango.
choices: They are now on taxiway E.
They missed the turn onto Tango.
choicesZh: 他们错过了转入Tango滑行道的路口

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, Wuhan Tower, radar shows you are 200 feet above glide slope.
P: Tower, CCA 981, roger, we've just lost glide slope indication on the instrument, we are going around as published.
Question: What type of approach was CCA 981 flying before the Missed Approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 981，武汉塔台，雷达显示你高于下滑道200 feet。
P: 塔台，CCA 981，收到，我们刚刚失去仪表上的下滑道指示，正在按公布程序复飞。
问题：CCA 981复飞前实施的是什么类型的进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. ILS.

cards.audioText:
P: NWA 968, waiting at holding point 29, request return to the stand, the brakes are overheating.
C: roger, NWA 968, return to the holding bay, first convenient turn left onto taxiway J.
P: left turn onto Taxiway J, NWA 968.
Question: Which taxiway is NWA 968 to use?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: NWA 968，在29等待点等待，请求返回停机位，刹车过热。
C: 收到，NWA 968，返回等待坪，在第一个方便的路口左转进入滑行道J。
P: 左转进入滑行道J，NWA 968。
问题：NWA 968将使用哪条滑行道？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Taxiway J

cards.audioText:
instructed, CSN 330, Beijing Control, CSN 330, if you copy, squawk ident. CSN 330, Transmitting on 121.5.
Question: What is happening between the air traffic controller and the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh:
已指示，CSN 330。北京管制，CSN 330，如果收到，设置应答机识别。CSN 330，在121.5上发射。
问题：空中交通管制员与飞行员之间发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio contact has been lost.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN 3251, request taxi.
C: CSN 3251, for your information, KAL 236 and CCA 9018 both B747 nearly collided on Runway 14R one minute ago, Stay there now, I will call you back.
P: roger, CSN 3251.
Question: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，CSN 3251，请求滑行。
C: CSN 3251，提醒你，KAL 236和CCA 9018这两架B747在1分钟前差点于Runway 14R相撞。现在原地等待，我会再次呼叫你。
P: 收到，CSN 3251。
问题：发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was almost a collision on the runway.
choices: There was a crash on the runway.
There was almost a collision on the runway.
There was a vehicle on the runway.

cards.audioText:
P: Manchester Ground, UAL 94, we have hydraulic problem, we have lost nose wheel steering, we have to hold position and request send a tug to take us back to the gate.
C: roger, UAL 94, stand by.
C: UAL 94, suggest you shut down the engine, there is a tug for the flight.
P: UAL 94, roger.
Question: What problem does UAL 94 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 曼彻斯特地面，UAL 94，我们有液压问题，已失去前轮转向能力，必须原地等待，请求派一辆牵引车将我们拖回登机口。
C: 收到，UAL 94，稍等。
C: UAL 94，建议关闭发动机，已经为该航班安排了一辆牵引车。
P: UAL 94，收到。
问题：UAL 94有什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A hydraulic problem.
choices: The electrics in the nose of the aircraft.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR 121, Stand Z4, Information F, ready for pushback and startup.
C: AFR 121, the tug A blue for pushback has malfunctioned, I am sending another tug, stand by.
P: Wilco, AFR 121.
Question: Why does the controller ask AFR 121 to wait?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，AFR 121，Z4停机位，通播F，已准备好推出和启动。
C: AFR 121，用于推出的牵引车发生故障，我正在派另一辆牵引车，稍等。
P: 照办，AFR 121。
问题：管制员为什么要求AFR 121等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Tug has broken down
choices: There is a vehicle behind the aircraft

cards.audioText:
P: QFA 235, hold on taxiway A.
C: QFA 235, hold short for departure, you are No 2 after Airbus 320.
P: holding short, No 2 for departure, QFA 235.
C: QFA 235, line up and wait.
P: line up and wait, QFA 235.
Question: What was the departure sequence for QFA 235?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: QFA 235，在滑行道A上等待。
C: QFA 235，在跑道外等待离场，你排在A320之后，是No. 2。
P: 在跑道外等待，离场顺序No. 2，QFA 235。
C: QFA 235，进入跑道等待。
P: 进入跑道等待，QFA 235。
问题：QFA 235的离场顺序是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Number 2.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 201, have you reduced to approach speed? You are gaining on the aircraft ahead of you.
P: AFR 201, unable to reduce speed, we have problem with flaps.
C: AFR 201, go around immediately, turn left heading 140, climb and maintain 4000ft for resequence ILS Runway 23L.
Question: Why can't they reduce to approach speed?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: AFR 201，你减至进近速度了吗？你正在接近前方航空器。
P: AFR 201，无法减速，我们的襟翼有问题。
C: AFR 201，立即复飞，左转航向140，爬升并保持4000ft，重新排序实施Runway 23L ILS进近。
问题：他们为什么无法减至进近速度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They can't extend their flaps.
choices: They are coming in too fast.
choicesZh: 他们需要一条更长的跑道

cards.audioText:
P: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, CCA 320, B747, we have shut down No. 2 engine due to excessive vibration, heading now 120 degrees, 600m, current position 20 miles east of HJU, request return to your airport for immediate landing.
Question: What type of aircraft was CCA 320?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，CCA 320，B747，由于振动过大，我们已关闭No. 2发动机。当前航向120度、高度600m，当前位置在HJU以东20 miles，请求返回你机场立即着陆。
问题：CCA 320是什么机型？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Boeing 747

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 482, descend to FL290 now for crossing traffic, be leveled at FL290 in two minutes or less.
P: roger, Descend to FL290 in two minutes or less for crossing, leaving FL330 now, NWA 482.
Question: When should they begin their descent?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: NWA 482，为避让穿越航空器，立即下降至FL290，在2分钟或更短时间内在FL290改平。
P: 收到，为避让穿越航空器，在2分钟或更短时间内下降至FL290，现正离开FL330，NWA 482。
问题：他们应在什么时候开始下降？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Immediately.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, request go round the CB from the right.
C: CCA 101, negative due to prohibited area (=forbidden area). Turn left 40 degrees track out 30km, report clear of CB.
Question: Why was CCA 101 not allowed to turn to left?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉管制，请求从右侧绕飞CB。
C: CCA 101，由于有禁区，不同意。左转40度，偏航30km，避开CB后报告。
问题：为什么不允许CCA 101向左转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Forbidden area

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, AFR966, intercept distress call from DLH124. DLH124 has fuel emergency with 15 minutes endurance, request landing priority. The aircraft's position is 15 miles east at 9000 feet.
C: AFR966, roger, mayday, break, break.
Q: Which of the following statements is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，法航966，截获汉莎航路124的遇险信号，汉莎124燃油短缺，只有15分钟的续航时间了，请求优先着陆，飞机目前位置在以东15海里，高度9000英尺。
管制员：法航966，收到Mayday，断开，断开。
问：以下哪个表述是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. DLH124 has fuel trouble.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, AFR 973, we reject takeoff due red lights on the panel came on before V1, request vacating runway immediately, the figure is going on.
C: AFR 973, via first convenient intersection. Taxi via B6 to No. 2 apron.
Question: What reason caused AFR 973 to abort takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 塔台，AFR 973，由于在V1前面板上的红色警告灯亮起，我们中断起飞，请求立即脱离跑道，警报仍在持续。
C: AFR 973，从第一个方便的交叉口脱离，经B6滑行至No. 2停机坪。
问题：什么原因导致AFR 973中断起飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Red warning lights appeared before V1.
choices: Red lights were seen on the runway before V1.
Red lights on another aircraft came out before V1.
Red warning lights appeared before V1.
choicesZh: 在达到V1前看到跑道上有红灯
另一架飞机的红灯在达到V1前亮起
在达到V1前出现了红色飞行物
在达到V1前出现了红色警告灯

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Control, AFR 342, we lost pressurization, 9200m descending.
C: AFR 342, roger MAYDAY, break, break, all aircraft below 9200m between PB and MB immediately depart route A593 to the east due to emergency descent.
Question: What does Beijing control instruct all aircraft between PB and MB to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京管制，AFR 342，我们失去增压，正从9200m下降。
C: AFR 342，收到MAYDAY，断开，断开，因有紧急下降，PB和MB之间9200m以下的所有航空器立即向东脱离航路A593。
问题：北京管制指示PB和MB之间的所有航空器做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Leave route A593 to the east.
choices: Depart route A593 to the west.
Leave route A593 to the east.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, windshear warning, strong low level windshear observed in the vicinity of Beijing airport at 1400 hours, what's your intention?
P: we'd like to delay our approach 30 minutes, CCA 981.
Question: Why do they want to delay their approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 981，风切变警告，1400时在北京机场附近观测到强低空风切变，报告你的意图。
P: 我们希望将进近推迟30分钟，CCA 981。
问题：他们为什么希望推迟进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of wind condition.

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 785, the ground mechanics reported that two white navigational light and one stroke light below APU exhaust off.
P: is that so, we have to check the MEL.
P: Ground, JAL 785, it's not airworthy, we will taxi back to park for replacement.
Question: Why did the aircraft taxi back?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 785，地面机务人员报告，APU排气口下方的两盏白色航行灯和一盏频闪灯熄灭。
P: 是吗？我们必须检查MEL。
P: 地面，JAL 785，该航空器不适航，我们将滑行返回停机位更换故障灯。
问题：航空器为什么滑行返回？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Not within MEL requirements
choices: Not in an air operating condition
choicesZh: 不符合最低设备清单要求

cards.audioText:
BAW 309, we are unable to control pressurization, cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request immediate descent to FL120.
C: BAW 309, roger, descend to FL120, report reaching.
P: descending to FL120, wilco, BAW 309.
Question: Which level is the aircraft descending to and for what reason?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: BAW 309，我们无法控制增压，客舱高度正在迅速上升，请求立即下降至FL120。
C: BAW 309，收到，下降至FL120，到达后报告。
P: 正在下降至FL120，照办，BAW 309。
问题：航空器正下降至哪个高度层，原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. FL120 due to depressurization

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR 667, passing 6000ft, request FL250.
C: AFR 667, negative for FL250 for the moment, climb to FL210, expedite until passing FL170, report passing FL170 and FL190.
P: roger, climbing to FL210, and expediting, call you when passing FL170 and FL190, AFR 667.
Question: At which level should AFR 667 slow down climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 离场，AFR 667，正通过6000ft，请求FL250。
C: AFR 667，暂时无法批准FL250，爬升至FL210，加速爬升直至通过FL170，报告通过FL170和FL190。
P: 收到，爬升至FL210并加速爬升，通过FL170和FL190时呼叫你，AFR 667。
问题：AFR 667应在哪个高度层减小爬升率？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After passing FL170.

cards.audioText:
P: CCA 982, we are unable to lower the landing gear, request proceed to hold to have a complete check.
P: CCA 982, flaps are still jammed, we have manually cranked down the main gear, but not the nose gear, request emergency landing.
C: CCA 982, set heading to LR, and hold, report when ready to leave.
Question: What does the crew request initially?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: CCA 982，我们无法放下起落架，请求前往等待航线进行全面检查。
P: CCA 982，襟翼仍然卡住，我们已用手摇方式放下主起落架，但前起落架尚未放下，请求紧急着陆。
C: CCA 982，飞向LR并等待，准备离开时报告。
问题：机组最初提出了什么请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Join the holding pattern for check.
choices: Join the holding pattern for check.
Make a low pass for visual check.
choicesZh: 加入等待航线进行检查
低空通场以便目视检查

cards.audioText:
P: B Ground, DAL 153, request departure information.
C: DAL 153, runway in use for takeoff 18L, wind 260, 10 knots, gusting to 20 knots temperature 10, dew point 9, QNH1012 taxiway W between C and D partially closed due work in progress.
Question: Why is the taxiway partially closed?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: B地面，DAL 153，请求离场情报。
C: DAL 153，起飞使用Runway 18L，风向260度、风速10 knots、阵风20 knots，气温10度、露点9度，QNH 1012。由于正在施工，滑行道W在C和D之间部分关闭。
问题：为什么该滑行道部分关闭？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due work in progress.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Approach, CCA 981, No. 2 engine flamed out during climbing, we intend to return to land, but we have to dump 20 tons of fuel first.
C: CCA 982, set heading to YV, after passing YV, heading 350, to start dumping, upon completion, turn left heading 160 to YV, maintain 5100m.
Question: What can we learn from this exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 北京进近，CCA 981，No. 2发动机在爬升过程中熄火，我们打算返航着陆，但必须先放掉20 tons燃油。
C: CCA 982，飞向YV，通过YV后航向350，开始放油；完成后左转航向160返回YV，保持5100m。
问题：从这段通话中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. CCA 981's is too heavy to land safely.
choices: CCA 981's is too heavy to land safely.
CCA 981 is coming back due to bird ingestion.
CCA 981 is coming back due engine overheating.
CCA 981 is holding for fuel jettison.

cards.audioText:
Center, CCA 106, we are experiencing moderate icing between FL240 and 260, de-icing equipment is unserviceable, request descend to FL210.
CCA 106, descend to FL210, report reaching.
Question: What happened to CCA 106?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制，CCA 106，我们在FL240至FL260之间遭遇中度积冰，除冰设备失效，请求下降至FL210。
CCA 106，下降至FL210，到达后报告。
问题：CCA 106发生了什么情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They ran into moderate icing and de-icing equipment failed.
choices: They were caught in moderate icing between FL210 and 240.
They ran into moderate icing and de-icing equipment failed.
They were caught in thunderstorm between FL240 and 260.
They were caught in moderate icing and anti-icing equipment failed.
choicesZh: 他们在FL210至FL240之间遭遇中度结冰
他们遭遇中度结冰且除冰设备失效
他们在FL240至FL260之间遭遇雷暴
他们遭遇中度结冰且防冰设备失效

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 201, you are taking the wrong direction, taxiway F is closed due to emergency traffic. Turn left to taxiway D and A to the holding point of Runway 09.
P: Turn left to taxiway D and A to the holding point of Runway 09, UAL 201.
Question: Why was taxiway F closed?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 201，你的滑行方向错误，F滑行道因紧急航空器而关闭。左转，经D和A滑行道滑行至Runway 09等待点。
P: 左转，经D和A滑行道滑行至Runway 09等待点，UAL 201。
问题：F滑行道为什么关闭？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An emergency traffic had not vacated the taxiway F.
choices: Its lighting system was out of service.
A broken traffic had skidded off the runway.
An emergency traffic had not vacated the taxiway F.
An emergency traffic took the wrong direction.
choicesZh: 一辆故障车辆滑出跑道
一架紧急航空器尚未脱离F滑行道
一架紧急航空器走错了方向

cards.audioText:
Panpan, panpan, panpan, New York Tower, BAW 452, we have an engine fire warning light. We have completed emergency checklist procedure, warning light remains illuminated. However, there is no visible signs of fire. We will need to vacate the runway, request taxi instructions.
Question: What action did the crew take?
cards.audioTextZh:
PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，纽约塔台，BAW 452，我们的发动机火警灯亮起。我们已完成紧急检查单程序，但警告灯仍然亮着。不过，没有可见的起火迹象。我们需要脱离跑道，请求滑行指令。
问题：机组采取了什么行动？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They did the emergency checklist.
choices: They shut down the faulty engine.
They extinguished the fire on engine.
choicesZh: 他们执行了紧急检查单
他们关闭了故障发动机
他们扑灭了发动机火灾

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Sierra Approach, BAW 983, emergency descent from FL310 to FL120 due sudden and rapid depressurization, heading 190, approaching SEG.
C: BAW 983, roger Mayday. Squawk 7700, report reaching FL120. No traffic in your area.
Question: For what reason did the crew declare a distress call?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，Sierra进近，BAW 983，因突然且快速失压，正从FL310紧急下降至FL120，航向190，正在接近SEG。
C: BAW 983，收到MAYDAY。应答机7700，到达FL120时报告。你所在区域没有其他航空器。
问题：机组因为什么原因发出遇险呼叫？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Sudden depressurization.

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Urumqi Control, AFR561, request immediate descent, we're running into dust cloud, possible volcanic ashes, No.2 engine flame out.
CTL: AFR561, roger, descend to 8100m.
Q: What might the aircraft encounter?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，乌鲁木齐区调，法航561，请求立即下降，我们遇到尘雾，有可能是火山灰，2发熄火。
管：法航561，收到，下降8100米。
问：这架飞机可能遇到了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Volcanic ash

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, cleared for takeoff.
PIL: Taking off, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, stop immediately, I say again, stop immediately, flames coming from left main gear.
PIL: Stopping and activating escape slides, request emergency services, CCA102.
Q: Why did the pilot activate escape slides?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，可以起飞。
飞：起飞，国航102.
管：国航102，立即终止，重复一遍，立即终止，左主起落架冒烟。
飞：停下，打开逃生滑梯，请求紧急服务，国航102。
问：为什么飞行员打开逃生滑梯？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Main gear on fire

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CSN6104, No.2 engine failure, request back to apron.
CTL: CSN6104, roger, is there any other problem?
PIL: Affirm, APU inoperative, the crossbleed valve malfunctioned, request taxi back via shortest route, CSN6104.
Q: Which problem did the pilot NOT report?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，南航6104，二发失效，请求返回停机坪。
管：南航104，收到，还有其他问题么？
飞：是的，APU失效，交输活门故障，请求按最短路线滑行回停机坪，南航6104。
问：飞行员未报告哪种问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Pressurization

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, CCA102, electrical failure due lightning, emergency circuit still functioning, request divert to the nearest airport.
CTL: CCA102, roger Mayday, cleared to divert to Wuhan, descend to 8100m, turn right heading 090, radar vectors.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is NOT correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，武汉区调，国航102，由于闪电，电气故障，应急电路仍能工作，请求改航到最近的机场。
管：国航102，收到Mayday求救信号，可以改航到武汉，下降8100米，右转航向090，雷达引导。
问：根据对话，下列哪个选项是错误的？
choices: The aircraft was struck by lightning
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was no backup power

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN203, Wuhan Approach. Read you 2. I say again, turn right heading 330 and descend to 4200m.
PIL: Roger, right heading 330 and descend to 4200m, leaving 6000m. We had a lightning strike, suspect some trouble with radios. Operations are normal now, CSN203.
Q: Which of the following problems might the aircraft have encountered?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航203，武汉进近。听你2个。重复一遍，右转航向330，下降4200米。
飞：收到，右转航向330，下降4200米，离开6000米。我们遇到雷击，怀疑无线电故障。目前操作正常，南航203。
问：飞机可能遇到下列哪种问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio lost

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, climb to 11600m.
PIL: Unable CCA121. That's too high for us. Request climb to 11300m.
CTL: CCA121, negative, only even levels available. Maintain 10100m or change request.
Q: What was the controller's intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，上11600米。
飞：不能，国航121。太高了。请求上11300米。
管：国航121，不行，只有偶数高度可用。保持10100米或更换请求。
问：管制员说的是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 10400 meters and 11000 meters were available

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ground, CCA121, request a tug around, we've just skidded off taxiway C, we can't get back on to the apron, left gear appears to be stuck in the mud.
CTL: CCA121, standby, ground handling says there is no tug available until 1015.
Q: According to the exchange, why did the pilot need a tug?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：地面，国航121，请求拖车，我们刚刚冲出了滑行道C，无法回到停机坪，左起落架似乎陷进泥里。
管：国航121，稍等，地勤说到10：15才有拖车可用。
问：根据对话，飞行员为什么需要拖车？
choices: The steering system was out of order
The aircraft could not get out of the mud
The pilot was not familiar with the taxiway
choicesZh: 飞行员不熟悉该滑行道
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The aircraft could not get out of the mud

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Departure, CCA101, request return to airport, dense smoke coming out of No.4 engine nacelle, suspect fire.
CTL: CCA101, roger MAYDAY. Turn left heading 090.
Q: What might have caused the pilot to request return?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京离场，国航101，请求返回机场，4号发动机舱有浓烟冒出，疑似着火。
管：国航101，收到MAYDAY。左转航向090。
问：造成飞行员要求返航的原因可能是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Engine cowling fire

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Shanghai Approach, AFR230 heavy, request immediate landing, we were hit by a light aircraft.
CTL: AFR230, roger MAYDAY. Maintain heading, you are number one. Confirm current condition.
PIL: Left aileron is out of control due torn-off wing tip, AFR230.
Q: According to the dialogue, which part of the aircraft was hit?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，上海进近，法航230重型，请求立即降落，我们和一架小型飞机相撞了。
管：法航230，收到MAYDAY。保持航向，你是第一个。确认当前状况。
飞：由于翼尖脱落，左副翼失控，法航230。
问：根据对话，飞机哪部分被撞了？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The left wing tip

cards.audioText:
PIL: Control, AFR126, over SZ, maintaining 11300m, TZH 01, estimate KM at 45.
CTL: AFR126, direct to KM, HUR then LADIX.
PIL: Roger, direct to KM, then LADIX, AFR126.
CTL: AFR126, direct to KM, HUR then LADIX.
Q: According to the controller, which of the following tracks should AFR126 fly?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：区调，法航126，飞过SZ，保持11300米，到达TZH时间01分，预计到达KM时间45分。
管：法航126，直飞KM，HUR，LADIX。
飞：收到，直飞KM，LADIX，法航126。
管：法航126，直飞KM，HUR，LADIX。
问：根据管制员的话，法航126应按下列哪个航迹飞行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. KM, HUR, LADIX

cards.audioText:
PIL: Departure, CES321, passing 1800m, climbing to 5100m. Request climbing to 5400m.
CTL: CES321, initially climb to 5100m, report passing 2400m.
PIL: Climb to 5100m, wilco, CES321.
Q: What should CES321 do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：离场，东方321，过1800米，爬升5100米。请求爬升5400米。
管：东方321，起始爬升5100米，过2400米报告。
飞：爬升5100米，东方321照办。
问：东方321接下来要做什么？
choices: Climb to 5400 meters and request clearance for 2400 meters
Tell ATC when reaching and maintaining 2400 meters
Climb to 5100 meters and report when climbing through 2400 meters
Climb to 5100 meters and report before reaching 2400 meters
choicesZh: 爬升到5100米，到达2400米之前叫
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Climb to 5100 meters and report when climbing through 2400 meters

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, Departure, radar contact, cancel SID turn left heading 360, maintain 5400m, expect short delay at that level due crossing traffic.
PIL: Roger. Cancel SID, turn left heading 360 and maintain 5400m, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, traffic is well cleared now, climb to and maintain 6600m.
Q: What should CCA121 do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，离场，雷达已识别，取消SID，左转航向360，由于交叉活动保持5400米，预计短时延误。
飞：收到。取消SID，左转航向360，保持5400米，国航121。
管：国航121，活动没影响，爬升6600米保持。
问：国航121接下来应该做什么？
choices: Report clear of traffic and continue climbing
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Climb from 5400 meters to 6600 meters

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Approach, NWA476, request priority landing. We've got a passenger on board who developed a fever and two passengers next to him had slight coughs, suspected swine flu cases.
CTL: NWA476, descend to 3000m, straight in approach runway 18R, first to land.
Q: Why did NWA476 request priority landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京进近，美西北476，请求优先着陆。机上有一名乘客发烧，挨着他的两名乘客轻微咳嗽，疑似感染流感。
管：美西北476，下降3000米，跑道18右，直接进近，第一个着陆。
问：美西北476为什么请求优先着陆？
choices: There was a suspected case of severe asthma
A passenger had a slight cough
There were suspected cases of swine flu
choicesZh: 机上有人疑似严重哮喘
机上疑似有人患了流感
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There were suspected cases of swine flu

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CSN309, what are the delays like? We've been holding for over 30mins.
CTL: CSN309, Beijing Control. Still waiting for military clearance.
PIL: If clearance not available, request radar vector to deviate military airspace, CSN309.
CTL: CSN309, now cleared, turn right direct to WXI.
Q: What did the crew want to do to avoid further delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，南航309，延误怎么样了？我们已经等了30多分钟了。
管：南航309，北京区调。继续等待空军放行。
飞：如果不能放行，请求雷达引导偏离军事活动空域，南航309。
管：南航309，活动清除，右转直飞WXI。
问：为了避免延迟更久，飞行员想做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Circumnavigate the military airspace

cards.audioText:
PIL: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, CSN309. Decompression in the cockpit. Request priority landing. We heard a thump, our windshield panel appears to be cracked by hailstones.
CTL: CSN309. Roger PANPAN. Report your position.
PIL: 3 miles DME north of BOBAK at 6000m, CSN309.
CTL: CSN309, follow BOBAK01 Arrival, runway 36L, you are number one.
Q: According to the pilot's report, which is NOT correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，南航309。座舱失压。请求优先降落。我们听到了重击声，风挡好像被雹暴击碎了。
管：南航309。收到PANPAN。报告你的位置。
飞：BOBAK北部3海里，高度6000米，南航309。
管：南航309，BOBAK01进场，跑道36左，你第一个着陆。
问：根据飞行员的报告，下列叙述哪个是错误的？
choices: The windshield appears to be cracked
There's been a sudden loss of cabin pressure
The pilot is requesting priority landing.
choicesZh: 飞行员正在请求优先降落
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The captain is unconscious

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, Beijing Tower, go around, I say again go around, the preceding aircraft is unable to vacate the runway.
PIL: Going around, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, orbit right, runway still blocked.
PIL: Wilco, CCA102.
Q: Why should CCA102 make missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，北京塔台，复飞，再说一遍，复飞，前机无法脱离跑道。
飞：复飞，国航102。
管：国航102，右转机动，跑道仍不可用。
飞：收到，国航102。
问：国航102为什么要复飞？
choices: There was debris on the runway
Another aircraft was taking off on the runway
Another aircraft was on the runway
choicesZh: 跑道上有其它飞机正在起飞
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Another aircraft was on the runway

cards.audioText:
PIL: CSN3471, ready to depart F for landing, expect a normal landing.
CTL: CSN3471, turn left heading 350 for right base runway 18L.
PIL: Left heading 350, runway 18L, CSN3471.
Q: What was CSN3471 doing prior to the controller's instructions?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：南航3471，准备离开F降落，预计正常着陆。
管：南航3471，左转航向350右四边进入跑道18左。
飞：左转航向350，跑道18左，南航3471。
问：收到管制员指令前南航3471在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Engaged in a holding pattern

cards.audioText:
PIL: Guangzhou Approach, CSN332. Request return to Guangzhou airport. We are unable to deploy our speed brake, possible structural damage.
CTL: CSN332, roger. Turn left, direct to YKI. Further track shortening and runway will advise shortly.
Q: What problem did CSN332 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：广州进近，南航332。请求返回广州机场。我们无法减速刹车，可能操作故障。
管：南航332，收到。左转直飞YKI。进一步缩短航迹，一会儿通知你跑道。
问：南航332遇到了什么问题？
choices: There was something wrong with speed brake
They couldn't land on the long runway
choicesZh: 他们不能在长跑道上降落
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. There was something wrong with speed brake

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, CCA101, engine fire, on short final, request fire services on arrival.
CTL: Fire services on arrival, roger, CCA101. Do you require an ambulance?
PIL: Affirm. Request emergency evacuation on arrival, CCA101.
Q: What will CCA101 not require on arrival?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，国航101，发动机失火，短五边，请求到达时提供消防服务。
管：到达时提供消防服务，收到，国航101。需要救护车么？
飞：是的。请求到达时紧急疏散，国航101。
问：到达时国航101不需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Emergency separation

cards.audioText:
PIL: Harbin Control, CES2301, maintaining FL180, ice building up on windshield, confirm severe icing in the area?
CTL: CES2301, descend to and maintain FL150, severe icing from FL180 upward.
Q: Why should CES2301 descend to FL150?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：哈尔滨区调，东方2301，保持高度层180，风挡上结冰，确认该区域是否有严重积冰？
管：东方2301，下降高度层150保持，高度层180以上有严重积冰。
问：东方2301为什么要下降高度层150？
choices: Because they are waiting for further instructions
Because of severe icing over FL180
Because of severe icing over FL150
choicesZh: 因为它们正在等待下一步指示
因为高度层180上有严重积冰
因为高度层150上有严重积冰
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of severe icing over FL180

cards.audioText:
PIL: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CCA102, bird strike, aircraft under control, but No.1 engine flame out after bird ingestion, require landing but request dump fuel for 8mins first.
CTL: Roger PAN, CCA102. Proceed to YV at 4200m, after passing YV, heading 350 for dumping.
Q: What caused the engine problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉进近，国航102，鸟击，飞机可控，但由于吸鸟，1号发动机熄火，需要降落，但请求先放油8分钟。
管：收到PAN，国航102，直飞YV，高度4200米，飞过YV后，航向350放油。
问：造成发动机故障的原因是什么？
choices: The aircraft was struck by unidentified objects
The captain could not control the aircraft
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The aircraft suffered bird ingestion

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, CES5402, we heard a loud explosion, severe vibration on the left side, we might be in some trouble here.
CTL: CES5402, roger MAYDAY. Advise intentions.
PIL: Standby. We're sorting out what is going on, CES5402.
CTL: CES5402, roger.
Q: What did the pilot intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，东方5402，我们听到巨大的爆炸声，左侧剧烈震动，我们可能遇到麻烦了。
管：东方5402，收到MAYDAY。请示意图。
飞：稍等，我们正在检查原因，东方5402。
管：东方5402，收到。
问：飞行员想做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Identify the problem

cards.audioText:
