PIL: Beijing Control, UAL897, POLHO 42, 10700m maintaining, squawk 0026, request 11300m.
CTL: UAL897, Beijing, radar contact, can you accept 11900m? If unable, descend to 10100m.
Q: Which levels are available for UAL897?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，美联航897，到达POLHO时间为42分，保持10700米，应答机0026，请求11300米。
管：美联航897，北京，雷达已识别，能否接受11900米？如不能，下降10100米。
问：美联航897可以在哪一高度飞行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 11900 meters or 10100 meters

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, CCA102 estimating VW 32, descending to 3600m.
CTL: CCA102, Wuhan, hold at VW as published, expect further clearance at 49, landing delays due to military activity.
Q: According to the statement, how long would the aircraft be delayed?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉区调，国航102，预计到达VW时间为32分，下降至3600米。
管：国航102，武汉，在VW标准等待，由于空军活动，预计等待时间为49分。
问：根据叙述，飞机要延误多长时间？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 17 minutes

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ramp Control, CES256, the catering truck has not arrived, could you check it for me?
CTL: CES256, since there are a lot of diverting aircraft, catering will be slower than usual. Call you back.
Q: According to the statement, what might be the cause of the delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：机坪，东方256，配餐车还没到，能帮我查一下么？
管：东方256，由于备降飞机很多，配餐会比平时慢一些。稍等叫你。
问：根据叙述，造成延误的可能原因是？
choices: The catering truck got some problem
The catering workers were on strike
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Too many aircraft needed catering

cards.audioText:
PIL: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Beijing Approach, AFR261, 30 miles east of KM at 6300m, epidemic on board, request priority landing and quarantine measures.
CTL: Roger PAN, AFR261, priority landing approved, we'll report to organize evacuation.
Q: According to the passage, why evacuation should be taken?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，北京进近，法航261，KM以东30海里，6300米，飞机上有传染病人，请求优先降落并实施检疫措施。
管：收到PAN，法航261，可以优先降落，我们将报告并组织援救。
问：根据对话，为什么要实施援救？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was pandemic on board

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Control, CCA102 heavy, request return to Beijing, rear cabin on fire.
CTL: CCA102 heavy, roger. Confirm dangerous cargo on board?
PIL: We have some chemicals for industrial use in the hold, CCA102.
Q: According to the report, what kind of cargo is on board?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京区调，国航102重型，请求返回北京，后舱失火。
管：国航102重型，收到。确认机上是否有危险物品。
飞：货舱内有一些化工用品，国航102。
问：根据报告，机上有哪种货物？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Industrial chemicals

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, Beijing Control, descend to FL260, thunderstorms reported 20 miles ahead of you.
PIL: Roger, request proceed offset 10 miles right of track, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, approved, when cleared of weather, direct to VYK.
Q: What did the crew request?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，北京区调，下降高度层260，报告显示你前方20海里处有雷暴。
飞：收到，请求右偏10海里，国航102。
管：国航102，同意，天气好转后，直飞VYK。
问：机组做了什么请求？
choices: Right divert 10 miles due to storm activity
Left divert 10 miles due to storm activity
Right divert 20 miles due to storm activity
choicesZh: 由于风暴活动，右偏航迹10英里
由于风暴活动，左偏航迹10英里
由于风暴活动，右偏航迹20英里
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Right divert 10 miles due to storm activity

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA918, unidentified helicopter traffic in this area, 1800m unverified, report traffic in sight.
PIL: Roger, CCA918.
CTL: CCA918, if unable to sight that traffic, hold present position.
PIL: Wilco, CCA918.
Q: Under what condition should CCA918 hold position?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航918，该区域内有不明直升机，1800米未核实，看到它报告。
飞：收到，国航918。
管：国航918，如不能看到活动，原地等待。
飞：照办，国航918。
问：在何种情况下，国航918应原地等待？
choices: The flight level of helicopter was unverified
An identified helicopter blocked the track.
The traffic above 1800 meters was unverified
choicesZh: 直升机飞行高度未核实
一不明直升机堵住航道
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The flight level of helicopter was unverified

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA102, maintaining 7500m, heading 110, request 9500m.
CTL: CCA102, negative. 8900m approved. Report reaching 8100m.
PIL: Roger, CCA102.
Q: According to the instruction, at which level should CCA102 report?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航102，7500米保持，航向110，请求9500米。
管：国航102，不同意。同意8900米，8100米时报告。
飞：收到，国航102。
问：根据指令，国航102应在哪个高度报告？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 8100 meters

cards.audioText:
PIL: Delivery, CCA102, request 15-minute delay for takeoff. Two passengers couldn't board due disease outbreak, so we have to off-load their luggage.
CTL: CCA102, roger delay, expedite unloading.
Q: Why did the crew request a delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：放行，国航102，请求延迟15分钟起飞。两名乘客疾病发作无法登机，我们必须卸下他们的行李。
管：国航102，收到，加快速度。
问：为什么机组请求推迟？
choices: They must unload the overweight luggage
They must unload the luggage of two passengers
choicesZh: 机组必须卸下超重行李
机组必须卸下两名乘客的行李
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They must unload the luggage of two passengers

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CES328, TCAS indicates opposite traffic climbing towards us. Can you confirm that traffic's intended level?
CTL: CES328, roger. That traffic is climbing to FL310, left converging and will cross from your 11 o'clock.
Q: Which is NOT correct according to the passage?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，东方328，TCAS显示有相对活动正在上升，你能确认那架飞机的目标高度层吗？
管：东方328，收到。那架飞机正上升到高度层310，左侧汇入并且从你11点钟方向穿过。
问：根据以上内容，哪项是不正确的？
choices: The traffic appeared to be climbing towards CES328
The traffic was to the right of CES328
The traffic would pass under CES328 without incident
choicesZh: 活动似乎在朝东方328上升
活动会从东方328下方安全通过
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The traffic was to the right of CES328

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, BAW245, 45km southeast of Beijing at 8900m, estimate POLHO at 55, request cross route R343 at POLHO.
CTL: BAW245, Beijing Control, cross R343 at POLHO approved, 55 or before.
Q: When should the pilot cross R343?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，英航245，北京东南方45千米，8900米，预计POLHO 55分，请求在POLHO穿过R343航路。
管：英航245，北京区调，同意POLHO 55分或之前穿过R343航路。
问：飞行员应该在何时穿过R343航路？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. No later than 55

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, report sighting traffic on your 11 o'clock below.
PIL: Looking, CCA121.
PIL: Negative contact, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, a 747 on your 12 o'clock below, now ahead of you on final for runway 18L, report in sight.
PIL: Still negative contact, advise, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, standby.
Q: What did the pilot report?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，在你下方11点方向的活动可见时报告。
飞：正在观察，国航121。
飞：无法看到，国航121。
管：国航121，一架747在你下方12点方向，现在在你前方18左五边上，能见报。
飞：仍然无法看到，请通知，国航121。
管：国航121，稍等。
问：飞行员报告的是什么情况？
choices: He could not see the 747 and wanted to climb
He could see the 747 and wanted to know what to do
He could not see the 747 and wanted to know what to do
He could see the 747 and was talking to the pilot
choicesZh: 他能看到747并想知道该怎样做
他看不到747并想知道该怎样做
他能看到747并正在和747的飞行员对话
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. He could not see the 747 and wanted to know what to do

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA201, leaving FL250 for FL200.
CTL: CCA201, Beijing Control, your transmission is partly broken up. Confirm leaving flight level 240?
PIL: Negative. We're leaving 250. I say again 250, CCA201.
CTL: CCA201, roger.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航201，从高度层250离开下降到高度层200。
管：国航201，北京区域，通讯有断续，确认离开高度层240？
飞：不同意，我们正离开250，我重复一遍250，国航201。
管：国航201，收到。
问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: The controller made a wrong instruction
The pilot made a mistake in transmitting
The controller had trouble reading the transmission
choicesZh: 飞行员在传送时出现错误
管制员在接收电文时遇到问题
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The controller had trouble reading the transmission

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, UAL782, we have fast moving traffic in front of us. It appears to be a military aircraft. We don't have it on our TCAS, can you see it?
CTL: UAL782, we don't see it on our radar either, probably a fighter without a transponder or not using it.
Q: According to the exchange, what was the pilot's main concern?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，美联航782，前方有快速移动活动，似乎是一架军用飞机。TCAS上没有显示，你能看到它吗？
管：美联航782，我们在雷达上也没有看到它，可能是一架没有应答机或不使用应答机的战斗机。
问：根据对话，飞行员主要关注的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Conflicting aircraft

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Departure, CCA102, passing 1200m, climbing to 4500m.
CTL: CCA102, Beijing Departure, radar shows you squawking 4261, squawk 4621 and reconfirm your level.
PIL: Apologies, now squawking 4621, passing 2100m, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, roger.
Q: What should the aircraft's transponder code be?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京离场，国航102，正通过1200米，上升到4500米。
管：国航102，北京离场，雷达显示你的应答机编码为4261，改变编码为4621并重新确认你的高度。
飞：抱歉，现在应答机编码为4621，通过2100米，国航102.
管：国航102，收到。
问：飞机的应答机编码应该是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Squawk 4621

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CSN205, port engine has some problems, request hold present position for 15 minutes.
CTL: CSN205, do you require any other assistance?
PIL: Negative, thanks, our engineer has just arrived, CSN205.
CTL: CSN205, roger, call again at 0012.
Q: According to the exchange, what should CSN205 do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，南航205，左舷发动机故障，请求当前位置等待15分钟。
管：南航205，还需要其它援助吗？
飞：不需要，谢谢，我们的工程师刚赶到，南航205。
管：南航205，收到，0012时再次呼叫。
问：根据对话，南航205下一步应该怎样做？
choices: Hold and wait 15 minutes for engineer to arrive
Remain in position while an engineer is called
Remain in position for an engine check
choicesZh: 原地等待，0012时呼叫工程师
原地等待，等待工程师15分钟
在当前位置呼叫工程师
在当前位置检查发动机
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Remain in position for an engine check

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA102, request holding instructions.
CTL: CCA102, Beijing, cleared to hold over WG, maintain 8400m, holding inbound track 110 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time one and a half minutes, expect further clearance in 10 minutes.
Q: According to the controller, which holding instruction is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航102，请求等待指令。
管：国航102，北京，可以在WG等待，保持8400米，等待入航边航迹110度，左等待，出航时间1分半，预计等待10分钟。
问：根据管制员所说，哪个等待指令是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Holding inbound track 110 degrees

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Tower, CES2015, aborting takeoff. Request taxi instruction due hydraulic warning light.
CTL: CES2015, roger, second vacated report.
PIL: First vacated, correction second vacated report, CES2015.
Q: According to the exchange, why did CES2015 abort takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉塔台，东方2015，中断起飞。液压警示灯亮，请求滑行指令。
管：东方2015，收到，第二次脱离时报告。
飞：第一次脱离，更正，第二次脱离，东方2015。
问：根据对话，为什么东方2015中断起飞？
choices: They had been given incorrect instructions
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They had a hydraulic problem

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL785, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
PIL: Approach, we prefer a visual approach to runway 36L, this will save time, UAL785.
CTL: Negative, the visibility is too low, you have to make a precision approach, the glide path of runway 36L is inoperative.
Q: What did UAL785 request?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：美联航785，使用36右盲降进近。
飞：进近，我们希望跑道36左目视进近，可以节省时间，美联航785。
管：不同意，可见度太低，必须精密进近，跑道36左下滑道不可用。
问：美联航785请求的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Visual approach runway 36L

cards.audioText:
PIL: Approach, ACA626, what is the delay like?
CTL: ACA626, delay uncertain, snow is picking up, say intention.
PIL: Approach, ACA626, standby, we'll contact our dispatcher, call you back.
Q: According to the exchange, what was the cause of the delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：进近，加航626，延误情况如何？
管：加航626，延误时间不确定，雪越来越大，说明意图。
飞：进近，加航626，稍等，我们会联系签派，稍后呼叫你。
问：根据对话，延误的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Snow was getting heavier

cards.audioText:
CTL: ACA2712, Beijing Approach, do you need fuel dumping?
PIL: Beijing Approach, ACA2712, we are not equipped with jettison gear, request radar vector for holding to consume some fuel.
CTL: ACA2712, turn right heading 350 to HUR hold as published.
Q: What did the pilot intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：加航2712，北京进近，飞机需要放油吗？
飞：北京进近，加航2712，飞机未配备放油装置，请求雷达引导等待航线来消耗燃油。
管：加航2712，按公布程序右转航向350至HUR等待。
问：飞行员想怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Waste fuel before approach

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA918, hold at holding point D, give way to A320 passing left to right.
PIL: Holding at D, CCA918.
PIL: Ground, CCA918, traffic is cleared, request continue taxi.
CTL: CCA918, cross D, then taxi via C and J to holding point runway 26.
Q: How should CCA918 taxi to holding point runway 26?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航918，在等待点D等待，给从左向右通过的A320让路。
飞：在D点等待，国航918。
飞：地面，国航918，飞机已通过，请求继续滑行。
管：国航918，穿过D，然后经C和J滑到跑道26等待点。
问：国航918应该如何滑到跑道26等待点？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Via C and J

cards.audioText:
PIL: Guangzhou Control, CSN256, clear of weather, visual an unverified aircraft northeast, our aircraft shook suddenly due wake turbulence.
CTL: CSN256, confirm anything abnormal?
PIL: I will check, standby, CSN256.
Q: According to the passage, what did CSN256 encounter?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：广州区调，南航256，天气没影响，东北方向可见不明飞机，由于尾流我们突然开始晃动。
管：南航256，确认一切正常？
飞：我会进行检查，稍等，南航256。
问：根据内容，南航256遭遇到什么情况？
choicesZh: 由天气引发的严重颠簸
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Wake flow from unidentified aircraft

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN326 confirm squawking 7500?
PIL: Affirm, CSN326. We have to go to Hong Kong airport but there's not enough fuel, we must divert to Zhengzhou airport for that.
Q: What should CSN326 do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航326，确认应答机7500？
飞：是的，南航326。我们要飞往香港机场，但飞机没有足够燃油，我们必须备降郑州机场。
问：南航326下一步应该怎样做？
choices: Divert to Hong Kong airport due to hijack
Change its final destination to Zhengzhou airport
choicesZh: 由于劫机，备降香港机场
将目的地改为郑州机场
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Refuel at Zhengzhou airport

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CES205, going around.
CTL: CES205, roger, go around as published.
CTL: CES205, if able, report problem.
PIL: ECAM indicated nose landing gear alignment failure, CES205.
Q: Which of the following might have caused the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京塔台，东方205，复飞。
管：东方205，收到，按程序复飞。
管：东方205，如有可能，报告问题。
飞：ECAM显示前起落架对准失效，东方205。
问：东方205复飞是由以下哪个原因引发？
choices: The glide slope was too low
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Nose landing gear deviation

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA102, passing 9200m.
CTL: CCA102, roger. Are you able to cross INTIK at 0053?
PIL: Affirm, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, cross INTIK 0053 or later due spacing.
Q: When should CCA102 cross INTIK?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航102，过9200米。
管：国航102，收到。0053时能通过INTIK吗？
飞：可以，国航102。
管：国航102，由于间隔，0053或之后通过INTIK。
问：国航102应该在何时穿过INTIK？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 0053 or later

cards.audioText:
PIL: Control, CSN518, TCAS descent, TCAS indicates fast moving traffic. We are following RA instructions to avoid the conflict.
CTL: CSN518, roger, military activity nearby, possibly a fighter according to its speed.
Q: According to the passage, what should the pilot do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：区调，南航518，TCAS指示下降，TCAS显示快速移动活动，我们正跟随RA指令避开冲突。
管：南航518，收到，附近有军事活动，根据速度可能是战斗机。
问：根据以上内容，飞行员接下来应怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Descend following RA instruction

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, request VOR/DME position report.
PIL: 25 miles from VYK on the 320 radial, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, traffic 10 o’clock, 25 kilometers southeast bound, A330 3000m maintaining, report traffic in sight.
PIL: Traffic in sight, CCA102.
Q: What was CCA102’s current position?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，请求VOR/DME位置报。
飞：距离VYK的320°径向线25海里处，国航102。
管：国航102，10点方向有活动向东南25千米，A330 3000米保持，活动可见时报告。
飞：活动可见，国航102。
问：国航102当前的位置在哪里？
choices: 10 miles from VYK on the 320 radial
25 miles from VYK on the 320 radial
25 kilometers from VYK on the 330 radial
25 kilometers from VYK on the 300 radial
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 25 miles from VYK on the 320 radial

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shenyang Control, CCA1463, de-icing equipment failure, request descent to 7500m or lower.
CTL: CCA1463, maintain present level for 02 minutes due to traffic.
PIL: Negative, leading edges iced over, request immediate descent, CCA1463.
CTL: CCA1463, roger, turn right heading 090, descend to 6300m.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：沈阳区调，国航1463，除冰故障，请求下降到7500米或更低。
管：国航1463，由于活动，保持当前高度2分钟。
飞：不同意，前缘结冰，请求立即下降，国航1463。
管：国航1463，收到，右转航向090，下降到6300米。
问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: There is probably ice above 7500 meters
There is probably ice above 6300 meters
The aircraft will descend 2 minutes later
The wind shear is iced over
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There is probably ice above 7500 meters

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, bird strike reported by a preceding aircraft.
PIL: Roger, CCA101.
PIL: Tower, CCA101, suspect a balloon to the east of the airport, height about 300m.
CTL: Roger, CCA101, we'll check.
Q: According to the statement, which of the following is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航101，前方飞机报告鸟击。
飞：收到，国航101。
飞：塔台，国航101，机场东部疑似有气球，高度大约300米。
管：收到，国航101，会进行检查。
问：根据陈述，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: There was a kite to the east of the airport
The aircraft reported an emergency at 300 meters
There was a balloon to the east of the airport
choicesZh: 飞机在300米报告紧急情况
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. There was a balloon to the east of the airport

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN1457, caution unscheduled taxiway work near the intersection of taxiway A and L just ahead. Are you able to taxi around that area for full length?
PIL: Affirm, request taxi around the work, CSN1457.
CTL: CSN1457, the alternative is an intersection departure from taxiway K.
PIL: Roger, CSN1457.
Q: According to the controller, which taxiway is the alternative?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航1457，注意前方滑行道A和L交叉点附近的计划外施工，你能绕施工区域滑行用全跑道吗？
飞：同意，请求绕施工区域滑行，南航1457。
管：南航1457，备选从滑行道K交叉点离场。
飞：收到，南航1457。
问：根据管制员所说，哪条滑行道是备选？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Taxiway K

cards.audioText:
CTL: ACA108, Beijing Tower, confirm you are approaching runway 18L? It seems that you are on the final of 18R.
PIL: Affirm for 18R. Sorry, we made a mistake. Is runway 18L still available? ACA108.
CTL: ACA108, do you have visual of 18L?
PIL: Affirm, 18L in sight, ACA108.
CTL: ACA108, cleared to land, runway 18L.
Q: Which of the following is most likely true?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：加航108，北京塔台，确认你正在进近跑道18左？似乎你在18右五边。
飞：确认跑道18右，抱歉，跑道18左现在可用吗？加航108。
管：加航108，跑道18左能见吗？
飞：是的，跑道18左能见，加航108。
管：加航108，可以在跑道18左着陆。
问：以下哪项最有可能是正确的？
choices: The controller issued an incorrect instruction
The aircraft was over the glide path
The pilot would continue approach for 18R
The pilot would adjust approach for 18L
choicesZh: 飞行员会继续跑道18右进近
飞行员会调整为跑道18左进近
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The pilot would adjust approach for 18L

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL567, confirm speed 250kts, your speed still higher than the preceding aircraft.
PIL: Unable to reduce to 250kts due high rate of descent, UAL567.
CTL: UAL567, roger, turn right heading 340 for reposition on the localizer.
Q: According to the exchange, what would the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：美联航567，确认速度250节，你的速度仍大于前方飞机。
飞：由于大下降率，无法减速到250节，美联航567。
管：美联航567，收到，右转航向340重新截获航道。
问：根据对话，飞行员会怎样做？
choices: Catch up with aircraft in front
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Delay localizer capture

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shanghai Approach, CES5205, we have been struck by lightning, something is wrong with the control system.
CTL: CES5205, roger. Radar indicates you have deviated track. Confirm the rudder is normal?
PIL: Rudder is okay, only the elevator control has a slight problem, we will have a higher approach speed, CES5205.
Q: According to the passage, which part of the aircraft was being in trouble?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：上海进近，东方5205，飞机被闪电击中，操纵系统出现问题。
管：东方5205，收到。雷达显示你已偏离航线。确认方向舵正常？
飞：方向舵正常，只是升降舵控制有小问题，我们将大速度进近，东方5205。
问：根据对话，飞机哪个部分出现了问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Elevator

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, turn right heading 260, direct to HG, resume own navigation.
PIL: Turn right heading 260, direct to HG, resume own navigation. Confirm resume normal speed 280kts, CCA121.
CTL: Negative, CCA121, maintain speed 250kts due spacing.
Q: According to the instruction, at what speed should the pilot fly?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，右转航向260，直飞HG，恢复自主领航。
飞：右转航向260，直飞HG，恢复自主领航。确认恢复正常速度280节，国航121。
管：不可以，国航121，由于间隔，保持速度250节。
问：根据指令，飞行员应该用什么速度飞行？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 250kts

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN6689, Guangzhou Departure, climb to 2400m, report reaching 1800m.
PIL: Guangzhou Departure, CSN6689, reaching 1800m.
CTL: CSN6689, continue climb to 3600m on standard, turn right direct to CG due traffic.
Q: According to the exchange, what was the pilot doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航6689，广州离场，上升到2400米，到达1800米时报告。
飞：广州离场，南航6689，到达1800米。
管：南航6689，上升到标准气压3600米，由于活动右转直飞CG。
问：根据对话，飞行员正在怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Making a departure

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Approach, AFR2256, No.2 engine flame out during climb, request return to Beijing airport.
CTL: AFR2256, Beijing roger, do you require radar vector?
PIL: Affirm, AFR2256.
CTL: AFR2256, radar vector to ILS approach runway 01, emergency assistance has been activated.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京进近，法航2256，爬升时2号发动机熄火，请求返回北京机场。
管：法航2256，北京收到，需要雷达引导吗？
飞：是的，法航2256。
管：法航2256，雷达引导跑道01盲降进近，已准备好紧急援助。
问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: The aircraft was vectored to runway 01
choicesZh: 飞机爬升时发动机起火
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The aircraft was vectored to runway 01

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN3206, climb to and maintain 8900m, cruising level 10100m.
PIL: Climb to and maintain 8900m, request 9800m for cruising, CSN3206.
CTL: CSN3206, negative, due to opposite direction, only odd level is available.
Q: Why did ATC reject the pilot's request?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航3206，上升保持8900米，巡航高度10100米。
飞：上升保持8900米，请求巡航高度9800米，南航3206。
管：南航3206，不可以，由于相对方向，只有奇数高度层可用。
问：为什么管制员不同意飞行员的请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due to opposite direction

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA101, we are experiencing moderate turbulence on FL148, request descent.
CTL: CCA101, standby. A B737 crossing 10 miles ahead of you at FL138 report no significant turbulence.
Q: What might ATC instruct CCA101 to do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航101，高度层148正在经历中度颠簸，请求下降。
管：国航101，稍等，前方10海里一架B737在高度层138报告没有明显颠簸。
问：ATC下一步可能会给国航101哪项指令？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Descend to FL138

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES215, divert immediately to Wuhan. We have just received an anonymous call saying there's a bomb on board.
PIL: Wilco, CES215, we'll execute emergency evacuation after landing. Confirm you'll have the bomb disposal squad ready?
Q: Which of the following should the pilot do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方215，立刻备降武汉。我们收到匿名电话说飞机上有炸弹。
飞：照办，东方215，我们会在着陆后执行紧急撤离。证实拆弹人员已就位？
问：飞行员下一步应该怎么做？
choices: Send the bomb disposal squad on board
Request an anonymous call for the bomb
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Contact Wuhan Approach

cards.audioText:
PIL: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Approach, ACA121, port engine failure, 5 miles west of HG, 8900m, heading 030, request return to Beijing.
CTL: ACA121, roger MAYDAY, radar vectors to runway 01, turn right direct to HG and descend to 6900m, you'll be number one.
Q: How many meters should ACA121 descend?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京进近，加航121，左舷发动机故障，HG西5海里，8900米，航向030，请求返回北京。
管：加航121，收到MAYDAY。雷达引导至跑道01，左转直飞HG后下降到6900米，你是第一个。
问：加航121应该下降多少米？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 2000 meters

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, Beijing Control, turn left back on course immediately due gun-launched area, otherwise you will assume complete responsibility.
PIL: Roger, something is wrong with FMS, turning back, CCA102.
Q: What should the pilot do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，北京区调，由于炮射区立刻左转回到归航，否则你需要承担全部责任。
飞：收到，FMS出错，返航，国航102。
问：飞行员下一步应该怎样做？
choices: Turn back due to approaching gun-launched area
Turn back due to approaching prohibited area
Return to the airport due to FMS failure
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Turn back due to approaching gun-launched area

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, standby for pushback, expect delay due congestion on the taxiway.
PIL: Roger. Can you advise how long the delay will be, CCA101?
CTL: CCA101, expect approximately a 5 to 10 minutes delay, there's an unserviceable aircraft shut down on taxiway A requiring tow back to the terminal.
Q: Why was there congestion on the taxiway?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航101，等待推出，由于滑行道拥挤预计延误。
飞：收到，预计延误多久，国航101？
管：国航101，预计延误5到10分钟，有故障飞机在滑行道A停下并请求拖回航站楼。
问：滑行道为什么会出现拥挤情况？
choices: Too many aircraft were on the taxiway
There was no available tow truck
An aircraft was stuck on the taxiway
choicesZh: 一架飞机被卡在滑行道上
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. An aircraft was stuck on the taxiway

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, Beijing Tower, backtrack to the stand, we received a call saying that a baggage loader was locked in your cargo hold.
PIL: Roger, turning around, CCA101.
Q: Why did the aircraft have to delay lining up?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航101，北京塔台，原路返回站台，我们收到电话说行李装运人员被锁在货舱内。
飞：收到，掉头，国航101。
问：为什么飞机要推迟排队？
choices: Because there was traffic on final
Because a person was locked in the cargo hold
Because a terrorist was on board
choicesZh: 因为有人被锁在货舱内
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Because a person was locked in the cargo hold

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA121, request emergency descent to 8400m. We have just run into severe turbulence.
CTL: CCA121, roger, descend to 8400m. Confirm require any other assistance?
PIL: 5 passengers are injured and aft fuselage is damaged. Request priority landing and medical service on arrival, CCA121.
Q: Which part of the aircraft is damaged?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航121，请求紧急下降到8400米，我们飞入严重颠簸中。
管：国航121，收到，下降到8400米，需要其它援助吗？
飞：有5名乘客受伤，飞机后机身受到损坏。请求优先着陆和到达时医疗服务，国航121。
问：飞机哪个部分受到损坏？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The rear

cards.audioText:
PIL: Going around. Confirm there is any standing water before landing at this weight, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, roger, climb to 2100m, contact Departure 126.6.
PIL: Climb to 2100m, 126.6, CCA121.
Q: What's the reason for the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：复飞，以当前重量着陆前确认是否有积水，国航121。
管：国航121，收到，上升到2100米，联系离场126.6。
飞：上升到2100米，126.6，国航121。问：飞机为什么复飞？
choices: The pilot was unsure of the runway condition
choicesZh: 飞行员不确定跑道状况
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The pilot was unsure of the runway condition

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, are you still experiencing any turbulence?
PIL: Only occasional light chop, the storm is behind us now, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, an aircraft crossing 10 miles ahead of you on FL250 reports no significant chop, you should be clear of turbulence soon.
PIL: Roger, CCA121.
Q: What did the controller advise CCA121?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，你还在颠簸吗？
飞：偶尔有轻度颠簸，风暴现在在我们后方，国航121。
管：国航121，你前方10海里高度层250有飞机报告无明显颠簸，不久你可以平稳飞行。
飞：收到，国航121。
问：管制员告知国航121哪种情况？
choices: They would experience turbulence 10 miles ahead
They would experience a storm on FL250
They would experience smoother conditions soon
They would clear of the other aircraft
choicesZh: 飞机将在前方10海里遭遇颠簸
飞机将在高度层250遭遇风暴
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. They would experience smoother conditions soon

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN207, from your present position turn left to taxiway B then taxi to hold point G for change of runway, runway 25, we've just received a report that lighting on runway 31R is unserviceable.
PIL: Taxiway B to hold point G runway 25, CSN207.
Q: Why was CSN207 instructed to turn to taxiway B?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航207，从当前位置左转到滑行道B，然后滑到等待点G改变跑道，跑道25。我们刚收到报告，跑道31右的照明无法使用。
飞：从滑行道B滑到等待点G跑道25，南航207。
问：为什么南航207接受指令转向滑行道B？
choices: Because the lighting on runway 31R was not available
Because another aircraft reported a delay vacating runway 31R
Because there was a problem with taxiway lighting
choicesZh: 因为跑道31右照明无法使用
因为另一架飞机报告跑道31右有延误飞机
因为滑行道照明出现问题
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Because the lighting on runway 31R was not available

cards.audioText:
CTL: ACA314, behind B737 on short final, line up behind, runway 25.
PIL: Behind B737, line up runway 25, ACA314.
CTL: ACA314, aircraft turning final runway 25, cleared for immediate takeoff.
PIL: Cleared for takeoff, ACA314.
Q: Which of the following shows the correct order of events for ACA314?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：加航314，短五边B737后，进跑道，跑道25。
飞：B737后，进跑道25，加航314。
管：加航314，有飞机正转向五边25，可以立刻起飞。
飞：可以起飞，加航314。
问：以下哪项是加航314正确操作顺序？
choices: Line up, wait then takeoff without delay
Wait, line up then takeoff without delay
Line up quickly, wait then takeoff
Wait until two aircraft have landed then takeoff without delay
choicesZh: 进跑道，等待，然后立刻起飞
等待，进跑道，然后立刻起飞
立即进跑道，等待，然后起飞
在两架飞机着陆前等待，然后立刻起飞
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Wait, line up then takeoff without delay

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, taxi to holding point K runway 36L via taxiways A and D, expedite taxi due to traffic at 11 o’clock.
PIL: Wilco, expediting taxi, request cross runway 36R, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, negative.
Q: According to the transmission, what was the pilot's intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，由于11点钟方向活动，加速滑行经滑行道A和D滑到跑道36左等待点K。
飞：照办，加速滑行，请求穿过跑道36右，国航102。
管：国航102，不可以。
问：根据电文，飞行员的意图是什么？
choices: Expedite taxi to holding point on runway 36R
choicesZh: 加速滑行至跑道36右等待点
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Cross runway 36R

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES5525, runway 36, cleared to land, wind calm.
PIL: Runway 36, cleared to land, CES5525.
CTL: CES5525, minimum delay on the runway after landing, no need to acknowledge.
Q: What did CES5525 need to do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方5525，跑道36，可以着陆，静风。
飞：跑道36，可以着陆，东方5525。
管：东方5525，着陆后有点延误，不需要认收。
问：东方5525接下来需要怎样做？
choices: Continue approach and readback the instruction
Continue approach and remain on the runway after landing
Continue approach without responding the instruction
choicesZh: 继续进近，着陆后在跑道停留
继续进近，不需要回应指令
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Continue approach without responding the instruction

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, reduce speed to 150kts, you are still too close to the traffic ahead.
PIL: Negative, our minimum approach speed is 160kts, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, roger, turn right heading 010, reposition the localizer.
Q: According to the exchange, what would the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，减速到150节，你和前方活动距离仍然太近。
飞：不可以，我们的最小进近速度是160节，国航102。
管：国航102，收到，右转航向010，重新截获航道。
根据对话，飞行员要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Delay approach

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, AFR126, 8900m maintaining, over DAPRO at 13, estimate LKG 25, next LEH.
CTL: AFR126, radar identified, descend to 5100m before LKG.
PIL: Descend to 5100m before LKG, AFR126.
Q: What was the position of the aircraft at the initial contact?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉区调，法航126，8900米保持，DAPRO上方13分，预计LKG 25分，下个报告点LEH。
管：法航126，雷达已识别，LKG前下降到5100米。
飞：LKG前下降到5100米，法航126。
问：初次通话时飞机的位置在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Over DAPRO

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA104, Beijing Approach, ILS approach runway 36R.
PIL: ILS approach runway 36R, wilco, CCA104.
CTL: CCA104, wind change, right orbit, expect change runway 18R.
PIL: Right orbit, CCA104.
Q: According to the controller, why should the pilot hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航104，北京进近，跑道36右盲降进近。
飞：跑道36右盲降进近，照办，国航104。
管：国航104，风向变化，向右盘旋，预计使用跑道18右。
飞：右转盘旋， 国航104。
问：根据管制员所说，为什么飞行员需要等待？
choices: To give way to departing traffic
To give way to traffic behind
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Wind direction changed

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, radar contact, maintain 9800m, reduce speed to cross CD 10 or later.
PIL: Roger, request level change to maintain speed, CCA121.
CTL: CCA121, no speed restriction on 8400m and 10400m.
Q: Under what circumstance should the pilot reduce speed?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，雷达看到，9800米保持，减速到达CD时间10分或以后。
飞：收到，请求改变高度保持速度，国航121。
管：国航121，8400米到10400米没有速度限制。
问：飞行员应该在哪种情况下减速？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. If maintaining 9800 meters

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, BAW787, maintaining 8900m, cabin altitude is fluctuating. We are trying to sort it out, standby.
CTL: Roger, BAW787.
PIL: Beijing Control, BAW787, request descent to 6300m, suspect slight pressurization problem.
Q: According to the exchange, what problem did the aircraft probably have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，英航787，8900米保持，座舱高度表指示波动，我们正在检查，稍等。
管：收到，英航787。
飞：北京区域，英航787，请求下降到6300米，疑似是轻微增压问题。
问：根据对话，飞机可能存在什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Pressurization

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, Beijing Approach, KM01 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R, descend to 2700m on QNH 1011, preceding aircraft reported there were thunderstorms in your inbound track.
PIL: KM01 arrival, ILS runway 36R, descend to 2700m on QNH 1011, build-ups ahead, request deviate 10 miles right of track, CCA101.
Q: According to the exchange, where were the thunderstorms in relation to CCA101?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航101，北京进近，KM01进场，跑道36右盲降进近，下降到修正海压2700米，修正海压1011，前方飞机报告向台航迹上有雷暴。
飞：KM01进场，跑道36右盲降进近，下降到修正海压2700米，修正海压1011，雷暴正在形成，请求右偏10海里，国航101。
问：根据对话，雷暴和国航101的距离是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Distance not mentioned

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN2256, Wuhan Tower, we have confirmed your hydraulic problem, say intention.
PIL: Wuhan Tower, CSN2256, we have manually lowered the gear, but gear unsafe indication on, request low pass for a visual inspection.
Q: After confirmation of the hydraulic problem, what did the pilot report?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航2256，武汉塔台，我们已被告知飞机液压故障，说明意图。
飞：武汉塔台，南航2256，已经手动放下起落架，但起落架危险指示仍在，请求低空通场进行目视检查。
问：确认液压故障后，飞行员报告哪种情况？
choices: They had put the undercarriage down safely
They could not put the undercarriage down
They wanted to check whether the undercarriage was safe
They had put the undercarriage down automatically
choicesZh: 飞行员想检查起落架是否安全
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. They wanted to check whether the undercarriage was safe

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Center, CCA102, request diversion 10 miles left of track due weather.
CTL: CCA102, Beijing, negative to left due restricted area. If able, divert right of track.
PIL: Roger, request diversion up to 30 miles right of track, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, diversion approved, cleared of weather direct to CHG.
Q: Which heading change was available for CCA102?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京管制，国航102，由于天气，请求左偏10海里。
管：国航102，北京，由于限飞区不可以。如可能右偏航线。
飞：收到，请求右偏30海里，国航102。
管：国航102，同意偏航，天气没影响直飞CHG。
问：国航102能改变的航向是什么？
choices: Divert left or right of track
Divert right of track in 30 miles
Divert no more than 30 miles right of track
Divert right of track direct to CHG
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Divert no more than 30 miles right of track

cards.audioText:
PIL: QFA235, holding on taxiway A.
CTL: QFA235, hold short for the departure. You are No.2 after the Airbus 320.
PIL: Holding short, No.2 for departing, QFA235.
CTL: QFA235, line up and wait.
PIL: Lining up, QFA235.
Q: What is the departure sequence for QFA235?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：澳航235，滑翔道A等待。
管：澳航235，等待离场。你在空客320后第二个。
飞：等待，第二个离场，澳航235。
管：澳航235，进入跑道等待。
飞：进入跑道，澳航235。
问：澳航235的离场顺序是第几？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Number 2

cards.audioText:
NWA18 is taxiing to runway 16 via taxiway T.
PIL: NWA18, holding short runway 16.
CTL: NWA18, approved to cross runway 16 without delay, traffic 3 miles final.
PIL: NWA18, unable to expedite, we are stopped.
CTL: NWA18, hold short of taxiway T, taxi clearance cancel.
Q: Describe what happened.
cards.audioTextZh:
美西北18正通过滑行道T滑到跑道16。
飞：美西北18，跑道16等待。
管：美西北18，同意立刻穿过跑道16，五边3海里有活动。
飞：美西北18，无法加速，飞机已停下。
管：美西北18，滑行道T等待，取消滑行许可。
问：请描述发生了什么情况。
choices: They didn't accept the clearance to cross
They were going too fast to stop
They crossed 16 and are holding short of taxiway T
choicesZh: 飞机没有接收许可进行穿行
飞机速度过快无法停下
飞机加速滑行穿过跑道16
飞机穿过跑道16，正在滑行道T等待
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They didn't accept the clearance to cross

cards.audioText:
PIL: Tianjin Ground, CCA410, stand 203, information J, request ATC clearance.
CTL: CCA410, cleared to Shanghai flight planned route, follow ANRAT 2D departure, initial climb to 2100m, after departure, contact 127.9, squawk 5345.
Q: What are the SID and transponder code?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：天津地面，国航410，机位203，通播J，请求ATC许可。
管：国航410，可以按计划航路飞往上海，ANRAT 2D离场，起始高度2100米，离场联系127.9，应答机5345。
问：标准离场程序和应答机编码是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. ANRAT 2D and 5345

cards.audioText:
PIL: CSN309, we have an indication of weather about 40km ahead of us, request turn right to go around it.
CTL: CSN309, negative due prohibit area, turn left 30 degrees, and track out 35km, report clear of the build up.
Q: What does the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：南航309，飞机前方40千米显示有天气情况，请求右转绕开天气。
管：南航309，由于禁航区不可以，左转30度，偏离35千米，远离天气后报告。
问：管制员要求飞行员怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Turn left 30 degrees

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL782, the Ground came to report that 2 white navigation lights and one strobe light below the APU exhaust off.
PIL: Is that so, we have to check MEL.
PIL: Ground, UAL782, this is not airworthy, we will taxi back to the park for a replacement.
Q: Why did the aircraft taxi back?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：美联航782，地面报告在APU下的2个白色航行灯和1个防撞灯不亮。
飞：我们必须要检查MEL。
飞：地面，美联航782，飞机不适航，我们将滑行回机位停机进行替换。
问：飞机为什么要滑行回机位？
choices: Not in an air operating condition
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Not within MEL requirements

cards.audioText:
PIL: ACA767, request climb to FL360 due to turbulence.
CTL: ACA767, FL360 not available due spacing, can you accept FL380?
PIL: Negative due weight, but we need to change level, a lower level is okay, ACA767.
CTL: ACA767, descend to FL300.
Q: Why could ACA767 not accept FL380?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：加航767，由于颠簸请求上升到高度层360。
管：加航767，由于间隔，高度层360不可行，你能接受高度层380吗？
飞：由于重量不可以，但是我们需要改变高度，可以更低高度，加航767。
管：加航767，下降到高度层300。
问：加航767为什么不接受高度层380。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due to weight

cards.audioText:
CSN3309, Beijing Control, if you read, squawk ident.
CSN3309, squawk ident observed, check your transmitter, read you one.
CSN3309, turn right 090 and descend to 5400 meters on standard. We’ll continue radar control, I read you one.
Q: What problem does CSN3309 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
南航3309，北京区调，如果能听到，应答机识别。
南航3309，应答机看到，检查发射机，我听你一个。
南航3309，右转090，下降到标准气压5400米，我们将继续雷达引导，我听你一个。
问：南航3309遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A transmitter problem

cards.audioText:
PIL: CCA750, we have a pressurization problem and need to descend to 5100 meters immediately.
CTL: CCA750, unable descend due to high terrain. For descend, turn right heading 060 degrees, expect descend clearance in 10 kilometers.
Q: Why are they unable to descend immediately?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：国航750，飞机增压出现问题，需要立刻下降到5100米。
管：国航750，地形影响不能下降。10公里以后下降，右转航向060。
问：飞机为什么无法立刻下降？
choices: Cleared to descend at pilot discretion
choicesZh: 可以飞行员自行决定下
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Unable due to high ground

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, request going on the CBs in the right.
CTL: CCA101, negative due to prohibited area, turn left 40 degrees and track out 30km. Report clear of the CBs.
Q: Why was CCA101 not allowed to turn to right?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉区调，请求绕开右侧积雨云。
管：国航101，由于禁航区不可以，左转40度航行30千米，避开天气后报告。
问：为什么不允许国航101右转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Forbidden area

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL15, be advised runway 23L ILS out of service, expect VOR approach to runway 16 circle to land runway 23R, surface wind 250 at 5, gusting to 15. Ceiling 350 meters, broken.
PIL: UAL15, information copied, checking our minima for approach, will advised.
Q: Which active runway is the surface wind favoring?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：美联航15，跑道23左盲降失效，预计VOR进近跑道16，盘旋着陆跑道23右。地面风风向250风速5节，云底高350米，多云。
飞：美联航15，消息已收到，检查进近最低标准。
问：地面风对哪条现用跑道有利？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Runway 23R

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA1, taxi to position and hold.
PIL: Tower, large flock of birds at runway 14R.
CTL: CCA1, the birds they are all the time.
PIL: You have alternate runway?
CTL: Runway 27L available expect 15-minute delay.
PIL: CCA1, we will accept the delay.
CTL: CCA1, hold present position, I can't move you yet, opposite direction traffic on T.
Q: Which of the statements is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航1，滑到位等待。
飞：塔台，跑道14右有一群鸟。
管：国航1，鸟群无法赶走。
飞：有备用跑道吗？
管：跑道27左可用，预计15分钟延误。
飞：国航1，我们接受延误。
管：国航1，当前位置等待，你还不能移动，相反方向T有活动。
问：以下哪项陈述是正确的？
choices: Another runway is not available currently
There is no available alternate runway
The birds will be moved out of the way
The delay is too long, so they accept the clearance
choicesZh: 另一条跑道当前不可用
延误时间太长，所以他们接受了许可
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Another runway is not available currently

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL985, be advised runway 23L ILS out of service, expect VOR approach to runway 16, circle to land runway 23R. Surface wind 250, 5 gusting to 15, ceiling 340 meters broken.
PIL: UAL985, information copied, checking your minima for approach, will advised.
Q: Why can't they approach runway 23L directly?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：美联航985，跑道23左盲降失效，预计VOR进近跑道16，盘旋着陆跑道23右。地面风风向250，风速5节，阵风15，云底高340米，多云。
飞：美联航985，消息已收到，检查进近最低标准。
问：飞机为什么不能直接进近跑道23左？
choices: Runway 23L ILS is out of service
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Runway 23L ILS is out of service

cards.audioText:
PIL: UAL350, we can't hold any longer, we have serious ill passenger on board.
CTL: UAL350, leave holding pattern, fly heading 050.
PIL: Heading 050, UAL350, request first aid after landing.
CTL: Roger, UAL350.
Q: What will be the immediate need after landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：美联航350，不能继续等待，飞机上有严重生病的乘客。
管：美联航350，离开等待航线，航向050。
飞：航向050，美联航350，请求着陆后提供急救。
管：收到，美联航350。
问：飞机着陆后急需什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Medical service

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ground, CSN3251, request taxi.
CTL: CSN3251, for information, UAL236 and CCA901, both B747s nearly collided on runway 14R 1 minute ago, stay there, I'll call you back.
PIL: Roger, holding, CSN3251.
Q: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：地面，南航3251，请求滑行。
管：南航3251，提示，美联航236和国航901，两架波音747，1分钟前险些在跑道14右相撞。原地等待，稍后呼叫你。
飞：收到，等待，南航3251。
问：发生了什么情况？
choices: There was a crash on the runway
There was almost a collision on the runway
There was a vehicle on the runway
choicesZh: 跑道上差点发生了相撞
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was almost a collision on the runway

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN141, taxi to the holding point runway 36 for a taxiway A4 and A. Taxi with caution, taxiway is slippery.
CTL: CSN141, stop immediately, there is conflicting traffic on the way to you.
PIL: Stopping, traffic in sight, CSN141.
Q: What did the flight crew possibly see on their way?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航141，经滑行道A4和A滑到跑道36等待点。滑行时注意，滑行道很滑。
管：南航141，立刻停止，途中有接近的冲突活动。
飞：已经停下，活动可见，南航141。
问：机组在滑行途中可能看到了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Oncoming traffic

cards.audioText:
PIL: Manchester Ground, UAL94, we have a hydraulic problem, and have lost nose wheel steering. We will have to hold position and request you send us a tug to take us back to the Gate.
CTL: Roger, UAL94, standby.
CTL: UAL94, suggest you shut down your engines, there is a tug on this way.
PIL: UAL94, roger.
Q: What problem does UAL94 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：曼彻斯特地面，美联航94，飞机出现液压问题，前轮无法转弯。我们在原地等待，请求拖轮将飞机拖回机位。
管：收到，美联航94，稍等。
管：美联航94，建议关闭发动机，拖轮将就位。
飞：美联航94，收到。
问：美联航94遇到了什么问题？
choices: The electrics in the nose of the aircraft
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A hydraulic problem

cards.audioText:
PIL: Tower, CSN3308, holding short of runway 36 right.
CTL: CSN3308, line up after the landing 747, number two for departure.
PIL: Roger, looking for traffic, traffic in sight. CSN3308.
Q: What is the pilot doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：塔台，南航3308，跑道36右等待。
管：南航3308，在着陆的747后进入跑道，第二个离场。
飞：收到，正在寻找活动，活动可见，南航3308。
问：飞行员正在做什么？
choices: Waiting to get on the runway
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Waiting to get on the runway

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL342, Wuhan Radar, for identification, turn left 30 degrees, heading 360.
PIL: Wuhan Radar, UAL342, we have a transponder on board. Request the transponder code.
CTL: UAL342, squawk 2234.
PIL: Squawk 2234, UAL342.
Q: What does the pilot mean by saying he has a transponder on board?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：美联航342，武汉雷达，为识别，左转30度，航向360。
飞：武汉雷达，美联航342，飞机上有应答机。请求应答机编码。
管：美联航342，应答机编码2234。
飞：应答机编码2234，美联航342。
问：飞行员说到飞机上有应答机时的意图是什么？
choices: To confirm that the transponder is working
To inform the controller the type of the aircraft
choicesZh: 通知管制员飞机的类型
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To get a SSR code

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW141, Wuhan Ground, hold for a while at holding point C.
PIL: We have been holding for ten minutes already.
CTL: BAW141, there are bird activities on both sides of the upwind.
PIL: Roger. Holding, BAW141.
Q: Why was BAW141 instructed to hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：英航141，武汉地面，在等待点C处等一会儿。
飞：我们已经等了10分钟。
管：英航141，上风两侧有鸟。
飞：收到，等待，英航141。
问：管制员为何命令飞行员等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Birds over the takeoff path

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, CSN3342, HM at 35, 9500m, estimating XSH at 50, next HG.
CTL: CSN3342, Wuhan Control, can you lose 5 minutes en route due to traffic separation?
Q: What does the controller want the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉区调，南航3342，HM，高度35，9500米，到XSH时间50分，下一点HG。
管：南航3342，武汉区调，由于交通间隔，能否减少5分钟飞行时间？\问：管制员让飞行员做什么？
choices: To keep enough space from the traffic ahead
To hold at present position for 5 minutes
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To keep enough space from the traffic ahead

cards.audioText:
PIL: Approach, SIA996, we've got a passenger on board with a very serious physical condition. We'll need to land as soon as possible.
CTL: SIA996, descend to 2400m, cleared for straight in approach runway 36.
Q: What does the pilot of SIA996 want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：进近，新航996，机上一名乘客身体状况恶劣。我们需要尽快着陆。
管：新航996，下降2400米，可以直接进近跑道36。
问：新航996想做什么？
choices: To have a straight in approach
To evacuate the passengers on board
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To land quickly

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, BAW303, left engine on fire. Emergency slides are released, request fire services and first aid.
C: BAW303, roger mayday, airport emergency assistance services will be notified.
Q: What has the crew done already?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，英航303，左发起火，紧急滑梯已释放，请求消防车和急救。
管制员：英航303，收到Mayday，将通知机场紧急救援服务部门。
问：机组已经做了什么？
choices: Released fire bottles on right engine.
choicesZh: 释放消防车上的灭火器。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Begun the evacuation procedures.

cards.audioText:
A: There's a broadcast that provides current routine information to arriving and departing aircraft by means of continuous and repetitive broadcasting throughout the day.
B: And it is identified by ICAO spelling alphabet letters, and transmitted in alphabetical order.
Q: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：有一个广播，通过连续和重复的广播，全天候的向到达和离场的飞机提供常规信息。
B：它由国际民航组织拼写字母识别，并按字母顺序传送。
问：他们正在讨论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. ATIS.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, ACA5261, I’ve intercepted Mayday from CCA5336, I say again, CCA5336, double engine failure, forced landing, current position 10 miles east of LADIX, over.
CTL: ACA5261, roger your relayed mayday from CCA5336.
Q: What do you learn from the exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，加航5261，我收到国航5336的Mayday信息，我再说一遍，国航5336，双发失效，准备迫降，目前位置在LADIX以西10海里，完毕。
管制员：加航5261，收到你转发的国航5336的Mayday信息。
问：我们可以从对话中得到什么信息？
choices: Air Canada has two engines failed.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Air China has an emergency.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Tower, CCA101, ready for departure.
CTL: CCA101, clear for takeoff, maintain runway heading until 1800m, then turn right en-route, contact 126.25.
P: Runway heading 1800m, then turn right, contact 126.25. Clear for takeoff, CCA101.
Q: What is not mentioned in the exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，国航101，准备好离场了。
管制员：国航101，可以起飞，保持跑道航向至1800米，然后在航路上右转，联系126.25。
飞行员：跑道航向直达1800米，然后右转，联系126.25，可以起飞，国航101。
问：对话中，没有提及的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Transponder code

cards.audioText:
PIL: Tower, CCA101, approaching taxiway 23.
CTL: CCA101, good evening, taxi to runway 07L via runway 07R, back track 07R to taxiway 11.
PIL: Confirm taxi straight ahead CCA101.
CTL: CCA101, negative, turn left, back track runway 07R to taxiway 11.
Q: How are they going to get to taxiway 11?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，国航101，到达滑行道23。
管制员：国航101，晚上好，通过跑道07右到跑道07左，在跑道07右调头进滑行道11。
飞行员：确认直线滑行，国航101。
管制员：不可，左转，在跑道07右调头然后进滑行道11。
问：他们如何到滑行道11？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. back track on R/W 07R

cards.audioText:
CTL: NWA808, Control, we have just received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft. Report your intention.
PIL: NWA808, in that case, we'd like to land at your field.
CTL: NWA808, descend to 4,500m, report passing HZ. Do you require any additional assistance?
PIL: We will use the emergency slides so that the bomb disposal squad can get on board right NWA808.
Q: Who declared the bomb threat?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：西北808，管制，我们收到一个匿名电话，说你的飞机上有炸弹，报告你的意图。
飞行员：西北808，这样的话，我们希望在你的机场降落。
管制员：西北808，下降到4500米，过HZ后报，你需要其他援助吗？
飞行员：我们需要使用紧急滑梯，这样排弹小组就可以上飞机了，西北808。
问：谁宣布了炸弹威胁？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. An unknown person.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Tower, ACA503, we are coming back due to a burst tyre during gear retraction. Luckily it didn't burst in the well, but the starboard flaps seem to have been damaged.
CTL: ACA503, are you able to manage a flaps-up landing?
PIL: Affirm. Can we use runway 22? It's longer.
CTL: ACA503 is cleared to land runway 22.
Q: What is wrong with ACA503?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：加航503，在收轮过程中，轮胎爆裂，我们现在正在返场，幸运的是，没有在起落架舱爆裂，但是，右侧襟翼看起来受损了。
管制员：加航503，你可以进行无襟翼着陆吗？
飞行员：确定，我们可以使用22号跑道吗？它更长些。
管制员：加航503，可以落地，跑道22。
问：加航503出了什么故障？
choices: Tyre burst outside the wheel well.
Tyre burst inside the wheel well.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Tyre burst outside the wheel well.

cards.audioText:
CTL: AFR188, you can't start up now. We had an emergency this morning. The runway had to be foamed and it is being cleaned at the moment.
PIL: Will it be reopened shortly?
CTL: Perhaps in a quarter of an hour, I will call you back.
Q: Why can't the pilot start up?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：法航188，你现在不能开车，今早上发生了紧急事件，跑道喷洒了泡沫，现在正在清理。
飞行员：一会儿会重新开放吗？
管制员：可能需要15分钟，等下叫你。
问：飞行员为什么不能开车？
choices: The runway cleaning is going on.
There is an emergency on runway now.
choicesZh: 跑道上正发生紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The runway cleaning is going on.

cards.audioText:
P: UAL853, engine NO.3 is overheating, probably due to bird ingestion on takeoff. Request priority landing at runway 36 right.
C: UAL853, runway 36 right is in use. You are number 1.
Question: What do you think will probably happen next?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：美联航853，3号发动机过热，可能原因是起飞时遭鸟击。请求优先着陆跑道36右。
管制员：美联航853，跑道36右目前在使用，你是第一个。
问：你认为接下来将会发生什么？
choices: They might encounter a bird strike.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. None of the above.

cards.audioText:
P: Winton Control, UA 563, we have been caught in severe turbulence. Would you check the type of aircraft ahead of us?
C: 563, it is a 747. Must be wake turbulence. Climb to FL270.
P: FL 270. Next time, please give us 6 miles at least behind a heavy aircraft.
Question: What does the pilot want the controller to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：温顿区调，美联航563，我们遭遇严重颠簸，你可以证实我们前方的飞机类型吗？
管制员：563，是一架747.肯定是因为尾流。爬升至高度层270。
飞行员：高度层270，下次，请在重型飞机后，给与我们至少6海里的间隔。
问：飞行员想让管制员做什么？
choices: To be aware of the separation.
To tell them there will be a turbulence.
To check the type of aircraft every time.
choicesZh: 告诉他们这里会有颠簸
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To be aware of the separation.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, KLM 546, our fuel endurance is only 50 minutes. We’d like to refuel at Rock.
C: KLM546, you’d better proceed to Mansfield instead, because the ground handling personnel at Rock are on strike. Advise if able.
Question: Why KLM 546 cannot refuel at Rock?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：区调，荷航546，我们的燃油续航只有50分钟。我们想在约克加油。
管制员：你最好飞往曼斯菲尔德，因为约克的地面人员现在罢工了，如果可以的话，请告知。
问：荷航546为什么不能在约克加油？
choices: Because the refueling personnel are unavailable
Because they had a bird strike.
Refueling is difficult to handle in Rock.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Because the refueling personnel are unavailable

cards.audioText:
P: Rock Approach, Trans 351, we won’t be able to dump. We’ve got an engine on fire at this time and we’ll have to come back and land with the fuel on board.
C: Roger 351, make a right turn, I say again a right turn on to heading 350.
Question: What is the pilot’s intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：约克进近，Trans351，我们无法放油。目前我们有一个发动机起火，我们将必须返航，并带燃油着陆。
管制员：收到351，右转，我再说一遍，右转航向350。
问：飞行员的意图是什么？
choices: To come back after dumping fuel.
To get an engine on fire.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To return for landing.

cards.audioText:
PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, HK Approach, Cathay 784, 30 miles west of Hong Kong at 8,000 feet, passenger with suspected heart attack, request priority landing.
Question: Why does the crew ask for priority landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，香港进近，国泰784，距离香港30海里，高度8000英尺，乘客疑似心脏病发作，请求优先着陆。
问：机组为什么请求优先着陆？
choices: A passenger is attacking the crew.
There is a criminal suspect on board.
They are at a too low altitude.
choicesZh: 机上有一名犯罪嫌疑人
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A passenger is seriously ill.

cards.audioText:
P: Good afternoon, sir.
Officer: Good afternoon. What can I do for you?
P: Yes, I am the captain of UAL303. I would like to check the weather information. When can we depart?
Officer: The thunderstorm is cleared away, and you can depart as scheduled.
P: Thank you.
Q: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：先生，下午好。
长官：你好，有什么可以帮到你的吗？
飞行员：是的，我是美联航303的机长，我想确认下天气信息，我们何时可以起飞？
长官：雷暴天气已经消散，你可以按计划起飞。
飞行员：谢谢。
问：他们在讨论什么？
choices: When the pilot can leave the office.
choicesZh: 飞行员何时离开办公室。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Weather information.

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday. Wuhan Approach, ACA503, fire detected in rear cabin, dense smoke has spread all over, request emergency assistance, we're maintaining 3,900m on heading 040 degrees, request return to land.
C: ACA503 roger Mayday, turn left heading 210. I will vector you to final of runway 04.
Q: Where is the fire?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，武汉进近，加航503，客舱后部起火，客舱布满浓烟。请求紧急救援，我们现在保持在高度3900米，航向040，请求返场着陆。
管制员：加航503，收到Mayday，左转航向210，我将引导你到跑道04的五边。
问：哪里起火了？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Rear part of the aircraft.

cards.audioText:
P: United 342 encountering severe icing at altitude 5400m. What altitude do you recommend?
C: United 342 we have several pilot reports which said that 4200m is clear of ice.
P: We request to descend 4200m, United 342.
Q: Where did the controller get the information for no ice level?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：美联航342，遇到强积冰，高度5400米。建议飞多高？
管制员：美联航342，收到多个飞行员报告称在4200米没有积冰。
飞行员：请求下降到4200米，美联航342。
问：管制员从哪里得到的没有积冰的信息？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. PIREP.

cards.audioText:
A: The main objective of AIS aerodrome unit is to provide the pilots with aeronautical information for a flight.
B: In fact, it’s very important to provide information in such way that it will facilitate self-briefing for pilots to obtain the required information.
Q: What is the main idea of this conversation?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：航空情报服务单位的主要目的是为飞行员提供飞行时所需的航空信息。
B：事实上，以这种方式提供信息是十分重要的，可以促进飞行员通过自我讲评的方式获取所需信息。
问：这段对话的主旨是什么？
choicesZh: 航空情报服务提供的信息。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The function of AIS.

cards.audioText:
A: I'm planning a flight to Blue yard airport, what about the weather there?
B: Captain, the weather is marginal, a thunderstorm might be there, there are some cumulonimbus clouds building, our weather radar shows some cells, a squall line must be developing at the head of the front.
Q: Which of the following words is not involved in the weather?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：我计划飞往Blue yard机场，那边的天气如何？
B：机长，天气情况很差，机场可能有雷暴，机场上空积雨云正在形成，我们的气象雷达显示有雷暴单体，锋前肯定有飑线正在形成。
问：以下哪个词不包含在此天气中？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Quarrel.

cards.audioText:
P: CSN306, request 10 degrees heading change to the right of the track to detour the cumulonimbus.
C: Roger, CSN306, turn right 10 degrees, heading 260.
P: Right heading 260, CSN306.
C: CSN306, clear of the CBs now, resume own navigation, report back on track.
Q: Which heading will be suitable for the aircraft come back on track?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：南方306，请求航向右转10度来绕飞积雨云。
管制员：收到，南方306，右转10度，航向260。
飞行员：右转航向260，南方306。
管制员：南方306，现在已避开积雨云，恢复自主领航，回到原航迹后报。
问：以下哪个航向可以让飞机回到原航迹？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Turn left.

cards.audioText:
P: Chengdu Tower, good morning, SIA952, established on the ILS.
C: SIA952, good morning, continue ILS approach, runway 02.
P: Continue SIA952.
C: SIA952, we have a report that a dog on the runway so advise caution during your approach, you may get a late clearance.
Q: Why did Control advise caution to SIA952?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：成都塔台，早上好，新航952，已建立盲降。
管制员：新航952，早上好，继续盲降进近，跑道02。
飞行员：继续进近，新航952。
管制员：新加坡952，我们收到报告，跑道上有一条狗，进近时小心，晚点给你许可。
问：管制员为什么建议新航952小心点？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Animal on the runway.

cards.audioText:
C: Speed bird 342, unknown traffic, 10 o’ clock, 6 miles, crossing left to right, height unknown, fast moving, if not sighted, turn left heading 270.
P: Left heading 270, speed bird 342.
C: Speed bird 342, clear of traffic, resume own navigation, direct to LADIX
P: Wilco, speed bird 342.
Q: Why did Speed bird 342 turn left?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：英航342，不明航空器，10点方向，6海里，正从左向右穿越，高度不明，移动速度很快，你如果没有看见航空器，左转航向270。
飞行员：左转航向270，英航342。
管制员：英航342，避开冲突航空器了，恢复自主领航，直飞LADIX。
飞行员：照办，英航342。
问：英航342为什么左转？
choices: Danger of collision with the ground.
Danger of collision with another aircraft.
choicesZh: 有与其他飞机相撞的危险。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Danger of collision with another aircraft.

cards.audioText:
C: Speed Bird 480 flames coming from your No.3 engine on takeoff. Please advise.
P: Roger, declaring an emergency. Request immediately return, Speed Bird 480.
Q: Why are they declaring an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：英航480，起飞时候，3号发动机起火，请知晓。
飞行员：收到，宣布紧急情况，请求立即返场，英航480。
问：为什么宣布紧急情况？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. engine fire.

cards.audioText:
C: Speed Bird 639 turn left heading 130 to offset your original track. The latest weather forecast reports CBs are prevailing on your route. Fly with caution. After going around them, resume navigation.
P: Turn left 130 to detour CBs, Speed Bird 639.
Q: What does the control instructions to Speed Bird 639 indicate?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：英航639，左转航向130，偏离原航迹。最新气象预报报告你的航路上有大片积雨云，请谨慎飞行，避开天气后，恢复自主领航。
飞行员：左转航向130，绕飞积雨云，英航639。问：管制员给英航639的指令预示着什么？
choices: It will turn left to resume its own navigation.
It is expected to meet CBs on its original route.
It will resume its own navigation after left turn.
It will offset its path to encounter CBs.
choicesZh: 飞机将左转，恢复自主领航。
飞机在原航路上将会遇到积雨云。
转向后，飞机将恢复自主领航。
飞机将偏离原航路，并遭遇积雨云。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. It is expected to meet CBs on its original route.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR201, cancel landing clearance runway 23L due to disabled aircraft, change runway 23R. Cleared to land runway 23R.
P: AFR201 unable to land runway 23R due to brake problem. We need the longer runway.
C: AFR201, go around immediately. Turn left heading 140 for vector ILS runway 23L, climb and maintain 4000 feet. The runway will be available in 5 minutes.
Q: Why can’t they land on runway 23R?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：法航201，由于航空器损坏，取消跑道23左的着陆许可，改成跑道23右，可以着陆，跑道23右。
飞行员：法航201，由于刹车系统故障，无法使用跑道23右着陆。我们需要更长的跑道。
管制员：法航201，立即复飞，左转航向140，引导至跑道23左盲降，爬升并保持4000英尺，跑道在5分钟以后可用。
问：为什么不能在跑道23右降落？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They need a longer runway.

cards.audioText:
P: United 350 we cannot hold any longer. We have serious ill passenger on board.
C: United 350 leave the holding pattern fly heading 050.
P: Heading 050, United 350. Request first aid after landing.
C: Roger United 350.
Q: What will be the immediately need after landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：美联航350，我们不能继续等待，机上有名病重乘客。
管制员：离开等待程序，航向050。
飞行员：航向050，美联航350，请求落地后急救。
管制员：收到，美联航350。
问：落地后，立即需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Medical service.

cards.audioText:
P: United 655 we have serious fuel leak, we are returning.
C: United 655 descend 3300 meters.
P: Leaving 5400 meters for 3300 meters, United 655.
C: United 655, do you require emergency assistant on landing?
P: Affirm, United 655.
Q: What is the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：美联航655，飞机出现严重燃油泄漏，我们正在返航。
管制员：美联航655，下降到3300米。飞行员：离开5400米到3300米，美联航655。
管制员：美联航655，你需要在落地后请求紧急援助吗？
飞行员：是的，美联航655。
问：飞机出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Fuel leak.

cards.audioText:
C: CES147, do you want medical personnel to meet you at the gate or on the taxiway after you exit the runway,
P: CES147, we exit on N, we’d like medical personnel to meet us there.
Q: Where does CES147 want the medical personal to meet them?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：东方147，你脱离跑道后，是希望医疗人员去停机坪还是去滑行道上？
飞行员：东方147，我们在N点脱离，我们希望医疗人员在那里和我们碰面。
问：东方147希望医疗人员在哪里和他们碰面？
choices: At the end of the runway.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. On taxiway November.

cards.audioText:
A: I’ve been told there are some changes for my departure.
B: Yes, the changes are as follows, climb on runway heading until 6000ft, then turn right to intercept 235 radial of MT VOR
Q: Which radio must be intercepted?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：我被告知离场信息有一些变化。
B：是的，做了一下变化，沿跑道方向爬升到6000英尺，然后右转至截获MT VOR台235径向线。
问：必须截获的无线电台是哪个？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 235 radial of MT VOR.

cards.audioText:
P: NW968, reaching holding point 29, request return to stand, the brake is overheating.
C: Roger, NW968, turning to holding bay, take first convenient left turn taxiway J.
P: Left turn on the taxiway J, NW968.
Q: Which taxiway is NW968 to use?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：西北968，到达等待点29，请求返回机坪，刹车过热。
管制员：收到，西北968，滑回机坪，左转进入滑行道J。
飞行员：左转进入滑行道J，西北968。
问：西北968使用的滑行道是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Taxiway J.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN330, Beijing Control, radio check, you didn’t report over LADIX as instructed
C: CSN330. Beijing Control.
C: CSN330. If you copy, squawk ident.
C: CSN330, Beijing Control, transmit on 121.5.
Q: What’s happening between the air traffic controller and the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：南方330，北京区调，无线电检查，你没有按指令过LADIX报。
管制员：南方330，北京区调。管制员：南方330，如果你能听到，应答机识别。
管制员：南方330，北京区调，在121.5频道上发话。
问：管制员和飞行员之间发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Radio contact has been lost.

cards.audioText:
A: Captain, do you think that maintenance check is one of the most important pre-flight activities?
B: Oh, yes, it is, it ensures that the airplane condition is acceptable for flight,
A: Em, I agree with you, and the aircraft maintenance engineers should be licensed by aviation authorities to check airframe, engines and system.
Q: What should maintenance engineers do from this conversation?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：机长，你认为维修检查是起飞前最重要的活动之一吗？
B：是的，它可以保证飞机处于适航状态。
A：嗯，我同意你的看法，维修机务人员应当由民航当局授予执照，来检查飞机的机身，发动机和系统。
问：在这段谈话中，维修机务人员应该做什么？
choices: Release the engine, airframe, and systems.
Replace the engine, airframe, and systems.
Consult the engine, airframe, and systems.
Inspect the engine, airframe, and systems.
choicesZh: 释放发动机，机身和系统。
更换发动机，机身和系统。
查阅发动机，机身和系统。
检查发动机，机身和系统。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Inspect the engine, airframe, and systems.

cards.audioText:
P: Tianjin Control, CSN4971, we are unable to control pressurization, cabin altitude is rising fast, request immediate descent, 3000m.
C: CSN4971, descend 3000m, report reaching.
P: Descending, 3000m. Report reaching, CSN4971.
Q: What was the crew's initial maneuver?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：天津区调，南方4971，我们无法控制增压系统，客舱高度正迅速上升，请求立刻下降到3000米。
管制员：南方4971，下降到3000米，到达后报。
飞行员：下降到3000米，到达后报，南方4971。
问：机组的初始操纵是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Go to lower altitude.

cards.audioText:
P: Tianjin Tower, CCA996, we have found some rubber on the runway, have you heard any reports from other aircraft that has departed from this runway recently.
C: CCA996, negative, you are the first reporter, where exactly you’ve found the debris?
Q: What did the pilot report?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：天津塔台，国航996，我们在跑道上发现了一些橡胶碎片，在最近从这条跑道起飞的其他飞机上，你们有没有收到相关报告？
管制员：国航996，没有，你是第一个报告的，你是在哪里发现的这些碎片的？
问：飞行员报告了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Rubber on the runway.

cards.audioText:
P: UAL655, we have a serious fuel leak, we are returning.
C: UAL655, descend to 3300m.
P: Leaving 5400m for 3300m, UAL655.
C: UAL655, do you require emergency assistance on landing?
P: Affirm, UAL655.
Q: What is the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：美联航655，飞机出现严重燃油泄漏，我们正在返航。
管制员：美联航655，下降到3300米。
飞行员：离开5400米到3300米，美联航655。
管制员：美联航655，你需要在落地后请求紧急援助吗？
飞行员：是的，美联航655。
问：飞机出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Fuel leak.

cards.audioText:
P: Manchester Ground, United 994, we have a hydraulic problem and have lost wheel steering, we will have to hold the position and we request you to send a tug to take us back to the gate
C: Roger, United 994, standby
C: United 994, suggest you shut down your engines, there’s a tug on its way.
P: United 994, roger.
Q: What problem does United 994 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：曼彻斯特地面，美联航994，我们的液压系统出了故障，失去了转向，我们需要原地等待，请派一辆拖车，将我们拖回停机位。
管制员：美联航994，稍等。
管制员：美联航994，建议你关闭发动机，拖车在路上了。
飞行员：美联航994，收到。
问：美联航994出了什么问题？
choices: The electrics in the nose of the aircraft.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A hydraulic problem.

cards.audioText:
P: Melbourne center, Speed bird 315, we are unsure of our position, and request vector to the nearest alternate due insufficient fuel, we are maintaining FL110, heading 060,
C: Speed bird 315, Melbourne center, copied your transmission, confirm you wish to call pan, sir?
P: Speed bird 315, affirm, panpan, panpan, panpan.
Q: Why does the pilot request vector to the nearest airport?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：墨尔本中心，英航315，我们不确定目前位置，由于燃油不足，请求引导至最近备降机场，我们目前保持在高度层110，航向060。
管制员：英航315，墨尔本中心，收到你的信息，确认你是否需要呼叫Pan？
飞行员：英航315，确认，Panpan，Panpan，Panpan。
问：飞行员为什么请求引导至最近的机场？
choices: There is a patient on board.
The port engine is on fire.
His aircraft is running out of fuel.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. His aircraft is running out of fuel.

cards.audioText:
A: Take the next right.
B: Are you sure? This is the runway, we must miss the turn, tell Ground holding for instructions.
C: CCA001 is just about to call you, you missed T, you may proceed down 5L, it’s not active, turn left on E, turn right on S to the runway, try not to miss S or you’ll beyond the runway.
Q: What did the crew do wrong?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：下个口右转。
B：你确定吗？这是跑道，我们肯定错过转弯了，告诉地面，原地等待下一步指令。
C：国航001，正打算呼叫你，你们错过了滑行道T，你们可以继续滑行到跑道05左，此跑道为非活动跑道，在E左转，在S右转进跑道，尽量别错过S，否则你们就出跑道了。
问：机组做错了什么？
choices: They are now on taxiway Echo.
They missed the turn onto Tango.
choicesZh: 他们在滑行道T错过转弯。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They missed the turn onto Tango.

cards.audioText:
A: Captain did you find some problem here in the cockpit?
B: Come here, look at the right-side chair, it is not moveable.
A: Let me check. Oh, yes, ok, the control lever is too tight. I am going to fix it. It won't take long.
B: The chair must be adjusted to the proper position to obtain the best reference position.
Q: Why should the chair be put in a proper position?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：机长，你发现驾驶舱里出问题了吗？
B：过来，你看看，右侧的座椅动不了了。
A：我来检查下，嗯，是，控制手柄太紧了，我这就处理，花不了很久。
B：座椅必须调节到最佳位置，来获得最佳目视基准位置。
问：座椅为什么需要调节到合适的位置？
choices: To get the most eye reference.
To get the biggest eye reference.
To get the optimum eye reference.
To get the highest eye reference.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To get the optimum eye reference.

cards.audioText:
P: ACA177, we have been experiencing severe turbulence at this flight level. Could we have a slightly low level?
C: ACA177, standby.
P: Roger, ACA177, if not available, we also accept a higher level.
C: ACA177, fly to FL370.
Q: Why does the pilot want to change the flight level?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：加航177，我们在此高度层经历了严重颠簸，我们可以下降点高度吗？
管制员：加航177，稍等。
飞行员：加航177，如果低高度不可用，我们也可以接受高一点的高度。
管制员：加航177，上高度层370。
问：飞行员为什么想要改变高度层？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Present level is too turbulent.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW238, ﬂight conditions are getting rough in your area present.
P: Yes, there is severe turbulence in clouds, request offset to the right of the course, BAW238.
C: BAW238, I have received information from previous traffic, flight at 9500 meters are stable.
P: BAW238, request climb 9600 meters.
Q: What was the pilot initial request?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：英航238，你当前区域的飞行条件正在变差。
飞行员：是的，云中有强颠簸，请求右偏航，英航238。
管制员：英航238，我收到前面飞机的报告，9500米高度很稳定。
飞行员：英航238，请求爬升至9600米。
问：飞行员的初始请求是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Turning to the right.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, AFR973, we rejected takeoff, the red lights on the panel came on before V1, request vacating runway immediately and we will figure out what's going on.
C: AFR973, vacate runway at your first convenient intersection. Taxi via B6 to No.2 apron.
Q: What reason caused AFR973 to abort takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，法航973，我们中断起飞了，在V1前，面板上的红灯就亮了，请求立即脱离跑道，然后我们看下出什么问题了。
管制员：法航973，在最方便的交叉口脱离跑道，通过B2滑行道到2号停机位。
问：什么原因导致法航973中断起飞？
choices: Red lights was seen on the runway before V1.
Red lights on another aircraft came out before V1.
Red warning lights appeared before V1.
choicesZh: V1前，其他飞机上发出红灯。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Red warning lights appeared before V1.

cards.audioText:
P: Melbourne Tower, QFA344, hold at holing point runway 29 ready for departure.
C: QFA344 hold at holding point runway 29 for a few minutes. The runway is still blocked by a Cessna.
Q: Why does the controller ask the pilot to hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：墨尔本塔台，澳航344，在跑道29等待点等待，准备好起飞了。
管制员：在跑道29等待点再等几分钟，跑道被一架塞斯纳挡住了。
问：为什么管制员让飞行员等待？
choices: Because there is an airplane on final.
Because an aircraft blocked the runway.
Because there is a tug on the runway.
Because the vehicle blocked the runway.
choicesZh: 因为一架航空器挡住了跑道。
因为跑道上有一辆拖车。
因为一辆汽车挡住了跑道。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Because an aircraft blocked the runway.

cards.audioText:
A: Did you hear of the accident that occurred recently in France?
B: No, what about it?
A: The air crash of a helicopter caused a local forest fire but fortunately it was extinguished quickly. The air crash resulted in a loss of three lives.
Q: What were the consequences of the air crash?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：你听说最近发生在法国的事故了吗？
B：没有，发生了什么事？
A：一架直升机失事，引起当地森林火灾，幸运的是，大火很快被扑灭，但是此次失事造成了3人死亡。
问：飞机失事的后果是什么？
choices: It resulted in the loss of three lives.
choicesZh: 森林火灾，但很快被扑灭。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Death and forest fire.

cards.audioText:
P: United Airlines 342 we are approaching to the gate.
C: United 342 hold where you are, all the passengers must stay on the board and it has been reported there is bird flu at your departure airport.
Q: What was the reason that the passengers were not allowed to disembark?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：美联航342，我们正在靠近机坪。
管制员：美联航342，原地等待，所有乘客待在飞机上，报道称你起飞的机场出现了禽流感。
问：乘客不允许下飞机的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Infectious disease.

cards.audioText:
C: United 985 be advised runway 23L ILS out of service, expect VOR approach to runway 16 circle land on runway 23R, surface wind 250 at 5, gusting 15, ceiling 350m broken.
P: United985, information copied, checking our minimum for approach, will advise.
Q: Why can't they approach R/W 23L directly?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：美联航985，告知跑道23左的ILS系统故障，预计VOR进近，跑道16，盘旋着陆，跑道23右，地面风向250，5米，阵风15米，云底高350米，散云。
飞行员：美联航985，收到消息，检查我们进近的最低高度，稍后告知。
问：他们为什么无法直接进近跑道23左？
choices: Runway 23L ILS is out of service.
choicesZh: 跑道23左的I盲降系统故障。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Runway 23L ILS is out of service.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, CCA101, can we take the second right?
C: CCA101 negative backtrack to exit the runway at first left fast turn-off. There are workmen on the second right.
Q: Why did CCA101 have to backtrack?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，国航101，我们可以使用第二个右转滑行道吗？
管制员：国航101，不可以，调头，在第一个左转滑行道快速转弯，第二个右转滑行道上有工人。
问：为什么国航101要调头？
choices: The pilot on the first left.
A vehicle on the second right.
choicesZh: 第二个右转滑行道上有工人。
第一个左转航行道上有飞行员。
第二个右转滑行道上有汽车。
第一个左转滑行道上有工人。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Workmen on the second right.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR121, stand Z4, information F, ready for pushback and startup.
C: AFR121, the tug A blue which was assigned to push back has some malfunction. I am working on sending another tug, standby.
P: Wilco, AFR121.
Q: Why does the controller ask AFR121 to wait?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，法航121，停机位Z4，通播F，准备好滑出和开车了。
管制员：法航121，指派了一辆蓝色拖车，但是这辆拖车除了故障，我正让另一辆拖车过去，稍等。
飞行员：照办，法航121。问：为什么管制员让法航121等待？
choices: There is a vehicle behind the aircraft.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Tug has broken down.

cards.audioText:
C: United347, descend immediately due to traffic, a Boeing 747 is closing on you.
P: Control, United airlines 347. Our resolution advisory direct to climb to avoid the traffic, the traffic ahead of us is descending.
Q: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：美联航347，由于航空器，立即下降，一架波音747正在接近你。
飞行员：区调，美联航347，我们的决策咨询指示我们爬升来避开航空器，前方的航空器正在下降。
问：发生了什么？
choices: Controller instructed both aircraft to descend.
TCAS indication agreed with ATC instruction.
TCAS indication went against ATC instruction.
choicesZh: 决策咨询指示美联航347下降。
管制员指示两架飞机下降。
TCAS指示和管制员指令一致。
TCAS指示和管制员指令冲突。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. TCAS indication went against ATC instruction.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA4326, after departure, climb straight ahead until passing 1200m, then follow flight planed route.
P: After departure, climb straight ahead until passing 1200m then follow flight planed route, CCA4326.
C: CCA4326, line up and wait runway 02, vehicle crossing upwind into the runway.
Q: Where is the vehicle?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航4326，起飞后，直线爬升至1200米，然后按计划航路飞行。
飞行员：起飞后，直线爬升至1200米，然后按计划航路飞行，国航4326
管制员：国航4326，上跑道等待，跑道02，一辆汽车正从离场边穿过跑道。
问：汽车在哪？
choices: At the opposite end of the runway.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. At the opposite end of the runway.

cards.audioText:
P: Zhengzhou, CSN309, request descent. The anti-ice system is inoperative.
C: CSN309, descend to 7000m. We had a pilot report 10 minutes ago. There was moderate turbulence at 8000m over ZHO.
P: Down to 7000m. Thanks for the alert, CSN309.
Q: Why does the pilot request descent?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：郑州，南方309，请求下降，防冰系统故障。
管制员：南方309，下降到7000米，10分钟前有飞行员报道，ZHO上空8000米处有中度颠簸。
飞行员：下降到7000米，感谢提醒，南方309。
问：飞行员为什么请求下降？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Because of unserviceable anti-ice system.

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday Mayday Mayday, NWA987, engine fire after takeoff, require turn back emergency landing.
C: NWA987, roger Mayday. Turn right heading 090.
P: NWA987, we’ve lost use of all instruments and the fire is s till burning. We have runway 22 in sight and are turning to land immediately, out.
Q: What type of approach will Northwest 987 carry out?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，西北987，起飞后发动机起火，请求返场，紧急着陆。
管制员：西北987，收到Mayday，右转航向090。
飞行员：西北987，我们的仪表都不可用，现在火还在烧，我们看到了跑道22，正在返场紧急着陆。
问：西北987将采用什么进近方式？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Visual Approach.

cards.audioText:
P: ACA16, we need to descend to 2500m due to pressurization problems.
C: ACA16, I can't descend you due to high ground. For descent turn right heading 020 degrees, then cleared to descend to 2000m at your discretion on 29.81 QNH.
Q: What did they have to do before they can descend?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：加航16，由于压力问题，我们需要下降到2500米。
管制：加航16，由于地形，无法下降，右转航向020，然后可以自主下降到2000米，QNH29.81。
问：他们下降前必须做什么？
choices: Cleared to 2000 meters at pilot discretion.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Turn to heading 020 degrees.

cards.audioText:
C: Qantas 5643, when ready, descend to FL170, report leaving FL220.
P: When ready, descend to FL170, report leaving FL220, Qantas 5643.
C: Qantas 5643, climb immediately FL240.
P: Climb immediately FL240, Qantas 5643.
Q: What was Qantas 5643 initially instructed to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：澳航5643，准备好后，下降到高度层170，离开高度层220后报。
飞行员：准备好后，下降到高度层170，离开高度层220后报，澳航5643。
管制员：澳航5643，立即爬升到高度层240。
飞行员：立即爬升到高度层240，澳航5643。
问：澳航5643的初始指令是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Descend when ready.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW141 continue on the inner, at Mike join the outer, cross 31L at Kilo.
P: Okay by the inner and uh, Mike outer and uh, Kilo Alpha, cross 31L uh, BAW141.
Q: What is the controller’s taxi instruction?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：英航141，继续在内滑行道，在M加入外滑行道，在K穿越跑道。
飞行员：好的，内滑行道，在M外滑行道，K，A，穿越跑道，英航141。
问：管制员的滑行指令是什么？
choices: K to inner, outer, cross 31L at M.
Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K.
M to outer, inner, cross 31L at K.
M to inner, outer, cross 31L at K.
choicesZh: 在K加入内滑行道，外滑行道，在M穿越跑道31左。
内滑行道，在M加入外滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左。
在M加入外滑行道，内滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左。
在M加入内滑行道，外滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, HAD306, we have just found a note on board saying a bomb has been planted in the hold, request landing priority and emergency assistance.
APP: HDA306, Wuhan Approach, roger, descend to 900m, fly heading 050.
Q: What happened on board?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，港龙306， 我们在飞机上收到一个便条，称货舱有炸弹，请求优先着陆和紧急救援。
管制员：港龙306，武汉进近，收到，下降到900米，航向050。
问：飞机上发生了什么？
choices: A passenger on board is very sick.
There is a bomb threat on board.
A note was found in the hold.
There is a bomb on board.
choicesZh: 机上有一名乘客非常不舒服。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. There is a bomb threat on board.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, SIA895, we missed the outer marker and going around, can you check the outer marker at your end before we make another attempt to land.
C: SIA895, roger, standard procedure.
C: SIA895, the outer marker operation is normal.
Q: What is the pilot’s request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，新航895，我们错过了外指点标，复飞了，在我们再次着陆之前，你可以检查下你那边的外指点标吗？
管制员：新航895，收到，标准（复飞）程序。
管制员：新航895，外指点标正常工作。
问：飞行员的请求是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Examine the outer marker.

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, CSN5402, severe vibration on the left side, we heard a loud explosion, seems we are in big trouble.
C: CSN5402, roger Mayday. What is your intention?
P: We are sorting out the problem, I will call you back.
C: CSN5402, Roger.
Q: What does the pilot intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，南方5402，左侧剧烈震动，我们听到了巨大的爆炸声，看起来我们遇到麻烦了。
管制员：南方5402，收到Mayday，你的意图是什么？
飞行员：我们正在找出问题所在，等下叫你。
问：飞行员打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To identify the problem

cards.audioText:
P: London Control, BAW403, we’ve lost pitch control, we need very long final, request fire services assistant on landing, position 14 miles from threshold, 4000 feet, heading 250.
C: BAW403, London, continue this heading for the moment. I will position you for a long stretch in the approach immediately.
Q: What did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：伦敦区调，英航403，我们失去了俯仰控制，我们需要一个长五边，着陆后请求消防援助，当前在跑道入口14海里，高度4000英尺，航向250。
管制员：英航403，伦敦，目前保持航向，我马上将给你一个长五边进近。
问：飞行员请求了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A long distance final.

cards.audioText:
A: I was wondering whether you know the wind shear.
B: Yes, the most hazardous wind shear is microburst. It can occur beneath a thunderstorm, rain shower or cumulous cloud.
Q: What kind of wind shear is most dangerous?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：我想知道你知道风切变吗？
B：是的，最危险的风切变是微下击暴流，它可以在雷暴、暴雨或者积雨云下方出现。
问：什么样的风切变最危险？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. microburst.

cards.audioText:
A: There are different types and degrees of pre-flight inspection.
B: Ah, yes, the individual components will be replaced based on the number of landings, flying hours, and other criteria.
Q: What are the criteria for replacement of individual item?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：有不同类型和等级的航前检查。
B：是的，个别组件会根据着陆次数、飞行时间和其他标准进行更换。
问：更换个别组件的标准是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Number of landings.

cards.audioText:
P: Qantas 235, holding on taxiway A
C: Qantas 235, hold short for the departure. You are No.2 after the airbus 320.
P: Holding short, No.2 for departure, Qantas 235.
C: Qantas 235, line up and wait.
P: Lining up, Qantas 235.
Q: What was the departure sequence for Qantas 235?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：澳航235，在滑行道A等待。
管制员：澳航235，在跑道外等待起飞，在空客320后，你是第二个。
飞行员：跑道外等待，第二个起飞，澳航235。
管制员：澳航235，上跑道等待。
飞行员：上跑道，澳航235。
问：澳航235的起飞顺序是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Number 2.

cards.audioText:
NW18 is taxing to RW 23R via taxiway T.
P: NW18, holding short RW 16.
C: NW18, cleared to cross RW 16 without delay, traffic 3 miles final
P: NW18, unable to expedite, we are stopped.
C: NW18, hold short of RW 16, taxi clearance cancel.
P: NW18, holding short.
Q: Describe what happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
西北18正在通过滑行道T前往跑道23右。
飞行员：西北18，在跑道16外等待。
管制员：西北18，立即穿越跑道16，五边3海里有航空器。
飞行员：西北18，无法加速，我们停下来了。
管制员：西北18，在跑道16外等待，取消滑行许可。
飞行员；西北18，在跑道外等待。
问：描述下发生了什么？
choices: They didn't accept the clearance to cross.
They were going too fast to stop.
They expedited their taxi across RW 16.
They crossed RW 16 and are holding short of taxiway Tango.
choicesZh: 他们没有接受穿越跑道的许可。
他们速度太快，无法停下。
他们穿越跑道16，并在滑行道T外等待。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They didn't accept the clearance to cross.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Hong Kong Approach, CSN3043, port engine failed, will attempt to land at your airport, 5 miles west of Charlie, 8000ft, heading 060.
CTL: CSN3043, Hong Kong Approach, roger Mayday, turn right heading 030, descend to 6000ft, you will be number one, if dangerous goods on board?
PIL: Turn right heading 030, descend to 6000ft, negative dangerous goods, CSN3403.
CTL: Roger, break break, all stations, stop transmitting, Mayday.
Q: Which of the following statement is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：Mayday Mayday Mayday，香港进近，南方3043，左发失效，将尝试在你的机场着陆。C西5海里，8000英尺，航向060。
管制员：南方3043，香港进近，收到Mayday，右转航向030，下到6000英尺，你是第一个，机上有危险品吗？
飞行员：右转航向030，下到6000英尺，没有危险品，南方3403。
管制员：收到，断开断开，各台注意，停止发话，有遇险航空器。
问：以下哪个说法是正确的？
choices: The aircraft encounters left engine failure.
There is dangerous goods on board.
The aircraft will be descending from 8000ft to 5000ft.
The aircraft is instructed to turn left heading 030.
choicesZh: 飞机将从8000英尺下到5000英尺
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The aircraft encounters left engine failure.

cards.audioText:
PIL: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Beijing Control, CCA981, smoke coming from engine bleed air system, we suspect that something is on fire, we have dropped the oxygen masks.
CTL: CCA981, roger Mayday, you are cleared to return, descend at your own discretion, what is your intention?
