飞行员（P）：收到，AFR 214使用VOR进近36左跑道。
问题：什么原因导致ILS进近无法使用？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Antenna problem.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, KLM 256. We have difficulty in maintaining straight course. Our plane tends to drift to the left. We are coming back. C: KLM 256, join downwind Runway 18L, you are number one.
Question: what happened to KLM 256?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，KLM 256。我们难以保持直线航向，飞机有向左偏航的趋势，我们正在返航。
管制员（C）：KLM 256，加入18左跑道下风边，你第一。
问题：KLM 256发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. KLM 256 has a control problem.

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 728, can you make a slot time of 52 minutes? P: Negative, we now have a catering delay. Put me back fifteen past the hour, JAL 728. C: Roger, 728, let me know when you are ready.
Question: why does the pilot want to delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：JAL 728，你能在52分离场吗？
飞行员（P）：不行，我们现在因餐饮服务（准备）延误了。请把我们安排到整点过15分钟，JAL 728。
管制员（C）：收到，728，你准备好时告知我。
问题：为什么飞行员想要延误？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due to food loading

cards.audioText:
P: Guangzhou tower, CSN 304, flaps and slats are jammed, we can't extend beyond 15, request divert to Zhuhai airport which has a longer runway. C: CSN 304, cleared to Zhuhai, I'll inform Zhuhai you have a Configuration problem.
Question: what is the problem of CSN 304?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：广州塔台，CSN 304，襟翼和缝翼卡住了，我们无法将其展开超过15，请求改航至跑道更长的珠海机场。
管制员（C）：CSN 304，准许改航至珠海，我会告知珠海你们存在构型问题。
问题：CSN 304遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Improper configuration problem

cards.audioText:
P: Shanghai Approach, EAL 456, request priority landing. We got a passenger on board who feels difficulty in breathing. C: EAL 456, down to 3000 feet, straight in approach Runway 18R, first to land.
Question: what might be the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：上海进近，EAL 456，请求优先着陆。我们机上有一名乘客呼吸困难。
管制员（C）：EAL 456，下降至3000英尺，直线进近18右跑道，优先着陆。
问题：可能出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. There is a patient with severe asthma.
choices: There is a patient with severe diarrhea.
There is a patient with severe asthma.
There is a patient with severe flu.
There is a patient with severe stomachache.
choicesZh: 一名患者患有严重腹泻
一名患者患有严重哮喘

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, DAL 335, we are returning due to burst tire during gear retraction. Request priority landing. C: DAL 335, Roger, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L, you are number one.
Question: What's the problem of DAL 335?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，DAL 335，因收轮时轮胎爆裂需返航，请求优先着陆。
管制员（C）：D335，收到，雷达引导至18左跑道仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近，你第一。
问题：DAL 335的问题是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Tyre blown out.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, TWA 368. We have to come back. We nearly stalled during the climb out. Cargo shifted in the front hold. C: TWA 368, Roger, turn left heading 270.
Question: Why did TWA 368 return?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉进近，TWA 368，我们需返航。爬升时险些失速，前货舱货物发生移位。
管制员（C）：TWA 368，收到，左转航向270。
问题：TWA 368为何返航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Loading problem.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan delivery, AFR 123, ready to copy ATC clearance. C: AFR 123, standby. We have not received your flight plan yet. Let me check and call you later.
Question: What problem does AFR 123 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉放行，AFR 123，准备接收空管放行指令。
管制员（C）：AFR 123，请稍候。我们尚未收到你的飞行计划，我核查后稍后联系你。
问题：AFR 123遇到什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Flight plan not received by Delivery.
choices: Flight plan not received by Delivery.
choicesZh: 放行管制未收到飞行计划

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan ground, AFR 321, radio check on 121 decimal 3. How do you read? C: Station calling ground, say again your call sign. Your transmission is jammed. Check your transmitter.
Question: What are the pilot and controller doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉地面，AFR 321，在121.3（频率）进行无线电检查。你听到的效果如何？
管制员（C）：呼叫地面的电台，重复你的呼号。你的信号受干扰。检查你的发射机。
问题：飞行员和管制员分别在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio check.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR 213. Passenger boarding is taking a longer time than before. It has not been completed yet. Please delay our departure time until 0850. C: AFR 213, Roger. Call back when you're ready.
Question: What happened to AFR 213?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：地面，AFR 213。旅客登机时间比以往更长，尚未完成。请将我们的起飞时间推迟至08:50。
管制员（C）：AFR 213，收到。准备好后回电。
问题：AFR 213发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They have a slow boarding.
choices: They need an early slot time.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 321, your company dispatcher advised us that there was an error in your load sheet. Please call the dispatcher. P: Roger, thanks. AFR 321.
Question: What does the pilot need to call the dispatcher?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：AFR 321，你公司签派员告知我们，你的载重表存在错误，请联系签派员。
飞行员（P）：收到，谢谢。AFR 321。
问题：飞行员为何需要联系签派员？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of the loading sheet error.
choices: Because of the loading sheet error.

cards.audioText:
P: Delivery, AFR 131, five minutes before start, request ATC clearance. C: AFR 131, standby. There's an error in your flight plan, the reporting office says you haven't filed the alternate.
Question: Why is the aircraft asked to stand by?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：放行，AFR 131，预计5分钟后启动发动机，请求空中交通管制许可。
管制员（C）：AFR 131，稍等。你的飞行计划存在错误，报告部门称你未提交备降场信息。
问题：飞机为何被要求等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because they did not file the alternate.
choices: Because it is 5 minutes before start.
Because they did not file the alternate.
Because they did not submit the flight plan.
choicesZh: 因为放行管制尚未准备好
因为他们没有申报备降场
因为他们没有提交飞行计划

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, NWA 146, we can't start up due flat batteries. Would you check with ground services for us, and see if we can use a GPU? C: NWA 146, stand by, I will inform them.
Question: what does the crew want?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：地勤，NWA 146，由于电池电量不足，我们无法启动（飞机）。你能帮我们联系一下地勤服务人员，看看我们能否使用地面电源设备（GPU）吗？
管制员（C）：NWA 146，稍等，我会通知他们。
问题：机组人员想要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To start up with ground power.
choices: Ground stuff to check their batteries.
To start up with ground power.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, SWA 3343, oil pressure dangerously low on the number two engine. Can we proceed Portland direct? C: Affirm, proceed to Tacoma direct at flight level one three zero.
Question: what happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：管制员，SWA 3343号航班，2号发动机油压低至危险水平。我们能直飞波特兰吗？
管制员（C）：可以，以飞行高度层130直飞塔科马。
问题：发生了什么事？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. low oil pressure.

cards.audioText:
P: Pacific 28, fuel leak on the left wing, coming back. Request clearance to Dosson direct. C: Cleared to Dosson, FL150.
Question: what is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：太平洋航空28号航班，左翼燃油泄漏，准备返航。请求直飞Dosson。
管制员（C）：准许直飞多森，飞行高度层150。
问题：出现了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Fuel leakage.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan approach, ACA 196. We are returning due to burst tire during gear retraction. Request priority landing. C: ACA 196, Roger, radar vectors, expect ILS approach Runway 32, you are number one.
Question: What is the problem of ACA 196?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，这里是ACA 196。由于收轮时轮胎爆裂，我们正在返航。请求优先着陆。
管制员：ACA 196，收到。雷达引导，预计使用32号跑道仪表着陆系统进近，你是第一顺位。
问题：ACA 196遇到了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Tyres blew out.

cards.audioText:
C: DLH 117, unknown traffic, 3:00, 15 kilometers, westbound, Airbus 320, 7800 meters, descending. P: Looking out, DLH 117.
Question: where is the traffic?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：汉莎117，不明航空器，方位3点钟方向，距离15公里，向西飞行，空客320，高度7800米，正在下降。
飞行员（P）：观察中，汉莎117。
问题：目标机在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 3 o'clock, 15 kilometers, 7800m.

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5581, Beijing ground, continue stand by for push back. A special fly is taxiing in. P: Roger, standing by, CES 5581.
Question: Why was CES 5581 delayed for push back?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员（C）：CES 5581，北京地面，继续等待推出。有一架专机正在滑行。
飞行员（P）：收到，等待中，CES 5581。
问题：为什么CES 5581航班在推出时被延误了？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A special aircraft was taxiing in.
choices: A special aircraft was taxiing in.
It wasn’t the slot time yet.
choicesZh: 一架特殊航空器正在滑入

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan ground, CCA 151, gate 10, request push back and start up. C: CCA 151, standby. Your slot time is not determined due to flow control. Call you back.
Question: why did the Controller refuse CCA 151's request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：武汉地面，CCA 151，10号登机口，请求推出和启动发动机。
管制员（C）：CCA 151，稍等。因流量控制，你的离场时间尚未确定。等会儿通知你。
问题：管制员为何拒绝CCA 151的请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Slot time not determined.

cards.audioText:
P: ACA 760, request holding procedure. C: ACA 760, hold over Enshi NDB 4200 meters, inbound track 250, left hand pattern, outbound time one minute.
Question: What is the out bound track of the holding pattern?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：ACA 760，请求等待程序。
管制员（C）：ACA 760，在恩施导航台上空等待，高度4200米，向台航迹250，左等待航线，出航时间1分钟。
问题：等待航线的出航航迹是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 070.

cards.audioText:
In order to reduce RTF communication, a pilot will make a position report only on first transfer of communication from another area control center, on reaching the limit of the ATC clearance, and when instructed by ATC.
Question: When will a pilot make a position report?
cards.audioTextZh:
为了减少无线电通话（RTF）通信，飞行员仅在从另一个区域管制中心首次转接通信时、达到空中交通管制许可的限制时以及在收到空中交通管制的指示时，才会进行位置报告。
问题：飞行员在什么时候会进行位置报告？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. All above.
choices: Reaching the limit of ATC clearance.

cards.audioText:
P: Shanghai Control, SIA 235, Boeing 777, hold over ZMK VOR, outbound leg, turn inbound. C: SIA 235, Shanghai Control, continue hold ZMK, delay not determined.
Question: When will SIA 235 make approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：上海管制，SIA 235，机型波音777，在ZMK VOR等待，出航航段，转向进近航段。
管制员（C）：SIA 235，上海管制，继续ZMK等待，延误时间未确定。
问题：SIA 235什么时候进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Delay not determined.

cards.audioText:
P: Hong Kong Tower, AFR 985, long final. C: AFR 985, Hong Kong Tower, number 2, wind calm. P: Number 2, AFR 985.
Question: what is the landing sequence for AFR 985?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：香港塔台，AFR 985，长五边。
管制员（C）：AFR 985，香港塔台，（你是）第二个（降落），静风。
飞行员（P）：明白是第二个（降落），AFR 985。
问题：AFR 985的降落顺序是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Number two to land.

cards.audioText:
P: Guangzhou, CSN 304, flaps and slats are jammed. We can't extend beyond one five. Request divert to Zhuhai airport, which has a longer runway. C: CSN 304, clear to Zhuhai. I'll inform Zhuhai you have a configuration problem.
Question: what does the crew intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员（P）：广州，CSN 304，襟翼和缝翼卡阻，无法放出超过15度。请求备降珠海机场，因其跑道更长。
管制员（C）：CSN 304，允许备降珠海。我将通知珠海你存在构型问题。
问题：机组打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To divert to Zhuhai.
choices: To make a high speed approach.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Tower, CSN 302, no contact at minima (=poor visibility), going around.
C: CSN 302, standard procedure.
Question: What is the reason for going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 北京塔台，CSN 302，在最低标准处无法建立目视接触，复飞。
C: CSN 302，按标准程序执行。
问题：复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Poor visibility.

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5195, go around, follow the localizer, climb to and maintain 2100 meters, the preceding aircraft aborted takeoff.
P: Going around, CES 5195.
Question: Why was CES 5195 instructed to go around?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CES 5195，复飞，沿航向道飞行，爬升并保持2100 meters，前机中断起飞。
P: 正在复飞，CES 5195。
问题：为什么指示CES 5195复飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The preceding aircraft rejected takeoff.
choices: The preceding aircraft was unable to vacate the runway.
The aircraft was too close to the preceding aircraft.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, Eva 761, request start engine at the gate due APU malfunction.
C: Eva 761, start engine at the gate approved, report ready for pushback.
Question: Why did the pilot request start engine at the gate?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，EVA 761，由于APU故障，请求在停机位启动发动机。
C: EVA 761，批准在停机位启动发动机，准备推出时报告。
问题：飞行员为什么请求在停机位启动发动机？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due to APU failure.
choicesZh: 由于地面电源装置失效
由于控制显示组件失效

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 428, expedite climb, terrain ahead, terrain alert, expedite passing 5000 feet, expedite.
P: expediting, CCA 428.
Question: Why was CCA 428 asked to expedite climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 428，加速爬升，前方有地形，地形警告，加速通过5000 feet，加速。
P: 正在加速爬升，CCA 428。
问题：为什么要求CCA 428加速爬升？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due to terrain alert.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, Qatar 274, we are fully ready for pushback and startup.
C: Qatar 274, roger, stand by, indefinite delay, emergency in progress.
Question: Why was Qatar 274 instructed to stand by?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，QTR 274，我们已完全准备好推出和启动。
C: QTR 274，收到，等待，延误时间未定，正在处置紧急情况。
问题：为什么指示QTR 274等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due emergency in progress.
choicesZh: 由于正在处置紧急情况
由于后方有航空器滑行

cards.audioText:
P: KLM 73 Echo, we have some unruly passengers on board, so we would like to return to the gate, request the police at the gate.
C: KLM 73 Echo, roger.
Question: Why did KLM 73 Echo request to return to the gate?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: KLM 73E，机上有一些扰乱秩序的乘客，因此我们希望返回登机口，请求警察在登机口等候。
C: KLM 73E，收到。
问题：KLM 73E为什么请求返回登机口？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There were some unruly passengers on board.
choices: There were some unruly passengers on board.
There was a seriously ill passenger on board.
There was a seriously injured passenger on board.
There was an illegal stowaway on board.
choicesZh: 机上有不守规矩的乘客
机上有一名病情严重的乘客
机上有一名受重伤的乘客
机上有一名非法偷渡者

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, CES 5325, what's the delay like?
C: CES 5325, delay not determined due variable visibility, suggest divert to Changsha Airport.
Question: Why did the controller suggest CES 5325 diverting to Changsha?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉进近，CES 5325，延误情况如何？
C: CES 5325，由于能见度变化，延误时间无法确定，建议改航长沙机场。
问题：管制员为什么建议CES 5325改航长沙？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Because delay was not determined due variable visibility.
choices: Because delay was not determined due variable visibility.
Because delay was not determined due runway obstruction.
Because delay was not determined due runway closure.
Because delay was not determined due variable wind.
choicesZh: 由于能见度多变，延误时间未定
由于跑道受阻，延误时间未定
由于跑道关闭，延误时间未定
由于风向多变，延误时间未定

cards.audioText:
C: DAL 303, reduce speed to 140 knots due separation.
P: negative, our minimum approach speed is 150 knots, DAL 303.
Question: Why was DAL 303 unable to accept 140 knots?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: DAL 303，由于间隔需要，减速至140 knots。
P: 无法执行，我们的最低进近速度是150 knots，DAL 303。
问题：DAL 303为什么无法接受140 knots？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due aircraft performance.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, this is BAW 233, we are ready for departure on Runway 29L.
C: BAW 233, your transmission is cut in and out. Check your mike button and call back.
Question: What was the problem in the transmission?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 塔台，BAW 233，我们已准备好从Runway 29L离场。
C: BAW 233，你的通话时断时续。检查话筒按钮后重新呼叫。
问题：通话出现了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Intermittent

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR 456, we are coming back due to cracked windscreen caused by bird strike during departure.
C: AFR 456, roger, join right downwind.
Question: Why did AFR return?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 离场，AFR 456，我们正在返航，因为离场期间鸟击造成风挡破裂。
C: AFR 456，收到，加入右三边。
问题：AFR为什么返航？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Windscreen cracked.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 1141, vacate runway via taxiway A4, caution, much trench on right side, correction, much trench on the left side of A4.
Question: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 1141，经滑行道A4脱离跑道，注意，A4右侧有沟槽，更正，沟槽在A4左侧。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A trench is on the left side of taxiway.
choices: A trench is on the left side of taxiway.
Work in progress next to the apron.
The center of the taxiway A4 is damaged.
The left of the taxiway A4 is damaged.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, take first left, then T5, P to Gate 212.
P: T5, P to Gate 212, CCA 981.
Question: When did this conversation take place?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 981，第一个路口左转，然后经T5、P滑行至Gate 212。
P: 经T5、P滑行至Gate 212，CCA 981。
问题：这段通话发生在什么时候？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. During taxi in.

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 501, hold short of Runway 16, give way to landing traffic, contact tower on 124.95.
Question: Why does Tower ask QFA 501 to hold short?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: QFA 501，在Runway 16外等待，给着陆航空器让行，在124.95联系塔台。
问题：塔台为什么要求QFA 501在跑道外等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Landing traffic on Runway 16

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 40 heavy, moderate turbulence reported ahead above FL 380. Would you like a lower altitude?
P: roger, is FL360 available, NWA 40 heavy.
Question: Where is the reported turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: NWA 40 heavy，前方FL 380以上报告有中度湍流。你是否需要较低高度？
P: 收到，FL360可用吗？NWA 40 heavy。
问题：报告的湍流位于哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Ahead and above FL 380.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 889, expect lower altitude until the climbing aircraft has passed, confirm you are levelling at 11,500m.
Question: What altitude does the controller think UAL 889 is at right now?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 889，在爬升航空器通过前预计使用较低高度，确认你正在11,500m改平。
问题：管制员认为UAL 889目前位于什么高度？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Maintaining 11,500 m.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, CCA 980, confirm holding instruction.
C: CCA 980, hold at N VOR/DME 120 radial, inbound track 220, right hand turn.
Question: What is the inbound track?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 管制，CCA 980，确认等待指令。
C: CCA 980，在N VOR/DME的120径向线上等待，向台航迹220，右转。
问题：向台航迹是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 220

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 321, caution, unknown balloon over right turning base of Runway 36 at 32, altitude 300m moving northbound 40km per hour.
Question: Why should UAL 321 keep a good look out?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 321，注意，Runway 36右转基准边上空有不明气球，时间32，高度300m，以40km per hour向北移动。
问题：UAL 321为什么应保持仔细观察？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. There is a balloon near the runway.
choices: There is a balloon near the runway.
He is 40 KM per hour too fast.
He is turning base for R/W36.
choicesZh: 他的速度快了每小时40千米

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, expedite descent 6000m, upon reaching, turn left 30 degrees, traffic 12 o'clock 10 miles, opposite direction, United B737 climbing to your altitude.
Question: What is the relative motion of the traffic?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 230，加速下降至6000m，到达后左转30度；冲突航空器位于12点钟方向、距离10 miles，相向飞行，是一架正在爬升至你方高度的UAL B737。
问题：冲突航空器的相对运动是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Opposite direction, below and climbing.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 480, flames coming out from your No. 3 engine on takeoff, please advise.
P: roger, declaring an emergency, request immediate return, BAW 480.
Question: Why are they declaring an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: BAW 480，起飞时你的No. 3发动机有火焰冒出，请报告意图。
P: 收到，宣布紧急状态，请求立即返航，BAW 480。
问题：他们为什么宣布紧急状态？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Engine fire.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN 15, on Taxiway N for Runway 27L, we see debris on the left side of runway near the high speed turn off. It appears to be a part of engine cowling.
Question: Where is the debris?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，CSN 15，我们正在滑行道N上前往Runway 27L。我们看到跑道左侧靠近快速脱离道处有碎片，看起来像是发动机整流罩的一部分。
问题：碎片在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. On the left side of the runway.
choices: On the high speed turn off.
On the right side of the runway.
On the left side of the runway.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 705, climb at pilot's discretion to 8000m, maintain heading 150 until advised.
P: leaving 6000m for 8000m, will advise, CCA 705.
Question: What is their present altitude?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 705，由飞行员自行决定爬升至8000m，保持航向150直至另行通知。
P: 离开6000m爬升至8000m，将报告，CCA 705。
问题：他们目前的高度是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 6000m
choicesZh: 由飞行员自行决定爬升

cards.audioText:
P: MD-11 on final in sight, BAW 315.
C: BAW 315, line up after the landing MD-11.
Question: What is BAW 315 going to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 已看到最后进近中的MD-11，BAW 315。
C: BAW 315，在着陆的MD-11之后进入跑道。
问题：BAW 315准备做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To line up after MD-11.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 223, RVR Runway 26L touchdown 600m, mid point 850m, stop end missing.
P: UAL 223.
Question: What is the best RVR?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 223，Runway 26L的RVR：接地区600m，中间段850m，停止端数据缺失。
P: UAL 223。
问题：哪一段的RVR最好？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Midpoint

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 785, behind departing AFR 74, cross Runway 14L behind, turn right on C, hold short of Runway 14R.
Question: What are they going to do when they reach RW14L?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 785，在离场的AFR 74之后穿越Runway 14L，在C右转，并在Runway 14R外等待。
问题：到达Runway 14L时，他们准备做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Cross the RW behind AFR 74.
choicesZh: 右转并在14L跑道上反向滑行

cards.audioText:
Pilot: "Shanghai Tower, CES 567, radio check on 123.45."
Controller: "CES 567, Shanghai Tower, read you 3, your signal is weak. Check your transmitter."
Question: What is the controller's response to the pilot's radio check?
cards.audioTextZh:
Pilot: “上海塔台，CES 567，在123.45进行无线电检查。”
Controller: “CES 567，上海塔台，信号强度3，信号较弱。检查你的发射机。”
问题：管制员如何回复飞行员的无线电检查？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The signal is weak
choices: The pilot's call sign is incorrect.

cards.audioText:
P: Guanghan Tower, B9725, radio check on 118.9, how do you read?
C: B9725, Guanghan Tower, I read you 1, check your transmitter.
Question: How is the radio signal of B9725?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 广汉塔台，B9725，在118.9进行无线电检查，听我的信号如何？
C: B9725，广汉塔台，信号强度1，检查你的发射机。
问题：B9725的无线电信号如何？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Unreadable.

cards.audioText:
P: Chengdu Tower, Sichuan 8885, radio check on 119.25, how do you read?
C: Sichuan 8885, Chengdu Tower, I read you 5.
Question: What's the readability of Sichuan 8885?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 成都塔台，Sichuan 8885，在119.25进行无线电检查，听我的信号如何？
C: Sichuan 8885，成都塔台，信号强度5。
问题：Sichuan 8885的可读性如何？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Perfectly readable.

cards.audioText:
P: Xiamen Approach, Xiamen 8205, radio check on 118.45, how do you read?
C: Xiamen 8205, Xiamen Approach, I read you 2, you are cut in and out.
Question: What's the readability of Xiamen 8205?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 厦门进近，Xiamen 8205，在118.45进行无线电检查，听我的信号如何？
C: Xiamen 8205，厦门进近，信号强度2，你的信号时断时续。
问题：Xiamen 8205的可读性如何？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Readable now and then.

cards.audioText:
CCA 101, hold short of Runway 36, traffic on short final, report have it in sight.
Question: When should the pilot make a report?
cards.audioTextZh:
CCA 101，在Runway 36外等待，短五边有航空器，看到该航空器后报告。
问题：飞行员应在什么时候报告？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. When he sees the traffic on final
choices: When he sees the traffic ahead.
When he sees the traffic on final
When he holds at holding point
When he turns off the runway.
choicesZh: 看到五边上的航空器时

cards.audioText:
CCA 500, Runway 26R RVR, touchdown 600m, mid-point 800m, stop-end 700m.
Question: what is the RVR of the stop end?
cards.audioTextZh:
CCA 500，Runway 26R的RVR：接地点600m，中间段800m，停止端700m。
问题：停止端的RVR是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 700m

cards.audioText:
C: GAF, traffic 10 o'clock, FL270, moving from left to right, 15 miles.
Question: What is the traffic condition?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: GAF，冲突航空器位于10点钟方向、FL270，正从左向右移动，距离15 miles。
问题：冲突航空器的情况如何？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 15 miles 10 o'clock FL270 moving from left to right.
choices: 15 miles 10 o'clock FL270 moving from left to right.
15 miles 10 o'clock FL270 moving from right to left.
15 miles 10 o'clock FL260 moving from left to right.
15 miles 10 o'clock FL260 moving from right to left.
choicesZh: 10点钟方向15海里、FL270、从左向右飞行
10点钟方向15海里、FL270、从右向左飞行
10点钟方向15海里、FL260、从左向右飞行
10点钟方向15海里、FL260、从右向左飞行

cards.audioText:
C: GCD, I read you 3 with loud background whistle.
Question: what is the transmission quality of GCD?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: GCD，信号强度3，并伴有很响的背景哨声。
问题：GCD的通话质量如何？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Readable but with difficulty
choicesZh: 不清楚且背景噪声很大

cards.audioText:
BAW 386, backtrack Runway 03, vacate runway via taxiway A1, taxi with caution a tug broke down at next intersection.
Question: Where is the Airbus?
cards.audioTextZh:
BAW 386，沿Runway 03反向滑行，经滑行道A1脱离跑道，谨慎滑行，下一个交叉口有一辆牵引车发生故障。
问题：Airbus在哪里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An unserviceable tug is stopping at the next intersection.
choices: BAW 386 should vacate by the end of Runway 03.
BAW 386 is broken down at the next intersection.
An unserviceable tug is stopping at the next intersection.
BAW 386 blocked the taxiway A1 and needs towing.
choicesZh: BAW 386在下一个交叉口发生故障
一辆故障牵引车停在下一个交叉口

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, HDA 613, passing 3000ft.
C: HDA 613, cancel SID turn right heading 240 to intercept CH 215.
Question: What is the departure route of Dragon air 613?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 离场，HDA 613，正通过3000ft。
C: HDA 613，取消SID，右转航向240，切入CH 215。
问题：HDA 613的离场航路是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Turn right heading 240 to intercept 215 radial.
choices: Turn left heading 204 to intercept 215 radial.
Turn right heading 240 to intercept 215 radial.
Turn right heading 240 to intercept 210 radial.
Turn right heading 204 to intercept 210 radial.
choicesZh: 左转航向204度，截获215度径向线
右转航向240度，截获215度径向线
右转航向240度，截获210度径向线
右转航向204度，截获210度径向线

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, UAL 048, request start up port outboard for engine check.
C: UAL 048, startup approved, but set your engine to idle due to noise abatement.
Question: Which engine will be started for check?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，UAL 048，请求启动左外侧发动机进行检查。
C: UAL 048，启动获准，但由于噪声管制，请将发动机设为慢车。
问题：将启动哪台发动机进行检查？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Left outboard engine.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CCA 101, the tow bar was broken, we are wait for a replacement.
C: CCA 101, call me back when ready.
Question: What happened to CCA 101?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，CCA 101，牵引杆断了，我们正在等待替换件。
C: CCA 101，准备好后再次呼叫我。
问题：CCA 101发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The towbar is broken during pushback.
choices: No tug is available for them now.
The tug is broken during pushback.
The towbar is broken during pushback.
The engines ingested foreign object during start-up.
choicesZh: 牵引车在推出期间发生故障
发动机启动时吸入异物

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 309, ILS CAT II is unreliable due to inoperative centerline lighting. ILS CAT I minima is in effect.
P: ILS CAT I minima, CSN 309
Question: What makes ILS category II unreliable?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 309，由于跑道中线灯失效，ILS CAT II不可靠，现执行ILS CAT I最低标准。
P: ILS CAT I最低标准，CSN 309。
问题：什么原因导致ILS CAT II不可靠？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Failing centerline lighting

cards.audioText:
P: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, UAL 521, a passenger is seriously ill, probably a heart attack, request divert to A.
C: roger, UAL 521, turn left heading 180, I will advise you request medical assistance upon landing.
Question: What happened on board?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，UAL 521，一名乘客病情严重，可能是心脏病发作，请求改航A机场。
C: 收到，UAL 521，左转航向180，我会通知落地后提供医疗援助。
问题：机上发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A passenger had a heart attack.
choices: Fire was detected in the rear galley.
A passenger had a heart attack.
A pregnant woman is about to give birth.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Center, CES 441, request turn left 30 degrees to detour the build-up.
C: CES 441, negative due military movement, turn right 30 degrees.
Question: Why did the controller not let the crew turn left?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉区调，CES 441，请求左转30度绕飞积云堆积区。
C: CES 441，由于有军事活动，不同意，右转30度。
问题：管制员为什么不允许机组左转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They would enter military area.
choices: They would enter a dangerous area.
They would run into the build-up area.
They would be hit by a missile.
choicesZh: 他们将进入云体发展区

cards.audioText:
Wuhan tower, ACA 2056, ready for departure.
ACA 2056, behind Boeing 747 on short final, line up and wait Runway 36R.
Question: What does the controller's instruction reply?
cards.audioTextZh:
武汉塔台，ACA 2056，已准备好离场。
ACA 2056，跟在短五边的Boeing 747之后，进入Runway 36R等待。
问题：管制员回复的指令是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. ACA 2056 has to wait for a landing 747 before lining up.
choices: ACA 2056 is number two for departure.
ACA 2056 has to wait for a departing 747 before lining up.
ACA 2056 has to wait for a landing 747 before lining up.
choicesZh: ACA 2056必须等一架离场的747后才能进入跑道
ACA 2056必须等一架着陆的747后才能进入跑道

cards.audioText:
C: Alpha Center, ACA 303, for sequencing, can you reduce to minimum speed? The next sector will advise your descent speed.
P: affirm, ACA 303.
Question: When will the pilot receive descend speed?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: Alpha管制，ACA 303，为便于排序，能否减至最小速度？下一管制区将告知你的下降速度。
P: 是的，ACA 303。
问题：飞行员何时会收到下降速度指示？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. When the next controller contacts him.
choices: When the next controller contacts him.
After he reduces to minimum speed.
choicesZh: 下一位管制员联系他时

cards.audioText:
panpan, panpan, panpan, Hongkong approach CES 141, we have low fuel on board, request landing priority. 15 miles east at FL110..
Question: What can we learn from this statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，香港进近，CES 141，机上燃油不足，请求优先着陆。当前位置在东侧15英里，FL110。
问题：我们能从这段通话中了解到什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. CSN 141 had a fuel emergency.
choices: CES 141 was west of Hongkong airport.
CSN 141 wanted to land at the alternate airport.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES5521, Beijing Tower, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 220, 16 m/s.
PIL: Beijing Tower, request hold present position till wind dies down. Advise us when it drops to 13 m/s or less, CES5521.
Q: According to the dialogue, what did the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方5521，北京塔台，可以起飞，地面风220，16米/秒。
飞：北京塔台，请求原地等候风减小。风速下降至不超过13米/秒时通知我，东方5521。
问：根据对话，飞行员想做什么？
choices: Tell the controller wind speed is changing
Delay takeoff due to high wind speed
choicesZh: 通知管制员风速正在改变
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Delay takeoff due to high wind speed

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA104, Beijing Control, RVR less than 200m due smog, expect dispersal within 30 minutes. Say intention.
PIL: Beijing Control, endurance 0100, request alternate to Hohhot, CCA104.
Q: According to the dialogue, when will the smog disappear?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航104，北京区调，由于烟雾，跑道RVR低于200米，预计持续时间30分钟，请示意图。
飞：北京区调，续航时间1小时，请求备降到呼和，国航104。
问：根据对话，烟雾何时消散？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Within 30 minutes

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, BAW28, problem with tug, request delay pushback for about 15 minutes.
CTL: BAW28, understand require 15 minutes. If exceed 15 minutes, slot time will be reallocated.
Q: According to the controller, what should BAW28 do to avoid further delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，英航28，拖车有问题，请求推迟15分钟推出。
管：英航28，了解，需要15分钟。如果超过15分钟，将重新分配离场时间。\问：根据管制员的话，为了避免更多的延迟，英航28应怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Pushback within 15 minutes

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Departure, BAW28, reaching 4500m.
CTL: BAW28, climb to 9500m, expedite climb until passing 7500m due to opposite traffic, report reaching 8100m.
Q: According to the exchange, which altitude should the aircraft climb to?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京离场，英航28，到达4500米。
管：英航28，爬升9500米，由于相对，快速爬升直到通过7500米，过8100米报告。
问：根据对话，飞机应爬升至多高？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 9500 meters

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA104, threshold runway 18R is displaced 100m due to broken surface. Change to runway 18L.
PIL: Roger, change to runway 18L, CCA104.
Q: Why was runway 18R inoperative?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航104，由于路面磨损 ，跑道18右入口内移100米。更换至跑道18左。
飞：收到，更换至跑道18左，国航104。
问：跑道18右为什么不可用？
choices: There was some debris on the surface
The surface of runway threshold was broken
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The surface of runway threshold was broken

cards.audioText:
L: Ramp, CCA165, we are ready to taxi out, but it seems that the chocks haven’t been removed.
RAMP: CCA165, roger, I will advise someone to check.
Q: Why couldn’t CCA165 taxi out?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：机坪，国航165，准备好滑出，轮挡好像没有撤掉。
机坪：国航165，收到，我派人去检查。
问：国航165为什么不能滑出？
choices: Somebody was still checking the brakes
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Chocks were still in place

cards.audioText:
PLT: Beijing Ground, CCA102, request Gate number.
CTL: CCA102, say again request.
PIL: Request Gate number, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, Gate 06.
Q: What did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航102，请求机位号。
管：国航102，重复请求。
飞：请求机位号，国航102。
管：国航102，停机位6号。
问：飞行员请求什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Stand number

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102 will lose identification temporarily due fade area, squawk ident in one minute.
PIL: Wilco, CCA102.
Q: What’s the intention of the controller?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，由于进入盲区，将失去雷达信号，一分钟后应答机识别。
飞：收到，国航102。
问：管制员的目的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Re-identify radar

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES641, Beijing Control, climb to 11000m due to converging traffic at HUR, pass CDY at 9800m or above.
PIL: Roger, CES641.
Q: What did the controller ask the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方641，北京区调，由于HUR处有会聚活动，爬升11000米，过CDY 9800米或更高。
飞：收到，东方641。
问：管制员让飞行员做什么？
choices: Climb to 9800 meters due to traffic
Reach 9800 meters or above at CDY
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Reach 9800 meters or above at CDY

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ramp control, AFR208, we have cancelled our departure due to mechanical problem, we would like to stay overnight.
Ramp: AFR208, roger, I will allocate a new stand for you later.
Q: According to the exchange, what did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：机坪，法航208，由于机械故障，取消航班，我们要在这里过夜。
机坪：法航208，收到，我一会儿给你分配新的停机位。
问：根据对话，飞行员请求什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Overnight stay

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN6101, traffic at 1 o’clock, 30 kilometers, altitude unknown due primary radar.
PIL: Traffic in sight, it’s below me, CSN6101.
Q: According to the exchange, what was the possible reason the controller didn’t know exactly where the traffic was?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航6101，1点钟方向有活动，距离30千米，一次雷达无法判断高度。
飞：看到活动，在我下方，南航6101。
问：根据对话，管制员无法得知活动的确切位置的可能原因是什么？
choices: They might not have secondary radar
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. They might not have secondary radar

cards.audioText:
PIL: Harbin Approach, CSN306, confirm there is no water on runway 11.
CTL: CSN306 unable to confirm right now. So far there has been no report of standing water.
Q: According to the controller’s statement, which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：哈尔滨进近，南航306，确认跑道11上没有水。
管：南航306，现在不能立刻确认。目前还没有积水报告。
问：根据管制员的叙述，下列说法哪个是正确的？
choices: There is report of standing water but not on runway 11
There may be standing water on runway 11
ATC will tell the pilot about the runway condition later
ATC has confirmed there is standing water on runway 11
choicesZh: 有积水报告，但不是跑道11的
ATC接下来会告知飞行员跑道情况
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. There may be standing water on runway 11

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, CCA101, maintaining FL350, any ride reports for this level?
CTL: CCA101, moderate turbulence is reported up to FL370. But no turbulence report at FL390.
Q: According to the controller, which of the following may be true?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉区调，国航101，保持高度层350，在这一高度有报告颠簸的么？
管：国航101，高度层350至370有中度颠簸。但高度层390没有颠簸报告。
问：根据管制员的叙述，下列说法哪个是正确的？
choices: There is moderate turbulence reported at FL390
There is moderate turbulence reported from FL370 to FL390
There is turbulence reported from FL350 to FL370
There is no turbulence at FL370
choicesZh: 高度层390有中度颠簸报告
高度层370至390有中度颠簸报告
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There is turbulence reported from FL350 to FL370

cards.audioText:
CTL: AFR108, hold present position, an unserviceable aircraft is on the runway ahead of you. We will tow you to taxiway I, expect change of runway.
PIL: Roger, holding in present position. AFR108.
Q: Why should AFR108 hold in present position?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：法航108，原地等待，有架故障飞机在你前方。我们将把你拖到滑行道I，预计更换跑道。
飞：收到，原地等待。法航108。
问：法航108为什么要原地等待？
choices: To wait for the unserviceable aircraft on the runway
To wait for the preceding aircraft
An inoperative aircraft on taxiway I
There will be a short delay because of the change of runway
choicesZh: 滑行道I上有一架故障飞机
因为更换跑道要稍等一会儿
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. There will be a short delay because of the change of runway

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES213, a B737 is lined up waiting to depart after you land, expedite vacate runway 25.
PIL: Roger, expedite vacate runway 25, CES213.
Q: What should CES213 do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方213，一架波音737排队等待你着陆后离场，尽快脱离跑道25。
飞：收到，尽快脱离跑道25，东方213。
问：东方213接下来应该做什么？
choices: Clear the runway to avoid delay of another aircraft
Clear the runway to avoid delay of two departing aircraft
choicesZh: 离开跑道，避免延误其它飞机
离开跑道，避免延误两架正在离场的飞机
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Clear the runway to avoid delay of another aircraft

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ground, AFR978, we’ve just skidded off taxiway C and we can’t get back to the paving. Left gear appears to be stuck in the mud. Request a tug around.
CTL: AFR978, standby, ground handling said there is no available tug right now.
Q: Why did the pilot request a tug?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：地面，法航978，我们刚刚冲出滑行道C，无法回到道面。左起落架似乎陷进泥里。请求地面拖车。
管：法航978，稍等，地勤说现在没有可用拖车。
问：飞行员为什么请求拖车？
choices: Taxiway C had too much debris
Left gear was sticking in the mud
There was too much mud on the paving
choicesZh: 滑行道C道面上有太多碎片
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Left gear was sticking in the mud

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, CES5321, maintain 11900m, estimate HEK 04.
CTL: CES5321, maintain altitude, contact 125.6. Good day.
Q: According to the statement, what was going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉区调，东方5321，保持11900米，预计到达HEK时间04分。
管：东方5321，保持高度，联系125.6。再见。
问：根据对话，发生了什么事情？
choices: The pilot was establishing communication with Wuhan
The controller was telling the pilot his frequency
The pilot was going to be handed over to next controller
The pilot was making a position report
choicesZh: 飞行员正在和武汉区调建立联系
管制员正在告诉飞行员他的频率
飞行员将转接到下一管制员
飞行员正在做位置报告
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The pilot was going to be handed over to next controller

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES584, expect moderate turbulence between FL250 and FL300.
PIL: Roger, thanks, CES584.
Q: According to the controller, which of the following is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方584，预计高度层250至高度层300间有中度颠簸。
飞：收到，谢谢，东方584。
问：根据管制员的指令，下列哪一说法是正确的？
choices: There is no turbulence on FL250
There is no turbulence on FL250 and FL300
There is moderate turbulence on FL250 and FL300
There is severe turbulence on FL250 and FL300
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There is moderate turbulence on FL250 and FL300

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN2246, continue descending to 3000m, report status.
PIL: We are repairing our supercharger, we can manage it, CSN2246.
Q: What was CSN2246 doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航2246，继续下降3000米，报告状态。
飞：我们正在修理增压器，能够修好，南航2246。
问：南航2246在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Fixing the supercharger

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN3009, informed dispatcher of your problem via ACARS so they are aware of your delay of about 30 minutes.
PIL: Roger, CSN3009.
Q: What did the controller inform the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航3009，通过ACARS告知签派员你的问题，让他们知晓你已延误30分钟。
飞：收到，南航3009。
问：管制员通知飞行员做什么？
choices: He knew about the ACARS problem
The dispatcher should be aware of the delay
He would instruct CSN3009 to delay for about 30 minutes
He had told the dispatcher about the 13-minute delay
choicesZh: 他将指示南航3009延误30分钟
他已经告诉签派员延误了13分钟
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The dispatcher should be aware of the delay

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES2536, Tower, caution wake turbulence, the recommended distance from the preceding aircraft is 8 kilometers.
PIL: Roger, we are decelerating, CES2536.
Q: According to the instruction, what should the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方2536，塔台，注意尾流湍流，建议与前机保持8千米距离。
飞：收到，我们正在减速，东方2536。
问：根据指令，飞行员应做什么？
choices: Reduce speed to avoid wake vortex
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Reduce speed to avoid wake vortex

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, proceed offset 2 miles right of track due cross radar signal.
PIL: Roger, proceed offset 2 miles right of track, CCA121.
Q: Why did the ATC inform the aircraft to deviate 2 miles right of track?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，由于雷达信号重叠，继续右偏航2海里。
飞：收到，右偏航2海里，国航121。
问：ATC为什么通知飞机右偏航2海里？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Due to radar signal overlap

cards.audioText:
PIL: CCA102 YAK 18 FL190 estimating KLE 25, request FL210.
CTL: CCA102 maintain present flight level until crossing KLE.
Q: Which level should CCA102 maintain at KLE?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：国航102，过YAK时间18分，高度层190，预计KLE时间25，申请爬升高度层210。
管：国航102，保持当前高度，直到过KLE。
问：在KLE国航102的飞行高度应保持在多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. FL190

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA918, cleared to land, runway 32, wind 210, 12m/s, covered with thin patches of ice, braking action poor, snow up to 13cm along edges.
PIL: Roger, CCA918.
Q: How thick is the snow along runway edges?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航918，可以着陆，跑道32，风210，12米/秒，道面有部分薄冰，刹车效应差， 跑道边缘雪厚13厘米。
飞：收到，国航918。
问：跑道边缘雪厚度是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 13cm

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN301, ILS approach is not possible due to antenna problem, cleared VOR approach runway 21, no delay expected.
PIL: Roger. CSN301.
Q: What was a possible cause of the unserviceable ILS approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航301，由于天线故障，不能盲降进近，可以VOR进近至跑道21，预计不会延误。
飞：收到，南航301。
问：造成无法盲降进近的可能原因是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Inoperative glide slope

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA918, Beijing Tower. Maintenance work is underway near the threshold of runway 25. Expect low visibility due fog and dust. No delay for landing.
PIL: Roger, CCA918.
Q: According to the controller, which of the following is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航918，北京塔台。跑道25入口附近正在进行维修工作。低能见由于雾和灰尘，落地没限制。
飞：收到，国航918。
问：根据管制员的指令，下列哪一说法是正确的？
choices: Visibility was lower due to fog and dust
Work was in progress adjacent to touchdown
Visibility was reduced because of smoke and dust
choicesZh: 维修工作造成降落延误
雾和灰尘造成低能见度
邻近接地点处正在工作
烟和灰尘造成能见度下降
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Visibility was lower due to fog and dust

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ground, CES210, we’re having some difficulty in unhooking the tug, request delay to taxi.
CTL: Roger, CES210, call me back when ready.
Q: Why did CES210 request a delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：地面，东方210，我们无法解开拖车，请求推迟滑行。
管：收到，东方210，准备好叫。
问：东方210为什么请求延迟？
choices: The tug engine had some problems
The crew was waiting for the tug
The crew had trouble unlinking from the tug
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The crew had trouble unlinking from the tug

cards.audioText:
PIL: CES2413, request descent.
CTL: CES2413 descend to FL120 cross KYE FL150 or above.
PIL: Descending to FL120, cross KYE FL150 or above, CES2413.
Q: In which level should the aircraft cross KYE?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：东方2413，请求下降。
管：东方2413，下降到高度层120，穿过KYE在高度层150或以上。
飞：下降到高度层120，穿过KYE在高度层150或以上，东方2413。
问：穿过KYE时飞机的高度层应该是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Not below FL150

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, CCA918, request extend hold until 1045.
CTL: CCA918, hold between PM and CG at 6600m, expect further clearance at 1055.
Q: Which is the earliest available clearance time for CCA918?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉区调，国航918，请求延长等待到1045。
管：国航918，在PM和CG间6600米等待，预计1055时给进一步指令。
问：国航918最早的可用指令时间是哪一个？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 1100

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN2013, Beijing Control, direct to KAKAT, resume own navigation, maintain present level for cruising.
PIL: Direct to KAKAT, request 8900m or lower, we have too much fuel, CSN2013.
Q: What’s the intention of the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航2013，北京区调，直飞KAKAT，恢复自主领航，保持当前高度巡航。
飞：直飞KAKAT，请求8900米或以下，燃油过多，南航2013。
问：飞行员的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To consume excess fuel

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Tower, CES5256, we lost main gear due hydraulic system problem, we’ll try manual extension.
CTL: CES5256, roger.
Q: What’s the pilot’s intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉塔台，东方5256，由于液压系统的问题，主起落架出现故障，我们将尝试手动放下起落架。
管：东方5256，收到。
问：飞行员的意图是什么？
choices: Request a low pass over the runway for gear check
choicesZh: 请求低空通场进行起落架检查
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Manually extend the gears

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA276, request landing before 10 due to approaching thunderstorm.
CTL: CCA276, continue holding 01 minute.
Q: Which of the following caused the landing request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航276，由于正在接近的雷暴，请求10分前着陆。
管：国航276，继续等待1分钟。
问：以下哪个原因使飞行员请求着陆？
choices: Report about hailstorm on the course
choicesZh: 航线上有正在接近的雷暴
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Approaching thunderstorm on the course

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW216, Beijing Control, radar contact.
PIL: Radar contact, omit position report, BAW216.
CTL: BAW216, roger, report over DKO which is a mandatory point.
Q: According to the statement, which is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：英航216，北京区调，雷达收到。
飞：雷达看到，省略位置报，英航216。
管：英航216，收到，在强制报告点DKO上方报告。
问：根据叙述，哪项是正确的？
choices: DKO is a non-compulsory reporting point
The pilot should report over DKO
The aircraft is now over DKO
The controller is requesting immediate position report
choicesZh: 管制员在要求立即位置报
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The pilot should report over DKO

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shanghai Approach, CES326, could you brighten the approach lights? The visibility is poor.
CTL: CES326, negative, they are already at maximum.
Q: What did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：上海进近，东方326，可以调亮进近灯光吗？能见度低。
管：东方326，不可以，进场灯亮度已最大。
问：飞行员请求的是什么？
choices: To turn on the approach lights
To turn off the approach lights
To turn up the approach lights
To turn down the approach lights
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To turn up the approach lights

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA101, Gate 302, ready for taxi.
CTL: CCA101, caution taxiway K is flooded, brake action is medium to poor.
Q: Why should the pilot be cautious during taxi?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航101，停机位302，准备滑出。
管：国航101，注意滑行道K被淹没，刹车效应中到差。
问：飞行员滑行时应该注意什么？
choices: The taxiway is covered with hailstone
The taxiway is covered with fog
The taxiway is covered with ice
The taxiway is covered with standing water
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The taxiway is covered with standing water

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA2403, Ground, standby for pushback, tail right, an A320 is taxiing from Gate 308.
PIL: Standing by, tail to right, CCA2403.
Q: What should CCA2403 do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航2403，地面，等待推出，机尾向右，一架A320正从308机位滑出。
飞：稍等，头朝左，国航2403。
问：国航2403下一步应该怎样做？
choices: Wait for the A320 to clear
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Wait for the A320 to clear

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CSN3627, apologies for the radio unserviceability. We suffered a lightning strike and had some trouble with our radios.
CTL: CSN3627, roger, keep monitor frequency.
Q: Why was CSN3627 asked to keep monitoring?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，南航3627，抱歉无线电无法使用。飞机遭遇雷击，无线电出现问题。
管：南航3627，收到，注意守听频率。
问：为什么要求南航3627守听频率？
choices: Because the pilot headed in the wrong direction
choicesZh: 因为飞行员向错误方向飞行
因为无线电信号不稳定
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because the radio was unstable

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN1512, cleared to KM01 arrival, runway 36L, surface wind 320 10m/s, gusting to 13m/s.
PIL: Cleared to KM01 arrival, runway 36L, say again gust information, CSN1512.
Q: What did the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航1512，可以KM01进场，跑道36左，地面风320 10m/s，阵风13m/s。
飞：KM01进场，跑道36左，请重复重复阵风信息，南航1512。
问：飞行员想怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Obtain gust data

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CSN2132, WXI 35, 9500m, estimating HG 50, next VYK.
CTL: CSN2132, decelerate en route due traffic separation.
Q: What did the controller instruct the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，南航2132，WXI 35分，9500米，预计HG 50分，下个报告点VYK。
管：南航2132，由于间隔巡航中减速。
问：管制员指挥飞行员怎样做？
choices: Keep enough space from traffic ahead
Keep high speed due to spacing
choicesZh: 与前方活动保持足够空间
由于间隔当前位置等待
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Keep enough space from traffic ahead

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ground, CCA102, how long is the delay going to be?
CTL: CCA102, expect 2 minutes. We have a vehicle conducting a visual inspection of the runway.
Q: Which of the following is the cause of delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：地面，国航102，延误预计有多久？
管：国航102，预计延误2分钟，有车辆正对跑道进行目视检查。
问：以下哪项是延误的原因？
choices: An aircraft is passing across the runway
A vehicle has broken down on the runway
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. The runway is under inspection

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA101, engine failure, request tow back to parking bay, and passengers need to transfer to another plane.
CTL: CCA101, roger, tow back to Gate 302.
Q: Which of the following did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航101，发动机失效，请求拖回停机位，乘客需要被转移到另一架飞机。
管：国航101，收到，拖回302机位。
问：飞行员请求的是以下哪项？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Transfer of passengers

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, use caution, taxi slowly to your Gate, there is no marshaller on duty.
PIL: Roger, thanks, CCA121.
Q: According to the statement, which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，注意，缓慢滑行到停机位，无进位引导。
飞：收到，谢谢，国航121。
问：根据陈述，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: The Gate is too narrow for the aircraft
There is nobody to guide the aircraft to the Gate
The marshaller is in the aircraft’s path
choicesZh: 无人引导飞机滑到机位
进位引导在飞机的进位轨迹
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There is nobody to guide the aircraft to the Gate

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, Beijing Control, descend to 8900m, report reaching, radar shadow about 50 miles ahead.
PIL: Roger, descend to 8900m, report reaching, CCA121.
Q: According to the information, which of the following is correct for CCA121?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，北京区调，下降到8900米，到达时报告，前方50海里为雷达盲区。
飞：收到，下降到8900米，到达时报告。国航121
问：根据信息，以下哪项关于国航121的信息是正确的？
choices: It will descend to 8900 meters after 50 miles
It will enter into a radar blind area
It will lose radio signal soon
It will report position after 50 miles
choicesZh: 飞机将会进入雷达盲区
飞机不久将会失去无线电信号
飞机在50海里后将报告位置
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. It will enter into a radar blind area

cards.audioText:
PIL: Shanghai Control, ACA208, we caught sight of an emergency beacon on the sea.
CTL: Roger, ACA208, thanks, we will send the message to relative department.
Q: According to the exchange, which is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：上海区调，加航208，我们看到海上有紧急救援无线电信标。
管：收到，加航208，谢谢，我们会将信息发给相关部门。
问：根据对话，哪项是正确的？
choices: The center warning lights of ACA208 illuminated
ACA208 reported an emergency signal in sight
ACA208 found something on fire in the sea
choicesZh: 加航208报告紧急信号可见
加航208发现海上有物体起火
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. ACA208 reported an emergency signal in sight

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Delivery, CCA102, our aircraft is being cleaned, request 10-minute delay.
CTL: Roger, CCA102, call back when ready.
Q: According to the report, what probably was CCA102 doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京放行，国航102，飞机正在清洁，请求延迟10分钟。
管：收到，国航102，准备好后呼叫我。
问：根据报告，国航102可能正在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Cleaning the aircraft cabin

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES263, cleared to Taiyuan, flight planned route, 8400m, expect runway 18L, RENOB 12 departure, initially climb to and maintain 2100m on QNH 1013, approach frequency 129.7, squawk 3201.
Q: Which information in the delivery clearance is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方263，可以按计划航路飞往太原，8400米，使用跑道18左，按RENOB 12离场，起始上升保持修正海压2100米，修正海压1013，进近频率129.7，应答机3201。
问：以下哪项是正确的放行许可信息？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Runway 18L, RENOB 12 departure, contact 129.7

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA6102, vacating the runway.
CTL: CCA6102, taxi to B2 next to an A330 on number one parking spot.
Q: What did the controller instruct the pilot to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航6102，脱离跑道。
管：国航6102，滑到B2，A330旁边，1号停机坪。
问：管制员指挥飞行员怎样做？
choices: Taxi inbound to the spot one
Taxi to Gate 2 next to A330
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Taxi inbound to the spot one

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, line up and wait, traffic turning upwind.
PIL: Roger, line up and wait, CCA121.
Q: According to the statement, why must CCA121 hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，进入跑道等待，有飞机加入一边。
飞：收到，进跑道等待，国航121。
问：根据陈述，为什么国航121需要等待？
choices: An aircraft is departing from the same runway
A ground service vehicle is crossing the runway
choicesZh: 一架飞机正从同一跑道离场
一辆地面服务车正穿过跑道
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An aircraft is departing from the same runway

cards.audioText:
PIL: Ground, CES3512, we have some problem with magneto, request hold position for check.
CTL: CES3512, roger, call me when ready for taxi.
Q: Which part of the aircraft has a problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：地面，东方3512，我们的磁发电机出现问题，请求原地等待进行检查。
管：东方3512，收到，准备滑出叫我。
问：飞机的哪个部分出现问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Magneto

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA102, serious fuel leakage, request return to Beijing airport.
CTL: CCA102, roger, turn right heading 200, expect runway 01.
Q: Why did CCA102 request return to Beijing airport?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航102，燃料泄漏严重，请求返回北京机场。
管：国航102，收到，右转航向200，预计跑道01。
问：为什么国航102请求返回北京机场？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Unexpected fuel loss

cards.audioText:
RAMP: CCA102, Quarantine advises that they will get on board your aircraft for a check, please don’t let the passengers off.
PIL: Roger, CCA102.
Q: Why couldn’t the passengers on CCA102 disembark yet?
cards.audioTextZh:
停机坪：国航102，检疫通知将会对飞机进行检查，请不要让乘客下飞机。
飞：收到，国航102。
问：为什么国航102的乘客仍无法下飞机？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Due to quarantine inspection

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA124, climb to 8400m, expedite passing 7800m, caution traffic 10 o’clock 25 kilometers, eastbound B737, 7200m maintaining.
PIL: Looking, CCA124.
Q: What direction was the traffic likely located from CCA124?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航124，上升到8400米，快速通过7800米，注意25千米10点方向往东活动的B737，7200米保持。
飞：正在观察，国航124。
问：活动可能位于国航124哪个方向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Left upward

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Ground, CES5215, startup failed, request taxi delay.
CTL: CES5215, do you require GPU assistance?
PIL: Affirm, correction, negative, APU is available now.
Q: What might the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉地面，东方5215，开车失败，请求推迟滑行。
管：东方5215，你需要GPU援助吗？
飞：是的，更正，不需要，APU现在可用。
问：飞行员可能想怎样做？
choices: Hold position to wait for GPU
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Hold position for engine check

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA981, request priority takeoff. We have first-aid relief materials on board.
CTL: CCA981, 10-minute delay due heavy snow. We’ll give you clearance as soon as possible.
Q: Why did the pilot request priority takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航981，请求优先起飞，机上有紧急救援物资。
管：国航981，由于大雪延误10分钟，我们会尽快给你通知。
问：飞行员为什么请求优先起飞？
choices: Because there were VIP on board
Because the crew needed a relief pilot
Because there were emergency supplies on board
choicesZh: 因为机组需要后备飞行员
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Because there were emergency supplies on board

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA121, request taxi to runway 18L.
CTL: CCA121, clear to taxi via Z3 A3 B, hold short of runway 18L. There’s a B777 inbound for Gate 16, report when clear.
Q: What has CCA121 been instructed to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
北京地面，国航121，请求滑到跑道18左。
管：国航121，可以经Z3，A3和B滑行，在跑道18左等待。一架B777正滑向16号机位，通过后报告。
choices: Taxi to holding point on runway 18L
Hold position until another aircraft has passed
Give way to another aircraft and hold position
choicesZh: 原地等待另一架飞机通过
给另一架飞机让路并原地等待
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Hold position until another aircraft has passed

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Approach, CCA104, request landing on runway 18L.
CTL: Negative, CCA104, Beijing Approach, runway 18L not available, we had the runway foamed for an emergency landing and it is being cleaned up now. Advise use runway 18R.
Q: Why can’t CCA104 land on runway 18L?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京进近，国航104，请求跑道18左着陆。
管：不可以，国航104，北京进近，跑道18左不可用。由于紧急着陆跑道被喷洒泡沫，现在正在清理，建议使用跑道18右。
问：为什么国航104不能在跑道18左着陆？
choices: Preceding aircraft is making an emergency landing
The runway is being foamed now
choicesZh: 前方飞机正在进行紧急着陆
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The runway is undergoing cleaning

cards.audioText:
PIL: Chengdu Control, CSN6161, request emergency descent to 8400m, suspect air convective motion between the two sides of the mountain.
CTL: Roger, CSN6161, descend to 8400m, if unable, call me again.
Q: According to the report, what was the aircraft experiencing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：成都区调，南航6161，请求紧急下降到8400米，山两侧之间疑似有空气对流运动。
管：收到，南航6161，下降到8400米，如果不能再次呼叫我。
问：根据对话，飞机正在经历什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Terrain turbulence

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Approach, CCA121, request landing runway 36R.
CTL: CCA121, circle to land runway 36L, 36R unavailable due traffic.
Q: What should CCA121 do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京进近，国航121，请求跑道36右着陆。
管：国航121，盘旋进近跑道36左，由于活动跑道36右不可用。
问：国航121接下来应该怎么做？
choices: Land as soon as possible to avoid traffic
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Land on runway 36L

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, turn right heading 090 for identification.
PIL: Turn right heading 090, CCA102.
CTL: CCA102, radar contact, position 10 miles northwest of HY.
Q: What did the controller intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，右转航向090识别。
飞：右转航向090，国航102。
管：国航102，雷达收到，位置HY西北10海里。
问：管制员想要做什么？
choices: Vector the aircraft due to spacing
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Find the aircraft on radar

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA102, Beijing Control, I cannot contact CSN6107 on 125.9, if able, pass message aircraft has been radar identified and should maintain present level.
PIL: Wilco, CCA102.
Q: According to the statement, what did the controller do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航102，北京区调，在125.9无法联系南航6107，如有可能，请转发信息，雷达已识别，保持当前高度。
飞：照办，国航102。
问：根据对话，管制员做了什么？
choices: Instructed CCA102 to omit position report and maintain present level
Asked CCA102 to change frequency on 125.9
choicesZh: 指挥国航102省略位置报并保持当前高度
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Asked CCA102 to transmit information

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN6645, Beijing Control, radar shows you are descending, confirm level?
PIL: Present level 10700m, CSN6645, we have been level 05 minutes, has your radar been interrupted?
Q: What did the pilot report to ATC?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航6645，北京区调，雷达显示你正在下降，证实高度？
飞：当前高度10700米，南航6645，我们已经平飞5分钟，你的雷达信号是否被中断？
问：飞行员向ATC报告了什么？
choices: Flight level of the aircraft was normal
The aircraft had descended 5 minutes ago
The aircraft can only hold for 5 minutes
choicesZh: 他们的雷达信号被中断
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Flight level of the aircraft was normal

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, descend to 3000m, turn left heading 030, continue approach for Hongqiao ILS, runway 36. Report established.
PIL: Descend to 3000m, left heading 030, report established, CCA101.
Q: Which of the following should the crew do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航101，下降到3000米，左转航线030，继续虹桥36号盲降进近，截获报。
飞：下降到3000米，左转航线030，建立报，国航101。
问：以下哪项是机组应该做的？
choices: Report to ATC after localizer capture
Report after establishing on runway 36 glide slope
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Report to ATC after localizer capture

cards.audioText:
CTL: UAL405 cleared to land.
PIL: Tower, UAL405, we have indications that our landing gear has not fully been extended, request low pass and tower fly-by for visual inspection.
Q: Which of the following statements is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：美联航405，可以着陆。
飞：塔台，美联航405，显示起落架似乎无法完全放下，请求低空通场和低空飞越塔台进行目视检查。
问：以下陈述哪项是正确的？
choices: UAL405 requested low pass due to traffic flying by
UAL405 requested low pass due to possible undercarriage problem
UAL405 had visual of other aircraft
choicesZh: 由于飞过活动，美联航405请求低空通场
由于起落架疑似故障，美联航405请求低空通场
美联航405可见另一架飞机
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. UAL405 requested low pass due to possible undercarriage problem

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Control, CCA108, the aircraft is rolling right and left up to 20 degrees, something is wrong with the rudder.
CTL: CCA108, confirm you have a problem with the radar?
Q: According to the pilot, what was malfunctioning?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉区调，国航108，飞机左右滚动20度，方向舵出现问题。
管：国航108，确认飞机雷达出现故障？
问：根据飞行员所说，哪个部分出现了故障？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Rudder

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CCA104, downwind.
CTL: CCA104, extend downwind one minute due departing aircraft, report turning base.
Q: What was the pilot instructed to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京塔台，国航104，三边。
管：国航104，由于离场飞机，将三边延长1分钟，转四边时报告。
问：飞行员收到的指令是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Extend landing time

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Control, CCA102, confirm Shenyang Center frequency is 118.9, we cannot establish contact with them.
CTL: CCA102, we have informed Shenyang Control by phone, try again 118.9.
Q: According to the exchange, which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京区调，国航102，证实沈阳中心频率118.9，我们无法建立联系。
管：国航102，已经电话通知沈阳区调，再试一次118.9。
问：根据对话，以下哪项是正确的？
choices: The pilot is asking for frequency conversion
The pilot is trying to make contact with Shenyang
The controller is correcting the frequency
choicesZh: 飞行员正在请求通话移交
管制员正在检查无线电
飞行员正在试图与沈阳建立通话
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The pilot is trying to make contact with Shenyang

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES5766, make a 360 turn left for sequencing.
PIL: 360 turn left, CES5766.
Q: What might be the purpose of the controller?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方5766，左转360由于排序。
飞：左转360，东方5766。
问：管制员的目的可能是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. For separation

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CES5549, going around, runway lighting failure.
CTL: CES5549, standard missed approach procedure as published.
Q: What was the cause of the missed approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京塔台，东方5549，复飞，跑道照明故障。
管：东方5549，按标准程序复飞。
问：复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Ground lighting failure

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA104, expedite taxi, traffic on final, caution shuttle bus is crossing from next intersection, report runway vacated.
PIL: Expediting, report vacated, CCA104.
Q: Why should CCA104 expedite taxiing?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航104，加速滑行，五边有活动，注意下个交叉点有摆渡车穿过，跑道脱离报告。
飞：加速，脱离后报告，国航104。
问：为什么国航104要加速滑行？
choices: Give way to traffic on the next intersection
To avoid a shuttle bus ahead
choicesZh: 给下个交叉点活动让路
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To avoid traffic on final

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA121, climb to and maintain 10100m finally.
PIL: Control, CCA121, request 8900m for cruising due to weight.
CTL: CCA121, due to Shenyang restriction, if above 9500m is not acceptable, you should descend to 7500m or below.
Q: According to the controller’s statement, which level was available?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航121，上升保持巡航高度10100米。
飞：区调，国航121，由于重量请求巡航高度8900米。
管：国航121，由于沈阳限制区，9500米以上不可行，你要下降到7500米或以下。
问：根据管制员的陈述，哪个高度是可行的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 7500 meters

cards.audioText:
PIL: Control, CCA102, 35km east of WA at 10100m, WA 45, correction 55, request clearance to cross airway R25 at YW.
CTL: CCA102, approved. Cross airway R25 at YW.
Q: According to the pilot, when would CCA102 arrive at WA?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：区调，国航102，WA东35千米，10100米。到WA 45分，更正，55分，请求在YW穿过航路R25的许可。
管：国航102，同意。在YW穿过航路R25。
问：根据飞行员，国航102何时会到达WA？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. 55

cards.audioText:
PIL: Wuhan Tower, CES435, ready for takeoff.
CTL: CES435, Wuhan Tower, cleared for takeoff, runway 25, after takeoff, turn right heading 300.
Q: What should CES435 do after takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：武汉塔台，东方435，准备好起飞。
管：东方435，武汉塔台，可以起飞，跑道25，起飞后右转航向300。
问：东方435起飞后应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Turn right, heading 300

cards.audioText:
PIL: Departure, CSN305, reaching 3000m. Request climb to 5700m.
CTL: CSN305, climb to 5400m. Expedite climb until passing 4200m, report reaching.
Q: In which level should CSN305 speed up its climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：离场，南航305，到达3000米，请求上升到5700米。
管：南航305，上升到5400米。加速上升直到通过4200米，到达时报告。
问：南航305应该在哪个高度范围内加速上升？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 3000 meters to 4200 meters

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA231, there are flames coming from our No.2 engine. Request emergency service.
CTL: CCA231, roger, fire engines and ambulance will be available in a few minutes.
Q: What problem did the No.2 engine have?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航231，2号发动机有火冒出，请求紧急服务。
管：国航231，收到，几分钟内消防车和救护车将准备好。
问：2号发动机出现哪种问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. No.2 engine was on fire

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, CCA918, squawk 1630, runway 25, information S, request taxi to intersection departure A.
CTL: CCA918, taxi via D3 to holding point A, runway 25, there will be a vehicle on B giving way to you.
Q: What should CCA918 do next?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，国航918，应答机1630，跑道25，通播S，请求滑行至交叉点A离场。
管：国航918，经D3滑到等待点A，跑道25，等待点B的车辆会给你让路。
问：国航918下一步应该怎样做？
choices: Taxi to the threshold of runway 25
Taxi via D3 to holding point B
Give way to a vehicle on B
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Taxi to holding point A

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CES5117, boarding is conducting, besides, catering is delayed, we will delay 15 minutes, request takeoff after 45.
CTL: Roger, CES5117, delay for 15 minutes.
Q: Why can’t CES5117 take off on time?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京塔台，东方5117，正在登机。此外，配餐延迟，我们会推后15分钟，请求45分后起飞。
管：收到，东方5117，延误15分钟。
问：为什么东方5117无法准时起飞？
choices: Cargo loading hasn’t been completed yet
Some passengers have missed the flight
The crew haven’t completed their checklists
Boarding hasn’t been completed and catering is delayed
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Boarding hasn’t been completed and catering is delayed

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Ground, ACA165, request pushback delay due TCAS failure.
CTL: Roger ACA165, call me when ready.
Q: Why couldn’t the aircraft push back?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京地面，加航165，由于TCAS故障请求延迟推出。
管：收到，加航165，准备好呼叫我。
问：为什么飞机无法推出？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. TCAS problem

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, backtrack to vacate via P3.
PIL: Tower, if available, request vacate via P4, CCA101.
Q: What did the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航101，掉头经P3脱离。
飞：塔台，如果可以，请求经P4脱离，国航101。
问：飞行员想要怎样做？
choices: Backtrack to vacate the runway via P3
Backtrack to vacate the runway via P4
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Vacate the runway via P4

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN6621, a helicopter is patrolling 3 miles north of the extended centerline of runway 18 below 1200m. Do not pass through the localizer.
PIL: Wilco, CSN6621.
Q: According to the controller, where was the helicopter?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航6621，一架直升机正在平行跑道18中心线延长线3海里高度低于1200米。不要穿过航向道。
飞：照办，南航6621。
问：根据管制员的话，直升机的位置在哪里？
choices: On the extended centerline at 1200 meters
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Below 1200 meters near runway 18

cards.audioText:
PIL: London Control, BAW403, we’ve lost pitch control, we need a very long final, request fire services on landing, position 14 miles from threshold, 4000 feet, heading 250.
CTL: BAW403, London, continue this heading for a moment, I’ll give you permission to make a long precision approach immediately.
Q: What did the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：伦敦区调，英航403，飞机失去俯仰操纵，我们需要长五边，请求着陆后消防服务，位置在入口14海里，高度4000英尺，航向250。
管：英航403，伦敦，暂时继续该航向，我会立刻给你长五边精密进场许可。
问：飞行员请求了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. A long distance final

cards.audioText:
PIL: Beijing Tower, CSN302, no contact at minima, going around.
CTL: CSN302, standard procedure.
Q: What is the reason for going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞：北京塔台，南航302，最低高度无法看到地面，复飞。
管：南航302，标准程序。
问：复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Poor visibility

cards.audioText:
P: Delivery, CCA334, confirm after departure heading south.
C: Negative, for your information, a glider is over near the south field.
Q: Why did the controller deny the pilots’ confirmation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：放行，国航334，确认离场后航向朝南。
管制员：不同意，提醒一下南部机场有一架滑翔机。
问：管制员为什么拒绝了飞行员的确认请求？
choices: The controller wants the pilot to fly east.
Flying activity is in the south field.
A glider will land in the south field.
A glider is hanging in the north field.
choicesZh: 管制员希望飞行员向东飞。
一架滑翔机将在南部机场降落。
一架滑翔机在机场北部滑翔。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Flying activity is in the south field.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Ground, CCA101, request tow Boeing 737 from stand M5 to maintenance apron due to the nose gear jammed.
C: The tow approved via taxiway M to maintenance apron.
Q: What is the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉地面，国航101，由于前起落架卡阻，申请拖车将波音737从停机位M5拖至维修机坪。
管制员：拖车可以经由滑行道M到维修机坪。
问：飞机的问题是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Nose gear can't be moved.

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW204, taxi to the holding point runway 27 via taxi way F, J and G.
PIL: F, J and G, to holding point runway 27, BAW204.
Q: What are the taxi routes?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：英航204，经滑行道F，J和G滑到跑道27等待点。
飞：F，J和G，跑道27等待点，英航204。
问：滑行路线是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. F, J and G

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW141 continue on the inner taxiway, at M join the outer taxiway, cross 31L at K.
PIL: OK by the inner taxiway and uh.., M outer taxiway and uh…, K A, cross 31L uh…BAW141.
Q: What is the controller's taxi instruction?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：英航141，继续在内滑行道滑行，在M加入外滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左。
飞：好吧，内滑行道滑行，然后……M外滑行道，然后……K，A穿越跑道31左……英航141。
问：管制员的滑行指令是什么？
choices: K to inner, outer, cross 31L at M
Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K
M to outer, inner, cross 31L at K.
M to inner, outer, cross 31L at K
choicesZh: K加入内滑行道、外滑行道，在M穿越跑道31左
内滑行道滑行，M加入外滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左
M加入外滑行道、内滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左
M加入内滑行道、外滑行道，在K穿越跑道31左
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES5401, maintain 8400m to HG unless otherwise instructed.
PIL: CES5401, maintain 8400m to HG.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：东方5401，保持8400米，直飞HG，除非另有指示。
飞：东方5401，保持8400米，直飞HG。
问：管制员的指令是什么意思？
choices: There is no possibility for level change
There is much possibility for level change
There is a little possibility for level change
choicesZh: 很有可能有改变飞行高度
很小可能改变飞行高度
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There is a little possibility for level change

cards.audioText:
CTL: CSN5265, pull in to the left, there is a B747 overtaking you on the right.
PIL: Roger, traffic in sight, CSN5265.
Q: What will the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管：南航5265，牵入左侧，你右侧有一架B747。
飞：收到，能看到飞机，南航5265。
问：飞行员要做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Give way to the B747

cards.audioText:
A: Do you know there’s a word that the controllers use to inform the pilots to ignore the clearance, issues at the beginning of the transmission?
B: Yes, there is an ICAO standard word.
Q: What word are they talking about in this conversation?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：你知道管制员常使用的一个单词，这个单词用来告诉飞行员忽略掉开始发话中的滑行许可吗？
B：知道，是有这个ICAO标准词汇。
问：在这段对话中，他们讨论的是哪个词？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Disregard

cards.audioText:
A: On landing, I noticed the nose gear has a little shimmy.
B: Ok, I'll check it, the fork looks good and the strut is in the center but the gear has not been locked down properly.
Q: What was the problem with the nose gear on landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：着陆的时候，我注意到前起落架有点振动。
B：好，我去检查下，连杆看起来没问题，支柱也处于中心位置，但是起落架没有被正确锁定。
问：着陆时，前起落架出了什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. A little shaking.

cards.audioText:
A: There is a height which the pilot must have the runway approach lights in sight, to continue the descent, or if not, must initiate the go-around during the precision approach.
B: The height is very important for safety.
Q: What were the men talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：在精密进近中，存在一个高度，在这个高度上，飞行员必须看到跑道进场灯来继续下降，如果没有看到，就必须执行复飞。
B：这个高度对飞行安全非常重要。
问：两人在讨论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Decision height.

cards.audioText:
CTL: ACA233, descend and maintain FL230.
PIL: Control, can we have that at the pilot's discretion?
Q: What was the pilot's intention under this situation?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：加航233，下高度层230保持。
飞行员：区调，我们可以自行决定吗？
问：在此情况下，飞行员的意图是什么？
choices: To continue descent by ATC instruction.
To decide how to fly by himself.
To decide when to descend by himself.
choicesZh: 通过管制指令继续下降。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To decide when to descend by himself.

cards.audioText:
CTL: NWA291, expedite descent to and maintain 3000 feet on QNH1012, join right downwind for runway 21L.
Q: Which level should the aircraft descend to and maintain?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：西北291，加速下降到3000英尺保持，修正海压1012，加入右三边，跑道21左。
问：航空器需要下降并保持在哪个高度层？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. 3,000 feet on QNH1012

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES402, turn right heading 040, descend to 900m, QFE1002.
Q: Which of the following is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
东方402，右转航向040，下降到900米，场面气压1002。
问：以下哪个是正确的？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Descend to 900m.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, severe turbulence was reported at FL290 over MRT.
PIL: Roger, request to alter the route because we have some problem with the yaw damper.
Q: What does the pilot want to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航101，MRT上方高度层290处有严重颠簸报告。
飞行员：收到，请求改变航路，因为我们的偏航阻尼出故障。
问：飞行员想干什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To use alternate route

cards.audioText:
CTL: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Wuhan Control, this is UAL982, my elevator is jammed in the up position and I cannot control my attitude, nor can I close my throttle.
PIL: UAL982, roger mayday. What is your intention?
Q: Which are involved in the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，武汉区调，美联航982，升降舵卡在上位，无法控制姿态，也不能关闭油门。
管制员：美联航982，收到Mayday，你的意图是什么？
问：问题包含哪些？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Throttle, elevator, attitude.

cards.audioText:
CTL: AFR334, negative to start up. We had an emergency this morning. There is still foam on the runway and it is being cleaned up at the moment.
PIL: Will it be reopened shortly?
CTL: Perhaps in 15 minutes, I will call you back.
Q: Why can't the pilot start up?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：法航334，不同意开车，早上出现了紧急情况，跑道上仍有泡沫，目前正在清理。
飞行员：一会儿会重新开放吗？
管制员：或许在15分钟以后，我会叫你。
问：飞行员为什么不能开车？
choicesZh: 紧急情况目前没处理完。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The runway is being cleaned.

cards.audioText:
CTL: BAW141, what is your intention?
PIL: We would like to execute fuel jettison procedure before the approach. BAW141.
CTL: BAW141, turn right heading 350 to HID, hold as published.
Q: What does the pilot intend to do?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：英航141，你的意图是什么？
飞行员：我们想在进近前执行放油程序，英航141。
管制员：英航141，右转航向350到HID，按发布的程序等待。
问：飞行员打算做什么？
choices: To go directly to the holding point.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To dump fuel before approach.

cards.audioText:
CTL: CES583, maintain flight level 330 to HG unless otherwise instructed.
PIL: Wilco, CES583.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：东方583，除非另有指令，保持高度层330到HG。
飞行员：照办，东方583。
问：管制员什么意思？
choices: There is a possibility of level change
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. There is a possibility of level change

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA101, you are approaching the boundary. Cross the boundary at own discretion.
PIL: Roger. CCA101.
CTL: CCA101, your ATC clearance will be suspended when you cross the boundary. Report when leaving.
Q: What can you learn from the controller's instruction?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航101，你将穿越边界，自己掌握穿越。
飞行员：收到，国航101。
管制员：国航101，在你穿越边界时候，将暂缓发布管制许可，离开后报。
问：从管制员的指令中，你能得到什么？
choices: The controller's clearance is not available.
The flight may cross the boundary.
The flight crossed the boundary and made an approach
choicesZh: 飞机穿越边界并进行进近。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The flight may cross the boundary.

cards.audioText:
PIL: AFR188, we'd like to delay our start-up. Flight operations have just told us we are to pick up 30 passengers from a Lufthansa flight which has been cancelled. I will call you back when we are ready.
CTL: AFR188, departure time 25, start up at own discretion.
Q: Why does the crew want to delay startup?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：法航188，我们希望推迟开车，运营部门告知我们，需要接载30名乘客，他们来自汉莎航空取消了的航班。我们准备好后再呼叫你。
管制员：法航188，起飞时间25分，自行决定开车。
问：机组为什么想推迟开车时间？
choices: The flight has just been cancelled.
They have to wait for a Lufthansa flight.
To take passengers from another flight.
choicesZh: 他们需要等待汉莎航班。
为了接载另外一架飞机上的乘客。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. To take passengers from another flight.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, UAL982, stopping at C5 intersection. I have a malfunction with my nose gear steering. Request assistance.
C: United airline 982, roger. I will send a tug right away.
Q: What is the pilot's problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：地面，美联航982，在C5交叉点停下，前轮转弯故障，请求支援。
管制员：美联航982，收到，马上派拖车。
问：飞行员的问题是什么？
choices: He needs a tug to push-back.
He needs a tug to get him back.
His nose gear is bogged down.
His nose gear is broken down.
choicesZh: 他的前起落架陷入泥地。
他的前起落架出故障了。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. His nose gear is broken down.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR188, for identification, turn left heading 270 and then turn right heading 360.
P: Left turn 270 and right for 360, AFR188.
Q: Why was AFR188 instructed to make this maneuver?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：法航188，为了识别，左转航向270，然后右转航向360.
飞行员：左转270，然后右转360。法航188。
问：法航188为什么要做此机动？
choices: The controller tries to find the aircraft on radar.
The controller tries to find the plane's identification number.
choicesZh: 管制员试图在雷达上识别飞机。
管制员试图发现航空器识别号。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The controller tries to find the aircraft on radar.

cards.audioText:
P: Control, NWA808, 15km from YIH, we have weather ahead. Request deviation to the right.
C: Negative, turn left heading 270, resume own navigation when clear of weather.
Q: Why did NWA808 ask for circumnavigation?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：区调，西北808，距YIH15公里，前方有天气，请求右偏航。
管制员：不可以，左转航向270，绕开天气后恢复自主领航。
问：西北808为什么请求绕航？
choices: Got a warning of wind shear.
Controller refused his request to turn left.
choicesZh: 管制员拒绝了他左转的请求。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Encountered an adverse meteorological condition.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, CES5321, 12,000m, 4 minutes to boundary.
C: CES5321, maintaining altitude and heading, contact 125.6, good day.
Q: What is going on?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉区调，东方5321，高度12000米，4分钟到达边界。
管制员：东方5321，保持高度和航向，联系125.6，再见。
问：正在发生什么？
choices: The flight was going to be handed over to next controller.
The pilot had established communication with Wuhan.
The controller was telling the pilot his frequency.
The pilot was listening to ATIS.
choicesZh: 飞机将要移交给下一个管制。
飞行员与武汉区调已经建立联系。
管制员正告知飞行员他的频率。
飞行员正在守听自动终端情报服务。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The flight was going to be handed over to next controller.

cards.audioText:
C: United 755, ceiling 250 feet variable. Visibility 2200 meters in fog, advise go around.
P: United 755.
P: United 755 no contact at minima, overshooting.
Q: What is the reason for advised going around?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：美联航755，云高250英尺，风向不定，雾中能见度2200米，建议复飞。
飞行员：美联航755。
飞行员：美联航755，最低不见跑道，正在复飞。
问：建议复飞的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Ceiling.

cards.audioText:
A: Could you check with Shanghai center to see if a high altitude is available, we need to get out of this turbulence.
B: Ok, I’ll contact with controller to see if we can get FL350.
Q: Why does the flight crew want to change altitude?
cards.audioTextZh:
A：你能和上海区调证实我们是否可以上高度，我们需要飞离颠簸。
B：好，我将和管制联系，看是否可以上高度层350。
问：为什么飞行机组想要改变高度层？
choices: To start to descend to Shanghai.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To avoid turbulent air.

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 204, taxi to the holding point RW27 via taxiway F, J and G.
P: F, J and G to holding point of RW27, Speedbird 204,
Q: What are the taxi routes?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：英航204，通过滑行道F，J和G滑行至跑道27等待点。
飞行员：F，J和G到跑道27等待点，英航204。
问：滑行路线是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. F, J and G.

cards.audioText:
P: Guangzhou Departure, CSN6549, airborne 600m, climbing 3000m, request heading 290 due weather.
Q: What stage of the flight does the transmission refer to?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：广州离场，南方6549，离地了，600米，正爬升至3000米，由于天气，请求航向290。
问：这段交流对应的飞行阶段是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After takeoff.

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR486, reaching 3000ft.
C: AFR486, climb to 9000ft, expedite climb until passing 5000ft, report 7000ft.
Q: In which section of altitude should AFR486 speed up and climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：离场，法航486，到达3000英尺。
管制员：法航486，爬升至9000英尺，加速爬升直到过5000英尺，7000英尺报。
问：在哪个高度阶段法航486需要加速爬升？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. 3000 to 5000 feet.

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, AFR132, 25km south of Wuhan, northbound, 2100m.
C: AFR132, say intentions.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，法航132，武汉南部25公里，向北飞，高度2100米。
管制员：法航132，说出你的意图。
问：管制员的意思是什么？
choices: To know what the pilot wants to do next.
To ask the pilot his rating.
To verify the pilot's original airport.
choicesZh: 想知道飞行员接下来打算做什么。
询问飞行员的型別等级。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To know what the pilot wants to do next.

cards.audioText:
C: United 223 RVR runway 36L, touch down 600m, midpoint 850m, stop end missing.
P: United 223.
Q: What is the best RVR?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：美联航223，跑道36左视程距：接地点：600米，中间段850米，停止端无数据丢失。
飞行员：美联航223。
问：最佳跑道视程距是？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. midpoint.

cards.audioText:
A: Hey, look that, there is some rubber on the runway. Maybe it came from an aircraft tyre.
B: Have we had any reports from landing or departing aircraft?
Q: What was on the runway?
cards.audioTextZh:
A: 喂，看，跑道上有些橡胶，可能来自于飞机的轮胎。
B：我们收到任何着陆或起飞的飞机报告吗？
问：跑道上有什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Rubber.

cards.audioText:
P: Ladies and gentlemen, due to our early arrival. Our gate is still occupied. We will have to wait here for a few minutes until the other plane pushes back.
Q: When can they go to their gate?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：女士们，先生们，因为我们提前到达，我们的停机位仍被占用。我们需要等一会，直到达其他飞机推出。
问：他们什么时候可以去停机位？
choices: Before the other plane pushes back.
Until the other plane pushes back.
choicesZh: 他们的停机位仍被占用。
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Until the other plane pushes back.

cards.audioText:
C: ACA130, taxi straight ahead. The airbus 320 coming from your right will give way to you at the intersection.
Q: Which aircraft will give way to ACA130?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：加航130，直接推出，在交叉口，从右方滑行过来的空客320会给你让路。
问：哪架飞机会给加航130让路？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. A320 on the right.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA4106, expedite climb to 9,800m, report HZ.
P: Unable to accept 9,800m due weight. CCA4106.
Q: What does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：国航4106，加速爬升至9800米，过HZ报。
飞行员：由于重量， 9800米不可以，国航4106。.
问：管制员的意思是什么？
choices: Complaining about the weight of the flight.
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Issuing a further climb instruction.

cards.audioText:
P: Delta 303, we’ll have to go back to the maintenance apron to check our flight controls. We found the rudder pedals are a bit tight.
C: Delta 303, roger, taxi to stand 12. We’ll contact maintenance department.
Q: What is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：达美303，我们必须回到维修机坪检查飞机操纵面，我们发现方向舵脚蹬有点紧。
管制员：达美303，收到，滑行到12号停机位，我们将联系维修部门。
问：问题是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The rudder pedals are jammed.

cards.audioText:
