cards.audioText: Our flight control computers are not functioning well. We are having difficulty maintaining level flight, unable RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们飞行操作计算机工作不太理想，我们保持平飞有些困难，不能在RVSM空域飞行。

cards.audioText: The aircraft has a tendency to roll to the right. I need additional airspace to maneuver.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机有向右横滚的趋势，我需要更多的的空域来机动。

cards.audioText: Request high speed approach. Part of our flight control surfaces have separated from the wing.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求大速度进近。部分飞机操作面与机翼分离。

cards.audioText: Request vectors for long final. We are controlling the airplane with mechanical backup.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求雷达引导到长五边。我们正用机械备用设备操作飞机。

cards.audioText: We have a problem with yaw damping. The aircraft is oscillating severely. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们偏航阻尼出现问题，飞机摇摆很严重，申请备降。

cards.audioText: We have a problem with fuel temperature. Request holding position on the taxiway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的燃油温度有问题。请求滑行道上原地等待。

cards.audioText: We might have a fuel leak near the wing root. Request fire trucks on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 翼根可能存在漏油，申请消防车到场。

cards.audioText: We are evacuating. Advise emergency personnel that fuel odors are still present in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正在紧急撤离。请告诉地面人员机上仍然有燃油味道。

cards.audioText: We are too heavy for landing. Request fuel-dump at the fuel dumping area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们返场落地重量会太重。申请去放油区域放油。

cards.audioText: We need about 18 minutes to jettison fuel before coming in for the approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在进近前需要大概18分钟放油。

cards.audioText: We cannot shut off the fuel dump valve. Request radar vectors for short final, Runway 17.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们无法关断放油活门，申请雷达引导到短五边，跑道17。

cards.audioText: We are indicating fuel filter clog. Request descent and to maintain high speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示有燃油过滤阻塞，申请下降并保持大速度。

cards.audioText: We are near the freezing temperature of jet fuel. Request descent to FL 390.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们接近燃油的冰点温度，申请下降到高度390。

cards.audioText: Request the longest runway and vectors for a wide downwind due to hydraulic failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于液压失效，请求最长的跑道和雷达引导到宽的三边。

cards.audioText: We still have only one hydraulic system. Request the longest runway for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仍然有一套液压系统。申请最长的跑道着陆。

cards.audioText: Our left engine anti-ice system has failed. Request immediate climb to leave the icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的左发防冰系统故障，申请立即上升来脱离结冰区域。

cards.audioText: We must descend immediately to exit icing conditions. Our right engine bleed air has failed.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们必须立即下降脱离结冰条件。我们的右发引气已失效。

cards.audioText: Our pitot static heating system has failed. We might have an altitude error.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们皮托管静压口加温系统故障了，我们可能有高度误差。

cards.audioText: We have an error in our airspeed. Request to climb to minimum safe altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的空速有误差。申请上升到最低安全高度以上。

cards.audioText: We have master warning lights in the cockpit. Request landing at the nearest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的驾驶舱主警告灯亮了。申请就近合适机场着陆。

cards.audioText: We have a master caution. I will notify you if a diversion is required.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一个主警告灯亮了。如需备降，我将告知。

cards.audioText: Some of our instruments are not indicating correctly. Request level off to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 一些仪表不能正确显示，申请改平飞执行检查单。

cards.audioText: Two of our display units have failed. We are no longer RNP qualified. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的两个显示屏故障。我们不再具备RNP资格。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to map drift on our navigation display.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为导航显示上地图漂移。

cards.audioText: We have autopilot disconnection. We are no longer RVSM qualified. Request leaving RVSM airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们自动驾驶脱开了，我们不再符合RVSM资质，申请离开RVSM空域。

cards.audioText: Request to climb to minimum safe altitude due to malfunction of navigation computers.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于导航计算机故障，申请爬升到最低安全高度。

cards.audioText: We have conflicting traffic at one o’clock, 6 miles, descending. Request heading 130 for avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示冲突飞机在我们1点钟方位，6海里处，正在下降。申请航向130来避开。

cards.audioText: We have conflicting traffic at eleven o’clock, 8 miles, climbing. Request vectors for avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示冲突飞机在我们11点钟方位，8海里处，正在上升。申请雷达引导来避开。

cards.audioText: Traffic at our twelve o’clock, 10 miles, climbing. Should we expedite our descent to cross altitudes?
cards.audioTextZh: 冲突飞机在我们12点钟方位，10海里处，正在上升。我们应该加速下降穿越高度吗？

cards.audioText: We are having abnormal engine indications. Request to reduce speed to 250 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示不正常的发动机参数。申请调速到250节。

cards.audioText: Our oil pressure reading is lower than normal. Request hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们滑油压力读数比正常要低。请求在当前位置等待。

cards.audioText: The oil temperature is higher than normal. We are monitoring other engine parameters.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们滑油温度比正常的要高。我们正在监控其他发动机参数。

cards.audioText: We are holding at present position. It appears one of the over-wing exits has unlocked.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在原地等待。好像机翼上方的一个出口松锁。

cards.audioText: Our brakes have seized. The tyres might burst during touchdown. Request fire trucks on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的刹车卡死了。可能接地时轮胎会爆胎。申请消防车到场。

cards.audioText: We have exhausted all options. We will land without the nose gear fully locked.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们用尽了所有选项。现在只能够尝试没有前起落架完全锁住的情况下落地。

cards.audioText: The tyres are deflated. We will have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection.
cards.audioTextZh: 轮胎瘪了，我们需要原地等待机务来做检查。

cards.audioText: Our inertial reference system has failed, unable GPS approach. Request ILS or VOR approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的惯导失效了，不能够使用GPS进近。申请盲降或VOR进近。

cards.audioText: We have to recalibrate our instruments. Request to level off and maintain heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们需要重新校准仪表。申请改平飞并保持航向。

cards.audioText: Our airspeed is unreliable. Request climb to minimum safe altitude to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的空速指示不可靠。申请爬升到最低安全高度来做检查单。

cards.audioText: Our weather radar has failed and we are in IMC. Request return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们气象雷达失效，我们仪表气象条件飞行。申请返场落地。

cards.audioText: Our weather radar has malfunctioned. What is the highest available level for cruise?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们气象雷达故障。最高可用的巡航高度是多少？

cards.audioText: Our weather radar has failed. How did the preceding aircraft deviate from the weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们气象雷达坏了。前机都怎么绕飞的？

cards.audioText: We do not have that route in our database. Which heading should we maintain for now？
cards.audioTextZh: 我们数据库没有这个航路。我们现在应该保持哪个航向？

cards.audioText: We have a navigation malfunction. Request diversion to a suitable airport that has less complex terrain.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有导航故障。申请备降到就近的较少复杂地形的机场。

cards.audioText: Our APU bleed air malfunctioned during engine startup. We are calling the ground staff, standby.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的APU引气在发动机开车时故障了。我们正在呼叫地面机务，请稍等。

cards.audioText: We are leaking bleed air. Request turn right heading 095 to avoid the icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的引气正在泄漏。请求右转095以避开结冰区。

cards.audioText: We have an abnormal noise coming from one of our cabin doors. Request rapid descent to 5000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一个客舱门有异常噪音。申请快速下降到5000英尺。

cards.audioText: Smoke is coming from the cabin floor. We are performing an evacuation. All slides have been deployed.
cards.audioTextZh: 有烟雾来自客舱地板。我们正在进行撤离。滑梯已经放出。

cards.audioText: We had a smoke warning from the forward cargo hold. We are evacuating.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有烟雾来自前货舱。我们正在进行撤离。

cards.audioText: We have a cargo smoke warning. We are disembarking passengers. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有货舱烟雾警告。我们正在让旅客下飞机。请求消防服务。

cards.audioText: The cockpit windshield has cracked. Request descent to FL220.
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱风挡裂了。请求下降高度220。

cards.audioText: Neither of us can see through our windshield. Does your airport permit auto-land?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们和副驾驶都无法通过风挡看到外面。你机场允许自动着陆吗？

cards.audioText: Our engine control has malfunctioned. We cannot get much thrust. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的发动机控制有故障。我们不能得到较大推力。申请立即下降。

cards.audioText: We have a low oil pressure warning from engine Number Two. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的二发有滑油压力低的警告。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We have performed our procedures but engine vibration still exists. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已完成了程序但发动机抖振仍然存在。申请备降。

cards.audioText: Engine Number Three has smoke coming out of the pylon section. We are evacuating.
cards.audioTextZh: 三号发动机吊架部位出现烟雾。我们正在撤离。

cards.audioText: Our left engine has ingested FOD. We are shutting down engines and holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的左发吸入了外物而损坏。我们马上关车并原地等待。

cards.audioText: We made a diversion due to reports of freezing rain at our original destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们备降是由于收到目的地机场冻雨报告。

cards.audioText: We are encountering clear ice. Request immediate right turn to heading 130.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遇到了明冰。申请立即右转航向130。

cards.audioText: We cannot continue holding in icing conditions. Request descent immediately and cancel speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不能在结冰条件下继续等待。请求立即下降并取消速度限制。

cards.audioText: We have a “Wind-shear Ahead” warning message. Request to delay takeoff or change to another runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们出现了“前方风切变”警告信息。请求延迟起飞，或换一条跑道。

cards.audioText: We have received information of a new volcanic eruption. Will it affect our route?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们收到火山喷发的一条新信息，会影响我们航路吗？

cards.audioText: We are unsure of our position due heavy fog. We are holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于浓雾，我们不确定我们的位置。原地等待中。

cards.audioText: We had a rapid airspeed decay due turbulence. Request immediate descent to FL390.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的空速由于颠簸快速衰减。申请立即下降到高度390。

cards.audioText: I apologize for the level bust, but we needed the altitude loss to recover from wind-shear.
cards.audioTextZh: 很抱歉偏离指定高度了，但我们需要损失高度来改出风切变。

cards.audioText: The thunderstorms will last for about 40 minutes according to the weather update. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 根据天气更新情况，雷暴将持续约40分钟。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We made the go-around because strong convective currents on short final made our approach unstable.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞的原因是因为短五边很强的对流气流使进近不稳定。

cards.audioText: We were struck by hail. Our airframe is severely damaged. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们被冰雹击中了。我们的机身严重受损。申请紧急服务。

cards.audioText: Request to cancel our approach. The runway is not long enough and there are water patches.
cards.audioTextZh: 申请取消进近。跑道不够长，还有部分积水。

cards.audioText: Request holding instructions. We’ll attempt another approach when the rain showers become lighter.
cards.audioTextZh: 申请等待指令。阵雨变小的时候我们再重新进近。

cards.audioText: We have observed blowing sand in the vicinity of the airport. How long will this last?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已观察到在机场邻近地区有吹沙，持续多长时间呢？

cards.audioText: Runway is covered with patches of ice. Braking action is medium to poor.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道被大片结冰覆盖。刹车效应中等偏差。

cards.audioText: A Pilot overflying reported seeing virga above the runways. Request to terminate our approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞越的一名飞行员报告在跑道上空看见了雨幡。申请终止进近。

cards.audioText: Lining up Runway 35. Runway lights are too bright. Request to dim the runway lights.
cards.audioTextZh: 进跑道35。跑道灯太亮。申请调暗跑道灯。

cards.audioText: The NOTAM says this part of the taxiway is closed during this period, please verify.
cards.audioTextZh: 航行通告说部分滑行道在这期间关闭。请核实。

cards.audioText: We are stopping taxi. The boarding bridge is not at its designated position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们停止（滑行）了。廊桥不在指定位置。

cards.audioText: Our cabin crew will direct all passengers to stay outside the runway after evacuation.
cards.audioTextZh: 撤离后我们的客舱机组将指导所有旅客待在跑道外。

cards.audioText: We have had a tail strike. Request to stop climb at 3000 feet and return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已发生机尾擦地。请求3000英尺停止爬升并返场着陆。

cards.audioText: We have veered off the runway due asymmetric thrust. We are evacuating. Request emergency assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于不对称推力，我们在跑道上突然转向偏出了跑道，正在撤离。申请紧急救助。

cards.audioText: We cannot get good climb profile due engine problems. Request maintain runway heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于发动机问题，我们不能得到很好的爬升剖面，申请保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: The center of gravity is disturbed. We will relocate passengers prior to approach. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 重心被干扰了。进近前我们将重新安排旅客。申请等待。

cards.audioText: My apologies for the deviation due the wrong altitude setting. Request further instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 抱歉由于错误的高度设定而偏离，申请进一步指令。

cards.audioText: My apologies for the level deviation. We were caught in a strong updraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 抱歉高度偏离了。我们遇到了强上升气流。

cards.audioText: We used too much speed brakes and penetrated our level. Did we cause any conflict?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们使用过大量的减速板而穿越了我们的高度。我们引起冲突了吗？

cards.audioText: We were not informed of a frequency change. I will now monitor your frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们未得到频率改变的通知。我将现在监听你的频率。

cards.audioText: We have three serious and five minor injuries on board. Request ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们机上有三人重伤，五人轻伤。请求救护车到场。

cards.audioText: One passenger is having difficulty breathing. Request descent to a lower level to reduce cabin altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客呼吸困难。请求立即下降到较低高度以减小客舱高度。

cards.audioText: A stressed passenger attempted to open an emergency exit. Request airport security on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名闹情绪的旅客试图打开应急出口。申请机场保安到场。

cards.audioText: We have a hostage situation. Request stair vehicles on standby to disembark the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一名人质。申请客梯车待命以便让旅客们下飞机。

cards.audioText: We have a passenger with a suspected heart attack. Request diversion to a suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有名乘客疑似有心脏病。申请备降到合适机场。

cards.audioText: A pregnant passenger is in severe pain. Request priority landing and ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名孕妇承受剧痛。申请优先着陆和救护车到场。

cards.audioText: We have an 8-month old infant with head injuries. Request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有个8个月大的婴儿头部受伤。申请救护车到场。

cards.audioText: We have a hijack situation on board. Can our destination airport provide armed intervention?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们被劫机了。我们的目的地机场能提供武装干涉吗？

cards.audioText: There is a stand-off in the cabin. Some of the hijackers are carrying blades.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱已陷于僵持状态。一些劫机犯拿着刀片。

cards.audioText: The air marshal and passengers have restrained five suspects. The situation is now under control.
cards.audioTextZh: 安全保安和旅客们已经制服了五名疑犯。局面得到了控制。

cards.audioText: Some explosives were discovered behind a panel near the back of the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱后部的一块面板后面发现一些爆炸物。

cards.audioText: A bomb has exploded and the cabin is full of smoke. Request emergency descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 炸弹已爆炸，客舱到处是烟雾。申请紧急下降。

cards.audioText: We are evacuating on the runway. Be advised the bomb is still on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正在跑道上紧急撤离。请你告知相关人员炸弹还在飞机上。

cards.audioText: Our cargo manifest shows that there are 80 kilograms of lithium batteries on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们货物舱单表明机上有80千克的锂电池。

cards.audioText: We have a possible traffic conflict at 10 o’clock, converging with our flight path.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们可能在10点钟方位有冲突飞机，与我们的飞行线路会聚。

cards.audioText: Some of the cabin crew are injured. They were serving meals during the TCAS maneuver.
cards.audioTextZh: 部分客舱机组受伤了。TCAS机动时他们正在供餐。

cards.audioText: We veered off the runway. We are evacuating near the runway and rapid exit J5.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们偏出了跑道，正在撤离。我们的位置在跑道和快速脱离道口J5附近。

cards.audioText: The military aircraft has made an abrupt maneuver indicating we may continue on this heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 军用飞机已突然机动，表明我们可以继续保持此航向。

cards.audioText: Confirm we are being vectored to fly overhead the airport for right downwind.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实你会引导我们飞越机场上空然后做右三边。

cards.audioText: Sorry, there was a problem with my audio equipment. How do you read me now?
cards.audioTextZh: 抱歉，因为我们的音频设备有问题。现在你听我几个？

cards.audioText: Not ready for immediate takeoff due possible wake turbulence from departing heavy aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 没有准备好立即起飞，刚起飞的重型机可能有尾流。

cards.audioText: Are you banning us from entry because of our airline or our aircraft type?
cards.audioTextZh: 你禁止我们飞入是因为我们公司或我们的机型吗？

cards.audioText: Approach clearance canceled, turn left direct to DA, climb to 4000 feet, hold as published, expect further clearance at time 50.
cards.audioTextZh: 取消进近许可，左转直飞DA，上升到4000英尺，按公布的航图等待，预计进一步许可时间50分。

cards.audioText: Hold south of AMS VOR at 9000 feet, inbound track 270 degrees,left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute. Expect further clearance at 46.
cards.audioTextZh: 在AMSVOR台以南等待，高度9000英尺，向台航迹270度，左等待，背台时间1分钟。预计进一步许可时间46分。

cards.audioText: Cleared to the 180 radial of PER VOR at 15 DME. Hold south, left hand pattern, outbound time 2 minutes, expect approach clearance at 37.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以在PER VOR台180径向线DME15海里处向南等待，左等待，背台时间2分钟，预计进近许可时间37

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination, flight planned route, cruising level 330,departure Runway 04, initial altitude 7000 feet. HZ01 Departure,squawk 2563, departure frequency 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以飞往目的地机场，按照计划的飞行路线，巡航高度层330，离场跑道04号，起始高度7000英尺。HZ-01号标准仪表离场，应答机2563，离场频率124.35。

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 Departure, initially climb to 4500 feet, cruising level 310, when airborne contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以按照计划航路飞往目的地机场，跑道36右，LKO-01号标准仪表离场，起始上升高度4500英尺，巡航高度层310，离地后联系119.7，应答机2515。

cards.audioText: Cleared via ZF-01 Departure, initial altitude 5000 feet. Departure frequency 125.9. Cruising level 290, departure Runway 04. Squawk 6563.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以经由ZF-01号标准仪表离场，起始高度5000英尺。离场频率125.9。巡航高度层290，离场跑道04号。应答机6563。

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination via flight plan route. Departure Runway 36L. HZ-01 Departure. Initial altitude 5000 feet. Cruising level 330. Departure frequency 119.45, squawk 5667.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以按照计划航路飞往目的地机场，离场跑道36左，HZ-01号标准仪表离场。起始高度5000英尺，巡航高度层330，离场频率119.45，应答机5667。

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination via flight planned route, initial climb to 2700 feet, request level change en-route, departure frequency 120.3,squawk 0722.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以按照计划航路飞往目的地机场，初始上升高度2700英尺，航路上申请改变高度，离场频率120.3，应答机0722。

cards.audioText: Hold on the 265 radial of BKM VOR between 25 and 30 miles DME, FL100, inbound track 085, right hand pattern, expected approach time 1022.
cards.audioTextZh: 在BKMVOR台265度径向线，DME距离25至30海里之间等待，高度层100，向台航迹085，右等待，预计进近时间1022。

cards.audioText: Hold at 20 DME of ST VOR, FL100, inbound track 260 degrees, left turns, limiting outbound distance 24 DME.
cards.audioTextZh: 在STVOR台DME20海里等待，高度层100，向台航迹260度，左转，限制背台距离DME24海里。

cards.audioText: Hold at BKM VOR FL250, right hand pattern, expect further clearance at 23, landing delay at destination airport 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 在BKMVOR台等待，高度250，右等待，预计进一步许可23分，目的地机场着陆延误30分钟。

cards.audioText: Radar service is terminated due technical failure. Maintain Mach number decimal 81 or less for separation.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于技术故障雷达服务终止。因间隔，保持马赫数点81或更小。

cards.audioText: Radar control is resumed, track direct to BKM VOR and increase speed to Mach number decimal 84.
cards.audioTextZh: 雷达管制恢复，直飞BKMVOR台，增速到马赫数点84。

cards.audioText: Position 42N（North）165E (East) at 0800, FL390, estimating 44N 180E at 0900 45N 170W next.
cards.audioTextZh: 当前位置北纬42度，东经165度，时间0800，高度390，预计北纬44,度，东经180度，时间0900，下一位置北纬45度，西经170度。

cards.audioText: We have only one air conditioning pack operational. Request a new cruising level below FL300.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仅有一个空调组件运行。请求新的巡航高度低于高度300。

cards.audioText: We just had a smoke emergency. We need to depressurize the airplane to let in fresh air. Request rapid descent to 8000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们刚发生烟雾紧急状况。需要释压让新鲜空气进入飞机。请求快速下降到8000英尺。

cards.audioText: Our cabin altitude at one time had reached 16000 feet. Some passengers have symptoms of hypoxia.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的座舱高度曾达到了16000英尺。部分旅客有缺氧症状。

cards.audioText: We are now ventilating with ram air. It is best that our rate of descent does not exceed 600 feet per minute.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们现在通过冲压空气通风，我们下降率最好不超过每分钟600英尺.

cards.audioText: The Morse code for the VOR is different from the approach chart. Confirm the VOR is fully operational.
cards.audioTextZh: VOR的莫尔斯代码与我们进近图上的不一致。证实VOR台在运行中。

cards.audioText: The approach lights for Runway 36L are a bit different from those shown on the airport diagram.
cards.audioTextZh: 36左跑道的进近灯光与机场图上的显示有点不同。

cards.audioText: We have multiple failures on the inertial reference system. We are no longer able to fly oceanic route. Request return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有多个惯导失效，我们不能再跨洋飞行，申请返场着陆。

cards.audioText: One of our generators has failed. At present moment, we are still able to continue to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们一部发电机故障了。目前看来，还能够继续飞往目的地。

cards.audioText: Electrical system has a serious malfunction. Request radar vectors to an airport that’s within 20 minutes of flight time.
cards.audioTextZh: 电力设备有严重故障。申请雷达引导到20分钟以内能够飞到的机场。

cards.audioText: We have less than 10 minutes of battery power left. We are preparing for ditching procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的电瓶电源供电不足10分钟，我们正在准备水上迫降程序。

cards.audioText: We have switched off most of our electrical systems for smoke procedure. Request vectors for a long final, Runway 15.
cards.audioTextZh: 为了排烟程序，我们关掉了大部分电气系统。申请引导到长五边，跑道15号。

cards.audioText: The windshield suddenly had electrical arcing. We need to pull the circuit breakers and delay the approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 风挡突然出现电弧，我们需要拨跳开关并推迟进近。

cards.audioText: The cockpit side window is not sealed properly. Request reduce to minimum speed and descend to 4000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱侧窗没关好，申请减速到最小速度，下降到4000英尺。

cards.audioText: We had to go around due pilot seat moving. We’ll try to reset the circuit breaker before making another approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 刚才复飞是由于驾驶员座椅自己移动了，我们得先试着复位椅子的跳开关再进近。

cards.audioText: We have already discharged the engine extinguishers. The fire warning light is still on. Do you have a visual on our left engine?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经释放了发动机灭火瓶，火警灯仍然亮。你们能目视看看我们的左发是否有火？

cards.audioText: We have an APU fire warning. Can you verify if there is smoke coming from the back of the plane?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有APU火警。你能否看到我们飞机后部是否有烟雾？

cards.audioText: The APU fire seems to be extinguished. Request fire trucks on standby and stairs vehicle to disembark the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: APU火情看样子被熄灭了，申请消防车待命，还有客梯车以便让旅客下飞机。

cards.audioText: We had a cargo smoke warning. Advise the ground handlers NOT to open our cargo door until the passengers have all disembarked.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有个货舱烟雾警告。请告知地面装卸人员在所有旅客下飞机之前千万别打开货舱门。

cards.audioText: We have smoke coming out of our avionics bay. It is out of control. Request proceed direct to final and cancel all speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱。已经失控了。申请直飞五边并取消全部速度限制。

cards.audioText: Our pitch control has malfunctioned. We cannot move the elevators. We are flying the airplane with only trim.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们俯仰控制失效了，升降舵动不了，我们尝试用配平来控制飞机。

cards.audioText: We have finished the checklist but still cannot retract some of the speed brakes. Request the longest runway for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们完成了检查单但还是不能收回一部分减速板。申请最长的跑道落地。

cards.audioText: We have asymmetric flaps. Airplane is rolling to the left. Request holding to solve the problem.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的襟翼位置不对称，飞机向左横滚，请求等待以解决问题。

cards.audioText: Request immediate climb above the minimum safe altitude to perform the checklist due to run-away trim condition.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于配平失控，申请立即上安全高度以上来做检查单。

cards.audioText: Request return to FL250.We just had an air-upset situation and lost a lot of altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 申请回到高度250，我们刚才有空中异常姿态的情况，而且掉了很多高度。

cards.audioText: We have lost electrical power to some of the flight control actuators. Request delay our descent to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的一些飞机操纵作动筒失去了电源。申请延迟下降来做检查单。

cards.audioText: We have a severe fuel leak situation, unable to reach the closest airport. You can expect us to make a forced landing near our present location.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有严重漏油情况，无法抵达最近的机场，估计会在我们当前位置附近地点做紧急迫降。

cards.audioText: Our cabin crew reports that we have fuel leak from the right wing. Request diversion to the closest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们客舱乘务员报告说右机翼漏油，申请飞往最近合适机场备降。

cards.audioText: We have already shut down engine Number One, but it is still leaking fuel near the pylon. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经关了一发，但发动机吊架附近仍然在漏油。申请紧急服务。

cards.audioText: The ground crew reports that we are leaking a bit of fuel from the bottom of the right engine nacelle. We are delaying taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 地面人员（机务）报告我们右发吊舱下方有漏燃油，我们延迟滑行。

cards.audioText: We need to continue to run the engines at our present location for a few minutes, will advise you shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们需要在当前位置让发动机运转几分钟，将很快告知你们。

cards.audioText: The ground crew reports that we are leaking a significant amount of fuel from the bottom of Number Three engine. We have just shut it down.
cards.audioTextZh: 地面人员（机务）报告我们三发下方有大量燃油泄漏，我们刚刚关车了。

cards.audioText: The fuel leak has stopped. But if a fire starts at any time, I will order an evacuation.
cards.audioTextZh: 漏油停止了。但如果任何时候有火警，我将发布紧急撤离指令。

cards.audioText: We have leaked a large amount of fuel onto the apron. Request fire trucks on standby and the stairs vehicle to disembark the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经有大量燃油漏到了机坪。申请消防车待命和客梯车让旅客离机。

cards.audioText: We have fumes in the cabin, possibly due to a fuel leak. We are anticipating an immediate evacuation after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们客舱有燃油味道，可能是漏油了。我们预计会在落地后立刻做紧急撤离。

cards.audioText: Our hydraulic systems have a malfunction. Request descent to lower levels to extend flaps in advance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的液压系统有个故障。请求下降到较低高度以便放出襟翼。

cards.audioText: Our hydraulic fluid is dangerously low, possibly due to a leak. Request descent to lower levels to extend flaps.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的液压油低得可怕，可能漏油。请求下降到低高度放出襟翼。

cards.audioText: Our ram air turbine is not providing any hydraulic pressure. We are still operating on one hydraulic system only. Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的冲压空气涡轮没有提供任何液压压力。我们仍然还是单套液压系统运行，申请到附近合适机场备降。

cards.audioText: Both our windshield heating systems have failed. Ice is obstructing our view. Request latest airport weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们风挡加温系统故障了，冰挡住了我们的视线。申请最新的机场天气。

cards.audioText: We had electrical arcing on the windshield and pulled the circuit breakers according to the checklist. Will advise when ready for approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的风挡刚才有电弧，根据检查单我们拨了跳开关。我们准备好进近时将告知你们。

cards.audioText: We performed the missed approach because my windshield wiper became inoperative and I could not see very well.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们执行了复飞是因为我的风挡雨刷坏了，我刚才无法看清楚了。

cards.audioText: We made the overshoot because of a stall warning, probably caused by a defective angle of attack probe.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为失速警告，可能是迎角探头有故障。

cards.audioText: About twenty passengers and crew members were injured during the TCAS maneuver. Request diversion and medical assistance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 大约20名旅客和机组人员在做机动时受伤了。申请备降和医疗援助到场。

cards.audioText: Engine indicates high EGT at idle power setting. We need to have partial thrust in the descent. Request an early descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机显示我们的油门收到慢车时EGT较高。我们需要带部分推力下降。申请提前下降。

cards.audioText: Our fuel endurance is 48 minutes. We must leave the hold otherwise we will be at minimum fuel.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们燃油续航时间是48分钟。我们必须离开等待，否则我们将出现最低燃油。

cards.audioText: It seems some of the spoilers cannot be retracted. We have to re-calculate our landing distance before we start our approach, standby.
cards.audioTextZh: 似乎一部分扰流板不能收回，我们重新计算一下着陆距离才能进近，稍等。

cards.audioText: We have an indication that the nose wheel did not extend properly. Request low pass for visual check.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仪表显示前轮没有正常放出。申请低空通场目视检查。

cards.audioText: We have lost our braking. We used thrust reversers to stop the aircraft. Request ground services to chock the nose wheel.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们失去了刹车，刚才用反推来停住飞机，申请地面服务用销子挡好前轮。

cards.audioText: We made the go-around because our landing gear wouldn't extend normally. Request holding pattern to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们刚才复飞的原因是起落架无法正常放出。申请等待来做检查单。

cards.audioText: We applied maximum braking when we rejected takeoff. Request fire services to escort the aircraft back to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 刚才中断起飞时我们使用了最大刹车。申请消防车护送飞机回停机坪。

cards.audioText: We made a go-around due to head-up display problem. We’ll inform you when we are ready for the approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为平显故障。准备好进近时我们将通知你们。

cards.audioText: We do not have that runway in our database. Request delay our descent while we program the CDU.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们数据库里没有这条跑道。我们需要输入CDU，申请延迟下降。

cards.audioText: Our oxygen pressure is dropping rapidly. Request to fly heading 050 and descent to FL180 to escape from the mountainous area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的氧气压力快速下降。申请航向飞050，下降到高度180以避开山区。

cards.audioText: The NOTAM says the ILS is unserviceable, but we are still picking up the Morse Code, confirm it is still in operation.
cards.audioTextZh: 航行通告说盲降不工作，但我们仍然收到了莫尔斯代码，证实盲降仍然可用。

cards.audioText: We have an engine failure. Following ETOPS procedure, request descent to FL200, maintain high speed and proceed direct to alternate airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们发动机故障了。按照ETOPS程序，申请下降高度200，保持大速度直飞备降场。

cards.audioText: We cannot provide oxygen to the passengers as we are not sure where the smoke is coming from.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不能给乘客提供氧气，因为我们不确定烟雾来源。

cards.audioText: There was heavy smoke in the cabin before we ventilated the aircraft. Request medical assistance for passengers after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们给飞机通风前客舱有很多烟雾。申请落地后给旅客提供医疗救助。

cards.audioText: The aircraft is depressurized. We are descending. Confirm 10,000 feet is enough to clear terrain until we reach our alternate.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机处在释压状态，我们正在下降。证实我们到达备降场前10000英尺是否能满足越障。

cards.audioText: We are no longer getting bleed air from the right engine. Request immediate descent to leave the icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不再有来自右发的引气。申请立即下降离开结冰区。

cards.audioText: We are unable to restart engine number one with bleed air. Request high speed for a windmill air start.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不能用引气启动一发。请求大速度风转启动。

cards.audioText: Both engine bleed air systems have failed and we are relying on APU bleed for air conditioning. Request descent to 14, 000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们发动机引气全部失效，现在依靠APU来提供空调。申请下降到14000英尺。

cards.audioText: We have no bleed air coming from either engines or APU. Request rapid descent to 10,000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们没有任何来自发动机或APU的引气，申请快速下降到10000英尺。

cards.audioText: Disregard my last CPDLC request for climb. We have a system problem and will maintain present level for now.
cards.audioTextZh: 作废上次CPDLC上升请求。我们出现了系统问题，将保持当前高度。

cards.audioText: We just had an APU fire warning, and discharged the fire extinguisher, Request visual check if there is smoke coming from our tail section.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们刚刚有过APU火警，也释放了灭火瓶。请目视检查我们飞机的尾部是否有烟雾。

cards.audioText: Another aircraft has seen a lot of smoke coming from our APU. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 另一架飞机看见我们APU有烟雾冒出，我们在进行紧急撤离。申请紧急服务。

cards.audioText: We have a generator failure and cannot start our APU at this altitude. Request descent to perform APU startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一部发电机故障，在这个高度不能启动APU。申请下降来启动APU。

cards.audioText: A passenger has opened an over-wing emergency exit. The slide has deployed. Request to cancel our slot time.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客打开了机翼紧急出口，滑梯已经放出。请求取消我们的离场时间。

cards.audioText: A passenger tried to unlock the cabin door in flight, the cabin crew restrained him. Request airport police on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客企图在空中打开客舱门，客舱机组已经将他制服，申请落地后机场警察到场。

cards.audioText: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. Advise the fire fighters that it might be an electrical fire.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有烟雾来自电子设备舱。请告诉消防员可能有电气火情。

cards.audioText: Our thrust lever is not responsive. We cannot reduce thrust on engine Number One. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们推力手柄反应不对，我们不能减少一发推力。请求等待。

cards.audioText: We have a thrust reverser opened in flight. We cannot maintain this level. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 空中反推被放出。我们不能保持高度。请求立即下降。

cards.audioText: We still cannot retract the thrust reverser. Our approach speed will be higher than normal. Request vectors for the longest Runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仍人不能收回反推。我们的进近速度会大于正常速度。申请雷达引导到最长的跑道落地。

cards.audioText: Our EGT continues to be above the maximum limit. Request descent. We might shut down engine Number Two shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的排气温度继续高于最大值限。申请下降。我们可能马上关掉二号发动机。

cards.audioText: The engine vibration is now causing the airplane to shake violently. We are shutting down our engine Number Three.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在发动机抖振引起飞机震动剧烈。我们正准备关掉三号发动机。

cards.audioText: We’ve made a visual inspection of engine Number Two from the cabin. The engine cowling has fallen off.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们从客舱里目视观察二号发动机。发动机整流罩脱落了。

cards.audioText: Ground vehicle has collided with our engine nacelle. Maintenance work is needed before flight. Request cancel our airway clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 地面车辆与发动机短舱碰撞了。飞行前需要机务维护。申请取消我们的航路许可。

cards.audioText: The Number Two engine has been shut down. We are no longer able to maintain level flight. Request descent to FL200.
cards.audioTextZh: 已关掉二号发动机。我们不能够保持平飞。申请下降到高度200。

cards.audioText: The uncontained engine failure has caused parts of the fuselage to be damaged. Request emergency descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机失效是非包容性质的，已经导致部分机身损坏。申请紧急下降。

cards.audioText: There is a huge gaping hole in the aisle, somehow the cabin floor has been punctured. We are re-seating passengers. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 过道出现很大的洞，不知怎么的，客舱地板被穿透了。我们重新安排旅客座位。申请等待。

cards.audioText: We have abnormal noise coming from the mid section of our fuselage, somewhere near the ceiling. Request descent and reduce speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的机身中部有异常噪音，在客舱顶部附近。申请下降并减速。

cards.audioText: We are unsure about the cause of the explosion. There are injuries in the cabin. We’ll give you an update as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不确定爆炸的原因。客舱有人受伤。我们一有新消息将尽快提供给你们。

cards.audioText: Some passengers have cuts and burn wounds due onboard explosion. Request diversion and medical services upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于机上爆炸，部分旅客有割伤和烧伤。申请备降和到场时的医疗服务。

cards.audioText: Ice is accumulating rapidly on the wings and fuselage. Request emergency descent to 6000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 机翼和机身的积冰速度很快。申请紧急下降到6000英尺。

cards.audioText: We had to descend immediately due to wind-shear at our cruise level. We didn’t have time to request descent as the frequency was busy.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们由于巡航高度层风切变的原因不得不立即下降，由于刚才频率繁忙，我们没有时间请示下降。

cards.audioText: The airplane began to buffet when climbing through FL380. We had to stop climb immediately to increase airspeed.
cards.audioTextZh: 刚才上升通过高度380时飞机开始抖振。我们必须立即停止爬升以增加空速。

cards.audioText: We are flying near our maximum altitude. We cannot maintain airspeed in this turbulence. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正接近我们的最大高度飞行。我们不能在颠簸中保持空速。申请立即下降。

cards.audioText: We encountered heavy rain and had a temporary flame out on our right engine. Request immediate climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遭遇了大雨，右发暂时熄火。申请立即上升。

cards.audioText: We have stopped on Runway 23 and will remain on the runway due heavy fog. I say again, we are still on the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已停在23号跑道上，但由于浓雾我们仍在跑道上。我再说一遍，我们仍在跑道上。

cards.audioText: There is heavy drifting fog. We think it is no longer safe to taxi. Request to hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 有较大平流雾。我们认为滑行不安全。请求原地等待。

cards.audioText: Frontal weather is quickly moving in from the west. If the holding is more than 10 minutes, we will have to divert.
cards.audioTextZh: 锋面天气很快由西移动过来。如果等待超过10分钟我们将备降。

cards.audioText: There was temperature inversion when we descended through 3000 feet. Our airspeed dropped suddenly by 25 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们下降通过3000英尺时有逆温层。我们的空速突然掉了25节。

cards.audioText: We performed the missed approach below the minimum because of advection fog. We could no longer see the runway lights.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于平流雾，我们执行了低于最低高度的复飞。我们不能够再看见跑道灯了。

cards.audioText: The latest weather says that frontal weather and freezing rain is now stationary over the airport. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 最新天气报说锋面天气和冻雨正在机场上空停留。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We can’t find any gaps for at least 100 miles in the squall line covering our arrival route. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 飑线覆盖我们进场航路，至少在100海里范围内我们都找不到任何空间穿越。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We can see dust swirls approaching the airport and we’re concerned about low level wind-shear. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们能看见尘埃涡流接近机场，我们担心低空风切变。请求等待。

cards.audioText: The latest SIGMET says a super-cell thunderstorm is developing at our destination. Is our flight affected?
cards.audioTextZh: 最新重要气象报表明超级单体雷暴正在我们目的地机场形成。我们的航班受影响吗？

cards.audioText: Request to continue our flight. Our ETA is in two hours and maybe the airport will have the runways cleared of snow by then.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求继续飞行。我们的预达时刻是两小时后，可能机场会在那时将跑道上的雪除干净。

cards.audioText: We had to make a quick heading change due ice pellets. You didn’t answer our request so we squawked 7700 and made the heading change.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们必须快速改变航向是因为冰丸。你没有回答我们的申请，因此我们设置应答机编码7700并改变了航向。

cards.audioText: We have just encountered a lightning strike. Some of our instruments have erroneous indications. Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们刚遇到了雷击。一些仪表出现错误指示。申请备降到最近的合适机场。

cards.audioText: We have had a lightning strike. So far no system seems to be affected. We will continue to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已遭遇雷击。目前为止没有系统受到影响。我们将继续前往目的地。

cards.audioText: Request to cancel our approach. Braking action is poor and we’re concerned about hydroplaning during rollout.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求取消进近。刹车效应差，我们担心滑跑时出现滑水现象。

cards.audioText: We have received reports of freezing rain ranging from ground up to 5000 feet. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们收到了冻雨报告，范围从地面到5000英尺。申请备降。

cards.audioText: A sandstorm is forecast to reach the airport within 20 minutes. We won’t get airborne by then. Request cancel startup and tow back to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计沙暴在20分钟内到达机场。到那时我们还没有升空。申请取消开车并拖飞机回停机位。

cards.audioText: Heavy blowing snow is expected to last for another 30 minutes. Request to terminate approach and holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 较大的吹雪预计持续30分钟。申请终止进近和等待指令。

cards.audioText: Ice patches are covering the runway mostly along the runway edge. Uncontaminated runway width is about 30 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 成片结冰覆盖跑道边缘大部分地方。未污染跑道的宽度约30米。

cards.audioText: A dissipating thunderstorm is ahead of us. We are near the zero-degree isotherm. Request deviate an additional 10 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: 消散的雷暴在我们前方。我们接近零度等温线。申请再向右偏离10海里。

cards.audioText: We have a visual on a tornado at our 10 o’clock, about 2 miles. Request immediate right turn.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在10点钟方位，约2海里的地方目视看见了龙卷风。请求立即右转。

cards.audioText: The weather forecast says that the typhoon along our route will be intensifying. Request change our airway clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 天气预报说台风沿我们航路将会增强。请求改变我们航路许可。

cards.audioText: The hurricane has gathered in strength and will affect all airports at the south coast. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 飓风已大量聚集，而且将影响南海岸的全部机场，申请备降。

cards.audioText: We have entered volcanic ash. Our radios and engines are not working properly, now heading 235, and descending to FL 220, squawking 7700.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经进入火山灰。我们的无线电和发动机都不能正常工作，现在航向235，下降到高度层220，应答机编码7700。

cards.audioText: We are landing into the sun in heavy haze. Can you turn on the approach lights to maximum intensity?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在严重霾中迎太阳着陆。能把进近灯调到最大强度吗？

cards.audioText: The follow-me vehicle is leading us to taxiway L3. Our wings will not clear the other airplanes on this narrow taxiway. We are stopping.
cards.audioTextZh: 引导车正引导我们到滑行道L3。在这条较窄的滑行道上我们的机翼无法避开其他飞机。我们停止滑行了。

cards.audioText: We are stopping. The ground marshaller is still guiding us in, but I think my engine will hit the boarding bridge if we taxi any further.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们停止了。地面信号员仍引导我们滑入，但我认为如果我们再滑入，我们的发动机将碰到廊桥。

cards.audioText: We are shutting down our engines. There are boxes blown by the wind toward our aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们关车了。风朝我们飞机方向吹过来了一些盒子。

cards.audioText: We had difficulty starting up our engines due strong tailwind. Request to change our pushback position facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于强顺风，我们开启发动机有困难。请求改变推出位置，面朝西。

cards.audioText: Another aircraft has collided with us. I’ll command an evacuation as soon as we both turn off our engines.
cards.audioTextZh: 另一架飞机与我们相撞。在我们双方都关车后，我将下指令尽快撤离。

cards.audioText: The tow bar has been bent. Our maintenance crew will inspect our nose wheel. Holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 拖杆弯曲了。我们的机务人员将检查前轮。原地等待。

cards.audioText: The tug has swung around and collided with our forward fuselage. We are shutting down engines. Request stairs vehicle and shuttle bus.
cards.audioTextZh: 拖车偏转撞到飞机前机身。我们正在关车。申请客梯车和摆渡车。

cards.audioText: A catering truck collided with our aft fuselage. There are fumes in the cabin and we are quickly disembarking all passengers. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: 餐车撞到了我们的机后身。客舱有烟雾，我们正在快速让旅客下飞机，申请消防服务。

cards.audioText: The flaps were extended inadvertently and hit the fuel truck. We are disembarking all onboard personnel. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: 襟翼无意中被放出，碰到了油车。我们正撤离机上人员。申请消防服务。

cards.audioText: Our airplane nose has now lifted off the ground due to improper load and balance. Request ground maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于不正确的配载和平衡，我们的飞机机头已经离地。申请地面维护。

cards.audioText: We have discovered leakage of dangerous goods in the cargo hold. Can you alert hazardous material specialists?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已发现货舱里的危险品泄漏。你们能通知危险品专家吗？

cards.audioText: The outer main landing gear might have rolled over runway lights when we made the one eighty turn. Request personnel to inspect.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们做180度转弯时外主起落架可能擦到了跑道灯。请求人员进行检查。

cards.audioText: A passenger has assembled a bomb in the lavatory. He is making threats. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客在厕所已安装一枚炸弹。他正在威胁我们。申请紧急服务

cards.audioText: We made a very hard landing. We’ll need maintenance inspection before our next flight. Suggest you check the runway touchdown zone.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们重着陆了。下次飞行前我们需要机务检查。建议你们检查跑道接地区。

cards.audioText: I can read you, but I’m not sure you can hear me. I will squawk ident to comply with your instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我能听到你，但我不确定你能听到我。我将识别应答机以遵守指令。

cards.audioText: I have heard an aircraft in distress but no one’s responding. I can help relay his message.
cards.audioTextZh: 我听到有飞机遇险了但没有人回应。我能帮助转报信息。

cards.audioText: Message relay: The aircraft in distress will ditch in the ocean. His present coordinate is One Eight Degrees, One Five Minutes, North, One Six Zero Degrees, Five Two Minutes East.
cards.audioTextZh: 转报：遇险飞机将海上迫降。目前的坐标是18度，15分钟，北，160度，52分钟，东。

cards.audioText: The aircraft in distress says he will attempt to force land in an area about ten miles Northeast of his position.
cards.audioTextZh: 遇险飞机说他将尝试在其位置东北10海里的区域迫降。

cards.audioText: Request diversion. The latest weather at our destination suggests snow storm will last for 5 hours.
cards.audioTextZh: 申请备降。目的地机场最新天气表明雪暴将持续5小时。

cards.audioText: Our radar shows a strong echo from the thunderstorm ahead. Request an immediate right turn to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: 雷达显示前方强雷暴回波。申请立即右转避让。

cards.audioText: A passenger activated the overhead emergency oxygen generator. Request airport security on arrival to detain this individual.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客触发了顶部紧急氧气发生器。请求机场保安到场拘留他。

cards.audioText: We have a passenger with severe hyperventilation. He has received first aid but his condition is not improving. Request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一名旅客有严重的过度换气症。他得到了急救但情况没有好转。申请救护车到场。

cards.audioText: There was a fight onboard among a few passengers. One of them is now bleeding seriously. Request police and ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 几名旅客在机上打斗。其中一人现在流血严重。请求警察和救护车到场。

cards.audioText: The purser told me the injured passenger has blood type O. Maybe this information is useful to the paramedics.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务长告知我受伤旅客血型是O型血。或许该信息对急救医务人员有用。

cards.audioText: A passenger is unconscious after suffering from seizure. The cabin crew is giving her first aid. We will advise if we require a diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客癫痫发作后失去知觉。客舱机组提供急救。如需备降我们将告知你们。

cards.audioText: Many passengers and crew were injured due severe turbulence. We will advise the number and severity of injuries when able.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于严重颠簸，多名旅客和机组都受伤了。如能够，我们将告知受伤人数和严重性。

cards.audioText: An elderly passenger has passed away. We will continue to our destination. Request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一位年长的旅客去世了。我们将继续到目的地。请求救护车到场。

cards.audioText: We found a passenger unconscious from a drug overdose in the lavatory. Request police and ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们发现一名旅客在洗手间服药（或毒品）过量失去意识了。请求警察和救护车到场。

cards.audioText: The sick passenger’s condition has improved. We no longer require the diversion. Request to continue to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 生病旅客的情况已经好转了。我们不再要求备降，请求继续飞往我们的目的地。

cards.audioText: We received an emergency call from the cabin, but now nobody is responding. We can hear shouting and disturbance. Our cabin crew might be under duress.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们收到客舱的急救呼叫，但现在没人回应。我们能听见喊叫声和斗殴声。我们的客舱机组可能受到了胁迫。

cards.audioText: We can see two masked men with sharp weapons on our cockpit door surveillance camera. They are kicking the cockpit door.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们通过驾驶舱监控摄像机看见两个头戴面具手拿利器的人。他们正在踢驾驶舱门。

cards.audioText: I can see the area outside of the cockpit. There are two hijack suspects standing in the aisle.
cards.audioTextZh: 我能看见驾驶舱外面区域。有两名劫机者正站在过道。

cards.audioText: One of the terrorists is about forty years old. He is about 180 cm tall, wearing a brown shirt and dark pants.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名恐怖分子大约40岁。他有180厘米高，穿着棕色衬衫和深色裤子。

cards.audioText: A terrorist is trying to access the cockpit. He is about 30 years old. He is wearing a hat and backpack.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名恐怖分子正试图接近驾驶舱。他约30岁。戴一顶帽子并双肩背包。

cards.audioText: The purser reports there are over ten hijackers onboard. They are threatening to kill passengers if we don’t fly to another destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务长报告机上有超过10名劫机犯。正威胁我们如果不飞往另一个目的地，他们要杀死旅客。

cards.audioText: We will remain on the runway. The hijackers have taken four hostages to the rear of the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们将停留在跑道上。劫机犯已把四名人质带到了客舱后部。

cards.audioText: We are unsure of our position due to navigation failure. If any station can hear me, please respond.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于导航失效，我们不确定位置。如有任何电台能听到我们，请回话。

cards.audioText: We only have standby magnetic compass due instrument failure. Now heading 245. Request navigation assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们因仪表失效只有备用磁罗盘。现在航向245。请求导航援助。

cards.audioText: We are unsure of our position due FMS failure. Last known position five miles north of FUPAD, now heading 165 for weather avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们由于飞行管理计算机失效不能确定位置。最后已知位置FUPAD以北5海里，现在航向165以避开天气。

cards.audioText: A ramp inspection discovered crates of lithium batteries in the cargo hold. We are verifying. Request delay pushback.
cards.audioTextZh: 机坪检查发现货舱有数箱锂电池。我们正在核实。请求延迟推出。

cards.audioText: We had a smoke warning in the cargo hold. We have discharged the fire extinguisher. We are concerned about lithium batteries in that compartment.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的货舱有烟雾警告。我们已释放灭火瓶。我们担心货舱的锂电池。

cards.audioText: Request passenger stairs connect immediately after we stop on the runway. We want to disembark passengers as quickly as possible.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们停在跑道上后请求立即连接客梯车。我们想尽快让旅客离机。

cards.audioText: We nearly collided with that aircraft. We had very little vertical separation. Do you know the flight number of that aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们几乎与那架飞机相撞了。我们几乎没有垂直间隔了。你们知道那架飞机的航班号吗？

cards.audioText: We have about thirty injured persons on board, four are very serious. Can you deliver this message to the medical staff that are standing by?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们机上有三十人受伤。其中四人受伤严重。你能把此信息告知待命的医疗人员吗？

cards.audioText: We are declaring minimum fuel. We will have less than 30 minutes endurance by the time we get to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们宣布最低燃油量。我们到达目的地之后会有少于30分钟续航时间。

cards.audioText: We are declaring fuel emergency. Our endurance is 1 hour 58 minutes. We are 1 hour 30 minutes from the closest alternate airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况。我们的续航时间1小时58分钟。我们离最近备降场时间是1小时30分钟。

cards.audioText: We have been intercepted by a military aircraft. It is rocking its wings to indicate we should follow.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们被一架军用飞机拦截了。它摇动机翼让我们跟着它。

cards.audioText: I’m trying to identify the type and nationality of the military aircraft. So far, no response on 121.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正试着识别军用飞机的机型和国籍。到目前为止，121.5频率没有回应。

cards.audioText: We are heading 085. This heading allows us to quickly exit the prohibited airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们现在航向085。该航向我们可以快速离开禁飞空域。

cards.audioText: If we continue to make orbits we will exceed our duty time limit by the time we land.
cards.audioTextZh: 如我们继续转圈，我们将在落地时超出值勤期限制。

cards.audioText: They have revived the unconscious passenger by CPR procedure. It looks like he’ll be fine. Request to cancel the diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 他们通过心肺复苏程序使失去知觉的旅客恢复了意识。似乎情况不错。申请取消备降。

cards.audioText: Unable speed 180 knots. We need to maintain a good speed in clean configuration due icing.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能保持速度180节。由于积冰，我们需要保持光洁形态和适当的速度。

cards.audioText: Unable to reduce speed below mach decimal 74. You can vector us if you’d like.
cards.audioTextZh: 速度不能调至低于马赫数点74。你可以引导让我们飞航向。

cards.audioText: Unable, an immediate right turn might not give us enough terrain clearance. Our turn radius is 4 miles at this speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能，立即右转的话我们越过地形的裕度可能不够。当前速度的转弯半径是4海里。

cards.audioText: Our aircraft has the required certification and is approved by your Civil Aviation Authority for scheduled flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们飞机有相应的资质，你们民航当局也批准我们可以执行定期航班。

title: 陆空通话
description: 结构 词汇 理解能力

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 432, you are parking at gate 24, you have got information H, ask Shanghai Delivery for ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 432，停在 24 号登机口，已收到 H 情报，向上海放行申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, QFA 432, gate 24, information H, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，QFA 432，24 号登机口，收到 H 情报，申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use Runway 26, HZ-01 departure, initial climb to 600 meters on QNH, after departure, contact 128.75, squawk 3421.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，使用跑道 26，HZ-01 离场，QNH 上初始爬升至 600 米，离场后联系 128.75，应答机 3421。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use Runway 26, HZ-01 departure, initial climb to 600 meters on QNH, after departure, contact 128.75, squawk 3421, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，使用跑道 26，HZ-01 离场，QNH 上初始爬升至 600 米，离场后联系 128.75，应答机 3421，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, read back correct, report when ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，复诵正确，准备好推出和开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, push back and start up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，推出和开车批准。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, taxi via taxiway F, C1 and B to holding point Runway 26. Caution! work in progress at the end of gate 319.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，经 F、C1 和 B 滑行道滑行至跑道 26 等待点。注意！319 号登机口末端有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway F, C1 and B to holding point Runway 26, roger, thanks, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 F、C1 和 B 滑行道滑行至跑道 26 等待点，收到，谢谢，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: As you are taxiing, you noticed some smoke coming from APU on Boeing 747 ahead of you, report this to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到前方 Boeing 747 的 APU 冒烟，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, we notice some smoke coming from APU on B747 ahead of us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，我们注意到前方 B747 的 APU 冒烟。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding point Runway 26, tell ATC you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 26 等待点，告诉 ATC 你准备好起飞。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, QFA 432, holding point Runway 26, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，QFA 432，跑道 26 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, behind landing traffic, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，在落地航空器之后，跟随其后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind landing traffic, line up behind, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在落地航空器之后，跟随其后进跑道，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 5100 meters, contact Beijing Approach and request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正到达 5100 米，联系北京进近并请求继续下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, reaching 5100 meters, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，正到达 5100 米，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，下降并保持 QNH 1031 上 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 QNH 1031 上 3300 米，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3300 米，请求继续下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，保持 3300 米，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, maintain 3300 meters, opposite traffic at 2 o'clock 10 miles, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，保持 3300 米，相对飞行航空器在 2 点钟方向 10 海里，脱离冲突后报告。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3300 meters, wilco, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 3300 米，照办，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller you are clear of traffic and request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已脱离该航空器，并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, clear of traffic, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，已脱离航空器，请求下降。

cards.audioText: B: You are cleared to 1200 meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, you suspect a sandstorm, tell Beijing Approach the situation and ask ATC if there is sandstorm forecast.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已获准下降至 1200 米，天空变暗，能见度变差，你怀疑有沙尘暴，告诉北京进近情况，并询问 ATC 是否有沙尘暴预报。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, descending to 1200 meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, we suspect a sandstorm, is there sandstorm forecast?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，正下降至 1200 米，天空变暗，能见度变差，我们怀疑有沙尘暴，是否有沙尘暴预报？

cards.audioText: B: The sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, inform ATC the situation, ask to climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: B：沙尘暴严重，能见度很差，通知 ATC 情况，请求爬升到更高高度以避开沙尘暴上方。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, the sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, request climb to a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，沙尘暴严重，能见度很差，请求爬升到更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，爬升至 2100 米，右转航向 230。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 2100 米，右转航向 230，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Your aircraft is Boeing 747, suddenly, number 1 number 2 engines have failed due to sandstorm, report it to Beijing Approach, ask if weather is clear in Beijing and request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的飞机是 Boeing 747，突然，1 号和 2 号发动机因沙尘暴失效，向北京进近报告，请问北京天气是否晴朗，并请求雷达引导前往北京优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Approach, QFA 432, No.1 and No.2 engines have failed due to sandstorm, request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing. Is weather in Beijing clear?
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京进近，QFA 432，1 号和 2 号发动机因沙尘暴失效，请求雷达引导前往北京优先着陆。北京天气晴朗吗？

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, turn right heading 250, the weather in Beijing is clear.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，右转航向 250，北京天气晴朗。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right heading 250, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，右转航向 250，QFA 432。

topics.name: QFA 160 燃油续航 导航定位

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 160, a flight from Tokyo to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over WXI, your transponder code is 4525, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 160，从东京飞往广州，保持 11000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机代码 4525，与郑州管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, maintaining 11000 meters, over WXI, squawking 4525.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，保持 11000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 4525。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，郑州管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 10400 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 10400 meters, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 10400 米，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: You wish to know until what time you can expect high level, ask Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你想知道什么时候可以预期高高度，询问郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, until what time we can expect high level?
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们什么时候可以预期高高度？

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, you can expect further climb after passing ZHO, but for now, continue descent to 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed due to temporary airways restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，郑州管制，飞越 ZHO 后可预期继续爬升，但现在继续下降并保持 9200 米，因临时航路限制减至最小速度。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expect further climb after passing ZHO, continue descend and maintain 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞越 ZHO 后预期继续爬升，继续下降并保持 9200 米，减至最小速度，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, orbit right from present position until further advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，从当前位置右盘旋，直到进一步通知。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until further advised, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从当前位置右盘旋，直到进一步通知，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: After several orbits, you have calculated that if you hold any longer, the fuel on board will approach the required minimums, inform Zhengzhou Control about your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：几次盘旋后，你计算出如果继续等待，机上燃油将接近所需最低量，通知郑州管制你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，如果再被延误，我们将达到最低燃油。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, roger, after this orbit, direct to AKOMA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，郑州管制，收到，本次盘旋后，直飞 AKOMA。
cards.referenceText: After this orbit, direct to AKOMA, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 本次盘旋后，直飞 AKOMA，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find you don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou and you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, notify Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你发现燃油不足以飞往广州，决定备降长沙机场，通知郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou, request divert to Changsha Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们没有足够燃油飞往广州，请求备降长沙机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, stand by for your request, temporary restriction is now cancelled, resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，等待你的请求，临时限制现已取消，恢复正常速度，直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复正常速度，直飞 OBLIK，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: You have a navigation system problem, your instrument is showing inaccurate position of your aircraft, notify Zhengzhou Control and ask for radar monitoring.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的导航系统有问题，仪表显示飞机位置不准确，通知郑州管制并请求雷达监控。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we have a navigation system problem, our instrument is showing inaccurate position, request radar monitoring.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们有导航系统问题，仪表显示位置不准确，请求雷达监控。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, roger, you are slightly deviating to the left, turn right 5 degrees, contact Wuhan Control on 134.7, request diversion from Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，收到，你稍微向左偏航，右转 5 度，联系武汉管制134.7，向武汉管制请求备降。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right 5 degrees, 134.7, QFA 160.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 9200 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 4525，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，保持 9200 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 4525。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 160, Wuhan Control, radar contact, I understand you have a navigation problem and fuel shortage, confirm you are diverting to Changsha.
B: Tell Wuhan Control you are performing the checklist and tell Wuhan Control to stand by.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：QFA 160，武汉管制，雷达识别，我了解你有导航问题和燃油不足，确认你正在备降长沙。
B：告诉武汉管制你正在执行检查单，并让武汉管制稍等。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, stand by, we are performing the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，请稍等，我们正在执行检查单。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control you are flying with basic navigation instruments and you want to change your alternate airport to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知武汉管制你正在使用基本导航仪表飞行，并希望将备降机场改为武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, we are flying with basic navigation instruments, request divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，我们正在使用基本导航仪表飞行，请求备降武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, roger, divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 120.45 when reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，收到，备降武汉批准，下降并保持 4800 米，到达时联系武汉进近120.45。
cards.referenceText: Divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, 120.45, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 备降武汉批准，下降并保持 4800 米，120.45，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 4800 meters, you have got information B, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正到达 4800 米，已收到 B 情报，与武汉进近首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 160, reaching 4800 meters, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 160，正到达 4800 米，收到 B 情报。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, information B is current, follow ZF-01A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，武汉进近，雷达识别，B 情报有效，执行 ZF-01A 进场，预期 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-01A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-01A 进场，预期 ILS 进近跑道 36R，QFA 160。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 160, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Inform the controller that you still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance and you are not declaring a fuel emergency.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：QFA 160，你是否宣布燃油紧急？
B：通知管制员你仍有超过 2 小时续航燃油，并且不宣布燃油紧急。
cards.referenceText: Negative, we still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance, QFA 160
cards.referenceTextZh: 否定，我们仍有超过 2 小时续航燃油，QFA 160。

topics.name: QFA 923 乘客，滑行道包裹 液压失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 923, you are near departure time, however 1 passenger is missing while his checked luggage is still on board, for security reasons, contact Company operations to offload the baggage.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 923，接近离场时间，但有 1 名旅客未到而其托运行李仍在机上。出于安全原因，联系公司运行卸下行李。
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, QFA 923, we are near departure time, 1 passenger is missing, but his checked luggage is still on board, request offload the baggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，QFA 923，我们接近离场时间，1 名旅客未到，但他的托运行李仍在机上，请求卸下行李。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at gate 51, you have got information W, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 51 号登机口，已收到 W 情报，请求前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, QFA 923, gate 51, information W, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，QFA 923，51 号登机口，收到 W 情报，申请前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，跑道 36 右，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，跑道 36R，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2515，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, expect 10 minutes delay due taxiway A3 is temporarily blocked by a broken down vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，预计延误 10 分钟，因 A3 滑行道被一辆故障车辆临时阻塞。
cards.referenceText: Roger, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, monitor Ground 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，守听地面 119.35。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, there is a Citation next to you being pushed, once the aircraft is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，你旁边有一架 Citation 正在推出，该机离开后，推出至 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Roger, once Citation is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，Citation 离开后，推出至 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头向东，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: As you are taxiing on taxiway A3, you notice several baggage are scattered on A3, about 400 meters ahead of your aircraft, tell Ground control why you have stopped taxiing and ask ground services to retrieve the baggage.
cards.audioTextZh: B：当你在 A3 滑行道滑行时，注意到数件行李散落在 A3，约在飞机前方 400 米处。告诉地面管制你为何停止滑行，并请求地面服务取回行李。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, we notice several baggage are scattered on A3, about 400 meters ahead, we have stopped taxiing, request ground services to retrieve/remove the baggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，我们注意到数件行李散落在 A3，约前方 400 米，我们已停止滑行，请求地面服务取回/移除行李。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, hold position, we have notified the ground handling department.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，保持位置，我们已通知地面保障部门。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, roger, thanks, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持位置，收到，谢谢，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, taxiway A3 is clear, expedite taxi via taxiway A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，A3 滑行道已畅通，经 A3 和 A 滑行道加速滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expedite taxi via taxiway A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，经 A3 和 A 滑行道加速滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, contact Wuhan Departure and request further climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，离开 1200 米爬升至 2400 米，联系武汉离场并请求继续爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, QFA 923, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，QFA 923，离开 1200 米爬升至 2400 米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, expedite climb to 6000 meters due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，武汉离场，雷达识别，因穿越航空器，加速爬升至 6000 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expedite climb to 6000 meters, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，加速爬升至 6000 米，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: During climbing, 1 of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an Urgency call and ask to level off at 4500 meters and then return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，你的 1 套液压系统失效，发出紧急呼叫，请求在 4500 米改平，然后返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, QFA 923, 1 of our hydraulic systems has failed, request level off at 4500 meters and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，QFA 923，我们 1 套液压系统失效，请求在 4500 米改平并返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, track direct to LKO, expect LKO-02A arrival, ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，爬升并保持 4500 米，左转，直飞 LKO，预期 LKO-02A 进场，ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, track direct to LKO, expect LKO-02A arrival, ILS approach Runway 36R, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 4500 米，左转，直飞 LKO，预期 LKO-02A 进场，ILS 进近跑道 36R，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，下降至 QNH 1012 上 2700 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 QNH 1012 上 2700 米，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，联系武汉塔台124.35。

cards.audioText: B: The purser informs you that a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, ask for an ambulance to wait at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务长通知你有一名旅客生病，可能过度换气，请求救护车在登机口等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 923, a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, request an ambulance to wait at the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 923，有一名旅客生病，可能过度换气，请求救护车在登机口等待。

topics.name: QFA 358 天气 气象雷达失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 358, from Singapore to Wuhan. You are maintaining 10100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 358，从新加坡飞往武汉。你在 DAPRO 上空保持 10100 米，应答机 3625，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, maintaining 10100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，在 DAPRO 上空保持 10100 米，应答机 3625。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend to and maintain 6300 meters at your discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，武汉管制，雷达识别，可自行决定时机下降并保持 6300 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6300 meters at our discretion, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自行决定时机下降并保持 6300 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达显示 LKO 西南有大范围 CB，请求右转航向 050 以避开天气。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, our weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，我们的气象雷达显示 LKO 西南有大范围 CB，请求右转航向 050 以避开天气。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 358, negative heading 050 due to the restricted area.
B: Tell Wuhan Control you want to fly heading 030 for at least 5 minutes before you can resume course.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：QFA 358，因限制区，否决航向 050。
B：告诉武汉管制你想飞航向 030 至少 5 分钟，然后才能恢复航路。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request heading 030 for at least 5 minutes before resume course, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求航向 030 至少 5 分钟，然后恢复航路，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, roger, heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，收到，航向 030 批准，脱离天气后，直飞 LKO。
cards.referenceText: Heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to LKO, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航向 030 批准，脱离天气后，直飞 LKO，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, descend to 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，下降至 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5100 meters, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 5100 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: You are maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, ATIS B received, now contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你保持 5100 米，飞越 LKO，已收到 ATIS B，现在联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，保持 5100 米，飞越 LKO，收到 B 情报。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, Wuhan Approach, LKO-2A arrival, descend to and maintain 1200 meters, be advised current information C, you are number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，武汉进近，LKO-2A 进场，下降并保持 1200 米，请注意当前情报 C，你是第一架。
cards.referenceText: LKO-2A arrival, descend to and maintain 1200 meters, information C, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: LKO-2A 进场，下降并保持 1200 米，收到 C 情报，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar has failed during descent, contact Wuhan Approach to request weather information along your route.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中你的气象雷达失效，联系武汉进近，请求航路沿线天气信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, our weather radar has failed during descent, request weather information along our route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，我们的气象雷达在下降过程中失效，请求航路沿线天气信息。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, roger, our weather radar shows cumulonimbus in the vicinity of DA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，收到，我们的气象雷达显示 DA 附近有积雨云。
cards.referenceText: Roger, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: Request Wuhan Approach for radar assistance to intercept final cause of Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: B：请求武汉进近提供雷达协助，以截获跑道 36 左的最后进近航道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, request radar vectors to intercept final course of Runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，请求雷达引导截获跑道 36L 最后进近航道。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，右转航向 090，下降并保持 900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，下降并保持 900 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 meters, cleared to intercept the localizer Runway 36L, contact Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，左转航向 030，下降并保持 600 米，许可截获跑道 36 左航向道，联系塔台 124.35。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 metres, cleared to intercept the localizer Runway 36L, 124.35, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 030，下降并保持 600 米，许可截获跑道 36L 航向道，124.35，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: You encountered the downdrafts on short final and executed a missed approach, informed Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在短五边遭遇下沉气流并执行复飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 358, we encountered the downdrafts on short final, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 358，我们在短五边遭遇下沉气流，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, roger, when able turn right heading 090, climb to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，收到，可以时右转航向 090，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉进近119.7。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, climb to 1500 meters, 119.7, QFA 358.

topics.name: QFA 701 前轮转向失效 PAPI灯暗

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 701, flying from Sydney to Wuhan, you are cruising at 10700 meters and squawking 3211, you are now entering Wuhan Control area, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 701，从悉尼飞往武汉，巡航高度 10700 米，应答机 3211，现在进入武汉管制区，与武汉管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, cruising at 10700 meters, squawking 3211.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，巡航高度 10700 米，应答机 3211。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, radar contact, maintain 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，雷达识别，保持 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 10700 meters, QFA 701.

cards.audioText: B: There is a thunderstorm buildup near LKO, asked how the preceding aircraft avoided the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：LKO 附近有雷暴发展，询问前机如何避开天气。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, there is a thunderstorm buildup near LKO, how did the preceding aircraft avoid the weather?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，LKO 附近有雷暴发展，前机如何避开天气？

cards.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Control you want to deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉武汉管制你想向东偏航 20 海里以避开天气。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，请求向东偏航 20 海里以避开天气。

cards.audioText: B: You are approaching the top of decent point but there are CBs at lower level, ask Wuhan Control to delay your descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正接近下降顶点，但低高度有 CB，请求武汉管制延迟下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request delay descent due CBs at lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因低高度有 CB，请求延迟下降。

cards.audioText: B: There are thunderstorms sources the south of the airport, arrival through LKO is difficult, ask Wuhan Control for an approach from the North and use ZF arrivals.
cards.audioTextZh: B：机场南侧有雷暴，难以经 LKO 进场，请求武汉管制从北侧进近并使用 ZF 进场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request approach from the north and ZF arrival due thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因雷暴，请求从北侧进近并使用 ZF 进场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, turn right heading 020, expect ZF-02 arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，右转航向 020，预期 ZF-02 进场。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 020, expect ZF-02 arrival, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 020，预期 ZF-02 进场，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: There is a small cumulonimbus in front of you, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你前方有一小块积雨云，请求向右机动，范围 2 海里内。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles due a small CB.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因一小块 CB，请求向右机动，范围 2 海里内。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your nose wheel steering failed, informed Wuhan Approach of the situation and tell him that you will stop on the runway after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，你的前轮转弯失效，通知武汉进近情况，并告诉他你将在落地后停在跑道上。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 701, our nose wheel steering failed, we will stop on the runway after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 701，我们的前轮转弯失效，落地后将停在跑道上。

cards.audioText: B: You are told to use the Runway 22 VOR DME approach, but the weather is deteriorating, ask Wuhan Tower for an ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你被告知使用跑道 22 VOR DME 进近，但天气正在变差，向武汉塔台请求跑道 18 左 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, request ILS approach Runway 18L due deteriorating weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，因天气变差，请求跑道 18L ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, ILS approach Runway 18L is approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，跑道 18 左 ILS 进近批准。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach Runway 18L, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可跑道 18L ILS 进近，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: The approach lights are not bright enough, asked Tower to increase the brightness of the approach lights.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近灯不够亮，请塔台提高进近灯亮度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, the approach lights are not bright enough, request brighten up the approach lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，进近灯不够亮，请求调亮进近灯。

cards.audioText: B: You executed missed approach because of poor visibility, inform Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你因能见度差执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, going around due poor visibility.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，因能见度差，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，收到，执行标准复飞程序。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: The visibility has improved, expect radar vectors for another approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：能见度已改善，预期雷达引导再次进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 701, the visibility has improved, expect radar vectors for another approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 701，能见度已改善，预期雷达引导再次进近。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach Runway 18L.
