cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，右转航向 090，许可跑道 18 左 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach Runway 18L, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，许可跑道 18L ILS 进近，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: You have landed at Wuhan Airport, but the tow truck is not in position, ask for a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已在武汉机场着陆，但拖车未就位，请求牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 701, the tow truck is not in position, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 701，拖车未就位，请求牵引车。

topics.name: QFA 923 液压问题 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 923, you are near departure time, however 1 passenger is missing while his checked luggage is still on board, for security reasons, contact Company operations to offload the baggage.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 923，接近离场时间，但有 1 名旅客未到而其托运行李仍在机上。出于安全原因，联系公司运行卸下行李。
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, QFA 923, we are near departure time, 1 passenger is missing, but his checked luggage is still on board, request offload the baggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，QFA 923，我们接近离场时间，1 名旅客未到，但他的托运行李仍在机上，请求卸下行李。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at gate 51, you have got information W, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 51 号登机口，已收到 W 情报，请求前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, QFA 923, gate 51, information W, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，QFA 923，51 号登机口，收到 W 情报，申请前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: QFA 923, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 923，许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2515。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 2515，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, expect 10 minutes delay due taxiway A3 is temporarily blocked by a broken down vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，预计延误 10 分钟，因 A3 滑行道被一辆故障车辆临时阻塞。
cards.referenceText: Roger, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, monitor Ground 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，守听地面 119.35。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, there is a Citation next to you being pushed, once the aircraft is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，你旁边有一架 Citation 正在推出，该机离开后，推出至 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Roger, once Citation is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，Citation 离开后，推出至 Z4，正对 213 号登机口，机头向东，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: QFA 923, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 923，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four, A tree and A to holding point Runway 36R, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: as you are taxiing on taxiway A3, you noticed several baggage are scattered on A3 about 400m ahead of your aircraft, tell Ground control why you have stopped taxiing and ask ground services/staff to retrieve the baggage.
cards.audioTextZh: 当你在 A3 滑行道上滑行时，注意到你前方约 400m 的 A3 上散落着数件行李，告诉地面管制你停止滑行的原因，并请求地面服务人员收走行李。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 923, we found several baggage (scattered) on A tree, 400 meters ahead, we have stopped taxiing, request ground services to retrieve the baggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 923，我们发现 A3 上散落着数件行李，位于前方 400 米，我们已停止滑行，请求地面服务人员收走行李。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, hold position, we have notified the ground handling department.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，保持位置，我们已通知地面保障部门。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, roger, thanks, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持位置，收到，谢谢，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: QFA 923, taxiway A3 is clear, expedite taxi via taxiway A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 923，A3 滑行道已清空，经 A3 和 A 滑行道加速滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: roger, expedite taxi via taxiway A tree and A to holding point Runway 36R, QFA 923
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，经 A3 和 A 滑行道加速滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, contact Wuhan Departure and request further climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，离开 1200 米爬升至 2400 米，联系武汉离场并请求继续爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, QFA 923, leaving 1200 meters for 2400 meters, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，QFA 923，离开 1200 米爬升至 2400 米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, expedite climb to 6000 meters due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，武汉离场，雷达识别，因穿越航空器，加速爬升至 6000 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expedite climb to 6000 meters, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，加速爬升至 6000 米，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: B: During climbing, 1 of your hydraulic systems has failed, make an Urgency call and ask to level off at 4500 meters and then return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，你的 1 套液压系统失效，发出紧急呼叫，请求在 4500 米改平，然后返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, QFA 923, 1 of our hydraulic systems has failed, request level off at 4500 meters and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，QFA 923，我们 1 套液压系统失效，请求在 4500 米改平并返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: QFA 923, roger PAN, climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, track direct to LKO, expect LKO02A, ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 923，收到 PAN，爬升并保持 4500 米，左转直飞 LKO，预计执行 LKO-02A 进场，ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: climb and maintain 4500 meters, turn left, direct to LKO, expect LKO02 A Arrival, ILS approach Runway 36R, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 4500 米，左转直飞 LKO，预计执行 LKO-02A 进场，ILS 进近 Runway 36R，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，下降至 QNH 1012 上 2700 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1012, QFA 923.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 QNH 1012 上 2700 米，QFA 923。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 923, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 923，联系武汉塔台124.35。

cards.audioText: B: The purser informs you that a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, ask for an ambulance to wait at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务长通知你有一名旅客生病，可能过度换气，请求救护车在登机口等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 923, a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, request an ambulance to wait at the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 923，有一名旅客生病，可能过度换气，请求救护车在登机口等待。

topics.name: QFA 701 起落架问题 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is QFA 701, from Sydney to Wuhan, cruising at 10,700 meters, squawking 3211, you are entering Wuhan Control area, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 QFA 701，从悉尼飞往武汉，正以 10,700 米巡航，应答机 3211，正在进入武汉管制区，首次联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, 1700 meters, squawking 3211.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，正保持 1,700 米，应答机 3211。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, Wuhan Control, radar contact, maintain 10,700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，武汉管制，雷达识别，保持 10,700 米。
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 10,700 meters, QFA 701.

cards.audioText: B: There is a thunderstorm buildup near LKO, asked how the preceding aircraft avoided the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：LKO 附近有雷暴发展，询问前机如何避开天气。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, there is a thunderstorm buildup near LKO, how did the preceding aircraft avoid the weather?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，LKO 附近有雷暴发展，前机如何避开天气？

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 701, the preceding aircraft just deviate 5 miles to the east, what's your intention?
B: tell Wuhan Control you want to deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： QFA 701，前机刚刚向东偏航 5 英里，你的意图是什么？
B： 告诉武汉管制，为避开天气，你希望向东偏航 20 英里。
cards.referenceText: request deviate 20 miles to the east, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求向东偏航 20 英里，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: You are approaching the top of decent point but there are CBs at lower level, ask Wuhan Control to delay your descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正接近下降顶点，但低高度有 CB，请求武汉管制延迟下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request delay descent due CBs at lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因低高度有 CB，请求延迟下降。

cards.audioText: B: There are thunderstorms sources the south of the airport, arrival through LKO is difficult, ask Wuhan Control for an approach from the North and use ZF arrivals.
cards.audioTextZh: B：机场南侧有雷暴，难以经 LKO 进场，请求武汉管制从北侧进近并使用 ZF 进场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request approach from the north and ZF arrival due thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因雷暴，请求从北侧进近并使用 ZF 进场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, turn right heading 020, expect ZF-02 arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，右转航向 020，预期 ZF-02 进场。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 020, expect ZF-02 arrival, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 020，预期 ZF-02 进场，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: Now there is a small cumulonimbus in front of you, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你前方有一小块积雨云，请求在右侧 2 英里范围内机动。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 701, request maneuver two miles to the right due a small CB.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 701，因一小块 CB，请求向右机动 2 英里。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your nose wheel steering failed, informed Wuhan Approach of the situation and tell him that you will stop on the runway after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，你的前轮转弯失效，通知武汉进近情况，并告诉他你将在落地后停在跑道上。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 701, our nose wheel steering failed, we will stop on the runway after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 701，我们的前轮转弯失效，落地后将停在跑道上。

cards.audioText: You are told to use Runway 22VOR/DME approach, but the weather is deteriorating, ask Wuhan Tower for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 你被告知使用 Runway 22 VOR/DME 进近，但天气正在恶化，向武汉塔台请求 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, request ILS approach Runway 18L, deteriorating weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，因天气恶化，请求 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, ILS approach Runway 18L is approved.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，批准 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: cleared ILS approach Runway 18L, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: The approach lights are not bright enough, asked Tower to increase the brightness of the approach lights.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近灯不够亮，请塔台提高进近灯亮度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, the approach lights are not bright enough, request brighten up the approach lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，进近灯不够亮，请求调亮进近灯。

cards.audioText: B: You executed missed approach because of poor visibility, inform Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你因能见度差执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 701, going around due poor visibility.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 701，因能见度差，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 701, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 701，收到，执行标准复飞程序。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, the visibility has improved now, expect radar vectors for another approach.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，现在能见度已经改善，预计雷达引导再次进近。
cards.referenceText: roger, expect radar vectors for another approach, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计雷达引导再次进近，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: QFA 701, turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 701，右转航向 090，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS approach Runway 18L, QFA 701.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，QFA 701。

cards.audioText: B: You have landed at Wuhan Airport, but the tow truck is not in position, ask for a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已在武汉机场着陆，但拖车未就位，请求牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA 701, the tow truck is not in position, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，QFA 701，拖车未就位，请求牵引车。

topics.name: QFA 160 机翼/控制面损坏 燃油紧急 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is QFA 160, a flight from Tokyo to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 11,000 meters, over WXI, your transponder code is 4525, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 QFA 160，这是一趟从东京飞往广州的航班，正保持 11,000 米飞越 WXI，应答机代码 4525，首次联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, maintaining 2000 meters, over WXI, squawking 4525.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，正保持 2,000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 4525。

cards.audioText: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 160，郑州管制，雷达识别，下降至并保持 10,400 米。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 10,400 meters, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至并保持 10,400 米，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: You wish to know until what time you can expect high level, ask Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你想知道什么时候可以预期高高度，询问郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, until what time we can expect high level?
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们什么时候可以预期高高度？

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, you can expect further climb after passing ZHO, but for now, continue descent to 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed due to temporary airways restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，郑州管制，飞越 ZHO 后可预期继续爬升，但现在继续下降并保持 9200 米，因临时航路限制减至最小速度。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expect further climb after passing ZHO, continue descend and maintain 9200 meters, reduced to minimum speed, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞越 ZHO 后预期继续爬升，继续下降并保持 9200 米，减至最小速度，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, orbit right from present position until further advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，从当前位置右盘旋，直到进一步通知。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until further advised, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从当前位置右盘旋，直到进一步通知，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: After several orbits, you have calculated that if you hold any longer, the fuel on board will approach the required minimums, inform Zhengzhou Control about your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：几次盘旋后，你计算出如果继续等待，机上燃油将接近所需最低量，通知郑州管制你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，如果再被延误，我们将达到最低燃油。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, Zhengzhou Control, roger, after this orbit, direct to AKOMA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，郑州管制，收到，本次盘旋后，直飞 AKOMA。
cards.referenceText: After this orbit, direct to AKOMA, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 本次盘旋后，直飞 AKOMA，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find you don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou and you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, notify Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你发现燃油不足以飞往广州，决定备降长沙机场，通知郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we don't have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou, request divert to Changsha Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们没有足够燃油飞往广州，请求备降长沙机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, stand by for your request, temporary restriction is now cancelled, resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，等待你的请求，临时限制现已取消，恢复正常速度，直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Resume normal speed, direct to OBLIK, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复正常速度，直飞 OBLIK，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: you have a navigation system problem, your instrument is showing inaccurate position of your aircraft, notify Zhengzhou Control ad ask for radar monitoring.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的导航系统出现问题，仪表显示的航空器位置不准确，通知郑州管制并请求雷达监控。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA 160, we have navigation system problem, our aircraft position might be inaccurate, request radar monitoring.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，QFA 160，我们的导航系统出现问题，航空器位置可能不准确，请求雷达监控。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, roger, you are slightly deviating to the left, turn right 5 degrees, contact Wuhan Control on 134.7, request diversion from Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，收到，你稍微向左偏航，右转 5 度，联系武汉管制134.7，向武汉管制请求备降。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right 5 degrees, 134.7, QFA 160.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 9200 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 4525，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 4525.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，保持 9200 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 4525。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 160, Wuhan Control, radar contact, I understand you have a navigation problem and fuel shortage, confirm you are diverting to Changsha.
B: Tell Wuhan Control you are performing the checklist and tell Wuhan Control to stand by.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：QFA 160，武汉管制，雷达识别，我了解你有导航问题和燃油不足，确认你正在备降长沙。
B：告诉武汉管制你正在执行检查单，并让武汉管制稍等。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, stand by, we are performing the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，请稍等，我们正在执行检查单。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control you are flying with basic navigation instruments and you want to change your alternate airport to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知武汉管制你正在使用基本导航仪表飞行，并希望将备降机场改为武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 160, we are flying with basic navigation instruments, request divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 160，我们正在使用基本导航仪表飞行，请求备降武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 160, roger, divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 120.45 when reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 160，收到，备降武汉批准，下降并保持 4800 米，到达时联系武汉进近120.45。
cards.referenceText: Divert to Wuhan approved, descend and maintain 4800 meters, 120.45, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 备降武汉批准，下降并保持 4800 米，120.45，QFA 160。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 4800 meters, you have got information B, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正到达 4800 米，已收到 B 情报，与武汉进近首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 160, reaching 4800 meters, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 160，正到达 4800 米，收到 B 情报。

cards.audioText: QFA 160, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, information B is current, follow ZF-01A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 160，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前情报为 B，执行 ZF-01A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: follow Z Foxtrot0 01A Arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, QFA 160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-001A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，QFA 160。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 160, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Inform the controller that you still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance and you are not declaring a fuel emergency.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：QFA 160，你是否宣布燃油紧急？
B：通知管制员你仍有超过 2 小时续航燃油，并且不宣布燃油紧急。
cards.referenceText: Negative, we still have more than 2 hours fuel endurance, QFA 160
cards.referenceTextZh: 否定，我们仍有超过 2 小时续航燃油，QFA 160。

topics.name: QFA 358 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 复飞

cards.audioText: Your call sign is QFA 358, from SIA to Wuhan. You are maintaining 10,100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625, contact Wuhan control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 QFA 358，从 SIA 飞往武汉。你正保持 10,100 米飞越 DAPRO，应答机 3625，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, maintaining 1100 meters over DAPRO, squawking 3625.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，正保持 1,100 米飞越 DAPRO，应答机 3625。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend to and maintain 6300 meters at your discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，武汉管制，雷达识别，可自行决定时机下降并保持 6300 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6300 meters at our discretion, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自行决定时机下降并保持 6300 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达显示 LKO 西南有大范围 CB，请求右转航向 050 以避开天气。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, our weather radar indicates a large group of CBs, southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 to avoid the weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，我们的气象雷达显示 LKO 西南有大范围 CB，请求右转航向 050 以避开天气。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA 358, Negative heading 050 due to restricted area.
B: Tell Wuhan control you want to fly heading 030 for at least 5 minutes before you can resume course.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： QFA 358，因限制区，不能使用航向 050。
B： 告诉武汉管制，你希望保持航向 030 至少 5 分钟，然后才能恢复航路。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA 358, request heading 030 for at least five minutes
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，QFA 358，请求保持航向 030 至少 5 分钟。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, roger, heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，收到，批准航向 030，脱离天气后直飞 LKO。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 030 is approved, when clear of weather, track direct to LKO, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准右转航向 030，脱离天气后直飞 LKO，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, descend to 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，下降至 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5100 meters, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 5100 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: You are maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, ATIS B received, now contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你保持 5100 米，飞越 LKO，已收到 ATIS B，现在联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，保持 5100 米，飞越 LKO，收到 B 情报。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, Wuhan approach, LKO-2A arrival, descent to and maintain 1,200 meters, information C is now current, you are number l.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，武汉进近，执行 LKO-2A 进场，下降至并保持 1,200 米，当前情报为 C，你是第一架落地航空器。
cards.referenceText: LKO two A arrival, descend to and maintain 1200 meters, information C, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 LKO-2A 进场，下降至并保持 1,200 米，C 情报，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar has failed during descent, contact Wuhan Approach to request weather information along your route.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中你的气象雷达失效，联系武汉进近，请求航路沿线天气信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, our weather radar has failed during descent, request weather information along our route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，我们的气象雷达在下降过程中失效，请求航路沿线天气信息。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, roger, our weather radar shows cumulonimbus in the vicinity of DA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，收到，我们的气象雷达显示 DA 附近有积雨云。
cards.referenceText: Roger, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: Request Wuhan approach for radar assistance to intercept final course of Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 向武汉进近请求雷达引导，以切入 Runway 36L 最后进近航道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA 358, request radar vectors to intercept final course Runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA 358，请求雷达引导切入 Runway 36L 最后进近航道。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 358, turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 358，右转航向 090，下降并保持 900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, descend to and maintain 900 meters, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，下降并保持 900 米，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 meters, cleared to intercept the localizer RWY 36 Left, contact tower124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，左转航向 030，下降至并保持 600 米，许可切入 Runway 36L 航向道，联系塔台 124.35。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 030, descend to and maintain 600 meters, cleared to intercept the localizer Runway 36L, 124.35, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 030，下降至并保持 600 米，许可切入 Runway 36L 航向道，124.35，QFA 358。

cards.audioText: B: You encountered the downdrafts on short final and executed a missed approach, informed Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在短五边遭遇下沉气流并执行复飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA 358, we encountered the downdrafts on short final, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，QFA 358，我们在短五边遭遇下沉气流，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: QFA 358, roger, when able, Turn right heading 090, climb to 1,500 meters, contact Wuhan approach 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 358，收到，可以时右转航向 090，爬升至 1,500 米，联系武汉进近 119.7。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, climb to 1,500 meters, contact Wuhan approach 119.7, QFA 358.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 090，爬升至 1,500 米，联系武汉进近 119.7，QFA 358。

topics.name: QFA 432 积冰/防冰 烟雾 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 432, you are parking at gate 24, you have got information H, ask Shanghai Delivery for ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 QFA 432，停在 24 号登机口，已收到 H 情报，向上海放行申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, QFA 432, gate 24, information H, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，QFA 432，24 号登机口，收到 H 情报，申请前往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: QFA 432, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use Runway 26, HZ01D, initial climb to 600 meters on QNH, after departure contact 128.75, squawk 3421.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 432，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，当前使用 Runway 26，执行 HZ-01D，按 QNH 初始爬升至 600 米，离场后联系 128.75，应答机 3421。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use Runway 26, HZ-01 departure, initial climb to 600 meters on QNH, 128.75, squawk 3421, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，当前使用 Runway 26，执行 HZ-01 离场，按 QNH 初始爬升至 600 米，128.75，应答机 3421，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, read back correct, report when ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，复诵正确，准备好推出和开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, push back and start up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，推出和开车批准。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: QFA 432, taxi via taxiway F, C1 and B to holding point Runway 26, caution, work in progress at the end of gate 319.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 432，经 F、C1 和 B 滑行道滑行至 Runway 26 等待点，注意 319 登机口末端正在施工。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway F, C one and B to holding point Runway 26, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 F、C1 和 B 滑行道滑行至 Runway 26 等待点，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: As you are taxiing, you noticed some smoke coming from APU on Boeing 747 ahead of you, report this to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到前方 Boeing 747 的 APU 冒烟，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA 432, we notice some smoke coming from APU on B747 ahead of us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，QFA 432，我们注意到前方 B747 的 APU 冒烟。

cards.audioText: Now you are at holding point Runway 26, tell ATC you are ready to take off.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 26 等待点，告诉空中交通管制你已准备好起飞。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, QFA 432, holding point Runway 26, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，QFA 432，Runway 26 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, behind landing traffic, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，在落地航空器之后，跟随其后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind landing traffic, line up behind, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在落地航空器之后，跟随其后进跑道，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 5100 meters, contact Beijing Approach and request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正到达 5100 米，联系北京进近并请求继续下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, reaching 5100 meters, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，正到达 5100 米，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，下降并保持 QNH 1031 上 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1031, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 QNH 1031 上 3300 米，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3300 米，请求继续下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, maintaining 3300 meters, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，保持 3300 米，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: QFA 432, maintain 3,300 meters, opposite traffic at 2 o'clock 10 miles, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA 432，保持 3,300 米，反向航空器位于你 2 点钟方向、距离 10 英里，脱离相关航空器后报告。
cards.referenceText: maintaining 3,300 meters, QFA 432.

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller you are clear of traffic and request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已脱离该航空器，并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, clear of traffic, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，已脱离航空器，请求下降。

cards.audioText: you are cleared to 1,200 meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, you suspect a sandstorm, tell Beijing Approach this situation and ask ATC if there is sandstorm forecast.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已获准下降至 1,200 米，天空正在变暗，能见度正在恶化，你怀疑出现沙尘暴，向北京进近报告这一情况，并询问空中交通管制是否有沙尘暴预报。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, descend to 1,200 meters, the sky is turning dark, the visibility is deteriorating, we suspect a sandstorm, is there sandstorm forecast?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，下降至 1,200 米，天空正在变暗，能见度正在恶化，我们怀疑出现沙尘暴，是否有沙尘暴预报？

cards.audioText: B: The sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, inform ATC the situation, ask to climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: B：沙尘暴严重，能见度很差，通知 ATC 情况，请求爬升到更高高度以避开沙尘暴上方。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, the sandstorm is severe and the visibility is very poor, request climb to a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，沙尘暴严重，能见度很差，请求爬升到更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，爬升至 2100 米，右转航向 230。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2100 meters, turn right heading 230, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 2100 米，右转航向 230，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: your aircraft is B747, Suddenly No. 1, No 2 engines have failed due to sandstorm, report it to Beijing Approach, ask if weather is clear in Beijing and request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的航空器为 B747。突然，1 号和 2 号发动机因沙尘暴失效。向北京进近报告，询问北京天气是否晴朗，并请求雷达引导至北京优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA 432, Boeing 747, No. one and No. two engines have failed due to sand storm, request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing. Is weather in Beijing clear?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，QFA 432，Boeing 747，1 号和 2 号发动机因沙尘暴失效，请求雷达引导至北京优先着陆。北京天气是否晴朗？

cards.audioText: C: QFA 432, turn right heading 250, the weather in Beijing is clear.
cards.audioTextZh: C：QFA 432，右转航向 250，北京天气晴朗。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right heading 250, QFA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，右转航向 250，QFA 432。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is QFA953. You are close to departure time. However, one passenger is missing while his checked luggage is still onboard. For security reasons, contact company operations to offload the baggage.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是澳航953，快到离场时间了；然而一名乘客未登机，他的行李还在机上。安全起见，联系公司运行部门卸下他的行李。】
cards.referenceText: Operations, QFA953, we are close to our departure time. One passenger is still missing; Request offload his checked luggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 运控，澳航953，我们快到起飞时间了。一名乘客仍未登机，请求卸下他的托运行李。

cards.audioText: [Now you are at Gate 51, ATIS W, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在51号机位，通播W，请求ATC放行至洛杉矶。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, QFA953, Gate 51, information W, destination Los Angeles, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，澳航953，51号机位，通播W，目的地洛杉矶，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: QFA953, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9800m, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往洛杉矶，跑道36右，LKO-01离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度9800米，离场频率119.7，应答机2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Los Angeles, flight planned route, LKO-01 departure runway 36R, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9800m, departure 119.7, squawk 2515, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往洛杉矶，跑道36右，LKO-01离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度9800米，离场频率119.7，应答机2515，澳航953。

cards.audioText: QFA953, expect 10min delay due taxiway A3 is temporally blocked by a broken down vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，滑行道A3被一辆抛瞄的车辆堵住，预计延误10分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, 10min delay, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，10分钟延误，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [The time is up for delay, call controller you can pushback and start-up.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【延误时间快结束了，呼叫管制员你可以推出开车了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA953, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，澳航953，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: QFA953, Wuhan Ground, the B737 right hand side is pushing. After traffic is clear, pushback onto taxiway Z4, abeam Gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，武汉地面，你右侧的波音737正在推出。活动清除后，推出到滑行道Z4，正切213号机位，头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Roger, after the B737 cleared, pushback onto taxiway Z4, abeam Gate 213, facing east, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，波音737起飞后，推出至滑行道Z4，正切213号机位，头朝东，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [As you are taxiing on taxiway A3, you noticed several baggage are scattered on A3 about 400 meters ahead of your aircraft. Tell Ground Control why you have stopped taxiing and ask ground staff to retrieve the baggage.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在滑行道A3上滑行时，你发现机身前方400米处散落着几件行李。告诉地面管制你为什么停止滑行，要求地面工作人员收走行李。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA953, we found several baggage scattered on A3. We stop taxi and holding present position, request ground service to retrieve the baggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，澳航953，我们发现滑行道A3上散落着几件行李。我们停止滑行，原地等待，请求地面工作人员收走行李。

cards.audioText: QFA953, hold your position, I will advise Ground Operations.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，原地等待，我会通知地面运行部门。
cards.referenceText: Holding, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，澳航953。

cards.audioText: QFA953, Ground, taxiway A3 cleared, expedite taxi via A3 and A to holding point runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，地面，滑行道A3清理完成，快速沿滑行道A3，A滑至跑道36右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expediting taxi via A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，快速沿滑行道A3，A滑至跑道36右等待点，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [You are now airborne, passing 1200m for 2400m. Contact Wuhan Departure and ask for further climb.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经起飞，通过1200米，上升2400米。联系武汉离场，请求爬升更高高度。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, QFA953, passing 1200m for 2400m, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，澳航953，通过1200米，上升2400米，请求爬升高高度。

cards.audioText: QFA953, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, expedite climb and maintain 6000m on standard due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，武汉离场，雷达已识别，由于交叉活动，快速上升保持标压6000米。
cards.referenceText: Expediting climb and maintain 6000m on standard, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 快速上升保持标压6000米，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [During climbing, one of your hydraulic systems failed, make an urgency call and ask to level off at 4500m and then return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【爬升过程中，机上一个液压系统失效，做紧急呼叫，请求在4500米平飞，之后返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, QFA953 one hydraulic system failure, request level off at 4500m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉离场，澳航953，机上一个液压系统失效，请求在4500米平飞，之后返回武汉机场

cards.audioText: QFA953, roger PANPAN, climb and maintain 4500m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，收到PANPAN，上升保持4500米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 4500m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R. QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持4500米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，盲降进近跑道36右，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [The purser informs you that a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, ask for an ambulance to wait at the gate.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【乘务长通知你有一名乘客生病了，可能是换气过度，请求到达机位时提供救护车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, QFA953, request an ambulance, we have a passenger possibly suffering from hyperventilation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，澳航953，请求提供救护车，机上有一名乘客好像换气过度。

cards.audioText: QFA953, roger. Radar vector ILS runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，收到。雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Radar vector ILS runway 36R, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is QFA378, from Singapore to Wuhan. You are maintaining 10100m estimate fly DAPRO time 45, next ZF at 56, squawk 3625, contact Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是澳航378，从新加坡飞往武汉。10100米保持，预计到达DAPRO时间45分，到达ZF时间56分，应答机3625，联系武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA378, ETA DAPRO 45, maintaining 10100m, next ZF 56, squawk 3625.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航378，预计到达DAPRO时间45分，10100米保持，到达ZF时间56分，应答机3625。

cards.audioText: QFA378, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 6300m at own discretion.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，武汉区调，雷达已识别，自主下降保持6300米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 6300m at own discretion., QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自主下降保持6300米，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [Your weather radar indicates a large groups of CBs southwest of LKO, request turn right heading 050 avoid the weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【机上天气雷达显示LKO西南方向有一大片积雨云，请求右转航向050躲避。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA378, request turn right heading 050 due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航378，由于天气原因，请求右转航行050。

cards.audioText: QFA378, Negative heading 050 due restricted area.[Tell Wuhan Control you want to fly heading 030 for at least 5 min before you can resume course.]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，由于限制区，不同意航向050。【告诉武汉区调，恢复航道，你想沿航向030飞至少5分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Request heading 030 for at least 5 min, then turn back to course, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求沿航向030飞至少5分钟，之后返回航路，澳航378。

cards.audioText: QFA378, turn right heading 030 approved, when clear of weather, turn left direct to LKO.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，同意右转航向030，天气好转后，左转直飞LKO。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right Heading 030, after clear of weather, direct to LKO, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向030，天气好转后，直飞LKO，快达378。

cards.audioText: QFA378, descend and maintain 5100m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，下降保持5100米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 5100m, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持5100米，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [You are maintaining 5100m over LKO, ATIS B is received, now contact Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机飞过LKO，5100米保持，收到通播B，现在联系武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, over LKO, maintaining 5100m, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，飞过LKO，5100米保持，通播B。

cards.audioText: QFA378, Wuhan Approach, cleared to LKO-2A arrival, descend and maintain 1200m on QNH1012, information C valid, you are No. 1.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 快达378，武汉进近，可以LKO-2A进场，下降保持修正海压1200米，修正海压1012，通播C有效，你第一个。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: LKO-2A arrival, descend and maintain 1200m on QNH1012, information C, No.1. QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: LKO-2A进近，下降保持修正海压1200米，修正海压1012，通播C有效，你第一个，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [Your weather radar had failed during descent, contact Wuhan Approach to request weather information along your route.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【下降时，机上天气雷达失效，联系武汉进近，请求提供航线途中天气信息。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, our weather radar failed. Request weather information along route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，机上天气雷达失效，请求提供航线途中天气信息。

cards.audioText: QFA378 our weather radar shows CBs in the vicinity of DA.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，我们的天气雷达显示DA附近有积雨云。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger CBs near DA, thank you, QFA378,
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到DA附近有积雨，谢谢，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [There is a crowded cumulonimbus views from the cockpit, describe it to controller and request make a visual maneuver.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【从座舱内可以看到大片积雨云，向管制员描述该情况，并请求目视机动。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, there are some CBs surround this area, request visual maneuver.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，这一区域附近有积雨云，请求目视绕飞。

cards.audioText: QFA378, negative, military activity restriction.[Tell the controller you need assistance to avoid these weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: 快达378，不同意，军事活动限制。【告诉管制员你需要援助来躲避积雨云。】
cards.referenceText: Request assistance (radar vector) to avoid weather, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求协助（雷达引导躲）避积雨云，澳航378。

cards.audioText: QFA378, fly heading 030 maintain 1200m.[Read Back]
cards.referenceText: Heading 030 maintaining 1200m. QFA378.

cards.audioText: [After a few minutes, your navigation instrument shows a traffic advisory alert, ask the controller whether he notice the activities.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【几分钟后，机上导航仪表显示交通活动警报，询问管制员是否注意到该活动。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, TA traffic alert, do you notice the aircraft around us?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，交通活动警报，你是否发现我们周围有活动？

cards.audioText: QFA378, negative show my radar, keep looking.[The aircraft is flying from your left to right at the same level, tell controller what you have seen.]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，我的雷达上未显示，继续观察。【同一高度层中有一架飞机正从你左侧飞到右侧，告诉管制员你看到了什么。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, traffic flying from left to right at the same level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，同一高度层中有一架飞机从左穿越至右侧。

cards.audioText: Roger, QFA378.[After you have cleared the weather. Request Wuhan Approach for radar assistance to intercept final course of runway 36L.]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，澳航378。【天气好转后，向武汉进近请求雷达引导切入跑道36左五边航迹。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA378, request radar vectors to intercept final course of runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航378，请求雷达引导切入跑道36左五边航迹。

cards.audioText: QFA378, turn right heading 090, descend and maintain 900m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，右转航向090，下降保持900米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, descend and maintain 900m, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向090，下降保持900米，澳航378。

cards.audioText: QFA378, turn left heading 300, descend and maintain 600m, cleared to intercept the localizer runway 36L, contact Tower 124.35.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，左转航向300，下降保持600米，可以切入跑道36左航向道，联系塔台124.35。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 300, descend and maintain 600m, cleared to intercept the localizer runway 36L, contact Tower 124.35, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向300，下降保持600米，可以切入跑道36左航道，联系塔台124.35，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [You encounter downdrafts on short final and executed a missed approach, inform Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在短五边遇到下降气流，执行复飞，通知武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA378, going around due wind shear on short final.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，澳航378，由于五边风切变，复飞了。

cards.audioText: QFA378, when able, turn right heading 090, climb and maintain 1500m, contact Wuhan Approach 119.7.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，可以时，右转航向090，上升保持1500米，联系武汉进近119.7。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, climb and maintain 1500m, 119.7, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向090，上升保持1500米，联系武汉进近119.7，澳航378。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is QFA953. You are close to departure time. However, one passenger is missing while his checked luggage is still onboard. For security reasons, contact company operations to offload the baggage.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是澳航953，快到离场时间了；然而一名乘客未登机，他的行李还在机上。安全起见，联系公司运行部门卸下他的行李。】
cards.referenceText: Operations, QFA953, we are close to our departure time. One passenger is still missing; Request offload his checked luggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 运控，澳航953，我们快到起飞时间了。一名乘客仍未登机，请求卸下他的托运行李。

cards.audioText: [Now you are at Gate 51, ATIS W, request ATC clearance to Los Angels.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在51号机位，通播W，请求ATC放行至洛杉矶。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, QFA953, Gate 51, information W, destination Los Angeles, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，澳航953，51号机位，通播W，目的地洛杉矶，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: QFA953, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9800m, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往洛杉矶，跑道36右，LKO-01离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度9800米，离场频率119.7，应答机2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Los Angeles, flight planned route, LKO-01 departure runway 36R, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9800m, departure 119.7, squawk 2515, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往洛杉矶，跑道36右，LKO-01离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度9800米，离场频率119.7，应答机2515，澳航953。

cards.audioText: QFA953, expect 10min delay due taxiway A3 is temporally blocked by a broken down vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，滑行道A3被一辆抛瞄的车辆堵住，预计延误10分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, 10min delay, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，10分钟延误，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [The time is up for delay, call controller you can pushback and start-up.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【延误时间快结束了，呼叫管制员你可以推出开车了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, QFA953, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，澳航953，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: QFA953, Delivery, monitor Ground on 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，放行，守听地面频率119.35。
cards.referenceText: Monitor Ground 119.35, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 守听地面频率119.35，澳航953。

cards.audioText: QFA953, Wuhan Ground, the B737 right hand side is pushing. After traffic is clear, pushback onto taxiway Z4, abeam Gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，武汉地面，你右侧的波音737正在推出。活动清除后，推出到滑行道Z4，正切213号机位，头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Roger, after the B737 cleared, pushback onto taxiway Z4, abeam Gate 213, facing east, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，波音737起飞后，推出至滑行道Z4，正切213号机位，头朝东，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [As you are taxiing on taxiway A3, you noticed several baggage are scattered on A3 about 400 meters ahead of your aircraft. Tell Ground Control why you have stopped taxiing and ask ground staff to retrieve the baggage.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在滑行道A3上滑行时，你发现机身前方400米处散落着几件行李。告诉地面管制你为什么停止滑行，要求地面工作人员收走行李。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA953, we found several baggage scattered on A3. We stop taxi and holding present position, request ground service to retrieve the baggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，澳航953，我们发现滑行道A3上散落着几件行李。我们停止滑行，原地等待，请求地面工作人员收走行李。

cards.audioText: QFA953, hold your position, I will advise Ground Operations.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，原地等待，我会通知地面运行部门。
cards.referenceText: Holding, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，澳航953。

cards.audioText: QFA953, Ground, taxiway A3 cleared, expedite taxi via A3 and A to holding point runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，地面，滑行道A3清理完成，快速沿滑行道A3，A滑至跑道36右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expediting taxi via A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，快速沿滑行道A3，A滑至跑道36右等待点，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [You are now airborne, passing 1200m for 2400m. Contact Wuhan Departure and ask for further climb.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经起飞，通过1200米，上升2400米。联系武汉离场，请求爬升更高高度。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, QFA953, passing 1200m for 2400m, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，澳航953，通过1200米，上升2400米，请求爬升高高度。

cards.audioText: QFA953, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, expedite climb and maintain 6000m on standard due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，武汉离场，雷达已识别，由于交叉活动，快速上升保持标压6000米。
cards.referenceText: Expediting climb and maintain 6000m on standard, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 快速上升保持标压6000米，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [During climbing, one of your hydraulic systems failed, make an urgency call and ask to level off at 4500m and then return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【爬升过程中，机上一个液压系统失效，做紧急呼叫，请求在4500米平飞，之后返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, QFA953 one hydraulic system failure, request level off at 4500m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉离场，澳航953，机上一个液压系统失效，请求在4500米平飞，之后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: QFA953, roger PANPAN, climb and maintain 4500m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，收到PANPAN，上升保持4500米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 4500m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R. QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持4500米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，盲降进近跑道36右，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [The purser informs you that a passenger has become ill, possibly suffering from hyperventilation, ask for an ambulance to wait at the gate.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【乘务长通知你有一名乘客生病了，可能是换气过度，请求到达机位时提供救护车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, QFA953, request an ambulance, we have a passenger possibly suffering from hyperventilation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，澳航953，请求提供救护车，机上有一名乘客好像换气过度。

cards.audioText: QFA953, roger. Radar vector ILS runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航953，收到。雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Radar vector ILS runway 36R, QFA953.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右，澳航953。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is QFA029, your destination is Dubai, you are going to depart from Beijing airport at Gate 302. Now call Beijing Delivery, and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是澳航029，目的地是迪拜，你正准备从北京机场302机位出发。现在联系北京放行并请求ATC许可。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, QFA029, Gate 302, request ATC clearance to Dubai.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，澳航029，机位302，请求飞往迪拜的管制许可。

cards.audioText: QFA029, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Dubai, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600m, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 11000m en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，北京放行，可以按计划航路飞往迪拜，起始高度6600米，RENOB 32离场，更改巡航高度11000米在航路上申请，应答机1725，跑道36R，离场频率127.75。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Dubai, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600m, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 11000m en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75. QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路飞往迪拜，起始高度6600米，按RENOB 32离场，改变高度11000米在航路上申请，应答机1725，跑道36R，离场频率127.75，澳航029。

cards.audioText: QFA029 read back correct, contact Ground 121.9, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，复诵正确，联系地面121.9，再见。

cards.audioText: [You are ready to start up engines, call Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已准备开车，呼叫地面。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, ready to start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，澳航029，准备开车。

cards.audioText: QFA029, standby for start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，稍等开车。
cards.referenceText: Standing by, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，澳航029。

cards.audioText: QFA029, start-up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，同意开车。
cards.referenceText: Start up approved, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意开车，澳航029。

cards.audioText: [You are ready for push back now, call Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已准备推出，联系地面。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, request push back.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，澳航029，请求推出，原地等待。

cards.audioText: QFA029, push back approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，同意推出。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出，澳航029。

cards.audioText: [You have a problem: during pushback, the tow-bar is bent and you have to wait for another one. Tell the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你遇到了问题，飞机推出时，拖车杆弯曲了，你必须要等待新的拖车杆，将情况告诉管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, the tow bar bent and we are waiting for another one.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，澳航029，拖车杆弯曲，我们正在等待新的拖车杆。

cards.audioText: QFA029 roger, call me back when ready to taxi.[You are ready for taxiing, call Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，收到，准备滑出时报告。【你已准备滑行，联系地面。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, ready for taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，澳航029，准备滑行。

cards.audioText: QFA029, taxi via taxiway A4 and B1 to holding point 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，经滑行道A4和B1滑到跑道36右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway A4 and B1 to holding point 36R, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 滑行经滑行道A4和B1滑到跑道36右等待点，澳航029。

cards.audioText: QFA029 taxi slower, give way to the Airbus coming from your right.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，减速滑行，给右侧的空中客车让路。
cards.referenceText: Give way to the Airbus coming from right, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给右侧的空中客车让路，澳航029。

cards.audioText: QFA029, taxi with caution, work in progress on right side of the taxiway.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，滑行时注意，滑行道右侧正在施工。
cards.referenceText: Roger, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，澳航029。

cards.audioText: QFA029 follow the B737 in front of you.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，跟随你前方的波音737。
cards.referenceText: Following the B737, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随波音737，澳航029。

cards.audioText: [You now find your nose wheel steering seems to be jammed, tell the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你发现前机轮转弯卡住了，将情况告诉管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, QFA029, our nose wheel steering seems to be jammed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，澳航029，前机轮转弯似乎卡住了。

cards.audioText: QFA029, do you require a tug?[Say yes, you need towing assistance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，你需要拖车吗？【回答管制员你需要拖车援助。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request towing assistance, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求拖车援助，澳航029。

cards.audioText: QFA029, roger, hold and standby for a few minutes while I’ll get a tug for you.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，收到，原地等待几分钟，我会找拖车援助。
cards.referenceText: Holding and standby, thank you, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，谢谢，澳航029。

cards.audioText: [You are now airborne, time 32, you are passing 1200m and climbing to 1800m, contact Beijing Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机已起飞，时间32，通过1200米上升到1800米，联系北京离场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, QFA029, airborne 32, passing 1200m climbing to 1800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，澳航029，起飞时间32，过1200米，上升到1800米。

cards.audioText: QFA029, cancel SID, turn left direct to CD, climb to and maintain 6600m.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，取消标准仪表离场，左转直飞CD，上升保持6600米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn left direct to CD, climb to and maintain 6600m, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消标准仪表离场，左转直飞CD，上升保持6600米，澳航029。

cards.audioText: [Your primary display system has a fault, request return to Beijing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【主显示系统出现故障，请求返回北京。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, QFA029 request return to Beijing due primary display system malfunction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，澳航029，由于主显示系统故障，请求返回北京。

cards.audioText: QFA029, say again please, I read you 2.[Tell the controller that the primary display system of yours broke down, only the co-pilot’s display is working. For safety’s sake, you want to return to Beijing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，请再说一遍，我听你两个。【告诉管制员主显示系统出现故障，只有副驾驶的显示系统可工作，安全起见你需要返回北京。】
cards.referenceText: My primary display system failed, we have only one working on the co-pilot side, request return to Beijing for safety, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主显示系统故障，只有副驾驶的显示系统可工作，请求返回北京，澳航029。

cards.audioText: QFA029, roger, turn left heading 180, radar vector to land.[Readback]
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，收到，左转航向180，雷达引导着陆。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 180, radar vector to land, QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向180，雷达引导着陆，澳航029。

cards.audioText: N: Your call sign is QFA432. Ask Shanghai Delivery for the departure clearance to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是澳航432，向上海放行请求飞往北京的离场许可。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, QFA432, request departure clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，澳航432，请求飞往北京的离场许可。

cards.audioText: C: QFA432, Shanghai Delivery, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway 26, follow H01D departure, initial climb to 6000ft on QNH, contact departure 128.75, squawk 3421.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航432，上海放行，可以经由计划航路飞往北京，跑道26，按照H01D离场，按修压初始爬升至6000英尺，联系离场128.75，应答机3421。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway 26, follow H01D departure, initial climb to 6000ft on QNH, contact departure 128.75, squawk 3421, QFA432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往北京，跑道26，按照H01D离场，按修压初始爬升至6000英尺，联系离场128.75，应答机3421，澳航432。

cards.audioText: N: Tell the controller you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知管制员你准备好滑行了。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA432, request taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，澳航432，请求滑行许可。

cards.audioText: C: QFA432,,taxi via F, C1 and B to holding point runway 26. Caution work in progress at the end of gate 319.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航432，经由滑行道F，C1和B滑行至跑道26等待点。注意机位319尽头有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via F, C1, B to holding point runway 26, roger caution, QFA432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道F，C1和B滑行至跑道26等待点，收到 。

cards.audioText: N: As you are taxiing, you notice some smoke coming from APU on B747 ahead of you, report this to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在滑行的时候，你看到前方B747的APU有烟雾冒出，报告给管制员。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA432, some smoke coming from the APU of the B747 ahead of us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，澳航432，前方B747的APU有烟雾冒出。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA432, roger, thank you.
N: You are now at the holding point of runway 26. Tell ATC you are ready to takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh:
澳航432，收到，谢谢。
你现在在跑道26的外等待点，告诉管制员你准备好起飞了。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, QFA432, holding point of runway 26, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，澳航432，跑道26的外等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: C: QFA432, behind landing traffic, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航432，在着陆的航空器后面，上跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Behind landing traffic, line up behind, QFA432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在着陆的航空器后面，上跑道等待，澳航432。

cards.audioText: N: Now you have reached 3300 meters over Beijing airport, request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在到达北京机场上空3300米，请求进一步下降。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, 3300m maintaining, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，澳航432，保持在3300米，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: QFA432, maintain 3300 meters, opposite traffic 1 o’clock 10 miles, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航432，保持3300米，对面航空器1点钟方向，10海里，解除冲突后报。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3300 meters, opposite traffic 1 o’clock, 10 miles, report clear of traffic, QFA432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持3300米，对面航空器1点钟方向，10海里，解除冲突后报，澳航432。

cards.audioText: N: Now you have cleared of the conflicting traffic, report to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你与冲突航空器解除冲突，报告给管制员。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, cleared of traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，澳航432，解除冲突。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, QFA432.
N: You were cleared to 1200m but notice the sky is turning yellow color and visibility is deteriorating quickly. You suspect a sandstorm. Tell Beijing Approach this and ask ATC if there is a sand storm forecast.
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，澳航432。
你被许可到1200米，但是你注意到天空变黄，能见度快速变差。你怀疑是沙尘暴。告知北京进近，询问管制员是否有沙暴预报。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, maintaining 1200 meters, the sky is turning yellow and the visibility is getting worse. Confirm if there is a sandstorm forecast.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，澳航432，在1200米保持，天空变黄，能见度变差，证实是否有沙尘暴预报。

cards.audioText: N: The sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor. Inform ATC of the situation and ask to climb to higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: 沙尘暴很严重，能见度很低。通知管制员该情况，请求爬升到更高的高度以飞越沙尘暴。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, the sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor, request climb to higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，澳航432，沙尘暴非常严重，现在能见度很低，请求爬升到更高高度以飞越沙尘暴。

cards.audioText: C: QFA432, climb to and maintain 7000 meters and turn right heading 210.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航432，上到7000米保持，右转航向210。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 7000 meters and turn right heading 210, QFA432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上到7000米保持，右转航向210，澳航432。

cards.audioText: N: Suddenly, your No.1 and No.2 engines have flamed out due to the dust storm, If the weather is clear at Beijing, request radar vectors to Beijing airport for priority landing. This is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 突然，由于沙尘暴，你的一、二发熄火了，如果北京的天气晴朗，申请雷达引导到北京机场优先降落。这是遇险通话。
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Beijing Approach, QFA432, No.1 and 2 engines failed due to dust storm. If the weather is clear at Beijing, request radar vectors to Beijing for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，北京进近，澳航432，由于因沙尘暴，一、二发失效。如果北京天气晴朗，申请雷达引导到北京优先降落。

cards.audioText: C: QFA432, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航432，收到Mayday，右转航向030，下降到3000米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters, QFA432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向030，下降到3000米，澳航432。

cards.audioText: C: QFA432, the weather is clear now, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 18L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航432，现在天气晴朗了，预计雷达引导盲降进近跑道18左，建立航向道后报。
cards.referenceText: Radar vectors for ILS approach runway 18L, report established, QFA432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达引导盲降进近跑道18左，建立航向道后报，澳航432。

cards.audioText: N: You have established ILS approach runway 18L, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在已经建立跑道18左盲降进近，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, QFA432, established ILS approach runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，澳航432，建立跑道18左盲降进近。

cards.audioText: C: QFA432, cleared to land, runway 18L, you are number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航432，可以落地。跑道18左，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 18L, number 1, QFA432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地。跑道18左，第一个，澳航432。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is QFA653, from Sydney to Wuhan, cruising at 10700m, squawk 3211. Now you are entering Wuhan Control area. Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是澳航653，从悉尼飞往武汉，巡航高度10700米，应答机3211。你现在正在进入武汉管制区域，与武汉区调进行初始联络。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA653, 10700m, squawk 3211.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航653，（高度）10700米，应答机3211。

cards.audioText: QFA653, Wuhan Control, radar contact, maintaining 10700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航653，武汉区调，雷达识别，保持10700米。
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 10700m, QFA653.

cards.audioText: [You find thunderstorms building up near LKO, ask the controller how the preceding aircraft avoided the weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你发现雷暴正在LKO附近形成，询问管制员，前机是如何避免天气的]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA653, thunderstorm near LKO, how did preceding aircraft avoid weather?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航635， LKO附近有雷暴，前机是如何避开天气的？

cards.audioText:
Preceding aircraft just deviate 5 miles to the east, what’s your intention?
[Tell ATC you want to deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid the weather.]
cards.audioTextZh:
前机向东偏航5海里，你的意图是什么?
[告诉管制员，你想向东偏航20海里来避开天气]
cards.referenceText: Request deviate 20 miles to the east to avoid the weather, QFA653
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求向东偏航20海里来避开天气，澳航653。

cards.audioText: [You are approaching the top of the descent point, but there is CBs at lower level, ask Wuhan Control to delay descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你正在接近下降点的顶部，但是在较低高度层有积雨云，告知武汉区调，推迟下降]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA653, request delay descent due CBs at lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航653，由于较低高度层有积雨云，请求推迟下降。

cards.audioText: [Now the thunderstorm is building up to the south of the airport, arrival through LKO is difficult. Ask Wuhan Control to approach from the north and use ZF arrival.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在，雷暴正在机场南部形成，通过LKO进场很困难，告诉武汉区调，从北部进近，使用ZF进场]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA653, request approach from the north and use ZF arrival due thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航653，由于雷暴，请求从北部进近，使用ZF进场。

cards.audioText: QFA653, turn right heading 020, expect ZF02 arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航653，右转航向020，预计ZF02进场程序。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 020, expect ZF02 arrival, QFA653.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向020，预计ZF02进场，澳航653。

cards.audioText: [Now there is small CBs in front of you, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在，你前方有一小团积雨云，请求在2海里内向右转]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA653, request maneuver to the right within 2 miles due CBs ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航653，由于前方积雨云，请求2海里内右转。

cards.audioText: [During descent, your nose wheel is inoperative, inform Wuhan Approach of the situation and tell them you will stop on the runway after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在下降过程中，你的前轮失效，将情况通知武汉进场，并告诉他们你着陆后将在跑道上停下]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA653, nose wheel failed, request stop on the runway after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，澳航653，前轮失效，请求着陆后在跑道上停下。

cards.audioText: [You are about to use the VOR/DME approach runway 22, but the weather is deteriorating, ask Wuhan Tower for ILS approach runway 18L.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你将使用VOR/DME进近，跑道22，但是天气正在恶化。告诉武汉塔台，使用ILS进近，跑道18左]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA653, request ILS approach runway 18L due to weather deteriorating.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，澳航653，由于天气恶化，请求ILS进近，跑道18左。

cards.audioText: QFA653, ILS runway 18L is approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航653，同意ILS进近，跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: ILS runway 18L approved, QFA653.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意ILS进近，跑道18左，澳航653。

cards.audioText: [The approach lights is not bright enough, ask Tower to increase the brightness of the approach lights.]
cards.audioTextZh: 进近灯光不够亮，告诉塔台，提高进近灯光的亮度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA653, request brighten/turn up the approach lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，澳航653，请求提高进近灯光亮度。

cards.audioText: [You are executing a missed approach because of poor visibility, inform Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 由于能见度差，你正在进行复飞，告知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, QFA653, going around due poor visibility.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，澳航653，由于能见度差，复飞了。

cards.audioText: QFA653, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航653， 按照标准复飞程序复飞。
cards.referenceText: Following the standard missed approach procedure, QFA653.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照标准复飞程序复飞，澳航653。

cards.audioText: QFA653, the visibility is improved now. Expect radar vector for another approach. Turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航653，能见度现在提高了，预计雷达引导，再次进近，右转航向090，可以ILS（进近），跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090, cleared for ILS runway 18L, QFA653.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向090，可以ILS（进近），跑道18左，澳航653。

cards.audioText: [Now you are at Wuhan Airport, the tow truck is not in position. Ask for a tug.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在武汉机场，但是拖车未就位，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA653, tug not in position, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，澳航653，拖车未就位，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 160 from Tokyo to Guangzhou, you are cruising at 11000 meters, over WX, make the initial contact with Zhengzhou control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是澳航160，从东京飞往广州，你现在在11000米巡航，飞过WX，与郑州区调建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, from Tokyo to Guangzhou, we are cruising at 11,000 meters over WX.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，澳航160，从东京飞往广州，我们在11000米巡航，飞过WX。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, maintain 10500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航160，郑州区调，雷达识别，10500米保持。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 10500 meters, QFA160.

cards.audioText: B: You wish to know until what time you can expect higher levels, ask Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你想知道什么时候可以上高度，询问郑州区调。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, confirm when we can climb to higher levels?
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，澳航160，证实什么时候我们可以上高度？

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, Zhengzhou Control, you can expect further climb after passing LKO, but for now continue descend to and maintain 9200 meters. Reduce to the minimum speed due the temporary airway restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，郑州区调，预计过LKO后可以上高度，但现在，继续下降并保持9200米，由于临时航路管控，减小至最小速度。
cards.referenceText: Expect further climb after passing LKO, continue descend to and maintain 9200 meters. Reduce to the minimum speed due the temporary airway restriction, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计过LKO后可以上高度，继续下降并保持9200米，由于临时航路管控，减小至最小速度，QFA160。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, Orbit right at present position until further advised.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，当前位置盘旋，直到进一步通知。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right at present position until further advised, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当前位置盘旋，直到进一步通知，QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller if you are going to orbit any longer, you will reach the minimum fuel.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知管制员，如果你继续盘旋，你将达到最低燃油。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, we will reach the minimum fuel if we are going to orbit any longer.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，QFA160，如果我们继续盘旋，我们将达到最低燃油。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, Zhengzhou control, roger, after this orbit track direct to AKOMA.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，郑州区调，收到，这次盘旋过后直飞AKOMA。
cards.referenceText: Roger, track direct to AKOMA after this orbit, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，这次盘旋过后直飞AKOMA，QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find you won’t have enough fuel to fly to Guangzhou. You decide to divert to Changsha airport. Notify Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，你发现你没有足够的燃油飞往广州，你决定改航到长沙机场，告知郑州区调。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, request divert to Changsha airport due fuel shortage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，QFA160，由于燃油短缺，请求改航长沙机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, standby for your request, the temporary restriction is canceled. Resume your normal speed, proceed direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，稍等，当前限制取消，恢复到正常速度，直飞OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Resume my normal speed, proceed direct to OBLIK, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复到正常速度，直飞OBLIK, QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: Your navigation system has a problem, your instrument is showing inaccurate position of your aircraft, notify Zhengzhou Control and ask for radar monitoring.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的导航系统出问题了，仪表无法指示飞机正确的位置信息，告知郑州区调，请求雷达监控。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, our navigation system has a problem, the instrument is showing inaccurate position of our aircraft, request radar monitoring.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，QFA160，我们的导航系统出问题了，仪表无法指示飞机正确的位置信息，请求雷达监视。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160 roger, you are slightly deviating to the left, turn right 8 degrees, contact Wuhan Control on 134.7 and request diversion from Wuhan control.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，收到，你现在稍微左偏，右转8度，联系武汉区调134.7，向武汉区调请求改航。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right 8 degrees, contact Wuhan Control on 134.7, wilco, good day, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，右转8度，联系武汉区调134.7，照办，再见，QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: You are maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK, your transponder code is 4525, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你保持在9200米，飞过OBLIK，你的应答机编码是4525，呼叫武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA160, we are maintaining 9200 meters, over OBLIK with transponder code 4525.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，QFA160，我们在9200米保持，飞过OBLIK，应答机编码4525。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA160, Wuhan control, radar contact. I understand you have a navigation problem and fuel shortage, confirm you are diverting to Changsha Airport.
B: Tell Wuhan control you are doing the checklist and tell Wuhan Control to standby.
cards.audioTextZh:
QFA160武汉区调，雷达识别，我了解到你遭遇导航问题，燃油短缺，证实你要改航长沙机场。
告知武汉区调你在执行检查单，稍等。
cards.referenceText: We are doing the checklist, standby, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们正在执行检查单，稍等，QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control that you are flying with basic navigation instruments and you will change the alternate airport to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知武汉区调，你现在依靠基本导航仪表飞行，你将改航到武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA160, we are flying with basic navigation instruments and we will change the alternate airport to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，QFA160，我们现在依靠基本导航仪表飞行，并将改航到武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, roger, divert to Wuhan Airport approved, descend to and maintain 4800 meters, contact 120.45 when reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，收到，同意改航到武汉机场，下到4800米保持，到4800米后联系120.45。
cards.referenceText: Roger, divert to Wuhan Airport approved, descend to and maintain 4800 meters, contact 120.45 when reaching, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，同意改航到武汉机场，下到4800米保持，到4800米后联系120.45， QFA160。

cards.audioText: B: You are reaching 4800 meters, receiving information B, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你到达4800米，收到通播B，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, QFA160, 4800 meters, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，QFA160，4800米，通播B。

cards.audioText: C: QFA160, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, B is current, expect ZF-01A arrival runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: QFA160，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前通播B，预计ZF-01A进场，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Information B, expect ZF-01A arrival runway 36R, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播B，ZF-01A进场，跑道36右，澳航160。

cards.audioText:
C: QFA160, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Inform the controller that you still have more than 2 hours fuel, you do not need to declare fuel emergency.
cards.audioTextZh:
QFA160，你宣布燃油紧急情况吗？
告知管制员你还有2个多小时的燃油，你不需要宣布燃油紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Negative, we still have more than 2 hours fuel, QFA160.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不需要，我们还有2个多小时的燃油，澳航160。

topics.name: SIA 852 地面车堵滑行道 前轮爆胎

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 852, you are at Wuhan Airport, stand 7, received ATIS M, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 852，在武汉机场 7 号机位，已收到 ATIS M，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 852, stand 7, information M, request clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 852，7 号机位，收到 M 情报，申请前往新加坡的放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, follow ZF-03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, Runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，执行 ZF-03 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 18 左，离场频率 124.7，应答机 4615。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, follow ZF-03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, Runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，执行 ZF-03 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 18L，离场频率 124.7，应答机 4615，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, push back and start up at your own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，自行决定推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up at our own discretion, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自行决定推出和开车，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: You have completed the push back and start up procedures. You decide to make an intersection departure from E2, contact Ground to request intersection departure from E2.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出和开车程序。你决定从 E2 交叉口离场，联系地面请求从 E2 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, push back and start up completed, request intersection departure from E2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，推出和开车完成，请求从 E2 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, roger, intersection departure from E2 is approved, taxi to E2 via A6, A2, hold short of Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，收到，E2 交叉口离场批准，经 A6、A2 滑行至 E2，跑道 18 左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E2 is approved, taxi to E2 via A6, A2, hold short of Runway 18L, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: E2 交叉口离场批准，经 A6、A2 滑行至 E2，跑道 18L 外等待，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about the situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行期间，你发现一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，你已停止飞机，通知 ATC 情况，并请求机场服务将车辆拖走。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, a vehicle has broken down on taxiway A, we have to stop our aircraft and request airport service to tow the vehicle away.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，我们必须停止飞机，请求机场服务将车辆拖走。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, roger, hold at present position, RAM services will be assume in a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，收到，在当前位置等待，RAM 服务几分钟后会处理。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, roger, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置等待，收到，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: You are now holding short of Runway 18L on E2, request departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 E2 上跑道 18 左外等待，请求离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, holding short of Runway 18L on E2, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，在 E2 上跑道 18L 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, cleared for takeoff Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，跑道 18 左可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道 18L，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: During the takeoff role, your nose will run over a sharp object on the runway surface and the nose wheel tire burst, you aborted the takeoff, notify Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：起飞滑跑期间，你的前轮压过跑道表面的尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，你中断起飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, our nose wheel has run over a sharp object on the runway, the tire got burst, we aborted takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，我们的前轮压过跑道上的尖锐物，轮胎爆胎，我们中断起飞。

cards.audioText: B: Inform ATC about the situation and request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知 ATC 情况，并请求消防车和维修。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, we have run over a sharp object, and our nose wheel tire got burst, request fire service and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，我们压过尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，请求消防和维修。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 852, roger, do you require anything else?
B: Tell the ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after inspection.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 852，收到，你还需要其他什么吗？
B：告诉 ATC 检查后你需要牵引车将飞机拖回停机坪。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request a tug to tow us back to the apron after inspection, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，请求检查后用牵引车将我们拖回停机坪，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，牵引车正在路上。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。

topics.name: SIA 123 拖把断了 鸟击 放油

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 123, stand 215, from Wuhan to Singapore, information B received, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 123，215 号机位，从武汉飞往新加坡，已收到 B 情报，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 123, stand 215, information B, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 123，215 号机位，收到 B 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, Runway 36R, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 6325.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 36 右，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, runaway 36R, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 6325, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 36R，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好了，联系地面请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 123, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 123，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，推出和开车批准，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头向东，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: While being pushed back, the tow bar bent, contact Ground to request another tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: B：推出过程中，拖把弯曲，联系地面请求另一根拖把。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 123, our tow bar was bent, request another tow bar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 123，我们的拖把弯曲，请求另一根拖把。

cards.audioText: B: While taxiing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到风向袋显示强顺风，联系塔台检查风。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, wind sock shows strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，风向袋显示强顺风，请求风向风速检查。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 123, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
