cards.referenceText: roger, cleared low pass on the left hand side of runway, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，许可从跑道左侧低空通场，SIA 223。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 223, the nose wheel doesn't appear to be down, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you ask for touch and go and you intend to jar the wheel down.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 223，前轮看起来没有放下，报告你的意图。
B： 告诉管制员你请求接地复飞，并打算通过震动将机轮放下。
cards.referenceText: SIA 223, request touch and go, jar down.
cards.referenceTextZh: SIA 223，请求接地复飞，尝试通过震动将机轮放下。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, cleared touch and go, heading 330, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，许可接地复飞，航向 330，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared touch and go Runway 36R, turn left heading 330, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可在 Runway 36R 接地复飞，左转航向 330，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: you are going around, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你正在复飞，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: SIA 223, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: SIA 223，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, roger, climb and maintain 600 meters, heading 330.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，收到，爬升至并保持 600 米，航向 330。
cards.referenceText: left turn heading 330, climb to 600 meters, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 330，爬升至 600 米，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: your nose wheel still appears to be jammed, tell the controller you have to make an emergency landing on Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的前轮看起来仍然卡住，告诉管制员你必须在 Runway 04 紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 223, nose wheel still appears to be jammed, we have to make an emergency landing Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 223，前轮看起来仍然卡住，我们必须在 Runway 04 紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, cleared for emergency landing on Runway 04, the emergency group is ready.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，许可在 Runway 04 紧急着陆，紧急救援组已就位。
cards.referenceText: roger, cleared for emergency landing on Runway 04, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，许可在 Runway 04 紧急着陆，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is SIA123. stand 215, from Wuhan to Singapore, information B. Request ATC clearance to Singapore.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你的呼号是新航123，215号机位，从武汉飞往新加坡，通播B，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA123, stand 215, information B, destination Singapore, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航123，215号机位，通播B，目的地新加坡，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。

cards.audioText: SIA123, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 36R, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 6325.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，武汉放行，可以按计划航路放行至新加坡，LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道36右，离场频率119.7，应答机6325。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 36R, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 6325, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至新加坡，LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道36右，离场频率119.7，应答机6325, 新航123。

cards.audioText: [You are now ready, contact Ground to request pushback and start-up.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在准备好了，联系地面，请求推出开车>]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA123, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航123，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA123, Wuhan Ground, pushback and startup approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，武汉地面，同意推出开车，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and startup approved, facing east, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，面朝东，新航123。

cards.audioText: [While taxiing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑行时，你注意到风袋显示有强烈顺风，联系塔台检查风的情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA123, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航123，证实地面风。

cards.audioText:
SIA123, surface wind 220 degrees, 8m/s.
[The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit. Contact Tower to change to runway 18L and state the reason.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航123，地面风220，8米/秒。
【该风速超过你的起飞限制。联系塔台更换至跑道18左并说明原因。】
cards.referenceText: Request runway 18L due the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于风速超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换跑道18左，新航123。

cards.audioText: SIA123, contact Ground 121.6.
cards.referenceText: Contact Ground 121.6, SIA123.

cards.audioText: SIA123, taxi to holding point runway 18L via E, D4, F.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，沿滑行道E，D4，F滑至跑道18左的等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18L via E, D4, and F. SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道E，D4，F滑至跑道18左的等待点，新航123。

cards.audioText: [After you pass taxiway E, you saw a cone lying on the taxiway D4, tell the controller what you have seen.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑过滑行道E后，你看到滑行道D4上有一个路障，告诉管制员你看到的情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA123, there is a cone lying on the taxiway D4 and it blocks my taxiway. Request assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航123，滑行道D4上有一个路障，它堵住了我的滑行道。请求援助。

cards.audioText: SIA123, roger that. Hold present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，收到。原地等待。
cards.referenceText: Holding, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，新航123。

cards.audioText: [You have departed from runway 18L, shortly after liftoff, you encountered a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an urgency call, request maintain runway heading.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已在跑道18左起飞，起飞后不久，飞机遭到了鸟击，右侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, SIA123, right engine failure due bird strike, request maintain runway heading.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉塔台，新航123，由于鸟击，右侧发动机失效，请求保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: [Tell the Tower you want to dump fuel and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉塔台你想放油之后返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA123 request fuel dumping and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航123，请求放油，之后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: SIA123, Tower, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO VOR 30 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，塔台，收到PANPAN，右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米，新航123。

cards.audioText: SIA123, after passing LKO, left heading 220, maintain 3000m, report over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，飞过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持，过LKO报告。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, left heading 220, maintaining 3000m, report over LKO, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持，过LKO报告，新航123。

cards.audioText: [You are over LKO, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你飞过LKO了，呼叫武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA123, over LKO 3000m maintaining.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，新航123，过LKO，高度3000米。

cards.audioText:
SIA123, advise the time required for fuel jettison.
[Tell Wuhan Control you need approximately 25 min.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航123，报告放油需要的时间。
【告诉武汉区调你需要大约25分钟。】
cards.referenceText: We need about 25min, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们需要大约25分钟，新航123。

cards.audioText: [Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉武汉进近放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道22。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA123, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，新航123，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道22。

cards.audioText: [You are now established on ILS approach runway 22, contact Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立盲降进近跑道22，联系塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA123, established ILS approach runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航123，建立盲降进近跑道22。

topics.name: SIA308 [驾驶舱烟雾，错过脱离道]

cards.audioText: B: [Your callsign is SIA308, a flight from Wuhan to Frankfurt. You’re parking at gate M5. You got the latest information G, contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是新航308，从武汉飞往法兰克福。你现在在M5号停机位。你收到了最新的通播G，联系武汉放行，申请管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA308, gate M5, information G, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航308，M5号机位，通播G，请求飞往法兰克福的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 1600m, ZF05 departure, cruising level 11000m, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，可以经由计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场跑道04，初始爬升至1600米，ZF05离场，巡航高度11000米，离场频率119.45，应答机3763。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb 1600m, ZF05 departure, cruising level 11000m, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场跑道04，初始爬升至1600米，ZF05离场，巡航高度11000米，离场频率119.45，应答机3763，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’ve completed pushback and start-up, you’re ready for taxi. Contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: B: 【你现在完成了推出开车，你准备好滑行了，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA308, pushback and start-up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航308，完成推出开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, Wuhan Ground, taxi via taxiway Z4, A2, A to the holding point of E5 runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，武汉地面，经由滑行道Z4，A2和A滑行到跑道04外等待点E5。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A2, A to the holding point of E5 runway 04, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A2和A滑行到跑道04外等待点E5，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re holding at holding point E5, runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower and tell controller you’re ready for departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: B: 【现在你已经在跑道04外等待点E5，联系武汉塔台，告诉管制员你准备好起飞了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA308, holding point E5, runway 04, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航308，跑道04外等待点E5，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, line up runway 04, and cleared for immediate takeoff, traffic on final.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，上跑道04，可以立即起飞，五边上有航空器。
cards.referenceText: Line up runway 04, and cleared for immediate takeoff, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道04，可以立即起飞，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re airborne, passing 600m, climbing to 1600m, contact Wuhan Departure and ask for cancel SID and proceed to ZF.]
cards.audioTextZh: B: 【你现在已经起飞，过600米，正向1600米爬升，联系武汉离场，请求取消标准离场，直飞ZF。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA308, airborne, passing 600m, climbing to 1600m, request cancel SID and proceed to ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，新航308，起飞了，过600米，正向1600米爬升，请求取消标准离场，直飞ZF。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, cancel SID, turn right direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 4500m.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，武汉离场，雷达看见了，取消标准离场，右转直飞ZF，上4500米保持。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn right direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 4500m, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消标准离场，右转直飞ZF，上4500米保持，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re en-route Germany, Rhein Radar Control, you’re cruising at FL360, make an initial contact with Rhein Radar Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在已经在德国莱茵雷达管制区航路上，你现在在高度层360巡航。与莱茵雷达管制区进行初始通话。】
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA308, en-route, cruising at FL360.
cards.referenceTextZh: 莱茵雷达，新航308，在航路上，高度层360。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, maintain FL360, offset 3 miles right of track due weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，保持高度层360，由于天气，右偏置3海里。
cards.referenceText: Maintain FL360, offset 3 miles right of track, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持高度层360，右偏置3海里，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have smoke in the cockpit, make a distress call to Rhein Radar and request emergency descent to remove the smoke.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你的驾驶舱出现烟雾，向莱茵雷达管制区做遇险呼叫，请求紧急下降来移除烟雾。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Rhein Radar, SIA308, we have smoke in the cockpit, request emergency descent for smoke removal.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，莱茵雷达，新航308，驾驶舱烟雾，请求紧急下降来移除烟雾。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA308, roger Mayday, descend to and maintain FL100, keep us advised the situation on board and your intention.
B: [Read back the instructions and tell the controller that you’re working the checklist and will advise.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 新航308，收到Mayday，下高度层100保持，告知我们机上情况以及你的意图。
B：【复诵指令，告知管制员，你现在正在执行检查单。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain FL100, we’re working the checklist and will advise, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到高度层100保持，我们正在执行检查单，将会告知，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [After completing the checklist, the smoke can’t be removed and you decide to divert to Paris, inform the controller your situation and intention.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【完成检查单后，烟雾无法移除，你决定改航到巴黎，告知管制员你的情况以及意图。】
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA308, the smoke can’t be removed, request divert to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 莱茵雷达，新航308，烟雾无法移除，请求改航到巴黎。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, roger, turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000ft, contact Paris Approach 119.4.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，收到，左转航向350，下到8000英尺保持，联系巴黎进近119.4。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000ft, contact Paris Approach 119.4, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向350，下到8000英尺保持，联系巴黎进近119.4，新航308。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, descend to and maintain 6000ft, cleared for ILS approach runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，下6000英尺保持，可以盲降进近跑道08左。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6000ft, cleared for ILS approach runway 08L, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下6000英尺保持，可以盲降进近跑道08左，新航308。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’ve landed on runway 08L, but you missed the first rapid exit, report to Paris Tower and request vacate via the second rapid exit.]
cards.audioTextZh: B: 【现在你已经落地跑道08左，但是你错过了第一个快速脱离道，联系巴黎塔台，请求从第二个快速脱离道脱离。】
cards.referenceText: Paris Tower, SIA308, we missed the first rapid exit, request vacate via the second rapid exit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巴黎塔台，新航308，我们错过了第一个快速脱离道，请求经由第二个快速脱离道脱离。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, roger, take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris on 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，收到，经由第二个快速脱离道脱离，脱离后，联系巴黎118.5。
cards.referenceText: Take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris on 118.5, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由第二个快速脱离道脱离，脱离后，联系巴黎118.5，新航308。

cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is SIA708, you are en route from Singapore to Beijing, you are overhead BUBDA, maintaining 11900m, your squawk number is 3705, make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是新航708，你现在正在从新加坡飞往北京的航路上，你现在已经过BUBDA，保持11900米，你的应答机编码是3705，与广州区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, SIA708 from Singapore to Beijing, overhead BUBDA, maintaining 11900m, squawking 3705.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，新航708，从新加坡飞往北京，过BUBDA，保持11900米，应答机3705。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA708, radar contact, track direct to DAPRO, confirm your aircraft type.
N: [You are flying a Boeing777, acknowledge the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：新航708，雷达看见了，直飞DAPRO，证实你的机型。
N：【你正在飞的是波音777，告知管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Track direct to DAPRO, affirm, we are a Boeing 777, SIA708.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞DAPRO，是的，我们飞的是波音777，新航708。

cards.audioText: C: SIA708, maintain 3 miles offset right of track, keep high speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C：新航708，从当前航迹又偏置3海里，保持高速。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3 miles offset to the right of track, keep high speed, SIA708.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从当前航迹又偏置3海里，保持高速，新航708。

cards.audioText: N: [Your cabin altitude is slightly increasing, as a precaution, you want to request a lower level, advise your intention to Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的座舱高度正在轻微上升，作为预防，你想申请更低高度。将你的意图告知广州区调。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, SIA708, request lower level due to increasing cabin altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，新航708，由于座舱高度，请求更低高度。

cards.audioText: C: SIA708, standby, traffic below your level, expect your descent in 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C：新航708，稍等，你的下方有航空器，预计5分钟后下降。
cards.referenceText: Standby, expect descent in 5 minutes, SIA708.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，预计5分钟后下降，；新航708。

cards.audioText: N: [You have a problem with pressurization, you are unsure whether the cabin pressure controller has malfunctioned, or the outflow valve has jammed, you wish to descent immediately to 9500m.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你遇到了增压问题，你不确定是座舱压力控制器出现了故障，还是排气阀卡住了，你希望立即下降到 9500 米的高度。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, SIA708, experiencing pressurization issues, request immediate descent to 9500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，新航708，遇到增压问题，请求立即下降到9500米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA708, roger, turn right heading 070, descend to and maintain 9500m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：新航708，右转航向070，下9500米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn right to 070, descend to and maintain 9500m, SIA708.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向070，下9500米保持，新航708。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA708, report the nature of your problem when able.
N: [You are leveling at 9500m, your pressurization looks to be stable, advise controller and request track direct to DAPRO.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：新航708，可以的时候，报告你的机上情况。
N：【你现在在9500米巡航，你的增压现在看起来稳定了，告知管制员，请求直飞DAPRO。】
cards.referenceText: Level at 9500m, pressurization appears stable, request track direct to DAPRO, SIA708.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在9500米巡航，增压现在看起来稳定了，请求直飞DAPRO，新航708。

cards.audioText: C: SIA708, unable, turn left heading 340 to intercept the A461 airway, maintaining offset 3 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：新航708，不可以，左转航向340，切A461航路，保持右偏置3海里。
cards.referenceText: Turn left to 340 to intercept A461, maintain 3 miles offset to the right, SIA708.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向340，切A461航路，保持右偏置3海里，新航708。

cards.audioText: N: [Suddenly, you have a cabin smoke alarm, you have deployed the cabin oxygen masks, report to Guangzhou Control, you want to make an emergency descent to 3300m, this is a distress call.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【突然，你有一个客舱烟雾告警，你释放了客舱氧气面罩，报告给广州区调，你想紧急下降到3300米，这是一个遇险通话。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Guangzhou Control, SIA708, cabin smoke alarm activated, deployed oxygen masks, request emergency descent to 3300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，广州区调，新航708，客舱烟雾告警激活，已经释放氧气面罩，请求紧急下降到3300米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA708, roger, turn right heading 080, descend to and maintain 3300m, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C：新航708，收到，右转航向080，下3300保持，可以的时候告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Turn right to 080, descend to 3300m, wilco, SIA708.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向080，下3300保持，将照办，新航708。

cards.audioText: N: [Your TCAS indicates low altitude traffic converging to your aircraft, advise Guangzhou Control and request heading change to avoid it.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的TCAS指示一个低高度航空器，正在向你靠近，请告知广州区调，并请求改变航向以避开它。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, SIA708, TCAS indicates low altitude traffic converging to my aircraft, request heading change to avoid converging traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，新航708，TCAS指示一个低高度航空器，正在向我靠近，请求改变航向来避开航空器。

cards.audioText: C: CCA101, turn right heading 360. Break break, SIA708, turn right heading 180.
cards.audioTextZh: C：国航101，右转航向360。断开，断开，新航708，右转航向180。
cards.referenceText: Turn right to 180, SIA708.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，新航708。

cards.audioText: N: [You are continuing the emergency descent, your purser has found the source of the smoke and will try to extinguish the fire once the safe altitude is reached, advise control that you are passing 8900m, and wish to divert to Changsha airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你正在继续执行紧急下降程序，乘务长已经找到了烟雾的来源，并会在达到安全高度后尝试扑灭火源。请通知管制部门你正在过 8900 米的高度，并希望改航至长沙机场。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, SIA708, continue emergency descent, passing 8900m, request diversion to Changsha Airport due to cabin smoke.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，新航708，继续进行紧急下降，过8900米，由于客舱烟雾，请求改航到长沙机场。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA708, Changsha Control, Changsha airport has approach restrictions, latest ATIS suggests visibility 320 in fog, advise your intentions.
N: [Ask Changsha Control whether if CAT II approach is available at Changsha airport.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：新航708，长沙区调，长沙机场有进近限制，最新的 ATIS 信息显示在大雾天气下能见度为 320 米，请告知你的意图。
N：【询问长沙区调长沙机场是否可以进行二类进近。】
cards.referenceText: Cconfirm Changsha Airport CAT II approach is available, SIA708.
cards.referenceTextZh: 证实长沙机场能否进行二类盲降，新航708。

cards.audioText: [You are SIA635, from Wuhan to Singapore, parking at Gate 232, you are fully ready for pushback and start-up, call Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是新航635，从武汉飞往新加坡，停在232号停机位，已充分准备好推出开车，呼叫地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA635, Gate 232, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航635，机位232号，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA635, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, pushback onto Z4, abeam Gate 234.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，武汉地面，同意推出开车，推出到滑行道Z4，正切234号机位。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up onto Z4, abeam 234, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出开车到滑行道Z4，正切234号机位，新航635。

cards.audioText: [You have one engine starter fails, you wish to have more time to start the engine manually on Z4.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机一发动机起动机失效，你希望可以在Z4上多停留一段时间，以手动启动发动机。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA635, we need more time to start engine on Z4 due engine starter failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航635，发动机起动机失效，需要在滑行道Z4上多停留一段时间，起动发动机。

cards.audioText: SIA635, how long is the delay?[Tell the controller you need approximately 5min.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，要延误多久？【告诉管制员你需要大概5分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Approximate 5min, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 大概5分钟，新航635。

cards.audioText: [After 5min, call Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【5分钟后，呼叫地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA635, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航635，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: SIA635, taxi to the holding point of runway 36R, via Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，沿滑行道Z4，A3，A滑至跑道36右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to the holding point of runway 36R, via Z4, A3 and A, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A3，A滑至跑道36右等待点，新航635。

cards.audioText: [There’s a B737 approaching you on E3, ask controller who has the right of the way.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑行道E3上有一架波音737正在接近你，询问管制员谁有优先权。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA635, confirm the right sequence?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航635，证实优先权？

cards.audioText: SIA635, hold present position, give way to B737.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，原地等待，给波音737让路。
cards.referenceText: Holding present position, give way to B737, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，给波音737让路，新航635。

cards.audioText: SIA635, caution work in progress in the vicinity of main taxiway.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，小心，主滑行道附近正在施工。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，新航635。

cards.audioText: SIA635, Tower, cleared for takeoff 36R, caution birds in the vicinity of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，塔台，可以起飞，跑道36右，注意，机场附近有鸟。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff 36R, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道36右，新航635。

cards.audioText: [Tell tower you have taken off.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉塔台你已经起飞。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA635, airborne runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航635，跑道36右起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA635, climb and maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，上升保持3000米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 3000m, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持3000米，新航635。

cards.audioText: [The cabin crew reported that there’s smoke coming from the air condition system in the cabin, make an urgency call and advise approach you want to level off at present level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【机组报告客舱内的空调系统冒烟了，做紧急呼叫，告诉进近你想在当前高度平飞。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, SIA635, smoke in cabin, request maintain present level.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉进近，新航635，客舱冒烟，请求保持当前高度。

cards.audioText: [Smoke is removed, you have turned off the air condition system, you want radar vectors to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【烟清除了，你关闭了空调系统，需要雷达引导至武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA635, cancel PANPAN, request radar vector to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，新航635，取消PANPAN，请求雷达引导至武汉机场。

cards.audioText: [To avoid high cabin altitude, ask to descent below 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【为了避免座舱压力过高，请求下降至3000米以下。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA635, request descent below 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，新航635，请求下降3000米以下。

cards.audioText: SIA635, descend and maintain 2700m on QNH 1016.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1016。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 2700m on QNH 1016, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压2700米, 修正海压1016，新航635。

cards.audioText: SIA635, Approach, do you need any emergency services?[Tell the controller that because there’s no passenger injury and the aircraft had no damage, you needn’t emergency services.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，进近，你需要紧急服务么？【告诉管制员飞机上没有乘客受伤，机身也未损坏，因而不需要紧急服务。】
cards.referenceText: Negative, no passengers injury and no aircraft damage, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不需要紧急服务，没有乘客受伤，机身也未损坏，新航635。

cards.audioText: [You are SIA151 from Singapore to Shanghai, now you are in Hong Kong area, cruising level at FL390, you are encountering severe icing at FL390 and want lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是新航151，从新加坡飞往上海，现在在香港空域，巡航高度层390，你在高度层390遇到了强烈积冰，想下降到较低高度。】
cards.referenceText: Hong Kong Radar, SIA151, request lower level due severe icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港雷达，新航151，由于强烈积冰，请求较更低高度。

cards.audioText: SIA151, Hong Kong Radar, descend and maintain FL310, reach FL310 within 4 minutes.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，香港雷达，下降保持高度层310，4分钟到。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain FL310, reach FL310 within 4 minutes, SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持高度层310，4分钟到，新航151。

cards.audioText: [During descending, you observed lightning to your right and aircraft was shaking, you suspect you have suffered lightning strike. Tell ATC this situation and request 10nm deviation to the left.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【下降时，你发现右侧有闪电，机身一直摇晃，怀疑遭到了雷击。告诉ATC当前状况，请求向左偏航10海里。】
cards.referenceText: Hong Kong Control, SIA151, request 10nm deviation to the left due weather and we suspect we have suffered lightning strike.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港区调，新航151，由于天气原因，同时我们怀疑飞机遭到了雷击，请求向左偏10海里。

cards.audioText: SIA151, deviation 10nm to the left approved.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，可以向左偏10海里。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Deviation 10nm to the left. SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向左偏10海里。新航151。

cards.audioText: [The purser report there is strange smell coming from the rear cabin. Tell ATC this situation and request further descent as a precaution.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【乘务长报告称后舱内传出异味。告诉ATC该情况，同时请求进一步下降作为预防措施。】
cards.referenceText: Hong Kong Control, SIA151, there is strange smell from our rear cabin, request descent as a precaution.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港区调，新航151，飞机后舱有异味，请求下降作为预防。

cards.audioText: SIA151, continue descend and maintain FL250.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，继续下降到高度层250保持。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain FL250, SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持高度层250，新航151。

cards.audioText: SIA151, confirm dangerous cargo on board?[Tell ATC you are carrying some flammable liquid in the aft cargo compartment.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，证实机上是否有危险物品？【告诉ATC后货舱内有一些易燃液体。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we are carrying some flammable liquid in the aft cargo compartment. SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的， 飞机后货舱内有一些易燃液体。新航151。

cards.audioText: SIA151, roger.[Now smoke start coming out from floor in the aft cabin, so you decide immediately divert to Hong Kong. Declare emergency and make a distress call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，收到。【客舱后部地板下有烟雾冒出，因此你决定立即改航至香港。宣布紧急状态并发布遇险信号。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY Hong Kong Radar, SIA151, smoke in cabin, request diversion to Hong Kong.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY，香港雷达，新航151，客舱有烟，请求备降香港。

cards.audioText: SIA151, roger MAYDAY, fly heading 010, descend and maintain FL110.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，收到MAYDAY，航向010，下降保持高度层110。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Fly heading 010, descend and maintain FL110. SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航向010，下降保持高度层110。新航151。

cards.audioText: [Tell ATC you may stop on runway and evacuate passengers there.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉ATC你可能停在跑道上疏散乘客。】
cards.referenceText: Hong Kong Control, SIA151, we may stop on runway and evacuate passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港区调，新航151，我们可能停在跑道上疏散乘客。

cards.audioText: SIA151, roger. What kind of emergency service do you need?[Tell ATC, you need fire service and medical service to be attendance near runway.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，收到。你需要哪种紧急服务？【告诉ATC，你需要消防及医疗服务在跑道附近准备好。】
cards.referenceText: We require fire service and medical service to be ready near runway, SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们需要消防及医疗服务在跑道附近就位，新航151。

cards.audioText: SIA151, fire and medical services will be ready.[After discharged the fire extinguisher and applied smoke procedure, the smoke stopped and is controlled. Tell ATC your situation and cancel the distress.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，消防及医疗服务将在跑道附近就位。【使用灭火器并执行烟雾程序后，烟雾被控制住，停止冒出。告诉ATC该情况并取消遇险信号。】
cards.referenceText: Hong Kong Control, SIA151, smoke is now controlled, cancel distress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港区调，新航151，烟雾已经被控制住了，取消遇险。

cards.audioText: SIA151, roger. Do you want continuing to Hong Kong?[Tell ATC you still need to land at Hong Kong as a precaution.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，收到。你还要继续前往香港么？【告诉ATC，为了预防你还需要备降香港。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request land at Hong Kong as a precaution, SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，以防万一请求降落在香港，新航151。

cards.audioText: SIA151, contact Approach on 119.1.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，联系进近119.1。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Approach on 119.1, SIA151.

cards.audioText: [Call Hong Kong Approach and tell controller you are in urgency situation, ask priority land.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【呼叫香港进近，告诉管制员你处于紧急状态，请求优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Hong Kong Approach, SIA151, smoke in cabin, request priority land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，新航151，客舱有烟雾，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: SIA151, descend and maintain 4000ft, fly heading 340 to join right base, report airfield in sight.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，下降保持4000尺，航向340加入右四边，看见机场时报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4000ft, fly heading 340 to join right base, report airfield in sight. SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4000尺，航向340加入右四边，看见跑道报告，新航151。

cards.audioText: [Tell ATC you need to park at remote area and disembark passengers there.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉ATC你需要停在远机位，让乘客在那里下飞机。】
cards.referenceText: Hong Kong Approach, SIA151, request to park at the remote apron and disembark passengers there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，新航151，请求在停在远机位，让乘客在那里下飞机。

cards.audioText: SIA151, we will relay your require to flight operation department.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，我们会将你的需求传达给飞行运行部门。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，新航151。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is SIA233. Stand 215, from Wuhan to Singapore, information B. Request ATC clearance to Singapore.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是新航233，215号机位，从武汉飞往新加坡，通播B，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA233, Stand 215, information B, destination Singapore, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航233，215号机位，通播B，目的地新加坡，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。

cards.audioText: SIA233, Wuhan Delivery cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 36R, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 6325.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，武汉放行，可以按计划航路放行至新加坡，LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道36右，离场频率119.7，应答机6325。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 36R, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 6325, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至新加坡，LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道36右，离场频率119.7，应答机6325, 新航233。

cards.audioText: [You are now ready, contact Ground to request pushback and start-up.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在准备好了，联系地面，请求推出开车]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA233, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航233，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA233, Wuhan Ground, pushback and startup approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，武汉地面，同意推出开车，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and startup approved, facing east, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，面朝东，新航233。

cards.audioText: [While taxiing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑行时，你注意到风袋显示有强烈顺风，联系塔台检查风向风速。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA233, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航233，证实风向风速。

cards.audioText: SIA233, surface wind 220 degrees, 8m/s.[The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit. Contact Tower to change to runway 18L and state the reason.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，地面风220，8米/秒。【该风速超过你的起飞限制。联系塔台更换至跑道18左并说明原因。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA233, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航233，该风速超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换跑道18左。

cards.audioText: SIA233, contact Ground 121.6.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，联系地面121.6。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Contact Ground 121.6, SIA233.

cards.audioText: [Contact Ground 121.6.]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA233 with you.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航233，听你指挥。

cards.audioText: SIA233, taxi to holding point runway 18L via E, D4, F.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，沿滑行道E，D4，F滑至跑道18左的等待点。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18L via E, D4, and F, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道E，D4，F滑至跑道18左的等待点，新航233。

cards.audioText: [After you pass taxiway E, you saw a cone lying on the taxiway D4, tell the controller what you have seen.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑过滑行道E后，你看到滑行道D4上有一个路障，告诉管制员你看到的情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA233, there is a cone lying on the taxiway D4 and it blocks my taxiway. Request assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航233，滑行道D4上有一个路障，它堵住了我的滑行道。请求援助。

cards.audioText: SIA233, roger that. Hold present position.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，收到。原地等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Holding, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，新航233。

cards.audioText: [You have departed from runway 18L, shortly after liftoff, you encountered a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an urgency call, request maintain runway heading.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已在跑道18左起飞，起飞后不久，飞机遭到了鸟击，右侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, SIA233, right engine failure due bird strike, request maintain runway heading.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉塔台，新航233，由于鸟击，右侧发动机失效，请求保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: [Tell the tower you want to dump fuel and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉塔台你想放油之后返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA233 request fuel dumping and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航233，请求放油，之后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: SIA 233, Tower, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO VOR 30 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，塔台，收到PANPAN，右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米，新航233。

cards.audioText: SIA233, after passing LKO, left heading 220, maintain 3000m, report over LKO.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，飞过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持，过LKO报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, left heading 220, maintaining 3000m, report over LKO, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持，过LKO报告，新航233。

cards.audioText: [You are over LKO, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你飞过LKO了，呼叫武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA233, over LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，新航233，过LKO。

cards.audioText: SIA233, advise the time required for fuel jettison.[Tell Wuhan Control you need approximately 25 min.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，报告放油需要的时间。【告诉武汉区调你需要大约25分钟。】
cards.referenceText: We need about 25min, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们需要大约25分钟，新航233。

cards.audioText: [Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉武汉进近放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道22。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA233, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，新航233，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道22。

cards.audioText: [You are now established on ILS approach runway 22, contact Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立盲降进近跑道22，联系塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA233, established ILS approach runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航233，建立盲降进近跑道22。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is SIA854, you are at Wuhan Airport, Stand 7, received ATIS M, request ATC clearance to Singapore.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是新航854，你在武汉机场，7号机位，收到通播M，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA854, Stand 7, information M, destination Singapore, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航854，7号机位，通播M，目的地新加坡，申请ATC放行。

cards.audioText: SIA854, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, ZF-03D departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往新加坡，ZF-03D离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道18左，离场频率124.7，应答机4615。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, ZF-03D departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往新加坡，ZF-03D离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道18左，离场频率124.7，应答机4615，新航854。

cards.audioText: [Now you are ready for pushback and start-up, contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已准备好推出开车，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA854, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航854，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA854, delay for pushback and start-up due flow control.[Read back the instructions and ask Ground how long the delay will be?]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，由于流量控制，推迟推出开车。【复诵指令并询问地面要延误多久。】
cards.referenceText: Standby, request how long will be delay, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，要延误多长时间？新航854。

cards.audioText: SIA854, delay about a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，延误几分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，新航854。

cards.audioText: [A few minutes later, contact Ground request a new clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【几分钟后，联系地面请求新的放行许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA854, request pushback and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航854，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA854, pushback and start-up at own discretion.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，自行推出开车。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up at own discretion, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自行推出开车，新航854。

cards.audioText: [You have completed the pushback and start-up procedures, you decided to make an intersection departure from E2. Contact Ground to request intersection departure from E2.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已完成推出开车程序，决定从滑行道E2减跑道起飞。联系地面，请求从滑行道E2减跑道起飞。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA854, request an intersection departure from E2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航854，请求在滑行道E2减跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA854, intersection departure from E2 approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of runway 18L.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，可以在滑行道E2进跑道起飞。沿滑行道A6, A, A2滑行至滑行道E2，在跑道18左外等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E2 approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of runway 18L, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以从滑行道E2进跑道起飞。沿滑行道A6，A，A2滑至滑行道E2，在跑道18左外等待，新航854。

cards.audioText: [During taxiing, you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about this situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑行中，你发现滑行道A上有一抛锚车辆，你停下飞机，通知ATC该情况，请求机场服务拖走该车辆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA854, there is a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, we stopped the aircraft, request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航854，滑行道A上有一抛锚车辆，我们停下飞机，请求机场服务拖走该车辆。

cards.audioText: SIA854, hold at present position. The ramp services will be there in a few minutes.[You are now holding short of runway 18L on E2. Request for departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，原地等待。机场服务几分钟后到。【你现在在滑行道E2，跑道18左外等待。请求离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA854, holding short of runway 18L on E2. Request line up and departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航854，滑行道E2上跑道18左外等待。请求上跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA854, Wuhan Tower, cleared for line up and takeoff, runway 18L.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，武汉塔台，可以进跑道起飞，跑道18左。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared for line up and takeoff runway 18L, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以进跑道18左起飞，新航854。

cards.audioText: [During the takeoff roll, your nose wheel ran over a sharp object on the runway surface and a nose wheel tire burst. You aborted takeoff. Notify Wuhan Tower and request fire engines and maintenance..]
cards.audioTextZh: 【起飞滑跑时，飞机前轮碾过锋利的道面上的锋利物体，前胎爆炸。你中止起飞。通知武汉塔台，请求消防车和维修服务。】
cards.referenceText: (Panpan Panpan Panpan) Wuhan Tower, SIA854, we aborted takeoff due ran over a sharp object and our nose wheel tire burst, request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: (Panpan Panpan Panpan) 武汉塔台，新航854，我们飞机前轮碾过道面上的锋利物体，前胎爆炸，中断起飞了，请求消防车和维修服务。

cards.audioText: SIA854, do you want any assistance?[Tell ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after initial inspection.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，需要援救么？【告诉ATC，你需要一辆拖车在初检后把飞机拖回停机坪。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request a tow truck back to the apron, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，需要一辆拖车把飞机拖回停机坪，新航854。

cards.audioText: SIA854, the tow truck is on the way. Contact Ground 121.75.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，拖车马上到。联系地面121.75。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Thank you, Ground 121.75, SIA854.

cards.audioText: [Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron after contact Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系地面，请求在停机坪处准备好客梯车及摆渡车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA854, request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航854，请求在停机坪处准备好客梯车及摆渡车。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is SIA786, you are parking at Gate 217, you have got information P, call Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance to Singapore.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是新航786，停在217号机位，已收到通播P，呼叫武汉放行，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery. SIA786, Gate 217, information P, destination Singapore, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航786，217号机位，通播P，目的地新加坡，向ATC申请放行。

cards.audioText: SIA786 Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10700m. Departure frequency 124.35, squawk 2067.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，武汉放行，可以按计划航路放行至新加坡。LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10700米。离场频率124.35，应答机2067。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10700m. Departure frequency 124.35, squawk 2067, SIA786.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至新加坡。LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10700米。离场频率124.35，应答机2067，新航786。

cards.audioText: [Tell ATC because heavy weight, can’t accept 10700m, request 9500m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉ATC由于机身过重，10700米不可用，请求9500米。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA786, negative 10700m due weight, request 9500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航786，由于重量，高度10700米不可用，请求9500米。

cards.audioText: [You are on the taxiway A, with engine start completed, contact Ground. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在滑行道A上，发动机已全部启动，联系地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA786 start-up completed, taxiway A, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航786发动机起动完成，在滑行道A上，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: SIA786, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point runway 36 via Z4 and A, hold short of E7.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，武汉地面，沿滑行道Z4，A滑行至跑道36等待点，在E7外等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36 via Z4 and A hold short of E7, SIA786.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A滑行至跑道36等待点，E7外等待，新航786。

cards.audioText: Request E7 intersection departure runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: 【请求从滑行道E7进跑道36起飞。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA786, request E7 intersection departure runway 36.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航786，请求从滑行道E7进跑道36起飞。

cards.audioText: Negative due sequencing.[A few minutes later.]SIA786, cleared for takeoff, runway 36, surface wind 350, 5 knots.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 不可以需要排序。【几分钟后。】新航786，可以起飞，跑道36，地面风350，5节。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 36, SIA786.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道36，新航786。

cards.audioText: SIA786, contact Departure on 118.98.
[After 5 hours. You are approaching Singapore airport, your landing gear can’t be extended, report this to Singapore Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【5小时后。你正在接近新加坡机场，飞机起落架无法放下，向新加坡进近报告该情况。】
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA786, our landing gear can’t be extended.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航786，我们的起落架无法放下。

cards.audioText: SIA786, say intention?[Tell ATC you want to terminate the approach, maintain 3000ft runway heading, complete the abnormal procedure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，请示意图？【告诉管制员你想中止进近，保持3000英尺，保持跑道航向，完成非正常程序。】
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA786, go around, request maintain runway heading and climb to 3000ft to complete abnormal procedure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航786，复飞了，请求保持跑道航向，爬升至3000英尺，完成非正常情况程序。

cards.audioText: [After finishing the checklist, you find your landing gear still can't be down, inform ATC and request low pass for visual check.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【完成检查单后，飞机起落架无法放下，向ATC请求低空通场以目视检查。】
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA786, our landing gear jammed, request low pass for visual check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航786，飞机起落架卡阻，请求低空通场目视检查。

cards.audioText: SIA786, low pass approved.[You are flying low pass the runway, ask Tower whether they saw the gear down normally.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，可以低空通场。【飞机在跑道上低空通场，询问塔台，起落架是否可以正常放下。】
cards.referenceText: Singapore Tower, SIA786, confirm gears down normally?
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡塔台，新航786，证实起落架能否正常放下？

cards.audioText: SIA786, your landing gear didn’t down.[Tell Tower you decided to land without part of landing gears, ask for foam runway and fire engines. In case of the land without gears, the medical assistance is necessary. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，起落架没放下。【告诉塔台你打算进行无部分起落架降落，请求提供跑道和消防车。假如无起落架降落，医疗援助是很必要的。】
cards.referenceText: Singapore Tower, SIA786, request fire engines and medical assistance due land part gears up. The foam runway is necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡塔台，新航786，由于实施部分起落架降落，请求提供消防车和医疗援助。需要泡沫跑道。

cards.audioText: SIA786, roger, the association assistance will be ready in second.[You are inbound of approach, call Tower and ask land instruction.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，收到，援助组织马上准备好。【你正在向台进近，呼叫塔台，请求着陆指令。】
cards.referenceText: Singapore Tower, SIA786, established the localizer, request land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡塔台，新航786，已建立航道，请求着陆。

cards.audioText: SIA786, cleared to land, wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，可以着陆，静风。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, SIA786.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，新航786。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is SIA497, you are at Wuhan Airport, Gate 215, information P received, request ATC clearance to Singapore.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是新航497，你现在在武汉机场，215号停机位，通播P，请求飞往新加坡的放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA497, gate 215, information P, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航497，215号停机位，通播P，请求飞往新加坡的放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA497, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800m, cruising level 10700m, runway 36R, frequency 119.7, squawk 2706.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航497，可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10700米，跑道36右，频率119.7，应答机2706。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial 1800m, cruising level 10700m, runway 36R, contact 119.7, squawk 2706. SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10700米，跑道36右，频率119.7，应答机2706，新航497。

cards.audioText: [Now you are on taxiway Z4 with the engines running, ask for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在Z4滑行道，发动机启动，请求滑行许可]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA497, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航497，Z4滑行道，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: SIA497, taxi to runway 36R via Z4, A, hold short of E7.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航497，经由Z4，A，滑行至跑道36右，在E7外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to runway 36R via Z4, A, hold short of E7. SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4，A，滑行至跑道36右，在E7外等待，新航497。

cards.audioText: [When taxi along taxiway A, ask for intersection departure from E5.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你沿着A滑行道滑行时，请求从E5减跑道起飞]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA497, taxiway A, request intersection departure from E5
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航497，A滑行道，请求从E5减跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: Negative due sequencing, continue taxi to holding point of runway 36R, hold short of E7.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于排序，不可以，继续滑行至跑道36右，在E7外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 36R, hold short of E7. SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 滑行至跑道36右，在E7外等待，新航497。

cards.audioText: [Now you are airborne, 600m climbing, contact departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在你离地了，600米爬升中，联系离场]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA497, airborne, 600m climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，新航497，离地了，600米爬升中。

cards.audioText: SIA497, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb to 3000m, QNH1021.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航497，雷达识别，左转直飞DA，爬升至3000米，修正海压1021。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb to 3000m, QNH1021, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，爬升至3000米，修正海压1021，新航497。

cards.audioText: [When you are approaching Singapore airport, your landing gears cannot be extended normally. Report this situation to Singapore airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你接近新加坡机场，你的起落架无法正常放下，将此情况报告给新加坡机场]
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, we can't extend the landing gears normally.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航497，我们无法正常放下起落架。

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller you want to terminate approach, maintain 600m on runway heading to complete abnormal procedures.]
cards.audioTextZh: [告诉管制员，你想终止进近，跑道航向保持600米，执行不正常程序]
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, request terminate approach, request maintain 600m on runway heading to carry out abnormal procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航497，请求终止进近，请求跑道航向保持600米执行不正常程序。

cards.audioText: [Now the landing gear is extended normally, but you lost nose wheel steering, request a tug after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 现在起落架正常放下，但是你失去前轮转弯，落地后，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, the landing gear is extended normally, but we lost nose wheel steering, request a tug after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航497，起落架可以正常放下，但是我们失去前轮转弯，落地后，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: Roger, tug will be ready after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，拖车在落地后就位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks. SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，新航497。

cards.audioText: Expect ILS approach runway 18L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计ILS进近，跑道18左，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: ILS approach runway 18L, report established, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: ILS进近，跑道18左，建立后报，新航497。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA852, you are at Wuhan Airport, stand 7, received ATIS M, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是新航852，你现在在武汉机场，7号停机位，收到机场通播M，请求飞往新加坡的放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA852, Stand 7, Information M, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新加坡852，停机位7号，通播M，请求飞往新加坡的放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA852, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, ZF 03D departure, initial climb to 1800m, cruising level 10400m, RWY 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，ZF03离场（程序），初始爬升高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道18左，离场频率124.7，应答机4615。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, ZF 03D departure, initial 1800m, cruising level 10400m, RWY 18L, contact 124.7, squawk 4615, SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，ZF03离场（程序），初始爬升高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道18左，离场频率124.7，应答机4615，新航852。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你准备好推出开车了，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航852，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText:
SIA852, delay for push back and start up due flow control.
[Read back the instruction and ask how long the delay will be.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航852，由于流控，推迟推出开车。
[复诵信息，并询问延误时间多久。]
cards.referenceText: Delay for push back and start up due flow control. How long is the delay? SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于流控，推迟推出开车，延误多久？新航852。

cards.audioText: SIA852, delay about a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，延误几分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，新航852。

cards.audioText: A few minutes later, contact Ground and request a new clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 几分钟后，联系地面，请求新的许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航852，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA852, push back and start up at your own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，自行决定推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up at own discretion, SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自行决定推出开车，新航852。

cards.audioText: You have completed the pushback and start up procedure, you decided to make an intersection departure from E2. Contact Ground to request intersection departure from E2.
cards.audioTextZh: 你完成了推出和开车程序，你决定从滑行道E2进行减跑道起飞，联系地面，请求从E2进行减跑道起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, completed pushback and start up. Request intersection departure from E2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航852，完成推出开车，请求从E2进行减跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA852, intersection departure from E2 is approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of RWY 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，可以从E2进行减跑道起飞，经由A6,A,A2，滑行至E2，跑道18左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E2 is approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of RWY 18L, SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以从E2进行减跑道起飞，经由A6,A,A2，滑行至E2，跑道18左外等待，新航852。

cards.audioText: During taxiing, you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about this situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: 在滑行过程中，你发现一辆汽车在滑行道A上抛锚了。你停下了飞机，告知管制员此情况，请求机场服务拖走汽车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, we stopped taxiing due to a vehicle broken down on taxiway, request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航852，滑行道上有汽车抛锚，我们停止滑行，请求机场服务拖走汽车。

cards.audioText: SIA852, hold at present position. The ramp services will be there in a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，在当前位置等待，机坪服务将在几分钟后到达。
cards.referenceText: Holding at present position, SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置等待，新航852。

cards.audioText: You are now holding short of RWY 18L on E2. Request for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在滑行道E2，跑道18左外等待，请求起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA852, we are holding short of RWY 18L on E2. Request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航852，我们在滑行道E2，跑道18左外等待，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA852, cleared for takeoff, runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，可以起飞，跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 18L. SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道18左，新航852。

cards.audioText: During the takeoff roll, your nose wheel ran over a sharp object on the runway surface and a nose wheel tire burst, you aborted takeoff. Notify Wuhan Tower and request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: 在起飞滑跑期间，你的前轮碾过跑道表面上的尖锐物，前轮爆胎，你中断起飞了，通知武汉塔台，请求消防车以及机务维修人员。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA852, we aborted takeoff due nose wheel tire burst. Request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航852，由于前轮爆胎，我们中断起飞了，请求消防车和机务维修人员。

cards.audioText:
SIA852, do you require anything else?
Tell ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after inspection.
cards.audioTextZh:
新航852，你还请求别的吗？
[告诉管制员，检查完飞机后，你需要一辆拖车，将飞机拖回机坪]
cards.referenceText: Affirm. Request a tug to tow back to the apron after inspection, SIA852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，检查完飞机后，请求一辆拖车，将飞机拖回机坪，新航852。

cards.audioText: SIA852, the tug is on the way. Contact ground 121.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航852，拖车在路上了，联系地面121.75。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, 121.75, SIA852.

cards.audioText: Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: [请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪待命]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA852, request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航852，请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪待命。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is SIA323. Stand 217, from Wuhan to Singapore, information V. Request ATC clearance to Singapore.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是新航323，217号停机位，从武汉飞往新加坡，通播V，请求飞往新加坡的飞行的许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA323, stand217, information V, destination Singapore, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航323, 217号停机位，通播V，目的地新加坡，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA323, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 9800m, runway 36R, when airborne, contact departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3652.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，武汉放行，可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-02离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度9800米，跑道36右，离地后，联系离场频率119.7，应答机3652。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 9800m, runway 36R, when airborne, contact departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3652. SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往新加坡，LKO-02离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度9800米，跑道36右，离地后，联系离场频率119.7，应答机3652，新航323。

cards.audioText: [You are now ready, contact Ground to request pushback and start-up.]
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你准备好了，联系地面，请求推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA323, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航323，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA323, Wuhan Ground, after A330 behind, pushback and start-up, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，武汉地面，在A330后，推出开车，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: After A330 behind, pushback and start-up, facing east, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在A330后，推出开车，面朝东，新航323。

cards.audioText: [Now you are at holding point of runway 36R, contact Tower for takeoff clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在跑道36右外等待点，联系塔台，请求起飞许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA323. We are at holding point of runway 36R, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航323，我们现在在跑道36右外等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA323, surface wind light and variable, cleared for takeoff, runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，地面轻风，风向多变，可以起飞，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 36R, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道36右，新航323。

cards.audioText: [During takeoff rolling, you find there is a ground vehicle crossing runway 36R. Tell ATC your decision to abort takeoff due runway incursion. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 在起飞滑跑中，你发现一辆地面车辆正在穿越跑道36右，告诉管制员，由于跑道入侵，你决定中断起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA323, we are aborting takeoff due runway incursion, a ground vehicle is crossing runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航323，由于跑道入侵，我们中断起飞了，一辆汽车正在穿越跑道。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, roger that, advise intentions when able.
[Now you have vacated runway and checked everything is normal, you want to change runway 36L for departure. Tell Tower. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，收到，可以的时候告知意图。
现在你已经脱离跑道，检查一切正常，你想更换至跑道36左起飞，告知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA323, everything is normal now, request change runway 36L for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航323，现在一切正常，请求更换至跑道36左起飞。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, standby for your request. Can you accept intersection departure from Z4?
[Tell tower you can not accept Z4 intersection departure because of your aircraft performance. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，稍等，你可以接受从Z4减跑道起飞吗？
告诉塔台，由于飞机性能，你无法接受从Z4减跑道起飞
cards.referenceText: Negative intersection departure due performance, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于性能，无法减跑道起飞，新航323。

cards.audioText: SIA323, change runway 36L for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，更换至跑道36左起飞。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36L, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36左，新航323。

cards.audioText: [You have departed from RWY 36L, shortly after liftoff, your starboard engine was on fire, and the EGT is very high, so you have to shut down this engine, make a distress call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你已经从跑道36左起飞，起飞不久后，你右侧发动机起火，排气温度非常高，因此你关闭了该发动机，做遇险通话。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. Wuhan Tower, SIA323, right engine on fire, EGT is too high, we are shutting down the engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. 武汉塔台，新航323，右侧发动机起火，排气温度过高，我们关闭了该发动机。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, roger MAYDAY. Say your intention.
[Tell the Tower you want to jettison fuel and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，收到MAYDAY，说出你的意图。
告诉塔台，你想放油，然后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Request fuel dumping and return to Wuhan airport, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求放油，返回武汉机场， 新航323。

cards.audioText: SIA323, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO VOR 030 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，右转航向240，切LKO VOR 030向台径向线，上3000米保持。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切LKO 030径向向台，上3000米保持，新航323。

cards.audioText: SIA323, after passing LKO, left heading 220, maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航323，过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, left heading 220, maintain 3000m, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持，新航323。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, advise the time required for fuel jettison.
[Tell Wuhan Approach you need approximately 18 minutes.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，告知放油所用时间。
告诉武汉进近，你需要18分钟。
cards.referenceText: We need about 18 minutes for fuel dumping, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们需要大约18分钟放油，新航323。

cards.audioText: [Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.]
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉武汉进近，完成放油，请求雷达引导至跑道22。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA323, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector for runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，新航323，完成放油，请求雷达引导至跑道22。

cards.audioText: [You are now established on ILS approach runway 22, contact Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在建立ILS进近，跑道22，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA323, established ILS approach runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航323，建立ILS进近，跑道22。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, do you need any assistance upon landing?
[inform Tower you need to order emergency evacuation after landing, request a shuttle bus to take passengers to the terminal.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，着陆后需要任何协助吗？
告诉塔台，你需要在着陆后组织紧急撤离，请求一辆摆渡车，将乘客送至航站楼。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we need to perform emergency evacuation, request shuttle bus on arrival, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们需要执行紧急撤离，着陆后请求摆渡车。

topics.name: AFR 113 左发失效 乘客中风

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 113, you're holding at holding point E1, Runway 04, you are fully ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 AFR 113，你在 E1 等待点，跑道 04，已完全准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 113, holding at holding point E1, Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 113，在 E1 等待点，跑道 04，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，在当前位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置等待，AFR 113。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 113, hold at present position, do you have the traffic on short final in sight?
B: Tell the controller yes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：AFR 113，在当前位置等待，你看到短五边航空器了吗？
B：告诉管制员看到了。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, traffic in sight, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，看到航空器，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, behind the CES 737 on short final, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，跟在短五边的 CES 737 后面，跟随其后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind the CES 737 on short final, line up behind, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟在短五边的 CES 737 后面，跟随其后进跑道，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact Departure 120.2.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，可以起飞，离地后联系离场 120.2。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact Departure 120.2, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，离地后联系离场 120.2，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: You are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure, ask if you can cancel the SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场，询问是否可以取消 SID 并直飞 LKO。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 113, passing 900 meters, request cancel the SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 113，正通过 900 米，请求取消 SID 并直飞 LKO。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, radar identified, continue climb to 2400 meters, turn right to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，雷达识别，继续爬升至 2400 米，右转至 LKO。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 2400 meters, turn right to LKO, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 2400 米，右转至 LKO，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, climb to 4500 meters and contact Wuhan Control 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，爬升至 4500 米并联系武汉管制119.7。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4500 meters and contact Wuhan Control 119.7, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 4500 米并联系武汉管制119.7，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: Your position is just over LKO, the next waypoint is DAPRO, ETA at time 34, make the standard position report and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的位置刚好在 LKO 上空，下一个航路点是 DAPRO，预计到达时间 34，做标准位置报告并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 113, over LKO, ETA DAPRO 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 113，飞越 LKO，预计 DAPRO 34，请求爬升。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，爬升至5100米，无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至5100米，无速度限制，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: During the climb, your port engine fails, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升过程中左发失效，请向管制员报告情况并申请返航着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR 113, our port engine fails, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，AFR 113，我们左发失效，申请返航着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Roger PAN, AFR 113, descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到紧急信号，AFR 113，下降至1800米，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至1800米，右转航向360，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, contact Approach 119.85.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，联系进近119.85。

cards.audioText: B: Your altitude is 1800 meters, you have information S, contact Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你当前高度1800米，已收到通播S，请联系进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 113, 1800 meters, information S.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 113，1800米，通播S。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 113, current information is T, descend to 900 meters, expect radar vectors for ILS Runway 36L.
B: Read back and ask to use Runway 36R to land due to performance limitations.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，当前通播为T，下降至900米，预计雷达引导ILS进近36左跑道。请复诵，并因性能限制申请使用36右跑道落地。
cards.referenceText: Information T, descend to 900 meters, expect radar vectors for ILS Runway 36L, request Runway 36R due performance, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播T，下降至900米，预计雷达引导ILS进近36L；因性能限制申请36R，AFR 113。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 113, change landing Runway 36R.
B: You have just got the information from the cabin that 1 of your passengers suffered a stroke during the incident, informed the controller and ask for ambulance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，改为36右跑道落地。你刚从客舱获知，一名旅客在事件中突发中风，请通知管制员并申请落地后救护车保障。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 113, 1 of our passengers suffered stroke, request ambulance after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 113，我们有一名旅客中风，申请落地后救护车保障。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, AFR 113, we will notify airport medical assistance, now turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，AFR 113，我们会通知机场医疗保障。现在左转航向330，下降至600米，可以ILS进近36右跑道。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，左转航向330，下降至600米，可以ILS进近36R，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告你已截获36右跑道航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 113, established on the localizer Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 113，已建立36R航向道。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, contact Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，联系塔台124.35。

topics.name: AFR 782 厕所冒烟 作PA 乘客烟熏

cards.audioText: B: You are the pilot of AFR 782 which is bound for Wuhan, you have just been handed over from Guangzhou Control, you are over DAPRO at time 35 and your level is 9500 meters, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你是飞往武汉的AFR 782，刚由广州管制移交，35分过DAPRO，高度9500米，请呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 782, over DAPRO at 35, maintain 9500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 782，35分过DAPRO，保持9500米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, Wuhan Control, radar identified, descend to 5100 meters before reaching LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，武汉管制，雷达识别，在到达LKO前下降至5100米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5100 meters before LKO, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 到LKO前下降至5100米，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over LKO at 5100 meters, you have copied the latest ATIS K, call Wuhan Approach control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在LKO上空，高度5100米，已收到最新通播K，请呼叫武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 782, maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, information K.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 782，保持5100米，过LKO，通播K。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow LKO-1A arrival, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1004.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，武汉进近，雷达联系，执行LKO-1A 进场，按QNH 1004下降并保持3300米。
cards.referenceText: Follow LKO-1A arrival, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1004, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行LKO-1A 进场，按QNH 1004下降并保持3300米，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: You've received a report from the flight attendant saying that there is smoke coming from the lavatory, you think it may develop into fire, so you declare distress to the ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务员报告洗手间有烟，你认为可能发展成火情，因此向空管宣布遇险。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, AFR 782, there is smoke coming from the lavatory, request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉进近，AFR 782，洗手间有烟，申请优先落地和应急保障。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, Wuhan Approach, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 040, descend to 2100 meters, radar vector to ILS approach Runway 36R, you have first priority.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，武汉进近，收到遇险信号，右转航向040，下降至2100米，雷达引导ILS进近36右跑道，你享有第一优先。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 040, descend to 2100 meters, radar vector to ILS approach Runway 36R, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向040，下降至2100米，雷达引导ILS进近36R，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: As the captain of the flight, you may want to make a passenger address. The PA may include: don't be panic, remain seated, the flight crew are experienced, ATC assistance is available to us, etc.
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，你可以向旅客广播。内容可包括：不要惊慌、保持就座、机组经验丰富、空管正在提供协助等。
cards.referenceText: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking, fasten your seatbelt and remain seated. Don't worry. Believe us, we are a very experienced flight crew, and we can control this situation, and air controller is ready to help us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 女士们、先生们，我是机长。请系好安全带并保持就座。请不要担心，相信我们，机组经验丰富，能够控制当前情况，空管也已准备好协助我们。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 782, Wuhan Approach, what is the situation on board now? keep us advised.
B: You are grateful for the reminding, report to ATC that more smoke accumulated in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing hard.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，武汉进近，目前机上情况如何？请随时通报。感谢提醒，并向空管报告客舱内烟雾越来越浓，旅客咳嗽严重。
cards.referenceText: Roger, the smoke is becoming more and more dense in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing more and more, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，客舱内烟雾越来越浓，旅客咳嗽越来越严重，AFR 782。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 782, Wuhan Approach, continue to descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1005, fire service and ambulance will be with you upon your landing.
B: You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，武汉进近，按QNH 1005继续下降至1200米，消防和救护车将在你落地时待命。请复诵许可并表示感谢。
cards.referenceText: Continue to descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1005, thank you very much, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1005继续下降至1200米，非常感谢，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: Now you report to ATC that you have already removed the dense smoke, 2 aged people and 1 baby are nearly suffocated, others are not seriously harmed.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在向空管报告，你们已经排除了浓烟，但两名老人和一名婴儿接近窒息，其他人没有严重受伤。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 782, we have removed the dense smoke, but 2 aged people and 1 baby are nearly suffocated, others are not seriously harmed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 782，我们已排除浓烟，但两名老人和一名婴儿接近窒息，其他人没有严重受伤。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, we'll relay this information to the parties concerned.
C: AFR 782, descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, you are Number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，我们会把信息转告相关单位。管制员：AFR 782，下降至900米，预计ILS进近36右跑道，你是第一架。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至900米，预计ILS进近36R，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: You are fully established on the ILS Runway 36R and your position is 12 Kilometers from touchdown, call Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已完全建立36右跑道ILS，距离接地点12公里，请呼叫武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 782, established on the ILS Runway 36R, 12 km from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 782，已建立36R ILS，距接地点12公里。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，继续进近，联系塔台118.6，再见。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, 118.6, AFR 782.

cards.audioText: B: Now contact Wuhan Tower, report to ATC that you are 11 Kilometers from touchdown on final, and you are emergency landing aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在联系武汉塔台，向空管报告你在五边，距接地点11公里，并且是紧急落地航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 782, 11 km on final, we have declared emergency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 782，五边11公里，我们已宣布紧急情况。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, radar identified, continue ILS approach Runway 36R, you are Number 1, report outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，雷达识别，继续ILS进近36右跑道，你是第一架，报告外指点标。
cards.referenceText: Continue ILS approach Runway 36R, report outer marker, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续ILS进近36R，报告外指点标，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: Now you're over outer marker, call Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你飞越外指点标，请呼叫武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 782, over outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 782，飞越外指点标。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, cleared to land Runway 36R, wind 340 degrees at 9 meters per second, QNH 1005.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，可以36右跑道落地，风向340度，风速9米/秒，QNH 1005。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 36R, QNH 1005, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以36R落地，QNH 1005，AFR 782。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 782, taxi to Number 5 Apron via taxiway E3, A, A8, the fire services and medical teams are waiting for you on the Apron.
B: You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，经滑行道E3、A、A8滑行至5号机坪，消防和医疗队已在机坪等待。请复诵许可并表示感谢。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to No.5 Apron via taxiway E3, A, A8, thank you very much, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道E3、A、A8滑行至5号机坪，非常感谢，AFR 782。

topics.name: AFR 941 右EGT波动 滑油压力下降 右发失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 941, you are descending through 3900 meters for 3600 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 941，正在从3900米下降至3600米，请联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 941, leaving 3900 meters for 3600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 941，离开3900米下降至3600米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, Wuhan Approach, radar identified, information E is current, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1004.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前通播为E，按QNH 1004下降并保持3000米。
cards.referenceText: Information E, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1004, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播E，按QNH 1004下降并保持3000米，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, descend and maintain 2400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed.
B: Read back the instruction and tell the controller that the clean configuration speed of your aircraft is 200 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，下降并保持2400米，减至最小光洁速度。请复诵指令，并告诉管制员你机型的光洁形态速度是200节。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 2400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed, our clean configuration speed is 200 knots, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持2400米，减至最小光洁速度，我们的光洁形态速度是200节，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, turn right heading 300, you are number 3, 25 miles from touchdown.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，右转航向300，你是第三架，距接地点25海里。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, roger, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向300，收到，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, turn left proceed direct DA, descend to and maintain 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，左转直飞DA，下降并保持2100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left proceed direct DA, descend to and maintain 2100 meters, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，下降并保持2100米，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, hold at DA as published.
B: Read back and ask the reason for holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，在DA按公布程序等待。请复诵并询问等待原因。
cards.referenceText: Hold at DA as published, what's the reason for holding? AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在DA按公布程序等待，请问等待原因？AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, there are having a runway inspection at the moment, expect to delay more than 15 minutes.
B: Read back the ATC instruction and report that you are entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，目前正在进行跑道检查，预计延误超过15分钟。请复诵空管指令，并报告你正在进入等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, we are entering the hold, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们正在进入等待，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: B: The EGT of your starboard engine is fluctuating, state the situation to the controller, ask to leave the holding pattern right away.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发排气温度波动，请向管制员说明情况，并申请立即脱离等待程序。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 941, the EGT of our starboard engine is fluctuating, request leave the holding pattern immediately.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 941，我们右发排气温度波动，申请立即脱离等待程序。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, roger, stand by, continue your hold, we're changing the landing sequence, expect call you in 2 minutes.
B: The oil pressure of your starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, state the situation to the controller, request immediate exit and request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，收到，请稍等，继续等待。我们正在调整落地顺序，预计2分钟后呼叫你。你的右发滑油压力正在快速下降，请向管制员说明情况，申请立即退出等待并下降。
cards.referenceText: The oil pressure of our starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, request immediate exit and descent, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们右发滑油压力正在快速下降，申请立即退出等待并下降，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, stand by, a traffic at your 3 o'clock position, is maintaining 1800 meters, crossing from your right to the left, report visual.
B: Tell the controller you have seen the conflicting aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，请稍等。你三点钟方向有冲突飞机，保持1800米，从你右侧向左侧穿越，看到请报告。告诉管制员你已看到冲突飞机。
cards.referenceText: Traffic in sight, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 看到该飞机，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: B: Your starboard engine has failed, make an Urgency call and ask for landing priority.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发已经失效，请发出紧急信号并申请优先落地。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, AFR 941, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，AFR 941，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, roger PAN, turn left heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，收到紧急信号，左转航向060，下降至900米，可以ILS进近36左跑道。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36L, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向060，下降至900米，可以ILS进近36L，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, contact Wuhan Tower, frequency 124.35, goodbye.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，联系武汉塔台，频率124.35，再见。

cards.audioText: B: Your heading is 060 and your altitude is 900 meters, contact Wuhan Tower and tell him about the condition of the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 你当前航向060，高度900米，请联系武汉塔台并说明飞机状况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 941, heading 060, 900 meters, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 941，航向060，900米，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, AFR 941, maintain present heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，AFR 941，保持当前航向。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，左转航向030，截获36左跑道航向道。
