cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在Z4滑行道，发动机已启动，请向地面管制申请滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，Z4滑行道，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, taxi to holding point Runway 04via Z4 and A, hold short of A4.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，经 Z4 和 A 滑行至 Runway 04 等待点，在 A4 前等待。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 04via taxiway Z four and A, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4 和 A 滑行至 Runway 04 等待点，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, give way to B737 vacating on E3, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A9, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，给正在 E3 脱离的 B737 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 和 A9 滑行道继续滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: give way to Boeing 737 vacating on E tree, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A niner, hold short of Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给正在 E3 脱离的 Boeing 737 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 和 A9 滑行道继续滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne at 600 meters climbing, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，600米爬升中，请联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, airborne, 600 meters climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，已离地，600米爬升中。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, radar contact, turn left, direct to DAL A, climb to 3000 meters on QNH1015.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，雷达识别，左转直飞 DAL A，在 QNH 1015 上爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: turn left, direct to DAL A, climb to 3000 meters QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DAL A，在 QNH 1015 上爬升至 3000 米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, climb to 6000 meters, expedite passing 3900m.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，爬升至 6000 米，加速爬升直至通过 3900m。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 6000 meters, expedite climb until passing 3900, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 6000 米，加速爬升直至通过 3900，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6000 meters, request higher level and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持6000米时遇到中度结冰，请申请更高高度并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, we are experiencing moderate icing at 6000 meters, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，我们在6000米遇到中度结冰，申请更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, negative due traffic, maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，因冲突飞机不能同意，保持6000米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 6000 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持6000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: Suddenly your left engine has failed at 6000 meters, make an urgency call to ATC and request to descend and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的左发突然在 6000 米失效，向 ATC 发出紧急呼叫，并请求下降和返回武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, our left engine failed at 6000 meters, request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉离场，AFR 101，我们的左发在 6000 米失效，请求下降并返回武汉机场落地。

cards.audioText: AFR 101, roger your PAN call, descend to 4,200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vector to Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 101，收到你的 PAN 呼叫，下降至 4,200 米，左转航向 010，预计雷达引导至 Runway 04。
cards.referenceText: descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vector to Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4200 米，左转航向 010，预计雷达引导至 Runway 04，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have successfully restarted the left engine, but you still decide to return to Wuhan for safety concerns, inform ATC about the current situation and cancel the Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已成功重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍决定返回武汉，请告知空管当前情况并取消紧急状态。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 101, cancel urgency, we have restarted our left engine, but we still want to return to land for safety concerns.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 101，取消紧急状态，我们已重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍希望返回落地。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on the ILS approach Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立04跑道ILS进近，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 101, established on the ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 101，已建立04跑道ILS进近。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, surface wind 070 degrees, 5 meters per second, Runway 04, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，地面风070度，5米/秒，04跑道，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以04跑道落地，AFR 101。

topics.name: AFR 332 烟雾 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: your call sign is AFR 332, a flight from Wuhan to Paris, you are at Gate 305, you have got information L, contact Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 AFR 332，这是一趟从武汉飞往巴黎的航班，位于 305 登机口，已收到 L 情报，联系武汉放行并申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 332, gate 305, information L, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 332，305 登机口，L 情报，申请前往巴黎的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText:
C: Station calling Wuhan Delivery, I read you 2.
B: you find you have some problem with your transmitter, inform Wuhan Delivery of your problem and tell the controller you need maintenance check.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： 呼叫武汉放行的电台，我听你为 2。
B： 你发现发射机有问题，向武汉放行报告问题，并告诉管制员你需要维修检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 332, we have some problem with our transmitter, request maintenance check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 332，我们的发射机有问题，请求维修检查。

cards.audioText: Now you have fixed the transmitter problem and you have copied the ATC clearance, you are ready for pushback and startup, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已修复发射机问题并抄收 ATC 放行许可，已准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 332, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 332，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: AFR 332, recleared to Paris, departure Runway 36R, ZF-12 departure, the rest unchanged, pushback and startup approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 332，重新许可飞往巴黎，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 ZF-12 离场，其余不变，推出和开车批准，机头朝北。
cards.referenceText: recleared to Paris, departure Runway 36R, ZF-12 departure, the rest unchanged, pushback and startup approved, facing north, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重新许可飞往巴黎，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 ZF-12 离场，其余不变，推出和开车批准，机头朝北，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: Now you are airborne, you are climbing to 1,800 meters, you observed a drone at your 10 o'clock above, closing to your flight track, report it to Wuhan Departure and request right turn for avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，正爬升至 1,800 米，观察到一架无人机位于 10 点钟上方，正在接近你的航迹，向武汉离场报告并请求右转避让。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 332, airborne, climbing to 1800 meters, we observed a drone at our 10 o'clock above, closing to our flight track, request right turn for avoidance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 332，已离地，正爬升至 1800 米，我们观察到一架无人机位于 10 点钟上方，正在接近我们的航迹，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText:
AFR 332, Wuhan Departure, roger, turn right heading 270, climb to 2,400 meters, maintain visual separation. When able, could you describe the drone in detail?
B: read back the ATC instructions and tell the controller it's a white drone, crossing from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh:
AFR 332，武汉离场，收到，右转航向 270，爬升至 2,400 米，保持目视间隔。可以时，请详细描述无人机。
B： 复诵空中交通管制指令，并告诉管制员这是一架白色无人机，正从左向右穿越。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 270, climb to 2,400 meters, maintain visual separation. It's a white drone, crossing from left to right, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 270，爬升至 2004 百米，保持目视间隔。这是一架白色无人机，正从左向右穿越，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: Now you are in Paris Control area, the purser reported there are toxic fumes in the rear lavatory, you decide to make an emergency descent for fume removal, make a distress call to Paris Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于巴黎管制区，乘务长报告后卫生间内有有毒烟雾，你决定紧急下降以排烟，向巴黎管制发出遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Paris Control, AFR 332, there are toxic fumes in the rear lavatory, request emergency descent for fume removal.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，巴黎管制，AFR 332，后卫生间内有有毒烟雾，请求紧急下降以排烟。

cards.audioText: AFR 332, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 340, descend to FL290. When able, say further intention.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 332，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 340，下降至 FL290。可以时，报告进一步意图。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 340, descend to FL290, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，下降至 FL290，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: Now you have removed the toxic fumes in the rear lavatory, you decide to continue the flight to Paris.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已排除后卫生间内的有毒烟雾，决定继续飞往巴黎。
cards.referenceText: Paris Control, AFR 332, we have removed the toxic fumes in the rear lavatory, we decide to continue the flight to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巴黎管制，AFR 332，我们已排除后卫生间内的有毒烟雾，决定继续飞往巴黎。

cards.audioText: AFR 332, roger, turn right heading 360, climb to and maintain FL390.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 332，收到，右转航向 360，爬升至并保持 FL390。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 360, climb to and maintain FL390, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 360，爬升至并保持 FL390，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: Now you are cruising at FL390, you smelled something unusual in the cockpit, but you haven't found out the source of the smell, report this situation to Paris Control and request hold for trouble shooting.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正以 FL390 巡航，在驾驶舱内闻到异常气味，但尚未查明气味来源，向巴黎管制报告情况并请求进入等待排故。
cards.referenceText: Paris Control, AFR 332, we smelled something unusual in the cockpit, but we haven't found out the source of the smell, request hold for trouble shooting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巴黎管制，AFR 332，我们在驾驶舱内闻到异常气味，但尚未查明气味来源，请求进入等待排故。

cards.audioText: AFR 332, roger, turn right, direct to CDG, hold at CDG as published.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR 332，收到，右转，直飞 CDG，按公布程序在 CDG 等待。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to C DAL G, hold at C DAL G as published, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 C DAL G，按公布程序在 C DAL G 等待，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: Now you find there is dense smoke in the cockpit, make a distress call and request divert to the nearest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你发现驾驶舱内有浓烟，发出遇险呼叫，并请求备降最近的合适机场。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Paris Control, AFR 332, there is dense smoke in the cockpit, request divert to the nearest suitable airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，巴黎管制，AFR 332，驾驶舱内有浓烟，请求备降最近的合适机场。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 332, roger MAYDAY, turn left heading 300, radar vector to Frankfurt airport, when able, report souls on board and fuel endurance.
B: read back and tell the controller you have 428 passengers and 12 crew members on board and fuel remaining 16000 pounds.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： AFR 332，收到 MAYDAY，左转航向 300，雷达引导前往法兰克福机场。可以时，报告机上人数和燃油续航时间。
B： 复诵指令，并告诉管制员机上有 428 名乘客和 12 名机组人员，剩余燃油 16,000 磅。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading tree zero zero, radar vector to Frankfurt airport, we have 400 and 28 passengers and 12 crew members on board and fuel remaining 16000 pounds, AFR 332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 300，雷达引导前往法兰克福机场，机上有 428 名乘客和 12 名机组人员，剩余燃油 16,000 磅，AFR 332。

cards.audioText: your company dispatcher just told you that the ground personnel in Frankfurt are on strike, so you decide to continue your flight to Paris.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的公司签派员刚刚告诉你，法兰克福的地面工作人员正在罢工，因此你决定继续飞往巴黎。
cards.referenceText: Paris Control, AFR 332, our company dispatcher just told us that the ground personnel in Frankfurt are on strike, we decide to continue our flight to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巴黎管制，AFR 332，我们的公司签派员刚刚告诉我们，法兰克福的地面工作人员正在罢工，我们决定继续飞往巴黎。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is AFR113, you are holding at holding point A9 of runway 04, you are fully ready. Contact Wuhan Tower and say you’re ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是法航113，你现在在跑道04外A9等待点等待，已经完全准备好。联系武汉塔台，告诉他们你准备好离场了。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR113, holding point A9 of runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航113，跑道04外A9等待点，准备好离场了。

cards.audioText: AFR113, hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，在当前位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Holding, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，法航113。

cards.audioText:
AFR113, hold at present position, do you have the traffic on short final in sight?
Tell the controller yes.
cards.audioTextZh:
法航113，在当前位置等待，你看到短五边上的航空器了吗？
告诉管制员已经看到。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, traffic in sight, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，看到航空器了，法航113。

cards.audioText: AFR113, behind the CES 737 on short final, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，在短五边上的东航737后，上跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Behind CES737 on short final, line up behind, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在短五边上的东航737后，上跑道等待。

cards.audioText: AFR113, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact departure 120.2.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，可以起飞，离地后，联系离场120.2。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 04,, after airborne, contact departure 120.2, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道04，离地后，联系离场120.2，法航113。

cards.audioText: You are passing 900m, contact Wuhan Departure, ask if you can cancel the SID, and proceed to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在正在过900米，联系武汉离场。询问是否可以取消SID，直飞LKO.
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR113, passing 900m, request cancel SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，法航113，正在过900米，请求取消SID，直飞LKO。

cards.audioText: AFR113, radar identified, continue climb to 2400m, turn right to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，雷达识别了，继续上到2400米，右转飞LKO。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb 2400m, turn right to LKO, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续上到2400米，右转飞LKO，法航113。

cards.audioText: AFR113, climb to 4500m and contact Wuhan Control on 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，上4500米，联系武汉区调119.7。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4500m and contact 119.7, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上到4500米，联系武汉区调119.7，法航113。

cards.audioText: Your position is just over LKO, the next way-point is DAPRO, ETA at time 34, make the standard position report, and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 你刚刚过LKO，下一个位置点是DAPRO，预计到达时间34分，做一个标准位置报，并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR113. maintaining 4500m. Over LKO, next DAPRO at 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航113，在4500米保持，过LKO，预计到达下一位置点DAPRO34分，请求爬升。

cards.audioText: AFR113, climb to 5100m, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，上到5100米，无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5100m, no speed restriction, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上到5100米，无速度限制，法航113。

cards.audioText: During climb, your port engine failed, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land. This is an urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 在爬升过程中，你的左发失效了，告诉管制员这一情形，你想返场着陆，这是一个紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR113, port engine failure, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, 武汉区调，法航113，左发失效，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: AFR113, Roger PAN, descend to 1800m, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，收到PAN，下到1800米，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800m, turn right heading 360, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到1800米，右转航向360，法航113。

cards.audioText: AFR113, contact Approach 119.85.
Your altitude is 1800m, you have information S, contact approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的高度是1800米，你收到通播S，联系进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan approach, AFR113. 1800m maintaining, information S.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航113，保持在1800米，通播S。

cards.audioText:
AFR113, current information is T, descend to 900m, expect radar vectors for ILS runway 36L.
Read back and ask to use runway 36R to land due to performance limitations.
cards.audioTextZh:
法航113，目前通播是T，下到900米，预计雷达引导ILS进近，跑道36左。
复诵，由于性能限制，请求使用跑道36右着陆。
cards.referenceText: Information T, descend to 900m, Request ILS runway 36R due to performance, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播T，下到900米，由于性能，请求跑道36右，法航113。

cards.audioText: AFR113, change landing runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，更换到36右跑道。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，法航113。

cards.audioText: You have just got the information from the cabin that one of your passengers suffered stroke during the incident. Inform the controller and ask for ambulance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 你从客舱收到一则消息，一名乘客在此事件中中风，告知管制员这个情况，并在着陆后请求救护车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR113, request ambulance after landing due to passenger suffered stroke.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航113，由于乘客中风，在着陆之后请求救护车。

cards.audioText: AFR113, roger, we will notify airport medical assistance, now turn left heading 330, descend to 600m, cleared ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，收到，我们将告知机场医疗救援，现在，左转航向330，下到600米，可以ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 330, descend to 600m, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向330，下到600米，可以ILS进近，跑道36右，法航113。

cards.audioText: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for RWY 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告管制员，你已经截获跑道36右的航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR113., localizer established for runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航113，建立了跑道36右的航向道。

cards.audioText: AFR113, contact Tower 124.35.
[Your call sign is AFR9939, you are flying from Wuhan to Beijing, your position now is gate 276, information B is valid, ask ATC for your airway clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是法航9939，你正从武汉飞往北京，你现在在276号机位，通播B有效，向管制请求你的航路许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR9939, gate 276, information B, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，法航9939，276号机位，通播B，请求前往北京的放行许可。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, Wuhan Delivery, you are cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use 04, follow HZ-01 Departure, initially 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3101.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，武汉放行，可以经由计划航路飞往北京，跑道04，按照HZ-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度10400米，离场频率119.6，应答机编码3101。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, runway in use 04, follow HZ-01 Departure, initially 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3101. AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往北京，跑道04，按照HZ-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度10400米，离场频率119.6，应答机编码3101，法航9939。

cards.audioText: [Now, you are on taxiway A1, request taxi instructions from Ground controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在滑行道A1，向地面管制请求滑行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR9939, taxiway A1, request to continue taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，法航9939，滑行道A1，请求继续滑行。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, Wuhan Ground, taxi via A1, A, M, to holding point M2. Caution work in progress at right side of M.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，武汉地面，经由滑行道A1，A和M，滑行至M2等待点，注意M右侧有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via A1, A, M, to holding point M2, roger caution, thanks, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A1，A和M，滑行至M2等待点，收到，谨慎滑行，法航9939。

cards.audioText: [You are approaching the holding point M2, inform Tower that you are ready for takeoff.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在到达M2等待点，告知武汉塔台，你准备好起飞了。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR9939, approaching holding point M2, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航9939，到达M2等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, you are cleared for immediate takeoff, runway 04, surface wind 300 at 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，可以立刻起飞，跑道04，地面风300, 2米每秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for immediate takeoff, runway 04, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以立刻起飞，跑道04，法航9939。

cards.audioText: [While you are accelerating for takeoff rolling, you notice a yellow ground vehicle is crossing runway 04, tell ATC you stopped immediately because of runway incursion.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你在起飞滑跑时，你看到一辆黄色的地面车辆正在穿过跑道04，由于跑道入侵，你立刻停止。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR9939, we rejected takeoff due runway incursion, vehicle crossing runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航9939，由于跑道入侵，我们中断起飞，跑道上有车辆。

cards.audioText:
ATC: Roger, AFR9939, advise intention when able.
[Tell ATC, you want to vacate runway via E2 and taxi back to the apron to have a ground check.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，法航9939，方便时告知意图。
告诉管制员，你想经由E2脱离跑道，滑回机坪进行检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR9939, request vacate runway via E2 and taxi back to the apron to have a ground check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航9939，请求经由E2脱离跑道，滑回机坪进行检查。

cards.audioText: [Later, everything is normal again, you are finally in the air, passing 600 meters for 1200 meters, tell Departure that you require further instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 后来，一切恢复正常，你最后升空，现在过600米，飞往1200米，告诉离场，请求进一步指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR9939, passing 600 meters for 1200 meters, request further instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，法航9939，过600米，飞往1200米，请求进一步指令。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, Wuhan Departure, continue climb to 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，武汉离场，继续爬升至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Climbing to 3000 meters. AFR9939.

cards.audioText: [Now, you are cruising at 10400 meters, suddenly the air becomes very turbulent, you suspect there is a moderate to severe clear air turbulence. Request a lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh:
你现在巡航在10400米，忽然气流变得很颠簸，你猜测中度到重度颠簸，请求下高度。
参考答案：
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR9939, at 10400 meters, request lower level due moderate to severe clear air turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航9939，10400米，由于中度到重度颠簸，请求下高度。

cards.audioText:
ATC: Roger, descend to 8900 meters, report if there is any injury on board.
[Your purser reports that there is a passenger with head injuries because of the turbulence.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，下到8900米，报告机上是否有人伤亡。
乘务长报告由于颠簸，机上有乘客头部受伤。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 8900 meters, purser reports we have a passenger with head injury. AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到8900米，乘务长报告有乘客头部受伤，法航9939。

cards.audioText:
ATC: Passenger with head injury, roger that, say intention, AFR9939.
[The purser has offered first aid to the injured passenger, he is OK now. You will continue the flight.]
cards.audioTextZh:
有乘客头部受伤，收到，报告意图，法航9939。
乘务长向受伤乘客提供了急救，他目前情况良好，你将继续飞行。
cards.referenceText: The passenger is OK now, we will continue the flight. AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 乘客情况目前良好，我们将继续飞行，法航9939。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, roger, direct to ENH, then, descent to 6000 meters, establish contact with Beijing Control 120.6.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，直飞ENH，然后下到6000米，联系北京区调120.6。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ENH, descent to 6000 meters, contact Beijing Control on 120.6. AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞ENH，然后下到6000米，联系北京区调120.6，法航9939。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over Beijing Capital airport, you have established ILS for runway 36R, tell Beijing Tower about your situation, request ambulance on arrival.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在到达北京首都机场上空，你已经建立跑道36右盲降，告诉北京塔台你的意图，请求到达后急救车就位。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, AFR9939, ILS established runway 36R, we have a passenger with head injury, request ambulance on arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，法航9939，建立跑道36右盲降，我们有一名乘客头部受伤，请求到达后急救车就位。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, Beijing Tower, ambulance will be ready on your arrival, cleared to land, runway 36R, wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，北京塔台，到达后救护车将就位，可以落地，跑道36右，静风。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 36R, thank you, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道36右，谢谢，法航9939。

topics.name: AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-1
cards.audioText: N: [You are from Paris to Wuhan. You are flying at 11300m, approaching SIA. Call Xi'an Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你从巴黎飞往武汉。你现在在11300米巡航，接近SIA，呼叫西安区调。】
cards.referenceText: Xi'an Control, AFR896, 11300m maintaining, approaching SIA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安区调，法航896，在11300米保持。接近SIA。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-2
cards.audioText: N: [You are experiencing moderate turbulence. You want to know the turbulence report at other level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你正在经历中度颠簸，你想知道其他高度层上的颠簸报告。】
cards.referenceText: Xi'an Control, AFR896, encountering moderate turbulence at present level, confirm if there is any turbulence report at other levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安区调，法航896，当前高度正遇到中度颠簸，证实其他高度上是否有颠簸报告

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-3
cards.audioText:
C: AFR896, You are the first aircraft in my sector. There is no report here.
N: [Tell the controller you want to descent to 10700m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
法航896，你是我扇区的第一个飞机，没有其他报告。
【告知管制员，你想下降到10700米。】
cards.referenceText: Request descend to 10700m, AFR896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求下降到10700米，法航896。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-4
cards.audioText: C: AFR896, descend and maintain 10700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航896，下到10700米保持。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 10700m, AFR896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到10700米保持，法航896。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-5
cards.audioText: N: [You are experiencing severe turbulence at 10700m. The pitot static heating feature has malfunctioned. You want to fly back to 11300m to avoid turbulence and ice. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在10700米遇到了强颠簸，你的皮托管静态加热功能发生故障，你想回到11300米来躲避颠簸和积冰，这是紧急通话。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Xi'an Control, AFR896, request fly back to 11300m due turbulence and ice area. The pitot heating feature has malfunctioned.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，西安区调，法航896，由于颠簸和积冰区域，请求飞回11300米，皮托管静态加热功能发生故障。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-6
cards.audioText: C: AFR896, climb and maintain 11300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航896，上到11300米保持。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 11300m, AFR896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上到11300米保持，法航896。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-7
cards.audioText: C: AFR896, contact Wuhan Control on 132.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航896，联系武汉区调132.35。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-8
cards.audioText: C: AFR896. Radar contact. Direct to ZHO, descend to 11000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航896，雷达识别，直飞ZHO，下到11000米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZHO, descend to 11000m, AFR896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞ZHO，下到11000米，法航896。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-9
cards.audioText: N: [Ask to climb to 11600m due icing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【由于积冰，请求上11600米。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR896, request climb to 11600m due icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航896，由于积冰，请求上11600米。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-10
cards.audioText: C: AFR896, climb to 11600m.
cards.referenceText: Climb to 11600m. AFR896.

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-11
cards.audioText: N: [You are established contact, initiated descend for runway 36R. During descending, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage. advice Wuhan Control this situation. this is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立联系，初始下降到跑道36右，在下降过程中，你的空速和高度读数异常，大概是由于积冰堵塞。告知武汉区调，这是一个紧急通话。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR896, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal due to the ice blockage during descend.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉区调，法航896，在下降过程中，由于积冰堵塞，空速和高度读数异常。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-12
cards.audioText:
C: AFR896, turn right heading 240, advice your intentions.
N: [Tell controller that your GPS altitude and ground speed is not accurate compared to barometric indications, but you can still maintain stable flight, request descend to leave the icing area.]
cards.audioTextZh:
法航896，右转航向240，告知你的意图。
【告诉管制员，你的GPS高度和地速与气压指示相比不准确，但你仍然可以保持稳定飞行，请求下降离开结冰区。】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, request descend to leave the icing area. The instrument readings are abnormal, but we can still maintain the stable flight, AFR896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，请求下降离开结冰区。仪表复数不正常，但我们依旧可以保持平稳飞行，法航896。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-13
cards.audioText: C: AFR896, descend to 3600m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航896，下降到3600米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3600m, AFR896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到3600米，法航896。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-14
cards.audioText:
C: AFR896, radar shows you are at 4800m. What's your current GPS altitude?
N: [Tell the controller GPS altitude is 3600m, request descend to 1800m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
法航896，雷达显示你在4800米。你当前的GPS高度是多少？
【告知管制员，你的GPS高度是3600米，请求下降到1800米。】
cards.referenceText: Our GPS shows 3600m, request descend to 1800m, AFR896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的GPS显示3600米，请求下降待1800米。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-15
cards.audioText:
C: AFR896, another aircraft has information with regards to the differences between his barometric and GPS altitude. I have him on 3000m, his reported GPS is 3600m.
N: [Request further descending and leaving icing area.]
cards.audioTextZh:
【法航896，另一架飞机也有关于他的气压高度和GPS高度差异的信息。我看到他在3000米，他报告的GPS是3600米。】
【请求进一步下降，然后离开积冰区域。】
cards.referenceText: Request further descending and leaving the icing area, AFR896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求进一步下降，然后离开积冰区域，法航896。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-16
cards.audioText: C: AFR896, contact approach on 124.55, we have informed them your altimeter errors.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航896，联系进近124.55，我们已经告知他们你的高度表错误。
cards.referenceText: Contact Approach on 124.55. AFR896.

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-17
cards.audioText: N: [You left the icing area and your instruments have returned to normal. Report to Wuhan Tower. You have established on the ILS 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你离开了积冰区域，你的仪表恢复正常，告知武汉塔台，你已经建立跑道36右的航向道。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR896, established on ILS approach Runway 36R, the instrument readings are normal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航896，预计盲降进近跑道36右，仪表读数正常了。

cards.taskTitle: 56-AFR896 [颠簸，皮托管加热失效，积冰堵塞]-18
cards.audioText: C: AFR896, wind calm runway 36R. Clear to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航896，静风跑道36右，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36R, AFR896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，法航896。

topics.name: AFR168 [襟翼、缝翼问题，起落架卡阻]

cards.audioText: N: [Your callsign is AFR168, you are inbound for Wuhan, descending passed 4800m for 3600m, call Wuhan Control to request further descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是法航168，你正飞往武汉，正从4800米下到3600米，呼叫武汉区调，请求进一步下降。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR168, destination Wuhan, descending from 4800m for 3600m, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航168，目的地武汉，正在从4800米下到3600米，请求进一步下降。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, Wuhan Control, contact Wuhan Approach on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，武汉区调，联系武汉进近124.35。

cards.audioText: N: [You are leveling at 3600m, you have received ATIS J, ask Wuhan Approach which arrival is in use.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在正在3600米平飞，你已经收到了通播J，询问武汉进近，可用的进近程序是哪一个。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, leveling at 3600m, ATIS J, request arrival in use.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，正在3600米平飞，收到通播J，请求可用进近程序。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, expect IKUBA 05A arrival, runway in use 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，武汉进近，雷达看见了，预计IKUBA 05A进近，使用跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Expect IKUBA 05A arrival, runway 04, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计IKUBA 05A进近，跑道04，法航168。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, descend to and maintain 2400m on QNH996.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，下2400米保持，修正海压996。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 2400m on QNH996, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下2400米保持，修正海压996，法航168。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, reduce speed to 170kts, track direct to DA, expect your approach from the west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，减速至170节，直飞DA，预计从西边进近。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to 170kts, track direct to DA, expect approach from the west, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减速至170节，直飞DA，预计从西边进近，法航168。

cards.audioText: N: [The slats on the aircraft are unable to be extended, advise controller about this situation, and request maintain speed 220kts.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你飞机上的缝翼无法放出，告知管制员此情况，请求速度保持220节。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, slats unable to extend, request maintain speed 220kts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，缝翼无法放出，请求速度保持220节。

cards.audioText: N: [You want to hold at DA to deal with this problem, notify Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你想在DA等待来解决这个问题，告知武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, request hold at DA to solve problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，请求在DA等待来解决问题。

cards.audioText: N: [You are unable to extend most of the flaps, and the slats remain in the zero position, advise Wuhan Approach that you require a longer runway for landing due to the high approach speed.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你已经无法放出大部分襟翼，缝翼也在零位，告知管制员，由于过高的进近速度，你需要一个更长的跑道着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, unable to extend most of the flaps, slats remain zero position, request longer runway for landing due to high approach speed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，无法放出大部分襟翼，缝翼也在零位，由于过高的进近速度，申请一个更长的跑道着陆。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, Wuhan Approach, roger, change your landing runway to 36R, advise when ready to approach.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，武汉进近，收到，着陆跑道更改至36右，准备好进近时报。
cards.referenceText: change to runway 36R, wilco, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 更改至36右，将照办，法航168。

cards.audioText: N: [You are now manually flying the aircraft due to auto-pilot malfunctioned, tell the controller you are ready for approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【由于自动驾驶失效，你现在正在手动操纵制飞机，告诉管制员，你准备好进近了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, we are on manual due auto-pilot malfunction, ready for approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，自动驾驶失效，正在手动操纵飞机，准备好进近了。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, Wuhan Approach, radar vectors, after this orbit, fly heading 060.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，武汉进近，雷法引导，这次盘旋后，航向060。
cards.referenceText: Radar vectors, after the orbit fly heading 060, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷法引导，这次盘旋后，航向060，法航168。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are 5 miles from touchdown, you have encountered wake turbulence from departing heavy aircraft, you decided to go around, call Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在距离接地点5海里，你遇到了前方起飞航空器导致的尾流，你决定复飞，呼叫武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR168, 5 miles from touchdown, encountered wake turbulence from departing heavy aircraft, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航168，距离接地点5海里，遇到了前方起飞航空器导致的尾流，复飞了。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, follow the published go around procedures, climb to 900m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，按照公布的复飞程序，上900米。
cards.referenceText: Follow published go around procedures, climb to 900m, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照公布的复飞程序，上900米，法航168。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, apologies for the separation problem, contact Wuhan Approach on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，抱歉间隔原因，联系武汉进近124.35。

cards.audioText: N: [Your landing gear was jammed during retraction, make an urgency call to Wuhan Approach about the situation, and request another holding pattern.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【在收上起落架过程中，你的起落架卡阻了，向武汉进近做一个紧急通话，告知此情况，请求再次加入等待程序。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, AFR168, landing gear jammed during retraction, request another holding pattern.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，法航168，在收上起落架过程中，起落架卡阻了，请求再次加入等待程序，

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, roger, turn left heading 250, track direct to DA, climb to and maintain 3900m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，收到，左转航向250，直飞DA，上3900米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 250, track direct to DA, climb to and maintain 3900m, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向250，直飞DA，上3900米保持，法航168。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR168, a thunderstorm will approach the airport within 30 minutes, acknowledge.
N: [Tell Wuhan Approach you will need to dumping fuel for about 10 minutes and return for an emergency landing.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：法航168，雷暴将在30分钟到达机场，请知晓。
N：【告知武汉进近，你需要放油10分钟，然后返场进行紧急着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach AFR168, request dumping fuel for 10 minutes and return for emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，请求放油10分钟，然后返场进行紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: C: AFR168, turn left heading 330, climb to maintain 4200m, expect your fuel dump instruction shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: C：法航168，左转航向330，上4200米保持，预计一会发布放油指令。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 330, climb to maintain 4200m, roger, AFR168.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向330，上4200米保持，收到，法航168。

cards.audioText: N: [Request Wuhan Approach for emergency service on arrival and that the runway is foamed up.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【请求武汉进近，在着陆后需要紧急服务，并且需要在跑道上喷洒泡沫。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR168, request emergency service on arrival and that the runway is foamed up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航168，请求在着陆后紧急服务，并且在跑道上喷洒泡沫。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is AFR151. You are at Wuhan airport, at Gate 215, information G received, request ATC clearance to Paris.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是法航151，在武汉机场，215号机位，收到通播G，向ATC申请放行至巴黎。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR151, Gate 215, information G, destination Paris, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，法航151，215号机位，通播G，目的地巴黎，请求管制许可。

cards.audioText: AFR151, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, runway 04, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10700m, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 2521.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往巴黎，LKO-01号离场，跑道04，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10700米，离场频率119.7，应答机2521。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, runway 04, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10700m, 119.7, squawk 2521, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至巴黎，LKO-01号离场，跑道04，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10700米，119.7，应答机2521，法航151。

cards.audioText: [You decide 10700m is not acceptable due to heavy weight. Ask whether 9500m is available.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【由于飞机过重，10700米不能接受。询问9500米是否可行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR151, negative 10700m due weight, confirm 9500m is available.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，法航151，由于重量，我们不能接受10700米，证实9500米可用。

cards.audioText: AFR151, recleared cruising level 9500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，重新允许巡航高度9500米。
cards.referenceText: Cruising level 9500m, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巡航高度9500米，法航151。

cards.audioText: [Now you are ready for pushback and start-up, contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已准备好推出开车，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR151, gate 215, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，法航151，215号停机位，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: AFR151, Ground, pushback and start-up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，地面，同意推出开车，头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, facing east, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，头朝东，法航151。

cards.audioText: [You are now on the taxiway Z4 with your engines running. Ask Ground Control for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在滑行道Z4上，发动机已经启动。向地面指挥询问滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR151, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，法航151，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: AFR151, taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A, hold short of A4.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，沿滑行道Z4，A滑至跑道04等待点，在A4外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A, hold short of A4, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A滑至跑道04等待点，在A4外等待，法航151。

cards.audioText: AFR151, give way to the B737 vacating from E3, when the traffic cleared, continue taxi A, A9, hold short of runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，给正在从E3脱离的波音737让路，飞机没影响后，继续沿滑行道A，A9滑至跑道04外等待。
cards.referenceText: Give way to the B737, when the traffic cleared, continue taxi A, A9, hold short of runway 04, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给波音737让路，飞机没影响后，继续沿滑行道A，A9滑至跑道04外等待，法航151。

cards.audioText: [Now you are airborne at 600m climbing, contact Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在飞机已起飞，600米爬升，联系武汉离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR151 airborne, passing 600m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，法航151起飞，通过600米。

cards.audioText: AFR 151, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000m on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉离场，雷达已识别，左转直飞DA，上升保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1015。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000m on QNH 1015, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，上升保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1015，法航151。

cards.audioText: AFR151, continue climb and maintain 6000m on standard, expedite passing 3900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，继续上升保持标压6000米，快速通过3900米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 6000m on standard, expedite passing 3900m, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持标压6000米，快速通过3900米，法航151。

cards.audioText: [You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6000m, request higher level and state the reason to Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【保持6000米时，你遇到了中度积冰，请求更高的飞行高度，并向武汉区调陈述原因。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR151, maintaining 6000m, request higher level due moderate icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航151，保持6000米，由于中度积冰，申请高高度。

cards.audioText: AFR 151, Wuhan Control, negative due traffic, maintain 6000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉区调，高度没位置，保持6000米。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 6000m, AFR151.

cards.audioText: [Suddenly your left engine failed at 6000m, make an urgency call ATC, and request descent and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在6000米处左侧发动机突然失效，紧急呼叫ATC，请求下降并返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR151, maintaining 6000m, left engine failure, request descent and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，法航151，保持6000米，左侧发动机失效，请求下降并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: AFR 151, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, descend and maintain 4200m, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for runway 04.[You successfully restart the left engine, decide to return to Wuhan. Inform ATC and cancel urgency.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，下降保持4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导跑道04。【你成功地重启了左侧发动机，决定返回武汉，通知ATC取消紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 4200m, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for runway 04, cancel PANPAN, we have successfully restarted the left engine, request return to Wuhan airport, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导跑道04，取消PANPAN，我们成功地重启了左侧发动机，请求返回武汉机场，法航151。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is AFR123, you are holding at holding point A9 runway 36L, you are fully ready. Call Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是法航123，你在跑道36左A9等待点等待，已经准备好。呼叫武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR123, holding point A9 runway 36L, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航123，跑道36左A9等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Tower, hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉塔台，原地等待。
cards.referenceText: Holding at present position, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, confirm the traffic in sight on short final?[Tell the controller yes.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，你看到短五边上的波音737了么？【告诉管制员看到了。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, traffic in sight, AFR123
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，看到了，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, line up behind the B737 on short final.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，跟五边波音737后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Line up behind the traffic, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟737后进跑道，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact Departure 120.2.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，可以起飞，起飞后，联系离场120.2。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, airborne 120.2, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，离地频率120.2.，法航123。

cards.audioText: [You are passing 900m, contact Wuhan Departure, ask whether you can cancel the SID, and proceed direct to LKO.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你正在通过900米，联系武汉离场，询问是否可以取消SID，直飞LKO。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR123, passing 900m, confirm can cancel SID and direct to LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，法航123，通过900米，证实可以取消SID，直飞LKO。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, continue climb and maintain 2400m, turn right direct to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉离场，雷达已识别，继续上升保持2400米，右转直飞LKO。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb and maintain 2400m, turn right direct to LKO. AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续上升保持2400米，右转直飞LKO，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, climb and maintain 4500m on standard, contact Wuhan Control 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，上升保持标压4500米，联系武汉区调119.7。
cards.referenceText: Climbing and maintain 4500m on standard, 119.7, AFR123.

cards.audioText: [Your maintain 4500m position is just over LKO time 23, the next way-point is DAPRO, ETA is 34, make the standard position report, and request climb.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你保持在4500米，过LKO时间23分，下一个点DAPRO，预计到达时间34分，做标准位置报告，并请求爬升。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR123, over LKO 23, maintaining 4500m, next DARPO 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航123，LKO 23分，保持4500米，下一个点DAPRO，预计到达时间34分，请求爬升。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Control, climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉区调，上升保持5100米，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持5100米，没有速度限制，法航123。

cards.audioText: [During the climb, your port engine separated, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【爬升过程中，左侧发动机分离，告诉管制员这一情况，以及你想返回着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Wuhan Control, AFR123, our left engine falls, request to return to the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, 武汉区调，法航123，飞机左侧发动机脱落，请求返回机场。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Control, roger Mayday, descend and maintain 1800m on QNH1012, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉区调，收到Mayday，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 1800m, QNH1012, turn right heading 360. AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，右转航向360，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, contact Approach 119.85.
[Your altitude is 1800m, you have information S, contact Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞行高度是1800米，你收到通播S，联系进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR123, maintaining 1800m, information S.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航123，保持1800米，通播S。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Approach, information Tango valid, descend and maintain 900m, expect radar vectors ILS runway 36L.[Read back and ask to use runway 36R to land due to performance limitations.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉进近，通播T有效，下降保持900米，雷达引导盲降跑道36左。【复诵，由于性能限度，请求降落在跑道36右。】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900m, expect radar vectors ILS runway 36L, information Tango. Request runway 36R due performance, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，雷达引导盲降跑道36左，通播T。由于飞机性能，请求跑道36右，法航123。

cards.audioText: AFR123, approved runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，同意跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Landing runway 36R, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 着陆跑道36右，法航123。

cards.audioText: [You have just got the information from the cabin that one of your passengers suffered stroke during the incident. Inform the controller and ask for ambulance after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你刚收到消息，降落过程中，一名乘客中风。通知管制员并要求到达时提供救护车。】
cards.referenceText: Approach, AFR123, request ambulance after landing, one passenger has suffered stroke.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，法航123，请求到达时提供救护车，一名乘客中风。

cards.audioText: AFR123, roger, we will notify airport medical assistance, now turn left heading 330, descend and maintain 600m, cleared ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，收到，我们会通知机场医疗援救，现在左转航向330，下降保持600米，可以盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 330, descend and maintain 600m, cleared ILS approach runway 36R. AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向330，下降保持600米，可以盲降进近跑道36右，法航123。

cards.audioText: [Report that you have intercepted the localizer for runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告进近你已切入航道，跑道36右。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR123, we have intercepted the localizer runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航123，已经切入航道36右。

cards.audioText: AFR123, contact Tower 124.35.
[You are from Paris to Wuhan. You are flying at 11300m, approaching SIA. Call Xi’an Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你从巴黎飞往武汉。你正在11300米飞行，接近SIA，联系西安区调。】
cards.referenceText: Xi’an Control, AFR986, maintaining 11300m, approaching SIA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安区调，法航986，保持11300米，接近SIA。

cards.audioText: AFR986, Xi’an Control, radar contact, maintain 11300m.[You are experiencing moderate turbulence. You want to know the turbulence report at other level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，西安区调，雷达已识别，保持11300米。【你遇到中度颠簸。想知道其它高度的颠簸报告。】
cards.referenceText: Xi’an Control, AFR986, we suffer from moderate turbulence, request turbulence condition at other levels,
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安区调，法航986，我们遇到了颠簸，请求其它高度的颠簸情况。

cards.audioText: AFR986, you are the first aircraft in my sector. No one reported.[Tell the controller you want to descend to 10700m due to turbulence.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，你在我这是第一架飞机。没有其它的报告。【告诉管制员，由于颠簸，你想下降到10700米。】
cards.referenceText: Xi’an Control, AFR986, request descent to 10700m due turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安区调，法航986，由于颠簸，请求下降至10700米。

cards.audioText: AFR986, descend and maintain 10700m approved.[You are experiencing severe turbulence at 10700m. The pitot static heating feature has malfunction. You want to fly back to 11300m to avoid turbulence and ice area. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，可以下降保持10700米。【你在10700米遇到强烈颠簸。皮托管加热功能故障。你想飞回11300米，以躲避颠簸和结冰区。做紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Xi’an Control, AFR986, request climb to 11300m due severe turbulence and ice area at 10700m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，西安区调，法航986，由于10700米处有强烈颠簸和结冰区，请求爬升11300米。

cards.audioText: AFR986, roger PANPAN, climb and maintain 11300m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，收到PANPAN，上升保持11300米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 11300m, AFR986.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持11300米，法航986。

cards.audioText: [You are maintaining 11300m, call Xi’an Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【保持11300米，呼叫区调。】
cards.referenceText: Xi’an Control, AFR986, maintaining 11300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安区调，法航986，保持11300米。

cards.audioText: AFR986, contact Zhengzhou Control on 132.35.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，联系郑州区调132.35。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control 132.35, AFR986.

cards.audioText: [You are flying at 11300m, squawk 3215. Call Zhengzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在11300米飞行，应答机3215，呼叫郑州区调。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, AFR986, maintaining 11300m, squawk 3215.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，法航986，保持11300米，应答机3215。

cards.audioText: AFR986, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact. Direct to ZHO, descend and maintain 11000m.[Read Back and ask to descend to 8400m due icing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，郑州区调，雷达已识别。直飞ZHO，下降保持11000米。【复诵，由于积冰请求下降到8400米。】
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZHO, request descend to 8400m due icing, AFR986.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞ZHO，由于积冰，请求下降8400米，法航986。

cards.audioText: AFR986, descend and maintain 8400m approved.[You are established contact, initiated descend for runway 36R. During descending, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage. Advise Wuhan Control this situation. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，下降保持8400米。【你建立了联系，先下降，降落到跑道36右。下降过程中，空速和高度指数异常，可能由于冻住了。告诉武汉区调这一状况。做紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR986. Airspeed and altitude indication abnormal due ice blockage.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，法航986。由于冻住了，空速和高度指数异常。

cards.audioText: AFR986, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 240, report intentions.[Tell controller that your GPS altitude and groundspeed is not accurate compared to barometric(气压高度表) indications, but can still maintain stable flight. request descend, leaving icing area.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，右转航向240，报告意图。【告诉管制员，你的GPS高度和地速数据与气压高度表显示的不准确，但仍能正常飞行。请求下降，离开积冰区域。】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240. Request descent and leaving icing area due inaccurate indications, AFR986.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，由于数据显示不准确，请求下降，离开积冰区域，法航986。

cards.audioText: AFR986, descend and maintain 3600m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，下降保持3600米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 3600m, AFR986.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持3600米，法航986。

cards.audioText: AFR986, radar shows you are at 4800m. What's your current GPS altitude?[Tell the controller GPS altitude is 3600m, request descent to 1800m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，雷达显示你在4800米。你现在的GPS高度是多少？【告诉管制员GPS高度是3600米，请求下降至1800米。】
cards.referenceText: Our GPS altitude is 3600m, request descent to 1800m AFR986.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的GPS高度为3600米，请求下降1800米，法航986。

cards.audioText: AFR986, another aircraft has information with regards to the differences between his barometric and GPS altitude. I have him on 3000m, his reported GPS is 3600m.[Request further descend and leaving icing area.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，另一架飞机也报告了气压高度表和GPS高度不同。我这里显示他在3000米，他报告他的GPS显示是3600米。【请求继续下降，离开积冰区域。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, AFR986, roger, thanks request further descend and leaving icing area
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，法航986，收到，谢谢，请求继续下降，离开积冰区域。

cards.audioText: AFR986, contact Approach on 124.55, we have informed them your altimeter errors.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，联系进近124.55，我们已经向他们报告了你的高度表有问题。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Contact Approach on 124.55. Thanks AFR986.
cards.referenceTextZh: 联系进近124.55，谢谢，法航986。

cards.audioText: [You left the icing area and your instruments have returned to normal. Report to Wuhan Tower. You have established on the ILS runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你离开了积冰区域，机上的仪表全部恢复正常。报告武汉塔台。你已经建立了盲降跑道36右。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR986. The instruments normal now. Established ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航986。仪表恢复正常了。建立盲降进近跑道36右。

cards.audioText: AFR986, Wuhan Tower, wind calm runway 36R. Cleared to land.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航986，武汉塔台，跑道36右静风，可以着陆。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36R, AFR986.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆跑道36右，法航986。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is AFR971, you are passing 3900m for 3600m. Contact Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是法航971，你正在通过3900米，下降3600米。联系武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR971, leaving 3900m for 3600m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航971，离开3900米，下降3600米。

cards.audioText: AFR971, Wuhan Approach, radar identified, information E valid, descend and maintain 3000m on QNH 1004.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，武汉进近，雷达已识别，通播E有效，下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1004。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 3000m on QNH 1004, information E, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1004，通播E，法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, descend and maintain 2400m, reduced to minimum clean speed.[Read back the instructions and tell the controller that the clean configuration speed of your aircraft is 200 knots.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，下降保持2400米，减速到最小光洁速度。【复诵指令，告诉管制员飞机的最小襟翼收上速度是200节。】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 2400m, the minimum speed 200 knots. AFR971
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持2400米，最小速度是200节，法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, turn right heading 300. You are No.3, 25 miles from touch-down.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，右转航向300。你是第三个，距离接地还有25海里。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right heading 300, No. 3, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向300，第三个，法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, turn left proceed direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，左转直飞DA，下降保持2100米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100m, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，下降保持2100米，法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, hold at DA as published.[Read back the controller’s instructions. And ask the reason for the hold.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，在DA标准等待。【复诵管制员的指令。询问等待的原因。】
cards.referenceText: Holding at DA as published, What’s the reason for the hold? AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在DA标准等待，等待的原因是什么？法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, runway inspection in progress at the moment, expect delay more than 15min.[Read back the ATC instructions, report that you are entering the hold and hold no more than 15min.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，正在测试跑道，预计延误15分钟以上。【复诵ATC的指令并报告其你已经进入等待点，等待不超过15分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Entering the holding pattern, and hold no more than 15min, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 已进入等待程序，等待不能超过15分钟，法航971。

cards.audioText: [The EGT of your starboard engine is fluctuating, state this situation to the controller. Ask to leave the holding pattern right away.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机右侧发动机的排气温度不稳定，把这一情况报告给管制员。请求立刻离开等待航线。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR971, The EGT of the right engine is fluctuating, request leave the holding pattern now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航971。右侧发动机的排气温度不稳定，请求现在离开等待程序。

cards.audioText: AFR971, roger, standby, continue hold, we are changing the landing sequences, expect to call you in 2min.[The oil pressure of your starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, state this situation to the controller, request immediate exit and request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，收到，稍等，继续等待，我们正在更改着陆顺序，预计2分钟内叫你。【右侧发动机的油压快速下降，向管制员报告该情况，请求立即退出等待程序并下降。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR971, the oil pressure of the right engine is rapidly decreasing, request immediate exit hold and descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航971，右侧发动机的油压快速下降，请求立即退出等待程序并下降。

cards.audioText: AFR971, standby, traffic at your 3 o’clock maintaining 1800m crossing from your right to left, report visual.[Tell the controller you have seen the conflicting aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，稍等，你3点钟方向，高度1800米，有一架飞机正在从你右侧穿越到左侧，能见报告。【告诉管制员你已经看到了冲突航空器。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR971, traffic in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航971，看到航空器了。

cards.audioText: [Your starboard engine has failed, make an urgency call, and ask for landing priority. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机右侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，并申请优先降落。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, AFR971, our right engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉进近，法航971，飞机右侧发动机失效，请求优先降落。

cards.audioText: AFR971, roger PANPAN. Turn left heading 060, descend and maintain 900m, cleared to ILS approach runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，收到PANPAN。左转航向060，下降保持900米，可以盲降进近跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 060, descend and maintain 900m, cleared to ILS approach runway 36L, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向060，下降保持900米，可以盲降进近跑道36左，法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, contact Wuhan Tower, frequency 124.35 good bye.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，武汉塔台，频率124.35，再见。
cards.referenceText: 124.35, good bye, AFR971.

cards.audioText: [Your heading is 060 and your altitude is 900m, contact Wuhan Tower and tell him about the condition of your aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的航向是060，高度900米，联系武汉塔台，告诉其飞机目前情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR971, heading 060, altitude 900m, our right engine has failed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航971，航向060，高度900米，飞机右侧发动机失效。

cards.audioText: AFR971, Wuhan Tower, roger, maintain present heading.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，武汉塔台，收到，保持当前航向。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Maintaining present heading. AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，法航971。

cards.audioText: AFR971, turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，左转航向030切入跑道36左航道。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向030切入跑道36左航道，法航971。

cards.audioText: [Report you have established localizer runway 36L.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告你已经建立了跑道36左航道。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR971, established localizer runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，跑道36左航道已经建立。

cards.audioText: AFR971, cleared to land, wind 300/5mps.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，可以着陆，风300，5米/秒。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 36L, AFR971.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆，跑道36左，法航971。

cards.audioText: [You are the pilot of AFR872 which is inbound for Wuhan. You have just been handed over from Guangzhou Control, you are over DAPRO at time 35 and your flight level is 9500m, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是法航872的飞行员，飞机飞往武汉。你刚从广州区调转出，过DAPRO时间35分，飞行高度9500米，呼叫武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR872, good morning, DAPRO 35, maintaining 9500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航872，早上好，过DAPRO时间35分，9500米保持。

cards.audioText: AFR872, Wuhan Control, radar identified, descend and maintain 5100m before LKO.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，武汉区调，雷达已识别，LKO前下降保持5100米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 5100m before LKO, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: LKO前下降保持5100米，法航872。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over LKO at 5100m, you have copied the latest ATIS K, call Wuhan Approach Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机飞过LKO，高度5100米，你抄收了最新的通播K，呼叫武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR872, maintaining 5100m, over LKO, information K.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航872，5100米保持，过LKO，通过K。

cards.audioText: AFR872, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow LKO-1A Arrival, descend and maintain 3600m on QNH1004.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，武汉进近，雷达已识别，LKO-1A进场，下降保持修正海压3600米，修正海压1004。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: LKO-1A Arrival, descend and maintain 3600m on QNH 1004, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: LKO-1A进场，下降保持修正海压3600米，修正海压1004，法航872。

cards.audioText: [You’ve received a report from the flight attendant saying that there is smoke coming from the lavatory. You think it may develop into fire, so you declare distress to the ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你收到乘务员的报告，卫生间内有烟冒出。你认为这可能会引发火灾，所以向ATC宣布遇险。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, AFR872, flight attendant reported smoke coming out from the lavatory, request priority landing and emergency services
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY，武汉进近，法航872，乘务员报告称卫生间内有烟冒出，请求优先着陆并提供紧急服务。

cards.audioText: AFR872, Wuhan Approach, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 040, descend and maintain 2100m, radar vector to ILS approach runway 36R, you are priority landing.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，武汉进近，收到MAYDAY，右转航向040，下降保持2100米，雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右，你优先着陆。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, right heading 040, descend and maintain 2100 m, ILS runway 36R, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，右转航向040，下降保持2100米，盲降进近跑道36右，法航872。

cards.audioText: [As the captain of the flight, you may want to make a passenger address. The ‘PA’ may include: don’t be panic, remain seated, the flight crew are experienced, ATC assistance is available to us, etc.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【作为此次航班的机长，你想要做旅客广播。广播内容可能包括：不要慌张，原位坐好，机组人员经验丰富，ATC会为我们提供援助等。】
cards.referenceText: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking. Fasten your seatbelt and remain seated. Don’t worry. Believe us, we are a very experienced flight crew, and we can control this situation. And air traffic control is ready to assist us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 旅客广播：女士们，先生们，现在是机长广播。请原位坐好，系好安全带。不用担心，相信我们，我们机组成员非常有经验，可以控制这种情况。同时空中交通管制已经准备好帮助我们了。

cards.audioText: AFR872, Wuhan Approach, what is the situation on board now? Keep us advised.[You are grateful for the reminding, report to ATC that more smoke accumulated in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing hard.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，武汉进近，现在机上情况怎么样？随时报告。【感谢ATC的提醒，报告客舱内烟雾越来越多，乘客们咳嗽的很严重。】
cards.referenceText: Thanks. The smoke is becoming denser in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing hard, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: 谢谢，客舱内的烟雾越来越浓，乘客们咳嗽的很严重，法航872。

cards.audioText: AFR872, Wuhan Approach, continue descend and maintain 1200m, fire services and ambulance will be with you upon your landing.[You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，武汉进近，继续下降保持1200米，消防车及救护车在你着陆时就已就位。【你需要复诵消息并表示感谢。】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 1200m, thank you very much, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持1200米，非常感谢，法航872。

cards.audioText: [Now you report to ATC that you have already removed the dense smoke, two aged people and one baby are nearly suffocated, others are not seriously harmed.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告ATC浓烟已经清除，两位年长者和一个婴儿差点窒息，其它人未严重受伤。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR872, we have removed the dense smoke, but we have two aged people and one baby are suffering smoke, others are not seriously harmed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航872，我们已经清除了浓烟，但机上有两位年长者及一个婴儿深受浓烟危害，其它人受伤不严重。

cards.audioText: Roger, we’ll relay this information to the parties concerned.[A few minutes later.]AFR872, descend and maintain 900m, expect ILS approach runway 36R, you are number 1.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，我们会将此信息转达给有关方面。【几分钟后。】法航872，下降保持900米，盲降进近跑道36右，你第一个。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900 meters, ILS runway 36R, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，盲降进近跑道36右，法航872。

cards.audioText: [You have fully established on the ILS runway 36R and your position is 12km from touchdown, call Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已完全建立了盲降进近，跑道36右，距离着陆12千米，呼叫武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR872, fully established ILS runway 36R, position 12km from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航872，完全建立盲降进近跑道36右，距离着陆12千米。

cards.audioText: AFR872, continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，继续进近，联系塔台118.6，再见。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, AFR872
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，联系塔台118.6，法航872。

cards.audioText: [Now contact Wuhan Tower, report to ATC that you are 11km from touchdown on final and you are an emergency landing aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系武汉塔台，报告ATC你距离五边着陆还有11千米，需要紧急着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR872, 11km from touchdown on final, we have declared emergency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航872，距离五边着陆还有11千米，我们已经宣布紧急状态。

cards.audioText: AFR872, radar identified, continue ILS approach runway 36R, you are no. 1, report outer marker.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，雷达已识别，继续盲降进近跑道36右，你第一个，过远台报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: ILS approach runway 36R, no. 1, report outer marker, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: 盲降进近跑道36右，第一个，过远台报告，法航872。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over outer marker, call Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 盲降进近跑道36右，过远台报告，法航872。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR872 at outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航872，过远台。

cards.audioText: AFR872, cleared to land runway 36R, wind 340 degrees at 9 m/s.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，可以着陆跑道36右，风340，9米/秒。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land 36R, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆跑道36右，法航872。

cards.audioText: [A few minutes later.]AFR872, Ground, taxi to No.5 Apron via taxiway E3, A, A8, the fire services and medical teams are waiting for you on the apron.[You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【几分钟后。】法航872，地面，沿滑行道E3，A，A8滑至5号停机坪，消防车和医疗队在那里等待。【你需要复诵并表示感谢。】
cards.referenceText: Taxi to No.5 Apron via taxiway E3, A, A8, thank you very much, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道E3，A，A8滑至5号停机坪，非常感谢，法航872。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is AFR126, destination Beijing, 8900m maintaining, over TMR, TZH 10, squawk 6021, now contact Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是法航126，目的地北京，高度8900米，应答机6021，飞过TMR, 到达TZH时间10分，现在联系北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, 8900m maintaining, over TMR, TZH 10, squawk 6021.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，法航126，高度8900米保持，过TMR，预计TZH时间10分，应答机6021。

cards.audioText: AFR126, Beijing Control, squawk 6021, standard, negative short cut, over fly TZH due to Air Force activity.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，北京区调，应答机6021，按标准程序飞，不能直飞，由于空军活动，过TZH。
cards.referenceText: Over fly TZH due to Air Force movement, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于空军活动，过TZH，法航126。

cards.audioText: [Ask the controller which runway is in use.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【询问管制员哪条跑道可用。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, request runway in use.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，法航126，申请可用跑道。

cards.audioText: AFR126, expect KM01 arrival, runway in use 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，预计KM01进场，跑道36左可用。
cards.referenceText: Expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计KM01进场，跑道36左，法航126。

cards.audioText: [Ask whether you can use KM03 arrival and land on runway 01.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【询问是否可以KM03进场，降落在跑道01上。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR126, if available, request KM03 arrival, landing on runway 01.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，法航126，如果可以，请求KM03进场，着陆跑道01.

cards.audioText: AFR126, after KM, you can request Beijing Approach for change of runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，过KM后，可以向北京进近请求更换跑道。
cards.referenceText: Roger. After KM, request change runway, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，KM后，请求更换跑道，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, descend to and maintain 4500m over KM.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，过KM下降保持4500米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4500m over KM, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4500米，过KM，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, contact Beijing Approach 119.7, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，联系北京进近119.7，再见。
cards.referenceText: 119.7, good day, AFR126.

cards.audioText: [Over KM, maintaining 4500m, contact Beijing Approach and request runway 01, KM03 arrival.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在KM上方，保持4500米，联系北京进近，请求跑道01，KM03进场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, over KM, maintaining 4500m, request runway 01, KM03 arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，法航126，过KM，保持4500米，请求跑道01，KM03进场。

cards.audioText: AFR126, negative due to spacing, KM01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information A.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，由于间隔不同意跑道01，KM01进场，使用跑道36左，通播A。
cards.referenceText: KM01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information A, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: KM01进场，使用跑道36左，通播A，法航126.

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller that your flap has some problems.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知管制员襟翼有问题】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, our flap has some problems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，法航126，我们的襟翼有问题。

cards.audioText: AFR126, roger, say intention. [You have to hold for a check.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，收到，请示意图。【你必须盘旋检查。】
cards.referenceText: Request holding for a check, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求等待盘旋检查，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, descend to and maintain 3000m on QNH 1012, turn left direct to HUR, hold as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1012，左转直飞HUR，标准等待。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 3000m on QNH 1012, turn left direct to HUR, hold as published, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1012，左转直飞HUR，标准等待，法航126。

cards.audioText: [Operations are now normal, request landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【操作正常，请求降落。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, operations are now normal, request landing/to cancel hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，法航126，操作正常，请求着陆（取消等待）。

cards.audioText: AFR126, Beijing Approach, continue holding. Runway is being cleaned due thick snow, landing action poor.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，北京进近，继续等待。跑道有积雪，正在清理，着陆效应差。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue holding, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，法航126

cards.audioText: AFR126, snow is getting heavier, you have to hold about 1 hour.[The remaining fuel can hold for half hour; you have to request diversion.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，雪越来越大，你必须等大约1小时。【剩余燃油只能维持半小时，你不得不请求改航。】
cards.referenceText: Our endurance is 0030, request diversion, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 续航时间30分钟，请求改航，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, stand by.[Your fuel temperature indicates abnormal, you can only hold 10 minutes, request divert to Dalian airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，稍等。【燃油温度显示异常，能继续等待10分钟，请求改航至大连机场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR126, fuel temperature warning light on, endurance only 10 minutes, request divert to Dalian.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，法航126，油温警告灯亮了，续航能力仅10分钟，请求改航至大连。

cards.audioText: Standby one, we will ask Air Force to use a temporary route.
cards.audioTextZh: 稍等，向空军申请临时航路。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, climb to and maintain 8100m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，上升保持标压8100米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 8100m on standard, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持标压8100米，法航126。

cards.audioText: AFR126, direct to Dalian airport, contact Beijing Control 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，直飞大连机场，联系北京区调120.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to Dalian, 120.35, AFR126.

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is AFR101, your destination is Paris, you are going to depart from Beijing airport at Gate 301. Now call Beijing Delivery, and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是法航101，目的地巴黎，从北京出发，301号机位，现在联系北京放行，请求放行。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, AFR101, Gate 301, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，法航101，机位301，请求放行。

cards.audioText: AFR101, cleared to Paris, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600m, RENOB32 departure, request level change for 10400m en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，可以按计划航路放行至巴黎，起始高度6600米。RENOB32离场，在航路上申请巡航高度10400m，应答机1725，跑道36右，离场频率127.75。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Paris, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600m, RENOB32 departure, request level change for 10400m en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至巴黎，起始高度6600米，RENOB32离场，航路申请更改巡航10400米，应答机1725，跑道36右，离场频率127.75，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, correct. Contact Ground 121.9.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，正确。联系地面121.9。
cards.referenceText: 121.9, good day, AFR101.

cards.audioText: [You are ready for pushback and startup, call Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【已准备好推出开车，联系地面。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, AFR101, (Gate 301) request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，法航101，（301号机位）请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: AFR101, Beijing Ground, short delay for pushback, an A340 inbound for Gate 302.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，北京地面，稍等推出，一架A340在302号机位进位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, short delay for pushback, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，稍等推出，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, pushback approved. [Ask ATC the direction of pushback.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，同意推出。【向ATC询问推出方向。】
cards.referenceText: Pushback approved, request direction for push back, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出，请求推出方向，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, my apologies, pushback and startup approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，抱歉，同意推出开车，头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and startup approved, facing east., AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，头朝东，法航101。

cards.audioText: [All engines have been started, everything checked out normal, received information G, request taxi from Beijing Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【发动机都已起动，一切检查正常，收到通播G，向北京地面请求滑行。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, AFR101, information G, ready for taxi/request taxi instruction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，法航101，通播G，准备滑出/请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: AFR101, information G changed, information H is available. [Report that you have received H but you want to change runway 01 for a short course.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，通播G更改，当前通播为H。【报告你已收到通播H，但你想减少滑行距离更换至跑道01。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, information H received, request runway 01 for a short course, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，通播H，由于滑行距离，申请跑道01，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, B737 inbound is approaching from left for Gate 303, once that aircraft is cleared, taxi via B and D, hold short of runway 01. [You received report from information H that B is closed.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到，一架波音737从303号机位左侧滑行入位，737一离开，你就可以沿滑行道B，D滑行至跑道01外等待。【你收到通播H，滑行道B已经关闭。】
cards.referenceText: ATIS H says that taxiway B is closed, confirm taxi via B, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播H显示滑行道B已经关闭，确认是否从B滑行出，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, correction, taxi via M and D, hold short of runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，更正，沿滑行道M，D滑行至跑道01外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via M and D, hold short of runway 01, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道M，D滑行至跑道01外等待，法航101。

cards.audioText: [Now you are airborne. Contact Beijing Departure, you are passing 1200m and climbing to 1800m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在已起飞。联系北京离场，正在过1200米，往1800米爬升。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, AFR101, passing 1200m climbing to 1800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，法航101，通过1200米，正上升至1800米。

cards.audioText: AFR101, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，北京离场，已识别，上升标压6000米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 6000m on standard, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升标压6000米，法航101。

cards.audioText: [Flight attendant reports that there is a man carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them. Require emergency descent to 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【机组人员报告称有一名男子身上携带爆炸物，并试图引爆它。请求紧急下降至3000米。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Departure, AFR101, request descent to 3000m, a man is carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京离场，法航101，请求下降至3000米，一名男子身上携带爆炸物，并试图引爆它。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, descend to 3000m on QNH 1011. Say endurance. [Readback and report that you can hold for 2 hours more.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到，下降到3000，修压1011，报告续航时间。【复诵并报告你可以坚持2个多小时。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000m on QNH 1011, endurance 0200, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到3000，修压1011，续航时间2小时，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, divert immediately to Tongzhou.[Request radar vector to Tongzhou.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，立即改航去通州。【请求雷达引导去通州。】
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to Tongzhou, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导至通州，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, turn right heading 180, maintain 3000m. When able, report current conditions on board. [Readback and then give a report that the dangerous man is still struggling and has hurt two passengers.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，右转航向180，保持3000。如果可以，报告机上目前状况。【复诵并报告该危险男子仍在挣扎，有两名乘客受伤。】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, maintain 3000m. The man is struggling and two passengers are hurt, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，保持3000。该男子仍在抗争，两名乘客受伤，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, say intentions. [Tell the ATC that the man has finally surrendered, the two passengers are in dangerous situation, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到，请示意图。【告诉ATC该名男子最终被控制住了，两名受伤乘客处于危险状态，请求返回北京机场并优先降落。】
cards.referenceText: The man is under control now, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing, two passengers are in critical condition, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 该名男子已被控制，请求返回北京机场并优先降落，两名乘客受伤严重，法航101。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger. Cleared runway 18R, you are number one. Police officers and medical services will be ready on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到。可以降落跑道18右，你第一个。到达时警察和医疗服务都已准备好。
cards.referenceText: Runway 18R, No.1, thanks, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道18右，第一个，谢谢，法航101。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is Air France 754, a flight from Paris to Guangzhou, you are leveling at 10100m, near DAPRO, squawk 3645, you are now at Wuhan control zone. Call Wuhan Control 128.75.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是法航754，从巴黎飞往广州，你的高度是10100米，接近DAPRO，应答机3645，你现在在武汉管制区域，呼叫武汉区调128.75。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR754, 10100m, near DAPRO, squawk 3645.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航754,10100米，接近DAPRO，应答机3645。

cards.audioText: AFR754, radar contact, continue climbing to 10300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航754，雷达识别，继续爬升到10300米。
cards.referenceText: Continue climbing to 10300 meters, AFR754.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升到10300米，法航754。

cards.audioText: [During climbing, you encountered CB and request 20 miles deviation to the west.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在爬升过程中，你遇到了积雨云，并请求西偏航20海里]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR754, request 20 miles deviation to the west due CB.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航754，由于积雨云，请求西偏航20海里。

cards.audioText:
AFR754, 20 miles deviate west is approved.
[During cruise, you find that the navigation performance has been downgraded, report this to ATC and ask them to verify your flight track.]
cards.audioTextZh:
法航754，同意西偏航20海里。
[在巡航过程中，你发现导航性能降级，向管制员报告，请他们核实你的飞行轨迹]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR754, our navigation performance down-graded, request verify our flight track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航754，我们的导航性能降级，请求核实我们的飞行轨迹。

cards.audioText: AFR754, you are still on track.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航754，你依旧在航路上。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks. AFR754.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，法航754。

cards.audioText: [Your weather radar failed, make an emergency call to Wuhan Control and request divert to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你的气象雷达失效了，向武汉区调做紧急呼叫，并请求改航到武汉机场]
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Wuhan Control, AFR754, our weather radar failed, request divert to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan，武汉区调，法航754，我们的气象雷达失效了，请求改航到武汉机场。

cards.audioText: AFR754, roger Panpan, turn left to WHA, descend to 5100m. Contact Wuhan Approach on 119.65.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航754，收到Pan，左转飞至WHA，下降到5100米，联系武汉进近119.65。
cards.referenceText: Turn left to WHA, descend to 5100m, contact 119.65, AFR754.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转飞至WHA，下降到5100米，联系119.65，法航754。

cards.audioText: [Contact Wuhan Approach, tell them your situation and ask for the current weather information at Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: [联系武汉进近，告诉他们你的清况，并询问当前武汉机场的天气信息]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR754, we are diverting to Wuhan airport due weather radar failure, confirm the weather in Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航754，由于气象雷达失效，我们正改航至武汉机场，证实武汉机场的天气。
