[Tell the controller, you need about 5 minutes. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 英航3532，西安收到，你需要向右偏置多久？
【告知管制员，你需要大概5分钟。】
cards.referenceText: About 5 minutes, BAW3532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 大概5分钟，英航3532。

cards.audioText: C: BAW3532, Xi’an roger, offset 20km right of track approved, descend to 10100m, report clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 英航3532，西安收到，可以右偏20公里，下到10100米，脱离天气后报。
cards.referenceText: Offset 20km right of track approved, descend to 10100m, wilco, BAW3532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以右偏20公里，下到10100米，照办，英航3532。

cards.audioText:
[Later]
[You are now clear of weather, report your situation to the controller, and request turn left and rejoin airway H14.]
cards.audioTextZh:
【后来】
【你现在脱离了天气，把你的情况报告给管制员，请求左转再次加入H14航路。】
cards.referenceText: Xi’an control, BAW3532, clear of weather, request turn left and rejoin airway H14.
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安区调，英航3532，脱离天气，请求左转加入H14航路。

cards.audioText: C: BAW3532, negative, due possible traffic 10 o'clock converging with your flight route, fly heading 105 and direct to P62.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 英航3532，不可以，10点钟方向有航空器汇入你的航路，航向105，直飞P62。
cards.referenceText: Heading 105, direct to P62, BAW3532.

cards.audioText:
C: BAW3532, reduce Mach number by two points due flow control.
(注：实际飞行中存在此类表达，指的是将马赫数减小 0.02。 )
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航3532，由于流控，马赫数减小2点。
cards.referenceText: Reduce Mach number by two points, BAW3532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 马赫数减小2点，英航3532。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW3532, descend and maintain 9800m, rate of descent 2500ft per minute due opposite traffic on your 12 o’clock.
[Tell controller, at current flight speeds, such a high rate of descent is not acceptable, you need to increase your speed. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航3532，下9800米保持，由于12点方向有对向航空器，下降率每分钟2500英尺。
【告知管制员，在当前速度，无法接受这么高的下降率，你需要增加速度。】
cards.referenceText: Unable 2500ft per minute, request increase speed, BAW3532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 无法每分钟2500英尺，请求增速，BAW3532。

cards.audioText: C: BAW3532, cancel ATC speed restriction, descend and maintain 9800m, rate of descent 2500ft per minute.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航3532，取消管制速度限制，下9800保持，下降率2500英尺每分。
cards.referenceText: No speed restriction, descend and maintain 9800m, rate of descent 2500ft per minute, BAW3532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有速度限制，下9800米保持，下降率2500英尺每分，BAW3532。

cards.audioText: [Now you are leveling at 9500m, you encountered moderate turbulence, you want to descend to 8900m and you also want to know if there is any ride report on that level, contact Shanghai control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你保持在9500米，你遇到了中度颠簸，你想下到8900米，同时你也想知道这个高度层是否有过颠簸报告，联系上海区调。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai control, BAW3532, 9500m maintaining, request descend to 8900m due moderate turbulence and confirm if there is any turbulence report on that level?
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，英航3532，正保持9500米，由于颠簸，请求下到8900米，证实此高度是否有颠簸报告。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW3532, Shanghai control, negative, no traffic on that level, we’ve not received any chop information.
[Ask to descend to 8900m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 英航3532，上海区调，没有，没有航空器在此高度层，我们没有收到任何颠簸报告。
【请求下到8900米。】
cards.referenceText: Request to descend to 8900m, BAW3532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求下到8900米，英航3532。

cards.audioText: C: BAW3532, down to 8900m, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航3532，下到8900米，到达后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 8900m, wilco, BAW3532.

cards.audioText: [You are now 8900m maintaining, about 10 miles from P344, you had electrical arcing on the windshield and your windshield seemed to be cracked on the outside. You want to divert to Hefei airport immediately. Report this situation to Shanghai control, this is an urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你正保持在8900米，距离P344大概10海里，你的风挡玻璃上有电弧，风挡玻璃似乎从外面裂开了。你要立即备降合肥机场。将此情况报告上海区调，这是紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Shanghai control, BAW3532, 8900m maintaining, 10 miles from P344, our outer windshield seemed to be cracked due electrical arcing, request divert to Hefei.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，上海区调，英航3235，在8900米保持，P344 10海里，由于电弧，外侧风挡玻璃似乎破裂，请求改航合肥。

cards.audioText: C: BAW3532, Shanghai control, roger Panpan, descend to and maintain 6900m, expedite descent.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航3532，上海区调，收到Panpan，下到6900米保持，加速下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6900m, wilco, BAW3532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到6900米保持，照办，英航3532。

cards.audioText: C: BAW3532, turn right heading 183, further descend to 4500m, contact Hefei approach 119.85.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 英航3532，右转航向183，继续下到4500米，联系合肥进近119.85。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 183, descend to 4500m, contact Hefei approach 119.85, BAW3532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向183，继续下到4500米，联系合肥进近119.85，英航3532。

cards.audioText: N: [Your callsign is BAW390, a flight from Wuhan to London, Bay 208, you have ATIS Z, request Delivery for your ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是英航309，一架从武汉飞往伦敦的航班，你现在在208机位，收到通播Z，向放行申请管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, BAW390, from Wuhan to London, Bay 208, ATIS Zulu, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，英航390，从武汉飞往伦敦，208机位，通播Z，申请管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, cleared to London, runway 18R, ZF-13D departure, flight planned route, initial climb to and maintain 1800m, cruising level 9500m, expect level change en route, squawk 5505.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，可以飞往伦敦，跑道18右，ZF13D离场，计划航路，初始高度1800米，巡航高度9500米，预计入行后变高度，应答机5505。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London, runway 18R, ZF-13D departure, flight planned route, initial climb to and maintain 1800m, cruising level 9500m, expect level change en route, squawk 5505, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以飞往伦敦，跑道18右，ZF13D离场，计划航路，初始高度1800米，巡航高度9500米，预计入行后变高度，应答机5505，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [You are fully ready at Bay 208, request Wuhan Ground for pushback and startup.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在在208机位上完全准备好了，联系武汉地面请求推出开车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW390, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航309，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, after company Boeing777 enters adjacent Bay 207, pushback and startup approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，公司的波音777进入到临近的207机位后，可以推出开车，头朝西。
cards.referenceText: After the traffic enter adjacent Bay 207, pushback and startup approved, facing west, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 公司的波音777进入到临近的207机位后，可以推出开车，头朝西，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [During pushback, the tow bar was bent, notify Wuhan Ground, you will hold at present position while waiting for a new tow bar.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【在推出过程中，你的拖杆断了，告知武汉地面，你将原地等待，等待新的拖杆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW390, tow bar bent during pushback, we will hold at present position for a new tow bar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航390，推出过程中拖杆断了，我们将原地等待，等待新的拖杆。

cards.audioText: N: [You have completed the pushback and startup procedures, now you find there is a problem with your nose wheel, request to hold position to have the maintenance examine the nose wheel.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你已经完成了推出开车程序，现在你发现你的前轮出现了问题，请求原地等待，让机务人员进行检查前轮。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW390, nose wheel problem, request hold position to check the nose wheel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航309，前轮问题，请求原地等待，让机务人员检查下前轮。

cards.audioText: N: [The engineers have repaired the nose wheel, request Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【机务人员已经修好了前轮，向武汉地面请求滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW390, nose wheel repaired, request taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航309，前轮已经修好，请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, taxi to holding point of runway 18R via Z4, C, hold at holding point 7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，经由滑行道Z4，C滑行到跑道18右等待点，在等待点7等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 18R via Z4, C, hold at holding point 7, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，C滑行到跑道18右等待点，在等待点7等待，英航390。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, A330 is taxiing northbound on C, follow that aircraft to holding point runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，滑行道C上有一架向北滑行的空客A330，跟着那架航空器滑行到跑道18右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Follow the traffic to holding point runway 18R, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟着航空器到跑道18右外等待点，英航309。

cards.audioText: N: [You are at the holding point of runway 18R, you are ready for takeoff, call Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在正在跑道18右的外等待点，你准备好起飞了，呼叫武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW390, holding point of runway 18R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航390，在跑道18右外等待点，准备好起飞了。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW390, caution, previous aircraft reported wind shear shortly after takeoff, what is your intention?
N: [Ask controller about the wind shear information for other departure runways.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航390，注意，之前的航班在起飞不久时候报告遇到风切变，你的意图是什么？
N：【询问管制员，其他起飞跑道的风切变信息。】
cards.referenceText: Request wind shear information for other departure runways, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 询问其他起飞跑道的风切变信息，英航390。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW390, there is no reported windshear for other runways.
N: [Advise controller that you want to change your departure runway to 18L.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航390，其他跑道没有风切变报告。
N：【告知管制员，你想把起飞跑道更改到18左。】
cards.referenceText: Request change to runway 18L, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求更改跑道至18左，英航390。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, roger, enter runway 18R, vacate via W4, report vacating.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，收到，上跑道18右，经由W4脱离，脱离时报。
cards.referenceText: Enter runway 18R, vacate via W4, wilco, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道18右，经由W4脱离，将照办，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are cruising at 9500m, overhead OBLIK, make the initial contact with Zhengzhou Control, and say your squawk number 5505.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在在9500米巡航，飞越OBLIK，与郑州区调建立初始联系，告知你的应答机编码是5505。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW390, cruising at 9500m, over OBLIK, Squawk 5505.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航390，在9500米巡航，过OBLIK，应答机5505。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, offset 3miles right of track.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，郑州区调，雷达看见了，右偏置3海里。
cards.referenceText: Offset 3 miles to the right, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右偏置3海里，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [There is towering cumulus build up ahead, you want to climb to 10100m to overfly, make the request to Zhengzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【前方积云堆积得很高，你打算上到 10100 米高度飞越过去，向郑州区调提出请求。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW390, towering CB ahead, request climb to 10100m to overfly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航390，前方积云很高，请求上10100米飞越。

cards.audioText: N: [You found that you can not overfly the weather, request turn right heading 030, so you can be clear of the weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你发现你无法飞越天气，请求右转航向030，这样你可以避开天气。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW390, negative overfly weather, request turn right heading 030 to get clear of weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航390，不可以飞越天气，请求右转航向030来避开天气。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW390, Zhengzhou Control, negative due to restricted airspace. You can turn right heading to 015 or turn left as required, which would you prefer?
N: [You decided to deviate to the right as turning left would no longer be feasible. Advise Zhengzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航390，郑州区调，由于限制区，不可以。你可以右转航向015或者左转，你倾向于哪一个？
N：【因为无法左转，你决定右偏置，告知郑州区调。】
cards.referenceText: Request deviate to the right, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求右偏置，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [You are suddenly caught up in severe turbulence, you can not maintain altitude, advise Zhengzhou Control. This is an urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你突然遇到了重颠簸，你无法保持高度，告知郑州区调，这是一个紧急通话。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Zhengzhou Control, BAW390, experiencing severe turbulence, unable to maintain altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，郑州区调，英航390，遇到了强颠簸，无法保持高度。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW390, Zhengzhou Control, roger, what is your intentions?
N: [Tell Zhengzhou Control you will need a further right deviation to heading of 090.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航390，郑州区调，收到，你的意图是什么？
N：【告知郑州管制，你需要继续右偏置到航向090。】
cards.referenceText: Request further deviation to the right to heading 090, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求继续右偏置到航向090，英航390。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, heading of 090 approved, report when you are able to turn left.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，可以航向090，准备好左转时报。
cards.referenceText: Heading 090 approved, wilco, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以航向090，将照办，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [Your purser reports that several passengers have been injured during turbulence, they are in serious need of medical attention, you decided to return to Wuhan airport. Tell Zhengzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的乘务长报告说有几名乘客在颠簸时受伤了，他们急需医疗看护，你决定返回武汉机场，告知郑州区调。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW390, passenger injured during turbulence and need medical help, request return to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航390，乘客在颠簸时受伤了，他们急需医疗看护，请求返回武汉。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, turn left proceed to OBLIK, descend to and maintain 2700m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，左转直飞OBLIK，下2700米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn left proceed to OBLIK, descend to and maintain 2700m, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞OBLIK，下2700米保持，英航390。

cards.audioText: N: [Your aircraft now is in the Wuhan Approach control area, the condition of injured passengers are getting worse, call Wuhan Approach to make a landing as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的飞机现在在武汉进近管制区，受伤乘客情况恶化，联系武汉进近，请求尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW390, injured passenger is getting worse, request landing as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，英航390，受伤乘客情况恶化，请求尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: N: [Advise Wuhan Approach you will require medical assistance after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【告知武汉进近，着陆后你需要医疗协助。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW390, request medical assistance after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，英航390，着陆后请求医疗协助。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW390, how many injured passenger on board will require ambulance?
N: [Notify Wuhan Approach that 3 passengers are in serious conditions and will require ambulance and two more passengers suffered minor cuts and will require some first aid treatment at the airport.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：英航390，机上多少受伤乘客需要救护车？
N：【告知武汉进近，有3名乘客受伤严重，需要救护车，另外还有2名乘客有轻微擦伤，需要在机场接受一些初步治疗。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW390, 3 passengers are in serious conditions and will require ambulance and two more passengers suffered minor cuts and will require some first aid treatment at the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，英航390，有3名乘客受伤严重，需要救护车，另外还有2名乘客有轻微擦伤，需要在机场接受一些初步治疗。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, roger, descent to and maintain 1200m, turn left heading 190, to intercept the localizer for runway 22, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，收到，下1200米保持，左转航向190，切跑道22航向道，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: Descent to and maintain 1200m, turn left heading 190, to intercept the localizer for runway 22, wilco, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下1200米保持，左转航向190，切跑道22航向道，将照办，英航390。

cards.audioText: C: BAW390, you are 17 track miles to touchdown, you are high on your approach, increase your rate of descent.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航390，你现在距离接地点17海里，你进近高度偏高，增加下降率。
cards.referenceText: 17 track miles to touchdown, increase rate of descent, BAW390.
cards.referenceTextZh: 距离接地点17海里，增加下降率，英航390。

topics.name: BAW931 [乘客重病，让路，发动机起火]

cards.audioText: 1N: You are BAW931, at stand 709, with information L, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.audioTextZh: 你是英航931，在709号机位，收到通播Lima，请求飞往伦敦的管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan delivery, BAW931, information L received, stand 709, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，英航931，收到通播Lima，709号机位，请求飞往伦敦的管制许可。

cards.audioText: 2C: Clear to London, via flight planned route. ZF05D departure, initially climb to 1500 m, cruising level 10,700 m, runway in use 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往伦敦，ZF05D离场，初始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，跑道18左，离场后联系124.7，应答机4503。
cards.referenceText: Clear to London via flight planned route. ZF05D departure, initially climb to 1500 m, cruising level 10,700 m. runway in use 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503, BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往伦敦，ZF05D离场，初始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，跑道18左，离场后联系124.7，应答机4503，英航931。

cards.audioText: 3N: Now you are ready for push-back and start up, contact ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你准备好推出开车了，联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW931, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航931，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: 4C: BAW931, Push back and start up approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航931，可以推出开车，朝北。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing north. BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，朝北，英航931。

cards.audioText: 5N: Now you have a problem. One of your passenger is seriously ill. You inform ATC and request to disembark the passenger. You have to delay the push-back due to disembarking the passenger.
cards.audioTextZh: N：你现在遇到了一个问题，一名乘客病得很重，告知管制员，请求让这名乘客下飞机。由于乘客要下飞机，所以你推迟推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW931, request delay push-back and disembark an ill passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航931，请求推迟推出，让生病乘客下飞机。

cards.audioText: 6N: This time, contact your company to inform this situation. And also request medical assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 这次，联系你们公司，告知此情况，同时申请医疗协助。
cards.referenceText: Company office(此处可以是Operation office或者dispatcher), BAW931, push-back is delayed due to ill passenger, request medical assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 公司，英航931，由于一名得病乘客，推迟推出，请求医疗协助。

cards.audioText: 7N: Now, you have disembarked this passenger. Request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，这名乘客已经下机，请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan ground, BAW931, ready to taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航931，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: 8C: BAW931, taxi to the Holding point of runway 18L via A7, A, hold short of A5.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航931，经由A7，A滑行道跑道18左外等待点，在A5等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to the holding point of runway 18L, via A7, A, hold short of A5, BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由A7，A滑行道跑道18左外等待点，在A5等待，英航931。

cards.audioText: 9N: There is a B777 of your company behind you, Give way to the A320 crossing from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: 你后方有一架本公司的波音777，给正在从左向右穿越的空客A320让路。
cards.referenceText: 9P: Give way to the A320, BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给空客A320让路，英航931。

cards.audioText: 10C: BAW931, continue taxi after traffic is cleared, hold short of runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航931，冲突接触后继续滑行，在跑道18左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi after traffic is cleared, hold short of runway 18L. BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 冲突接触后继续滑行，在跑道18左外等待，英航931。

cards.audioText: 11C: BAW931, Line up and wait, clear for takeoff 18L, wind calm. Contact departure 124.5 after airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航931，上跑道等待，可以起飞，跑道18左，静风。离地后联系124.5。（注意，实际运行中，上跑道与起飞许可不会同时发布，这里是原题反馈，学员注意按题干要求复诵即可）
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, 124.5, clear for takeoff, runway 18L, BAW931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道等待，124.5，可以起飞，跑道18左，英航931。

cards.audioText: 12N: During take off rolling, your right engine suddenly got fire. You have to abort takeoff, contact ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 在滑跑期间，你右发突然着火。 你必须中断起飞，联系管制员。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW931, abort takeoff due to right engine fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航931，右发起火，中断起飞了。

cards.audioText: 13N: The fire can not be extinguished. Inform this to ATC. Also you want to carry out evacuation, and request emergency equipment.
cards.audioTextZh: 火无法熄灭，告知管制员此情况。同时，你想执行应急撤离，请求应急设备。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW931, We can’t extinguish the fire, request emergency evacuation and emergency equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航931，火无法熄灭，请求应急撤离和应急设备。

cards.audioText: [You are BAW951, at Stand 709, with information L, call Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance to London.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是英航951，709号机位，通播L，呼叫武汉放行，请求放行至伦敦。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, BAW951, Parking bay 709, information L, destination London, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，英航951，停机位709，通播L，目的地伦敦，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: BAW951, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to London, via flight planned route. ZF-05D departure, initially climb 1500m, cruising level 10700m. Runway 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往伦敦。ZF-05D离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，跑道18左，离场联系124.7，应答机4503。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London, flight planned route, SID ZF-05D, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 10700m, runway 18L, after departure contact 124.7, squaw 4503. BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往伦敦。ZF-05D离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，跑道18左，离场联系124.7，应答机4503，英航951。

cards.audioText: [Now you are ready for pushback and start-up, contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已准备好推出开车，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW951, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航951，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: BAW951, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，武汉地面，同意推出开车，头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, facing north, BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，头朝北，英航951。

cards.audioText: [Now you have a problem. One of your passengers is seriously ill. You inform ATC and request to disembark the passenger. You have to delay the pushback due to disembarking the passenger.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你遇到个问题。机上一名乘客生病严重。你通知ATC，请求让该乘客下飞机。由于该乘客离机，你不得不延误推出。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW951, request delay push back and startup, we will disembark the ill passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航951，请求推迟推出开车，我们要让生病乘客离机。

cards.audioText: [This time, contact your company to inform this situation. And also, request medical assistance]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系公司，报告该情况。同时请求医疗援助。】
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, BAW951, request disembark an ill passenger, and request medical assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，英航951，请求让生病乘客下机，并请求医疗救援。

cards.audioText: [Now, you have disembarked this passenger. Request taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在该乘客已经离机。请求滑行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW951, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，英航951，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: BAW951, taxi to the Holding point of runway 18L, via A7, A, hold short of A5.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，沿滑行道A7，A滑至跑道18左等待点，在A5外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to the Holding point of runway 18L, via A7, A, hold short of A5, BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道A7，A滑行跑道18左等待点，在A5外等待，英航951。

cards.audioText: [There is a B777 of your company behind you, and give way to the A320 crossing from left to right.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你公司的一架波音777在你后面，给从左到右的A320让路。】
cards.referenceText: Give way to the A320 crossing from left to right BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给从左到右的A320让路，英航951。

cards.audioText: BAW951, continue taxi after traffic cleared, hold short of runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，飞机没影响后继续滑行，跑道18左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi after traffic cleared, hold short of runway 18L. BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机没影响后继续滑行，跑道18左外等待，英航951。

cards.audioText: [You are holding short of runway 18L, and ready for take-off, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在跑道18左外等待，准备起飞，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW951, hold short runway 18L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航951，跑道18左外等待，准备好起飞。

cards.audioText: BAW951, line up runway 18L, cleared for takeoff, wind calm, contact departure 124.5 after airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，进跑道18左等待，可以起飞，静风，离地后联系离场124.5。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for take-off runway 18L, after departure contact 124.5. BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道18左，离场后联系124.5。英航951。

cards.audioText: [During take-off rolling, your right engine suddenly got fire. You have to abort takeoff. Contact ATC. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【起飞滑跑阶段，飞机右侧发动机突然着火。你不得不中断起飞。联系ATC。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Tower, BAW951, aborted take-off due engine fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，塔台，英航951，由于发动机失火，中断起飞。

cards.audioText:
Roger, BAW951, do you need any assistance?[The fire cannot be extinguished. Inform this to ATC,
also you want to carry out emergency evacuation and request emergency equipment.]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，英航951，需要其它援助么？【火无法熄灭。通知ATC该情况。同时你想进行紧急撤离，请求应急设备。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we cannot pull out the fire. Request emergency evacuation and emergency equipment, BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，火没有被扑灭，请求紧急撤离和应急设备，英航951。

cards.audioText: Roger, BAW951, fire engines and ambulances are on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，英航951，消防车和救护车在路上。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，英航951。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is BAW141, destination Beijing, estimate GUPAD 20, level 8900m, TYN 35, next ISGOD, contact Beijing Control, report in cloud at 10100m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是英航141，目的地北京，预计到达GUPAD 时间20分，高度8900米，TYN时间35分，下一个点ISGOD，联系北京区调，报告在10100米云中。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141 at 10100m in cloud, estimate GUPAD 20, maintaining 8900m, TYN 35, next ISGOD.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，英航141，高度10100米云中，预计到达GUPAD时间20分，高度8900米，到达TYN时间35分，下一点ISGOD。

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing Control, previous aircraft have required diversions right of track due to weather, please advise if you require the same.[Meteorological radar shows that you are fine at this stage.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京区调，前机因为天气原因要求改航至原航路右侧，如果有相同需求请通知。【气象雷达显示当前阶段状况良好。】
cards.referenceText: Negative, BAW141. (Radar shows normal. )
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，英航141。（气象雷达显示当前阶段状况良好。）

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing roger, contact me if require deviation.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京收到，如果需要改航联系我。
cards.referenceText: Roger, wilco, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，照办，英航141。

cards.audioText: [There is CB ahead of you, request deviation 5 miles right of track.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机前方有积雨云，请求右偏航5海里。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141, request deviate/offset 5 miles right of track due to CB ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，英航141，由于前方积雨云，请求右偏航5海里。

cards.audioText: BAW141, deviate 5 miles right of track approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，可以右偏航5海里。
cards.referenceText: 5 miles right of track approved, thanks, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以右偏航5海里，谢谢，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, traffic information, detect primary radar signal at 1 o’clock, 50 kilometers, northwest bound, altitude unknown, we are unable to communicate with the aircraft.[Tell the controller that your TCAS has no indication of that aircraft, and confirm whether the traffic is in conflict with you.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，活动通报，探测到1点钟方向有一次雷达信号，距离50千米，向西北飞行，高度未知，我们无法和该飞机取得联系。【告知管制员飞机上的TCAS系统未显示该飞机，并确认该交通是否和你有冲突。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, we do not have TCAS indication, confirm that the unidentified aircraft will not be in conflict with us, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，TCAS上没有显示，确认该不明身份的飞机是否和我们有冲突，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, the aircraft is currently parallel to your track. You are closing on that aircraft, report sighting. [Tell the controller that you are crossing cloud and you can’t see the aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，该飞机目前与你处于平行航道，你离它越来越近，能见报告。【告知管制员你正在穿越云层，无法看到该飞机。】
cards.referenceText: We are crossing cloud. Negative contact with the aircraft, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们在云中穿梭，无法看见该飞机，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing Control, probable false signal, proceed normally.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京区调，可能是错误信号，继续正常飞行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，英航141。

cards.audioText: [You suffered lightning strike, make a distress call and request descent to 4200m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【遭遇雷击，发送遇险信号，请求下降4200米。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Control, BAW141, lightning strike, request descent to 4200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY，北京区调，英航141，雷击，请求下降4200米。

cards.audioText: BAW141, descend to 4200m, report conditions.[You are checking and now suspect navigation system is malfunctioning.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，下降4200米，报告情况。【你正在检查，导航系统似乎发生故障。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200m, we are checking the navigation system, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到4200米，我们正在检查导航系统，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing roger, when ready, advise intention.[You lost directional indication, if weather permits, request navigation assistance to Beijing airport]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京收到，准备好时通知意图。【你失去了方向指示，如果天气允许，请求雷达引导至北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: If weather permits, request navigation assistance to Beijing airport due directional indication failure, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果天气允许，由于航向指示失效，请求导航至北京机场，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing roger, Beijing CAVOK, your position is 25 miles northeast of VYK on a heading of about 070, expect small correcting turns to the left in 5 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京收到，北京CAVOK，你的位置是VYK东北25海里，航向大约070，预计向左稍微偏转5海里。
cards.referenceText: Expect small correcting turns to the left in 5 miles, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向左稍微偏转5海里，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, this is Beijing Approach, descend to 1800m on QNH 1011, expect runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京进近，下降修正海压1800米，修正海压1011，预计跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800m on QNH 1011, expect runway 36L, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降修正海压1800米，修正海压1011，预计跑道36左，英航141。

cards.audioText: BAW141, you are 15 miles to touchdown on runway 36L, descend to 900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，距离跑道36左接地点15海里，下降900米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900m, BAW141.

cards.audioText: BAW141, position 10 miles northeast of the field, 3 miles north of the extended center line of runway 36L, a correcting heading won’t be necessary, descend to 600m, report visual.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，位于机场东北10海里，跑道36左延长线南部3海里，不需要修正航向，下降600米，能见跑道报告。
cards.referenceText: Position 10 miles northeast of the field, 3 miles north of the extended center line of runway 36L,, descend to 600m, report visual, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 位于机场东北10海里，跑道36左延长线南部3海里，下降600米，能见机场后报告，英航141。

cards.audioText: [Tell the ATC that you have sighted the field.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知管制员你可以看到机场】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, BAW141. field in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，英航141，看见跑道了。

cards.audioText: BAW141, roger, cleared visual approach, join final for runway 36L, you are number one, contact Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，收到，可以目视进近，加入跑道36左五边，你第一个着陆，联系塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Cleared visual approach, join final for runway 36L, No.1, 118.1, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以目视进近，加入跑道36左五边，第一个，118.1，英航141。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is BAW038, from Beijing to London, passing 1200m climbing to 1800m, now contact Beijing Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是英航038，飞机从北京飞往伦敦，通过1200米，正在上升至1800米，现在联系北京离场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, passing 1200m climbing to 1800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，英航038，通过1200米，正上升至1800米。

cards.audioText: BAW038, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，北京离场，雷达已识别，上升到标准气压6000米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 6000m on standard, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升到标准气压6000米，英航038。

cards.audioText: [The aircraft ingested something, request descent to 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机吸入了某些东西，请求下降到3000米。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, foreign object ingestion, request descent to 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，英航038，飞机吸入异物，请求下降到3000米。

cards.audioText: BAW038, roger, descend to 3000m on QNH 1011.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，收到，下降到3000米，修正海压1011。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000m on QNH 1011, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到3000米，修正海压1011，英航038。

cards.audioText: BAW038, Beijing Departure, report intention.[Your turbine blades appear to be broken, request return to Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，北京离场，报告意图。【你的涡轮叶片似乎破损了，请求返回北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request return to Beijing airport, our turbine blades may have been broken, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求返回北京机场，涡轮叶片可能已破损，英航038。

cards.audioText: BAW038, roger, turn right heading 180, information I, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，收到，右转航向180，通播I，雷达引导着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, information I, radar vector for landing, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，通播I，雷达引导着陆，英航038。

cards.audioText: BAW038, report current situation.[Tell the controller that the port engine flamed out and you should land as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，报告现在的情况。【告诉管制员左发熄火了，你需要尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Beijing Departure, BAW038, port engine flames out, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, 北京离场，英航038，左发动机熄火，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: BAW038 roger, can you execute normal landing, do you require fuel dumping?[You can land normally and no need for fuel dumping.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，收到，能否执行正常着陆，需要放油吗？【飞机可以正常着陆，不需要放油。】
cards.referenceText: We can make a normal landing without dumping fuel, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以正常着陆不需要放油，英航038。

cards.audioText: [2 minutes later.][Tell the controller the fuel passage is blocked, only the auxiliary fuel tank is available, request priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【2分钟后】【告诉管制员燃油管道被堵住了，只有备用油箱可以使用，请求优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, fuel passage blocked by a foreign object, now only the auxiliary fuel tank is operative, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，英航038，燃油管道被异物堵住，现在只有备用油箱可用，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: BAW038, Beijing roger, report endurance.[Tell Control that your endurance is 30 minutes.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，北京收到，报告续航时间。【告诉管制员你的续航时间是30分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Endurance 0030, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 续航时间0030，英航038。

cards.audioText: BAW038, roger, turn right heading 300, expect runway 01, caution surface wind 240, 12m/s, gusting to 18m/s.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，收到，右转航向300，预计跑道01，注意地面风240, 12米/秒，阵风18米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, expect runway 01, roger, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向300，预计跑道01，收到，英航038。

cards.audioText: BAW038, turn right heading 340, report established localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，右转航向340，建立航向道后报。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, report established localizer, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向340，建立航向道后报，英航038。

cards.audioText: [You have established localizer.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立好航向道。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, BAW038, established localizer.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进场，英航038，已建立航向道。

cards.audioText: BAW038, continue approach, contact Beijing Tower 118.1, I will advise them of your problem.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1，我会通知他们你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, 118.1, thanks, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，118.1，谢谢，英航038。

cards.audioText: [You have established ILS.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立盲降。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, BAW038, established ILS.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，英航038，建立盲降。

cards.audioText: BAW038, Beijing Tower, continue approach, report outer marker, caution surface wind 240, 12m/s, gusting to 18m/s.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，北京塔台，继续进近，过远台报告，注意地面风240, 12米/秒，阵风18米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Roger, report outer marker, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，远台报，英航038。

cards.audioText: [Over outer marker.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【到外指点标。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, BAW038, outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，英航038，过远台。

cards.audioText: BAW038, cleared to land runway 01, wind 240, 12m/s, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，可以着陆跑道01，风向240, 风速12米/秒，脱离跑道后报。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 01, report vacated, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆跑道01，脱离后报，英航038。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is BAW120, from London to Wuhan, cruising at 11000m, over WXI, Squawk 4521, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是英航120，从伦敦飞往武汉，在11000米巡航，飞过WXI，应答机4521，与郑州区调做初始报话。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW120, cruising at 11000m, over WXI, Squawk 4521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航120，在11000米巡航，飞过WXI，应答机4521。

cards.audioText:
BAW120, Zhengzhou Control, radar identified, descend and maintain 9200m.
You want to maintain present level and descend after passing AKOMA.
cards.audioTextZh:
英航120，郑州区调，雷达识别了，下9200米保持。
你想保持当前高度，在通过AKOMA点后下降。
cards.referenceText: Request maintain present level and descend after passing AKOMA., BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求保持当前高度，通过AKOMA点后下降，英航120。

cards.audioText:
You can either descend now without speed restrictions or maintain 11000m and fly heading 260 for 5min, which do you prefer?
Tell the controller you want to descend to 9200m.
cards.audioTextZh:
你可以现在下降，没有速度限制，也可以在11000米保持，航向260保持5分钟，你选哪一个？
告诉管制员，你想下降到9200米。
cards.referenceText: Request descend to 9200, BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求下降到9200米，英航120。

cards.audioText: Roger, descend to 9200m, rate of descent at 2000ft per min or greater. Offset 3 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，下降到9200米，下降率每分钟2000英尺或更大。右偏航3海里。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 9200m, rate of descent at 2000ft per minute or greater. Offset 3 miles to the right. BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到9200米，下降率每分钟2000英尺或更大。右偏航3海里，英航120。

cards.audioText: Now you are maintaining 9200m in icing condition. Indications show pitot tube heating has failed and your air speed indications appear to be inaccurate. Call Zhengzhou Control tell him you want to descend to a lower level to avoid icing condition.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在保持在9200米，遇到积冰，你的皮托管加热系统失效了，你空速指示不正确，呼叫郑州区调，告诉他你想下降到更低高度来避开积冰。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW120, maintaining 9200m in icing condition. Our pitot tube heating has failed and the air speed indications are not correct. Request descend to a lower level to avoid icing condition.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航120，在9200米保持，遇到积冰，我们的皮托管加热系统失效了，空速指示不正确，请求下降到更低高度来避开积冰。

cards.audioText: BAW120, descend to and maintain 7800m, cancel offset. Track direct to AKOMA, reduce speed to minimum clean speed due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航120，下到7800米保持，取消偏航。直飞AKOMA，由于流控，速度减小到最低光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 7800m, cancel offset. Track direct to AKOMA, reduce speed to minimum clean speed due flow control. BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到7800米保持，取消偏航。直飞AKOMA，由于流控，速度减小到最低光洁速度，英航120。

cards.audioText: You are maintaining 7800m, overhead OBLIK, inform Zhengzhou Control that your air speed indication is working normally, you want to resume normal speed and continue descend.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在7800米保持，飞过OBLIK，告知郑州区调，你的空速指示正常工作了，你想恢复到正常速度，继续下降。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW120. Maintaining 7800m, over OBLIK, our air speed indication is working normally, request resume normal speed and continue descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航120，在7800米保持，飞过OBLIK，我们的空速指正常工作了，请求恢复到正常速度，继续下降。

cards.audioText: Roger, BAW120. Speed restriction is canceled. Descend to and maintain 6600m, contact 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，英航120，取消速度限制，下6600米保持，联系119.7。
cards.referenceText: Cancel speed restriction, descend and maintain 6600m, contact 119.7, BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消速度限制，下6600米保持，联系119.7，英航120。

cards.audioText: Now you are passing 7200m, descend to 6600m. transponder code 4521, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你通过7200米，下降到6600米，应答机代码4521，呼叫武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW120, passing 7200m, descend to 6600m. transponder code 4521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，英航120，通过7200米，下降到6600米，应答机代码4521。

cards.audioText: BAW120, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend to 4800m from present position, track direct to ZF, contact Wuhan Approach 120.45.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航120，武汉区调，雷达识别了，从当前位置下降到4800米，直飞ZF，联系武汉进近120.45。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4800m from present position, track direct to ZF, contact Wuhan Approach 120.45. BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从当前位置下降到4800米，直飞ZF，联系武汉进近120.45，英航120。

cards.audioText: You are about to level off at 4800m, information I received, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你打算在4800米改平，收到通播I，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW120, level off at 4800m, information I.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，英航120，在4800米改平，收到通播I。

cards.audioText: Wuhan Approach, radar contact, expect ZF-12 arrival, runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: 武汉进近，雷达识别了。预计ZF-12A进场，跑道18右。
cards.referenceText: ZF-12arrival, runway 18R. BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF-12进场，跑道18右，英航120。

cards.audioText: You are 10 miles from touchdown, establish ILS for runway 18R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你离接地点10海里，建立ILS，跑道18右，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW120, 10 miles from touchdown, establish ILS for runway 18R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航120，接地点10海里，建立ILS盲降，跑道18右。

cards.audioText: Wind 220 degrees, 10 meters per second, gusting 15m/sec, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 风向220度，10米每秒，阵风15米每秒。可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 18R, BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道18右，英航120。

cards.audioText: You encounter low level wind shear at 300m and decide to go around. Call Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在300米遭遇低空风切变，决定复飞，呼叫塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW120, going around due low level wind shear at 300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航120，300米遇到低空风切变，复飞了。

cards.audioText: BAW120, follow the published missed approach procedure, climb to and maintain 1800m.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航120，按照发布的复飞程序，上1800米保持。
cards.referenceText: Follow the published missed approach procedure, climb to and maintain 1800m, BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照发布的复飞程序，上1800米保持，英航120。

cards.audioText: Tell Wuhan Tower you want to make ILS approach runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉武汉塔台，你想进行ILS进近，跑道22。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW120, request ILS approach runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，英航120，请求ILS进近，跑道22。

cards.audioText: Roger, contact Approach 120.45 for vectors onto final runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，联系进近120.45，雷达引导进入跑道22五边。
cards.referenceText: Contact approach 120.45 for vectors onto final runway 22, BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 联系进近120.45，雷达引导进入跑道22五边，英航120。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is BAW871, from Beijing to London, you are at stand 215, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是英航871，从北京飞往伦敦，你现在在215号停机位，请求飞往伦敦的管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, BAW871, stand 215, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，英航871，215号停机位，请求飞往伦敦的管制许可。

cards.audioText: BAW871, cleared to London via flight planned route, follow VYK 05D Departure, initially 900m on 1023, cruising level 10,400m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，可以经由计划航路飞往伦敦，按照VYK05离场程序，初始爬升至900米，修正海压1023，巡航高度10400米，离场后联系120.6，应答机4523。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London via flight planned route, follow VYK 05D Departure, initially 900m on 1023, cruising level 10,400m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往伦敦，按照VYK05离场程序，初始爬升至900米，修正海压1023，巡航高度10400米，离场后联系120.6，应答机4523，英航871。

cards.audioText: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在准备好了，联系地面，请求推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW871, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，英航871，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: BAW871, Push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，同意推出开车，面朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，面朝西，英航871。

cards.audioText: You noticed the tug is not in position yet, ask Ground control for a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: 你注意到拖车未就位，向地面管制请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW871, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，英航871，请求拖车。

cards.audioText:
BAW871, roger, the tug is on the way.
While taxiing, you notices the wind sock shows a strong tail wind, contact Ground to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh:
英航871，收到，拖车在路上。
滑行过程中，你注意到风袋显示强顺风，联系地面，检查风向风速。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW871, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，英航871，请求风向风速。

cards.audioText: BAW871, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，地面风220度，8米每秒。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，英航871。

cards.audioText: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact tower to change to runway 22 and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 顺风量超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台，更换为跑道22, 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, BAW871, the tailwind exceeds takeoff limit, request change to runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，英航871，顺风量超过起飞限制，请求更换为跑道22。

cards.audioText: After airborne, you fly into a flock of birds, the left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return for landing. This is an urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后，你飞入鸟群，你左侧风挡破裂，请求放油并返场着陆。这是一个紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, BAW871, we encountered bird strike and our left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，英航871，我们我们遭遇鸟击，左侧风挡破裂，请求放油并返场着陆。

cards.audioText: BAW871, roger your pan, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb to 3300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，收到Pan，右转航向240，切LKO030向台径向线，爬升至3300米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb to 3300m, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切LKO030向台径向线，爬升至3300米，英航871。

cards.audioText: BAW871, after LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300m, report over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，LKO之后，右转航向220，保持3300米，过LKO报。
cards.referenceText: After LKO, turn right heading 220, maintaining 3300m, report over LKO/wilco, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: LKO之后，右转航向220，保持3300米，过LKO报/照办，英航871。

cards.audioText: Now you finished fuel dumping, ask for radar vectors to runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你完成了放油，请求雷达引导至跑道22。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, BAW871, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector to runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，英航871，完成放油，请求雷达引导至跑道22。

cards.audioText: BAW871, turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH1015, expect runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，右转直飞DA，下到2100米，修正海压1015，预计使用跑道22。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH1015, expect runway 22, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞DA，下到2100米，修正海压1015，预计使用跑道22，英航871。

cards.audioText: Your APU has failed, tell this situation to Beijing Tower and ask for Ground Power Unit.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的APU失效了，将情况告知北京塔台，请求地面动力装置。
cards.referenceText: Beiing Tower, BAW871, request ground power unit due APU failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，英航871，由于APU失效，请求地面动力装置。

cards.audioText: BAW871, ground power will be ready, caution crosswind when landing, expect ZF-01 arrival, cleared to land, runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航871，地面电源将就绪，着陆时注意侧风，预计ZF-01进场，可以落地，跑道22。
cards.referenceText: Thanks for caution, ZF-01 arrival, cleared to land, runway 22, BAW871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 谢谢提示，ZF-01进场，可以落地，跑道22，英航871。

topics.name: UAL 221 乘客心脏病 乘客不舒服

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 221, you are maintaining 9200 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5536, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 221，保持 9200 米，飞越 IKUBA，应答机 5536，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 221, maintaining 9200 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5536.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 221，保持 9200 米，飞越 IKUBA，应答机 5536。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, maintain 9200 meters, direct to XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，保持 9200 米，直飞 XSH。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 9200 meters, direct to XSH, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 9200 米，直飞 XSH，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: B: You are encountering severe turbulence at 9200 meters, contact Shanghai Control and check if any higher level is available.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 9200 米遭遇严重颠簸，联系上海管制，询问是否有更高高度可用。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 221, we are encountering severe turbulence at 9200 meters, is higher level available?
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 221，我们在 9200 米遭遇严重颠簸，是否有更高高度可用？

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 221, 11600 meters is available now, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you are unable to accept 11600 meters because of performance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 221，11600 米现在可用，报告意图。
B：告诉管制员因性能原因无法接受 11600 米。
cards.referenceText: Negative, we are unable to accept 11600 meters due performance, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不能接受，因性能原因无法接受 11600 米，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, maintain present level, expect higher level after XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，保持当前高度，过 XSH 后预计可上升至更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, expect higher level after XSH, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，过 XSH 后预计可上升至更高高度，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over XSH, maintaining 9200 meters, contact Wuhan Control and request higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 XSH，保持 9200 米，联系武汉管制请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 221, over XSH, maintaining 9200 meters, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 221，飞越 XSH，保持 9200 米，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to and maintain 10400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升并保持 10400 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 10400 meters, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 10400 米，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, 1 of the passengers suffered from heart attack, contact Wuhan Control and request descent to lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：突然有 1 名旅客心脏病发作，联系武汉管制，请求下降到较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 221, 1 of the passengers suffered from heart attack, request descent to lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 221，1 名旅客心脏病发作，请求下降到较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, maintain 10400 meters due airspace congestion, reduce speed to Mach 0.75.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，因空域拥挤，保持 10400 米，减速至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 10400 meters, reduce speed to M.75, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 10400 米，减速至 M.75，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: B: The flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告有一名旅客身体不适，向武汉管制报告并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 221, the flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 221，乘务员报告有一名旅客身体不适，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, descend to 6600 meters, level at XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，下降至 6600 米，在 XSH 改平。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 6600 meters, level at XSH, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6600 米，在 XSH 改平，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, track direct to XSH, follows ZF-2A arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，直飞 XSH，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to XSH, follows ZF-2A arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36R, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 XSH，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, you have got information O, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 ZF，保持 6600 米，已收到通播 O，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 221, over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, information O.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 221，飞越 ZF，保持 6600 米，收到通播 O。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, current information is P, descend to and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前通播为 P，下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Information P, descend to and maintain 4200 meters, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播 P，下降并保持 4200 米，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL 221。

topics.name: UAL 403 防冰 因重量提前下降

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 403, you are at Wuhan Airport, before departure, you received the cabin report said that there is ice and snow buildup on the wings, contact Wuhan Ground and tell the controller you want to have ice removed before start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 403，在武汉机场，离场前收到客舱报告，机翼有冰雪堆积，联系武汉地面，告知需要在开车前除冰。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, there is ice and snow buildup on the wings, request de-icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 403，机翼有冰雪堆积，请求除冰。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, where do you want to de-ice?
B: Tell the controller you want to de-ice on taxiway Z4.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 403，你想在哪里除冰？
B：告诉管制员想在滑行道 Z4 除冰。
cards.referenceText: Request de-icing on taxiway Z4, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求在滑行道 Z4 除冰，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the Ground controller you have completed de-icing and you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉地面管制员你已完成除冰，准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, de-icing completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 403，除冰完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: The de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, tell the Ground controller you need to takeoff before 0835, and request intersection departure from Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: B：除冰液有效时间只有 30 分钟，告诉地面管制你需要在 0835 前起飞，并请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, we need to takeoff before 0835, request intersection departure from Z4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 403，除冰液有效时间只有 30 分钟，我们需要在 0835 前起飞，请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: B: You have encountered moderate turbulence, ask Guangzhou Control for a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你遭遇中度颠簸，向广州管制请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，我们遭遇中度颠簸，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, 10700 meters and 11300 meters are both available, which 1 do you prefer?
B: Tell the controller you want to climb to 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 403，10700 米和 11300 米都可用，你偏好哪一个？
B：告诉管制员你想爬升至 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 10700 meters, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求爬升至 10700 米，UAL 403。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, radar shows you are a bit higher than your assigned level, check your altitude.
B: Tell the controller you are running into some turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 403，雷达显示你略高于指定高度，请检查高度。
B：告诉管制员你正在遭遇颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, we are running into some turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，我们正在遭遇颠簸。

cards.audioText: B: Ask Guangzhou Control if there is any turbulence reported from preceding aircraft at 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：询问广州管制，前机是否报告 11300 米有颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, is there any turbulence reported from preceding aircraft at 11300 meters?
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，前机是否报告 11300 米有颠簸？

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, there is no turbulence report at 11300 meters.
B: Tell the controller you want to climb to 11300 meters due turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 403，11300 米没有颠簸报告。
B：告诉管制员因颠簸请求爬升至 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request climb to 11300 meters due turbulence, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，因颠簸请求爬升至 11300 米，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, climb and maintain 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，爬升并保持 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 11300 meters, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11300 米，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Guangzhou Control you request earlier descent because your landing weight exceeds maximum landing weight, and you will request descent now.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉广州管制，因为着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，请求提前下降，并请求现在开始下降。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, request earlier descent due our landing weight exceeds maximum landing weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，因着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，请求提前下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, descend to 4500 meters, reach 4500 meters before ATAGA, start descent at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，下降至 4500 米，在 ATAGA 前达到 4500 米，自主决定开始下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4500 meters, reach 4500 meters before ATAGA, start descent at own discretion, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4500 米，在 ATAGA 前达到 4500 米，自主决定开始下降，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: There is an indication of thunderstorm ahead, contact Guangzhou Control and request offset 10 miles right to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：前方有雷暴迹象，联系广州管制，请求向右偏航 10 海里避让天气。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, request offset 10 miles right due CB ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，前方有 CB，请求向右偏航 10 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, 10 miles right approved, report clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，同意向右 10 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 10 miles right approved, report clear of weather, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右 10 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of whether, report the situation to Guangzhou Control and request direct to TON.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离天气，向广州管制报告并请求直飞 TON。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, clear of whether, request direct to TON.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，已脱离天气，请求直飞 TON。

topics.name: UAL 831 后客舱异响 慢释压

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 831, a flight from Wuhan to San Francisco, you have completed push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 831，从武汉飞往旧金山，已完成推出和开车，联系武汉地面获取滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 831, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 831，推出开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A7 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，经滑行道 F、A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A7 and A, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 F、A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, contact Wuhan Tower on 118.65.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，联系武汉塔台118.65。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 04, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 等待点，准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 831, holding point Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 831，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, cleared for takeoff Runway 04, surface wind 060, 10 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，跑道 04 可以起飞，地面风 060，10 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 04, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 04 可以起飞，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，已离地，通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb to 3900 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，取消 SID，直飞 HFE，按标准气压爬升至 3900 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb to 3900 meters on standard, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，直飞 HFE，按标准气压爬升至 3900 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, the purser tells you a passenger has heard abnormal noises from the rear cabin, you decide to level off at 2700 meters, advise Wuhan Departure your intention to level off due possible problem in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，乘务长告诉你有旅客听到后客舱异常声响，你决定在 2700 米改平，向武汉离场说明因客舱可能存在问题，请求在 2700 米改平。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, a passenger has heard abnormal noises from the rear cabin, request level off at 2700 meters due possible cabin problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，有旅客听到后客舱异常声响，因客舱可能存在问题，请求在 2700 米改平。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, climb to and maintain 2700 meters, advise intention.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，爬升并保持 2700 米，报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 2700 meters, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 2700 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: The aircraft is leveling, no one else can confirm the noise that the particular passenger heard, you check all the instruments are indicating normally, you decide to continue the flight and request a higher level, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：飞机已改平，没有其他人能确认该旅客听到的声音，各仪表指示正常，你决定继续飞行并请求更高高度，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, all the instruments are indicating normally, request continue the flight and request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，各仪表指示正常，请求继续飞行并请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, climb to 4500 meters on standard, contact Wuhan Control 120.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，按标准气压爬升至 4500 米，联系武汉管制120.5。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4500 meters on standard, 120.5, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升至 4500 米，120.5，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 10700 meters, over HFE, squawking 5316, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持 10700 米，飞越 HFE，应答机 5316，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 831, maintaining 10700 meters, over HFE, squawking 5316.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 831，保持 10700 米，飞越 HFE，应答机 5316。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, Shanghai Control, radar contact, proceed direct to VMB.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，上海管制，雷达识别，直飞 VMB。
cards.referenceText: Proceed direct to VMB, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 VMB，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: Now you confirm the strange sound from the cabin, your instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly, slow depressurization is suspected, request immediate descent from 10700 meters to 3000 meters. This is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在确认客舱有异常声音，仪表显示客舱高度缓慢上升，怀疑缓慢释压，请求从 10700 米立即下降至 3000 米。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL 831, our instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly, suspect slow depressurization, request immediate descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，上海管制，UAL 831，仪表显示客舱高度缓慢上升，怀疑缓慢释压，请求立即下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, roger PAN, turn right heading 150, initially descend and maintain 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，收到 PAN，右转航向 150，先下降并保持 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 150, descend and maintain 8900 meters, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 150，下降并保持 8900 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 831, turn left heading 210, descend to 3300 meters.
B: Read back ATC instructions and request the nearest suitable airport for landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 831，左转航向 210，下降至 3300 米。
B：复诵管制指令，并请求前往最近合适机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 210, descend to 3300 meters, request the nearest suitable airport for landing, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 210，下降至 3300 米，请求最近合适机场着陆，UAL 831。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 831, the closest airport is Nanjing Airport, current visibility is marginal, I have to check if they can accommodate an aircraft of your size. Hongqiao and Pudong Airport has longer runway and can definitely accommodate your aircraft, advise your intention?
B: Ask radar vector to Shanghai Hongqiao or Pudong Airport which has a better visibility.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 831，最近的机场是南京机场，当前能见度临界，我需要确认他们能否接收你们这种机型。虹桥和浦东机场跑道更长，肯定可以接收，请报告意图。
B：请求雷达引导至上海虹桥或浦东机场，选择能见度较好的机场。
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to Shanghai Hongqiao or Pudong Airport which has a better visibility, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导至上海虹桥或浦东机场，选择能见度较好的机场，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, direct to HSH, expect radar vectors to land at Pudong Airport, contact Shanghai Approach on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，直飞 HSH，预计雷达引导至浦东机场着陆，联系上海进近128.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HSH, expect radar vectors to land at Pudong Airport, 128.35, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 HSH，预计雷达引导至浦东机场着陆，128.35，UAL 831。

topics.name: UAL 182 火山灰 双发失效 一发重启不稳定

cards.audioText: B: Your aircraft call sign is UAL 182, you are at the holding point of Runway 04, call Wuhan Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的航空器呼号是 UAL 182，在跑道 04 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台，报告准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 182, holding point of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 182，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, behind China Southern Boeing 777 on short final, line up behind Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，在短五边 China Southern Boeing 777 后，跟随其后进入跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Behind CSN B777 on short final, line up behind Runway 04, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随短五边 CSN B777 后进入跑道 04，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, when airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne and passing 200 meters, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 200 米，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 182, airborne, passing 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 182，已离地，通过 200 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, after passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: After passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are in London Control area, FL350, you encountered volcanic ash, tell ATC the situation and request descent, call London Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在伦敦管制区，飞行高度层 350，遭遇火山灰，向 ATC 报告情况并请求下降，呼叫伦敦管制。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we encountered volcanic ash at FL350, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们在 FL350 遭遇火山灰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, turn right heading 300, descend to FL290.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，右转航向 300，下降至飞行高度层 290。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, descend to FL290, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，下降至 FL290，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC you are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, both engines flamed out, make a Distress call and request land at the nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，双发熄火，发出遇险呼叫并请求在最近机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, London Control, UAL 182, both engines flamed out, request land at the nearest airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，伦敦管制，UAL 182，双发熄火，请求在最近机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 340.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 340。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent, tell ATC the situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启，告诉 ATC 当前情况。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at the nearest airport because the running engine is not stable.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，你的意图？
B：告诉 ATC 因工作发动机不稳定，仍需在最近机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, request land at the nearest airport due the running engine is not stable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，因工作发动机不稳定，请求在最近机场着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, continue descent to 9000 feet, expect to land at Beatle Airport.
B: Tell controller you are not familiar with Beatle Airport, request airport information.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，继续下降至 9000 英尺，预计在 Beatle Airport 着陆。
B：告诉管制员你不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场信息。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 9000 feet, we are not familiar with Beatle Airport, request airport information, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 9000 英尺，我们不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场信息，UAL 182。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, Beatle Airport landing Runway 02, elevation 2000 feet, runway 3000 meters long, 45 meters wide, ILS CAT I and II available.
B: Tell ATC you are able to land at this airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，Beatle Airport 使用着陆跑道 02，机场标高 2000 英尺，跑道长 3000 米、宽 45 米，可用 ILS CAT I 和 II。
B：告诉 ATC 你可以在该机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we are able to land at this airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们可以在该机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, continue descent to 5000 feet and contact Approach 121.3.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，继续下降至 5000 英尺，联系进近 121.3。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 5000 feet and contact Approach 121.3, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 5000 英尺，联系进近 121.3，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Approach, tell them your emergency situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：联系进近，告知他们你的紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, we encountered volcanic ash, both engines flamed out, 1 engine was successfully restarted but not stable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，我们遭遇火山灰，双发熄火，1 台发动机已成功重启但不稳定。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, roger your situation, runway is at your 2 o'clock, 10 miles, report airfield in sight.
B: Tell ATC you see the airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，收到你的情况，跑道在你 2 点钟方向 10 海里，看到机场后报告。
B：告诉 ATC 你看到机场。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, airfield in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，已看到机场。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Approach you need emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉进近你需要应急服务在跑道附近待命。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, request emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，请求应急服务在跑道附近待命。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 805 on a flight to Guangzhou, you are approaching WXI, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 6527, contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 805，飞往广州，正在接近 WXI，保持 11000 米，应答机 6527，联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, approaching WXI, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 6527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，接近 WXI，保持 11000 米，应答机 6527。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar contact, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to Mach 0.75 due to Wuhan Control restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，雷达识别，向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，因武汉管制限制，减速至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to M.75, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向航迹右侧偏置 3 海里，减速至 M.75，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，向郑州管制请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, our weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request 20 miles deviation right of track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，我们气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 805。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 805, reduce speed to Mach 0.72.
B: Advise Zhengzhou Control Mach 0.72 is not acceptable, it's too low for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 805，减速至马赫 0.72。
B：告知郑州管制 M.72 不能接受，对你们飞机来说太低。
cards.referenceText: Negative, unable M.72, it's too low for our aircraft, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不能接受，无法保持 M.72，对我们飞机来说太低，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, Zhengzhou Control, maintain Mach 0.75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due to Wuhan radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，郑州管制，保持马赫 0.75，因武汉雷达故障，我们正在限制飞越武汉管制区的飞机数量。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain M.75, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持 M.75，UAL 805。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 805, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
B: Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 0638Z.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 805，你预计到达 OBLIK 的时间是多少？
B：告知郑州管制预计 0638Z 到达 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Estimating OBLIK 0638Z, UAL 805
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计 OBLIK 0638Z，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the orbit, ask Zhengzhou Control to track direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成盘旋，请求郑州管制直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, request track direct to OBLIK.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，请求直飞 OBLIK。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, negative direct to OBLIK, turn left heading 130 to intercept Amber 461.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，不能直飞 OBLIK，左转航向 130，切入 Amber 461。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 130 to intercept A461, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 130，切入 A461，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, 50 miles to OBLIK, contact Wuhan Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，距 OBLIK 50 海里，联系武汉管制118.9。

cards.audioText: B: You are over OBLIK at time 0646, maintaining 11000 meters, you are estimating ZF at time 0658, your next way point is WUH, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你 0646 飞越 OBLIK，保持 11000 米，预计 0658 到达 ZF，下一航路点 WUH，向武汉管制作标准位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 805, over OBLIK 0646, maintaining 11000 meters, estimating ZF 0658, next WUH.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 805，0646 飞越 OBLIK，保持 11000 米，预计 ZF 0658，下一点 WUH。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, roger, maintain 11000 meters, report ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，收到，保持 11000 米，报告 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 11000 meters, report ZF, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 11000 米，报告 ZF，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar failure, for identification, reset squawk 3572.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，雷达故障，为识别，重设应答机 3572。
cards.referenceText: Reset squawk 3572, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重设应答机 3572，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, squawk ident.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，应答机识别。
cards.referenceText: Squawk ident, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 应答机识别，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar identified, resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，雷达已识别，恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO。
cards.referenceText: Resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 219, from New York to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawk number is 3566, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 219，从纽约飞往武汉，保持 11000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566，呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，保持 11000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3566。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 9200 米，因穿越冲突航空器，通过 9800 米前加快下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9200 meters, expedite descent until passing 9800 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 9200 米，通过 9800 米前加快下降，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9200 meters, you are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, inform ATC this situation and request further descent to 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持 9200 米，遭遇中度晴空颠簸，告知 ATC 并请求继续下降至 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, maintaining 9200 meters, we are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence, further descent to 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，保持 9200 米，我们遭遇中度晴空颠簸，请求继续下降至 8400 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 8400 米，到达后报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, check with Wuhan Control if it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: B：TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动的航空器，向武汉管制确认是否为冲突航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o'clock, confirm it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，TCAS 显示 9 点钟方向有一架快速移动航空器，请确认是否为冲突航空器。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, negative, the aircraft is a military aircraft flying parallel to your current track and will overtake you shortly, report clear of traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，不是，该机为军机，与你当前航迹平行飞行，将很快超越你，脱离冲突后报告。
cards.referenceText: Roger, report clear of traffic, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，脱离冲突后报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now that aircraft has passed you, report it to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在该机已超过你，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 219, clear of traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 219，已脱离冲突。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-03 arrival Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计 ZF-03 进场跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Reduce to minimum speed, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-03 arrival Runway 36R, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减至最小速度，直飞 ZF，预计 ZF-03 进场跑道 36R，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 4200 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 4200 米，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: You are now levelling at 4200 meters and approaching ZF, information A received, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在 4200 米改平并接近 ZF，已收到通播 A，首次联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 219, maintaining 4200 meters, approaching ZF, information A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 219，保持 4200 米，接近 ZF，收到通播 A。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 36 右 ILS 进近，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 219, established ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 219，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, continue approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，继续进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach Runway 36R, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近跑道 36R，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: All stations! All stations! Be advised Runway 36R is closed due to an unserviceable aircraft occupying the runway. Break, Break, UAL 219, flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：各机注意！各机注意！跑道 36 右因故障航空器占用关闭。Break，Break，UAL 219，飞航向 360，爬升并保持 1500 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, flying heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500 meters, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，飞航向 360，爬升并保持 1500 米，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR DME approach runways 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR DME approach runways 04, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 170，预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 219, turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach Runway 04, report inbound.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 219，右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 310, cleared for VOR DME approach Runway 04, report inbound, UAL 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 310，可以 VOR DME 进近跑道 04，向台时报告，UAL 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are inbound course for Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 向台航道上，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 219, inbound Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 219，跑道 04 向台。
