cards.referenceText: Right heading 280, descend to and maintain 9500m, wilco, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向280，下到9500米保持，照办，美联航221。

cards.audioText: [As you are leveling at 9500m, you encounter severe turbulence. You have a rapid airspeed decay due turbulence, so you want to descend immediately to a lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【当你在9500米平飞时，你遇到了强颠簸。由于颠簸，空速快速下降，因此你想立刻下降到更低高度。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL221, leveling at 9500m, we encounter turbulence and our airspeed decreases rapidly, request immediate descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，美联航221，在9500米平飞，我们遇到了颠簸，我们的空速快速下降，请求立刻下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, descend to 8100m, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，下到8100米，到达后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 8100m, wilco, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到8100米，照办，美联航221。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Control on 125.3.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，雷达服务终止，联系武汉区调125.3。

cards.audioText: [You are now leveling at 8100m, next waypoint P344. A rear cabin crew reported an old man suffers from heart attack, and he is having difficulty breathing. For safety concerns, you want to divert to Hefei airport, inform Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在8100米平飞，下一个航路点是P344，后舱一名乘务员报告说一名老年人心脏病犯了，他现在呼吸困难。出于安全考虑，你想改航到合肥机场，告知武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL221, 8100m maintaining, next P344, an old man suffers from heart attack, and he is having difficulty breathing. Request divert to Hefei.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航221，正保持在8100米，下一航路点P344，一名老年人心脏病犯了，他现在呼吸困难，请求改航到合肥机场。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL221, Wuhan Control, roger, maintain present heading and descend to 7200m. Advise the detailed information and the severity of the passenger.
[Tell Wuhan Control that the sick passenger is about 60 years old, sitting in seat 35A. He takes medicine with him, and the cabin crew is offering first aid.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 美联航221，武汉区调，收到，保持当前航向，下到7200米。告知乘客的详细信息以及病情严重性。
【告知武汉区调，乘客大概60岁，坐在35A。他携带了药物，客舱乘务员正在提供急救。】
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading and descend to 7200m. The sick passenger is about 60 years old, sitting in seat 35A. He takes medicine with him, and the cabin crew is offering first aid, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，下到7200米。乘客大概60岁，坐在35A。他携带了药物，客舱乘务员正在进行急救。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, roger that. Further descend to 6300m, and let us know the development of the onboard situation.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，收到。继续下到6300米，让我们知晓机上的发展情况。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 6300m, wilco, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到6300米，照办，美联航221。

cards.audioText: [Inform Wuhan Control that after receiving the first aid by the cabin crew, the sick passenger’s condition has improved and he is now conscious. Therefore, you no longer require the diversion, you want to continue to your destination Wuhan.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知武汉区调，乘务员提供了急救之后，乘客情况好多了，恢复了意识。因此，你不再需要改航，你想继续飞往你的目的地武汉。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL221, the sick passenger is conscious after the first aid, request cancel diversion and continue to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航221，经过急救，乘客现在恢复意识，请求取消调改航，继续飞往武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, Wuhan Control, roger, you can still continue to your original airport Wuhan, descend to 4500m, and expect ILS approach runway 04R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，武汉区调，收到，你可以继续飞往你的原计划武汉机场，下到4500米，预计盲降进近跑道04右。
cards.referenceText: Original airport, descend to 4500m, ILS approach runway 04R, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原机场，下到4500米，盲降进近跑道04右，美联航221。

cards.audioText: [You are now on long final runway 04R, about 7nm from touchdown, request your landing clearance from Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在04右跑道长五边，距离接地点大概7海里，向武汉塔台申请着陆许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL221, long final runway 04R, about 7nm from touchdown, request landing clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航221，跑道04右长五边，接地点大概7海里，请求着陆许可。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, Wuhan Tower, roger, you are cleared to land, runway 04R, wind 240 degrees 18 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，武汉塔台，收到，可以落地，跑道04右，风240度，18节。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 04R, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道04右，美联航221。

cards.audioText: [Because the sick passenger is seating near the door number two on the left side (L2), you want to open that door when you arrive at the gate and let medical staff help to deplane that passenger, inform controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【由于受伤乘客坐在左2门附近，你想在到达机位的时候打开此门，让医疗人员协助乘客下飞机，告知管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL221, request open the door number two on the left side (L2) and let medical staff help to deplane that passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航221，请求打开左2门，让医疗人员协助乘客下飞机。

cards.audioText: C: UAL221, Wuhan Tower, roger, you can open that door and we have delivered your message to the medical staff that are standing by.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航221，武汉塔台，收到，你可以打开此门，我们已经将你的信息告知正在等待的医疗人员。
cards.referenceText: Thank you, UAL221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 谢谢，美联航221。

cards.audioText: [Your call-sign is UAL887, a passenger flight from Tokyo to Guangzhou. You are now flying at 9500m, estimating OBLIK at 35, squawking 5355. Make an initial contact with Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是美联航887，一架从东京飞往广州的客运航班。你现在在9500米飞行，预计过OBLIK时间35分，应答机5355。与北京区调进行初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, 9500m maintaining, ETA OBLIK 35, squawk 5355.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，正保持在9500米，预计过OBLIK时间35分，应答机5355。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, Beijing Control, radar contact, maintain present altitude, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，北京区调，雷达看见了，保持当前高度，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present altitude, no speed restriction, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，没有速度限制，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [You have an indication of cumulonimbus about 40km ahead, therefore, you want to turn right to go round it.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【前方40公里处显示有积雨云，因此，你想右转绕飞。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, we have an indication of CB about 40km ahead, request turn right to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，前方40公里处显示有积雨云，请求右转绕飞。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, turning right is not approved due prohibited area, turn left 30 degrees, track out 35km, report clear of the build-up.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，不行，由于禁区，左转30度，出航35公里，离开积雨云后报。
cards.referenceText: Turn left 30 degrees, track out 35km, wilco, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转30度，出航35公里，照办，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [You are now clear of cumulonimbus and closing back to your original course, report to the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在离开积雨云，正返回原航路，告知管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, clear of CB and returning back to our original course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，离开积雨云，正返回原航路。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL887, Beijing Control, roger, report joining.
[Later...]
[A flight attendant reports that a pregnant woman is about to deliver a baby, and she is in severe pain. Inform Beijing Control the situation. This is an emergency call.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C:美联航887，北京区调，收到，加入后报。
【后来...】
【一名乘务员报告说一名怀孕乘客要生孩子，她现在疼得厉害。告知北京区调，这是一个紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Beijing Control, UAL887, a pregnant woman is on board is about to deliver a baby, she is in severe pain.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，北京区调，美联航887，一名怀孕乘客将要在飞机上生孩子，她现在疼得厉害。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL887, Beijing Control, roger that. Notify us the further situation and your intention.
[Tell controller that the pure oxygen is being fed to the woman, and she is about to give birth on the plane. You want to divert to Wuhan.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 美联航887，北京区调，收到。告知情况的发展以及你的意图。
【告知管制员，已经给乘客提供纯氧，她打算在飞机上生孩子。你想备降到武汉。】
cards.referenceText: The pure oxygen is being fed to the woman, and she is about to give birth on the plane, request divert to Wuhan, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 已经给乘客提供纯氧，她打算在飞机上生孩子，请求改航到武汉，美联航887。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, roger that. You are cleared to divert to Wuhan. Turn right heading 216 and descend to 8100m.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，收到。你可以改航到武汉。右转航向216，下8100米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to divert to Wuhan, turn right heading 216 and descend to 8100m, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以改航到武汉，右转航向216，下8100米，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Make a passenger address to find if any doctor or nurse is available to offer help.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【进行机上广播，看是否能找到医生或护士。】
cards.referenceText: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking: a female passenger is about to give birth on the plane, so if you are a doctor or nurse, please kindly offer some help, thank you so much!
cards.referenceTextZh: 女士们，先生们，这里是机长广播：一名女性乘客将要在飞机上生孩子，因此如果你是医生或者护士，请提供帮助，谢谢。

cards.audioText:
[15 minutes later.]
[Tell controller that the baby is delivered safely, but the mother has fainted, request landing as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh:
【15分钟后。】
【告知管制员，孩子成功出生，但是妈妈已经昏迷，请求尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, the baby has been delivered safely, but the mother lost consciousness, request landing as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，孩子安全出生，但是妈妈失去意识，请求尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, Beijing Control, roger your information. Further descend to 5100m, contact Wuhan Approach 126.3.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，北京区调，收到你的情报。继续下到5100 米，联系武汉进近126.3。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5100m, contact Wuhan Approach on 126.3, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到5100米，联系武汉进近126.3，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Contact Wuhan Approach and ask controller to arrange doctor and ambulance on arrival.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系武汉进近，请求管制员安排医生和救护车在着陆后就位。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL887, request doctor and ambulance on arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，美联航887，请求着陆后医生和救护车就位。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, radar vectors for ILS approach runway 04R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，武汉进近，雷达看到了，雷达引导盲降进近跑道04右。
cards.referenceText: Radar vectors for ILS approach runway 04R, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达引导，盲降进近跑道04右，美联航887。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, turn left heading 190, descend to and maintain 3600m on QNH 1006, reduce to minimum approach speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，左转航向190，下到3600米保持，修压1006，减小到最低进近速度。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 190, descend to and maintain 3600m on QNH1006, reduce to minimum approach speed, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向190，下到3600米保持，修压1006，减小到最低进近速度，美联航887。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, descend to 1200m, turn right heading 226 to intercept the localizer runway 04R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，下1200米，右转航向226来截获跑道04右航向道，截获后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1200m, turn right heading 226 to intercept the localizer runway 04R, wilco, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向226来截获跑道04右航向道，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Now you have intercepted the localizer of runway 04R, inform Tower controller. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在已经截获跑道04右航向道，告知塔台管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL887, intercepted the localizer of runway 04R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航887，截获跑道04右航向道。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, Wuhan Tower, continue approach, runway 04R, report outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，武汉塔台，继续进近，跑道04右，过外指点标后报。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, runway 04R, wilco, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，跑道04右，照办，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over outer marker.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在已经过了外指点标。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL887, over outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航887，过外指点标。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, cleared to land, runway 04R, surface wind 170, 13m/s, QNH1006, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，可以落地，跑道04右，地面风170度，13米每秒，修压1006，脱离后报。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 04R, QNH1006, wilco, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道04右，修压1006，照办，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [During landing, you hear a loud bang and the plane bounces. You suspect the plane has encountered a tail strike. Inform this to the controller and request ground staff to have a visual check of your tail section at the gate.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在着陆中，你听到了一声巨响，飞机弹跳。你怀疑飞机遇到了擦机尾。告知管制员该情况，请求地面人员在你到达机位后目视检查机尾部分。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL887, we hear a loud bang and the plane bounces during landing, suspect a tail strike, request ground staff to have a visual check of our tail section at the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航887，我们听到了一声巨响，飞机弹跳，怀疑飞机遇到了擦机尾，请求地面人员在机位目视检查机尾部分。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, roger, vacate runway via fast exit J4, contact Wuhan Ground on 118.025.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，收到，经由快速脱离道J4脱离，联系武汉地面118.025。
cards.referenceText: Vacate runway via fast exit J4, contact Wuhan Ground on 118.025, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由快速脱离道J4脱离，联系武汉地面118.025，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Your callsign is UAL921, you are from Wuhan to San Francisco, ready for taxi, call Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是UAL921，你从武汉飞往旧金山，准备滑行，呼叫武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL921, from Wuhan to San Francisco, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，美联航921，从武汉飞往旧金山，请求滑出。

cards.audioText: UAL921, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point of runway 04 via F, A7, A.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，武汉地面，沿滑行道F，A7，A滑至跑道04等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 04 via F, A7 and A, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道F，A7，A滑至跑道04等待点，美联航921。

cards.audioText: UAL921, read back correct, contact Tower on 118.65.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，复诵正确，联系塔台118.65。
cards.referenceText: Contact Tower 118.65, UAL921.

cards.audioText: [You are holding short of runway 04, you are ready for departure, call Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在跑道04外等待，已经准备好起飞，呼叫塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL921, holding short runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航921，跑道04外等待，准备好起飞。

cards.audioText: UAL921, Wuhan Tower, winds 060 degrees 10m/s, runway 04, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，武汉塔台，地面风060，10米/秒，跑道04，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff runway 04, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道04，美联航921。

cards.audioText: [You are passing 600m for 1500m, call Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机通过600米爬升1500米，呼叫离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL921, airborne runway 04, passing 600m for 1500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，美联航921，04号起飞，通过600米上升1500米。

cards.audioText: UAL921, cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb and maintain 3900m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，取消SID，直飞HFE，上升保持标压3900米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb and maintain 3900m on standard, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消SID，直飞HFE，上升保持标压3900米，美联航921。

cards.audioText: [Purser tells you a passenger has heard abnormal noises from aft cabin. You decide to level off at 2700m. Advice Departure your intention to level off due to possible problem in cabin.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【乘务长告诉你一位乘客听到机舱尾部发出异常噪音。你决定在2700米平飞。告诉离场，由于客舱可能出现问题，你想要平飞。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL921, request level off at 2700m due possible problem in cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，美联航921，由于客舱可能出现问题，请求2700米平飞。

cards.audioText: UAL921, climb and maintain 2700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，上升保持2700米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 2700m, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持2700米，美联航921。

cards.audioText: UAL921, Departure, what’s the malfunction of your aircraft?[Aircraft levels off. No one else can confirm the noise that the particular passenger heard. You check: all the instruments are indicating normally. You decide: continue the flight and request for a higher level. Call Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，离场，飞机出现什么故障了？【飞机平飞。其它人都无法确认该乘客听到的噪音。你检查发现所有仪表显示正常。你决定继续飞行，并请求更高的高度。呼叫离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL921, the aircraft normal now, continue the flight and request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，美联航921，目前飞机正常，继续飞行，请求高高度。

cards.audioText: UAL921, roger, climb and maintain 4500m on standard, contact Control on 125.0.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，收到，上升保持标压4500米，联系区调125.0。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 4500m on standard, 125.0, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持标压4500米，125.0，美联航921。

cards.audioText: [You are cruising at 10700m, over HFE at 22, squawk 5316, call Shanghai Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在10700米巡航，过HFE时间22分，应答机5316，呼叫上海区调。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL921, maintaining 10700m, over HFE 22, squawk 5316.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，美联航921，10700米保持，HFE 22分，应答机5316。

cards.audioText: UAL921, Shanghai Control, radar contact. Proceed direct to VMB.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，上海区调，雷达已识别。直飞VMB。
cards.referenceText: Direct to VMB, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞VMB，美联航921。

cards.audioText: [Strong sound from cabin. Your instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly. Slow depressurization is suspected. Request immediate descent from 10700m to 3000m. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【座舱内有巨大声响。你的仪表显示座舱压力正在慢慢升高。疑似缓慢释压。请求立即从10700米下降至3000米。紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL921. There is slow depressurization in cabin, request descent from 10700m to 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，上海区调，美联航921，客舱缓慢释压，请求离开10700米下降到3000米。

cards.audioText: UAL921, roger PANPAN. Turn right heading 150. Initially descend and maintain 8900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，收到PANPAN。右转航向150。起始下降保持8900米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 150, descend and maintain 8900m, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向150。下降保持8900米，美联航921。

cards.audioText: UAL921, turn left heading 120. Descend and maintain 3300m.[Read back the instruction. Ask for land at the nearest suitable airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，左转航向120。下降保持3300米。【复诵该指令。请求在最近的合适机场降落。】
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 120, descend and maintain 3300m, request land at the nearest airport, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向120，下到3300米保持，请求在最近的机场降落，美联航921。

cards.audioText: UAL921, the closest airport is Nanjing Airport. Current visibility is marginal. I have to check if they can accommodate an aircraft of your size. Hongqiao and Pudong airport has longer runways and can definitely accommodate your aircraft. Advised your intention.[Ask for radar vector to the airport that has better visibility between Hongqiao and Pudong.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，最近的机场是南京机场。当前能见度处于临界状态。我要检查南京机场能否接收你。虹桥机场和浦东机场有更长的跑道，并且肯定可以接收你。请示意图。【请求雷达引导至能见度较高的虹桥机场或浦东机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request fly to the better visibility airport between Hongqiao and Pudong, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求飞往能见度较高的虹桥机场或浦东机场，美联航921。

cards.audioText: UAL921, roger, direct to HSH, expect radar vector to land at Pudong Airport. Contact Shanghai Approach on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，收到，直飞HSH，雷达引导至浦东机场。联系上海进近128.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HSH, radar vector to Pudong, contact Shanghai Approach 128.35, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HSH，雷达引导至浦东机场。联系上海进近128.35，美联航921。

cards.audioText: [You are at the holding point of runway 04. Call Wuhan Tower, you are ready for takeoff.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在跑道04的等待点。呼叫武汉塔台，你已准备好起飞。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL162, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航162，准备好起飞。

cards.audioText: UAL162, Wuhan Tower, behind China Southern B777 on short final, then line up runway 04.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，武汉塔台，跟在短五边南航波音777落地后进跑道04等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Behind China Southern B777 on short final, then line up runway 04, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟短五边南航波音777落地后进跑道04等待，美联航162。

cards.audioText: UAL162, when airborne turn right heading 070 climb and maintain 3000m. Cleared for immediate take-off runway 04.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，离地后右转航向070，上升保持3000米。可以立刻起飞，跑道04。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: When airborne turn right heading 070 climb and maintain 3000m. Cleared for immediate take-off runway 04, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向070，上升保持3000米。可以立刻起飞，跑道04，美联航162。

cards.audioText: [Now you are airborne, and passing 1200m, call Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机已经离地，飞过1200米，呼叫武汉离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL162, airborne runway 04, passing 1200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，美联航162，跑道04起飞，通过1200米。

cards.audioText: UAL162, after passing 1200m, turn left direct to ZF.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，通过1200米后左转直飞ZF。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: After passing 1200m, turn left direct to ZF, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过1200米后左转直飞ZF，美联航162。

cards.audioText: [After 9 hours flight. Now you are in London control area, maintaining FL350. You have encountered volcanic ash. Tell controller the situation and request descent. Call London Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞行9个小时后，你到了伦敦管制区，高度层350保持。你遇到了火山灰，告诉管制员该情况并请求下降。呼叫伦敦区调。】
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL162, maintaining FL350, we have encountered volcanic ash, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦区调，美联航162，高度层350保持，我们遇到了火山灰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: UAL162, turn right heading 300, descend and maintain FL290.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，右转航向300，下降保持高度层290。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right heading 300, descend and maintain FL290, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向300，下降保持高度层290，美联航162。

cards.audioText: [Tell ATC, you are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly but aircraft can still be controlled.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉ATC，你仍在火山灰区域，发动机震动剧烈，但飞机仍能控制。】
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL162, we are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly but aircraft can be still controlled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦区调，美联航162，我们还在火山灰区域内，发动机震动剧烈，但飞机仍能控制。

cards.audioText: [During descent, both engines flamed out. Make a distress call and request land at the nearest airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【下降时，发动机全部熄火。做一个遇险呼叫并请求在最近的机场降落。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. London Control, UAL162. Both engines flame out. Request land at the nearest airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY。伦敦区调，美联航162。双发熄火，请求降落在最近的机场。

cards.audioText: UAL162, London Control, roger MAYDAY. Turn right heading 340.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，伦敦区调，收到MAYDAY。右转航向340。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right heading 340, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向340，美联航162。

cards.audioText: [One engine was successfully restarted during descent. Tell ATC the situation.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【下降时，一侧发动机成功重新起动。告诉ATC这一情况。】
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL162, one engine was successfully restarted.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦区调，美联航162，一侧发动机起动成功。

cards.audioText: UAL162, report intention.[Tell ATC you still need to land at the nearest airport because the running engine is not stable.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，报告意图。【告诉ATC你仍需要降落在最近的机场，因为重启的发动机运行不稳定。】
cards.referenceText: We still need to land at the nearest airport due the running engine is not stable, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于重启的发动机运行不稳定，我们仍需降落在最近的机场，美联航162。

cards.audioText: UAL162, continue descend and maintain 9000 feet on QNH 1021, expect to land at Beatle airport.[Tell controller you are not familiar with Beatle airport. Request airport information.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，继续下降保持修正海压9000英尺，修正海压1021，预计降落在Beatle机场。【告诉管制员你不熟悉该机场。请求提供机场信息。】
cards.referenceText: Continue descend and maintain 9000 feet QNH 1021, request airport information, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降保持修正海压9000英尺，修正海压1021，请求提供机场信息，美联航162。

cards.audioText: UAL162, Beatle airport landing runway 02, elevation 2000ft, runway 3000m long, 45m wide, ILS CAT I and II available.[Tell ATC you are able to land at this airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，Beatle机场使用着陆跑道02，标高2000英尺，跑道长3000米，宽45米，支持一类、二类盲降。【告诉ATC你能降落在这个机场。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, we can land at this airport, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们能够降落在这个机场，美联航162。

cards.audioText: UAL162, continue descend and maintain 5000 feet and contact Beatle Approach 121.3.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，继续下降保持5000英尺，联系Beatle机场进近121.3。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Continue descend and maintain 5000 feet and contact Beatle Approach 121.3, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降保持5000英尺，联系Beatle机场进近121.3，美联航162。

cards.audioText: [Contact Beatle Approach, tell them your emergency situation.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系该机场进近，告诉他们你的紧急状况。】
cards.referenceText: Beatle Approach, UAL162, we have one engine failure, request emergency land.
cards.referenceTextZh: Beatle进近，美联航162，机上一发失效，请求紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: UAL162, Beatle Approach, roger, runway is at your 2 o’clock, 10 miles, report airfield in sight.[Tell ATC you can see the runway.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航162，Beatle进近，收到，跑道在你2点钟方向，距离10海里，能见跑道报告。【告诉ATC你能看到跑道。】
cards.referenceText: Runway in sight, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 能见跑道，美联航162。

cards.audioText: [Tell Approach, you need emergency services to be ready near the runway.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉进近，跑道附近需要准备好紧急服务。】
cards.referenceText: Beatle Approach, UAL162, we need emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: Beatle进近，美联航162，跑道附近需要准备好紧急服务。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is UAL239, from New York to Wuhan. You are maintaining 11000m ETA OBLIK at 55, squawk 3566. Call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是美联航239，从纽约飞往武汉，11000米保持，预计到达OBLIK时间55分，应答机3566，呼叫武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL239, maintaining 11000m ETA OBLIK 55, squawk 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航239，11000米保持，预计到达OBLIK时间55分，应答机3566。

cards.audioText: UAL239, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 9200m, expedite descend until passing 9800m due crossing traffic.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，武汉区调，雷达已识别，下降保持9200米，由于交叉活动，快速下降通过9800米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9200m, expedite descent until passing 9800m, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持9200米，由于交叉活动，快速下降通过9800米，美联航239。

cards.audioText: [You are now maintaining 9200m. You are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence (CAT). Inform ATC of this situation and request further descend and maintain 8400m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞行高度9200米保持。你正在经历中度晴空乱流。通知ATC该情况并请求进一步下降8400米保持。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL239, maintaining 9200m. Request further descent to 8400m due moderate clear air turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航239，9200米保持。由于晴空乱流，请求进一步下降8400米。

cards.audioText: UAL239, continue descend and maintain 8400m, report reaching.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，继续下降保持8400米保持，到达报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Continue descend and maintain 8400m, report reaching. UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降保持8400米保持，到达报，美联航239。

cards.audioText: [TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o’clock. Check with Wuhan Control if it is a conflicting traffic.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【TCAS显示9点钟方向有一架快速移动的飞机，和武汉区调核实是否有冲突活动。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL239, TCAS shows a traffic at 9 o’clock. Is it a conflicting aircraft?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航239，TCAS显示9点钟方位有活动。是冲突飞机么？

cards.audioText: UAL239, negative, that aircraft is military aircraft flying parallel to your current track and will overtake you shortly. Report traffic in sight.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，不是，那是一架军用飞机，正沿你当前航迹平行飞行，不久就会超过你。能见飞机报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, wilco, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，照办，美联航239。

cards.audioText: [Now that aircraft has passed you. Report to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【那架飞机超过你了。向ATC报告。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL239, the traffic is cleared.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航239，航空器解除冲突。

cards.audioText: UAL239, reduce to minimum speed. Fly direct to ZF, expect ZF-3 arrival runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，速度减至最小。直飞ZF，预计ZF-3进场，跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Minimum speed. Direct to ZF, ZF-3 arrival runway 36R, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 最小速度。直飞ZF，ZF-3进场，跑道36右，美联航239。

cards.audioText: UAL239, continue descend and maintain 4200m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，继续下降保持4200米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200m, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4200米，美联航239。

cards.audioText: [You are now leveling off at 4200m and approaching ZF, information A received, make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你正在4200米平飞，接近ZF，收到通播A，和武汉进近进行初次联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL239, approaching ZF, maintaining 4200m, information A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，美联航239，接近ZF，4200米保持，通播A。

cards.audioText: UAL239, Wuhan Approach, radar contact.[Now you have established ILS approach runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，武汉进近，雷达已识别。【你已建立盲降进近跑道36右，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL239, established ILS runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航239，建立盲降进近跑道36右。

cards.audioText: UAL239, continue approach runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，继续进近跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Continue approach runway 36R, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近跑道36右，美联航239。

cards.audioText: All stations! All stations! Be advised runway 36R is closed due an unserviceable aircraft occupying the runway. Break, UAL239, fly heading 360, climb and maintain 1500m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 全体注意！全体注意！由于停放一架故障飞机，跑道36右关闭。还有，美联航239，航向360，上升保持1500米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, heading 360, climb and maintain 1500m, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，航向360，上升保持1500米，美联航239。

cards.audioText: UAL239, turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR/DME approach runway 04.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，右转航向170，雷达引导VOR/DME进近跑道04。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right heading 170, radar vectors for VOR/DME approach runway 04, UAL239
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向170，雷达引导VOR/DME进近跑道04，美联航239。

cards.audioText: UAL239, turn right heading 310, cleared for the VOR/DME approach runway 04, report inbound.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，右转航向310，可以VOR/DME进近跑道04，向台报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right heading 310, cleared for VOR/DME approach runway 04, report inbound, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向310，可以VOR/DME进近跑道04，向台报告，美联航239。

cards.audioText: [You are now inbound course for runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在跑道04入台航道，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL239, VOR/DME approach runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航239，VOR/DME进近跑道04。

cards.audioText: [You are estimating WXI at time 34 maintaining 11000m, squawk 6527. Contact Zhengzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【预计到达WXI时间34分，11000米保持，应答机6527，联系郑州区调。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, ETA WXI 34 maintaining 11000m, squawk 6527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，预计到达WXI时间34分，11000米保持，应答机6527。

cards.audioText: UAL865, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce Mach .75, due Wuhan Control restrictions.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，郑州区调，雷达已识别，向右偏3海里，由于武汉区调限制，马赫数减小至点75。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Offset 3 miles right of track, reduce Mach .75, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右偏3海里，马赫数减小至点75，美联航865。

cards.audioText: [Adverse weather ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20nm deviation right of track and state the reason.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【前方天气状况恶劣，向郑州区调请求向右偏20海里并说明原因。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, request 20nm deviation right of track due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，由于天气原因，请求向右偏20海里。

cards.audioText: UAL865, 20nm deviation to the right approved, report clear of weather.[Tell the controller you are cleared of weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，可以向右偏20海里，天气好转报告。【告诉管制员天气好转。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, clear of weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，脱离天气。

cards.audioText: UAL865, the restriction still exists, reduce Mach number .72 [Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，限制仍有效，减小马赫数至点72。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Reduce to Mach.72, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减小马赫数至点72，美联航865。

cards.audioText: [Advise Zhengzhou Control Mach .72 is not acceptable which is too slow for your aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉郑州区调马赫数点72对你的飞机来说太慢了。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, we cannot accept Mach .72, too slow for us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，我们不能接受马赫数点72，对我们来说太慢了。

cards.audioText: UAL865, Zhengzhou Control, maintain Mach .75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due Wuhan radar failure.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，郑州区调，马赫数点75保持，由于武汉雷达失效，我们正在限制武汉管制区内飞行的飞机数量。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger. Maintaining Mach .75, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，马赫数点75保持，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, report estimated time of OBLIK.[Inform Zhengzhou control your estimated time for OBLIK is 0638.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，报告预计到达OBLIK时间。【通知郑州区调，预计到达OBLIK时间为06:38。】
cards.referenceText: Estimating OBLIK 0638, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计到达OBLIK时间为06:38，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, make a right orbit due spacing, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646.[Tell Zhengzhou Control, you are the international flight, you can’t hold for a long time due to fuel limitation.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，由于间隔，右转机动，到达OBLIK时间不早于06:46。‘【告诉郑州区调，你们是国际航班，由于油量限制，你们不能长时间盘旋等待。】
cards.referenceText: Orbit right due spacing, over OBLIK not early than 0646, we are an international flight, we cannot hold for a long time due fuel limitation, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于间隔，右转机动，到达OBLIK时间不早于06:46，我们是一架国际航班，由于油量限制，我们不能长时间等待，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, confirm the fuel endurance?[Tell the controller the fuel endurance is 45min, you can’t hold more than 30min.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，证实燃油续航时间。【告诉管制员燃油续航时间为45分钟，飞机不能盘旋等待超过30分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Our endurance is 45min, negative hold more than 30min, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 续航时间45分钟，不能盘旋等待超过30分钟，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, I can’t tell you the exactly time of hold, do you need declare an emergency fuel?[Tell controller you can hold for now, inform the latest notice as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，我无法确定等待时间，你需要宣布紧急燃油么？【告诉管制员你现在还可以等待，请求尽快通知下一指令。】
cards.referenceText: We can hold now, please acknowledge the time as soon as possible, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们现在还能等待，请尽快确认等待时间，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, make a standard hold at present position.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，在原地标准等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Make a standard hold at present position, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地标准等待，美联航865。

cards.audioText: [After hold 20min, ask controller how long will you delay for the flight.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【等待20分钟后，询问管制员航班还要延误多久。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, confirm how long shall we hold?
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，证实下还要等待多久？

cards.audioText: UAL865, negative time. Do you want to divert to alternation or declare an emergency fuel?[Ask controller which airport is suitable for divert to and is there any delay for the alternation.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，不能确定。你想改航到备降机场或是宣布紧急燃油状态么？【询问管制员哪个机场适合备降以及备降机场是否有延误。】
cards.referenceText: Confirm which airport is available for us, and is there any delay for the alternation, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 证实哪个机场适合我们改航，备降机场是否有延误。美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, Xinzheng is available for you to divert. Say intentions.[Xinzheng airport is not the regular airport for your company, you need to ask permission and tell controller later.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，新郑机场适合改航。请示意图。【新郑机场不是你公司的常用机场，你需要获得公司许可后再回复管制员。】
cards.referenceText: We need to ask permission to divert to the airport, standby, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们需要获得公司的许可才能改航，稍等，美联航865。

cards.audioText: [After you get the permission, you can divert to Xinzheng, tell ATC you can fly to Zhengzhou and ask for help to Xinzheng.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【获得许可之后，你可以改航到新郑机场，告诉ATC你可以飞往新郑机场，并请求帮助前往机场。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL865, we can divert to Xinzheng, request radar vector.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，美联航865，我们可以改航至新郑机场，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText: UAL865, roger. Standby.[A few minutes later.]UAL865, Zhengzhou Control, Wuhan is available, do you want to continue fly to Wuhan?[Ask controller you want to fly to Wuhan and ask for direct to Wuhan due to the hold for a long time.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，收到。稍等。【几分钟后。】美联航865，郑州区调，武汉可以飞了，你想继续飞往武汉么？【告诉管制员你想飞往武汉，另外因为等待时间太久，请求直飞武汉。】
cards.referenceText: Request direct to Wuhan due long time delay, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于等待太久，请求直飞武汉，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL865, direct to IAF of runway 36R, contact Wuhan Control 125.5.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，直飞IAF，跑道36右，联系武汉区调125.5。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Direct to IAF of runway 36R, Wuhan Control 125.5, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞IAF，跑道36右，联系武汉区调125.5，美联航865。

cards.audioText: [Tell Wuhan Control, you are directing to IAF of runway 36R, declare you are minimum fuel. Ask to direct to FAF of runway 36R. This is an urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉武汉区调，你正在直飞IAF，跑道36右，宣布最低燃油状态。请求直飞FAF，跑道36右。这是紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, UAL865, minimum fuel, request direct to FAF of runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，美联航865，最低燃油，请求直飞FAF，跑道36右。

cards.audioText: UAL865, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, direct to FAF of runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，直飞FAF，跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Direct to FAF of runway 36R, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞FAF，跑道36右，美联航865。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is UAL887, destination Hong Kong, over POLHO 20, level 10100m, estimate TMR 45, next TZH, contact Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是UAL（美联航）887，目的地香港，过POLHO 20分，高度10100米，预计TMR 45分，下个报告点TZH，联系北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, 10100m maintaining, POLHO 20, estimate TMR 45, next TZH.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，101000米保持，POLHO 20分，预计TMR 45分，下个报告点TZH。

cards.audioText: UAL887, Beijing Control, recycle squawk 0036.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，北京区调，转换到应答机0036。
cards.referenceText: Squawk 0036, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 应答机0036，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [A flight attendant reports that a pregnant woman is about to give birth.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【乘务员报告一位孕妇即将生产。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Control, UAL887, a pregnant woman on board is about to give birth.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京区调，美联航887，机上一位孕妇即将生产。

cards.audioText: UAL887 roger, turn right heading 140, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，收到，右转航向140，雷达引导着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 140, radar vector for landing, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向140，雷达引导着陆，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [15 minutes later.] [Tell ATC that the baby is delivered safely, but the mother has fainted, request landing as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【15分钟后】【告诉ATC孩子平安出生，但母亲已经昏迷，请求尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, baby has been delivered safely, but the woman lost consciousness, request landing as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，孩子平安出生，但母亲失去意识，请求尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: UAL887, roger, ambulance and doctor will be ready on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，收到，救护车和医生将在到达后就位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，美联航887。

cards.audioText: UAL887, direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m, contact Beijing Approach 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，直飞HUR，下降保持3600米，联系北京进近119.7。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m, 119.7, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HUR，下降保持3600米，119.7，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [You are descending to 3600m, contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已下降到3600米，联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, UAL887, descending to 3600m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美联航887，下降到3600米。

cards.audioText: UAL887, Beijing Approach, descend to 1800m on QNH, QNH 1011, expect runway 01, information H.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，北京进近，下降到修正海压1800米，修正海压1011，预计跑道01，通播H。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800m on QNH, QNH 1011, expect runway 01, information H, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到修正海压1800米，修正海压1011，预计跑道01，通播H，美联航887。

cards.audioText: UAL887, turn right heading 170, radar vector for landing.[Adverse weather is en route, request heading 190.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，右转航向170，雷达引导着陆。【途中出现恶劣天气，请求航向190。】
cards.referenceText: Request turn right heading 190 due weather, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于恶劣天气，请求右转航向190，美联航887。

cards.audioText: UAL887, turn right heading 190 approved.[Report cleared of weather, request heading 300 for final.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航，同意右转航向190。【报告已经远离天气，请求航向300加入五边。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, UAL887, cleared of weather, request heading 300 for final.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美联航887，远离天气，请求航向300加入五边。

cards.audioText: UAL887, negative, due to restricted area, if able, turn right heading 280 initially.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，由于限飞区不同意，如可能初始右转航向280。
cards.referenceText: Initial turn right heading 280, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 初始右转航向280，美联航887。

cards.audioText: UAL887, continue turn right heading 340 intercept localizer runway 01, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，继续右转航向340，切入跑道01航道，建立报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340 intercept localizer runway 01, report established, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向340，切入01航道，建立航道报，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [You have established localizer.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立航道。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, UAL887, established localizer.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美联航887，建立航道。

cards.audioText: UAL887, continue approach, contact Beijing Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, 118.1, thanks, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，118.1，谢谢，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Report to Tower that you have established ILS.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告塔台你已经建立盲降。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, UAL887, established ILS.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，美联航887，建立盲降。

cards.audioText: UAL887, Beijing Tower, continue approach, report outer marker, caution low cloud and rain in this area.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，北京塔台，继续进近，到外信标台报告，注意区域内低云和雨。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, report outer marker, thanks, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，到外信标台报告，谢谢，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Over outer marker.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【到达外信标台上方。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, UAL887, outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，美联航887，外信标台。

cards.audioText: UAL887, cleared to land runway 01, surface wind 160, 7m/s, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，可以着陆01，地面风160, 7m/s，脱离后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 01, report vacated, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以在跑道01着陆，脱离后报告，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [When you are landing, tail strike occurs, request assistance from Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【着陆时飞机擦机尾，向塔台请求援助。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, UAL887, tail strike when landing, request emergency assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，美联航887，着陆时擦机尾，请求紧急援助。

cards.audioText: Roger, UAL887, maintenance will arrive soon.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，美联航887，维修人员会马上到达。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，美联航887。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is UAL895, destination Beijing, approaching POLHO, estimate POLHO 30, level 12100m, TMR 50, next TZH, now contact Beijing Control and request clearance to cross the national boundary line.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是UAL（美联航）895，目的地北京，正在接近POLHO，预计POLHO 30分，高度12100米，TMR 50分，下个报告点TZH，现在联系北京区调并请求穿越国境线许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL895, 12100m maintaining, estimate POLHO 30, TMR 50, next TZH, request clearance for entry.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航895，12100米保持，预计POLHO 30分，TMR 50分，下个报告点TZH，请求进入许可。

cards.audioText: Station calling Beijing, confirm call sign.[Say call sign and squawk number 2456.]
cards.audioTextZh: 哪个呼叫北京，确认呼号。【告知你的呼号和应答机编码2456。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL895, squawk 2456.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航895，应答机2456。

cards.audioText: UAL895, Beijing roger, hold short of the national boundary line, we show you do not have permission to enter the country. Standby one.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，北京收到，国境线外等待，这里显示你没有入境许可，稍等。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of the national boundary line, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 国境线外等待，美联航895。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over POLHO at 30, report Beijing Control for further advice.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【过POLHO 30分，报告北京区调，请求进一步指令。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL895, over POLHO 30, advise instruction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航895，过POLHO 30分，请求指令。

cards.audioText: UAL895, roger, right orbit due Air Force restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，收到，由于空军限制区右转机动。
cards.referenceText: Right Orbit, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转机动，美联航895。

cards.audioText: UAL895, Beijing Control, cleared for entry, back on course G218, radar contact.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，北京区调，准许入境，回到G218航路，雷达识别。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for entry, back on course G218, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 准许入境，回到G218航路，美联航895。

cards.audioText: [5 minutes later.][You have some autothrottle system problems, you’d like to descend to 8900m to complete some checklists.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【5分钟后】【飞机自动油门系统出现故障，你想下降到8900米完成检查单。】
cards.referenceText: (Panpan Panpan Panpan) Beijing Control, UAL895, autothrottle system failure, request descent to 8900m for check.
cards.referenceTextZh: (Panpan Panpan Panpan) 北京区调，美联航895，自动油门系统故障，请求下降到8900米检查。

cards.audioText: UAL895, roger, descend to 8900m. [5 minutes later.]UAL895, do you require any other assistance?[Now you have finished checklists and can fly normally.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，收到，下降到8900米。【5分钟后】美联航895，你需要其它援助吗？【你已完成检查单，现在可以正常飞行。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL895, checklists complete, everything is normal now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航895，完成检查单，现在一切正常。

cards.audioText: UAL895, roger, descend to and maintain 4500m by KM.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，收到，下降保持4500米过KM。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4500m by KM, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4500米过KM，美联航895。

cards.audioText: UAL895, Beijing is snowing heavily, runway unserviceable for one hour due to lack of snow removal equipment, say intention.[Request continue approach, you can hold for one hour with enough fuel.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，北京有大雪，由于缺少除雪设备跑道关闭1小时，说明意图。【请求继续进近，燃料足够飞行1小时。】
cards.referenceText: Request continue approach, we can hold for one hour, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求继续进近，我们可以继续飞行1小时，美联航895。

cards.audioText: UAL895, roger, direct to HUR for hold, contact Beijing Approach on 129.0.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，收到，直飞HUR等待，联系北京进近129.0。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HUR for hold, Approach 129.0, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HUR等待，北京进近129.0，美联航895。

cards.audioText: [Establish initial contact with Beijing Approach, you are 4500m maintaining and flying direct to HUR.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【与北京进近建立初次联系，4500米保持，正在直飞HUR。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, UAL895, 4500m maintaining, direct to HUR.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美联航895，4500米保持，直飞HUR。

cards.audioText: UAL895, Beijing Approach, direct to HUR join standard holding procedure as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，北京进近，直飞HUR加入标准等待。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HUR join standard holding procedure as published, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HUR加入标准等待，美联航895。

cards.audioText: [30 minutes later.]UAL895, Beijing Approach, no significant weather change within two hours, report endurance.[You have only one hour fuel endurance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【30分钟后】美联航895，北京进近，2小时内无明显天气变化，报告续航时间。【你的续航时间只有1小时。】
cards.referenceText: Endurance 60 minutes, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 续航时间60分钟，美联航895。

cards.audioText: UAL895, confirm alternate.[Your alternate is Tianjin.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，证实备降场。【你的备降机场在天津。】
cards.referenceText: Alternate Tianjin, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 备降机场天津，美联航895。

cards.audioText: UAL895, there is frost fog in Tianjin, and visibility is too low.[Request diversion to Hohhot.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，天津有冻雾，可见度很差。【请求备降呼和浩特。】
cards.referenceText: Request diversion to Hohhot.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求备降呼和浩特，美联航895。

cards.audioText: UAL895, ice on runway in Hohhot, suggest Dalian or Shenyang.[After contact with your dispatcher, you decide to divert to Dalian. Tell the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，呼和跑道有冰，建议大连或沈阳。【与签派联系后，你决定备降大连，告知管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, UAL895, request diversion to Dalian.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美联航895，请求备降大连。

cards.audioText: UAL895, Beijing roger, direct to LADIX, climb to 6300m, contact Beijing Control on 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，收到，直飞LADIX，上升到6300米，联系北京区调120.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to LADIX, climb to 6300m, 120.35, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞LADIX，上升到6300米，120.35，美联航895。

cards.audioText: [You are at Wuhan airport, before departure, you received the cabin report said there is ice build-up on the wing, you want to make a de-icing procedure, report to ground controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在武汉机场，离场前，你收到一个客舱报告，称机翼上有积冰，你希望执行除冰程序，报告给地面管制员]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL403, request de-icing procedure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，美联航403，请求除冰程序。

cards.audioText:
UAL403, Wuhan Ground, where do you want to de-ice?
[Tell ground you want to de-ice on taxiway Z4.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航403，武汉地面，你想在哪里除冰？
[告诉管制员，你希望在滑行道Z4除冰]
cards.referenceText: Request de-ice on Z4, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求在Z4除冰，美联航403。

cards.audioText: [Inform Ground de-icing completed, request taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: [告知地面，除冰程序完成，请求滑行]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL403, de-icing completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，美联航403，除冰程序完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: UAL403, Ground, taxi to holding point runway 36R via Z4, A3, and A.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，通过滑行道Z4，A3和A，到跑道36右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via Z4, A3, A, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过滑行道Z4，A3和A，到跑道36右等待点，美联航403。

cards.audioText: [You notice ice contaminated on taxiways, and your de-icing fluid can only be effective for 30 minutes, tell Ground you need to make an intersection departure from Z4 before 0835Z.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你发现积冰污染了滑行道，你的除冰液有有效期仅为30分钟，告诉管制员，你需要在08：35Z前，从滑行道Z4进行减跑道起飞]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL403, request Z4 intersection departure before 0835Z due de-icing fluid is effective for 30min.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，美联航403，由于除冰液有效期仅为30分钟，请求在08：35Z前，从滑行道Z4进行减跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: UAL403, intersection departure before 0835Z is approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，可以在08:35Z前减跑道起飞。
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure before 0835Z approved, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以在08:35Z前减跑道起飞，美联航403。

cards.audioText: [Now you are cruising at 10200m, and encountering moderate turbulence. Ask control for a higher level.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在10200米巡航，遭遇了中度颠簸，报告管制员，申请更高高度]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL403, request climbing due moderate turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航403，由于中度颠簸，请求爬升。

cards.audioText:
UAL403, 10700m and 11200m are both available, which do you prefer?
[Tell controller you prefer 10,700m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航403,10700米和11200米都可用，你选哪一个？
[告诉管制员你想选10700米]
cards.referenceText: Request 10700m, UAL403.

cards.audioText: UAL403, climb and maintain 10700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，爬升至10700米保持。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 10700m, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至10700米保持，美联航403。

cards.audioText:
UAL403, radar shows your aircraft is a little higher than your assigned level, please check your altitude.
[Because of turbulence, you want to climb to 11300m to avoid it. Ask Wuhan Control if any turbulence was reported at that level by preceding aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航403，雷达显示你的飞机比指定的高度层稍高，请检查你的高度。
[由于颠簸，你想爬升至11300米避开颠簸，询问武汉区调，在此高度上，前机是否有颠簸的报告]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL403, confirm if there is any turbulence report at 11300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航403，证实11300米上是否有颠簸报。

cards.audioText:
UAL403, there is no turbulence report at 11300m.
[Tell controller you want to climb to 11300m due turbulence.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航403,11300米上没有颠簸报。
[告诉武汉区调，由于颠簸，你想爬升至11300米]
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 11300m due turbulence, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求爬升至11300米避开颠簸，美联航403。

cards.audioText: UAL403, climb and maintain 11300m. Contact Guangzhou Control on 119.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，爬升至11300米保持，联系广州区调119.75。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 11300m, 119.75, UAL403.

cards.audioText: [Contact Guangzhou control and request descent to 4500m.]
cards.audioTextZh: [联系广州区调，请求下降至4500米]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL403, request descent to 4500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，美联航403，请求下降至4500米。

cards.audioText: UAL403, Guangzhou Control, descend to 4500m. Reach 4500m 10 miles before ATAGA, descend at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，广州区调，下降至4500米。在ATAGA 10海里前下降到4500米。自行决定下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4500m, reach 4500m 10 miles before ATAGA, descend at own discretion, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到4500米，在ATAGA 10海里前下降到4500米。自行决定下降，美联航403。

cards.audioText: [You encountered some turbulence again, tell Guangzhou Control you want to deviate 10 miles to the right to avoid it.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你又一次遇到了颠簸，告诉广州区调，你想右偏10海里来避开颠簸]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL403, request deviate 10 miles to the right to avoid turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，美联航403，请求右偏10海里来避开颠簸。

cards.audioText: UAL403, deviate 10 miles to the right approved, then track direct to TAN, contact approach 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航403，可以右偏10海里，直飞TAN，联系进近118.5。
cards.referenceText: Deviate 10 miles to the right, track direct to TAN, 118.5, UAL403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右偏航10海里，直飞TAN，118.5，美联航403。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL219, from New York to Wuhan. You are maintaining 11000m over OBLIK, squawk number is 3566. Call wuhan control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是美联航219，从纽约飞往武汉，你现在保持在11000米，过OBLIK，应答机编码3566，呼叫武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan control, UAL219, 11000m over OBLIK, squawking 3566.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航219,11000米，过OBLK，应答机3566。

cards.audioText: UAL 219, Wuhan control, radar contact, descend to and maintain 9200m, expedite descend until passing 9800m due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，武汉区调，雷达识别，下降并保持9200米，由于通过航空器，加速下降直到过9800米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 9200m, expedite descend until passing 9800m, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持9200米，加速下降直到过9800米。

cards.audioText: You are now maintaining 9200m and are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence (CAT). Inform ATC of this situation and request further descent to 8400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在保持在9200米，你正在经历中度晴空颠簸，告知管制员此情况，请求进一步下降到8400米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan control, UAL219, maintaining 9200m. Request further descent to 8400m due moderate clear air turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航219，目前在9200米保持，由于中度晴空颠簸，请求进一步下降到8400米。

cards.audioText: UAL219, continue descent and maintain 8400m, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，继续下降并保持在8400米，到达后报。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to and maintain 8400m, wilco, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持在8400米，照办，美联航219。

cards.audioText: TCAS shows a fast moving aircraft at 9 o’clock. Check with Wuhan Control if it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: TCAS显示，9点钟方向有一架快速移动的航空器，与武汉区调确认，是否为冲突航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan control, UAL219, TCAS shows a traffic at 9 o’clock. Confirm it is a conflicting aircraft?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航219，TCAS显示9点钟方向有一架航空器，确认是否为冲突航空器？

cards.audioText: UAL219, negative, that aircraft is military aircraft flying parallel to your current track and will overtake you shortly. Report traffic in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，不是，该飞机为一架军机，与你现在的航迹平行飞行，不久将超过你。看到航空器后报。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，美联航219。

cards.audioText: Now that aircraft has passed you. Report to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，航空器冲突已解除，报告给管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan control, UAL219, clear of traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航219，与航空器解除冲突。

cards.audioText: UAL219, reduce to minimum speed. Track direct to ZF, expect ZF-3 arrival RWY 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，减小到最小速度，直飞ZF，预计ZF-3进场，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Reduce to minimum speed. Track direct to ZF, ZF-3 arrival RWY 36R, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减小到最小速度，直飞ZF，预计ZF-3进场，跑道36右，美联航219。

cards.audioText: UAL219, continue descent to and maintain 4200m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，继续下降并保持在4200米。
cards.referenceText: Descent to and maintain 4200m, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持在4200米，美联航219。

cards.audioText: You are now leveling at 4200m and approaching ZF, information A received, make an initial contact with Wuhan approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 武汉进近，美联航219，保持在4200米，接近ZF，通播A。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan approach, UAL219 maintaining 4200m, approaching ZF, information A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，美联航219，保持在4200米，接近ZF，通播A。

cards.audioText: Now you have established ILS approach RWY 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，你已经建立了ILS进近，跑道36右，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL219, established ILS approach RWY 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航219，建立ILS进近，跑道36右。

cards.audioText: UAL219, continue approach RWY 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，继续进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach RWY 36R, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，跑道36右，美联航219。

cards.audioText: All stations! All stations! Be advised RWY 36R is closed due to an unserviceable aircraft occupying the runway. Break break, UAL219, fly heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 各台注意，各台注意，通知下，由于一架故障飞机占用跑道，跑道36右关闭，断开，断开，美联航219，航向360，爬升并保持1500米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, heading 360, climb to and maintain 1500m, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，航向360，爬升并保持1500米，美联航219。

cards.audioText: UAL219, turn right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR/DME approach RWY 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，右转航向170，预计雷达引导，VOR/DME进近，跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 170, expect radar vectors for VOR/DME approach RWY 04, UAL219
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向170，预计雷达引导，VOR/DME进近，跑道04，美联航219。

cards.audioText: UAL219, turn right heading 310, cleared for the VOR/DME approach RWY 04, report inbound.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转航向310，可以VOR/DME进近，跑道04，向台报，美联航219。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 310, cleared for VOR/DME approach RWY 04, report inbound, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向310，可以VOR/DME进近，跑道04，向台报，美联航219。

cards.audioText: You are now inbound course for RWY 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在进入跑道04向台航迹，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL219, VOR/DME approach RWY 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航219，VOR/DME进近，跑道04。

cards.audioText: [Your callsign is UAL835, you are now at Guangzhou Control area, maintaining 8100 meters, over ATAGA, squawk 5703, contact Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是美联航835，你现在在广州区调范围，8100米保持，过ATAGA，应答机5703，联系广州区调。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL835, maintaining 8100 meters, over ATAGA, squawk 5703.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，美联航835，在8100米保持，过ATAGA，应答机5703。

cards.audioText: UAL835, radar contact. Proceed direct to WXI, climb and maintain 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，雷达识别了，直飞WXI，上9500米保持。
cards.referenceText: Direct to WXI, climb and maintain 9500 meters, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞WXI，上9500米保持，美联航835。

cards.audioText:
UAL835, what is your estimated time for WXI?
[Tell controller your estimated time for WXI is 0635Z.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航835，预计什么时候过WXI？
[告诉管制员，预计过WXI的时间是06:35Z。]
cards.referenceText: Estimated time for WXI is 0635Z, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计过WXI时间为06:35，美联航835。

cards.audioText: [Your weather radar shows a red area 50 miles in front of you, you want to offset 5 miles to the right to avoid the thunderstorm, ask Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示，前方50英里有雷暴，你想右偏5海里来飞避雷暴，请求广州区调。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL835, request offset 5 miles to the right to avoid thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，美联航835，请求右偏5海里避开雷暴。

cards.audioText: UAL835, offset 5 miles to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，同意右偏5海里，飞离天气后报。
cards.referenceText: Offset 5 miles to the right approved, wilco, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意右偏5海里，照办，美联航835。

cards.audioText:
UAL835, due to temporary airspace limitations, reduce to mach decimal 72.
[Tell ATC mach decimal 72 is not acceptable for you, it’s too slow for your aircraft. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航835，由于目前空域限制，减小马赫数至0.72。
[告诉管制员，无法减小至马赫数0.72，对你的飞机来说太慢了。]
cards.referenceText: negative, unable mach decimal 72, too slow for us, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，无法马赫数0.72，对我们来说太慢了，美联航835。

cards.audioText: UAL835, reduce to mach decimal 75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Guangzhou control area.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，减小至马赫数0.75，我们正在限制进入广州区调范围的飞机数量。
cards.referenceText: Reduce to mach decimal 75, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减小至马赫数0.75，美联航835。

cards.audioText: UAL835, turn right heading 230, maintain 10100 meters, contact Wuhan Control 121.6, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，右转航向230，保持10100米，联系武汉区调121.6，再见。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 230, maintain 10100 meters, contact Wuhan Control 121.6, good day, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向230，保持10100米，联系武汉区调121.6，再见，美联航835。

cards.audioText: [You are cruising 10100 meters, over OBLIK, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在10100米巡航，过OBLIK，呼叫武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL835, cruising 10100 meters, over OBLIK, squawk 5703.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航835，在10100米巡航，过OBLIK，应答机5703。

cards.audioText: UAL835, Wuhan control, descend to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，武汉区调，下8400米保持，到达到后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 8400 meters, report reaching, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下8400米保持，到达后报，美联航835。

cards.audioText: [As you were descending, you executed TCAS climbing maneuver, report this situation to Wuhan. ]
cards.audioTextZh: [在下降过程中，你执行了TCAS爬升机动，将此情况报告给武汉。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 835, we executed TCAS climbing maneuver as we are descending.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航835，在下降过程中，我们执行了TCAS爬升机动。

cards.audioText: [Now the conflicting traffic is clear, you resumed descend, tell ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在你和冲突航空器已解除冲突，继续下降，告诉管制员。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL835, we are clear of traffic, we resumed descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航835，我们摆脱冲突，继续下降。

cards.audioText: UAL835, continue descend to 3600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，继续下降至3600米。
cards.referenceText: continue descend to 3600 meters. UAL835
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至3600米，美联航835。

cards.audioText: [The purser tells you, during the maneuver, there are 5 passengers injured, 2 of them are injured very seriously. Inform Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: [乘务长告诉你，在机动期间，有5名乘客受伤，其中2名受重伤，告诉武汉区调。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL835, we have 5 passengers injured, and 2 are very serious during the TCAS maneuver.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航835，在机动期间，我们有5名乘客受伤，其中2名受重伤。

cards.audioText:
Roger, UAL835, what is your intention?
[The injured passengers are bleeding seriously, You request priority landing at Wuhan airport, and request ambulance on arrival. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航835，你的意图是什么？
[受伤的乘客流血严重，你请求在武汉机场优先着陆，并在着陆后请求救护车。]
cards.referenceText: Request priority landing and ambulance on arrival, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求优先着陆，并在着陆后请求救护车，美联航835。

cards.audioText: UAL835, priority landing approved, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航835，同意优先着陆，预计雷达引导，ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Priority landing approved, radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意优先着陆，雷达引导，ILS进近，跑道36右，美联航835。

cards.audioText: [You have captured the localizer for runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower, confirm medical assistance is ready.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你截获了跑道36右的航向道，联系武汉塔台，证实医疗救援已就位。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL835, localizer established runway 36R, confirm medical service is ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，美联航835，建立跑道36右的航向道，证实医疗救援已就位。

cards.audioText: Affirm, UAL835, ambulance and doctors are waiting at the gate, cleared to land, runway 36R, surface wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: 是的，救护车和医生正在机坪等候，可以落地，跑道36右，地面静风。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared to land, runway 36R, thank you, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，可以落地，跑道36右，谢谢，美联航835。

topics.name: KLM 88 电力不足 复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is KLM 88, you are at gate 504, the boarding hasn't been completed and you have catering delay, you have to delay about 15 minutes, contact Shanghai Delivery and request delay the flight until time 25.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 KLM 88，在 504 登机口，登机尚未完成且配餐延误，需要延误约 15 分钟，联系上海放行，请求航班延误至 25 分。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, KLM 88, gate 504, the boarding hasn't been completed and we have catering delay, we have to delay about 15 minutes, request delay the flight until time 25.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，KLM 88，504 登机口，登机尚未完成且配餐延误，需要延误约 15 分钟，请求航班延误至 25 分。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, roger, report when ready.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，收到，准备好后报告。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at gate 504, you have got the information F, you are ready to copy ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在 504 登机口，已收到通播 F，准备抄收飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, KLM 88, gate 504, information F, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，KLM 88，504 登机口，收到通播 F，请求飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure Runway 34, initial climb 900 meters on QNH, cruising level 10700 meters, after departure, contact 127.35, squawk 7423.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，按计划航路放行至阿姆斯特丹，离场跑道 34，按 QNH 初始爬升 900 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场后联系 127.35，应答机 7423。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure Runway 34, initial climb 900 meters on QNH, cruising level 10700 meters, after departure, contact 127.35, squawk 7423, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至阿姆斯特丹，离场跑道 34，按 QNH 初始爬升 900 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场后联系 127.35，应答机 7423，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Shanghai Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备推出和开车，联系上海地面。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM 88, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，KLM 88，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，可以推出开车，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，机头朝西，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM 88, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，KLM 88，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, taxi to holding point Runway 34 via taxiway Z, T3, T4 and R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，经滑行道 Z、T3、T4 和 R 滑行至跑道 34 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 34 via taxiway Z, T3, T4 and R, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z、T3、T4 和 R 滑行至跑道 34 等待点，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi, you notice an Airbus 320 was broken down on taxiway T3, you have stopped your aircraft, contact Shanghai Ground and request further instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行过程中，你发现一架 Airbus 320 在滑行道 T3 上故障，你已停止飞机，联系上海地面请求进一步指令。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM 88, an A320 was broken down on taxiway T3, we have stopped our aircraft, request further instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，KLM 88，一架 A320 在滑行道 T3 上故障，我们已停止，请求进一步指令。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, hold position, expect delay 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，保持当前位置，预计延误 5 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold position, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持当前位置，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: You are at holding point Runway 34, you are ready for departure, contact Shanghai Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在跑道 34 等待点，准备离场，联系上海塔台。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, KLM 88, holding point Runway 34, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，KLM 88，跑道 34 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, Runway 34, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，跑道 34，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Runway 34, cleared for takeoff, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 34，可以起飞，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Shanghai Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 600 米，联系上海离场。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Departure, KLM 88, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海离场，KLM 88，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, Shanghai Departure, radar contact, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，上海离场，雷达识别，按 QNH 1012 爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1012, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1012 爬升至 3000 米，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to 3000 meters. During climbing, you have got a warning, the indication shows electrical power is low, make an Urgency call to Shanghai Departure and request return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在正爬升至 3000 米。爬升过程中出现警告，指示显示电力不足，向上海离场发出紧急呼叫并请求返场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Shanghai Departure, KLM 88, climbing to 3000 meters, our electrical power is low, request return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，上海离场，KLM 88，正爬升至 3000 米，电力不足，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, Departure, roger PAN, descend to 1200 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，离场，收到 PAN，下降至 1200 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1200 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 1200 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: During approach, you can't establish a stable approach due to low electrical power, you have made a missed approach, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近过程中，由于电力不足无法建立稳定进近，你已复飞，联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Departure, KLM 88, we can't establish a stable approach due to low electrical power, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海离场，KLM 88，因电力不足无法建立稳定进近，正在复飞。

cards.audioText:
C: KLM 88, roger, follow the published missed approach procedure, climb to 1200 meters, if able, advise further intentions.
B: Read back the instruction and tell the controller that you want to circle to Runway 18L for visual approach.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：KLM 88，收到，执行公布复飞程序，爬升至 1200 米，如可以，报告后续意图。
B：复诵指令，并告诉管制员你想盘旋至跑道 18 左目视进近。
cards.referenceText: Follow the published missed approach procedure, climb to 1200 meters, request circle to runaway 18L for visual approach, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行公布复飞程序，爬升至 1200 米，请求盘旋至跑道 18L 目视进近，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, Departure, cleared visual approach Runway 18L. Caution, runway is wet, braking action medium.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，离场，可以目视进近跑道 18 左。注意跑道湿，刹车效应中等。
cards.referenceText: Cleared visual approach Runway 18L, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以目视进近跑道 18L，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, the runway is slippery, you skidded off Runway 18L, ask Tower for a tug and passenger stairs.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后跑道湿滑，你滑出跑道 18 左，向塔台请求拖车和客梯车。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, KLM 88, the runway is slippery, we skidded off Runway 18L, request a tug and passenger stairs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，KLM 88，跑道湿滑，我们滑出跑道 18L，请求拖车和客梯车。

topics.name: KLM 88 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动 复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is KLM 88, you are at gate 504, the boarding hasn't been completed and you have catering delay, you have to delay about 15 minutes, contact Shanghai Delivery and request delay the flight until time 25.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 KLM 88，在 504 登机口，登机尚未完成且配餐延误，需要延误约 15 分钟，联系上海放行，请求航班延误至 25 分。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, KLM 88, gate 504, the boarding hasn't been completed and we have catering delay, we have to delay about 15 minutes, request delay the flight until time 25.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，KLM 88，504 登机口，登机尚未完成且配餐延误，需要延误约 15 分钟，请求航班延误至 25 分。

cards.audioText: KLM 88, roger, report when ready.
cards.audioTextZh: KLM 88，收到，准备好时报告。
cards.referenceText: wilco/report when ready, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办/准备好时报告，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at gate 504, you have got the information F, you are ready to copy ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在 504 登机口，已收到通播 F，准备抄收飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, KLM 88, gate 504, information F, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，KLM 88，504 登机口，收到通播 F，请求飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: KLM 88, cleared to destination via flight planned route, departure Runway 34, initial climb 900 meters on QNH, cruising level 10,700 meters, after departure contact 127.35, squawk 7423.
cards.audioTextZh: KLM 88，许可按飞行计划航路飞往目的地，离场使用 Runway 34，按 QNH 初始爬升至 900 米，巡航高度 10,700 米，离场后联系 127.35，应答机 7423。
cards.referenceText: cleared to destination via flight planned route, departure Runway 34, initial climb 900 meters QNH, cruising level 1700 meters, 127.35, squawk 7423, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往目的地，离场使用 Runway 34，按 QNH 初始爬升至 900 米，巡航高度 1700 米，127.35，应答机 7423，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Shanghai Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备推出和开车，联系上海地面。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM 88, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，KLM 88，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，可以推出开车，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，机头朝西，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM 88, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，KLM 88，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, taxi to holding point Runway 34 via taxiway Z, T3, T4 and R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，经滑行道 Z、T3、T4 和 R 滑行至跑道 34 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 34 via taxiway Z, T3, T4 and R, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z、T3、T4 和 R 滑行至跑道 34 等待点，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: During taxi, you notice an Airbus 3 20 was broken down on taxiway T3, you have stopped your aircraft, contact Shanghai Ground and request further instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 滑行期间，你发现一架 Airbus 320 故障停在 T3 滑行道上。你已停住航空器，联系上海地面并请求进一步指令。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM 88, an Airbus 320 was broken down taxiway T tree, we have stopped our aircraft, request further instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，KLM 88，一架 Airbus 320 故障停在 T3 滑行道上，我们已停住航空器，请求进一步指令。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, hold position, expect delay 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，保持当前位置，预计延误 5 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold position, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持当前位置，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: You are at holding point Runway 34, you are ready for departure, contact Shanghai Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在跑道 34 等待点，准备离场，联系上海塔台。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, KLM 88, holding point Runway 34, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，KLM 88，跑道 34 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, Runway 34, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，跑道 34，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Runway 34, cleared for takeoff, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 34，可以起飞，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Shanghai Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 600 米，联系上海离场。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Departure, KLM 88, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海离场，KLM 88，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: KLM 88, Shanghai Departure, radar contact, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: C：KLM 88，上海离场，雷达识别，按 QNH 1012 爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1012, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1012 爬升至 3000 米，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to 3000 meters. During climbing, you have got a warning, the indication shows electrical power is low, make an Urgency call to Shanghai Departure and request return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在正爬升至 3000 米。爬升过程中出现警告，指示显示电力不足，向上海离场发出紧急呼叫并请求返场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Shanghai Departure, KLM 88, climbing to 3000 meters, our electrical power is low, request return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，上海离场，KLM 88，正爬升至 3000 米，电力不足，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: KLM 88, Departure, roger PAN, descend to 1,200 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: KLM 88，离场，收到 PAN，下降至 1,200 米，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: descend to 1200 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 1200 米，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: B: During approach, you can't establish a stable approach due to low electrical power, you have made a missed approach, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近过程中，由于电力不足无法建立稳定进近，你已复飞，联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Departure, KLM 88, we can't establish a stable approach due to low electrical power, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海离场，KLM 88，因电力不足无法建立稳定进近，正在复飞。

cards.audioText:
C: KLM 88, roger, follow the published missed approach procedure, climb to 1,200 meters. If able, advise further intentions.
B: read back the instruction and tell the controller that you want to circle to Runway 18L for visual approach.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： KLM 88，收到，执行公布的复飞程序，爬升至 1,200 米。如可以，报告后续意图。
B： 复诵指令，并告诉管制员你希望盘旋至 Runway 18L 做目视进近。
cards.referenceText: follow the published missed approach procedure, climb to 1200 meters, request circle to Runway 18L visual approach, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行公布的复飞程序，爬升至 1200 米，请求盘旋至 Runway 18L 做目视进近，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: KLM 88, Departure, cleared visual approach, Runway 18L. Caution, runway is wet, braking action medium.
cards.audioTextZh: KLM 88，离场，许可目视进近 Runway 18L。注意，跑道湿滑，刹车效应中等。
cards.referenceText: cleared visual approach, Runway 18L, KLM 88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可目视进近 Runway 18L，KLM 88。

cards.audioText: After landing, the runway is slippery, you skidded off/veered off Runway 18L, ask Tower for a tug and passenger stairs.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆后，跑道湿滑，你滑出/偏出 Runway 18L，向塔台请求拖车和客梯车。
cards.referenceText: Tower, KLM 88, the runway is slippery, we skidded off Runway 18L, request a tug passenger stairs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 塔台，KLM 88，跑道湿滑，我们滑出 Runway 18L，请求拖车和客梯车。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is KLM88, you are at Wuhan Airport, stand 223, you are fully ready, call Wuhan delivery and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是荷航88，你现在武汉机场，223号停机位，你现在准备好了，呼叫武汉放行，申请管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, KLM88, stand 223, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，荷航88，223号机位，请求管制许可。

cards.audioText: KLM88, negative due traffic on short final, standby.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，不可以，短五边上有航空器，稍等。
cards.referenceText: Roger, standby, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，稍等，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [You have been waiting for 15 minutes, and some passengers in the cabin are complaining, you want to know how long the delay is, ask Wuhan delivery for confirmation.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你已经等了15分钟了，客舱有乘客抱怨，你想知道延误多久，询问武汉放行，进行确认。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, KLM88, confirm the delay time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，荷航88，确认延误时间。

cards.audioText: KLM88, delay not determined, expect further clearance in 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，延误时间不确定，预计在5分钟后收到下一个许可。
cards.referenceText: Roger, 5 minutes, thanks, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，5分钟，谢谢，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [5 minutes later, you want to request the ATC clearance again.]
cards.audioTextZh: [5分钟后，你想再次申请管制许可。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, KLM88, stand 223, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，荷航88,223号停机位，请求管制许可。

cards.audioText: KLM88, cleared to destination via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 11000m, squawk 3512.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，可以经由计划航路飞往目的地，LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度11000米，应答机3512。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to destination via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 11000m, squawk 3512, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往目的地，LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度11000米，应答机3512，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [Now you’re ready for push-back and startup, call Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在你准备好推出开车了，呼叫武汉地面。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, KLM88, request push-back and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，荷航88，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: KLM88, push-back approved, facing east, start your engines at your own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，同意推出，面朝东，自行决定开车。
cards.referenceText: Push-back approved, facing east, startup at own discretion, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，面朝东，自行决定开车，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [You have completed pushback and startup, request taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你完成了推出开车，请求滑行指令。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, KLM88, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，荷航88，请求滑行。
