cards.audioText: KML88, taxi via taxiway Z4, A2, E2 to the holding point of runway 04, taxi with caution due constructions near taxiway E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88， 经由Z4，A2，E2，滑行至04跑道外等待点，谨慎滑行，E1滑行道上有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A2, E2 to the holding point of runway 04, thanks, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4，A2，E2，滑行至04跑道外等待点，谢谢，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [Now you have reached the holding point of runway 04, you are ready for takeoff.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在到达了04跑道外等待点，你准备好起飞了。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, KLM88, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，荷航88，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: KLM88, cleared for takeoff, runway 04, keep runway heading until 800m, contact Wuhan departure on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，可以起飞，跑道04，保持跑道航向直到800米，联系武汉离场128.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 04, runway heading until 800m, contact Wuhan departure 128.35, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道04，跑道航向直到800米，联系武汉离场128.35，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [During the landing gear retraction, you find your landing gear cannot be retracted, you’ve completed the checklist, but the problem still cannot be fixed, report this situation to Wuhan Departure, this is an urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在收轮期间，你发现你的起落架无法收回，你完成了检查单，但是依旧没有解决问题，将此情况报告给武汉离场，这是一个紧急呼叫。]
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Wuhan Departure, KLM88, our landing gear cannot be retracted.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan，武汉离场，荷航88，我们的起落架无法收回。

cards.audioText:
KLM88, Wuhan Departure, roger pan, what is your intention?
[Tell controller you want to return to Wuhan airport with priority.]
cards.audioTextZh:
荷航88，武汉离场，你的意图是什么？
[告诉管制员，你想返回武汉机场，优先着陆。]
cards.referenceText: Request priority landing to Wuhan airport, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求优先着陆武汉机场，荷航88。

cards.audioText: KLM88, roger, follow LKO-01 arrival, fly direct to the holding point as published to burn fuel, you are the first one in the landing sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，收到，按照LKO-01进场，直飞发布的等待点进行放油，你第一个着陆。
cards.referenceText: LKO-01 arrival, fly direct to the holding point as published, No.1, thanks, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: LKO-01进场，直飞发布的等待点，第一个，谢谢，荷航88。

cards.audioText:
KLM88, when able, report persons on board.
[Tell the controller that the POB is 178, including 5 children.]
cards.audioTextZh:
荷航88，可以的时候，报告机上人数。
[告诉管制员，机上人数是178，包含5名儿童。]
cards.referenceText: POB is 178, including 5 children, KLM88,
cards.referenceTextZh: 机上人数178，包含5名儿童，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [Your landing gear problem cannot be fixed, tell the controller that you need a tug because you cannot taxi back to the apron with your own power.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你的起落架问题依旧，没解决，告诉管制员，你需要一辆拖车，因为你无法自行滑回机坪。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, KLM88, we cannot taxi back due to landing gear problem, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，荷航88，由于起落架问题，我们无法滑回机坪，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: KLM88, the tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，拖车在路上了。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，荷航88。

cards.audioText: KLM88, expect ILS approach runway 04, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，预计ILS进近，跑道04，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: ILS approach runway 04, wilco, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: ILS进近，跑道04，建立后报，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is KLM88, you are at Pudong Airport, stand 223, you are fully ready, call Shanghai delivery and request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是荷航88，你现在浦东机场，223号停机位，你现在准备好了，呼叫上海放行，申请管制许可，目的地阿姆斯特丹。
cards.referenceText: Pudong Delivery, KLM88, stand 223, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 浦东放行，荷航88，223号机位，请求放行许可，目的地阿姆斯特丹。

cards.audioText: KLM88, Shanghai Delivery. Cleared to destination via flight planned route, use runway 35, LAK-05D departure, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 11000m, squawk 3512.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，可以经由计划航路飞往目的地，跑道35，LAK-05D离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度11000米，应答机3512。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to destination via flight planned route, runway 35, LAK-05D departure, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 11000m, squawk 3512, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往目的地，跑道35，LAK-05D离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度11000米，应答机3512，荷航88。

cards.audioText: KLM88, readback correct, contact 118.9 when ready for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，复诵正确，准备好推出开车叫118.9。
cards.referenceText: Contact 118.9 when ready, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 准备好时叫118.9，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [Tell Ground controller, passenger boarding is not completed, You have to wait for 15 minutes before you can pushback and startup]
cards.audioTextZh: [跟地面说你还要再等15分钟才能推出开车，乘客登机还没完成。]
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM88, request 15 minutes delay due boarding not completed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，荷航88，由于登机未完成，请求15分钟延误。

cards.audioText:
Roger delay, KLM88, call me when ready.
[You are fully ready, now call Ground, request pushback and startup.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，有延误，荷航88，准备好叫。
你现在准备好了，呼叫地面，请求推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM88, stand 223, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，荷航88，223号停机位，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: KLM88, pushback approved, facing east, startup at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，同意推出，开车自行掌握，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback approved, facing east, startup at own discretion, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，开车自行掌握，机头朝东，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [You have completed pushback and startup, request taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你完成了推出开车，请求滑行指令。]
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, KLM88, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，荷航88，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: KLM88, taxi via taxiway Z, Z4, A2, E2 and M1 to the holding point of runway 35, taxi with caution due workmen near taxiway Z.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88， 经由Z，Z4，A2，E2，M1，滑行至35跑道等待点，谨慎滑行，滑行道Z附近有工人。
cards.referenceText: Roger. Taxi via taxiway Z, Z4, A2, E2, M1 to the holding point of runway 35, thanks, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z，Z4，A2，E2，M1滑行至35跑道外等待点，谢谢，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [Now you have reached the holding point of runway 35, you are ready for takeoff.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在到达了35号跑道等待点，你准备好起飞了。]
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, KLM88, holding point of runway 35, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，荷航88，跑道35等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: KLM88, Shanghai Tower, cleared for takeoff, runway 35, keep runway heading until 900m, contact Departure on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，上海塔台，可以起飞，跑道35，保持跑道航向直到900米，联系离场128.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 35, runway heading until 900m, contact departure 128.35, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道35，跑道航向直到900米，联系离场128.35，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [During climb, you found your generators have failed, and you are flying with aircraft battery, report this situation to Shanghai Departure, tell them you need to return.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在爬升过程中，你发现你的发电机故障了，现在靠电池供电，报告该情况，并请求返场。]
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Departure, KLM88, we are flying with aircraft battery, our generators failed, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海离场，荷航88，发电机故障了，现在靠电池供电，请求返场 。

cards.audioText: KLM88, Shanghai Departure, roger, expect ILS approach runway 35.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，上海离场，收到，预计使用35号跑道，盲降进近。
cards.referenceText: Expect ILS approach runway 35, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计盲降进近，35号跑道，荷航88。

cards.audioText:
KLM88, previous pilot reported the ILS signal for runway 35 is very unstable, are you able to make a second approach to another runway 36L?
[Tell controller, you are unable to do that, you don’t have enough electrical power left for a second approach]
cards.audioTextZh:
荷航88，前机报告跑道35盲降信号不稳定，你可以使用另外一条跑道36左吗？
[告诉管制员，你无法照办，没有足够的电力进行第二次进近。]
cards.referenceText: Negative, unable due power not enough, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，我电力不足，无法照办，荷航88。

cards.audioText: KLM88, visual approach, continue descent, runway 35, you are number one, report airfield in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，目视进近，继续下降，跑道35，你是第一个，机场可见报告。
cards.referenceText: No.1, visual approach, continue descent, runway 35, wilco, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一个，目视进近，继续下降，跑道35，照办，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [You are joining downwind of runway 35, tell Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你正在加入跑道35的三边，告诉进近。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, KLM88, joining downwind of runway 35.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，荷航88，正在加入跑道35的三边。

cards.audioText: KLM88, roger, report on final.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，荷航88，五边报。
cards.referenceText: Report final, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 五边报，荷航88。

cards.audioText: KLM88, now establish contact with Tower 128.9.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，现在联系塔台128.9。

cards.audioText: KLM88, Shanghai Tower, you are cleared to land, surface wind 330, 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88，上海塔台，可以落地，地面风330，2米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 35, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道35，荷航88。

cards.audioText: [During landing, your aircraft skidded off the runway, tell Tower you are unable to taxi back by yourself.]
cards.audioTextZh: 落地的时候，你的飞机偏出跑道，告诉塔台你无法靠自己滑回了。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Tower, KLM88, my aircraft skidded off the runway, unable to taxi back with my own power.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海塔台，荷航88，飞机偏出跑道，无法自行滑回。

cards.audioText:
Report your intention, KLM88.
[Tell ATC, that you need shuttle bus to disembark passengers and a tug to tow you back to apron.]
cards.audioTextZh:
报告你的意图，荷航88。
告诉管制，你需要摆渡车让乘客下飞机以及拖车拖你回机坪。
cards.referenceText: Request shuttle bus to disembark passengers and a tug to tow us back to apron, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求摆渡车让乘客下飞机，以及拖车拖飞机回机坪，荷航88。

cards.audioText: Roger, KLM88, emergency services will be ready soon.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，荷航88，马上准备应急救援。
cards.referenceText: Thanks, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 感谢，荷航88。

topics.name: JAL 602 老太太摔倒骨折 担架

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is JAL 602, a flight from Tokyo to Wuhan, now you are over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters, make initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 JAL 602，从东京飞往武汉，现在飞越 DAPRO，保持 10100 米，首次联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，飞越 DAPRO，保持 10100 米。

cards.audioText: B: You now have an indication of a thunderstorm on your radar screen, fifty kilometers ahead of you, request ATC clearance to offset 5 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在雷达屏幕显示前方 50 公里有雷暴，请求 ATC 许可向右偏航 5 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, we have an indication of a thunderstorm 50 km ahead, request offset 5 miles to the right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，我们显示前方 50 公里有雷暴，请求向右偏航 5 海里。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 602, offset 5 miles to the right approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 602，同意向右偏航 5 海里。
cards.referenceText: Offset 5 miles to the right approved, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 5 海里，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: B: Later you find more thunderstorms ahead of you, request climb to 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：随后你发现前方有更多雷暴，请求爬升至 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, request climb to 10700 meters due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，因天气请求爬升至 10700 米。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 602, 10700 meters not available due to military activity at the moment, can you accept 11300 meters?
B: Tell the controller you are unable to climb to 11300 meters due performance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：JAL 602，目前因军事活动，10700 米不可用，可以接受 11300 米吗？
B：告诉管制员因性能原因无法爬升至 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, negative/unable due performance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，不能接受，因性能原因无法爬升。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 602, maintain 10100 meters.
cards.referenceText: Maintain 10100 meters, JAL 602.

cards.audioText: B: To avoid thunderstorm, you request turn right heading 240 and maintain this heading for fifty miles.
cards.audioTextZh: B：为避让雷暴，你请求右转航向 240，并保持该航向 50 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, request turn right heading 240 and maintain this heading for 50 miles to avoid thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，为避让雷暴，请求右转航向 240 并保持该航向 50 海里。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 602, negative, heading 240 is not available to restricted area, deviation to the left is available, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you want to turn left heading 080.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：JAL 602，不可以，航向 240 因限制区不可用，左侧偏航可用，报告意图。
B：告诉管制员你想左转航向 080。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, roger, request turn left heading 080.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，收到，请求左转航向 080。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 602, turn left heading 080 approved, report clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 602，同意左转航向 080，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 080 approved, report clear of weather, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意左转航向 080，脱离天气后报告，JAL 602。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 602, how many miles do you want to fly on this heading?
B: Tell the controller fifty miles is enough for you.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：JAL 602，你想沿该航向飞多少海里？
B：告诉管制员 50 海里足够。
cards.referenceText: 50 miles is enough, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 50 海里足够，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of weather, inform Wuhan Control and request direct to ZF and descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离天气，通知武汉管制，并请求直飞 ZF 和下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, clear of weather, request direct to ZF and descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，已脱离天气，请求直飞 ZF 并下降。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 602, direct to ZF, descend and maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 602，直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZF, descend and maintain 6000 meters, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: B: Now you see CBs in front of you, you want to maneuver 2 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在看到前方有 CB，想向右机动 2 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, request maneuver 2 miles to the right due to CBs ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，前方有 CB，请求向右机动 2 海里。

cards.audioText: B: During maneuver, an old lady fell in the cabin and was injured, she might be suffering from bone fracture, inform Wuhan Approach the situation and ask for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：机动过程中，一位老太太在客舱摔倒受伤，可能骨折，向武汉进近报告情况并请求优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL 602, an old lady fell in the cabin and was injured, she might be suffering from bone fracture, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，JAL 602，一位老太太在客舱摔倒受伤，可能骨折，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 602, roger, you are number 1, expect radar vectors, do you require any medical assistance on arrival?
B: Tell the controller you need medical assistance, and you will open the rear cabin door to deplane the sick passenger by a stretcher.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：JAL 602，收到，你是第一架，预计雷达引导，落地后需要医疗协助吗？
B：告诉管制员需要医疗协助，并将打开后客舱门，用担架让病患下机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL 602, request medical assistance and open the rear cabin door to deplane the sick passenger by a stretcher.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，JAL 602，请求医疗协助，并打开后客舱门，用担架让病患下机。

topics.name: JAL 220 转述接收机失效 吸入外来物体 右发超温

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is JAL 220, from Shanghai to Hongkong, you have intercepted an Urgency call from CCA 105, CCA 105 was transmitting blind due to receiver failure, he intended to request priority landing at Xiamen, relay the message to Xiamen Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 JAL 220，从上海飞往香港，你截收到 CCA 105 的紧急呼叫，CCA 105 因接收机故障正在盲发，意图请求在厦门优先着陆，将该信息转报给厦门进近。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Xiamen Approach, JAL 220, we have intercepted an Urgency call from CCA 105, CCA 105 was transmitting blind due to receiver failure, request priority landing at Xiamen.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，厦门进近，JAL 220，我们截收到 CCA 105 的紧急呼叫，CCA 105 因接收机故障正在盲发，请求在厦门优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 220, maintain present heading, maintain 9800 meters, contact Hongkong Center on 112.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 220，保持当前航向，保持 9800 米，联系香港管制112.5。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading, maintain 9800 meters, contact Hongkong Center on 112.5, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，保持 9800 米，联系香港管制112.5，JAL 220。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining FL320, you are over FISHA, your transponder code is 3062, make an initial contact with Hongkong Center.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持飞行高度层 320，飞越 FISHA，应答机代码 3062，首次联系香港管制。
cards.referenceText: Hongkong Center, JAL 220, maintaining FL320, over FISHA, squawking 3062.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，JAL 220，保持 FL320，飞越 FISHA，应答机 3062。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, you encountered foreign object ingestion, possibly volcanic ash, your starboard engine is overheating, you ask Hongkong Center for emergency descent to FL220 and radar vectors to Hongkong for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：突然遭遇外来物吸入，可能是火山灰，右发过热，你向香港管制请求紧急下降至飞行高度层 220，并请求雷达引导至香港优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Hongkong Center, JAL 220, we encountered foreign object ingestion, possibly volcanic ash, our starboard engine is overheating, request emergency descent to FL220 and radar vectors to Hongkong for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，JAL 220，我们遭遇外来物吸入，可能是火山灰，右发过热，请求紧急下降至 FL220，并雷达引导至香港优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 220, roger, FL220 is not available due to traffic, maintain FL320, turn right, direct to TD, contact Hongkong Approach on 123.8.
cards.audioTextZh: C: JAL 220，收到，由于交通原因，飞行高度层 220 不可用，保持飞行高度层 320，右转，直飞 TD，联系香港进近123.8。
cards.referenceText: Maintain FL320, turn right, direct to TD, 123.8, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 FL320，右转，直飞 TD，123.8，JAL 220。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are 5 miles south of TD VOR, state your situation to Hongkong Approach and ask for straight in ILS approach Runway 07L and priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 TD VOR 以南 5 海里，向香港进近说明情况，并请求跑道 07L 直线 ILS 进近和优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Hongkong Approach, JAL 220, 5 miles south of TD VOR, we encountered foreign object ingestion, possibly volcanic ash, request straight in ILS approach Runway 07L and priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，JAL 220，在 TD VOR 以南 5 海里，我们遭遇外来物吸入，可能是火山灰，请求跑道 07L 直线 ILS 进近和优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 220, Hongkong Approach, turn right heading 240 to intercept TD VOR 030 radial inbound, descend to FL110.
cards.audioTextZh: C: JAL 220，香港进近，右转航向 240，切入 TD VOR 030 径向线向台，下降到飞行高度层 110。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240 to intercept TD VOR 030 radial inbound, descend to FL110, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 TD VOR 030 径向线向台，下降到 FL110，JAL 220。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 220, when able, state persons on board.
B: Tell the controller the persons on board is 188, including 4 children.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 220，可以时报告机上人数。
B: 告诉管制员机上人数 188，包括 4 名儿童。
cards.referenceText: POB 188, including 4 children, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机上人数 188，包括 4 名儿童，JAL 220。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 220, cleared straight in ILS approach Runway 07L, you are number 1 to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C: JAL 220，可以跑道 07L 直线 ILS 进近，你是第 1 架着陆。
cards.referenceText: Cleared straight in ILS approach Runway 07L, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以跑道 07L 直线 ILS 进近，JAL 220。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 220, surface wind 090, 20 knots.
B: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to Runway 25.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 220，地面风 090，20 节。
B: 由于强顺风，你想改用跑道 25。
cards.referenceText: Hongkong Approach, JAL 220, request change to Runway 25 due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，JAL 220，由于强顺风，请求改用跑道 25。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 220, change to Runway 25 approved, maintain 6000 feet, turn right to TD, you are number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: JAL 220，批准改用跑道 25，保持 6000 英尺，右转至 TD，你是第 1 架。
cards.referenceText: Change to Runway 25 approved, maintain 6000 feet, turn right to TD, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准改用跑道 25，保持 6000 英尺，右转至 TD，JAL 220。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you find your APU has failed, tell the situation to Hongkong Ground and ask for ground power unit.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 着陆后，你发现 APU 失效，向香港地面说明情况并请求地面电源车。
cards.referenceText: Hongkong Ground, JAL 220, our APU has failed, request ground power unit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港地面，JAL 220，我们的 APU 失效，请求地面电源车。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 220, Hongkong Ground, roger, do you need any other service?
B: Tell the controller you need a tow truck to tow you to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 220，香港地面，收到，还需要其他服务吗？
B: 告诉管制员你需要拖车把你拖到停机坪。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request a tow truck to tow us to the apron, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求拖车把我们拖到停机坪，JAL 220。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 220, roger, do you need medical assistance at the ramp?
B: Tell the controller you need medical assistance at the ramp.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 220，收到，你在停机坪需要医疗援助吗？
B: 告诉管制员你在停机坪需要医疗援助。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request need medical assistance at the ramp, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求在停机坪提供医疗援助，JAL 220。

topics.name: JAL 602 雷暴绕飞 乘客医疗 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is JAL 602, a flight from Tokyo to Wuhan, now you are over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters, make initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 JAL 602，从东京飞往武汉，现在飞越 DAPRO，保持 10100 米，首次联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，飞越 DAPRO，保持 10100 米。

cards.audioText: you now have an indication of a thunderstorm on your radar screen, 50km ahead of you, request ATC clearance to offset 5 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你的雷达屏幕显示前方 50 公里处有雷暴，请求空中交通管制许可向右偏置 5 英里。
cards.referenceText: Control, JAL 602, thunderstorm 50 kilometers ahead, request offset five miles to the right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 管制，JAL 602，前方 50 公里处有雷暴，请求向右偏置 5 英里。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 602, offset 5 miles to the right approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 602，同意向右偏航 5 海里。
cards.referenceText: Offset 5 miles to the right approved, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 5 海里，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: B: Later you find more thunderstorms ahead of you, request climb to 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：随后你发现前方有更多雷暴，请求爬升至 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, request climb to 10700 meters due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，因天气请求爬升至 10700 米。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 60210700 meters not available due to military activity at the moment, can you accept 11300 meters?
B: tell the controller you are unable to climb to 11300 meters due performance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： JAL 602，因军事活动，目前 10700 米不可用，能否接受 11300 米？
B： 告诉管制员，因性能原因你无法爬升至 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: negative, unable 2300 meters, due performance, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，因性能原因无法爬升至 2300 米，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: JAL 602, maintain 10,100 meters.
cards.referenceText: maintaining 1100 meters, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 1100 米，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: B: To avoid thunderstorm, you request turn right heading 240 and maintain this heading for fifty miles.
cards.audioTextZh: B：为避让雷暴，你请求右转航向 240，并保持该航向 50 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, request turn right heading 240 and maintain this heading for 50 miles to avoid thunderstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，为避让雷暴，请求右转航向 240 并保持该航向 50 海里。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 602, negative, heading 240 is not available due restricted area. Deviation to the left is available, say your intention.
B: tell the controller you want to turn left heading 080.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： JAL 602，不行，因限制区，航向 240 不可用。可以向左偏航，报告你的意图。
B： 告诉管制员你希望左转航向 080。
cards.referenceText: roger, request turn left heading 080, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求左转航向 080，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 602, turn left heading 080 approved, report clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 602，同意左转航向 080，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 080 approved, report clear of weather, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意左转航向 080，脱离天气后报告，JAL 602。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 602, how many miles do you want to fly on this heading?
B: Tell the controller fifty miles is enough for you.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：JAL 602，你想沿该航向飞多少海里？
B：告诉管制员 50 海里足够。
cards.referenceText: 50 miles is enough, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 50 海里足够，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of weather, inform Wuhan Control and request direct to ZF and descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离天气，通知武汉管制，并请求直飞 ZF 和下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, clear of weather, request direct to ZF and descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，已脱离天气，请求直飞 ZF 并下降。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 602, direct to ZF, descend and maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 602，直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZF, descend and maintain 6000 meters, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，JAL 602。

cards.audioText: B: Now you see CBs in front of you, you want to maneuver 2 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在看到前方有 CB，想向右机动 2 海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL 602, request maneuver 2 miles to the right due to CBs ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，JAL 602，前方有 CB，请求向右机动 2 海里。

cards.audioText: B: During maneuver, an old lady fell in the cabin and was injured, she might be suffering from bone fracture, inform Wuhan Approach the situation and ask for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：机动过程中，一位老太太在客舱摔倒受伤，可能骨折，向武汉进近报告情况并请求优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL 602, an old lady fell in the cabin and was injured, she might be suffering from bone fracture, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，JAL 602，一位老太太在客舱摔倒受伤，可能骨折，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 602, roger, you are No. 1, expect radar vectors, do you require any medical assistance on arrival?
B: Tell the controller you need medical assistance and you will open the rear cabin door to deplane the sick passenger by a stretcher.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： JAL 602，收到，你是第 1 个，预计雷达引导。到达时是否需要医疗援助？
B： 告诉管制员你需要医疗援助，并将打开后舱门，用担架将患病旅客送下飞机。
cards.referenceText: request medical assistance, open the rear cabin door, deplane the sick passenger stretcher, JAL 602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求医疗援助，打开后舱门，用担架将患病旅客送下飞机，JAL 602。

topics.name: JAL 220 鸟击 积冰/防冰 乘客医疗

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is JAL 220, from Shanghai to Hongkong, you have intercepted an Urgency call from CCA 105, CCA 105 was transmitting blind due to receiver failure, he intended to request priority landing at Xiamen, relay the message to Xiamen Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 JAL 220，从上海飞往香港，你截收到 CCA 105 的紧急呼叫，CCA 105 因接收机故障正在盲发，意图请求在厦门优先着陆，将该信息转报给厦门进近。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Xiamen Approach, JAL 220, we have intercepted an Urgency call from CCA 105, CCA 105 was transmitting blind due to receiver failure, request priority landing at Xiamen.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，厦门进近，JAL 220，我们截收到 CCA 105 的紧急呼叫，CCA 105 因接收机故障正在盲发，请求在厦门优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 220, maintain present heading, maintain 9800 meters, contact Hongkong Center on 112.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：JAL 220，保持当前航向，保持 9800 米，联系香港管制112.5。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading, maintain 9800 meters, contact Hongkong Center on 112.5, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，保持 9800 米，联系香港管制112.5，JAL 220。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining FL320, you are over FISHA, your transponder code is 3062, make an initial contact with Hongkong Center.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持飞行高度层 320，飞越 FISHA，应答机代码 3062，首次联系香港管制。
cards.referenceText: Hongkong Center, JAL 220, maintaining FL320, over FISHA, squawking 3062.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，JAL 220，保持 FL320，飞越 FISHA，应答机 3062。

cards.audioText: Suddenly, you encountered foreign object ingestion, possibly bird ingestion, your starboard engine is overheating. You ask Hongkong Center for emergency descent to FL220 and radar vectors to Hongkong for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 突然，你遭遇外来物吸入，可能是鸟类吸入，右发动机过热。向香港管制请求紧急下降至 FL220，并请求雷达引导至香港优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Hongkong Center, JAL 220, we encountered foreign object ingestion, possibly bird ingestion, our starboard engine is overheating, request emergency descent to FL220 radar vector to Hongkong priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港管制，JAL 220，我们遭遇外来物吸入，可能是鸟类吸入，右发动机过热，请求紧急下降至 FL220，并请求雷达引导至香港优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 220, roger, FL220 is not available due to traffic, maintain FL320, turn right, direct to TD, contact Hongkong Approach on 123.8.
cards.audioTextZh: C: JAL 220，收到，由于交通原因，飞行高度层 220 不可用，保持飞行高度层 320，右转，直飞 TD，联系香港进近123.8。
cards.referenceText: Maintain FL320, turn right, direct to TD, 123.8, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 FL320，右转，直飞 TD，123.8，JAL 220。

cards.audioText: Now you are 5 miles south of TD VOR, state your situation to Hongkong Approach and ask for straight in ILS approach Runway 07L and priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 TD VOR 以南 5 英里，向香港进近说明情况，并请求直进 ILS 进近 Runway 07L 和优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Hongkong Approach, JAL 220, we encountered foreign object ingestion, possibly bird ingestion, request straight in ILS approach Runway 07L priority landing, position five miles south of T DAL VOR.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，JAL 220，我们遭遇外来物吸入，可能是鸟类吸入，请求直进 ILS 进近 Runway 07L 并优先着陆，位置在 T DAL VOR 以南 5 英里。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 220, Hongkong Approach, turn right heading 240 to intercept TD VOR 030 radial inbound, descend to FL110.
cards.audioTextZh: C: JAL 220，香港进近，右转航向 240，切入 TD VOR 030 径向线向台，下降到飞行高度层 110。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240 to intercept TD VOR 030 radial inbound, descend to FL110, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 TD VOR 030 径向线向台，下降到 FL110，JAL 220。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 220, when able, state persons on board.
B: Tell the controller the persons on board is 188, including 4 children.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 220，可以时报告机上人数。
B: 告诉管制员机上人数 188，包括 4 名儿童。
cards.referenceText: POB 188, including 4 children, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机上人数 188，包括 4 名儿童，JAL 220。

cards.audioText: JAL 220, cleared straight in ILS approach Runway 07L, you are no. 1 to land.
cards.audioTextZh: JAL 220，许可直进 ILS 进近 Runway 07L，你是第 1 个着陆。
cards.referenceText: cleared straight in ILS approach Runway 07L, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可直进 ILS 进近 Runway 07L，JAL 220。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 220, surface wind 090, 20 knots.
B: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to Runway 25.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 220，地面风 090，20 节。
B: 由于强顺风，你想改用跑道 25。
cards.referenceText: Hongkong Approach, JAL 220, request change to Runway 25 due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，JAL 220，由于强顺风，请求改用跑道 25。

cards.audioText: C: JAL 220, change to Runway 25 approved, maintain 6000 feet, turn right to TD, you are number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: JAL 220，批准改用跑道 25，保持 6000 英尺，右转至 TD，你是第 1 架。
cards.referenceText: Change to Runway 25 approved, maintain 6000 feet, turn right to TD, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准改用跑道 25，保持 6000 英尺，右转至 TD，JAL 220。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you find your APU has failed, tell the situation to Hongkong Ground and ask for ground power unit.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 着陆后，你发现 APU 失效，向香港地面说明情况并请求地面电源车。
cards.referenceText: Hongkong Ground, JAL 220, our APU has failed, request ground power unit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港地面，JAL 220，我们的 APU 失效，请求地面电源车。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 220, Hongkong Ground, roger, do you need any other service?
B: Tell the controller you need a tow truck to tow you to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 220，香港地面，收到，还需要其他服务吗？
B: 告诉管制员你需要拖车把你拖到停机坪。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request a tow truck to tow us to the apron, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求拖车把我们拖到停机坪，JAL 220。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 220, roger, do you need medical assistance at the ramp?
B: Tell the controller you need medical assistance at the ramp.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 220，收到，你在停机坪需要医疗援助吗？
B: 告诉管制员你在停机坪需要医疗援助。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request need medical assistance at the ramp, JAL 220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求在停机坪提供医疗援助，JAL 220。

cards.audioText: N: [Your callsign is JAL503, from Wuhan to Tokyo. You have completed the pushback procedure and your aircraft is on taxiway Z4. Call Wuhan Ground and get the approval to run the engine.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是日航503，从武汉飞往东京。你已经完成推出程序，你的飞机现在在滑行道Z4上，联系武汉地面，申请开车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, JAL503 on taxiway Z4, from Wuhan to Tokyo, request engine start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，日航503，在滑行道Z4上，从武汉飞往东京，请求开车。

cards.audioText: C: JAL503, start up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：日航503，可以开车。
cards.referenceText: Start up approved, JAL503.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以开车，日航503。

cards.audioText: N: [During engine startup, the engine starter has malfunctioned. Tell Wuhan Ground your situation and an extended delay for maintenance inspection.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【在开车过程中，发动机启动器故障，将此情况告知管制员，航班将延长延误时间以进行机务检查。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, JAL503, we have a malfunction with our engine starter, expect an extended delay for maintenance inspection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，日航503，我们的发动机启动器故障，预计延长延误时间进行机务检查。

cards.audioText:
C: JAl503, I cannot have you occupy Z4 for extended periods, advise you tow your aircraft back to the gate.
N: [Tell ATC you will comply and will ask for maintenance to tow your aircraft back to the Gate 237.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：日航503，我不能让你继续占据滑行道Z4，建议将你的飞机推回机位。
N：【告诉管制员你将照办，将请求机务人员将你的飞机拖回机坪237。】
cards.referenceText: Wilco, we will arrange for maintenance to tow us back to Gate 237, JAL503.
cards.referenceTextZh: 将照办，我们将安排机务把我们的飞机拖回237机位，日航503。

cards.audioText: C: JAL503, that Gate is now occupied, tell maintenance to tow your aircraft to 239.
cards.audioTextZh: C：日航503，该机位已被占用，告诉机务把你拖到239机位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, gate 239, JAL503.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，239机位，日航503。

cards.audioText: N: [After the replacement of the engine starter and maintenance release completed, you have finished startup and arrived at holding point of runway 36R. You want to ask for takeoff clearance. Call Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【在更换发动机启动器并完成维护检查后，您已完成开车，并抵达跑道36右等待点。您想要请求起飞许可。请呼叫武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, JAL503, holding point runway 36R, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，日航503，跑到36右外等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: C: JAL503, standby, runway 36R in the process of snow removal. Hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: C：日航503，稍等，跑道36右正在进行除雪。原地等待。
cards.referenceText: standby, hold at present position, JAL503.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，原地等待，日航503。

cards.audioText: N: [You are airborne and maintaining runway heading, passing 300m, climbing to 1800m. Make an initial contact with Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你起飞了，保持跑道航向，过300米，正上到1800米，与武汉离场建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, JAL503 airborne, maintaining runway heading, passing 300m climbing to 1800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，日航503，起飞了，保持跑道航向，过300米，正上到1800米。

cards.audioText: C: JAL503, noise abatement procedure in effect, climb to and maintain 3300m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：日航503，降噪程序生效，上3300米保持。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3300m, JAL503.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上3300米保持，日航503。

cards.audioText: N: [When you were over HG, a balloon was in your 12 o’clock position. You have just taken evasive actions. Report this situation to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【当你过HG后，在你12点钟方向有一个气球，你执行了避让动作，将此情况告知管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, JAL503, over HG, we encountered a balloon at our 12 o’clock, we took evasive action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，日航503，过HG，我们在12点钟方向遇到了一个气球，我们采取了避让动作。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL503, can you describe the balloon? Was any object clinging to the balloon?
N: [Tell the controller it is difficult to judge the size of the balloon, it is probably a parade balloon, there isn’t any object clinging to the balloon.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：日航503，你能描述一下那个气球的情况吗？气球上有没有附着什么东西？
N：【告知管制员很难判断气球的大小，它可能是游行用的气球，气球上没有附着任何物体。】
cards.referenceText: Difficult to judge the size, possibly a parade balloon, no objects clinging to it, JAL503.
cards.referenceTextZh: 很难判断气球的大小，它可能是游行用的气球，气球上没有附着任何物体，日航503。

cards.audioText: N: [Several hours later, you are flying at FL330 in Tokyo Control, squawking 3345. Make an initial contact with Tokyo Control for further instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【几小时后，你现在在高度层330飞行，在东京区调管制范围内，应答机3345，与东京区调建立初始联系，请求进一步指令。】
cards.referenceText: Tokyo Control, JAL503 at FL330, squawk 3345 ready for further instruction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 东京区调，日航503，高度层330，应答机3345，请求进一步指令。

cards.audioText: C: JAL503, Tokyo Control, radar identified, descend to and maintain FL250, expedite passing FL330.
cards.audioTextZh: C：日航503，东京区调，雷达看见了，下高度层250保持，加速过高度层330。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain FL250, expedite passing FL330, JAL503.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下高度层250保持，加速过高度层330，日航503。

cards.audioText: N: [When approaching to FL250, the visibility is becoming very poor. At the same time, air data instruments reading are becoming inaccurate. Report your situation to Tokyo Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【在接近高度层250时，能见度变得非常差。同时，大气数据仪表的读数也不再准确。请向东京区调报告的的情况。】
cards.referenceText: Tokyo Control, JAL503, experiencing poor visibility and inaccurate air data readings while approaching FL250.
cards.referenceTextZh: 东京区调，日航503，在接近高度层250时，能见度变得非常差，大气数据仪表的读数也不再准确。

cards.audioText:
C: JAL503, a new SIGMET issued indicate a volcano eruption. You may have entered vocalic ash band, turn left heading 270.
N: [You find your engines were vibrating fiercely, flame out occurred on both engines and your aircraft was descending in order to sustain flight. You tried to restart the engines, but only the left engine has been restarted. Make a distress call and request priority landing at Osaka Kansai International Airport.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：日航503，新的SIGMET报表明有火山爆发。您可能进入了火山灰带，请左转航向 270。
N：【您发现发动机抖震严重，两台发动机都熄火了，你的飞机开始下降以维持飞行。你试图重启发动机，但只有左侧发动机成功重启。做遇险通话，并请求优先降落到大阪关西国际机场。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Tokyo Control, JAL503, engines vibrating, flame out on both engines, descending for flight sustainment. Left engine restarted, request priority landing at Osaka Kansai International Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，东京区调，日航503，发动机抖震，双发熄火，下降来维持飞行，左发成功重启，请求优先降落到大阪关西国际机场。

cards.audioText: C: JAL503, roger, turn left heading 180, descend to and maintain FL150, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C；日航503，收到，左转航向180，下高度层150保持，到达后报。
cards.referenceText: Turn left to 180, descend to and maintain FL150, will report reaching, JAL503.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向180，下高度层150保持，到达后报，日航503。

cards.audioText: N: [You are not familiar with Osaka Kansai International Airport. Contact Osaka Approach and ask for radar guidance, you are at FL150.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你对大阪冠希机场不熟悉，联系大阪进近，请求雷达引导，你现在在高度层150。】
cards.referenceText: Osaka Approach, JAL503 at FL150, unfamiliar with Osaka Kansai, request radar guidance for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 大阪进近，日航503，高度层150，不熟悉关西机场，请求雷达引导着陆。

topics.name: JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-1
cards.audioText: [Your call sign is JAL220, from Tokyo to Wuhan, now you are cruising at 10400m, over OBLIK, you received an urgency call from CCA105, they encountered receiver failure and they are transmitting blind, inform this to Wuhan control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是日航220，从东京飞往武汉，现在你在10400米巡航，飞过OBLIK，你收到来自国航105的紧急呼叫，他们遭遇了接收机失效，现在正在盲发，告知武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Wuhan Control, JAL220, cruising level 10400m, over OBLIK, we received an urgency call from CCA105, they encountered receiver failure and they are transmitting blind, request emergency assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，武汉区调，日航220，在10400米巡航，飞过OBLIK，我们收到来自国航105的紧急呼叫，他们遭遇了接收机失效，现在正在盲发，申请紧急援助。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-2
cards.audioText: JAL220, roger, thanks, advise CCA105 to maintain heading and altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，收到，谢谢，告知国航105保持航向和高度。
cards.referenceText: Roger, advise CCA105 to maintain heading and altitude, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，告知国航105保持航向和高度，日航220。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-3
cards.audioText: JAL220, descend to and maintain 9200m, adjust speed less than 260 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，下9200米保持，调整速度不超过260节。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 9200m, adjust speed less than 260 knots, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下9200米保持，调整速度不超过260节，日航220。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-4
cards.audioText: JAL220, maintain present heading and descend to 5100m, contact Approach 112.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，保持当前航向，下到5100米，联系进近112.5。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading and descend to 5100m, contact 112.5, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，下到5100米，联系进近112.5，日航220。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-5
cards.audioText: [During the descend, a flock of birds struck your aircraft and your windshield was broken. The cabin crew reported that the oxygen masks in the cabin dropped automatically. You asked for radar vectors to Wuhan airport for priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在下降过程中，一群鸟撞到你的飞机，你的风挡玻璃破裂了。乘务员报告称，客舱的氧气面罩自动脱落。你请求雷达引导至武汉机场，进行优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Wuhan Approach, JAL220, we encountered bird strike during the descent. The windshield was broken. Request radar vectors and priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday，武汉进近，日航220，我们在下降过程中遭遇鸟击。风挡玻璃破裂。请求雷达引导，优先着陆。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-6
cards.audioText: JAL220, roger Mayday, descend to 5400m and contact Wuhan Approach on 115.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，收到Mayday，下降到5400米，联系武汉进近115.5。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5400m, contact Wuhan Approach on 115.5, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到5400米，联系武汉进近115.5，日航220。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-7
cards.audioText: Now you are 5 miles south of LKO, state your situation to Wuhan Approach and ask for ILS approach and priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，你在LKO以南5海里，向武汉进近陈述你的情况，请求ILS进近，优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL220, we encountered bird strike and our windshield was cracked, request ILS approach and priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，日航220，我们遭遇鸟击，风挡玻璃破裂，请求ILS进近，优先着陆。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-8
cards.audioText: JAL220, Wuhan Approach, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radio inbound, descend to 3300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，武汉进近，右转航向240，切LKO 030 无线电向台，下到3300米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, LKO 030 radio inbound, descend to 3300m, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，LKO 030 向台，下到3300米，日航220。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-9
cards.audioText:
JAL220, when able, state persons on board.
[Tell the controller the persons on board is 188, including 4 children.]
cards.audioTextZh:
日航220，可以的时候，报机上人数。
【告诉管制员，机上人数为188，包括4名儿童。】
cards.referenceText: The POB is 188, 4 children included, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机上人数为188，包括4名儿童，日航220。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-10
cards.audioText: JAL220, roger, turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH1015, expect runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，收到，右转直飞DA，下到2100米，修正海压1015，预计跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH1015, expect runway 36L. JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞DA，下到2100米，修正海压1015，预计跑道36左，日航220。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-11
cards.audioText: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于强顺风，你想变更到跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL220, request change to runway 36R due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，日航220，由于强顺风，请求变更到跑道36右。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-12
cards.audioText: JAL220, change to runway 36R is approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, you are number one.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，同意变更到跑道36右，在600米保持，右转飞至WHA，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, number one for landing, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，在600米保持，右转飞至WHA，第一个落地，日航220。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-13
cards.audioText: After landing, you find your APU has failed, tell this situation to Wuhan Tower and ask for Ground Power Unit.
cards.audioTextZh: 落地后，你发现你的APU失效了，将情况告知武汉塔台，请求地面电力设备。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, JAL220, request ground power unit due APU failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，由于APU失效，请求地面电力设备。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-14
cards.audioText:
JAL220, Wuhan Tower, roger, do you need any other services?
[Tell the controller you need a tow truck to tow you back to the apron.]
cards.audioTextZh:
日航220，武汉塔台，收到，你还需要别的服务吗？
【告知管制员，你需要一辆拖车将你拖回机坪。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request a tow truck, thanks, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求一辆拖车，谢谢，日航220。

cards.taskTitle: 9. JAL220 information relay, bird strike, APU failure-15
cards.audioText:
JAL220, roger, do you need medical help at the ramp?
[Tell the controller you need the medical help at the ramp.]
cards.audioTextZh:
日航220，收到，到达机坪需要医疗救援吗？
【告诉管制员，在机坪你需要医疗救援。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request medical help at the ramp, thanks, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，在机坪上请求医疗救援，谢谢，日航220。

cards.audioText: Your callsign is JAL602, from Tokyo to Wuhan, cruising at 10,100m, you have enter the Wuhan control areas, contact Wuhan control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是日航602，从东京飞往武汉，巡航在10100米，你进入武汉管制区域，联系武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan control, JAL602, 10,100m.

cards.audioText: You now have an indication about thunderstorm on your radar screen, 50km ahead of you. Request ATC clearance to offset 5 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你的雷达屏幕上显示前方50千米处有雷暴，请求管制许可，右偏5海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, request offset 5 miles to the right due thunderstorm..
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，日航602，由于雷暴，请求右偏5海里。

cards.audioText:
JAL602, offset 5 miles to the right is approved.
Later you find more thunderstorm ahead of you, request climb to 10,700m.
cards.audioTextZh:
日航602，同意右偏航5海里。
[之后，你发现前方有更多雷暴，请求爬升至10700米。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, request 10,700m due weather,
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，日航602，由于天气，申请10700米。

cards.audioText:
JAL602, negative, 10,700m is not available due military activity, can you accept 11,300m?
Tell ATC you cannot accept 11,300m due performance.
cards.audioTextZh:
日航602，不可以，由于军事活动，10700米不可用，你能接受11300米吗？
告诉管制员，由于性能，无法接受11300米。
cards.referenceText: Negative, unable 11,300m due performance, JAL602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，由于性能，无法接受11300米，日航602。

cards.audioText: JAL602, maintain 10,100m.
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 10,100m., JAL602.

cards.audioText: To avoid thunderstorm you request turn right heading 240, and maintain this heading for 50 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: 为了避开雷暴，你请求右转航向240，并在此航向上保持50海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, request turn right heading 240, and maintain this heading for 50 miles to avoid the weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，日航602，请求右转航向240，并在此航向上保持50海里来避开雷暴。

cards.audioText:
JAL602, negative, heading240 is not available due restricted area. Diversion to the left is available, say your intention.
Tell controller you want to turn left heading 080.
cards.audioTextZh:
日航602，不可以，由于限制区，航向240不可用。可以左偏航，说出你的意图。
[告诉管制员，你想左转航向080。]
cards.referenceText: Request turn left heading 080, JAL602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 申请左转航向080，日航602。

cards.audioText: JAL602, left heading 080 is approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航602，同意左转航向080。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 080, JAL602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向080，日航602。

cards.audioText:
JAL602, how much miles do you want to fly on this heading?
Tell the controller 50 miles is enough.
cards.audioTextZh:
日航602，你想在此航向飞多少海里？
告诉管制员，50海里足够了。
cards.referenceText: 50 miles, JAL602.

cards.audioText: Now you are clear of weather, contact Wuhan control and request direct to ZF and descend.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你脱离天气，联系武汉区调，请求直飞ZF并下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, clear of weather, request direct to ZF and descend.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，日航602，脱离天气，请求直飞ZF并下降。

cards.audioText: Now you see CBs in front of you, request maneuver 2 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，你在前方看到积雨云，请求向右机动2海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, request 2 miles maneuver to the right due CBs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，日航602，由于积雨云，请求向右机动2海里。

cards.audioText: During maneuver, an old lady fell in the cabin. She might be suffering from bone fracture. Inform the situation to the controller and request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 在机动飞行过程中，客舱有一名年长女士跌倒，她有可能骨折了，告知管制员情况，并请求优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, JAL602, an old lady fell in the cabin. She might be suffering from bone fracture. Request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，日航602，一名年长女士在客舱摔倒了，她有可能骨折了，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
JAL602 priority landing is approved. Expect radar vectors. Do you require medical assistance on arrival?
Tell the controller you need the medical assistance and you will open the right rear door to deplane the sick passenger by stretcher.
cards.audioTextZh:
日航602，可以优先着陆，预计雷达引导，在着陆后，你请求医疗援助吗？
告诉管制员，你需要医疗援助，你将打开右侧后门，并用担架将患病乘客抬下飞机。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request medical assistance, we will open the right rear door to deplane the sick passenger by stretcher, JAL602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求医疗援助，我们将打开右侧后门，并用担架将患病乘客抬下飞机，日航602。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is JAL220, from Tokyo to Wuhan, now you are cruising at 10400m, over OBLIK, you received an urgency call from CCA105, they encountered receiver failure and they are transmitting blind, inform this to Wuhan control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是日航220，从东京飞往武汉，现在你在10400米巡航，飞过OBLIK，你收到来自国航105的紧急呼叫，他们遭遇了接收机失效，现在正在盲发，告知武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Panpan Relay, Panpan Relay, Panpan Relay, Wuhan Control, JAL220, cruising level 10400m, over OBLIK, we received an urgency call from CCA105, they encountered receiver failure and they are transmitting blind, request emergency assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，武汉区调，日航220，在10400米巡航，飞过OBLIK，我们收到来自国航105的紧急呼叫，他们遭遇了接收机失效，现在正在盲发，申请紧急援助。

cards.audioText: JAL220, roger, thanks, advise CCA105 to maintain heading and altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，收到，谢谢，告知国航105保持航向和高度。
cards.referenceText: Roger, advise CCA105 to maintain heading and altitude, JAL220
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，告知国航105保持航向和高度，日航220。

cards.audioText: JAL220, descend to and maintain 9200m, adjust speed less than 260 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，下9200米保持，调整速度不超过260节。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 9200m, adjust speed less than 260 knots, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下9200米保持，调整速度不超过260节，日航220。

cards.audioText: JAL220, maintain present heading and descend to 5400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，保持当前航向，下到5400米。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading and descend to 5400m, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，下到5400米，日航220。

cards.audioText: During the descend, a flock of birds struck your aircraft and your windshield was broken. The cabin crew reported that the oxygen masks in the cabin dropped automatically. You asked for radar vectors to Wuhan airport for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 在下降过程中，一群鸟撞到你的飞机，你的风挡玻璃破裂了。乘务员报告称，客舱的氧气面罩自动脱落。你请求雷达引导至武汉机场，进行优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, JAL220, we encountered bird strike during the descent. The windshield was broken. Oxygen masks fell down in cabin, Request radar vectors and priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉区调，日航220，我们在下降过程中遭遇鸟击。风挡玻璃破裂。氧气面罩脱落，请求雷达引导，优先着陆。

cards.audioText: JAL220, roger Mayday, descend to 5100m and contact Wuhan Approach on 125.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，收到Mayday，下降到5100米，联系武汉进近125.5。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5100m, contact Wuhan Approach on 125.5, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到5100米，联系武汉进近125.5，日航220。

cards.audioText: Now you are 5 miles south of LKO, state your situation to Wuhan Approach and ask for ILS approach and priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，你在LKO以南5海里，向武汉进近陈述你的情况，请求ILS进近，优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL220, 5 miles south of LKO, we encountered bird strike and our windshield was cracked, request ILS approach and priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，日航220，在LKO以南5海里，我们遭遇鸟击，风挡玻璃破裂，请求ILS进近，优先着陆。

cards.audioText: JAL220, Wuhan Approach, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, descend to 3300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，武汉进近，右转航向240，切LKO 030 向台径向线，下到3300米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, descend to 3300m, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，正切LKO 030 向台，下到3300米，日航220。

cards.audioText:
JAL220, when able, state persons on board.
Tell the controller you the persons on board is 188, including 4 children.
cards.audioTextZh:
日航220，可以的时候，报机上人数。
告诉管制员，机上人数为188，包括4名儿童。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL220, the POB is 188, 4 children included.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，日航220，机上人数为188，包括4名儿童。

cards.audioText: JAL220, roger, turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH1015, expect runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，收到，右转直飞DA，下到2100米，修正海压1015，预计跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH1015, expect runway 36L. JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞DA，下到2100米，修正海压1015，预计跑道36左，日航220。

cards.audioText: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于强顺风，你想变更到跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, JAL220, request change to runway 36R due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，日航220，由于强顺风，请求变更到跑道36右。

cards.audioText: JAL220, change to runway 36R is approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, you are number one.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，同意变更到跑道36右，在600米保持，右转飞至WHA，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Change to runway 36R is approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, number one for landing, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意变更到跑道36右，在600米保持，右转飞至WHA，第一个落地，日航220。

cards.audioText: After landing, you find your APU has failed, tell this situation to Wuhan Tower and ask for Ground Power Unit.
cards.audioTextZh: 落地后，你发现你的APU失效了，将情况告知武汉塔台，请求GPU。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, JAL220, request ground power unit due APU failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，由于APU失效，请求GPU。

cards.audioText:
JAL220, Wuhan Tower, roger, do you need any other services?
Tell the controller you need a tow truck to tow you back to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh:
日航220，武汉塔台，收到，你还需要别的服务吗？
告知管制员，你需要一辆拖车将你拖回机坪。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request a tow truck, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求一辆拖车，日航220。

cards.audioText:
JAL220, roger, do you need medical help at the ramp?
Tell the controller you need the medical help at the ramp.
cards.audioTextZh:
日航220，收到，到达机坪需要医疗救援吗？
[告诉管制员，在机坪你需要医疗救援。]
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request medical help at the ramp, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，在机坪上请求医疗救援，日航220。

topics.name: ACA 219 询问天气 能见差复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 219, from Vancouver to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3555, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 219，从 Vancouver 到 Wuhan，保持 11000 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 3555，与 武汉管制 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 219, maintaining 11000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3555.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 219，保持 11000 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 3555。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, reduce speed to Mach 0.75 due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，由于流量控制，减速到马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to M.75, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减速到 M.75，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，下降到 9200 米，减速到 270 节以下，直到通知。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 9200 米，减速到 270 节以下，直到通知，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your TCAS indicates there is a converging traffic at your 2 o'clock, below, climbing, confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with you.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 下降过程中，你的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有交叉交通，在下方，正在爬升，向武汉管制确认是否与你冲突。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 219, our TCAS indicates there is a converging traffic at our 2 o'clock, below, climbing, is it in conflict with us?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 219，我们的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有交叉交通，在我们下方，正在爬升，是否与我们冲突？

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, negative, the aircraft is climbing to 8900 meters, it will cross behind your shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，否，该飞机正在爬升到 8900 米，很快将在你后方穿越。
cards.referenceText: Roger, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: You have just received the latest ATIS, saying the visibility at Wuhan is low, you want to know if your alternate airport Changsha is available for diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你刚收到最新 ATIS，说 Wuhan 能见度低，你想知道备降机场 Changsha 是否可用于改航。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 219, the latest ATIS says the visibility at Wuhan is low, is Changsha available for diversion?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 219，最新 ATIS 说 Wuhan 能见度低，Changsha 是否可用于改航？

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 219, Changsha Airport is available, confirm you are diverting to Changsha?
B: Tell the controller you are not diverting to Changsha at the moment, and you still want to fly to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 219，Changsha Airport 可用，确认你要改航 Changsha？
B: 告诉管制员目前不改航 Changsha，仍想飞往 Wuhan。
cards.referenceText: We won't divert at the moment, we still want to fly to Wuhan, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们目前不改航，仍想飞往 Wuhan，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, roger, track direct to ZF, follow ZF-2A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，收到，直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计跑道 36R ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to ZF, follow ZF-2A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计跑道 36R ILS 进近，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，下降并保持 4200 米，减速到最小光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，减速到最小光洁速度，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, contact Wuhan Tower 119.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，联系武汉塔台119.6。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on ILS approach Runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, established on ILS approach Runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 219，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, roger, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550 meters, midpoint 600 meters, rollout 500 meters, continue approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，收到，地面风静风，RVR 接地点 550 米，中段 600 米，停止端 500 米，继续进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue approach Runway 36R, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续进近跑道 36R，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud information.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你距接地点 10 海里，向武汉塔台询问云况信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, 10 miles from touchdown, request cloud information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 219，距接地点 10 海里，请求云况信息。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，疏云 700 米，可以着陆跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land Runway 36R, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 疏云 700 米，可以着陆跑道 36R，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: At the minimum, you are unable to see approach lights, you are carrying out a missed approach, advise Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 在最低标准高度，你看不到进近灯，正在执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText:
Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, we are unable to see approach lights at minimum, going around.
(no contact at the minimum)
cards.referenceTextZh:
武汉塔台，ACA 219，我们在最低标准高度看不到进近灯，复飞。
（最低标准高度无目视）

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，收到，执行标准复飞程序，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, inform Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正在爬升到复飞高度，决定改航 Changsha Airport，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, request divert to Changsha Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 219，请求改航 Changsha Airport。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, roger, turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，收到，右转，直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, contact Wuhan Departure on 120.4.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，联系 Wuhan Departure 120.4。

topics.name: ACA 331 有毒烟雾 有乘客昏迷

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 331, from Wuhan to Vancouver, push back and start up have been completed, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 331，从 Wuhan 到 Vancouver，推出和开车已完成，准备滑行，联系武汉地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 331, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 331，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway A7, A, Z4 and C.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，经滑行道 A7、A、Z4 和 C 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway A7, A, Z4 and C, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A7、A、Z4 和 C 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, follow Airbus 319 on M to holding point Runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，跟随 M 上的 Airbus 319 到跑道 18R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Follow A319 on M to holding point Runway 18R, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随 M 上的 A319 到跑道 18R 等待点，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, Runway 18R is closed due to disabled aircraft on the runway, change your ATC clearance to Runway 18L, ZF-12 departure, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，跑道 18R 因跑道上有故障航空器关闭，将你的 ATC 许可改为跑道 18L，ZF-12 离场，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: Roger, Runway 18L, ZF-12 departure, the rest unchanged, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 18L，ZF-12 离场，其余不变，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, enter Runway 18R from C3, vacate runway via C4, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，从 C3 进入跑道 18R，经 C4 脱离跑道，报告脱离。
cards.referenceText: Enter Runway 18R from C3, vacate runway via C4, report vacated, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从 C3 进入跑道 18R，经 C4 脱离跑道，报告脱离，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have exited the Runway 18R via C4, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已通过 C4 脱离跑道 18R，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 331, Runway 18R vacated via C4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 331，已通过 C4 脱离跑道 18R。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, continue taxi to holding point 18 left via taxiway M, A and A1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，继续经滑行道 M、A 和 A1 滑行至 18L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi to holding point 18L via taxiway M, A and A1, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续经滑行道 M、A 和 A1 滑行至 18L 等待点，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, climbing to 1800 meters, you see a helicopter ten o'clock above, it is closing to your aircraft, inform Wuhan Departure and request right turn to avoid the traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，爬升到 1800 米，看到一架直升机在 10 点钟方向上方，正接近你的飞机，通知 Wuhan Departure 并请求右转避让该交通。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA 331, airborne, climbing to 1800 meters, we see a helicopter 10 o'clock above, closing, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA 331，已离地，爬升到 1800 米，我们看到一架直升机在 10 点钟方向上方，正在接近，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2400 meters, maintain visual separation with the helicopter.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，右转航向 240，加快爬升到 2400 米，与直升机保持目视间隔。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2400 meters, maintain visual separation with the helicopter, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，加快爬升到 2400 米，与直升机保持目视间隔，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, after traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb and maintain 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，交通解除后，直飞 ZF，恢复自主导航，爬升并保持 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: After traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb and maintain 5100 meters, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 交通解除后，直飞 ZF，恢复自主导航，爬升并保持 5100 米，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9500 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 5655, contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你保持 9500 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 5655，联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, maintaining 9500 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA 331，保持 9500 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 5655。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，郑州管制，雷达识别，爬升并保持 10100 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 10100 meters, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 10100 米，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, your cabin crew report there are toxic fumes in rear cabin, you decided to expedite descent for smoke removal, make a Distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 突然，客舱乘务员报告后客舱有有毒烟雾，你决定为排烟加快下降，向郑州管制发出遇险呼叫并请求在 3000 米改平。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, the cabin crew report there are toxic fumes in rear cabin, request expedite descent to 3000 meters for smoke removal.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州管制，ACA 331，客舱乘务员报告后客舱有有毒烟雾，请求加快下降到 3000 米以排烟。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1008, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 030，按 QNH 1008 下降到 3000 米，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1008, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，按 QNH 1008 下降到 3000 米，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: B: After cabin check, tell Zhengzhou Control the toxic fume might be caused by dangerous goods leaking in the cargo hold.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 客舱检查后，告诉 郑州管制，有毒烟雾可能由货舱危险品泄漏引起。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, the toxic fume might be caused by dangerous goods leaking in the cargo hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA 331，有毒烟雾可能由货舱危险品泄漏引起。

cards.audioText: B: Several passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume and become unconscious, tell Zhengzhou Control the situation and request diversion to Zhengzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 数名旅客受到有毒烟雾严重影响并失去意识，向郑州管制说明情况并请求改航 Zhengzhou。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, several passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume and become unconscious, request divert to Zhengzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA 331，数名旅客受到有毒烟雾严重影响并失去意识，请求改航 Zhengzhou。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, Zhengzhou Control, roger, turn left heading 360, contact Zhengzhou Approach 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，郑州管制，收到，左转航向 360，联系郑州进近120.35。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 360, 120.35, ACA 331.

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, Zhengzhou Approach, radar contact, track direct to CGO, descend to 3000 meters, expect radar vector ILS Runway 12.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，郑州进近，雷达识别，直飞 CGO，下降到 3000 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 12。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to CGO, descend to 3000 meters, expect radar vector ILS Runway 12, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 CGO，下降到 3000 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 12，ACA 331。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 331, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell Zhengzhou Approach you need an ambulance and dangerous goods specialists.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 331，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉 郑州进近 你需要救护车和危险品专家。
cards.referenceText: Request an ambulance and dangerous goods specialists, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求救护车和危险品专家，ACA 331。

topics.name: ACA 909 女客心脏病 听不到通播

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 909, your destination is Beijing, and you are leaving 1200 meters and say good-bye to Wuhan Tower, contact Wuhan Approach and request to climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 909，目的地 Beijing，正在离开 1200 米，并向武汉塔台告别，联系武汉进近并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 909, leaving 1200 meters, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 909，离开 1200 米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, Wuhan Approach, good morning, radar contact, follow ZF-1D departure, climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1013.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，武汉进近，早上好，雷达识别，执行 ZF-1D 离场，按 QNH 1013 爬升到 1800 米。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-1D departure, climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1013, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-1D 离场，按 QNH 1013 爬升到 1800 米，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: B: You just reached 1800 meters and you got some moderate chop at the level, inform the controller about that and request 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你刚到达 1800 米，在该高度遇到中度颠簸，通知管制员并请求 4500 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 909, maintaining 1800 meters, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request 4500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 909，保持 1800 米，我们遇到中度颠簸，请求 4500 米。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 909, Approach, unable to approve 4500 meters due traffic, 3900 meters available.
B: Tell the controller that you want to climb to 3900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 909，进近，由于交通原因不能批准 4500 米，3900 米可用。
B: 告诉管制员你想爬升到 3900 米。
cards.referenceText: We accept 3900 meters, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们接受 3900 米，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that the weather radar shows a cumulonimbus on route ahead about 30 Kilometers, and your level is 3900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员气象雷达显示航路前方约 30 公里有积雨云，你的高度是 3900 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 909, maintaining 3900 meters, the weather radar shows a CB ahead of us, about 30 km.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 909，保持 3900 米，气象雷达显示我们前方有 CB，约 30 公里。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, ACA 909, report your intentions.
B: Tell the controller that you want radar guidance to go round the CB.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，ACA 909，报告你的意图。
B: 告诉管制员你需要雷达引导绕飞 CB。
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to circumnavigate the CB, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导绕飞 CB，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, turn left heading 300.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，左转航向 300。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 300, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 300，ACA 909。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 909, now you are cleared of the CB, climb to 4500 meters, turn right heading 030 to rejoin the ZF-1D departure.
B: Acknowledge the controller's instruction and tell him you want to fly to ZF directly from present position.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 909，现在你已脱离 CB，爬升到 4500 米，右转航向 030 重新加入 ZF-1D 离场。
B: 确认管制员指令，并告诉他你想从当前位置直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Roger, climb to 4500 meters, request direct to ZF, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，爬升到 4500 米，请求直飞 ZF，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, cleared direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，可以直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Cleared direct to ZF, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以直飞 ZF，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, maintain 4500 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，保持 4500 米，联系武汉管制118.1。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4500 meters, 118.1, ACA 909.

cards.audioText: B: You are just over ZF, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你刚过 ZF，与 武汉管制 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 909, maintain 4500 meters, over ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 909，保持 4500 米，过 ZF。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升到 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 8900 meters, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 8900 米，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: B: A flight attendant told you that there is a male passenger suffering a heart attack, inform the controller about that and tell him you want to go back to Wuhan. This is an Urgent call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 一名乘务员告诉你有一名男性旅客心脏病发作，通知管制员，并告诉他你想返回 Wuhan。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA 909, We have a male passenger suffering heart attack, request direct back to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA 909，我们有一名男性旅客心脏病发作，请求直飞返回 Wuhan。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, Wuhan Control, roger PAN PAN, turn right direct to ZF, and descend to 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，武汉管制，收到 PANPAN，右转直飞 ZF，下降到 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to ZF, descend to 4200 meters, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 ZF，下降到 4200 米，ACA 909。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 909, do you need any medical assistance?
B: Tell the controller that you need a physician and an ambulance upon landing or after landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 909，你们需要医疗援助吗？
B: 告诉管制员你们着陆时或着陆后需要医生和救护车。
cards.referenceText: We need a physician and an ambulance upon arrival, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们到达时需要医生和救护车，ACA 909。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, an ambulance and a physician will be ready.
C: ACA 909, Wuhan Control, maintain 4200 meters, contact Approach on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，救护车和医生会准备好。
C: ACA 909，武汉管制，保持 4200 米，联系 进近 118.9。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4200 meters, 118.9, ACA 909.

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Approach that you have a passenger suffering heart attack and request landing priority.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知 武汉进近 你有一名旅客心脏病发作，并请求着陆优先。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 909, we have a passenger suffering heart attack, request priority for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 909，我们有一名旅客心脏病发作，请求着陆优先。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 909, Wuhan Approach, roger, radar contact, follow ZF-1A arrival and descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1013, information D is valid.
B: Read back the controller's instruction and ask the detail of Information D, because you could not receive the Information on the radio.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 909，武汉进近，收到，雷达识别，执行 ZF-1A 进场，按 QNH 1013 下降到 1800 米，信息 D 有效。
B: 复诵管制员指令，并询问信息 D 的详情，因为你无法通过无线电接收该信息。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-1A arrival, descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1013, can you repeat the ATIS? We are unable to pick it up on the radio.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-1A 进场，按 QNH 1013 下降到 1800 米，请重复 ATIS？无线电无法收到。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 909, Approach, surface wind 350 degrees at 3 meters per second, visibility 8 Kilometers, ILS approach runway in use 36R, QNH 1013 hectopascal.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 909，进近，地面风 350 度 3 米/秒，能见度 8 公里，使用跑道 36R ILS 进近，QNH 1013 百帕。
cards.referenceText: ILS approach Runway 36R, QNH 1013 hpa, ACA 909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R ILS 进近，QNH 1013 hpa，ACA 909。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you want to land at the Runway 18L visually to save time.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你想目视降落跑道 18L 以节省时间。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 909, request to make a visual approach for Runway 18L to save time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 909，请求目视进近跑道 18L 以节省时间。

topics.name: ACA 452 偷渡犯 导航，自驾失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 452, you are at stand 203, from Wuhan to Tokyo, you just got informed an illegal stowaway on board, and he must be taken away by police, contact Wuhan Ground to delay the push back.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 452，在 203 号机位，从 Wuhan 到 Tokyo，刚得知机上有非法偷渡者，必须由警方带走，联系武汉地面请求延迟推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 452, stand 203, request delay the push back due an illegal stowaway must be taken away by police.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 452，203 号机位，由于一名非法偷渡者必须由警方带走，请求延迟推出。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, report POB when ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，准备推出和开车时报告机上人数。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: Now tell the Ground controller you are ready for push back and start up, POB 235.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在告诉地面管制员你准备推出和开车，机上人数 235。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 452, request push back and start up, POB235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 452，请求推出和开车，机上人数 235。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，推出和开车批准，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝西，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi, the visibility is getting worse due to dust storm, tell the controller you will hold position until visibility gets better.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 滑行期间，由于沙尘暴能见度变差，告诉管制员你将原地等待，直到能见度好转。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 452, the visibility is getting worse due to dust storm, request hold position until visibility gets better.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 452，由于沙尘暴能见度变差，请求原地等待，直到能见度好转。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, the visibility now is 1000 meters, continue taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway Z4 and C, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，现在能见度 1000 米，继续经滑行道 Z4 和 C 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点，联系武汉塔台124.35。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway Z4 and C, 124.35, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经滑行道 Z4 和 C 滑行至跑道 18R 等待点，124.35，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 18R, tell the Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 18R 等待点，告诉塔台你准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 452, holding point Runway 18R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 452，跑道 18R 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, when airborne, contact 119.35, follow the abatement procedure, cleared for takeoff Runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，离地后联系 119.35，执行减噪程序，跑道 18R 可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, contact 119.35, follow the abatement procedure, cleared for takeoff Runway 18R, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后联系 119.35，执行减噪程序，跑道 18R 可以起飞，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: During takeoff climbing, you encountered wake turbulence from the preceding aircraft, contact Wuhan Departure to turn right to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 起飞爬升期间，你遭遇前机尾流，联系 Wuhan Departure 请求右转避让。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA 452, we encountered wake turbulence from the preceding aircraft, request turn right to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA 452，我们遭遇前机尾流，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, Wuhan Departure, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 3300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，Wuhan Departure，右转，直飞 ZF，爬升并保持 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 3300 meters, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，爬升并保持 3300 米，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: You are levelling at 10700 meters, your onboard navigation computers failed, you are flying with raw data, inform Wuhan Control the situation and request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你正在 10700 米改平，机载导航计算机失效，正在用原始数据飞行，向武汉管制说明情况并请求雷达引导。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, levelling at 10700 meters, our onboard navigation computers failed, we are flying with raw data, request radar vectors.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，正在 10700 米改平，我们的机载导航计算机失效，正在用原始数据飞行，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 452, what's the situation like on board?
B: Tell the controller you need 1 minute to perform the checklist and will advise.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 452，机上情况如何？
B: 告诉管制员你需要 1 分钟执行检查单，稍后通知。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, we need 1 minute to perform the checklist and will advise.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，我们需要 1 分钟执行检查单，稍后通知。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, maintain present level, turn left heading 010, keep informed if you can't maintain RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，保持当前高度，左转航向 010，如不能保持 RVSM，请随时告知。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, turn left heading 010, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，左转航向 010，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: After finishing the checklist, the malfunction can't be solved and your autopilot failed, you are unable RVSM due equipment, inform Wuhan Control your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 完成检查单后，故障无法解决，自动驾驶失效，由于设备原因无法 RVSM，向武汉管制通报情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, the malfunction can't be solved and our autopilot failed, unable RVSM due equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，故障无法解决，我们的自动驾驶失效，由于设备原因无法 RVSM。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, turn right heading 040, descend to 8100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，右转航向 040，下降到 8100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 040, descend to 8100 meters, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 040，下降到 8100 米，ACA 452。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 452, when able, advise your intention.
