B: Tell the control you will maintain 8100 meters and divert to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 452，可以时报告意图。
B: 告诉管制你将保持 8100 米并改航 Beijing。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, request maintain 8100 meters and divert to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，请求保持 8100 米并改航 Beijing。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, roger, contact Zhengzhou Control 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，收到，联系郑州管制119.35。

topics.name: ACA 517 左发失效 复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 517, you are maintaining 10100 meters, approaching DAPRO, squawking 3215, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 517，保持 10100 米，接近 DAPRO，应答机 3215，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 517, maintaining 10100 meters, approaching DAPRO, squawking 3215.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 517，保持 10100 米，接近 DAPRO，应答机 3215。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, Wuhan Control, radar identified, omit position reports.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，武汉管制，雷达识别，省略位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Omit position reports, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 省略位置报告，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: B: There is moderate turbulence at 10100 meters, ask Wuhan Control if there is any turbulence reported at 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 10100 米有中度颠簸，询问 武汉管制 10700 米是否有颠簸报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 517, there is moderate turbulence at 10100 meters, is there any turbulence reported at 10700 meters?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 517，10100 米有中度颠簸，10700 米是否有颠簸报告？

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 517, there is no turbulence report at 10700 meters
B: Ask to climb to 10700 meters due moderate turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 517，10700 米没有颠簸报告。
B: 因中度颠簸请求爬升到 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 10700 meters due moderate turbulence, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因中度颠簸请求爬升到 10700 米，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, climb to reach 10700 meters within 2 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，爬升并在 2 分钟内到达 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to reach 1 10700 meters within 2 minutes, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并在 2 分钟内到达 10700 米，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: B: When you are at 10700 meters, your left engine failed, make an Urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 当你在 10700 米时，左发失效，发出紧急呼叫并请求右转下降到 6300 米。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA 517, our left engine failed, request turn right and descend to 6300 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA 517，我们左发失效，请求右转并下降到 6300 米。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，右转航向 200，下降并保持 6300 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300 meters, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 200，下降并保持 6300 米，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: B: Advise Wuhan Control you want to divert to Wuhan and track direct to WHA and descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知 武汉管制 你想改航 Wuhan，直飞 WHA 并下降到较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 517, request divert to Wuhan and track direct to WHA and descend to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 517，请求改航 Wuhan，直飞 WHA，并下降到较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, turn left, direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，左转，直飞 WHA，下降并保持 2100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100 meters, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 WHA，下降并保持 2100 米，ACA 517。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 517, expect radar vector for VOR DME approach 36 right.
B: The weather is deteriorating and below landing minimum, ask for ILS approach 36 left.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 517，预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近 36R。
B: 天气恶化并低于着陆最低标准，请求 ILS 进近 36L。
cards.referenceText: Expect radar vector for VOR DME approach 36R, request ILS approach 36L due deteriorating weather and below landing minimum, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计雷达引导 VOR DME 进近 36R，因天气恶化并低于着陆最低标准，请求 ILS 进近 36L，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, Runway 36L is not available, runway in use 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，跑道 36L 不可用，使用跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Roger, runway in use 36R, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，使用跑道 36R，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, you are number 1 to land, there are no speed restrictions in Wuhan terminal area.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，你是第 1 架着陆，Wuhan 终端区无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: No speed restrictions, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 无速度限制，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: B: You executed a missed approach procedure and try to land on Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你执行复飞程序，并尝试在跑道 36R 着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 517, going around, we will try to land on Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 517，复飞，我们将尝试在跑道 36R 着陆。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, climb to 1200 meters, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，爬升到 1200 米，执行标准复飞程序。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 1200 meters, follow the standard missed approach procedure, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 1200 米，执行标准复飞程序，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, maintain 1200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，保持 1200 米，预计雷达引导跑道 36R ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 1200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 1200 米，预计雷达引导跑道 36R ILS 进近，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, runway covered with patches of water, braking action medium.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，跑道有片状积水，刹车效应中等。
cards.referenceText: runway covered with patches of water, breaking action medium, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道有片状积水，刹车效应中等，ACA 517。

topics.name: ACA 521 滑行道障碍 机长心脏病

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 521, a flight from Wuhan to Toronto, you are at gate 232, you have got the latest ATIS T, contact Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 521，从 Wuhan 到 Toronto，位于 232 号登机口，已收到最新 ATIS T，联系武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, ACA 521, gate 232, information T, request ATC clearance to Toronto.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，ACA 521，232 号登机口，信息 T，请求前往 Toronto 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb to 1500 meters, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，可以按计划航路前往 Toronto，离场跑道 04，初始爬升到 1500 米，ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，途中请求高度变更，离场频率 125.75，应答机 5655。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb to 1500 meters, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Toronto，离场跑道 04，初始爬升到 1500 米，ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，途中请求高度变更，离场频率 125.75，应答机 5655，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成推出和开车，准备滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 521, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 521，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 E5 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 E5 前等待，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you see there is an obstruction ahead of you on taxiway A3, you confirm the taxi instructions with Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你看到前方滑行道 A3 上有障碍物，向武汉地面确认滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 521, there is an obstruction ahead of us on A3, confirm the taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 521，A3 上我们前方有障碍物，请确认滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, hold at present position, the ground handling will deal with it.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，原地等待，地面保障会处理。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, the obstruction has been removed, continue taxi via A3, A to holding point Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，障碍物已移除，继续经 A3、A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via A3, A to holding point Runway 04, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 A3、A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point E5 Runway 04, you are fully ready, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 04 E5 等待点等待，完全准备好，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 521, holding at holding point E5 Runway 04, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 521，在跑道 04 E5 等待点等待，完全准备好。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, line up and cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, surface wind 030 degrees, 8 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，进跑道并立即起飞，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，地面风 030 度 8 节。
cards.referenceText: Line up and cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道并立即起飞，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, you are passing 1200 meters, climbing to 2400 meters, make an initial contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，正通过 1200 米，爬升到 2400 米，与 Wuhan Departure 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA 521, passing 1200 meters, climbing to 2400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA 521，通过 1200 米，爬升到 2400 米。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, radar contact, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，雷达识别，右转，直飞 ZF，爬升到 4500 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, climb to 4500 meters, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，爬升到 4500 米，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Your TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300 meters above your level, confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有冲突交通，在你高度上方 300 米，向武汉管制确认是否与你的飞机冲突。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 521, our TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300 meters above our level, is it in conflict with us?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 521，我们的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有冲突交通，在我们高度上方 300 米，是否与我们冲突？

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, negative, it is parallel to your flight track.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，否，它与你的航迹平行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: During cruise, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, make an Urgency call to Wuhan Control and request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 巡航期间，机长突然心脏病发作，向武汉管制发出紧急呼叫并请求立即返航优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA 521, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA 521，机长突然心脏病发作，请求立即返航优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, roger PAN PAN, turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300 meters, you are number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，收到 PANPAN，左转航向 220，直飞 ZF，下降到 3300 米，你是第 1 架。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300 meters, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，直飞 ZF，下降到 3300 米，ACA 521。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 521, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need an ambulance and a physician.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 521，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要救护车和医生。
cards.referenceText: Request an ambulance and a physician, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求救护车和医生，ACA 521。

topics.name: ACA 412 请求绕飞 左发进水熄火

cards.audioText: B: You are over TOG at 35, FL210, you want to descend to FL170, report to Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你在 TOG 上空 35，飞行高度层 210，想下降到飞行高度层 170，向广州管制报告。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA 412, over TOG at 35, FL210, request descend to FL170.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA 412，在 TOG 上空 35，FL210，请求下降到 FL170。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 412, can you make FL190 by TUX?
B: You want FL170 because the turbulence is likely to get worse further along the route.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 412，你能在 TUX 前达到飞行高度层 190 吗？
B: 你想要飞行高度层 170，因为航路前方乱流可能会加重。
cards.referenceText: That can't be sure, the turbulence is likely to get worse further along the route, FL170 is preferable, ACA 412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 无法确定，航路前方乱流可能会加重，FL170 更合适，ACA 412。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 412, we have to coordinate.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 412，我们必须协调。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, ACA 412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，ACA 412。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 412, your request to TUX FL170 has been approved, at the same time, remain on 215 radial GIL VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 412，你到 TUX 飞行高度层 170 的请求已获批准，同时保持在 GIL VOR 215 径向线上。
cards.referenceText: Cross TUX FL170, remain on 215 radial GIL VOR, ACA 412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 TUX 时 FL170，保持在 GIL VOR 215 径向线上，ACA 412。

cards.audioText: B: You want to put off the descent, call Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你想推迟下降，呼叫管制。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA 412, request to delay the descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA 412，请求延迟下降。

cards.audioText:
C: Descend immediately due traffic.
B: You tell the controller that you will run into CBs if you descend right now.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 因活动立即下降。
B: 告诉管制员如果现在下降，你们会进入 CB。
cards.referenceText: The thunderstorm will be encountered if we decide right now, ACA 412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我们现在下降，会遭遇雷暴，ACA 412。

cards.audioText: C: Turn right heading 120 to detour the CBs.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 右转航向 120 绕飞 CB。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 120, ACA 412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 120，ACA 412。

cards.audioText: B: You tell the controller that you will check out more than 30 miles if you go round the CBs from the right. You ask the permission of a left sight.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员，如果从右侧绕飞 CB，会偏出超过 30 miles。你请求从左侧绕飞许可。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA 412, if we go around the CBs from the right, we have to track out more than 30 miles. How about the left side turning?
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA 412，如果我们从右侧绕飞 CB，必须偏出超过 30 miles。能否从左侧转弯？

cards.audioText:
C: There is only 15 miles for you to go if you want to detour from the left due restricted area.
B: You need 20 miles.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 由于限制区，如果你想从左侧绕飞，只有 15 miles 可用。
B: 你需要 20 miles。
cards.referenceText: I need at least 20 miles on the left side, 15 miles is not enough, ACA 412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左侧我至少需要 20 miles，15 miles 不够，ACA 412。

cards.audioText: C: I will contact with the military, standby.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 我会联系军方，等待。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, thank you, ACA 412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，谢谢，ACA 412。

cards.audioText:
C: No reply from the military, what do you prefer?
B: You intend to go round the CBs from the left.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 军方没有回复，你更倾向哪种？
B: 你打算从左侧绕飞 CB。
cards.referenceText: We would like to circumnavigate the thunderstorm from the left, ACA 412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们希望从左侧绕飞雷暴，ACA 412。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 412, cleared to detour the thunderstorm from the left.
B: You ran into severe turbulence in CBs, some persons injured.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 412，许可从左侧绕飞雷暴。
B: 你进入 CB 遭遇严重乱流，有人受伤。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA 412, we have encountered the CBs with severe turbulence, some persons injured.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA 412，我们遭遇 CB 和严重乱流，有人受伤。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 412, what's your intention?
B: You want priority landing and medical assistance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 412，你的意图是什么？
B: 你想优先落地并需要医疗协助。
cards.referenceText: Request priority landing and medical assistance, ACA 412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求优先落地和医疗协助，ACA 412。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 412, emergency services will be notified. Ambulance will be there waiting for you.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 412，将通知应急服务。救护车会在那里等你。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, ACA 412.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，ACA 412。

cards.audioText: B: Declare Urgency due to port inboard engine flamed out resulting from water ingestion, you are suffering a steep left turn.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 因吸水导致左内侧发动机熄火宣布紧急状态，你们正经历急剧左转。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA 412, port inboard engine flamed out resulting from water ingestion, we are suffering a steep left turn.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，广州管制，ACA 412，左内侧发动机因吸水熄火，我们正在急剧左转。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 412, roger PAN, report your intention if available.
B: You want emergency landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 412，收到 PAN，如可能报告你的意图。
B: 你想紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA 412, request emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，ACA 412，请求紧急着陆。

topics.name: ACA 123 装载问题 右发漏油

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 123. The aircraft is parking on the apron and you are ready for ATC clearance. Now contact Delivery for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 123。飞机停在机坪，你已准备好取得 ATC 许可。现在联系放行申请 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Delivery, ACA 123, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 放行，ACA 123，请求 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 123, you are cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, cruise level 10200 meters, D06 departure, squawk 2315.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 123，许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，巡航高度 10200 meters，D06 离场，squawk 2315。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, cruise level 10200 meters, D06 departure, squawk 2315, ACA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往北京，巡航高度 10200 meters，D06 离场，squawk 2315，ACA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You tell the controller that the original flight direct to Beijing has been revised.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员原直飞北京的航班已被修改。
cards.referenceText: Delivery, ACA 123, I have been told that the flight to Beijing has been revised.
cards.referenceTextZh: 放行，ACA 123，我被告知飞往北京的航班已修改。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 123, I am sorry, I have not got your latest flight plan. Hold on, I will call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 123，抱歉，我还没有收到你的最新飞行计划。稍等，我会再呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Roger, ACA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，ACA 123。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, your flight plan has been amended, you’ll divert to COG to pick up some cargo and transit passengers, is that right?
B: Tell the controller Yes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，你的飞行计划已修改，你将改航到 COG 接载一些货物和中转旅客，是这样吗？
B: 告诉管制员是。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, that is correct, ACA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，正确，ACA 123。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, have you received departure information?
B: You have got information K, but you don’t know the present information code. You ask about it.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，你收到离场信息了吗？
B: 你已收到信息 K，但不知道当前信息代码。你询问。
cards.referenceText: We have received Information K. What is the current information? ACA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们已收到信息 K。当前信息是什么？ACA 123。

cards.audioText:
C: Information K is not valid, Information L is current.
B: Tell the controller you are going to write down the present ATIS.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 信息 K 已失效，当前为信息 L。
B: 告诉管制员你将抄收当前 ATIS。
cards.referenceText: Thank you. We are going to copy the information data right away, ACA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 谢谢。我们马上抄收信息数据，ACA 123。

cards.audioText: B: Contact the Ground controller and tell him you have to delay the departure for about 10 minutes, the moving jet-way to the satellite is not working properly.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系地面管制员，告诉他你们必须延误离场约 10 分钟，通往卫星厅的自动步道工作不正常。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, the moving walkway to our satellite has some problem. We have to delay our departure for about 10 minutes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，我们卫星厅的自动步道有问题。我们必须延误离场约 10 分钟。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, you would expect a delay of 1 hour if you don’t make this slot.
B: Tell the controller that the moving walkway has been fixed. All the passengers will be on the aircraft in a few minutes, but the luggage loading is too slow due an old fashioned loader, you request the controller to inform the ground handling and send a new loader as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，如果你赶不上这个时刻，预计会延误 1 小时。
B: 告诉管制员自动步道已经修好。所有旅客几分钟内会上机，但由于一台老式装载机，行李装载太慢，你请求管制员通知地服并尽快派一台新装载机。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, the moving jet-way has been fixed. All the passengers will finish boarding in a couple of minutes, but luggage loading has not been completed due to a slow-moving loader. Please inform the ground handling to send another one as quickly as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，自动步道已经修好。所有旅客几分钟内完成登机，但由于装载机移动慢，行李装载尚未完成，请通知地服尽快再派一台。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, I am sorry, there is no loader on hand now.
B: You would like to know if you would be delayed for an hour.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，抱歉，现在没有可用装载机。
B: 你想知道是否会延误 1 小时。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, do you mean that we will have a delay of an hour if we don't depart on time?
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，你的意思是如果我们不能准时离场，就会延误 1 小时吗？

cards.audioText:
C: Affirm. My apologies, there is no spare loader at the moment.
B: Contact the Ground controller and tell him that you are ready for engine start up
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 肯定。抱歉，目前没有备用装载机。
B: 联系地面管制员，告诉他你已准备好开车。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, ready for start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，准备好开车。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, startup approved.
B: You tell the controller that the ground mechanic has found that No.1 engine is leaking fuel.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，批准开车。
B: 告诉管制员地面机务发现 1 号发动机漏油。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, the ground mechanic has found that No.1 engine is leaking.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，地面机务发现 1 号发动机漏油。

cards.audioText:
C: Is the leakage serious? What is your intention?
B: You tell the controller that the starboard engine fuel line has been leaking slightly. You are not certain if you can continue the flight. You will contact with the company dispatcher.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 漏油严重吗？你的意图是什么？
B: 告诉管制员右发燃油管路轻微泄漏。你不确定是否能继续飞行。你将联系公司签派。
cards.referenceText: The starboard engine fuel line has been leaking slightly. I’m not sure if our flight will continue or not. I’ll consult with our company dispatcher, ACA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右发燃油管路轻微泄漏。我不确定我们的航班是否会继续。我会咨询公司签派，ACA 123。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 123, your clearance will expire then, I’ll give you a new slot when you are ready.
B: You tell the controller that your flight has to be cancelled.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 123，你的许可届时会过期，准备好后我会给你新的时刻。
B: 告诉管制员你的航班必须取消。
cards.referenceText: Ground, ACA 123, we have to cancel our flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，ACA 123，我们必须取消航班。

topics.name: ACA 331 烟雾 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 331, from Wuhan to Vancouver, push back and start up have been completed, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 331，从 Wuhan 到 Vancouver，推出和开车已完成，准备滑行，联系武汉地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 331, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 331，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: ACA 331, taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway A7, A, Z4 and C.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 331，经 A7、A、Z4 和 C 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway A seven, A, Z four and C, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A7、A、Z4 和 C 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18R 等待点，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: ACA 331, follow Airbus 319 on M to holding point Runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 331，跟随 M 上的 Airbus 319 前往 Runway 18R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: follow Airbus 319 on M to holding point Runway 18R, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随 M 上的 Airbus 319 前往 Runway 18R 等待点，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: ACA 331, Runway 18R is closed due to disabled aircraft on the runway, change your ATC clearance to Runway 18L, ZF-12 departure, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 331，因 Runway 18R 上有故障航空器，该跑道已关闭，将你的 ATC 放行许可更改为 Runway 18L、ZF-12 离场，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: roger, Runway 18L, ZF-12 departure, the rest unchanged, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，Runway 18L，ZF-12 离场，其余不变，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: ACA 331, enter Runway 18R from C3, vacate runway via C4, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 331，从 C3 进入 Runway 18R，经 C4 脱离跑道，脱离后报告。
cards.referenceText: enter Runway 18R from C tree, vacate runway via C four, report vacated, 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从 C3 进入 Runway 18R，经 C4 脱离跑道，脱离后报告，331。

cards.audioText: now you have exited the Runway 18R via C4, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已从 C4 脱离 Runway 18R，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 331, Runway 18R vacated via C4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 331，已从 C4 脱离 Runway 18R。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, continue taxi to holding point 18 left via taxiway M, A and A1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，继续经滑行道 M、A 和 A1 滑行至 18L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi to holding point 18L via taxiway M, A and A1, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续经滑行道 M、A 和 A1 滑行至 18L 等待点，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: now you are airborne, climbing to 1,800 meters, you see a helicopter 10 o' clock above, it is closing to your aircraft, inform Wuhan Departure and request right turn to avoid the traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，正爬升至 1,800 米，看到一架直升机位于 10 点钟上方，正在接近你的航空器，通知武汉离场并请求右转避让。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA 331, airborne, climbing to 1,800 meters, we see helicopter 10 o' clock above, closing, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，ACA 331，已离地，正爬升至 1,800 米，我们看到一架直升机位于 10 点钟上方，正在接近，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: ACA 331, turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2,400 meters, maintain visual separation with the helicopter.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 331，右转航向 240，加速爬升至 2,400 米，与直升机保持目视间隔。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2,400 meters, maintain visual separation, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，加速爬升至 2,400 米，保持目视间隔，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, after traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb and maintain 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，交通解除后，直飞 ZF，恢复自主导航，爬升并保持 5100 米。
cards.referenceText: After traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb and maintain 5100 meters, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 交通解除后，直飞 ZF，恢复自主导航，爬升并保持 5100 米，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 9500 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 5655, contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你保持 9500 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 5655，联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, maintaining 9500 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA 331，保持 9500 米，过 OBLIK，应答机 5655。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，郑州管制，雷达识别，爬升并保持 10100 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 10100 meters, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 10100 米，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: suddenly your cabin crew reports there are toxic fumes in rear cabin, you decided to expedite descent for smoke removal. make a distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱机组突然报告后舱有有毒烟雾，你决定加速下降以排烟。向郑州管制发出遇险呼叫，并请求在 3000 米改平。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, our cabin crew reports there are toxic fumes in rear cabin, request expedite descent for smoke removal, request level off at 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，郑州管制，ACA 331，客舱机组报告后舱有有毒烟雾，请求加速下降以排烟，请求在 3000 米改平。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1008, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 030，按 QNH 1008 下降到 3000 米，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1008, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，按 QNH 1008 下降到 3000 米，ACA 331。

cards.audioText: B: After cabin check, tell Zhengzhou Control the toxic fume might be caused by dangerous goods leaking in the cargo hold.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 客舱检查后，告诉 郑州管制，有毒烟雾可能由货舱危险品泄漏引起。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, the toxic fume might be caused by dangerous goods leaking in the cargo hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA 331，有毒烟雾可能由货舱危险品泄漏引起。

cards.audioText: B: Several passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume and become unconscious, tell Zhengzhou Control the situation and request diversion to Zhengzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 数名旅客受到有毒烟雾严重影响并失去意识，向郑州管制说明情况并请求改航 Zhengzhou。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA 331, several passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume and become unconscious, request divert to Zhengzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，ACA 331，数名旅客受到有毒烟雾严重影响并失去意识，请求改航 Zhengzhou。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, Zhengzhou Control, roger, turn left heading 360, contact Zhengzhou Approach 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，郑州管制，收到，左转航向 360，联系郑州进近120.35。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 360, 120.35, ACA 331.

cards.audioText: C: ACA 331, Zhengzhou Approach, radar contact, track direct to CGO, descend to 3000 meters, expect radar vector ILS Runway 12.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 331，郑州进近，雷达识别，直飞 CGO，下降到 3000 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 12。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to CGO, descend to 3000 meters, expect radar vector ILS Runway 12, ACA 331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 CGO，下降到 3000 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 12，ACA 331。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 331, what assistance do you need?
B: tell Zhengzhou Approach you need ambulance and dangerous goods specialists.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： ACA 331，你需要什么协助？
B： 告诉郑州进近，你需要救护车和危险品专家。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Approach, ACA 331, request ambulance and dangerous goods specialists.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州进近，ACA 331，请求救护车和危险品专家。

topics.name: ACA 219 TCAS机动 复飞 备降/返航

cards.audioText: Your call sign is ACA 219, from Vancouver to Wuhan, you are maintaining 11,000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3555, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 ACA 219，从温哥华飞往武汉，正保持 11,000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3555，与武汉管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 219, maintaining 2000 meters, over OBLIK, squawking 3555.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 219，正保持 2000 米，飞越 OBLIK，应答机 3555。

cards.audioText: ACA 219, Wuhan Control, radar contact, reduce speed to mach decimal 75 due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 219，武汉管制，雷达识别，因流量控制将速度减至 Mach 0.75。
cards.referenceText: reduce speed to mach decimal seven five, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 将速度减至 Mach 0.75，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，下降到 9200 米，减速到 270 节以下，直到通知。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 9200 米，减速到 270 节以下，直到通知，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your TCAS indicates there is a converging traffic at your 2 o'clock, below, climbing, confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with you.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 下降过程中，你的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有交叉交通，在下方，正在爬升，向武汉管制确认是否与你冲突。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 219, our TCAS indicates there is a converging traffic at our 2 o'clock, below, climbing, is it in conflict with us?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 219，我们的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有交叉交通，在我们下方，正在爬升，是否与我们冲突？

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, negative, the aircraft is climbing to 8900 meters, it will cross behind your shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，否，该飞机正在爬升到 8900 米，很快将在你后方穿越。
cards.referenceText: Roger, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: You have just received the latest ATIS, saying the visibility at Wuhan is low, you want to know if your alternate airport Changsha is available for diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你刚收到最新 ATIS，说 Wuhan 能见度低，你想知道备降机场 Changsha 是否可用于改航。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 219, the latest ATIS says the visibility at Wuhan is low, is Changsha available for diversion?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 219，最新 ATIS 说 Wuhan 能见度低，Changsha 是否可用于改航？

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 219, Changsha Airport is available, confirm you are diverting to Changsha?
B: Tell the controller you are not diverting to Changsha at the moment, and you still want to fly to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 219，Changsha Airport 可用，确认你要改航 Changsha？
B: 告诉管制员目前不改航 Changsha，仍想飞往 Wuhan。
cards.referenceText: We won't divert at the moment, we still want to fly to Wuhan, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们目前不改航，仍想飞往 Wuhan，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: ACA 219, roger, track direct to ZF, follow Z FOXTROT-2A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 219，收到，直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: track direct to ZF, follow ZF two A Arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，下降并保持 4200 米，减速到最小光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，减速到最小光洁速度，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, contact Wuhan Tower 119.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，联系武汉塔台119.6。

cards.audioText: Now you are established on ILS approach Runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，距接地点 15 英里，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, established ILS Runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 219，已建立 ILS Runway 36R，距接地点 15 英里。

cards.audioText: ACA 219, roger, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550m, midpoint 600 meters, rollout 500m, continue approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 219，收到，地面静风，RVR 接地区 550m、中段 600 米、滑跑端 500m，继续进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: roger, continue approach Runway 36R, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续进近 Runway 36R，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud information.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你距接地点 10 海里，向武汉塔台询问云况信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, 10 miles from touchdown, request cloud information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 219，距接地点 10 海里，请求云况信息。

cards.audioText: ACA 219, cloud broken 700m, cleared to land Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 219，碎云 700m，许可在 Runway 36R 落地。
cards.referenceText: cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land Runway 36R, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 碎云 700 米，许可在 Runway 36R 落地，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: At the minimum, you are unable to see approach lights, you are carrying out a missed approach, advise Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 在最低标准高度，你看不到进近灯，正在执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText:
Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, we are unable to see approach lights at minimum, going around.
(no contact at the minimum)
cards.referenceTextZh:
武汉塔台，ACA 219，我们在最低标准高度看不到进近灯，复飞。
（最低标准高度无目视）

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，收到，执行标准复飞程序，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Changsha Airport, inform Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正在爬升到复飞高度，决定改航 Changsha Airport，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, request divert to Changsha Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 219，请求改航 Changsha Airport。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 219, roger, turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 219，收到，右转，直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米，ACA 219。

cards.audioText: ACA 219, contact Wuhan Departure on 120.4
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 219，联系武汉离场 120.4。
cards.referenceText: one two zero decimal, ACA 219.
cards.referenceTextZh: one two zero decimal，ACA 219。

topics.name: ACA 452 颠簸 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 452, you are at stand 203, from Wuhan to Tokyo, you just got informed an illegal stowaway on board, and he must be taken away by police, contact Wuhan Ground to delay the push back.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 452，在 203 号机位，从 Wuhan 到 Tokyo，刚得知机上有非法偷渡者，必须由警方带走，联系武汉地面请求延迟推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 452, stand 203, request delay the push back due an illegal stowaway must be taken away by police.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 452，203 号机位，由于一名非法偷渡者必须由警方带走，请求延迟推出。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, report POB when ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，准备推出和开车时报告机上人数。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: Now tell the Ground controller you are ready for push back and start up, POB 235.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在告诉地面管制员你准备推出和开车，机上人数 235。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 452, request push back and start up, POB235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 452，请求推出和开车，机上人数 235。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，推出和开车批准，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝西，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi, the visibility is getting worse due to dust storm, tell the controller you will hold position until visibility gets better.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 滑行期间，由于沙尘暴能见度变差，告诉管制员你将原地等待，直到能见度好转。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 452, the visibility is getting worse due to dust storm, request hold position until visibility gets better.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 452，由于沙尘暴能见度变差，请求原地等待，直到能见度好转。

cards.audioText: ACA 452, the visibility now is 1000m, continue taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway Z4 and C, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 452，当前能见度为 1000m，经 Z4 和 C 滑行道继续滑行至 Runway 18R 等待点，联系武汉塔台 124.35。
cards.referenceText: roger, taxi to holding point Runway 18R via taxiway Z four and C, 124.35, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，经 Z4 和 C 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18R 等待点，124.35，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: Now you are at holding point Runway 18R, tell the tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 18R 等待点，告诉塔台你已准备好起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 452, holding point Runway 18R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 452，Runway 18R 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: ACA 452, when airborne, contact 119.35, follow the noise abatement procedure, cleared for takeoff Runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 452，离地后联系 119.35，执行减噪程序，许可从 Runway 18R 起飞。
cards.referenceText: when airborne, contact 119.35, follow the noise abatement procedure, cleared for takeoff Runway 18R, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后联系 119.35，执行减噪程序，许可从 Runway 18R 起飞，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: During takeoff climbing, you encountered wake turbulence from the preceding aircraft, contact Wuhan Departure to turn right to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 起飞爬升期间，你遭遇前机尾流，联系 Wuhan Departure 请求右转避让。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA 452, we encountered wake turbulence from the preceding aircraft, request turn right to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA 452，我们遭遇前机尾流，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, Wuhan Departure, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 3300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，Wuhan Departure，右转，直飞 ZF，爬升并保持 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 3300 meters, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，爬升并保持 3300 米，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: you are levelling at 10,700 meters, your onboard navigation computers failed, you are flying with raw data, inform Wuhan Control the situation and request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 你正改平至 10,700 米，机载导航计算机失效，正在使用原始数据飞行，向武汉管制通报情况并请求雷达引导。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, levelling at 1700 meters, our onboard navigation computers failed, we are flying with raw data, request radar vectors.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，正改平至 1700 米，我们的机载导航计算机失效，正在使用原始数据飞行，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText:
ACA 452, what's the situation like onboard?
tell the controller you need one minute to perform the checklist and will advise.
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 452，机上情况如何？
告诉管制员你需要一分钟执行检查单，稍后报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, we need one minute to perform the checklist and will advise.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，我们需要一分钟执行检查单，稍后报告。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, maintain present level, turn left heading 010, keep informed if you can't maintain RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，保持当前高度，左转航向 010，如不能保持 RVSM，请随时告知。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, turn left heading 010, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，左转航向 010，ACA 452。

cards.audioText: B: After finishing the checklist, the malfunction can't be solved and your autopilot failed, you are unable RVSM due equipment, inform Wuhan Control your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 完成检查单后，故障无法解决，自动驾驶失效，由于设备原因无法 RVSM，向武汉管制通报情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, the malfunction can't be solved and our autopilot failed, unable RVSM due equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，故障无法解决，我们的自动驾驶失效，由于设备原因无法 RVSM。

cards.audioText: ACA 452, turn right heading 040, descend to 8100m.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 452，右转航向 040，下降至 8100m。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 040, descend to 8100 meters, ACA 452.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 040，下降至 8100 米，ACA 452。

cards.audioText:
ACA 452, when able, advise your intention.
Tell the control you will maintain 8100m and divert to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 452，可以时报告意图。
告诉管制员你将保持 8100m 并备降北京。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 452, request maintain 8,100 meters and divert to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 452，请求保持 8,100 米并备降北京。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 452, roger, contact Zhengzhou Control 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 452，收到，联系郑州管制119.35。

topics.name: ACA 517 发动机失效 颠簸 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is ACA 517, you are maintaining 10,100 meters, approaching DAPRO, squawking 3215, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 ACA 517，正保持 10,100 米，接近 DAPRO，应答机 3215，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 517, maintaining 1100 meters, approaching DAPRO, squawking 3215.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 517，正保持 1100 米，接近 DAPRO，应答机 3215。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, Wuhan Control, radar identified, omit position reports.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，武汉管制，雷达识别，省略位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Omit position reports, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 省略位置报告，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: There is moderate turbulence at 10,100 meters, Ask Wuhan Control if there is any turbulence reported at 10,700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 10,100 米有中度颠簸，询问武汉管制 10,700 米是否有颠簸报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 517, there is moderate turbulence at 1100 meters, is there any turbulence reported at 1700 meters?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 517，1100 米有中度颠簸，1700 米是否有颠簸报告？

cards.audioText:
ACA 517, there is no turbulence report at 10,700 meters.
ask to climb to 10,700 meters due moderate turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 517，10,700 米没有颠簸报告。
因中度颠簸请求爬升至 10,700 米。
cards.referenceText: request climb to 1700 meters due moderate turbulence, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因中度颠簸请求爬升至 1700 米，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: ACA 517, climb to reach 10700 meters within 2 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 517，在 2 分钟内爬升到达 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to reach 1700 within two minutes, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在两分钟内爬升到达 1700，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: when you are at 10,700 meters, your left engine failed, make an urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6,300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 当你位于 10,700 米时，左发失效，发出紧急呼叫并请求右转和下降至 6,300 米。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA 517, our left engine failed, request turn right and descend to 6003 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA 517，我们的左发失效，请求右转并下降至 6003 米。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，右转航向 200，下降并保持 6300 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300 meters, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 200，下降并保持 6300 米，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: B: Advise Wuhan Control you want to divert to Wuhan and track direct to WHA and descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知 武汉管制 你想改航 Wuhan，直飞 WHA 并下降到较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 517, request divert to Wuhan and track direct to WHA and descend to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 517，请求改航 Wuhan，直飞 WHA，并下降到较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, turn left, direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，左转，直飞 WHA，下降并保持 2100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100 meters, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 WHA，下降并保持 2100 米，ACA 517。

cards.audioText:
ACA 517, expect radar vector for VOR/DME approach 36 right.
The weather is deteriorating and below landing minimum, ask for ILS approach 36 Left.
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 517，预计雷达引导 VOR/DME 进近 Runway 36R。
天气正在恶化并低于着陆最低标准，请求 ILS 进近 Runway 36L。
cards.referenceText: expect radar vector for VOR, DME approach Runway 36R, request ILS approach Runway 36L due deteriorating weather and below landing minima, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计雷达引导 VOR、DME 进近 Runway 36R，因天气恶化并低于着陆最低标准，请求 ILS 进近 Runway 36L，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: ACA 517, Runway 36L is not available, runway in use 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 517，Runway 36L 不可用，当前使用 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: roger, Runway 36R, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，Runway 36R，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, you are number 1 to land, there are no speed restrictions in Wuhan terminal area.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，你是第 1 架着陆，Wuhan 终端区无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: No speed restrictions, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 无速度限制，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: you executed a missed approach procedure and try to land on Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已执行复飞程序，并尝试在 Runway 36R 落地。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 517, going around, we will try to land on Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 517，正在复飞，我们将尝试在 Runway 36R 落地。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, climb to 1200 meters, follow the standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，爬升到 1200 米，执行标准复飞程序。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 1200 meters, follow the standard missed approach procedure, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 1200 米，执行标准复飞程序，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: ACA 517, maintain 1,200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 517，保持 1,200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: maintain 1200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 1200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，ACA 517。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 517, runway covered with patches of water, braking action medium.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 517，跑道有片状积水，刹车效应中等。
cards.referenceText: runway covered with patches of water, breaking action medium, ACA 517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道有片状积水，刹车效应中等，ACA 517。

topics.name: ACA 521 乘客医疗 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is ACA 521, a flight from Wuhan to Toronto, you are at gate 232, you have got the latest ATIS T, contact Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 ACA 521，从 Wuhan 到 Toronto，位于 232 号登机口，已收到最新 ATIS T，联系武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, ACA 521, gate 232, information T, request ATC clearance to Toronto.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，ACA 521，232 号登机口，信息 T，请求前往 Toronto 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: ACA 521, cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb to 1,500 meters, Z FOXTROT-05 departure, cruising level 10,400 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 521，许可按飞行计划航路飞往多伦多，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1,500 米，执行 ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 10,400 米，途中申请改变高度，离场频率 125.75，应答机 5655。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb to 1500 meters, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 1400 meters, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往多伦多，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1500 米，执行 ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 1400 米，途中申请改变高度，离场频率 125.75，应答机 5655，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成推出和开车，准备滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 521, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 521，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 E5 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 E5 前等待，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you see there is an obstruction ahead of you on taxiway A3, you confirm the taxi instructions with Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你看到前方滑行道 A3 上有障碍物，向武汉地面确认滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA 521, there is an obstruction ahead of us on A3, confirm the taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，ACA 521，A3 上我们前方有障碍物，请确认滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, hold at present position, the ground handling will deal with it.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，原地等待，地面保障会处理。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, the obstruction has been removed, continue taxi via A3, A to holding point Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，障碍物已移除，继续经 A3、A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via A3, A to holding point Runway 04, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 A3、A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point E5 Runway 04, you are fully ready, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 04 E5 等待点等待，完全准备好，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 521, holding at holding point E5 Runway 04, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 521，在跑道 04 E5 等待点等待，完全准备好。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, line up and cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, surface wind 030 degrees, 8 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，进跑道并立即起飞，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，地面风 030 度 8 节。
cards.referenceText: Line up and cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道并立即起飞，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, you are passing 1200 meters, climbing to 2400 meters, make an initial contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，正通过 1200 米，爬升到 2400 米，与 Wuhan Departure 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA 521, passing 1200 meters, climbing to 2400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，ACA 521，通过 1200 米，爬升到 2400 米。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, radar contact, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，雷达识别，右转，直飞 ZF，爬升到 4500 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, climb to 4500 meters, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，爬升到 4500 米，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: Your TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300 meters above your level, confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有冲突交通，在你高度上方 300 米，向武汉管制确认是否与你的飞机冲突。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 521, our TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o'clock, 300 meters above our level, is it in conflict with us?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 521，我们的 TCAS 显示 2 点钟方向有冲突交通，在我们高度上方 300 米，是否与我们冲突？

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, negative, it is parallel to your flight track.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，否，它与你的航迹平行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，ACA 521。

cards.audioText: B: During cruise, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, make an Urgency call to Wuhan Control and request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 巡航期间，机长突然心脏病发作，向武汉管制发出紧急呼叫并请求立即返航优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA 521, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，ACA 521，机长突然心脏病发作，请求立即返航优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: ACA 521, roger PAN PAN, turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300 meters, you are number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: ACA 521，收到 PANPAN，左转航向 220，直飞 ZF，下降到 3300 米，你是第 1 架。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300 meters, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，直飞 ZF，下降到 3300 米，ACA 521。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA 521, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need an ambulance and a physician.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: ACA 521，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要救护车和医生。
cards.referenceText: Request an ambulance and a physician, ACA 521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求救护车和医生，ACA 521。

topics.name: ACA 571 颠簸 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is ACA 571, a flight from Toronto to Wuhan, now you are over OBLIK, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 2563, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 ACA 571，这是一趟从多伦多飞往武汉的航班，现在飞越 OBLIK，正保持 11000 米，应答机 2563，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 571, over OBLIK, maintaining 2000 meters, squawking 2563.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 571，飞越 OBLIK，正保持 2000 米，应答机 2563。

cards.audioText: ACA 571, Wuhan Control, radar contact, maintain 11000 meters, offset 3 miles right of track due weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 571，武汉管制，雷达识别，保持 11000 米，因前方天气向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里。
cards.referenceText: maintain 2000 meters, 11000 meters offset tree miles right of track, ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 2000 米，在 11000 米向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，ACA 571。

cards.audioText:
ACA 571, you are deviating too much from the flight path, turn left 30 degrees.
Read back ATC instructions and tell Wuhan Control you are flying into a group of CBs and show your apologies.
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 571，你偏离航路过多，左转 30 度。
复诵 ATC 指令，并告诉武汉管制你正飞入一组 CB，同时表示歉意。
cards.referenceText: turn left 30 degrees, my apologies, we are flying into a group of C Bs, ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转 30 度，抱歉，我们正飞入一组 CB，ACA 571。

cards.audioText: Now you are experiencing severe clear air turbulence at 11000 meters, contact Wuhan Control and ask if there is any turbulence reported by previous aircraft at other adjacent levels.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在 11000 米遭遇严重晴空颠簸，联系武汉管制，并询问前机是否在其他相邻高度报告过颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 571, we are experiencing severe clear air turbulence at 2000 meters, 11000 meters is there any turbulence reported by previous aircraft at other adjacent levels?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 571，我们在 2000 米遭遇严重晴空颠簸，11000 米，前机是否在其他相邻高度报告过颠簸？

cards.audioText:
ACA 571, there is no turbulence report at 11600 meters.
acknowledge the transmission and tell Wuhan Control you are unable to climb to 11600 meters due performance and ask if the lower levels are available.
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 571，11600 米没有颠簸报告。
确认收到，并告诉武汉管制，由于性能原因你无法爬升至 11600 米，询问较低高度是否可用。
cards.referenceText: roger, we are unable to climb to 2600 meters, are lower levels available? ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们无法爬升至 2600 米，较低高度是否可用？ACA 571。

cards.audioText:
ACA 57110400 meters and 9800 meters are both available, which do you prefer?
Tell Wuhan Control you'd like to descend to 9800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 571，10400 米和 9800 米均可用，你选择哪一个？
告诉武汉管制你想下降至 9800 米。
cards.referenceText: request descend to 9800 meters, ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求下降至 9800 米，ACA 571。

cards.audioText: ACA 571, descend and maintain 9800 meters, turn left, direct to IKUBA.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 571，下降并保持 9800 米，左转直飞 IKUBA。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 9800 meters, turn left, direct to IKUBA, ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 9800 米，左转直飞 IKUBA，ACA 571。

cards.audioText: Now you are over IKUBA at 15, maintaining 9800 meters, inform Wuhan Control, you have encountered severe turbulence and ask for 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 IKUBA 上空，at 15，正保持 9800 米，通知武汉管制你遭遇严重颠簸，并请求 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA 571, over IKUBA at 15, maintaining 9800 meters, we have encountered severe turbulence, request 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，ACA 571，位于 IKUBA 上空，at 15，正保持 9800 米，我们遭遇严重颠簸，请求 8400 米。

cards.audioText: ACA 571, roger, descend and maintain 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 571，收到，下降并保持 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 8400 meters, ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 8400 米，ACA 571。

cards.audioText:
ACA 571, is there any damage to the aircraft or any passenger injuries?
tell the controller there is no damage to the aircraft and no passenger injuries.
cards.audioTextZh:
ACA 571，航空器是否有任何损伤，或是否有乘客受伤？
告诉管制员航空器没有损伤，也没有乘客受伤。
cards.referenceText: there is no damage to the aircraft and no passenger injuries, ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航空器没有损伤，也没有乘客受伤，ACA 571。

cards.audioText: ACA 571, descend to and maintain 5400 meters, reach 5400 meters 10 miles before XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 571，下降至并保持 5400 米，在 XSH 前 10 英里到达 5400 米。
cards.referenceText: descend to and maintain 5400 meters, reach 5400 meters 10 miles before XSH, ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至并保持 5400 米，在 XSH 前 10 英里到达 5400 米，ACA 571。

cards.audioText: Now you are approaching XSH, maintaining 5400 meters, you have got information O, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正接近 XSH，保持 5400 米，已收到 O 情报，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA 571, approaching XSH, maintaining 5400 meters, information O.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，ACA 571，正接近 XSH，保持 5400 米，O 情报。

cards.audioText: ACA 571, turn right heading 360, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 571，右转航向 360，下降至并保持 2400 米，雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 360, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R, ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 360，下降至并保持 2400 米，雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，ACA 571。

cards.audioText: ACA 571, turn right heading 330, descend to and maintain 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 571，右转航向 330，下降至并保持 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 330, descend to and maintain 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, report established, ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至并保持 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，建立后报告，ACA 571。

cards.audioText: Now you are established on the ILS Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 571, established on the ILS Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，ACA 571，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: ACA 571, Runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: ACA 571，Runway 36R，许可落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, ACA 571.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，许可落地，ACA 571。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is ACA219, you are now maintaining at 10700m, over ZHO at 35, next OBLIK at 50, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是加航219，你现在保持在10700米，过ZHO，35分，下一航路点OBLIK，50分，向武汉区调做一个标准位置报。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, 10700m, over ZHO at 35, next OBLIK at 50.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航219，10700米，过ZHO 35分，下一航路点OBLIK，50分。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, Wuhan Control, radar contact, fly direct to OBLIK, due delay in your destination airport, reach OBLIK not before 55.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，武汉区调，雷达识别了，直飞OBLIK，由于目的地机场有延误，到达OBLIK不要早于55分。
cards.referenceText: Fly direct to OBLIK, wilco, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞OBLIK，照办，加航219。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’ve over OBLIK at time 03, report to Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已经飞过OBLIK 03分，报告给武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, over OBLIK at 03.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航219，过OBLIK，03分。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, expect further clearance at 15.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，预计15分发布下一许可。
cards.referenceText: Roger, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，加航219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, descend to and maintain 4200m, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，下到4200米保持，速度减小至最小光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4200m, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到4200米保持，速度减小至最小光洁速度，加航219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, contact Wuhan Tower 119.6.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，联系武汉塔台119.6。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have established on ILS approach, runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touch down, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已经建立盲降进近，跑道36右，你距离接地点15海里，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, established on ILS approach, runway 36R, 15 miles from touch down.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航219，已经建立盲降进近，跑道36右，距离接地点15海里。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, Wuhan Tower, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550m, mid-point 600m, roll-out 500m, continue approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，武汉塔台，地面静风，跑道视距接地点550米，中间点600米，终点段500米，继续进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Roger that, continue approach runway 36R, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续进近，跑道36右，加航219。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud base.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你距离接地点10海里，向武汉塔台询问云底高。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA 219, 10 miles from touchdown, request/confirm cloud base.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航219，距离接地点10海里，请求/证实云底高。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, cloud broken, 700m, cleared to land, runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，散云，700米，可以落地，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared to land runway 36R, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，可以落地，跑道36右，加航219。

cards.audioText: B: [At the minimum, you are unable to see the approach lights, you are carrying out a missed approach procedure, advise Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在最低高度，你无法看到进近灯，你执行了复飞程序，告知塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, no contact at minimum, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航219，最低高度无法目视，复飞了。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，按照标准复飞程序，可以时告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, wilco, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照标准复飞程序，照办，加航219。

cards.audioText: B: [Now You are climbing to the missed approach altitude, you decided to divert to Changsha airport, inform Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在爬升到复飞高度，你决定改航至长沙机场，告知武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, request divert to Changsha airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航219，请求改航至长沙机场。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, turn right direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，右转直飞LKO，上到2400米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400m, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞LKO，上到2400米保持，加航219。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, contact Wuhan Approach on 120.4, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，联系武汉进近120.4，再见。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is ACA331, from Wuhan to Vancouver, pushback and start up have been completed, request Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是加航331，从武汉飞往温哥华，已经完成了推出开车，向武汉地面请求滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA331, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航331，完成了推出开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point runway 18R via A7, A, Z4, C.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，武汉地面，经由滑行道A7，A和Z4，C滑行至跑道18右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18R via A7, A, Z4, C, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A7，A，Z4和C滑行至跑道18右外等待点，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, follow the A319 on M to holding point runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，跟随着M滑行道上的A319，滑行至跑道18右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Follow the A319 on M to holding point runway 18R, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随着M上的A319，滑行至跑道18右外等待点，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, runway 18R is closed due to disable aircraft on the runway. Change your ATC clearance to runway 18L. ZF-12D departure, the rest is unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，由于跑道上有故障航空器，18右跑道关闭。更改你的管制放行许可至18左，ZF-12D离场，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: Roger, runway 18L, ZF-12D departure, the rest is unchanged, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道18左，ZF-12D离场，其余不变，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, enter the runway 18R from C, vacate runway via C4, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，经由C进入18右跑道，经由C4脱离跑道，脱离后报。
cards.referenceText: Enter the runway 18R from C, vacate runway via C4, wilco, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由C进入18右跑道，经由C4脱离跑道，照办，加航331。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have vacated runway 18R via C4, report to Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在经由C4脱离跑道18右，报告给地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA331, we have vacated runway 18R via C4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航331，我们已经经由C4脱离跑道18右。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, continue taxi to holding point runway 18L via M, A, A1.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，继续经由滑行道M，A，A1滑行至跑道18左外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi to holding point 18L via M, A, A1, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续经由滑行道M，A，A1滑行至跑道18左外等待点，加航331。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are airborne, climbing to 1800m, you see a helicopter on 10 o'clock above. It is closing to your aircraft. Inform Wuhan Departure and ask for a right turn to avoid the traffic.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已经离地，爬升至1800米，你看到上方10点钟方向有一架直升机，它正在靠近你的飞机。报告给武汉离场，请求右转躲避航空器。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA331, airborne, climbing to 1800m, there is a helicopter on 10 o'clock above. It is closing to our aircraft, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航331，离地了，爬升至1800米，10点钟方向有一架直升机，它正在靠近我们飞机，请求右转躲避航空器。

cards.audioText: C: ACA33I, roger, turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2400m, maintain visual separation with the helicopter.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，收到，右转航向240，加速爬升至2400米，与直升机保持目视间隔。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, expedite climb to 2400m, maintain visual separation with the helicopter, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，加速爬升至2400米，与直升机保持目视间隔，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, after the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，航空器脱离冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上到5100米保持。
cards.referenceText: After the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航空器脱离冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上到5100米保持，加航331。

cards.audioText: B: [You are now at cruising level 9500m, over OBLIK, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control, your squawk number is 5655.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在9500米巡航，飞过OBLIK，与郑州区调建立初始联系，你的应答机编码是5655。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, maintaining 9500m, over OBLIK, squawking 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，加航331，在9500米保持，过OBLIK，应答机5655。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, climb to and maintain 10100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，郑州区调，雷达识别，上10100米保持。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 10100m, ACA331.

cards.audioText: B: [Suddenly, your cabin crew reports there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. You decide to expedite descend for smoke removal. Make a distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【突然，乘务员报告后客舱有有毒气体。你决定加速下降进行除烟程序。向郑州区调做遇险呼叫，请求在3000米平飞。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. Request expedite descend for smoke removal and level off at 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州区调，加航331，后客舱有有毒气体，请求加速下降进行除烟程序，并在3000米改平。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA331, Zhengzhou Control, roger Mayday, turn right heading 060, descend to and maintain 3000m. When able, report POB.
B: [Inform Zhengzhou Control, your POB is 223, including 5 children.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航331，郑州区调，收到Mayday，右转航向060，下降到3000米保持，可以的时候，报告机上人数。
【告知管制员，机上人数223，包括5名儿童。】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 060, descend to and maintain 3000m, our POB is 223, including 5 children, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向060，下降到3000米保持，机上人数223，包括5名儿童，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, descend to 1800m and contact Zhengzhou Approach on 113.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，下降到1800米，联系郑州进近113.35。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800m and contact Zhengzhou Approach on 113.35, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到1800米，联系郑州进近113.35，加航331。

topics.name: ACA521 [滑行道障碍物，机长心脏病]

cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is ACA521, a flight from Wuhan to Toronto. You are at Gate 232, you have got the latest ATIS T, contact Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是加航521，从武汉飞往多伦多。你现在在232机位，你收到最新通播T，联系武汉放行，请求管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, ACA521, Gate 232 with information T, request ATC clearance to Toronto.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，加航521，232机位，通播T，请求飞往多伦多的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, Wuhan Delivery, Cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb to 1500m, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 10400m, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，北京放行，可以经由计划航路飞往多伦多，离场跑道04，初始爬升至1500米，ZF05离场，巡航高度10400米，入航后变更高度，离场频率125.75，应答机5655。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Toronto via flight planned route, departure runway 04, initial climb to 1500m, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 10400m, request level change en route, departure frequency 125.75, squawk 5655, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往多伦多，离场跑道04，初始爬升至1500米，ZF05离场，巡航高度10400米，入航后变更高度，离场频率125.75，应答机5655，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you have completed push-back and startup. You are ready to taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在完成了推出开车。你准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA521, push-back and startup completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航521，完成推出开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，经由滑行道Z4，A3和A，滑行到跑道04外等待点，在E5等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A3和A，滑行到跑道04外等待点，在E5等待，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you see there is an obstruction ahead of you on taxiway A3. You confirm the taxi instructions with Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在前方滑行道A3上，你看到了一个障碍物，你想与武汉地面证实滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA521, obstruction ahead on taxiway A3, confirm taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航521，滑行道A3上有障碍物，证实滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, hold at present position, the ground personnel will deal with it.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，当前位置等待，地面人员将会处理。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold at present position, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，当前位置等待，加航521。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, the obstruction has been removed, continue taxi via A3, A to holding point runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，障碍物已被移除，继续沿A3和A滑行至跑道04外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi via A3, A to holding point runway 04, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续沿A3和A滑行至跑道04外等待点，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are holding at holding point E5, runway 04, you are fully ready, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在跑道04外等待点E5，你完全准备好了，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA521, holding at holding point E5, runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航521，04跑道E5等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, Wuhan Tower, line up and cleared for immediate takeoff, runway 04, surface wind 030 degrees, 8kts.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，武汉塔台，上跑道，可以立即起飞，跑道04，地面风030度，8节。
cards.referenceText: Line up and cleared for immediate takeoff runway 04, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道，可以立即起飞，跑道04，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are airborne, you are passing 1200m, climbing to 2400m, make an initial contact with Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已离地，正通过1200米上到2400米，与武汉离场建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA521, airborne, passing 1200m, climbing to 2400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航521，离地了，正通过1200米上到2400米。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, radar contact, turn right direct to ZF, climb to 4500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，雷达看见了，右转直飞ZF，上4500米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to ZF, climb to 4500m ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞ZF，上4500米，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [Your TCAS indicates there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o’clock, 300m above your level. Confirm with Wuhan Control if it is in conflict with your aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的TCAS指示2点钟有一架冲突航空器，在你高度层上方300米。与武汉区调证实是否与你是冲突航空器。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA521, TCAS indication of traffic 2 o’clock 300m above, confirm it is a conflicting traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航521，TCAS指示2点钟方向有一架航空器，在我们上方300米，证实它是否是一架冲突航空器。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, negative. It is parallel to your flight track.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，不是的， 它与你航迹平行。
cards.referenceText: Roger thanks, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [During cruise, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, make a distress call to Wuhan Control and request immediate return for priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在巡航时，机长突然遇到心脏病，与武汉区调进行遇险通话，请求立刻返航进行优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Control, ACA521, captain heart attack, request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，武汉区调，加航521，机长心脏病发作，请求立即返航。优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, roger Mayday, turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300m, you are No.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，收到Mayday，左转航向220，直飞ZF，下3000米，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300m, No.1 ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向220，直飞ZF，下3300米，第一个，加航521。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA521, What assistance do you need?
N: [Tell the controller you need an ambulance and a physician.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航521，你需要什么样的协助？
【告知管制员，你需要救护车和医生。】
cards.referenceText: Request ambulance and doctors, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求救护车和医生，加航521。

cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is ACA121, you are 6 miles from touchdown, your fuel warning light is on, call Wuhan approach for ILS approach and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是加航121，你现在距离接地点6海里，你的燃油告警灯亮了，呼叫武汉进近，请求盲降进近，优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA121, 6 miles from touchdown, our fuel warning light is on, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航121，接地点6海里，我们的燃油告警灯亮了，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, Wuhan approach, roger, cleared ILS approach runway 36R and turn right heading 300 to final. You are 5 and half miles from touchdown.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，武汉进近，收到，可以盲降进近跑道36右，右转航向300加入五边，你现在距离接地点5.5海里。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 36R and turn right heading 300 to final, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以盲降进近跑道36右，右转航向300加入五边，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, turn right to 310 to intercept the localizer, contact 118.7 for Tower, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，右转航向310，截获航向道，联系塔台118.7，再见。
cards.referenceText: Turn right to 310 to intercept the localizer, 118.7, good day, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向310，截获航向道，联系塔台118.7，再见，加航121。

cards.audioText: N: [Contact Wuhan Tower, you are approaching AKO, level 1100 meters.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系武汉塔台， 你正在接近AKO，在1100米平飞。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, approaching AKO, level at 1100m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航121，接近AKO，在1100米平飞。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA121, Wuhan Tower, for your information, there is lighting maintenance in progress near the end of runway.
N:[ You ask if ILS CAT II is available.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航121，武汉塔台，跑道头有灯光系统维修工作。
【询问二类盲降是否可用。】
cards.referenceText: Confirm if ILS category II available? ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 证实二类盲降是否可用，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, Wuhan Tower, ILS CAT II is unserviceable due to the inoperative center line lighting; ILS CAT I minimum is effective.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，武汉塔台，由于跑道中线灯光系统故障，二类盲降不可用，一类盲降最低标准生效。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action is poor.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，跑道道面有积冰，刹车性能差。
cards.referenceText: Roger, braking action is poor, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，刹车性能差，加航121。

cards.audioText: N: [You request to dim the approach lights to grade 3. They look too bright from your aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你请求将进近灯调整到3级，从你飞机上看太亮了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, request to dim the approach lights to grade 3. They look too bright.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航121，请求将进近灯调暗至3级，它们太亮了。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger.
C: ACA121, check gear down and you are cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh:
收到。
加航121，检查起落架放下，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Check gear down and cleared to land, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 检查起落架放下，可以落地，加航121。

cards.audioText: N: [You have three green lights. The PAPI (PAPI precision approach path indicator) appears to be a little bit low but actually your aircraft is high on the glide path. Report to the Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你看到了3个绿灯，PAPI灯（精密进近航道指示器）看起来有点低，但是实际上你的飞机在下滑道上方，告知塔台管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, we have 3 green, the PAPI seems to be a little bit low but our aircraft is actually high on the glide path.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航121，我们看到3个绿灯，PAPI灯看起来有点低，但是实际上我们的飞机在下滑道以上。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, Wuhan Tower, look at the whole airfield and adjust your descent rate.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，武汉塔台，看下整个机场，调整你的下降率。
cards.referenceText: Look at the whole airfield and adjust descent rate, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 看下整个机场，调整下降率，加航121。

cards.audioText: N: [You tell controller you're overshooting, your altitude is too high.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知管制员，你复飞了，你的高度太高了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA121, going around, our altitude is too high.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航121，我们复飞了，我们的高度太高了。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, check your aircraft condition in the holding area. Contact Departure on 119.9
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，在等待区域检查飞机状态，联系离场119.9。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, contact departure 119.9, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，联系进近119.9，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, confirm you are overshooting.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，证实你复飞了。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we are overshooting, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们复飞了，加航121。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, sir, what's your intention.
N: [Tell departure you want to circle back for another landing on runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，你的意图是什么？
【告知离场，你想盘旋进近跑道36右再次降落。】
cards.referenceText: Request circle back for another landing on runway 36R, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求盘旋进近跑道36右再次降落，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, I am sorry to inform you that runway 36R is closed. There are patches of snow and much debris on the runway. Use runway 04 instead. Fly heading 134 to intercept Localizer of runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航121，抱歉通知，跑道36右关闭了，跑道上有雪块和许多碎屑。使用跑道04，航向134切跑道04航向道。
cards.referenceText: Runway 04, fly heading 134 to intercept Localizer of runway 04, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道04，航向134切跑道04航向道，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: ACA121, the wind is northwest about 10 to 15. Turn left heading 070 and descends to 1200 meters, QNH 1001.
cards.referenceText: Turning left heading 070 and descends to 1200m, QNH1001, ACA121.

cards.audioText:
C: ACA121, what is the status of your aircraft?
N: [Tell the controller your aircraft is in good condition, but this time you don’t have enough fuel for another missed approach. You want a successful landing this time.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航121，飞机目前的状态如何？
【告知管制员，你飞机状态良好，但这次，你没有足够的燃油来再次进近，你这次想成功着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA121, unable another missed approach due fuel shortage, request to land this time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航121，由于燃油短缺，无法再次进近，请求着陆。

cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is ACA303, a flight from Wuhan to Vancouver, you are at stand 233 and information F received, request Wuhan Delivery for your ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是加航303，从武汉飞往温哥华，你现在在233机位，收到了通播F，向武汉放行请求管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, ACA303, stand 233, information F, request ATC clearance to Vancouver.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，加航303，233机位，通播F，请求飞往温哥华的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to destination Vancouver, runway 04, ZF-01D departure, flight planned route, initial altitude 1,500m, cruising level 9,500m, request level change en route, squawk 3252, departure frequency 123.32.
