cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，武汉放行，可以飞往目的地温哥华，跑道04，ZF-01D离场，计划航路，初始高度1500米，巡航高度9500米，入行后转高度，应答机3252，离场频率123.32。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to destination Vancouver, runway 04, ZF-01D departure, flight planned route, initial altitude 1,500m, cruising level 9,500m, request level change en route, squawk 3252, departure frequency 123.32, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以飞往目的地温哥华，跑道04，ZF-01D离场，计划航路，初始高度1500米，巡航高度9500米，入行后转高度，应答机3252，离场频率123.32，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [Call Wuhan Ground for your push back and start-up instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【呼叫武汉地面，请求推出开车指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA303, stand 233, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航303，233机位，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, Wuhan Ground, push back and start up approved, push to taxiway Z4, face east.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，武汉地面，可以推出开车，推到滑行道Z4，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, push to taxiway Z4, face east, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，推到滑行道Z4，面朝东，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [You have completed your engine start-up, you are ready for taxi, call Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在已经完成了开车，你准备好滑行了，呼号武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA303, start-up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航303，完成开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A, hold short of A6.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，经由滑行道Z4，A滑行到跑道04外等待点，在A6等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A, hold short of A6, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A滑行到跑道04外等待点，在A6等待，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [The airport is experiencing icing conditions. You need to perform de-icing procedures, call Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【机场遇到了积冰情况，你需要执行除冰程序，呼叫武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA303, request de-icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航303，请求除冰。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, roger, taxi to de-icing area 5 via A5.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，收到，经由A5滑行到5号除冰区。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to de-icing area 5 via A5, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由A5滑行到5号除冰区，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [You are now holding short of runway 04, you are fully ready for takeoff, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在跑道04外等待，你准备好起飞了，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA303, holding short of runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航303，在跑道04外等待，准备好起飞了。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, Wuhan Tower, behind the BAW747 on short final, line up behind, runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，武汉塔台，在短五边上的英航747后面，上跑道等待，跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Behind the traffic/BAW 747 on short final, line up behind, runway 04, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在短五边上的英航747/航空器后面，上跑道等待，跑道04，加航303。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, after airborne, contact Departure 119.7. Surface wind 080 at 4 m/s, cleared for takeoff, runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，离地后，联系离场119.7。地面风080度，4米每秒，可以起飞，跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 04, 119.7, ACA303.

cards.audioText: N: [You are passing 900m for 1,500m. Your No.3 engine vibration indication is near the maximum limit, call Wuhan Departure for a holding pattern at 1,200m to perform the checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在过900米上1500米，你的3号发动喘振指示接近最大值，呼叫武汉离场，在1200米加入等待程序，以此执行检查单。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA303, passing 900m for 1,500m. Our No.3 engine vibration indication is near the maximum limit, request a holding pattern at 1,200m to perform the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航303，过900米上1500米。我们的3号发动喘振指示接近最大值，请求在1200米加入等待程序，以此执行检查单。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, roger, proceed direct to HZ, climb to and maintain 1,200m, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，收到，直飞HZ，上到1200米保持，可以的时候报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Proceed direct to HZ, climb to and maintain 1,200m, wilco, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HZ，上到1200米保持，照办，加航303。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, join the published holding pattern at HZ, expect further clearance at time 0135.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，在HZ加入公布的等待程序，预计在1点35分得到进一步许可。
cards.referenceText: Join the published holding pattern at HZ, expect further clearance at time 0135, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在HZ加入公布的等待程序，预计在1点35分得到进一步许可，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [You suspect the engine vibration problem is caused by icing, request Wuhan Departure for a higher level to leave the icing area.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你怀疑发动机喘振问题是由积冰导致，向武汉离场请求高高度，离开积冰区。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA303, we suspect the engine vibration problem is caused by icing, request further climb to leave the icing area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航303，我们怀疑发动机喘振问题是由积冰导致，请求进一步爬升，离开积冰区域。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA303, roger, what level would you prefer?
N: [Ask the controller if 4,500m is available.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航303，收到，你喜欢哪个高度？
【询问管制员，4500米是否可用。】
cards.referenceText: We prefer 4,500m/Request 4,500m, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们更喜欢4500米/请求4500米，加航303。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA303, climb to and maintain 4,500m, expedite passing 2,700m.
N: [Read back the instruction and advise the controller you are climbing on reduced thrust and will require some time before reaching that altitude.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航303，上到4500米保持，加速过2700米。
【复诵指令，告知管制员，你正在减推力爬升，在到达那个高度之前需要一些时间。】
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 4,500m, unable expedite due reduced thrust, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上到4500米保持，由于减推力，无法加速爬升，加航303。

cards.audioText:
C: ACA303, are you declaring an emergency?
N: [Tell Wuhan Departure, you are not declaring an emergency at this time, you still have to perform engine checks once you leave the icing area.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航303，你需要宣布紧急情况吗？
【告知武汉离场，现在你不需要宣布紧急情况，你离开积冰区域后，还需要执行发动机检查。】
cards.referenceText: Negative, we will perform engine checks once we leave the icing area, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，我们离开积冰区域后，还需要执行发动机检查，加航303。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, roger, turn right heading 070, climb to and maintain 4,500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，收到，右转航向070，上4500米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 070, climb to and maintain 4,500m, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向070，上4500米保持，加航303。

cards.audioText: N: [You have almost reached 4,500m, your No.3 engine is operating normally, you decided to continue to your destination, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你马上到4500米，你的3号发动机运行正常，你打算继续飞往目的地，呼叫武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA303, approaching 4,500m, No.3 engine is operating normally, we will continue to our destination.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航303，接近4500米，3号发动机运行正常，我们将继续飞往目的地。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, roger, contact Zhengzhou Control on 127.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航303，收到，联系郑州区调127.5。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is ACA587, cruising level 10100m, squawk 3215, approaching DAPRO, make an initiate contact with Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是加航587，巡航高度10100米，应答机3215，接近DAPRO，和广州区调进行初次联系。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA587, maintaining 10100m, approaching DAPRO, squawk 3215.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航587，保持10100米，接近DAPRO，应答机3215。

cards.audioText: ACA587, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, maintain 10100m, report DAPRO.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，广州区调，雷达已识别，保持10100米，到DAPRO报告。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 10100m, report DAPRO, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持10100米，DAPRO报告，加航587。

cards.audioText: [There’s moderate turbulence at 10100m, ask if there’s any turbulence at 10700m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【10100米处有中度颠簸，询问10700米处是否有颠簸。】
cards.referenceText: Control, ACA587, we suffer moderate turbulence at 10100m. Confirm any turbulence reported at 10700m?
cards.referenceTextZh: 区调，加航587，我们在10100米遇到中度颠簸。证实10700米处有报告颠簸么？

cards.audioText: ACA587, no reported turbulence at 10700m.[Ask to climb to 10700m due to moderate turbulence.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，10700米处无颠簸报告。【由于中度颠簸，请求爬升10700米。】
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 10700m due moderate turbulence, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于中度颠簸，请求爬升10700米，加航587。

cards.audioText: ACA587, climb and maintain 10700m within 2min.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，上升保持10700米，2分钟到。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 10700m within 2min, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持10700米，2分钟到，加航587。

cards.audioText: [When you are at 10700m, left engine failed, make an urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6300m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在10700米时，左侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，请求右转航行，并下降6300米。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA587, left engine failure, request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，广州区调，加航587，左侧发动机失效，请求右转，下降6300米。

cards.audioText: ACA587, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，收到PANPAN，右转航向200，下降保持6300米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300m, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向200，下降保持6300米，加航587。

cards.audioText: [Advise Guangzhou Control you want to divert to Wuhan airport, and track direct to WHA, and descend to low level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉广州区调你想改航至武汉机场，直飞WHA，下降至较低高度。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA587, request divert to Wuhan, request direct to WHA, descend to lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航587，请求改航至武汉，直飞WHA，下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: ACA587, turn left direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100m on QNH 1023.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，左转直飞WHA，下降保持修正海压2100米，修正海压1023。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to WHA, descend and maintain 2100m QNH 1023, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞WHA，下降保持修正海压2100米，修正海压1023，加航587。

cards.audioText: [The weather is deteriorating and is below landing minima, ask ATC for ILS approach runway 36L.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【天气状况恶劣，低于着陆最低天气标准，向ATC请求盲降进近跑道36左。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, ACA587, request ILS approach runway 36L due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，加航587，由于天气原因，请求盲降进近跑道36左。

cards.audioText: ACA587, runway 36L not available, runway in use 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，跑道36左不可用，使用跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Landing runway 36R, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在跑道36右降落，加航587。

cards.audioText: [Ask controller is there any restrictions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【询问管制员是否有限制。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA587, confirm any restrictions?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航587，证实是否有其它限制？

cards.audioText: ACA587, no speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Roger, no speed restrictions, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，没有速度限制，加航587。

cards.audioText: [You executed missed approach procedure and try to land on runway 36R. State this situation to Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【执行复飞程序，尝试降落在跑道36右。向塔台报告该情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA587, going around and we try to land runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航587，复飞，我们试降跑道36右。

cards.audioText: ACA587, Tower, climb and maintain 1200m, follow standard missed approach procedure, standby sequences.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，塔台，上升保持1200米，执行标准复飞程序，按顺序等待。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 1200m, standard missed approach procedure, standby sequences, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持1200米，执行标准复飞程序，按顺序等待，加航587。

cards.audioText: ACA587, runway 36R is available now, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，现在跑道36右可用，雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达引导，盲降跑道36右，加航587。

cards.audioText: [You established on runway 36R, and ask Tower for runway braking action.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【建立盲降跑道36右，询问塔台该跑道的刹车效应。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, ACA587, established 36R, request braking action of 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，加航587，建立盲降跑道36右，请求跑道36右刹车效应。

cards.audioText: ACA587, braking action good runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，跑道36右刹车效应好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，加航587。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is ACA989; your destination is Beijing, and you are leaving 1200m and say good-bye to Wuhan Tower. Contact Wuhan Approach and request climb.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是加航989，目的地北京，通过1200米，和武汉塔台告别，联系武汉进近，请求爬升。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA989, passing 1200m, request continue climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航989，离开1200米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Wuhan Approach, good morning, radar contact, follow ZF-1D departure, climb and maintain 1800m on QNH 1013.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，武汉进近，早上好，雷达已识别，ZF-1D离场，上到修正海压1800米保持，修正海压1013。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-1D departure, climb and maintain 1800m on QNH1013, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF-1D离场，上到修正海压1800米保持，修正海压1013，加航989。

cards.audioText: [You just reached 1800m, and you got some moderate chop at the level, inform the controller about that and request 4500m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你刚到达1800米，在这一个高度遇到了中度颠簸，通知管制员该情况并请求爬升4500米。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA989, reaching 1800m, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request 4500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航989，到达1800米，我们遇到了中度颠簸，请求爬升4500米。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Approach, unable to approve 4500m due traffic, 3900m available.[Tell the controller that you want to climb to 3900m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，进近，由于活动，4500米不可用，3900米可用。【告诉管制员你想爬升至3900米。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request climb to 3900m, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求上升3900米，加航989。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that the weather radar shows a cumulonimbus on route ahead about 30Km, and your level is 3900m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员，气象雷达显示航路前方30千米处有积雨云，你的高度是3900米。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA989, maintaining 3900m, the radar indicates a CB ahead of us, about 30km.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航989，3900米保持，雷达显示飞机前方30千米处有积雨云。

cards.audioText: Roger, report your intentions.[Tell the controller that you want radar guidance to go round the CB.]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，报告意图。【告诉管制员你想要雷达引导绕飞积雨云区域。】
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to avoid the CB, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导躲避积雨云，加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, turn left heading 300.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，左转航向300。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 300, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向300，加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, now you are cleared of the weather, climb and maintain 4500m on standard, turn right heading 030 to rejoin the ZF-1D departure.[Acknowledge the controller’s instruction and tell him you want to fly to ZF directly from present position.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，天气好转，上升保持标压4500米，右转航向030重新加入ZF-1D离场。【确认收到管制员指令并告诉他你想从当前位置直飞ZF。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, climb and maintain 4500m on standard. Request direct to ZF. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，上升保持标压4500米。请求直飞ZF。加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, cleared direct to ZF.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，可以直飞ZF。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZF. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞ZF，加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, maintain 4500m, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，4500米保持，联系武汉区调118.1。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 4500m, contact Wuhan Control 118.1, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，4500米保持，联系武汉区调118.1，加航989。

cards.audioText: [You are just over ZF, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你刚过ZF，和武汉区调进行初次联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA989, maintaining 4500m, over ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航989，4500米保持，过ZF。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb and maintain 8900m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，武汉区调，雷达已识别，上升保持8900米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, climb and maintain 8900m, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，上升保持8900米，加航989。

cards.audioText: [A flight attendant told you that there is a male passenger suffering a heart attack. Inform the controller about that, and tell him you want to go back to Wuhan. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【一名乘务员告诉你机上有一名男性乘客心脏病发作。告知管制员这一情况以及想要返回武汉的意图。这是紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, ACA989, we have a male passenger suffering heart attack, request go back to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，加航989，机上一男性乘客突发心脏病，请求返回武汉。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN. Turn right direct to ZF, descend and maintain 4200m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，武汉区调，收到PANPAN。右转直飞ZF，下降保持4200米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200m, turn right direct to ZF, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4200米，右转直飞ZF，加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, do you need any medical assistance?[Tell the controller that you need a physician and an ambulance upon landing or after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，需要医疗援助么？【告诉管制员，你在降落时或着陆后需要一名医生及一辆救护车。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request ambulance and a physician ready on arrival. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求在到达时将医生和救护车准备好。加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989. Roger, an ambulance and a physician will be ready.[A few minutes later.]ACA989, Wuhan Control, maintain 4200m, contact Approach on 118.9.[Read back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989。收到，到达时救护车及医生会准备好。【几分钟后。】加航989，武汉区调，4200米保持，联系进近118.9。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4200m, Approach 118.9, ACA989.

cards.audioText: [Inform Wuhan Approach that you have a passenger suffering heart attack, and request landing priority.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知武汉进近，机上一名乘客心脏病发作，请求优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA989, a passenger suffering heart attack, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航989，一名乘客心脏病发作，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Wuhan Approach, Roger, follow ZF-1A arrival, and descend and maintain 1800m on QNH 1013. Information D.[Read back the controller’s instruction, and ask the detail of information D because you could not receive the information on the radio.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，武汉进近，收到，ZF-1A进场，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1013。通播D。【复诵管制员指令，询问通播D详细内容，因为你并未收到该消息。】
cards.referenceText: ZF-1A arrival; descend and maintain 1800m on QNH 1013. Request details of information D. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF-1A进场，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1013。请求告知通播D详细内容，加航989。

cards.audioText: ACA989, surface wind 350 degrees at 3m/s, visibility 8km, ILS approach runway in use 36R, QNH 1013 Hpa.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，地面风350，3米/秒，能见度8千米，盲降进近跑道36右，修正海压1013。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: ILS approach runway in use 36R, QNH 1013 Hpa. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 盲降进近跑道36右，修正海压1013，加航989。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you want to land at runway 18L visually to save time.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员，为了节省时间，你想进行目视进近跑道18左。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA989, request visual approach runway 18L to save time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航989，为了节约时间，请求目视进近跑道18左。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is ACA647, you are at stand 203, from Wuhan to Tokyo. You just got informed an illegal stowaway on board and he must be taken away by police. Contact Wuhan Ground to delay the pushback.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你的呼号是加航647，你现在在203号停机位，从武汉飞往东京，你刚刚得知一则消息，机上有一名非法偷渡者，必须被警察带走，联系武汉地面，推迟推出]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA647, stand 203, request delay the pushback to disembark the illegal stowaway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航647，203号停机位，请求推迟推出，让非法偷渡者下飞机。

cards.audioText:
ACA647, roger, report POB when ready for push.
[Now you are ready. Contact Ground and request pushback and start up, POB 235.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航647，收到，准备好推出的时候，报告机上人数。
[你现在准备好了，联系地面，请求推出开车，机上人数235]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA647, request pushback and start up, POB235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航647，请求推出开车，机上人数235。

cards.audioText: ACA647, pushback and startup approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航647，同意推出开车，面朝西。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and startup approved, facing west, ACA647.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，面朝西，加航647。

cards.audioText: [During taxiing, the visibility gets worse due sudden dust storm. Tell ATC and request hold position until the visibility gets better.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在滑行过程中，由于沙尘暴，能见度变差，告诉管制员，请求原地等待，直到能见度变好]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA647, request holding position until the visibility improves due dust storm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航647，由于沙尘暴，请求原地等待，直到能见度变好。

cards.audioText: ACA647, the visibility now is 1000m, continue taxi to the holding point runway 18R via Z4, C, contact Tower 124.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航647，能见度现在是1000米，经由Z4，C滑行至跑道18右，联系塔台124.5。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18R via Z4, C, contact 124.5, ACA647.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4，C滑行至跑道18右，联系塔台124.5，加航647。

cards.audioText: [Now you are at the holding point of runway 18R, tell Tower you are ready for takeoff.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在跑道18右等待点，告知管制员，你准备好起飞了]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA647, holding point runway 18R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航647，跑道18右等待点，准备好起飞了。

cards.audioText: After airborne contact departure 119.35, follow the noise abatement procedure, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后，联系119.35，按照降噪程序，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Contact departure 119.35, follow noise abatement procedure, clear for takeoff, runway 18R, ACA647.
cards.referenceTextZh: 联系离场119.35，按照降噪程序，可以起飞，跑道18右，加航647。

cards.audioText: [During takeoff climbing, you encountered the wake turbulence from the preceding aircraft, contact departure to turn right to avoid it.]
cards.audioTextZh: [起飞爬升期间，你遇到前机产生的尾流，联系离场，请求右转避开]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA647, encountering wake turbulence, request turn right to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航647，遇到尾流，请求右转避开。

cards.audioText: ACA647, Wuhan Departure, turn right direct to ZF, climb and maintain 3300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航647，武汉离场，右转直飞ZF，上3300米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to ZF, climb and maintain 3300m, ACA647.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞ZF，上3300米保持，加航647。

cards.audioText: [Now you are leveling at 10700m, your onboard navigation computer has failed. You are flying on raw data, inform Wuhan Control the situation, and request radar vector.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在10700米平飞，你的机载导航计算机故障，你现在按照原始数据飞行，告知武汉区调此情况，请求雷达引导]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA647, leveling at 10700m, our onboard navigation computer has failed. We are flying on raw data, request radar vector.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航647，在10700米平飞，我们的机载导航计算机故障，我们现在按照原始数据飞行，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText: [ATC asks if you can remain RVSM airspace. Tell the controller you need 1 minute to perform the checklist and will advise.]
cards.audioTextZh: [管制员询问你是否可以保持RVSM空域。告知管制员，你需要1分钟来执行检查单，并将告知]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA647, request 1 minute to perform the checklist, and will advise.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航647，请求1分钟来执行检查单，并将告知。

cards.audioText: ACA647, maintain present altitude and turn left heading 010. Keep informed if you cannot remain RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航647，保持当前高度，左转航向010。如无法保持RVSM，请告知。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present altitude and turn left heading 010, keep informed if cannot remain RVSM, ACA647.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，左转航向010。如无法保持RVSM，会告知，加航647。

cards.audioText: [After finishing the checklist, you are unable to remain RVSM due equipment. The malfunction cannot be solved, and the autopilot failed.]
cards.audioTextZh: [完成检查单后，由于设备，你无法保持RVSM。故障无法解决，自动驾驶失效]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA647, we can't remain RVSM due equipment and we can't solve the problem, the autopilot also failed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航647，由于设备，无法保持RVSM。我们无法解决故障，自动驾驶也失效了。

cards.audioText: ACA647, turn right heading 040, descend to 8100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航647，右转航向040，下降到8100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 040, descend to 8100m, ACA647.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向040，下降到8100米，加航647。

cards.audioText: [You want to maintain 8100m, and divert to Beijing.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你想保持在8100米，并改航至北京]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA647, request divert to Beijing and maintain 8100m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航647，请求改航至北京，并在8100米保持。

cards.audioText: ACA647, contact Zhengzhou Control on 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航647，联系郑州区调119.35。
cards.referenceText: Contact Zhengzhou Control on 119.35, ACA647.
cards.referenceTextZh: 联系郑州区调119.35，加航647。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is ACA554, from Wuhan to Vancouver, pushback and start-up have been completed, request Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你的呼号是加航554，从武汉飞往温哥华，已经完成推出开车，向武汉地面请求滑行指令]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA554, pushback and start up completed, request taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航554，已经完成推出开车，请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: ACA554, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point via A7, A, Z4, C.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，武汉地面，经由滑行道A7，A，Z4，C，滑行至等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point via A7, A, Z4, C, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A7，A，Z4，C，滑行至等待点，加航554。

cards.audioText: ACA554, follow the A319 on M to holding point runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，跟随着M上的A319，滑行至跑道18右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Follow the A319 on M to holding point runway 18R, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随着M上的A319，滑行至跑道18右等待点，加航554。

cards.audioText: ACA554, runway 18R is closed due to disable aircraft on the runway. Change your ATC clearance to runway 18L, ZF-12D departure, the rest is unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，由于故障航空器，跑道18右关闭。你的放行许可更改至跑道18左，ZF-12D离场，其余指令不变。
cards.referenceText: Runway 18L, ZF-12D departure, rest unchanged, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道18左，ZF-12D离场，其余未变，加航554。

cards.audioText: ACA554, enter runway 18R from C, vacate runway via C4, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，由C进跑道18右，通过C4脱离跑道，脱离后报。
cards.referenceText: Enter runway 18R from C, vacate runway via C4, report vacated, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由C进跑道18右，通过C4脱离跑道，脱离后报，加航554。

cards.audioText: [Now you have vacated runway 18R via C4, report to Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在已经通过C4脱离跑道18右，报告给地面]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, ACA554, vacated runway 18R via C4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，加航554，已经通过C4脱离跑道18右。

cards.audioText: ACA554, continue taxi to holding point 18L via M, A, A1
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，继续通过M，A，A1，滑行至跑道18左等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi to holding point 18L via M, A, A1, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续通过M，A，A1，滑行至跑道18左等待点，加航554。

cards.audioText: [Now you are airborne, climbing to 1800m, you see a helicopter at 10 o'clock above. It is closing to your aircraft. Inform Wuhan Control and ask for a right turn to avoid the traffic.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在离地了，正爬升至1800米，你看到上方10点钟方向上有一架直升机。它正在接近你的飞机。告知武汉区调，请求右转躲避航空器]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA554, airborne, climbing to 1800m, helicopter at 10 o'clock above. It is closing to my aircraft. Request right turn to avoid the traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航554，离地了，正爬升至1800米，上方10点钟方向上有一架直升机。它正在接近我的飞机。请求右转躲避航空器。

cards.audioText: ACA554, roger, turn right heading 240, expedite climb 2400m, maintain visual separation with the helicopter.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，收到，右转航向240，加速爬升至2400米，与直升机保持目视间隔。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, expedite climb 2400m, maintain visual separation with the helicopter, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，加速爬升至2400米，与直升机保持目视间隔，加航554。

cards.audioText: ACA554, after the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，与航空器解除冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上5100米保持。
cards.referenceText: After the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 与航空器解除冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上5100米保持，加航554。

cards.audioText: [You are now at cruising level 9500m, over OBLIK, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control, your squawk number is 5655.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在到达巡航高度9500米，过OBLIK，与郑州区调做初始联络，你的应答机是5655]
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA554, 9500m, over OBLIK, squawk 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，加航554，9500米，过OBLIK，应答机5655。

cards.audioText: ACA554, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, climb to and maintain 10100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，郑州区调，雷达识别，上10100米保持。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 10100m, ACA554.

cards.audioText: [Suddenly, your cabin crew reports there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. You decide to expedite descent for smoke removal. Make a distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: [突然，你的乘务员报告客舱后部出现有毒烟雾，你决定加速下降，进行除烟，向郑州区调宣布遇险，并请求在3000米改平]
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA554, toxic fume in the rear cabin, we are expediting descent for smoke removal, request level off at 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州区调，加航554，客舱后部出现有毒烟雾，我们加速下降，进行除烟，请求在3000米改平。

cards.audioText:
ACA554, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 030, descend to 3000m, QNH1008, advise intentions when able.
[Tell Zhengzhou Control, the toxic fume is caused by dangerous cargo leakage in cargo hold.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航554，收到MAYDAY，右转航向030，下降到3000米，修正海压1008，如可以，告知意图。
[告诉郑州区调，有毒烟雾是由于货舱危险品泄露导致的]
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, descend to 3000m, QNH1008, the toxic fume is caused by dangerous cargo leakage in cargo hold, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向030，下降到3000米，修正海压1008，有毒烟雾是由于货舱危险品泄露导致的，加航554。

cards.audioText: [Passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume, and become unconscious. Tell Zhengzhou Control the situation and ask for divert to Zhengzhou Airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: [由于有毒烟雾，乘客受到严重影响，失去意识。将情况告知郑州区调，请求改航至郑州机场]
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA554, passengers have been seriously affected by the toxic fume, and become unconscious. Request divert to Zhengzhou Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，加航554，由于有毒烟雾，乘客受到严重影响，失去意识。请求改航至郑州机场。

cards.audioText: ACA554, Zhengzhou Control, roger, turn left heading 360, contact Zhengzhou Approach 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，郑州区调，收到，左转航向360，联系郑州进近120.35。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 360, contact Zhengzhou Approach 120.35, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向360，联系郑州进近120.35，加航554。

cards.audioText: ACA554, Zhengzhou Approach, radar contact, track direct to CGO, maintain 3000m, expect radar vectors for ILS runway 12.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，郑州进近，雷达识别，直飞CGO，保持3000米，预计雷达引导，ILS跑道12。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to CGO, maintain 3000m, expect radar vectors for ILS runway 12, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞CGO，保持3000米，预计雷达引导ILS跑道12，加航554。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is ACA526, from Vancouver to Wuhan, you are cruising at 11000m over OBLIK, squawk 3555.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航526，从温哥华飞往武汉，你现在在11000米巡航，过OBLIK，应答机（编码）3555。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA526, 11000m over OBLIK, squawk 3555.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航526，（高度）11000米，过OBLIK，应答机（编码）3555。

cards.audioText: ACA526, Wuhan control, radar contact, reduce speed to Mach number decimal 75 due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航526，武汉区调，雷达识别，由于流量管控，速度减小至马赫数点75。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to Mach number decimal 75, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 速度减小至马赫数点75，加航526。

cards.audioText: ACA526, descend to and maintain 9200m, adjust speed less than 270 knots until further advised.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航526，下降并保持在9200米，调整速度低于270节直到进一步通知。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 9200m, adjust speed less than 270 knots until further advised, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持在9200米，调整速度低于270节直到进一步通知，加航526。

cards.audioText: [The TCAS indicating converging traffic at 2 o'clock position, below and climbing, confirm if it is a conflicting traffic.]
cards.audioTextZh: [TCAS显示汇入飞机在2点钟位置，下方，正在爬升。证实是否为冲突航空器]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA526, TCAS shows a converging traffic at 2 o'clock, confirm if it is conflict with us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航526，TCAS显示2点钟有汇入航空器，证实是否与我们冲突。

cards.audioText: ACA526, negative, that aircraft is climbing to 8900m, it will cross behind you shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航526，不是，航空器正爬升至8900米，它很快会在你后方穿过。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thank you. ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，加航526。

cards.audioText: [ATIS shows the visibility at Wuhan airport is low. You want to know if your alternate airport Changsha is available for diversion.]
cards.audioTextZh: [机场通播显示武汉机场的能见度很低，你想知道能否备降到长沙机场]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA526, ATIS shows the visibility at Wuhan airport is low, confirm if Changsha is available for diversion.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航526，机场通播显示武汉机场的能见度很低，证实能否备降到长沙。

cards.audioText:
ACA526 Changsha is available, confirm you are diverting to Changsha.
[Tell the controller you are not diverting to Changsha for the moment, you still want to fly to Wuhan.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航526，长沙机场可用，确认你正在改航到长沙。
[告诉管制员你目前不改航到长沙，你依旧想飞往武汉]
cards.referenceText: Negative, we still want to fly to Wuhan, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不了，我们依旧希望飞往武汉，加航526。

cards.audioText: Roger, ACA526. Track direct to ZF, expect ZF-2A arrival runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，加航526，直飞ZF，预计ZF-2A进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to ZF, expect ZF-2A arrival runway 36R. ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞ZF，预计ZF-2A进近，跑道36右，加航526。

cards.audioText: ACA526, descend to and maintain 4200m, maintain minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航526，下降并保持在4200米，保持最小光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4200m, maintain minimum clean speed, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持在4200米，保持最小光洁速度，加航526。

cards.audioText: ACA526, contact approach on 119.6.
[Now you are established on ILS approach runway 36R. You are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你建立了ILS进近，跑道36右。你离接地点15海里，联系塔台]
cards.referenceText:
Wuhan Tower, ACA526, established on ILS approach runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
注：建立航向道/ILS进近后，联系塔台即可。
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航526，建立ILS进近，跑道36右，离接地点15海里。

cards.audioText: Roger. Surface wind calm. RVR touch down 550m, midpoint 600m, rollout 500m. continue approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，地面静风，接地点RVR550米，中间点600米，终止端500米，继续进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText:
Continue approach runway 36R, ACA526.
注：风和RVR值属于情报，无需复诵。
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近跑道36右，加航526。

cards.audioText: [Now you are 10 miles from touchdown. Ask Wuhan Tower for cloud base.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在你距离接地点10海里。询问武汉塔台云底高]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA526, 10 miles from touchdown, confirm the cloud base.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航526，离接地点10海里，证实云底高。

cards.audioText: Cloud broken 700m, cleared to land Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 多云700米，可以落地，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 36R, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道36右，加航526。

cards.audioText: [At the minimum, you are unable to see approach lights. You are carrying out a missed approach procedure. Advise Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在最低高度，你无法看到进近灯，你正在执行复飞程序，告知塔台]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA526, going around, approach lights not in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航526，没有看到进近灯，复飞了。

cards.audioText: Roger, follow the missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，按照标准复飞程序，可以时，告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the missed approach procedure, wilco, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照标准复飞程序，照办，加航526。

cards.audioText: [Now you are climbing to the missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Changsha Airport. Inform Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在爬升到复飞高度，你决定改航到长沙机场，告知塔台]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA526, we are climbing to the missed approach altitude, request divert to Changsha Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航526，我们现在爬升到复飞高度，请求改航到长沙机场。

cards.audioText: Roger, turn right track to LKO, descend to and maintain 2400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，右转直飞LKO，下降并保持到2400米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right track to LKO, descend to and maintain 2400m, ACA526.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞LKO，下降并保持到2400米，加航526。

cards.audioText: ACA526, contact Departure on 120.4, goodbye.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航526，联系离场120.4，再见。
cards.referenceText: 120.4, goodbye. ACA526.

cards.audioText: [Your callsign is ACA909; your destination is Beijing, and you are leaving 1,200m and say good-bye to Wuhan Tower. Contact Wuhan Departure, and request to climb.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航909，你的目的地是北京，你现在离开1200米，和武汉塔台说了再见。联系武汉离场，请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA909, leaving 1,200m, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航909，离开1200米，请求进一步爬升。

cards.audioText: ACA909, Wuhan Departure, good morning, radar contact, follow ZF-01 Departure, climb to 1,800 m on QNH 1013.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，武汉离场，早上好，雷达识别，ZF-01离场，爬升至1800米，QNH1013。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-01 Departure, climb to 1,800 m on QNH1013, ACA909
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF-01离场，爬升至1800米，QNH1013，加航909。

cards.audioText: [You just reached 1,800 m, and you got some moderate chop at the level, inform the controller about that and request 4,500 m.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你刚到达1800米，你在此高度遇到中度颠簸，告知管制员这个清况，请求上4500米]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA909, maintaining 1,800 m, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request 4,500 m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航909，在1800米保持，我们遇到了中度颠簸，请求上4500米。

cards.audioText:
ACA909, Departure, unable to approve 4,500 m due traffic, 3,900 m available
[Tell the controller that you want to climb to 3,900 m]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航909，离场，由于航空器，不同意上4500米，3900米可用。
[告诉管制员你想爬升至3900米]
cards.referenceText: We accept 3,900 m, ACA909
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们接受3900米，加航909。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that the weather radar shows a cumulonimbus on route ahead about 30 Km, and your level is 3,900 m.]
cards.audioTextZh: [告知管制员，气象雷达显示前方30千米处有积雨云，你高度为3900米]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, ACA909, maintaining 3,900 m; the radar indicates a CB ahead of us, about 30 km
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，加航909，在3900米保持，雷达显示前方大概30千米处有积雨云。

cards.audioText:
Roger, report your intentions.
[Tell the controller that you want radar guidance to go round the CB.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，报告你的意图。
[告诉管制员，你希望雷达引导，避开积雨云]
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to circumnavigate the weather ahead. ACA909
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导，避开前方天气，加航909。

cards.audioText: ACA909, turn left heading 300.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，左转航向300。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 300, ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向300，加航909。

cards.audioText:
ACA909, now you are clear of weather, climb to 4,500 m, turn right heading 030 to rejoin the ZF-1 departure.
[Acknowledge the controller’s instruction and tell him you want to fly to ZF directly from present position.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航909，你现在脱离天气了，爬升至4500米，右转航向030，再次加入ZF-1离场程序。
[认收管制员指令，告诉管制员你想从当前位置直飞ZF]
cards.referenceText: Roger, climb to 4,500 m. Request direct to ZF. ACA909
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，爬升至4500米，请求直飞ZF，加航909。

cards.audioText: ACA909, cleared direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，可以直飞ZF。
cards.referenceText: Roger, direct to ZF.ACA909
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，直飞ZF，加航909。

cards.audioText: ACA909, maintain 4,500 m, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，在4500米保持，联系武汉区调118.1。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4,500 m, 118.1, ACA909.

cards.audioText: [You are just over ZF, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你刚飞过ZF，与武汉区调做初始联络]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA909, 4,500 m, over ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航909，,4500米，过ZF。

cards.audioText: ACA909, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to 8,900 m
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，武汉区调，雷达识别，爬升至8900米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, climb to 8,900 m, ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，爬升至8900米，加航909。

cards.audioText: [A flight attendant told you that there is a male passenger suffering a heart attack. Inform the controller about that, and tell him you want to go back to Wuhan. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: [一名乘务员告诉你，一名男性乘客遭遇心脏病。告知管制员情况，告诉他你想返回武汉，这是一个紧急呼叫]
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Wuhan Control, ACA909, we have a male passenger suffering heart attack, request direct back to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan，武汉区调，加航909，我们有一名男性乘客遭遇心脏病，请求返回武汉。

cards.audioText: ACA909, Wuhan Control, roger Panpan. Turn right direct to ZF, and descend to 4,200 m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，武汉区调，收到Pan，右转直飞ZF，下降到4200米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4,200 m, turn right direct to ZF, ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到4200米，右转直飞ZF，加航909。

cards.audioText:
ACA909, do you need any medical assistance?
[Tell the controller that you need a physician and an ambulance upon landing or after landing. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航909，你需要任何医疗援助吗？
[告诉管制员，在着陆时或者着陆后，你需要一名医生以及一辆救护车]
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we need an ambulance and a physician upon arrival. ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们在着陆时需要一辆救护车和一名医生，加航909。

cards.audioText:
Roger, an ambulance and a physician will be ready.
ACA909, Wuhan Control, maintain 4,200 m, contact Approach on 118.9
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，救护车和医生将待命。
加航909，武汉区调，保持4200米，联系进近118.9。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 4,200 m, Approach 118.9, ACA909

cards.audioText: [Inform Wuhan Approach that you have a passenger suffering heart attack, and request landing priority.]
cards.audioTextZh: [告知武汉进近，你有一名乘客遭遇心脏病，并请求优先着陆]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA909, 4200m, we have a passenger suffering heart attack, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航909，高度4200米，我们有一名乘客遭遇心脏病，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
ACA909, Wuhan Approach, roger, radar contact, follow ZF-01A arrival, and descend to 1,800 m on QNH 1013. Information D is valid.
[Readback the controller’s instruction, and ask the detail of information D because you could not receive the information on the radio.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航909，武汉进近，收到，雷达识别，按照ZF-01A进场，下降到1800米，QNH1013，通播D有效。
[复诵管制员的指令，询问通播D的细节，因为你在无线电收不到通播。]
cards.referenceText: Roger, follow ZF-01A arrival; descend to 1,800 m on QNH 1013. Can you repeat the ATIS D, we are unable to pick up on the radio, ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，按照ZF-01A进场，下降到1800米，QNH1013，你能重复通播D吗，我们无线电无法接收此通播，加航909。

cards.audioText: ACA909, Approach, surface wind 350 degrees at 3 m/s, visibility 8 Km, ILS approach, runway in use 36R, QNH 1013 Hpa.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，进近，地面风350度，3米每秒，能见度8千米。ILS进近，使用跑道36右，QNH1013Hpa。
cards.referenceText: ILS approach, runway in use 36R, QNH 1013Hpa. ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 盲降进近，使用跑道36右，QNH1013Hpa，加航909。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you want to land at runway 18L visually to save time.]
cards.audioTextZh: [告知管制员，为了节省时间，你想目视着陆，跑道18左]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA909, request to make a visual approach and land for runway 18L to save time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航909，为了节省时间，请求目视进近并在跑道18左着陆。

cards.audioText: Your all sign is ACA517, Cruising at 10,100m, squawk 3215, approaching DAPRO, make an initial contact with Guangzhou control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航517，在10100米巡航，应答机3215，接近DAPRO，与广州区调进行初始联络。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA517, 10,100m maintaining, squawk 3215, approaching DAPRO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航517，保持在10100米，应答机3215，接近DAPRO。

cards.audioText:
ACA517, radar identified.
There’s moderate turbulence at 10,100m, ask if there’s any turbulence at 10,700m.
cards.audioTextZh:
加航517，雷达识别。
[在10100米有中度颠簸，询问10700米是否有颠簸。]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA517, we encountered moderate turbulence at 10,100m, confirm there is turbulence at 10,700m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航517，我们在10100米遇到中度颠簸，证实10700米是否有颠簸。

cards.audioText:
ACA517, there’s no turbulence at 10,700m.
Ask to climb to 10,700m due moderate turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
加航517，在10700米没有颠簸。
由于中度颠簸，请求爬升至10700米。
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 10,700m due moderate turbulence, ACA517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于中度颠簸，请求爬升至10700米，加航517。

cards.audioText: ACA517, climb to 10,700m within 2 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航517, 2分钟内爬升至10700米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 10,700m within 2 minutes, ACA517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 2分钟内爬升至10700米，加航517。

cards.audioText: When you are at 10,700m, your left engine failed, make an urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 当你在10700米时，你的左发失效了，做紧急呼叫，请求右转下降至6300米。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA517, left engine failure, request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，广州区调，加航517，左发失效，请求右转下降到6300米。

cards.audioText: ACA517, turn right heading 200, descend to 6000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航517，右转航向200，下降到6000米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 200, descend to 6000m, ACA517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向200，下降到6000米，加航517。

cards.audioText: Advise Guangzhou Control you want to divert to Wuhan airport, and track direct to WHA, and descend to lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知广州区调，你想改航到武汉机场，直飞WHA，下降到更低高度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA517, request to divert to Wuhan and direct to WHA, descend to lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航517，请求备降至武汉机场，直飞WHA，下降到更低高度。

cards.audioText: ACA517, turn left direct to WHA, descend to 2100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航517，左转直飞WHA，下降到2100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to WHA, descend to 2100m, ACA517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞WHA，下降到2100米，加航517。

cards.audioText: The weather is deteriorating and is below landing minima, ask for ILS approach for runwy 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 天气正在降级，已低于最低着陆标准，请求ILS进近，跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA517, request ILS approach for runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航517，请求ILS进近，跑道36左。

cards.audioText: ACA517, runway 36L is not available, runway in use 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航517，跑道36左不可用，使用跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Runway in use 36R, ACA517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 使用跑道36右，加航517。

cards.audioText: ACA517, no speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航517，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: No speed restrictions, ACA517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有速度限制，加航517。

cards.audioText: You executed missed approach procedure and try to land on runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 你执行了复飞程序，想尝试在跑道36右着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA517, going around and we try to land on runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航517，复飞了，我们尝试下在跑道36右着陆。

cards.audioText: ACA517, climb to 1200m, follow standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航517，爬升到1200米，按照标准复飞程序。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 1200m, follow standard missed approach procedure, ACA517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到1200米，按照标准复飞程序，加航517。

topics.name: CCA 101 地面障碍 沙暴双发失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 101 at Beijing Airport, your parking bay is 531 with information S, request ATC clearance to HongKong.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 Beijing Airport 的 CCA 101，停机位 531，收到信息 S，请求前往 HongKong 的 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA 101, bay 531, information S, request ATC clearance to HongKong.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CCA 101，531 号停机位，信息 S，请求前往 HongKong 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, cleared to HongKong via flight planned route, Runway 36L, RENOB-02 departure, initial altitude 900 meters, expect en-route altitude 10 minutes after departure, departure frequency 119.65. Call me ready for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，可以按计划航路前往 HongKong，跑道 36L，RENOB-02 离场，初始高度 900 米，预计离场后 10 分钟给途中高度，离场频率 119.65。准备推出和开车时呼叫我。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to HongKong via flight planned route, Runway 36L, RENOB-02 departure, initial altitude 900m, expect en-route altitude 10min after departure, departure frequency 119.65, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 HongKong，跑道 36L，RENOB-02 离场，初始高度 900 米，预计离场后 10 分钟给途中高度，离场频率 119.65，CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
B: You are now at the holding point of Runway 36R.
C: CCA 101, behind the departing Airbus 330, cross Runway 36R behind, then taxi via E and hold short of Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 你现在在跑道 36R 等待点。
C: CCA 101，在离场 Airbus 330 后面，跟在其后穿越跑道 36R，然后经 E 滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Behind A330, cross Runway 36R behind, taxi via E and hold short of Runway 36L, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟在 A330 后面，在其后穿越跑道 36R，经 E 滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing, you observed a cone marker in front of you on the taxiway E, you have stopped the aircraft, report the situation to ATC and confirm if the taxiway E is closed.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 滑行中，你在滑行道 E 前方看到一个锥形标志，你已停住飞机，向 ATC 报告情况并确认滑行道 E 是否关闭。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 101, a cone marker in front of us on the taxiway E, we have stopped, is the taxiway E closed?
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 101，滑行道 E 上我们前方有一个锥形标志，我们已停住，滑行道 E 是否关闭？

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, negative, taxiway E is fully open, are you able to taxi around it?
B: Tell ATC that you are unable to taxi around it and request ground personnel to remove it.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 101，否，滑行道 E 完全开放，你能绕过它滑行吗？
B: 告诉 ATC 你无法绕过它，请求地面人员移除。
cards.referenceText: We are unable to taxi around it, request ground personnel to remove it, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们无法绕过它，请求地面人员移除，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, roger, hold present position.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，收到，原地等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold present position, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
B: Several minutes later.
C: CCA 101, Ground, the safety officer confirms the taxiway is now clear, continue on E and hold short of Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 几分钟后。
C: CCA 101，地面，安全员确认滑行道现在已清空，继续在 E 上滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue on E and hold short of Runway 36L, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续在 E 上滑行并在跑道 36L 前等待，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are now at the holding point of Runway 36L, tell ATC that you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在跑道 36L 等待点，告诉 ATC 你准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 101, holding point of Runway 36L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 101，跑道 36L 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, behind landing traffic line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，在着陆交通后面，跟在后面进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind landing traffic line up behind, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在着陆交通后面进跑道，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: It is much later, you initiate approach, you have reached 15000 meters and request further descent, call HongKong Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 很久以后，你开始进近，已到达 15000 米并请求继续下降，呼叫 香港进近。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA 101, maintain 15000m, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA 101，保持 15000 米，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, maintain 15000 meters, opposite traffic 2 o’clock 10 miles, report clear of traffic.
B: Tell the controller you are clear of the other aircraft and request to fly lower.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 101，保持 15000 米，相对交通 2 点钟方向 10 海里，报告脱离交通。
B: 告诉管制员你已脱离另一架飞机，并请求降低高度。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA 101, clear of traffic, request to fly lower.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA 101，脱离交通，请求降低高度。

cards.audioText: B: You were cleared to 5000 meters but notice the sky turning dark and visibility is getting worse quickly, you suspect a sand storm. Tell HongKong Approach this situation and ask ATC if there is a sandstorm forecast.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你获准下降到 5000 米，但注意到天空变暗、能见度迅速变差，你怀疑有沙尘暴。向香港进近说明情况，并询问 ATC 是否有沙尘暴预报。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA 101, the sky turning dark and visibility is getting worse quickly, we suspect a sandstorm, is there a sandstorm forecast?
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA 101，天空变暗，能见度迅速变差，我们怀疑有沙尘暴，是否有沙尘暴预报？

cards.audioText: B: The sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor. Inform ATC the situation and ask to climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 沙尘暴非常严重，现在能见度很差。通知 ATC 情况，并请求爬升到较高高度以越过沙尘暴。
cards.referenceText: HongKong Approach, CCA 101, the sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor, request climb to a higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港进近，CCA 101，沙尘暴非常严重，现在能见度很差，请求爬升到较高高度以越过沙尘暴。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, climb and maintain 7000 meters and turn right heading 210.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，爬升并保持 7000 米，右转航向 210。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 7000m, turn right heading 210, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 7000 米，右转航向 210，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, your No.1 and No.2 engines have flamed out due to the dust storm, request radar vectors to HongKong Airport for priority landing. This is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 突然，由于沙尘暴，你的 1 号和 2 号发动机熄火，请求雷达引导至 HongKong Airport 优先着陆。这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, HongKong Approach, CCA 101, our No.1 and No.2 engines have flamed out due to the dust storm, request radar vectors to HongKong Airport for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，香港进近，CCA 101，由于沙尘暴，我们的 1 号和 2 号发动机熄火，请求雷达引导至 HongKong Airport 优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 260, this will take you direct to HongKong, the weather at HongKong Airport is clear.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，收到 Mayday，右转航向 260，这将使你直飞 HongKong，HongKong Airport 天气晴好。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 260, roger, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 260，收到，CCA 101。

topics.name: CCA 105 装没听清许可 跑道入侵

cards.audioText:
B: You are the pilot of CCA 105 and now waiting for ATC clearance.
C: CCA 105 is cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, cruising level 9200 meters, LKO-1D departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne.
B: The tower controllers voice is disturbed, and you didn't hear the words after 9200 meters, ask the controller to repeat the latter part of the instruction.
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 你是 CCA 105 的飞行员，现在等待 ATC 许可。
C: CCA 105 可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，巡航高度 9200 米，LKO-1D 离场，应答机 2052，离地后联系武汉进近118.9。
B: 塔台管制员声音受干扰，你没有听到 9200 米之后的话，请管制员重复指令后半部分。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 105, say again after 9200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 105，请重复 9200 米之后内容。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 105, cruising level 9200 meters, LKO-1D departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 105，巡航高度 9200 米，LKO-1D 离场，应答机 2052，离地后联系武汉进近118.9。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, cruising level 9200 meters, LKO-1D departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，巡航高度 9200 米，LKO-1D 离场，应答机 2052，离地后联系武汉进近118.9，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: B: You have completed the relevant checklist, ask the Tower controller to let you to start your engine.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已完成相关检查单，请求塔台管制员允许你起动发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 105, request startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 105，请求开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 105, startup is approved, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 105，开车批准，准备滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Start up approved, call you ready for taxi, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 开车批准，准备滑行时呼叫你，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready to taxi out, ask the Tower controller for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备滑出，向塔台管制员请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 105, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 105，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 105, taxi via taxiway A7 and A to holding point of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 105，经滑行道 A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway A7 and A to holding point of Runway 36R, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 105。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 105, hold position, traffic ten o'clock, approaching you from your left.
B: Acknowledge the instruction, and inform the controller that you have seen the traffic.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 105，原地等待，交通在 10 点钟方向，从你左侧接近。
B: 确认指令，并通知管制员你已看到该交通。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, traffic in sight, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，看到交通，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: B: Later, you are approaching the active Runway 36R, ask the Tower controller for permission to enter the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 稍后，你接近使用中的跑道 36R，向塔台管制员请求进入跑道许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 105, approaching Runway 36R, request line up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 105，接近跑道 36R，请求进跑道。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 105, line up and wait.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 105，进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道等待，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 105, cleared for take off Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 105，跑道 36R 可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for take off Runway 36R, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以起飞，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: B: This is a night operation. When you are running out your speed has just retrieved V R, you suddenly see a slow moving object ahead of you, it is crossing the runway from left to right. You pull backs and rotate to avoid the traffic, and you felt a shake from the nose gear. You get airborne at time 23, and report the accident to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 这是夜间运行。当你加速滑跑速度刚到 VR 时，突然看到前方有一个缓慢移动物体，正从左向右穿越跑道。你拉杆抬轮避让该交通，并感觉前起落架震动。你在 23 分离地，向武汉进近报告事故。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 105, airborne at time 23, we encountered runway incursion during take off, a slow moving object ahead of us, it is crossing the runway from left to right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 105，23 分离地，我们起飞时遭遇跑道侵入，前方有缓慢移动物体，正从左向右穿越跑道。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 105, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, is there any damage to the aircraft? Report your intentions.
B: Tell the Approach controller that you want to land at Wuhan Airport, and you don't know about any damage.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 105，武汉进近，雷达识别，飞机是否受损？报告你的意图。
B: 告诉进近管制员你想在 Wuhan Airport 着陆，不知道是否有损伤。
cards.referenceText: We want to land at Wuhan Airport, and we are not sure about any damage, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们想在 Wuhan Airport 着陆，不确定是否有损伤，CCA 105。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 105, roger, do you want to hold and have a check?
B: Tell the controller that you do want to hold and check.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 105，收到，你想等待并检查吗？
B: 告诉管制员你确实想等待并检查。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA 105, climb to 900 meters on QNH 1011, turn left direct to DA and hold over DA.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，CCA 105，按 QNH 1011 爬升到 900 米，左转直飞 DA 并在 DA 上空等待。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 900 meters on QNH 1011, turn left direct to DA and hold over DA, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1011 爬升到 900 米，左转直飞 DA 并在 DA 上空等待，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you found out that there is something wrong with the nose gear, tell the controller you need to dump fuel before landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你发现前起落架有问题，告诉管制员着陆前需要放油。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 105, we have something wrong with the nose gear, request dump fuel before landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 105，我们前起落架有问题，请求着陆前放油。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA 105, climb to 2100 meters on QNH, turn left heading 130, radar vector to the dumping area.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，CCA 105，按 QNH 爬升到 2100 米，左转航向 130，雷达引导至放油区。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2100 meters on QNH, turn left heading 130, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 爬升到 2100 米，左转航向 130，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: B: Later, inform the controller that you have finished the fuel dumping and want to be radar guided to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 稍后，通知管制员你已完成放油，并希望雷达引导至 Wuhan Airport。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 105, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 105，放油完成，请求雷达引导至 Wuhan。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 105, descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 290, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 105，下降到 900 米，右转航向 290，雷达引导跑道 36L ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 290, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36L, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 900 米，右转航向 290，雷达引导跑道 36L ILS 进近，CCA 105。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 105, do you need any assistance upon landing?
B: Tell the controller that you are going to make a landing without nose gear, you need fire trucks and a foamed runway.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 105，着陆时你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你将不放前起落架着陆，需要消防车和铺泡沫跑道。
cards.referenceText: We are going to land without the nose gear, we need fire trucks and a foamed runway, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们将不放前起落架着陆，需要消防车和铺泡沫跑道，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA 105, foamed runway and fire trucks will be ready upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，CCA 105，铺泡沫跑道和消防车将在着陆时准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 105, reduce speed to 180 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 105，减速到 180 节。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to 180 knots, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减速到 180 节，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 105, turn left heading 330 to intercept the localizer for Runway 36L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 105，左转航向 330 切入跑道 36L 航向道，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 330 to intercept the localizer for Runway 36L, report established, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 330 切入跑道 36L 航向道，建立后报告，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you have captured the localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你已截获航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 105, ILS established.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 105，ILS 已建立。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA 105, cleared ILS approach Runway 36L, 13 miles from touchdown, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，CCA 105，可以跑道 36L ILS 进近，距接地点 13 海里，雷达服务终止，联系武汉塔台124.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach Runway 36L, 124.35, CCA 105.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以跑道 36L ILS 进近，124.35，CCA 105。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 425, stand 08, from Wuhan to Tokyo, information K received, request ATC clearance to Tokyo.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 425，08 号机位，从 Wuhan 到 Tokyo，已收到信息 K，请求前往 Tokyo 的 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 425, stand 08, information K, request ATC clearance to Tokyo.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 425，08 号机位，信息 K，请求前往 Tokyo 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 425, cleared to Tokyo via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, climb and maintain 1500 meters initially, cruising level 10100 meters, Runway 36R, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 6325.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 425，可以按计划航路前往 Tokyo，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升并保持 1500 米，巡航高度 10100 米，跑道 36R，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Tokyo via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, climb and maintain 1500m initially, cruising level 10100m, Runway 36R, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 6325, CCA 425.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Tokyo，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升并保持 1500 米，巡航高度 10100 米，跑道 36R，联系离场 119.7，应答机 6325，CCA 425。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在准备好，联系 地面请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 425, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 425，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 425, push back and start up approved, facing East.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 425，推出和开车批准，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing East, CCA 425.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝东，CCA 425。

cards.audioText: B: While taxiing, you noticed the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 滑行时，你注意到风袋显示强顺风，联系 塔台 检查风。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 425, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 425，请求检查风。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 425, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 425，地面风 220 度，8 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA 425.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CCA 425。

cards.audioText: B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to Runway 18L and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系 塔台请求改用跑道 18L 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 425, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 425，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 18L。

cards.audioText: B: You are now at cruising level 10100 meters, few minutes later, you find out you have flown into volcanic ash cloud, No.1 engine has stalled and then flamed out. Make an urgency call, state your situation and request return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在巡航高度 10100 米，几分钟后发现飞入火山灰云，1 号发动机喘振后熄火。发出紧急呼叫，说明情况并请求返回 Wuhan Airport。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CCA 425, we have flown into volcanic ash cloud, No.1 engine has stalled and then flamed out, request return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，CCA 425，我们飞入火山灰云，1 号发动机喘振后熄火，请求返回 Wuhan Airport。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 425, roger your PAN, turn left heading 060, descend and maintain 4200 meters, wait for further instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 425，收到你的 PAN，左转航向 060，下降并保持 4200 米，等待进一步指令。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 060, descend and maintain 4200m, CCA 425.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 060，下降并保持 4200 米，CCA 425。

cards.audioText: B: You are leveling off at 4200 meters, you find out everything is clear, you decide to restart the No.1 engine, tell ATC your decision.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你正在 4200 米改平，发现一切正常，决定重启 1 号发动机，告诉 ATC 你的决定。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA 425, maintain 4200m, everything is clear, we decide to restart the No.1 engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CCA 425，保持 4200 米，一切正常，我们决定重启 1 号发动机。

cards.audioText: B: Your No.1 engine restarted, tell ATC you decide to continue to the destination, request their approval.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的 1 号发动机重启成功，告诉 ATC 你决定继续飞往目的地，请求批准。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA 425, our No.1 engine restarted, request continue to Tokyo.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CCA 425，我们的 1 号发动机已重启，请求继续飞往 Tokyo。

topics.name: CCA 878 乘客心脏病 一发脱离

cards.audioText: B: Tell the Tower you are ready to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 塔台 你准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Sanya Tower, CCA 878, ready to taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三亚塔台，CCA 878，准备滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 878, taxi to holding point of Runway 08 via taxiway E2 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 878，经滑行道 E2 和 A 滑行至跑道 08 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of Runway 08 via taxiway E2 and A, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 E2 和 A 滑行至跑道 08 等待点，CCA 878。

cards.audioText: B: As you are taxiing, the purser calls you on the intercom, you have a passenger who have become very ill and you must return to the gate, tell air traffic controllers this.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 滑行时，乘务长通过内话呼叫你，有一名旅客病情很重，你必须返回登机口，把这件事告诉空中交通管制员。
cards.referenceText: Sanya Tower, CCA 878, we have a passenger who have become very ill and we have to return to the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三亚塔台，CCA 878，我们有一名旅客病情很重，必须返回登机口。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 878, roger, continue taxi via A, cleared to enter the runway, then exit left via E, continue to gate 7.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 878，收到，继续经 A 滑行，可以进入跑道，然后经 E 左转脱离，继续到 7 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi via A, cleared to enter the runway, then exit left via E, continue to gate 7, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续经 A 滑行，可以进入跑道，然后经 E 左转脱离，继续到 7 号登机口，CCA 878。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 878, can you tell us the exact problem the passenger has.
B: Tell air traffic control the passenger has suffered a heart attack and you were treating him with oxygen.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 878，能告诉我们旅客的具体问题吗？
B: 告诉空中交通管制，旅客心脏病发作，你们正在给他吸氧。
cards.referenceText: The passenger has suffered a heart attack and we are treating him with oxygen, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 该旅客心脏病发作，我们正在给他吸氧，CCA 878。

cards.audioText: B: It is now thirty minutes later in the day, the sick passenger has disembarked and you were at the holding point for Runway 08, tell the Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在是当天 30 分钟后，患病旅客已下机，你在跑道 08 等待点，告诉 塔台 你准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Sanya Tower, CCA 878, hold at holding point Runway 08, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三亚塔台，CCA 878，在跑道 08 等待点等待，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 878, line up and wait.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 878，进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道等待，CCA 878。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 878, hold position for 5 minutes due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 878，由于流量控制，原地等待 5 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，CCA 878。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 878, after departure, maintain runway heading and climb 900 meters, cleared for takeoff, Runway 08, surface wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 878，离场后保持跑道航向并爬升 900 米，跑道 08 可以起飞，地面风静风。
cards.referenceText: After departure, maintain runway heading and climb 900 meters, cleared for takeoff, Runway 08, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场后保持跑道航向并爬升 900 米，跑道 08 可以起飞，CCA 878。

cards.audioText: B: It is now later in the flight and you are experiencing some light turbulence, request a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在飞行后段，你正在经历轻度颠簸，请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Sanya Control, CCA 878, we are experiencing light turbulence, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三亚管制，CCA 878，我们正在经历轻度颠簸，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 878, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 878，爬升并保持 10100 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 10100 meters, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 10100 米，CCA 878。

cards.audioText: B: You reach 10100 meters, but the turbulence is now worse and is now class to severe, ask to climb to 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你到达 10100 米，但颠簸现在更严重，已接近严重，请求爬升到 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Sanya Control, CCA 878, request climb to 10700 meters due severe turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三亚管制，CCA 878，因严重颠簸请求爬升到 10700 米。

cards.audioText:
C: 10700 meters not available, we can give you a lower level if you require.
B: Tell the controller you require a lower level.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 10700 米不可用，如需要，我们可以给你较低高度。
B: 告诉管制员你需要较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request a lower level, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求较低高度，CCA 878。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, 1 of your engines separates, tell air traffic control this and say you would like to descend to 8100 meters and divert to Shanghai, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 突然，你的一台发动机脱落，告诉空中交通管制，并说你想下降到 8100 米并改航 Shanghai，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Sanya Control, CCA 878, 1 of our engines separated, request descend to 8100 meters and divert to Shanghai.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，三亚管制，CCA 878，我们一台发动机脱落，请求下降到 8100 米并改航 Shanghai。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 878, roger MAYDAY, turn left heading 230, and descent to 8100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 878，收到 MAYDAY，左转航向 230，下降到 8100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 230, and descent to 8100 meters, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 230，下降到 8100 米，CCA 878。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 878, all runway is will be available at Shanghai Pudong for you, surface wind calm.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 878，Shanghai Pudong 所有跑道都将可供你使用，地面风静风。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CCA 878。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 878, descend to 3300 meters, flight direct DUMET.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 878，下降到 3300 米，直飞 DUMET。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3300 meters, flight direct DUMET, CCA 878.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 3300 米，直飞 DUMET，CCA 878。

topics.name: CCA 124 疑似起飞鸟击 右发熄火

cards.audioText: B: You are parked on stand D3 and have listened to the ATIS with information P, please ask Beijing Delivery for your ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你停在 D3 机位，已收听 ATIS 信息 P，请向北京放行请求 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA 124, stand D3, information P, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CCA 124，D3 机位，信息 P，请求前往 London 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, is cleared to London via flight planned route, cruising level 10400 meters, initial climb 900 meters on 1023, follow VYK-05D departure, contact 120.6, squawk 4523.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，可以按计划航路前往 London，巡航高度 10400 米，初始爬升 900 米按 1023，执行 VYK-05D 离场，联系 120.6，应答机 4523。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London via flight planned route, cruising level 10400 meters, initial climb 900 meters on 1023, follow VYK-05D departure, contact 120.6, squawk 4523, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 London，巡航高度 10400 米，初始爬升 900 米按 1023，执行 VYK-05D 离场，联系 120.6，应答机 4523，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready to push back and start up, contact ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在准备推出和开车，联系 ATC。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 124, ready for pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 124，准备推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, push back approved, facing east, start up at your own discretion, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，推出批准，机头朝东，自行决定开车，准备滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing east, start up at own discretion, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出批准，机头朝东，自行决定开车，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, call ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备滑行，呼叫 ATC。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 124, ready to taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 124，准备滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, taxi via Z6 and F to the holding point Runway 36R, caution work in progress on the intersection of taxiway Z3 and Z6.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，经 Z6 和 F 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，注意滑行道 Z3 和 Z6 交叉口有施工。
cards.referenceText: Roger, taxi via Z6 and F to holding point Runway 36R, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，经 Z6 和 F 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: A ground vehicle crossing taxiway F, suddenly appears in front of you near the intersection of Z3 and Z6, you nearly hit it, inform to controller about this.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 一辆穿越滑行道 F 的地面车辆突然出现在你前方，靠近 Z3 和 Z6 交叉口，你差点撞上，向管制员通报。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 124, a ground vehicle crossing taxiway F, suddenly appears in front of me near the intersection of Z3 and Z6, we nearly hit it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 124，一辆穿越滑行道 F 的地面车辆突然出现在我前方，靠近 Z3 和 Z6 交叉口，我们差点撞上。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 124, yeah, it's an online vehicle, um just been informed that it was an ambulance attending an injured workman, is everything okay with your aircraft?
B: Tell the controller that you applied maximum brake to stop the airplane, but the flight attendant has not given you any injury reports.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 124，是的，那是一辆在线车辆，呃刚获知它是去处理受伤工人的救护车，你的飞机一切正常吗？
B: 告诉管制员你使用最大刹车停住飞机，但乘务员没有给你任何受伤报告。
cards.referenceText: We applied maximum brake to stop the airplane, but there was no injury report, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们使用最大刹车停住飞机，但没有受伤报告，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, continue taxi to the holding point of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，继续滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi to the holding point of Runway 36R, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, Ground, contact Beijing on 118.7, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，地面，联系 Beijing 118.7，再见。
cards.referenceText: 118.7, good day, CCA 124.

cards.audioText: B: Contact the Tower and tell them you are approaching the end of your taxi at the holding point, and you are now ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系 塔台，告诉他们你接近滑行终点的等待点，现在准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 124, we are approaching the holding point of Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 124，我们正接近跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, roger, line up and wait.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，收到，进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道等待，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for takeoff, call the Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备起飞，呼叫 塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 124, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 124，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, cleared for takeoff, wind 340 at 7 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，可以起飞，风 340，7 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, continue VYK-05D departure, contact Departure on 120.6, good bye.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，继续 VYK-05D 离场，联系 Departure 120.6，再见。
cards.referenceText: Continue VYK-05D departure, contact Departure on 120.6, good bye, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续 VYK-05D 离场，联系 Departure 120.6，再见，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: You fly through a flock of birds, called Beijing Departure and tell them you may have hit a bird during takeoff, the left engine EGT is higher and you want to hold at CDY to carry out a check.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你穿过一群鸟，呼叫 Beijing Departure 并告诉他们你起飞时可能撞鸟，左发 EGT 较高，想在 CDY 等待以进行检查。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CCA 124, we fly through a flock of birds, maybe we hit a bird during takeoff, the left engine EGT is higher, request hold at CDY for check.
cards.referenceTextZh: Beijing Departure，CCA 124，我们穿过一群鸟，起飞时可能撞鸟，左发 EGT 较高，请求在 CDY 等待检查。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, continue climb to 900 meters on QNH 1023, turn right, direct to CDY and hold at CDY at 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，按 QNH 1023 继续爬升到 900 米，右转，直飞 CDY，并在 CDY900 米等待。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 900 meters on QNH 1023, turn right direct to CDY and hold at CDY at 900 meters, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1023 爬升到 900 米，右转直飞 CDY，并在 CDY 900 米等待，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller you now have a right engine flame out, and you wish to return to Beijing after the fuel dumping, this is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知管制员你现在右发熄火，希望放油后返回 Beijing，这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, CCA 124, right engine flame out, request return to Beijing after dump fuel.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，Beijing Departure，CCA 124，右发熄火，请求放油后返回 Beijing。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 124, roger PAN, maintain 900 meters on QNH, turn left heading 020 degrees, radar vectors to the dumping area.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 124，收到 PAN，按 QNH 保持 900 米，左转航向 020 度，雷达引导至放油区。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 900 meters on QNH, turn left heading 020 degrees, CCA 124.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 保持 900 米，左转航向 020 度，CCA 124。

cards.audioText: B: You have arrived at the dumping area and have finished dumping fuel, inform the controller that you have completed fuel dumping and request radar guidance back to Beijing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已到达放油区并完成放油，通知管制员放油完成，请求雷达引导返回 Beijing。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CCA 124, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector back to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Beijing Departure，CCA 124，放油完成，请求雷达引导返回 Beijing。

topics.name: CCA 101 撞未知物体 风挡裂

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 101 and you are at Wuhan Airport, you are now taxiing on taxiway A3 to taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 101，位于 Wuhan Airport，现在正在从滑行道 A3 滑向滑行道 A。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 101, taxiing from taxiway A3 to A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 101，正从滑行道 A3 滑向 A。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, taxi with extreme caution and keep close to the centerline of your taxiway.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，极其谨慎滑行，并靠近你所在滑行道中心线。
cards.referenceText: Keep close to the centerline of the taxiway, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 靠近滑行道中心线，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: You want to check with Wuhan Ground for NOTAM bulletin A0011.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你想向武汉地面确认 NOTAM 通告 A0011。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 101, confirm NOTAM A0011.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 101，确认 NOTAM A0011。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, latest bulletin A0011 says taxiway A3 is newly repaired on the second mid section of the left side.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，最新通告 A0011 说滑行道 A3 左侧第二中段新近修复。
cards.referenceText: Roger, taxiway A3 is newly repaired on the second mid section of the left side, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，滑行道 A3 左侧第二中段新近修复，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are approaching the holding point of Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你正接近跑道 36R 等待点，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 101, approaching the holding point of Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 101，接近跑道 36R 等待点。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, hold short, traffic on final.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，等待，五边有交通。
cards.referenceText: Hold short, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, we've just been informed a large bird was sacked into your port engine a moment, please check.
B: Say your EGT of port engine is not in normal range, you figure something is wrong and you ask the controller for his instruction.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 101，我们刚被告知一只大鸟刚才被吸入你的左发，请检查。
B: 说你的左发 EGT 不在正常范围，你判断有问题，并向管制员请求指令。
cards.referenceText: Roger, our EGT of port engine is not in normal range, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们左发 EGT 不在正常范围，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, hold at your present position.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，在当前位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置等待，CCA 101。
