cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, the maintenance department asked you to shut down the right engine straight away.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，维修部门要求你立即关停右发。
cards.referenceText: We will shut down the engine, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们将关停发动机，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, we send you a tug to tow you back to the maintenance bay.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，我们派拖车把你拖回维修机位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
B: After settling the problem, you took off, now you are under Departure control.
C: CCA 101, cancel SID, track direct to GH, climb and maintain 1800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 解决问题后，你起飞了，现在由 Departure 管制。
C: CCA 101，取消 SID，直飞 GH，爬升并保持 1800 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, track direct to GH, climb and maintain 1800 meters, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，直飞 GH，爬升并保持 1800 米，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are now over GH, report to ATC that you have observed a balloon at your eleven o'clock position 3 miles away.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在 GH 上空，向 ATC 报告在 11 点钟方向 3 海里处看到一个气球。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 101, over GH, we observed a balloon at our 11 o'clock position 3 miles away.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA 101，过 GH，我们在 11 点钟方向 3 海里处看到一个气球。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, 101, climb to and maintain 3900 meters on standard, i'll check the balloon.
B: Report to ATC you collided with an unknown foreign object, the windshield is broken.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，101，按标准气压爬升并保持 3900 米，我会查明该气球。
B: 向 ATC 报告你撞上了不明外来物，风挡破裂。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3900 meters on standard, we collided with an unknown foreign object, the windshield is broken, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升并保持 3900 米，我们撞上不明外来物，风挡破裂，CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, 101, say your intention.
B: Tell ATC that you decide to go back to the departing airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，101，说明你的意图。
B: 告诉 ATC 你决定返回起飞机场。
cards.referenceText: Request go back to the departing airport, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求返回起飞机场，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, turn left heading 280.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，左转航向 280。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 280, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 280，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, turn left heading 240.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，左转航向 240。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 240, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 240，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Your TCAS is activated, and your aircraft is descending under TCAS control, report to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的 TCAS 启动，飞机正在 TCAS 控制下下降，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 101, TCAS descending.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA 101，TCAS 下降。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, what is the problem?
B: Tell the controller you have a conflicting traffic, it's Boeing 757, at about 2 o'clock from right to left.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，是什么问题？
B: 告诉管制员你有冲突交通，是 Boeing 757，约在 2 点钟方向从右向左。
cards.referenceText: We have a conflicting traffic, it's B757, at about 2 o'clock from right to left, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们有冲突交通，是 B757，约在 2 点钟方向从右向左，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, 101, turn left heading 210, descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1002.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，101，左转航向 210，按 QNH 1002 下降到 1200 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 210, descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1002, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 210，按 QNH 1002 下降到 1200 米，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, turn left heading 070, this will lead you ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，左转航向 070，这将引导你进行跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 070, ILS approach Runway 36R, report established, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 070，跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA 101。

topics.name: CCA 512 右发失效 重启失败

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 512, you are at Wuhan Airport, parking at gate 211, you have got information V, request ATC clearance to Changsha from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 512，位于 Wuhan Airport，停在 211 号登机口，已收到信息 V，向武汉放行请求前往 Changsha 的 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 512, gate 211, information V, request ATC clearance to Changsha.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 512，211 号登机口，信息 V，请求前往 Changsha 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, Runway 04, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2016.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，可以按计划航路前往 Changsha，LKO-02 离场，初始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 8400 米，跑道 04，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2016。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb 1800 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, Runway 04, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2016, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Changsha，LKO-02 离场，初始爬升 1800 米，巡航高度 8400 米，跑道 04，离场频率 119.7，应答机 2016，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 512, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 512，准备推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，推出和开车批准，机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝东，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: B: You are now on the taxiway Z4 with engines running, ask Ground control for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在滑行道 Z4，发动机运转，向 地面 管制请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 512, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 512，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，经滑行道 Z4 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 A4 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 A4 前等待，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, caution work in progress near the right side of A3.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，注意 A3 右侧附近有施工。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, give way to Airbus 320 vacating on E3, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via A, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，给正在 E3 脱离的 Airbus 320 让路，交通解除后，继续经 A 滑行，在跑道 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Traffic in sight, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via A, hold short of Runway 04, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 看到交通，交通解除后，继续经 A 滑行，在跑道 04 前等待，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne at 900 meters climbing, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已离地，900 米爬升，联系 Wuhan Departure。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 512, airborne, 900 meters climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA 512，已离地，900 米爬升。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1020.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，Wuhan Departure，雷达识别，左转，直飞 DA，按 QNH 1020 爬升到 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1020, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DA，按 QNH 1020 爬升到 3000 米，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, climb to and maintain 6600 meters, expedite until passing 3900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，爬升并保持 6600 米，通过 3900 米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6600 meters, expedite until passing 3900 meters, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 6600 米，通过 3900 米前加快爬升，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: B: You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6600 meters, request a higher level and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你保持 6600 米时遭遇中度积冰，请求更高高度并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA 512, maintaining 6600 meters, we are experiencing moderate icing, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CCA 512，保持 6600 米，我们遭遇中度积冰，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, climb to and maintain 7200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，爬升并保持 7200 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 7200 meters, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 7200 米，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, your starboard engine failed at 7200 meters, make an Urgency call to ATC and request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 突然，你的右侧发动机在 7200 米失效，向 ATC 发出紧急呼叫，并请求下降和返回 Wuhan Airport。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CCA 512, our starboard engine failed at 7200 meters, request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，CCA 512，我们的右侧发动机在 7200 米失效，请求下降并返回 Wuhan Airport。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, roger PAN, descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，收到 PAN，下降到 4200 米，左转航向 010，预计跑道 04 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect ILS approach Runway 04, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 4200 米，左转航向 010，预计跑道 04 ILS 进近，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 512, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1019.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 512，按 QNH 1019 下降到 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1019, CCA 512.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1019 下降到 3000 米，CCA 512。

cards.audioText: B: You fail to restart the right engine, ask ATC for priority landing and also ask for the longest runway for safety concern.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你未能重启右发，向 ATC 请求优先着陆，并出于安全考虑请求最长跑道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 512, we fail to restart the right engine, request priority landing and the longest runway for safety concern.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 512，我们未能重启右发，出于安全考虑，请求优先着陆和最长跑道。

cards.audioText: B: You have established on ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 512, established on ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 512，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 527, you are at gate 211, you have received ATIS C, your destination is Guangzhou, contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 527，位于 211 号登机口，已收到 ATIS C，目的地 Guangzhou，联系武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 527, gate 211, information C, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 527，211 号登机口，信息 C，请求前往 Guangzhou 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3515.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，武汉放行，可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，离场跑道 36R，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3515, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Guangzhou，离场跑道 36R，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3515，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are on the taxiway Z4, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground and request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在滑行道 Z4，准备滑行，联系武汉地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 527, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 527，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, follow CSN 737 on A7, you are number 2 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，跟随 A7 上的 CSN 737，你是第 2 架离场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, follow CSN 737 on A7, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跟随 A7 上的 CSN 737，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at threshold of Runway 36R, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 36R 入口，准备离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 527, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 527，跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, surface wind 350, 5 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，跑道 36R 可以起飞，地面风 350，5 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 36R 可以起飞，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: After you just takeoff, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 刚起飞后，通过 600 米，联系 Wuhan Departure。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 527, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA 527，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, climb to 3000 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，Wuhan Departure，雷达识别，爬升到 3000 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3000 meters, expedite climb until passing 2100 meters, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 3000 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at cruising level, the thunderstorm is detected in front of you, you want to make a fifteen miles deviation to the east of the current track from Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在巡航高度，前方探测到雷暴，你想向广州管制请求偏离当前航迹以东 15 海里。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA 527, our weather radar shows a CB ahead, request 15 miles to the east from current track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA 527，我们的气象雷达显示前方有 CB，请求从当前航迹向东偏置 15 海里。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, offset 15 miles to the east approved, when clear of whether, direct to ATAGA.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，批准向东偏置 15 海里，天气解除后，直飞 ATAGA。
cards.referenceText: Offset 15 miles to the east approved, when clear of whether, direct to ATAGA, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准向东偏置 15 海里，天气解除后，直飞 ATAGA，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, descend to 4200 meters when ready, reach 4200 meters 10 miles before ATAGA.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，准备好时下降到 4200 米，在 ATAGA 前 10 海里到达 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters when ready, reach 4200 meters 10 miles before ATAGA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 准备好时下降到 4200 米，在 ATAGA 前 10 海里到达 4200 米。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, increase rate of descent to greater than 2000 feet per minute until passing 5700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，通过 5700 米前，增加下降率至大于每分钟 2000 英尺。
cards.referenceText: Increase rate of descent to greater than 2000 feet per minute until passing 5700 meters, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 5700 米前，增加下降率至大于每分钟 2000 英尺，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established with Guangzhou Approach, your assigned landing runway is 02 right, you want to land Runway 02L due performance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已与 广州进近 建立联系，指定着陆跑道为 02R，由于性能原因你想落跑道 02L。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CCA 527, request Runway 02L due performance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CCA 527，因性能原因请求跑道 02L。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, Runway 02L is not available due runway inspection, runway in use 02R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，跑道 02L 因跑道检查不可用，使用跑道 02R。
cards.referenceText: Roger, Runway 02R, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 02R，CCA 527。

cards.audioText: B: You have established on the localizer Runway 02R, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已建立跑道 02R 航向道，联系 塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CCA 527, established on the localizer Runway 02R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CCA 527，已建立跑道 02R 航向道。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 527, cleared to land 02 right, expedite vacating runway after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 527，跑道 02R 可以着陆，着陆后加快脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land 02R, expedite vacating runway after landing, CCA 527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 02R 可以着陆，着陆后加快脱离跑道，CCA 527。

topics.name: CCA 725 一发启动失败 老太太心脏病 前轮转向失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 725, you are parking at 812, you have got information Y, your destination is Beijing, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 725，停在 812，已收到信息 Y，目的地 Beijing，向武汉放行请求 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 725, gate 812, information Y, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 725，812 号登机口，信息 Y，请求前往 Beijing 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, ZF-01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 4721.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 725，可以按计划航路前往 Beijing，离场跑道 36R，ZF-01 离场，初始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 4721。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, ZF-01 departure, initially climb 1500 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, after departure, contact 119.7, squawk 4721, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Beijing，离场跑道 36R，ZF-01 离场，初始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 10700 米，离场后联系 119.7，应答机 4721，CCA 725。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Delivery to tell them you want to use Runway 36L due parking position.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系 放行，告诉他们你因停机位置想使用跑道 36L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 725, request Runway 36L due parking position.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 725，因停机位置请求跑道 36L。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, Runway 36L is not available due rubber removal, runway in use 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 725，跑道 36L 因除胶不可用，使用跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Roger, runway in use 36R, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，使用跑道 36R，CCA 725。

cards.audioText: B: While you are starting the engines, 1 of the engine starters failed, contact Ground to request hold at present position to carry out emergency procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 开车时，一台发动机起动机失效，联系 地面请求在当前位置等待以执行应急程序。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 725, 1 of the engine starters failed, request hold at present position to carry out emergency procedure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 725，一台发动机起动机失效，请求在当前位置等待以执行应急程序。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have solved the problem, you are holding at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已解决问题，正在跑道 36R 等待点等待，准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 725, holding at holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 725，在跑道 36R 等待点等待，准备离场。

cards.audioText: B: During initial climb, an old lady on board suffered from a heart attack, this is an Urgency call, tell the controller you want to return to the airport and request priority landing in medical assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 初始爬升期间，机上一名老妇人心脏病发作，这是紧急呼叫，告诉管制员你想返回机场，并请求优先着陆和医疗援助。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CCA 725, an old lady suffered from a heart attack, request return to Wuhan for priority landing and medical assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，Wuhan Departure，CCA 725，一名老妇人心脏病发作，请求返回 Wuhan 优先着陆并提供医疗援助。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, roger PAN, turn right, direct to ZF, descend and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1011, ZF-02 arrival, expect ILS approach 36 left.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 725，收到 PAN，右转，直飞 ZF，按 QNH 1011 下降并保持 3000 米，ZF-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近 36L。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, descend and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1011, ZF-02 arrival, expect ILS approach 36L, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，按 QNH 1011 下降并保持 3000 米，ZF-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近 36L，CCA 725。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 725, descend and maintain 2100 meters
B: Read back and ask for QNH.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 725，下降并保持 2100 米。
B: 复诵并请求 QNH。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 2100 meters, request QNH, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 2100 米，请求 QNH，CCA 725。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, QNH 1019, correction, 1009.
cards.referenceText: QNH 1009, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1009，CCA 725。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, cleared to land 36 left, surface wind 340, 5 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 725，跑道 36L 可以着陆，地面风 340，5 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land 36L, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36L 可以着陆，CCA 725。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, your nose wheel steering has malfunctioned, you are unable to vacate 36 left, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 着陆后，你的前轮转弯故障，无法脱离 36L，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 725, our nose wheel steering has malfunctioned, unable to vacate 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 725，我们的前轮转弯故障，无法脱离 36L。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 725, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need a tug to tow you back to the terminal.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 725，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要拖车把你拖回航站楼。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 725, request a tug to tow us to the terminal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 725，请求拖车把我们拖到航站楼。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, the tug will arrive in 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 725，拖车将在 5 分钟内到达。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CCA 725。

cards.audioText: B: Now the lady's condition is deteriorating, you confirm with the controller if the medical service will be ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在这位女士情况正在恶化，你向管制员确认登机口医疗服务是否准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 725, the lady's condition is deteriorating, is medical service ready at the gate?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 725，这位女士情况正在恶化，登机口医疗服务准备好了吗？

cards.audioText: C: CCA 725, affirm, the ambulance and medical services have been ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 725，是的，救护车和医疗服务已在登机口准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA 725.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CCA 725。

topics.name: CCA 985 电子舱问题 电子舱冒烟

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 985, from Wuhan to Frankfurt, you are at bay 221, with information H, contact Wuhan Delivery for Airway clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 985，从 Wuhan 到 Frankfurt，位于 221 号停机位，收到信息 H，联系武汉放行请求航路许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 985, bay 221, information H, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 985，221 号停机位，信息 H，请求前往 Frankfurt 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, Runway 04, follow ZF-01 departure, initial climb 1500 meters on QNH, cruising level 9500 meters, departure frequency 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，武汉放行，可以按计划航路前往 Frankfurt，跑道 04，执行 ZF-01 离场，按 QNH 初始爬升到 1500 米，巡航高度 9500 米，离场频率 119.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, Runway 04, follow ZF-01 departure, initially climb to 1500 meters on QNH, cruising level 9500 meters, departure frequency 119.35, CCA 985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Frankfurt，跑道 04，执行 ZF-01 离场，按 QNH 初始爬升到 1500 米，巡航高度 9500 米，离场频率 119.35，CCA 985。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, read back correct, your slot time is 1435, contact Wuhan Ground 121.85.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，复诵正确，你的放行时刻是 1435，联系武汉地面121.85。
cards.referenceText: Slot time 1435, 121.85, CCA 985.

cards.audioText: B: During push back, you have a small avionics problem, you wish to remain on taxiway Z4 for approximately 5 minutes, inform Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 推出期间，你有一个小的航电问题，希望在滑行道 Z4 上停留约 5 分钟，通知 武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 985, request remain on taxiway Z4 due small avionics problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 985，因小的航电问题，请求停留在滑行道 Z4。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, CCA 985, advise when you are ready.
B: You decide the maintenance are needed before departure, tell Wuhan Ground you want to return to gate 221 to have plane checked by engineers.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，CCA 985，准备好时通知。
B: 你决定起飞前需要维修，告诉 武汉地面 你想返回 221 号登机口，让工程师检查飞机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 985, request taxi back to gate 221 to have plane checked by engineers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 985，请求滑回 221 号登机口，让工程师检查飞机。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, gate 221 will be occupied by another aircraft in a minute, stand by for a while, I will assign you another gate.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，221 号登机口一分钟后将被另一架飞机占用，稍等，我会给你分配另一个登机口。
cards.referenceText: Roger, standing by, CCA 985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，等待，CCA 985。

cards.audioText: B: The engineers have fixed the avionics problem, request Wuhan Ground for engine start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 工程师已修复航电问题，向武汉地面请求发动机开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 985, the engineers have fixed the avionics problem, request start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 985，工程师已修复航电问题，请求开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, your slot time is expired, your new slot time is 1615, start up at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，你的放行时刻已过期，新放行时刻是 1615，自行决定开车。
cards.referenceText: Slot time 1615, start up at own discretion, CCA 985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 放行时刻 1615，自行决定开车，CCA 985。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the engine start up procedures, call Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成发动机开车程序，呼叫 武汉地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 985, start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 985，开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, taxi via taxiway C, M and A to holding point Runway 04, hold short of Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，经滑行道 C、M 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 Z4 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway C, M and A to holding point Runway 04, hold short of Z4, CCA 985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 C、M 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，在 Z4 前等待，CCA 985。

cards.audioText: B: You are now at holding point Runway 04, you are ready for takeoff, call Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 04 等待点，准备起飞，呼叫 武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 985, holding point Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 985，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, surface wind 070 degrees, 3 meters per second, cleared for takeoff, Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，地面风 070 度，3 米/秒，跑道 04 可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, Runway 04, CCA 985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 04 可以起飞，CCA 985。

cards.audioText: B: Shortly after airborne, smoke is coming from the avionics bay, make a Distress call to Wuhan Tower and ask for immediate return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 离地后不久，航电舱冒烟，向武汉塔台发出遇险呼叫并请求立即返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, CCA 985, smoke is coming from the avionics bay, request immediate return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，CCA 985，航电舱冒烟，请求立即返回着陆。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Tower you want to level off at 600 meters and remain on the tower frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 武汉塔台 你想在 600 米改平，并保持在塔台频率。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 985, request level off at 600 meters and remain this frequency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 985，请求在 600 米改平并保持本频率。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Tower you want to fly a right-hand circuit for immediate landing Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 武汉塔台 你想加入右起落航线，立即在跑道 04 着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 985, request join right-hand circuit for immediate landing Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 985，请求加入右起落航线，立即在跑道 04 着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 985, maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind Runway 04, report turning base.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 985，保持 600 米，右转加入跑道 04 下风，转基线时报告。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind Runway 04, report turning base, CCA 985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 600 米，右转加入跑道 04 下风，转基线时报告，CCA 985。

cards.audioText: B: The smoke situation cannot be controlled, request emergency services upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 烟雾情况无法控制，请求着陆时提供应急服务。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 985, smoke cannot be controlled, request emergency services upon landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 985，烟雾无法控制，请求着陆时提供应急服务。

topics.name: CCA 976 烟雾警报 烟雾难以忍受

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 976, you are parking at gate 26, you have received information P, request ATC clearance to Beijing from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 976，停在 26 号登机口，已收到信息 P，向武汉放行请求前往 Beijing 的 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 976, gate 26, information P, request ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 976，26 号登机口，信息 P，请求前往 Beijing 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, ZF-01 departure, initial altitude 2700 meters, cruising level 8100 meters, after departure, contact 125.9, squawk 6563, runway in use 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，可以按计划航路前往 Beijing，ZF-01 离场，初始高度 2700 米，巡航高度 8100 米，离场后联系 125.9，应答机 6563，使用跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing via flight planned route, ZF-01 departure, initial altitude 2700 meters, cruising level 8100 meters, after departure, contact 125.9, squawk 6563, runway in use 04, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Beijing，ZF-01 离场，初始高度 2700 米，巡航高度 8100 米，离场后联系 125.9，应答机 6563，使用跑道 04，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, push back approved, report ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，推出批准，准备滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出批准，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 976, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 976，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, there is a disabled Boeing 737 on the taxiway A, follow the follow-me car on A9, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，滑行道 A 上有一架故障 Boeing 737，跟随 A9 上的引导车，在跑道 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, follow the follow-me car on A9, hold short of Runway 04, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跟随 A9 上的引导车，在跑道 04 前等待，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，在跑道 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of Runway 04, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在跑道 04 前等待，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, contact Wuhan Tower 118.2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，联系武汉塔台118.2。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 976, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 976，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, traffic on 11 kilometers final, wind calm, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，11 公里五边有交通，风静，跑道 04 可以立即起飞。
cards.referenceText: Roger, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: B: As you apply power, you hear a master warning alarm, tell Wuhan Tower you are stopping.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 当你加推力时，听到主警告警报，告诉 武汉塔台 你正在中止。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 976, stopping due to master warning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 976，因主警告中止起飞。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, expedite taxi and vacated at F, contact Ground when clear of runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，加快滑行并在 F 脱离，脱离跑道后联系 地面。
cards.referenceText: Expedite taxi and vacated at F, contact Ground when clear of runway, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加快滑行并在 F 脱离，脱离跑道后联系 地面，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Ground you are clear of Runway 04 at F, and that you had to abort takeoff because flap setting is incorrect.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 地面 你已在 F 脱离跑道 04，并因襟翼设置不正确不得不中止起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 976, runway vacated at F, we had to abort takeoff due to incorrect flap setting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 976，已在 F 脱离跑道，我们因襟翼设置不正确不得不中止起飞。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 976, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 976，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, line up Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，进入跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Line up Runway 04, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 04，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, cancel SID, maintain runway heading to 1500 meters, track direct to ZF, Runway 04, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，取消 SID，保持跑道航向到 1500 米，直飞 ZF，跑道 04，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, maintain runway heading to 1500 meters, track direct to ZF, Runway 04, cleared for takeoff, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，保持跑道航向到 1500 米，直飞 ZF，跑道 04，可以起飞，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: B: During initial climb, you have a smoke warning, report it to Wuhan Departure and request immediate return for priority landing Runway 04, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 初始爬升期间，你有烟雾警告，向 Wuhan Departure 报告并请求立即返回跑道 04 优先着陆，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Departure, CCA 976, we have a smoke warning, request immediate return for priority landing Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，Wuhan Departure，CCA 976，我们有烟雾警告，请求立即返回跑道 04 优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, climb to 900 meters, turn right heading 070, expect radar vector ILS Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，爬升到 900 米，右转航向 070，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 900 meters, turn right heading 070, expect radar vector ILS Runway 04, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到 900 米，右转航向 070，预计雷达引导 ILS 跑道 04，CCA 976。

cards.audioText: B: Now the source of smoke can't be detected and is becoming unbearable, notify Wuhan Tower you hope to turn left, and make a landing on the nearest available Runway 22, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在烟源无法确定且变得难以忍受，通知 武汉塔台 你希望左转，并在最近可用跑道 22 着陆，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: Mayday MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, CCA 976, the source of smoke can't be detected and is becoming unbearable, request turn left to make a landing on the nearest available Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，CCA 976，烟源无法确定且变得难以忍受，请求左转在最近可用跑道 22 着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 976, turn left heading 310, radar vector for a visual approach Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 976，左转航向 310，雷达引导目视进近跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 310, radar vector for a visual approach Runway 22, CCA 976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 310，雷达引导目视进近跑道 22，CCA 976。

topics.name: CCA 937 地勤行李出错 2发间歇噪音

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 937, you are parking at gate 213, you have got information N, call Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 937，停在 213 号登机口，已收到信息 N，呼叫 武汉放行请求前往 Amsterdam 的 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 937, gate 213, information N, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CCA 937，213 号登机口，信息 N，请求前往 Amsterdam 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 937, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, follow ZF-12 departure, cruising level 9500 meters, initial climb 1500 meters, after departure, contact 125.65, squawk 3251, runway in use 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 937，武汉放行，可以按计划航路前往 Amsterdam，执行 ZF-12 离场，巡航高度 9500 米，初始爬升 1500 米，离场后联系 125.65，应答机 3251，使用跑道 18L。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, follow ZF-12 departure, cruising level 9500 meters, initially climb 1500 meters, after departure, contact 125.65, squawk 3251, runway in use 18L, CCA 937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Amsterdam，执行 ZF-12 离场，巡航高度 9500 米，初始爬升 1500 米，离场后联系 125.65，应答机 3251，使用跑道 18L，CCA 937。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 937, expect slot time 20 due to temporary departure restriction, report when ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 937，由于临时离场限制，预计放行时刻 20，准备推出和开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expect slot time 20, CCA 937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计放行时刻 20，CCA 937。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller that there are 2 passengers missing and the bags have already removed from the aircraft, the loading sheet is amended, contact the controller to report the situation and state you are ready for push.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员有 2 名旅客缺失，行李已从飞机上卸下，装载单已修改，联系管制员报告情况并说明准备推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 937, there are 2 passengers missing, the bags have removed, the loading sheet is amended, ready for push.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 937，有 2 名旅客缺失，行李已卸下，装载单已修改，准备推出。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 937, the slot time restriction is cancelled, contact Ground 121.75.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 937，放行时刻限制取消，联系 地面 121.75。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller you started the engines and request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员你已起动发动机，请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 937, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 937，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 937, taxi to holding point Runway 18L via the taxiway Z4, A2, A, hold short of E1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 937，经滑行道 Z4、A2、A 滑行至跑道 18L 等待点，在 E1 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 18L via the taxiway Z4, A2, A, hold short of E1, CCA 937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A2、A 滑行至跑道 18L 等待点，在 E1 前等待，CCA 937。

cards.audioText: B: Your company has advised the ground service personnel have made a mistake during the baggage removal procedure of missing passenger, you have to taxi back to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 公司通知你，地面服务人员在缺失旅客行李卸载程序中出错，你必须滑回登机口。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 937, our company has advised the ground service personnel have made a mistake during the baggage removal procedure of missing passenger, request taxi back to the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 937，公司通知我们地面服务人员在缺失旅客行李卸载程序中出错，请求滑回登机口。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 937, taxi to gate 213 via taxiway M, M3, Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 937，经滑行道 M、M3、Z4 滑行至 213 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to gate 213 via taxiway M, M3, Z4, CCA 937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 M、M3、Z4 滑行至 213 号登机口，CCA 937。

cards.audioText: B: Now the baggage problem has been fixed, you ask for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在行李问题已解决，你请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 937, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 937，准备推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 937, a cold front is advancing to the airport, expect change Runway 04, stand by for new departure clearance, push back and start up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 937，冷锋正向机场推进，预计改用跑道 04，等待新的离场许可，推出和开车批准。
cards.referenceText: Roger, expect Runway 04, push back and start up approved, CCA 937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，预计跑道 04，推出和开车批准，CCA 937。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 937, recleared to Amsterdam, follow ZF-01 departure, Runway 04, initial climb 1500 meters, rest unchanged.
B: Read back the instructions and advise you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 937，重新许可前往 Amsterdam，执行 ZF-01 离场，跑道 04，初始爬升 1500 米，其余不变。
B: 复诵指令并告知你准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-01 departure, Runway 04, initially climb 1500 meters, rest unchanged, request taxi, CCA 937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-01 离场，跑道 04，初始爬升 1500 米，其余不变，请求滑行，CCA 937。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are rotating normally, report you are airborne, passing 900 meters, climbing to 1500 meters and request cancel SID, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正常抬轮，报告已离地，通过 900 米，爬升到 1500 米，并请求取消 SID，联系 Wuhan Departure。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 937, airborne, passing 900 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, request cancel SID.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA 937，已离地，通过 900 米，爬升到 1500 米，请求取消 SID。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 937, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, cancel SID, proceed to ZF, climb and maintain 4500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 937，Wuhan Departure，雷达识别，取消 SID，飞往 ZF，爬升并保持 4500 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, proceed to ZF, climb and maintain 4500 meters, CCA 937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，飞往 ZF，爬升并保持 4500 米，CCA 937。

cards.audioText: B: The number 2 engine produced intermittent noises, as a precaution, you want to terminate the flight and return, notify Wuhan Departure and request level off at 2700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 2 号发动机出现间歇性噪声，作为预防措施，你想终止飞行并返回，通知 Wuhan Departure 并请求在 2700 米改平。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 937, the No.2 engine produced intermittent noises, request level off at 2700 meters and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Wuhan Departure，CCA 937，2 号发动机出现间歇性噪声，请求在 2700 米改平并返回 Wuhan Airport 着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 937, climb and maintain 2700 meters, turn left heading 220, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 937，爬升并保持 2700 米，左转航向 220，雷达引导跑道 04 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 2700 meters, turn left heading 220, radar vector for ILS approach Runway 04, CCA 937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 2700 米，左转航向 220，雷达引导跑道 04 ILS 进近，CCA 937。

cards.audioText: B: In order to reduce weight to maximum landing weight, you request fifteen minutes for fuel dumping.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 为了减重到最大着陆重量，你请求 15 分钟放油。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 937, request 15 minutes for fuel dumping to reduce weight to maximum landing weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 937，请求 15 分钟放油，以减重到最大着陆重量。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 937, stand by, continue present heading.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 937，等待，继续当前航向。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, continue present heading, CCA 937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，继续当前航向，CCA 937。

topics.name: CCA 321 机长心脏骤停失能 PCR ILS区域非空

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 321, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are maintaining 10100 meters, squawking 3120, your captain suffered from cardiac arrest and became incapacitated, make a Distress call with Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 321，从 Beijing 到 Guangzhou，保持 10100 米，应答机 3120，你的机长心脏骤停并失能，向广州管制发出遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Guangzhou Control, CCA 321, maintaining 10100 meters, squawking 3120, our captain suffered from cardiac arrest and became incapacitated.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，广州管制，CCA 321，保持 10100 米，应答机 3120，我们的机长心脏骤停并失能。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 321, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, roger MAYDAY, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller to stand by and you are checking if there is a doctor on board.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 321，广州管制，雷达识别，收到 MAYDAY，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员稍等，你正在查看机上是否有医生。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, we are checking if there is a doctor on board, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，我们正在查看机上是否有医生，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: B: The purser found a doctor on board and offered CPR procedures to revive the captain, but the captain is having difficulty in breathing, inform Guangzhou Control about the situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 乘务长在机上找到一名医生，并进行 CPR 试图抢救机长，但机长呼吸困难，向广州管制通报情况。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA 321, the purser found a doctor on board and offered CPR procedures to revive the captain, but the captain is having difficulty in breathing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CCA 321，乘务长在机上找到一名医生并进行 CPR 试图抢救机长，但机长呼吸困难。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 321, when able, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller that you'd like to divert to Wuhan and you need physician and first aid upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 321，可以时说明意图。
B: 告诉管制员你想改航 Wuhan，并且着陆时需要医生和急救。
cards.referenceText: Request divert to Wuhan and request a physician and first aid upon landing, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求改航 Wuhan，并请求着陆时提供医生和急救，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 321, roger, turn right, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 321，收到，右转，直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，联系武汉进近119.35。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to ZF, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, 119.35, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 ZF，下降并保持 6000 米，119.35，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6000 meters, inform your situation to Wuhan Approach and request priority landing and medical services.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 ZF 上空，保持 6000 米，向武汉进近说明情况并请求优先着陆和医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CCA 321, over ZF, maintaining 6000 meters, our captain got incapacitated, he is having difficulty in breathing, request priority landing and medical services.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉进近，CCA 321，过 ZF，保持 6000 米，我们的机长失能，他呼吸困难，请求优先着陆和医疗服务。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 321, follow ZF-02A arrival, descend to 4200 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 321，执行 ZF-02A 进场，下降到 4200 米，预计雷达引导跑道 36R ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-02A arrival, descend to 4200 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-02A 进场，下降到 4200 米，预计雷达引导跑道 36R ILS 进近，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 321, descend to 2400 meters, turn right heading 350, reduce speed to 240 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 321，下降到 2400 米，右转航向 350，减速到 240 节。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2400 meters, turn right heading 350, reduce speed to 240 knots, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 2400 米，右转航向 350，减速到 240 节，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 321, descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 321，下降到 900 米，右转航向 330，可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, turn right heading 330, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, report established, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 900 米，右转航向 330，可以跑道 36R ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 321, established on ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 321，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 321, continue approach Runway 36R, surface wind 350 degrees, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 321，继续进近跑道 36R，地面风 350 度，3 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach Runway 36R, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近跑道 36R，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 321, Runway 36R, cleared to land, surface wind 340 degrees, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 321，跑道 36R，可以着陆，地面风 340 度，3 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，可以着陆，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: B: During final approach, you find the ILS area is not clear and you are going around, inform Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 最后进近中，你发现 ILS 区域未净空，正在复飞，通知 武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 321, ILS area is not clear, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 321，ILS 区域未净空，复飞。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 321, my apologies for that, follow the standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 321，对此表示歉意，执行标准复飞程序，爬升到 1500 米，联系武汉进近119.35。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1500 meters, 119.35, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，爬升到 1500 米，119.35，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have vacated the Runway 36R, tell the controller you need a follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已脱离跑道 36R，告诉管制员你需要引导车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 321, Runway 36R vacated, request a follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CCA 321，已脱离跑道 36R，请求引导车。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 321, hold position, the follow-me car is on the way for you.
B: Tell the controller you have seen the follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 321，原地等待，引导车正在前往你处。
B: 告诉管制员你已看到引导车。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, follow-me car in sight, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，看到引导车，CCA 321。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 321, follow the follow-me car to gate 557 via taxiway T4 and D.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 321，跟随引导车经滑行道 T4 和 D 到 557 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Follow the follow-me car to gate 557 via taxiway T4 and D, CCA 321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随引导车经滑行道 T4 和 D 到 557 号登机口，CCA 321。

topics.name: CCA 101 除冰 4号引擎灭火失败

cards.audioText: B: You are at Beijing Airport, your call sign is CCA 101, there's ice accumulated on your plane, you want to have the ice removed before start-up. Contact Beijing Ground to request de-icing service.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你在 Beijing Airport，呼号 CCA 101，飞机上有积冰，想在开车前除冰。联系北京地面请求除冰服务。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 101, there's ice accumulated on our plane, request de-icing service.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 101，我们飞机上有积冰，请求除冰服务。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, Beijing Ground, where do you want to de-ice?
B: Tell Ground you want to de-ice on taxiway D7.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 101，北京地面，你想在哪里除冰？
B: 告诉 地面 你想在滑行道 D7 除冰。
cards.referenceText: Request to de-ice on taxiway D7, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求在滑行道 D7 除冰，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Ground de-icing completed on D7, ready to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 通知 地面，在 D7 除冰完成，准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 101, de-icing completed on D7, ready to taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 101，D7 除冰完成，准备滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via W2, Z4 and B, caution, taxiway is covered with ice patches.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，经 W2、Z4 和 B 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，注意，滑行道有片状结冰。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via W2, Z4 and B, roger, thanks, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 W2、Z4 和 B 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，收到，谢谢，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: Your de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, tell Ground that you need to take off before 0900 and request an intersection departure from Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的除冰液只有效 30 分钟，告诉 地面 你需要在 0900 前起飞，并请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 101, our de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, we need to take off before 0900, request intersection departure from Z4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 101，我们的除冰液只有效 30 分钟，需要在 0900 前起飞，请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 101, negative due sequencing, continue taxi to holding point Runway 36R via W2, Z4 and B.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 101，因排序原因不批准，继续经 W2、Z4 和 B 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi to holding point Runway 36R via W2, Z4 and B, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 W2、Z4 和 B 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 101, stop immediately, a catering truck has just knocked an engine of your plane.
B: Ask Ground which engine it is.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 101，立即停止，一辆配餐车刚撞到了你飞机的一台发动机。
B: 询问 地面 是哪台发动机。
cards.referenceText: Roger, which engine has been knocked? CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，哪台发动机被撞？CCA 101。

cards.audioText:
C: No.4, the right outboard engine.
B: Tell controller that you have to shut down all 4 engines and discharge fire extinguishers of engine number 4.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 4 号，右外侧发动机。
B: 告诉管制员你必须关停全部 4 台发动机，并释放 4 号发动机灭火瓶。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 101, we have to shut down all 4 engines and discharge fire extinguishers of engine No.4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 101，我们必须关停全部 4 台发动机，并释放 4 号发动机灭火瓶。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA 101, I’ll send out the fire brigade.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 收到，CCA 101，我会派消防队。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CCA 101。

cards.audioText: B: The fire cannot be extinguished, inform this to ATC, this is a Distress call, also you want to carry out evacuation and request emergency equipment.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 火无法扑灭，向 ATC 通知，这是遇险呼叫，同时你想进行撤离并请求应急设备。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Ground, CCA 101, the fire cannot be extinguished, we are evacuating, request emergency equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京地面，CCA 101，火无法扑灭，我们正在撤离，请求应急设备。

topics.name: CCA 1089 慢释压 有乘客昏迷

cards.audioText: B: You are currently at gate 325, with information U copied, the time is 7 AM, request ATC clearance to Sanya.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你当前在 325 号登机口，已收到信息 U，时间是早上 7 点，请求前往 Sanya 的 ATC 许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA 1089, gate 325, information U, request ATC clearance to Sanya.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CCA 1089，325 号登机口，信息 U，请求前往 Sanya 的 ATC 许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 1089, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Sanya via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow RENOB-31 departure, initial climb to 1200 meters, QNH 1022, after departure, contact 120.6, squawk 1212.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 1089，北京放行，可以按计划航路前往 Sanya，使用跑道 36R，执行 RENOB-31 离场，初始爬升到 1200 米，QNH 1022，离场后联系 120.6，应答机 1212。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Sanya via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow RENOB-31 departure, initial climb to 1200 meters, QNH 1022, after departure, contact 120.6, squawk 1212, CCA 1089.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路前往 Sanya，使用跑道 36R，执行 RENOB-31 离场，初始爬升到 1200 米，QNH 1022，离场后联系 120.6，应答机 1212，CCA 1089。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 1089, read back correct, when ready for push back and start up, contact Ground on 121.75.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 1089，复诵正确，准备推出和开车时联系 地面 121.75。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Ground you are ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉 地面 你准备推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 1089, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 1089，准备推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 1089, Beijing Ground, good morning, departure time is 30, push back and start up at your own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 1089，北京地面，早上好，离场时间 30，自行决定推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Departure time is 30, push back and start up at own discretion, CCA 1089.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场时间 30，自行决定推出和开车，CCA 1089。

cards.audioText: B: You have been pushed back and started your engines, tell the controller you are ready to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已推出并起动发动机，告诉管制员你准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 1089, ready to taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 1089，准备滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 1089, taxi to the holding point of Runway 36R via taxiway G1 and E1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 1089，经滑行道 G1 和 E1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway G1 and E1, CCA 1089.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 G1 和 E1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 1089。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller that China Southern aircraft is now clear and you want to continue to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员 China Southern 航空器现在已离开，你想继续滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 1089, clear of traffic, request continue taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 1089，脱离交通，请求继续滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 1089, taxi to the holding point of Runway 36R via taxiway G1 and E1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 1089，经滑行道 G1 和 E1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of Runway 36R via taxiway G1 and E1, CCA 1089.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 G1 和 E1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CCA 1089。

cards.audioText: B: You are now at the holding point of Runway 36R, you've already contacted Tower, now tell the Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，已联系 塔台，现在告诉 塔台 你准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 1089, hold at holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 1089，在跑道 36R 等待点等待，准备离场。

cards.audioText: B: You are now twenty minutes into the flight and you are cruising at 6000 meters, ask climb to a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在飞行 20 分钟后，你以 6000 米巡航，请求爬升到更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 1089, cruising at 6000 meters, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 1089，6000 米巡航，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: B: As you were climbing, suddenly the cabin altitude warning horn sounds and you are slowly losing cabin pressure, tell the controller the due to depressurization, you're initiating an emergency descent. You do not consider this to be a Distress or Urgency situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 爬升时，客舱高度警告喇叭突然响起，客舱正在缓慢失压，告诉管制员由于失压，你正在开始紧急下降。你不认为这是遇险或紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 1089, the cabin altitude warning horns, we are slowly losing cabin pressure, emergency descent due to depressurization.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 1089，客舱高度警告喇叭响起，我们正在缓慢失压，因失压紧急下降。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, CCA 1089, fly heading 230 degrees.
B: Reply to the controller and request QNH.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，CCA 1089，飞航向 230 度。
B: 回复管制员并请求 QNH。
cards.referenceText: Fly heading 230, request QNH, CCA 1089.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞航向 230，请求 QNH，CCA 1089。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 1089, QNH is 1020, what level do you require?
B: Reply to the transmission, tell the controller you will descend to 3000 meters on QNH.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 1089，QNH 是 1020，你需要什么高度？
B: 回复电台，告诉管制员你将按 QNH 下降到 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: QNH 1020, request descend to 3000 meters on QNH, CCA 1089.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1020，请求按 QNH 下降到 3000 米，CCA 1089。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 1089, roger, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1020, report passing 5400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 1089，收到，按 QNH 1020 下降到 3000 米，通过 5400 米报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1020, report passing 5400 meters, CCA 1089.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1020 下降到 3000 米，通过 5400 米报告，CCA 1089。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 1089, are you declaring an Emergency? are there any injuries on board?
B: Tell the controller that you now consider it an Emergency, because you have several unconscious passengers, also report passing 5400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 1089，你是否宣布紧急情况？机上有伤员吗？
B: 告诉管制员你现在认为这是紧急情况，因为有数名旅客失去意识，同时报告通过 5400 米。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Control, CCA 1089, we have several unconscious passengers, passing 5400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京管制，CCA 1089，我们有数名旅客失去意识，正在通过 5400 米。

cards.audioText: B: You are now level of 3000 meters and are considering diverting to Hangzhou, ask for the weather at Hangzhou Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在在 3000 米平飞，正在考虑改航 Hangzhou，询问 Hangzhou Airport 天气。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 1089, level at 3000 meters, request divert to Hangzhou and weather at Hangzhou Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 1089，3000 米平飞，请求改航 Hangzhou，并请求 Hangzhou Airport 天气。

topics.name: CCA 301 刹车超温 一个前轮没气

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 301, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are parking at gate 215, you are ready for push back and start up, contact Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 301，从 Beijing 到 Guangzhou，停在 215 号登机口，准备推出和开车，联系北京地面。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 301, gate 215, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 301，215 号登机口，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 301, Beijing Ground, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 301，北京地面，推出和开车批准，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝西，CCA 301。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已完成推出和开车，准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 301, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 301，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 301, Beijing Ground, taxi via taxiway Y4 and G2, hold short of H.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 301，北京地面，经滑行道 Y4 和 G2 滑行，在 H 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Y4 and G2, hold short of H, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Y4 和 G2 滑行，在 H 前等待，CCA 301。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing, you notice the Airbus 330 in front of you is leaking fluid from the right engine, report it to Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 滑行期间，你注意到前方 Airbus 330 右发漏液，向北京地面报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 301, the A330 ahead is leaking fluid from the right engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 301，前方 A330 右发漏液。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, thank you, CCA 301, continue taxi.
B: Tell the controller that you are unable to taxi because you find the taxiway surface is contaminated with leaking fluid.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，谢谢，CCA 301，继续滑行。
B: 告诉管制员你无法滑行，因为发现滑行道表面被泄漏液体污染。
cards.referenceText: We are unable to taxi, the taxiway surface is contaminated with leaking fluid, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们无法滑行，滑行道表面被泄漏液体污染，CCA 301。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 301, roger, turn left, taxi via Y1, then turn left, taxi via Y2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 301，收到，左转，经 Y1 滑行，然后左转，经 Y2 滑行。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, taxi via Y1, then turn left, taxi via Y2, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，经 Y1 滑行，然后左转，经 Y2 滑行，CCA 301。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 301, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 301，跑道 36R 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 301, line up and be ready for immediate departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 301，进跑道，准备立即离场。
cards.referenceText: Line up and be ready for immediate departure, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道，准备立即离场，CCA 301。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 301, Runway 36R, cleared for immediate takeoff, surface wind 340 degrees, 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 301，跑道 36R，可以立即起飞，地面风 340 度，2 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared for immediate takeoff, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，可以立即起飞，CCA 301。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 301, stop immediately! I say again! stop immediately!
B: Tell the controller you use the maximum brakes and you are stopping on the runway.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 301，立即停止！我再说一遍！立即停止！
B: 告诉管制员你使用最大刹车，正在跑道上停止。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 301, we used the maximum breaks and we are stopping on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 301，我们使用最大刹车，正在跑道上停止。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 301, vacate runway via E2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 301，经 E2 脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Vacate runway via E2, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 E2 脱离跑道，CCA 301。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have vacated Runway 36R via E2 and ask Beijing Tower the reasons for rejected takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已通过 E2 脱离跑道 36R，并询问 北京塔台 中断起飞的原因。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 301, Runway 36R vacated via E2, confirm the reasons for rejected takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 301，已通过 E2 脱离跑道 36R，确认中断起飞原因。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 301, the landing aircraft on the short final just made the go around.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 301，短五边上的着陆航空器刚复飞。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CCA 301。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find your brakes are overheating, tell the controller you need 2 minutes to cool the brakes.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你发现刹车过热，告诉管制员你需要 2 分钟冷却刹车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 301, our brakes are overheating, we need 2 minutes to cool the brakes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 301，我们刹车过热，需要 2 分钟冷却刹车。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 301, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ground services to cool the wheels.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 301，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要地面服务冷却机轮。
cards.referenceText: Request ground services to cool the wheels, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求地面服务冷却机轮，CCA 301。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 301, what else do you need?
B: Tell the controller 1 of your nose wheel tires was deflated, you have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 301，还需要什么？
B: 告诉管制员你一个前轮轮胎泄气，必须在当前位置等待维修检查。
cards.referenceText: 1 of our nose wheel tires was deflated, we have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们一个前轮轮胎泄气，必须在当前位置等待维修检查，CCA 301。

cards.audioText: B: After the check, the maintenance staff told you that your parking brakes have seized, report it to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 检查后，维修人员告诉你停车刹车卡滞，向管制员报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 301, our parking breaks have seized.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 301，我们的停车刹车卡滞。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 301, what assistance do you require?
B: Tell the controller you need a tug to tow you back to the maintenance apron.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 301，你需要什么援助？
B: 告诉管制员你需要拖车把你拖回维修机坪。
cards.referenceText: Request a tug to tow us back to the maintenance apron, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求拖车把我们拖回维修机坪，CCA 301。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 301, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 301，原地等待，拖车很快到。
cards.referenceText: Holding, roger, thanks, CCA 301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，收到，谢谢，CCA 301。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 432, you are performing a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are maintaining 5400 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5655, make initial contact with Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 432，执行 Guangzhou 到 Beijing 航班，保持 5400 米，过 IKUBA，应答机 5655，与 北京进近 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 432, maintaining 5400 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 432，保持 5400 米，过 IKUBA，应答机 5655。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, Beijing Approach, radar contact, climb to and maintain 6600 meters, contact Beijing Control on 118.2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，北京进近，雷达识别，爬升并保持 6600 米，联系北京管制118.2。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6600 meters, 118.2, CCA 432.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 6600 meters, contact Beijing Control and request further climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你保持 6600 米，联系北京管制并请求继续爬升。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 432, maintaining 6600 meters, requests further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 432，保持 6600 米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, negative due traffic, maintain 6600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，因交通原因不批准，保持 6600 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 6600 meters, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持 6600 米，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, climb to and maintain 8900 meters, turn left heading 210, fly direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，爬升并保持 8900 米，左转航向 210，直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 8900 meters, turn left heading 210, fly direct to OBLIK, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 8900 米，左转航向 210，直飞 OBLIK，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: B: During cruise, your weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request turn right and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 巡航期间，你的气象雷达发现前方有雷暴，请求右转并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 432, our weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request turn right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 432，我们的气象雷达发现前方有雷暴，请求右转。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, negative due military activity, continue present heading for 20 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，因军事活动不批准，继续当前航向 20 海里。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue present heading for 20 miles, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续当前航向 20 海里，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of whether, report it to Beijing Control and request resume flight route.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已脱离天气，向北京管制报告并请求恢复航路。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 432, clear of whether, request resume flight route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 432，已脱离天气，请求恢复航路。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, turn left heading 240 to rejoin Amber 461, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，左转航向 240 重新加入 Amber 461，爬升并保持 10100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 240 to rejoin A461, climb and maintain 10100 meters, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 240 重新加入 A461，爬升并保持 10100 米，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, maintain 10100 meters, offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，保持 10100 米，向左偏置 10 海里，以避让报告的强下沉气流。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 10100 meters, offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 10100 米，向左偏置 10 海里，以避让报告的强下沉气流，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are flying into a small cumulonimbus, contact Beijing Control and tell the controller you'd like to hold at PEK VOR for weather improvement.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正飞入一小块积雨云，联系北京管制，告诉管制员你想在 PEK VOR 等待，等待天气好转。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 432, we are flying into a small cumulonimbus, request hold at PEK VOR for weather improvement.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 432，我们正飞入一小块积雨云，请求在 PEK VOR 等待，等待天气好转。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, hold at PEK VOR as published, when clear of weather, contact Beijing Approach on 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，按公布程序在 PEK VOR 等待，天气解除后联系北京进近119.25。
cards.referenceText: Hold at PEK VOR as published, when clear of weather, contact Beijing Approach on 119.25, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按公布程序在 PEK VOR 等待，天气解除后联系北京进近119.25，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are approaching RENOB, maintaining 4800 meters, you have got information L, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你接近 RENOB，保持 4800 米，已收到信息 L，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 432, approaching RENOB, maintaining 4800 meters, information L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 432，接近 RENOB，保持 4800 米，信息 L。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, RENOB-2B arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，北京进近，雷达识别，下降并保持 2400 米，RENOB-2B 进场，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 2400 meters, RENOB-2B arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 01, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 2400 米，RENOB-2B 进场，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 01, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，右转航向 330，下降到 900 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 01, report established, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降到 900 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA 432。

topics.name: CCA 368(印度口音)跑线 复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 368, a flight from Shenzhen to Beijing, your weather radar indicates a squall line near VYK, contact Beijing Approach and request parallel offset 10 miles right of track until PEK VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 368，从 Shenzhen 到 Beijing，气象雷达显示 VYK 附近有飑线，联系北京进近，请求平行偏置航迹右侧 10 海里，直到 PEK VOR。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 368, our weather radar indicates a squall line near VYK, request parallel offset 10 miles right of track until PEK VOR.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 368，我们的气象雷达显示 VYK 附近有飑线，请求平行偏置航迹右侧 10 海里，直到 PEK VOR。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, Beijing Approach, radar contact, negative due prohibited area, turn left heading 230, track out 25 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，北京进近，雷达识别，因禁区不批准，左转航向 230，向外飞 25 海里。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn left heading 230, track out 25 miles, CCA 368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，左转航向 230，向外飞 25 海里，CCA 368。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, when clear of weather, fly direct to AA443.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，天气解除后，直飞 AA443。
cards.referenceText: When clear of weather, fly direct to AA443, CCA 368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 天气解除后，直飞 AA443，CCA 368。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, turn right, direct to AA442, hold at AA442 as published.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，右转，直飞 AA442，按公布程序在 AA442 等待。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to AA442, hold at AA442 as published, CCA 368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 AA442，按公布程序在 AA442 等待，CCA 368。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, orbit right from present position until advised, Runway 18L is not available now.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，从当前位置右盘旋，直到通知，跑道 18L 现在不可用。
cards.referenceText: Roger, orbit right from present position until advised, CCA 368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，从当前位置右盘旋，直到通知，CCA 368。

cards.audioText: B: After several orbit, you find the fuel on board will approach the required minimum, report it to Beijing Approach and request leave the hold and request priority landing Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 经过几圈盘旋后，你发现机上燃油将接近所需最低油量，向北京进近报告，请求离开等待并请求跑道 01 优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 368, the fuel on board will approach the required minimum, request leave the hold and request priority landing Runway 01.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 368，机上燃油将接近所需最低油量，请求离开等待，并请求跑道 01 优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, after this orbit, leave the hold, fly heading 360, direct to LADIX.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，完成这圈盘旋后，离开等待，飞航向 360，直飞 LADIX。
cards.referenceText: After this orbit, leave the hold, fly heading 360, direct to LADIX, CCA 368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 完成这圈盘旋后，离开等待，飞航向 360，直飞 LADIX，CCA 368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over PEK, maintaining 4200 meters, you have received information S, tell Beijing Approach you are ready for approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在 PEK 上空，保持 4200 米，已收到信息 S，告诉 北京进近 你准备进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 368, over PEK, maintaining 4200 meters, information S, ready for approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 368，过 PEK，保持 4200 米，信息 S，准备进近。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, Beijing Approach, follow PEK-05 arrival, descend to 2100 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，北京进近，执行 PEK-05 进场，按 QNH 1008 下降到 2100 米，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Follow PEK-05 arrival, descend to 2100 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach Runway 01, CCA 368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 PEK-05 进场，按 QNH 1008 下降到 2100 米，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近，CCA 368。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 01, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，下降并保持 1500 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 01, report established, CCA 368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 1500 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA 368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have intercepted the ILS signals of Runway 01, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已截获跑道 01 的 ILS 信号，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 368, established ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 368，已建立跑道 01 ILS 进近。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, Runway 01, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，跑道 01，可以着陆。
cards.referenceText: Runway 01, cleared to land, CCA 368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 01，可以着陆，CCA 368。

cards.audioText: B: During final approach, an aircraft is crossing Runway 01, you executed a missed approach, report it to Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 最后进近中，一架飞机正在穿越跑道 01，你执行复飞，向北京塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 368, an aircraft is crossing Runway 01, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 368，一架飞机正在穿越跑道 01，复飞。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, climb straight ahead until 230 meters, turn right direct to PEK, hold at PEK at 600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，直线爬升到 230 米，右转直飞 PEK，在 PEK600 米等待。
cards.referenceText: Climb straight ahead until 230 meters, turn right direct to PEK, hold at PEK at 600 meters, CCA 368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直线爬升到 230 米，右转直飞 PEK，在 PEK 600 米等待，CCA 368。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have landed on Runway 01, you find the runway surface is slippery, the braking action is medium, report it to Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已在跑道 01 着陆，发现跑道表面湿滑，刹车效应中等，向北京塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 368, the runway surface is slippery, the breaking action is medium.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 368，跑道表面湿滑，刹车效应中等。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 368, roger, thanks, vacate Runway 01 via rapid exit E2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 368，收到，谢谢，经快速出口 E2 脱离跑道 01。
cards.referenceText: Vacate Runway 01 via rapid exit E2, CCA 368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经快速出口 E2 脱离跑道 01，CCA 368。

topics.name: CCA 102 左发熄火 液压 起落架

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 102, now call Wuhan Departure and report you are 400 meters, climbing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CCA 102，现在呼叫武汉离场并报告你 400 米，正在爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 102, 400 meters climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CCA 102，400 米爬升中。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 102, Wuhan Departure is with you. Continue climb to 4200 meters. Pass Hekou at 4200 meters.
B: Acknowledge the controller’s instruction
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CCA 102，武汉离场收到。继续爬升至 4200 米。以 4200 米通过河口。
B：确认收到管制员指令。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 4200 meters. Pass Hekou at 4200 meters, CCA 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 4200 米。以 4200 米通过河口，CCA 102。

cards.audioText: B: As the aircraft is reaching 4200 meters, you suddenly find No.1 engine has flamed out. You declare an emergency.
cards.audioTextZh: B：飞机到达 4200 米时，你突然发现 1 号发动机熄火。你宣布紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CCA 102, No.1 engine has flamed out at 4200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，CCA 102，1 号发动机在 4200 米熄火。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger PAN, CCA 102, what is your intention?
B: Tell controller you intend to return to land as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：收到 PAN，CCA 102，你的意图？
B：告诉管制员你打算尽快返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA 102, we would like to return to land on the departure airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，CCA 102，我们想返回起飞机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 102, turn left proceed to HG, make straight in ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CCA 102，左转前往 HG，执行跑道 18L 直线 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Turn left proceed to HG, make straight in ILS approach Runway 18 left, CCA 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转前往 HG，执行跑道 18L 直线 ILS 进近，CCA 102。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 102, contact Tower 124.35.
B: Call Tower.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CCA 102，联系塔台 124.35。
B：呼叫塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 102, go ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 102，请讲。

cards.audioText: B: You have another problem. The hydraulic pressure is dropping rapidly.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你有另一个问题。液压压力正在快速下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 102, we have another problem, the hydraulic pressure is dropping rapidly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 102，我们还有一个问题，液压压力正在快速下降。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 102, Can you extend the landing gear?
B: You are not certain if you could extend the gear. You are going around.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CCA 102，你能放下起落架吗？
B：你不确定是否能放下起落架。你正在复飞。
cards.referenceText: We can not sure if we could extend the landing gear, going around, CCA 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们不能确定是否能放下起落架，正在复飞，CCA 102。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 102, standard missed approach.
B: You are flying to the holding for further check of the landing gear.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CCA 102，标准复飞。
B：你正飞往等待区进一步检查起落架。
cards.referenceText: We are going to the holding for further check. Call you back, CCA 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们去等待区进一步检查。稍后呼叫你，CCA 102。

cards.audioText: B: You have tried several ways, but you could not extend the landing gear. You decided to make a belly landing. Tell the controller about it
cards.audioTextZh: B：你尝试了几种方法，但无法放下起落架。你决定进行机腹着陆。告诉管制员。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 102, I have tried several ways, but I could not extend the landing gear. We would like to make a belly landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 102，我尝试了几种方法，但无法放下起落架。我们想进行机腹着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 102, any airport assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you like the runway to be foamed at the touch down zone of the landing runway.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CCA 102，你需要任何机场协助吗？
B：告诉管制员你希望在落地跑道接地区铺设泡沫。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 102, request a foam carpet at the touch down zone of the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 102，请求在跑道接地区铺设泡沫。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 102, roger. We will spray foam around the touch down.
B: You ask how long will foam spray last.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CCA 102，收到。我们将在接地区周围喷洒泡沫。
B：你询问泡沫喷洒将持续多久。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 102, how long will foam spray last?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 102，泡沫喷洒会持续多久？

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 102, foam spraying will last 15 minutes. I will call you back.
B: Tell controller you would like to land as soon as possible
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CCA 102，泡沫喷洒将持续 15 分钟。我稍后呼叫你。
B：告诉管制员你想尽快着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 102, we would like to land as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 102，我们想尽快着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 102, cleared to land Runway 18L, wind 120, 10 knots.
B: You confirm with the controller if the landing runway is 18 Left.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CCA 102，跑道 18L 可以落地，风 120，10 节。
B：你向管制员确认落地跑道是否为 18L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 102, confirm landing runway is 18 left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 102，确认落地跑道是 18L。

cards.audioText:
C: Correct, CCA 102, landing Runway 18L, report runway in sight.
B: You have runway in sight, report to Tower.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：正确，CCA 102，落地跑道 18L，报告看到跑道。
B：你看到跑道，向塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA 102, runway in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CCA 102，看到跑道。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 102, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CCA 102，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, CCA 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，CCA 102。

topics.name: CCA 102 鸟击 左1风挡裂开

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 102, now call Wuhan Approach and report you are 10 miles north of Hekou, you are continuing approaching.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 102，现在呼叫 武汉进近，报告你在 Hekou 以北 10 miles，继续进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA 102, we are 10 miles north of Hekou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CCA 102，我们在 Hekou 以北 10 miles。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 102, Wuhan Approach is with you. Have you got the current ATIS?
