C: CCA321, negative deviation 20 miles to the right due restricted area.
B: [You want to know if you can deviate 100 miles to the left.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航321，由于禁飞区域，不能右偏置20海里。
【你想知道你是否可以左偏100海里。】
cards.referenceText: Confirm we can deviate 100 miles to the left, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 证实能否左偏100海里，国航321。

cards.audioText: CCA321, cleared to deviate 100 miles to the left.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航321，可以左偏置100海里。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to deviate 100 miles to the left, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以左偏置100海里，国航321。

cards.audioText: B: [You are now 15 miles southwest of LKO. Suddenly, you encountered heavy hail. The windshield was smashed and multiple cracks obscured your view. The airspeed indications in the cockpit have also become unreliable. You want to divert to Wuhan Airport. Make a distress call to Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在LKO西南15海里，突然，你遇到了强冰雹，你的风挡破裂了，裂纹阻挡了你的视野，驾驶舱里的空速指示也变得不可靠。你想改航至武汉机场，向广州区调做一个遇险通话。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Guangzhou Control, CCA321, 15 miles southwest of LKO, we encountered heavy hail. The windshield was smashed and multiple cracks obscured our view, The airspeed indications in the cockpit have also become unreliable. Request divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，广州区调，国航321，LKO西南15海里，我们遇到了冰雹，我们的风挡破裂了，裂纹阻挡了我们的视野，驾驶舱里的空速指示也变得不可靠。请求改航至武汉机场。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, roger Mayday, descend to 7800m initially.
B: [You want to descend to 6600m instead.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航321，广州区调，收到Mayday，初始下降到7800米。
【你想下降到6600米。】
cards.referenceText: Request 6600m, CCA321.

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, 6600m is not available due current military activity, descend to 7800m initially.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航321，由于当前军机活动，6600米不可用，初始下降到7800米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, descend to 7800m initially, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，初始下降到7800米，国航321。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, when ready, report onboard situation.
B: [Tell the controller that the engines and control surfaces are working normally, and there is no passenger injury in the cabin.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航321，可以的时候，报告机上情况。
【告诉管制员，发动机和操纵面工作正常，客舱内无乘客受伤。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA321, the engines and control surfaces are working normally, and there is no passenger injury in the cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，国航321，发动机和操纵面工作正常，客舱内无乘客受伤。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, roger, turn right heading 329, further descend to 5400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航321，收到，右转航向329，继续下降到5400米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 329, further descend to 5400m, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向329，继续下降到5400米，国航321。

cards.audioText: B: [Because neither of you nor co-pilot can see through the windshield, you want to activate the auto-land on Wuhan Airport, inform Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【由于你和你的副驾都无法通过风挡看清外面，因此你想在武汉机场激活了自动着陆，告知广州区调。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA321, request activate the auto-land on Wuhan Airport due neither of us can see through the windshield.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，国航321，由我们都无法通过风挡看清外面，请求在武汉机场激活自动着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, roger, we’ve informed your situation to Wuhan Airport, and necessary emergency assistance will be provided upon your landing, continue descend to 4200m and expect LKO-02 arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航321，收到，我们已经将你的情况告知武汉机场，在你着陆后将提供必要的协助，继续下降到4200米，预计LKO-02进场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue descend to 4200m and expect LKO-02 arrival, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续下降到4200米，预计LKO-02进场，国航321。

cards.audioText: B: [During the approach to Wuhan Airport, your auto-landing system has malfunctioned, and you can not continue approach and land on Wuhan airport, you want to know the nearest suitable alternate airport, ask Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在进近武汉机场过程中，你的自动着陆系统失效了。你无法继续进近并在武汉机场着陆，你想知道最近的备降机场，询问武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA321, our auto-landing system has malfunctioned, we can not continue approach and land on Wuhan airport, request nearest suitable alternate airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，国航321，我们的自动着陆系统失效了，无法继续进近并在武汉机场着陆，请求最近的备降机场。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, roger, your nearest suitable alternate airport is Changsha Airport, which is 120 miles away, confirm you want to divert to Changsha?
B: [Tell the controller you decided to divert to Changsha.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航321，收到，你的最近的备降机场是长沙机场，120海里，证实你想备降至长沙？
【告知管制员，你想备降至长沙。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request divert to Changsha, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求备降至长沙，国航321。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, Wuhan Approach, cleared divert to Changsha, fly heading 140 and rejoin airway R343, fly direct to LCC.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航321，武汉进近，可以备降至长沙，航向140，加入R343航路，直飞LCC。
cards.referenceText: Cleared divert to Changsha, heading 140 and rejoin airway R343, fly direct to LCC, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以备降至长沙，航向140，加入R343航路，直飞LCC，国航321。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, further descend to 2400m, contact Changsha Approach on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航321，继续下降到2400米，联系长沙进近124.35.。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2400m, 124.35., CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到2400米，联系长沙进近124.35.，国航321。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is CCA321, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, you are now over DAPRO at 9200m. Make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航三两幺，从武汉飞往广州，你现在飞过DAPRO，高度九千二，与广州区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA321, over DAPRO, maintaining 9200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，国航三两幺，飞过DAPRO，保持在九千二。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, radar identified.
B: [Your captain is suddenly incapacitated with a suspected food poisoning, you have called the purser from the intercom and asked the flight attendants to get him out of the cockpit and give him first aid in time. Inform Guangzhou Control the situation and request return to land as soon as possible. This is a distress call.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航三两幺，武汉区调，雷达识别了。
【机长疑似食物中毒突然失能，你已经通过内话联系了乘务长，让乘务员把他抬出驾驶舱，并及时进行急救。告知广州区调此情况并请求尽快着陆。这是一个遇险通话。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Guangzhou Control, CCA321, our captain is suddenly incapacitated with a suspected food poisoning, we have given him first aid, request land as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，广州区调，国航三两幺，机长疑似食物中毒突然失能，我们已经向他进行急救，请求尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, roger Mayday, keep present heading and descend to 8400m, when able, report situation on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，收到Mayday，保持当前航向，下降到八千四，可以的时候，报告机上情况。
cards.referenceText: Present heading, descend to 8400m, wilco, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当前航向，下到八千四，照办，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: B: [Inform the controller that the flight attendants have offered first aid to the captain, but the captain still feels so sick, so you want medical team to be ready upon landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知管制员，乘务员已经对机长实施了急救，但是机长已经很不舒服，你希望着陆之后医疗队伍就位。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA321, the flight attendants have offered first aid to the captain, but the captain still feels so sick, request medical assistance on arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，国航三两幺，乘务员已经对机长实施了急救，但是机长已经很不舒服，请求到达之后医疗队伍就位。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, medical assistance will be ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，广州区调，医疗救援将就位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢。国航三两幺。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, report estimated time over IKUBA.
B: [Tell controller your estimated time over IKUBA is 0806.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航三两幺，广州区调，预报过IKUBA的时间。
【告诉管制员，你预计0806过IKUBA。】
cards.referenceText: Estimated time over IKUBA 0806, CCA321,
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计过0806过IKUBA，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, reach IKUBA no later than 0800.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，广州区调，过IKUBA不晚于0800。
cards.referenceText: IKUBA no later than 0800, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过IKUBA不晚于0800，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have flown over IKUBA, time 0755, inform controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在已经过IKUBA，时间0755，告知管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA321, over IKUBA at 0755.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，国航三两幺，过IKUBA，时间0755。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, roger, fly direct to PAVTU and then turn left and join airway H24.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，广州区调，收到，直飞PAVTU。然后左转加入H24航路。
cards.referenceText: Fly direct to PAVTU and then turn left and join airway H24, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞PAVTU。然后左转加入H24航路，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, what are the conditions onboard?
B: [Inform controller that the captain is now sitting in the rest area, he is feeling better now but still unable to fly the plane.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航三两幺，广州区调，机上现在情况如何？
【告知管制员，机长现在在休息区休息，他感觉好多了，但是依旧无法驾驶飞机。】
cards.referenceText: The captain is now sitting in the rest area, he is feeling better now but still unable to fly the airplane, CCA321,.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机长现在在休息区休息，他感觉好多了，但是依旧无法驾驶飞机，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, roger, turn right heading 038, descend to and maintain 5400m, increase speed to 320 knots or greater.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，广州区调，收到，右转航向038，下到五千四保持，速度调至320节或更大。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 038, descend to and maintain 5400m, increase speed to 320 knots or greater, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向038，下到五千四保持，速度增大到320节或更多，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, contact Wuhan Approach on 117.35, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，联系武汉区调117.35，再见。
cards.referenceText: 117.35, good day, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 117.35，再见，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: B: [You’re now handed over to Wuhan Approach, report your distress situation to the controller and request priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在被移交给了武汉进近，将你的遇险情况报告给管制员，并请求优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Approach, CCA321, 5400m maintaining, our captain is suddenly incapacitated with a suspected food poisoning, he is getting better now but still unable to fly the plane. Request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，武汉进近，国航三两幺，保持在五千四，机长疑似食物中毒突然失能，他现在感觉好多了，但是已经无法驾驶飞机。请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, Wuhan Approach, roger Mayday, keep present heading and fly direct to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，武汉进近，收到Mayday，保持当前航向，直飞LKO。
cards.referenceText: Keep present heading and fly direct to LKO, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，直飞LKO，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, descend to 3600m on QNH1022, no ATC speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，下到三千六，QNH1022，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3600m on QNH1022, no speed restrictions, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到三千六，QNH1022，没有速度限制，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: B: [You are 12 miles from LKO, 3600m maintaining, suddenly, you notice that there are abnormal indications in the cockpit showing that your hydraulic system is malfunctioning, notify Wuhan Approach of this situation.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在距离LKO12海里，在三千六保持，突然，你注意到驾驶舱内有不正常的指示，表明你的液压系统出现了故障，告知武汉进近此情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA321, 12 miles from LKO, 3600m maintaining, abnormal indications in the cockpit showing that our hydraulic system is malfunctioning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，国航三两幺，距离LKO12海里，在三千六保持，驾驶舱内有不正常的指示，我们的液压系统出现了故障。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, Wuhan Approach, roger, what is your intention?
[Tell controller, you want to reduce to minimum clean speed to perform the checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航三两幺，武汉进近，收到，你的意图是什么？
【告知管制员，你想减小到最小光洁速度来执行检查单。】
cards.referenceText: Request reduce to minimum clean speed to perform the checklist, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求减小到最小光洁速度来执行检查单，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, roger, maintain 290 knots until further advised.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，收到，保持290节，直到通知。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 290 knots, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持290节，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: B: [After finishing the checklist, you still can not solve the problem, and you have to land with left landing gear not fully locked. Inform controller and request foaming the runway.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【完成检查单后，你依旧无法解决问题，你必须在起落架没有完全锁死的情况下着陆。告知管制员，请求在跑道上喷洒泡沫。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA321, our hydraulic system is still malfunctioning, request foaming the runway due left landing gear not fully locked.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，国航三两幺，我们的液压系统依旧故障，由于起落架未完全锁死，请求在跑道上喷洒泡沫。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA321, we've notified relevant departments at the airport, and they're aware of your situation. Descend to 1800m, continue approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，国航三两幺，我们已经通知机场相关部门，他们已经知晓你的情况。下到一千八，继续进近。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800m and continue approach, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到一千八，继续进近，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, expect ILS approach runway 18L, wind calm, maintain 1200m until glide path interception.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，预计盲降进近跑道18左，静风，截获下滑道前高度保持一千二。
cards.referenceText: ILS approach runway 18L, maintain 1200m until glide path interception, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 盲降进近跑道18左，截获下滑道前高度保持一千二，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: B: [During approach, you find the ILS signal of runway 18L is very unstable, and you want to know if any other pilot reports a similar situation.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在进近过程中，你发现跑道18左的盲降信号不稳定，你想知道其他飞行员是否报告了类似的情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA321, ILS signal of runway 18L is very unstable, did any other pilot report a similar situation?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，国航三两幺，跑道18左盲降信号不稳定，其他飞行员是否报告过类似的情况？

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, negative, we’ve never received such report, do you request approach to another runway or request another type of approach?
B: [Tell controller you want to change to runway 18R.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航三两幺，没有，我们没有收到类似的报告，你是请求进近其他跑道还是请求其他进近方式？
【告诉管制员，你想更换至跑道18右。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request change to runway 18R, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求更换至跑道18右，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, change to runway 18R approved, you are number one in the landing sequence, and contact Wuhan Tower on 118.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，可以更换至跑道18右，在着陆顺序中，你是第一个，联系塔台118.35。
cards.referenceText: Roger, runway 18R, number one, 118.35, thanks, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道18右，第一个，118.35，谢谢，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: B: [Due to hydraulic failure, you want a wide downwind, inform controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【由于液压失效，你想要一个宽三边，告知管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA321, request a wide downwind due hydraulic system failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航三两幺，由于液压失效，请求一个宽三边。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, wide downwind approved, cleared to land, runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，允许宽三边，可以着陆，跑道18右。
cards.referenceText: Roger, wide downwind, cleared to land runway 18R, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，宽三边，可以着陆跑道18右，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA937, you are at G213, receive information N, call Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航937，你在213号机位，收到通播N，呼叫武汉放行，请求ATC放行至阿姆斯特丹。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA937. Gate 213, Information N, destination Amsterdam, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，国航937。机位213，通播N，目的地阿姆斯特丹，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: CCA937, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route. Follow ZF-12D departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9500m, after departure contact 125.65, squawk 3251, runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹。ZF-12D离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度9500米，离场后联系125.65，应答机3251，跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, ZF-12D departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9500m, departure 125.65, squawk 3251, runway 18L, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹。ZF-12D离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度9500米，离场后联系125.65，应答机3251，跑道18左，国航937。

cards.audioText: CCA937, read back correct, expect slot time 20 due to temporary departure restriction. Report when ready for pushback and start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，复诵正确，根据临时离场限制，预计离场时间20分。准备好推出开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Expect slot time 20, wilco, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计离场时间20，将照办，国航937。

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller that there are two passengers missing, and the bags have already removed from the aircraft. The load sheet is amended. Contact the controller to report the situation and state you are ready for push.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉管制员机上两名乘客没来，他们的行李已卸下。舱单已经修订。联系管制员报告该情况，并说明你已准备好推出。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA937, two passengers missing and bags are removed, request pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，国航937，2名乘客没来，行李已经卸下，请求推出。

cards.audioText: CCA937, Delivery, the slot time restriction cancelled. Contact Ground on 121.75 for pushback and start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，放行，离场限制取消。联系地面121.75，请求推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Contact Ground 121.75, CCA937.

cards.audioText: CCA937, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, report ready taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，武汉地面，同意推出开车，准备好滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, report ready taxi, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，准备好滑行时报告，国航937。

cards.audioText: [You are ready for taxi, call Ground you can taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你准备好滑行，告诉地面你可以滑行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA937, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航937，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CCA937, taxi to the holding point of runway 18L via Z4, A2, A, hold short of E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，沿滑行道Z4，A2，A滑行至跑道18左等待点，在E1外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A2, A to runway 18L, hold short of E1, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A2，A滑行至跑道18左等待点，在E1外等待。国航937。

cards.audioText: CCA937, hold position. Your company operation asks you to contact them on frequency 133.9. Advise when you are ready taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，原地等候。你公司的运行部门要求你联系他们133.9。准备好滑出报告。
cards.referenceText: Holding. Contact company operation on 133.9. Report when ready for taxi, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待。联系公司133.9。准备好滑出报告，国航937。

cards.audioText: [Company tells you that the ground staff made a mistake during the baggage removal procedure. You want to taxi back to the gate.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【公司告诉你，地面工作人在行李拆卸程序中犯了一个错误。你想要滑回停机位。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA937, request taxi back due baggage problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航937，由于行李问题，请求滑回。

cards.audioText: CCA937, taxi to Gate 213 via M, M3, Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，沿滑行道M，M3，Z4滑回213号机位。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to Gate 213 via M, M3, Z4, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道M，M3，Z4滑回213号机位，国航937。

cards.audioText: [Now the baggage problem has been fixed. You ask for pushback and start up again.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在行李问题解决了。重新请求推出开车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA937, gate 213, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航937，213号机位，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CCA937, a cold front is advancing to the airport. Expect change runway 04. Standby for the new departure clearance. Pushback and start-up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，机场现在有冷锋临近。预计更换跑道04。稍等新的离场许可。同意推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved. Runway 04. Standby for new departure clearance due weather, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车。跑道04。由于天气，等待新的离场许可，国航937。

cards.audioText: CCA937, recleared to Amsterdam, follow ZF-01D departure, runway 04, initial climb 1500m, rest unchanged.[Read back the instructions and advise when you are ready for taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，重新许可放行至阿姆斯特丹，ZF-01D离场，跑道04，起始高度1500米，其余不变。【复诵指令，准备好滑行时报告。】
cards.referenceText: Recleared to Amsterdam, follow ZF-01D departure, runway 04, initial climb 1500m, rest unchanged. Request taxi, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重新许可放行至阿姆斯特丹，ZF-01D离场，跑道04，起始高度1500米，其余不变。请求滑行，国航937。

cards.audioText: [You are rotate normally. Report you are airborne, passing 900m, climbing for 1500m, request cancel SID.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机抬轮正常。离地时报告，通过900米，上升1500米，请求取消SID。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA937, airborne, passing 900m, climbing to 1500m, request cancel SID.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，国航937，离地，通过900米，上升1500米，请求取消SID。

cards.audioText: CCA937, Wuhan Departure, radar contact. Cancel SID, Direct to ZF, climb and maintain 4500m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，武汉离场，雷达已识别。取消SID，直飞ZF，上升保持标压4500米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, direct to ZF, climb and maintain 4500m on standard, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消SID，直飞ZF，上升保持标压4500米，国航937。

cards.audioText: [The No. 2 engine produced intermittent noises, as a precaution, you want to terminate the flight and return. Notify the Wuhan Departure and request level off at 2700m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【2号发动机产生间歇性噪音，为了预警，你想要中止飞行，返回机场。通知武汉离场，请求在2700米平飞。】
cards.referenceText: Departure, CCA937, request level off at 2700m and return to Wuhan airport due to engine No.2 problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场，国航937，由于2号发动机问题，请求2700米平飞并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CCA937, climb and maintain 2700m, turn left heading 220. Radar vector for runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，上升保持2700米，左转航向220。雷达引导至跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 2700m, turn left heading 220. Radar vector for runway 04, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持2700米，左转航向220。雷达引导至跑道04，国航937。

cards.audioText: [To avoid overweight landing. You request a 15min fuel dumping.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【为了防止飞机超重着陆。请求放油15分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA937, Request fuel dumping for 15min to reduce the landing weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，国航937，为了减小着陆重量，请求放油15分钟。

cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is CCA1301, from Beijing to Guangzhou. You are now at stand 133, with information F. Ask for your ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航1301，从北京飞往广州。你现在在133停机位，收到通播F，请求你的管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CCA1301, stand 133, information F, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，国航1301,133停机位，通播F，请求管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, follow VYK 02D Departure, initial climb 1200m on QNH1023, cruising level 10,300m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，按照VYK 02D离场，初始爬升至1200米，修正海压1023，巡航高度10300米，离场后联系120.6，应答机4523。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, follow VYK 02D Departure, initial climb 1200m on QNH1023, cruising level 10,300m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，按照VYK 02D离场，初始爬升至1200米，修正海压1023，巡航高度10300米，离场后联系120.6，应答机4523，国航1301。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are ready for pushback and startup, contact Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你准备好推出开车了，联系地面。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，国航1301，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，可以推出开车，面朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，面朝西，国航1301。

cards.audioText: N: [All engines have been started, everything checked out normal, request taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【所有发动机已经启动，所有项目检查正常，请求滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, request taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，国航1301，请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, taxi to runway 35R via taxiway Y3, T5 and E to holding point C2.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，经由Y3，T5和E，滑行至跑道35右等待点C2。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to runway 35R via taxiway Y3 and T5 and E to holding point C2, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Y3，T5和E，滑行至跑道35右等待点C2，国航1301。

cards.audioText: N: [You are now at holding point of runway 35R. You want to take off immediately.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在跑道35右外等待点，你想立即起飞。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, holding point of runway 35R, request immediate departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1301，跑道35右外等待点，请求立即起飞。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1301, Beijing Tower, negative at the moment, traffic on final, hold short of runway 35R, report the traffic on final in sight.
N: [Inform the controller you’ve got the visual contact to the aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1301，北京塔台，暂时不行，五边上有航空器，在跑道35右外等待，看到五边上的航空器后报。
【告知管制员你已经看到航空器了。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, holding short of runway 35R, traffic in sight, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，在跑道35右外等待，看到航空器了，国航1301。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, Beijing Tower, after the landing traffic vacated from G6, line up and wait.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，北京塔台，在着陆航空器通过G6脱离后，上跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: After the landing traffic vacated from G6, line up and wait, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在着陆航空器通过G6脱离后，上跑道等待，国航1301。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, wind 300 at 6, runway 35R, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，风向300，6米每秒，跑道35右，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 35R, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道35右，国航1301。

cards.audioText: N: [During the takeoff rolling, you read high starboard engine vibration. For safety precautions, you performed a rejected takeoff and shut down the starboard engine. Inform controller your situation, and you also want to know if there is any visual fire on the landing gears and tyres.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在起飞滑跑期间，你的右发抖震偏高，出于安全起见，你执行了中断起飞并关闭了右发。告知管制员此情况，并且你想知道起落架和轮胎处是否有明火。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, we aborted takeoff due right engine vibration, and we’ve shut down the engine. Confirm if there is any visual fire on the landing gears and tyres.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1301，由于右发抖震，我们执行了中断起飞，我们已经关断了右发。证实我们的起落架和轮胎处是否有明火。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1301, Beijing Tower, negative, no visual fire on the landing gears or tyres, report intention.
N: [Tell the controller you want to vacate runway and taxi to the ramp for a thorough check but you have to wait to cool the brakes for about 5 minutes. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1301，北京塔台，不，起落架和轮胎处没有明火。报告意图。
【告知管制员你想脱离跑道，滑行至机坪进行全面检查，但是你需要等待大约5分钟来冷却刹车。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request vacate runway and taxi to the ramp for a check after cooling the brakes for about 5 minutes., CCA1301
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求冷却刹车大概5分钟后脱离跑道，滑行至机坪进行全面检查， 国航1301。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CCA1301, when ready, take next right on G4, contact Ground on 122.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，国航1301，准备好后。使用下一个右方脱离道G4，联系地面122.7。
cards.referenceText: Next right on G4, 122.7, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下一个右方脱离道G4，122.7，国航1301。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, Beijing Ground, taxi back to the apron via G4, G and Y6.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，北京地面，经由滑行道G4，G和Y6滑行至机坪。
cards.referenceText: Taxi back to the apron via G4, G and Y6, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道G4，G和Y6滑行至机坪，国航1301。

cards.audioText: N: [During taxi back, you noticed an A320 ahead of you is leaking a significant amount of fuel from the bottom of the left engine. Tell ATC about the situation. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在滑行过程中，你发现前面的A320从左发底部漏出大量燃油。告知管制员此情况。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA1301, an A320 ahead of us is leaking fuel from left engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，国航1301，我们前面的A320左发正在漏油。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, roger, hold for a few minutes, the airport maintenance staff and services will be there in a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，收到，等待几分钟，机场机务人员和服务将会在几分钟后到达。
cards.referenceText: Holding, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，国航1301。

cards.audioText: N: [It is late in the night, the maintenance engineers have fixed all the problems and you’re now on the runway 35R. Request takeoff clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在已经是夜里，机务人员已经解决了所有问题，你现在在跑道35右。请求起飞许可。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1301, runway 35R, request departure clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航1301，跑道35右，请求离场许可。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, change to CY08 departure, wind calm, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，更改为CY08离场，静风，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: CY08 departure, cleared for takeoff, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: CY08离场，可以起飞，国航1301。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1301, keep runway heading until 800m, after airborne, contact Beijing Departure on 119.5 for further instructions, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1301，保持跑道航向直到800米。离地后联系北京离场119.5，再见。
cards.referenceText: Runway heading until 800m, 119.5, good day, CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道航向直到800米，119.5，再见，国航1301。

topics.name: CCA1368 [等待，跑道入侵，刹车性能]

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA1368, you are approaching DUGEB, maintaining 5400m, squawk 1021 with information B, contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航幺三六八，你现在到达DUGEB，在五千四保持，应答机幺洞两幺，通播Bravo，联系北京进近】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1368, approaching DUGEB, maintaining 5400m, squawk 1021, information B.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航幺三六八，接近DUGEB，在五千四保持，应答机幺洞两幺，通播Bravo。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, Beijing Approach, radar contact, cleared for DUGEB-9Z Arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，北京进近，雷达看见了，可以DUGEB-Niner Zulu进近，预计盲降跑道三六右。
cards.referenceText: DUGEB-9Z Arrival, runway 36R, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: DUGEB-Niner Zulu进近，跑道三六右，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, turn right heading 060, track direct to AA443, descend to and maintain 4500m by AA443.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，右转航向洞六洞，直飞Alpha Alpha四四三，在Alpha Alpha四四三之前下到四千五。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 060, track direct to AA443, descend to and maintain 4500m by AA443, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向洞六洞，直飞Alpha Alpha四四三，在Alpha Alpha四四三之前下到四千五，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1368, due landing delays at Beijing about 20 minutes, you are expected to hold at AA442.
[You want to know the holding details.]
cards.audioTextZh:
管：国航幺三六八，由于北京机场着陆延误二十分钟，预计你要在Alpha Alpha四四两等待。
【你想知道等待的细节】
cards.referenceText: Request holding instructions, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求等待程序，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, hold over AA442 130 radial 14 DME fix, one and a half minute inbound legs, left hand pattern, maintain 2700m, expect further clearance at 45, time now 30.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，在Alpha Alpha四四两一百三十度径向线DME幺四海里点等待，入航时间一分半，左等待，保持两拐，预计进一步许可时间四五分，当前时间三洞分。
cards.referenceText: Hold over AA442 130 radial 14 DME fix, one and a half minute inbound legs, left hand pattern, maintain 2700m, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在Alpha Alpha四四两一百三十度径向线DME幺四海里点等待，入航时间一分半，左等待，保持两拐，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: [The fuel indicator in your cockpit shows that the fuel endurance is 50 minutes, inform the controller that you have to leave the hold otherwise you will be at minimum fuel.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你驾驶舱内的油量指示燃油续航为五十分，告知管制员你必须要离开等待程序，否则你将进入最低燃油】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1368, our endurance is 50 minutes, request leave the hold otherwise we will be at the minimum fuel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航幺三六八，我们的燃油续航五十分，请求离开等待，否则我们将进入最低燃油。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, Beijing roger, leave the holding pattern and turn left heading 033, further descend to 2400m and contact Beijing Tower on 118.3, we have informed your situation to them.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，北京收到，离开等待程序，左转航向洞三三，继续下到两千四，联系北京塔台幺幺八点三，我们已经向他们告知你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Leave the holding pattern and turn left heading 033, further descend to 2400m and contact Beijing Tower on 118.3, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离开等待程序，左转航向洞三三，继续下到两千四，联系北京塔台幺幺八点三，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: [You are now 18 miles from touchdown, and you have received the latest information O, contact Beijing Tower and request straight-in ILS approach 36L due fuel problem. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
参考答案：
【你现在距离接地点幺八海里，你已收到通播Oscar，联系北京塔台，由于燃油问题，请求直接进近跑道三六左。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1368, 18 miles from touchdown, information O, request straight-in ILS approach 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航幺三六八，接地点幺八海里，通播Oscar，请求直接进近跑道三六左。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, Beijing Tower, radar contact, cleared ILS approach runway 36L, descend and maintain 1800m.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，北京塔台，雷达看见了，可以盲降进近跑道三六左，下一千八保持。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 36L, descend and maintain 1800m, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以盲降进近跑道三六左，下一千八保持，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, fly heading 360, continue descent and maintain 1200m, increase your rate of descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，航向三六洞，继续下一千二保持，加速下降。
cards.referenceText: Heading 360, descend and maintain 1200m, wilco, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航向三六洞，继续下一千二保持，将照办，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, reduce speed to 200 knots until 10 DME, descend to 900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，速度减小到两百节直到DME十海里，下九百。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to 200 knots until 10 DME, descend to 900m, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 速度减小到两百节直到DME十海里，下九百，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, turn left heading 330, intercept localizer runway 36L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，左转航向三三洞，切跑道三六左航向道，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 330, intercept localizer runway 36L, wilco, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向三三洞，切跑道三六左航向道，照办，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller you have intercepted the localizer of runway 36L.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知管制员你已经切跑道三六左的航向道】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1368, intercepted the localizer of runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航幺三六八，已经切跑道三六左的航向道。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, roger, reduce speed to 180 knots, continue approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，速度减小至一百八十节，继续进近。
cards.referenceText: 180 knots, continue approach, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一百八十节，继续进近，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: [As you are landing, you see a ground vehicle on runway 36L, you decide to perform the missed approach procedure, inform Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在着陆时，你看到跑道三六左上有一辆车，你决定执行复飞，告知塔台】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1368, going around, a ground vehicle on runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航幺三六八，复飞了，跑道三六左上有车辆。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, roger, turn left heading 300, climb and maintain 900m. The vehicle was inspecting the runway surface, and he didn’t vacate the runway in time as instructed.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，左转航向三洞洞，上九百保持，车辆在检查跑道道面，他没有按照指示脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 300, climb and maintain 900m, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向三洞洞，上九百保持，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, change to land on runway 01, wind 240 degrees 18 knots, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，改到跑道洞幺着陆，风两四洞度幺八节，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 01, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道洞幺，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: [After landing, you notice that the runway surface is slippery, and you managed to stop your aircraft 200 meters near the stop end, you suspect the runway braking action of runway 01 is medium to poor, inform Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【着陆后，你发现跑道道面湿滑，你在跑道头两百米处停住飞机，你怀疑跑道洞幺刹车性能中到差，告知塔台】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA1368, the runway surface is slippery. We stop our aircraft 200 meters near the stop end, and we suspect the braking action of runway 01 is medium to poor.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航幺三六八，跑道道面湿滑，我们在跑道头两百米处停住飞机，我们怀疑跑道洞幺刹车性能中到差。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, roger, thanks, vacate runway via E3, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，收到，谢谢，经由Echo三脱离，脱离后报。
cards.referenceText: Vacate runway via E3, wilco, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Echo三脱离跑道，照办，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is CCA2119, you are maintaining 4,500 meters over VYK, you have received information X, make an initial contact with Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航2119，你现在正保持在4500米，过VYK，你已经收到通播X，与北京进近进行初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, maintaining 4500m, over VYK, information X.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，正保持4500米，过VYK， 通播X。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descent to 3,000m, QNH 1011, expect ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，北京进近，雷达看见了，下3000米，修压1011，预计盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Descent to 3,000m, QNH 1011, expect ILS approach runway 36R, CCA2119.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下3000米，修压1011，预计盲降进近跑道36右，国航2119。

cards.audioText: N: [Your weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, ask Beijing Approach to turn left to circumnavigate the weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，询问北京进近，左转绕飞天气。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, request turn left to avoid the weather ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，请求左转避开天气。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, negative due prohibited area. Turn right heading 030.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，由于禁飞区，不可以，右转航向030。
cards.referenceText: Roger, turn right heading 030, CCA2119.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，右转航向030，国航2119。

cards.audioText: N: [During maneuver, your left windshield has cracked, report it to Beijing Approach and request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在机动过程中，你的左侧风挡破裂，报告给北京进近，请求下降。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, request descent due left windshield cracked.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，由于风挡破裂，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, turn right heading 330, descend to and maintain 1,800 meters, when able, advise your situation on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，右转航向330，下到1800米保持，可以的时候，报告机上情况。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to and maintain 1,800 meters, wilco, CCA2119.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向330，下到1800米保持，照办，国航2119。

cards.audioText: N: [A few minutes later, tell the controller that the aircraft is still controlled and there are no injuries on board.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【几分钟后，告知管制员，飞机仍旧可以控制，机上没有人受伤。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, aircraft is under control, and no one injured on board.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，飞机现在可以控制，机上没有人受伤。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, continue present heading, descent to 1,200 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，保持当前航向，下1200米保持，可以盲降进近。跑道36右，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: Continue present heading, descent to 1,200 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, wilco, CCA2119.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，下1200米保持，可以盲降进近，跑道36右，照办，国航2119。

cards.audioText: N: [Now you have established on the localizer runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在已经建立跑道36右的航向道。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, established on the localizer runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，建立跑道36右的盲降。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, radar service terminated, you are 10 miles from touchdown, contact Beijing Tower 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，雷达服务终止，你现在距离接地点10海里，联系北京塔台118.5。
cards.referenceText: Roger, 118.5 CCA2119.

cards.audioText: N: [Now You are 10 miles from touchdown, Contact Beijing Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在距离接地点10海里，联系北京塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA2119, 10 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航2119，距离接地点10海里。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, surface wind 350 degrees, 5 knots, runway 36R, clear to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，地面风350度，5节，跑道36右，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, clear to land, CCA2119.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，可以落地，国航2119。

cards.audioText: N: [After landing, you can’t find the taxiway clearly, ask Beijing Ground for a tug to tow you to the apron.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【落地之后，你不发清晰找到滑行道，请求北京地面安排一辆拖车将你拖回机坪。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA2119, request a tug to tow back to the apron due windshield cracked.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，国航2119，由于风挡破裂，请求一辆拖车将我们拖回机坪。

cards.audioText: C: CCA2119, hold position, the tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航2119，原地等待，拖车正在路上。
cards.referenceText: Holding position, roger thanks, CCA2119.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，收到，谢谢，国航2119。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA532, you are at Wuhan airport, Gate 211, information V received, request ATC clearance to Changsha.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航532，你在武汉机场，211号机位，收到通播V，请求ATC放行至长沙。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 532, Gate 211, information V, destination Changsha, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，国航532，211号机位，通播V，目的地长沙，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 8400m, runway 04, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 2016.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，武汉放行，可以按计划航路放行至长沙，LKO-02离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度8400米，跑道04，联系离场119.7，应答机2016。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 8400m, runway 04, Departure 119.7, squawk 2016, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往长沙，LKO-02离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度8400米，跑道04，联系离场119.7，应答机2016，国航532。

cards.audioText: [Now you are ready for pushback and start-up, contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经准备好推出开车，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA 532, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航532，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, facing east.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，武汉地面，可以推出开车，头朝东。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, facing east, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，头朝东，国航532。

cards.audioText: [You are now on the taxiway Z4 with your engines running. Ask Ground for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在滑行道Z4上，发动机全部起动。向地面请求滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA532, taxiway Z4 with engines running, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航532，滑行道Z4上，发动机全部起动，请求滑出。

cards.audioText: CCA532, taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A. hold short of A4.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，沿滑行道Z4，A滑行至跑道04，在A4外等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via Z4, A. hold short of A4, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A滑行至跑道04，在A4外等待，国航532。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Ground, caution, work in progress near the right side of taxiway A3.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，地面，小心，滑行道A3右侧附近正在施工。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger caution, thanks, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到谨慎（滑行），谢谢，国航532。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Ground, give way to the A320 vacating on E3, when the traffic is clear, continue taxi A, A9, hold short of runway 04.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，地面，给滑行道E3上的A320让路，没影响后，继续沿滑行道A，A9滑行，在跑道04外等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Give way to the A320, when traffic is clear, continue taxi A, A9, hold short of runway 04, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给A320让路，活动清除时，继续沿滑行道A，A9滑行，在跑道04外等待，国航532。

cards.audioText: [Now you are airborne at 900m climbing, contact Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机已离地，高度900米上升，联系武汉离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA532 airborne, passing 900m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，国航532，离地，通过900米。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000m on QNH 1020.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，武汉离场，雷达已识别，左转直飞DA，上升保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1020。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000m on QNH 1020, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，上升保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1020，国航532。

cards.audioText: CCA532, climb and maintain 6600m on standard, expedite passing 3900m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，上升保持标压6600米，快速通过3900米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 6600m on standard, expedite passing 3900m, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持标压6600米，快速通过3900米，国航532。

cards.audioText: [You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6600m, request higher level and state Wuhan Control the reason.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在6600米遇到了中度积冰，请求更高飞行高度，并向武汉区调说明原因。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA532, maintaining 6600m, request higher level due moderate icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，国航532，保持6600米，由于中度积冰，请求高高度。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Wuhan Control climb and maintain 7200m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，武汉区调，上升保持7200米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 7200m, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持7200米，国航532。

cards.audioText: [Suddenly your starboard engine failed at 7200m, make an urgency call ATC, and request descent and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在7200米时，右侧发动机突然失效，紧急呼叫ATC，并请求下降，返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CCA532, maintaining 7200m, right engine failure, request descent and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，国航532，保持7200米，右侧发动机失效，请求下降，返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CCA532, roger PANPAN, descend and maintain 4200m, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for runway 04.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，收到PANPAN，下降保持4200米，左转航向010，雷达引导至跑道04。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200m, left heading 010, expect radar vector runway 04, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导至跑道04，国航532。

cards.audioText: CCA532, continue descend and maintain 3000m on QNH 1019.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，继续下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1019。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 3000m on QNH1019, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压3000米，修正海压1019，国航532。

cards.audioText: [You failed to restart the right engine, ask ATC for priority landing, also ask for the longest runway for safety concerns.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【右侧发动机重启失败，向ATC请求优先着陆，提供最长的跑道。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CCA532, we failed to restart the right engine, request priority land and the longest runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，国航532，右侧发动机重启失败，请求优先着陆，并提供最长的跑道。

cards.audioText: [Now you have established on ILS approach runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立的盲降进近跑道36右，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA532, established on ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航532，建立盲降进近跑道36右。

cards.audioText: [You are at G213, receive information N, call Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在213号机位，收到通播N，呼叫武汉放行，请求ATC放行至阿姆斯特丹。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA987. Gate 213, Information N, destination Amsterdam, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，国航987。机位213，通播N，目的地阿姆斯特丹，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: CCA987, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route. Follow ZF-12D departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9500m, after departure contact 125.65, squawk 3251, runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹。ZF-12D离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度9500米，离场后联系125.65，应答机3251，跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, ZF-12D departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9500m, departure 125.65, squawk 3251, runway 18L, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹。ZF-12D离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度9500米，离场后联系125.65，应答机3251，跑道18左，国航987。

cards.audioText: CCA987, read back correct, expect slot time 20 due to temporary departure restriction. Report when ready for pushback and start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，复诵正确，根据临时离场限制，预计离场时间20分。准备好推出开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Slot time 20, report ready for pushback and start-up, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场时间20分，准备好推出开车时报告，国航987。

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller that there are two passengers missing, and the bags have already removed from the aircraft. The load sheet is amended. Contact the controller to report the situation and state you are ready for push.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉管制员机上两名乘客没来，他们的行李已卸下。舱单已经修订。联系管制员报告该情况，并说明你已准备好推出。】
cards.referenceText: WuhanDelivery, CCA987, two passengers missing and bags are removed, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，国航987，2名乘客没来，行李已经卸下，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CCA987, Delivery, the slot time restriction cancelled. Contact Ground on 121.75 for pushback and start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，放行，离场限制取消。联系地面121.75，请求推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Contact Ground 121.75, CCA987.

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller you can start the engines and request taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉管制员你可以启动发动机，请求滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA987, request start-up and taxi instruction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航987，请求开车及滑行指令。

cards.audioText: CCA987, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, report ready taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，武汉地面，同意推出开车，准备好滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, report ready taxi, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，准备好滑行时报告，国航987。

cards.audioText: [You are ready for taxi, call Ground you can taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你准备好滑行，告诉地面你可以滑行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA987, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航987，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CCA987, taxi to the holding point of runway 18L via Z4, A2, A, hold short of E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，沿滑行道Z4，A2，A滑行至跑道18左等待点，在E1外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A2, A to runway 18L, hold short of E1, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A2，A滑行至跑道18左等待点，在E1外等待。国航987。

cards.audioText: CCA987, hold position. Your company operation asks you to contact them on frequency 133.9. Advise when you are ready taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，原地等候。你公司的运行部门要求你联系他们133.9。准备好滑出报告。
cards.referenceText: Holding. Contact company operation on 133.9. Report when ready for taxi, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待。联系公司133.9。准备好滑出报告，国航987。

cards.audioText: [Company tells you that the ground staff made a mistake during the baggage removal procedure. You want to taxi back to the gate.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【公司告诉你，地面工作人在行李拆卸程序中犯了一个错误。你想要滑回停机位。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA987, request taxi back due baggage problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航987，由于行李问题，请求滑回。

cards.audioText: CCA987, taxi to Gate 213 via M, M3, Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，沿滑行道M，M3，Z4滑回213号机位。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to Gate 213 via M, M3, Z4, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道M，M3，Z4滑回213号机位，国航987。

cards.audioText: [Now the baggage problem has been fixed. You ask for pushback and start up again.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在行李问题解决了。重新请求推出开车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA987, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航987，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CCA987, a cold front is advancing to the airport. Expect change runway 04. Standby for the new departure clearance. Pushback and start-up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，机场现在有冷锋临近。预计更换跑道04。稍等新的离场许可。同意推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved. Runway 04. Standby for new departure clearance due weather, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车。跑道04。由于天气，等待新的离场许可，国航987。

cards.audioText: CCA987, recleared to Amsterdam, follow ZF-01D departure, runway 04, initial climb 1500m, rest unchanged.[Read back the instructions and advise when you are ready for taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，重新许可放行至阿姆斯特丹，ZF-01D离场，跑道04，起始高度1500米，其余不变。【复诵指令，准备好滑行时报告。】
cards.referenceText: Recleared to Amsterdam, follow ZF-01D departure, runway 04, initial climb 1500m, rest unchanged. Request taxi, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重新许可放行至阿姆斯特丹，ZF-01D离场，跑道04，起始高度1500米，其余不变。请求滑行，国航987。

cards.audioText: [You are rotate normally. Report you are airborne, passing 900m, climbing for 1500m, request cancel SID.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机抬轮正常。离地时报告，通过900米，上升1500米，请求取消SID。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA987, airborne, passing 900m, climbing to 1500m, request cancel SID.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，国航987，离地，通过900米，上升1500米，请求取消SID。

cards.audioText: CCA987, Wuhan Departure, radar contact. Cancel SID, Direct to ZF, climb and maintain 4500m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，武汉离场，雷达已识别。取消SID，直飞ZF，上升保持标压4500米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, direct to ZF, climb and maintain 4500m on standard, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消SID，直飞ZF，上升保持标压4500米，国航987。

cards.audioText: [The No. 2 engine produced intermittent noises, as a precaution, you want to terminate the flight and return. Notify the Wuhan Departure and request level off at 2700m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【2号发动机产生间歇性噪音，为了预警，你想要中止飞行，返回机场。通知武汉离场，请求在2700米平飞。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA987, request level off at 2700m and return to Wuhan airport due to engine No.2 problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，国航987，由于2号发动机问题，请求2700米平飞并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CCA987, climb and maintain 2700m, turn left heading 220. Radar vector for runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，上升保持2700米，左转航向220。雷达引导至跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 2700m, turn left heading 220. Radar vector for runway 04, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持2700米，左转航向220。雷达引导至跑道04，国航987。

cards.audioText: [To avoid overweight landing. You request a 15min fuel dumping.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【为了防止飞机超重着陆。请求放油15分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CCA987, Request fuel dumping for 15min to reduce the landing weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，国航987，为了减小着陆重量，请求放油15分钟。

cards.audioText: [You are the pilot of CCA451 and now waiting for ATC clearance.]CCA451 Wuhan Tower, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, cruising level 9200m, LKO-1D departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne.[The Tower controller's voice is disturbed, and you didn't hear the words after“9200 m”, ask the controller to repeat the latter part of the instruction.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是国航451的飞行员，正在等待ATC的离场许可。】国航451，武汉塔台，可以按计划行列放行至广州，巡航高度9200米，LKO-1D离场，应答机2052，起飞后联系武汉进近118.9。【塔台的声音被干扰了，你没听到“9200米”之后的信息，请管制员重复指令的后半部分。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA451, read you 2, say again after 9200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航451，听你2个，“9200米”后信息再说一遍。

cards.audioText: CCA451, cruising level 9200 m, LKO-1D departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，巡航高度9200米，LKO-1D离场，应答机2052，起飞后联系武汉进近118.9。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou, via flight planned route, cruising level 9200m, LKO-1D departure, squawk 2052, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9 when airborne. CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至广州，巡航高度9200米，LKO-1D离场，应答机2052，起飞后联系武汉进近118.9，国航451。

cards.audioText: [You have completed the relevant checklist. Ask the Tower controller to let you to start your engine.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已完成相关检查单。告诉塔台并请求启动发动机。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA451, request start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航451，请求开车。

cards.audioText: CCA451, start-up approved, report when ready for taxi.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，可以开车，准备好滑行报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: start-up approved, report when ready for taxi, CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以开车，准备好滑行报告，国航451。

cards.audioText: [Now you are ready to taxi out, ask the Tower controller for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已准备好滑出，向塔台询问滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA451, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航451，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CCA451, taxi via taxiway A7 and A to holding point of runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，沿滑行道A7，A滑至跑道36右的等待点。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Taxiway A7 and A to holding point of runway 36R, CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道A7，A滑至跑道36右的等待点，国航451。

cards.audioText: CCA451, hold position, traffic 10 o’clock, approaching you from your left.[Acknowledge the instruction, and inform the controller that you have seen the traffic.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，原地等待，10点钟方向有飞机正在从左侧接近你。【确认收到指令，通知管制员你已看到该飞机。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, holding position, traffic in sight, CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，原地等待，飞机已看到，国航451。

cards.audioText: [Later, you are approaching the active runway 36R, ask the Tower controller for permission to enter the runway.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【过了一会儿，你正在接近现用跑道36右，向塔台请求进入该跑道。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA451, approaching runway 36R, request line up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航451，接近跑道36右，请求进跑道。

cards.audioText: CCA451, line up and wait.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，进跑道等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道等待，国航451。

cards.audioText: CCA451, cleared for takeoff, runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，可以起飞，跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 36R, CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道36右，国航451。

cards.audioText: [(This is a night operation). When you are rolling out, your speed has just reached VR, you suddenly see a slow moving object ahead of you; it is crossing the runway from left to right. You pull back and rotate to avoid the traffic, and you felt a shake from the nose gear. You get airborne at time 23, and report the accident to Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【（这是夜间作业。）滑跑时，飞机速度刚达到了VR，你看到前方有一缓慢移动的物体；它从跑道左侧穿至右侧。你立即拉杆抬头以躲避活动，同时感觉前起落架震动了一下。起飞时间23分，向武汉进近报告该事故。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA451, airborne 23, nose gear hit something during takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，国航451，起飞时间23分，起飞时前起落架撞到东西了。

cards.audioText: CCA451, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, is there any damage to the aircraft? Report your intentions.[Tell the approach controller that you want to land at Wuhan airport, and you don’t know anything about the damage.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，武汉进近，雷达已识别，飞机有损伤么？报告意图。【告诉进近你想降落在武汉机场，你不知道飞机是否有损坏。】
cards.referenceText: Request land at Wuhan airport, and we don't know anything about the damage. CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求返回武汉机场，我们不清楚是否有损伤，国航451。

cards.audioText: CCA451, roger, do you want to hold and have a check?[Tell the controller that you want to hold and check.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，收到，你想要等待并进行检查么？【告诉管制员你想等待并接受检查。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request hold and check, CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求等待并检查，国航451。

cards.audioText: Roger, CCA451, climb and maintain 900m, turn left direct to DA, and hold over DA.[Read back the controller’s instruction.]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，国航451，上升保持900米，左转直飞DA，在DA等待。【复诵管制员的指令。】
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 900m, turn left direct to DA, and hold over DA. CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持900米，左转直飞DA，在DA等待，国航451。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you found out that there is something wrong with the nose gear. Tell the controller you need to dump fuel before landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员，你发现前起落架有些故障。告诉管制员着陆前飞机需要放油。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA451, we have something wrong with the nose gear; we have to dump fuel before landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，国航451，飞机前起落架有故障，着陆前我们必须放油。

cards.audioText: Roger, CCA451, climb and maintain 2100m, turn left heading 130, radar vector to the dumping area.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，国航451，上升保持2100米，左转航向130，雷达引导至放油区。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 2100m, turning left heading 130, CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持2100米，左转航向130，国航451。

cards.audioText: [Later, inform the controller that you have finished the fuel dumping and want to be radar guided to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【过了一会儿，通知管制员你已完成放油，想要雷达引导至武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA451, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，国航451，放油完成，请求雷达引导至武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CCA451, descend and maintain 900m, turn right heading 290, radar vector for the ILS approach runway 36L.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，下降保持900米，右转航向290，雷达引导盲降进近跑道36左。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900m, turn right heading 290, ILS approach runway 36L. CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，右转航向290，盲降进近跑道36左，国航451。

cards.audioText: CCA451, do you need any assistance upon landing?[Tell the controller that you are going to make a landing without nose gear, you need fire trucks and a foamed runway.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，着陆后需要帮助么？【告诉管制员，你准备进行无起落架着陆，需要消防车及一条泡沫跑道。】
cards.referenceText: We are going to land without the nose gear; request fire trucks and a foamed runway. CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们准备进行无起落架着陆，请求提供消防车及泡沫跑道，国航451。

cards.audioText: Roger CCA451, foamed runway and fire trucks will be ready upon landing.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，国航451，着陆时泡沫跑道及消防车将会准备好。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，国航451。

cards.audioText: CCA451, reduce speed to 180 knots.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，减速到180节。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Reducing speed to180 knots, CCA451.

cards.audioText: CCA451, turn left heading 330 to intercept the localizer for runway 36L, report established.[Read back the controller’s instruction.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，左转航向330，切入跑道36左航道，建立后报告。【复诵管制员指令。】
cards.referenceText: Left heading 330 to intercept the localizer of runway 36L, report established, CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向330，切入跑道36左航道，建立后报告，国航451。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you have captured the localizer.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员你已截获航道。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CCA451, established Localizer.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，国航451，已建立航道。

cards.audioText: Roger, CCA451, cleared ILS approach runway 36L, 13 miles from touch down, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，国航451，可以盲降进近跑道36左，距离着陆13海里，雷达服务中止，联系武汉塔台124.35。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 36L, contact Wuhan Tower 124.35. CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以盲降进近跑道36左，联系武汉塔台124.35，国航451。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA983, from Los Angeles to Beijing, DABMA 30, level 9800m, SABEM 45, contact Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是CCA（国航）983，飞机从洛杉矶飞往北京，DABMA 30分，高度9800米，SABEM 45分，联系北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, from Los Angeles to Beijing, DABMA 30, maintaining 9800m, SABEM 45.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航983，洛杉矶飞往北京，DABMA 30分，9800米保持，SABEM 45分。

cards.audioText: CCA983, Beijing Control, confirm squawk 1230.[Your squawk is 1232.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，北京区调，证实应答机1230。【你的应答机编码是1232。】
cards.referenceText: Negative, squawk is 1232, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不对，应答机编码1232，国航983。

cards.audioText: Roger, CCA983, squawk 1232, radar contact.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，国航983，应答机1232, 雷达看到。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，国航983。

cards.audioText: [You are experiencing severe turbulence, request descent to low level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在经历严重颠簸，请求下降到低高度层。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983. We are experiencing severe turbulence, request descent to low level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航983，我们正在经历严重颠簸，请求下降到低高度层。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, descend to 8400m.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，下降到8400米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 8400m, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到8400米，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, what is the detailed ride condition?[Tell the ATC the turbulence is caused by cumulonimbus.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，穿越颠簸状态如何？【告诉ATC颠簸是由积雨云引起的。】
cards.referenceText: The turbulence is caused by cumulonimbus, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 颠簸是由积雨云引起的，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, thanks.[Report to the controller that you have been struck by lightning.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，谢谢。【报告管制员飞机遭受了雷击。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, we have been struck by lightning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航983，我们遭受雷击。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, confirm your operations are normal?[Tell the controller that flight is smooth, but the main power doesn’t work, now you are using the auxiliary power supply.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，证实能够正常飞行？ 【告诉管制员飞行操作顺畅，但是主电源不工作，现在你正在使用辅助电源。】
cards.referenceText: Negative, flight is smooth, but the main power doesn’t work, we are using the auxiliary power supply now, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，飞行操作顺畅，失去主电源，我们现在正在使用辅助电源，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, any other problem?[There is something wrong with the navigation system, ask ATC to monitor you closely.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，还有其它问题吗？【导航系统出现问题，向ATC请求密切监控。】
cards.referenceText: Our navigation system is out of action, please keep a close eye on us, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的导航系统不工作，请对我们进行密切监控，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, where did the lightning strike you?[Only the left hand windshield was struck, others are all normal.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，雷击在飞机哪个部位？【只有左边挡风玻璃遭受雷击，其它部位全部正常。】
cards.referenceText: Lightning hit us above the left hand windshield, zero damage, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击在左挡风玻璃，无损伤，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, say intention.[Request priority landing at Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，说明意图。【请求优先着陆在北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request priority landing at Beijing airport, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求优先着陆北京机场，国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger. Turn left direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m. Expect runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到。左转直飞HUR，下降保持3600米，预计跑道01。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m. Expect runway 01, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞HUR，下降并保持3600，预计跑道01，国航983。

cards.audioText: [You want to know the weather condition at Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你想知道北京机场的天气情况。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA983, advise weather condition at Beijing airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航983，请告知北京机场的天气情况。

cards.audioText: CCA983, weather is clearing except for a little ice on the runway, expect a visual approach runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，天气晴朗，但跑道有少量冰，预计目视进近跑道01。
cards.referenceText: Visual approach, runway 01, thanks, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 目视进近，跑道01，谢谢，国航983。

cards.audioText: [As a passenger was bruised on the head during the turbulence, request medical service on arrival.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【因为机上有一位乘客在颠簸中擦伤头部，请求到达时的医疗服务。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA983, request medical service on arrival as a passenger was hurt during the turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航983，请求到达时医疗服务，一位乘客在颠簸中受伤。

cards.audioText: CCA983, medical services will be ready on arrival.[You have established localizer, contact Beijing Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，医疗服务将在到达后就位。【你已经建立好航向道，联系北京塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA983, established localizer.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，国航983，已建立好航向道。

cards.audioText: CCA983, cleared to land runway 01, runway is covered with patches of ice, braking action poor, use caution.[Readback and ask the tower whether the preceding aircraft can land normally.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，允许着陆跑道01，跑道被冰覆盖，刹车效应差，务必谨慎。【复诵并向塔台询问前面的飞机是否能正常着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 01, braking action poor, did the preceding aircraft land normally? CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 允许着陆跑道01，刹车效应差，前机能正常着陆吗？国航983。

cards.audioText: CCA983, all preceding aircraft had normal landings, standing ice is not that serious.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983, 之前的所有飞机都已经正常着陆，积冰不是非常严重。
cards.referenceText: Thanks, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 谢谢，国航983。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA991, you are just over CD at 6000m, ask Beijing Approach to transfer you to Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是CCA991，飞机通过CD保持6000米，向北京进近请求移交至北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA991, 6000m maintaining, over CD, request change to Beijing Control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航991，保持6000米过CD，请求换频到北京区调。

cards.audioText: CCA991, climb to and maintain 6600m, contact Beijing Control 124.55.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，上升保持6600米，联系北京区调124.55。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6600m, 124.55, CCA991.

cards.audioText: [Make an initial contact with Beijing Control, 6600m maintaining, request 10400m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【与北京区调建立初次联系，6600米保持，请求上升到10400米。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA991, 6600m maintaining. Request climb to 10400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，6600米保持，请求上升到10400米。

cards.audioText: CCA991, Beijing Control. Initial climb to and maintain 8400m, standby for higher due to traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，北京区调。起始上升保持8400米，由于活动稍等更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Initial climb to and maintain 8400m, standing by, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 初始爬升并保持8400米，稍等，国航991。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you have an indication of weather about 40km ahead of you, request turn right heading 240.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管控员你前方40千米有天气显示，请求右转航向240。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA991. We have an indication of bad weather about 40km ahead of us, request turn right heading 240.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，我们前方40千米有恶劣天气，请求右转航向240。

cards.audioText: CCA991, how many miles do you need to deviate from the weather?[You need 50-70 miles to deviate.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，你需要偏航多少海里绕飞天气？【你需要偏航50到70海里。】
cards.referenceText: Request deviation 50 to 70 miles, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求偏航50到70海里，国航991。

cards.audioText: CCA991, standby, we will ask the Air Force.[Hurry up, otherwise you will enter CBs.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，稍等，我们会询问空军。【要赶快，否则将会飞入积雨云。】
cards.referenceText: Request expedite, we are near the CBs, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求加快，我们接近积雨云了，国航991。

cards.audioText: CCA991, deviation approved. Turn right heading 240 to deviate, no more than 80 miles, report change heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，同意偏航。右转航向240，偏航不要超过80海里，航向有变化报告。
cards.referenceText: Deviation approved, turn right heading 240 to deviate, no more than 80 miles, report change heading, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意偏航，右转航向240，偏航不超过80海里，航向有变化报告，国航991。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you have cleared of CB and request direct to WXI.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员你已远离积雨云，请求直飞WXI。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA991, cleared of weather, request direct to WXI.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，天气没影响，请求直飞WXI。

cards.audioText: CCA991, negative due to Air Force restriction. Resume course as soon as able.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，由于空军限制区不可以，尽快归航。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, resuming course, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，归航，国航991。

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller you are on course at 10400m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知管制员你在10400米归航。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA991, course resumed at 10400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，10400米归航。

cards.audioText: [You find smoke coming from engine bleed air system. Declare urgency to ATC, request lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你发现发动机引气系统有烟冒出，向ATC宣布紧急，请求更低高度。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Control, CCA991, smoke is coming from engine bleed system, request lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京区调，国航991，发动机引气系统有烟冒出，请求更低高度。

cards.audioText: CCA991, Beijing Control, roger PANPAN, descend to and maintain 6900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，北京区调，收到PANPAN，下降保持6900米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6900m, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持6900米，国航991。

cards.audioText: CCA991, Beijing Control. Report situation.[Tell the controller that you suspect something is on fire, you try to find the exact location of the fire, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，北京区调。报告情况。【告诉管制员你怀疑机上起火，你试图找出起火的准确位置，请求返回北京机场并优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: We suspect something is on fire, we are trying to locate the source now. Request return to Beijing airport and priority landing, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 疑似起火，我们正在定位火源，请求返回北京机场优先着陆，国航991。

cards.audioText: CCA991, if able turn left heading 360, descend to and maintain 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，如可能左转航向360，下降保持6300米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 360, descend to and maintain 6300m, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向360，下降保持6300米，国航991。

cards.audioText: CCA991, descend to and maintain 5100m. Contact Beijing Approach 120.6.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，下降保持5100米。联系北京进近120.6。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 5100m, 120.6, CCA991.

cards.audioText: [Make a distress call for Beijing Approach, report engine fire, request landing as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【向北京进近发出遇险信号，报告发动机起火情况，请求尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Approach, CCA991, engine fire, request expedite landing clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京进近，国航991，发动机起火，请求紧急着陆许可。

cards.audioText: CCA991, roger, descend to and maintain 1800m on QNH 1012, information D, expect ILS approach runway 18R, you are number one.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，收到，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，通播D，预计跑道18右盲降进近，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 1800m on QNH 1012, information D, ILS runway 18R, number one, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，通播D，跑道18右盲降进近，第一个，国航991。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you have open flames in the cargo compartment and rear cabin. Several passengers are hurt, request medical and fire services on landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员飞机货舱和客舱后部有明火，几位乘客受伤，请求着陆后提供医疗和消防服务。】
cards.referenceText: (Mayday Mayday, mayday) Beijing Approach, CCA991. Request medical and fire services on landing. We have open flames in the cargo compartment and rear cabin. Several passengers are hurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: （Mayday Mayday, mayday）北京进近，国航991。请求着陆后医疗和消防服务，货舱和客舱后部有明火，几位乘客受伤。

cards.audioText: CCA991, roger. Airport emergency services will be notified.[You have fully established on the ILS runway 18R, call Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，收到，将通知机场紧急服务。【你已完全建立跑道18右盲降，联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA991, ILS established runway 18R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航991，建立盲降，跑道18右。

cards.audioText: CCA991, continue approach and contact Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，继续进近，联系塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach and contact Tower 118.1, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，联系塔台118.1，国航991。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA985 from Wuhan to Frankfurt, you are at Bay 221, with information H, contact Wuhan Delivery for airway clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是国航985，从武汉飞往法兰克福，你现在在221号停机位，收到通播H，联系武汉放行，请求航路许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA985, bay 221, information H, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，国航985，221号停机位，收到通播H，请求飞往法兰克福的管制许可。

cards.audioText: CCA985, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, runway 04, follow ZF-01D departure, initially climb to 1500m on QNH, cruising level 9500m, departure frequency 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，武汉放行，可以经由计划航路飞往法兰克福，跑道04，按照ZF-01离场，初始爬升至修正海压1500米，巡航高度9500米，离场频率119.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, runway 04, follow ZF-01D departure, initially climb to 1500m on QNH, cruising level 9500m, departure frequency 119.35. CCA985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往法兰克福，跑道04，按照ZF-01离场，初始爬升至修正海压1500米，巡航高度9500米，离场频率119.35，国航985。

cards.audioText: CCA985, read back correct, your slot time is 1435, contact Wuhan Ground on 121.85.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，复诵正确，你的离场时间是14:35，联系武汉地面121.85。
cards.referenceText:
Slot time 1435, 121.85. CCA985.
（注：只要是管制员给出的离场时间（限制或许可时间），飞行员必须复诵。如果是随口告知的参考时间（非指令），可以不复诵，但谨慎起见，复诵更安全）

cards.audioText: [During pushback you have a small avionics problem, you wish to remain on taxiway Z4 for approximately 5 minutes, inform Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在推出过程中，你的航空电子设备出现了一些小问题，你希望在Z4滑行道上停留大约5分钟，告知武汉地面]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, request remain on taxiway Z4 for about 5mins due a small avionics problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航985，由于航空电子设备出现小问题，请求在Z4滑行道停留大约5分钟。

cards.audioText:
Roger, CCA985, advise when you are ready.
[You decided that the maintenance are needed before departure, tell Wuhan Ground you want to return to Gate 221 to have the plane checked by the engineers.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，国航985，准备好后告知。
[你决定，在离场前，需要对飞机进行维修，告诉武汉地面，你想返回到221号停机位，让机务检查飞机]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, request return to Gate 221 to have the plane checked by the engineers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航985，请求返回221号停机位，让机务检查飞机。

cards.audioText: CCA985, Gate 221 will be occupied by another aircraft in a minute, standby a while, I will assign you another gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985, 221号停机位会在1分钟后被另一架飞机占用，稍等下，我会给你分配别的机位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, standby. CCA985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，稍等，国航985。

cards.audioText: [The engineers have fixed the avionic problem, request Wuhan Ground for engine start up.]
cards.audioTextZh: [工程师解决了航空电子设备的问题，联系武汉地面，请求启动发动机]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, avionic problem fixed, request start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航985，航空电子设备问题解决，请求启动发动机。

cards.audioText: CCA985, your slot time is expired, your new slot time is 1615, start up at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，你的离场时间已经过期，你的新的离场时间是16:15，自行决定开车时间。
cards.referenceText: 1615, start up at own discretion, CCA985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 16：15，自行决定开车时间，国航985。

cards.audioText: [Now you have completed the engine start up procedures, call Wuhan Ground for taxiway instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在，你完成了发动机启动程序，呼叫武汉地面，请求滑行指令]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CCA985, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，国航985，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CCA985, taxi via taxiway C, M, A to holding point runway 04. Hold short of Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，经由滑行道C、M、A，滑行至跑道04，在Z4等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway C, M, A to holding point runway 04. Hold short of Z4. CCA985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道C、M、A，滑行至跑道04，在Z4等待，国航985。

cards.audioText: [You are now at holding point of runway 04, you are ready for takeoff, call Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在跑道04等待点，你准备好起飞了，呼叫武汉塔台]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, holding point of runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航985，跑道04等待点, 准备好离场了。

cards.audioText: CCA985, surface wind 070 degrees, 3 m/s, cleared for takeoff runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，地面风070度，3米每秒， 可以起飞，跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff runway 04, CCA985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道04，国航985。

cards.audioText: [Shortly after airborne, smoke is coming from the avionics bay, make a distress call to Wuhan Tower and ask for immediate return for landing. ]
cards.audioTextZh: [离地不久，烟雾从电子设备舱冒出，向武汉塔台做遇险通话，请求立即返场着陆]
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Tower, CCA985, request immediate return for landing due avionics bay smoke.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday，Mayday，Mayday，武汉塔台，国航985，由于烟雾从电子设备舱冒出，请求立即返场着陆。

cards.audioText: [Tell Tower you want to level off at 600m and remain on the Tower frequency.]
cards.audioTextZh: [告诉塔台，你希望在600米改平，并保持塔台频率]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, request level off at 600m and remain on the Tower frequency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航985，请求在600米改平，并保持塔台频率。

cards.audioText: [Tell Wuhan Tower you want to fly a right hand circuit for immediate landing runway 04.]
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉武汉塔台，你要飞右起落，并立即降落04跑道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, request a right hand circuit for immediate landing runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航985，请求飞右起落，并立即降落04跑道。

cards.audioText: CCA985, maintain 600m, turn right to join the downwind for runway 04, report when turning base.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，保持600米，右转加入三边，跑道04，进入四边后报。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 600m, turn right to join the downwind for runway 04, report when turning base. CCA985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持600米，右转加入三边，跑道04，进入四边后报，国航985。

cards.audioText: [The smoke situation cannot be controlled, request emergency services upon landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: [烟雾情况不受控制，在着陆后请求紧急服务]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CCA985, request emergency services upon landing due the smoke situation cannot be controlled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，国航985，由于烟雾情况不受控制，在着陆后请求紧急服务。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA1432, destination Beijing. You are just handed to Beijing Approach, and maintaining 4200m with information S, your squawk code is 1026, contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航1432，目的地北京。你刚刚移交给北京进近，你现在正保持在4200米，收到通播S，你的应答机编码是1026，联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1432, destination Beijing, maintaining 4200m with information S, squawk 1026.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航1432，目的地北京，正保持在4200米，通播S，应答机1026。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, Beijing Approach, radar identified, expect IKUBA-1A arrival and expect ILS approach runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，北京进近，雷达看见了，预计IKUBA-1A进近，预计盲降进近跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: IKUBA-1A arrival, runway 18L, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: IKUBA-1A进近，跑道18左，国航1432。

cards.audioText: [Your weather radar shows that there is a thunderstorm developing near your destination, and it will affect your flight, you want to know your approach time.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的气象雷达显示雷暴在你目的地机场附近形成，这将影响你的飞行，你想知道你的进近时间。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1432, request approach time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航1432，请求进近时间。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1432, expect 15 minutes delay, expect approach time 0345.
[Because of the bad weather, you want to land as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1432，预计延误15分钟，预计进近时间0345分。
【由于恶劣天气，你想尽量着陆】
cards.referenceText: Request to land as soon as possible, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求尽快着陆，国航1432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, negative, you have traffic at 12 o’clock and 5 miles, he is the number 1 for runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，不可以，你12点钟方向5海里有航空器，他第一个落地跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CCA1432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，国航1432。

cards.audioText: [Your weather radar shows a strong echo from the thunderstorm ahead. So you want radar vectors to go round the weather, ask for Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的气象雷达显示前方雷暴有很强回音。你想要雷达引导绕飞天气，请求北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA1432, request radar vectors to go round the weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航1432，请求雷达引导，绕飞天气。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1432, turn right heading 320, continue descend and maintain 3600m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航1432，右转航向320，继续按标压下到3600米保持。
