cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 311, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, the preceding aircraft reported a squall line 100 miles ahead on the weather radar, contact Beijing Control and request turn right to circumnavigate the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 311，从北京飞往广州，前机报告气象雷达上前方 100 海里有飑线，联系北京管制并请求右转绕飞天气。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 311, the preceding aircraft reported a squall line 100 miles ahead on the weather radar, request turn right to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 311，前机报告气象雷达上前方 100 海里有飑线，请求右转避让。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 311, Beijing Control, negative due prohibited area, turn left 30 degrees, track out 35 kilometers, report clear of CB.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 311，北京管制，因禁区不能同意，左转 30 度，偏航 35 公里，报告脱离 CB。
cards.referenceText: Turn left 30 degrees, track out 35 kilometers, report clear of CB, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转 30 度，偏航 35 公里，报告脱离 CB，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of CB and closing back to the course, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已脱离 CB，正回到航路，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 311, clear of CB and closing back to the course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 311，已脱离 CB，正回到航路。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 311, the preceding aircraft reported severe turbulence of 10400 meters, 11000 meters is available, what's your intention?
B: Acknowledge the transmission and tell the controller you'd like to climb to 11000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 311，前机报告 10400 米有严重颠簸，11000 米可用，你的意图？
B：确认收到并告诉管制员你想爬升至 11000 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request climb to 11000 meters, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求爬升至 11000 米，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 311, climb to and maintain 11000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 311，爬升并保持 11000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11000 meters, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11000 米，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 311, after passing MUDAM, fly direct to ASAVA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 311，过 MUDAM 后，直飞 ASAVA。
cards.referenceText: After passing MUDAM, fly direct to ASAVA, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 MUDAM 后，直飞 ASAVA，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 311, orbit right from present position until advised to weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 311，从当前位置右盘旋，直到另行通知，因前方天气。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until advised, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从当前位置右盘旋，直到另行通知，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: B: After several orbits, you find you don't have enough fuel to hold any further, report the situation to Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：几圈盘旋后，你发现没有足够燃油继续等待，向北京管制报告情况。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 311, we don't have enough fuel to hold any further.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 311，我们没有足够燃油继续等待。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 311, roger, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you require radar vector to Beijing for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 311，收到，说明意图。
B：告诉管制员你需要雷达引导到北京优先落地。
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to Beijing for priority landing, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导到北京优先落地，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 311, roger, turn left heading 190, fly direct to GUVBA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 311，收到，左转航向 190，直飞 GUVBA。
cards.referenceText: Then left heading 190, fly direct to GUVBA, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 190，直飞 GUVBA，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 311, turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published due weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 311，左转航向 150，直飞 AA446，因天气在 AA446 按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 150，直飞 AA446，在 AA446 按公布程序等待，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: B: You have been holding at AA446 for about 30 minutes, you are reaching the minimum fuel situation, contact Beijing Control and request leave the hold and land as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已在 AA446 等待约 30 分钟，正接近最低燃油状态，联系北京管制并请求离开等待并尽快着陆。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN 311, we have been holding at AA446 for about 30 minutes, we are reaching the minimum fuel situation, request leave the hold and land as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CSN 311，我们已在 AA446 等待约 30 分钟，正接近最低燃油状态，请求离开等待并尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 311, roger, leave the hold, proceed to LADIX, descent to 6000 meters, contact Beijing Approach on 119.35, we have informed them about your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 311，收到，离开等待，前往 LADIX，下降至 6000 米，联系北京进近119.35，我们已通知他们你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Leave the hold, proceed to LADIX, descent to 6000 meters, 119.35, roger, thanks, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离开等待，前往 LADIX，下降至 6000 米，119.35，收到，谢谢，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over LADIX, maintaining 6000 meters, you have received information L, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 LADIX 上空，保持 6000 米，已收到通播 L，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN 311, over LADIX, maintaining 6000 meters, information L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CSN 311，LADIX 上空，保持 6000 米，通播 L。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 311, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descent to 4200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 311，北京进近，雷达识别，下降至 4200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Descent to 4200 meters, expect radar vector ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4200 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 311。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 311, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: Tell the controller that you are declaring fuel emergency and request priority landing Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 311，你是否宣布燃油紧急情况？
B：告诉管制员你宣布燃油紧急情况，并请求跑道 36R 优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: We are declaring fuel emergency and request priority landing Runway 36R, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们宣布燃油紧急情况，请求跑道 36R 优先着陆，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 311, roger, you are number 1 to land, cleared straight in ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 311，收到，你是落地第 1 架，许可直线 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立。
cards.referenceText: Cleared straight in ILS approach Runway 36R, report established, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可直线 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立，CSN 311。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 36R, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 311, established on ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 311，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 36R。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 311, Beijing Tower, Runway 36R, clear to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 311，北京塔台，跑道 36R，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, clear to land, CSN 311.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，可以落地，CSN 311。

topics.name: CSN 102 轮挡 左发防冰失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 102, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are at gate 211, you are ready for push back and start up, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 102，从北京飞往广州，在 211 号登机口，准备好推出和开车，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN 102, gate 211, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN 102，211 号登机口，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, push back and start up approved, Runway 19R, QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，同意推出和开车，跑道 19R，QNH 1014。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, runway 19right, QNH 1014, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，跑道 19R，QNH 1014，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: You have completed push back and start up, but the chocks are still in position, inform the controller of the situation and ask ground handling to remove the chocks.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出和开车，但轮挡仍在位，告知管制员情况并请求地面保障移除轮挡。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN 102, the chocks are still in position, request ground handling to remove the chocks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN 102，轮挡仍在位，请求地面保障移除轮挡。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN 102, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN 102，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, taxi to holding point Runway 19R via taxiway Z18, M5, hold short of F.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，经滑行道 Z18、M5 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点，F 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 19R via taxiway Z18, M5, hold short of F, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z18、M5 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点，F 外等待，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of taxiway F, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 F 滑行道外等待，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN 102, holding short of taxiway F.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN 102，在 F 滑行道外等待。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, hold short of F, contact Beijing Ground on 121.95.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，F 外等待，联系北京地面121.95。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of F, 121.95, CSN 102.

cards.audioText: B: During taxi, you find there is ice and snow on the aircraft wings, contact Beijing Ground and tell the controller you want to have the ice and snow removed before takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，你发现机翼上有冰雪，联系北京地面并告诉管制员你想在起飞前除冰雪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 102, there is ice and snow on the aircraft wings, request de-icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 102，机翼上有冰雪，请求除冰。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 102, de-ice on taxiway Z4.
B: Tell Beijing Ground the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes and your slot time is 35.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 102，在滑行道 Z4 除冰。
B：告诉北京地面除冰液只有效 30 分钟，你的时隙是 35。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 102, the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes and our slot time 35.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 102，除冰液只有效 30 分钟，我们的时隙是 35。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, taxi via taxiway Z4 and F to holding point Runway 19R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，经滑行道 Z4 和 F 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4 and F to holding point Runway 19R, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4 和 F 滑行至跑道 19R 等待点，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, you are passing 600 meters, make initial contact with Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，与北京离场首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN 102, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN 102，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, Beijing Departure, radar contact, climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，北京离场，雷达识别，QNH 1014 爬升至 1800 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 1800 meters on QNH 1014, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1014 爬升至 1800 米，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: You are maintaining 1800 meters, you are encountering severe icing, tell the controller you want a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你保持 1800 米，正在遭遇严重结冰，告诉管制员你想要更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN 102, maintaining 1800 meters, we are encountering severe icing, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN 102，保持 1800 米，我们正在遭遇严重结冰，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, negative due traffic, maintain 1800 meters until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，因交通不能同意，保持 1800 米直到通知。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 1800 meters until advised, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持 1800 米直到通知，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: Now the icing condition is deteriorating, your left engine anti-ice has failed, make an Urgency call and ask for a higher level to leave icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在结冰情况恶化，你的左发防冰失效，发布紧急情况呼叫，并请求更高高度离开结冰区。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, CSN 102, the icing condition is deteriorating, our left engine anti-ice has failed, request a higher level to leave icing area.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，CSN 102，结冰情况正在恶化，我们左发防冰失效，请求更高高度离开结冰区。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, roger PAN PAN, climb to and maintain 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，收到 PANPAN，爬升并保持 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3000 meters, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 3000 米，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have left icing area, tell the controller that you have experienced severe icing between 1800 meters and 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离开结冰区，告诉管制员你在 1800 米至 2100 米之间遭遇严重结冰。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN 102, we have experienced severe icing between 1800 meters and 2100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN 102，我们在 1800 米至 2100 米之间遭遇严重结冰。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 102, descend to 900 meters on QNH 1014.
B: You confirm with Beijing Departure if you should descend to 900 meters because it is below the minimum safe altitude.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 102，QNH 1014 下降至 900 米。
B：你向北京离场确认是否应下降至 900 米，因为这低于最低安全高度。
cards.referenceText: Confirm descend to 900 meters, it is below the minimum safe altitude, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 确认下降至 900 米，这低于最低安全高度，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, my apologies, cancel speed restrictions, recleared to descend to 1500 meters on QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，抱歉，取消速度限制，重新许可 QNH 1014 下降至 1500 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel speed restrictions, descend to 1500 meters on QNH 1014, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消速度限制，QNH 1014 下降至 1500 米，CSN 102。

topics.name: CSN 001 老太太受伤 2座乘客重伤

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 001, a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are cruising at 9200 meters, squawking 3625.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 001，从广州飞往北京，在 9200 米巡航，应答机 3625。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN 001, maintaining 9200 meters, squawking 3625.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN 001，保持 9200 米，应答机 3625。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 001, Guangzhou Control, radar contact, maintain present level.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 001，广州管制，雷达识别，保持当前高度。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, CSN 001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，CSN 001。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 001, there was a severe ride report by previous pilot at 10700 meters, what's your intention?
B: Tell the controller that you'd like to climb to 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 001，前机飞行员报告 10700 米有严重颠簸，你的意图？
B：告诉管制员你想爬升至 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 11300 meters, CSN 001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求爬升至 11300 米，CSN 001。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 001, roger, climb to and maintain 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 001，收到，爬升并保持 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11300 meters, CSN 001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11300 米，CSN 001。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, the purser reports that an old lady was injured, report it to Guangzhou Control and request descend to 8400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，乘务长报告一位老太太受伤，向广州管制报告并请求下降至 8400 米。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN 001, the purser reports that an old lady was injured, request descend to 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN 001，乘务长报告一位老太太受伤，请求下降至 8400 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 001, roger, descend to maintain 8400 meters, expedite descent until passing 10100 due crossing traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 001，收到，下降并保持 8400 米，因穿越飞机，通过 10100 前加快下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend to maintain 8400 meters, expedite descent until passing 10100 meters, CSN 001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 8400 米，通过 10100 米前加快下降，CSN 001。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 001, when able, say you are further intention.
B: Tell Guangzhou Control that 2 passengers in Seat 35L and 35H were seriously injured, and you'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 001，能够时说明进一步意图。
B：告诉广州管制 35L 和 35H 座位的 2 名旅客严重受伤，你想备降武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: 2 passengers in Seat 35L and 35H were seriously injured and we'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport, CSN 001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 35L 和 35H 座位的 2 名旅客严重受伤，我们想备降武汉机场，CSN 001。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 001, roger, contact Wuhan Control on 118.9, we have informed them of your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 001，收到，联系武汉管制118.9，我们已告知他们你的情况。
cards.referenceText: 118.9, roger, thanks, CSN 001.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 8100 meters, you are over IKUBA, squawking 3625, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 8100 米，在 IKUBA 上空，应答机 3625，与武汉管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN 001, maintaining 8100 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 3625.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CSN 001，保持 8100 米，IKUBA 上空，应答机 3625。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 001, Wuhan Control, radar contact, continue descent to 6300 meters, turn right, direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 001，武汉管制，雷达识别，继续下降并保持 6300 米，右转，直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Continue descend and maintain 6300 meters, turn right, direct to ZF, CSN 001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降并保持 6300 米，右转，直飞 ZF，CSN 001。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 001, descend and maintain 4500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 001，下降并保持 4500 米，联系武汉进近119.25。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4500 meters, 119.25, CSN 001.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 4500 meters, you have received the ATIS N, tell your situation to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 ZF 上空，保持 4500 米，已收到 ATIS N，向武汉进近说明你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 001, over ZF, maintaining 4500 meters, information N.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 001，ZF 上空，保持 4500 米，通播 N。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 001, Wuhan Approach, roger, do you require any emergency services?
B: Tell Wuhan Approach you need ambulance and first aid upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 001，武汉进近，收到，你需要任何应急服务吗？
B：告诉武汉进近你抵达时需要救护车和急救。
cards.referenceText: Request ambulance and first aid upon arrival, CSN 001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求抵达时救护车和急救，CSN 001。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 001, we will relay your message to the related parties, you are number 1, now turn left heading 120, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 001，我们会把你的信息转告相关单位，你是第 1 架，现在左转航向 120，下降并保持 1500 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 120, descend and maintain 1500 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 120，下降并保持 1500 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 001。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 001, Runway 36R, cleared to land, the ambulance will be ready near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 001，跑道 36R，可以落地，救护车将在跑道附近准备好。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, CSN 001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，可以落地，CSN 001。

cards.audioText: B: You are unfamiliar with Wuhan Airport, contact Wuhan Tower and tell the controller you need a follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你不熟悉武汉机场，联系武汉塔台并告诉管制员你需要引导车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 001, we are unfamiliar with Wuhan Airport, request a follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 001，我们不熟悉武汉机场，请求引导车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 001, when vacated, follow the follow-me car to gate 213.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 001，脱离跑道后，跟随引导车到 213 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: When vacated, follow the follow-me car to gate 213, CSN 001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 脱离跑道后，跟随引导车到 213 号登机口，CSN 001。

topics.name: CSN 102 乘客被热咖啡烫伤

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 102, a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are at gate 223, contact Guangzhou Ground and request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 102，从广州飞往北京，在 223 号登机口，联系广州地面并请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN 102, gate 223, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 102，223 号登机口，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，同意推出和开车，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，机头朝西，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, stand by, expect 30 minutes delay, lightning and thunder were reported in the vicinity of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，等待，因机场附近报告闪电和雷声，预计延误 30 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, stand by, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，等待，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, contact Ground and request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，联系地面并请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN 102, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 102，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, taxi via J1, Z to holding point Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，经 J1、Z 滑行至跑道 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via J1, Z to holding point Runway 19, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 J1、Z 滑行至跑道 19 等待点，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: You are holding at holding point F1 Runway 19, you are ready for departure, contact Guangzhou Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在跑道 19 F1 等待点等待，准备好离场，联系广州塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 102, holding point F1 Runway 19, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 102，跑道 19 F1 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: B: Weather forecast says the thunderstorm will not improve in about half an hour, you decide to taxi back to the apron for holding.
cards.audioTextZh: B：天气预报称雷暴约半小时内不会好转，你决定滑回机坪等待。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 102, the thunderstorm will not improve in about half an hour, request taxi back to the apron for holding.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 102，雷暴约半小时内不会好转，请求滑回机坪等待。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, line up and wait Runway 19, expect 30 minutes delay.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，进入跑道 19 等待，预计延误 30 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait Runway 19, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 19 等待，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: Thirty minutes later, the weather is improving, you observed a small cell 3 miles from Runway 19, you ask to turn right heading 120 and climb to 900 meters to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: B：三十分钟后，天气正在好转，你观察到距跑道 19 三海里有小单体，申请右转航向 120 并爬升至 900 米以避开。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 102, we observed a small cell 3 miles from Runway 19, request turn right heading 120 and climb to 900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 102，我们观察到距跑道 19 三海里有小单体，请求右转航向 120 并爬升至 900 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, when airborne, turn right heading 120, climb to 900 meters, cleared for takeoff Runway 19, contact Departure on 121.95.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，离地后右转航向 120，爬升至 900 米，跑道 19 可以起飞，联系离场 121.95。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, turn right heading 120, climb to 900 meters, cleared for takeoff Runway 19, 121.95, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 120，爬升至 900 米，跑道 19 可以起飞，121.95，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Guangzhou Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系广州离场。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN 102, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，CSN 102，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, Guangzhou Departure, radar contact, turn right heading 300, climb to 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，广州离场，雷达识别，右转航向 300，爬升至 900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, climb to 900 meters, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，爬升至 900 米，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, climb to 3000 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，标准气压爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3000 meters on standard, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 标准气压爬升至 3000 米，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, 1 of the passengers was scalded by hot coffee, contact Guangzhou Departure and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，1 名旅客被热咖啡烫伤，联系广州离场并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN 102, 1 of the passengers was scalded by hot coffee, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，CSN 102，1 名旅客被热咖啡烫伤，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 102, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need medical services upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 102，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉管制员落地后你需要医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: Request medical services upon landing, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求落地后医疗服务，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, medical services will be ready upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，医疗服务将在落地后准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, descend to 2100 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，下降至 2100 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 19。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2100 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 19, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 2100 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 19，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, cleared for ILS approach Runway 19, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，许可 ILS 进近跑道 19，报告建立。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for ILS approach Runway 19, report established, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近跑道 19，报告建立，CSN 102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS approach Runway 19, contact Guangzhou Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 19，联系广州塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 102, established ILS approach Runway 19.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 102，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 19。

cards.audioText: B: Now you confirm if the medical service will be ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你确认医疗服务是否会在登机口准备好。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 102, is medical service ready at the gate?
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 102，医疗服务是否已在登机口准备好？

cards.audioText: C: CSN 102, the ambulance and medical staff have been ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 102，救护车和医护人员已在登机口准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CSN 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CSN 102。

topics.name: CSN 235 完全准备 强风切变

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 235, a flight from Beijing to Shanghai Hongqiao, you are parking at 217, you have got information G, contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 235，从北京飞往上海虹桥，停在 217，已收到通播 G，联系北京放行并请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CSN 235, gate 217, information G, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，CSN 235，217 号登机口，通播 G，请求飞往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 235, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, departure Runway 08L, LMN-41 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9200 meters, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 235，北京放行，许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 08L，LMN-41 离场，起始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9200 米，离场后联系 119.8，应答机 3223。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, departure Runway 08L, LMN-41 departure, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 9200 meters, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223, CSN 235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 08L，LMN-41 离场，起始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 9200 米，离场后联系 119.8，应答机 3223，CSN 235。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 235, your slot time is 0800, expect 15 minutes delay due temporary airway restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 235，你的时隙是 0800，因临时航路限制预计延误 15 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, slot time 0800, expect 15 minutes delay, CSN 235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，时隙 0800，预计延误 15 分钟，CSN 235。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 235, the airway restriction has been cancelled, report ready for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 235，航路限制已取消，报告准备好开车。
cards.referenceText: Roger, report ready for start up, CSN 235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，报告准备好开车，CSN 235。

cards.audioText: B: All the passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed, you are fully ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：所有旅客已登机，所有客舱门已关闭，你完全准备好。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 235, all passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 235，所有旅客已登机，所有客舱门已关闭，完全准备好。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 235, start up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 235，同意开车。
cards.referenceText: Start up approved, CSN 235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意开车，CSN 235。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 235, ready for push back.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 235，准备好推出。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 235, push back approved, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 235，同意推出，机头朝南。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing south, CSN 235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝南，CSN 235。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the push back, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 235, push back completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 235，推出完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 235, taxi via taxiway T4, D and A to holding point Runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 235，经滑行道 T4、D 和 A 滑行至跑道 08L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway T4, D and A to holding point Runway 08L, CSN 235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 T4、D 和 A 滑行至跑道 08L 等待点，CSN 235。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of Runway 08L, you are ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 08L 外等待，准备好离场，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN 235, holding short of Runway 08L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CSN 235，跑道 08L 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 235, line up Runway 08L and cleared for takeoff, caution strong wind shear at the departure end of the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 235，进入跑道 08L 并可以起飞，注意跑道离场端有强风切变。
cards.referenceText: Line up Runway 08L and cleared for takeoff, roger, thanks, CSN 235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 08L 并可以起飞，收到，谢谢，CSN 235。

cards.audioText: B: Just after liftoff, you encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200 meters, report it to Beijing Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：刚离地后，你在地面至 200 米之间遭遇强风切变，向北京离场报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN 235, we encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，CSN 235，我们在地面至 200 米之间遭遇强风切变。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 235, roger, climb to 4200 meters, resume own navigation to LMN.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 235，收到，爬升至 4200 米，恢复自主导航至 LMN。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4200 meters, resume own navigation to LMN, CSN 235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 4200 米，恢复自主导航至 LMN，CSN 235。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 235, continue climb to 5100 meters, contact Beijing Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 235，继续爬升至 5100 米，联系北京管制118.9。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 5100 meters, 118.9, CSN 235.

topics.name: CSN 682 试音 襟翼卡起飞位 液压漏油

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 682, you are at stand K38 with information B, your destination is Guangzhou, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 682，在 K38 号停机位，通播 B，目的地广州，向武汉放行请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN 682, stand K38, information B, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CSN 682，K38 停机位，通播 B，请求 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 682, I read you 3, loud background whistle, check your transmitter.
B: You have the transmitter checked and carry out radio check with Wuhan Delivery on the frequency 118.3.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 682，我听你 3，背景有很大的哨音，检查你的发射机。
B：你检查发射机后，在 118.3 频率与武汉放行进行无线电检查。
cards.referenceText:
Wuhan Delivery, CSN 682, radio check on frequency 118.3,
1, 2, 3, 4, 5, how do you read?
cards.referenceTextZh:
武汉放行，CSN 682，在频率 118.3 无线电检查，
1，2，3，4，5，你听我怎样？

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 682, I read you 5.
B: Acknowledge the transmission and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 682，我听你 5。
B：确认收到并请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Roger, stand K38, information B, request ATC clearance, CSN 682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，K38 停机位，通播 B，请求 ATC 放行许可，CSN 682。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，武汉放行，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场频率 119.6，应答机 3115。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115, CSN 682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 8400 米，离场频率 119.6，应答机 3115，CSN 682。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, and you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN 682, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CSN 682，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, CSN 682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN 682。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 682, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 682，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, Runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 350 degrees, 5 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，跑道 36R，可以起飞，地面风 350 度，5 节。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, CSN 682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以起飞，CSN 682。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 682, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 682，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，武汉进近，雷达识别，爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2100 meters, CSN 682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 3900 米，通过 2100 米前加快爬升，CSN 682。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, you find that the flaps are jammed at takeoff position, inform Wuhan Approach this situation, and ask to fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你发现襟翼卡在起飞位置，告知武汉进近该情况，并请求直飞 WHA 排故。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 682, our flaps are jammed at takeoff position, request fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 682，我们的襟翼卡在起飞位置，请求直飞 WHA 排故。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, roger, turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，收到，右转，直飞 WHA，爬升并保持 3000 米，在 WHA 按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published, CSN 682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 WHA，爬升并保持 3000 米，在 WHA 按公布程序等待，CSN 682。

cards.audioText: B: During hold, you notice that 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid rapidly, make an urgency call to Wuhan Approach and request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：等待中，你注意到 1 套液压系统正在快速漏液，向武汉进近发布紧急情况呼叫，并请求下降返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSN 682, 1 of the hydraulic system is leaking fuel rapidly, request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CSN 682，1 套液压系统正在快速漏燃油，请求下降并返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, roger PAN, turn right heading 240, descend to 2400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，收到 PAN，右转航向 240，下降至 2400 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 2400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 36R, CSN 682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，下降至 2400 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 682。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, report established, CSN 682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，报告建立，CSN 682。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have intercepted the localizer Runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已截获跑道 36R 航向道，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 682, established localizer Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 682，已建立跑道 36R 航向道。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 682, cleared to land Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 682，跑道 36R 可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 36R, CSN 682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以落地，CSN 682。

topics.name: CSN 302 异物击中，疑似冰雹，仪表失真

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 302, you are at parking bay 235, you are ready for push back, contact Guangzhou Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CSN 302，在 235 号停机位，准备好推出，联系广州地面。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN 302, bay 235, ready for push back.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 302，235 号机位，准备好推出。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, stand by, expect 20 minutes delay, thunderstorm is approaching the airport, numerous aircraft holding for weather improvement.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，等待，预计延误 20 分钟，雷暴正接近机场，多架飞机因等待天气好转而等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, stand by, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，等待，CSN 302。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 302, report tug is ready.
B: Tell the controller the tug is in position and you are ready for push back.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 302，报告拖车准备好。
B：告诉管制员拖车已到位，你准备好推出。
cards.referenceText: The tug is ready and we are ready for push back, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 拖车已准备好，我们准备好推出，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, push back approved, facing east, Runway 19, stand by for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，同意推出，机头朝东，跑道 19，等待开车。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing east, Runway 19, stand by for start up, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝东，跑道 19，等待开车，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have been waiting for the start of clearance for about 15 minutes, contact Guangzhou Ground for start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已等待开车许可约 15 分钟，联系广州地面请求开车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN 302, we have been waiting for about 15 minutes, request start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 302，我们已等待约 15 分钟，请求开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, expect departure at 49, start up at own discretion, QNH 1008, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，预计 49 离场，自行决定开车，QNH 1008，准备滑行时报告。
cards.referenceText: Expect departure at 49, start up at own discretion, QNH 1008, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计 49 离场，自行决定开车，QNH 1008，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN 302, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 302，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, taxi via Juliette, D, T3 and T4 to holding point Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，经 Juliette、D、T3 和 T4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to holding point Runway 19, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 J、D、T3 和 T4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, hold short of T3, give way to Airbus 320 crossing from right to left.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，T3 外等待，避让从右至左穿越的 Airbus 320。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of T3, give way to A320, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: T3 外等待，避让 A320，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, traffic is clear, continue taxi via D, T3 and T4 to holding point Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，交通已脱离，继续经 D、T3 和 T4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue taxi via D, T3 and T4 to holding point Runway 19, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续经 D、T3 和 T4 滑行至跑道 19 等待点，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding point F1, Runway 19, you are fully ready, contact Guangzhou Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 F1、跑道 19 等待点，完全准备好，联系广州塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 302, holding point F1, Runway 19, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 302，F1 等待点，跑道 19，完全准备好。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 302, line up and wait Runway 19, caution thunderstorm building up at the departure end of Runway 19.
B: Read back ATC clearance and request right turn when airborne due weather.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 302，跑道 19 进跑道等待，注意跑道 19 离场端雷暴正在发展。
B：复诵 ATC 许可并因天气请求离地后右转。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait Runway 19, request right turn when airborne due weather, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 19 进跑道等待，因天气请求离地后右转，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, turn right heading 120, direct to LMN, Runway 19, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 180 degrees, 5 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，右转航向 120，直飞 LMN，跑道 19 可以起飞，地面风 180 度，5 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 120, direct to LMN, Runway 19, cleared for takeoff, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 120，直飞 LMN，跑道 19 可以起飞，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, maintaining 2100 meters, heading 120, contact Guangzhou Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，保持 2100 米，航向 120，联系广州进近。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 302, airborne, maintaining 2100 meters, heading 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 302，已离地，保持 2100 米，航向 120。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, climb to 2700 meters on QNH 1008.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，QNH 1008 爬升至 2700 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2700 meters on QNH 1008, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1008 爬升至 2700 米，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, suddenly you have been struck by foreign object, possibly hail strike, your instruments are indicating incorrectly, report it to Guangzhou Approach and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，你突然被外来物击中，可能是冰雹撞击，仪表指示不正确，向广州进近报告并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 302, we have been struck by foreign object, possibly hail strike, our instruments are indicating incorrectly, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 302，我们被外来物击中，可能是冰雹撞击，仪表指示不正确，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, roger, descend to 1500 meters, expect radar vector for final Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，收到，下降至 1500 米，预计雷达引导至跑道 19 五边。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1500 meters, expect radar vector for final Runway 19, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 1500 米，预计雷达引导至跑道 19 五边，CSN 302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, contact Guangzhou Tower on 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，联系广州塔台118.5。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 302, Runway 19, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 302，跑道 19，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 19, cleared to land, CSN 302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 19，可以落地，CSN 302。

topics.name: CSN 426 乘客坐错 翼尖相撞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 426, at gate 410, ask Beijing East Ground for taxi instruction.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CSN 426，在 410 登机口，请向北京东地面申请滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Beijing East Ground, CSN 426, gate 410, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京东地面，CSN 426，410 登机口，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 426, taxi to holding point of Runway 36R via Y1 and C1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 426，经 Y1 和 C1 滑行至跑道 36 right 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of Runway 36R via Y1 and C1, CSN 426.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Y1 和 C1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN 426。

cards.audioText: B: Now you’re on the taxiway C1, you got the report from the purser that 1 passenger had boarded the wrong airplane. Request back to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你在滑行道 C1，乘务长报告有 1 名旅客登错飞机。请求返回登机口。
cards.referenceText: Beijing East Ground, CSN 426, request back to gate due to 1 passenger boarding the wrong aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京东地面，CSN 426，由于 1 名旅客登错飞机，请求返回登机口。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 426, backtrack at present position, back to the gate via C1 and Y1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 426，在当前位置反向滑行，经 C1 和 Y1 返回登机口。
cards.referenceText: Backtrack at present position, back to the gate via C1 and Y1, CSN 426.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置反向滑行，经 C1 和 Y1 返回登机口，CSN 426。

cards.audioText: B: Half an hour later, you ask Ground for permission of taxiing again.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 半小时后，你再次向地面申请滑行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing East Ground, CSN 426, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京东地面，CSN 426，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 426, taxi to holding point of Runway 36R via Y1 and C1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 426，经 Y1 和 C1 滑行至跑道 36 right 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of Runway 36R via Y1 and C1, CSN 426.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Y1 和 C1 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CSN 426。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 426, hold short at intersection between Y1 and T2, 1 Airbus 330 taxiing east on taxiway T2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 426，在 Y1 与 T2 交叉口前等待，1 架 Airbus 330 正在 T2 上向东滑行。
cards.referenceText: Holding short, A330 in sight, CSN 426.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，看到 A330，CSN 426。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 426, after Airbus 330 vacating intersection, continue to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 426，Airbus 330 脱离交叉口后，继续滑行。
cards.referenceText: After A330 is clear, continue to taxi, CSN 426.
cards.referenceTextZh: A330 clear 后继续滑行，CSN 426。

cards.audioText: B: Your aircraft left wingtip collided with left stabilizer of Airbus 330 during taxiing, report it to the controller and ask for assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你机左翼尖在滑行中与 Airbus 330 左平尾相撞，向管制员报告并请求协助。
cards.referenceText: Beijing East Ground, CSN 426, our aircraft left wingtip collided with left stabilizer of A330, request airport assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京东地面，CSN 426，我机左翼尖与 A330 左平尾相撞，请求机场协助。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 426, I’ve reported it to relevant departments. And investigation car is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 426，我已向相关部门报告。调查车正在路上。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CSN 426.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CSN 426。

cards.audioText: B: You reported the accident to the company and you got the company’s decision that the passengers would be arranged for another airplane, you request the controller to send shuttle bus soon.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你已向公司报告事故，公司决定将旅客安排到另一架飞机上，你请求管制员尽快派摆渡车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing East Ground, CSN 426, request shuttle bus to send passengers back to gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京东地面，CSN 426，请求摆渡车送旅客返回登机口。

topics.name: CSN 303 防冰坏 微动开关问题

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CSN 303, now call Guangzhou Control and tell him you’ve just passed 3600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CSN 303，现在呼叫 广州管制，告诉他你刚通过 3600 meters。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN 303, passing 3600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN 303，正在通过 3600 meters。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 303, roger, continue climbing to level 4200 meters on QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 303，收到，按 QNH 1014 继续爬升到 4200 meters。
cards.referenceText: Continue climbing to 4200 meters, QNH1014, CSN 303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升到 4200 meters，QNH1014，CSN 303。

cards.audioText: B: You find a gradual ice build-up. You think that might be caused by de-icing equipment failure. Require descent to below the freezing level.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你发现逐渐积冰。你认为可能是除冰设备故障造成。要求下降到结冰层以下。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN 303, we are getting a gradual ice build-up as a result of suspected deicing equipment failure. We require descent to below the freezing level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN 303，我们出现逐渐积冰，怀疑由除冰设备故障导致。我们要求下降到结冰层以下。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 303, roger, descend 3000 meters, QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 303，收到，下降 3000 meters，QNH 1014。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters, QNH1014, CSN 303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 3000 meters，QNH1014，CSN 303。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 303, let me know if you require lower, do emergency conditions exist at the moment?
B: You reply that the current level is ok but the de-ice system still refuses working. The emergency condition is still existing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 303，如需更低请告诉我，目前是否存在紧急情况？
B: 你回答当前高度可以，但除冰系统仍不工作。紧急情况仍然存在。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN 303, that should be sufficiently low enough, but the de-ice system still refuses working. I mean that emergency conditions do exist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN 303，这个高度应该足够低，但除冰系统仍不工作。我的意思是紧急情况确实存在。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, CSN 303.
B: Tell the controller you intend to dump fuel for 15 minutes then return to land.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，CSN 303。
B: 告诉管制员你打算放油 15 分钟，然后返场落地。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN 303, we will require a return to the field and an extra 15 minutes en-route for fuel dumping.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN 303，我们需要返场，并在航路上额外 15 分钟放油。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 303, understand, turn right heading 330, expect Runway 02L.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 303，明白，右转航向 330，预计跑道 02 left。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, expect Runway 02L, CSN 303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，预计跑道 02L，CSN 303。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 303, do you expect your approach and landing to be normal?
B: Give an affirmative reply.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 303，你预计进近和着陆正常吗？
B: 肯定回答。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, CSN 303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，CSN 303。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 303, orbit left from your present position, you may have wide orbits, fuel dumping approved, report on completion.
B: Read-back and tell the controller you’re commencing the fuel dumping.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 303，从当前位置左盘旋，可以大范围盘旋，批准放油，完成后报告。
B: 复诵并告诉管制员你们正在开始放油。
cards.referenceText: Left hand orbits, we’re commencing the fuel dump this time, CSN 303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左盘旋，我们现在开始放油，CSN 303。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller fuel dumping completed, and request a further clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉管制员放油完成，并请求进一步许可。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN 303, we’ve completed the fuel dump and request a further clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CSN 303，我们已完成放油，请求进一步许可。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 303, roger, fly heading 320 and contact Approach on 130.0.
B: Read-back and you are not sure of the Approach frequency. You hear it as 120.0.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 303，收到，飞航向 320，联系进近 130.0。
B: 复诵，但你不确定进近频率。你听成了 120.0。
cards.referenceText: Vacating the orbit, flying heading 320, confirm Approach frequency is 120.0, CSN 303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 脱离盘旋，飞航向 320，请确认进近频率是 120.0，CSN 303。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 303, negative, contact Approach on 130.0.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 303，否定，联系进近 130.0。
cards.referenceText: Roger, Approach 130.0, CSN 303.

cards.audioText: B: Contact Baiyun Approach, tell him you have got information G.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 联系白云进近，告诉他你已收到信息 G。
cards.referenceText: Baiyun Approach, CSN 303, received information G.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云进近，CSN 303，已收到信息 G。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 303, Approach, descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1014, Left pattern Runway 02L, 20 miles to run.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 303，进近，按 QNH 1014 下降到 1200 meters，跑道 02 left 左航线，距接地点 20 miles。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1200 meters on QNH1014, CSN 303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH1014 下降到 1200 meters，CSN 303。

cards.audioText: B: Report you have a flap extension problem caused by prior icing issue, perhaps a micro-switch malfunction. You will conduct a flapless landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 报告你因先前积冰问题出现襟翼放出故障，可能是微动开关故障。你将进行无襟翼着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Baiyun Approach, CSN 303, we have a flap extension due to prior icing issue; perhaps a micro-switch malfunction, request flapless landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，白云进近，CSN 303，由于先前积冰问题，我们有襟翼放出故障，可能是微动开关故障，请求无襟翼着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 303, roger, change of Runway 02R, which is 200 meters longer. Turn right heading 200 for downwind, now with 10 miles to touchdown, maintain 1200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 303，收到，改用跑道 02 right，该跑道长 200 meters。右转航向 200 加入下风边，现在距接地点 10 miles，保持 1200 meters。
cards.referenceText: Runway 02 right, right turn, heading 200 and maintain 1200 meters, CSN 303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 02 right，右转，航向 200，保持 1200 meters，CSN 303。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 303, contact Baiyun Tower on 118.1. We have notified your condition to Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 303，联系白云塔台118.1。我们已将你的情况通知塔台。

cards.audioText: B: Now, contact Baiyun Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在联系白云塔台。
cards.referenceText: Baiyun Tower, CSN 303, maintain 1200m, left downwind for Runway 02R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云塔台，CSN 303，保持 1200m，跑道 02R 左下风。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 303, roger, continue descent to 900 meters on QNH, you are NO.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 303，收到，按 QNH 继续下降到 900 meters，你是 1 号。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900m on QNH, NO.1, CSN 303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到 900m，按 QNH，1 号，CSN 303。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 303, extend downwind as you wish, turn left at your own discretion to join base. Mind your speed!
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 303，按你的需要延长下风边，自行决定左转加入基线。注意速度！
cards.referenceText: Roger, CSN 303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CSN 303。

topics.name: CSN 230 滑行灯暗 右主轮滑出跑道

cards.audioText:
B: Your call sign is CSN 230. The aircraft has just landed on Runway 02R of Baiyun Airport.
C: CSN 230, backtrack the runway, vacate the runway via A5.
cards.audioTextZh:
B: 你的呼号是 CSN 230。飞机刚在 Baiyun Airport 跑道 02 right 落地。
C: CSN 230，在跑道上反向滑行，经 A5 脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Backtrack the runway, vacate the runway via A5, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在跑道上反向滑行，经 A5 脱离跑道，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, visibility 300 meters, low visibility procedure in effect, taxi with caution.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，能见度 300 meters，低能见度程序生效，谨慎滑行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, expedite vacating runway, traffic on short final. Contact Baiyun Ground on 120.2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，加速脱离跑道，短五边有活动。联系白云地面120.2。
cards.referenceText: Expedite vacating runway, 120.2, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加速脱离跑道，120.2，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: B: Now contact Baiyun Ground and tell him you have vacated runway
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在联系白云地面，告诉他你已脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: Baiyun Ground, CSN 230, runway vacated.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云地面，CSN 230，跑道已脱离。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, stand 35 via taxiway A5, A, G, E and Q.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，经滑行道 A5、A、G、E 和 Q 到 35 号机位。
cards.referenceText: A5, A, G, E and Q to stand 35, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A5、A、G、E 和 Q 到 35 号机位，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: B: You find the taxiway lighting is very dim, and ask for brightening them up.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你发现滑行道灯很暗，请求调亮。
cards.referenceText: Baiyun Ground, CSN 230, can you turn up the taxiway lighting? It’s really dim.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云地面，CSN 230，能否调亮滑行道灯？灯光真的很暗。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, already on its maximum setting. Taxi with caution.
B: You tell controller that you need a detailed instruction.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 230，已经是最大设置。谨慎滑行。
B: 告诉管制员你需要详细指令。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request detailed taxi instruction, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求详细滑行指令，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, taxi straight ahead, I’ll keep you advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，直行滑行，我会持续给你提示。
cards.referenceText: Taxi straight ahead, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直行滑行，CSN 230。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, give way to the outbound traffic on your right, report have it in sight.
B: Tell him you have not found the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 230，给你右侧离场飞机让路，看到后报告。
B: 告诉他你没有看到该飞机。
cards.referenceText: Negative contact, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 未看到，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, hold at present position. Traffic is crossing right to left.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，在当前位置等待。飞机正从右向左穿越。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置等待，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, continue taxi, A is the first taxiway on your left.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，继续滑行，A 是你左侧第一条滑行道。
cards.referenceText: Left turn at first intersection, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在第一个交叉口左转，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, follow taxiway A till next intersection, then right.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，沿滑行道 A 到下一个交叉口，然后右转。
cards.referenceText: Follow taxiway A, turn right at next intersection, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道 A，下一交叉口右转，CSN 230。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 230, you’ve taken a wrong turn. Now you are on EC.
B: Apologize to the controller, and ask him what you should do next.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 230，你转错了。现在你在 EC 上。
B: 向管制员道歉，并问他下一步该怎么办。
cards.referenceText: Sorry for that. Request further instruction, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 对此抱歉。请求进一步指令，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: Ah, CSN 230, continue taxi. Once reaching Cargo Apron, make a right 180. Make sure you have enough space to do it.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 嗯，CSN 230，继续滑行。到达货运机坪后右转 180。确认你有足够空间完成。
cards.referenceText: Roger, Cargo Apron, then right 180, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，货运机坪，然后右转 180，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: B: Tell him you have made a 180.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 告诉他你已经完成 180。
cards.referenceText: Baiyun Ground, CSN 230, backtrack completed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云地面，CSN 230，反向滑行完成。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, taxi eastward via previous route. Do not turn unless I call you.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，经原路线向东滑行。除非我呼叫你，不要转弯。
cards.referenceText: Eastward via previous route, straight ahead, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经原路线向东，直行，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, now turn right onto taxiway Q. Caution, taxiway is slippery.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，现在右转上滑行道 Q。注意，滑行道湿滑。
cards.referenceText: Turn right onto taxiway Q, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转上滑行道 Q，CSN 230。

cards.audioText: B: Your right main gear skidded off the taxiway. Ask for a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的右主起落架滑出滑行道。请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Baiyun Ground, CSN 230, our right main gear skidded off the taxiway. Request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 白云地面，CSN 230，我们的右主起落架滑出滑行道。请求拖车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 230, copied that. Wait a minute.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 230，收到。稍等。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CSN 230.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CSN 230。

topics.name: CSN 557 液压问题 起落架问题 燃油泄漏

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN 557, you are flying from Wuhan to Rome, you are taxiing southbound on taxiway C to holding point Runway 36L, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 557，正从武汉飞往罗马，正沿 C 滑行道向南滑行至 Runway 36L 等待点，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 557, taxiway C holding point Runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 557，C 滑行道，Runway 36L 等待点。

cards.audioText: CSN 557, line up Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 557，进入 Runway 36L 等待。
cards.referenceText: line up Runway 36L, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入 Runway 36L 等待，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: CSN 557, wind calm, contact approach on 119.25 when airborne, cleared for takeoff Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 557，静风，离地后联系进近 119.25，许可从 Runway 36L 起飞。
cards.referenceText: 119.25, cleared for takeoff Runway 36L, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 119.25，许可从 Runway 36L 起飞，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: B: After airborne, you have an undercarriage warning, your left main gear has not fully retracted, call Wuhan Approach and request maintain 1200 meters and speed 180 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: B：离地后，你有起落架警告，左主起落架未完全收上，呼叫武汉进近并请求保持 1200 米、速度 180 节。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 557, we have an undercarriage warning, our left main gear has not fully retracted, request maintain 1200 meters and speed 180 knots.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 557，我们有起落架警告，左主起落架未完全收上，请求保持 1200 米、速度 180 节。

cards.audioText: CSN 557, climb and maintain 1,200 meters, speed 180 knots approved, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 557，爬升并保持 1,200 米，批准速度 180 节，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: climb and maintain 1,200 meters, speed 180 knots, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 1,200 米，速度 180 节，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: B: After performing the checklist, you still can't verify the landing gear position, tell Wuhan Approach you want to return to Wuhan Airport and fly a low pass over airfield for visual inspection.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，你仍无法确认起落架位置，告诉武汉进近你想返回武汉机场，并在机场上空低通场进行目视检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 557, we can't verify the landing gear position, request return to Wuhan Airport and request a low pass over airfield for visual inspection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 557，我们无法确认起落架位置，请求返回武汉机场，并请求在机场上空低通场进行目视检查。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, turn right, track direct to DA NDB, descend to 900 meters, follow published procedure, cleared ILS approach 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，右转，直飞 DA NDB，下降至 900 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, track direct to DA NDB, descend to 900 meters, follow published procedure, cleared ILS approach 36R, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 DA NDB，下降至 900 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: CSN 557, you are 10 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 557，你距接地点 10 英里，联系武汉塔台 118.5。

cards.audioText: call Tower and tell them you are established on ILS Runway 36R, you are ready for low pass.
cards.audioTextZh: 呼叫塔台并告知你已建立 ILS Runway 36R，准备低空通场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 557, established ILS Runway 36R, ready for low pass.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 557，已建立 ILS Runway 36R，准备低空通场。

cards.audioText: CSN 557, wind calm, cleared low pass Runway 36R, not below 100 meters above the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 557，静风，许可在 Runway 36R 低空通场，距跑道上方不得低于 100 米。
cards.referenceText: cleared low pass Runway 36R, not below 100 meters above the runway, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可在 Runway 36R 低空通场，距跑道上方不得低于 100 米，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, after low pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 900 米。
cards.referenceText: After low pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 900 meters, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 900 米，CSN 557。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 557, we have a good look at your undercarriage, your left main landing gear is stuck halfway, it is not in the extended position, advise intention.
B: Tell Tower you want to perform hold near the airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CSN 557，我们看清了你的起落架，你的左主起落架卡在半程，未在放下位置，告知意图。
B：告诉塔台你想在机场附近等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request hold near the airport, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求在机场附近等待，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: CSN 557, turn left, direct to DAL A, climb to 1,200 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 557，左转直飞 DAL A，爬升至 1,200 米，联系武汉进近 119.25。
cards.referenceText: turn left, direct to DAL A, climb to 1200 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.25, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DAL A，爬升至 1200 米，联系武汉进近 119.25，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1200 meters, call Wuhan Approach and request holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你正直飞 DA，保持 1200 米，呼叫武汉进近并请求等待指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN 557, tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1200 meters, request holding instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CSN 557，正直飞 DA，保持 1200 米，请求等待指令。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, hold at DA NDB as published, expect further clearance at 50, report entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，武汉进近，雷达识别，在 DA NDB 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可 50，报告进入等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at DA NDB as published, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 DA NDB 按公布程序等待，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: B: During hold, another warning is triggered, 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid slowly, this is an Urgency call, you want to dump fuel and return for emergency landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：等待中，另一个警告触发，1 套液压系统缓慢漏油，这是紧急情况呼叫，你想放油并返回紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSN 557, 1 of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid slowly, request dump fuel and return for emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CSN 557，1 套液压系统缓慢漏油，请求放油并返回紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 557, roger PAN, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, turn left heading 310, radar vector to dump fuel, we will have emergency services ready and foam the runway slowly.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CSN 557，收到 PAN，爬升并保持 3000 米，左转航向 310，雷达引导航空放油，我们将准备好应急服务并缓慢给跑道铺泡沫。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3000 meters, turn left heading 310, radar vector to dump fuel, roger, thanks, CSN 557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 3000 米，左转航向 310，雷达引导航空放油，收到，谢谢，CSN 557。

cards.audioText: after emergency landing at Runway 36R, the aircraft is still intact, you want to make an emergency evacuation.
cards.audioTextZh: 在 Runway 36R 紧急着陆后，航空器仍然完好，你想实施紧急撤离。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN 557, the aircraft is still intact, request emergency evacuation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CSN 557，航空器仍然完好，请求紧急撤离。

topics.name: CSN 542 撞气球 可疑炸弹/无人认领行李 机翼/控制面损坏

cards.audioText: you are at Gate K10 with information B. Request clearance from Chengdu Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你位于 K10 登机口，已收到 B 情报。向成都放行申请放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Delivery, CSN 542, gate K10, information B, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都放行，CSN 542，K10 登机口，B 情报，申请 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN 542, Chengdu delivery, good afternoon. Information B is valid. Cleared to destination via flight planned route. Runway 02. After departure turn right direct BHS. Initial climb to 1,200 meters on QNH 1021. After departure contact 125.6.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 542，成都放行，下午好。B 情报有效。许可按飞行计划航路飞往目的地。Runway 02。离场后右转直飞 BHS。在 QNH 1021 上初始爬升至 1,200 米。离场后联系 125.6。
cards.referenceText: Information B Cleared to destination via flight planned route. Runway 02. After departure turn right direct BHS. Initial climb to 1200 meters on QNH 1021. 125.6, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: B 情报，许可按飞行计划航路飞往目的地。Runway 02。离场后右转直飞 BHS。在 QNH 1021 上初始爬升至 1200 米。125.6，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, read back correct, when ready for push back and start up, contact Ground 121.85.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，复诵正确，准备推出和开车时联系 地面 121.85。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready for startup, request push back and permission to start your engines from Chengdu Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你现在准备开车，向成都地面请求推出和开车许可。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, CSN 542, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，CSN 542，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, push back and start up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，推出和开车批准。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，CSN 542。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 542, we just had reports of a bomb left in your first class passenger section. Please advise your intentions.
B: acknowledge the transmission and tell the controller you have the crew check the first-class cabin.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CSN 542，我们刚刚收到报告，你的头等舱客舱内被放置了一枚炸弹。请告知你的意图。
B： 确认收到，并告诉管制员你将让机组检查头等舱。
cards.referenceText: roger, we will have the crew member check the first-class cabin, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们将让一名机组成员检查头等舱，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: B: During the search, the cabin crew find a bag that is not claimed by any passengers, inform Ground about this and tell them that because there are no aircraft around you, you will hold position.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 搜查期间，客舱机组发现一个无人认领的包，通知 地面，并告诉他们由于你周围没有飞机，你将原地等待。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, CSN 542, the cabin crew found a bag that is not claimed by any passenger, request hold position due there are no aircraft around us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，CSN 542，客舱机组发现一个无人认领的包，由于我们周围没有飞机，请求原地等待。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, CSN 542, do you need any further assistance?
B: Tell the controller you will disembark the passengers, and request passenger steps and a bomb squad.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，CSN 542，你还需要其他援助吗？
B: 告诉管制员你将让旅客下机，并请求客梯和排爆小组。
cards.referenceText: We will disembark the passengers, request passenger steps and a bomb squad, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们将让旅客下机，请求客梯和排爆小组，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: B: It is now later in the day, the suspected bomb was an empty bag, you are at the holding point of Runway 02, tell the traffic controller you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 当天稍后，疑似炸弹是一个空包，你在跑道 02 等待点，告诉交通管制员你准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Tower, CSN 542, the suspected bomb was an empty bag, holding point of Runway 02, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都塔台，CSN 542，疑似炸弹是一个空包，在跑道 02 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, after departure maintain runway heading, cleared for takeoff Runway 02, surface wind 010 at 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，离场后保持跑道航向，跑道 02 可以起飞，地面风 010，2 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: After departure maintain runway heading, cleared for takeoff Runway 02, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场后保持跑道航向，跑道 02 可以起飞，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, contact Departure on 125.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，联系 Departure 125.6。

cards.audioText: Contact departure. Your altitude is now passing 200m.
cards.audioTextZh: 联系离场。你当前高度正通过 200m。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Departure, CSN 542, passing 200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都离场，CSN 542，正通过 200m。

cards.audioText: C: Good afternoon, CSN 542, maintain runway heading, climb to 3000 meters, be advised we have received some reports of a large unmanned weather balloons in your area.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 下午好，CSN 542，保持跑道航向，爬升到 3000 米，通知你，我们收到一些报告称你所在区域有大型无人气象气球。
cards.referenceText: Maintain runway heading, climb to 3000 meters, roger, thanks, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持跑道航向，爬升到 3000 米，收到，谢谢，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: As you are climbing you notice a large unmanned balloon. Your position is 4 miles north of airfield away, height 2000m. Report this to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升过程中，你发现一个大型无人气球。你的位置在机场以北 4 英里处，高度 2000m。向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Departure, CSN 542, we notice a large unmanned balloon north of airfield four miles, 2000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都离场，CSN 542，我们发现一个大型无人气球，位于机场以北四英里，高度 2000 米。

cards.audioText: B: Before ATC replies, you suddenly hit another balloon you did not see, the aircraft becomes difficult to control and you want to return to land at Chengdu, tell ATC this. This is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 在 ATC 回复前，你突然撞上另一个没看到的气球，飞机变得难以控制，你想返回 Chengdu 着陆，告诉 ATC。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Chengdu Departure, CSN 542, we hit another balloon we did not see, the aircraft becomes difficult to control, request return to land at Chengdu.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，Chengdu Departure，CSN 542，我们撞上另一个未看到的气球，飞机变得难以控制，请求返回 Chengdu 着陆。

cards.audioText: CSN 542, roger Pan, turn left heading 200, descend to 1,200 meters. All Runways available for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 542，收到 PAN，左转航向 200，下降至 1,200 米。所有跑道均可落地。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 200, descend to 1,200 meters, roger, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 200，下降至 1,200 米，收到，CSN 542。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 542, radar vectors are available or you can fly a visual circuit and join left downwind, please advise.
B: Tell the controller you will join left downwind.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 542，可以提供雷达引导，或你可以飞目视起落航线并加入左下风，请告知。
B: 告诉管制员你将加入左下风。
cards.referenceText: Request join left downwind, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求加入左下风，CSN 542。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 542, roger, report downwind and when able can you tell us what is the damage to your aircraft?
B: Reply to the transmission and tell them you have a large hole in your wing and the control surfaces are damaged.
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 542，收到，报告下风，可以时告诉我们你的飞机损伤情况。
B: 回复通话，告诉他们机翼上有一个大洞，操纵面受损。
cards.referenceText: We have a large hole in our wing and the control surfaces are damaged, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的机翼上有一个大洞，操纵面受损，CSN 542。

cards.audioText: Now you are on downwind, report it to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于三边，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Tower, CSN 542, downwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都塔台，CSN 542，三边。

cards.audioText: C: CSN 542, you are number 1, cleared to land Runway 02, report on final.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CSN 542，你是第 1 架，跑道 02 可以着陆，五边报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 02, CSN 542.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 02 可以着陆，CSN 542。

topics.name: CSN 3102 雷暴绕飞 积冰/防冰 乘客医疗

cards.audioText: Your callsign is CSN 3102, a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are at Gate 223, contact Guangzhou Ground and request pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 3102，这是一趟从广州飞往北京的航班，你位于 223 登机口，联系广州地面并申请推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN 3102, Gate 223, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 3102，223 登机口，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, pushback and startup approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，推出和开车批准，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: pushback and startup approved, facing west, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝西，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, stand by, expect 30 minutes, lightning and thunder were reported in the vicinity of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，等待，预计 30 分钟，机场附近报告有闪电和雷暴。
cards.referenceText: roger, stand by, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，等待，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, contact Ground and request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，联系地面并请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN 3102, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CSN 3102，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, taxi via Juliet1, Z to holding point Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，经 J1、Z 滑行至 Runway 19 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via J one, Z to holding point Runway 19, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 J1、Z 滑行至 Runway 19 等待点，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: You are holding at holding point F1 Runway 19, you are ready for departure, contact Guangzhou Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在跑道 19 F1 等待点等待，准备好离场，联系广州塔台。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 3102, holding point F1 Runway 19, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 3102，跑道 19 F1 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: Weather forecast says the thunderstorm will not improve in about half an hour, one of the passengers is getting anxious. You decide to taxi back to the apron to disembark the passenger.
cards.audioTextZh: 天气预报称雷暴在大约半小时内不会改善，一名乘客开始焦虑。你决定滑回机坪让该乘客下机。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 3102, the thunderstorm will not improve in about half an hour, one of the passenger is getting anxious, request taxi back to the apron to disembark the passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 3102，雷暴在大约半小时内不会改善，一名乘客开始焦虑，请求滑回机坪让该乘客下机。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, Line up and wait Runway 19, vacate via A2, taxi to gate 223 via taxiway A and Z.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，进入 Runway 19 等待，经 A2 脱离，经 A 和 Z 滑行道滑行至 223 登机口。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait Runway 19, vacate via A two, taxi to gate 223 via taxiway A and Z, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入 Runway 19 等待，经 A2 脱离，经 A 和 Z 滑行道滑行至 223 登机口，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Thirty minutes later, the weather is improving, you observed a small cell 3 miles from Runway 19, you ask to turn right heading 120 and climb to 900 meters to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: B：三十分钟后，天气正在好转，你观察到距跑道 19 三海里有小单体，申请右转航向 120 并爬升至 900 米以避开。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 3102, we observed a small cell 3 miles from Runway 19, request turn right heading 120 and climb to 900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 3102，我们观察到距跑道 19 三海里有小单体，请求右转航向 120 并爬升至 900 米。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102 when airborne, turn right heading 120, climb to 900 meters, cleared for takeoff Runway 19, contact Departure on 121.95.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，离地后右转航向 120，爬升至 900 米，许可从 Runway 19 起飞，联系离场 121.95。
cards.referenceText: when airborne, turn right heading 120, climb to 900 meters, cleared for takeoff Runway 19, 121.95, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 120，爬升至 900 米，许可从 Runway 19 起飞，121.95，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Guangzhou Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，联系广州离场。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN 3102, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，CSN 3102，已离地，通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, Guangzhou Departure, radar contact, turn right heading 300, climb to 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，广州离场，雷达识别，右转航向 300，爬升至 900 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 300, climb to 900 meters, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，爬升至 900 米，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, climb to 3000 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，按标准气压爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 3000 meters on standard, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升至 3000 米，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, 1 of the passengers was scalded by hot coffee, contact Guangzhou Departure and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升中，1 名旅客被热咖啡烫伤，联系广州离场并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Departure, CSN 3102, 1 of the passengers was scalded by hot coffee, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州离场，CSN 3102，1 名旅客被热咖啡烫伤，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 3102, what assistance do you need?
B: tell the controller you need medical services upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CSN 3102，你需要什么协助？
B： 告诉管制员你需要落地时提供医疗服务。
cards.referenceText: request medical services upon landing, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求落地时提供医疗服务，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, medical services will be ready upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，医疗服务将在落地时就位。
cards.referenceText: roger, thanks, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, descend to 2,100 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，下降至 2,100 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 19。
cards.referenceText: descend to 2100 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 19, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 2100 米，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 19，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, cleared for ILS approach Runway 19, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 19，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared for ILS approach Runway 19, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近 Runway 19，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: now you have established on ILS approach Runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 19。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN 3102, established ILS approach Runway 19.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CSN 3102，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 19。

cards.audioText: B: Now you confirm if the medical service will be ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你确认医疗服务是否会在登机口准备好。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN 3102, is medical service ready at the gate?
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CSN 3102，医疗服务是否已在登机口准备好？

topics.name: CSN 3102 机翼/控制面损坏 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: your call sign is CSN 3102, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are at gate 211, you are ready for pushback and startup, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CSN 3102，这是一趟从北京飞往广州的航班，你位于 211 登机口，已准备好推出和开车，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Apron, CSN 3102, gate 211, ready for pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机坪，CSN 3102，211 登机口，已准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, pushback and startup approved, Runway 19R, QNH 1014.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，推出和开车批准，Runway 19R，QNH 1014。
cards.referenceText: pushback and startup approved, Runway 19R, QNH 1014, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，Runway 19R，QNH 1014，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: You have completed push back and start up, but the chocks are still in position, inform the controller of the situation and ask ground handling to remove the chocks.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出和开车，但轮挡仍在位，告知管制员情况并请求地面保障移除轮挡。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN 3102, the chocks are still in position, request ground handling to remove the chocks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN 3102，轮挡仍在位，请求地面保障移除轮挡。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN 3102, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN 3102，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, taxi to holding point Runway 19R via taxiway Z18, M5, hold short of F.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，经 Z18、M5 滑行道滑行至 Runway 19R 等待点，在 F 前等待。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 19R via taxiway Z18, M five, hold short of F, CSN 3102
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z18、M5 滑行道滑行至 Runway 19R 等待点，在 F 前等待，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of taxiway F, contact Beijing Apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 F 滑行道外等待，联系北京机坪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Apron, CSN 3102, holding short of taxiway F.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京机坪，CSN 3102，在 F 滑行道外等待。

cards.audioText: CSN 3102, hold short of F, contact Beijing Ground on 121.95.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN 3102，在 F 前等待，联系北京地面 121.95。
cards.referenceText: hold short of F, contact Beijing Ground on 121.95, CSN 3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 F 前等待，联系北京地面 121.95，CSN 3102。

cards.audioText: B: During taxi, you find there is ice and snow on the aircraft wings, contact Beijing Ground and tell the controller you want to have the ice and snow removed before takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，你发现机翼上有冰雪，联系北京地面并告诉管制员你想在起飞前除冰雪。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN 3102, there is ice and snow on the aircraft wings, request de-icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CSN 3102，机翼上有冰雪，请求除冰。
