B: 【收到此通话，告知管制员，你想上到11000米。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request climb to 11000m, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求爬升至11000米，南方3112。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, climb to and maintain 11000m.
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 11000m, CSN3112.

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, after passing MUDAM, fly direct to ASAVA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3112，过MUDAM后，直飞ASAVA。
cards.referenceText: After passing MUDAM, fly direct to ASAVA, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过MUDAM后，直飞ASAVA，南方3112。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, orbit right from present position until advised of the weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方3112，从现在位置向右盘旋等待，前方天气情况稍后告知。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until advised, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从现在位置向右盘旋等待直到告知，南方3112。

cards.audioText: B: [After several orbits, you find you don’t have enough fuel to hold any further. Report this situation to Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【经过多次盘旋，你发现你没有足够的燃油继续等待。将情况报告给北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3112, we don’t have enough fuel to hold any further.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方3001，我们没有足够的燃油继续等待。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN3112, roger, say your intention.
B: [Tell the controller you require radar vectors to Beijing for priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 南方3112，收到，说明你的意图。
B:【告知管制员，你需要雷达引导到北京进行优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Request radar vectors to Beijing for priority landing, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导到北京进行优先着陆，南方3112。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, turn left heading 190, fly direct to GUVBA.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3112，左转航向190，直飞GUVBA。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 190, fly direct to GUVBA, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向190，直飞GUVBA，南方3112。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published due weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方3112，左转航向150，直飞AA446，由于天气，在AA446按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向150，直飞AA446，在AA446按公布程序等待，南方3112。

cards.audioText: B: [You have been holding at AA446 for about 30 minutes. You are reaching the minimum fuel situation. Contact Beijing Control and request leave the hold and land as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: B:【你已经在AA446等待了约30分钟，你进入了紧急燃油状态，联系北京区调，申请离开等待区，尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3112, we have been holding at AA446 for about 30 minutes, we are reaching the minimum fuel situation. Request leave the hold and land as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方3112，我们已经在AA446等待了约30分钟，我们进入了紧急燃油状态，申请离开等待区，尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, roger, leave the hold, proceed to LADIX, descend to 6000m, contact Beijing Approach on 119.35, we have informed them about your situation.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方3112，收到，离开等待区，直飞LADIX，下6000米，联系北京进近119.35，我们已经将你的情况告知他们。
cards.referenceText: Leave the hold, proceed to LADIX, descend to 6000m, 119.35, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离开等待区，直飞LADIX，下6000米，联系北京进近119.35，南方3112。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are over LADIX, maintaining 6000m, you have received information L, contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【现在你已经过LADIX，保持在6000米，你收到了最新的通播L，联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN3112, over LADIX, maintaining 6000m, information L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，南方3112，过LADIX，正保持6000米，通播L。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descend to 4200m, expect radar vector ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3112，北京进近，雷达看见了，下4200米保持，预计雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200m, expect radar vector ILS approach runway 36R, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下4200米保持，预计雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右，南方3112。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN3112, are you declaring fuel emergency?
B: [Tell the controller that you’re declaring fuel emergency and request priority landing runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 南方3112，你需要宣布紧急情况吗？
B：【告知管制员你将宣布燃油紧急情况，请求优先着陆跑道36右。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we are declaring fuel emergency and request priority landing runway 36R, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们将宣布燃油紧急情况，请求优先着陆跑道36右，南方3112。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, roger, you are number one to land, cleared straight-in ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3112，收到，你第一个落地，可以直接盲降进近跑道36右，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: Number one, cleared straight-in ILS approach runway 36R, wilco, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一个，可以直接盲降进近跑道36右，照办，南方3112。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’ve established on ILS approach runway 36R, contact Beijing Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: B:【现在你已经建立跑道36右的盲降，联系北京塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN3112, established on ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，南方3112，已经建立跑道36右的盲降。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, Beijing Tower, runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3112，北京塔台，跑道36右，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，可以落地，南方3112。

cards.audioText: B: [Your callsign is CSN9302, you’re parking at bay 235. You’re ready for pushback, contact Guangzhou Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你的呼号是南方9302，你现在在235号机位，你准备好推出了，联系广州地面。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, bay 235, ready for pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，南方9302，235号机位，请求推出。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, standby, expect 20 minutes delay. Thunderstorm is approaching the airport, numerous aircraft holding for weather improvement.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，稍等，预计延误20分钟，雷暴正接近机场，很多飞机正在等待天气变好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, standby, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，稍等，南方9302。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN9302, report tug is ready.
B: [Tell the controller the tug is ready and you’re ready for pushback.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 南方9302，拖车就位后报。
B：【告知管制员拖车已就位，你准备好推出了。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, the tug is ready, and we’re ready for pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，南方9302，拖车已就位，我们准备好推出了。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, pushback approved, facing east, runway 19, standby for startup.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，可以推出，朝东，跑道19，稍等开车。
cards.referenceText: Pushback approved, facing east, runway 19, standby for startup, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出，朝东，跑道19，稍等开车，南方9302。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’ve been waiting for the startup clearance for about 15 minutes, contact Guangzhou Ground for startup.]
cards.audioTextZh: B:【你等你的开车许可已经等了15分钟了，联系广州地面，申请开车。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, we’ve been waiting for about 15 minutes, request startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，南方9302，我们已经等了15分钟了，申请开车。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, expect departure at 49, startup at own discretion, QNH1008, report when ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，预计离场时间49分，自行决定开车，修压1008，准备好滑行时报。
cards.referenceText: Expect departure at 49, startup at own discretion, QNH1008, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计离场时间49分，自行决定开车，修压1008，南方9302。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re ready for taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: B:【你现在准备好滑行了。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CSN9302, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，南方9302，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to the holding point of runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方9302，经由滑行道J，D，T3和T4滑行到跑道19外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to the holding point of runway 19, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道J，D，T3和T4滑行到跑道19外等待点，南方9302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, hold short of T3, give way to A320 crossing from right to left.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，在T3外等待，给从右向左穿越的A320让路。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of T3, give way to A320, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在T3外等待，给A320让路，南方9302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, traffic is clear, continue taxi via D, T3 and T4 to the holding point of runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，冲突解除，继续沿D，T3和T4滑行到跑道19外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Continue taxi via D, T3 and T4 to the holding point of runway 19, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续沿D，T3和T4滑行到跑道19外等待点，南方9302。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re at the holding point F1, runway 19, you’re fully ready, contact Guangzhou Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在在F1等待点，跑道19，你完全准备好了，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN9302, holding point F1, runway 19, fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，南方9302，F1等待点，跑道19，完全准备好了。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN9302, line up and wait runway 19, caution thunderstorm building up at the departure end of runway 19.
B: [Read back ATC’s clearance and request right turn when airborne due weather.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方9302，上跑道19等待，注意跑道19一边（离场边）上有雷暴正在生成。
B：【复诵管制的许可，由于天气，起飞后请求右转。】
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait runway 19, request right turn when airborne due weather, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道19等待，由于天气，起飞后请求右转，南方9302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, turn right heading 120, runway 19, cleared for takeoff, surface wind 180 degrees, 5m/s.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，右转航向120，跑道19，可以起飞，地面风180度，5米每秒。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 120, runway 19, cleared for takeoff, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向120，跑道19，可以起飞，南方9302。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re airborne, maintaining 2100m, heading 120. Contact Guangzhou Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在起飞了，正保持2100米，航向120，联系广州进近。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN9302, airborne, maintaining 2100m, heading 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，南方9302，正保持2100米，航向120。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, climb to 2700m on QNH 1008.
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2700m on QNH 1008, CSN9302.

cards.audioText: B: [During climb, suddenly you’ve been struck by a foreign object, possibly hail strike. Your instruments are indicating incorrectly. Report this situation to Guangzhou Approach and request return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【在爬升过程中，你突然遭遇外物撞击，可能是冰雹。仪表显示异常。向广州进近报告此情况，请求返航着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN9302, we’ve been struck by a foreign object, possibly hail strike, our instruments are indicating incorrectly, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，南方9302，我们被外物撞击，可能是冰雹，仪表显示异常，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, roger, descend to 1500m, expect radar vectors for final runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，下1500米，预计雷达引导至19跑道五边。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1500m, expect radar vectors for final runway 19, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下1500米，预计雷达引导至19跑道五边，南方9302。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, contact Tower 118.5.
C: CSN9302, runway 19, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方9302，跑道19，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 19, cleared to land, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道19，可以落地，南方9302。

cards.audioText: N: [Your flight number is CSN905, a flight from Changchun to Wuhan. You are cruising at 10400m, you are approaching BIDOG. Your squawk number is 2332. Make the initial contact with Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是南方905，一架从长春飞往武汉的航班。你现在在10400米巡航，你正接近BIDOG，你的应答机编码是2332。与北京区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN905, maintaining 10400m, approaching BIDOG, squawking 2332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方905，正保持10400米，接近BIDOG，应答机2332。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, Beijing Control, radar contact, change your squawk number to 0423.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，北京区调，雷达看见了，应答机编码改为0423。
cards.referenceText: Squawking 0423, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 答机编码0423，南方905。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, reduced to Mach point 75 due to flow restrictions in the Zhengzhou Control area.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，由于郑州管制区流控限制，速度减小至点75。
cards.referenceText: Roger, reduce to Mach point 75, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，速度减小至点75，南方905。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, descend to and maintain 9,200m, rate of descent at 2,000 ft/min or greater.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，下9200米保持，下降率2000英尺每分或更大。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9,200m at 2,000 ft/min or greater, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下9200米保持，下降率2000英尺每分或更大，南方905。

cards.audioText: N: [A cold front is passing Beijing Control area, numerous thunderstorms are coming from the west, request Beijing Control that you want to climb to 11600m.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【冷锋正在穿越北京管制区，西侧有大量雷暴天气正在靠近，向北京区调申请，你想上116000米。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN905, request climb to 11600m due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方905，由于天气，请求上11600米。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, negative, higher levels are occupied, advise your intentions.
N: [Advise the controller you wish to turn left and track direct to WXI.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，不可以，更高的高度被占用，告知你的意图。
N：【告知管制员，你向左转直飞WXI。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request turn left and track direct to WXI, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求左转直飞WXI，南方905。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, negative, do not deviate off course.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，不可以，不能偏航。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，南方905。

cards.audioText: N: [Advise controller that if there is no other options are available to avoid the weather, you will have to divert to Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【告知管制员，如果没有别的办法来避开天气，你就只能备降北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN905, if there is no other options are available to avoid the weather, request divert to Beijing airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方905，如果没有别的办法来避开天气，我们就只能备降北京机场。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, stand by.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，稍等。
cards.referenceText: Standing by, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，南方905。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, 11,000m is available now, advise your intentions.
N: [Tell Beijing Control that you can accept 11,000m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，11000米现在可用，告知你的意图。
N：【告知管制员，你可以接受11000米。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, we can accept 11,000m, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们可以接受11000米，南方905。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, turn right heading 250.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，右转航向250。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 250, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向250，南方905。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, climb to and maintain 11,000m, turn left parallel to your course.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，上11000米保持，左转，保持与当前航迹平行。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11,000m, turn left parallel to our course, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上11000米保持，左转，保持与当前航迹平行，南方905。

cards.audioText: N: [You observed a flash of lightning and heard a loud thud. Your transponders have malfunctioned, notify Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你观察到闪电并听到一声巨响。应答机故障，现通知北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN905, we have observed a flash of lightning and heard a loud thud, transponders have malfunctioned.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方905，我们观察到闪电并听到一声巨响，应答机故障了。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, I have lost your altimetry readout, confirm you are still maintaining 11,000m.
N: [Tell Beijing Control you are maintaining 11,000m, and request immediate left turn to a heading of 180 degrees.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，你的高度数据已消失，请确认你是否仍保持在11000米。
N: 【告知北京区调，你正保持11000米。请求立即左转航向180度。】
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 11,000m and request an immediate left turn to a heading 180 degrees, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 正保持11000米，请求立即左转航向180度，南方905。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, roger, left heading of 180 degrees approved, what is your status?
N: [Readback the controller’s instructions and notify Beijing Control that some electrical equipment have malfunctioned, including the transponders.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，收到，可以左转航向180度。你那边状况如何？
N: 【复诵管制的指令，通知北京区调，部分电子设备包括应答机发生故障。】
cards.referenceText: Left heading of 180 degrees, some electrical equipment have malfunctioned, including the transponders, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向180度，部分电子设备包括应答机发生故障，南方905。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, roger, advise when clear of the weather. You are expected to descend shortly.
N: [You decided to continue flight to Wuhan. You are now cruising at 7,800m over WXI, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou control.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，收到，脱离天气后告知。预计你一会就下降。
N：【你决定继续飞往武汉，你现在在7800米巡航，过WXI，与郑州区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, CSN905, maintaining 7,800m, over WXI.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，南方905，正保持7800米，过WXI。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, Zhengzhou Control, give a full position report.
N: [Provide the following Information in your position report: You are cruising at 7,800m, overhead WXI at 1215. Your ETA to the next way point AKOMA is 1235. The waypoint after that is ZHO.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，郑州管制，做一个完整的位置报。
N：【在位置报中，提供以下信息：你正在7800米巡航，在12点15分飞跃WXI，预计过航路点AKOMA时间12点35分，下一点是ZHO。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, CSN905, maintaining 7,800m, overhead WXI at 1215, ETA AKOMA at 1235, next ZHO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，南方905，保持7800米，在12点15分飞跃WXI，预计过航路点AKOMA时间12点35分，下一点是ZHO。

cards.audioText: B: [Your callsign is CSN3235, a flight from Beijing to Shanghai. You’re parking at 217, you’ve got information G. Contact Beijing Delivery and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你的呼号是南方3235，一架从北京飞往上海的航班，你现在在217号机位，你收到了通播G，联系北京放行，请求管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, CSN3235, gate 217, information G, request ATC clearance to Shanghai.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，南方3235，217机位，请求飞往上海的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, cleared to Shanghai via flight planned route, departure runway 08L, LMN41 departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9200m, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，可以经由计划航路飞往上海，起飞跑道08左，LMN41离场，初始爬升1500米，巡航高度9200米，起飞后，联系119.8，应答机3223。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Shanghai via flight planned route, departure runway 08L, LMN41 departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 9200m, after departure, contact 119.8, squawk 3223, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往上海，起飞跑道08左，LMN41离场，初始爬升1500米，巡航高度9200米，起飞后，联系119.8，应答机3223，南方3235。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, your slot time is 0800, expect 15 minutes delay due temporary airway restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，你的离场时间是0800，由于当前航路限制，预计15分钟延误。
cards.referenceText: Roger, slot time 0800, expect 15 minutes delay, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，离场时间0800，预计15分钟延误，南方3235。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, the airway restriction has been cancelled, report ready for startup.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，航路限制已取消，准备好开车时报。
cards.referenceText: Roger, wilco, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，将照办，南方3235。

cards.audioText: B: [All the passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed. You’re fully ready.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【所有乘客已经登机，所有舱门已关闭，你现在完全准备好了。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3235, all the passengers have boarded the aircraft, all cabin doors have been closed. We’re fully ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，南方3235，所有乘客已经登机，所有舱门已经关闭，我们已经完全准备好了。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, startup approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，可以开车。
cards.referenceText: Startup approved, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以开车，南方3235。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re ready for pushback.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在准备好推出了。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3235, request pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，南方3235，请求推出。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, pushback approved, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，可以推出，面朝南。
cards.referenceText: Pushback approved, facing south, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出，面朝南，南方3235。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’ve completed the pushback, you’re ready for taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在完成推出，准备好滑行了。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3235, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，南方3235，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, taxi via T4, D and A to holding point of runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，经由滑行道T4，D和A，滑行至跑道08左外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via T4, D and A to holding point of runway 08L, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道T4，D和A，滑行至跑道08左外等待点，南方3235。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re holding short of runway 08L, you’re ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在在跑道08左的外等待点，你准备好起飞了，联系北京塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CSN3235, holding point of runway 08L, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，南方3235，跑道08左的外等待点，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, line up runway 08L and cleared for takeoff. Caution strong wind shear at the departure end of the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，上跑道08左等待，可以起飞，注意跑道一边（起飞边）上有强风切变。
cards.referenceText: Line up runway 08L and cleared for takeoff, roger, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道08左等待，可以起飞，收到，南方3235。

cards.audioText: B: [Just after the liftoff, you encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200m. Report it to Beijing Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【离地后，你在地面和高度200之间遇到了强风切变，报告给北京离场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN3235, we encountered strong wind shear between the surface and 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，南方3235，我们在地面和高度200之间遇到了强风切变。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, climb to 4200m, resume own navigation to LMN.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，上4200米，自主领航到LMN。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4200m, resume own navigation to LMN, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上4200米，自主领航到LMN，南方3235。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3235, continue climb to 5100, contact Beijing Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3235，继续上5100米，联系北京区调118.9。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 5100, contact Beijing Control on 118.9, CSN3235.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续上5100米，联系北京区调118.9，南方3235。

cards.audioText: N: [Your aircraft callsign is CSN3118, a flight from Beijing to Wuhan. You are now maintaining 10400m and in Wuhan Control Area, squawking 4332. Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的飞机呼号是南方3118，一架从北京飞往武汉的航班。你现在正保持在10400米，在武汉区调管制区，应答机4332，与武汉区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN3118, maintaining 10400m, squawking 4332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南方3118，正保持10400米，应答机4332。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN3118, I read you 3, say again your squawk and level.
N: [You adjust the radio equipment, ask the controller whether you can be heard clearly.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方3118，我听你3个，再说一遍你的应答机和高度层。
N：【你调试了你的无线电设备，询问管制员是否听你清楚。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN3118, how do you read?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南方3118，你听我如何？

cards.audioText:
C: CSN3118, I read you 5.
N: [Tell the controller you are maintaining 10400m and squawking 4332.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方3118，我听你5个。
N：【告知管制员，你现在正保持10400米，应答机4332。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN3118, maintaining 10400m and squawking 4332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南方3118，正保持10400米，应答机4332。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3118, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend to and maintain 9800m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3118，武汉区调，雷达看见了，下9800米保持。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 9800m, CSN3118.

cards.audioText: N: [After leveling at 9800m, you find rapid accumulation of ice on the leading edge slats, the attitude of your aircraft is unstable. Report your situation and ask for emergency descent. This is an urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【在9800米巡航后，你发现前缘缝翼快速出现积冰，飞机姿态不稳定。报告此情况，请求紧急下降，这是一个紧急通话。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CSN3118, leveling at 9800m, rapid accumulation of ice on the leading edge slats and our attitude is unstable, request emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉区调，南方3118，正在9800米巡航，前缘缝翼快速出现积冰，飞机姿态不稳定，请求紧急下降。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3118, roger, descend to and maintain 4200m, high rate of descent approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3118，收到，下4200米保持，可以快速下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4200m, high rate of descent approved, CSN3118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下4200米保持，可以快速下降，南方3118。

cards.audioText: N: [After leaving the icing level, you are rid of your aircraft’s icing problems, and will continue your approach to Wuhan airport. Information D received. Make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【离开积冰高度后，你解决了飞机的积冰问题，你将继续进近武汉机场，你收到了通播D，与武汉进近进行初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN3118, maintaining 4200m, information D received.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南方3118，正保持4200米，通播D。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN3118, Wuhan Approach, current information is E, runway in use 36R.
N: [Tell the controller you want to descend.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方3118，武汉进近，当前通播为E，使用跑道36右。
N：【告知武汉进近，你想下降。】
cards.referenceText: Information E, runway 36R, request descend, CSN3118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播E，跑道36右，请求下降，南方3118。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3118, descend to and maintain 3600m, QNH 1014, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-1A arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3118，下3600米保持，修正海压1014，直飞ZF，预计ZF-1A进近。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 3600m, QNH 1014, track direct to ZF, expect ZF-1A arrival, CSN3118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下3600米保持，修正海压1014，直飞ZF，预计ZF-1A进近，南方3118。

cards.audioText: N: [You are over ZF, flying on 3600m. Tell ATC that you want to descend to 1800m and track direct to final.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在过ZF，在3600米飞行。告知管制员，你想下1800米，直飞五边。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN3118, over ZF, 3600m, request descend to 1800m and track direct to final.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南方3118，过ZF，3600米，请求下1800米，直飞五边。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3118, negative due sequencing, you are No.2, follow China Eastern A330. Descend to and maintain 2400m, turn right heading 180.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3118，由于顺序，不可以，你第二份，跟着东航的A330，下2400米保持，右转航向180。
cards.referenceText: No.2, follow China Eastern A330, descend to and maintain 2400m, turn right heading 180, CSN3118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第二个，跟着东航的A330，下2400米保持，右转航向180，南方3118。

cards.audioText: N: [You are on right downwind for runway 36R, you estimate a 25 track miles till touchdown, ask Approach for further descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你在跑道36右的右三边，预计距离接地点25海里，向进近请求继续下降。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN3118, right downwind for runway 36R, estimate a 25 track miles till touchdown, request further descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南方3118，跑道36右的右三边，预计距离接地点25海里，请求继续下降。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CSN3118, descend to and maintain 1200m, turn right heading 330 to intercept the localizer of runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：收到，南方3118，下1200米保持，右转航向330来切跑道36右的航向道，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 1200m, turn right heading 330 to intercept the localizer of runway 36R, wilco/report established, CSN3118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下1200米保持，右转航向330来切跑道36右的航向道，建立后报，南方3118。

cards.audioText: N: [After established on ILS, you discovered a landing gear warning, indicating the nose gear had not been extended properly. Report to Wuhan Tower that you will overshoot and request join a holding pattern to perform the checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【建立盲降后，你发现一个起落架告警，指示前起落架没有正确放出。报告给武汉塔台，你将复飞，然后申请加入等待程序，来执行检查单。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3118, ILS established, we had a landing gear warning, indicating the nose gear had not been extended properly, request overshoot and join a holding pattern to perform the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方3118，建立盲降了，我们有一个起落架告警，指示前起落架没有正确放出，请求复飞并加入等待程序来执行检查单。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3118, go around, climb to 1500m.
cards.referenceText: Going around, climb to 1500m, CSN3118.

cards.audioText: C: CSN3118, track direct to AB, hold as published, report entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3118，直飞AB，按公布的程序等待，加入等待后报。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to AB, hold as published, report entering the hold, CSN3118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞AB，按公布的程序等待，加入等待后报，南方3118。

cards.audioText: N: [You have entered holding pattern and finished the checklist. But you are not sure whether the nose gear has been extended fully. Tell Tower that you want to exit the hold and make a low pass to confirm the nose gear is in the normal position.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你已经加入到等待程序，完成了检查单，但是你不确定前起落架是否完全放出。告知塔台，你想离开等待，进行低空通常来检查前起落架是否在正常位置。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3118, we have entered holding pattern and finished the checklist, but we are not sure whether the nose gear has been extended fully, request exit the hold and make a low pass for a visual check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方3118，我们已经进入到等待程序，完成了检查单，但是我们不确定前起落架是否完全放出，请求离开等待程序，进行低空通场目视检查。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CSN3118, exit hold, cleared for ILS approach, runway 36R, low pass approved, not below 150m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：收到，南方3118，离开等待，可以盲降进近，跑道36右，可以低空通场，不低于150米。
cards.referenceText: Exit hold, cleared for ILS approach, runway 36R, low pass approved, not below 150m, CSN3118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离开等待，可以盲降进近，跑道36右，可以低空通场，不低于150米，南方3118。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3118, your nose gear appears to be down. Go around, climb to 1200m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3118，你的前轮看起来已经放下，复飞，上1200米。
cards.referenceText: Going around, climb to 1200m, CSN3118.

cards.audioText: N: [Advise controller that you have joined downwind and want to make an ILS approach runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【告知管制员，你已经加入三边，想进行盲降进近跑道36右。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3118, on downwind, request ILS approach, runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方3118，在三边，请求盲降进近跑道36右。

cards.audioText: N: [You are now on short final. At this time, the runway is still occupied by preceding aircraft. You have to initiate the missed approach and report to the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在在短五边，此时，跑道依旧被前机占据，你必须执行复飞，报告给管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3118, the runway is still occupied by preceding aircraft, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方3118，跑道被前机占据，复飞了。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3118, go around as published, the aircraft on the runway has rejected takeoff, possibly due to blown tyre, a runway inspection is scheduled as soon as he is able to vacate, I will notify you when the runway is ready.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3118，按公布的程序复飞，跑道上飞机中断起飞了，大概是因为胎爆，他可以脱离后，将尽快进行跑道检查，跑道可用时，我会通知你。
cards.referenceText: Roger, go around as published, CSN3118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到 ，按发布的程序复飞，南方3118。

cards.audioText: N: [The fuel quantity indicator shows that the endurance is 25 minutes. Report your situation to ATC and ask to land as soon as possible. This is a distress call.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【油量指示显示燃油续航25分钟，向管制员告知你的情况，请求尽快着陆，这是一个遇险通话。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, CSN3118, our endurance is 25 minutes, request land as soon as possible/priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，南方3118，我们的续航只有25分钟，请求尽快着陆/优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3118, roger, descend to and maintain 900m, turn right heading 330, cleared for ILS approach, runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3118，收到，下900保持，右转航向330，可以盲降进近，跑道36右。建立后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 900m, turn right heading 330, cleared for ILS approach, runway 36R, report established, CSN3118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下900保持，右转航向330，可以盲降进近，跑道36右。建立后报，南方3118。

cards.audioText: N: [Your aircraft has just landed on runway 36R, but you find that the aircraft cannot taxi because the nose wheel steering is inoperative. Tell controller that your situation and ask for ground service to help your aircraft leave the runway.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的飞机刚刚降落在36右跑道上，但你发现飞机不能滑行，因为前轮转向故障。告诉管制员你的情况，请求地面服务帮助你的飞机离开跑道。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3118, our nose wheel steering is inoperative, request ground service to help us leave the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方3118，我们的前轮转向故障，请求地面服务帮助我们的飞机离开跑道。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CSN3118, hold your present position, the tug will arrive in a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C：收到，南方3118，当前位置等待，拖车一会就到。
cards.referenceText: Holding present position, thanks, CSN3118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当前位置等待，谢谢，南方3118。

topics.name: CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-1
cards.audioText: N: [Your aircraft call-sign is CSN3347, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, bay 221, information C received. Contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的航空器呼号是南方3347，从武汉飞往广州，221号机位，收到了通播C，联系武汉放行，申请管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN3347, bay 221, information C received, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方3347，221号机位，收到通播C，申请飞往广州的管制许可。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-2
cards.audioText: C: CSN3347, Wuhan Delivery, expect 5 minutes delay, your flight plan is being processed.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3347，武汉放行，预计延误5分钟，正在处理你的飞行计划。
cards.referenceText: Roger, 5 minutes delay, CSN3347.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，延误5分钟，南方3347。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-3
cards.audioText: N: [5 minutes later, you try to contact the controller again for ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【5分钟后，你想再次联系管制员，申请你的管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN3347, bay 221, information C received, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方3347，机位221，收到通播C，请求飞往广州的管制许可。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-4
cards.audioText: C: CSN3347, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, expect LKO-01D departure, initially climb to 900m, cruising level 10,100m, runway 36R, squawk 3353, departure frequency 123.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3347，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，预计LKO-01D离场，初始爬升至900米，巡航高度10100米，跑道36右，应答机3353，离场频率123.1。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, expect LKO-01D departure, initially climb to 900m, cruising level 10,100m, runway 36R, squawk 3353, departure frequency 123.1, CSN3347.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，预计LKO-01D离场，初始爬升至900米，巡航高度10100米，跑道36右，应答机3353，离场频率123.1，南方3347。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-5
cards.audioText: C: CSN3347, readback is correct, contact Ground on 121.9 for pushback and start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3347，复诵正确，联系地面121.9推出开车。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-6
cards.audioText: N: [Contact Wuhan Ground and ask for pushback and start-up.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【联系武汉地面，请求推出开车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3347, bay 221, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方3347，机坪221，请求推出开车。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-7
cards.audioText: C: CSN3347, inbound traffic is a company A330 taxiing behind, once that traffic is cleared, pushback and start-up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3347，一架公司的A330正在后方滑行，一旦解除冲突，可以推出开车。
cards.referenceText: After the company A330 has passed clear, pushback and start-up approved, CSN3347.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在公司的A330解除冲突后，可以推出开车，南方3347。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-8
cards.audioText: N: [When you are starting up the engines, the port engine experiences a start-up problem. Report this situation and ask for maintenance staff to inspect the engine.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【当你在启动发动机时，左发遇到了启动问题，报告该情况，请求机务人员检查发动机。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3347, the port engine had a problem during startup, request maintenance staff to inspect/check the engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方3347，在启动过程中，左发遇到问题，请求机务人员检查发动机。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-9
cards.audioText: N: [After the inspection, the port engine had been started up successfully. Contact Ground for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【检查之后，左发成功启动，联系地面，申请滑行指令。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3347, after the inspection, the port engine had been started up successfully, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方3347，检查之后，左发成功启动，请求滑行。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-10
cards.audioText: C: CSN3347, taxi to holding point runway 36R via Z4, A2 and A. Taxi with caution, work in progress on A5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3347，经由滑行道Z4，A2和A，滑行到跑道36右外等待点，谨慎滑行，A5上有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R via Z4, A2 and A, thanks for the caution, CSN3347.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A2和A，滑行到跑道36右外等待点，感谢提醒，南方3347。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-11
cards.audioText: N: [You are on taxiway A near taxiway A5. A large wooden box has been discarded on taxiway A. Report to ATC and ask for its removal.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你在滑行道A上，接近A5，一个大木箱子散落在滑行道A上，报告给管制员，请求移除。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3347, we are on taxiway A near taxiway A5, a large wooden box is in front of us, request to remove it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方3347，我们在滑行道A上，接近A5，前方有一个大木箱子，请求移除。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-12
cards.audioText: N: [The obstruction has been removed, you continue to taxi on taxiway A. When approaching the intersection A7, you find a B737 at your 10 o’clock position taxiing from left to right. You have stopped your aircraft, report this situation to controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【障碍物被移除，你继续在滑行道A上滑行，当接近联络道A7的时候，你发现10点钟方向有一架B737正从左向右滑行，你停下了飞机，告知管制员这个情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3347, we continue to taxi on taxiway A, when approaching the intersection A7, we find a B737 at our 10 o’clock taxiing from left to right, we have stopped the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方3347，我们继续在滑行道A上滑行，当我们到达A7的时候，我们发现10点钟方向上有一架B737正从左向右滑行，我们停下了飞机。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-13
cards.audioText: C: CSN3347, after cleared of traffic, continue taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3347，脱离冲突后，继续滑行。
cards.referenceText: When the traffic is clear, continue taxi, CSN3347.
cards.referenceTextZh: 脱离冲突后，继续滑行，南方3347。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-14
cards.audioText: N: [While you are taxiing, the wind sock shows that the wind has changed. Ask ATC for wind information.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【在滑行时，风袋显示风向改变，向管制员询问风的信息。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3347, request wind information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方3347，请求风的信息。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-15
cards.audioText:
C: CSN3347, wind 240 degrees at 10 m/s.
N: [The wind speed has exceeded your aircraft’s tailwind limitation. You decide to change to runway 18L for takeoff. State your request and reason to the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方3347，风向240，10米每秒。
N：【风速超过了你的顺风限制，你决定改到跑道18左起飞，向管制员告知你的请求及原因。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN3347, the wind speed has exceeded our aircraft’s tailwind limitation, request change to runway 18L for takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方3347，风速超过飞机的顺风限制，我请求改到跑道18左起飞。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-16
cards.audioText: N: [You are now holding at holding point runway 18L, ready for departure, contact Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在在跑道18左外等待点，你准备好起飞了，联系塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3347, we are holding at holding point runway 18L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方3447，我们在跑道18左的外等待点，准备好起飞了。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-17
cards.audioText: C: CSN3347, behind B777 on short final, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3347，在短五边的B777之后，上跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Behind B777 on short final, line up behind, CSN3347.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在短五边的B777之后，上跑道等待，南方3347。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-18
cards.audioText: C: CSN3347, when airborne, contact Departure on 123.1, wind 240 degrees, 8m/s, cleared for takeoff, runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3347，离地后，联系离场123.1，风向240度，8米每秒，可以起飞，跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, contact Departure on 123.1, cleared for takeoff, runway 18L, CSN3347.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后，联系离场123.1，可以起飞，跑道18左，南方3347。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-19
cards.audioText: N: [You are about to roll on runway 18L. Suddenly, a ground vehicle is attempting to cross runway 18L. You are stopping, contact Tower and report this situation.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你正要在跑道18左滑跑，突然，一辆地面车辆试图穿越跑道18左，你停下来了，联系塔台，报告你的情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN3347, a ground vehicle is attempting to cross runway 18L, we are stopping.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方3347，一辆地面车辆试图穿越跑道18左，我们停下来了。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-20
cards.audioText: C: CSN3347, cancel takeoff, hold position.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3347，取消起飞，原地等待。
cards.referenceText: Cancel takeoff, holding position, CSN3347.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消起飞，原地等待，南方3347。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-21
cards.audioText: N: [Your aircraft is in Wuhan Control area, cruising at 10100m. Suddenly, your instruments indicate that there is a conflicting traffic at your 2 o’clock position passing from right to left. Report your situation to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的飞机现在在武汉区调管制区，巡航高度10100米，突然，你的仪表指示有一架冲突航空器在你的2点钟方向，正在从右向左穿越，告知管制员你的情况。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN3347, cruising at 10100m. Our instruments indicate that there is a conflicting traffic at 2 o’clock position passing from right to left.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南方3347，在10100米巡航，我们的仪表指示在2点钟方向有一架冲突航空器正从右向左穿越。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-22
cards.audioText:
C: Roger, CSN3347, descend to and maintain 9500m.
N: [TCAS resolution advisory orders a climbing maneuver. You are following your TCAS climb. Advise ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：收到，南方3347，下9500米保持。
N：【你的TCAS决策告警执行了爬升机动，你按照TCAS进行爬升，告知管制员。】
cards.referenceText: We are following our TCAS climb, CSN3347.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们按照TCAS爬升，南方3347。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-23
cards.audioText: N: [After the TCAS conflict has been resolved, you have returned to 10100m and continue your flight planned route. You have encountered clear air turbulence and need to change your level, inform Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【TCAS冲突解决后，你回到了10100米，继续计划航路飞行，你遇到了清空颠簸，需要改变高度，告知武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN3347, we have returned to 10100m and continue our flight planned route, request change our level due clear air turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南方3347，我们回到了10100米，继续按计划航路飞行，由于晴空点播，请求改变高度。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-24
cards.audioText:
C: Roger, climb and maintain 11300m.
N: [You cannot accept this instruction, because your aircraft is too heavy, ask controller for a lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：收到，上11300米保持。
N：【你无法接受此高度，因为你的飞机太重了，向管制员申请更低的高度。】
cards.referenceText: Negative, request a lower level due aircraft weight, CSN3347.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，由于飞机重量，请求更低的高度，南方3347。

cards.taskTitle: 82-CSN3347 [发动机启动问题，地面障碍物]-25
cards.audioText: C: CSN3347, descend to and maintain 9500m.
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 9500m, CSN3347.

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN6682, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, you are at stand 215, make initial contact with Wuhan Ground and make a radio check.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方6682，从武汉飞往广州，你现在在215号停机位，与广州地面进行初始报话，并进行无线电检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN6682, stand 215, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, how do you read?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方6682，215号停机位，1，2，3，4，5，你听我几个？

cards.audioText: CSN6682, Wuhan Ground, I read you five. Here is your ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，武汉地面，我听你5个，以下是你的放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Roger, ready to copy, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，准备好抄收了，南方6682。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initially climb to 1,200m, cruising level 9,800m, after departure contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，按照LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，离场后联系119.7，应答机2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou, via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow LKO01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 9800m, after departure contact 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，按照LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，离场后联系119.7，应答机2515，南方6682。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你准备好推出开车了，联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN6682, request push-back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方6682，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，同意推出开车，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，面朝东，南方6682。

cards.audioText: You have completed push back and start up, request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在完成了推出开车，请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN6682, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方6682，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, taxi via A4, A3, C, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，经由滑行道A4，A3, C，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via A4, A3, C, hold short of runway 36R, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A4，A3, C，在跑道36右外等待，南方6682。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你准备好起飞了。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN6682, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方6682，准备好离场了。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, climb to 3900m, expedite until passing 2100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，爬升至3900米，加速直到通过2100米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900m, expedite until passing 2100m, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至3900米，加速直到通过2100米，南方6682。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, stop climbing due converging traffic, level off at 2,700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，由于汇聚航空器，停止爬升，在2700米改平。
cards.referenceText: Level off at 2700m, CSN6682.

cards.audioText: You found one of your hydraulic systems failed, make an urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你发现你的一个液压系统失效了，做紧急呼叫，并将此情况告诉管制员，请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CSN6682, we have one hydraulic system failure, request level off at 3900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉区调，南方6682，我们的一个液压系统失效了，请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, roger PAN, maintain 3900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，收到PAN，保持3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3900m, Turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach, runway 36R, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，ILS进近，跑道36右，南方6682。

cards.audioText: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for RWY 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告你已经截获跑道36右的航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN6682, established localizer for runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南方6682，建立跑道36右的航向道。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, contact Tower 124.35.
[You are CSN339, parking at Gate 51, with Information C, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, ask for ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是南航339，停在51号机位，通播C，从武汉飞往广州，请求ATC放行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN339, Parking bay 51, information C, destination Guangzhou, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南航339，51号机位，通播C，目的地广州，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: CSN339, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initially climb 1200m, cruising level 9800m, after departure contact 119.7, squawk 2515.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，LKO-01离场，起始高度1200米，巡航高度9800米，离场后联系119.7，应答机2515。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou, via flight planned route, runway 36R LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1200m, cruising level 9800m, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，LKO-01离场，起始高度1200米，巡航高度9800米，离场后联系119.7，应答机2515，南航339。

cards.audioText: CSN339, due to military activity, expect 1 hour delay, you are No.5 in sequence.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，由于军事活动，预计延误1小时，你排第五个。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, No.5, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，第5个，南航339。

cards.audioText: [1 hour has passed, ask controller how long would you wait.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【1小时过去了，询问管制员你还要等多久。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN339. How long shall we delay?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南航339。我们还要等多久？

cards.audioText: CSN339, standby one.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，稍等。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Standby, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，南方339。

cards.audioText: [You are now ready for pushback and start-up. Call Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已准备好推出开车。呼叫武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN339, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南航339，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CSN339, Wuhan Ground, after B737 behind cleared, pushback onto Z4, abeam Gate 213, facing east.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，武汉地面，波音737没影响后，推出开车至滑行道Z4，正切机位213，头朝东。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: After traffic cleared, pushback onto Z4, abeam 213, facing east, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没影响后，推出开车至滑行道Z4，正切213号机位，头朝东，南航339。

cards.audioText: [You have completed pushback and start-up, request taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你完成了推出开车，请求滑行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN339, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南航339，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN339, taxi via Z4, A3, A, hold short of runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，沿滑行道Z4，A3，A，滑至跑道36右外等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A, and hold short of runway 36R, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A3，A, 滑至跑道36右外等待。南航339。

cards.audioText: [Now you are ready for takeoff. Call Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已准备好起飞。呼叫武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN339, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南航339，请求起飞。

cards.audioText: CSN339, Wuhan Tower, Behind B737, line up behind, runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，武汉塔台，波音737起飞后进跑道36右等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: After traffic behind, line up runway 36R, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 737起飞后进跑道36右等待，南航339。

cards.audioText: [You are airborne, call Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已离地，呼叫武汉离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CSN339, airborne.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，南航339，离地了。

cards.audioText: CSN339, climb and maintain 3900m, expedite until passing 2100m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，上升保持标压3900米，尽快通过2100米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 3900m on standard, expedite until passing 2100m, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持标压3900米，尽快通过2100米，南航339。

cards.audioText: CSN339, stop climbing due converging traffic, maintain 2700m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，由于会聚活动，停止爬升，2700米保持。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Stop climbing, and maintaining 2700m, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 停止爬升，保持2700米，南航339。

cards.audioText: [You found one of your hydraulic systems is failed, make an urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3900m and then return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你发现机上一个液压系统失效，紧急呼叫ATC，告诉其该情况并请求在3900米平飞，之后返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CSN339, we have one hydraulic system failure, request level off at 3900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，南航339，机上一个液压系统失效，请求在3900米平飞，之后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CSN339, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, maintain 3900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，3900米保持，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，盲降进近跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 3900m, left direct to LKO, LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 3900米保持，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，盲降进近跑道36右，南航339。

cards.audioText: [A thunderstorm was detected near LKO, ask to deviate 20 miles to the left.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【探测到LKO附近有雷暴，请求向左偏航20海里。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN339, request offset 20miles left of track due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南航339，由于天气原因，请求向左偏20海里。

cards.audioText: CSN339, offset approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，偏置同意。
cards.referenceText: Offset approved, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意偏置，南航339。

cards.audioText: [You are CSN351, from Wuhan to Moscow, Gate 224, with information C, request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是南航351，从武汉飞往莫斯科，224号机位，通播C，请求ATC放行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN351, Parking bay 224, information C, destination Moscow, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南航351，机位224，通播C，目的地莫斯科，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: CSN351, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, follow ZF-01D departure, cruising level 8900m, initial altitude 1500m, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航351，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往莫斯科，ZF-01D离场，巡航高度8900米，起始高度1500米，离场频率119.45，应答机3223。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Moscow, via flight planned route, ZF-01D departure, cruising level 8900m, initial climb 1500m, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223, CSN351.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往莫斯科，ZF-01D离场，巡航高度8900米，起始高度1500米，离场频率119.45，应答机3223，南航351。

cards.audioText: [The maintenance stuff has deferred an MEL item regarding APU. Contact Ground that you will be ready for start-up one engine at Gate in 5min.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【维修人员根据MEL中APU的项目进行保留，告诉地面5分钟内你就可以在机位启动发动机。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN351, we’ll be ready to start-up one engine at Gate in 5min.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南航351，5分钟内我们就能启动好一台发动机。

cards.audioText: CSN351, Wuhan Ground, roger, report ready.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航351，武汉地面，收到，准备好报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Report ready, CSN351.
cards.referenceTextZh: 准备好报告，南航351。

cards.audioText: [You are ready for push, tell controller you can pushback and start-up.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已准备好推出，告诉管制员你已准备好推出开车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN351, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南航351，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CSN351, pushback and start-up approved, pushback onto taxiway F, facing south. Report taxi.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航351，可以推出开车，推出至滑行道F，头朝南，滑行后报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, pushback onto taxiway F, facing south, report taxi, CSN351.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，推出至滑行道F，头朝南，报告滑行，南航351。

cards.audioText: [You have pushed back and started-up already, call Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经推出开车完毕，呼叫地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN351, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南航351，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN351, taxi to holding point runway 04 via F, A9, hold short of A.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航351，沿滑行道F，A9滑至跑道04等待点，在滑行道A外等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Taxi to Holding point runway 04 via F, A9, hold short of A. CSN351.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道F，A9滑至跑道04等待点，在滑行道A外等待，南航351。

cards.audioText: [While taxiing, an auto brake caution message is displayed on aircraft’s warning system, so you stopped taxiing, advise Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑行时，警告系统显示自动刹车信息，因此你停止滑行，告诉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN351, we stopped taxiing due a caution message.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南航351，收到一条预警信息，我们停下来了。

cards.audioText: CSN351, roger, hold at present position, advise intentions when able. [Tell the controller that you are still able to taxi but you need 5min to solve the problem, ask to hold at convenient position on taxiway.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航351，收到，原地等待，可以时报告意图。【告诉管制员你仍能滑行，但是需要5分钟解决问题，请求在滑行道上方便的位置等待。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN351, request 5min and hold at convenient position to solve the problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南航351，请求停在一个没影响的位置5分钟来解决问题。

cards.audioText: CSN351, roger, hold present position.[While communicating with mechanic and dispatcher, you discovered that some pages of onboard flight manual were missing, it is against regulation to continue the flight, report to ATC and ask for returning to the gate.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航351，收到，原地等待。【和机械师及签派员沟通时，你发现机载飞行手册少了几页，按规定不能继续飞行，报告ATC并请求返回停机位。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN351, request return to apron due to flight manuals missing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南航351，由于飞行手册少了几页，请求返回停机坪。

cards.audioText: CSN351, taxi to Gate 224 via A8, A, A5.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航351，沿滑行道A8，A，A5滑至224号机位。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: A8, A, A5, Parking bay 224, CSN351.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道A8，A，A5滑至224号机位，南航351。

cards.audioText: [Two hours later, you are now cruising at 9500m, you are ETA WXI at 04, your squawk code is 3223, call Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【两小时后，你在9500米巡航，预计到达WXI时间04分，应答机编码3223，呼叫北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN351, maintaining 9500m, ETA WXI 04, squawk 3223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航351，9500米保持，预计到达WXI时间04分，应答机3223。

cards.audioText: CSN351, Beijing Control radar contact, maintain 9500m.[There is CB ahead of your route, request climb a higher level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航351，北京区调，雷达已识别，9500米保持。【飞机航路前方有积雨云，请求爬升至更高高度。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN351, request a higher level due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航351，由于天气原因，请求爬升高高度。

cards.audioText: CSN351, climb and maintain 10700m.[Tell Beijing control you’re too heavy, request a step climb to 10700m in about 10 minutes.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航351，上升保持10700米。【告诉管制员机身太重，请求在10分钟内阶梯爬升至10700米。】
cards.referenceText: Negative due weight, request a step climb to 10700m in about 10 minutes, CSN351.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于飞机重量，不能爬升，请求在10分钟内阶梯爬升10700米，南航351。

cards.audioText: CSN351 Roger.[There is a restriction ahead, controller tells you maintain a low speed. Ask controller which speed is available.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航351，收到。【前方有限制，管制员告诉你保持低速。告诉管制员可以接受的速度。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN351, confirm which speed is suitable over fly the restriction area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航351，证实能以什么速度飞过限制区域。

cards.audioText: CSN351, due separation, maintain Mach number not greater than .77.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 由于间隔，保持马赫数不超过点77。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Maintain Mach number not greater than .77, CSN351.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持马赫数不超过点77，南航351。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CSN421. You are just over ZF and maintaining 4500m. You are about to enter the Area Control airspace. Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是南航421，刚过ZF，4500米保持。你即将进入区域管制空域。和武汉区调进行初次联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN421, over ZF, maintaining 4500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南航421，过ZF，4500米保持。

cards.audioText: [Ask Wuhan Control for 8900m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【向武汉区调请求爬升8900米。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN421, request climb to 8900m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南航421，请求爬升8900米。

cards.audioText: CSN421, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb and maintain 7500m initially, expect 8900m able at time 16.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，武汉区调，雷达已识别，起始爬升保持7500米，预计16分能到达8900米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 7500m, 8900m able at time 16, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升保持7500米，预计16分能到达8900米，南航421。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you have encountered a severe Clear Air Turbulence, and ask for 8900m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员你遇到了强烈的晴空乱流，请求爬升至8900米。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN421, we have encountered a severe clear air Turbulence, request 8900m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南航421，我们遇到了强烈的晴空乱流，请求爬升8900米。

cards.audioText: CSN421, climb and maintain 8900m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，爬升保持8900米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 8900m, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升保持8900米，南航421。

cards.audioText: CSN421, Wuhan Control, is there any damage to the aircraft or passenger injuries?[Tell the controller that there isn’t any damage, and the purser told you that passengers are OK.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，武汉区调，飞机有损伤么？乘客有受伤么？【告诉管制员飞机没有任何损伤，乘务长说乘客也没受伤。】
cards.referenceText: No damage and the purser reported that the passengers are OK, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有损伤，乘务长说乘客也都很安全，南航421。

cards.audioText: [Inform Wuhan Control that you have just received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知武汉区调你刚接到匿名电话称机上有炸弹。】
cards.referenceText: (Mayday Mayday Mayday) Wuhan Control, CSN421, we have just received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board.
cards.referenceTextZh: (Mayday Mayday Mayday) 武汉区调，南航421，我们刚接到匿名电话，称飞机上有炸弹。

cards.audioText: CSN421, roger, report your intentions.[Tell the controller that you wish to land at Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，收到，报告意图。【告诉管制员你希望降落在武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request to land at Wuhan airport. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求降落在武汉机场，南航421。

cards.audioText: CSN421, roger, turn left direct to ZF, descend to 4800m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，收到，左转直飞ZF，下降4800米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to ZF, descend to 4800m, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞ZF，下降到4800米，南航421。

cards.audioText: CSN421, do you need any assistance.[Inform the controller that you need a bomb disposal squad upon landing, and you will use the emergency slides to deplane the passengers.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，你是否需要援助。【通知管制员，飞机降落时需要一支排弹小组，同时你会打开紧急逃生滑梯让乘客离机。】
cards.referenceText: We will use the emergency slides for evacuation, and we need a bomb disposal squad ready on arrival. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们会使用紧急逃生滑梯疏散乘客，到达时需要一支排弹小组，南航421。

cards.audioText: CSN421, roger, maintain 4800m, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，收到，4800米保持，联系武汉进近118.9。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 4800m, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 4800米保持，联系武汉进近118.9，南航421。

cards.audioText: [Make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach; inform the controller that you have received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft, and you are returning to Wuhan.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【和武汉进近进行初次联系；通知管制员你收到匿名电话，称飞机上有炸弹，你正在返回武汉。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN421, maintaining 4800m, over ZF. We have received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board. We are turning back to land at Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南航421，4800米保持，过ZF。我们收到匿名电话，称飞机上有炸弹，我们正在返回降落到武汉。

cards.audioText: CSN421, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow ZF-1A arrival; descend and maintain 2700m on QNH1017, information C.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，武汉进近，雷达已识别，ZF-1A进场；下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1017，通播C。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: ZF-1A arrival, descend and maintain 2700 m on QNH 1017; information C. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF-1A进场，下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1017，通播C，南航421。

cards.audioText: CSN421, descend and maintain 900m, expect ILS approach runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，下降保持900米，预计盲降进近跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900m, ILS approach runway 36R. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，盲降进近跑道36右，南航421。

cards.audioText: CSN421, reduce speed to 200 knots, turn right heading 330.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，速度减至200节，右转航向330。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to 200 knots; turn right heading 330, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 速度减至200节，右转航向330，南航421。

cards.audioText: CSN421, intercept the localizer of runway 36R, report established.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，切入跑道36右航道，建立后报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Intercept the localizer of runway 36R, report established, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 切入跑道36右航向道，建立后报告，南航421。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that you have captured the signal of the localizer.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员你已截获航向道信号。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN421, localizer established.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南航421，航道已建立。

cards.audioText: Roger, CSN421, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, 13 miles from touch down, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南航421，可以盲降进近跑道36右，距离着陆13海里，雷达服务中止，联系武汉塔台124.35。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 36R, Wuhan Tower 124.35. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以盲降进近跑道36右，武汉塔台124.35，南航421。

cards.audioText: [Later, you cannot see the runway at decision altitude during approach, inform tower controller that you need to make another approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【过了一会儿，在决断高度你无法看到跑道，通知塔台管制员你需要重新进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN421, we are going around, no contact at minima.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南航421，我们复飞了，最低标准不能见跑道。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CSN6202, destination Harbin. You just departed from Beijing airport at 23. You are passing 1200m and want to climb to 1800m, contact Beijing Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是南航6202，目的地哈尔滨。北京机场起飞的时间是23分。刚刚飞过1200米，想爬升到1800米，联系北京离场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN6202, from Beijing to Harbin, airborne 23, passing 1200m, request climb to 1800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，南航6202，北京飞哈尔滨，离地时间23分，过1200米，请求上1800米。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, Beijing Departure, radar contact, due to slower preceding traffic, cancel SID, turn right heading 010.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，北京离场，雷达已识别，由于前机减速，取消SID，右转航向010。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, turn right heading 010, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消SID，右转航向010，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, climb to 5400m on standard, resume own navigation, direct to YV via flight planned route.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，上升标压5400米，自主领航，按计划航路直飞YV。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5400m on standard, direct to YV via flight planned route, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升标压5400米，按计划航路直飞YV，南航6202。

cards.audioText: [Inform the controller that your weather radar shows a build-up around YV, request direct to KAKAT.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员你的气象雷达显示YV处有积雨云，请求直飞KAKAT。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, CSN6202, radar indicates a CB around YV, request direct to KAKAT.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，南航6202，雷达显示YV附近有积雨云，请求直飞KAKAT。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, contact Beijing Control 125.9 for request.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，联系北京区调125.9，请求直飞。

cards.audioText: [Make an initial contact with Beijing Control, 5400m maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due to weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【开始联系北京区调，保持5400米，由于天气原因，请求直飞KAKAT。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, 5400m maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航6202，保持5400米，由于天气原因，请求直飞KAKAT。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, climb to and maintain 10700m. Due Air Force restriction, suggest heading 020. [Because the CB is too large, you want heading 030.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，上升并保持10700米。由于空军限制，建议航向020。【由于积雨云范围太大，你想要航向030。】
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 10700m, request heading 030 due CB, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升并保持10700米，由于积雨云，请求航向030，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, turn right heading 030 approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，同意右转航向030。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向030，南航6202。

cards.audioText: [Now you have cleared weather, back on course.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【天气转好，返回航道。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, cleared weather, back on course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航6202，天气转好，返回航道。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, Beijing roger. [Tell the controller that you have ice accumulation as a result of suspected de-icing equipment failure. Request descent below the freezing level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，北京收到。【告知管制员你遇到积冰，除冰装置疑似故障。请求下降至结冰高度以下。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, possible de-icing equipment failure, ice is building up. Request descent below freezing level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航6202，除冰装置似乎有问题，积冰严重。请求下降至结冰高度以下。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, roger descent to 6300m. Report if you still have emergency condition on this level?[Tell the controller this level should be sufficient and emergency conditions do not exist.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，收到，下降6300米。报告你是否在此高度还有紧急情况？【告知管制员这个高度足够了，不存在紧急状况。】
cards.referenceText: Descending to 6300m, negative emergency conditions, this level is sufficient, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到6300米，没有紧急状况，这个高度已经足够，南航6202。

cards.audioText: [There may be a problem about flight control system, request return to Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞行操纵系统似乎有问题，请求返回北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, request return to Beijing airport due possible problems with flight control system.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航6202， 请求返回北京机场，飞行操纵系统似乎有问题。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, roger, confirm approach and landing normal? [Say no problem.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，收到，确定进近着陆正常？【回答没问题。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, turn right direct to GITUM, descend to and maintain 3600m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，右转直飞GITUM，下降保持3600米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to GITUM, descend to and maintain 3600m, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞GITUM，下降保持3600米，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, contact Approach 120.6.
[Descend to 3600m. Contact Approach, tell him you have a further problem with your leading edge flap extension and believe it is because of the prior icing issue.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【下降3600米，联系进近，告知他前缘襟翼无法放下，应该是受之前的积冰影响。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CSN6202, descending to 3600m. We have a problem with our leading edge flap extension.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，南航6202，正下降至3600米。我们的前缘襟翼无法放下。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, Beijing Approach, roger, do you require any other assistance? [Tell Approach you have a micro-switch malfunction and will conduct a flapless landing and request runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，北京进近，收到，是否需要其它援助？【告知进近微动电门故障，准备实施无襟翼着陆，并请求降落在跑道36右。】
cards.referenceText: Due possible micro-switch malfunction, we’ll be conducting a flapless landing and request runway 36R, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于微动电门似乎发生故障，我们准备实施无襟翼着陆，请求跑道36右，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202 roger, change of runway 36R, turn left heading 090,  descend to and maintain 2700m on QNH 1013, information C.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，收到，更换跑道36右，左转航向090，下降保持修正海压2700米保持，修正海压1013，通播C。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, turn left heading 090, descend to and maintain 2700m on QNH 1013, information C, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，左转航向090，下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1013，通播C，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, turn right heading 270, descend to 1800m.
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 270, descend to 1800m, CSN6202.

cards.audioText: CSN6202, the field is 11 miles away, report visual contact. [Tell the approach, you have the runway in sight.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，距离机场还有11海里，能见地面叫。【告诉进近，你可以看见跑道。】
cards.referenceText: Runway in sight, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 看到跑道了，南航6202。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, make visual approach 36R, turn final when ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，目视进近跑道36右，准备好后转向五边。
cards.referenceText: Make visual approach 36R, turn final when ready, CSN6202.
cards.referenceTextZh: 目视进近跑道36右，准备好后转向五边，南航6202。

cards.audioText: [You are the pilot of CSN6306 which is bound for Dalian. You are going to depart from Shanghai airport at Gate 23. Now call Delivery, and request your ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是航班CSN6306的飞行员，飞机飞往大连。你正在上海机场23号停机位准备出发，现在联系放行并请求放行许可。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, CSN6306, destination Dalian, Gate 23, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，南航6306，目的地大连，23号门，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN6306, Shanghai Delivery, copy clearance, cleared to Dalian, via flight planned route, D2 Departure, initial climb to 900m. Request level change en route, squawk 4736.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6306，上海放行，抄收放行许可，可以按计划航路飞往大连，按D2离场，起始高度900米。在航路上申请改变高度，应答机4736。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Dalian, via flight planned route, D2 Departure, initial climb to 900m. Request level change en route, squawk 4736, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路飞往大连，D2离场，起始高度900米。在航路上申请改变高度，应答机4736.

cards.audioText: [You are ready for push back.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已准备好推出。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, CSN6306, ready for push back.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，南航6306，准备推出。

cards.audioText: CSN6306, Shanghai Ground, expect delay 20 minutes due weather on your route. I will call you back.[After 30 minutes, you want to change route through COL to save time.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6306，上海地面，由于航路上天气，预计延误20分钟，稍后叫你。【30分钟后，你想要改变航线过COL节省时间。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, CSN6306, can we change route through COL to avoid delay?
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，南航6306，我们可以改变航线过COL避免延误吗？

cards.audioText: Negative, CSN6306, you must fly via planned route.
cards.audioTextZh: 不可以，南航6306，必须按计划航路飞行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, via planned route, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，按计划航路飞行，南航6306。

cards.audioText: [You have finished pushback and start-up, ready for taxi, contact Shanghai Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已推出开车，准备滑行，联系上海地面。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, CSN6306, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，南航6306，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN6306, Shanghai Ground, the weather is deteriorating, confirm you will depart on schedule under this condition?[You say yes, the weather is not below your company minima.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6306，上海地面，天气情况恶劣，确认在这种情况按时离场？【回答管制员确认，天气情况没有低于公司最低标准。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, the weather is not below our company minima, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，天气情况没有低于公司最低标准，南航6306。

cards.audioText: Roger, CSN6306, runway 31 via taxiway D1 B1 and A12.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南航6306，经滑行道D1，B1和A12滑到跑道31。
cards.referenceText: Roger, runway 31, taxiway D1 B1 and A12, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，跑道31，滑行道D1，B1和A12，南航6306。

cards.audioText: [Now you are en route, the No.2 engine failed, call Shanghai Control to request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你在航路上，2号发动机故障，联系上海区调并请求下降。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Shanghai Control, CSN6306, engine failure on No.2, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, 上海区调，南航6306，2号发动机故障，请求下降。

cards.audioText: Roger, CSN6306, descend to 5400m initially.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南航6306，初步下降到5400米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5400m initially, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 初步下降到5400米，南航6306。

cards.audioText: [At 5400m, you are unable to maintain the present level, request descent to 4500m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 到达5400米，飞机无法保持当前高度，请求下降到4500米。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CSN6306. unable to maintain present level, request descent to 4500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，南航6306，不能在当前高度保持， 请求下降到4500米。

cards.audioText: CSN6306, descend to 4500m.[Request return to Shanghai airport and fuel dumping.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6306，下降到4500米。【请求返回上海机场并在返回前放油。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4500m, and request return to Shanghai airport and fuel dumping, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到4500米，请求返回上海机场并执行放油，南航6306。

cards.audioText: Roger, CSN6306. Turn right heading 230, radar vector for fuel dumping.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南航6306，右转航向230，雷达引导放油。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 230, radar vector for fuel dumping, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向230，雷达引导放油，南航6306。

cards.audioText: [Fuel dumping completed, request priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机完成放油，请求优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CSN6306, dump completed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，南航6306，完成放油，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: Roger, CSN6306, direct to CG, descend to 3600m. Contact Shanghai Approach 123.45.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南航6306，直飞CG，下降到3600米，联系上海进近123.45。
cards.referenceText: Direct to CG, descend to 3600m, 123.45, CSN6306.

cards.audioText: [Establish initial contact with Shanghai Approach, maintaining 3600m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【与上海进近建立起始联系，3600米保持。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, CSN6306, maintaining 3600m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，南航6306，3600米保持。

cards.audioText: CSN6306, Shanghai Approach, radar contact. Descend to 2700m on QNH 1010, information K, you are number one.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6306，上海进近，雷达看到。下降到修正海压2700米，修正海压1010，通播K，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2700m on QNH 1010, information K, number one, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到修正海压2700米，修正海压1010，通播K，第一个，南航6306。

cards.audioText: CSN6306, do you require any other assistance?[You need fire and medical services.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6306，你需要其它援助吗？【你需要消防和医疗服务。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request fire and medical services, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，请求消防和医疗服务，南航6306。

cards.audioText: CSN6306, a fire engine and ambulance will be ready on landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6306，消防车和救护车将在着陆时就位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，南航6306。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CSN586, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, gate 213, information G received, request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方586，从武汉飞往广州，213号停机位，收到通播G，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN586, gate 213, information G, destination Guangzhou, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方586，,213号停机位，通播G，目的地广州，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN586, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, follow LKO 01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 8400m, when airborne contact departure 119.7, squawk 3115.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，跑道36右，按照LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度8400米，离地后联系119.7，应答机3115。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, LKO 01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 8400m, contact 119.7, squawk 3115, CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，跑道36右，按照LKO01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度8400米，离地后联系119.7，应答机3115，南方586。

cards.audioText: [Now you are pushback with the engines running, request taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在你在发动机启动情况下推出，请求滑行指令]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN586, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方586，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN586, taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，经由Z4，A3，A，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R, CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4，A3，A，在跑道36右外等待，南方586。

cards.audioText: CSN586, taxi with caution, men and equipment operating east of taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，谨慎滑行，滑行道A东部有人和设备运行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，南方586。

cards.audioText: [You encountered the wind shear between 200m to 400m, report the situation to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你在200米到400米之间遇到了风切变，向管制员报告此情况]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CSN586, we encountered wind shear between 200m to 400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，南方586，在200米到400米之间遇到了风切变。

cards.audioText: [Now you are cruising at 8000m, approaching DAPRO, make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在巡航在8000米，接近DAPRO，与广州区调进行初始联系]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN586, maintaining 8000m, approaching DAPRO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方586，正保持在8000米，接近DAPRO。

cards.audioText: CSN586, Guangzhou Control, radar identified, omit position report.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，广州区调，雷达识别，省略位置报。
cards.referenceText: Omit position report. CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 省略位置报，南方586。

cards.audioText: [As you were descending to 4200m, you executed TCAS RA climbing maneuver, report the situation to controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你下降到4200米时，你执行了TCAS RA 爬升机动，将情况报告管制员]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN586, we executed TCAS RA climbing maneuver while descending to 4200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方586，我们在下降到4200米时，执行了TCAS RA 爬升机动。

cards.audioText: [Now the conflicting traffic is clear, resume descend. Report the situation to the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在与冲突航空器已解除冲突，恢复下降。将此情况报告给管制员]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN586, conflicted traffic clear, resume descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方586，与冲突航空器已解除冲突，恢复下降。

cards.audioText: CSN586 continue descend to 3600m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，继续下降到3600米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descend to 3600m, CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降到3600米，南方586。

cards.audioText: [Now you are established on the ILS approach runway 36R, tell the controller you cannot see PAPI light.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在建立了ILS进近，跑道36右，告诉管制员，你看不到PAPI灯]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN586, ILS established, runway 36R, PAPI light not in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，南方586，建立ILS进近，跑道36右，看不到PAPI灯。

cards.audioText: CSN586, cleared to land, PAPI light is out of service.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，可以落地，PAPI灯故障。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 36R, CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道36右，南方586。

cards.audioText: [Ask for follow me car after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: [请求落地后引导车]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CSN586, request a follow me car after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，南方586，落地后，请求引导车。

cards.audioText: The follow me car will wait for you on the taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: 引导车将在滑行道A等你。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks. CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，南方586。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CSN582. You are at Gate K10 with information B. Request clearance from Chengdu Delivery.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你的呼号是南方582，你在K10停机位，通播B，向成都放行申请许可。]
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Delivery, CSN582, Gate K10, information B, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都放行，南方582，K10停机位，通播B，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CSN582, Chengdu Delivery, good afternoon. Information B valid. Cleared to Shanghai via flight planned route. Runway 02. After departure turn right direct BHS. Initial climb 1200m on QNH 1021. After departure contact 125.6, squawk 3656.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方582，成都放行，下午好，通播B有效，可以经由计划航路飞往上海，跑道02，离场后右转直飞BHS，按照修正海压1021初始爬升至1200米，联系离场125.6，应答机3656。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Shanghai via flight planned route. Runway 02. After departure turn right direct to BHS. Initial climb 1200m on QNH 1021. After departure contact 125.6, squawk 3656, CSN582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往上海，跑道02，离场后右转直飞BHS，按修正海压1021初始爬升至1200米，联系离场125.6，应答机3656，南方，582。

cards.audioText: C: CSN582, read back correct. When ready for pushback and start-up, contact Ground 121.85.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方582，复诵正确，可以推出开车时，联系地面121.85。
