cards.audioText: [You are now ready for start-up. Request pushback and permission to start your engines from Chengdu Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在准备好开车了，向成都地面请求推出开车。]
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, CSN582, ready for/request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，南方582，准备好/请求推出开车了。

cards.audioText: C: CSN582, Chengdu Ground, pushback and start-up approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方582，成都地面，同意推出开车。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, CSN582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，南方582。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN582, we just had report of a bomb left in your first class passenger section. Please report intentions.
[Tell the controller the cabin crew and the securities are searching the bomb.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方582，我们收到一个报告，客舱头等舱区域有炸弹，请报告意图。
[告知管制员，客舱乘务员和安全员正在寻找炸弹。]
cards.referenceText: We are searching for/looking for/ the bomb, CSN582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们正在寻找炸弹，南方582。

cards.audioText: [During the search, the cabin crew find a bag that is not claimed by any passengers. Inform Ground about this and tell them that because there is no aircraft around you, you will hold at present position.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在寻找过程中，乘务员发现一个无人认领的包。告知地面此事，告诉他们，因为你周围没有航空器，你将原地等待。]
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Ground, CSN582, we found a bag unidentified (we found an unknown bag), request hold position due no aircraft around us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都地面，南方582，我们发现一个不明包裹，由于四周没有航空器，请求原地等待。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN582, roger, do you need any further assistance?
[Tell the controller you will disembark the passengers and request passenger steps and a bomb squad.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方582，收到，你需要进一步的协助吗？
[告知管制员，你将让乘客下飞机，请求客梯和拆弹小组。]
cards.referenceText:
Affirm, we will disembark the passengers, request passenger stairs and bomb squad, CSN582.
注意客梯车的表达可以是passengers step、passengers stairs或者stair vehicle。
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们将让乘客下飞机，请求客梯和拆弹小组，南方582。

cards.audioText: [It is late the day. The suspected bomb was an empty bag. You are at the holding point of runway 02. Tell ATC you are ready for takeoff.]
cards.audioTextZh: [天已晚，疑似炸弹的包是个空包，你在跑道02外等待点，你准备好起飞了。]
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Tower, CSN582, holding point of runway 02, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都塔台，南方582，跑道02外等待点，准备好起飞了。

cards.audioText: C: CSN582, Chengdu Tower, after departure maintain runway heading, cleared for takeoff RWY02. Surface wind 010, 2m/s.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方582，成都塔台，离场后保持跑道航向，可以起飞，跑道02，地面风010, 2米每秒。
cards.referenceText: Maintain runway heading, cleared for takeoff RWY02. CSN582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道航向，可以起飞，跑道02，南方582。

cards.audioText: [You are departed from runway 02, call Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你从跑道02离场，呼叫塔台。]
cards.referenceText:
Chengdu Tower, CSN582, airborne, runway 02.
注：我们一般用airborne表示飞机离地了。
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都塔台，南方582，离地了，跑道02。

cards.audioText: C: CSN582, contact Departure on 125.6.
[Contact Departure. Your altitude is now passing 1200m.]
cards.audioTextZh: [联系离场，你的高度现在已经过1200米。]
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Departure, CSN582, passing 1200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都离场，南方582，过1200米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN582, Chengdu Departure, good afternoon. Maintain runway heading, climb and maintain 3000m. There are some flights reported the large unmanned weather balloons in your flight route area.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方582，成都离场，下午好，保持跑道航向，上3000米保持，许多航班报告，在你的航路区域有一些无人气象气球。
cards.referenceText:
Roger, thanks, maintain runway heading, climb and maintain 3000m, CSN582.
题干中的There are some flights reported the large unmanned weather balloons in your flight route area属于情报，直接回复roger即可。
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，保持跑道航向，上3000米保持，南方582。

cards.audioText: [As you are climbing, you notice a large unmanned balloon. Your position is 4 miles north of the airfield and current height is 2000 meters. Report this to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你爬升时，你注意到一个大型无人气球，你的位置是机场以北4海里，当前高度2000米，将此报告给管制员。]
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Departure, CSN582, we have seen a large unmanned balloon. Our position is 4 miles north of the airfield and current height is 2000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都离场，南方582，我们看到一个大型无人气球，我们位置是机场以北4海里，当前高度2000米。

cards.audioText: [Before ATC replies you suddenly hit another balloon you did not see. The aircraft becomes difficult to control and you want to return to land at Chengdu. Tell ATC this. This is an Urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在管制员回复之前，你撞上了一个你没有注意到的气球，飞机变得很难控制，你想返场降落成都，告知管制员此事，这是一个紧急呼叫。]
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Chengdu Departure, CSN582, we just hit a balloon, request return to Chengdu for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，成都离场，南方582，我们撞上了一个气球，请求成都降落。

cards.audioText: C: CSN582, Chengdu Control, roger Panpan, turn left heading 200, descend and maintain 1200m. All runways available for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方582，成都区调，收到PANPAN，左转航向200，下到1200米保持，所有跑道可用于着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 200, descend and maintain 1200m, CSN582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向200，下到1200米保持，南方582。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN582, radar vectors are available or you can fly a visual circuit and join left downwind. Report intention.
[Tell the controller you will join left downwind.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方582，雷达引导可用，或者你可以目视盘旋加入左三边，报告意图。
[告诉管制员你将加入左三边。]
cards.referenceText: Request join left downwind, CSN582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求加入左三边，南方582。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN582, roger, report downwind. And when able can you tell us what is the damage to your aircraft?
[Reply to the transmission and tell them you have a large hole in your wing and the controls are damaged.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方582，收到，三边报，可以的时候告知飞行受损情况。
[回复指令，告诉他们机翼有个大洞，飞行操纵面受损。]
cards.referenceText: Report downwind. We have a large hole in our wing and the controls are damaged, CSN582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 三边报，机翼有个大洞，飞行操纵面受损，南方582。

cards.audioText: C: CSN582, you are No.1, cleared to land RWY02. Report on final.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方582，你是第一个，可以着陆，跑道02，五边报。
cards.referenceText:
Report on final, No.1, cleared to land RWY02, CSN582.
注：题干中最后的五边报report on final不用必须放在答案开头，也可以用wilco代替。
cards.referenceTextZh: 五边报，第一个，可以着陆，跑道02，南方582。

cards.audioText: You are CSN319, parking at gate 51, with Information C, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, ask for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方319，停在51号停机位，通播C，从武汉飞往广州，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN319, gate 51, information C, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方319，51号停机位，通播C，请求飞往广州的放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN319, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow LKO01 departure, initially climb to 1,200m, cruising level 9,800m, after departure contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，按照LKO01离场。初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，离场后联系119.7，应答机2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, follow LKO01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 9800m, contact 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，按照LKO01离场。初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，离场后联系119.7，应答机2515，南方319。

cards.audioText: CSN319, due to military activity, expect 1hour delay, you are No.5 in sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，由于军事活动，预计有1小时延误，你是第五个。
cards.referenceText: Roger, No.5 in sequence, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，第五个，南方319。

cards.audioText: You are now ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在准备好推出开车了。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN319, request pushback and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方319，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CSN319, after B737 behind is clear, push back onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，与后方B737解除冲突后，在Z4推出，正切213号停机位，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: After B737 is clear, pushback onto Z4, abeam gate 213, facing east, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 与后方B737解除冲突后，在Z4推出，正切213号停机位，面朝东，南方319。

cards.audioText: You have completed push back and start up, request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 你完成了推出开车，请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN319, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方319，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN319, taxi via Z4, A3, A, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，经由滑行道Z4,A3,A，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A, hold short of runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4,A3,A，在跑道36右外等待，南方319。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在，你准备好起飞了。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN319. Ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方319，准备好起飞了。

cards.audioText: CSN319, Behind B737, line up behind, runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，在B737后，上跑道等待，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Behind B737, line up behind, runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在B737后，上跑道等待，跑道36右，南方319。

cards.audioText: CSN319, climb to 3,900m, expedite until passing 2,100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，爬升到3900米，加速爬升至2100米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900m, expedite until passing 2100m, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到3900米，加速爬升至2100米，南方319。

cards.audioText: CSN319, stop climbing due converging traffic, level off at 2,700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，由于汇入航空器，停止爬升，在2700米改平。
cards.referenceText: level off at 2700m due converging traffic, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于汇入航空器，在2700米改平，南方319。

cards.audioText: You found one of your hydraulic systems failed, make an urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3,900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你发现，你的一个液压系统失效了，做紧急呼叫，告诉管制员这个情况，并请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CSN319, we have one hydraulic system failure, request level off at 3,900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，南方319，我们一个液压失效，请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: Roger PAN, maintain 3,900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach r/w 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到PAN，保持高度3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3,900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持高度3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，ILS进近，跑道36右，南方319。

cards.audioText: Thunderstorm was detected near LKO, ask to deviate 20 miles to the left.
cards.audioTextZh: 在LKO探测到雷暴，请求左偏航20海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN319, request deviate 20miles to the left due to thunderstorm near LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南方319，由于LKO附近有雷暴，请求左偏航20海里。

topics.name: CSN371 [自动刹车告警，手册问题]

cards.audioText: You are CZ371, from Wuhan to Moscow, Bay 224, with information C, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方371，从武汉飞往莫斯科，224号停机位，通播C，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CZ371. Bay 224, information C received, request ATC clearance to Moscow.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方371, 224号停机位，收到通播C，请求飞往莫斯科的放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN371, cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, follow ZF01D departure, cruising level 8,900m, initial altitude 1,500m, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223. Read back information.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方371，可以经由计划航路飞往莫斯科，按照ZF01离场，巡航高度8900米，初始高度1500米，离场频率119.45，应答机3223。复诵信息。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Moscow via flight planned route, follow ZF01D departure, cruising level 8,900m, initial altitude 1,500m, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3223, CSN371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往莫斯科，按照ZF01离场，巡航高度8900米，初始高度1500米，离场频率119.45，应答机3223，南方371。

cards.audioText: The maintenance staff has deferred an MEL item regarding APU, contact Ground that you will be ready for start up one engine at bay in 5 mins.
cards.audioTextZh: 机务人员保留了APU的一个项目，告知地面，你准备好在5分钟后，在停机位启动一台发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN371, we’ll be ready to start up one engine at bay in 5mins.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方371，我们准备好在5分钟后，在停机位启动一台发动机。

cards.audioText: CSN 371, pushback is approved, pushback onto taxiway F, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方371，同意推出，推出到F滑行道，朝南。
cards.referenceText: Pushback is approved, pushback onto taxiway F, facing south., CSN371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，推出到F滑行道，朝南，南方371。

cards.audioText: CSN371, taxi to holding point runway 04 via F, A9, hold short of A.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方371，经由滑行道F，A9滑行到跑道04，在A外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via F, A9, hold short of A. CSN371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道F，A9滑行到跑道04，在A外等待，南方371。

cards.audioText: While taxing, an auto brake caution message is displayed on aircraft’s warning system, so you stopped taxing, advise Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 在滑行中，一条自动刹车告警信息出现在飞机的告警系统中，因此你停止滑行，告知地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CZ371, we have autobrake caution message, we are stopping taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方371，我们有一个自动刹车告警信息，我们停止滑行了。

cards.audioText:
CSN371, roger, hold at present position, advise intentions when able.
Tell the controller that you are still able to taxi, but you need 5mins to solve the problem, ask to hold at convenient position on taxiway.
cards.audioTextZh:
南方371，收到，原地等待，方便时告知意图。
告诉管制员，你仍然可以滑行，但是你需要5分钟来解决问题，请求在滑行道上的方便位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, we are able to taxi but need 5 minutes to solve the problem. Request hold at convenient position on taxiway, CSN371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，我们仍然可以滑行，但是需要5分钟解决问题，请求在滑行道上方便的位置等，南方371。

cards.audioText: While communicating with mechanic and dispatcher, you discovered that some pages of onboard flight manual were missing, it is against regulation to continue the flight, report to ATC and ask for returning to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 在与机务和签派的沟通中，你发现机上飞行手册有几页不见了，这违反了继续飞行的规定，告知管制员，并请求返回机坪。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN371, request return to apron due to flight manuals problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方371，由于飞行手册问题，请求返回机坪。

cards.audioText: CZ371, taxi to Bay 224 via A8, A, A5.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方371，经由A8，A，A5，滑回机坪224。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to Bay 224 via A8, A, A5, CZ371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由A8，A，A5，滑回机坪224，南方371。

cards.audioText: Two hours later, you are now cruising at 9500m, you are approaching WXI, your squawk number is 3223, call Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 2小时后，你现在巡航在9500米，你正在接近WXI，你的应答机编码是3223，呼叫北京区调。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN371, 9500m, approaching WXI, squawking 3223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方371，9500米，接近WXI，应答机编码3223。

cards.audioText: Tell Beijing Control you're too heavy, request a step climb to 10,700m in about 1 hour.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉北京区调，你的飞机过重，请求在1小时内阶段爬升至10700米。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN371, unable due weight, request a step climb to 10,700m in about 1 hour.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方371，由于飞机重量无法做到，请求在1小时内阶段爬升至10700米。

cards.audioText: CZ371, due separation, maintain Mach number not greater than point 80.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方371，由于间隔，保持马赫数不大于0.80。
cards.referenceText: Maintain Mach number not greater than point 80, CSN371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持马赫数不大于0.80，南方371。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is CSN6682, you are at stand K38 with information B. Your destination is Guangzhou, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是南方6682，你在K38停机位，收到通播B。你的目的地是广州，向武汉放行请求管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN6682, stand K38, information B, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方6682，K38机位，通播B，请求管制许可。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN6682, I read you 3, loud background whistle, check your transmitter.
B: [You have the transmitter checked and carry out radio check with Wuhan Delivery on the frequency 118.3.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方6682，我听你3个，很尖锐的背景音；检查你的发射机。
B：【你检查了发射机，与武汉放行在频率118.3上进行无线电检查。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN6682, radio check on frequency 118.3, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, how do you read?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方6682，在频率118.3上进行无线电检查，1，2，3，4，5，你听我几个？

cards.audioText:
C: CSN6682, I read you 5.
B: [Acknowledge the transmission and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方6682，我听你5个。
B：【收到并确认这条信息，并请求管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, stand K38, information B, request ATC clearance, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，K38机位，通报B，请求管制许可，南方6682。

cards.audioText: C: CSN6682, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, follow LKO01 Departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方6682，武汉放行，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，起飞跑道36右，按照LKO01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度8400米，离场频率119.6，应答机3115。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure runway 36R, follow LKO 01 Departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 8400 meters, departure frequency 119.6, squawk 3115, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，起飞跑道36右，按照LKO01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度8400米，离场频率119.6，应答机3115，南方6682。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have completed push back and startup, and you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【现在你完成了推出开车，你准备好滑行了，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN6682, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方6682，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CSN6682, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方6682，经由Z4，A3和A滑行到跑道36右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point runway 36R, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4，A3和A滑行到跑道36右外等待点，南方6682。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are at holding point runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在在跑道36右的外等待点，你准备好离场了，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN6682, holding point runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方6682，跑道36右外等待点，准备好起飞了。

cards.audioText: C: CSN6682, runway 36R, 350 degrees, 5 knots, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方6682，跑道36右，风向350度，5节，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 36R, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道36右，南方6682。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在已经离地，过600米，联系武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN6682, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南方6682，离地了，过600米。

cards.audioText: C: CSN6682, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方6682，武汉进近，雷达看见了，上3900米，快速爬升到2100米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900 meters, expedite until passing 2100 meters, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上3900米，快速爬升至2100米，南方6682。

cards.audioText: B: [During climb, you find that the flaps are jammed at takeoff position, inform Wuhan Approach this situation, and ask to fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【爬升中，你发现你的襟翼卡在了起飞位，把这个情况告知武汉进近，请求直飞WHA进行排故。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN6682, our flaps are jammed at takeoff position, request fly direct to WHA for trouble shooting.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南方6682，我们的襟翼卡在了起飞位，请求直飞WHA进行排故。

cards.audioText: C: CSN6682, roger, turn right direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方6682，收到，右转直飞WHA，上3000米保持，按照公布程序在WHA等待。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, hold at WHA as published, SN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞WHA，上3000米保持，按照公布程序在WHA等待，南方6682。

cards.audioText: B: [During hold, you notice that one of the hydraulic systems is leaking fluid rapidly, make an urgency call to Wuhan Approach and request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【在等待程序中，你发现其中一个液压系统正在快速泄漏液压油，向武汉进近发出紧急呼叫，请求下降并返航在武汉机场着陆。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CSN6682, one of the hydraulic system is leaking fluid rapidly, request descent and return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，南方6682，一个液压系统正在快速泄漏液压油，请求下降并返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN6682, roger PAN, turn right heading 240, descend to 2400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方6682，收到PAN，右转航向240，下2400米保持，预计雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 2400 meters, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 36R, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，下2400米保持，预计雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右，南方6682。

cards.audioText: C: CSN6682, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方6682，右转航向330，下900米保持，可以盲降进近跑道36右，建立后报。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, report established, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向330，下900米保持，可以盲降进近跑道36右，建立后报，南方6682。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have intercepted the localizer runway 36R, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【现在你已经截获跑道36右航向道，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN6682, intercepted the localizer for runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方6682，截获跑道36右航向道。

cards.audioText: C: CSN6682, cleared to land runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方6682，可以落地，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36R, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道36右，南方6682。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN6682, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, you are at stand 215, make initial contact with Wuhan Ground and make a radio check.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方6682，从武汉飞往广州，你现在在215号停机位，与广州地面进行初始报话，并进行无线电检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN6682, stand 215, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, how do you read?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方6682，215号停机位，你听我几个？

cards.audioText: CSN6682, Wuhan Ground, I read you five. Here is your ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，武汉地面，我听你5个，以下是你的管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Roger, ready to copy, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，准备好抄收了，南方6682。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initially climb to 1,200m, cruising level 9,800m, after departure contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，按照LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，离场后联系119.7，应答机2515。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou, via flight planned route, runway in use 36R, follow LKO01 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 9800m, after departure contact 119.7, squawk 2515, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，使用跑道36右，按照LKO-01离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，离场后联系119.7，应答机2515，南方6682。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你准备好推出开车了，联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN6682, request push-back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方6682，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，同意推出开车，面朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，面朝西，南方6682。

cards.audioText: You have completed push back and start up, request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在完成了推出开车，请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN6682, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方6682，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, taxi via A4, A3, C, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，经由滑行道A4，A3,C，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via A4, A3, C, hold short of runway 36R, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A4，A3,C，在跑道36右外等待，南方6682。

cards.audioText: Now you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你准备好起飞了。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN6682, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方6682，准备好离场了。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, line up and wait, runway 36R, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，上跑道等待，跑道36右，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, runway 36R, cleared for takeoff, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道等待，跑道36右，可以起飞，南方6682。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, climb to 3900m, expedite until passing 2100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，爬升至3900米，加速爬升至2100米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3900m, expedite passing 2100m, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至3900米，加速爬升至2100米，南方6682。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, stop climbing due converging traffic, level off at 2,700m.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，由于拥堵航空器，停止爬升，在2700米改平。
cards.referenceText: Level off at 2700m due converging traffic, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于拥堵航空器，在2700米改平，南方6682。

cards.audioText: You found one of your hydraulic systems failed, make an urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你发现你的一个液压系统失效了，做紧急呼叫，并将此情况告诉管制员，请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CSN6682, we have one hydraulic system failure, request level off at 3900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉区调，南方6682，我们的一个液压系统失效了，请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, roger PAN, maintain 3900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，收到PAN，保持在3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进近，ILS进场，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进近，南方6682。

cards.audioText: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for RWY 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告你已经截获跑道36右的下滑道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN6682, established localizer for runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南方6682，建立跑道36右的下滑道。

cards.audioText: CSN6682,, contact tower 124.35.
Your call sign is CSN3109, from Wuhan to Beijing, you are now leveling at 8900 meters, expect OBLIK 25, make a position report to Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方3109，从武汉飞往北京，你现在在8900米平飞，预计25分到达OBLIK，向广州区调做位置报。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN3109, leveling at 8900 meters, expect OBLIK 25.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方3109，8900米平飞，预计25分过OBLIK。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, Guangzhou Control, maintain present altitude, contact Beijing Control on 132.2.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，广州区调，保持当前高度，联系北京区调132.2。
cards.referenceText:
Maintain present altitude and contact Beijing Control on 132.2, CSN3109.
注：此处答案可以省略为：present attitude and 132.2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，联系北京区调132.2，南方3109。

cards.audioText: [Your weather radar shows that there is a thunderstorm 33 miles ahead, you want to climb to 10100m to fly over it, contact Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你的气象雷达显示前方33海里有雷暴，你想上10100米飞越雷暴，联系北京区调。]
cards.referenceText:
Beijing Control, CSN3109, our weather radar shows that there is a thunderstorm 33 miles ahead, request climb to 10100m to fly over it.
注：此处答案可省略为：Beijing Control, CSN3109, request climb to 10100m due weather/bad weather/adverse weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方3109，我们的气象雷达显示前方33海里有雷暴，请求上10100米飞越雷暴。

cards.audioText:
CSN3109, negative, but you can either turn left or right to go round it, which do you prefer?
[Tell controller you can make a left turn.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方3109，不可，但是你可以左转或者右转来飞避它，你更喜欢哪一个？
[告诉管制员，你可以左转。]
cards.referenceText:
Request a left turn, CSN3109.
注：此处为被动报话格式：通话内容+己方呼号；go round：绕飞。
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求左转，南方3109。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, turn left heading 270 for 5 miles, when clear of weather, return to the original route.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，可以左转270度飞5海里，当脱离天气，回到原航路。
cards.referenceText: Left heading 270 for 5 miles, wilco, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转270度飞5海里，照办，南方3109。

cards.audioText:
[Now you are clear of weather and back to the original course.]
CSN3109, descend to 7500m.
cards.audioTextZh:
[现在你脱离天气，回到原航路了。]
南方3109，下到7500米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 7500m, CSN3109.

cards.audioText: During the descent, you encountered a strong hail and experienced heavy turbulence. The outer windshield of your aircraft cracked due to hail strike, tell your situation to Beijing Approach, and request emergency landing, this is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 在下降过程中，你遇到了冰雹和颠簸。飞机外侧风挡玻璃由于冰雹撞击而出现裂纹，将情况告知北京区调，请求紧急着陆，这是一个遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Approach, CSN3109, our outer windshield cracked due to hail strike, request emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. 北京进近，南方3109，我们外侧风挡玻璃由于冰雹撞击而出现裂纹，请求紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, roger Mayday, cleared for ILS approach, runway 36R, and you are No.1 in the landing sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，收到MAYDAY，可以ILS进近，跑道36右，你是第一个着陆。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for ILS approach, runway 36R, No.1 in landing sequence, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以ILS进近，跑道36右，第一个着陆，南方3109。

cards.audioText:
CSN3109, when able, state your situation.
[Inform the controller that your engines and control surfaces are working normally, but the outer windshield is cracked.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方3109，可以的时候，陈述你的情况。
[告知管制员，飞机发动机和操纵面正常，但是外侧风挡玻璃出现裂纹。]
cards.referenceText: Our engines and control surfaces are working normally, but the outer windshield is cracked, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机发动机和操纵面正常，但是外侧风挡玻璃出现裂纹， 南方3109。

cards.audioText:
CSN3109, report persons on board and confirm whether you need medical services upon arrival.
[Inform Beijing Approach that you have 275 passengers on board and there is no injury report, so no medical assistance is required.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南方3019，报告机上人数，证实着陆后是否需要医疗救援。
[告诉管制员，机上有275名乘客，无人受伤，不需要医疗救援。]
cards.referenceText: We have 275 passengers on board and there is no injury report, no medical assistance is required, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们机上有275名乘客，无人受伤，不需要医疗救援，南方3109。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, continue approach and contact Tower on 118.6.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，继续进近，联系塔台118.6。
cards.referenceText:
Continue approach and contact Tower on 118.6, CSN3109.
注：此处答案可省略为：Continue approach and 118.6, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，联系塔台118.6，南方3109。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, wind 310, 5m/s, runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，风310度，5米每秒，跑道36右，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 36R, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道36右，南方3109。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, vacate runway via W6.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，通过W6滑行道脱离。
cards.referenceText: Vacate runway via W6, CSN3109.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过W6滑行道脱离，南方3109。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, contact Ground on 121.8, good bye.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，联系地面121.8，再见。
cards.referenceText:
Contact Ground on 121.8, CSN3109.
注：此处答案可省略为：121.8, CSN3109.

cards.audioText: [You find an Airbus 320 block the taxiway W6 ahead, you now want to change taxiway to E6, call Beijing Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你发现前方W6滑行道被一架A320挡住，你现在想更换至E6滑行道，呼叫北京地面。]
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CSN3109, an Airbus 320 is blocking the taxiway W6 ahead, request change to taxiway E6.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，南方3109，前方W6滑行道被一架A320挡住，请求更换至E6滑行道。

cards.audioText: CSN3109, change to taxiway E6 approved, taxi with caution due the taxiway is slippery.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3109，可以更换至E6滑行道，跑道湿滑，谨慎滑行。
cards.referenceText:
Taxiway E6 approved, thanks, CSN3109.
注：题干中的change to taxiway E6 approved属许可，需要复诵。
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以E6滑行道。谢谢，南方3109。

topics.name: CES 556 醉客不理性乱秩序 氧气面罩 灭火器

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 556, from Seoul to Wuhan, you are maintaining 9200 meters, approaching JTN, squawking 1532, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 556，从首尔飞往武汉，保持 9200 米，接近 JTN，应答机 1532，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 556, maintaining 9200 meters, approaching JTN, squawking 1532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 556，保持 9200 米，接近 JTN，应答机 1532。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, direct to TOL, reduce speed to Mach 0.79.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，直飞 TOL，减速至马赫 0.79。
cards.referenceText: Direct to TOL, reduce speed to M.79, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 TOL，减速至 M.79，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: Near TOL, you are experiencing moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000 meters and 10400 meters, contact Shanghai Control and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：在 TOL 附近，你在 6000 米至 10400 米之间遭遇中到强晴空颠簸，联系上海管制并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 556, we are experiencing moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000 meters and 10400 meters, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 556，我们在 6000 米至 10400 米之间遭遇中到强晴空颠簸，请求爬升。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 556, the alternative level is 11600 meters, what's your intention?
B: Tell the controller you can accept 11600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 556，备选高度为 11600 米，你的意图？
B：告诉管制员你可以接受 11600 米。
cards.referenceText: We can accept 11600 meters, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们可以接受 11600 米，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, climb to and maintain 11600 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，爬升并保持 11600 米，报告到达。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11600 meters, report reaching, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11600 米，报告到达，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: You receive the report from the cabin that a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally, affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order, you suspect the higher cabin altitude is making passengers uncomfortable, you want to fly lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你收到客舱报告，一名醉酒旅客行为异常，影响客舱服务并扰乱客舱秩序，你怀疑较高客舱高度让旅客不适，想飞较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 556, a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally, affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order, we suspect the higher cabin altitude is making passengers uncomfortable, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 556，一名醉酒旅客行为异常，影响客舱服务并扰乱客舱秩序，我们怀疑较高客舱高度让旅客不适，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, maintain 11600 meters due to airspace congestion, reduce speed to Mach 0.75.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，因空域拥挤，保持 11600 米，减速至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 11600 meters, reduce speed to M.75, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 11600 米，减速至 M.75，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, contact Wuhan Control on 128.55.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，联系武汉管制128.55。

cards.audioText: B: The flight attendant reported 2 passengers took out their overhead oxygen masks, they are being closely monitored, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent now.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告 2 名旅客取出了头顶氧气面罩，他们正被严密监控，向武汉管制报告并请求立即下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 556, the flight attendant reported 2 passengers took out their overhead oxygen masks, they are being closely monitored, request descent now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 556，乘务员报告 2 名旅客取出了头顶氧气面罩，他们正被严密监控，请求立即下降。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, descend to 6600 meters and level by XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，下降至 6600 米，并在 XSH 前改平。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 6600 meters and level by XSH, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6600 米，并在 XSH 前改平，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, due to temporary airspace restriction is effective immediately, after passing XSH, follow ZF-03A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，因临时空域限制立即生效，过 XSH 后，执行 ZF-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: After passing XSH, follow ZF-03A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 XSH 后，执行 ZF-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, contact Wuhan Approach 120.4.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，联系武汉进近120.4。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, you have got information O, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 ZF 上空，保持 6600 米，已收到通播 O，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, information O.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，ZF 上空，保持 6600 米，通播 O。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, information is P, descend and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，武汉进近，雷达识别，通播是 P，下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, information P, descend and maintain 4200 meters, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，通播 P，下降并保持 4200 米，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed a cumuliform clouds ahead, contact Wuhan Approach and request turn left and track direct to HG.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的气象雷达观察到前方积状云，联系武汉进近并请求左转直飞 HG。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, our weather radar observed CB ahead, request turn left and track direct to HG.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，我们的气象雷达观察到前方 CB，请求左转并直飞 HG。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: While intercepting the localizer, 1 drunk passenger discharged the fire extinguisher, the purser make an emergency call said there are still passengers standing in the cabin, inform Wuhan Approach the situation and request terminate approach and proceed to holding area.
cards.audioTextZh: B：截获航向道时，1 名醉酒旅客释放了灭火器，乘务长紧急呼叫称客舱仍有旅客站立，通知武汉进近该情况并请求终止进近，前往等待区。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, 1 drunk passenger discharged the fire extinguisher, there are still passengers standing in the cabin, request terminate approach and proceed to holding area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，1 名醉酒旅客释放了灭火器，客舱仍有旅客站立，请求终止进近并前往等待区。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, turn left, direct to DA, climb to 1200 meters, hold as published, expect further clearance at time 50.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，左转，直飞 DA，爬升至 1200 米，按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 50。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 1200 meters, expect further clearance at time 50, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DA，爬升至 1200 米，预计进一步许可时间 50，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: Now the problematic passenger has been properly restrained, advise the Approach controller you are ready to leave the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在问题旅客已被妥善约束，告知进近管制员你准备好离开等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, the problematic passenger has been properly restrained, request leave the hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，问题旅客已被妥善约束，请求离开等待。

topics.name: CES 232 右主起落架 通场 等待

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 232, from Wuhan to Singapore, you are taxiing Southbound on taxiway C to holding point Runway 36L, call Wuhan Tower for takeoff clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 232，从武汉飞往新加坡，正在 C 滑行道向南滑行至跑道 36L 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台请求起飞许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 232, taxiing Southbound on taxiway C to holding point Runway 36L, request takeoff clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 232，正在 C 滑行道向南滑行至跑道 36L 等待点，请求起飞许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, Wuhan Tower, line up and wait Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，武汉塔台，跑道 36L 进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait Runway 36L, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36L 进跑道等待，CES 232。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, wind calm, cleared for takeoff Runway 36L, contact Wuhan Departure 118.25 when airborne.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，风静，跑道 36L 可以起飞，离地后联系武汉离场 118.25。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 36L, 118.25, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36L 可以起飞，118.25，CES 232。

cards.audioText: B: After airborne, you have an undercarriage warning, the indication shows your right main gear has not been retracted, call Wuhan Approach and request maintain 1500 meters and speed 200 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: B：离地后，你有起落架警告，指示显示右主起落架未收上，呼叫武汉进近并请求保持 1500 米、速度 200 节。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 232, we have an undercarriage warning, our right main gear has not been retracted, request maintain 1500m and speed 200kts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 232，我们有起落架警告，右主起落架未收上，请求保持 1500 米、速度 200 节。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, Wuhan Approach, roger, climb and maintain 1500 meters, speed 200 knots approved, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，武汉进近，收到，爬升并保持 1500 米，速度 200 节同意，能够时告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 1500m, speed 200 knots, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 1500 米，速度 200 节，CES 232。

cards.audioText: B: After performing the abnormal checklist, you still cannot confirm the landing gear position, tell Wuhan Approach you want to return to Wuhan Airport and make a low-pass over the runway for visual check.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成非正常检查单后，你仍无法确认起落架位置，告诉武汉进近你想返回武汉机场，并在跑道上方低通场目视检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 232, we cannot confirm the landing gear position, request return to Wuhan Airport and make a low-pass over the runway for visual check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 232，我们无法确认起落架位置，请求返回武汉机场，并在跑道上方低通场目视检查。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, turn right track direct to EB NDB, descend and maintain 1200 meters, follow the published procedure, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，右转直飞 EB NDB，下降并保持 1200 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Turn right track direct to EB NDB, descend and maintain 1200m, follow the published procedure, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 EB NDB，下降并保持 1200 米，按公布程序，许可 ILS 进近跑道 36R，CES 232。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, you are 11 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower on 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，你距接地点 11 海里，联系武汉塔台118.5。
cards.referenceText: 11 miles from touchdown, 118.5, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 距接地点 11 海里，118.5，CES 232。

cards.audioText: B: Call Wuhan Tower and tell the controller you have established ILS Runway 36R and you are ready for the low-pass.
cards.audioTextZh: B：呼叫武汉塔台并告诉管制员你已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 232, established ILS Runway 36R, ready for low-pass.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 232，已建立 ILS 跑道 36R，准备低通场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, wind calm, cleared low-pass Runway 36R, not below 200 meters above the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，风静，跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 200 米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared low-pass Runway 36R, not below 200m above the runway, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 低通场许可，不低于跑道上方 200 米，CES 232。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, after low-pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 1200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 1200 米。
cards.referenceText: After low-pass, maintain runway heading, climb to 1200m, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低通场后，保持跑道航向，爬升至 1200 米，CES 232。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 232, we’ve had a good look at your undercarriage, your right main gear seems to be in the extended position, advise intentions.
B: Tell Wuhan Tower the indication still shows right landing gear unlocked, you want to perform a hold over WHA as published.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 232，我们已看清你的起落架，你的右主起落架似乎在放下位置，告知意图。
B：告诉武汉塔台指示仍显示右起落架未锁定，你想在 WHA 上空按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 232, the indication still shows right landing gear unlocked, request hold over WHA as published.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 232，指示仍显示右起落架未锁定，请求在 WHA 按公布程序等待。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, turn left proceed direct to DA, climb and maintain 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 119.225.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 1500 米，联系武汉进近119.225。
cards.referenceText: Turn left proceed direct to DA, climb and maintain 1500m, 119.225, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 1500 米，119.225，CES 232。

cards.audioText: B: You are tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1500 meters, call Wuhan Approach and request holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正直飞 DA，保持 1500 米，呼叫武汉进近并请求等待指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 232, tracking direct to DA, maintaining 1500m, request holding instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 232，正直飞 DA，保持 1500 米，请求等待指令。

cards.audioText: C: CES 232, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, hold at DA as published, expect further clearance at time 30, report entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 232，武汉进近，雷达识别，在 DA 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 30，报告进入等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at DA as published, expect further clearance at time 30, report entering the hold, CES 232.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 DA 按公布程序等待，预计进一步许可时间 30，报告进入等待，CES 232。

topics.name: CES 529 右空调过热都失效 5乘客重伤

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 529, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 529，保持 8400 米，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, maintaining 8,400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, Shanghai Control, radar contact, climb to 10400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 10400 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 10400 meters, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 10400 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are cruising at 10400 meters, your instruments indicate 1 of your air conditioning packs has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 10400 米巡航，仪表显示 1 个空调组件故障，联系上海管制并请求下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, maintaining 10400 meters, our instruments indicate 1 of our air conditioning packs has malfunctioned, request descend to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，保持 10400 米，我们的仪表显示 1 个空调组件故障，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned and request emergency descent, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 529, our right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned, request emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 529，我们的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 529, our cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 529，我们的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，QNH 1031 下降至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1031 下降至 3000 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3000 meters, cabin altitude has resumed to normal, you will cancel Distress, report it to Shanghai Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，你将取消遇险，向上海进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, CES 529, maintaining 3000 meters, the cabin altitude has resumed to normal, cancel Distress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，CES 529，保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，取消遇险。

cards.audioText: B: The cabin crew reports 5 passengers in the cabin are seriously injured during emergency descent, inform the situation to Shanghai Control and request diversion to Hangzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B：客舱机组报告 5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，向上海管制通报情况并请求备降杭州。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, 5 passengers are seriously injured, request divert to Hangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，5 名旅客严重受伤，请求备降杭州。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 529, divert to Hangzhou approved, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ambulances upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 529，同意备降杭州，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉管制员抵达时需要救护车。
cards.referenceText: Divert to Hangzhou approved, request ambulances upon arrival, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意备降杭州，请求抵达时救护车，CES 529。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, roger, ambulance will be ready upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，收到，救护车将在抵达时准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES 529。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now tell Hangzhou Tower about your situation and request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在告诉杭州塔台你的情况并请求优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 529, 5 passengers were seriously injured during emergency descent, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 529，5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, straight ILS approach Runway 06, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，直线 ILS 进近跑道 06，报告建立。
cards.referenceText: Straight ILS approach Runway 06, report established, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直线 ILS 进近跑道 06，报告建立，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 06。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 529, established on ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 529，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 06。

topics.name: CES 565 高客舱高警报 缝翼卡阻

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 565, from Wuhan to Los Angeles, you are parking at gate 227, with information M, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 565，从武汉飞往洛杉矶，停在 227 号登机口，通播 M，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 565, gate 227, information M, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 565，227 号登机口，通播 M，请求飞往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, ZF-01 departure, runway in use 36L, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 10100 meters, squawk 5655.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，许可飞往洛杉矶，按飞行计划航路，ZF-01 离场，使用跑道 36L，起始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 10100 米，应答机 5655。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, ZF-01 departure, runway in use 36L, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 10100 meters, squawk 5655, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往洛杉矶，按飞行计划航路，ZF-01 离场，使用跑道 36L，起始爬升 1500 米，巡航高度 10100 米，应答机 5655，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: You are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 565, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 565，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, after company Airbus 340 is clear, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，同公司 Airbus 340 脱离后，同意推出和开车，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: After company Airbus 340 is clear, push back and start up approved, facing west, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同公司 Airbus 340 脱离后，同意推出和开车，机头朝西，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: Now the push back and start up is completed, ask for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在推出和开车已完成，请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 565, push back and start up is completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 565，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, taxi to holding point 36 left via taxiway Z4, C and C1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，经滑行道 Z4、C 和 C1 滑行至 36L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point 36L via taxiway Z4, C and C1, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、C 和 C1 滑行至 36L 等待点，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36L, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36L 等待点，准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 565, holding point Runway 36L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 565，跑道 36L 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, behind landing Air China Boeing 747 on short final, line up and wait behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，在短五边落地的 Air China Boeing 747 后，跟在后面进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Behind landing Air China B747 on short final, line up and wait behind, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在短五边落地的 Air China B747 后，跟在后面进跑道等待，CES 565。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, wind 350 degrees, 2 meters per second, cleared for takeoff Runway 36L, after departure, contact Wuhan Departure 125.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，风 350 度，2 米/秒，跑道 36L 可以起飞，离场后联系武汉离场 125.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 36L, after departure, contact Wuhan Departure 125.35, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36L 可以起飞，离场后联系武汉离场 125.35，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: You are cruising at 3300 meters, you are encountering moderate icing, contact Wuhan Control and ask for a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 3300 米巡航，遭遇中度结冰，联系武汉管制并请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 565, we are encountering moderate icing at 3300 meters, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 565，我们在 3300 米遭遇中度结冰，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, climb and maintain 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，爬升并保持 9500 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 9500 meters, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 9500 米，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, you got a warning, you are leaking the bleed air and the cabin altitude is rising slowly, inform Wuhan Control you want to level off and might expect emergency descent soon.
cards.audioTextZh: B：突然你收到警告，正在漏引气，客舱高度缓慢上升，通知武汉管制你想改平，并可能很快需要紧急下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 565, we have a warning that the bleed air is leaking, the cabin altitude is rising slowly, request level off and emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 565，我们有引气泄漏警告，客舱高度缓慢上升，请求改平并紧急下降。

cards.audioText: B: The bleed air is no longer supplying and the high cabin altitude warning is triggered, make an Emergency call and tell the controller you want to make an emergency descent to 3000 meters, and request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: B：引气不再供应，高客舱高度警告触发，发布紧急呼叫并告诉管制员你想紧急下降至 3000 米，并请求雷达引导。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CES 565, the high cabin altitude warning is triggered, request emergency descent to 3000 meters and request radar vectors.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，CES 565，高客舱高度警告触发，请求紧急下降至 3000 米并请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, turn right heading 180, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1018.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，右转航向 180，QNH 1018 下降至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1018, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 180，QNH 1018 下降至 3000 米，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 3000 meters in icing condition, contact Wuhan Approach and ask for landing information.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在结冰条件下到达 3000 米，联系武汉进近并请求落地信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 565, reaching 3000 meters in icing condition, request landing information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 565，在结冰条件下到达 3000 米，请求落地信息。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, direct to HG, ZF-01 arrival, expect ILS approach 36 left.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，直飞 HG，ZF-01 进场，预计 ILS 进近 36L。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HG, ZF-01 arrival, expect ILS approach 36L, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 HG，ZF-01 进场，预计 ILS 进近 36L，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: During approach, your slats can't be extended, request the longer Runway 36R and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：进近中，你的缝翼无法放出，请求较长的跑道 36R 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 565, our slats can't be extended, request the longer Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 565，我们的缝翼无法放出，请求较长的跑道 36R。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, change Runway 36R, continue present heading, descend to 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，改用跑道 36R，继续当前航向，下降至 900 米。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, continue present heading, descend to 900 meters, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R，继续当前航向，下降至 900 米，CES 565。

topics.name: CES 728 强积冰 进近灯暗

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 728, you are parking at gate 212, you have received information W, ask Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 728，停在 212 号登机口，已收到通播 W，向武汉放行请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 728, gate 212, information W, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 728，212 号登机口，通播 W，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-02 departure, initial climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.6, squawk 3615.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，LKO-02 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.6，应答机 3615。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-02 departure, initially climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.6, squawk 3615, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往广州，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 36R，LKO-02 离场，起始爬升 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.6，应答机 3615，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have been pushed back with engines running, request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已推出，发动机运转，请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 728, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 728，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CES 728。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, give way to Air China Airbus 319 on A7, you are number 2 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，避让 A7 上的 Air China Airbus 319，你是第 2 架离场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, traffic in sight, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，看到飞机，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, contact Tower for takeoff clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，联系塔台请求起飞许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 728, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 728，跑道 36R 等待点，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, line up and wait, expect 1 minute delay, there will be a helicopter crossing the runway from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，进跑道等待，预计延误 1 分钟，将有直升机从左至右穿越跑道。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, roger, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道等待，收到，CES 728。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, wind 010 degrees, 2 meters per second, cleared for takeoff, caution storm approaching north of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，风 010 度，2 米/秒，可以起飞，注意机场北侧有风暴接近。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, roger, thanks, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以起飞，收到，谢谢，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: It's much later in the flight, you are at cruising level, ask Wuhan Control if 10400 meters is available, and if there is any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft on that level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：飞行后段，你在巡航高度，询问武汉管制 10400 米是否可用，以及前机是否报告该高度有颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 728, is 10400 meters available? Is there any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft at 10400 meters?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 728，10400 米是否可用？前机是否报告 10400 米有颠簸？

cards.audioText:
C: CES 728, 10400 meters is available. There is no turbulence report at 10400 meters.
B: Tell the controller you want to climb to 10400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 728，10400 米可用。10400 米没有颠簸报告。
B：告诉管制员你想爬升至 10400 米。
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 10400 meters, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求爬升至 10400 米，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are in Guangzhou Control, cruising at 10400 meters because you are encountering severe icing, you want to descend to a lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在广州管制区，由于在 10400 米遭遇严重结冰，你想下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CES 728, we are encountering severe icing at 10400 meters, request descend to a lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CES 728，我们在 10400 米遭遇严重结冰，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, descend to and maintain 4200 meters, maintain high speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，下降并保持 4200 米，保持大速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4200 meters, maintain high speed, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，保持大速度，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: You are now with Guangzhou Approach, you want to maintain high speed as long as possible to avoid ice accumulation, tell ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在与广州进近联系，你想尽可能长时间保持大速度以避免积冰，告诉 ATC。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CES 728, request maintain high speed to avoid ice accumulation
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CES 728，请求保持大速度以避免积冰。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, no speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: No speed restrictions, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 无速度限制，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: While on final approach, you notice the approach lights are 2 dim, ask the controller to increase the intensity of the approach lights.
cards.audioTextZh: B：在最后进近时，你注意到进近灯太暗，请求管制员增加进近灯亮度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CES 728, the approach lights are 2 dim, request brighten the approach lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CES 728，进近灯太暗，请求调亮进近灯。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, roger, the approach flights will be turned up shortly, cleared to land Runway 20L, surface wind calm, caution runway is wet, braking action medium.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，收到，进近灯很快会调亮，跑道 20L 可以落地，地面风静，注意跑道湿，刹车效应中等。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, cleared to land Runway 20L, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，跑道 20L 可以落地，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you have difficulty in taxiing in poor visibility, contact Guangzhou Ground for a follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，你在低能见度下滑行困难，联系广州地面请求引导车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CES 728, we have difficulty in taxing in poor visibility, request a follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CES 728，我们在低能见度下滑行困难，请求引导车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, the follow-me car will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，引导车很快会来。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 769, a flight from Wuhan to Amsterdam, you are parking at stand 221, you have received information C, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 769，从武汉飞往阿姆斯特丹，停在 221 号停机位，已收到通播 C，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 769, stand 221, information C, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 769，221 号停机位，通播 C，请求飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1800 meters, HZ-01 departure, cruising level 11000 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3562.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，武汉放行，许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 1800 米，HZ-01 离场，巡航高度 11000 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3562。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1800 meters, HZ-01 departure, cruising level 11000 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3562, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 1800 米，HZ-01 离场，巡航高度 11000 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3562，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 769, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 769，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, push back and start up approved, long pushed back, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，同意推出和开车，长推出，机头朝南。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, long pushed back, facing south, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，长推出，机头朝南，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 769, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 769，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, taxi via D, D4, hold short of Runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，经 D、D4 滑行，跑道 36 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via D, D4, hold short of Runway 36, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 D、D4 滑行，跑道 36 外等待，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing, a passenger opened an emergency exit, inform the controller of this situation and airport security is needed to remove the passenger.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，一名旅客打开了应急出口，通知管制员该情况并需要机场安保带走该旅客。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 769, a passenger opened an emergency exit, request airport security to remove the passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 769，一名旅客打开了应急出口，请求机场安保带走该旅客。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, recleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 2100 meters, HZ-02 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，重新许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，起始爬升 2100 米，HZ-02 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: Recleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 2100 meters, HZ-02 departure, cruising level 10400 meters, the rest unchanged, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重新许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，起始爬升 2100 米，HZ-02 离场，巡航高度 10400 米，其余不变，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point W2 Runway 36, contact Wuhan Tower and ask the permission to cross Runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36 W2 等待点等待，联系武汉塔台并请求穿越跑道 36。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 769, holding point W2 runway 36, request cross Runway 36.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 769，跑道 36 W2 等待点，请求穿越跑道 36。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, expedite cross Runway 36, when vacated, taxi the taxiway Z5, A4 and A, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，快速穿越跑道 36，脱离后，经滑行道 Z5、A4 和 A 滑行，跑道 04 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Expedite cross Runway 36, when vacated, taxi the taxiway Z5, A4 and A, hold short of Runway 04, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 快速穿越跑道 36，脱离后，经滑行道 Z5、A4 和 A 滑行，跑道 04 外等待，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of Runway 04, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 769, holding short of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 769，跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, line up Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，进入跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Line up Runway 04, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 04，CES 769。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, cleared for takeoff Runway 04, surface wind 020, 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，跑道 04 可以起飞，地面风 020，2 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 04, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 04 可以起飞，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 11000 meters, over WXI, squawking 3562, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 11000 米，在 WXI 上空，应答机 3562，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES 769, maintaining 11000 meters, over WXI, squawking 3562.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CES 769，保持 11000 米，WXI 上空，应答机 3562。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, increase speed to Mach 0.83 or greater, fly direct to PEK.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，增速至马赫 0.83 或更大，直飞 PEK。
cards.referenceText: Increase speed to M.83 or greater, fly direct to PEK, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 增速至 M.83 或更大，直飞 PEK，CES 769。

topics.name: CES 151 拖把断了 鸟击一发失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 151, you are at gate 232, you have got information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 151，在 232 号登机口，已收到通播 S，向武汉放行请求飞往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 151, gate 232, information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 151，232 号登机口，通播 S，请求飞往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, Wuhan Delivery, information S is valid, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, Runway 36R, initial climb to 1800 meters, ZF-01 departure, cruising level 10100 meters, after departure, contact 123.4, squawk 4125.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，武汉放行，通播 S 有效，许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，跑道 36R，起始爬升至 1800 米，ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 10100 米，离场后联系 123.4，应答机 4125。
cards.referenceText: Information S is valid, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, Runway 36R, initial climb to 1800 meters, ZF-01 departure, cruising level 10100 meters, after departure, contact 123.4, squawk 4125, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播 S 有效，许可飞往上海虹桥，按飞行计划航路，跑道 36R，起始爬升至 1800 米，ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 10100 米，离场后联系 123.4，应答机 4125，CES 151。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 151, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 151，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, push back and start up approved, push back to taxiway Z4, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，同意推出和开车，推出至滑行道 Z4，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, push back to taxiway Z4, facing west, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，推出至滑行道 Z4，机头朝西，CES 151。

cards.audioText: B: While being pushed back, the tow bar was broke and slash bent, report it to Ground controller and request a new tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: B：推出过程中，拖杆断裂并弯曲，向地面管制员报告并请求新的拖杆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 151, the tow bar was bent during push back, request a new tow bar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 151，推出过程中拖杆弯曲，请求新的拖杆。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back with engines running on taxiway Z4, ask Ground for taxiing instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在滑行道 Z4 已完成推出，发动机运转，向地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 151, push back and start up completed, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 151，推出和开车完成，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CES 151。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, hold short of A7, give way to Airbus 320 coming from your right, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，A7 外等待，避让从你右侧来的 Airbus 320，交通脱离后继续经滑行道 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Hold short of A7, traffic in sight, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A to holding point Runway 36R, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: A7 外等待，看到飞机，交通脱离后继续经滑行道 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，CES 151。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows there is strong tailwind, report it to Wuhan Tower and check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 等待点，风向袋显示有强顺风，向武汉塔台报告并核实风。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 151, holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows there is strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 151，跑道 36R 等待点，风向袋显示有强顺风，请求风检查。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 151, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: The tail wind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to Runway 18L and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 151，风 200 度，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台改用跑道 18L 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 151, the tail wind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 151，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 18L。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne from Runway 18L, you encountered a bird strike during the initial climb, 1 of your engines failed, inform the situation to Wuhan Approach and tell the controller you intend to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你从跑道 18L 离地，初始爬升中遭遇鸟击，1 台发动机失效，向武汉进近通报情况并告诉管制员你打算返回武汉机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, CES 151, we encountered a bird strike during initial climb, 1 of our engines failed, request return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，CES 151，我们在初始爬升中遭遇鸟击，1 台发动机失效，请求返回武汉机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS Runway 36R, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 跑道 36R，CES 151。

cards.audioText: B: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: B：由于强顺风，你想改用跑道 18L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 151, request change to Runway 18L due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 151，因强顺风，请求改用跑道 18L。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, change to Runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right, direct to WHA, contact Wuhan Approach 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，同意改用跑道 18L，保持 600 米，右转，直飞 WHA，联系武汉进近121.7。
cards.referenceText: Change to Runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right, direct to WHA, 121.7, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意改用跑道 18L，保持 600 米，右转，直飞 WHA，121.7，CES 151。

cards.audioText: C: CES 151, climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 151，爬升并保持 900 米，过 WHA 后，飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 18L。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L, CES 151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 900 米，过 WHA 后，飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 18L，CES 151。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 102, destination Beijing, 4800 meters maintaining, estimating DOGAR 05, information F, now contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 102，目的地北京，保持 4800 米，预计 DOGAR 05，通播 F，现在联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES 102, 4800 metres maintaining, estimating DOGAR 05, information F.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES 102，保持 4800 米，预计 DOGAR 05，通播 F。

cards.audioText: C: CES 102, Beijing Approach, DOGAR-03 arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 01, maintain 4800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 102，北京进近，DOGAR-03 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 01，保持 4800 米。
cards.referenceText: DOGAR-03 arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 01, maintain 4800 metres, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: DOGAR-03 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 01，保持 4800 米，CES 102。

cards.audioText: B: Flight attendants reported that a loud noise is coming from the backward right of the cabin, report this to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告客舱后右方传来很大噪音，向管制员报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES 102, we have a loud noise coming from the cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES 102，我们客舱有很大噪音。

cards.audioText: C: CES 102, descend to and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 102，QNH 1012 下降并保持 2100 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 2100 metres on QNH 1012, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1012 下降并保持 2100 米，CES 102。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 102, can you describe the sound in more detail?
B: It seems to be an outside air noise or a slight depressurization problem.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 102，你能更详细描述声音吗？
B：似乎是外部气流声或轻微失压问题。
cards.referenceText: It seems to be an outside air noise or a slight depressurization problem, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 似乎是外部气流声或轻微失压问题，CES 102。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 102, roger.
B: The engineers advised that it may be a problem with the door seal. They suggested you reduce speed to minimum, report to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 102，收到。
B：工程师建议可能是门封问题。他们建议你减速到最小，向管制员报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES 102, maybe a problem with the door seal. The engineers suggested we reduce speed to minimum.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES 102，可能是门封问题。工程师建议我们减速到最小。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 102, affirm, do you require emergency services on arrival?
B: You have 3 passengers injured during emergency descent, so you will need medical service on arrival, require priority lending.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 102，肯定，抵达时你需要应急服务吗？
B：你有 3 名旅客在紧急下降中受伤，所以抵达时需要医疗服务，并请求优先落地。
cards.referenceText: We have 3 injured persons during emergency descent, require ambulance on arrival, request priority landing, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们有 3 名人员在紧急下降中受伤，抵达时需要救护车，请求优先落地，CES 102。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 102, roger, you are number 1, doctor and ambulance will be ready on arrival.
B: Request change Runway 36R to save time.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 102，收到，你是第 1 架，医生和救护车将在抵达时准备好。
B：请求改用跑道 36R 以节省时间。
cards.referenceText: Request runway change to 36R to save time, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求改用跑道 36R 以节省时间，CES 102。

cards.audioText: C: CES 102, roger, turn left heading 300, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 102，收到，左转航向 300，雷达引导着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 300, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 300，CES 102。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 102, the weather is deteriorating, say intention.
B: Tell the controller you want to continue approach.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 102，天气正在恶化，说明意图。
B：告诉管制员你想继续进近。
cards.referenceText: Request continue approach, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求继续进近，CES 102。

cards.audioText: C: CES 102, descend to and maintain 900 meters, turn right heading 330, report established on localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 102，下降并保持 900 米，右转航向 330，报告建立航向道。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 900 metres, turn right heading 330, report established on the localizer, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 900 米，右转航向 330，报告建立航向道，CES 102。

cards.audioText: B: Report established on localizer 5 miles final Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: B：报告已建立跑道 36R 五边 5 海里航向道。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES 102, established on localizer 5 miles final Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES 102，已建立跑道 36R 五边 5 海里航向道。

cards.audioText: C: CES 102, continue approach and contact Beijing Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 102，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, 118.1, CES 102.

cards.audioText: B: Report to Tower that you have established ILS.
cards.audioTextZh: B：向塔台报告你已建立 ILS。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES 102, established ILS.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CES 102，已建立 ILS。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 102, Beijing Tower, expect low visibility for your arrival, say intention.
B: You want to try landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 102，北京塔台，预计你抵达时低能见度，说明意图。
B：你想尝试着陆。
cards.referenceText: Roger, I want to try landing, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我想尝试着陆，CES 102。

cards.audioText: C: CES 102, continue approach, report outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 102，继续进近，报告外指点标。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, report outer marker, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，报告外指点标，CES 102。

cards.audioText: B: Over outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: B：过外指点标。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES 102, outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CES 102，外指点标。

cards.audioText: C: CES 102, cleared to land Runway 36R, surface wind 160, 7 meters per second, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 102，跑道 36R 可以落地，地面风 160，7 米/秒，报告脱离。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 36R, report vacated, CES 102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以落地，报告脱离，CES 102。

topics.name: CES 325 左翼撞击 三号熄火 冲出跑道

cards.audioText: B: You are the pilot of CES 325 which is bound for Wuhan. You have just been handed over from Hefei Control, you are over IKUBA at 23, and your level is 8400 meters, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你是飞往武汉的 CES 325 飞行员。你刚从合肥管制移交过来，23 在 IKUBA 上空，高度 8400 米，呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 325, over IKUBA at 23, maintain 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 325，23 在 IKUBA 上空，保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: C: CES 325, Wuhan Control, radar identified, descent to and maintain 6000 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 325，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 6000 米，报告到达。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, descend to and maintain 6000 meters, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，下降并保持 6000 米，CES 325。

cards.audioText: B: You have just followed your TCAS RA instruction. You have stopped your descent at nearly 6800 meters and track out 9 kilometers right of the course, report to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你刚按 TCAS RA 指令执行。你在约 6800 米停止下降，并向航路右侧偏出 9 公里，向 ATC 报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 325, our TCAS instructed us to stop descent at 6800 meters, and we are tracking out 9 km right of the course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 325，我们的 TCAS 指令我们在 6800 米停止下降，并正向航路右侧偏出 9 公里。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CES 325, you have just passed the traffic, descent to 6000 meters and turn left heading 170 immediately, there is military activity in the area right now.
cards.audioTextZh: C：收到，CES 325，你刚通过冲突飞机，下降至 6000 米并立即左转航向 170，该区域现在有军事活动。
cards.referenceText: Roger, descend to 6000 meters and turn left heading 170 immediately, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，下降至 6000 米并立即左转航向 170，CES 325。
