cards.audioText: B: You hear a loud bang, it seems that the left wing has been hit by something, and you feel the airplane has a banking tendency. Declare Urgency to ATC and request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你听到一声巨响，似乎左翼被什么东西击中，并感觉飞机有坡度趋势。向 ATC 宣布紧急情况并请求优先着陆和应急服务。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CES 325, the left wing was hit by some foreign object, and the plane has a banking tendency. Request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，武汉管制，CES 325，左翼被某个外来物击中，飞机有坡度趋势。请求优先着陆和应急服务。

cards.audioText: C: CES 325, roger PAN. Descend to and maintain 4800 meters, report passing XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 325，收到 PAN。下降并保持 4800 米，报告通过 XSH。
cards.referenceText: Continue descend to 4800 meters, report passing XSH, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 4800 米，报告通过 XSH，CES 325。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 325, we have notified the other relevant parties, please give us more description about your present situation.
B: Report to ATC that No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency. You guess that might be some more damages to the left wing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 325，我们已通知其他相关单位，请给我们更多你当前情况的描述。
B：向 ATC 报告 3 号发动机已熄火，克服坡度趋势更加困难。你猜测左翼可能还有更多损伤。
cards.referenceText: No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency, we suspect there might be some more damages to the left wing, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 3 号发动机已熄火，克服坡度趋势更加困难，我们怀疑左翼可能还有更多损伤，CES 325。

cards.audioText: C: CES 325, keep us advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 325，随时通报。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，CES 325。

cards.audioText: B: Now, you are over XSH at 4800 meters, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 XSH 上空，高度 4800 米，呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 325, over XSH at 4800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 325，XSH 上空，高度 4800 米。

cards.audioText: C: CES 325, maintain present level and contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 325，保持当前高度，联系武汉进近118.9，再见。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, 118.9, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，118.9，CES 325。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over XSH at 4800 meters, call Wuhan Approach and inform them that you are in distress now.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 XSH 上空，高度 4800 米，呼叫武汉进近并告知他们你现在处于遇险状态。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CES 325, we have been struck by foreign object, No.3 engine flame out and the aircraft tends to bank, we are now passing XSH at 4800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，武汉进近，CES 325，我们被外来物击中，3 号发动机熄火，飞机有坡度趋势，我们现在通过 XSH，高度 4800 米。

cards.audioText: C: CES 325, roger MAYDAY, the center controller as told us your situation, you will have the top priority. Descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1008, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, you are number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 325，收到 MAYDAY，管制中心已告诉我们你的情况，你将有最高优先级。QNH 1008 下降至 1200 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，你是第 1 架。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1008, ILS approach Runway 36R, No.1, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1008 下降至 1200 米，ILS 进近跑道 36R，第 1 架，CES 325。

cards.audioText: B: Now you want to verify the wind data, ask ATC to give detailed wind information.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你想核实风数据，请 ATC 提供详细风信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 325, request wind information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 325，请求风信息。

cards.audioText: C: CES 325, eh, let me see, the latest ATIS shows, wind 310 degrees, at 11 meters per second, but it is variable.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 325，呃，让我看看，最新 ATIS 显示，风 310 度，11 米/秒，但风向不定。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES 325。

cards.audioText: B: You consider there might be some problem with your landing, so you ask ATC to provide emergency assistance upon you landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你认为着陆可能有问题，所以请求 ATC 在你着陆时提供应急协助。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 325, request emergency assistance upon our landing due to possible landing problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 325，因可能存在着陆问题，请求着陆时应急协助。

cards.audioText: C: CES 325, roger, well, fire services and ambulance will be ready upon you landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 325，收到，嗯，消防和救护车将在你着陆时准备好。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES 325。

cards.audioText: B: Now, you have fully established on the ILS Runway 36R, call Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完全建立跑道 36R ILS，呼叫武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 325, established on the ILS Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 325，已建立跑道 36R ILS。

cards.audioText: C: CES 325, continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 325，继续进近，联系塔台 118.6，再见。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近并联系塔台 118.6，再见，CES 325。

cards.audioText: B: Now contact Tower, report to air traffic control that you are on emergency landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在联系塔台，向空中交通管制报告你正在紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 325, we are on emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 325，我们正在紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 325, radar identified, continue ILS approach Runway 36R, you are No.1, report the outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 325，雷达识别，继续 ILS 进近跑道 36R，你是第 1 架，报告外指点标。
cards.referenceText: Continue ILS approach Runway 36R, we are No.1, report the outer marker, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续 ILS 进近跑道 36R，我们是第 1 架，报告外指点标，CES 325。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over the outer marker, call Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在外指点标上空，呼叫武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 325, over outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 325，外指点标上空。

cards.audioText: C: CES 325, cleared land Runway 36R, wind 300 degrees at 12 meters per second, QNH 1008.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 325，跑道 36R 可以落地，风 300 度，12 米/秒，QNH 1008。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 36R, QNH 1008, CES 325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以落地，QNH 1008，CES 325。

cards.audioText: B: You have just skidded off the runway but managed to stop the aircraft on the grass strip, report to ATC and request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你刚滑出跑道，但设法将飞机停在草地带上，向 ATC 报告并请求应急服务。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 325, we skidded off the runway and manage to stop the aircraft on the grass, request emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 325，我们滑出跑道并设法将飞机停在草地上，请求应急服务。

topics.name: CES 5118 加餐水 前机堵滑行道

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 5118, from Wuhan to Beijing, parking at gate 223, when you are ready request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 5118，从武汉飞往北京，停在 223 号登机口，准备好时请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, gate 223, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，223 号登机口，请求 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, stand by, I will check your flight plan.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，等待，我检查你的飞行计划。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: All flight attendants told you passengers have boarded, all cargo doors are closed, now report ready for clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：所有乘务员告诉你旅客已登机，所有货舱门已关闭，现在报告准备好接收放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, gate 223, ready to copy ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，223 号登机口，准备好抄收飞往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, is cleared to Beijing, cruising level 10700 meters, Runway 18L, ZF-11 departure, initially 900 meters, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，许可飞往北京，巡航高度 10700 米，跑道 18L，ZF-11 离场，起始 900 米，离场频率 120.6，应答机 3021。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing, cruising level 10700 meters, Runway 18L, ZF-11 departure, initially 900 meters, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往北京，巡航高度 10700 米，跑道 18L，ZF-11 离场，起始 900 米，离场频率 120.6，应答机 3021，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, read back correct, remain this frequency, call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，复诵正确，保持本频率，稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Remain this frequency, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持本频率，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: 5 minutes later, no call from Delivery, ask about the duration and reason of the delay.
cards.audioTextZh: B：5 分钟后，放行没有呼叫，询问延误时长和原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, what's the delay like and what's the reason for the delay?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，延误情况如何，延误原因是什么？

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, due to thunderstorm activity, flow control is now in effect, expect 8 minutes separation between each aircraft going the same direction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，由于雷暴活动，流量控制现已生效，预计同方向每架飞机间隔 8 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
B: Heavy rain is starting to fall, accompanied with lightning and thunder.
C: All the aircraft on my frequency, airport will temporarily close, thunderstorms on final, expect delay until the weather improves, squawk ident if you copy this message.
cards.audioTextZh:
B：大雨开始落下，并伴随闪电和雷声。
C：我频率上的所有飞机，机场将临时关闭，五边有雷暴，预计延误至天气好转，如收到此信息请应答机识别。
cards.referenceText: Roger, squawk ident, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，应答机识别，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: 1 hour later, the weather is getting better and the airport is open, now ask for your departure sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: B：1 小时后，天气好转，机场开放，现在询问你的离场顺序。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, request departure sequence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，请求离场顺序。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, you are currently number 1 in your direction, expect about 20 minutes delay, contact Ground on 121.8.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，你当前在你方向上排第 1，预计约 20 分钟延误，联系地面 121.8。
cards.referenceText: Roger, 121.8, CES 5118.

cards.audioText: B: Inform Ground that you are ready for push back and start.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知地面你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, push back approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，同意推出，机头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing north, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝北，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: You realize that the tug is not in position yet, advise Ground control you need another 5 minutes to be ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你意识到拖车还未到位，告知地面管制你还需要 5 分钟准备。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, tug is not in position, request 5 minutes to be ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，拖车未到位，请求 5 分钟准备。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, roger, stand by for push, I will call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，收到，等待推出，我稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, are you fully ready now?we have a slot time for departure in 10 minutes.
B: You need to open the cabin door to add passenger food and drinks due to the long delay, advise Ground you will need another 5 minutes for catering.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 5118，你现在完全准备好了吗？我们有一个 10 分钟后离场的时隙。
B：由于长时间延误，你需要打开客舱门添加旅客餐食和饮料，告知地面你还需要 5 分钟配餐。
cards.referenceText: We need to open the cabin door to add passenger's food and drinks due long delay, we need another 5 minutes for catering, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于长时间延误，我们需要打开客舱门添加旅客餐食和饮料，我们需要另外 5 分钟配餐，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, roger, report ready.
B: 5 minutes later, catering completed, call ready.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 5118，收到，报告准备好。
B：5 分钟后，配餐完成，呼叫准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, catering completed, ready for pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，配餐完成，准备好推出。

cards.audioText: C: Push back approved until abeam gate 221, do not block gate 222, there is incoming traffic to that gate.
cards.audioTextZh: C：同意推出至正对 221 号登机口，不要阻挡 222 号登机口，有进港飞机要去该登机口。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved until abeam gate 221, don't block gate 222, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出至正对 221 号登机口，不要阻挡 222 号登机口，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: Engine start completed, now request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：发动机启动完成，现在请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, startup completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, taxi via M, A, hold short of E1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，经 M、A 滑行，E1 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via M, A, hold short of E1, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 M、A 滑行，E1 外等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: Can you accept E1 intersection for departure?Takeoff roll distance available 3300 meters.
B: Tell the Tower you can accept.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：你能接受 E1 交叉口离场吗？可用起飞滑跑距离 3300 米。
B：告诉塔台你可以接受。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we can accept intersection departure from E1, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以，我们可以接受 E1 交叉口离场，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, roger, line up and wait via taxiway E1.
B: Report to the Tower that the aircraft in front of you is blocking E1.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 5118，收到，经 E1 滑行道进跑道等待。
B：向塔台报告你前方的飞机阻挡 E1。
cards.referenceText: Negative, the aircraft in front of us is blocking E1, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不能，前方飞机阻挡 E1，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, roger, break! Break! CSN 328, taxi forward to be clear of E1.
B: The aircraft moved, you are able to continue taxi and line up.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 5118，收到，break！break！CSN 328，向前滑行以让开 E1。
B：该飞机移动后，你可以继续滑行并进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5118, traffic is clear, we are able to continue taxi and line up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5118，交通已脱离，我们可以继续滑行并进跑道。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，可以起飞，跑道 18L，起始保持跑道航向，爬升至 1500 米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1500 meters, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道 18L，起始保持跑道航向，爬升至 1500 米，CES 5118。

topics.name: CES 277 襟翼卡阻 无法完全放下

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 277, you are parking at gate 213, you have received information M, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 277，停在 213 号登机口，已收到通播 M，向武汉放行请求飞往伦敦希思罗的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 277, gate 213, information M, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 277，213 号登机口，通播 M，请求飞往伦敦希思罗的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, cleared to London Heathrow via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 2700 meters, LKO-02 departure, cruising level 8400 meters, squawk 2512.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，许可飞往伦敦希思罗，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 2700 米，LKO-02 离场，巡航高度 8400 米，应答机 2512。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London Heathrow via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 2700 meters, LKO-02 departure, cruising level 8400 meters, squawk 2512, CES 277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往伦敦希思罗，按飞行计划航路，离场跑道 04，起始爬升 2700 米，LKO-02 离场，巡航高度 8400 米，应答机 2512，CES 277。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 277, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 277，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway A4, E2, hold short of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，经滑行道 A4、E2 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway A4, E2, hold short of Runway 36R, CES 277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 A4、E2 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，跑道 36R 外等待，CES 277。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of Runway 36R, contact the controller to request cross the Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36R 外等待，联系管制员请求穿越跑道 36R。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 277, holding short of Runway 36R, request cross the Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 277，跑道 36R 外等待，请求穿越跑道 36R。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, expedite cross Runway 36R, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，快速穿越跑道 36R，报告脱离。
cards.referenceText: Expedite cross Runway 36R, report vacated, CES 277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 快速穿越跑道 36R，报告脱离，CES 277。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have exited Runway 36R, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已脱离跑道 36R，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 277, Runway 36R vacated.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 277，跑道 36R 已脱离。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of Runway 04, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 277, holding short of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 277，跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, after departure, climb straight ahead until 600 meters, follow SID, direct to LKO, contact Wuhan Departure 120.2, cleared for takeoff Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，离场后直线爬升至 600 米，执行 SID，直飞 LKO，联系武汉离场 120.2，跑道 04 可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: After departure, climb straight ahead until 600 meters, follow SID, direct to LKO, contact Wuhan Departure 120.2, cleared for takeoff Runway 04, CES 277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场后直线爬升至 600 米，执行 SID，直飞 LKO，联系武汉离场 120.2，跑道 04 可以起飞，CES 277。

cards.audioText: B: After takeoff, your flaps seem to be jammed, report the situation to Wuhan Approach and request hold for further check.
cards.audioTextZh: B：起飞后，你的襟翼似乎卡住，向武汉进近报告情况并请求等待以进一步检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 277, our flaps seem to be jammed, request hold for further check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 277，我们的襟翼似乎卡住，请求等待以进一步检查。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, roger, turn right, direct to LKO, hold at LKO VOR 210 radio, hold at 3300 meters, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，收到，右转，直飞 LKO，在 LKO VOR 210 径向等待，等待高度 3300 米，入航航迹 280 度，左等待，出航时间 1 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, hold at LKO VOR 210 radio, hold at 3300 meters, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute, CES 277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，在 LKO VOR 210 径向等待，等待高度 3300 米，入航航迹 280 度，左等待，出航时间 1 分钟，CES 277。

cards.audioText: B: After performing the checklist, the flap problem can't be solved, report it to Wuhan Approach and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，襟翼问题无法解决，向武汉进近报告并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 277, the flap problem can't be solved, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 277，襟翼问题无法解决，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, turn right heading 340, follow LKO-03A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，右转航向 340，执行 LKO-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, follow LKO-03A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 04, CES 277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，执行 LKO-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 04，CES 277。

cards.audioText: B: You can't fully extend the flaps, tell Wuhan Tower that you need to land on the longest runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你无法完全放出襟翼，告诉武汉塔台你需要在最长跑道上着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 277, we can't fully extend the flaps, request the longest runway for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 277，我们无法完全放出襟翼，请求最长跑道着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, turn right heading 030 to join right hand downwind Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，右转航向 030，加入跑道 04 右三边。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030 to join right hand downwind Runway 04, CES 277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，加入跑道 04 右三边，CES 277。

cards.audioText: C: CES 277, cleared to land, Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 277，可以落地，跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, Runway 04, CES 277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道 04，CES 277。

topics.name: CES 565 缝翼问题 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CES 565, from Wuhan to Los Angeles, you are parking at Gate 227, with information M, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CES 565，从武汉飞往洛杉矶，停在 227 登机口，已收到 M 情报，申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 565, Gate 227, information M, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 565，227 登机口，M 情报，申请前往洛杉矶的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 565, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, ZF-01 departure, runway in use 36 Left, initial climb 1,500 meters, cruising level 10,100 meters, squawk 5655.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 565，许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，执行 ZF-01 离场，使用 Runway 36L，初始爬升至 1,500 米，巡航高度 10,100 米，应答机 5655。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, ZF-01 departure, runway in use 36 Left, initial climb 1500 meters, cruising level 1100 meters, squawk 5655, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往洛杉矶，执行 ZF-01 离场，使用 Runway 36L，初始爬升至 1500 米，巡航高度 1100 米，应答机 5655，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: You are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 565, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 565，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, after company Airbus 340 is clear, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，同公司 Airbus 340 脱离后，同意推出和开车，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: After company Airbus 340 is clear, push back and start up approved, facing west, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同公司 Airbus 340 脱离后，同意推出和开车，机头朝西，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: Now the push back and start up is completed, ask for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在推出和开车已完成，请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 565, push back and start up is completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 565，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CES 565, taxi to holding point 36 Left via taxiway Z4, C and C1.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 565，经 Z4、C 和 C1 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36L 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point tree six Left via taxiway Z four, C and C one, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、C 和 C1 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36L 等待点，CES 565。

cards.audioText: now you are at holding point Runway 36L, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36L 等待点，已准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 565, holding point Runway 36L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 565，Runway 36L 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, behind landing Air China Boeing 747 on short final, line up and wait behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，在短五边落地的 Air China Boeing 747 后，跟在后面进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Behind landing Air China B747 on short final, line up and wait behind, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在短五边落地的 Air China B747 后，跟在后面进跑道等待，CES 565。

cards.audioText: CES 565, wind 350 degrees 2 meters per second, cleared for takeoff Runway 36L, after departure, contact Wuhan Departure 125.35.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 565，风向 350 度，风速 2 米/秒，许可从 Runway 36L 起飞，离场后联系武汉离场 125.35。
cards.referenceText: cleared for takeoff Runway 36L, after departure, contact Wuhan Departure 125.35, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可从 Runway 36L 起飞，离场后联系武汉离场 125.35，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: You are cruising at 3300 meters, you are encountering moderate icing, contact Wuhan Control and ask for a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 3300 米巡航，遭遇中度结冰，联系武汉管制并请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 565, we are encountering moderate icing at 3300 meters, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 565，我们在 3300 米遭遇中度结冰，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, climb and maintain 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，爬升并保持 9500 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 9500 meters, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 9500 米，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, you got a warning, you are leaking the bleed air and the cabin altitude is rising slowly, inform Wuhan Control you want to level off and might expect emergency descent soon.
cards.audioTextZh: B：突然你收到警告，正在漏引气，客舱高度缓慢上升，通知武汉管制你想改平，并可能很快需要紧急下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 565, we have a warning that the bleed air is leaking, the cabin altitude is rising slowly, request level off and emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 565，我们有引气泄漏警告，客舱高度缓慢上升，请求改平并紧急下降。

cards.audioText: B: The bleed air is no longer supplying and the high cabin altitude warning is triggered, make an Emergency call and tell the controller you want to make an emergency descent to 3000 meters, and request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: B：引气不再供应，高客舱高度警告触发，发布紧急呼叫并告诉管制员你想紧急下降至 3000 米，并请求雷达引导。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CES 565, the high cabin altitude warning is triggered, request emergency descent to 3000 meters and request radar vectors.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，CES 565，高客舱高度警告触发，请求紧急下降至 3000 米并请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText: C: CES 565, turn right heading 180, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1018.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 565，右转航向 180，QNH 1018 下降至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1018, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 180，QNH 1018 下降至 3000 米，CES 565。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are reaching 3000 meters in icing condition, contact Wuhan Approach and ask for landing information.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在结冰条件下到达 3000 米，联系武汉进近并请求落地信息。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 565, reaching 3000 meters in icing condition, request landing information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 565，在结冰条件下到达 3000 米，请求落地信息。

cards.audioText: CES 565, direct to HG, ZF-02 arrival, expect ILS approach 36 Left.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 565，直飞 HG，执行 ZF-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36L。
cards.referenceText: direct to HG, ZF-02 arrival, expect ILS approach 36 left, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 HG，执行 ZF-02 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36L，CES 565。

cards.audioText: during approach, your slats can't be extended, request the longer Runway 36R and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近期间，你的前缘缝翼无法放出，请求较长的 Runway 36R 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 565, our slats can't be extended, request the longer Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 565，我们的前缘缝翼无法放出，请求较长的 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: CES 565, change Runway 36R, continue present heading, descend to 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 565，改用 Runway 36R，保持当前航向，下降至 900 米。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, continue present heading, descend to 900 meters, CES 565.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，保持当前航向，下降至 900 米，CES 565。

topics.name: CES 728 颠簸 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 728, you are parking at gate 212, you have received information W, ask Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 728，停在 212 号登机口，已收到通播 W，向武汉放行请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 728, gate 212, information W, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 728，212 号登机口，通播 W，请求飞往广州的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 728, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-02 departure, initially climb 1,200 meters, cruising level 9,800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.6, squawk 3615.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 728，许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-02 离场，初始爬升至 1,200 米，巡航高度 9,800 米，离地后联系 119.6，应答机 3615。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-02 departure, initially climb 1200 meters, cruising level 9800 meters, when airborne, contact 119.6, squawk 3615, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往广州，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-02 离场，初始爬升至 1200 米，巡航高度 9800 米，离地后联系 119.6，应答机 3615，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have been pushed back with engines running, request taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已推出，发动机运转，请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 728, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 728，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CES 728, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 728，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z four, A tree and A, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CES 728。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, give way to Air China Airbus 319 on A7, you are number 2 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，避让 A7 上的 Air China Airbus 319，你是第 2 架离场。
cards.referenceText: Roger, traffic in sight, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，看到飞机，CES 728。

cards.audioText: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, contact tower for takeoff clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，联系塔台申请起飞许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 728, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 728，Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, line up and wait, expect 1 minute delay, there will be a helicopter crossing the runway from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，进跑道等待，预计延误 1 分钟，将有直升机从左至右穿越跑道。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, roger, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进跑道等待，收到，CES 728。

cards.audioText: CES 728, wind 010 degrees, 2 meters per second, cleared for takeoff, caution storm approaching north of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 728，风向 010 度，风速 2 米/秒，许可起飞，注意机场北侧有风暴逼近。
cards.referenceText: cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, roger, thanks, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可从 Runway 36R 起飞，收到，谢谢，CES 728。

cards.audioText: It's much later in the flight, you are at cruising level, ask Wuhan Control if 10,400 meters is available and if there is any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft on that level.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行已过很长时间，你正处于巡航高度，询问武汉管制 10,400 米是否可用，以及前机是否在该高度报告过颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 728, is 10,400 meters available? Is there any turbulence reported by preceding aircraft at that level?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 728，10,400 米是否可用？前机是否在该高度报告过颠簸？

cards.audioText:
CES 72810400 meters is available, there is no turbulence report at 10,400 meters.
Tell the controller you want to climb to 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
CES 728，10400 米可用，10,400 米没有颠簸报告。
告诉管制员你想爬升至 10,400 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 728, request climb to 10,400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 728，请求爬升至 10,400 米。

cards.audioText: Now you are in Guangzhou Control, cruising at 10,400 meters, because you are encountering severe icing, you want to descend to a lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于广州管制区，巡航高度为 10,400 米，由于遭遇严重积冰，想下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CES 728, we are encountering severe icing at 10,400 meters, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，CES 728，我们在 10,400 米遭遇严重积冰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, descend to and maintain 4200 meters, maintain high speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，下降并保持 4200 米，保持大速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4200 meters, maintain high speed, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，保持大速度，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: You are now with Guangzhou Approach, you want to maintain high speed as long as possible to avoid ice accumulation, tell ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在与广州进近联系，你想尽可能长时间保持大速度以避免积冰，告诉 ATC。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CES 728, request maintain high speed to avoid ice accumulation
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，CES 728，请求保持大速度以避免积冰。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, no speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: No speed restrictions, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 无速度限制，CES 728。

cards.audioText: While on final approach, you notice the approach lights are too dim, ask the controller to increase the intensity of the approach lights.
cards.audioTextZh: 在最后进近时，你注意到进近灯太暗，要求管制员提高进近灯亮度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CES 728, the approach lights are too dim, request brighten up the approach lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，CES 728，进近灯太暗，请求调亮进近灯。

cards.audioText: CES 728, roger, the approach lights will be turned up shortly, cleared to land Runway 20L, surface wind calm, caution runway is wet, braking action medium.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 728，收到，进近灯将很快调亮，许可在 Runway 20L 落地，地面静风，注意跑道湿滑，刹车效应中等。
cards.referenceText: roger, thanks, cleared to land Runway 20L, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，许可在 Runway 20L 落地，CES 728。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you have difficulty in taxiing in poor visibility, contact Guangzhou Ground for a follow-me car.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，你在低能见度下滑行困难，联系广州地面请求引导车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CES 728, we have difficulty in taxing in poor visibility, request a follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，CES 728，我们在低能见度下滑行困难，请求引导车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 728, the follow-me car will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 728，引导车很快会来。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES 728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES 728。

topics.name: CES 556 颠簸 雷暴绕飞 积冰/防冰

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 556, from Seoul to Wuhan, you are maintaining 9200 meters, approaching JTN, squawking 1532, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 556，从首尔飞往武汉，保持 9200 米，接近 JTN，应答机 1532，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 556, maintaining 9200 meters, approaching JTN, squawking 1532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 556，保持 9200 米，接近 JTN，应答机 1532。

cards.audioText: CES 556, direct to TOL, reduce speed to mach. 79.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 556，直飞 TOL，将速度减至 Mach 0.79。
cards.referenceText: direct to TOL, reduce speed to mach decimal seven niner, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 TOL，将速度减至 Mach 0.79，CES 556。

cards.audioText: Near TOL, you are experiencing moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000 meters and 10,400 meters, contact Shanghai Control and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 在 TOL 附近，你在 6000 米至 10,400 米之间遭遇中度至严重晴空颠簸，联系上海管制并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 556, we are experiencing moderate to severe clear air turbulence near TOL between 6,000 meters and 10,400 meters, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 556，我们在 TOL 附近的 6,000 米至 10,400 米之间遭遇中度至严重晴空颠簸，请求爬升。

cards.audioText:
CES 556, the alternative level is 11,600 meters, what's your intention?
tell the controller you can accept 11,600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
CES 556，可用的备选高度为 11,600 米，你的意图是什么？
告诉管制员你可以接受 11,600 米。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 556, we can accept 11,600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 556，我们可以接受 11,600 米。

cards.audioText: CES 556, climb to and maintain 11,600 meters, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 556，爬升至并保持 11,600 米，到达后报告。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 2600 meters, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至并保持 2600 米，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: You receive the report from the cabin that a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally, affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order, you suspect the higher cabin altitude is making passengers uncomfortable, you want to fly lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你收到客舱报告，一名醉酒旅客行为异常，影响客舱服务并扰乱客舱秩序，你怀疑较高客舱高度让旅客不适，想飞较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 556, a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally, affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order, we suspect the higher cabin altitude is making passengers uncomfortable, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 556，一名醉酒旅客行为异常，影响客舱服务并扰乱客舱秩序，我们怀疑较高客舱高度让旅客不适，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: CES 556, maintain 11,600 meters due to airspace congestion, reduce speed to mach.75.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 556，因空域拥堵保持 11,600 米，将速度减至 Mach 0.75。
cards.referenceText: maintain 11,600 meters, reduce speed to mach decimal seven five, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 11,600 米，将速度减至 Mach 0.75，CES 556。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, contact Wuhan Control on 128.55.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，联系武汉管制128.55。

cards.audioText: B: The flight attendant reported 2 passengers took out their overhead oxygen masks, they are being closely monitored, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent now.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告 2 名旅客取出了头顶氧气面罩，他们正被严密监控，向武汉管制报告并请求立即下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES 556, the flight attendant reported 2 passengers took out their overhead oxygen masks, they are being closely monitored, request descent now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，CES 556，乘务员报告 2 名旅客取出了头顶氧气面罩，他们正被严密监控，请求立即下降。

cards.audioText: C: CES 556, descend to 6600 meters and level by XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 556，下降至 6600 米，并在 XSH 前改平。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 6600 meters and level by XSH, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6600 米，并在 XSH 前改平，CES 556。

cards.audioText: CES 556, due to temporary airspace restriction is effective immediately, after passing XSH, direct to ZF, follow ZF03A, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 556，由于临时空域限制立即生效，飞越 XSH 后直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: after passing XSH, direct to ZF, follow ZF03 A Arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞越 XSH 后直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CES 556。

cards.audioText: CES 556, contact Wuhan Approach 120.4.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 556，联系武汉进近 120.4。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, you have got information O, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 ZF 上空，保持 6600 米，已收到通播 O，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, information O.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，ZF 上空，保持 6600 米，通播 O。

cards.audioText: CES 556, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, current information is P, descend and maintain 4,200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 556，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前情报为 P，下降并保持 4,200 米。
cards.referenceText: roger, information P, descend and maintain 4200 meters, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，P 情报，下降并保持 4200 米，CES 556。

cards.audioText: your weather radar observed the cumuliform clouds ahead, contact Wuhan Approach and request turn left and track direct to HG.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达观察到前方有积状云，联系武汉进近，请求左转直飞 HG。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, our weather radar observed the cumuliform clouds thunderstorm; CB ahead, request turn left and track direct to HG.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，我们的气象雷达观察到前方有积状云雷暴；前方有 CB，请求左转直飞 HG。

cards.audioText: CES 556, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 556，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CES 556。

cards.audioText: CES 556, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 556，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: While intercepting the localizer, 1 drunk passenger discharged the fire extinguisher, the purser make an emergency call said there are still passengers standing in the cabin, inform Wuhan Approach the situation and request terminate approach and proceed to holding area.
cards.audioTextZh: B：截获航向道时，1 名醉酒旅客释放了灭火器，乘务长紧急呼叫称客舱仍有旅客站立，通知武汉进近该情况并请求终止进近，前往等待区。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, 1 drunk passenger discharged the fire extinguisher, there are still passengers standing in the cabin, request terminate approach and proceed to holding area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，1 名醉酒旅客释放了灭火器，客舱仍有旅客站立，请求终止进近并前往等待区。

cards.audioText: CES 556, turn left, direct to DAL A, climb to 1,200 meters, hold as published, expect further clearance at time 50.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 556，左转直飞 DAL A，爬升至 1,200 米，按公布程序等待，预计在时间 50 获得进一步许可。
cards.referenceText: turn left, direct to DAL A, climb to 1200 meters, hold as published, expect further clearance at time 50, CES 556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，直飞 DAL A，爬升至 1200 米，按公布程序等待，预计在时间 50 获得进一步许可，CES 556。

cards.audioText: B: Now the problematic passenger has been properly restrained, advise the Approach controller you are ready to leave the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在问题旅客已被妥善约束，告知进近管制员你准备好离开等待。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 556, the problematic passenger has been properly restrained, request leave the hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 556，问题旅客已被妥善约束，请求离开等待。

topics.name: CES 2151 鸟击 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: your call sign is CES 2151, you are at Gate 232, you have got information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CES 2151，位于 232 登机口，已收到 S 情报，向武汉放行申请前往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 2151, Gate 232, information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 2151，232 登机口，S 情报，申请前往上海虹桥的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, Wuhan Delivery, information S is valid, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, Runway 36R, initial climb to 1800 meters, Z FOXTROT-01 departure, cruising level 10100 meters, after departure contact 123.4, Squawk 4125.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，武汉放行，S 情报有效，许可按飞行计划航路飞往上海虹桥，Runway 36R，初始爬升至 1800 米，执行 ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 10100 米，离场后联系 123.4，应答机 4125。
cards.referenceText: information S is valid, cleared to Shanghai via flight planned route, Runway 36R, initial climb to 1800 meters, ZF-01 departure, cruising level 1100 meters, after departure, contact 123.4, Squawk 4125, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: S 情报有效，许可按飞行计划航路飞往上海，Runway 36R，初始爬升至 1800 米，执行 ZF-01 离场，巡航高度 1100 米，离场后联系 123.4，应答机 4125，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 2151, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 2151，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, pushback and startup approved, push back to taxiway Z4, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，推出和开车批准，向后推出至 Z4 滑行道，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: pushback and startup approved, push back to taxiway Z four, facing west, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，向后推出至 Z4 滑行道，机头朝西，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: B: While being pushed back, the tow bar was broke and slash bent, report it to Ground controller and request a new tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: B：推出过程中，拖杆断裂并弯曲，向地面管制员报告并请求新的拖杆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 2151, the tow bar was bent during push back, request a new tow bar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 2151，推出过程中拖杆弯曲，请求新的拖杆。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back with engines running on taxiway Z4, ask Ground for taxiing instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在滑行道 Z4 已完成推出，发动机运转，向地面请求滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 2151, push back and start up completed, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 2151，推出和开车完成，滑行道 Z4，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, taxi via taxiway Z4, A3 and A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four, A tree and A to holding point Runway 36R, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, hold short of A7, give way to Airbus 320 coming from your right, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A to holding point Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，在 A7 前等待，给从你右侧驶来的 Airbus 320 让行，相关航空器通过后，经 A 滑行道继续滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: hold short of A seven, traffic in sight, when traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A to holding point Runway 36R, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 A7 前等待，已看到相关航空器，相关航空器通过后，经 A 滑行道继续滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows there is strong tailwind, report it to Wuhan Tower and check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，风向袋显示有强顺风，向武汉塔台报告并核实风况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 2151, holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows there is strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 2151，位于 Runway 36R 等待点，风向袋显示有强顺风，请求核实风况。

cards.audioText:
CES 2151, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact tower to change to Runway 18L and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
CES 2151，风向 200 度，风速 8 米/秒。
顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台请求更换至 Runway 18L 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 2151, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limits, request change to Runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 2151，因顺风超过起飞限制，请求更换至 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: now you are airborne from Runway 18L, you encountered a bird strike during the initial climb, one of your engines failed, inform the situation to Wuhan Approach and tell the controller you intend to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已从 Runway 18L 离地，在初始爬升期间遭遇鸟击，一台发动机失效，向武汉进近通报情况，并告诉管制员你打算返回武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 2151, we encountered a bird strike during initial climb, one of the engines failed, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 2151，我们在初始爬升期间遭遇鸟击，一台发动机失效，请求返场落地。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: climb and maintain 600 meters, turn right to join downwind and cleared for ILS Runway 36R, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 600 米，右转加入三边，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于强顺风，你想改用 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 2151, request change to Runway 18L due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 2151，因强顺风请求改用 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, change to Runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right direct to WHA, contact Wuhan Approach 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，批准改用 Runway 18L，保持 600 米，右转直飞 WHA，联系武汉进近 121.7。
cards.referenceText: change to Runway 18L is approved, maintain 600 meters, turn right, direct to WHA, 121.7, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准改用 Runway 18L，保持 600 米，右转，直飞 WHA，121.7，CES 2151。

cards.audioText: CES 2151, climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 2151，爬升至并保持 900 米，飞越 WHA 后飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: climb to and maintain 900 meters, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach Runway 18L, CES 2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至并保持 900 米，飞越 WHA 后飞航向 360，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，CES 2151。

topics.name: CES 5118 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 舱门问题

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 5118, from Wuhan to Beijing, parking at gate 223, when you are ready request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 5118，从武汉飞往北京，停在 223 号登机口，准备好时请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, gate 223, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，223 号登机口，请求 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, stand by one, I'll check your flight plan.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，稍等，我会检查你的飞行计划。
cards.referenceText: stand by, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: All flight attendants told you passengers have boarded, all cargo doors are closed, now report ready for clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：所有乘务员告诉你旅客已登机，所有货舱门已关闭，现在报告准备好接收放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, gate 223, ready to copy ATC clearance to Beijing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，223 号登机口，准备好抄收飞往北京的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 5118 is cleared to Beijing, cruising level 10,700 meters, r/w 18 Left, Z FOXTROT-11 departure, initially 900 meters, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，许可飞往北京，巡航高度 10,700 米，Runway 18L，执行 ZF-11 离场，初始高度 900 米，离场频率 120.6，应答机 3021。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Beijing, cruising level 1700 meters, Runway 18L, ZF-11 departure, initially 900 meters, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可飞往北京，巡航高度 1700 米，Runway 18L，执行 ZF-11 离场，初始高度 900 米，离场频率 120.6，应答机 3021，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, read back correct, remain this frequency, call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，复诵正确，保持本频率，稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Remain this frequency, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持本频率，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: 5 minutes later, no call from delivery. Ask about the duration and reason of the delay
cards.audioTextZh: 5 分钟后，仍未收到放行的呼叫。询问延误时长和原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, what is the expected delay and the reason for it?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，预计延误多久，原因是什么？

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, due to thunderstorm activity, flow control is now in effect, expect 8 minutes separation between each aircraft going the same direction.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，由于雷暴活动，流量控制现已生效，预计同方向每架飞机间隔 8 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
B: Heavy rain is starting to fall, accompanied with lightning and thunder.
C: All the aircraft on my frequency, airport will temporarily close, thunderstorms on final, expect delay until the weather improves, squawk ident if you copy this message.
cards.audioTextZh:
B：大雨开始落下，并伴随闪电和雷声。
C：我频率上的所有飞机，机场将临时关闭，五边有雷暴，预计延误至天气好转，如收到此信息请应答机识别。
cards.referenceText: Roger, squawk ident, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，应答机识别，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: 1 hour later, the weather is getting better and the airport is open, now ask for your departure sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: B：1 小时后，天气好转，机场开放，现在询问你的离场顺序。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5118, request departure sequence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5118，请求离场顺序。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, you are currently No. 1 in your direction, expect about 20 minutes delay, contact ground on 121.8.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，你当前在本方向排序第一，预计延误约 20 分钟，联系地面 121.8。
cards.referenceText: roger, 121.8, CES 5118.

cards.audioText: B: Inform Ground that you are ready for push back and start.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知地面你准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, push back approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，同意推出，机头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Push back approved, facing north, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝北，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: You realize that the tug is not in position yet, advise Ground control you need another 5 minutes to be ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你意识到拖车还未到位，告知地面管制你还需要 5 分钟准备。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, tug is not in position, request 5 minutes to be ready.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，拖车未到位，请求 5 分钟准备。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, roger, stand by for push, I will call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，收到，等待推出，我稍后呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Stand by, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, are you fully ready now? We have a slot time for departure in 10 minutes.
B: You need to open the cabin door for adding passenger's food and drinks due to long delay. Advise ground you will need another 5 minutes for catering.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 5118，你现在完全准备好了吗？我们有一个 10 分钟后离场的时隙。
B： 由于长时间延误，你需要打开舱门补充乘客的餐食和饮料。通知地面你还需要 5 分钟进行配餐。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, we need to open the cabin door to add passengers' food and drinks due to the long delay. We need another five minutes for catering.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，由于长时间延误，我们需要打开舱门补充乘客的餐食和饮料，还需要五分钟进行配餐。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, roger report ready.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，收到，准备好后报告。
cards.referenceText: wilco, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: 5 minutes later, catering completed, call ready
cards.audioTextZh: 5 分钟后，配餐完成，呼叫已准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, catering completed, ready for pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，配餐完成，已准备好推出。

cards.audioText: CES 5118, push back approved until abeam Gate 221, do not block gate 222, there's incoming traffic to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5118，批准推出至与 221 登机口平行的位置，不要挡住 222 登机口，有航空器正进该登机口。
cards.referenceText: roger, push back approved until abeam Gate 221, do not block gate 222, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，批准推出至与 221 登机口平行的位置，不要挡住 222 登机口，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: Engine start completed, now request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：发动机启动完成，现在请求滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5118, startup completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5118，开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, taxi via M, A, hold short of E1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 5118，经 M、A 滑行，E1 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via M, A, hold short of E1, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 M、A 滑行，E1 外等待，CES 5118。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, Can you accept E1 intersection for departure? takeoff roll distance available 3300 m.
B: tell tower you can accept it.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 5118，你能接受从 E1 交叉口离场吗？可用起飞滑跑距离为 3300 m。
B： 告诉塔台你可以接受。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5118, affirm, we can accept an intersection departure from E1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5118，可以，我们可以接受从 E1 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, roger, line up and wait via taxiway E1.
B: Report to Tower that the aircraft in front of you is blocking E1.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 5118，收到，经 E1 滑行道进入跑道等待。
B： 向塔台报告你前方的航空器挡住了 E1。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5118, line up and wait via Taxiway E1, but the aircraft in front of us is blocking E1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5118，经 E1 滑行道进入跑道等待，但我们前方的航空器挡住了 E1。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 5118, roger, break! Break! CSN 328, taxi forward to be clear of E1.
B: The aircraft moved, you are able to continue taxi and line up.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 5118，收到，break！break！CSN 328，向前滑行以让开 E1。
B：该飞机移动后，你可以继续滑行并进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5118, traffic is clear, we are able to continue taxi and line up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5118，交通已脱离，我们可以继续滑行并进跑道。

cards.audioText: C: CES 5118, cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1,500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C： CES 5118，许可从 Runway 18L 起飞，起初保持跑道航向，爬升至 1,500 米。
cards.referenceText: cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1500 meters, CES 5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可从 Runway 18L 起飞，起初保持跑道航向，爬升至 1500 米，CES 5118。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 769, a flight from Wuhan to Amsterdam, you are parking at stand 221, you have received information C, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 769，从武汉飞往阿姆斯特丹，停在 221 号停机位，已收到通播 C，请求 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 769, stand 221, information C, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 769，221 号停机位，通播 C，请求飞往阿姆斯特丹的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 769, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1,800 meters, HZ-01 departure, cruising level 11,000 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3562.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 769，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1,800 米，执行 HZ-01 离场，巡航高度 11,000 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3562。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1800 meters, HZ-01 departure, cruising level 2000 meters, 11000 meters departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3562, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1800 米，执行 HZ-01 离场，巡航高度 2000 米，11000 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3562，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 769, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 769，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, push back and start up approved, long pushed back, facing south.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，同意推出和开车，长推出，机头朝南。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, long pushed back, facing south, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出和开车，长推出，机头朝南，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 769, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 769，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, taxi via D, D4, hold short of Runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，经 D、D4 滑行，跑道 36 外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via D, D4, hold short of Runway 36, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 D、D4 滑行，跑道 36 外等待，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing, a passenger opened an emergency exit, inform the controller of this situation and airport security is needed to remove the passenger.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行中，一名旅客打开了应急出口，通知管制员该情况并需要机场安保带走该旅客。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 769, a passenger opened an emergency exit, request airport security to remove the passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 769，一名旅客打开了应急出口，请求机场安保带走该旅客。

cards.audioText: CES 769, recleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 2,100 meters, HZ-02 departure, cruising level 10,400 meters, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 769，重新许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，初始爬升至 2,100 米，执行 HZ-02 离场，巡航高度 10,400 米，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: recleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 2100 meters, HZ-02 departure, cruising level 10,400 meters, the rest unchanged, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重新许可飞往阿姆斯特丹，初始爬升至 2100 米，执行 HZ-02 离场，巡航高度 10,400 米，其余不变，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point W2 Runway 36, contact Wuhan Tower and ask the permission to cross Runway 36.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 36 W2 等待点等待，联系武汉塔台并请求穿越跑道 36。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 769, holding point W2 runway 36, request cross Runway 36.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 769，跑道 36 W2 等待点，请求穿越跑道 36。

cards.audioText: CES 769, expedite cross Runway 36, when vacated, taxi via taxiway Z5, A4 and A, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 769，加速穿越 Runway 36，脱离后经 Z5、A4 和 A 滑行道滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待。
cards.referenceText: expedite cross Runway 36, taxi via taxiway Z five, A four and A, hold short of Runway 04, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加速穿越 Runway 36，经 Z5、A4 和 A 滑行道滑行，在 Runway 04 前等待，CES 769。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of Runway 04, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 769, holding short of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 769，跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, line up Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，进入跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Line up Runway 04, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道 04，CES 769。

cards.audioText: C: CES 769, cleared for takeoff Runway 04, surface wind 020, 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 769，跑道 04 可以起飞，地面风 020，2 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 04, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 04 可以起飞，CES 769。

cards.audioText: Now you are maintaining 2000 meters, over WXI, squawking 3562, contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正保持 2000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 3562，联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES 769, maintaining 2000 meters, 11000 meters over WXI, squawking 3562.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CES 769，正保持 2000 米，11000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 3562。

cards.audioText: CES 769, increase speed to mach decimal 83 or greater, fly direct to PEK.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 769，将速度增加至 Mach 0.83 或更大，直飞 PEK。
cards.referenceText: increase speed to mach decimal 83 or greater, fly direct to PEK, CES 769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 将速度增加至 Mach 0.83 或更大，直飞 PEK，CES 769。

topics.name: CES 529 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 529, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 529，保持 8400 米，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, maintaining 8,400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: CES 529, Shanghai Control, radar contact, climb to 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 529，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 10,400 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 10,400 meters, CES 529.

cards.audioText: now you are cruising at 10,400 meters, your instruments indicate left pack has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正以 10,400 米巡航，仪表显示左组件故障，联系上海管制并请求下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, maintaining 10,400 meters, our instruments indicate the left pack has malfunctioned, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，正保持 10,400 米，我们的仪表显示左组件故障，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned and request emergency descent, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 529, our right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned, request emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 529，我们的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 529, our cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 529，我们的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，QNH 1031 下降至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1031 下降至 3000 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3000 meters, cabin altitude has resumed to normal, you will cancel Distress, report it to Shanghai Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，你将取消遇险，向上海进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, CES 529, maintaining 3000 meters, the cabin altitude has resumed to normal, cancel Distress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，CES 529，保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，取消遇险。

cards.audioText: B: The cabin crew reports 5 passengers in the cabin are seriously injured during emergency descent, inform the situation to Shanghai Control and request diversion to Hangzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B：客舱机组报告 5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，向上海管制通报情况并请求备降杭州。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, 5 passengers are seriously injured, request divert to Hangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，5 名旅客严重受伤，请求备降杭州。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 529, divert to Hangzhou approved, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ambulances upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 529，同意备降杭州，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉管制员抵达时需要救护车。
cards.referenceText: Divert to Hangzhou approved, request ambulances upon arrival, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意备降杭州，请求抵达时救护车，CES 529。

cards.audioText: CES 529, roger, ambulance will be ready upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 529，收到，救护车将在到达时就位。
cards.referenceText: roger, thanks, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES 529。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now tell Hangzhou Tower about your situation and request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在告诉杭州塔台你的情况并请求优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 529, 5 passengers were seriously injured during emergency descent, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 529，5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, straight ILS approach Runway 06, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，直线 ILS 进近跑道 06，报告建立。
cards.referenceText: Straight ILS approach Runway 06, report established, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直线 ILS 进近跑道 06，报告建立，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 06。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 529, established on ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 529，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 06。

topics.name: CES 209 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CES 209, you are in Shanghai Control area, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CES 209，你位于上海管制区，正保持 8400 米，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 209, maintaining 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 209，正保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: CES 209, Shanghai Control, radar contact, climb to 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 10,400 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 10,400 meters, CES 209.

cards.audioText: now you are cruising at 10,400 meters, your instruments indicate left pack has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正以 10,400 米巡航，仪表显示左组件故障，联系上海管制并请求下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 209, maintaining 10,400 meters, our instruments indicate our left pack has malfunctioned, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 209，正保持 10,400 米，我们的仪表显示左组件故障，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: CES 209, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 240, descend to 8,900 meters initially, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，先下降至 8,900 米，CES 209。

cards.audioText: During descent, your right pack is overheating and both packs have malfunctioned, and request emergency descent. This is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降期间，右组件过热且两个组件均发生故障，请求紧急下降。这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 209, our right pack is overheating and both packs have malfunctioned, request emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 209，我们的右组件过热且两个组件均发生故障，请求紧急下降。

cards.audioText: During descent, your cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters, this is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降期间，你的客舱高度迅速升高，请求紧急下降至 3000 米，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 209, request emergency descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 209，请求紧急下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: CES 209, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，在 QNH 1031 上下降至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031, CES 209
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 QNH 1031 上下降至 3000 米，CES 209。

cards.audioText: Now you are maintaining 3000 meters, cabin altitude has resumed to normal, you will cancel distress, report it to Shanghai Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，你将取消遇险状态，向上海进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, CES 209, maintaining 3000 meters, the cabin altitude has resumed to normal, cancel distress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，CES 209，正保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，取消遇险状态。

cards.audioText: the cabin crew reports 5 passengers in the cabin are (seriously) injured during emergency descent, inform the situation to Shanghai Control, and request divert to Hangzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱机组报告，在紧急下降期间客舱内有 5 名乘客（严重）受伤，向上海管制通报情况并请求备降杭州。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 209, five passengers are seriously injured, request divert to Hangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 209，五名乘客严重受伤，请求备降杭州。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 209, divert to Hangzhou approved, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 209，批准备降杭州，你需要什么协助？
B： 告诉管制员你需要在到达时安排救护车。
cards.referenceText: divert to Hangzhou approved, request ambulances on arrival, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准备降杭州，请求在到达时安排救护车，CES 209。

cards.audioText: CES 209, ambulances will be ready upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，救护车将在到达时就位。
cards.referenceText: roger, thanks, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES 209。

cards.audioText: CES 209, turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2,100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，右转航向 180，下降并保持 2,100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 06。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 06，CES 209。

cards.audioText: now tell Hangzhou tower about your situation and request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在向杭州塔台说明你的情况并请求优先落地。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 209, five passengers were seriously injured during emergency descent, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 209，五名乘客在紧急下降期间严重受伤，请求优先落地。

cards.audioText: CES 209, straight in ILS approach Runway 06, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，直线 ILS 进近 Runway 06，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: straight in ILS approach Runway 06, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直线 ILS 进近 Runway 06，CES 209。

cards.audioText: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 06。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 209, established ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 209，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 06。

topics.name: CES 5277 襟翼问题 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CES 5277, you are parking at gate 213, you have received information F, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CES 5277，停在 213 登机口，已收到 F 情报，向武汉放行申请前往伦敦希思罗的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES 5277, Gate 213, information F, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，CES 5277，213 登机口，F 情报，申请前往伦敦希思罗的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES 5277, cleared to London Heathrow via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 2700 meters, LKO-02 departure, cruising level 8400 meters, squawk 2512.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5277，许可按飞行计划航路飞往伦敦希思罗，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 2700 米，执行 LKO-02 离场，巡航高度 8400 米，应答机 2512。
cards.referenceText: cleared to London Heathrow via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 2700 meters, LKO-02 departure, cruising level 8400 meters, squawk 2512, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往伦敦希思罗，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 2700 米，执行 LKO-02 离场，巡航高度 8400 米，应答机 2512，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES 5277, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，CES 5277，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CES 5277, taxi to holding point Runway 04via taxiway A4, E2, hold short of Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5277，经 A4、E2 滑行道滑行至 Runway 04 等待点，在 Runway 36R 前等待。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 04via taxiway A four, E two, hold short of Runway 36R, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A4、E2 滑行道滑行至 Runway 04 等待点，在 Runway 36R 前等待，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: Now you are holding short of Runway 36R, contact the controller to request cross the Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在 Runway 36R 前等待，联系管制员请求穿越 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5277, holding short of Runway 36R, request cross Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5277，在 Runway 36R 前等待，请求穿越 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: CES 5277, expedite cross Runway 36R, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5277，加速穿越 Runway 36R，脱离后报告。
cards.referenceText: expedite cross Runway 36R, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加速穿越 Runway 36R，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: Now you have exited Runway 36R, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已脱离 Runway 36R，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5277, Runway 36R vacated.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5277，已脱离 Runway 36R。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding short of Runway 04, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5277, holding short of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5277，跑道 04 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: CES 5277, after departure, climb straight ahead until 600 meters, follow SID, direct to LKO, contact Wuhan departure 120.2, cleared for takeoff Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5277，离场后直线爬升至 600 米，执行 SID，直飞 LKO，联系武汉离场 120.2，许可从 Runway 04 起飞。
cards.referenceText: after departure, climb straight ahead until 600 meters, follow SID, direct to LKO, contact Wuhan departure 120.2, cleared for takeoff Runway 04, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离场后直线爬升至 600 米，执行 SID，直飞 LKO，联系武汉离场 120.2，许可从 Runway 04 起飞，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: B: After takeoff, your flaps seem to be jammed, report the situation to Wuhan Approach and request hold for further check.
cards.audioTextZh: B：起飞后，你的襟翼似乎卡住，向武汉进近报告情况并请求等待以进一步检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 5277, our flaps seem to be jammed, request hold for further check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 5277，我们的襟翼似乎卡住，请求等待以进一步检查。

cards.audioText: CES 5277, roger, turn right, direct to LKO, hold at LKO VOR, 210 radial, hold at 3,300 meters, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time one minute.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5277，收到，右转直飞 LKO，在 LKO VOR 等待，210 径向线，在 3,300 米等待，向台航迹 280 度，左等待，背台时间一分钟。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to LKO, hold at LKO VOR, 210 radial, hold at 3300 meters, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time one minute, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，在 LKO VOR 等待，210 径向线，在 3300 米等待，向台航迹 280 度，左等待，背台时间一分钟，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: B: After performing the checklist, the flap problem can't be solved, report it to Wuhan Approach and request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，襟翼问题无法解决，向武汉进近报告并请求返回着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES 5277, the flap problem can't be solved, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，CES 5277，襟翼问题无法解决，请求返回着陆。

cards.audioText: CES 5277, turn right heading 340, follow LKO-03A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5277，右转航向 340，执行 LKO-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 04。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 340, follow LKO03 A Arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 04, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，执行 LKO-03A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 04，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: B: You can't fully extend the flaps, tell Wuhan Tower that you need to land on the longest runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你无法完全放出襟翼，告诉武汉塔台你需要在最长跑道上着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES 5277, we can't fully extend the flaps, request the longest runway for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，CES 5277，我们无法完全放出襟翼，请求最长跑道着陆。

cards.audioText: CES 5277, turn right heading 030 to join right hand downwind Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5277，右转航向 030，加入 Runway 04 右三边。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 030 to join right hand downwind Runway 04, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 030，加入 Runway 04 右三边，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: CES 5277, cleared to land, Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 5277，许可在 Runway 04 落地。
cards.referenceText: cleared to land, Runway 04, CES 5277.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可在 Runway 04 落地，CES 5277。

cards.audioText: 1B: Your call sign is CES728 from Wuhan to Guangzhou, you are at gate 213, information W received, request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方728，从武汉飞往广州，你现在在213号停机位，收到通播W，请求管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES728, from Wuhan to Guangzhou gate 213, information W, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方728，从武汉飞往广州，213号停机位，通播W，请求管制许可。

cards.audioText: 2C: CES728, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, LKO-02 departure, initially climb to 1200m, cruising level 9800m, contact 119.6 when airborne, squawk 3615.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方728，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，跑道36右，LKO-02离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，离地后联系119.6，应答机编码3615。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, LKO-02 departure, initially climb to 1200m cruising level 9800m, contact 119.6 when airborne, squawk 3615, CES728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，跑道36右，LKO-02离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，离地后联系119.6，应答机编码3615，东方728。

cards.audioText: 3B: Now you are pushing back with engines running, request taxi clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正在推出，发动机已经运转，请求滑行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES728, pushing back, request taxi clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方728，正在推出，请求滑行许可。

cards.audioText: 4C: CES728, taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方728，经由滑行道Z4，A3，A滑行至跑道36右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point runway 36R, CES728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A3，A滑行至跑道36右外等待点，东方728。

cards.audioText: 5C: CES728, give way to Air China A319 on taxiway A7, you are No.2.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方728，给在滑行道A7上的国航A319让路，你是第二个。
cards.referenceText: Give way to Air China A319 on taxiway A7, No.2. CES728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给在滑行道A7上的国航A319让路，第二个，东方728。

cards.audioText: 6B: You are at holding point of runway 36R, contact Tower for takeoff clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在跑道36右外等待点，联系塔台，请求起飞许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES728, holding point of runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方728，跑道36右外等待点，准备好起飞了。

cards.audioText: 7C: CES728, line up and wait, expect 1min delay. There will be a helicopter crossing the runway from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方728，上跑道等待，预计1分钟延误，有一架直升机在从左向右穿越跑道。
cards.referenceText: Lining up and wait, expect 1min delay, CES728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道等待，东方728。

cards.audioText: 8C: CES728, wind 010 degrees 2m/s, clear for takeoff runway 36R. Caution storm north of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方728，地面风010度，2米每秒，可以起飞， 跑道36右，小心机场北部有风暴。
cards.referenceText: Clear for takeoff runway 36R, CES728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞， 跑道36右，东方728。

cards.audioText: 9B: You are now at cruising level. You want to climb to 10400m to avoid turbulence. Ask Wuhan Control if 10400m is available and if there is any turbulence reported on that level.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在到达巡航高度，你想爬升至10400米来躲避颠簸，询问武汉区调，10400米是否可用，以及在此高度是否有颠簸报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES728, confirm 10400m is available and there is any turbulence reported on that level?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方728，我们在巡航高度，请求爬升至10400米来躲避颠簸，证实10400米是否可用，以及此高度是否有颠簸？

cards.audioText:
10C: CES728, Wuhan Control, 10400m is available and no turbulence reported on that level.
10B: You want to climb to 10400m.
cards.audioTextZh:
东方728，武汉区调，10400米可用，没有颠簸报告。
【你想爬升至10400米。】
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 10400m, CES728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求爬升至10400米，东方728。

cards.audioText: 11B: You are now in Guangzhou Control, cruising at 10400m, because you are encountering the icing condition, you want to descend to a lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在广州区调，巡航高度10400米，由于你遇到了积冰情况，你想下降至更低高度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CES728, cruising at 10400m, request descend due icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，东方728，巡航高度10400米，由于积冰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: 12C: CES728, descend to 4200m, maintain high speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方728，下到4200米，保持高航速。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200m, maintain high speed, CES728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到4200米，保持高航速，东方728。

cards.audioText: 13B: You are now with Guangzhou Approach, you want to maintain high speed as long as possible to avoid ice accumulation. Tell ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在已经和广州进近建立联系，你想尽可能保持高航速来避免积冰，告知管制员。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CES728, request maintain high speed as long as possible to avoid ice accumulation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，东方728，请求尽可能保持高航速来避免积冰

cards.audioText: 14C: CES728, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方728，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: No speed restriction, CES728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有速度限制，东方728。

cards.audioText: 15B: While on final approach, you notice the approach lights are too dim, ask the controller to increase the intensity of the approach lights.
cards.audioTextZh: 在五边进近时，你注意到进近灯过暗，请求管制提高进近灯亮度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Tower, CES728, request brighten the approach lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，东方728，请求提高进近灯亮度。

cards.audioText: 16C: Roger, CES728, the approach lights will be turned up shortly. Clear to land runway 27L, wind calm. Caution runway is wet, braking action medium.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，东方728，进近灯很快会调高亮度。可以落地，跑道27左，静风，注意跑道湿滑，刹车性能中等。
