cards.referenceText: Clear to land runway 27L, roger, braking action medium, CES728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，跑道27左，收到，刹车性能中等，东方728。

cards.audioText: 17B: After landing, you find taxi is too difficult in poor visibility, ask ground control for a follow me car.
cards.audioTextZh: 落地后，你发现在低能见度下滑行困难，向地面管制请求一辆引导车。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Ground, CES728, It’s difficult to taxi in poor visibility, request a follow-me car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，东方728，低能见度下滑行困难，请求一辆引导车。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is CES529, a flight from Wuhan to Shanghai, you are near departure time, one passenger was found taking some forbidden goods on board, you have to check his luggage again, contact Wuhan Delivery and request delay the flight.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方529，一架从武汉飞往上海的航班，你现在接近离场时间，一名乘客发现携带违禁物品登机，你需要再次检查他的行李，联系武汉放行，请求推迟航班。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES529, a passenger has taken some forbidden goods on board, we are checking the luggage again, request delay our flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方529，一名乘客发现携带违禁物品登机，我们需要再次检查他的行李，请求推迟航班。

cards.audioText:
C: CES529, roger, call me back when ready.
B: [Now you are ready to copy ATC clearance to Shanghai, you are at gate 212. You have received information J.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方529，收到，准备好时叫。
【你现在准备好抄收到上海的放行许可，你在212号机位。你已经收到通播J。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES529, gate 212, information J received, request ATC clearance to Shanghai.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方529，212号机位，收到通播J，请求飞往上海的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, clear to Shanghai via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF 02 departure, initial climb to 1800m, cruising level 10100m, Departure frequency 119.25, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，可以经由计划航路飞往上海，跑道36右，ZF02离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10100米，离场频率119.25，应答机2515。
cards.referenceText: Clear to Shanghai via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF 02 departure, initial climb to 1800m, cruising level 10100m, departure frequency 119.25, squawk 2515. CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往上海，跑道36右，ZF02离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10100米，离场频率119.25，应答机2515，东方529。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have completed push back and start up procedures. You are ready for taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已经完成推出开车程序，你准备好滑行了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES529, push back and start up completed, request taxi. （可以直接说request taxi）
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方529，已经推出开车，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, taxi to holding point runway 36R, via taxiway Z4, T3, C and A1.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，经由滑行道 Z4、T3、C和A1滑行至跑道36右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 36R, via taxiway Z4, T3, C and A1, CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道 Z4、T3、C和A1滑行至跑道36右外等待点，东方529。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are airborne, leaving 1200m for 2400m, make an initial contact with Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已离地，从1200米飞往2400米，与武汉离场建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES529, airborne, leaving 1200m for 2400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方529，离地了，从1200米飞往2400米。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, turn right direct to ZF, climb to 5100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，武汉离场，雷达已识别，右转直飞ZF，上5100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to ZF, climb to 5100m, CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞ZF，上5100米，东方529。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over ZF, maintaining 5100m, squawk 2515, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你在ZF上空，5100米保持，应答机2515，与武汉区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES529, over ZF, maintaining 5100m, squawk 2515.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方529，过ZF，在5100米保持，应答机2515。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, climb to 9500m.
cards.referenceText: Climb to 9500m, CES529.

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are cruising at 10700m. Your instruments indicate one of your air conditioning packs has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request to descend to a lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【目前你在10700米巡航，仪表显示一个空调组件失效，联系上海区调，请求下降到较低高度。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES529, maintain 10700m, request descent due one air conditioning pack has malfunctioned.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，东方529，10700米保持，由于一个空调组件失效，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900m initially.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，右转航向240，初始下降至8900米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 8900m initially, CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，初始下降至8900米，东方529。

cards.audioText:
C: CES529, What's the situation like on board now?
B: [Tell the controller that you have pressurization problem, cabin altitude is rising slowly and request descent to 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方529，机上现在情况如何？
【告知管制员，你出现增压问题，客舱高度缓慢上升，请求下降到3000米。】
cards.referenceText: Request descent to 3000m due cabin depressurization, CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于客舱失压，请求下降到3000米，东方529。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, descend to 3000m on QNH 1031.
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000m on QNH 1031, CES529.

cards.audioText: B: [During emergency descent, the cabin crew reported five passengers in the cabin are seriously injured, inform the situation to Shanghai Control and request divert to Hangzhou.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在紧急下降过程中，乘务员报告客舱内5名乘客受伤严重，将情况告知上海区调，请求备降至杭州。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES529, 5 passengers were injured during emergency descent, request to divert to Hangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海区调，东方529，在紧急下降过程中，有5名乘客受伤严重，请求备降至杭州。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100m, QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，右转航向180，下降至2100米保持，QNH1031。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100m, QNH 1031, CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，下降至2100米保持，QNH1031，东方529。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is CES769, a flight from Wuhan to Amsterdam. You are parking at Stand 223. You have received information C, request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方769，一架从武汉飞往阿姆斯特丹的飞机。你现在停在223号停机位，你已经收到通播C，请求管制放行许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES769, stand 223, information C, request ATC clearance to Amsterdam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方769，223号停机位，通播C，请求飞往阿姆斯特丹的放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure runway 36, initial climb to 1800m, HZ-01 departure, cruising level 11000m, squawk 6127.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，武汉放行，可以经由计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹，离场跑道36，初始爬升至1800米，HZ-01离场，巡航高度11000米，应答机6127。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Amsterdam via flight planned route, departure runway 36, initial climb to 1800m, HZ01 departure, cruising level 11000m, squawk 6127, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往阿姆斯特丹，离场跑道36，初始爬升至1800米，HZ-01离场，巡航高度11000米，应答机6127，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [Two passengers are quarreling loudly in the cabin, and the air security are needed to remove the passengers away, report it to Wuhan Delivery, and request to delay the flight.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【两名乘客在客舱大吵起来，需要安保人员将他们送下飞机。将情况报告给武汉放行，请求推迟航班。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES769, two passengers are quarreling loudly in the cabin, we need air security to remove the passengers, and request to delay the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方769，两名乘客在客舱大吵起来，我们需要安保人员将他们送下飞机，请求推迟航班。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, report when ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，准备好了叫。
cards.referenceText: Roger, wilco, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，照办，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [Now the passengers have been removed by the airport security. You are ready to copy ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在乘客已经被安保人员送下飞机，你准备好抄收放行许可了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES769, we are fully ready to copy ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方769，我们准备好抄收管制许可了。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, re-cleared to Amsterdam, initial climb to 1200m, HZ-02 departure, squawk 5101, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，重新许可至阿姆斯特丹，初始爬升至1200米，HZ-02离场，应答机5101，其余不变。
cards.referenceText: Re-cleared to Amsterdam, initial climb 1200m, HZ-02 departure, squawk 5101, the rest unchanged, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 重新许可至阿姆斯特丹，初始爬升至1200米，HZ-02离场，应答机5101，其余不变，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are holding at holding point runway 36, contact Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在跑道36的外等待点等待，联系武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES769, holding at holding point of runway 36.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方769，在跑道36的外等待点等待。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, expedite cross runway 36, taxi via taxiway Z5, A4 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，加速穿越跑道36，经由滑行道Z5，A4和A滑行。
cards.referenceText: Expedite cross runway 36, taxi via taxiway Z5, A4 and A, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加速穿越跑道36，经由滑行道Z5，A4和A滑行，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are ready for departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你准备好离场了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES769, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方769，准备好离场了。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, line up and cleared for immediate takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，上跑道，可以立即起飞。
cards.referenceText: Line up and cleared for immediate takeoff, runway 36, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道，可以立即起飞，跑道36，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are airborne, passing 600m for 1200m, contact Wuhan Departure and request further climb.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已经离地，正在过600米飞往1200米，联系武汉离场请求进一步爬升。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES769, airborne, passing 600m for 1200m, request further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方769，离地了，过600米，飞往1200米，请求进一步爬升。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, radar contact, climb to 3000m on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，雷达识别，爬升至3000米，修压1012。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 3000m on QNH 1012, CES769.

cards.audioText: B: [During climb, your instrument shows that cabin temperature is too high, report it to the controller and ask to level off to perform the checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在爬升过程中，你的仪表显示客舱温度过高，将此报告给管制员，请求平飞并执行检查单。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES769, cabin temperature is too high, request level off to perform the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方769，客舱温度过高，请求平飞并执行检查单。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, climb and maintain 2400m, when able, say your intention.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，上到2400米保持，可以的时候，告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 2400m, wilco, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上2400米保持，照办，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [After performing the checklist, you decide to dump fuel and return for landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【当执行完检查单，你决定放油并返场着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES769, request dump fuel and return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方769，请求放油并返场着陆。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is CES556, you are maintaining 9200m, ETA JTN at 55, squawk 1532; make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方556，飞机保持9200米，预计到达JTN时间55分，应答机1532；和武汉区调建立初次联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES556, 9200m maintaining, ETA JTN 55, squawk 1532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方556，保持9200米。预计到达JTN时间55分，应答机1532。

cards.audioText:
C: CES556, Wuhan Control, radar contact, direct to TOL, confirm Mach number .79.
B: [Tell controller you are maintaining Mach number .79. And read back instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方556，武汉区调，雷达已识别，直飞TOL，证实马赫数点79。
【告诉管制员你在维持马赫数点79并复诵指令。】
cards.referenceText: Direct to TOL, affirm Mach number .79, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞TOL，证实马赫数点79，东方556。

cards.audioText:
C: CES556, around TOL reported moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000m to 10400m. The alternative level is 11600m, report intention?
B: [Tell the controller you can accept 11600m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方556，TOL附近报告有强烈晴空乱流，高度6000米至10400米。备用高度是11600米，报告意图。【告诉管制员11600米可用。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm 11600m, CES556.

cards.audioText: B: [You receive the report from cabin said that a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order. You suspect the higher cabin altitude make the passenger uncomfortable. You want to fly a lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你收到客舱报告，一名醉酒乘客行为异常，影响客舱服务，扰乱客舱秩序。你怀疑较高的客舱压力让该乘客不舒服。你想请求较低高度。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES556, request descent due passenger uncomfortable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方556，乘客不舒服，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: CES556, maintaining 11600m due the airspace congestion. Reduce Mach number to .75.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方556，由于空域拥挤，保持11600米。减小马赫数到点75。
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 11600m, reduce Mach number .75, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持11600米。减小马赫数到点75，东方556。

cards.audioText: B: [The passenger took out the overhead oxygen mask. He is being closely monitored. Report the situation to the controller and request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【该乘客拿出头顶上的氧气面罩。他被密切地监测。报告管制员该情况并请求下降。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES556, request descent. The passenger took out the oxygen mask and being monitored.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方556，请求下降。该乘客拿出氧气面罩，他已被监控起来。

cards.audioText: C: CES556, descend and maintain 6600m by XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方556，下降保持6600米，过XSH。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 6600m by XSH, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持6600米过XSH，东方556。

cards.audioText: C: CES556, due to temporarily airspace restriction is effective immediately, after XSH, direct to ZF, expect ZF-03A Arrival. ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方556，由于临时空域限制立即生效，过XSH，直飞ZF，预计ZF-03A进场，盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: After XSH, direct to ZF, expect ZF-03A arrival. ILS approach runway 36R, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过XSH后，直飞ZF，预计ZF-03A进场，盲降进近跑道36右，东方556。

cards.audioText: C: CES556, contact Wuhan Approach on 120.4.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方556，联系武汉进近120.4。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach 120.4, CES556.

cards.audioText: B: [You have received ATIS O and is proceeding direct to ZF, maintaining 6600m. Call Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你收到ATIS O，继续直飞ZF，6600米保持。呼叫武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, maintaining 6600m, information O, direct to ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方556，6600米保持，通播O，直飞ZF。

cards.audioText: C: CES556, information P valid, descend and maintain 4200m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方556，通播P生效，下降保持4200米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200m, information P, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4200米，通播P，东方556。

cards.audioText: B: [You find the cumuliform clouds ahead; request turn left direct to HG. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你发现前方有积雨云，请求左转直飞HG。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, Request turn left direct to HG due CBs ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方556，前方有积雨云，请求左转直飞HG。

cards.audioText: C: CES556, Airspace restriction canceled. Turn left heading 220. Radar vector ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方556，空域限制取消。左转航向220。雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, radar vector ILS approach runway 36R, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向220。雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右，东方556。

cards.audioText: C: CES556, turn right heading 330, descend and maintain 900m ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方556，右转航向330，下降保持900米，盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900m, turn right heading 330, ILS approach runway 36R, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，右转航向330，盲降进近跑道36右，东方556。

cards.audioText: B: [While intercepting the localizer, the drunk passenger discharges the fire extinguisher. The purser make an emergency call said there is still passenger standing in the cabin. Inform the Wuhan Approach the situation and request terminate the approach, proceed to the holding area.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【切入航道时，该醉酒乘客打开灭火器。接到乘务长的紧急呼叫，说仍有乘客站在客舱里。通知武汉进近该情况，请求中止进近，继续进入等待区。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, request terminate the approach and hold due passenger discharges the fire extinguisher and some passengers standing in the cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方556，一名乘客打开灭火器，还有一些乘客站在客舱里，请求中止进近并等待。

cards.audioText: C: CES556, direct to DA, climb and maintain 1200m, expect further clearance time 50.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，直飞DA，上升保持1200米，预计抄收进一步许可时间为50分。
cards.referenceText: Direct to DA, climb and maintain 1200m, copy time 50, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞DA，上升保持1200米，抄收时间50分，东方556。

cards.audioText: B: [Now the problematic passenger has been properly restrained. Advice the Approach you are ready to leave the hold. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【该问题乘客已被适当控制。告诉进近你已准备好离开等待区。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES556, request leave the hold and continue approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方556，请求离开等待区继续进近。

cards.audioText: [Your call-sign is CES5227, from Wuhan to London Heathrow. Now you are at gate 26, information F, request your ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方5227，从武汉到伦敦希斯罗。你现在在26号机位，通播F，请求管制许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5227, gate 26, information F, request ATC clearance to London Heathrow.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方5227，26号机位，通播F，请求飞往伦敦希斯罗的管制许可。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Delivery, you are cleared to your destination via flight planed route, runway in use 04, HZ-02D departure, initial climb to 600m, cruising level 10700m, squawk 3532, departure frequency 126.3.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉放行，你可以经由计划航路飞往目的地，使用跑道04，HZ-02D离场，初始爬升到600米，巡航高度10700米，应答机3532，离场频率126.3。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to destination via flight planed route, runway in use 04, HZ-02D departure, initial climb to 600m, cruising level 10700m, squawk 3532, departure frequency 126.3, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往目的地，使用跑道04，HZ-02D离场，初始爬升到600米，巡航高度10700米，应答机3532，离场频率126.3，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [Contact Wuhan Ground and request your taxi clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系武汉地面，请求滑行许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5227, request taxi instruction.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方5227，请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Ground, taxi to holding point of runway 04 via A4, E2, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉地面，经由滑行道A4，E2滑行到跑道04外等待点，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point of runway 04 via A4, E2, hold short of runway 36R, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A4，E2滑行到跑道04外等待点，在跑道36右外等待，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [You are holding short of runway 36R on E2, request cross runway 36R, contact Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在跑道36右外等待点E2上，请求穿越跑道36右，联系塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5227, holding short of runway 36R on E2, request cross runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5227，跑道36右外等待点E2上，请求穿越跑道36右。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Tower, roger, cleared to cross runway 36R, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉塔台，收到，可以穿越跑道36右，脱离后报。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to cross runway 36R, wilco, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以穿越跑道36右，照办，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [You are at holding point of runway 04, request departure clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在跑道04外等待点，请求离场许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5227, holding point of runway 04, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5227，跑道04外等待点，请求离场。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Tower, after airborne, fly runway heading to 600m, follow SID fly to HZ, when airborne contact 126.3, cleared for takeoff, runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉塔台，离地后，跑道航向上到600米，按照标准离场程序飞往HZ，离地后，联系126.3，可以起飞，跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Runway heading to 600m, follow SID fly to HZ, 126.3, cleared for takeoff, runway 04, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道航向上到600米，按照标准离场程序飞往HZ，126.3， 可以起飞，跑道04，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [During climb, your trailing flaps cannot be fully retracted, contact Departure, state your situation and request fly to the holding area to perform checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【爬升过程中，你的后襟翼不能完全收上，联系离场，说明你的情况并请求飞到等待区执行检查单。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES5227, trailing flaps cannot be fully retracted, request fly to the holding area to perform checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方5227，后襟翼不能完全收上，请求飞到等待区执行检查单。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Departure, hold over LKO VOR 130 radial, inbound track 085, 30-40 miles legs, right hand pattern at 2700m.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉离场，在LKO台130度径向线等待，入航航迹085度，航段30-40海里，右等待，高度2700米。
cards.referenceText: Hold over LKO VOR 130 radial, inbound track 085, 30-40 miles legs, right hand pattern at 2700m, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在LKO台130度径向线等待，入航航迹085度，航段30-40海里，右等待，高度2700米，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [After you finish the checklist, you cannot fix the flaps problem, you want to request another approach, inform Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在完成检查表后，你依然无法解决襟翼问题，你想申请再次进近，通知离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES5227, we cannot fix the flaps problem, request another approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方5227，我们无法解决襟翼问题，请求再次进近。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Departure, roger. Then fly heading 300, and this will vector you to join right hand downwind for runway 04. Contact Tower 118.025.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉离场，收到。航向300度，这将引导你加入跑道04右三边。联系塔台118.025。
cards.referenceText: Fly heading 300, to right hand downwind for runway 04, contact Tower 118.025, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航向300度，加入跑道04右三边，联系塔台118.025，东方5227。

cards.audioText: [Because you can not fully extend the flaps, ask for the longest available runway from Tower controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【因为你不能完全展开襟翼，请向塔台管制员申请最长可用跑道。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5227, we can not fully extend the flaps, request the longest available runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5227，我们无法完全展开襟翼，申请最长可用跑道。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Tower, roger. You are cleared to land on runway 04L, which is 3600 meters in length. Wind 030 at 8 knots, visibility 10 kilometers.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5227，武汉塔台，收到。你可以在跑道04左降落，跑道长3600米。风速030度，8节，能见度10公里。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land on runway 04L, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆，跑道04左，东方5227。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Tower. Continue your approach and report final.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉塔台，继续进近，五边后报。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, wilco, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，照办，东方5227。

cards.audioText: B: [You’re the pilot of CES5325, which is bound for Wuhan. You’ve just been handed over from Hefei Control. You’re over IKUBA at 23, and your level is at 8400m, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你是东方5325的飞行员，目的地武汉。你刚刚从合肥区调交接过来。你23分过IKUBA，高度8400米，呼叫武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, over IKUBA at 23, maintain 8400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南方5325，23分过IKUBA，正保持8400米。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, radar identified, descend to and maintain 6000m, report reaching.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，雷达看见了，下6000米保持，到达后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 6000m, wilco, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下6000米保持，将照办，东方5325。

cards.audioText: B: [You’ve just followed your TCAS RA instruction. You’ve stopped your descent at nearly 6800m, and track out 9km right of the course, report to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你已执行了TCAS RA指令。你已停止下降，高度维持在约6800米，并偏航右转偏离原航线9公里，现向空管报告。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, our TCAS instructed us to stop descent at 6800m, and we are tracking out 9km right of the course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方5325，TCAS指示我们在6800米停止下降，我们偏航右转偏离原航线9公里。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, CES5325, you’ve just passed the traffic, descend to 6000m and turn left heading 170 immediately, there is military activity in the area right now.
cards.audioTextZh: C：收到，东方5325，你刚刚过冲突航空器，立刻下6000米并左转航向170，该区域目前有军事活动。
cards.referenceText: Roger, descend to 6000m and turn left heading 170 immediately, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，立刻下6000米并左转航向170，东方5325。

cards.audioText: B: [You hear a loud bang, it seems that the left wing has been hit by something, and you feel the airplane has banking tendency. Declare Urgency to ATC and request priority landing and emergency services.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你听到一声巨响，左侧机翼似乎被异物击中，且飞机出现倾斜趋势。立即向空管通报紧急情况，请求优先着陆及地面应急服务待命。】
cards.referenceText: PAN PAN, PAN PAN, PAN PAN, Wuhan Control, CES5325, the left wing was hit by some foreign objects. And the plane has a banking tendency. Request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: PAN PAN，PAN PAN，PAN PAN，武汉区调，东方5325，左侧机翼似乎被异物击中，且飞机出现倾斜趋势。请求优先着陆及地面应急服务待命。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, roger PAN, descend to and maintain 4800m, report over XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，收到PAN，下4800米保持，过XSH报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4800m, wilco, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下4800米保持，照办，东方5325。

cards.audioText:
C: CES5325, we’ve notified the other relevant parties, please give us more description about your present situation.
B: [Report to ATC that No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency. You guess there might be more damages to the left wing.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：东方5325，我们已通知相关单位，请详细描述你目前的状况。
B：【向空管报告：3号发动机已熄火，飞机倾斜趋势加剧，难以改平。推测左侧机翼可能还有更多损伤。】
cards.referenceText: No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency. We suspect there might be some more damages to the left wing, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 3号发动机已熄火，飞机倾斜趋势加剧，难以改平。我们推测左侧机翼可能还有更多损伤，东方5325。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, keep us advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，保持联系并随时通报情况。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，东方5325。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, maintain present level and contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，保持当前高度，联系武汉进近118.9，再见。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, 118.9, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，118.9，东方5325。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re over XSH at 4800m, call Wuhan Approach and inform them that you’re in distress now.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【现在你已经过XSH，高度4800米，联系武汉进近，告知他们你现在遇险了。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Approach, CES5325, we’ve been struck by foreign objects, No.3 engine flame out and the aircraft tends to bank, we are now passing XSH at 4800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，武汉进近，东方5325，我们被外物损伤，3号发动机熄火，飞机有倾斜趋势，我们现在已经过XSH，高度4800米。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, roger Mayday, the Center controller has told us your situation, you’ll have the top priority. Descend to 1200m on QNH1018, expect ILS approach runway 36R, you’re No.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，收到Mayday，区调已经告知我们你的情况，你享有优先权。下1200米，修压1018，预计盲降进近跑道36右，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1200m on QNH1018, expect ILS approach runway 36R, No.1, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下1200米，修压1018，预计盲降进近跑道36右，第一个，东方5325。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you want to verify the wind data, ask ATC to give detailed wind information.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在想证实风的信息。向管制员询问具体的风的信息。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, request wind information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方5325，请求风的信息。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, let me see, the latest ATIS shows, wind 310 degrees, at 11m/s, but it’s variable.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，最新的ATIS显示，风向310度，11米每秒，但是风向风速不定。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方5325。

cards.audioText: B: [You consider there might be some problems with you landing, so you ask ATC to provide emergency assistance upon your landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你认为着陆时可能会出现问题，所以，你向管制申请着陆时提供应急协助。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, request emergency assistance upon landing due to possible landing problems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方5325，由于着陆问题，请求在着陆时提供紧急协助。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, roger, fire services and ambulance will be ready upon your landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，收到，消防服务和救护车在你着陆时将就位。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方5325。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’ve fully established on the ILS runway 36R, call Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【现在你已经完全建立跑道36右的航向道，联系武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES5325, established on the ILS runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方5325，已经完全建立跑道36右的航向道。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，继续进近，联系塔台118.6，再见。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，联系塔台118.6，东方5325。

cards.audioText: B: [Now contact Tower, report to ATC that you are on emergency landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【现在联系塔台，报告管制员，你现在正在进行紧急着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5325, we are on emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5325，我们正在进行紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES5325, radar identified, continue ILS approach runway 36R, you’re No.1, report the outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方5325，雷达看见了，继续盲降进近跑道36右，你是第一个，外指点标报。
cards.referenceText: Continue ILS approach runway 36R, No.1, wilco, CES5325.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续盲降进近跑道36右，第一个，照办，东方5325。

cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is CES209, you are approaching VYK, maintaining 4500m, squawking 3125, make an initial contact with Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是东方209，你现在接近VYK，保持在4500米，应答机3125，与北京区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES209, approaching VYK, maintaining 4500m, squawking3125.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方209，接近VYK，保持在4500米，应答机3125。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, Beijing Control, radar contact, direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，北京区调，雷达看见了，直飞VYK，过VYK后，上8400米。
cards.referenceText: Direct to VYK, after passing VYK, climb to 8400m, CES209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞VYK，过VYK后，上8400米，东方209。

cards.audioText: N: [Your weather radar observed thunderstorm ahead, request Beijing Control for right turn to avoid the thunderstorm.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的气象雷达观察到前方有雷暴，向北京区调请求右转避开雷暴。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES209, thunderstorm ahead on radar, request right turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方209，雷达显示前方有雷暴，请求右转避开。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, negative due military activity, turn right heading 010.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，由于军事活动不可以，右转航向010。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 010, CES209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向010，东方209。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, turn left heading 350.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，左转航向350。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 350, CES209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向350，东方209。

cards.audioText: N: [Now there is a strong echo of thunderstorm, you are too close to the weather, request left turn to avoid it.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【雷暴有很强的回音，你距离雷暴太近，请求左转避让。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES209, we are too close to thunderstorm, request left turn to avoid it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方209，我们离雷暴太近，请求左转避让。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, left turn is not permitted due restricted area.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，由于限制区，禁止左转。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方209。

cards.audioText: N: [Suddenly, you have suffered from hail strike, your left windshield has cracked, report it to Beijing Control and request return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【突然，你遇到了雹击，你左侧的风挡破裂，将情况报告给北京区调，请求着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES209, hail strike and left windshield is cracked, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方209，雹击，左侧的风挡破裂，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, roger, turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 2400m.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，收到，右转航向340，直飞VYK，下到2400米保持。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, direct to VYK, descend to and maintain 2400m, CES209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向340，直飞VYK，下到2400米保持，东方209。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, descend to 2400m, contact Beijing Approach 119.25.
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2400m, 119.25, CES209.

cards.audioText: N: [Now you are maintaining 2400m, over VYK, you have got information K, contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你现在保持在2400米，过VYK，你收到通播K，联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES209, maintaining 2400m over VYK, information K.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方209，保持2400米，过VYK，通播K。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, Beijing Approach, radar contact, follow VYK05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，北京进近，雷达看见了，按照VYK05进场，预计雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Follow VYK05 arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36R, CES209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照VYK05进场，预计雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右，东方209。

cards.audioText: N: [During approach, neither of you can see through the windshield due to cracked windshield, you ask Beijing Tower for auto land.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【进近过程中，由于风挡破裂，你们两都无法通过玻璃看到外面，向北京塔台请求自动着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES209, neither of us can see through the windshield due to cracked windshield, request auto land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方209，由于风挡破裂，你们两都无法通过玻璃看到外面，请求自动着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, runway 36R, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，跑道36右，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared to land, CES209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，可以落地，东方209。

cards.audioText: N: [After landing, you can’t see the taxiway clearly due to cracked windshield, request a tug.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【着陆后，由于风挡破裂，你看不清滑行道，请求拖车。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES209, unable to see taxiway clearly due cracked windshield, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方209，由于风挡破裂，看不清滑行道，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: C: CES209, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C：东方209，原地等待，拖车马上来。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, roger thanks, CES209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，收到，谢谢，东方209。

cards.audioText: [You are maintaining 9200m, ETA JTN at 55, squawk 1532; make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机保持9200米，预计到达JTN时间55分，应答机1532；和武汉区调建立初次联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES586, 9200m maintaining, ETA JTN 55, squawk 1532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方586，保持9200米。预计到达JTN时间55分，应答机1532。

cards.audioText: CES586, Wuhan Control, radar contact, direct to TOL, confirm Mach number .79.[Tell controller you are maintaining Mach number .79. And read back instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，武汉区调，雷达已识别，直飞TOL，证实马赫数点79。【告诉管制员你在维持马赫数点79并复诵指令。】
cards.referenceText: Direct to TOL, affirm Mach number .79, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞TOL，证实马赫数点79，东方586。

cards.audioText: CES586, around TOL reported moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000m to 10400m. The alternative level is 11600m, report intention?[Tell the controller you can accept 11600m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，TOL附近报告有强烈晴空乱流，高度6000米至10400米。备用高度是11600米，报告意图。【告诉管制员11600米可用。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm 11600m, CES586.

cards.audioText: [You receive the report from cabin said that a drunk passenger is behaving irrationally affecting cabin services and disturbing cabin order. You suspect the higher cabin altitude make the passenger uncomfortable. You want to fly a lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你收到客舱报告，一名醉酒乘客行为异常，影响客舱服务，扰乱客舱秩序。你怀疑较高的客舱压力让该乘客不舒服。你想请求较低高度。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES586, request descent due passenger uncomfortable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方586，乘客不舒服，请求下降。

cards.audioText: CES586, maintaining 11600m due the airspace congestion. Reduce Mach number to .75.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，由于空域拥挤，保持11600米。减小马赫数到点75。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 11600m, reduce Mach number .75, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持11600米。减小马赫数到点75，东方586。

cards.audioText: [The passenger took out the overhead oxygen mask. He is being closely monitored. Report the situation to the controller and request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【该乘客拿出头顶上的氧气面罩。他被密切地监测。报告管制员该情况并请求下降。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES586, request descent. The passenger took out the oxygen mask and being monitored.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方586，请求下降。该乘客拿出氧气面罩，他已被监控起来。

cards.audioText: CES586, descend and maintain 6600m by XSH.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，下降保持6600米，过XSH。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 6600m by XSH, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持6600米过XSH，东方586。

cards.audioText: CES586, due to temporarily airspace restriction is effective immediately, after XSH, direct to ZF, expect ZF-03A Arrival. ILS approach runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，由于临时空域限制立即生效，过XSH，直飞ZF，预计ZF-03A进场，盲降进近跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: After XSH, direct to ZF, expect ZF-03A arrival. ILS approach runway 36R, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过XSH，直飞ZF，预计ZF-03A进场，盲降进近跑道36右，东方586。

cards.audioText: CES586, contact Wuhan Approach on 120.4.[Readback]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，联系武汉进近120.4。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach 120.4, CES586.

cards.audioText: [You have received ATIS O and is proceeding direct to ZF, maintaining 6600m. Call Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你收到ATIS O，继续直飞ZF，6600米保持。呼叫武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES586, maintaining 6600m, information O, direct to ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方586，6600米保持，通播O，直飞ZF。

cards.audioText: CES586, information P valid, descend and maintain 4200m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，通播P生效，下降保持4200米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200m, information P, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4200米，通播P，东方586。

cards.audioText: [You find the cumuliform clouds ahead; request turn left direct to HG. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你发现前方有积雨云，请求左转直飞HG。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES586, Request turn left direct to HG due cumuliform clouds ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方586，前方有积雨云，请求左转直飞HG。

cards.audioText: CES586, Airspace restriction canceled. Turn left heading 220. Radar vector ILS approach runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，空域限制取消。左转航向220。雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, radar vector ILS approach runway 36R, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向220。雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右，东方586。

cards.audioText: CES586, turn right heading 330, descend and maintain 900m ILS approach runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，右转航向330，下降保持900米，盲降进近跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900m, turn right heading 330, ILS approach runway 36R, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，右转航向330，盲降进近跑道36右，东方586。

cards.audioText: [While intercepting the localizer, the drunk passenger discharges the fire extinguisher. The purser make an emergency call said there is still passenger standing in the cabin. Inform the Wuhan Approach the situation and request terminate the approach, proceed to the holding area.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【切入航道时，该醉酒乘客打开灭火器。接到乘务长的紧急呼叫，说仍有乘客站在客舱里。通知武汉进近该情况，请求中止进近，继续进入等待区。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES586, Terminate the approach and request hold due passenger discharges the fire extinguisher and some passengers standing in the cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方586，中止进近，一名乘客打开灭火器，还有一些乘客站在客舱里，请求中止进近并等待。

cards.audioText: CES586, direct to DA, climb and maintain 1200m, expect further clearance time 50.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，直飞DA，上升保持1200米，预计抄收进一步许可时间为50分。
cards.referenceText: Direct to DA, climb and maintain 1200m, copy time 50, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞DA，上升保持1200米，抄收时间50分，东方586。

cards.audioText: [Now the problematic passenger has been properly restrained. Advice the Approach you are ready to leave the hold. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【该问题乘客已被适当控制。告诉进近你已准备好离开等待区。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES586, request leave the hold and continue approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方586，请求离开等待区继续进近。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CES582 from Wuhan to Beijing. Parking at Gate 223. When you are ready, request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方582，飞机从武汉飞往北京。停机位223号。准备好时，请求ATC放行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES582, Gate 223, destination Beijing request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方582，223号机位，目的地北京，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: CES582, Wuhan Delivery, standby one, I’ll check your flight plan.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，武汉放行，稍等，我要检查你的飞行计划。
cards.referenceText: Standing by, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，东方582。

cards.audioText: [Flight attendant told you passengers have boarded. All cargo doors are closed. Now report ready for clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【乘务员告诉你乘客登机完毕。货舱门已关闭。现在报告准备好。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES582, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方582，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: CES582 cleared to Beijing, via flight planned route ZF-03 departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 10700m, departure frequency 124.5, squawk code 3415.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，可以按计划航路放行到北京，ZF-03离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，离场频率124.5，应答机编码3415。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing, via flight planned route, ZF-03 departure, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 10700m, departure 124.5, squawk 3415, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往北京，ZF-03离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，离场频率124.5，应答机编码3415，东方582。

cards.audioText: CES582, read back correct, remain this frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，复诵正确，注意守听。
cards.referenceText: Wilco/remain this frequency, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办/守听，东方582。

cards.audioText: [5 minutes later, no call from Delivery, ask about duration and reason of the delay.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【5分钟后，未收到放行消息，询问等待时间及延误的原因。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES582, confirm duration and reason of the delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方582，证实延误时间和原因。

cards.audioText: CES582 due thunderstorm activity, flow control in effect. Expect 8min separation between each aircraft going same direction.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，由于雷雨活动，现在进行流量控制。同向飞机要保持8分钟间隔。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方582。

cards.audioText: [Heavy rain is starting to fall, accompany with thunder and lightning.]CES582, Delivery, airport will be temporarily closed. Thunderstorms on final. Expect delay until the weather improves we will inform you as soon as the airport open.
cards.audioTextZh: 【开始下大雨了，伴有雷鸣和闪电。】东方582，放行，机场将暂时关闭。五边有雷暴。预计要延误到天气好转，机场开放时会立即通知你。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方582。

cards.audioText: [One hour later, the weather is getting better and the airport is open. Now ask for your departure sequence.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【一小时后，天气好转，机场开了。现在向管制员询问你的离场顺序。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES582, request my departure sequence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方582，询问下我的离场顺序。

cards.audioText: CES582 you are currently No.1 in your direction. Expect about 20min delay. Contact Ground 121.8.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，目前你是你所飞方向的第一个。预计延迟20分钟。联系地面121.8。

cards.audioText: [Inform Wuhan Ground you are ready pushback and start-up.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知武汉地面你已经准备好推出开车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES582, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方582，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CES582, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, facing north.[You realize the tug is not in position yet. Advise Ground Control you need another 5 minutes to be ready.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，同意推出开车，头朝北。【你发现拖车没在。告诉地面指挥你还需要5分钟准备好。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES582, request another 5 minutes’ due tug not in position.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方582，由于拖车没到位，请求再等待5分钟。

cards.audioText: CES582 roger, standby push, I will call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，收到，稍等推出，一会儿叫你。
cards.referenceText: Standing by, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，东方582。

cards.audioText: CES582 Ground, confirm fully ready? We have a slot time for departure in 10 minutes.[You need to open the cabin door to add passenger food and drinks due to the long delay. Advise Ground you’ll need another 5 minutes for catering.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，地面，证实完全准备好了么？给你的离场是时间是10分钟之内。【由于长时间延误，你需要打开客舱门，装载乘客食物和饮料。告诉地面，你需要5分钟进行配餐。】
cards.referenceText: Request another 5 minutes due catering, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因为配餐，请求再推迟5分钟，东方582。

cards.audioText: CES582 roger, report ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，收到，准备好报告。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方582。

cards.audioText: [5 minutes later, catering completed. Call ready.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【5分钟后，配餐完毕。报告准备好。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES582, Request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方582，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CES582, pushback and start-up approved until abeam Gate 221. Do not block Gate 222, incoming traffic to that gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，同意推出开车，推到正切221号机位，不要挡住222机位，有进位飞机。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved until abeam Gate 221. Do not block Gate 222. CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，推到正切221号机位。不要挡住222机位。东方582。

cards.audioText: [Engine start completed, now request for taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【发动机启动完毕，请求滑行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES582, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方582，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CES582 can you accept E1 intersection for departure? Takeoff roll is available 3300 meters.[Tell tower you can accept.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方583，你能否接受从滑行道E1进跑道起飞？起飞可用滑跑距离3300米。【告诉塔台你能接受。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm we can accept E1 intersection for departure, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们能接受从滑行道E1进跑道起飞，东方582。

cards.audioText: CES582 roger, line up and wait runway 18L via taxiway E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，收到，从滑行道E1进跑道18左等待。
cards.referenceText: lining up and wait runway 18L via E1, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从滑行道E1进跑道18左等待，东方582。

cards.audioText: [Report to the Wuhan Tower that the aircraft in front of you is blocking E1.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告武汉塔台，前机挡住了滑行道E1。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES582, the aircraft in front of us block E1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方582，前方有飞机挡住了滑行道E1。

cards.audioText: CES582, roger. Break, break, CSN326, taxi forward to be clear of E1.[The aircraft moved, you are able to continue taxi and line up.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582，收到。还有，南航326，向前滑行，让开滑行道E1。【前机移动，你可以继续滑行上跑道等待。】
cards.referenceText: Tower, CES582, traffic is cleared, request continue taxi and line up runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 塔台，东方582，活动清除，请求继续滑行进跑道18左等待。

cards.audioText: CES582. Cleared for takeoff runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方582。可以起飞，跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff runway 18L, CES582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道18左，东方852。

cards.audioText: [You are CES615, from Wuhan to Shanghai Hongqiao airport. Gate 232, Information S, ask for ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是东方615，从武汉飞往上海虹桥机场。232号机位，通播S，请求ATC放行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES615, information S, destination Shanghai Hongqiao, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方615，通播S，目的地上海虹桥机场，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: CES615, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10100m, after departure contact 123.4, squawk 4125.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往上海虹桥机场，跑道36右，ZF-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10100米，起飞后联系123.4，应答机4125。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao, via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10100m, departure 123.4, squawk 4125, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往上海虹桥机场，跑道36右，ZF-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10100米，离场后联系123.4，应答机4125，东方615。

cards.audioText: [You found that the tow bar was not available, contact Ground for the tow bar.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你发现牵引杆无法使用，联系地面要一个新的。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES615, request a new tow bar due the tow bar not available.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方615，牵引杆不能使用，请求提供一个新的。

cards.audioText: CES615, roger. Tow bar is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，收到。牵引杆马上送到。
cards.referenceText: Thanks, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 谢谢，东方615。

cards.audioText: [You have already pushback and start-up, tell Ground you can taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经推出开车，告诉地面你可以滑行了。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES615, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方615，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CES615, taxi via Z4, A3, A to the holding point of A7.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，沿滑行道Z4，A3，A滑至滑行道A7的等待点。
cards.referenceText: Z4, A3, A to the holding point of A7, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道Z4，A3，A滑至滑行道A7的等待点，东方615。

cards.audioText: CES615, two cranes erected west of taxiway A, taxi with caution.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，滑行道A西侧有2辆起重机，小心滑行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES615
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，东方615。

cards.audioText: CES615, give way to A320 on A7. When it is clear, continue taxi to A, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，给滑行道A7上的A320让路。没影响后，继续滑行至滑行道A，跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Give way to the traffic on A7, after traffic cleared, taxi to A, hold short of runway 36R, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给滑行道A7上的A320让路。飞机没影响后，继续滑至滑行道A，跑道36右外等待，东方615。

cards.audioText: [The wind sock indicates strong tailwind, ask Tower to check the wind.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【风袋显示有强烈顺风，让塔台查看风向风速。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES615, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方615，核实风向风速。

cards.audioText: CES615, current wind 350 degrees at 6mps.[The wind is excess the company regulation of the takeoff wind speed; tell the controller you need to change the runway 36L.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，当前风350，6米/秒。【该风速超过公司规定的起飞风速；告诉管制员你需要更换至跑道36左。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES615, the wind excesses the company regulation. Request change runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方615，该风速超过公司规定。请求更换至跑道36左。

cards.audioText: CES615, change runway 36L approved, taxi to holding point 36L, via A, A2 and Z2.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，可以更换至跑道36左，沿滑行道A，A2，Z2滑行至跑道36左等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point 36L, via A, A2 and Z2, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道A，A2，Z2滑至跑道36左等待点，东方615。

cards.audioText: CES615, the takeoff aircraft ahead reported birds in the vicinity of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，前方起飞的飞机报告机场附近有鸟群。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，东方615。

cards.audioText: [You encountered bird strike and one of your engines failed, make an urgency call and ask to return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你遇到鸟击，一发失效，做紧急呼叫，要求返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, CES615, engine failure due bird strike, request return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉塔台，东方615，由于鸟击，发动机失效，请求返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CES615, roger PANPAN, climb and maintain 600m, turn right to join downwind, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，收到PANPAN，上升保持600米，右转加入左三边，可以盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 600m, right turn join downwind, ILS approach runway 36R, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持600米，右转加入左三边，可以盲降进近跑道36右，东方615。

cards.audioText: [Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to runway 36L.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【由于强烈顺风，你想更换至跑道36左。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES615, request change to runway 36L due strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方615，由于强烈顺风，请求更换至跑道36左。

cards.audioText: CES615, change to runway 36L approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, contact Approach on 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，同意更换至跑道36左，保持600米，右转直飞WHA，联系进近121.7。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36L approved, maintaining 600m, right turn to WHA, Approach 121.7, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意跑道36左，保持600米，右转直飞WHA，联系进近121.7，东方615。

cards.audioText: [Tell controller you are maintaining 600m, track fly to WHA on Approach 121.7.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉管制员你正保持在600米，飞往WHA，进近121.7。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES615, maintaining 600m, direct to WHA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方615，600米保持，直飞WHA。

cards.audioText: CES615, Wuhan Approach radar contact, climb and maintain 900m, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方615，武汉进近，雷达已识别，上升保持900米，飞过WHA后，航向360，雷达引导盲降进近跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 900m, after WHA, heading 360, radar vector ILS 36L, CES615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持900米，飞过WHA后，航向360，雷达引导盲降进近跑道36左，东方615。

cards.audioText: [You are the pilot of CES543 which is bound for Wuhan. You have just been handed over from Hefei Control, you are over IKUBA at 23, and your level is 8400m, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是东方543的飞行员，飞机飞往武汉。你刚从合肥区调转出，IKUBA时间23分，高度8400米，呼叫武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES543, IKUBA 23, maintaining 8400m, destination Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方543，IKUBA时间23分，8400米保持，目的地武汉。

cards.audioText: CES543, Wuhan Control, radar identified, descend and maintain 6000m, report reaching.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方543，武汉区调，雷达已识别，下降保持6000米，到达报。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 6000m, report reaching. CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持6000米，到达报，东方543。

cards.audioText: [You have just followed your TCAS RA instruction. You have stopped your descent at nearly 6800m and track out 9km right of the course. Report to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你刚刚执行了机上TCAS RA的指令。你在6800米停止下降并向右偏9千米，向ATC报告。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES543, our TCAS instructed us to stop descent and turn right to avoid traffic, maintaining 6800m, 9 km right of the course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方543，机上TCAS指示飞机在6800米停止下降并向右偏9千米。

cards.audioText: Roger, CES543, you have just passed the traffic, descend and maintain 6000m and turn left heading 170 immediately. There is military activity in the area right now.[You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，东方543，你刚躲避过活动，立即下降保持6000米，左转航向170。飞机位于军事活动区域内。【你需要复诵指令并表示感谢。】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 6000m, turn left heading 170 immediately, thanks, CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 立即下降保持6000米，左转航向170，谢谢，东方543。

cards.audioText: [You hear a loud bang, it seems that the left wing has been hit by something, and you feel the airplane has a banking tendency. Declare urgency to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你听到一声巨响，好像是左侧机翼撞到东西了，你觉得飞机有倾斜的趋势。向ATC报告该紧急情况。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CES543, the left wing was hit by some foreign object, and the plane has a banking tendency, request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，东方543，左侧机翼被异物袭击，飞机有倾斜趋势，请求优先着陆并提供紧急服务。

cards.audioText: CES543, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, descend and maintain 4800m, report passing XSH.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方543，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，下降保持4800米，过XSH报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4800m, report passing XSH, CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4800米，过XSH报告，东方543。

cards.audioText: CES543, Wuhan Control, we have notified the other relevant parties. Please give us more detail about your present situation.[Report to ATC that No.3 engine has flamed out and it is even harder to overcome the banking tendency. You guess that there might be some more damages to the left wing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方543，武汉区调，已经通知了有关部门。请详细告诉我们你当前的情况。【告诉ATC 3号发动机熄火，飞机很难克服倾斜趋势。你猜测左侧机翼可能还有更多的损伤。】
cards.referenceText: No.3 engine flameout and it became harder to overcome the bank tendency. Suspect the left wing damaged. CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 3号发动机熄火，飞机很难克服倾斜趋势。怀疑左侧机翼损坏。东方543。

cards.audioText: CES543, keep us advised.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方543，随时报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Wilco, CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方543。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over XSH at 4800m, call Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已飞过XSH，高度4800米，呼叫武汉区调。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES543, maintaining 4800m, over XSH.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方543，4800米保持，过XSH。

cards.audioText: CES543, maintain present level, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9, good day.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方543，保持当前高度，联系武汉进近118.9，再见。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, 118.9, good day. CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，118.9，再见，东方543。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over XSH at 4800m, call Wuhan Approach and inform them that you are in distress now.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已过XSH，高度4800米，呼叫武汉进近，通知他们你遇到危险。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CES543, left wing hit something, No.3 engine flameout and the airplane has banking tendency, we are now passing XSH, maintaining 4800m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY，武汉进近，东方543，左侧机翼受到撞击，3号发动机熄火，飞机有倾斜趋势，我们飞过XSH，4800米保持。

cards.audioText: Roger, the center controller has told us your situation, you will have the top priority. Descend and maintain 1200 m on QNH1008, expect ILS Approach runway 36R, you are number 1.[You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，中央管制告诉我们你的情况，你将优先着陆。下降保持修正海压1200米，修正海压1008，盲降进近跑道36右，你第一个。【你需要复诵并表示感谢。】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 1200m on QNH1008, ILS runway 36R, thank you very much, CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压1200米，修正海压1008，盲降进近跑道36右，非常感谢，东方543。

cards.audioText: [Now you want to verify the wind data, Ask ATC to give detailed wind information.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你想要核对风的信息，让ATC提供详细的风的信息。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES543, request detailed wind information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方543，请求提供详细风的信息。

cards.audioText: CES543, the latest ATIS shows, wind 310 degrees, 11 m/s, but variable.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方543，最新通播显示，风310，11米/秒，但变化不定。
cards.referenceText: Roger, CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方543。

cards.audioText: [You consider there might be some problem with your landing, so you ask ATC to provide emergency assistance upon your landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你觉得飞机着陆有问题，所以要求ATC在降落时提供紧急援助。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES543, request emergency assistance upon landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方543，请求着陆时提供紧急援助。

cards.audioText: CES543, Roger, fire services and ambulance will be ready upon your landing.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方543，收到，着陆时消防车及救护车都将准备好。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，东方543。

cards.audioText: [You have fully established on the ILS runway 36R, call Wuhan Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已完全建立盲降进近跑道36右，呼叫武汉进近。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES543, ILS fully established. Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方543，已建立盲降。跑道36右。

cards.audioText: CES543, continue approach and contact tower 118.6, good day.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方543，继续进近，联系塔台118.6，再见。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: 118.6, good day, CES543.

cards.audioText: [Contact Wuhan Tower, report to Air Traffic Control that you are a landing aircraft at emergency.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系武汉塔台，向管制员报告你需要紧急降落。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES543, we are emergency landing aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方543，我们是需要紧急降落的飞机。

cards.audioText: CES543, radar identified, continue ILS approach runway 36R, you are no. 1, report the outer marker.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方543，雷达已识别，继续盲降进近跑道36右，你第一个，过远台报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: ILS Approach runway 36R, report outer marker, CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 盲降进近跑道36右，过远台报告，东方543。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over the outer marker, call Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已过远台，呼叫武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES543, outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方543，过远台。

cards.audioText: CES543, cleared to land runway 36R, wind 300 degrees at 12 m/s, QNH1008.[You are required to read back the clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方543，可以降落跑道36右，风300，12米/秒，修正海压1008。【你需要复诵指令。】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, runway 36R QNH1008 CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆，跑道36右，修正海压1008，东方543。

cards.audioText: [You have just skidded off the runway but managed to stop the airplane on the grass strip, report to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你冲出了跑道，但成功地把飞机停在了草坪上，报告ATC。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES543, we have just skidded off the runway but managed to stop the airplane on the grass strip.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方543，我们冲出了跑道，但停在了草坪上。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CES5102, destination Beijing, 4800m maintaining, estimating DOGAR05, information F, now contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方5102，目的地北京，保持4800米，预计到达DOGAR时间为05分，通播F，现在联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, 4800m maintaining, estimating DOGAR05, information F.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方5102，保持4800米，预计到达DOGAR时间为05分，通播F。

cards.audioText: CES5102, Beijing Approach, DOGAR03 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 01, maintain 4800m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，北京进近，DOGAR-03进场，盲降进近跑道01，保持4800米。
cards.referenceText: DOGAR03 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 01, maintain 4800m, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: DOGAR-03进场，预计盲降进近跑道01，保持4800米，东方5102。

cards.audioText: [Flight attendants reported that a loud noise is coming from the backward right of the cabin, report this to the controller and request emergency descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【空乘人员听到客舱右后方一声巨响，把这一情况报告给管制员，请求紧急下降。】
cards.referenceText: (Mayday Mayday Mayday) Beijing Approach, CES5102, we have a loud noise coming from the cabin, request emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: （Mayday Mayday Mayday）北京进近，东方5102，我们听到客舱内一声巨响，请求紧急下降。

cards.audioText: CES5102, descend to and maintain 2100m on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，下降并保持2100，修正海压1012。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 2100m on QNH 1012, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持2100，修正海压1012，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, can you describe the sound in more detail?[It seems to be an outside air noise or a slight depressurization problem.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，可以具体描述一下那声巨响么？【似乎是外部空气噪音或轻微失压问题。】
cards.referenceText: It sounds like an outside air noise or a slight depressurization problem, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 听起来像是外部空气噪音或是轻微失压造成的，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, roger.[The engineers advised that it may be a problem with the door seal. They suggested you reduce speed to minimum, report to the controller.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，收到。【工程师说可能是舱门密封有问题。他们建议将速度降至最低，报告给管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, maybe a problem with the door seal. The engineers suggest we reduce speed to minimum.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方5102，可能是舱门密封有问题。工程师建议减速至最低。

cards.audioText: CES5102, affirm, do you require emergency service on arrival?[You have three passengers injured during emergency descent, so you will need medical service on arrival, require priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，同意，到达时需要紧急服务么？【紧急下降时有三名乘客受伤，所以到达时你需要医疗服务，并请求优先降落。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, we have three injured persons during descent. Request priority landing and require ambulance on arrival, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，下降时有三名乘客受伤。请求优先降落，到达时需要救护车，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, roger, you are number one, doctors and ambulance will be ready on arrival. [Request change runway 36R to save time.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，收到，你第一个，到达时医生和救护车都将准备好。【为了节省时间请求更换至36右跑道。】
cards.referenceText: No.1, request runway change to 36R, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一个，请求更换至36右跑道，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, Beijing roger, turn left heading 300, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，北京收到，左转航向300，雷达引导降落。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 300, radar vector for landing, ES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向300，雷达引导降落，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, the weather is deteriorating, say intentions. [Tell the controller you want to continue approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，恶劣天气状况，请示意图。【告诉管制员你想继续进近。】
cards.referenceText: Request continue approach, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求继续进近，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, descend to and maintain 900m, turn right heading 330, report established on localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，下降保持900米，右转航向330，建立航道报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 900m, turn right heading 330, report established on the localizer, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，右转航向330，建立航道报告，东方5102。

cards.audioText: [Report established on localizer 5 miles final RWY 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【跑道36右五边5海里航向道建立后报】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, established on localizer 5 miles final runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方5102，跑道36右，五边5海里航向道已建立。

cards.audioText: CES5102, continue approach and contact Beijing Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, 118.1, CES5102.

cards.audioText: [Report to Tower that you have established ILS.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告知塔台你已经建立了盲降。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES5102, established ILS.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方5102，建立盲降。

cards.audioText: CES5102, Beijing Tower, expect low visibility for your arrival, say intention.[You want to try landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，北京塔台，机场低能见，请示意图。【你想尝试降落。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request landing, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求着陆， 东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, continue approach, report outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，继续进近，过远台报告。
cards.referenceText: Report outer marker, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过远台报告，东方5102。

cards.audioText: [Over outer marker.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【过远台了。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES5102, outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方5102，远台。

cards.audioText: CES5102, cleared to land runway 36R, surface wind 160, 7m/s, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，可以着陆，跑道36右，地面风160，7米/秒，脱离后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36R, report vacated, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆，跑道36右，脱离后报告，东方5102。

cards.audioText: [You call sign is CES220, destination Pudong, over NIXAL 0025, level 12500m, estimate DOTOS 0035, next TODOM contact Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是CES220，目的地浦东。NIXAL上方0025，高度12500米，预计DOTOS 0035，下个报告点TODOM。联系北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES220, over NIXAL 0025, level 12500m, estimate DOTOS 0035, next TODOM.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方220，NIXAL上方0025，高度12500米，预计DOTOS 0035，下个报告点TODOM。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing Control, squawk 0077 radar contact, descend to and maintain 11900m.[Request 12500m to Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京区调，应答机0077雷达识别，下降保持11900米。【向北京区调请求高度12500米。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES220, request to maintain 12500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方220，请求保持12500米。

cards.audioText: CES220, cleared to maintain 12500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，可以保持12500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to maintain 12500m. CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以保持12500米，东方220。

cards.audioText: [The plane encounters a strong head wind, and fuel is running out, the warning light is on, request alternate to Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机遭遇强烈顶风，燃料正在耗尽，燃料示警灯亮了，请求备降北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Control, CES220, request alternate to Beijing airport, we are running out of fuel due to head winds en route, our fuel light is on.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京区调，东方220，请求备降北京机场，由于巡航途中顶风燃料快耗尽，燃料警示灯亮着。

cards.audioText: CES220, roger, report endurance.[Report that your endurance is about 1 hour and 30 minutes.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，收到，报告续航时间。【报告你的续航时间约为1小时30分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Endurance 0130, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 续航时间0130，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, roger.[You cannot divert or hold in case of any emergency, so request direct to Beijing airport and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，收到。【如果发生紧急情况你将无法备降或等待，所以请求直飞北京机场并优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CES220, request direct to Beijing airport and priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方220，请求直飞北京机场优先着陆。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, turn left heading 160, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，左转航向160，雷达引导着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 160, radar vector for landing, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向160，雷达引导着陆，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, descend to 8900m.[To save fuel, request maintain 12500m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，下降8900米。【为节省燃油，请求保持12500米。】
cards.referenceText: Negative, request maintain 12500m to save fuel, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，请求12500米保持以节省燃油，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, maintain 12500m approved.[You are now approaching KM, 4500m maintaining, expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, information I, now contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，同意12500米保持。【你正在接近KM，4500米保持，KM01进场，跑道36左，通播I，现在联系北京进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES220, 4500m maintaining, expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, information I.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方220，4500米保持，KM01进场，跑道36左，通播I。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing Approach, descend to 2100m on QNH 1011, turn right heading 110 join downwind. Reduce speed to 250kts.[Readback]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京进近，下降到修正海压2100米，修正海压1011，右转航向110加入三边，减速250节。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2100m on QNH 1011, turn right heading 110 join downwind. Reduce speed to 250kts, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 降到修正海压2100米，修正海压1011，右转航向110加入三边，减速到250节，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, reduce speed to 190kts.[There is something wrong with the spoilers. They are locked in position, request maintain 210kts.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，减速到190节。【飞机扰流板出现问题，被锁在原位，请求保持210节。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES220, request maintain 210kts. Something is wrong with the spoilers. They are locked in position.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方220，请求保持210节。飞机扰流板出现问题，被锁在原位。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, maintain 210kts. Report intention.[You intend to maintain 210kts, the minimum clean speed, and you are trying to extend the spoiler again.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，保持210节，报告意图。【你想保持最小光洁速度210节，并尝试再次打开扰流板。】
cards.referenceText: Request to minimum clean speed 210kts, and we are trying to extend the spoilers again, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求保持最小光洁速度210节，我们正在尝试再次打开扰流板，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, can you describe the problem further?[Tell the controller that you are sorting it out, probably hydraulic problem, or maybe steering system fault.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，你能进一步描述问题吗？【告诉管制员你正在检查，可能是液压问题，或是转向系统故障。】
cards.referenceText: We are sorting it out, suspect hydraulic problem, or steering system malfunctioned, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们正在检查，怀疑是液压问题，或转向系统故障，东方220。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, turn right heading 180, I will extend your downwind. Call me when you ready to turn in.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，右转航向180，我会延长你的三边，准备好转向五边通知。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, extended downwind, call you back, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，延长三边，稍后联系你，东方220。

cards.audioText: [2 minutes later.][You have solved the problem and can continue again.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【2分钟后】【你已经解决问题，现在可以继续进近。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES220, problem solved, request continue approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，东方220，问题已解决，请求继续进近。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, turn right heading 300 for base.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，右转航向300加入四边。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300 for base, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向300加入四边，东方220。

cards.audioText: [Report to Beijing Tower that you have established ILS.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【向北京塔台报告你已经建立盲降。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES220, established on ILS.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方220，已建立盲降。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing Tower, continue approach, report outer marker. [Over outer marker.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京塔台，继续进近，到外信标台报告。【到达外信标台上方。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES220, outer marker、
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方220，到外信标台。

cards.audioText: CES220, cleared to land, wind 330, 8m/s, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，可以着陆，地面风330, 8m/s，脱离后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, report vacated, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆，脱离后报告，东方220。

cards.audioText: [Request Beijing Tower to turn down the approach lights to grade 3, they look too bright from your aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【向北京塔台请求将进场灯的亮度调为3级，从机内看进场灯太过明亮。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CES220, request turn down the approach light to grade 3, they look too bright from here.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，东方220，请示调暗进场灯亮度到3级，在五边上看进近灯太亮。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, I will inform the ramp.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，我会通知机坪。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，东方220。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CES565, from Wuhan to Los Angeles, you are at gate 227, with information M, request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方565，从武汉到洛杉矶，你现在在227号停机位，通播M，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES565, gate 227, information M, request ATC clearance to Los Angeles.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方565，227号停机位，通播M，请求到洛杉矶的放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES565, cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, follow ZF-01D departure, runway 36L, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 10100m, squawk 5655.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方565，可以经由计划航路飞往洛杉矶，按照ZF-01d离场，跑道36左，初始爬升到1500米，巡航高度10100米，应答机5655。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Los Angeles via flight planned route, follow ZF-01D departure, runway 36L, initial climb to 1500m, cruising level 10100m, squawk 5655, CES565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往洛杉矶，按照ZF-01d离场，跑道36左，初始爬升到1500米，巡航高度10100米，应答机5655，东方565。

cards.audioText: [Now you are ready for pushback and startup, call Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在准备好推出开车了，呼叫地面]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES565, ready for push back and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方565，准备好推出开车了。

cards.audioText: CES565, after A340 behind, push back and start up, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方565，在A340之后，推出开车，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: After A340 behind, push back and start up, facing west, CES565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在A340之后，推出开车，机头朝西，东方565。

cards.audioText: [Now the pushback and startup is completed. Ask for taxi instructions.]
cards.audioTextZh: [现在完成推出开车，请求滑行指令]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES565, pushback and startup completed, request taxi instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方565，完成推出开车，请求滑行指令。

cards.audioText: CES565, taxi via Z4, C, C1 to holding point of runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方565，经由滑行道Z4, C，C1，跑道36左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, C, C1 to holding point of runway 36L, CES565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4, C，C1，跑道36左外等待, 东方565。

cards.audioText: [Now you are at the holding point of runway 36L, you are ready for departure, call Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在跑道36左外等待，你准备好离场了，呼叫塔台]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES565, holding point runway 36L, request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方565,36左跑道外等待，请求离场。

cards.audioText: CES565, behind CCA B747 on final, line up 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方565，在五边国航747的后面，上跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Behind CCA B747 on final, line up 36L, CES565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在五边国航747的后面，上跑道36左，东方565。

cards.audioText: Wind 350 degrees 2 meters per second, cleared to take off, runway 36L, after departure contact 125.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 风向350度，2米每秒，可以起飞，跑道36左，离场后联系125.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to take off, runway 36L, after departure contact 125.35, CES565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道36左，离场后联系125.35，东方565。

cards.audioText: [You are cruising at 3300m, you encountered the icing condition, request high level.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在巡航在3300米，你遇到积冰，请求高高度]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES565, maintaining 3300m, request high level due icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方565，在3300米保持，由于积冰，请求高高度。

cards.audioText: CES565, climb and maintain 9500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方565，上9500米保持。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 9500m, CES565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上9500米保持，东方565。

cards.audioText: [Suddenly, you got a warning, you are leaking bleed air and the cabin altitude are slowly rising. Inform the controller you want to be level and might expect emergency descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: [突然，你收到一个报警，你正出现引气泄漏，客舱高度正在慢慢变高，告诉管制员你希望改平，并可能会紧急下降]
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Wuhan Control, CES565, request leveling and expect emergency descent due bleed air leaking and cabin altitude rising.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，武汉区调，东方565，由于引气泄漏，客舱高度变高，请求改平，并可能会紧急下降。

cards.audioText: [The bleed air no longer supplies, high cabin altitude warning is triggered. Make an urgency call and tell the controller you want to make an emergency descent to 3000m and request radar vector.]
cards.audioTextZh: [引气停止供应，高客舱高度警告触发，宣布紧急情况，并告诉管制员你想紧急下降到3000米，并请求雷达引导]
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Wuhan Control, CES565, we will make an emergency descent to 3000m and request radar vectors due high cabin altitude warning.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，武汉区调，东方565，我们将紧急下降到3000米，由于高客舱高度告警，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText: CES565, roger, turn right heading 180, descend to 3000m, QNH1018.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方565，收到，右转航向180，下降到3000米，QNH1018。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend to 3000m, QNH1018, CES565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，下降到3000米，QNH1018，东方565。

cards.audioText: [Now you are reaching 3000m in icing condition, call Wuhan for landing information.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在到达3000米，遇到积冰，叫武汉，请求着陆信息]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES565, reaching 3000m in icing condition, request landing information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方565，到达3000米，遇到积冰，请求着陆信息。

cards.audioText: CES565, direct to HG, expect ZF-02A arrival, runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方565，直飞HG，预计ZF-02进场，跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HG, expect ZF-02A arrival, runway 36L, CES565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HG，预计ZF-02进场，跑道36左，东方565。

cards.audioText: [During approach, your slats cannot be extended, request the longer runway 36R and state the reason.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在进近过程中，你的缝翼无法打开，请求更长的跑道36右，并陈述原因]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CES565, request the longer runway 36R due to slats extension problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，东方565，由于缝翼打开问题，请求更长的跑道36右。

cards.audioText: CES565, roger, change runway 36R, maintain present heading, descend to 900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方565，收到，更改跑道36右，保持当前航向，下降到900米。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, maintain present heading, descend to 900m, CES565.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，保持当前航向，下降到900米，东方565。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CES568, gate 213, information W received, request ATC clearance from Wuhan.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方568,213号停机位，收到通播W，请求从武汉起飞的许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES568, gate 213, information W, request ATC clearance to Guangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方568,213号停机位，通播W，请求到广州的许可。

cards.audioText: CES568, cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, LKO-02 departure, initially climb to 1200m cruising level 9800m, contact 119.6.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方568，可以经由计划航路飞往广州，跑道36右，LKO-02离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，联系119.6。
cards.referenceText:
Cleared to Guangzhou via flight planned route, runway 36R, LKO-02 departure, initially climb to 1200m cruising level 9800m, contact 119.6, CES568.
题干中没有出现应答机，考试时也会有这样的情况，题干中没有说，就不需要复诵。
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往广州，跑道36右，LKO-02离场，初始爬升至1200米，巡航高度9800米，联系119.6，东方568。

cards.audioText: [Now you are pushing back with engines running, request taxi instruction.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在正在推出，发动机已启动，请求滑行指令]
cards.referenceText:
Wuhan Ground, CES568, pushing back with engines running, request taxi.
注：此题答案可直接简化为：Wuhan Ground, CES568, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方568，正在推出，发动机已启动，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CES568, taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方568，经由Z4,A3,A，滑行至跑道36右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point runway 36R. CES568.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4,A3,A，滑行至跑道36右等待点，东方568。

cards.audioText: CES568, give way to Air China A319 on taxiway A7, you are No.2.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方568，给在A7滑行道上的国航A319让路，你是第二个。
cards.referenceText: Give way to Air China A319 on taxiway A7, No.2, CES568.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给在A7滑行道上的国航A319让路，第二个，东方568。

cards.audioText: [You are at holding point of runway 36R, contact Tower for takeoff clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在跑道36右等待点，联系塔台，请求起飞许可]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES568, holding point of runway 36R, ready for/request departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方568，36右跑道等待点，准备好/请求起飞了。

cards.audioText: CES568, line up and wait, expect 1 min delay. There'll be a helicopter crossing the runway from left to right.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方568，上跑道等待，预计1分钟延误，一架直升机将从左到右穿越跑道。
cards.referenceText: Lining up and wait, CES568.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上跑道等待，东方568。

cards.audioText: CES568, wind 010 degrees 2 m/s, cleared for takeoff runway 36R. Caution storm north of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方568，风向010度，2米每秒，可以起飞，跑道36右，注意，机场北部有风暴。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff runway 36R, roger, CES568.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道36右，收到，东方568。

cards.audioText: [You are now at cruising level. You want to climb to 10400m to avoid turbulence. Ask Wuhan Control if 10400m is available and if there is any turbulence reported on that level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在到达巡航高度，你想爬升到10400米来避免颠簸。询问武汉区调，10400米是否可用，以及在此高度层是否有颠簸报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES568, confirm 10400m is available? And confirm any turbulence reported at that level?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方568，证实10400米是否可用？证实此高度是否有任何颠簸？

cards.audioText: [10400m is available and no turbulence reported on that level, request climb to 10400m.]
cards.audioTextZh: [10400米可用，在此高度没有颠簸报告，请求爬升到10400米]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES568, request 10400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方568，请求10400米。

cards.audioText: [You are now in Guangzhou Control, cruising at 10400m, because you are encountering the icing condition, you want to descend to a lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在进入广州区调管制区，在10400米巡航，由于你遭遇积冰情况，你想下降到更低高度]
cards.referenceText:
