Guangzhou Control, CES568, cruising at 10400m, request descent due icing.
注：除了使用参考答案中的cruising at 10400m报告高度信息外，还可以说成10400m maintaining或直接说10400m。
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，东方568，在10400米巡航，由于积冰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: CES568, descend to 4200m, maintain high speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方568，下降到4200米，保持高速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200m, maintain high speed, CES568.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到4200米，保持高速度，东方568。

cards.audioText: [You are now with Guangzhou Approach, you want to maintain high speed as long as possible to avoid ice accumulation. Tell ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在进入广州进近管制，你想尽可能长时间地保持最大速度来防止积冰堆积，告诉管制员]
cards.referenceText:
Guangzhou Approach, CES568, request maintain high speed as long as possible to avoid ice accumulation.
注：参考答案中的to avoid ice accumulation也可使用due icing condition来代替。
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，东方568，请求尽可能长时间地保持最大速度来防止积冰形成。

cards.audioText: CES568, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方568，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: No speed restriction, CES568.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有速度限制，东方568。

cards.audioText: [While on final approach, you notice the approach lights are too dim, ask the controller to increase the intensity of the approach lights.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在五边进近过程中，你注意到进近灯很暗，请求管制员增强进近灯光亮度]
cards.referenceText:
Guangzhou Tower, CES568, request brighten the approach lights.
注：表示增强亮度的词可以是:brighten/enhance the brightness/increase the brightness
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州塔台，东方568，请求调亮进近灯光。

cards.audioText: Roger, CES568, the approach lights will be turned up shortly. Cleared to land runway 27L, wind calm. Caution runway is wet, braking action medium.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方568，进近灯光马上会调亮，可以落地，跑道27左，静风。注意，跑道湿滑，刹车效应中等。
cards.referenceText:
roger, cleared to land runway 27L, braking action medium. CES568.
注：题干中的braking action medium--刹车效应中等属于情报，无需复诵。
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，可以落地跑道27左，刹车效应中等，东方568。

cards.audioText: [After landing, you find taxi is too difficult in poor visibility, ask Ground control for a follow-me-car.]
cards.audioTextZh: [着陆后，你发现在低能见度下滑行太困难，请求地面管制员派一辆引导车]
cards.referenceText:
Guangzhou Ground, CES568, it's difficult to taxi in poor visibility, request a follow-me-car.
注：参考答案中的 it's difficult to taxi in poor visibility可不说，或者用due bad weather/low visibility代替。
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州地面，东方568，在低能见度下滑行太困难，请求一辆引导车。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CES5118 from Wuhan to Beijing, parking at gate 223, now you are ready, request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方5118，从武汉飞往北京，现在停在223号停机位，你现在准备好了，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, gate 223, destination Beijing, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方5118，223号停机位，目的地北京，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES5118 standby one, I’ll check your flight plan.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，稍等，我检查下你的飞行计划。
cards.referenceText:
Standby, CES5118.
注：standby指的是“本频道稍等”，可直接回复standby。
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，东方5118。

cards.audioText: [The flight attendant tells you passengers have boarded. All cargo doors are closed. Now report ready for clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: [乘务员告诉你，乘客已登机，所有货舱门关闭。现在，报告自己准备好，请求许可]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, we’re fully ready, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方5118，我们完全准备好了，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: CES5118, cleared to Beijing, FL107, runway 18L, ZF11 departure, initially 900m, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，可以飞往北京，高度层107，跑道18左，ZF11离场，初始爬升至900米，离场频率120.6，应答机编码3021。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Beijing, FL107, runway 18L, ZF11 departure, initially 900m, departure frequency 120.6, squawk 3021, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以飞往北京，高度层107，跑道18左，ZF11离场，初始爬升至900米，离场频率120.6，应答机编码3021，东方5118。

cards.audioText: CES5118, read back correct, remain this frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118.复诵正确，长守该频率。
cards.referenceText: Roger, monitor, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，守听。东方5118。

cards.audioText: [5 minutes later, no call from Delivery, ask about duration and reason of the delay.]
cards.audioTextZh: [5分钟后，放行未呼叫，询问延误持续的时间和原因]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, confirm the duration and reason of the delay?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方5118，证实延误多久，延误的原因是什么？

cards.audioText: CES5118, due to thunderstorm activity, flow control is now in effect. Expect 8 minutes separation between each aircraft going same direction.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于雷暴活动，实施流量管控，飞往同一方向的飞机之间，预计有8分钟的间隔。
cards.referenceText:
Roger, CES5118.
注：题干内容为管制提供的情报（information），无需复诵，可用roger回答。
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，东方5118。

cards.audioText:
[Heavy rain is starting to fall, accompanying with thunder and lightning.]
All aircraft on my frequency, airport will be temporarily closed. Thunderstorms on final. Expect delay until the weather improves. Squawk ident if you copy this message.
cards.audioTextZh:
[开始下大雨，伴有打雷和闪电]
我频率上所有的航空器，机场将会暂时关闭。五边上有雷暴。预计延误直到天气变好。若收到此信息，应答机识别。
cards.referenceText:
Roger, squawking ident, CES5118.
注：实际运行中应答机识别只需做动作，无需回复。但在考试中，建议直接像参考答案一样回复管制的指令。
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，应答机识别，东方5118。

cards.audioText: [One hour later, the weather is getting better and the airport is open. Now ask for your departure sequence.]
cards.audioTextZh: [一小时后，天气变好，机场开放，现在，询问你的离场顺序]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES5118, request departure sequence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方5118，请求离场顺序。

cards.audioText: CES5118, you are currently No.1 in your direction. Expect about 20 minutes delay. Contact Ground on 121.8.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，你目前是你方向上第一个。预计延误20分钟，联系地面121.8。
cards.referenceText: Roger, 121.8, No.1, CES5118.

cards.audioText: [Inform ground you are ready for pushback and start.]
cards.audioTextZh: [告知地面，你准备好推出开车了]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方5118，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CES5118, push back approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，同意推出，机头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Pushback approved, facing north, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出，机头朝北，东方5118。

cards.audioText: [You realize the tug is not in position yet. Advise ground control you need another 5 minutes to be ready.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你注意到拖车没有就位。告知地面管制，你需要延误5分钟准备。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, tug is not ready, request 5 minutes delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方5118，拖车未就位，请求5分钟延误。

cards.audioText: CES5118, roger, standby for push, I will call you back.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，收到，稍等推出，一会呼叫你。
cards.referenceText: Standby, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，东方5118。

cards.audioText:
CES5118, are you fully ready now? We have a slot time for departure in 10 minutes.
[You need to open the cabin door to add passenger food and drinks due to the long delay. Advise Ground you will need another 5 minutes for catering.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方5118，你现在完全准备好了吗？我们10分钟后有一个离场时间。
[由于长时间延误，你需要打开客舱门，增加乘客餐食和饮料，告知地面，你还需要5分钟来进行配餐]
cards.referenceText: Negative, we need another 5 minutes for catering due long delay, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，由于长时间延误，我们需要5分钟来进行配餐，东方5118。

cards.audioText: CES5118, roger, report ready.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，收到，准备好后报。
cards.referenceText:
Wilco, call you back, CES5118.
注意：此处可以说wilco或者call you back。
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，等会呼叫你，东方5118。

cards.audioText: [Five minutes later, catering completed, call ready.]
cards.audioTextZh: [5分钟之后，配餐完成，呼叫已准备好]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, we are ready, request pushback.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方5118，我们准备好了，请求推出。

cards.audioText: Pushback approved until abeam gate 221. Do not block gate 222, there is incoming traffic to that gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 推出正切到221号停机位，不要堵塞222号停机位，有架航空器要进入该机位。
cards.referenceText:
Pushback approved until abeam gate 221, not block gate 222, roger, CES5118.
注：此处的推出指令较为复杂，但需要完整复诵，不可用wilco或者roger省略回答。
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出正切到221号停机位，不要堵塞222号停机位，收到，东方5118。

cards.audioText: [Engine start completed, now request for taxi.]
cards.audioTextZh: [发动机启动完成，现在请求滑行]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES5118, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方5118，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: CES5118, taxi via M, A, hold short of E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，经由滑行道M、A，在E1外等待
cards.referenceText: Taxi via M, A, hold short of E1, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道M、A，在E1外等待，东方5118。

cards.audioText:
CES5118, can you accept E1 intersection for departure? Take off roll is available 3300m.
[Tell tower you can accept.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方5118，你能接受从E1减跑道起飞吗？可用起飞滑跑3300米。
[告诉管制员你可以接受]
cards.referenceText: Affirm, E1 intersection for departure, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意，E1减跑道起飞，东方5118。

cards.audioText: CES5118, roger, line up and wait via taxiway E1.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，收到，通过E1上跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait via taxiway E1, runway 18L, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过E1上跑道等待，跑道18左，东方5118。

cards.audioText: [Report to the tower that the aircraft in front of you is blocking E1.]
cards.audioTextZh: [报告给管制员，前面的飞机堵塞了E1滑行道]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5118, an aircraft in front is blocking E1.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5118，前面的飞机阻塞了E1滑行道。

cards.audioText:
CES5118, roger, Break, break, CSN326, taxi forward to be clear of E1.
[The aircraft moved, you are able to continue taxi and line up.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，收到，断开，断开，南方326，向前滑行，脱离E1。[飞机移动了，你现在可以继续滑行并上跑道了]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES5118, request continue taxi and line up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方5118，继续滑行，上跑道。

cards.audioText: CES5118. Cleared for takeoff, runway 18L, initially maintain runway heading, climb to 1500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5118，可以起飞，跑道18左，初始保持跑道航向，爬升至1500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 18L, runway heading, climb to 1500m, CES5118.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道18左，跑道航向，爬升至1500米，东方5118。

cards.audioText: [Your callsign is CES243, an A320 is on T22 A arrival for runway 18L. You have been told to contact Wuhan Approach. You are 5 miles south of T VOR. You have a fire warning in the cockpit. You notice that the left engine is on fire.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方243，一架A320以T22-A进场，跑道18左。你被告知联系武汉进近。你在TVOR以南5海里。你的驾驶舱内部出现火警告警。你注意到你的左侧发动机失火了。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CES243, 5 miles south of T VOR, left engine on fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY，武汉进近，东方243，T VOR以南5海里，左发动机失火。

cards.audioText: CES243, roger MAYDAY, you are number one to the airport. Descend via T22 A Arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，收到MAYDAY，你第一个落地。通过T22-A下降。
cards.referenceText: No. 1, descend via T-22A Arrival, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一个，通过T-22A下降，东方243。

cards.audioText:
CES243, when able state fuel on board and POB.
[Tell the controller you have 8000kg fuel on board and POB is 161.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方243，方便的时候，报告机上燃油和人员。
[告诉管制员，机上燃油8000千克，人员161。]
cards.referenceText: We have 8000kg fuel on board and POB is 161, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们有8000千克燃油，机上人员161，东方243。

cards.audioText: CES243, when able squawk 7700
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，方便的时候，应答机7700。
cards.referenceText: Squawk 7700, CES243.

cards.audioText: CES243, turn to heading 020 for a short vector around VFR traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，航向020，短引导绕过目视飞行航空器。
cards.referenceText: Heading 020, short vector, traffic in sight, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航向020，短引导，冲突可见，东方243。

cards.audioText: CES243, emergency equipment will be standing by when you land.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，当你落地时，紧急设备将随时待命。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，东方243。

cards.audioText:
CES243, contact tower on 135.00 when you turn final. You are cleared visual approach runway 18 left or right, your choice.
[Tell controller you will take runway 18L.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方243，当你转向五边的时候，联系塔台135.00，你可以目视进近跑道18左或者18右，你的选择是？
[告诉管制员，你将使用跑道18左。]
cards.referenceText: Request runway 18L, contact Tower 135.00, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求跑道18左，联系塔台135.00，东方243。

cards.audioText: [During the descent to the airport, your flight attendant informs you that a passenger in the cabin is very ill, possibly have a heart attack. Inform ATC of your additional medical emergency.]
cards.audioTextZh: 在向机场下降过程中，你的客舱乘务员告知你客舱中有一名乘客病得很严重，可能是有心脏病，告知管制员额外的医疗紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES243, we have a sick passenger on board, possibly heart attack, request medical assistance after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方243，我们机上有一名病重乘客，可能是心脏病，请求着陆后医疗协助。

cards.audioText: CES243, understand you also have a medical emergency, now traffic no factor, turn 30 right to resume the T 22A arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，明白你也有医疗紧急情况，现在无冲突航空器，右转30度，重新加入T22-A进场程序。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, turn 30 right to resume T-22A Arrival, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，右转30度，重新加入T22-A进场程序。

cards.audioText: [You have done the engine fire checklist and have successfully extinguished the engine fire. Tell the controller you are going to stop on the taxiway first and have emergency equipment approach the aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你完成了发动机起火检查单，并且成功扑灭了发动机起火。告诉管制员，你会首先在滑行道上停下，然后需要紧急救援设备接近飞机]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CES243, we are stopping on the taxiway, request emergency equipment approach us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，东方243，我们正在滑行道上停下，请求紧急设备接应。

cards.audioText: [After landing, tower confirms that there isn’t any smoke or fire visible from your left engine. Tell the ground controller to have the fire equipment follow you to the gate. Medical personnel ready to board the aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh: [着陆之后，塔台确认从你的左引擎没有看到任何烟或明火。告诉地面管制让消防设备跟着你到机位。医务人员准备登机]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES243, request fire service follow us to the gate, we hope medical personnel can wait us there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方243，请求消防设备跟着我们到机位，我们希望医务人员可以在那里等我们。

cards.audioText: CES243, taxi via A, H to gate. Medical personnel will meet you at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方243，通过滑行道A，H到停机位，医务人员会在停机位等你们。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via A, H to gate, thanks, CES243.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过滑行道A，H到停机位，东方243。

cards.audioText: You are CES2151, from Wuhan to Shanghai Hongqiao airport. Gate 232, Information S, ask for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方2151，丛武汉飞往上海虹桥，232号停机位，通播S，请求放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES2151, gate 232, information S, request ATC clearance to Shanghai Hongqiao
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，东方2151，232号停机位，通播S，请求飞往上海虹桥的许可。

cards.audioText: CES2151, cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF01 departure, initial altitude 1,800m, climb to 10,100m, after departure contact 123.4, squawk 4125.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，可以经由计划航路飞往上海虹桥，跑道36右，ZF01离场，初始高度1800米，爬升至10100米，离场后，联系123.4，应答机4125。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Shanghai Hongqiao, via flight planned route, runway 36R, ZF01 departure, initial altitude 1,800m, climb to 10,100m, contact 123.4, squawk 4125, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以经由计划航路飞往上海虹桥，跑道36右，ZF01离场，初始高度1800米，爬升至10100米，离场后，联系123.4，应答机4125，东方2151。

cards.audioText: You found that the tow bar was not available, contact Ground for the tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: 你发现拖杆不在位，联系地面，请求拖杆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES2151, request a tow bar due tow bar is not available.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方2151，由于拖杆不可用，请求拖杆。

cards.audioText: CES2151, taxi via Z4, A3, A to the holding point of A7.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，经由滑行道Z4，A3，A，滑行至A7等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to the holding point of A7, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A3，A，滑行至A7等待点，东方2151。

cards.audioText: CES2151, 2 cranes erected west of taxiway A, taxi with caution.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，滑行道A西面竖着两架起重机，谨慎滑行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，东方2151。

cards.audioText: CES2151, give way to A320 on A7. When it is clear, continue taxi to A, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，给A7处的A320让路，当与航空器解除冲突，继续滑行至A，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Give way to A320 on A7, when clear, continue taxi to A, hold short of runway 36R, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 给A7处的A320让路，当与航空器解除冲突，继续滑行至A，在跑道36右外等待，东方2151。

cards.audioText: The wind sock indicates strong tailwind, ask to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: 风袋显示有很强的顺风，请求确认风的情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CES2151, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，东方2151，请求校对风向风速。

cards.audioText: After airborne, you encountered bird strike and one of your engines failed, make an urgency call and ask to return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后，你遭遇了鸟击，你的一个发动机失效，做紧急通话，并请求返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CES2151, engine failure due to bird strike, request return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN,PANPAN,PANPAN，武汉离场，东方2151，由于鸟击，发动机故障，请求返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: CES2151, roger PAN, climb and maintain 600m, turn right to join downwind, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，收到PAN，爬升至600米保持，右转加入三边，可以ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 600m, turn right join downwind, cleared for ILS approach runway 36R, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至600米保持，右转加入三边，可以ILS进近，跑道36右，东方2151。

cards.audioText: Because of strong tailwind, you want to change to runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于强顺风，你想更改到跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES2151, request change to runway 18L due to strong tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方2151，由于强顺风，请求更改到跑道18左。

cards.audioText: CES2151, change to runway 18L is approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, contact approach on 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，同意更改到18左，保持在600米，右转至WHA，联系进近121.7。
cards.referenceText: Runway 18L, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, 121.7, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道18左，保持在600米，右转至WHA，121.7，东方2151。

cards.audioText: CES2151, climb to 900m, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，爬升至900米，过WHA后，航向360，预计雷达引导ILS进近，跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 900m, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 18L, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至900米，WHA后，航向360，预计雷达引导ILS进近，跑道18左，东方2151。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is AFR101, your destination is Paris, you are going to depart from Beijing airport at Gate 301. Now call Beijing Delivery, and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是法航101，目的地巴黎，从北京出发，301号机位，现在联系北京放行，请求放行。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, AFR101, Gate 301, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，法航101，机位301，请求放行。

cards.audioText: AFR101, cleared to Paris, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600m, RENOB32 departure, request level change for 10400m en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，可以按计划航路放行至巴黎，起始高度6600米。RENOB32离场，在航路上申请巡航高度10400m，应答机1725，跑道36右，离场频率127.75。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Paris, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600m, RENOB32 departure, request level change for 10400m en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至巴黎，起始高度6600米，RENOB32离场，航路申请更改巡航10400米，应答机1725，跑道36右，离场频率127.75，法航101。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is QFA029, your destination is Dubai, you are going to depart from Beijing airport at Gate 302. Now call Beijing Delivery, and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是QFA（澳航）029，目的地是迪拜，你正准备从北京机场302机位出发。现在联系北京放行并请求ATC许可。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, QFA029, Gate 302, request ATC clearance to Dubai.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，澳航029，机位302，请求飞往迪拜的管制许可。

cards.audioText: QFA029, Beijing Delivery, cleared to Dubai, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600m, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 11000m en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航029，北京放行，可以按计划航路飞往迪拜，起始高度6600米，RENOB 32离场，更改巡航高度11000米在航路上申请，应答机1725，跑道36R，离场频率127.75。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Dubai, via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600m, RENOB 32 departure, request level change for 11000m en route, squawk 1725, runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75. QFA029.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路飞往迪拜，起始高度6600米，按RENOB 32离场，改变高度11000米在航路上申请，应答机1725，跑道36R，离场频率127.75，澳航029。

cards.audioText: [You are the pilot of CSN6306 which is bound for Dalian. You are going to depart from Shanghai airport at Gate 23. Now call Delivery, and request your ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是航班CSN6306的飞行员，飞机飞往大连。你正在上海机场23号停机位准备出发，现在联系放行并请求放行许可。】
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Delivery, CSN6306, destination Dalian, Gate 23, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海放行，南航6306，目的地大连，23号门，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: CSN6306, Shanghai Delivery, copy clearance, cleared to Dalian, via flight planned route, D2 Departure, initial climb to 900m. Request level change en route, squawk 4736.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6306，上海放行，抄收放行许可，可以按计划航路飞往大连，按D2离场，起始高度900米。在航路上申请改变高度，应答机4736。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Dalian, via flight planned route, D2 Departure, initial climb to 900m. Request level change en route, squawk 4736, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路飞往大连，D2离场，起始高度900米。在航路上申请改变高度，应答机4736.

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is AFR151. You are at Wuhan airport, at Gate 215, information G received, request ATC clearance to Paris.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是法航151，在武汉机场，215号机位，收到通播G，向ATC申请放行至巴黎。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR151, Gate 215, information G, destination Paris, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，法航151，215号机位，通播G，目的地巴黎，申请ATC放行许可。

cards.audioText: AFR151, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, runway 04, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10700m, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 2521.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往巴黎，LKO-01号离场，跑道04，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10700米，离场频率119.7，应答机2521。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, runway 04, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10700m, 119.7, squawk 2521, AFR151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至巴黎，LKO-01号离场，跑道04，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10700米，119.7，应答机2521，法航151。

cards.audioText: [You are BAW951, at Stand 709, with information L, call Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance to London.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你是英航951，709号机位，通播L，呼叫武汉放行，请求放行至伦敦。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, BAW951, Parking bay 709, information L, destination London, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，英航951，停机位709，通播L，目的地伦敦，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: BAW951, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to London, via flight planned route. ZF-05D departure, initially climb 1500m, cruising level 10700m. Runway 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往伦敦。ZF-05D离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，跑道18左，离场联系124.7，应答机4503。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London, flight planned route, SID ZF-05D, initial climb 1500m, cruising level 10700m, runway 18L, after departure contact 124.7, squaw 4503. BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往伦敦。ZF-05D离场，起始高度1500米，巡航高度10700米，跑道18左，离场联系124.7，应答机4503，英航951。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CCA532, you are at Wuhan airport, Gate 211, information V received, request ATC clearance to Changsha.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航532，你在武汉机场，211号机位，收到通播V，请求ATC放行至长沙。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CCA 532, Gate 211, information V, destination Changsha, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，国航532，211号机位，通播V，目的地长沙，请求ATC放行。

cards.audioText: CCA532, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 8400m, runway 04, contact Departure on 119.7, squawk 2016.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航532，武汉放行，可以按计划航路放行至长沙，LKO-02离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度8400米，跑道04，联系离场119.7，应答机2016。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Changsha via flight planned route, LKO-02 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 8400m, runway 04, Departure 119.7, squawk 2016, CCA532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往长沙，LKO-02离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度8400米，跑道04，联系离场119.7，应答机2016，国航532。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CES582 from Wuhan to Beijing. Parking at Gate 223. When you are ready, request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方582，飞机从武汉飞往北京。停机位223号。准备好时，请求ATC放行。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CES582, Gate 223, destination Beijing request ATC clearance.

cards.referenceTextZh: 可以从E2进行减跑道起飞，经由A6,A,A2，滑行至E2，跑道18左外等待，新航852。

cards.audioText: CSN319, taxi via Z4, A3, A, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方319，经由滑行道Z4,A3,A，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A, hold short of runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4,A3,A，在跑道36右外等待，南方319。

cards.audioText: CSN371, taxi to holding point runway 04 via F, A9, hold short of A.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方371，经由滑行道F，A9滑行到跑道04，在A外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via F, A9, hold short of A. CSN371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道F，A9滑行到跑道04，在A外等待，南方371。

cards.audioText: CES2151, taxi via Z4, A3, A to the holding point of A7.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，经由滑行道Z4，A3，A，滑行至A7等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to the holding point of A7, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A3，A，滑行至A7等待点，东方2151。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, taxi via A4, A3, C, hold short of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，经由滑行道A4，A3, C，在跑道36右外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via A4, A3, C, hold short of runway 36R, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A4，A3, C，在跑道36右外等待，南方6682。

cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to the holding point of runway 19.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方9302，经由滑行道J，D，T3和T4滑行到跑道19外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via J, D, T3 and T4 to the holding point of runway 19, CSN9302.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道J，D，T3和T4滑行到跑道19外等待点，南方9302。

cards.audioText: C: SIA308, Wuhan Ground, taxi via taxiway Z4, A2, A to the holding point of E5 runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 新航308，武汉地面，经由滑行道Z4，A2和A滑行到跑道04外等待点E5。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z4, A2, A to the holding point of E5 runway 04, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A2和A滑行到跑道04外等待点E5，新航308。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3001, taxi via taxiway T4, P1 to the holding point of runway 02L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3001，经由滑行道T4，P1，滑行到跑道02左外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway T4, P1 to the holding point of runway 02L, CSN3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道T4，P1，滑行到跑道02左外等待点，南方3001。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, expedite cross runway 36, taxi via taxiway Z5, A4 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，加速穿越跑道36，经由滑行道Z5，A4和A滑行。
cards.referenceText: Expedite cross runway 36, taxi via taxiway Z5, A4 and A, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 加速穿越跑道36，经由滑行道Z5，A4和A滑行，东方769。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，经由滑行道Z4，A3和A，滑行到跑道04外等待点，在E5等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 04 via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, hold short of E5, ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A3和A，滑行到跑道04外等待点，在E5等待，加航521。

cards.audioText: C: CSN1310, roger, taxi via taxiway Z0, F2, F and W3 to the holding point of runway 36R. Taxi with caution, taxiway F is partially flooded.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方1310，收到，经由滑行道Z0，F2，F和W3滑行到跑道36右外等待点。谨慎滑行，滑行道F上有部分积水。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway Z0, F2, F and W3 to the holding point of runway 36R, roger caution, CSN1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z0，F2，F和W3滑行到跑道36右外等待点，收到谨慎，南方1310。

cards.audioText: [As you are taxiing on taxiway A3, you noticed several baggage are scattered on A3 about 400 meters ahead of your aircraft. Tell Ground Control why you have stopped taxiing and ask ground staff to retrieve the baggage.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在滑行道A3上滑行时，你发现机身前方400米处散落着几件行李。告诉地面管制你为什么停止滑行，要求地面工作人员收走行李。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, QFA953, we found several baggage scattered on A3. We stop taxi and holding present position, request ground service to retrieve the baggage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，澳航953，我们发现滑行道A3上散落着几件行李。我们停止滑行，原地等待，请求地面工作人员收走行李。

cards.audioText: CCA937, taxi to Gate 213 via M, M3, Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航937，沿滑行道M，M3，Z4滑回213号机位。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to Gate 213 via M, M3, Z4, CCA937.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道M，M3，Z4滑回213号机位，国航937。

cards.audioText: 4C: CES728, taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方728，经由滑行道Z4，A3，A滑行至跑道36右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point runway 36R, CES728.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道Z4，A3，A滑行至跑道36右外等待点，东方728。

cards.audioText: ATC: AFR9939, Wuhan Ground, taxi via A1, A, M, to holding point M2. Caution work in progress at right side of M.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航9939，武汉地面，经由滑行道A1，A和M，滑行至M2等待点，注意M右侧有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via A1, A, M, to holding point M2, roger caution, thanks, AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A1，A和M，滑行至M2等待点，收到，谨慎滑行，法航9939。

cards.audioText: CSN817, taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方817，经由Z4，A3，A滑行至跑道36右外等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via Z4, A3, A to holding point of runway 36R, CSN817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z4，A3，A滑行至跑道36右外等待点，南方817。

cards.audioText: KLM88, taxi via taxiway Z, Z4, A2, E2 and M1 to the holding point of runway 35, taxi with caution due workmen near taxiway Z.
cards.audioTextZh: 荷航88， 经由Z，Z4，A2，E2，M1，滑行至35跑道等待点，谨慎滑行，滑行道Z附近有工人。
cards.referenceText: Roger. Taxi via taxiway Z, Z4, A2, E2, M1 to the holding point of runway 35, thanks, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由Z，Z4，A2，E2，M1滑行至35跑道外等待点，谢谢，荷航88。

cards.audioText: AFR332, taxi via taxiway A3, A, E5 to the holding point of runway 22. Taxi with caution, the taxiway is slippery due to the heavy rain.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航332，经由滑行道A3，A，E5滑至跑道22外等待点，谨慎滑行，由于大雨，滑行道湿滑。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway A3, A, E5 to the holding point of runway 22, roger caution, AFR332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道A3，A，E5滑至跑道22外等待点，收到提醒，法航332。

cards.audioText: C: QFA432,,taxi via F, C1 and B to holding point runway 26. Caution work in progress at the end of gate 319.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航432，经由滑行道F，C1和B滑行至跑道26等待点。注意机位319尽头有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via F, C1, B to holding point runway 26, roger caution, QFA432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道F，C1和B滑行至跑道26等待点，收到。

cards.audioText: CCA985, taxi via taxiway C, M, A to holding point runway 04. Hold short of Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航985，经由滑行道C、M、A，滑行至跑道04，在Z4等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via taxiway C, M, A to holding point runway 04. Hold short of Z4. CCA985.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由滑行道C、M、A，滑行至跑道04，在Z4等待，国航985。

cards.audioText: AFR101, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000m on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，北京离场，已识别，上升标压6000米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 6000m on standard, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升标压6000米，法航101。

cards.audioText: [Flight attendant reports that there is a man carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them. Require emergency descent to 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【机组人员报告称有一名男子身上携带爆炸物，并试图引爆它。请求紧急下降至3000米。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Departure, AFR101, request descent to 3000m, a man is attempting to detonate explosives strapped to his body, the flight attendants are trying to get him under control.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，北京离场，法航101，请求下降至3000米，一名男子试图引爆绑在身上的爆炸物，机组人员正在试图控制他。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, descend to 3000m on QNH 1011. Say endurance. [Readback and report that you can hold for 2 hours more.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到，下降到3000，修压1011，报告续航时间。【复诵并报告你可以坚持2个多小时。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000m on QNH 1011, endurance 2 hours, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到3000，修压1011，续航时间2小时，法航101。

cards.audioText: JAL220, maintain present heading and descend to 5100m, contact Approach 112.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，保持当前航向，下到5100米，联系进近112.5。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading and descend to 5100m, contact 112.5, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，下到5100米，联系进近112.5，日航220。

cards.audioText: During the descend, a flock of birds struck your aircraft and your windshield was broken. The cabin crew reported that the oxygen masks in the cabin dropped automatically. You asked for radar vectors to Wuhan airport for priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 在下降过程中，一群鸟撞到你的飞机，你的风挡玻璃破裂了。乘务员报告称，客舱的氧气面罩自动脱落。你请求雷达引导至武汉机场，进行优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, JAL220, we encountered bird strike during the descent. The windshield was broken. Oxygen masks fell down in cabin, Request radar vectors and priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉区调，日航220，我们在下降过程中遭遇鸟击。风挡玻璃破裂。氧气面罩脱落，请求雷达引导，优先着陆。

cards.audioText: JAL220, roger Mayday, descend to 5400m and contact Wuhan Approach on 115.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，收到Mayday，下降到5400米，联系武汉进近115.5。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5400m, contact Wuhan Approach on 115.5, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到5400米，联系武汉进近115.5，日航220。

cards.audioText: CES220, cleared to maintain 12500m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，可以保持12500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to maintain 12500m. CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以保持12500米，东方220。

cards.audioText: [The plane encounters a strong head wind, and fuel is running out, the warning light is on, request alternate to Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机遭遇强烈顶风，燃料正在耗尽，燃料示警灯亮了，请求备降北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Control, CES220, request alternate to Beijing airport, we are running out of fuel due to head winds en route, our fuel light is on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，东方220，请求备降北京机场，由于巡航途中顶风燃料快耗尽，燃料警示灯亮着。

cards.audioText: CES220, roger, report endurance.[Report that your endurance is about 1 hour and 30 minutes.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，收到，报告续航时间。【报告你的续航时间约为1小时30分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Endurance 0130, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 续航时间0130，东方220。

cards.audioText: Roger, CSN6306, runway 31 via taxiway D1 B1 and A12.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南航6306，经滑行道D1，B1和A12滑到跑道31。
cards.referenceText: Runway 31, taxiway D1 B1 and A12, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道31，滑行道D1，B1和A12，南航6306。

cards.audioText: [Now you are en route, the No.2 engine failed, call Shanghai Control to request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你在航路上，2号发动机故障，联系上海区调并请求下降。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Shanghai Control, CSN6306, engine failure on No.2, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, 上海区调，南航6306，2号发动机故障，请求下降。

cards.audioText: Roger, CSN6306, descend to 5400m initially.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南航6306，初步下降到5400米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5400m initially, CSN6306.
cards.referenceTextZh: 初步下降到5400米，南航6306。

cards.audioText: CCA991, negative due to Air Force restriction. Resume course as soon as able.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，由于空军限制区不可以，尽快归航。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, resuming course, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，归航，国航991。

cards.audioText: [You find smoke coming from engine bleed air system. Declare urgency to ATC, request lower level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你发现发动机引气系统有烟冒出，向ATC宣布紧急，请求更低高度。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Control, CCA991, smoke is coming from engine bleed system, request lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，发动机引气系统有烟冒出，请求更低高度。

cards.audioText: CCA991, Beijing Control, roger PANPAN, descend to and maintain 6900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，北京区调，收到PANPAN，下降保持6900米。
cards.referenceText: Wilco, descend to and maintain 6900m, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，下降保持6900米，国航991。

cards.audioText: SIA635, climb and maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航635，上升保持3000米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 3000m, SIA635.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持3000米，新航635。

cards.audioText: [The cabin crew reported that there’s smoke coming from the air condition system in the cabin, make an urgency call and advise approach you want to level off at present level.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【机组报告客舱内的空调系统冒烟了，做紧急呼叫，告诉进近你想在当前高度平飞。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Approach, SIA635, smoke in cabin, request maintain present level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，新航635，客舱冒烟，请求保持当前高度。

cards.audioText: [Smoke is removed, you have turned off the air condition system, you want radar vectors to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【烟清除了，你关闭了空调系统，需要雷达引导至武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Approach, SIA635, cancel PANPAN, request radar vector to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，新航635，取消PANPAN，请求雷达引导至武汉机场。

cards.audioText: UAL921, Shanghai Control, radar contact. Proceed direct to VMB.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，上海区调，雷达已识别。直飞VMB。
cards.referenceText: Direct to VMB, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞VMB，美联航921。

cards.audioText: [There is strong sound from cabin. Your instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly. Slow depressurization is suspected. Request immediate descent from 10700m to 3000m. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【座舱内有巨大声响。你的仪表显示座舱压力正在慢慢升高。疑似缓慢释压。请求立即从10700米下降至3000米。紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL921. There is slow depressurization in cabin, request descent from 10700m to 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，上海区调，美联航921，客舱缓慢释压，请求离开10700米下降到3000米。

cards.audioText: UAL921, roger PANPAN. Turn right heading 150. Initially descend and maintain 8900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航921，收到PANPAN。右转航向150。起始下降保持8900米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 150, descend and maintain 8900m, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向150。下降保持8900米，美联航921。

cards.audioText: ACA587, climb and maintain 10700m within 2min.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，上升保持10700米，2分钟到。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 10700m within 2min, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持10700米，2分钟到，加航587。

cards.audioText: [When you are at 10700m, left engine failed, make an urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6300m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你在10700米时，左侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，请求右转航行，并下降6300米。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA587, left engine failure, request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，广州区调，加航587，左侧发动机失效，请求右转，下降6300米。

cards.audioText: ACA587, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，收到PANPAN，右转航向200，下降保持6300米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 200, descend and maintain 6300m, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向200，下降保持6300米，加航587。

cards.audioText: AFR 151, Wuhan Control, negative due traffic, maintain 6000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉区调，高度没位置，保持6000米。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 6000m, AFR151.

cards.audioText: [Suddenly your left engine failed at 6000m, make an urgency call ATC, and request descent and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在6000米处左侧发动机突然失效，紧急呼叫ATC，请求下降并返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR151, maintaining 6000m, left engine failure, request descent and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉区调，法航151，保持6000米，左侧发动机失效，请求下降并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: AFR 151, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, descend and maintain 4200m, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for runway 04.[You successfully restart the left engine, decide to return to Wuhan. Inform ATC and cancel urgency.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航151，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，下降保持4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导跑道04。【你成功地重启了左侧发动机，决定返回武汉，通知ATC取消紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR151, cancel PANPAN, we have successfully restarted the left engine, request return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航151，取消PANPAN，我们成功地重启了左侧发动机，请求返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Control, climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉区调，上升保持5100米，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持5100米，没有速度限制，法航123。

cards.audioText: [During the climb, your port engine separated, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【爬升过程中，左侧发动机分离，告诉管制员这一情况，以及你想返回着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Wuhan Control, AFR123, our left engine falls, request to return to the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, 武汉区调，法航123，飞机左侧发动机脱落，请求返回机场。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Control, roger Mayday, descend and maintain 1800m on QNH1012, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉区调，收到Mayday，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 1800m, QNH1012, turn right heading 360. AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，右转航向360，法航123。

cards.audioText:
B: [Later.]
B: [You are now in Wuhan Control area. The purser reports that a 73-year-old woman in 35H suffers from stroke and is having a terrible headache. Report this situation to Wuhan Control and ask for landing priority. This is an emergency call.]
cards.audioTextZh:
【一会后。】
【你现在在武汉区调。乘务长报告说，35H座位上一名73岁的妇女中风，头痛得厉害。将此情况报告武汉区调，请求优先降落。这是紧急通话。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Wuhan Control, CSN3001, a 73-year-old woman in 35H suffers from stroke, and is having a terrible headache, request landing priority.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，武汉区调，南方3001，35H座位上一名73岁的妇女中风，头痛得厉害，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL887, Beijing Control, roger, report joining.
[Later...]
[A flight attendant reports that a pregnant woman is about to deliver a baby, and she is in severe pain. Inform Beijing Control the situation. This is an emergency call.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C:美联航887，北京区调，收到，加入后报。
【后来...】
【一名乘务员报告说一名怀孕乘客要生孩子，她现在疼得厉害。告知北京区调，这是一个紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Beijing Control, UAL887, a pregnant woman is on board is about to deliver a baby, she is in severe pain.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，北京区调，美联航887，一名怀孕乘客将要在飞机上生孩子，她现在疼得厉害。

cards.audioText: [You are now 8900m maintaining, about 10 miles from P344, you had electrical arcing on the windshield and your windshield seemed to be cracked on the outside. You want to divert to Hefei airport immediately. Report this situation to Shanghai control, this is an urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你正保持在8900米，距离P344大概10海里，你的风挡玻璃上有电弧，风挡玻璃似乎从外面裂开了。你要立即备降合肥机场。将此情况报告上海区调，这是紧急呼叫。】
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Shanghai control, BAW3532, 8900m maintaining, 10 miles from P344, our outer windshield seemed to be cracked due electrical arcing, request divert to Hefei.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，上海区调，英航3235，在8900米保持，P344 10海里，由于电弧，外侧风挡玻璃似乎破裂，请求改航合肥。

cards.audioText: N: [You are established contact, initiated descend for runway 36R. During descending, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal, possibly due to ice blockage. advice Wuhan Control this situation. this is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已经建立联系，初始下降到跑道36右，在下降过程中，你的空速和高度读数异常，大概是由于积冰堵塞。告知武汉区调，这是一个紧急通话。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR896, airspeed and altitude readings are abnormal due to the ice blockage during descend.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉区调，法航896，在下降过程中，由于积冰堵塞，空速和高度读数异常。

cards.audioText: [You have departed from runway 18L, shortly after liftoff, you encountered a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an urgency call, request maintain runway heading.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已在跑道18左起飞，起飞后不久，飞机遭到了鸟击，右侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。】
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, SIA123, right engine failure due bird strike, request maintain runway heading.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉塔台，新航123，由于鸟击，右侧发动机失效，请求保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: During climb, your port engine failed, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land. This is an urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 在爬升过程中，你的左发失效了，告诉管制员这一情形，你想返场着陆，这是一个紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR113, port engine failure, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, 武汉区调，法航113，左发失效，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: After airborne, you fly into a flock of birds, the left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return for landing. This is an urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后，你飞入鸟群，你左侧风挡破裂，请求放油并返场着陆。这是一个紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, BAW871, we encountered bird strike and our left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，英航871，我们我们遭遇鸟击，左侧风挡破裂，请求放油并返场着陆。

cards.audioText: You found one of your hydraulic systems failed, make an urgency call and tell ATC this situation and ask to level off at 3900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你发现你的一个液压系统失效了，做紧急呼叫，并将此情况告诉管制员，请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CSN6682, we have one hydraulic system failure, request level off at 3900m and then return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉区调，南方6682，我们的一个液压系统失效了，请求在3900米改平，然后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: When you are at 10,700m, your left engine failed, make an urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 当你在10700米时，你的左发失效了，做紧急呼叫，请求右转下降至6300米。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA517, left engine failure, request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，广州区调，加航517，左发失效，请求右转下降到6300米。

cards.audioText: After airborne, you encountered bird strike and one of your engines failed, make an urgency call and ask to return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后，你遭遇了鸟击，你的一个发动机失效，做紧急通话，并请求返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, CES2151, engine failure due to bird strike, request return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN,PANPAN,PANPAN，武汉离场，东方2151，由于鸟击，发动机故障，请求返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: [A flight attendant told you that there is a male passenger suffering a heart attack. Inform the controller about that, and tell him you want to go back to Wuhan. This is an urgent call.]
cards.audioTextZh: [一名乘务员告诉你，一名男性乘客遭遇心脏病。告知管制员情况，告诉他你想返回武汉，这是一个紧急呼叫]
cards.referenceText: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan, Wuhan Control, ACA909, we have a male passenger suffering heart attack, request direct back to Wuhan.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan, Panpan, Panpan，武汉区调，加航909，我们有一名男性乘客遭遇心脏病，请求返回武汉。

cards.audioText: [Before ATC replies you suddenly hit another balloon you did not see. The aircraft becomes difficult to control and you want to return to land at Chengdu. Tell ATC this. This is an Urgency call.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在管制员回复之前，你撞上了一个你没有注意到的气球，飞机变得很难控制，你想返场降落成都，告知管制员此事，这是一个紧急呼叫。]
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Chengdu Departure, CSN582, we just hit a balloon, request return to Chengdu for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，成都离场，南方582，我们撞上了一个气球，请求成都降落。

cards.audioText: [The bleed air no longer supplies, high cabin altitude warning is triggered. Make an urgency call and tell the controller you want to make an emergency descent to 3000m and request radar vector.]
cards.audioTextZh: [引气停止供应，高客舱高度警告触发，宣布紧急情况，并告诉管制员你想紧急下降到3000米，并请求雷达引导]
cards.referenceText: Panpan Panpan Panpan, Wuhan Control, CES565, we will make an emergency descent to 3000m and request radar vectors due high cabin altitude warning.
cards.referenceTextZh: Pan Pan Pan，武汉区调，东方565，我们将紧急下降到3000米，由于高客舱高度告警，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText: B: [You hear a loud bang, it seems that the left wing has been hit by something, and you feel the airplane has banking tendency. Declare Urgency to ATC and request priority landing and emergency services.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你听到一声巨响，左侧机翼似乎被异物击中，且飞机出现倾斜趋势。立即向空管通报紧急情况，请求优先着陆及地面应急服务待命。】
cards.referenceText: PAN PAN, PAN PAN, PAN PAN, Wuhan Control, CES5325, the left wing was hit by some foreign objects. And the plane has a banking tendency. Request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: PAN PAN，PAN PAN，PAN PAN，武汉区调，东方5325，左侧机翼似乎被异物击中，且飞机出现倾斜趋势。请求优先着陆及地面应急服务待命。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you have smoke in the cockpit, make a distress call to Rhein Radar and request emergency descent to remove the smoke.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你的驾驶舱出现烟雾，向莱茵雷达管制区做遇险呼叫，请求紧急下降来移除烟雾。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Rhein Radar, SIA308, we have smoke in the cockpit, request emergency descent for smoke removal.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，莱茵雷达，新航308，驾驶舱烟雾，请求紧急下降来移除烟雾。

cards.audioText: N: [During cruise, the captain suddenly suffered from heart attack, make a distress call to Wuhan Control and request immediate return for priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【在巡航时，机长突然遇到心脏病，与武汉区调进行遇险通话，请求立刻返航进行优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Wuhan Control, ACA521, captain heart attack, request immediate return for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，武汉区调，加航521，机长心脏病发作，请求立即返航。优先着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, radar identified.
B: [Your captain is suddenly incapacitated with a suspected food poisoning, you have called the purser from the intercom and asked the flight attendants to get him out of the cockpit and give him first aid in time. Inform Guangzhou Control the situation and request return to land as soon as possible. This is a distress call.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航三两幺，武汉区调，雷达识别了。
【机长疑似食物中毒突然失能，你已经通过内话联系了乘务长，让乘务员把他抬出驾驶舱，并及时进行急救。告知广州区调此情况并请求尽快着陆。这是一个遇险通话。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Guangzhou Control, CCA321, our captain is suddenly incapacitated with a suspected food poisoning, we have given him first aid, request land as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，广州区调，国航三两幺，机长疑似食物中毒突然失能，我们已经向他进行急救，请求尽快着陆。

cards.audioText: B: [Suddenly, your cabin crew reports there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. You decide to expedite descend for smoke removal. Make a distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【突然，乘务员报告后客舱有有毒气体。你决定加速下降进行除烟程序。向郑州区调做遇险呼叫，请求在3000米平飞。】
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA331, there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. Request expedite descend for smoke removal and level off at 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州区调，加航331，后客舱有有毒气体，请求加速下降进行除烟程序，并在3000米改平。

cards.audioText: B: [You are now 15 miles southwest of LKO. Suddenly, you encountered heavy hail. The windshield was smashed and multiple cracks obscured your view. The airspeed indications in the cockpit have also become unreliable. You want to divert to Wuhan Airport. Make a distress call to Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在在LKO西南15海里，突然，你遇到了强冰雹，你的风挡破裂了，裂纹阻挡了你的视野，驾驶舱里的空速指示也变得不可靠。你想改航至武汉机场，向广州区调做一个遇险通话。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Guangzhou Control, CCA321, 15 miles southwest of LKO, we encountered heavy hail. The windshield was smashed and multiple cracks obscured our view, The airspeed indications in the cockpit have also become unreliable. Request divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，广州区调，国航321，LKO西南15海里，我们遇到了冰雹，我们的风挡破裂了，裂纹阻挡了我们的视野，驾驶舱里的空速指示也变得不可靠。请求改航至武汉机场。

cards.audioText: [You have departed from RWY 36L, shortly after liftoff, your starboard engine was on fire, and the EGT is very high, so you have to shut down this engine, make a distress call.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你已经从跑道36左起飞，起飞不久后，你右侧发动机起火，排气温度非常高，因此你关闭了该发动机，做遇险通话。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. Wuhan Tower, SIA323, right engine on fire, EGT is too high, we are shutting down the engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. 武汉塔台，新航323，右侧发动机起火，排气温度过高，我们关闭了该发动机。

cards.audioText: During the descent, you encountered a strong hail and experienced heavy turbulence. The outer windshield of your aircraft cracked due to hail strike, tell your situation to Beijing Approach, and request emergency landing, this is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 在下降过程中，你遇到了冰雹和颠簸。飞机外侧风挡玻璃由于冰雹撞击而出现裂纹，将情况告知北京区调，请求紧急着陆，这是一个遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Approach, CSN3109, our outer windshield cracked due to hail strike, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY. 北京进近，南方3109，我们外侧风挡玻璃由于冰雹撞击而出现裂纹，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: [Your callsign is CES243, an A320 is on T22 A arrival for runway 18L. You have been told to contact Wuhan Approach. You are 5 miles south of T VOR. You have a fire warning in the cockpit. You notice that the left engine is on fire.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是东方243，一架A320以T22-A进场，跑道18左。你被告知联系武汉进近。你在TVOR以南5海里。你的驾驶舱内部出现火警告警。你注意到你的左侧发动机失火了。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, CES243, 5 miles south of T VOR, left engine on fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY，武汉进近，东方243，T VOR以南5海里，左发动机失火。

cards.audioText: [Suddenly, your cabin crew reports there are toxic fume in the rear cabin. You decide to expedite descent for smoke removal. Make a distress call to Zhengzhou Control and request to level off at 3000m.]
cards.audioTextZh: [突然，你的乘务员报告客舱后部出现有毒烟雾，你决定加速下降，进行除烟，向郑州区调宣布遇险，并请求在3000米改平]
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Zhengzhou Control, ACA554, toxic fume in the rear cabin, we are expediting descent for smoke removal, request level off at 3000m.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，郑州区调，加航554，客舱后部出现有毒烟雾，我们加速下降，进行除烟，请求在3000米改平。

cards.audioText: N: Suddenly, your No.1 and No.2 engines have flamed out due to the dust storm, If the weather is clear at Beijing, request radar vectors to Beijing airport for priority landing. This is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 突然，由于沙尘暴，你的一、二发熄火了，如果北京的天气晴朗，申请雷达引导到北京机场优先降落。这是遇险通话。
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Beijing Approach, QFA432, No.1 and 2 engines failed due to dust storm. If the weather is clear at Beijing, request radar vectors to Beijing for priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，北京进近，澳航432，由于因沙尘暴，一、二发失效。如果北京天气晴朗，申请雷达引导到北京优先降落。

cards.audioText: UAL239, continue descend and maintain 4200m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，继续下降保持4200米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200m, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持4200米，美联航239。

cards.audioText: You are now leveling at 4200m and approaching ZF, information A received, make an initial contact with Wuhan approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在正保持在4200米，接近ZF，收到通播A，与武汉进近建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan approach, UAL219 maintaining 4200m, approaching ZF, information A.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，美联航219，保持在4200米，接近ZF，通播A。

cards.audioText: ACA989, maintain 4500m, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，4500米保持，联系武汉区调118.1。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 4500m, contact Wuhan Control 118.1, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，4500米保持，联系武汉区调118.1，加航989。

cards.audioText: [You are just over ZF, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你刚过ZF，和武汉区调进行初次联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA989, maintaining 4500m, over ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航989，4500米保持，过ZF。

cards.audioText: CSN421, roger, maintain 4800m, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，收到，4800米保持，联系武汉进近118.9。
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 4800m, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 4800米保持，联系武汉进近118.9，南航421。

cards.audioText: [Make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach; inform the controller that you have received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft, and you are returning to Wuhan.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【和武汉进近进行初次联系；通知管制员你收到匿名电话，称飞机上有炸弹，你正在返回武汉。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN421, maintaining 4800m, over ZF. We have received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board. We are turning back to land at Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南航421，4800米保持，过ZF。我们收到匿名电话，称飞机上有炸弹，我们正在返回降落到武汉。

cards.audioText: CSN6202, contact Beijing Control 125.9 for request.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航6202，联系北京区调125.9，请求直飞。

cards.audioText: [Make an initial contact with Beijing Control, 5400m maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due to weather.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【开始联系北京区调，保持5400米，由于天气原因，请求直飞KAKAT。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN6202, 5400m maintaining, request direct to KAKAT due weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南航6202，保持5400米，由于天气原因，请求直飞KAKAT。

cards.audioText: CCA991, climb to and maintain 6600m, contact Beijing Control 124.55.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，上升保持6600米，联系北京区调124.55。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6600m, 124.55, CCA991.

cards.audioText: [Make an initial contact with Beijing Control, you are 6600m maintaining, request 10400m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【与北京区调建立初次联系，6600米保持，请求上升到10400米。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA991, 6600m maintaining. Request climb to 10400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，国航991，6600米保持，请求上升到10400米。

cards.audioText: UAL895, roger, direct to HUR for hold, contact Beijing Approach on 129.0.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，收到，直飞HUR等待，联系北京进近129.0。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HUR for hold, Approach 129.0, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HUR等待，北京进近129.0，美联航895。

cards.audioText: [Establish initial contact with Beijing Approach, you are 4500m maintaining and flying direct to HUR.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【与北京进近建立初次联系，4500米保持，正在直飞HUR。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, UAL895, 4500m maintaining, direct to HUR.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美联航895，4500米保持，直飞HUR。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN6682, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, you are at stand 215, make initial contact with Wuhan Ground and make a radio check.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方6682，从武汉飞往广州，你现在在215号停机位，与广州地面进行初始报话，并进行无线电检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, CSN6682, stand 215, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, how do you read?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，南方6682，215号停机位，1，2，3，4，5，你听我几个？

cards.audioText: CSN586, taxi with caution, men and equipment operating east of taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，谨慎滑行，滑行道A东部有人和设备运行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks. Taxi with caution. CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，谨慎滑行，南方586。

cards.audioText: [Now you are cruising at 8000m, approaching DAPRO, make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在巡航在8000米，接近DAPRO，与广州区调进行初始联系]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN586, maintaining 8000m, approaching DAPRO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方586，正保持在8000米，接近DAPRO。

cards.audioText: ACA554, after the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，与航空器解除冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上5100米保持。
cards.referenceText: After the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 与航空器解除冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上5100米保持，加航554。

cards.audioText: [You are now at cruising level 9500m, over OBLIK, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control, your squawk number is 5655.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在到达巡航高度9500米，过OBLIK，与郑州区调做初始联络，你的应答机是5655]
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, ACA554, 9500m, over OBLIK, squawk 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，加航554，9500米，过OBLIK，应答机5655。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is QFA653, from Sydney to Wuhan, cruising at 10700m, squawk 3211. Now you are entering Wuhan Control area. Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是澳航653，从悉尼飞往武汉，巡航高度10700米，应答机3211。你现在正在进入武汉管制区域，与武汉区调进行初始联络。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, QFA653, 10700m, squawk 3211.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，澳航653，（高度）10700米，应答机3211。

cards.audioText: ACA909, maintain 4,500 m, contact Wuhan Control on 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航909，在4500米保持，联系武汉区调118.1。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 4,500 m, contact Wuhan Control 118.1, ACA909.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，在4500米保持，联系武汉区调118.1，加航909。

cards.audioText: UAL219, continue descent to and maintain 4200m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航219，继续下降并保持在4200米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4200m, UAL219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持在4200米，美联航219。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is QFA 160 from Tokyo to Guangzhou, you are cruising at 11000 meters, over Whiskey X-ray, make the initial contact with Zhengzhou control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是澳航160，从东京飞往广州，你现在在11000米巡航，飞过WX，与郑州区调建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, from Tokyo to Guangzhou, we are cruising at 11,000 meters over WX.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，澳航160，从东京飞往广州，我们在11000米巡航，飞过WX。

cards.audioText: Your all sign is ACA517, Cruising at 10,100m, squawk 3215, approaching DAPRO, make an initial contact with Guangzhou control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航517，在10100米巡航，应答机3215，接近DAPRO，与广州区调进行初始联络。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA517, 10,100m maintaining, squawk 3215, approaching DAPRO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航517，保持在10100米，应答机3215，接近DAPRO。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is BAW120, from Wuhan to London, cruising at 11000m, over WXI, Squawk 4521, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是英航120，从武汉飞往伦敦，在11000米巡航，飞过WXI，应答机4521，与郑州区调做初始报话。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW120, from Wuhan to London, cruising at 11000m, over WXI, Squawk 4521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航120，从武汉飞往伦敦，在11000米巡航，飞过WXI，应答机4521。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is CSN6682, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, you are at stand 215, make the initial contact with Wuhan Delivery and request ATC clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是南方6682，从武汉飞往广州，你现在在215号停机位，和武汉放行进行初始通话，请求放行许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, CSN6682, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, stand 215, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，南方6682，从武汉飞往广州，215号停机位，请求放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, after the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，航空器脱离冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上到5100米保持。
cards.referenceText: After the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航空器脱离冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上到5100米保持，加航331。

cards.audioText: C: CES529, Wuhan Departure, radar identified, turn right direct to ZF, climb to 5100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方529，武汉离场，雷达已识别，右转直飞ZF，上5100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to ZF, climb to 5100m, CES529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞ZF，上5100米，东方529。

cards.audioText: [Now you are over ZF, maintaining 5100m, squawk 2515, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你在ZF上空，5100米保持，应答机2515，与武汉区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES529, over ZF, maintaining 5100m, squawk 2515.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方529，过ZF，在5100米保持，应答机2515。

cards.audioText: N: [Your flight number is CSN905, a flight from Changchun to Wuhan. You are cruising at 10400m, you are approaching BIDOG. Your squawk number is 2332. Make the initial contact with Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: N：【你的呼号是南方905，一架从长春飞往武汉的航班。你现在在10400米巡航，你正接近BIDOG，你的应答机编码是2332。与北京区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN905, maintaining 10400m, approaching BIDOG, squawking 2332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方905，正保持10400米，接近BIDOG，应答机2332。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you’re en-route Germany, Rhein Radar Control, you’re cruising at FL360, make an initial contact with Rhein Radar Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你现在已经在德国莱茵雷达管制区航路上，你现在在高度层360巡航。与莱茵雷达管制区进行初始通话。】
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA308, en-route, cruising at FL360.
cards.referenceTextZh: 莱茵雷达，新航308，在航路上，高度层360。

cards.audioText: N: [Your call sign is CCA2119, you are maintaining 4,500 meters over VYK, you have received information X, make an initial contact with Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航2119，你现在正保持在4500米，过VYK，你已经收到通播X，与北京进近进行初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA2119, maintaining 4500m, over VYK, information X.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，国航2119，正保持4500米，过VYK， 通播X。

cards.audioText: [Your call-sign is UAL887, a passenger flight from Tokyo to Guangzhou. You are now flying at 9500m, estimating OBLIK at 35, squawking 5355. Make an initial contact with Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是美联航887，一架从东京飞往广州的客运航班。你现在在9500米飞行，预计过OBLIK时间35分，应答机5355。与北京区调进行初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, UAL887, 9500m maintaining, ETA OBLIK 35, squawk 5355.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，美联航887，正保持在9500米，预计过OBLIK时间35分，应答机5355。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is BAW3532, from London to Shanghai, you are now on airway H14, 11600m maintaining, next HO, make an initial contact with Xi’an Control. ]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是英航3532，从伦敦飞往上海，你现在在航路H14上，正保持11600米，下一点是HO，与西安区调进行初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Xi’an Control, BAW3532, now on airway H14, 11600m maintaining, next HO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 西安区调，英航3532，现在在航路H14上，正保持11600米，下一点是HO。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is CES556, you are maintaining 9200m, ETA JTN at 55, squawk 1532; make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是东方556，飞机保持9200米，预计到达JTN时间55分，应答机1532；和武汉区调建立初次联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES556, 9200m maintaining, ETA JTN 55, squawk 1532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方556，保持9200米。预计到达JTN时间55分，应答机1532。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is CCA321, from Wuhan to Guangzhou, you are now over DAPRO at 9200m. Make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航三两幺，从武汉飞往广州，你现在飞过DAPRO，高度九千二，与广州区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA321, over DAPRO, maintaining 9200m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，国航三两幺，飞过DAPRO，保持在九千二。

cards.audioText: B: [Now you are airborne, leaving 1200m for 2400m, make an initial contact with Wuhan Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你已离地，从1200米飞往2400米，与武汉离场建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES529, airborne, leaving 1200m for 2400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方529，离地了，从1200米飞往2400米。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is CCA321, from Beijing to Guangzhou. You are now cruising at 10400m with squawk 3210, estimating fly over LKO at time 30, next DAPRO at 45. Make an initial contact with Guangzhou Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是国航321，从北京飞往广州。巡航高度10400米，应答机3210，预计30分飞过LKO，45分飞过DAPRO，与广州区调建立初始联系。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CCA321, Beijing to Guangzhou, cruising at 10400m with squawk 3210, estimating fly over LKO at time 30, next DAPRO at 45.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，国航321，北京飞往广州，巡航高度10400米，应答机3210，预计30分飞过LKO，45分飞过DAPRO。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is BAW120, from London to Wuhan, cruising at 11000m, over WXI, Squawk 4521, make an initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是英航120，从伦敦飞往武汉，在11000米巡航，飞过WXI，应答机4521，与郑州区调做初始报话。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW120, cruising at 11000m, over WXI, Squawk 4521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，英航120，在11000米巡航，飞过WXI，应答机4521。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is QFA 160 from Tokyo to Guangzhou, you are cruising at 11000 meters, over WX, make the initial contact with Zhengzhou control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是澳航160，从东京飞往广州，你现在在11000米巡航，飞过WX，与郑州区调建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, QFA160, from Tokyo to Guangzhou, we are cruising at 11,000 meters over WX.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，澳航160，从东京飞往广州，我们在11000米巡航，飞过WX。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN3109, from Wuhan to Beijing, you are now leveling at 8900 meters, expect OBLIK 25, make a position report to Guangzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南方3109，从武汉飞往北京，你现在在8900米巡航，预计25分到达OBLIK，向广州区调做位置报。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, CSN3109, 8900m maintaining, expect OBLIK 25.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，南方3109，8900米保持，预计25分过OBLIK。

cards.audioText: AFR113, climb to 4500m and contact Wuhan control on 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，上4500米，联系武汉区调119.7。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4500m and contact 119.7, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上到4500米，联系武汉区调119.7，法航113。

cards.audioText: Your position is just over LKO, the next way-point is DAPRO, ETA at time 34, make the standard position report, and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 你刚刚过LKO，下一个位置点是DAPRO，预计到达时间34分，做一个标准位置报，并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR113. Over LKO, next DAPRO at 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航113，过LKO，预计到达下一位置点DAPRO34分，请求爬升。

cards.audioText: UAL811, roger, reach OBLIK earlier than 1020.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航811，收到，10点20分前过OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Reach OBLIK earlier than 1020, UAL811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 10点20分前过OBLIK，美联航。

cards.audioText: You are over OBLIK at time 1015, maintaining 11000 meters, you are estimating ZF at 1030. Your next waypoint is WUH, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在10点15分过OBLIK，高度保持在一万一，预计过ZF时间10点30分，下一航路点WUH，向武汉区调做标准的位置报。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL811, over OBLIK at 1015, maintaining 11000 meters, estimating ZF at 1030, next waypoint WUH.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，美联航811，10点15分过OBLIK，高度保持在一万一，预计过ZF时间10点30分，下一航路点WUH。

cards.audioText: B: [Your call sign is ACA219, you are now maintaining at 10700m, over ZHO at 35, next OBLIK at 50, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是加航219，你现在保持在10700米，过ZHO，35分，下一航路点OBLIK，50分，向武汉区调做一个标准位置报。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, ACA219, 10700m, over ZHO at 35, next OBLIK at 50.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，加航219，10700米，过ZHO 35分，下一航路点OBLIK，50分。

cards.audioText: AFR123, climb and maintain 4500m on standard, contact Wuhan Control 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，上升保持标压4500米，联系武汉区调119.7。
cards.referenceText: Climbing and maintain 4500m on standard, 119.7, AFR123.

cards.audioText: [You are maintaining 4500m and just over LKO at time 23, the next way-point is DAPRO, ETA is 34, make the standard position report, and request climb.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你保持在4500米，过LKO时间23分，下一个点DAPRO，预计到达时间34分，做标准位置报告，并请求爬升。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR123, over LKO 23, maintaining 4500m, next DARPO 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航123，LKO 23分，保持4500米，下一个点DAPRO，预计到达时间34分，请求爬升。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN905, Zhengzhou Control, give a full position report.
N: [Provide the following Information in your position report: You are cruising at 7,800m, overhead WXI at 1215. Your ETA to the next way point AKOMA is 1235. The waypoint after that is ZHO.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方905，郑州管制，做一个完整的位置报。
N：【在位置报中，提供以下信息：你正在7800米巡航，在12点15分飞跃WXI，预计过航路点AKOMA时间12点35分，下一点是ZHO。】
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, CSN905, maintaining 7,800m, overhead WXI at 1215, ETA AKOMA at 1235, next ZHO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州区调，南方905，保持7800米，在12点15分飞跃WXI，预计过航路点AKOMA时间12点35分，下一点是ZHO。

cards.audioText: ACA587, no speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航587，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Roger, ACA587.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，加航587。

cards.audioText: [You executed missed approach procedure and try to land on runway 36R. State this situation to Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【执行复飞程序，尝试降落在跑道36右。向塔台报告该情况。】
cards.referenceText: Tower, ACA587, going around and we try to land runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 塔台，加航587，复飞，我们试降跑道36右。

cards.audioText: AFR123, Wuhan Control, climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航123，武汉区调，上升保持5100米，没有速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 5100m, no speed restriction, AFR123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持5100米，没有速度限制，法航123。

cards.audioText: [During the climb, your port engine separated, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【爬升过程中，左侧发动机分离，告诉管制员这一情况，以及你想返回着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Wuhan Control, AFR123, our left engine falls, request to return to the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, 武汉区调，法航123，飞机左侧发动机脱落，请求返回机场。

cards.audioText: AFR971, runway inspection in progress at the moment, expect delay more than 15min.[Read back the ATC instructions, report that you are entering the hold and hold no more than 15min.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航971，正在测试跑道，预计延误15分钟以上。【复诵ATC的指令并报告其你已经进入等待点，等待不超过15分钟。】
cards.referenceText: Approach, AFR971, entering the holding pattern, and hold no more than 15min,
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，法航971，我已进入等待程序，等待不能超过15分钟。

cards.audioText: [The EGT of your starboard engine is fluctuating, state this situation to the controller. Ask to leave the holding pattern right away.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞机右侧发动机的排气温度不稳定，把这一情况报告给管制员。请求立刻离开等待航线。】
cards.referenceText: Approach, AFR971, The EGT of the right engine is fluctuating, request leave the holding pattern now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，法航971。右侧发动机的排气温度不稳定，请求现在离开等待程序。

cards.audioText: BAW951, Wuhan Ground, pushback and start-up approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航951，武汉地面，同意推出开车，头朝北。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up approved, facing north, BAW951.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，头朝北，英航951。

cards.audioText: [Now you have a problem. One of your passengers is seriously ill. You inform ATC and request to disembark the passenger. You have to delay the pushback due to disembarking the passenger.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【现在你遇到个问题。机上一名乘客生病严重。你通知ATC，请求让该乘客下飞机。由于该乘客离机，你不得不延误推出。】
cards.referenceText: Ground, BAW951, request delay push back and startup, we will disembark the ill passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，英航951，请求推迟推出开车，我们要让生病乘客离机。

cards.audioText: [This time, contact your company to inform this situation. And also, request medical assistance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系公司，报告该情况。同时请求医疗援助。】
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, BAW951, request disembark, and request an ambulance due a passenger seriously ill.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，英航951，由于一名乘客生病严重，请求让其下机，并提供一辆救护车。

cards.audioText: CCA987, read back correct, expect slot time 20 due to temporary departure restriction. Report when ready for pushback and start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航987，复诵正确，根据临时离场限制，预计离场时间20分。准备好推出开车时报告。
cards.referenceText: Report ready for pushback and start-up, CCA987.
cards.referenceTextZh: 准备好推出开车时报告，国航987。

cards.audioText: [Tell the controller that there are two passengers missing, and the bags have already removed from the aircraft. The load sheet is amended. Contact the controller to report the situation and state you are ready for push.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉管制员机上两名乘客没来，他们的行李已卸下。舱单已经修订。联系管制员报告该情况，并说明你已准备好推出。】
cards.referenceText: Ground, CCA987, two passengers missing and bags are removed, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，国航987，2名乘客没来，行李已经卸下，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: CES586, turn right heading 330, descend and maintain 900m ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，右转航向330，下降保持900米，盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900m, turn right heading 330, ILS approach runway 36R, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，右转航向330，盲降进近跑道36右，东方586。

cards.audioText: [While intercepting the localizer, the drunk passenger discharges the fire extinguisher. The purser make an emergency call said there is still passenger standing in the cabin. Inform the Wuhan Approach the situation and request terminate the approach, proceed to the holding area.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【切入航道时，该醉酒乘客打开灭火器。接到乘务长的紧急呼叫，说仍有乘客站在客舱里。通知武汉进近该情况，请求中止进近，继续进入等待区。】
cards.referenceText: Approach, CES586, Terminate the approach and request hold due passenger discharges the fire extinguisher and some passengers standing in the cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，东方586，中止进近，一名乘客打开灭火器，还有一些乘客站在客舱里，请求中止进近并等待。

cards.audioText: SIA151, deviation 10nm to the left approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航151，可以向左偏10海里。
cards.referenceText: Deviation 10nm to the left. SIA151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向左偏10海里。新航151。

cards.audioText: [The purser report there is strange smell coming from the rear cabin. Tell ATC this situation and request further descent as a precaution.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【乘务长报告称后舱内传出异味。告诉ATC该情况，同时请求进一步下降作为预防措施。】
cards.referenceText: Hong Kong Control, SIA151, there is strange smell from our rear cabin, request descent as a precaution.
cards.referenceTextZh: 香港区调，新航151，飞机后舱有异味，请求下降作为预防。

cards.audioText: SIA854, intersection departure from E2 approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，可以在滑行道E2进跑道起飞。沿滑行道A6, A, A2滑行至滑行道E2，在跑道18左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E2 approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of runway 18L, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以从滑行道E2进跑道起飞。沿滑行道A6，A，A2滑至滑行道E2，在跑道18左外等待，新航854。

cards.audioText: [During taxiing, you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about this situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑行中，你发现滑行道A上有一抛锚车辆，你停下飞机，通知ATC该情况，请求机场服务拖走该车辆。】
cards.referenceText: Ground, SIA854, there is a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, we stopped the aircraft, request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，新航854，滑行道A上有一抛锚车辆，我们停下飞机，请求机场服务拖走该车辆。

cards.audioText: UAL239, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 9200m, expedite descend until passing 9800m due crossing traffic.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，武汉区调，雷达已识别，下降保持9200米，由于交叉活动，快速下降通过9800米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9200m, expedite descent until passing 9800m, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持9200米，由于交叉活动，快速下降通过9800米，美联航239。

cards.audioText: [You are now maintaining 9200m. You are experiencing moderate clear air turbulence (CAT). Inform ATC of this situation and request further descend and maintain 8400m.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【飞行高度9200米保持。你正在经历中度晴空乱流。通知ATC该情况并请求进一步下降8400米保持。】
cards.referenceText: Control, UAL239, maintaining 9200m. Request further descent to 8400m due moderate clear air turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 区调，美联航239，9200米保持。由于晴空乱流，请求进一步下降8400米。

cards.audioText: AFR872, Wuhan Approach, what is the situation on board now? Keep us advised.[You are grateful for the reminding, report to ATC that more smoke accumulated in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing hard.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，武汉进近，现在机上情况怎么样？随时报告。【感谢ATC的提醒，报告客舱内烟雾越来越多，乘客们咳嗽的很严重。】
cards.referenceText: Thanks. The smoke is becoming denser in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing hard, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: 谢谢，客舱内的烟雾越来越浓，乘客们咳嗽的很严重，法航872。

cards.audioText: BAW038, report current situation.[Tell the controller that the port engine flamed out and you should land as soon as possible.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，报告现在的情况。【告诉管制员左发熄火了，你需要尽快着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Port engine flames out, request priority landing, BAW038.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左发动机熄火，请求优先着陆，英航038。

cards.audioText: JAL220, change to runway 36R is approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, you are number one.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，同意变更到跑道36右，在600米保持，右转飞至WHA，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, number one for landing, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，在600米保持，右转飞至WHA，第一个落地，日航220。

cards.audioText: After landing, you find your APU has failed, tell this situation to Wuhan Tower and ask for Ground Power Unit.
cards.audioTextZh: 落地后，你发现你的APU失效了，将情况告知武汉塔台，请求地面电力设备。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, JAL220, request ground power unit due APU failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，由于APU失效，请求地面电力设备。

cards.audioText: CCA991, Beijing Control. Report situation.[Tell the controller that you suspect something is on fire, you try to find the exact location of the fire, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，北京区调。报告情况。【告诉管制员你怀疑机上起火，你试图找出起火的准确位置，请求返回北京机场并优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: We suspect something is on fire, we are trying to locate the source now, Request return to Beijing airport and priority landing, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 疑似起火，我们正在定位火源，请求返回北京机场优先着陆，国航991。

cards.audioText: CSN586, taxi with caution, men and equipment operating east of taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方586，谨慎滑行，滑行道A东部有人和设备运行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks. Taxi with caution. CSN586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，谨慎滑行，南方586。

cards.audioText: [You encountered the wind shear between 200m to 400m, report the situation to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你在200米到400米之间遇到了风切变，向管制员报告此情况]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN586, we encountered wind shear between 200m to 400m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南方586，在200米到400米之间遇到了风切变。

cards.audioText: QFA683, taxi via F, C1 and B to holding point runway 26. Caution work in progress at the end of gate 319.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航683，经由F，C1和B，滑行至跑道26等待点，注意，319号机坪尽头有施工。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via F, C1, B to holding point runway 26, thanks for caution, QFA683.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经由F，C1和B，滑行至跑道26等待点，谢谢提醒，澳航683。

cards.audioText: [As you are taxiing, you notice some smoke coming from APU on B747 ahead of you, report this to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你在滑行时，你注意到前方B747的APU冒出烟雾，将此报告给管制员]
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Ground, QFA683, some smoke coming from the APU of the B747 ahead of us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海地面，澳航683，我前方B747的APU冒出烟雾。

cards.audioText: SIA497, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb to 3000m, QNH1021.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航497，雷达识别，左转直飞DA，爬升至3000米，修正海压1021。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb to 3000m, QNH1021, SIA497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，爬升至3000米，修正海压1021，新航497。

cards.audioText: [When you are approaching Singapore airport, your landing gears cannot be extended normally. Report this situation to Singapore airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你接近新加坡机场，你的起落架无法正常放下，将此情况报告给新加坡机场。]
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA497, we can't extend the landing gears normally.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，新航497，我们无法正常放下起落架。
