cards.audioText: C: CSN9302, climb to 2700m on QNH 1008.
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2700m on QNH 1008, CSN9302.

cards.audioText: B: [During climb, suddenly you’ve been struck by a foreign object, possibly hail strike. Your instruments are indicating incorrectly. Report this situation to Guangzhou Approach and request return to land.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【在爬升过程中，你突然遭遇外物撞击，可能是冰雹。仪表显示异常。向广州进近报告此情况，请求返航着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Approach, CSN9302, we’ve been struck by a foreign object, possibly hail strike, our instruments are indicating incorrectly, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州进近，南方9302，我们被外物撞击，可能是冰雹，仪表显示异常，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, orbit right from present position until advised of the weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方3112，从现在位置向右盘旋等待，前方天气情况稍后告知。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right from present position until advised, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从现在位置向右盘旋等待直到告知，南方3112。

cards.audioText: B: [After several orbits, you find you don’t have enough fuel to hold any further. Report this situation to Beijing Control.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【经过多次盘旋，你发现你没有足够的燃油继续等待。将情况报告给北京区调。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CSN3112, we don’t have enough fuel to hold any further.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，南方3112，我们没有足够的燃油继续等待。

cards.audioText: [During climb, you found your generators have failed, and you are flying with aircraft battery, report this situation to Shanghai Departure, tell them you need to return.]
cards.audioTextZh: [在爬升过程中，你发现你的发电机故障了，现在靠电池供电，报告该情况，并请求返场。]
cards.referenceText: Mayday Mayday Mayday, Shanghai Departure, KLM88, we are flying with aircraft battery, our generators failed, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: Mayday Mayday Mayday，上海离场，荷航88，发电机故障了，现在靠电池供电，请求返场。

cards.audioText: [You are now at 3600m, you smell something unusual in the cockpit, but you haven’t found out the source of the smell, report this situation to Wuhan Tower and request to hold for doing the checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh: [你现在在3600米，你在驾驶舱内闻到异常气味，但是你没有发现气味来源，将情况报告给武汉塔台，申请等待并执行检查单。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR332, 3600m, we find unusual smell in the cockpit, but we haven’t found out the source, request to hold for checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航332, 3600米，我们在驾驶舱发现异常气味，但是我们还没有发现气味来源，请求等待并执行检查单。

cards.audioText: [As you are climbing, you notice a large unmanned balloon. Your position is 4 miles north of the airfield and current height is 2000 meters. Report this to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: [当你爬升时，你注意到一个大型无人气球，你的位置是机场以北4海里，当前高度2000米，将此报告给管制员。]
cards.referenceText: Chengdu Departure, CSN582, we have seen a large unmanned balloon. Our position is 4 miles north of the airfield and current height is 2000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 成都离场，南方582，我们看到一个大型无人气球，我们位置是机场以北4海里，当前高度2000米。

cards.audioText:
AFR754, 20 miles deviate west is approved.
[During cruise, you find that the navigation performance has been downgraded, report this to ATC and ask them to verify your flight track.]
cards.audioTextZh:
法航754，同意西偏航20海里。
[在巡航过程中，你发现导航性能降级，向管制员报告，请他们核实你的飞行轨迹。]
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR754, our navigation performance down-graded, request verify our flight track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航754，我们的导航性能降级，请求核实我们的飞行轨迹。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, QFA432.
N: You were cleared to 1200m but notice the sky is turning yellow color and visibility is deteriorating quickly. You suspect a sandstorm. Tell Beijing Approach this and ask ATC if there is a sand storm forecast.
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，澳航432。
你被许可到1200米，但是你注意到天空变黄，能见度快速变差。你怀疑是沙尘暴。告知北京进近，询问管制员是否有沙暴预报。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, maintaining 1200 meters, the sky is turning yellow and the visibility is getting worse. Confirm if there is a sandstorm forecast.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，澳航432，在1200米保持，天空变黄，能见度变差，证实是否有沙尘暴预报。

cards.audioText: N: The sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor. Inform ATC of the situation and ask to climb to higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.audioTextZh: 沙尘暴很严重，能见度很低。通知管制员该情况，请求爬升到更高的高度以飞越沙尘暴。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, QFA432, the sandstorm is very severe and visibility is now very poor, request climb to higher level to get above the sandstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，澳航432，沙尘暴非常严重，现在能见度很低，请求爬升到更高高度以飞越沙尘暴。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN1310, roger, fire trucks and stair vehicles have been sent. Report current situation.
[The fuel leak has stopped, but you still need some ground assistance to deal with the fuel on the runway.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 南方1310，收到，消防车和客梯车已经出动。报告当前情况。
【燃油泄漏已经停止，但你仍然需要一些地面协助来处理跑道上的燃油。】
cards.referenceText: The fuel leak has stopped, but we still need some ground assistance to deal with the fuel on the runway, CSN1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 燃油泄漏已经停止，但是我们仍然需要一些地面协助来处理跑道上的燃油，南方1310。

cards.audioText: B: [The passenger took out the overhead oxygen mask. He is being closely monitored. Report the situation to the controller and request descent.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【该乘客拿出头顶上的氧气面罩。他被密切地监测。报告管制员该情况并请求下降。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES556, request descent. The passenger took out the oxygen mask and being monitored.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方556，请求下降。该乘客拿出氧气面罩，他已被监控起来。

cards.audioText:
UAL921, the closest airport is Nanjing Airport. Current visibility is marginal. I have to check if they can accommodate an aircraft of your size. Hongqiao and Pudong airport has longer runways and can definitely accommodate your aircraft. Advised your intention.
[Ask for radar vector to the airport that has better visibility between Hongqiao and Pudong.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航921，最近的机场是南京机场。当前能见度处于临界状态。我要检查南京机场能否接收你。虹桥机场和浦东机场有更长的跑道，并且肯定可以接收你。请示意图。
【请求雷达引导至能见度较高的虹桥机场或浦东机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request fly to the better visibility airport between Hongqiao and Pudong, UAL921.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求飞往能见度较高的虹桥机场或浦东机场，美联航921。

cards.audioText: AFR986, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 240, report intentions.[Tell controller that your GPS altitude and groundspeed is not accurate compared to barometric(气压高度表) indications, but can still maintain stable flight. request descend, leaving icing area.]
cards.audioTextZh:
法航986，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，右转航向240，报告意图。
【告诉管制员，你的GPS高度和地速数据与气压高度表显示的不准确，但仍能正常飞行。请求下降，离开积冰区域。】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240. Request descent and leaving icing area due inaccurate indications, AFR986.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，由于数据显示不准确，请求下降，离开积冰区域，法航986。

cards.audioText: CES586, around TOL reported moderate to severe clear air turbulence between 6000m to 10400m. The alternative level is 11600m, report intention?[Tell the controller you can accept 11600m.]
cards.audioTextZh:
东方586，TOL附近报告有强烈晴空乱流，高度6000米至10400米。备用高度是11600米，报告意图。
【告诉管制员11600米可用。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm 11600m, CES586.

cards.audioText: CSN351, roger, hold at present position, advise intentions when able. [Tell the controller that you are still able to taxi but you need 5min to solve the problem, ask to hold at convenient position on taxiway.]
cards.audioTextZh:
南航351，收到，原地等待，可以时报告意图。
【告诉管制员你仍能滑行，但是需要5分钟解决问题，请求在滑行道上方便的位置等待。】
cards.referenceText: Ground, CSN351, request 5min and hold at convenient position to solve the problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 地面，南航351，请求停在一个没影响的位置5分钟来解决问题。

cards.audioText: CSN582, radar vectors are available or you can fly a visual circuit and join left downwind. Report intention.[Tell the controller you will join left down wind.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航582，可以雷达引导，也可以做一个目视起落航线，加入左三边。报告意图。【告诉管制员你将加入左三边。】
cards.referenceText: Request join left down wind, CSN582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求加入左三边， 南航582。

cards.audioText: UAL162, report intention.[Tell ATC you still need to land at the nearest airport because the running engine is not stable.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航162，报告意图。
【告诉ATC你仍需要降落在最近的机场，因为重启的发动机运行不稳定。】
cards.referenceText: We still need to land at the nearest airport due the running engine is not stable, UAL162.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于重启的发动机运行不稳定，我们仍需降落在最近的机场，美联航162。

cards.audioText: UAL865, Xinzheng is available for you to divert. Say intentions.[Xinzheng airport is not the regular airport for your company, you need to ask permission and tell controller later.]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航865，新郑机场适合改航。请示意图。
【新郑机场不是你公司的常用机场，你需要获得公司许可后再回复管制员。】
cards.referenceText: Control, UAL865, we need to ask permission to divert to the airport, standby.
cards.referenceTextZh: 区调，美联航865，我们需要获得公司的许可才能改航，稍等。

cards.audioText: ACA989, roger, report your intentions.[Tell the controller that you want radar guidance to go round the CB.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，收到，报告意图。【告诉管制员你想要雷达引导绕飞积雨云区域。】
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to avoid the CB, ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导躲避积雨云，加航989。

cards.audioText: CCA451, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, is there any damage to the aircraft? Report your intentions.[Tell the approach controller that you want to land at Wuhan airport, and you don’t know anything about the damage.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航451，武汉进近，雷达已识别，飞机有损伤么？报告意图。
【告诉进近你想降落在武汉机场，你不知道飞机是否有损坏。】
cards.referenceText: Request land at Wuhan airport, and we don't know anything about the damage. CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求返回武汉机场，我们不清楚是否有损伤，国航451。

cards.audioText: CSN421, roger, report your intentions.[Tell the controller that you wish to land at Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，收到，报告意图。【告诉管制员你希望降落在武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request to land at Wuhan airport. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求降落在武汉机场，南航421。

cards.audioText: SIA786, say intention?[Tell ATC you want to terminate the approach, maintain 3000ft runway heading, complete the abnormal procedure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航786，请示意图？【告诉管制员你想中止进近，保持3000英尺，保持跑道航向，完成非正常程序。】
cards.referenceText: Request go around, maintaining runway heading and 3000ft to complete abnormal procedure, SIA786.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求复飞，保持跑道航向，3000英尺，完成非正常情况程序，新航786。

cards.audioText: AFR126, roger, say intention. [You have to hold for a check.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航126，收到，请示意图。【你必须盘旋检查。】
cards.referenceText: Request holding for a check, AFR126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求等待盘旋检查，法航126。

cards.audioText: BAW141, Beijing roger, when ready, advise intention.[You lost directional indication, if weather permits, request navigation assistance to Beijing airport]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，北京收到，准备好时通知意图。【你失去了方向指示，如果天气允许，请求雷达引导至北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141, if weather permits, request navigation assistance to Beijing airport due directional indication failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，英航141，如果天气允许，由于航向指示失效，请求导航至北京机场。

cards.audioText: AFR101, roger, say intentions. [Tell the ATC that the man has finally surrendered, the two passengers are in dangerous situation, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 法航101，收到，请示意图。【告诉ATC该名男子最终被控制住了，两名受伤乘客处于危险状态，请求返回北京机场并优先降落。】
cards.referenceText: The man is under control now, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing, two passengers are in critical condition, require medical assistance on arrival, AFR101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 该名男子已被控制，请求返回北京机场，优先降落，两名乘客受伤严重，请求到达时安排医疗救助，法航101。

cards.audioText: CES5102, the weather is deteriorating, say intentions. [Tell the controller you want to continue approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，恶劣天气状况，请示意图。【告诉管制员你想继续进近。】
cards.referenceText: Request continue approach and try to land, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求继续进近，尝试降落，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CES5102, Beijing Tower, expect low visibility for your arrival, say intention.[You want to try landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方5102，北京塔台，机场低能见，请示意图。【你想尝试降落。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request landing, CES5102,.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求着陆，东方5102。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger, say intention.[Request priority landing at Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到，说明意图。【请求优先着陆在北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request priority landing at Beijing airport, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求优先着陆北京机场，国航983。

cards.audioText: BAW038, Beijing Departure, report intention.[Your turbine blades appear to be broken, request return to Beijing airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 英航038，北京离场，报告意图。【你的涡轮叶片似乎破损了，请求返回北京机场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW038, request return to Beijing airport, our turbine blades may have been broken.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，英航038，请求返回北京机场，涡轮叶片可能已破损。

cards.audioText: CES220, Beijing roger, maintain 220kts. Report intention.[You intend to maintain 210kts, the minimum clean speed, and you are trying to extend the spoiler again.]
cards.audioTextZh: 东方220，北京收到，保持220节，报告意图。【你想保持最小光洁速度210节，并尝试再次打开扰流板。】
cards.referenceText: Minimum clean speed is 210kts, intend to maintain 210kts and try to extend the spoilers again, CES220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 最小光洁速度是210节，保持210节并尝试再次打开扰流板，东方220。

cards.audioText: NWA89, Beijing roger, can you land normally, say intention. [Tell the approach that it is not serious, you can land normally.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，收到，能否正常着陆，说明意图。【告诉北京进近问题不严重，可以正常着陆。】
cards.referenceText: GPWS failure not serious, able to land normally, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 近地警告系统故障不严重，可以正常着陆，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, say intention.[Tell the Tower you’re going around.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，说明意图。【告诉塔台你准备复飞。】
cards.referenceText: Going around, NWA89,.
cards.referenceTextZh: 复飞了，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, roger, say intention.[Tell the Departure you want to circle back for another landing on runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，收到，说明意图。【告诉离场你想机动飞行一圈后转回跑道36右着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, NWA89, request landing on runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，美西北89，请求跑道36右着陆。

cards.audioText: UAL895, Beijing is snowing heavily, runway unserviceable for one hour due to lack of snow removal equipment, say intention.[Request continue approach, you can hold for one hour with enough fuel.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，北京有大雪，由于缺少除雪设备跑道关闭1小时，说明意图。【请求继续进近，燃料足够飞行1小时。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, request continue approach, we can hold for one hour, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京区调，请求继续进近，我们可以继续飞行1小时，美联航895。

cards.audioText: ACA554, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 030, descend to 3000m, QNH1008, advise intentions when able. [Tell Zhengzhou Control, the toxic fume is caused by dangerous cargo leakage in cargo hold.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航554，收到MAYDAY，右转航向030，下降到3000米，修正海压1008，如可以，告知意图。 [告诉郑州区调，有毒烟雾是由于货舱危险品泄露导致的]
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 030, descend to 3000m, QNH1008, the toxic fume is caused by dangerous cargo leakage in cargo hold, ACA554.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向030，下降到3000米，修正海压1008，有毒烟雾是由于货舱危险品泄露导致的，加航554。

cards.audioText: C: CSN582, we just had report of a bomb left in your first class passenger section. Please report intentions. [Tell the controller the cabin crew and the securities are searching the bomb.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南方582，我们收到一个报告，客舱头等舱区域有炸弹，请报告意图。 [告知管制员，客舱乘务员和安全员正在寻找炸弹。]
cards.referenceText: We are searching for/looking for/ the bomb, CSN582.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们正在寻找炸弹，南方582。

cards.audioText: JAL602, negative, heading240 is not available due restricted area. Diversion to the left is available, say your intention. Tell controller you want to turn left heading 080.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航602，不可以，由于限制区，航向240不可用。可以左偏航，说出你的意图。 [告诉管制员，你想左转航向080。]
cards.referenceText: Request turn left heading 080, JAL602.
cards.referenceTextZh: 申请左转航向080，日航602。

cards.audioText:
CSN371, roger, hold at present position, advise intentions when able.
Tell the controller that you are still able to taxi, but you need 5mins to solve the problem, ask to hold at convenient position on taxiway.
cards.audioTextZh:
南方371，收到，原地等待，方便时告知意图。
告诉管制员，你仍然可以滑行，但是你需要5分钟来解决问题，请求在滑行道上的方便位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold position, We are able to taxi but need 5 minutes to solve the problem. Request hold at convenient position on taxiway, CSN371.
cards.referenceTextZh: 原地等待，我们仍然可以滑行，但是需要5分钟解决问题，请求在滑行道上方便的位置等待，南方371。

cards.audioText:
Report your intention, KLM88.
[Tell ATC, that you need shuttle bus to disembark passengers and a tug to tow you back to apron.]
cards.audioTextZh:
报告你的意图，荷航88。
告诉管制，你需要摆渡车让乘客下飞机以及拖车拖你回机坪。
cards.referenceText: Request shuttle bus to disembark passengers and a tug to tow us back to apron, KLM88.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求摆渡车让乘客下飞机，以及拖车拖飞机回机坪，荷航88。

cards.audioText:
Roger, UAL835, what is your intention?
[The injured passengers are bleeding seriously, You request priority landing at Wuhan airport, and request ambulance on arrival. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航835，你的意图是什么？
[受伤的乘客流血严重，你请求在武汉机场优先着陆，并在着陆后请求救护车。]
cards.referenceText: Request priority landing and ambulance on arrival, UAL835.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求优先着陆，并在着陆后请求救护车，美联航835。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN3112, roger, say your intention.
B: [Tell the controller you require radar vectors to Beijing for priority landing.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 南方3112，收到，说明你的意图。
B:【告知管制员，你需要雷达引导到北京进行优先着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Request radar vectors to Beijing for priority landing, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导到北京进行优先着陆，南方3112。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA308, roger Mayday, descend to and maintain FL100, keep us advised the situation on board and your intention.
B: [Read back the instructions and tell the controller that you’re working the checklist and will advise.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 新航308，收到Mayday，下高度层100保持，告知我们机上情况以及你的意图。
B：【复诵指令，告知管制员，你现在正在执行检查单。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain FL100, we’re working the checklist and will advise, SIA308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到高度层100保持，我们正在执行检查单，将会告知，新航308。

cards.audioText:
C: CSN3001, roger Panpan, descend to 9200m. When able, say your further intention.
B: [Inform controller that cabin crew have provided necessary first aid to the sick passenger, but you still need doctors and medical service to be ready at the gate after landing.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C：南方3001，收到Panpan，下9200米，可以的时候，报告你的意图。
【告知管制员，乘务员已经给患病乘客提供了必要的急救，但是着陆后，你依旧需要医生和救护车在机位上就绪。】
cards.referenceText: Descend to 9200m, request doctors and medical service to be ready at the gate, CSN3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下9200米，请求医生和救护车在机位上就绪，南方3001。

cards.audioText: C: ACA303, climb to and maintain 4,500m, expedite passing 2,700m. N: [Read back the instruction and advise the controller you are climbing on reduced thrust and will require some time before reaching that altitude.]
cards.audioTextZh:
加航303，上到4500米保持，加速过2700米。
【复诵指令，告知管制员，你正在减推力爬升，在到达那个高度之前需要一些时间。】
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 4,500m, unable expedite due reduced thrust, ACA303.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上到4500米保持，由于减推力，无法加速爬升，加航303。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, sir, what's your intention.
N: [Tell departure you want to circle back for another landing on runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh:
收到，你的意图是什么？
【告知离场，你想盘旋进近跑道36右再次降落。】
cards.referenceText: Request circle back for another landing on runway 36R, ACA121.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求盘旋进近跑道36右再次降落，加航121。

cards.audioText: C: CES769, climb and maintain 2400m, when able, say your intention.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方769，上到2400米保持，可以的时候，告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 2400m, wilco, CES769.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上2400米保持，照办，东方769。

cards.audioText: B: [After performing the checklist, you decide to dump fuel and return for landing.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【当执行完检查单，你决定放油并返场着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, CES769, request dump fuel and return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，东方769，请求放油并返场着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL887, Beijing Control, roger that. Notify us the further situation and your intention.
[Tell controller that the pure oxygen is being fed to the woman, and she is about to give birth on the plane. You want to divert to Wuhan.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 美联航887，北京区调，收到。告知情况的发展以及你的意图。
【告知管制员，已经给乘客提供纯氧，她打算在飞机上生孩子。你想备降到武汉。】
cards.referenceText: The pure oxygen is being fed to the woman, and she is about to give birth on the plane, request divert to Wuhan, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 已经给乘客提供纯氧，她打算在飞机上生孩子，请求改航到武汉，美联航887。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, CSN1310, ground assistance is already for you, report your intention.
[As passengers have been successfully deplaned, you want to vacate the runway and taxi back to the remote apron and have maintenance staff check the aircraft and refuel the aircraft.]
cards.audioTextZh:
C: 收到，南方1310，地面援助已经在找你了，报告你的意图。
【由于乘客已经成功下机，你要脱离跑道，滑回远机坪，让维修人员检查飞机并给飞机加油。】
cards.referenceText: Request taxi back to the remote apron and have maintenance staff check the aircraft and refuel the aircraft, CSN1310.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求滑回远机坪，让维修人员检查飞机并加油，南方1310。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR896, turn right heading 240, advice your intentions.
N: [Tell controller that your GPS altitude and ground speed is not accurate compared to barometric indications, but you can still maintain stable flight, request descend to leave the icing area.]
cards.audioTextZh:
法航896，右转航向240，告知你的意图。
【告诉管制员，你的GPS高度和地速与气压指示相比不准确，但你仍然可以保持稳定飞行，请求下降离开结冰区。】
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, request descend to leave the icing area. The instrument readings are abnormal, but we can still maintain the stable flight, AFR896.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，请求下降离开结冰区。仪表复数不正常，但我们依旧可以保持平稳飞行，法航896。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA1301, Beijing Tower, negative, no visual fire on the landing gears or tyres, report intention.
N: [Tell the controller you want to vacate runway and taxi to the ramp for a thorough check but you have to wait to cool the brakes for about 5 minutes. ]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航1301，北京塔台，不，起落架和轮胎处没有明火。报告意图。
【告知管制员你想脱离跑道，滑行至机坪进行全面检查，但是你需要等待大约5分钟来冷却刹车。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request vacate runway and taxi to the ramp for a check after cooling the brakes for about 5 minutes., CCA1301.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求冷却刹车大概5分钟后脱离跑道，滑行至机坪进行全面检查， 国航1301。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, Wuhan Approach, roger, what is your intention?
[Tell controller, you want to reduce to minimum clean speed to perform the checklist.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航三两幺，武汉进近，收到，你的意图是什么？
【告知管制员，你想减小到最小光洁速度来执行检查单。】
cards.referenceText: Request reduce to minimum clean speed to perform the checklist, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求减小到最小光洁速度来执行检查单，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA321, negative, we’ve never received such report, do you request approach to another runway or request another type of approach?
B: [Tell controller you want to change to runway 18R.]
cards.audioTextZh:
国航三两幺，没有，我们没有收到类似的报告，你是请求进近其他跑道还是请求其他进近方式？
【告诉管制员，你想更换至跑道18右。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, request change to runway 18R, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请求更换至跑道18右，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: C: ACA219, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航219，按照标准复飞程序，可以时告知意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, wilco, ACA219.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按照标准复飞程序，照办，加航219。

cards.audioText: B: [Now You are climbing to the missed approach altitude, you decided to divert to Changsha airport, inform Wuhan Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你现在爬升到复飞高度，你决定改航至长沙机场，告知武汉塔台。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA219, request divert to Changsha airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航219，请求改航至长沙机场。

cards.audioText:
11C: CSN557, we have a good look at your undercarriage. Your left main landing gear is stuck halfway. It is not in the extended position. Advise intention.
11N: Tell tower you want to perform hold near airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
南方557，我看清楚了你的起落架，你的左起落架卡在半路了，没有在放出位置，告知意图。
【告知管制，你想在机场附近等待。】
cards.referenceText: Request hold near the airport, CSN557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求在机场附近等待，南方557。

cards.audioText:
ATC: Passenger with head injury, roger that, say intention, AFR9939.
[The purser has offered first aid to the injured passenger, he is OK now. You will continue the flight.]
cards.audioTextZh:
有乘客头部受伤，收到，报告意图，法航9939。
乘务长向受伤乘客提供了急救，他目前情况良好，你将继续飞行。
cards.referenceText: The passenger is OK now, we will continue the flight. AFR9939.
cards.referenceTextZh: 乘客情况目前良好，我们将继续飞行，法航9939。

cards.audioText:
SIA323, roger MAYDAY. Say your intention.
[Tell the Tower you want to jettison fuel and return to Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh:
新航323，收到MAYDAY，说出你的意图。
告诉塔台，你想放油，然后返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Request fuel dumping and return to Wuhan airport, SIA323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求放油，返回武汉机场， 新航323。

cards.audioText: Roger, CCA451, climb and maintain 900m, turn left direct to DA, and hold over DA.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，国航451，上升保持900米，左转直飞DA，在DA等待。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 900m, turn left direct to DA, and hold over DA. CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升保持900米，左转直飞DA，在DA等待，国航451。

cards.audioText: CCA451, descend and maintain 900m, turn right heading 290, radar vector for the ILS approach runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航451，下降保持900米，右转航向290，雷达引导盲降进近跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900m, turn right heading 290, ILS approach runway 36L. CCA451.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，右转航向290，盲降进近跑道36左，国航451。

cards.audioText: CSN339, Wuhan Ground, after B737 behind cleared, pushback onto Z4, abeam Gate 213, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，武汉地面，波音737没影响后，推出开车至滑行道Z4，正切机位213，头朝东。
cards.referenceText: After traffic cleared, pushback onto Z4, abeam 213, facing east, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没影响后，推出开车至滑行道Z4，正切213号机位，头朝东，南航339。

cards.audioText: CSN339, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, maintain 3900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航339，武汉区调，收到PANPAN，3900米保持，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 3900m, left direct to LKO, LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R, CSN339.
cards.referenceTextZh: 3900米保持，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，盲降进近跑道36右，南航339。

cards.audioText: AFR332, follow ZF01D, runway heading until 1200m, contact Wuhan Departure on 124.25.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航332，按照ZF01离场，跑道航向直到1200米，联系武汉离场，124.25。
cards.referenceText: ZF01D, runway heading until 1200m, contact Departure on 124.25, AFR332.
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF01离场，跑道航向直到1200米，联系武汉离场，124.25，法航332。

cards.audioText: AFR332, descend to and maintain 600m, turn right to join the downwind for runway 22, report when turning base.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航3332，下到600米保持，右转加入跑道22的3边，进入4边后报。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 600m, turn right to join the downwind for runway 22, report when turning base, AFR332.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到600米保持，右转加入跑道22的3边，进入4边后报，法航332。

cards.audioText: SIA233, Tower, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO VOR 30 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，塔台，收到PANPAN，右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米，新航233。

cards.audioText: CES586, due to temporarily airspace restriction is effective immediately, after XSH, direct to ZF, expect ZF-03A Arrival. ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方586，由于临时空域限制立即生效，过XSH，直飞ZF，预计ZF-03A进场，盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Direct to ZF, expect ZF-03A arrival. ILS approach runway 36R, CES586.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞ZF，预计ZF-03A进场，盲降进近跑道36右，东方586。

cards.audioText: CSN421, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow ZF-1A arrival; descend and maintain 2700m on QNH1017, information C.
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，武汉进近，雷达已识别，ZF-1A进场；下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1017，通播C。
cards.referenceText: ZF-1A arrival, descend and maintain 2700 m on QNH 1017; information C. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF-1A进场，下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1017，通播C，南航421。

cards.audioText: UAL895, Beijing roger, direct to LADIX, climb to 6300m, contact Beijing Control on 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航895，收到，直飞LADIX，上升到6300米，联系北京区调120.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to LADIX, climb to 6300m, 120.35, UAL895.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞LADIX，上升到6300米，120.35，美联航895。

cards.audioText: JAL220, Wuhan Approach, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radio inbound, descend to 3300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，武汉进近，右转航向240，切LKO 030 无线电向台，下到3300米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, LKO 030 radio inbound, descend to 3300m, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，LKO 030 向台，下到3300米，日航220。

cards.audioText: JAL220, roger, turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH1015, expect runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，收到，右转直飞DA，下到2100米，修正海压1015，预计跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH1015, expect runway 36L. JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞DA，下到2100米，修正海压1015，预计跑道36左，日航220。

cards.audioText: JAL220, change to runway 36R is approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, you are number one.
cards.audioTextZh: 日航220，同意变更到跑道36右，在600米保持，右转飞至WHA，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, number one for landing, JAL220.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，在600米保持，右转飞至WHA，第一个落地，日航220。

cards.audioText: Roger, CES543, you have just passed the traffic, descend and maintain 6000m and turn left heading 170 immediately. There is military activity in the area right now.[You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，东方543，你刚躲避过活动，立即下降保持6000米，左转航向170。飞机位于军事活动区域内。【你需要复诵指令并表示感谢。】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 6000m, turn left heading 170 immediately, thanks, CES543.
cards.referenceTextZh: 立即下降保持6000米，左转航向170，谢谢，东方543。

cards.audioText: CCA983, roger. Turn left direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m. Expect runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航983，收到。左转直飞HUR，下降保持3600米，预计跑道01。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m. Expect runway 01, CCA983.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞HUR，下降并保持3600，预计跑道01，国航983。

cards.audioText: BAW141, roger, cleared visual approach, join final for runway 36L, you are number one, contact Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航141，收到，可以目视进近，加入跑道36左五边，你第一个着陆，联系塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Cleared visual approach, join final for runway 36L, No.1, 118.1, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以目视进近，加入跑道36左五边，第一个，118.1，英航141。

cards.audioText: CCA991, roger, descend to and maintain 1800m on QNH 1012, information D, expect ILS approach runway 18R, you are number one.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航991，收到，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，通播D，预计跑道18右盲降进近，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 1800m on QNH 1012, information D, ILS runway 18R, number one, CCA991.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1012，通播D，跑道18右盲降进近，第一个，国航991。

cards.audioText: UAL239, reduce to minimum speed. Fly direct to ZF, expect ZF-3 arrival runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，速度减至最小。直飞ZF，预计ZF-3进场，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Minimum speed. Direct to ZF, ZF-3 arrival runway 36R, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 最小速度。直飞ZF，ZF-3进场，跑道36右，美联航239。

cards.audioText: UAL239, turn right heading 310, cleared for the VOR/DME approach runway 04, report inbound.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航239，右转航向310，可以VOR/DME进近跑道04，向台报告。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 310, cleared for VOR/DME approach runway 04, report inbound, UAL239.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向310，可以VOR/DME进近跑道04，向台报告，美联航239。

cards.audioText: UAL865, Zhengzhou Control, radar contact, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce Mach .75, due Wuhan Control restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航865，郑州区调，雷达已识别，向右偏3海里，由于武汉区调限制，马赫数减小至点75。
cards.referenceText: Offset 3 miles right of track, reduce Mach .75, UAL865.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右偏3海里，马赫数减小至点75，美联航865。

cards.audioText: UAL887, direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m, contact Beijing Approach 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航887，直飞HUR，下降保持3600米，联系北京进近119.7。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HUR, descend to and maintain 3600m, 119.7, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞HUR，下降保持3600米，119.7，美联航887。

cards.audioText: ACA989, Wuhan Approach, Roger, follow ZF-1A arrival, and descend and maintain 1800m on QNH 1013. Information D.[Read back the controller’s instruction, and ask the detail of information D because you could not receive the information on the radio.]
cards.audioTextZh: 加航989，武汉进近，收到，ZF-1A进场，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1013。通播D。【复诵管制员指令，询问通播D详细内容，因为你并未收到该消息。】
cards.referenceText: Roger, follow ZF-1A arrival; descend and maintain 1800m on QNH 1013. Request details of information D. ACA989.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，ZF-1A进场，下降保持修正海压1800米，修正海压1013。请求告知通播D详细内容，加航989。

cards.audioText: QFA378, turn right heading 030 approved, when clear of weather, turn left direct to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 澳航378，同意右转航向030，天气好转后，左转直飞LKO。
cards.referenceText: Right Heading 030, after clear of weather, direct to LKO, QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向030，天气好转后，直飞LKO，快达378。

cards.audioText: QFA378, Wuhan Approach, cleared to LKO-2A arrival, descend and maintain 1200m on QNH1012, information C valid, you are No. 1.
cards.audioTextZh: 快达378，武汉进近，可以LKO-2A进场，下降保持修正海压1200米，修正海压1012，通播C有效，你第一个。
cards.referenceText: LKO-2A arrival, descend and maintain 1200m on QNH1012, information C, No.1. QFA378.
cards.referenceTextZh: LKO-2A进近，下降保持修正海压1200米，修正海压1012，通播C有效，你第一个，澳航378。

cards.audioText: AFR872, Wuhan Approach, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 040, descend and maintain 2100m, radar vector to ILS approach runway 36R, you are priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航872，武汉进近，收到MAYDAY，右转航向040，下降保持2100米，雷达引导盲降进近跑道36右，你优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Roger, right heading 040, descend and maintain 2100 m, ILS runway 36R, AFR872.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，右转航向040，下降保持2100米，盲降进近跑道36右，法航872。

cards.audioText: B: [You’ve just followed your TCAS RA instruction. You’ve stopped your descent at nearly 6800m, and track out 9km right of the course, report to ATC.]
cards.audioTextZh: B：【你已执行了TCAS RA指令。你已停止下降，高度维持在约6800米，并偏航右转偏离原航线9公里，现向空管报告。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CES5325, our TCAS instructed us to stop descent at 6800m, and we are tracking out 9km right of the course.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，东方5325，TCAS指示我们在6800米停止下降，我们偏航右转偏离原航线9公里。

cards.audioText: C: CSN905, descend to and maintain 9,200m, rate of descent at 2,000 ft/min or greater.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方905，下9200米保持，下降率2000英尺每分或更大。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 9,200m at 2,000 ft/min or greater, CSN905.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下9200米保持，下降率2000英尺每分或更大，南方905。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3112, turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published due weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方3112，左转航向150，直飞AA446，由于天气，在AA446按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 150, direct to AA446, hold at AA446 as published, CSN3112.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向150，直飞AA446，在AA446按公布程序等待，南方3112。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3001, cleared to deviate 20 miles to the left, maintain present altitude, expect fly direct to P419. Notify us when you are clear of the weather. We will radar vector you back to your original route.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 南方3001，可以左偏置20海里，保持当前高度，预计直飞P419，脱离天气时报。我们将雷达引导你返回原航路。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to deviate 20 miles to the left, maintain present altitude, expect fly direct to P419, wilco, CSN3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以左偏置20海里，保持当前高度，预计直飞P419，将照办，南方3001。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3001, turn left heading 048 degrees, direct to BOGRO, and then join airway A461.
cards.audioTextZh: C：南方3001，左转航向048度，直飞BOGRO，然后加入A461航路。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 048 degrees, direct to BOGRO, and then join airway A461, CSN3001.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向048度，直飞BOGRO，然后加入A461航路，南方3001。

cards.audioText: C: ACA521, roger Mayday, turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300m, you are No.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航521，收到Mayday，左转航向220，直飞ZF，下3000米，你是第一个。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, direct to ZF, descend to 3300m, No.1 ACA521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向220，直飞ZF，下3300米，第一个，加航521。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Departure, hold over LKO VOR 130 radial, inbound track 085, 30-40 miles legs, right hand pattern at 2700m.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉离场，在LKO台130度径向线等待，入航航迹085度，航段30-40海里，右等待，高度2700米。
cards.referenceText: Hold over LKO VOR 130 radial, inbound track 085, 30-40 miles legs, right hand pattern at 2700m, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在LKO台130度径向线等待，入航航迹085度，航段30-40海里，右等待，高度2700米，东方5227。

cards.audioText: C: CES5227, Wuhan Tower, after airborne, fly runway heading to 600m, follow SID fly to HZ, when airborne contact 126.3, cleared for takeoff, runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 东方5227，武汉塔台，离地后，跑道航向上到600米，按照标准离场程序飞往HZ，离地后，联系126.3，可以起飞，跑道04。
cards.referenceText: Runway heading to 600m, follow SID fly to HZ, 126.3, cleared for takeoff, runway 04, CES5227.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道航向上到600米，按照标准离场程序飞往HZ，126.3， 可以起飞，跑道04，东方5227。

cards.audioText: C: UAL887, turn left heading 190, descend to and maintain 3600m on QNH 1006, reduce to minimum approach speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C: 美联航887，左转航向190，下到3600米保持，修压1006，减小到最低进近速度。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 190, descend to and maintain 3600m on QNH1006, reduce to minimum approach speed, UAL887.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向190，下到3600米保持，修压1006，减小到最低进近速度，美联航887。

cards.audioText: C: BAW3532, cancel ATC speed restriction, descend and maintain 9800m, rate of descent 2500ft per minute.
cards.audioTextZh: C：英航3532，取消管制速度限制，下9800保持，下降率2500英尺每分。
cards.referenceText: No speed restriction, descend and maintain 9800m, rate of descent 2500ft per minute, BAW3532.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有速度限制，下9800米保持，下降率2500英尺每分，BAW3532。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, Beijing roger, leave the holding pattern and turn left heading 033, further descend to 2400m and contact Beijing Tower on 118.3, we have informed your situation to them.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，北京收到，离开等待程序，左转航向洞三三，继续下到两千四，联系北京塔台幺幺八点三，我们已经向他们告知你的情况。
cards.referenceText: Leave the holding pattern and turn left heading 033, further descend to 2400m and contact Beijing Tower on 118.3, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离开等待程序，左转航向洞三三，继续下到两千四，联系北京塔台幺幺八点三，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, hold over AA442 130 radial 14 DME fix, one and a half minute inbound legs, left hand pattern, maintain 2700m, expect further clearance at 45, time now 30.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，在Alpha Alpha四四两一百三十度径向线DME幺四海里点等待，入航时间一分半，左等待，保持两拐，预计进一步许可时间四五分，当前时间三洞分。
cards.referenceText: Hold over AA442 130 radial 14 DME fix, one and a half minute inbound legs, left hand pattern, maintain 2700m, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在Alpha Alpha四四两一百三十度径向线DME幺四海里点等待，入航时间一分半，左等待，保持两拐，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: C: CCA1368, turn right heading 060, track direct to AA443, descend to and maintain 4500m by AA443.
cards.audioTextZh: 管：国航幺三六八，右转航向洞六洞，直飞Alpha Alpha四四三，在Alpha Alpha四四三之前下到四千五。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 060, track direct to AA443, descend to and maintain 4500m by AA443, CCA1368.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向洞六洞，直飞Alpha Alpha四四三，在Alpha Alpha四四三之前下到四千五，国航幺三六八。

cards.audioText: C: CES556, due to temporarily airspace restriction is effective immediately, after XSH, direct to ZF, expect ZF-03A Arrival. ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方556，由于临时空域限制立即生效，过XSH，直飞ZF，预计ZF-03A进场，盲降进近跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: After XSH, direct to ZF, expect ZF-03A arrival. ILS approach runway 36R, CES556.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过XSH后，直飞ZF，预计ZF-03A进场，盲降进近跑道36右，东方556。

cards.audioText: C: CSN3102, Guangzhou Departure, radar contact, turn right heading 088, track direct to CON, climb to and maintain 2100m when passing CON.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方3102，广州离场，雷达识别了，右转航向088，直飞CON，过CON后上2100米保持。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 088, track direct to CON, climb to and maintain 2100m when passing CON, CSN3102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向088，直飞CON，过CON后上2100米保持，南方3102。

cards.audioText: Roger, descend to 9200m, rate of descent at 2000ft per min or greater. Offset 3 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，下降到9200米，下降率每分钟2000英尺或更大。右偏航3海里。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 9200m, rate of descent at 2000ft per minute or greater. Offset 3 miles to the right. BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降到9200米，下降率每分钟2000英尺或更大。右偏航3海里，英航120。

cards.audioText: BAW120, descend to and maintain 7800m, cancel offset. Track direct to AKOMA, reduce speed to minimum clean speed due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: 英航120，下到7800米保持，取消偏航。直飞AKOMA，由于流控，速度减小到最低光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 7800m, cancel offset. Track direct to AKOMA, reduce speed to minimum clean speed due flow control. BAW120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到7800米保持，取消偏航。直飞AKOMA，由于流控，速度减小到最低光洁速度，英航120。

cards.audioText: C: ACA331, after the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航331，航空器脱离冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上到5100米保持。
cards.referenceText: After the traffic is clear, track direct to ZF, resume own navigation, climb to and maintain 5100m, ACA331.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航空器脱离冲突后，直飞ZF，恢复自主领航，上到5100米保持，加航331。

cards.audioText: CES2151, change to runway 18L is approved, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, contact approach on 121.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，同意更改到18左，保持在600米，右转至WHA，联系进近121.7。
cards.referenceText: Runway 18L, maintain 600m, turn right to WHA, 121.7, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道18左，保持在600米，右转至WHA，121.7，东方2151。

cards.audioText: CES2151, climb to 900m, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vectors for ILS approach runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 东方2151，爬升至900米，过WHA后，航向360，预计雷达引导ILS进近，跑道18左。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 900m, after WHA, fly heading 360, expect radar vector for ILS approach runway 18L, CES2151.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至900米，WHA后，航向360，预计雷达引导ILS进近，跑道18左，东方2151。

cards.audioText: SIA123, Tower, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO VOR 30 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航123，塔台，收到PANPAN，右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m, SIA123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米，新航123。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, roger, turn right heading 038, descend to and maintain 5400m, increase speed to 320 knots or greater.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，广州区调，收到，右转航向038，下到五千四保持，速度调至320节或更大。
cards.referenceText: Right heading 038, descend to and maintain 5400m, increase speed to 320 knots or greater, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向038，下到五千四保持，速度增大到320节或更多，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, Guangzhou Control, roger, fly direct to PAVTU and then turn left and join airway H24.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航三两幺，广州区调，收到，直飞PAVTU。然后左转加入H24航路。
cards.referenceText: Fly direct to PAVTU and then turn left and join airway H24, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞PAVTU。然后左转加入H24航路，国航三两幺。

cards.audioText: 7C: CSN557, turn right track direct to "D" NDB, descend and maintain 900m, follow the published procedure. Clear for ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方557，右转直飞“D”NDB，下到900米保持，按照发布的程序，可以ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Turn right track direct to "D" NDB, descend and maintain 900m, follow the published procedure. Clear for ILS approach runway 36R, CSN557.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞“D”NDB，下到900米保持，按照发布的程序，可以ILS进近，跑道36右，南方557。

cards.audioText: CCA976, cancel SID, maintain runway heading to 1500 meters, track direct ZF, runway 04, cleared for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航976，取消SID，保持跑道航向直到1500米，直飞ZF，跑道04，可以起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff. runway 04. After departure, cancel SID, maintain runway heading to 1500m, direct to ZF, CCA976.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道04，离场后，取消SID，保持跑道航向直到1500米，直飞ZF，国航976。

cards.audioText: Roger PAN, maintain 3,900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach r/w 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到PAN，保持高度3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3,900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R, CSN319.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持高度3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，ILS进近，跑道36右，南方319。

cards.audioText: C: CCA321, Wuhan Approach, cleared divert to Changsha, fly heading 140 and rejoin airway R343, fly direct to LCC.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航321，武汉进近，可以备降至长沙，航向140，加入R343航路，直飞LCC。
cards.referenceText: Cleared divert to Changsha, heading 140 and rejoin airway R343, fly direct to LCC, CCA321.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以备降至长沙，航向140，加入R343航路，直飞LCC，国航321。

cards.audioText: CCA527, descend to 4200m, when ready reach 4200m 10 miles before ATAGA.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航527，下到4200米，在ATAGA前10海里下到4200米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200m, reach 4200m 10 miles before ATAGA, CCA527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到4200米，在ATAGA前10海里下到4200米，国航527。

cards.audioText: CSN6682, roger PAN, maintain 3900m, turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 南方6682，收到PAN，保持3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 3900m, Turn left direct to LKO, expect LKO-02 arrival, ILS approach, runway 36R, CSN6682.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持3900米，左转直飞LKO，预计LKO-02进场，ILS进近，跑道36右，南方6682。

cards.audioText: Your call sign is JAL220, from Tokyo to Wuhan, now you are cruising at 10400m, over OBLIK, you received an urgency call from CCA105, they encountered receiver failure and they are transmitting blind, inform this to Wuhan control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是日航220，从东京飞往武汉，现在你在10400米巡航，飞过OBLIK，你收到来自国航105的紧急呼叫，他们遭遇了接收机失效，现在正在盲发，告知武汉区调。
cards.referenceText: Panpan Relay, Panpan Relay, Panpan Relay, Wuhan Control, JAL220, cruising level 10400m, over OBLIK, we received an urgency call from CCA105, they encountered receiver failure and they are transmitting blind, request emergency assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: Panpan Panpan Panpan，武汉区调，日航220，在10400米巡航，飞过OBLIK，我们收到来自国航105的紧急呼叫，他们遭遇了接收机失效，现在正在盲发，申请紧急援助。

cards.audioText: Your callsign is UAL811, from Los Angeles to Wuhan, you have received an urgency call from AFR131, AFR131 had a suspected slow depressurization, they are leaving 9800 meters for 3000 meters, please relay this message to Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是美联航811，从洛杉矶飞往武汉，你收到法航131的紧急呼叫，法航131疑似遭遇缓慢释压，他们正从九千八下到三千，请将这则信息转发给郑州区调。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Zhengzhou Control, UAL811, message relay from AFR131, AFR131 encountered slow decompression, they are leaving 9800 meters for 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，郑州区调，美联航811，转发法航131的信息，法航131遭遇缓慢释压，他们正从九千八下到三千。

cards.audioText: [Your call sign is NWA89, destination Beijing, 5100m maintaining, approaching KM, expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, information J, now contact Beijing Approach.]
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是NWA（美西北）89，目的地北京，5100米保持，正在接近KM，预计KM01进场，跑道36左，通播J，现在联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, NWA89, 5100m maintaining, approaching KM, expect KM01 arrival, runway 36L, information J.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美西北89，5100米保持，正在接近KM，预计KM01进场，跑道36左，通播J。

cards.audioText: NWA89, Beijing Approach, cleared for KM01 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 36L, descend to and maintain 2700m on QNH 1010.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，北京进近，可以KM01进场，预计跑道36左盲降进近，下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1010。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for KM01 arrival, expect ILS approach, runway 36L, descend to and maintain 2700m on QNH 1010, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以KM01进场，预计跑道36左盲降进近，下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1010，美西北89。

cards.audioText: [Tell the Approach that your GPWS is out of service.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉北京进近飞机的近地警告系统不工作了。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, NWA89, GPWS failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美西北89，近地警告系统故障。

cards.audioText: NWA89, Beijing roger, can you land normally, say intention. [Tell the approach that it is not serious, you can land normally.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，收到，能否正常着陆，说明意图。【告诉北京进近问题不严重，可以正常着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, able to land normally, GPWS failure not serious, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，可以正常着陆，近地警告系统故障不严重，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, Beijing roger, descend to and maintain 900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，北京收到，下降保持900米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 900m, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, turn right heading 330 intercept localizer for runway 36L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，右转航向330切入跑道36左航道，建立报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330 intercept localizer for runway 36L, report established, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向330，切入跑道36左航向道，建立报告，美西北89。

cards.audioText: [Report established on localizer 5 miles final runway 36L.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告五边5海里建立航道36左。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, NWA89, established on localizer 5 miles final runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，美西北89，五边5海里，建立航道36左。

cards.audioText: NWA89, continue approach and contact Beijing Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach and contact Beijing Tower 118.1, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，联系北京塔台118.，美西北89。

cards.audioText: [Report to Tower that you have established ILS.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【报告塔台你已建立盲降。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, NWA89, established ILS.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，美西北89，建立盲降。

cards.audioText: NWA89, cleared to land runway 36L, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，可以着陆36左，脱离报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36L, report vacated, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以着陆36L，脱离后报告，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, confirm altitude, mode C shows you’re too low.[The PAPI shows three red lights, but according to your PFD, your aircraft is high on the glide path. Report to the Tower.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，证实C模式应答机高度模式打开，你高度显示太低。【PAPI显示三个红灯，但根据主飞行显示器，飞机高于下滑道，将情况报告给塔台。】
cards.referenceText: The PAPI indicates we are a little bit low but PFD shows we are high on the glide path, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: PAPI显示飞机位置低，但飞行显示器显示飞机高于下滑道，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, say intention.[Tell the Tower you’re going around.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，说明意图。【告诉塔台你准备复飞。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, NWA89, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，美西北89，复飞。

cards.audioText: NWA89, climb to 2100m, contact Departure 119.9.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，上升2100米，联系离场119.9。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 2100m, contact Departure 119.9, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上升2100米，联系离场119.9，美西北89。

cards.audioText: [You are climbing to 2100m, call Beijing Departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已上升到2100米，联系北京离场。】
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, NWA89, climbing to 2100m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，美西北89，上升2100米。

cards.audioText: NWA89, roger, say intention.[Tell the Departure you want to circle back for another landing on runway 36R.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，收到，说明意图。【告诉离场你想机动飞行一圈后转回跑道36右着陆。】
cards.referenceText: Request circle back for another landing on runway 36R, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求机动飞行一圈后转回跑道36右着陆，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, roger, turn right heading 090 for crosswind.
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，收到，右转航向090加入二边。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 090 for crosswind, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向090加入两边，美西北89。

cards.audioText: NWA89, what is the status of your aircraft?[Tell the controller your aircraft is in good condition, but now you don’t have enough fuel for another missed approach. You want a successful landing this time.]
cards.audioTextZh: 美西北89，飞机现在什么情况？【告诉管制员飞机情况良好，但是你没有足够燃料再次复飞，你希望这次能成功着陆。】
cards.referenceText: The aircraft is in good condition, but I don’t have enough fuel for another missed approach. I need to make a good landing this time, NWA89.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机状况良好，但没有足够燃料再次复飞，这次我需要成功着陆，美西北89。

title: OPI
description: 发音 结构 词汇 流利度 理解能力 应对能力

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered a lightning strike during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过雷击吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never encountered a lightning strike during flight. I know that lightning strikes are dangerous, so I avoid them during flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我在飞行中从未遭遇过雷击。我知道雷击很危险，因此在飞行中会避开雷电活动区域。

cards.audioText: Under what weather conditions are lightning strikes most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷击最可能在哪些天气条件下发生？
cards.referenceText: Lightning strikes are most likely to occur in thunderstorms or cumulonimbus clouds.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击最可能发生在雷暴或积雨云中。

cards.audioText: Why are lightning strikes hazardous to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么雷击会危及飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: A lightning strike may damage the fuselage, wings, or electronic equipment. It may also cause electrical failure or disrupt communication and navigation systems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击可能损坏机身、机翼或电子设备，还可能导致电气故障，或使通信和导航系统中断。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if the aircraft is struck by lightning during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中飞机遭遇雷击时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would first maintain control of the aircraft and follow the SOP and checklist. I would check for structural or system damage and report the situation to ATC. If the damage were severe, I would request a diversion to an alternate airport. After landing, I would request a maintenance inspection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会首先控制好飞机，并遵循标准操作程序和检查单。我会检查飞机是否存在结构或系统损伤，并向空中交通管制报告情况。如果损伤严重，我会申请改航至备降机场。着陆后，我会申请进行维修检查。

cards.audioText: What measures can pilots take to reduce the risk of a lightning strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以采取哪些措施降低遭遇雷击的风险？
cards.referenceText: Before flight, I check the weather reports and avoid areas where lightning is likely. During flight, I monitor the weather radar and request a deviation from ATC if lightning is detected ahead. I also avoid cumulonimbus clouds and thunderstorm areas.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行前，我会查看天气报告，并避开可能发生雷电的区域。飞行中，我会监控气象雷达；如果前方探测到雷电，就向空中交通管制申请绕飞。我还会避开积雨云和雷暴区域。

cards.audioText: What damage can a lightning strike cause to an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷击会对飞机造成哪些损伤？
cards.referenceText: A lightning strike may damage the fuselage, wings, or electronic equipment. It may also cause communication or navigation failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击可能损坏机身、机翼或电子设备，还可能导致通信或导航失效。

cards.audioText: During which phase of flight is an aircraft most likely to be struck by lightning?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在哪个飞行阶段最容易遭遇雷击？
cards.referenceText: An aircraft is most likely to be struck by lightning during climb, descent, or holding rather than at normal cruise altitude. These phases often take it through active cloud layers at lower altitudes. The risk is greatest near thunderstorms and at levels where the temperature is close to freezing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机在爬升、下降或等待阶段比在正常巡航高度更容易遭到雷击，因为这些阶段常会穿过较低高度的活跃云层。雷暴附近以及温度接近冰点的高度层风险最大。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered icing conditions during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过结冰条件吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never encountered in-flight icing. I know that icing can affect aircraft performance, so I try to avoid icing conditions during flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我从未在飞行中遇到过结冰。我知道结冰会影响飞机性能，因此会尽量避开结冰条件。

cards.audioText: What cockpit or other indications can alert pilots to airframe icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些驾驶舱指示或其他迹象可以提醒飞行员机体结冰？
cards.referenceText: Pilots may see ice building up on the windshield or wings. Reduced airspeed, changes in altitude or climb performance, and reports from ATC or other pilots can also provide warning. Some large aircraft have ice detectors that give a direct indication.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可能看到风挡或机翼上开始积冰。空速下降、高度或爬升性能变化，以及空中交通管制或其他飞行员的报告，也能提供警示。一些大型飞机装有可直接提供指示的结冰探测器。

cards.audioText: How can in-flight icing affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 空中结冰会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: In-flight icing may reduce lift, increase drag, and cause flight-control problems or a stall. It may also cause incorrect airspeed or altitude indications and may lead to engine vibration, flameout, or failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行中结冰会减小升力、增大阻力，并可能导致飞行操纵问题或失速。它还可能造成空速或高度指示错误，并可能引起发动机振动、熄火或失效。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they encounter icing conditions in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中遇到结冰条件时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would turn on the pitot heating system, advise ATC of the situation, and request a route or flight-level change to avoid the icing conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会打开空速管加温系统，向空中交通管制报告情况，并申请改变航路或飞行高度层，以避开结冰条件。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if ice begins to accumulate on the wings in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中机翼开始积冰时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would report the situation to ATC and request an altitude change to leave the icing area. I would also turn on the aircraft's de-icing and anti-icing systems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会向空中交通管制报告情况，并申请改变高度以离开结冰区域。我还会打开飞机的除冰和防冰系统。

cards.audioText: Under what atmospheric conditions is aircraft icing likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些大气条件下容易发生飞机结冰？
cards.referenceText: Aircraft icing is likely when the air and aircraft surface temperatures are below 0°C and there are enough supercooled droplets in the air. It is more likely in cold, humid conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当空气和飞机表面温度低于 0°C，且空气中有足够多的过冷水滴时，飞机容易结冰。寒冷潮湿条件下更容易发生结冰。

cards.audioText: On which parts of an aircraft is ice most likely to form?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机哪些部位最容易结冰？
cards.referenceText: Ice is most likely to form on exposed leading edges and critical components. These include the wings, windshield, engine air intakes, pitot tubes, static ports, radio antennas, and landing gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 冰最容易积聚在暴露的前缘和关键部件上，包括机翼、风挡、发动机进气口、空速管、静压孔、无线电天线和起落架。

cards.audioText: What de-icing systems are installed on the aircraft you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的飞机安装了哪些除冰系统？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft I fly uses hot air, electrical heating, and de-icing fluid for ice protection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我所飞的飞机使用热空气、电加温和除冰液进行防冰保护。

cards.audioText: How does an aircraft's anti-icing system work?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机的防冰系统如何工作？
cards.referenceText: An aircraft anti-icing system uses electrical power or hot engine bleed air to heat critical surfaces. These may include the windshield, pitot tubes, wing leading edges, and engine intakes. The heat prevents ice from building up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机防冰系统利用电力或发动机热引气加热关键表面。这些表面可能包括风挡、空速管、机翼前缘和发动机进气口。加热可以防止冰层积聚。

cards.audioText: What types of airframe ice can form in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中可能形成哪些类型的机体积冰？
cards.referenceText: The common types of airframe ice are rime ice, clear ice, and mixed ice.
cards.referenceTextZh: 常见的机体积冰类型包括雾凇冰、明冰和混合冰。

cards.audioText: Which type of airframe ice poses the greatest threat to flight safety, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪种类型的机体积冰对飞行安全威胁最大？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Clear ice poses the greatest threat. It can form a smooth, hard layer that changes the aerodynamic shape, is difficult to remove, and can accumulate quickly. This may lead to a loss of lift and control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 明冰的威胁最大。它会形成光滑坚硬的冰层，改变气动外形，难以清除，而且可能迅速积聚。这可能导致升力和操纵能力丧失。

cards.audioText: What is the difference between de-icing and anti-icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 除冰与防冰有什么区别？
cards.referenceText: De-icing removes ice, snow, or frost that has already accumulated on an aircraft. Anti-icing helps prevent new ice from forming after de-icing. Many operations use de-icing first and anti-icing second.
cards.referenceTextZh: 除冰是清除已经积聚在飞机上的冰、雪或霜。防冰则是在除冰后帮助防止新的冰层形成。许多运行先除冰，随后再进行防冰。

cards.audioText: What is holdover time in ground de-icing and anti-icing operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 在地面除冰和防冰作业中，什么是保持时间？
cards.referenceText: Holdover time is the estimated period during which anti-icing fluid protects an aircraft from ice, snow, or frost accumulation. It begins when the final anti-icing application starts and ends when the fluid loses effectiveness. It depends on the fluid type, weather, and precipitation intensity; if it expires before takeoff, new contamination may form and re-treatment may be needed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持时间是指防冰液保护飞机免受冰、雪或霜积聚的预计时段。它从最后一次防冰液喷洒开始时计算，到防冰液失效时结束。保持时间取决于液体类型、天气和降水强度；如果起飞前超过保持时间，可能再次形成污染，需要重新处理。

cards.audioText: Why must an aircraft take off within the applicable holdover time after ground de-icing or anti-icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在地面除冰或防冰后，为什么必须在适用的保持时间内起飞？
cards.referenceText: Anti-icing fluid loses effectiveness over time. If takeoff is delayed beyond the applicable holdover time, ice, snow, or frost may accumulate again on critical surfaces. This contamination can reduce lift and increase drag, so the aircraft must be treated again before takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 防冰液的有效性会随时间下降。如果起飞延误并超过适用的保持时间，冰、雪或霜可能再次积聚在关键表面上。这种污染会减小升力并增大阻力，因此飞机必须在起飞前重新进行除防冰处理。

cards.audioText: What are the common types of aircraft de-icing and anti-icing fluids?
cards.audioTextZh: 常见的飞机除冰液和防冰液有哪些类型？
cards.referenceText: The four common fluid categories are Type I, Type II, Type III, and Type IV.
cards.referenceTextZh: 常见的四类液体是 I 型、II 型、III 型和 IV 型。

cards.audioText: How do the common types of aircraft de-icing and anti-icing fluids differ?
cards.audioTextZh: 常见类型的飞机除冰液和防冰液有何区别？
cards.referenceText: Type I is a thin, heated de-icing fluid that runs off quickly and provides a short holdover time. Type II is thicker and remains on the surface longer, while Type III is designed for smaller aircraft. Type IV is very thick and provides the longest holdover time.
cards.referenceTextZh: I 型是黏度较低的加热除冰液，会很快流走，保持时间较短。II 型黏度更高，在表面停留时间更长；III 型适用于较小型飞机。IV 型黏度很高，保持时间最长。

cards.audioText: Who is responsible for deciding whether de-icing or anti-icing is needed before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前由谁负责决定是否需要除冰或防冰？
cards.referenceText: The pilot in command has final responsibility for deciding whether de-icing or anti-icing is required. The pilot should assess the weather and any contamination and may consult dispatch and ground de-icing personnel for technical advice. The final decision remains with the captain.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是否需要除冰或防冰，最终由机长负责决定。机长应评估天气和任何污染情况，并可向签派和地面除冰人员征询技术意见。最终决定仍由机长作出。

cards.audioText: How should the appropriate de-icing or anti-icing fluid be selected in heavy snow?
cards.audioTextZh: 大雪条件下应如何选择合适的除冰液或防冰液？
cards.referenceText: In heavy snow, a two-step process may use heated Type I fluid to remove existing contamination, followed by Type IV fluid for anti-icing. The crew should check the fluid's certified weather conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在大雪条件下，两步法可以先使用加热的 I 型液体清除已有污染，再使用 IV 型液体进行防冰。机组应核对该液体获准使用的天气条件。

cards.audioText: What is wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是风切变？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear is a sudden change in wind speed or direction over a short distance or within a small area. It can cause rapid changes in aircraft airspeed and altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变是风速或风向在很短距离或很小区域内突然发生变化。它会使飞机空速和高度迅速改变。

cards.audioText: Where is wind shear most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变最可能在哪里发生？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear is most likely near thunderstorms and convective cells, especially close to the ground where microbursts can affect takeoff and approach. It can also occur near frontal weather and strong changes in surface wind. Low-level wind shear is particularly dangerous because there is little height available for recovery.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变最容易发生在雷暴和强对流单体附近，尤其在接近地面的区域，微下击暴流会影响起飞和进近。它也可能出现在锋面天气和地面风发生强烈变化的区域。低空风切变特别危险，因为可用于改出的高度很少。

cards.audioText: Have you ever received a wind shear warning in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中收到过风切变警告吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never received a wind shear warning in flight. I fly a DA-40 for flight training, and that aircraft does not have a wind shear warning system.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我在飞行中从未收到过风切变警告。我使用 DA-40 进行飞行训练，这种飞机没有风切变警告系统。

cards.audioText: What are the possible consequences if a pilot ignores a wind shear warning?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞行员忽视风切变警告，可能会造成哪些后果？
cards.referenceText: If a pilot ignores a wind shear warning, the aircraft may experience sudden airspeed and altitude changes. It may become difficult to control and could stall or crash.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞行员忽视风切变警告，飞机的空速和高度可能突然变化。飞机可能变得难以操纵，并可能失速或坠毁。

cards.audioText: How are pilots warned about wind shear on your aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的飞机通过什么方式向飞行员发出风切变警告？
cards.referenceText: The DA-40 I fly does not have a wind shear warning system. On large commercial aircraft, weather radar and EGPWS can provide a wind shear warning to the pilots.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的 DA-40 没有风切变警告系统。在大型商用飞机上，气象雷达和 EGPWS 可以向飞行员提供风切变警告。

cards.audioText: Why is wind shear a threat to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么风切变会威胁飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear can cause sudden increases or decreases in airspeed and a rapid loss of altitude. The aircraft may become difficult to control, stall, or crash.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变会使空速突然增大或减小，并造成高度迅速下降。飞机可能变得难以操纵、失速，甚至坠毁。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered wind shear in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过风切变吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I once encountered wind shear during a training flight. The aircraft's speed and altitude changed abruptly. I maintained control, communicated with ATC, and adjusted the flight parameters to recover from the situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我曾在一次训练飞行中遭遇风切变。飞机的速度和高度突然变化。我控制好飞机，与空中交通管制沟通，并调整飞行参数，使飞机恢复正常状态。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they hear a "GO-AROUND, WINDSHEAR AHEAD" warning during approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中听到“复飞，前方风切变”警告时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: The pilots should go around immediately. They should use TOGA thrust, maintain the required configuration until clear of the wind shear, and closely monitor airspeed, altitude, attitude, and vertical speed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应立即复飞。他们应使用 TOGA 推力，在脱离风切变之前保持规定的构型，并密切监控空速、高度、姿态和垂直速度。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they encounter wind shear during the takeoff roll before V1?
cards.audioTextZh: 在 V1 前的起飞滑跑阶段遇到风切变时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: Before V1, the pilots should reject the takeoff by reducing power, using rudder to keep the aircraft straight, and applying the brakes to stop on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 V1 之前，飞行员应减小推力，使用方向舵保持飞机直线，并使用刹车使飞机停在跑道上，从而中断起飞。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you encountered wind shear and a sudden loss of airspeed as the aircraft approached rotation speed?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机接近抬前轮速度时，如果遭遇风切变并且空速突然下降，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If the event were recognized before the takeoff decision speed and a safe rejection could be initiated, I would maintain directional control and reject the takeoff in accordance with the procedure. At or after the decision speed, I would continue, rotate normally at the calculated rotation speed, and follow the wind-shear escape guidance. I would avoid configuration changes until the aircraft was clear of the shear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果在起飞决断速度之前识别到该情况，并且能够安全中断起飞，我会保持方向控制并按照程序中断起飞。在达到或超过决断速度后，我会继续起飞，按计算的抬轮速度正常抬轮，并遵循风切变逃逸指引。在飞机脱离风切变之前，我会避免改变构型。

cards.audioText: How can wind shear cause an aircraft to deviate from the glide slope during approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 进近过程中，风切变如何导致飞机偏离下滑道？
cards.referenceText: A sudden increase in headwind can raise indicated airspeed and lift, causing the aircraft to move above the glide slope. A downdraft or a change to tailwind can reduce airspeed and lift and push it below the glide slope. Because these changes can occur quickly, large corrections may make the approach unstable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 顶风突然增强会使指示空速和升力增大，导致飞机高于下滑道。下沉气流或变为顺风会使空速和升力减小，并将飞机推至下滑道以下。由于这些变化可能迅速发生，过大的修正会使进近变得不稳定。

cards.audioText: Why is low-level wind shear more hazardous than wind shear at higher altitudes?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么低空风切变比高空风切变更危险？
cards.referenceText: Low-level wind shear occurs close to the ground, often during takeoff, climb, approach, or landing. A sudden loss of airspeed or altitude leaves less time and height for recovery, and nearby terrain or buildings may be difficult to clear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低空风切变发生在接近地面的区域，通常出现在起飞、爬升、进近或着陆阶段。空速或高度突然下降会使飞行员用于改出的时间和高度更少，附近地形或建筑物也可能难以越过。

cards.audioText: How should pilots respond to a wind shear warning in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中收到风切变警告时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: During takeoff, the pilots should maintain control, add power, and leave the wind shear area. During landing, they should go around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起飞过程中，飞行员应控制好飞机，增加推力并离开风切变区域。着陆过程中则应复飞。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if they encounter wind shear during takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞过程中遇到风切变时，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If wind shear is encountered before V1, the pilots should not continue the takeoff. If it is encountered after V1, they should maintain aircraft control, add power, and leave the wind shear area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果在 V1 之前遭遇风切变，飞行员不应继续起飞。如果在 V1 之后遭遇，应控制好飞机，增加推力并离开风切变区域。

cards.audioText: How can wind shear affect aircraft performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变会如何影响飞机性能？
cards.referenceText: Wind shear may cause the aircraft's airspeed to increase or decrease, and it may cause a loss of altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 风切变可能使飞机空速增大或减小，也可能造成高度损失。

cards.audioText: What would you do if low-level wind shear were forecast for takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果预报起飞时会出现低空风切变，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If low-level wind shear were forecast before takeoff, I would delay the takeoff or change to another runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果起飞前预报有低空风切变，我会推迟起飞或改用另一条跑道。

cards.audioText: How can pilots recognize that they have encountered wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何判断飞机已经遭遇风切变？
cards.referenceText: Pilots may recognize wind shear from sudden changes in airspeed, ground speed, or vertical speed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以通过空速、地速或垂直速度突然变化来识别风切变。

cards.audioText: What measures can help reduce accidents caused by wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些措施有助于减少风切变造成的事故？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can check forecasts, ATIS, and NOTAMs before flight and avoid takeoff or landing in areas affected by wind shear. In flight, they can use weather radar and pilot reports and monitor wind changes. Training, predictive wind shear systems, and timely ATC alerts also help reduce accidents.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以在飞行前查看预报、ATIS 和航行通告，并避免在受风切变影响的区域起飞或着陆。飞行中可以利用气象雷达和飞行员报告，并监控风的变化。训练、预测式风切变系统以及空中交通管制及时发出的警告也有助于减少事故。

cards.audioText: During which seasons is wind shear most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些季节最容易出现风切变？
cards.referenceText: The season depends on the local climate, so there is no single answer worldwide. Convective wind shear is most likely during the local thunderstorm season, while frontal and inversion-related wind shear can occur at other times. Pilots should use current forecasts, reports, and local weather patterns rather than relying only on the time of year.
cards.referenceTextZh: 具体季节取决于当地气候，因此全球没有统一答案。对流性风切变最常见于当地雷暴季节，而锋面或逆温相关的风切变也可能在其他时段发生。飞行员应依据当前预报、报告和当地天气规律，而不能只看季节。

cards.audioText: What is runway visual range (RVR)?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是跑道视程（RVR）？
cards.referenceText: Runway visual range is the distance over which a pilot on the runway centreline can see the runway surface markings or the lights that outline the runway or identify its centreline. It is normally reported in metres or feet for a particular part of the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道视程是指位于跑道中线上的飞行员能够看清跑道道面标志，或跑道边界灯光及中线灯光的距离。通常以米或英尺报告，并对应跑道的特定部分。

cards.audioText: When should pilots obtain current RVR information?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员应在什么时候获取最新的 RVR 信息？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should obtain current RVR information when visibility at the airport is low.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场能见度较低时，飞行员应获取当前的跑道视程信息。

cards.audioText: From what sources can pilots obtain RVR information?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以从哪些来源获取 RVR 信息？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can obtain RVR information from ATIS or from the air traffic controller.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以从 ATIS 或空中交通管制员处获得跑道视程信息。

cards.audioText: When are low-visibility procedures required?
cards.audioTextZh: 何时需要实施低能见度程序？
cards.referenceText: Low-visibility procedures are required when the reported visibility, cloud ceiling, or RVR reaches the activation criteria published for that aerodrome. ATC or the aerodrome operator activates the procedures to protect sensitive areas and control surface movements. The exact trigger is local, so pilots must check the current airport information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当报告能见度、云底高或跑道视程达到该机场公布的启动标准时，就需要实施低能见度程序。空中交通管制或机场运营方会启动这些程序，以保护敏感区并控制地面活动。具体启动条件由当地规定，因此飞行员必须查看最新机场信息。

cards.audioText: What is your company's policy on takeoffs in low-visibility conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 贵公司对低能见度条件下起飞有什么规定？
cards.referenceText: At my flight school, if the visibility is below our takeoff minimum, we wait for the weather to improve.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我的航校，如果能见度低于我们的起飞最低标准，就等待天气好转。

cards.audioText: What is your company's policy on landings in low-visibility conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 贵公司对低能见度条件下着陆有什么规定？
cards.referenceText: At my flight school, we do not land when the reported weather is below the applicable landing minimum. The approach may be continued only when the aircraft, equipment, airport facilities, and pilot qualifications meet the requirements. If the required visual reference is not obtained at the decision point, we go around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我的航校，报告天气低于适用的着陆最低标准时，我们不会着陆。只有飞机、设备、机场设施和飞行员资质均满足要求时，才能继续进近。如果在决断点未获得所需目视参考，我们就复飞。

cards.audioText: How can pilots prevent runway incursions while taxiing in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度滑行时，飞行员如何防止跑道侵入？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should taxi slowly, use the airport chart, and obtain ATC clearance before entering a runway. They should read back instructions clearly, confirm any doubt with ATC, and maintain good situational awareness. A follow-me vehicle can be requested if necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应缓慢滑行、使用机场图，并在进入跑道前取得空中交通管制许可。他们应清楚复诵指令，对任何疑问向管制确认，并保持良好情景意识。必要时可以申请引导车。

cards.audioText: What precautions should pilots take when taxiing in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度滑行时，飞行员应采取哪些预防措施？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should maintain good situational awareness and follow ATC instructions carefully. If visibility is extremely poor, they may request a follow-me vehicle.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应保持良好情景意识，并认真遵循空中交通管制指令。如果能见度极低，可以申请引导车。

cards.audioText: How can pilots prevent ground collisions in low-visibility conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度条件下，飞行员如何防止地面碰撞？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should taxi slowly and cautiously, follow ATC instructions, and read them back clearly. They should monitor the frequency and airport chart, confirm their position if in doubt, and maintain good cockpit communication and situational awareness.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应缓慢谨慎滑行，遵循空中交通管制指令并清楚复诵。他们应守听频率、查看机场图，有疑问时确认位置，并保持良好的驾驶舱沟通和情景意识。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do after missing the correct taxiway in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度下错过正确滑行道后，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should stop immediately, report the aircraft's position to ATC, and request further instructions. The aircraft should not continue without ATC clearance, and the pilot may request a follow-me vehicle if necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员应立即停车，向空中交通管制报告飞机位置，并申请进一步指令。未经管制许可不得继续滑行，必要时飞行员可以申请引导车。

cards.audioText: What consequences can result from disorientation in low-visibility conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度条件下迷失方向可能导致哪些后果？
cards.referenceText: Disorientation in low visibility can lead to a runway incursion, a ground collision, entry onto the wrong taxiway, or a missed approach. It may also cause an unstable landing, runway overrun or veer-off, aircraft damage, and injuries.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低能见度下的迷航可能导致跑道侵入、地面碰撞、误入错误滑行道或复飞。还可能造成着陆不稳定、冲出或偏出跑道、飞机损坏和人员受伤。

cards.audioText: What hazards can arise during low-visibility operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度运行中可能出现哪些危险？
cards.referenceText: Low visibility can reduce situational awareness, increase pilot workload, and raise the risk of misjudgment. It may lead to a runway incursion, ground collision, missed taxiway or runway, unstable approach, go-around, delay, or diversion.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低能见度会降低情景意识、增加飞行员工作负荷，并提高误判风险。它可能导致跑道侵入、地面碰撞、错过滑行道或跑道、进近不稳定、复飞、延误或改航。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered turbulence during a flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过颠簸吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. During a training flight from Guanghan to Suining, I encountered severe turbulence while cruising at 1,800 metres. We maintained control and climbed to 2,100 metres, where the conditions became normal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的。在一次从广汉飞往遂宁的训练飞行中，我在 1,800 米巡航时遭遇严重颠簸。我们控制好飞机并爬升到 2,100 米，之后飞行条件恢复正常。

cards.audioText: Do you think turbulence is dangerous to flight safety? Why or why not?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为颠簸会危及飞行安全吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Light turbulence is usually manageable, but severe turbulence can be dangerous. It may make the aircraft difficult to control, cause an altitude deviation or structural damage, and injure people on board. For that reason, severe turbulence should be avoided when possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 轻度颠簸通常可以应对，但严重颠簸可能非常危险。它会使飞机难以操纵，造成高度偏差或结构损伤，并使机上人员受伤。因此，应尽可能避开严重颠簸。

cards.audioText: Why is severe turbulence dangerous?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么严重颠簸很危险？
cards.referenceText: Severe turbulence can make the aircraft difficult to control and cause a sudden loss of speed or altitude. It may damage the fuselage or wings and injure crew members or passengers. It is especially hazardous during critical phases such as takeoff and landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 严重颠簸会使飞机难以操纵，并造成速度或高度突然下降。它可能损坏机身或机翼，使机组成员或旅客受伤。在起飞和着陆等关键阶段，危险尤其大。

cards.audioText: What damage can severe turbulence cause?
cards.audioTextZh: 严重颠簸会造成哪些损伤？
cards.referenceText: Severe turbulence can cause structural damage to the aircraft, including damage to the fuselage and wings.
cards.referenceTextZh: 严重颠簸会造成飞机结构损伤，包括机身和机翼损伤。

cards.audioText: What procedures should pilots follow to avoid clear-air turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 为避免晴空颠簸，飞行员应遵循哪些程序？
cards.referenceText: Before flight, pilots should review weather forecasts, pilot reports, and information from ATC and brief the crew about possible clear-air turbulence. In flight, they should remain in contact with ATC and request a route or altitude change when necessary. The crew and passengers should fasten their seatbelts when turbulence is expected or encountered.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行前，飞行员应查看天气预报、飞行员报告和空中交通管制信息，并向机组说明可能出现的晴空颠簸。飞行中应与管制保持联系，并在必要时申请改变航路或高度。预计或遭遇颠簸时，机组和旅客应系好安全带。

cards.audioText: What threats does clear-air turbulence pose to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 晴空颠簸会对飞行安全构成哪些威胁？
cards.referenceText: Clear-air turbulence can be difficult to detect before the aircraft enters it. It can make the aircraft difficult to control, cause structural damage to the fuselage or wings, and injure passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机进入晴空颠簸前可能很难探测到它。晴空颠簸会使飞机难以操纵，造成机身或机翼结构损伤，并使旅客受伤。

cards.audioText: How can pilots reduce the risks of turbulence during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中，飞行员如何降低颠簸带来的风险？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can obtain turbulence reports from other aircraft and ATC. If turbulence is encountered, they should report it to ATC and request an altitude change when appropriate. They should also inform the cabin crew and passengers to remain seated and fasten their seatbelts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以从其他飞机和空中交通管制获得颠簸报告。遭遇颠簸时，应向管制报告，并在适当情况下申请改变高度。还应通知客舱机组和旅客保持就座并系好安全带。

cards.audioText: What is clear-air turbulence (CAT)?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是晴空颠簸（CAT）？
cards.referenceText: CAT stands for clear-air turbulence. It is turbulence that occurs in clear air without visible clouds.
cards.referenceTextZh: CAT 是晴空颠簸的缩写。它是发生在没有可见云层的晴空中的颠簸。

cards.audioText: How can mountain-wave turbulence affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 山岳波颠簸会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Mountain-wave turbulence can cause violent shaking and make the aircraft difficult to control. It may lead to a loss of speed or altitude, structural damage, and injuries. It also increases pilot workload and the risk of unstable flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 山地波颠簸会造成剧烈抖动，并使飞机难以操纵。它可能导致速度或高度损失、结构损伤和人员受伤，还会增加飞行员工作负荷和飞行不稳定的风险。

cards.audioText: How can pilots detect cumulonimbus clouds or thunderstorms ahead during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中，飞行员如何探测前方的积雨云或雷暴？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can obtain information from ATC, look outside for visible cumulonimbus clouds, and monitor the airborne weather radar for cumulonimbus clouds or thunderstorms ahead. Good task sharing allows the pilot flying to control the aircraft while the pilot monitoring watches the weather information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以从空中交通管制获取信息，目视查找积雨云，并利用机载气象雷达监控前方积雨云或雷暴。良好的任务分工使操纵飞行员能够控制飞机，监控飞行员则关注天气信息。

cards.audioText: What hazards can cumulonimbus clouds and thunderstorms pose to an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 积雨云和雷暴会给飞机带来哪些危险？
cards.referenceText: Cumulonimbus clouds and thunderstorms may contain lightning, heavy rain, strong winds, and severe turbulence. These hazards can make the aircraft difficult to control, reduce visibility, damage the structure or electronic equipment, and injure passengers. Heavy rain may also contribute to an engine flameout.
cards.referenceTextZh: 积雨云和雷暴中可能有雷电、强降雨、强风和严重颠簸。这些危险会使飞机难以操纵、降低能见度、损坏结构或电子设备，并使旅客受伤。强降雨还可能导致发动机熄火。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered a cumulonimbus cloud or thunderstorm during a flight? If so, what happened?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过积雨云或雷暴吗？如果遇到过，当时发生了什么？
