It allows the pilot to see the required information without having to look down.
It is used to present information such as airspeed, heading and altitude and so on to the pilot.
cards.referenceTextZh:
HUD指的是抬头显示，它是驾驶舱里的现代设备。
它允许飞行员不用低头就可以获得所需信息。
它可以向飞行员展示空速、航向、高度等信息。

cards.audioText: What is CVR? What are the functions of CVR?
cards.audioTextZh: CVR是什么？CVR的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: CVR stands for cockpit voice recorder. CVR is used to record audio in the cockpit, on radio and intercom communications.
cards.referenceTextZh: CVR是驾驶舱话音记录器的缩写。CVR用于记录驾驶舱内的无线电和对讲机通信的音频。

cards.audioText: What do you know about FDR?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道飞行数据记录仪吗？
cards.referenceText: FDR stands for flight data recorder.
cards.referenceTextZh: FDR指的是飞行数据记录器。

cards.audioText: What are the usage of CVR and FDR?
cards.audioTextZh: CVR和FDR的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText:
CVR and FDR also called the black box, which is usually painted in red or orange.
They record many important flight information, such as altitude, heading, speed, rate of climb, engine parameters, aircraft system operating condition, etc.
The CVR and FDR can help investigators to analyze the accident afterwards.
cards.referenceTextZh:
CVR和FDR也被称为黑匣子，通常被漆成红色或橙色。
它们记录了许多重要的飞行信息，如高度、航向、速度、爬升率、发动机参数、飞机系统运行状况等。
CVR和FDR可以帮助调查人员在事后对事故进行分析。

cards.audioText: What is EFB? What is the usage of EFB?
cards.audioTextZh: EFB是什么？EFB的用处是什么？
cards.referenceText:
EFB stands for electronic flight bag.
It is an electronic information management device that helps flight crews perform flight management tasks more easily and efficiently by using less paper.
It is designed to reduce or replace the paper references commonly found in flight bags carried by pilots, including: aircraft operations manuals, flight crew operations manuals, and navigation chart.
cards.referenceTextZh:
EFB指的是电子飞行包。
它是一种电子信息管理设备，通过减少纸张的使用，帮助机组人员更容易、更有效地执行飞行管理任务。
其目的是减少或替代飞行员随身携带的飞行包中常见的纸质参考资料，包括:飞机操作手册、机组操作手册、航图等。

cards.audioText: What will you do if you see the airport below but with EGPWS triggered?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你看到机场，但是你的EGPWS触发了，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: If we have seen the airport but our EGPWS was triggered, we will follow the EGPWS to pull up the aircraft, and make a missed approach, then we will report this situation to ATC.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我们已经看见跑道，但近地警告被触发，我们将遵照近地警告系统指示拉起飞机并且复飞，然后我们要把这个情况汇报给管制员。

cards.audioText: What do you know about the TCAS?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对TCAS了解多少？
cards.referenceText:
TCAS stands for Traffic Collision Alert and Avoidance System.
TCAS indicates the speed, direction, and position of the conflicting traffic.
In case of TCAS RA, it also guides the aircraft to avoid traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh:
TCAS是空中防撞系统的缩写。
TCAS显示冲突航空器的速度、方向和位置。
在TCAS RA的情况下，它还可以引导飞机避开冲突航空器。

cards.audioText: Is your aircraft equipped with TCAS?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的飞机上有TCAS吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I fly Cessna172, we don’t have it on my aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我飞的是塞斯纳172，我的飞机上没有TCAS。

cards.audioText: Who will be allowed to enter the cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 谁可以被允许进入驾驶舱？
cards.referenceText: Usually the flight crew, inspectors, supervisors can be allowed to enter the cockpit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常是飞行机组、检察员或者局方检察员可以被允许进入驾驶舱。

cards.audioText: What EFB application do you use during the pre-flight preparation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行前准备中，你会使用什么EFB程序？
cards.referenceText: Usually, I often use flight crew operating manual, navigation chart and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常，我会使用机组操作手册，导航图等。

cards.audioText: What is your opinion on your company’s CVR supervision policy?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们公司的CVR监管政策是什么？
cards.referenceText: The cockpit voice recorder mainly records the conversations between the crew and the controllers on the ground, as well as various sounds in the cockpit (including the running of the aircraft engine) and so on. In our company, the flight supervision department has the right to monitor the CVR.
cards.referenceTextZh: 驾驶舱话音记录器主要记录机组人员和地面管制人员的通话、机组人员之间的对话以及驾驶舱内出现的各种音响（包括飞机发动机的运转声音）等。在我们公司，飞行监管部门有权对CVR进行监控。

cards.audioText: Will the supervision affect your performance in flight, like your action or operation will be restricted?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得公司对CVR的监管会影响你的飞行表现吗？譬如限制你的行为和操作？
cards.referenceText: No, it won’t. Because as a qualified pilot, we should be responsibility for our action and operation so as to ensure flight safety. It is a good way to remind us keep focused on our duties.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，不会。因为作为一名合格的飞行员，我们需要对自己的行为和操作负责，以此来保证飞行安全。监管是一个提醒我们专注于自己责任的好方法。

cards.audioText: Can the HUD be used to lower the landing minimum?
cards.audioTextZh: HUD可以用来降低着陆的最小值吗？
cards.referenceText: HUD can make the aircraft take off in low visibility, and reduce the decision altitude of the aircraft when landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以使飞机在低能见度下起飞，在飞机着陆时，可以降低飞机的决断高度。

cards.audioText: Besides HUD, do you know any other minimum equipment landing facilities?
cards.audioTextZh: 除了HUD，你还知道其他别的最小着陆设备吗？
cards.referenceText: Well, sorry, I am still a student pilot now, I am not familiar with this question, but in the future, I hope I can be a qualified pilot and have more knowledge to answer this question.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不好意思，我现在还是一个飞行学员，我对这个问题还不是很熟悉，但是在将来，我希望自己可以做一名合格的飞行员，然后有更多的知识储备来回答这个问题。

cards.audioText: Can you name some emergency equipment in your cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能说出飞机驾驶舱里的应急设备吗？
cards.referenceText: We have a lot of emergency equipment in the cockpit, such as portable oxygen bottles, first aid kits, fire extinguishers and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的驾驶舱里有很多应急设备，譬如说手提氧气瓶、急救箱、灭火瓶等。

cards.audioText: What was the aircraft you first flew?
cards.audioTextZh: 你第一次驾驶的飞机是什么型号？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft I first flew was C172, which was made in the US. It’s a four-seat, single-engine, high-wing and fixed-wing aircraft. The cruising altitude of C172 is usually below 3000 meters. In C172, there’s no pressurization system and air conditioning system, and its slow speed is good for pilots to enjoy the beautiful sceneries while flying. I flew C172 for about 120 hours. My flying experience with C172 was very interesting and memorable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我第一次驾驶的是塞斯纳172型飞机，产自美国。塞斯纳172是一款四座位单引擎上单翼固定翼飞机。其巡航高度通常在3000米以下，机舱内无增压系统和空气调节系统。另外，塞斯纳172的飞行速度较慢，适合飞行员欣赏途中的风景。我驾驶C172大约120小时，这些飞行经历既有趣又难忘。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft do you fly now? What other types have you flown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在飞什么机型？你还飞过其它机型么？
cards.referenceText: I fly A320 of Airbus family now, and I have flown Y-5, a single propeller aircraft, and MD82. They are conventional aircraft. The flight management and navigation systems are out of date, but the maneuverability of MD82 is excellent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我现在飞空客A320系列，之前飞过单螺旋桨的Y-5系列和MD82型飞机，它们都是传统型号的飞机。虽然飞行管理系统和导航系统都已过时，但MD82的机动性能仍很出色。

cards.audioText: What are the main types of aircraft in your fleet?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们机队的主要机型有哪些？
cards.referenceText: Our fleet consists of more than one hundred Airbuses, more than seventy Boeings and some other aircraft like MD, CRJ, and ERJ.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们机队有100余架空客飞机，70余架波音型飞机，以及MD、 CRJ、ERJ型飞机。

cards.audioText: Can you say something about the A320?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能介绍下A320型飞机吗？
cards.referenceText:
A320 is a short to medium range aircraft with two powerful turbofan engines. It has a single aisle and its maximum seating capacity is 158. A320 has fly-by-wire and is easy to control. It has advanced flight management system and greatly reduces the work load of pilot.

I don't fly Airbus aircraft so I'm not familiar with it, but I know Airbus is highly computerized. So, in abnormal situation, it can solve most of the problems automatically. It is fly-by-wire, which can reduce pilots’ workload. Also in Airbus aircraft, the traditional control column has been replaced by side-sticks, thus
giving pilots more space in the cockpit.
cards.referenceTextZh:
A320系列是一款单通道双发中短程飞机，舱内设158个座位。A320操作便捷，采用电传操控系统。其先进的飞行管理系统，大幅减轻了飞行员的工作负荷。

我没飞过空客系列，所以我不了解A320，但我知道空客飞机是高度计算机化产品。遇到异常情况时，它可以自动解决大部分的问题。A320采用电传操纵，减轻了飞行员的工作负荷。另外，空客飞机采用侧置的操纵杆代替传统驾驶盘，为飞
行员提供了更多的座舱空间。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft did you fly in your flight school?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行学院时你飞过什么型号的飞机？
cards.referenceText: I flew TB-20 and PA-42 in my flight school. TB-20 is light, single engine, pistonpowered aircraft designed in the late 1970s. It has a variable pitch propeller, and it's the first of this class in Europe at that time. The Piper PA-42 Cheyenne is a turboprop aircraft built by Piper Aircraft. The PA-42 Cheyennes are developed from the earlier PA-31T Cheyennes I and II.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在飞行学院飞过TB-20和 PA-42。TB-20是一款小型单引擎活塞式飞机，设计于20世纪70年代。它配备了可变螺距螺旋桨，是当时欧洲同级别飞机中的翘楚。派珀PA-42系列是由派珀公司研发的涡轮螺旋桨飞机。派珀PA-42夏衍是在早期的PA-31T夏衍I和PA-31T夏衍II的基础上设计研发的。

cards.audioText: What are some advantages of Airbus compared to Boeing?
cards.audioTextZh: 和波音系列相比，空中客车系列有哪些优点？
cards.referenceText:
Airbus is much more efficient and economical to operate than Boeing. Besides, Airbus pays more attention to the introduction of advanced technology to improve aircraft performance. For example, it was the first time to introduce digital fly-by-wire controls into an airliner, which facilitated the aircraft operation greatly.

Airbus is highly computerized. In abnormal situation, it can solve most problems automatically, but Boeing usually shows problems on warning display and pilots will have to do checklists and solve problems by themselves. Also in Airbus aircraft, the traditional control column has been replaced by side-sticks. Thus, pilots have more space in the cockpit than in Boeing aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh:
相比于波音系列，空客系列操作起来更加高效经济。另外，空客公司更加注重引进先进技术，提高飞机性能。例如，空客公司是首个使用数字电传操纵飞行控制系统的公司，极大地方便了飞机的操作。

空客飞机高度计算机化。遇到异常情况时，它可以自行解决大部分问题，而波音系列通常是在警告指示上显示，飞行员必须按照检查单自行解决问题。另外，空客系列已经采用侧置的操纵杆代替传统驾驶盘。飞行员在座舱内的活动空间比波音系列大。

cards.audioText: What is the spoiler and what is its function?
cards.audioTextZh: 扰流板是什么？它有什么功能？
cards.referenceText: The spoiler is a device hinged on the upper surface of an airplane wing to break up the airflow around an aerodynamic surface, decrease lift and provide bank or descent control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 扰流板位于机翼上表面，用来阻断机翼气动面的气流，减少升力，提供坡度或控制下降。

cards.audioText: What's the function of the air conditioning system and what would you do if you experienced air conditioning system malfunction in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 空气调节系统的功能是什么？飞行中如果遇到空气调节系统失灵怎么办？
cards.referenceText:
As far as I know, the air conditioning system is applied to heat and cool the cabin and cockpit to desired temperature settings. If I encountered air conditioning
malfunction in flight, I would first do trouble shooting according to the SOPs, and if it’s hard to solve the problem, I will descend to a low altitude to assure safety and request to land at the neatest airport as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，空气调节系统用于加热或冷却客舱和座舱温度到所需温度值。若飞行中空气调节系统失灵，首先我会按照操作程序进行故障排查，如不能解决问题，我会操控飞机较低高度以确保安全，并迅速向最近的机场发送降落请求。

cards.audioText: Where do airplanes get their electrical supply?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在哪里充电？
cards.referenceText: Engines are the main devices that supply electrical power to the aircraft, besides, the ground power and APU can supply power to the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发动机是为飞机提供电能的主要装置，此外地面电源和APU（辅助动力装置）也可以为飞机提供电能。

cards.audioText: What if the electrical system malfunctions in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中电气系统发生故障应如何应对？
cards.referenceText: First I will do some immediate action such as reset alternator/ generator by turning their switches or circuit breakers off, then on again. If problem persists, I will turn alternator/generator off, start conserve battery power and request priority landing at the nearest airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先我会立即采取一些行动，如通过重启开关或关闭断路器来重置发电机。如果问题仍未解决，我会关闭发电机，节省电量，并请求优先降落在最近的机场。

cards.audioText: Can you briefly say something about the wind shear warning system?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能否简单地介绍下飞机上的风切变预警系统？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, Boeing and Airbus are equipped with two kinds of aircraft wind shear systems, predictive wind shear (PWS) and reactive wind shear systems (RWS). Comparatively speaking, the alerting time of PWS is much longer than that of the RWS.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，波音和空客飞机都配备了两种风切变系统，分别是预测性风切变系统（PWS）和反应式切变系统（RWS）。相比而言，预测性风切变系统的报警时间比反应式风切变系统要长。

cards.audioText: Is the phraseology important to the radio communication for pilots? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在无线电通讯中使用术语是否重要？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Radio phraseologe is critical, it can avoid the misunderstanding in the communication between pilots and controllers. Proper phraseology enhances safety and is also the performance of a professional pilot.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，无线电术语非常关键，可以避免飞行员与管制员通信中的误解。使用标准术语可提高安全性，也是专业飞行员的表现。

cards.audioText: In what situations may the radio communication failure happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 在何种情况下会发生无线电通信故障？
cards.referenceText: Although the complete loss of communication is an extremely rare event due to duplication of equipment in modern aircraft, there are still situations which contribute to full or partial communication breakdown, such as airborne or ground radio equipment malfunction, radio interference, stuck microphone selector, English language skills below the required level, etc. So pilots and controllers should be well prepared to manage it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于现代飞机上安装了双套通信设备，无线电通信完全故障极其罕见，但仍存在导致通信完全或部分故障的情况，如机载或地面无线电设备故障、无线电干扰、麦克风故障，以及英语能力不达标等。因此飞行员和管制员应为无线电通讯故障做好充足的准备。

cards.audioText: How should you perform when the radio communication failure happens?
cards.audioTextZh: 无线电通信故障发生时你应如何应对？
cards.referenceText: First I will try to contact ATC on 121.5MHz, if it doesn't work, I will squawk 7600 and continue the route last assigned by ATC. If I can receive ATC instruction but I can’t transmit out, I will squawk ident to confirm the instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先我会尝试通过调频121.5和ATC联系，若无法联系，我会把应答机拨到7600编码并按照ATC上一指令继续航程。若可以收到ATC的指令但无法回复，我会按下通讯窗口的【IDENT】键以确认指令。

cards.audioText: Do you know some incidents caused by the radio communication failure? If yes, can you tell me one of them?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道一些由无线电通信故障引发的事故吗？如果知道，能否告诉我其中一件？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Although I have never encountered the situation by myself, I heard about some. For example, in 2012, an airplane flown by Spanish carrier Vueling from Malaga to Amsterdam lost radio contact with ATC, as soon as the plane landed at Schiphol airport, it was surrounded by security forces and a negotiator was sent to talk to the crew. After speaking to the captain the negotiator was certain there were no hijackers on the plane. The Netherlands intercepted it with two fighter planes and then sent security forces to surround it at Amsterdam airport in a hijack scare caused by a loss of radio contact.
cards.referenceTextZh: 知道。我未亲身经历过，但听说过。例如，2012年，西班牙伏林航空公司运营的一架从马拉加飞往阿姆斯特丹的飞机和ATC失去了联系，飞机降落在史基浦机场上时，安全部队立刻包围了飞机，一名谈判代表被指派前往和机组人员交涉。谈判代表和机长交涉后确认机上没有劫持者。荷兰空管因无法与该飞机进行无线电通信，怀疑其被劫持，因而派出两架战斗机拦截了这架飞机，并派遣安全部队在阿姆斯特丹机场包围了它。

cards.audioText: What do you know about the navigation aids in aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对飞机上的导航系统了解多少？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, aircraft are installed with several navigation aids, for instance, automatic direction finder (ADF), inertial navigation, compasses, radar navigation, VHF omnidirectional range (VOR) and global navigation satellite system (GNSS).
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，飞机上安装了多种导航系统，例如，自动测向仪（ADF）、惯性导航、罗盘、雷达导航、全向导航（VOR）和全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）。

cards.audioText: Will an aircraft totally lose navigation aids?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机的导航系统会完全失效吗？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, total navigation aids failure of aircraft will never happen, since there are several independently navigation operating instruments, pilots can generally get some sort of directions. The plane has its magnetic compass and hopefully gyro compass as well, and pilots also can look through windows to look for landmarks during low level flight, so normally an aircraft won't totally lose navigation aids.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，飞机导航系统不会完全失效，因为飞机上有几个独立的导航操控仪器，飞行员大体上可以辨别出方向。飞机上有磁罗盘及陀螺仪，并且在较低高度飞行时，飞行员可以窗外寻找路标，所以飞机一般不会完全失去导航系统。

cards.audioText: What will you do if you find your navigation system is inaccurate during flight? Have you heard such malfunction that caused an incident?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果发现导航系统不准确，你会怎样做？你知道这一故障引起的事故吗？
cards.referenceText: I will ask for ATC assistance to confirm my current position and heading, then I will disengage autopilot and change to manual control, meanwhile I will request direct route for quick landing. I've heard such accident before, which was Adam Air Flight 574 in 2007. The pilots lost control of the aircraft after they became preoccupied with troubleshooting the inertial navigation system and inadvertently disconnected the autopilot. In this accident, the aircraft crashed with all 102 people on board died.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会请ATC协助确认当前位置和航向，之后我会解除自动驾驶状态，手动操纵飞机，同时我会请求较短航线尽快着陆。我曾听过这种事故，2007年发生在亚当航空574号航班上。飞行员专注于处理机上惯性导航系统故障，无意解除了自动驾驶系统，无法控制飞机。这次事故中，这架飞机坠毁，机上全部102名人员遇难。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me something about the lighting systems in the airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能否介绍一下机场照明系统？
cards.referenceText:
In an airport, there are various kinds of lighting systems, like the approach and landing lighting systems, including Precision Approach Path Indicator (PAPI) lights and Visual Approach Slope Indicator System (VASIS) lights. Also, there are runway lighting systems, such as runway centerline lighting systems, runway
edge lighting systems and so on. Moreover, some taxiways even have automatic lighting systems. They are used to help aircraft landing at night, in heavy rain, fog or some other poor visibility condition. The intensity of the runway lighting systems can be adjusted to help pilots see the runway better, and the lights on
the runways and taxiways serve to guide pilots to make ground movement when necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场内有多种照明系统，如进场着陆照明系统，包括精密进近航道指示器（PAPI）和目视进近下滑道指示系统（VASIS）。机场还有跑道照明系统，如跑道中心线照明系统、跑道边缘照明系统等。此外，部分滑行道甚至有自动照明系统。这些照明系统用于帮助飞机在夜间、雨天、雾天等能见度低的情况下着陆。跑道照明系统的强度可以调节，以帮助飞行员更好地观察跑道，跑道和滑行道上的照明灯用于指导飞行员在必要时进行地面活动。

cards.audioText: Do you want to fly any new type of aircraft such as B787 or A380?
cards.audioTextZh: 你想驾驶新型飞机吗，如波音787或空客A380？
cards.referenceText: B787 is the dreamliner, and A380 is the biggest passenger aircraft in the world. The feeling of flying that kind of aircraft will be different. So, it would be great to have a chance to fly the big aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 波音787是梦幻客机，A380是世界上载客量最大的飞机。驾驶这些飞机会有不同的感觉。所以如果有机会能飞大飞机肯定很不错。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer flying two-engine or four-engine aircraft? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢驾驶双发飞机还是四发飞机？为什么？
cards.referenceText: In consideration of safety, I don't know which to choose, because both of them are designed to be very safe, even though a few of them had some accidents because of abnormal situations. While in view of comfort, I prefer two-engine aircraft, since they produce less noise and are more comfortable for passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 考虑到安全性，我不知道如何选择，因为两种飞机设计得都很安全。虽然其中一些机型因非正常情况出过事故。若考虑舒适性，我更喜欢双发飞机，因为其噪音小，更舒适。

cards.audioText: What is the most significant difference between RNAV and RNP?
cards.audioTextZh: RNAV和RNP有哪些主要不同点？
cards.referenceText: RNAV (regional area navigation) relies on ground navigation equipment, which cannot provide accurate navigation and requires radar monitoring. Therefore, RNAV is often used in large airports with ground navigation facilities. RNP (required navigation) relies on GNSS, whose onboard equipment must be capable of monitoring and alerting, does not require radar monitoring, and can operate in mountainous or highland airports where ground equipment is lacking.
cards.referenceTextZh: RNAV（区域导航）依赖于地面导航设备，不能提供精确导航，需要雷达监控，因此常应用于地面导航设施齐备的大型机场；RNP（所需导航性能）依赖于GNSS（全球导航卫星系统），其机载设备必须具备监视和告警的性能，不需要雷达监控，可以在缺乏地面设备的山区或高原机场运行。

cards.audioText: Are there wind shear detection radar system deployed at airplanes?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机上是否有风切变探测系统？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. In the predictive wind shear detection mode, the weather radar processor of the aircraft detects the presence of the microburst. To complement the reactive wind shear system and provide an early warning of potential wind shear activity, some weather radars feature the capability to detect wind shear areas ahead of
the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有。预测风切变检测模式下，机上的天气雷达处理器检测出是否存在微爆流。为了弥补反应性风切变系统的不足，并提供潜在风切变活动预警，一些天气雷达具有检测飞机前方是否有风切变区域的能力。

cards.audioText: How does the wind shear warning system work?
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变预警系统如何工作？
cards.referenceText: The wind shear warning system is initiated whenever the energy level of aircraft falls below a predetermined threshold. The airborne wind shear detection and alert system, fitted in an aircraft, detects and alerts the pilot both visually and aurally of a wind shear condition. In reactive wind shear detection system, the detection takes place when the aircraft penetrates a wind shear condition of sufficient force, which can pose a hazard to the aircraft. While in predictive wind shear detection system, the detection takes place, if such wind shear condition is ahead of the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机的能量水平低于预定阈值时，风切变预警系统将会启动。风切变探测和预警系统安装在飞机内部，为飞行员在视觉和听觉上提供风切变警告。反应性风切变预警系统在飞机进入强力风切变区域时发出警告，这可能对飞机造成危害。而预测性风切变预警系统在飞机前方出现风切变状况就会进行预警。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me something about the components of electric system in an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能介绍下机上电气系统组件吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Aircraft are installed with either a 14 or 28 volt direct-current electrical system, and normally aircraft electric system consists of the following parts: generator, battery, battery switch, bus bar, fuses, and circuit breakers, voltage regulator, load meter, associated electrical wiring, etc.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。飞机安装有14或28伏直流电气系统。通常飞机电气系统由以下部件组成：发电机、电池、电池开关、汇流条、保险丝、断路器、稳压器、测力计和关联电线等。

cards.audioText: How does the electric system work in aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机上的电气系统如何工作？
cards.referenceText: An aircraft electrical system is a self contained network of components that generate, transmit, distribute, utilize and store electrical energy. It can be turned on or off with a battery switch which controls the electrical power to aircraft in a way similar to the master switch. Turning the battery switch to “ON” position can provide electrical energy to all the electrical facilities circuits except the ignition system.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机的电气系统是由产生、传输、分配、利用和存储电能的部件组成的封闭网络。它由一电池开关控制，以类似于主开关的方式掌控飞机的电力。将电池开关转到“ON”位置可以向除点火系统外的所有电气设备电路提供电能。

cards.audioText: What if the electrical system malfunctions?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果电气系统出现故障该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Electrical failure is not very common but does happen every now and then. Usually a blown fuse or circuit breaker popping indicating a temporarily overload on that device or circuit. If it’s circuit breaker tripped, resolve it as the way that nonessential circuit breakers are not to be reset in flight, but essential circuit breakers are to be reset. If it’s inverter inoperative, select the other inverter.
cards.referenceTextZh: 电气系统故障虽不常见但偶尔发生。通常，保险丝熔断或断路器弹出，代表该设备或电路临时超载。若断路器跳闸，不用重置副断路器，但要重置主断路器。若换流器失效，可以选择另一台换流器。

cards.audioText: What's the function of hydraulic system?
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: Hydraulic system is one of the core systems in the aircraft, it’s used to provide hydraulic power to operate many aircraft units such as landing gears, nose wheel steering, brakes and flight control surfaces.
cards.referenceTextZh: 液压系统是飞机中的核心系统之一，它用于给飞机上的许多系统如起落架系统、前轮转弯系统、刹车系统以及飞行操纵面提供液压以完成操纵。

cards.audioText: What does EFIS stand for? What is the use of EFIS?
cards.audioTextZh: EFIS代表的意思是什么？EFIS的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: EFIS stands for electronic flight instrument system. It consists of PFD and MFD. PFD shows primary flight data, such as altitude, heading, attitude, airspeed, vertical speed and yaw. MFD is used to display navigation information, weather information, flight plan and other important information. All the data are displayed on EFIS vividly and accurately. It helps to reduce our workload, improve situation awareness, and enhance flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: EFIS代表电子飞行仪表系统，它由主要飞行显示器（PFD）和多功能飞行显示器（MFD）组成。PFD显示主要飞行数据，例如高度、航向、姿态、速度、垂直速度、转弯；MFD用来显示导航信息、天气信息、飞行计划以及其他重要信息。所有这些信息都生动准确地显示在EFIS上，EFIS有助于减轻工作负荷，提高情景意识，增强飞行安全。

cards.audioText: What are the differences between traditional cockpits and modern cockpits?
cards.audioTextZh: 传统驾驶舱和现代驾驶舱有什么不同？
cards.referenceText: Traditional cockpits use analog instrument to show flight information, such as ADI (Attitude Direction Indicator), HSI (Horizontal Situation Indicator), ASI (Airspeed Indicator), and so on. These analog instruments are more reliable, they can be used even in case of electrical failure. However, each indicator only shows one single flight data, so it may cost more time for pilots to monitor the instrument. Modern cockpits are equipped with digital displays like PFD and MFD. Various important flight information can be shown in a single display. It can save the time of scanning instrument for flight information and thus greatly reduce pilots workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: 传统驾驶舱使用模拟仪表指示飞行数据，例如ADI（姿态指引仪），HSI（水平状态指示器），ASI（空速表）等。传统仪表更可靠，即便电力故障也依然可用，但每块指示器仅显示单个飞行数据，可能需要消耗更多时间监视仪表。现代驾驶舱装有数字显示例如PFD和MFD。各类重要的飞行数据都可以显示在单块仪表上，有助于节省使用仪表查看信息的时间，减轻飞行员的工作负荷。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me something about flight control surfaces?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否介绍一下飞行操纵面？
cards.referenceText: Generally, flight control surfaces can be divided into primary flight control surfaces and secondary flight control surfaces. The primary flight control surfaces include rudders, elevators and ailerons. The secondary flight control surfaces include flaps, slats, trim tabs, spoilers and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行操纵面包括主飞行操纵面和辅助飞行操纵面。主飞行操纵面包括方向舵、升降舵和副翼。辅助飞行操纵面包括襟翼、缝翼、配平调整片、扰流板等。

cards.audioText: What are positions and functions of flight control surfaces?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行操纵面位于哪里？作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: Ailerons are located on each wing and used to control the rolling of aircraft. The rudder is located at the trailing edge of the vertical stabilizer and controls the nose yaw to the left and right. The elevator situated on the trailing edge of the horizontal stabilizer controls the pitch.
cards.referenceTextZh: 副翼位于机翼上，用来控制飞机滚转。方向舵位于垂直安定面后缘，控制机头左右偏转。升降舵位于水平安定面后缘，控制飞机俯仰。

cards.audioText: What are possible reasons that may cause the aircraft out of control?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机失控的原因有哪些？
cards.referenceText: There are many reasons for the aircraft out of control, such as flight control system failure, hydraulic system failure, engine failure, stall, structural damage, and adverse weather like clear air turbulence, micro-burst, wind shear and icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 导致飞机失控的原因有很多，比如飞行操纵失效、液压失效、发动机失效、失速、飞机结构损伤，以及恶劣天气像晴空颠簸、微下击暴流、风切变和积冰。

cards.audioText: What are the flight control limitations of your aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞机型的飞行操纵限制有哪些？
cards.referenceText: I fly C172 now. As far as I know, the stall speed of C172 is 47 knots, the maximum airspeed of C172 is 163 knots, and the service ceiling of C172 is 4100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我现在飞塞斯纳172型飞机。据我所知，塞斯纳172的失速速度是47节，最大空速限制是163节，实用升限是4100米。

cards.audioText: What do you know about oxygen system in an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对氧气系统了解多少？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, the oxygen system on most commercial aircraft consist of the flight crew oxygen system, the passenger oxygen system, and portable oxygen cylinders. If the cabin pressurization system failed and the cabin altitude was above a safe level, oxygen masks will drop down in front of the passenger automatically. Portable oxygen cylinders can be used for first aid.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，大多数客机上的氧气系统都包括机组氧气系统，旅客氧气系统，和便携式氧气瓶。一旦座舱增压系统失效，座舱高度高于安全高度，旅客氧气面罩会自动脱落。便携式氧气瓶可用作急救。

cards.audioText: What are the methods to communicate with ATC during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中与管制通信的方法有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
The most common communication system in use today is the VHF system. In addition to VHF equipment, large aircraft are usually equipped with HF communication systems and CPDLC (Controller-Pilot Data Link
Communications).
cards.referenceTextZh: 当今应用最广泛的通信系统是甚高频（VHF）系统。除了VHF以外，大型飞机通常还装有高频通信（HF）系统和管制员—飞行员数据链通信（CPDLC）。

cards.audioText: What are the differences between passenger flight and cargo flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 客航与货航有什么区别？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, there are some differences between passenger flight and cargo flight. First, for passenger flight, it transports passengers and luggage to their destination; while for cargo flight, it only transports cargo. Second, there are many doors and emergency exits on a passenger flight aircraft, while, there are less doors on a cargo flight aircraft, instead, the doors on the cargo flight aircraft are relatively larger and wider.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，货机和客机存在一些区别。首先，对于客航来说，它是将乘客和货物运送到目的地；而对于货航来，它只运输货物，第二，在客航飞机上，有很多的舱门和紧急出口，然而，在货航飞机上，就没有这么多的舱门，相反，货航飞机上的舱门相对更大更宽。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-1
cards.audioText: How do you think China's aviation industry will develop over the next ten years?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为未来十年中国航空业将如何发展？
cards.referenceText: I think China’s aviation industry will continue to grow over the next ten years. Airlines may expand their fleets and route networks, use more domestically produced aircraft, and apply technologies such as artificial intelligence and big data in operations and passenger services. The industry is also likely to focus more on cleaner aircraft and fuels and on training pilots, controllers, and maintenance personnel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为未来十年中国航空业将继续增长。航空公司可能扩大机队和航线网络，使用更多国产飞机，并在运行和旅客服务中应用人工智能和大数据等技术。行业也可能更加重视更清洁的飞机和燃料，以及飞行员、管制员和维修人员的培养。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-2
cards.audioText: How might cockpit navigation technology develop in the future?
cards.audioTextZh: 未来驾驶舱导航技术可能如何发展？
cards.referenceText: I think cockpit navigation will use more advanced and more integrated systems in the future. Satellite navigation such as GPS and BeiDou may work more closely with RNAV and RNP functions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为未来驾驶舱导航将采用更先进、集成度更高的系统。GPS 和北斗等卫星导航可能与 RNAV 和 RNP 功能更加紧密地协同工作。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-3
cards.audioText: What progress has China's civil aviation made over the past decade?
cards.audioTextZh: 过去十年，中国民航取得了哪些进步？
cards.referenceText: Over the past decade, China’s civil aviation has expanded its route and airport networks and increased its fleet and passenger traffic. It has adopted technologies such as HUD, GNSS, and artificial intelligence and strengthened international cooperation. The development of domestic aircraft such as the C919 has also been an important part of this progress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过去十年，中国民航扩大了航线和机场网络，增加了机队规模和旅客运输量。它采用了 HUD、GNSS 和人工智能等技术，并加强了国际合作。C919 等国产飞机的发展也是这一进步的重要组成部分。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-4
cards.audioText: What new technologies or equipment have been adopted in China's civil aviation?
cards.audioTextZh: 中国民航采用了哪些新技术或新设备？
cards.referenceText: Examples include head-up displays for low-visibility operations and GNSS, RNAV, and RNP for more precise navigation. Electronic flight bags have replaced many paper documents, and artificial intelligence is being used for predictive maintenance. Advanced weather radar and digital communication systems such as CPDLC have also been adopted.
cards.referenceTextZh: 相关例子包括用于低能见度运行的平视显示器，以及用于更精确导航的 GNSS、RNAV 和 RNP。电子飞行包已经取代许多纸质文件，人工智能也用于预测性维修。此外，先进气象雷达和 CPDLC 等数字通信系统也得到应用。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-5
cards.audioText: How can pilots adapt safely to new aviation technologies and equipment?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何安全适应新的航空技术和设备？
cards.referenceText: Pilots can adapt by attending ground and simulator training, studying manuals and updates, and practising with colleagues. They should follow safety regulations and SOPs, use good CRM, and avoid becoming over-reliant on automation. Sharing experience and providing feedback can also help the new equipment be used safely and efficiently.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员可以通过参加地面和模拟机训练、学习手册和更新资料，并与同事练习来适应新设备。他们应遵守安全规章和标准操作程序，运用良好 CRM，并避免过度依赖自动化。分享经验和提供反馈也有助于安全高效地使用新设备。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-6
cards.audioText: Do you think artificial intelligence could replace pilots in the future, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为人工智能未来可能取代飞行员吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: No, I do not think artificial intelligence will completely replace pilots. AI is good at data processing and routine tasks, but pilots provide judgment, situational awareness, and decision-making in complex emergencies. Human supervision and emergency response will remain important for flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，我认为人工智能不会完全取代飞行员。人工智能擅长数据处理和例行任务，但飞行员能在复杂紧急情况下提供判断、情景意识和决策。人的监督和应急响应对飞行安全仍然重要。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-7
cards.audioText: How could augmented reality and virtual reality improve simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 增强现实和虚拟现实可以如何改进模拟机训练？
cards.referenceText: AR and VR could make simulator training feel more realistic. They could help pilots learn procedures, practise abnormal situations, improve flying skills, and build knowledge in a controlled environment. They could also support better communication and cooperation among crew members.
cards.referenceTextZh: AR 和 VR 可以使模拟机训练感觉更真实。它们能帮助飞行员学习程序、练习非正常情况、提高飞行技能，并在受控环境中积累知识。它们还可以促进机组成员之间更好的沟通与合作。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-8
cards.audioText: What do you know about artificial intelligence and its use in aviation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对人工智能及其在航空领域的应用有哪些了解？
cards.referenceText: AI stands for artificial intelligence, an area of computer science concerned with intelligent machines. In aviation, it can support automation, predictive maintenance, weather forecasting, and navigation. It may reduce pilot workload, but human supervision is still needed for safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: AI 是人工智能的缩写，是计算机科学中研究智能机器的领域。在航空中，它可以支持自动化、预测性维修、天气预报和导航。它可能降低飞行员工作负荷，但安全仍需要人的监督。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-9
cards.audioText: What do you know about the C919?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对 C919 有哪些了解？
cards.referenceText: The C919 is a commercial jet developed and manufactured in China for short- to medium-haul routes. It uses LEAP engines and a fly-by-wire flight-control system. The aircraft made its first flight at Shanghai Pudong International Airport on May 5, 2017.
cards.referenceTextZh: C919 是中国研发制造、用于中短程航线的商用喷气飞机。它使用 LEAP 发动机和电传飞行操纵系统。该机于 2017 年五月 5 日在上海浦东国际机场完成首飞。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-10
cards.audioText: What is your opinion of the C919?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何看待 C919？
cards.referenceText: I have a positive opinion of the C919 because it uses modern flight technology. Its fly-by-wire and automatic flight-control systems can improve aircraft performance and passenger comfort, while digital flight instruments can improve situational awareness and reduce pilot workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我对 C919 持积极看法，因为它采用现代飞行技术。其电传和自动飞行操纵系统可以改善飞机性能和旅客舒适度，数字飞行仪表则能提高情景意识并降低飞行员工作负荷。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-11
cards.audioText: How does the C919 compare with other single-aisle commercial aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: C919 与其他单通道商用航空器相比表现如何？
cards.referenceText: Like other single-aisle commercial aircraft, the C919 is designed mainly for short- to medium-haul routes. It has a strong emphasis on Chinese development and intellectual property and uses advanced aerodynamics, lightweight materials, and efficient engines. More established competing aircraft have broader global customer bases and more mature industrial support.
cards.referenceTextZh: 与其他单通道商用飞机一样，C919 主要面向中短程航线。它突出中国自主研发和知识产权，并采用先进气动设计、轻质材料和高效发动机。更成熟的竞争机型拥有更广泛的全球客户基础和更完善的产业支持。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-12
cards.audioText: Which Chinese airlines currently operate the C919?
cards.audioTextZh: 目前有哪些中国航空公司运营 C919？
cards.referenceText: China Eastern Airlines, Air China, and China Southern Airlines currently operate the C919. COMAC confirmed in July 2026 that the aircraft had been delivered to all three airlines and placed in commercial service. The operator list may change as future deliveries enter service.
cards.referenceTextZh: 中国东方航空、中国国际航空和中国南方航空目前运营 C919。中国商飞于 2026 年七月确认，飞机已经交付给这三家航空公司并投入商业运营。随着后续交付进入运行，运营人名单可能发生变化。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-13
cards.audioText: What is sustainable aviation fuel, or SAF?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是可持续航空燃料（SAF）？
cards.referenceText: SAF stands for sustainable aviation fuel. It is aviation fuel made from renewable sources such as used cooking oil, agricultural waste, animal fats, or household waste. It can reduce lifecycle carbon emissions and can be blended with conventional jet fuel for use in existing aircraft engines.
cards.referenceTextZh: SAF 是可持续航空燃料的缩写。它由废弃食用油、农业废弃物、动物脂肪或生活垃圾等可再生来源制成。它可以减少全生命周期碳排放，并能与传统喷气燃料混合后用于现有飞机发动机。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-14
cards.audioText: What are the main advantages of SAF compared with conventional jet fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 与传统航空喷气燃料相比，可持续航空燃料（SAF）有哪些主要优势？
cards.referenceText: SAF can produce lower lifecycle carbon emissions than conventional jet fuel. It can also reduce particulate and sulfur-oxide emissions, which can improve local air quality near airports. SAF can be blended for use in existing engines and refuelling infrastructure, and using waste feedstocks can support a circular economy.
cards.referenceTextZh: SAF 的全生命周期碳排放可以低于传统喷气燃料。它还能减少颗粒物和硫氧化物排放，改善机场附近的局部空气质量。SAF 可以混合后用于现有发动机和加油基础设施，使用废弃物原料也有助于循环经济。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-15
cards.audioText: What are the main challenges of using SAF in commercial aviation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在商业航空中使用可持续航空燃料（SAF）面临哪些主要挑战？
cards.referenceText: The main challenges are high cost and limited supply. Production capacity is still limited, and collecting enough suitable feedstock at scale can be difficult. Certification and testing take time, while transport and storage must be managed carefully to prevent contamination.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要挑战是成本高和供应有限。目前产能仍然不足，大规模收集足够的合适原料也很困难。认证和测试需要时间，运输和储存则必须认真管理以防污染。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-16
cards.audioText: What role can SAF play in aviation's transition toward net-zero carbon emissions?
cards.audioTextZh: 在航空业向净零碳排放转型的过程中，可持续航空燃料（SAF）可以发挥什么作用？
cards.referenceText: SAF can play an important role by reducing lifecycle emissions from aircraft that are already in service. Because it can be used with the existing fleet, it offers a more immediate option than technologies that require completely new aircraft designs. Wider use will still require major investment, greater production capacity, lower costs, and more feedstock.
cards.referenceTextZh: SAF 可以通过降低现役飞机的全生命周期排放发挥重要作用。由于它能用于现有机队，与需要全新飞机设计的技术相比，可以更快投入使用。扩大应用仍需要大量投资、更高产能、更低成本和更多原料。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-1
cards.audioText: What is your current position?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前担任什么职位？
cards.referenceText: I am a student pilot and I am currently undergoing flight training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是一名学员飞行员，目前正在接受飞行训练。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-2
cards.audioText: Could you describe your work background?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能否介绍一下自己的工作经历？
cards.referenceText: I am a student pilot at Jiutian Flight School, where I train on the DA-40. I have accumulated 100 flight hours and currently hold a private pilot licence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是九天航校的一名学员飞行员，使用 DA-40 训练。我已经积累 100 小时飞行时间，目前持有私用驾驶员执照。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-3
cards.audioText: When and where did you complete your most recent transition training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近一次转机型训练是在何时、何地完成的？
cards.referenceText: I have not completed any transition training yet.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有完成任何转机型训练。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-4
cards.audioText: Which aircraft type did your most recent transition training cover?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近一次转机型训练针对哪种机型？
cards.referenceText: No aircraft type applies because I have not completed any transition training yet.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有适用机型，因为我还没有完成任何转机型训练。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-5
cards.audioText: Have you completed any high-performance aircraft training? If so, what did it cover?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否完成过高性能航空器训练？如果有，培训内容是什么？
cards.referenceText: No, I have not completed high-performance aircraft training yet. I am still training on the DA-40 at flight school, so I do not claim any syllabus, qualification, or flight time for a high-performance aircraft. I would complete the programme approved for the relevant aircraft before operating one.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我还没有完成高性能飞机训练。目前仍在航校使用 DA-40 训练，因此不会声称自己具备高性能飞机的课程经历、资质或飞行时间。驾驶相关飞机前，我会完成经批准的训练方案。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-6
cards.audioText: When and where did you complete your high-performance flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在何时、何地完成了高性能飞行训练？
cards.referenceText: I have not completed high-performance flight training yet. I am still receiving flight training at a flight school.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有完成高性能飞行训练，目前仍在航校接受飞行训练。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-7
cards.audioText: How many flight hours did you accumulate during high-performance flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在高性能飞行训练期间积累了多少飞行小时？
cards.referenceText: I have not accumulated any hours in high-performance flight training because I have not started that training yet. My current flight time has been gained during ordinary flight training on the DA-40.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有开始高性能飞行训练，因此没有积累相关飞行时间。目前的飞行时间来自使用 DA-40 进行的普通飞行训练。

cards.audioText: Why is training in aviation English and radiotelephony important for pilots?
cards.audioTextZh: 航空英语和无线电通话训练为什么对飞行员很重要？
cards.referenceText: The training teaches pilots standard phraseology and radiotelephony communication procedures. These skills are important for clear and reliable communication between pilots and air traffic controllers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 培训教授飞行员标准通话用语和无线电通话程序。这些技能对于飞行员与空中交通管制员之间清晰可靠的通信十分重要。

cards.audioText: What aviation English training have you received, including any radiotelephony courses?
cards.audioTextZh: 你接受过哪些航空英语培训，包括无线电通话课程（如有）？
cards.referenceText: I have taken ICAO and ATPL English courses, as well as reading, listening, and spoken-English classes. During ground training, I also completed a course in English radiotelephony communication.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我参加过 ICAO 和 ATPL 英语课程，以及阅读、听力和英语口语课程。地面训练期间，我还完成了英语无线电通话课程。

cards.audioText: How does aviation English differ from everyday English?
cards.audioTextZh: 航空英语与日常英语有何不同？
cards.referenceText: Aviation English places greater emphasis on standard words, phrases, and communication procedures. It is designed to be accurate, concise, and clear so that pilots and controllers avoid misunderstandings. Everyday English is more flexible and can also rely on gestures and other context.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航空英语更强调标准词语、短语和通信程序，要求准确、简洁、清楚，使飞行员和管制员避免误解。日常英语更灵活，也可以依赖手势和其他语境信息。

cards.audioText: What did you learn from your aviation English training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从航空英语培训中学到了什么？
cards.referenceText: I learned the communication procedures used between pilots and controllers. I also learned to use standard words and phrases, speak clearly, and avoid misunderstandings.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我学习了飞行员与管制员之间使用的通信程序，也学习了使用标准词语和短语、清楚表达并避免误解。

cards.audioText: Do you find it difficult to communicate with ATC in English? Why or why not?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得用英语与空中交通管制部门沟通困难吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I sometimes find it difficult, especially when controllers speak quickly, use an unfamiliar accent, or change a clearance unexpectedly. Standard phraseology makes routine calls easier, but non-routine situations require stronger listening and plain-English skills. Regular practice with real ATC recordings and simulator scenarios helps me improve.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，有时我会觉得困难，尤其是管制员语速很快、口音不熟悉，或突然更改许可时。标准通话用语使例行呼叫更容易，但非正常情况需要更强的听力和普通英语表达能力。经常练习真实管制录音和模拟机场景能帮助我提高。

cards.audioText: How do you improve your aviation English communication skills?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何提高自己的航空英语沟通能力？
cards.referenceText: I study ICAO terminology and practise standard communication sentences every day. I use simulator scenarios and practise English radiotelephony with colleagues so that we can correct mistakes. I also listen to real ATC communications, watch training videos, and review aviation English manuals and course material.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我每天学习 ICAO 术语并练习标准通信句子。我利用模拟机场景，并与同事练习英语无线电通话，以便相互纠错。我还收听真实空中交通管制通信、观看培训视频，并复习航空英语手册和课程材料。

cards.audioText: How long have you been learning English?
cards.audioTextZh: 你学习英语多长时间了？
cards.referenceText: I have been learning English for more than 15 years. During flight training, I also studied radiotelephony, aviation terminology, and interview English.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我学习英语已经超过 15 年。飞行训练期间，我还学习了无线电通话、航空术语和面试英语。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft do you currently fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前飞哪种型号的飞机？
cards.referenceText: I am a student pilot, and I currently fly the DA-40 for flight training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是一名学员飞行员，目前使用 DA-40 进行飞行训练。

cards.audioText: What are your plans for your future aviation career?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对未来的航空职业生涯有什么规划？
cards.referenceText: I plan to obtain my commercial pilot licence and then join a reputable airline. I hope to build experience steadily, become a captain in the future, and contribute to safe flight operations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我计划先取得商用驾驶员执照，然后加入一家信誉良好的航空公司。我希望稳步积累经验，将来成为机长，并为飞行安全作出贡献。

cards.audioText: What are the main operating limitations of the aircraft type you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞机型的主要运行限制有哪些？
cards.referenceText: I fly a DA-40, but the exact numerical limitations depend on the variant. The main limits cover airspeed, engine operation, aircraft weight and centre of gravity, manoeuvring and load factor, flap use, and approved weather or icing conditions. I obtain the applicable values from the flight manual and cockpit placards before flight; any demonstrated crosswind value is considered separately from a mandatory operating limitation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我驾驶 DA-40，但具体数值限制取决于不同型号。主要限制包括空速、发动机运行、飞机重量与重心、机动与载荷系数、襟翼使用，以及获准飞行的天气或结冰条件。飞行前，我会从飞行手册和驾驶舱标牌中获取适用数值；经验证的侧风值与强制性运行限制应分别看待。

cards.audioText: Do you like the aircraft type you currently fly, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢目前所飞的机型吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I like the aircraft I currently fly. It was the first aircraft I flew as a pilot, so it is special to me. It also performs well and is easy to control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢目前驾驶的飞机。它是我作为飞行员驾驶的第一架飞机，所以对我来说很特别。它的性能也不错，而且容易操纵。

cards.audioText: What has been the most unforgettable experience of your aviation career?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的航空职业生涯中最难忘的经历是什么？
cards.referenceText: My most unforgettable experience was my first solo flight last year. The sky was clear, visibility was acceptable, and the wind was calm. I felt nervous at first, but my instructor encouraged me, and I completed three traffic patterns safely.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最难忘的经历是去年的第一次单飞。当时天空晴朗，能见度可以接受，风也很小。起初我有些紧张，但教员鼓励了我，最后我安全完成了三个起落航线。

cards.audioText: If you could choose, would you prefer to fly a Boeing or an Airbus aircraft, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果可以选择，你更愿意驾驶波音还是空客飞机？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I would prefer to fly an Airbus. Its side-stick layout provides more space around the pilot's seat, which I find comfortable. I also like its fly-by-wire technology because it can reduce pilot workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更愿意驾驶空客飞机。它的侧杆布局让驾驶座周围有更大的空间，我觉得很舒适。我也喜欢它的电传操纵技术，因为这项技术可以减轻飞行员的工作负荷。

cards.audioText: What general differences do pilots notice between Boeing and Airbus flight decks?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员通常会注意到波音与空客驾驶舱之间有哪些差异？
cards.referenceText: A common difference is the primary control interface. Boeing flight decks typically use control columns, while Airbus flight decks use side-sticks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个常见区别是主要操纵装置。波音驾驶舱通常使用驾驶盘，而空客驾驶舱使用侧杆。

cards.audioText: What do you consider the main technological strengths and limitations of the aircraft type you currently fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为目前所飞机型的主要技术优势和局限性是什么？
cards.referenceText: I currently fly the C172. Its main strength is that it is easy to control, which makes it suitable for initial training. Its limitations include relatively modest operating altitude and endurance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我目前驾驶 C172。它的主要优点是容易操纵，因此适合初始训练。它的局限包括运行高度和续航能力相对有限。

cards.audioText: What is the passenger capacity of the aircraft type you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞机型的载客量是多少？
cards.referenceText: I fly the C172, which can accommodate two passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是 C172，它可以搭载两名乘客。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft types are operated in your company's fleet?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所在公司的机队运营哪些机型？
cards.referenceText: I am not employed by an airline, so I do not have a company fleet. My flight school operates the DA-40, which is the aircraft I currently use for training. Other aircraft may be available at the school, but I do not claim to fly them.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我没有在航空公司任职，因此没有所谓的公司机队。我的航校使用 DA-40，这也是我目前用于训练的飞机。学校可能还有其他飞机，但我不会声称自己驾驶过它们。

cards.audioText: How does the aircraft you fly now compare with the aircraft you flew during flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在所飞的航空器与飞行训练期间驾驶的航空器相比如何？
cards.referenceText: I am still in flight training, so the aircraft I fly now is the same DA-40 that I use for training. I like its predictable handling and modern cockpit, and it is suitable for learning normal procedures and instrument flying. I have not yet transitioned to a different aircraft type.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我仍在接受飞行训练，所以我现在驾驶的就是训练所用的 DA-40。我喜欢它稳定且易于预判的操纵特性和现代化驾驶舱，它适合学习正常程序和仪表飞行。我还没有改装到其他机型。

cards.audioText: What is your opinion of large commercial aircraft designed and manufactured in China?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何看待中国设计和制造的大型商用飞机？
cards.referenceText: I have a positive opinion of Chinese-designed commercial aircraft such as the ARJ21 and C919. They use advanced equipment and systems designed to support safe and comfortable operations. I am proud of their development and would be interested in flying one in the future.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我对 ARJ21 和 C919 等中国设计的商用飞机持积极看法。它们采用先进的设备和系统，旨在支持安全、舒适的运行。我为它们的发展感到自豪，也有兴趣将来驾驶其中一种机型。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft type ratings have you held?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾持有哪些航空器型别等级？
cards.referenceText: I have not held an aircraft type rating. I am still training on the DA-40 at flight school, so I do not claim an airline-aircraft qualification. I would need to complete the approved training and checks before holding any type rating.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有取得任何型别等级。目前我仍在航校使用 DA-40 训练，因此不会声称自己具备航空公司飞机的资质。取得任何型别等级前，我都需要完成批准的训练和检查。

cards.audioText: What are the main systems on the aircraft type you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞的机型有哪些主要系统？
cards.referenceText: The main systems on the aircraft I fly include the navigation, electrical, and communication systems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我所驾驶的飞机主要系统包括导航系统、电气系统和通信系统。

cards.audioText: Would you like to work for a foreign airline, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你愿意为外国航空公司工作吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I would consider working for a foreign airline. It would allow me to experience a different aviation culture and management system, improve my cross-cultural communication, and develop my professional skills.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我会考虑到外国航空公司工作。这样可以让我体验不同的航空文化和管理体系，提高跨文化沟通能力，并发展自己的专业技能。

cards.audioText: What challenges might a pilot face when working for a foreign airline?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员为外国航空公司工作时可能面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: A pilot may face language barriers when communicating with colleagues and controllers. The pilot also has to adapt to different aviation regulations, operating procedures, cultural expectations, and working rhythms. Integrating into a new team can take time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员在与同事和管制员沟通时可能遇到语言障碍，还需要适应不同的航空法规、运行程序、文化习惯和工作节奏。融入一个新团队可能需要一些时间。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft types have you flown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过哪些机型？
cards.referenceText: I have flown the DA-40 during my flight training. It is the only aircraft type I claim to have flown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在飞行训练期间驾驶过 DA-40。这是我唯一声称驾驶过的机型。

cards.audioText: How are you today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你今天感觉怎么样？
cards.referenceText: I am doing well today, thank you for asking.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我今天状态很好，谢谢关心。

cards.audioText: What is the weather like today, and is it suitable for flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 今天天气怎么样？适合飞行吗？
cards.referenceText: The sky is clear, visibility is acceptable, and the wind is calm. There is plenty of sunshine, so it is a good day for flying.
cards.referenceTextZh: 天空晴朗，能见度可以接受，风也很小。阳光充足，因此今天很适合飞行。

cards.audioText: How did you get to the test center today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你今天是怎么到达考试中心的？
cards.referenceText: I came to the test center by subway. It was convenient and punctual, and I avoided the road traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是乘地铁到考试中心的。地铁方便准时，也让我避开了道路交通。

cards.audioText: Did you sleep well last night?
cards.audioTextZh: 你昨晚上睡得好吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I did. I slept very well last night.

No, I didn't, because it's hard for me to sleep in a different place.
cards.referenceTextZh:
嗯，我昨晚睡得挺好。

不好，我换了地方就很难入睡。

cards.audioText: What are you going to do after this test?
cards.audioTextZh: 这次考试结束后你打算做什么？
cards.referenceText: After the test, I will review the main topics and identify the areas I need to improve. I will also continue practising spoken aviation English to prepare for future flight work.
cards.referenceTextZh: 考试后，我会复习主要话题，找出自己需要提高的方面。我也会继续练习航空英语口语，为今后的飞行工作做准备。

cards.audioText: Which part of the ICAO English test do you find most difficult, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得 ICAO 英语考试的哪个部分最难？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I find the interactive communication section the most difficult, especially when discussing complex emergency situations. It requires fluent expression, accurate aviation terminology, and a quick response to the examiner's questions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得互动交流部分最难，尤其是讨论复杂紧急情况时。它要求表达流利、航空术语准确，并能迅速回答考官的问题。

cards.audioText: How many flight hours have you accumulated in total?
cards.audioTextZh: 你总共积累了多少飞行小时？
cards.referenceText: I have accumulated about 15 flight hours in total. Most of that time was gained through dual instruction on the DA-40. I am continuing to build experience as I prepare for my first solo flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我累计飞行了大约 15 小时，其中大部分是在 DA-40 上进行的带飞训练。为了准备第一次单飞，我正在继续积累经验。

cards.audioText: What does your company's logo look like?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所在公司的标志是什么样的？
cards.referenceText: I am a student pilot and have not officially joined an airline, so I do not have a company logo to describe.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是一名学员飞行员，尚未正式加入航空公司，因此没有可以介绍的公司标志。

cards.audioText: Which airline do you work for?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪家航空公司工作？
cards.referenceText: I work for Air China, it is one of the biggest airlines and the only flag-carrier in China. It is based in Beijing and has 7 branches/branch companies all over the country. There are over 200 aircraft in the fleet with over 2000 pilots. The routes cover domestic and international cities. It flies to almost every important city in the world, for example, Moscow, Rome, Dubai, Tokyo, Los Angeles and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在中国国航工作，国航是中国最大的航空公司之一，是中国唯一载国旗飞行的航空公司。国航总部在北京，在全国各地还有7个分公司。国航拥有200多架飞机，2000多名飞行员。国航航线遍布国内外，航班几乎可飞往全世界每个重要国家，例如：莫斯科、罗马、迪拜、东京、洛杉矶等。

cards.audioText: How many years have you worked as a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从事飞行员工作多少年了？
cards.referenceText: I have not worked as a professional pilot yet because I am still a student pilot. My aviation experience comes from flight training rather than employment. I plan to apply for a pilot position after I complete the required licences and training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我仍是一名飞行学员，因此还没有担任过职业飞行员。我的航空经历来自飞行训练，而不是受雇工作。完成规定的执照和训练后，我计划应聘飞行员职位。

cards.audioText: How long have you worked for your current company?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在目前所在的公司工作多长时间了？
cards.referenceText: I do not have a current employer because I am still training at flight school. Therefore, I have not worked for a company as a pilot. My present focus is completing my training and building the experience needed for future employment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我仍在航校训练，目前没有雇主。因此，我还没有在任何公司担任过飞行员。现阶段我主要专注于完成训练，并积累未来就业所需的经验。

cards.audioText: Do you like your company's logo, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢自己公司的标志吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I have not joined an airline yet, so I do not have a company logo to evaluate. I do like my flight school's logo because it is simple, easy to recognise, and represents aviation training. A good logo should be clear and professional rather than too complicated.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有加入航空公司，所以没有可以评价的公司标志。我很喜欢航校的标志，因为它简洁、容易识别，也能体现飞行训练的特点。好的标志应当清晰、专业，不宜过于复杂。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite city, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪座城市？为什么？
cards.referenceText: My favourite city is Chengdu because it is my hometown and my family lives there. I enjoy its relaxed atmosphere, Sichuan food, and green public spaces. It also has many interesting places to visit, including the giant panda research base.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的城市是成都，因为那里是我的家乡，我的家人也住在那里。我喜欢成都悠闲的氛围、川菜和绿意盎然的公共空间。那里还有许多有趣的景点，包括大熊猫繁育研究基地。

cards.audioText: What is the traffic like where you live now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前居住地的交通状况怎么样？
cards.referenceText: I currently live in Xi'an. Traffic is often busy, and there are frequent traffic jams because it is a large city.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我目前住在西安。作为一座大城市，这里的交通经常很繁忙，也时常堵车。

cards.audioText: Which do you prefer, your hometown or the city where you live now, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家乡和目前居住的城市相比，你更喜欢哪一个？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I prefer my hometown because I grew up there and know it very well. My family still lives there, which makes it especially important to me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更喜欢自己的家乡，因为我在那里长大，对那里非常熟悉。我的家人现在仍住在那里，所以家乡对我格外重要。

cards.audioText: What is your hometown famous for?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家乡因什么而闻名？
cards.referenceText: My hometown is Chengdu in Sichuan Province. It is famous for Sichuan food, especially hot pot and mapo tofu, and for attractions such as the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的家乡是四川省成都市。那里以川菜闻名，尤其是火锅和麻婆豆腐，还有成都大熊猫繁育研究基地等景点。

cards.audioText: What is the weather usually like in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家乡通常是什么天气？
cards.referenceText: The weather in my hometown is usually mild and humid. Summers are not extremely hot, winters are relatively warm, and most of the rain falls in summer and autumn.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的家乡通常气候温和湿润。夏天不会极端炎热，冬天相对温暖，降雨大多集中在夏季和秋季。

cards.audioText: How does your hometown compare with the city where you live now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家乡与目前居住的城市相比如何？
cards.referenceText: My hometown is more relaxed, with a strong cultural atmosphere and a slower pace of life. The city where I live now is a busy aviation hub with a faster working rhythm and more convenient transport, especially for air travel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的家乡生活节奏较慢，氛围更轻松，也有浓厚的文化气息。我现在居住的城市是一座繁忙的航空枢纽，工作节奏更快，交通也更便利，尤其是航空出行。

cards.audioText: What interesting places can visitors see in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 游客可以在你的家乡参观哪些有趣的地方？
cards.referenceText: Visitors can see giant pandas at the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding. They can also visit Jinli Ancient Street to experience traditional Sichuan culture and the Dujiangyan Irrigation System to see remarkable ancient engineering.
cards.referenceTextZh: 游客可以在成都大熊猫繁育研究基地看到大熊猫。他们也可以到锦里古街体验传统四川文化，或参观都江堰水利工程，了解非凡的古代工程技术。

cards.audioText: What is your preferred mode of transportation, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种交通方式？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I prefer to travel by air because it is fast and efficient, especially over long distances. It also lets me experience aviation directly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更喜欢乘飞机旅行，因为它快捷高效，尤其适合长途出行。乘飞机也能让我直接感受航空。

cards.audioText: Do you think owning a car is necessary in your hometown, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为在家乡拥有一辆汽车有必要吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: It depends on a person's needs. A car is useful for families in suburban areas or people who often travel to remote places. For someone living downtown with convenient public transport, owning a car may not be necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这取决于个人需求。对住在郊区的家庭或经常前往偏远地区的人来说，汽车很有用。对住在市中心且公共交通便利的人来说，可能没有必要拥有汽车。

cards.audioText: Which place abroad would you most like to visit, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最想去国外的哪个地方？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I have not travelled abroad yet, but I would most like to visit the United States. I would like to see its aviation museums and training institutions and learn more about aviation technology and training concepts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我还没有出国旅行过，但最想去美国。我想参观那里的航空博物馆和训练机构，进一步了解航空技术和训练理念。

cards.audioText: Have you ever operated an international flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否曾执行过国际航班？
cards.referenceText: No, I have not operated an international flight yet. My flight experience is mainly limited to domestic training flights, although I have studied international flight operations in theory. I hope to gain experience on international routes after becoming a professional pilot.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我还没有执行过国际航班。我的飞行经历主要是国内训练飞行，不过我在理论上学习过国际飞行运行。成为职业飞行员后，我希望能积累国际航线经验。

cards.audioText: Does your company operate any international routes?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所在公司是否运营国际航线？
cards.referenceText: I am not employed by an airline, so I do not have a company route network. My flight-school operations are domestic training flights rather than scheduled international services. I hope to gain international flying experience after completing my training and joining an airline.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我没有在航空公司任职，因此没有公司的航线网络。我的航校运行是国内训练飞行，而不是定期国际航班。完成训练并加入航空公司后，我希望能获得国际飞行经验。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer international or domestic routes, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢国际航线还是国内航线？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I appreciate both types of route. International routes offer opportunities to experience different cultures and aviation environments, while domestic routes involve more familiar procedures. For those reasons, I do not have a strong preference.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢这两类航线。国际航线提供了体验不同文化和航空环境的机会，国内航线的运行程序则更加熟悉。因此，我没有明显的偏好。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer long-haul or short-haul routes, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢远程航线还是短程航线？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I do not have a strong preference. Long-haul routes require good physical fitness and fatigue management, while short-haul routes require pilots to adapt to frequent takeoffs and landings. Both types of route can help a pilot improve different skills.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我没有明显的偏好。长途航线要求良好的身体素质和疲劳管理能力，短途航线则要求飞行员适应频繁的起飞和着陆。两类航线都能帮助飞行员提高不同方面的技能。

cards.audioText: What hobbies do you have?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有哪些爱好？
cards.referenceText: I enjoy reading, especially books about aviation history. It broadens my knowledge of the aviation industry.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢阅读，尤其喜欢航空史方面的书籍。这能拓宽我对航空业的了解。

cards.audioText: What do you like to do when you are not flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 不飞行时你喜欢做什么？
cards.referenceText: When I am not flying, I like to cook. Trying new recipes and preparing good meals is a relaxing way to spend my time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不飞行时，我喜欢做饭。尝试新食谱并做出可口的饭菜，是一种令人放松的休闲方式。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy traveling?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢旅行吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy traveling.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢旅行。

cards.audioText: Have you ever traveled abroad?
cards.audioTextZh: 你出国旅行过吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have. I have travelled to Australia, the United States, Japan, and South Africa.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我去过澳大利亚、美国、日本和南非。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy listening to music?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢听音乐吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy listening to music.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢听音乐。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy watching movies?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢看电影吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy watching movies because they allow me to experience different stories.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢看电影，因为电影能让我体验不同的故事。

cards.audioText: What type of movie do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种类型的电影？
cards.referenceText: I do not have just one favorite type. I enjoy action films, comedies, horror films, romances, documentaries, and cartoons. For me, the quality of the movie matters more than its genre.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我并非只喜欢一种类型。我喜欢动作片、喜剧片、恐怖片、爱情片、纪录片和动画片。对我来说，电影本身的质量比类型更重要。

cards.audioText: What's your favorite movie?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪部电影？
cards.referenceText: My favorite movie is Sully. It tells the story of Captain Sully's successful river ditching after a bird strike. I see him as a hero.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的电影是《萨利机长》。它讲述了萨利机长在遭遇鸟击后成功迫降河面的故事。我把他视为英雄。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite movie star?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的电影明星是谁？
cards.referenceText: My favorite movie star is Tom Cruise. I think he is handsome and charming, and I especially enjoy his performance in Mission: Impossible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的电影明星是汤姆·克鲁斯。我觉得他英俊而有魅力，尤其喜欢他在《碟中谍》中的表演。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy reading?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢阅读吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy reading.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢阅读。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite book?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪本书？
cards.referenceText: My favorite book is To Kill a Mockingbird because it is full of wisdom.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的书是《杀死一只知更鸟》，因为书中充满智慧。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy sports or outdoor activities?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢运动或户外活动吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy sports. Swimming and running are my favorites because they help me build strength.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢运动。游泳和跑步是我最喜欢的运动，因为它们能帮助我增强体质。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite sport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪项运动？
cards.referenceText: Swimming and running are my favorite sports. They help me build strength.
cards.referenceTextZh: 游泳和跑步是我最喜欢的运动，它们能帮助我增强体质。

cards.audioText: How often do you play sports?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久参加一次体育运动？
cards.referenceText: I usually play sports two or three times a week. I enjoy running and playing badminton because they improve my fitness and help me relax after studying or flight training. I reduce the intensity before an important flight so that I am properly rested.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我通常每周运动两到三次。我喜欢跑步和打羽毛球，因为这些运动既能改善体能，也能让我在学习或飞行训练后放松下来。重要飞行前，我会降低运动强度，确保自己得到充分休息。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite athlete?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的运动员是谁？
cards.referenceText: My favorite athlete is Kobe Bryant. I admire him very much.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的运动员是科比·布莱恩特，我非常敬佩他。

cards.audioText: How often do you use a computer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久使用一次电脑？
cards.referenceText: I use a computer often.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我经常使用电脑。

cards.audioText: How have computers changed people's lives?
cards.audioTextZh: 电脑如何改变了人们的生活？
cards.referenceText: Computers have become an essential part of daily life. People now use them for work, entertainment, games, and finding information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 电脑已经成为日常生活中不可或缺的一部分。人们现在用电脑工作、娱乐、玩游戏和查找信息。

cards.audioText: What kind of music do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种类型的音乐？
cards.referenceText: I like light music best. Its gentle melodies and soothing rhythms help me relax after training and concentrate while reading or thinking. Cheerful light music can also improve my mood.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢轻音乐。轻柔的旋律和舒缓的节奏能让我在训练后放松，也有助于我在阅读或思考时集中注意力。欢快的轻音乐还能改善我的心情。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite singer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的歌手是谁？
cards.referenceText: My favorite singer is Jay Chou. I find his music touching and beautiful.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的歌手是周杰伦。我觉得他的音乐动人而优美。

cards.audioText: How often do you go to the cinema?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久去一次电影院？
cards.referenceText: I go to the cinema about twice a month.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我大约每月去电影院两次。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy shopping online?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢网上购物吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I enjoy shopping online. I often use Taobao because many goods are affordable and delivery is fast.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢网上购物。我经常使用淘宝，因为许多商品价格实惠，而且配送很快。

cards.audioText: Which website do you visit most often, and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最常访问哪个网站？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I visit Taobao most often. I use it for online shopping because many goods are affordable and delivery is fast.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最常访问淘宝。我用它进行网上购物，因为许多商品价格实惠，而且配送很快。

cards.audioText: What progress or developments has China's civil aviation industry made in the last decade?
cards.audioTextZh: 中国民航在过去十年取得了哪些进步或发展？
cards.referenceText: The progress or development made by China's civil aviation in the past decade has been rapid. We independently developed the C919 large aircraft, built the Daxing Airport, opened up more and more international and domestic routes, and traveling by plane has become increasingly popular and common.
cards.referenceTextZh: 中国民航在过去十年取得的进步或发展是飞快的，我们独立研制了C919大飞机，建造了大兴机场，开辟了越来越多的国际、国内航线，乘坐飞机出行变得越来越受欢迎，越来越普遍。

cards.audioText: What’s your opinions about the progress of China’s aircraft industry?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对我国航空制造业的发展情况有何看法？
cards.referenceText: Our country's aircraft industry has made huge development. We independently developed the C909 and C919 aircraft, and at the same time, we have also made great progress in engine research.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我国的航空制造业取得了很大的发展，我们独立研制了C909和C919，同时，我们在发动机研究方面也取得了巨大的进步。

cards.audioText: What modern equipment and technologies have been used by China's civil aviation industry?
cards.audioTextZh: 中国民航使用了哪些新设备和新技术？
cards.referenceText: China's civil aviation has adopted many new technologies and equipment, such as TCAS, BDS, HUD, AR and VR, etc.
cards.referenceTextZh: 中国民航采用了很多新技术和新设备，比如TCAS，BDS，HUD，AR和VR等。

cards.audioText: How do you deal with the challenges brought by the new equipment and technologies?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何应对来自新技术和新设备的挑战？
cards.referenceText: In my opinion, we should conduct relevant theoretical studies and take relevant simulator training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我看来，我们应当进行相关的理论学习，其次，我们需要通过相关的模拟机训练。

cards.audioText: Against the backdrop of the aviation industry's development, as a pilot, how do you plan to respond?
cards.audioTextZh: 在航空业发展的背景下，作为一名飞行员，您打算如何应对呢？
cards.referenceText: First of all, we should embrace the development of civil aviation and maintain a positive attitude towards new technologies and equipment. Secondly, we should conduct relevant theoretical studies. Thirdly, we need to take simulator training to enhance our flight skills.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，我们要拥抱民航的发展，对新技术和设备保持积极态度，其次，我们应进行相关的理论学习，其次，我们需要通过相关的模拟机训练，提升自己的飞行技术。

cards.audioText: When and where did you learn flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是何时开始，在哪里学习飞行的？
cards.referenceText: I learned flying in CAFUC in 2008. In the first two years in university, I studied basic flying theories and aviation English in Guanghan, Sichuan Province. In the third year, I had my primary flight training in Luoyang Branch, Henan Province.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我于2008年在中国民航飞行学院学习飞行。大学前两年，我在四川广汉学习飞行基本理论及航空英语。第三年，我在河南洛阳进行初级飞行训练。

cards.audioText: How many hours in total have you flown/accumulated?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的飞行时间累计有多少？
cards.referenceText: I have flown more than 12000 hours. / I have flown 7000 hours totally. / I have accumulated 2500 flight hours. / I have flown single-engine aircraft C172 for 120 hours, and PA-44 for 50 hours.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的飞行时间超过1.2万小时。/ 我共飞行了7000小时。/ 我的飞行时间累计2500小时。/ 我驾驶C172型单引擎飞机共120小时，驾驶PA-44型飞机共50小时。

cards.audioText: Are you a captain or a first officer? Where are you based now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是机长还是副驾驶？你们公司的总部在哪里？
cards.referenceText: I'm a captain and we are based in Wuhan now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是机长。我们公司的总部目前在武汉。

cards.audioText: Do you like your current job as a pilot? Don’t you feel stressful?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢现在这份做飞行员的工作吗？你不觉得有压力吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I love this job. I believe that if we find something we love we'll never hate our jobs. Instead, we're paid to have fun. Sometimes I actually feel stressful, especially after a long international flight, but I can adjust myself from the high pressure quickly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我喜欢这份工作。我相信只要找到自己喜欢做的事就不会讨厌工作。相反，在享受乐趣的同时还有收入。有时候我的确感到有压力，特别是长途国际航班后，但我可以很快从高压下调整过来。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages and disadvantages of being a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 做飞行员的优缺点分别是什么？
cards.referenceText: Speaking of advantages, first, I can get high salary and good benefits, especially when I become a captain. If I work hard, my family can have a better life. Second, I can fly to different places all around the world, where I can feel different cultures and taste kinds of delicious foods. Third, with the development of aviation industry, pilots can learn many new ideas and technologies. When it comes to disadvantages, first, the work as a pilot is much more stressful because we must be responsible for the safety of hundreds of passengers on board. Second, it's a pity that we don't have enough time to stay with our family and friends. Last, to become a qualified pilot requires more money and consumes longer time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 说到优点，第一，我可以得到高薪资和良好的福利，尤其是当上机长后。如果我努力工作，我的家人可以生活得更好；第二，我可以飞往世界各地，体验不同文化，品尝各色美食；第三，随着航空业的发展，飞行员可以学习许多新的理念和技术。说到缺点，第一，飞行员承受的压力很大，因为我们要保证机舱内上百名乘客的安全；第二，我们没有足够的时间陪家人朋友；最后，成为一名合格的飞行员需要投入更多的钱和时间。

cards.audioText: What does your family think about your job?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家人怎样看待你的工作？
cards.referenceText: They are proud of me for being a pilot. They all support my job. Before each flight, they help me to pack my luggage, and after the flight they prepare delicious food for me. I know they worry about me but they have never complained.
cards.referenceTextZh: 他们为我的工作而骄傲。我的家人都支持我的工作。每次飞行任务之前，他们都帮我整理行李。飞行任务结束后，他们为我准备美食。我知道他们会担心我，但他们从不向我抱怨。

cards.audioText: Who influenced you most in choosing this job?
cards.audioTextZh: 选择这个职业时谁对你的影响最大？
cards.referenceText: I think it was my father, he was a pilot and has retired now. He often told me many stories about flying when I was a little boy, since then I had great interest in flying and I had determined to be a pilot. / Nobody influenced me. I became a pilot by chance, and I feel everything happens naturally.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得是我的父亲，他曾是一名飞行员，现在已经退休了。在我小时候，他经常给我讲许多飞行中的故事，从那时起我就对飞行产生了极大的兴趣并决定要成为一名飞行员。/没人影响我。我偶然间成为了一名飞行员，我感觉所有事情都是自然而成的。

cards.audioText: What are the most challenging parts of your job?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员工作中最具挑战性的部分是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Being a pilot is a challenging job. We must be responsible for the safety of all passengers on board, so it's risky and stressful. During flight, we have to be very focused and careful, and I often feel exhausted. Sometimes I suffer from jet lag, so I don't think it's good for my health. With the development of aviation
industry, pilots must learn new ideas and technologies to keep pace with the times, so learning knowledge is another big challenge for us.
cards.referenceTextZh:
做飞行员极具挑战性。我们必须对机舱内所有乘客的安全负责，所以这份工作充满了风险和压力。飞行中，我们必须非常专注、仔细，我经常会因此感觉疲惫。有时候我要承受时差，因此我认为做飞行员对我的健康不利。随着航天业的发
展，飞行员必须学习新观念和新技术，与时俱进，所以学习对我们来说是另一大挑战。

cards.audioText: What challenges will pilots meet in the near future?
cards.audioTextZh: 在不久的将来，飞行员将遇到怎样的挑战？
cards.referenceText: With the rapid development of modern technology, aircraft become more and more advanced/automatic/computerized, more and more systems will be controlled by intelligent computers, so pilots must learn more new ideas and technologies.
cards.referenceTextZh: 随着现代科技的迅速发展，飞机变得越来越先进/自动化/计算机化，越来越多的系统将由智能计算机控制，所以飞行员必须学习新观念和新技术。

cards.audioText: How to recover from the red-eye flight as a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为飞行员如何从红眼航班中恢复过来？
cards.referenceText: Actually, I've never flown the red-eye flight, or the pink or even purple flight, but I think exercising, eating a filling meal and enjoying a nice sleep before the flight will ensure our body in a good condition and make us recover from tiredness.
cards.referenceTextZh: 实际上我没有飞过红眼航班，也没飞过粉眼或紫眼航班，但是我认为飞行前适度运动，吃一顿饱饭，享受一个良好的睡眠，都将确保我们的身体在一个良好的状态并且能够从疲倦中恢复过来。

cards.audioText: How did you feel when you flew for the first time?
cards.audioTextZh: 你第一次飞行时感觉如何？
cards.referenceText: My first flight was unforgettable. I was very nervous when I entered into the real cockpit for the first time. My hands were trembling when holding the control column, and I felt a mind blank for more than ten seconds. Then my instructor guided me how to operate each step. When I became relaxed, everything seemed to become easier. I followed the instruction and successfully flew into the sky. I won't forget my first solo flight forever.
cards.referenceTextZh:
第一次飞行经历很难忘。第一次踏进真实的座舱时我非常紧张。握住操控杆时我的手在颤抖，大脑至少有超过十秒钟的空白。之后教练一步步地指导我如何操作。放松下来后，所有的操作都变得简单。我按照指令成功地操纵飞机飞上天
空。我永远都不会忘记第一次单独飞行的经历。

cards.audioText: Do you think the job of pilot is promising?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为做飞行员有前途吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. I think so. With the development of China’s civil aviation industry, more and more people are traveling by plane, and more and more new aircraft are produced and purchased. Therefore, more pilots are needed in the near future, so I think the job is promising.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为有前途。随着中国民航业的发展，越来越多的人乘坐飞机旅行，飞机的生产量及购买量也越来越大。因此，在不久的将来，飞行员的需求量也将增大，所以我认为这份工作是有前途的。

cards.audioText: What is your career plan in the next few years?
cards.audioTextZh: 你未来几年的职业规划是什么？
cards.referenceText:
I am a co-pilot now. I will make great efforts to be a captain in the next few years.

I want to fly more international routes, so I will work hard to improve my oral English.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我现在是副驾驶员，在未来几年我会努力地成为一名机长。

我想飞更多的国际航线，因此我会努力学习，提高我的口语。

cards.audioText: According to your experience, how can a student pilot become a qualified pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 根据你的经验，飞行学员如何才能成为合格的飞行员？
cards.referenceText:
A student pilot must have a certain period of ground school learning to grasp the
knowledge related to flight. Also he must have real flight practice to gain good flight skill. Until he has passed all the required exams, involving theoretic and technique, and has got certificate of each course, he can become a qualified pilot.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一名飞行学员必须在地面训练学校学习一段时间，掌握飞行相关知识。此外，他必须进行真正的飞行实践，以获得良好的飞行技巧。通过所有必需的理论及技术考试，每门课程都取得合格证后，就可以成为一名合格的飞行员。

cards.audioText: Where did you have the initial training as a student pilot? Can you say something about that?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里接受初级培训的？能否讲一下？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. I had my initial training in CAFUC in 2008 and the aircraft type I flew was C172. I spent 2 years there with 40 classmates. At first stage, we studied ground theory and aircraft system in computer-based training (CBT). After we passed the test, a flight instructor guided us to practice flight control in the simulator. Initial
training gave me a general idea about the aircraft. It is a very useful and helpful experience for me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。2008年我在中国民航飞行学院接受初级培训，飞的是C172。我和40名同学在这里学习了两年。第一阶段，我们学习了地面理论，并通过计算机辅助训练（CBT）熟悉了飞机构造。通过考试后，飞行教练指导我们在模拟机中练习飞行控制。初级训练后我对飞机有了大致了解。这对我来说是一段非常有用和有益的经验。

cards.audioText: What do you think is the most difficult part in your flight training? How do you cope with/overcome it?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行训练中，你认为哪部分是最困难的？你是怎样解决/克服它的？
cards.referenceText:
In my flight training, especially during the primary training, I think the most difficult part is landing. In this stage, we have to consider many factors, descend rate, thrust, weather condition, approach speed and so on. All these factors will affect landing safety. Although it was a little bit difficult for me at first, I believe
practice makes perfect, so I study hard and after hundred times of practice, I can make better landings now.

In my flight training, I think the most difficult part is to deal with abnormal situations. In order to cope with such situations, we should have much knowledge on aviation, practice more and try to familiarize ourselves with all kinds of abnormal procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh:
在飞行训练中，特别是初级训练时，我认为最困难的部分是降落。在这个阶段，我们必须考虑诸多因素，下降率、推力、天气状况、进近速度等。所有这些因素都会影响降落安全。虽然起初这对我来说有点困难，但我相信熟能生巧。所以我努力练习，经过数百次实践，现在我可以更好地降落。

飞行训练中，我觉得最困难的部分是处理异常状况。为了应对这些状况，我们应该学习更多的航天知识，勤加练习，让自己熟悉更多的非正常程序。

cards.audioText: How often do you take recurrent training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久参加一次复训？
cards.referenceText: According to CCAR 121, I take the recurrent training every 12 months.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据局方121部规定，每12个月参加一次复训。

cards.audioText: How often do you take proficiency check?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久参加一次熟练检查？
cards.referenceText: According to CCAR 121, I take the proficiency testing every 6 months.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据局方规定，每6个月参加一次熟练检查。
