cards.audioText: How often does your company provide simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你公司多久进行一次模拟机复训？
cards.referenceText: Every six months.
cards.referenceTextZh: 每六个月一次。

cards.audioText: What do you think is the purpose of the simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为参加模拟训练的目的是什么？
cards.referenceText: Well, I don't think the purpose of the simulator training is to completely take place of actual flight training but to thoroughly familiarize pilots with the aircraft concerned before they maneuver costly and riskily actual flight training. Simulator training also is useful for reviewing and familiarizing pilots with new modifications to existing aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 嗯，我认为参加模拟训练的目的并不完全是为了替代实际飞行训练，而是在飞行员们进行昂贵且危险的实际飞行训练演习之前，使之完全熟悉相关飞机。模拟训练有助于飞行员研究和熟悉现有飞机的改变。

cards.audioText: Where do you have your simulator training? What do you learn from it?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里参加的模拟机训练？从中学到了什么？
cards.referenceText: I have my simulator training in Guanghan Simulator Training Center. During the training, I review/practice emergency procedures, which makes me more confident and courageous when facing abnormal situations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在广州模拟训练中心进行模拟机训练。训练期间，我复习/练习了应急程序，这让我在面对异常状况的时候更加自信、勇敢。

cards.audioText: What do you think of your recurrent training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得你的复训怎么样？
cards.referenceText: In the recurrent training, there are lots of practice and training about many emergency procedures. I learned much about how to handle emergency situations, such as engine fire, hydraulic failure, communication failure, stall, aborted takeoff, emergency evacuation and so on. In our flight, although we normally can not encounter these conditions, there is a saying that “forewarned is forearmed”. We are required to continuously improve our flight skills and learn to handle/cope with the emergency conditions in the training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 复训期间，我们要做大量的关于紧急程序的培训及实践。我学到了很多关于如何处理紧急状况的知识，包括处理发动机失火、液压故障、通讯故障、失速、起飞中断、紧急疏散等。尽管飞行中一般不会遇到这些情况，但俗话说“有备无患”。在训练中我们被要求不断提高飞行技能，学习解决紧急状况。

cards.audioText: Can you list some subjects in your simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否列举一些模拟训练中的项目？
cards.referenceText: Yes, in the simulator training, we practice some procedures including engine fire, both engine failure, cabin depressurization, and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，在模拟训练中，我们练习一些应急程序，包括发动机熄火、两发失效、机舱减压等。

cards.audioText: Do you have any training experience of evacuation? Tell me about it.
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否接受过疏散训练么？给我讲一下。
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have had evacuation training for many times. For example, when I had my initial training of evacuation in London, the flight instructor simulated the cockpit fire. As the pilot flew, my co-pilot and I had our oxygen masks worn. Then I requested the purser to execute the evacuation following the standard operation procedures. Whereafter I made an announcement through the passenger addressing system to tell the passengers the reasons and precautions in executing the emergency evacuation. In the process, everything was completed orderly and efficiently.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我接受过很多次疏散训练。例如，我在伦敦接受第一次疏散训练时，教员模拟了驾驶舱失火。作为训练的飞行员，我和副驾驶都带上了氧气面罩。之后我要求乘务长按照标准操作程序撤离，并通过定址系统告知乘客紧急疏散的原因和预防程序。整个过程中，一切都高效、有序地完成。

cards.audioText: Please say something about your simulator training you have received.
cards.audioTextZh: 请讲讲你所接受的模拟训练。
cards.referenceText: OK. In Air China, we had lots of chances to practice different kinds of simulator training both at home and aboard. The simulator training, I had received included initial training, transition training and recurrent training. For me, most knowledge of handling abnormal and emergency situations was got from simulator training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。在国航，我们有大量在国内外的进行各种模拟训练的机会。我所接受的模拟训练包括初级训练、改装训练和复训。对我来说，大部分处理异常和紧急情况的知识都是从模拟训练中获得的。

cards.audioText: What do you think are the benefits of simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为模拟机训练的好处是什么？
cards.referenceText: I think simulator training has become very important in preparing for being a qualified pilot. Firstly, it helps pilots become familiar with abnormal situations. Practicing in a simulated environment can help a pilot remain level headed during crisis so that he/she can work effectively when dealing with emergency. Secondly, simulator training can help a pilot see the gaps in real flight. There could be some shortcomings in capability when flying, so during simulation training, a pilot gets the opportunity to practice more without risking the safety of aircraft and the people inside.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为参加模拟机训练在成为合格飞行员的准备过程中是非常重要的。第一，它帮助飞行员熟悉异常情况。在一个模拟的环境中练习可以帮助飞行员在遇到危机时仍能保持头脑清醒，在处理紧急情况时更加高效地工作。第二，模拟训练可以让飞行员找到真实飞行中的一些不足之处。飞行员在真实飞行中可能有些能力不足之处，所以在模拟训练时，飞行员可以有更多的练习机会，而不会危及到飞机及机内人员的安全。

cards.audioText: What significant influence did the simulated training exert on your flight career?
cards.audioTextZh: 模拟训练对你的飞行事业有哪些显著的影响？
cards.referenceText: We practiced many simulated training about abnormal and emergency situations which might happen in real flight. Because of such training, we have been familiar with the procedure of various abnormal and emergency situations, which is very useful to ensure the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们做过多次关于异常及紧急情况的模拟训练，这些情况都可能发生在真实飞行中。因为这些训练，我们已经熟悉了应对各种异常及紧急情况的操作程序，这对保证飞行安全来说是非常有用的。

cards.audioText: What’s the most important thing you have learned from your training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在训练中学到的最重要的东西是什么？
cards.referenceText: Leaving the practical and professional knowledge aside, I have acquired some important practical experience through many abnormal and emergency situation practices, I think it’s the most important thing I have learned that can make me qualified to handle lots of problems in my flight career in future.
cards.referenceTextZh: 除了实用和专业的知识外，通过大量练习处理异常及紧急情况，我还获得了一些重要的实践经验。我认为我学到的最重要的东西就是通过这些练习我能够处理许多未来飞行生涯中可能遇到的问题。

cards.audioText: What was the most impressing in your flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行训练中遇到的最难忘的事情是什么？
cards.referenceText: What impressed me most was that instructors went out of their way to teach us operating skills and made us deeply know what a pilot meant to a flight. At that time, I determined to try my best to take my responsibility to ensure the safety of the passengers on the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我印象最深刻的是，教员不辞辛苦教我们操作技巧，让我们深切地了解到飞行员对于飞机的意义。那时，我决定要尽我所能完成任务，保证机上乘客的安全。

cards.audioText: Can you choose your favorite type of aircraft for flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能否选择自己喜欢的机型参加飞行训练？
cards.referenceText: No, I cannot. We pilots can’t make our own choices of types of aircraft. In fact, we get models distributed according to the hours we have flown and stages we have been training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，无法选择。飞行员不能自行决定要飞的机型。实际上，我们是根据飞行时间和训练阶段来分配机型的。

cards.audioText: Did you experience any emergency procedures during simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 在模拟训练时，你练习过紧急程序么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. The emergency procedures are the most important parts of the simulator training. In the simulator training, we practiced almost every possibility of the emergency situations, especially some usual emergency, such as engine failure, engine fire, emergency descent, wind shear, emergency evacuation and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到过。紧急程序是模拟训练中最重要的部分。在训练中，我们几乎练习了所有可能发生的紧急情况，尤其是一些常发生的紧急情况，如发动机熄火、发动机起火、紧急下降、风切变、紧急疏散等。

cards.audioText: Do you practice cabin depressurization in the simulator? How would you perform?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在模拟机中练习过处理座舱降压么？你会如何处理这种情况？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I do. In the simulator, similar abnormal situations are usually set up and the flight crew need to complete the emergency procedures. We should wear the oxygen masks, at the same time, we need to make sure the passengers’ masks are deployed. Also, we should notify the ATC to request to deviate and descend immediately to a lower altitude to ensure the passengers to breathe without an oxygen mask and avoid any possible airframe damage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我练习过。在模拟机中经常会设置非正常情况，机组人员需要完成紧急程序。我们应该戴上氧气面罩，同时要确保乘客的面罩也已戴好。此外我们应该通知ATC要求改航，并立即下降到较低的高度，以确保乘客能够正常呼吸，并避免机身受到任何损坏。

cards.audioText: How many hours do you usually need for simulator training each year?
cards.audioTextZh: 你每年要进行多长时间的模拟器训练？
cards.referenceText: I have 16 hours’ simulator training every time. It’s divided into 4 days, 4 hours a day, and I have simulator training twice every year, so all together I have 32 hours’ simulator training every year.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我每次要进行16小时的模拟器训练。这16个小时分成四天完成，每天4小时。我每年要参加两次训练，所以每年共进行32小时训练。

cards.audioText: Please tell me the advantages and disadvantages of the simulator training.
cards.audioTextZh: 说一下模拟机训练的优缺点。
cards.referenceText: Relative to real aircraft training, the simulator training has many advantages. Firstly, its cost is much lower. Pilots can practice as many times as they like. Secondly, there is no danger in practicing abnormal situations. Thirdly, the company bears no risk of fatal accidents, and there are also some disadvantages for simulator training. For example, because of the limitation of the existing technology, the feedback and movement of the simulator may not be as real as the real aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。相较于真实训练，模拟机训练有许多优点。第一，成本相对较低。飞行员想练多少次都可以；第二，模拟机训练可以毫无风险地练习异常情况；第三，公司不用承担事故风险。同时模拟机训练也有一些缺点。例如，由于现有科技的限制，模拟机的反馈和动作都不是太真实。

cards.audioText: How do you know about CRM?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对机组资源管理有多少了解？
cards.referenceText: Crew Resource Management is also called Cockpit Resource Management, which is a cockpit management concept involving a pilot’s thorough use of all available resources, both inside the cockpit and outside. It is an essential part of any flight department’s training and a critical piece of knowledge in an airline pilot’s career. All professional pilots are trained in CRM, and the focus remains on specific concepts such as aeronautical decision-making, risk management, teamwork, and error management. CRM teaches us how to communicate with each other, how to solve problems and how to act duties of crew members. Good CRM can reduce crew errors and workload, improve cooperation between crew members, and make flight operations safe and efficient.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组资源管理也称为驾驶舱资源管理，是一个涉及飞行员充分利用驾驶舱内外可用资源的驾驶舱管理概念。它是飞行部门培训的重要组成部分，也是航空公司飞行员职业生涯中的重要知识。所有的专业飞行员都要培训机组资源管理，重点仍然在诸如航空决策、风险管理、团队合作和错误管理等具体概念上。机组资源管理教导我们如何相互沟通、如何解决问题以及如何做好机组人员你的本职工作。良好的机组资源管理可以减少机组错误，减轻工作量，提高成员间合作效率，实现飞行操作安全化、高效化。

cards.audioText: What should you do when you receive a clearance?
cards.audioTextZh: 获得指令后你应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Firstly, I should follow the instruction. Secondly, if I encounter questions or difficulties, I should request as early as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，我应该遵循指示。之后，如果我遇到问题或困难，应及时报告。

cards.audioText: Does captain always check with co-pilot on received clearances?
cards.audioTextZh: 机长是否经常与副驾驶核实收到的指令？
cards.referenceText: Yes. It’s necessary for us to understand clearly about all the clearances. If we are unsure about the ATC clearance, we should request the clarification immediately in case of misunderstanding.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的。清楚地了解所有的指令对我们来说是非常必要的。如果我们对ATC的指令不确定时，应该立刻要求澄清以防误解。

cards.audioText: What’s the main duty of a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员的主要职责是什么？
cards.referenceText: The main duty of a pilot is to make sure the safety of the flight and passengers. When an emergency situation happens, he should be able to handle the emergency situation, and if necessary, he should help evacuate passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员的主要职责是确保飞行及乘客的安全。发生紧急情况时，他应该能够解决问题。必要时，他应该帮助乘客疏散。

cards.audioText: What are the different duties of captain and first officer?
cards.audioTextZh: 机长和副驾驶的职责有什么不同？
cards.referenceText: Captain is the final decision maker during the flight whereas the first officer should complete his own duty to assist the captain and give him advice when necessary. In my opinion, both captain and the first officer are important for ensuring the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机长是飞行期间的最终决策者，副驾驶应完成自己的职责，协助机长并在必要时为机长提供建议。在我看来，机长和副驾驶对确保飞行安全都是非常重要的。

cards.audioText: If you have a first officer or captain that you don’t like, how would you handle the situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你不喜欢一起工作的机长或副驾驶，你会怎样处理这种情况？
cards.referenceText: First of all, I would rather do my job following standard operation procedures (SOP). Secondly, I will try to avoid any possible confliction, and create relaxing environment. Lastly, if necessary, I have to feed back to crew scheduling.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，我会选择按照标准运行程序（SOP）工作。其次，我会尽量避免任何可能发生的冲突，营造轻松的氛围。最后，必要的话，我会把情况反馈给机组排班人员。

cards.audioText: How decisions are made on the flight deck?
cards.audioTextZh: 机长和副驾驶是如何做决策的？
cards.referenceText: Nowadays, both the captain and the first officer make decisions on the flight deck. But years ago, most captains were not willing to listen to others’ advice and first officers were always reluctant to put forward different ideas. However, since the introduction of CRM into aviation industry, the decision is made when the captain and the first officer agree on an issue.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如今，机长和副驾驶都在驾驶舱做决策。但多年前，大多数机长不太愿意听取别人的意见，副驾驶也不愿意提出不同观点。然而，自从引进机组资源管理制度到航空业，机长和副驾驶对某一事件达成一致观点才会做决定。

cards.audioText: How do you think of the introduction of CRM?
cards.audioTextZh: 你怎样看待引入机组资源管理？
cards.referenceText: Since the introduction of CRM into aviation industry, pilots have learnt that nobody is perfect, and the best way to prevent making mistakes is to have others watch your back. I think the arrival of CRM has been a good change not only for the pilots, but also for flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自从引进机组资源管理制度到航空业，飞行员们就知道了人无完人，防止决策失误的最好办法是有人监督。我认为引进机组资源管理对飞行员乃至飞行安全都是一个好的改变。

cards.audioText: Tell me about the task sharing of flight crew members in your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 请告诉我你们机上的机组人员是如何分配任务的？
cards.referenceText: In our aircraft, we strictly follow the SOP and the captain would assign tasks to every crew member. When emergency situation happens, we usually cooperate with each other and solve the problem together.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我们飞机上，大家都严格遵守标准运行程序，机长将任务分配给每一个成员。发生紧急情况时，我们通常会互相合作，共同解决问题。

cards.audioText: In your opinion, how to improve CRM?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你看来，如何提高机组资源管理？
cards.referenceText: Firstly, crew members should establish good communication, so that some mistakes can be prevented and corrected timely. Secondly, crew members should make full use of the facilities and the ground navigation equipment. Thirdly, the crew should operate the plane strictly according to manuals and standard operation procedures. Lastly, the crew should comply with the aviation regulations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，机组成员间应建立良好的沟通，这样可以防止并及时纠正一些错误。其次，机组成员应充分利用设施和地面导航设备。另外，成员应按照手册和标准运行程序，严格操纵飞机。最后，机组成员应遵守航空法规。

cards.audioText: How to balance your work time and break time?
cards.audioTextZh: 怎样平衡工作时间和休息时间？
cards.referenceText: I have a personal schedule recording my daily arrangement, with its help I can arrange my daily work and break time reasonably. I have many hobbies, like riding, playing basketball, so during my break time, I can relax myself thoroughly. Every year I will take a long vacation for travelling. In my work time, I am always fully present and I really appreciate every flight of my duty time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 嗯，我有一个个人时间表，记录我每天的安排，有了它我可以合理的安排我的日常工作及休息时间。我有许多爱好，像骑马、打篮球，所以休息时，我可能全面放松自己。每年我都会放个长假去旅行。工作时，我完全投入，同时我很珍视每次飞行任务。

cards.audioText: What will you do if your flight time is approaching duty time limit?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你的飞行时间达到工作时间限制，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Our company prohibits flying under fatigue condition in order to avoid any incident or disaster, so if my flight time is approaching duty time limit, I will request my company for duty off and have a good rest.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们公司禁止在疲劳状态下飞行，以避免发生任何事故或灾难。所以如果我的飞行时间达到工作时间限制，我会和公司请求下班，好好休息。

cards.audioText: What are the most important principles of CRM?
cards.audioTextZh: CRM最重要的原则是什么？
cards.referenceText: CRM stands for Crew Resource Management. It means flight crew should work as a team. Though each member of the flight crew has different duties and responsibilities, he can not work individually. They must cooperate with each other during flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: CRM代表机组资源管理；意思是飞机机组成员应作为一个团队工作。虽然每个机组成员都有不同的任务和责任，也不能单独工作。飞行期间，他们必须互相合作。

cards.audioText: What factors do you think would affect the flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为哪些因素会影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: There are many factors that may affect flight safety, including human factors, severe weather, aircraft malfunction and serious surrounding environments.
cards.referenceTextZh: 影响飞行安全的因素有许多，包括人为原因、恶劣天气、飞机故障以及恶劣的周边环境。

cards.audioText: How do you think of human errors?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何看待人为失误？
cards.referenceText: The human error is one primary factor that influences flight safety. It is recorded that more than 70% accidents are caused by human errors. Any crew members may contribute to the error chain, not just the pilot. But pilot error (language barrier, crew coordination/ decision faults, mid-air collision, blatant violations of rules/regulations, etc.) is the major factor that influences flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 人为失误是影响飞行安全的主要因素之一。据记载，70%以上的事故都是由人为失误造成的。除了飞行员，任一机组成员都可能失误，造成连锁反应。但是飞行员的失误（语言障碍、机组协调问题、决策失误、中空碰撞、公然违反规则规定等）是影响飞行安全的主要因素。

cards.audioText: What can be done to prevent pilots from becoming a potential hazard?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何防止飞行员成为潜在的危险？
cards.referenceText: From my point of view, great efforts should be made to ensure pilots’ health, flying skills, decision-making ability and language proficiency at the highest possible level. We pilots must be strict with ourselves, stay away from alcohol and drug, follow the rules and make flight safety our first priority at any time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 就我看来，飞行员应尽最大努力保证其安全、飞行能力、决策能力及语言能力在一个尽可能高的水平。我们飞行员必须严于律己，远离酒精、毒品，遵守规则，无论何时把飞行安全放在第一位。

cards.audioText: How should pilots and ATC cooperate with each other to ensure the flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为了确保飞行安全，飞行员与ATC应如何配合？
cards.referenceText: Effective communication between pilots and ATC is very important. To understand each other quickly and clearly, they should use standard phraseology to communicate. ATC should stay clear and calm when making instruction, and pilots must make clear response, express their intention clearly, as well as adhere to standards and regulations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员与ATC间的有效沟通是非常重要的。为了快速、清晰地了解对方意图，双方应使用术语交流。发出指令时，ATC应保证声音清晰稳定。飞行员必须做出明确的回应，清楚地表达自己的意图，同时应遵守标准和规章

cards.audioText: Do you think standardization will improve flight safety and efficiency?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得标准化能否提高飞行安全及效率？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Standardization stems from previous mistakes and successful experiences. It can largely decrease human errors and enlarge safety margin. If the flight operation can be standardized, flight safety and efficiency can be improved to a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得可以。标准化是从过去的错误和成功的经验中总结出来的。它可以在很大程度上减少人为失误，扩大安全裕度。如果飞行操作被标准化，那么飞行安全及效率将提升到一个更高的水平。

cards.audioText: Many new technologies have been used in the aircraft. What are the advantages of the new technologies for pilots?
cards.audioTextZh: 许多新型技术被应用到飞机上。这些新技术对飞行员来说有什么优点？
cards.referenceText: The use of new technologies on the aircraft has greatly reduced the workload of the pilots, giving them more time and energy to manage the flight. To some extent, it has improved the aviation security.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在飞机上应用新兴技术大大地减少了飞行员的工作量，让他们有更多的时间和精力来管理飞机。某种程度上，新技术的应用提高了航空安全性。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me some reasons that make pilots dump fuel during the flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否告诉我飞行中需要飞行员放油的原因么？
cards.referenceText: Generally speaking, if the aircraft has some serious problems such as engine flame out, cabin or cargo fire, serious electrical or hydraulic malfunctions, you need to divert to the origin airport or the nearest airport. If the aircraft is overweight then, you have to dump fuel to reduce the landing weight to a suitable weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一般来说，如果飞机出现了一些严重的问题，如发动机熄火、座舱或货舱失火、严重的电气或液压故障，你需要改航回到出发机场或最近的机场。如果飞机超重，你必须放油，把着陆重量降低到最佳着陆重量。

cards.audioText: Why would fatigue endanger flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么疲劳驾驶会危及飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Pilots fatigue is very dangerous to flight safety. If a pilot feels very tired during flight, he cannot concentrate on controlling the aircraft, especially when something unusual happens, he cannot take the correct action immediately and might cause an accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员疲劳严重威胁飞行安全。如果飞行员飞行时感到非常疲惫，他就无法专注地操控飞机，尤其发生异常情况时，他不能迅速做出正确反应，这就可能造成飞行事故。

cards.audioText: What's your suggestion for flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对飞行安全有什么建议？
cards.referenceText: Pilots should do a thorough plan before flight. pilots should strictly follow ATC’s instructions. Every crew member should cooperate with each other during flight. I think these are the most important things for flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先飞行前飞行员应做一个完整的计划。同时他们应严格执行ATC的指令。飞行时机组成员应互相配合。我觉得这些对飞行安全来说是最重要的。

cards.audioText: What are some communication requirements during an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 紧急情况下的通讯要求有哪些？
cards.referenceText: During emergency situation, pilots should make a simple and clear communication in short instructions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到紧急情况时，飞行员的通讯需要简洁、明了，并使用简短指令。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered an in-flight emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遭遇过紧急情况吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have. Several years ago, I had a medical emergency situation. An old passenger was having a heart attack while we were flying from Beijing to Shanghai. Luckily, we had a doctor, who came immediately to attend the sick passenger after I made a PA. I contacted ATC to report the situation and required priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 几年前，我在飞行中遭遇医疗紧急情况。在北京到上海途中，一位年长的乘客心脏病发作。幸运的是，飞机上有一名医生。在我广播后，这名医生立刻来照顾生病的乘客。我向ATC报告情况并申请优先着陆。

cards.audioText: What specific conditions may lead to a diversion?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些特定条件会导致改航？
cards.referenceText: Many factors may result in a diversion. For example, aircraft system failure in-flight, passenger becoming very sick during flight, the destination airport being closed because of bad weather or airport facility malfunction. Moreover, sometimes a hijacker may force a pilot to divert to his destination airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有许多因素，例如：飞行时系统故障、乘客不适、到达机场因恶劣天气或机场设备故障导致关闭。此外，有时劫机者会胁迫飞行员改航到另一机场。

cards.audioText: What damage does turbulence have to the flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 颠簸对飞行安全会造成哪些伤害？
cards.referenceText: Severe turbulence is harmful for configuration of the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 严重颠簸会对飞机的结构造成损坏。

cards.audioText: Have you encountered drunk passenger or fight during flight? How did you deal with the situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你遇到过醉酒，有暴力发生的航班吗？你是如何处理的？
cards.referenceText: When we meet drunk passenger or fight during flight, we will first consider their influences towards other passengers. If the situation is serious, we need to ask for assistance from relevant departments.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到类似的旅客，首先要看他们的行为是否影响到其他旅客，如果非常严重就需要取得相关部门的帮助。

cards.audioText: What will you do when the warning alerts are triggered during take-off?
cards.audioTextZh: 在起飞时触发了警报你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Any warning alerts should be paid attention by pilots, because the alerts indicate the malfunction of the aircraft, especially during takeoff. So, if the warning alerts are triggered during takeoff, I will abort take-off, or continue takeoff according to the situation, and determine the failure the first time then handle the fault.
cards.referenceTextZh: 任何在飞机上的警报都应该引起飞行员的重视，警报说明飞机系统出现了故障，出现了问题，尤其在起飞关键阶段。所以在起飞关键阶段，遇到了任何警报需要中断起飞，或者根据情况继续起飞，起飞以后第一时间判断故障并处理故障。

cards.audioText: During flight, if you lose flight control, what would you do? (e.g. Elevator, ailerons, rudder, flaps, etc.)
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中，如果你失去了对飞机的控制，你会怎样做？（例如：升降舵、副翼、方向舵、襟翼等）
cards.referenceText: If I lose flight control during flight, I would isolate the fault as soon as possible, then use auxiliary system to recover the controlling of the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞行中失去了对飞机的控制，我会尽快隔离该故障使用备用方式对飞机恢复控制。

cards.audioText: What are the possible reasons of runway incursions?
cards.audioTextZh: 可能引起跑道入侵的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: The reasons of runway incursions various, but the main reason is the communication problem. The communication between pilots and controllers is very important.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道入侵的原因有很多，最主要的还是沟通问题，飞行员与管制员的沟通起到了至关重要的作用。

cards.audioText: Are there any risks or threats when pilots operate on the short and narrow runways? What are they?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在距离短和狭窄的跑道上操作飞机是否有风险？都有哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think it is dangerous to operate on short and narrow runways because it is easy to overrun or skid off the runway. So, when we make takeoff or landing on such runways, we should be careful about flight data, especially the aircraft performance and weather and control the aircraft smoothly for takeoff and landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为存在风险，因为这样很容易冲出跑道。所以当我们在这种跑道起飞或降落时，我们应该关注飞行数据，尤其是飞机表现和天气情况，并在起飞或降落时平稳控制飞机。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do to ensure safe landing on a short and narrow runway?
cards.audioTextZh: 在距离短或狭窄的跑道上飞行员应该怎样做来保证飞机安全着陆？
cards.referenceText: When we make landing on such runways, a pilot should be pay more attention to aircraft weight, weather condition, braking action and land the aircraft at touchdown area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在这种跑道上着陆时，飞行员应该关注飞机的重量、天气情况、刹车情况并在着陆区域着陆。

cards.audioText: Nowadays, the terminal airspace is becoming more and more crowded, do you think there are any potential risks?
cards.audioTextZh: 如今，终端空域正变得越来越拥挤，你认为这样有什么潜在的风险吗？
cards.referenceText: The crowded terminal airspace becomes the potential risk of air conflict. For flight safety, effective communication is need between controllers and pilots, so aircraft can fly orderly in limited airspace, then the flight safety can be ensured.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，现在空域的紧张是直接导致空中冲突的潜在危险的原因。为了保证飞行安全，需要管制员和飞行员之间进行良好的沟通，才可以在有限的空域内进行有序的飞行，进而保证飞行安全。

cards.audioText: Please make a brief introduction to the airline you are serving in.
cards.audioTextZh: 请简单介绍下你所在的航空公司。
cards.referenceText: OK. I am from China Southern Airlines. It' s the newest member of Sky Team with main flight operations based at Guangzhou Baiyun International AirPort, Beijing Capital International Airport and Zhengzhou Xinzheng International Airport. China Southern Airlines has 13 branches located throughout China and 54 international offices located in major metropolitan markets around the world. It' s one of China' s best-known airlines.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。我来自中国南方航空公司。它是天合联盟的最新成员，主运营基地分布在广州白云国际机场、北京首都国际机场以及郑州新郑国际机场。中国南方航空公司有13家分公司遍布全国，并在世界各地主要城市有54个国际办事处。它是中国最知名的航空公司之一。

cards.audioText: Can you say something about your corporate culture?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否介绍下你们的公司文化？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Hainan Airlines has been able to integrate the cultural essence of China with the latest Western scientific skills into its corporate culture. We are dedicated to be a modern cutting-edge airline.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。海南航空公司将中国文化精髓与西方科学技术融入到其企业文化中。我们致力于成为一家现代尖端的航空公司。

cards.audioText: What will happen if CG is put a little bit forward of aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机重心略靠前会发生什么？
cards.referenceText: If CG is put a little bit forward, the aircraft nose would be too heavy and it would be hard to operate the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果重心略靠前，机头过重，飞机将很难操纵。

cards.audioText: How do you think of preflight inspection of the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 你怎样看待飞行员的飞行前检查？
cards.referenceText: I think preflight inspection of the pilot is just as important as preflight inspection of the aircraft. It is vital to ensure pilots' health at the highest possible level. Having a cold or other illness or taking prescription medicine can seriously affect pilots’ability to concentrate, thus affecting the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为飞行员的飞行前检查和飞机的检查同等重要。在尽可能高的高度飞行，确保飞行员的健康是至关重要的。感冒及其它疾病，或是服用处方药都可能严重地影响飞行员的注意力，从而影响飞行安全。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages when flying at high altitudes?
cards.audioTextZh: 客机在高空飞行的优点是什么？
cards.referenceText: Aircraft will consume less fuel at higher altitudes, because less power is required at higher altitude due to thin air. Besides, cruising high can avoid some interference like birds, helicopters or other aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机在较高的高度飞行消耗的燃料较少，因为高空空气稀薄，需要的功率较低。另外，在高空巡航可以避免鸟类、直升机或其它飞机的干扰。

cards.audioText: Can you make a brief introduction of TCAS?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否简单地介绍下TCAS？
cards.referenceText: Yes. TCAS is shorted for traffic collision avoidance system, which is an aircraft collision avoidance system aimed to reduce the incidence of mid-air collisions. Most big airplanes use TCAS. It automatically monitors the airspace to avoid conflicting traffic by vertical movement or level change. TCAS reduces the pilot’s workload and the rate of aviation accidents, and it has greatly improved flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。TCAS是空中防撞系统的英文缩写，是旨在减少中空碰撞的飞机防撞系统。大多数大型飞机都使用TCAS。它可以自动监控空域，以避免因垂直或水平变化引起的交通冲突。TCAS减少了飞行员的工作量及航空事故的概率，大大地提高了飞行安全。

cards.audioText: What action would you perform if your TCAS is out of work during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中如果交通警告和防撞系统失灵你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I will fly away from RVSM airspace and request a lower altitude to operate. Meanwhile I will ask ATC for special assistance and request a safer separation to assure flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会飞离RVSM空域，并请求在较低高度飞行。同时，我会像ATC请求特别援助，并要求安全隔离，以确保飞行安全。

cards.audioText: What is the role of normal checklists?
cards.audioTextZh: 正常检查单的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: Normal checklists enhance flight safety by providing an opportunity to confirm that the safety critical aspects of the systems and aircraft configuration are correctly set. By following normal checklists, any mistakes in settings will be identified and corrected before they may cause safety problems. Normal checklist actions, as with all SOPs, are intended to check or verify actions that were accomplished from memory. A defined flow pattern should be employed for each cockpit panel. Safety-critical points should be cross-checked through the use of normal checklists.
cards.referenceTextZh: 正常检查单通过检查系统的安全关键部分和飞机配置是否设置正确来加强飞行安全。按照正常检查单，设置中出现任何错误都会在其造成安全问题前被发现并纠正。按照标准运行程序执行正常检查单是为了检查或确认是否所有记忆的项目都已经完成。驾驶舱操作面板应配备标准巡视流程。为了保证飞行安全应对正常检查单进行交叉检查。

cards.audioText: What would you suggest for flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对维护飞行安全有什么建议？
cards.referenceText: Now we are too busy with flight duty and always feel tired. As we all know, fatigue will endanger flight safety, I want to have more time to relax myself, and it’s good for my health. So, I think more holidays should be arranged for pilots.
cards.referenceTextZh: 目前我们忙于飞行任务，总会觉得累。大家都知道，疲劳驾驶会危及飞行安全，我想要有更多的时间放松自己，这对我的健康也是有益处的。我认为应该为飞行员安排更多的假期。

cards.audioText: As a captain, what will you do in a hijack?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，遇到劫持你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: We have detailed procedures to deal with hijack, so if there is hijack, I think I’ll follow the procedures in the Operation Manual. I must keep calm and squawk 7500 without being noticed. Then I will report our situation to ATC if possible. If the hijacker wants to destroy the aircraft, I think the most important thing should be making sure the safety of the passengers and aircraft. During the whole process, I will make every command firmly, and every crew member should work well with each other.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们有详细的操作程序来应对劫持，所以如果遇到劫持，我想我会按照操作手册中的程序解决。我必须保持镇定并趁其不备发送编码7500。如果可以的话，我会把情况报告给ATC。如果劫机者想要毁坏飞机，我觉得最重要的还是保证乘客及飞机的安全。整个过程中，我会坚决地执行每个命令，机组成员间也应互相合作。

cards.audioText: How do you think delays are more common at larger airports than smaller ones?
cards.audioTextZh: 你怎样看待大型机场比小型机场更容易发生延误的情况？
cards.referenceText: I think it is understandable that there are more flight delays at larger airports than smaller ones, because there is too much traffic at larger airports and too many passengers to handle every day.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为大型机场比小型机场更容易延误是很合理的，因为大型机场交通流量大，每天都要处理很多乘客事宜。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages and disadvantages of flying domestic routes?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞国内航线的优缺点分别是什么？
cards.referenceText: When flying domestic routes, I can go home more often, and spend much more time with my family and friends, and the pressure is relatively less for me, but I have less opportunities to learn aviation English with different accents around the world. Domestic routes are short, flying domestic routes is a high-demanding and challenging work. Pilots need to acquire the flight skill and knowledge of routes firmly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞国内航线时，我可以经常回家，有更多的时间和家人朋友在一起，而且对我来说压力较小。但是和世界各地不同口音的人交流、练习英语的机会就少了。国内航班距离短，工作强度大，富有挑战，同时飞行员需要更好的掌握飞行技术以及航线知识。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages and disadvantages of flying international routes?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得飞国际航线的优缺点分别是什么？
cards.referenceText: Flying international routes, I can travel around the world and take some opportunity to practice my English, as well as learn more different culture around the world. But the requirement for international flying is higher and more challenging. During flying, pilots may suffer from Jet-lag, high intensity flight and high altitude hypoxia. Meanwhile, pilot also have to adapt to different environment, climate and culture. It is the basic literacy of a qualified pilot to adapt to diverse environments.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞国际航线，我可以周游世界，并有机会练习英语，还可以感受世界各地的不同文化。但是飞国际航线的要求更高，更具有挑战性。时差、高强度飞行以及高空缺氧状态都是飞行中可能遇到的问题。同时飞行员还需要适应不同的环境、气候、文化等。适应多元的环境，这也是一名合格飞行员的基本素养。

cards.audioText: Why do you choose to be a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 你为什么选择成为一名飞行员？
cards.referenceText: Because I’m very proud to be a pilot. Being a pilot offers me a good opportunity to travel and to see the world. I have been to many places, Europe, America, Asia, and so on. I have met people of different backgrounds and have experienced their cultures. All these are valuable experience for me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 能成为一名飞行员我感到自豪。当飞行员提供给我一个环游世界的机会。我去过很多地方，欧洲、美洲、亚洲等。我遇到过许多不同背景的人，体验了他们的文化。这些经历对我来说都是很宝贵的。

cards.audioText: Do you think the communication among crew members is important? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否认为机组成员间的交流很重要？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Communication among crew members is very important. Because they are working as a team, if they have different ideas during flight, they must speak out to sort a common understanding of the problem. That will benefit their job.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的。机组成员间的交流非常重要。因为他们作为一个团队工作，如果在飞行中有不同的想法，他们必须说出来，达成共识。这将有利于他们的工作。

cards.audioText: Do you think team work is important in your work? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为团队合作在你的工作中是否重要？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think team work is very important in my work. We have a special terminology for team work, which is CRM. I think CRM is very important for us especially during an emergency situation, because a better CRM can ensure the flight safety and decrease threats and errors.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为团队合作在我的工作中是非常重要的。我们用一个特别的术语来称呼团队合作，就是CRM。我觉得CRM对我们来说非常重要，尤其是遇到紧急状况时，一个好的CRM可以确保飞行安全，减少威胁和失误。

cards.audioText: If your flight is delayed, how do you comfort passengers?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你的航班延误了，你如何安抚你的旅客？
cards.referenceText: If my flight is delayed, I will tell passengers the situation through PA. I will try to take off as soon as possible so I will ask passengers to wait patiently.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果航班延误，我会做个机长广播告知旅客我们现在遇到的问题，我们会尽最大努力尽快起飞，请耐心等待。

cards.audioText: Assume that you are going to fly tomorrow, will you make any preparations today?
cards.audioTextZh: 假设明天你有飞行任务，你今天会做哪些准备吗？
cards.referenceText: If I will fly tomorrow, I will ask for the following information of destination airport: the condition of airport, the location, the runway condition, the departure and approach frequency. I also need to know the condition of surrounding alternate airport, the route, the alternate airport of departure/destination airport and the weather condition en route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果明天我有航班任务，我首先会要了解一下目的地机场的情况，地理位置，跑道情况，进离场以及一些频率。周边备降机场的情况，所飞的航路。以及起飞机场备降机场和目的地机场以及航路上的天气情况。

cards.audioText: Do you think flying at higher altitude can save more fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为在更高高度飞行能节省更多的燃油吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think so. Generally speaking, at higher level, air density is less than that of lower level, the plane gets more lift with less thrust, so flying at higher level is more fuel-efficient. But it doesn’t mean the higher the better, while cruising at high altitude, we may encounter severe weather conditions such as severe turbulence or severe icing, it may increase the fuel consumption. So the altitude must be around the optimum altitude, which can help to save fuel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我认为能。一般来讲，高度越高，空气密度越低，飞机能够在较小的推力下得到更大升力，因此在更高的高度飞行时省油，但并不是说越高越省油，当在更高高度飞行时，我们可能会遇到强烈的湍流或严重积冰等恶劣天气，这样反而会增加燃油消耗，因此，飞行高度应该是在最佳飞行高度范围内，这样才能够节省燃油。

cards.audioText: When using contaminated fuel, what might be the consequences?
cards.audioTextZh: 使用受污染的燃油可能会导致什么结果？
cards.referenceText: Contaminated fuel may affect engine performance and cause engine problem, or even cause damage to the engine, which will increase the operational risks during flight. Therefore, in preflight inspection, we must follow the checklist to check the fuel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 受污染的燃油可能会影响发动机性能，导致发动机出现问题，甚至会损坏发动机，从而增加飞行中的运行风险。因此，在飞行前检查中，我们必须严格按照检查单要求来检查燃油。

cards.audioText: How do you think of this Oral Proficiency Interview by computer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对通过电脑进行的口语能力面试怎么看？
cards.referenceText: Generally speaking, this is an advanced test approach. It is more convenient and effective, and I’m less nervous when I take the test by computer instead of face-to-face test. In addition, such kind of test is really helpful for improving my oral English and professional knowledge. It should be much better if we have more efficient training materials to be familiar with the test, such as some guidance books or some regular training courses.
cards.referenceTextZh: 总的来说，通过电脑的考试方法很先进，这种方法更方便、高效。和面对面的考试相比，通过电脑考试减轻了我的紧张程度。此外，这样的考试对于提高英语口语和专业知识的水平真的很有帮助。如果我们能有更好的培训材料来熟悉考试会更好，例如一些辅导书或是定期培训课程。

cards.audioText: Do you think the ICAO English test is difficult? Which part is the most difficult for you?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得ICAO英语测试难吗？你觉得哪一部分最难？
cards.referenceText: A little difficult for me, especially Part 2. Because I think it’s hard for me to remember so many sentences in a short time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 对我来说有点难，尤其是第二部分。因为我觉得我很难在短时间内记住这么多句子。

cards.audioText: Are you satisfied with your performance today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对自己今天的表现满意吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I feel good in the test. I’ve tried my best in the last months, so I believe I can smile at the result whatever I fail or pass this time. And I hope I’ll be the lucky dog.
cards.referenceTextZh: 满意，我感觉我在考试中表现得不错。上个月我尽全力复习，所以不论是否能通过，我都会微笑面对考试结果，希望我可以幸运地通过考试。

cards.audioText: What do you think of PEPEC test?
cards.audioTextZh: 你怎么看待PEPEC测试？
cards.referenceText: I think the PEPEC test is necessary for pilots, especially for those who fly international flights, it will improve our radiotelephony communication in English.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得PEPEC测试对飞行员非常有必要，特别是那些飞国际航班的飞行员，它能够提高我们的英语无线电陆空通话水平。

cards.audioText: Do you think you can pass the test this time?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为这次你能通过考试吗？
cards.referenceText: I have made a lot of preparation for this test and tried my best to answer every subject just now. I will be very excited if I can pass the test this time, while if I failed, I would continue my English study. In short, whether I can pass the test or not, I believe I have done a good job.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我为这次考试做了许多准备，刚才我也努力回答了所有问题，如果能通过这次考试我会非常高兴。但是如果没有通过，我会继续学习英语。总之，不论我是否能通过，我相信这次我已经做得很好了。

cards.audioText: Is this the first time for you to take the PEPEC test?
cards.audioTextZh: 这是你第一次参加中国民航飞行人员英语等级考试(PEPEC)吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, it is. /No, it’s the second time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的。/不，第二次。

cards.audioText: Which part is the most difficult for you?
cards.audioTextZh: 对你来说考试哪一部分最困难？
cards.referenceText: The first part of listening test is much more difficult, because some details of dialogues are hard to handle for me. Besides, the third part of oral test is also difficult because some aviation knowledge and emergency situations are easy to understand and express in Chinese while difficult in English, but I believe that practice makes perfect. The more we practice, the easier it becomes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 听力考试的第一部分比较困难，因为对话中的一些细节对我来说不容易听懂。此外，口语考试的第三部分同样比较困难，因为使用中文时，那些航空知识和紧急情况很容易听懂或表述出来，但使用英文时就很困难。但是我相信，熟能生巧，我练习得越多，考试对我来说就会越容易。

cards.audioText: Do you have confidence to pass the test?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有信心通过考试吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think I have tried my best and I hope I can pass it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我认为自己已经尽力了，我希望自己可以顺利通过。

cards.audioText: Do you have something to say before finishing the test?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在考试结束前有什么想说的吗？
cards.referenceText: I would like to give thanks for your time first, and I’ve found that my English remains to be improved. Through this test, I deeply realize that English plays an important role in radiotelephony communication. I will make more efforts to improve my English skills in future. Thanks for the test and thank you again.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先我要感谢你在考试中为我花费的时间，还有就是我发现我的英语仍有提升空间。通过这次考试，我深深体会到英语在陆空通话中的重要性。未来我会更努力地提高自己的英语水平。感谢这次考试并再次感谢你。

cards.audioText: How do you think of today’s test?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得今天的考试怎么样？
cards.referenceText: I’m not pleased with my performance. Though I have made good preparations for it, I’m not in good test condition because of poor sleep last night. / I feel good in today’s test. The listening test is easier than I practiced before and the subjects in the oral test are all familiar to me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我不太满意我的表现。虽然我做了充分的准备，但是昨晚没睡好导致今天状态不佳。/ 我感觉不错。听力部分比我之前练习的简单一些，口语部分的话题我都很熟悉。

cards.audioText: What are the differences between this test and other kinds of tests?
cards.audioTextZh: 这次考试和其它类型的考试有什么不同？
cards.referenceText: This is the only test I have taken and I am not in a position to make a comment, I am afraid. / This is the first test I’ve ever taken that we make the oral English test by a computer. The test method is new and suitable for pilots and controllers. Meanwhile, I feel more relaxed to speak facing a computer than to speak face-to-face with a strict real person.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是我第一次参加这种考试，恐怕没办法回答这个问题。/ 这是我第一次用计算机做口语测试。这种测试方式很新颖，适用于飞行员和管制员。同时，面对计算机说话比和严肃的人面对面交流让我更放松。

cards.audioText: Do you have some advice about PEPEC?
cards.audioTextZh: 就PEPEC考试，你有什么建议吗
cards.referenceText: The test is a little bit difficult for me, but it is helpful for all the pilots and controllers. I hope the CAAC invest more manpower and material resources.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这个考试对我来说虽然有点难，但它对所有飞行员及管制员都有很大的帮助。我希望民航总局能够投入更多的人力及物力资源。

cards.audioText: How do you think of the PEPEC system?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得PEPEC考试系统怎么样？
cards.referenceText: Every coin has two sides. PEPEC system is a pressure for us, it can also improve our English level. We will benefit from the PEPEC sooner or later.
cards.referenceTextZh: 任何事物都有两面性。PEPEC考试给我们压力的同时，也提升了我们的英语水平。我们迟早会受益于它。

cards.audioText: When did you start learning English?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是什么时候开始学英语的？
cards.referenceText: I began to learn English at middle school. / I started to learn English from the year before last year, when I transferred from the air force.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我从中学时开始学英语。/ 前年从空军调动后我开始学英语。

cards.audioText: How long have you been learning English? Have you received any training related English?
cards.audioTextZh: 你学习英语多长时间了？你接受过任何英语训练吗？
cards.referenceText:
I have learned English for more than 10 years.
And I have received 2 months of English training related to this test.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我已经学习英语10几年了。
我也已经接受过2个月与此次考试相关的英语培训。

cards.audioText: Is this your first time to have an English test?
cards.audioTextZh: 这是你第一次参加英语考试吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, it’s my first time to have the English test. / No, it isn’t. I have taken many English tests in middle school and university. / This is the fifth time for me to attend the English test.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，这是我第一次参加英语考试。/ 不是，我在中学和大学时参加过很多英语考试。/ 这是我第五次参加英语考试。

cards.audioText: What are the effective ways to learn English?
cards.audioTextZh: 学习英语有哪些好的方法？
cards.referenceText: I think listening, reading, speaking and practicing is the most effective way to learn English. At the same time, we can also improve our listening and expression ability by listening to English songs, watching English movies or programs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为多听，多读，多说，多练是学习英语最有效的办法，同时，我们还可以通过听英文歌，看英文电影或者节目的方式提高我们的听力和表达能力。

cards.audioText: Have you taken any aviation English test before?
cards.audioTextZh: 你之前参加过航空英语考试吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have. Before PEPEC test, I have to take Basic English Test and Radiotelephony English Test, which we call double-certificate English test, and Airline Transport Pilot License (ATPL) test. They are all aviation English tests.
cards.referenceTextZh: 参加过，在PEPEC考试前，我参加过基础英语考试和无线电通话考试，这两个考试被称为双证书英语考试。我还参加过航线运输飞行员执照，以上考试都是航空英语考试。

cards.audioText: Do you think watch English movie or programs is a good way to improve your English proficiency?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为看英文电影或节目是提高英语水平的好办法吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think so. Because watching English movies or programs can help us get familiar with some common English expressions and improve our listening ability. So I think watching English movies or programs is a good way to improve our English proficiency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，确实是。因为看英语电影或节目可以让我们熟悉一些英语常用表达，提高我们的听力能力。因此，我认为看英文电影或节目是提高我们英语水平的好办法。

cards.audioText: Have you ever taken any aviation English training before?
cards.audioTextZh: 你之前参加过航空英语相关的培训吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I took one month PEPEC preparation course last winter.
cards.referenceTextZh: 参加过，去年冬天我参加了为期一个月的PEPEC培训课程。

cards.audioText: Do you think it’s necessary for you to continue the English study in the near future?
cards.audioTextZh: 在不久的将来，你认为还有必要学习英语吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, absolutely, I will never give up English learning in the near future, because it’s very important for pilots.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，肯定是很必要的。在不久的将来，我不会放弃英语学习，因为它对飞行员来说非常重要。

cards.audioText: Do you think your English has been improved since you began studying?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为开始学习后你的英语水平有提高吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, of course. Through studying, I learnt a lot of words and phrases, I know the basic structure and grammar of English, so now it’s easier for me to watch English films and read English books. / I think I’ve made a little progress. At least I dare to open my mouth. When I talk with foreigners, I’m not nervous and can speak a little. During the flight from Sydney to Beijing I could understand the ATC’s instructions and respond timely and correctly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当然有提高，在学习中我积累了很多单词和短语，了解到英语的基本结构和语法，现在我在看英文电影和读英文书时感到更容易。/ 我认为我有了一点进步，至少现在我敢说英语了。当我和外国人交谈时，我不再感到紧张并且能说一些英语。从悉尼飞北京时我能听懂ATC的指令并及时正确地回复ATC。

cards.audioText: What role does English play in your work?
cards.audioTextZh: 英语在你的工作中起什么作用？
cards.referenceText: English plays a very important role in my work. Most instruments in aircraft are marked with English abbreviation words, and the same with many signs in airports. Additionally, it’s essential for pilots and ATC’s radiotelephony communication, especially in international flights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 英语在我的工作中起重要作用。飞机上的大部分仪器标注的都是英文缩写词，机场的很多标志也是一样。此外飞行员和ATC在陆空通话中必须要使用英语，尤其是飞国际航班时。

cards.audioText: Do you think English is hard to learn? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为英语是否很难学？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think English is quite difficult for me, especially speaking and listening. There are a lot to learn, grammar, pronunciation, vocabulary and so on. / I haven’t read the alphabets for ten years, so I have to restart to learn ABC. / No, I don’t think it’s hard to learn. I began to study English from the middle school, so I can listen and speak oral English well.
cards.referenceTextZh: 很难学，我认为英语对我来说很难，尤其是口语和听力。需要学习的内容很多，例如语法、发音、词汇等。/ 我已经有十年没有接触英语了，所以我必须要重新学习英语。/ 不难学，我认为英语没那么难，我从中学开始学英语，所以我的听力和口语都很好。

cards.audioText: What have you done to improve your oral English?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾为提高口语做过什么？
cards.referenceText: To improve my oral English, I have paid more attention to communicating ability instead of only laying emphasis on grammatical correctness. I try to talk more with my foreign teacher or some other partners. Sometimes it’s hard to get English partners, so I always talk to myself about what I have seen or what I have done. Additionally, I like to retell some English articles and stories in my own words, and I feel it’s a simple method of practicing spoken English.
cards.referenceTextZh: 为了提高口语水平，我在学习中不止侧重于语法正确性，而是更注重沟通能力。我尝试多与外教和同学用英语交谈，有时很难找到可以和我对话的同学，所以我经常把自己看到的或经历到的事情用英语说给自己听。此外，我喜欢用自己的语言复述英文文章和故事，我认为这是个提高口语水平的简单的方法。

cards.audioText: Will you keep on learning English? / Will you continue to improve your English?
cards.audioTextZh: 你会继续学习英语吗？ / 你会继续提高自己的英语水平吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, absolutely I will. English plays an important role in my work. It’s an essential communication tool for pilots and controllers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当然会，英语在我的工作中起重要的作用。对于飞行员和管制员来说英语是必不可少的交流工具。

cards.audioText: Do you enjoy speaking English?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢说英语吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I do. I enjoy speaking English. I feel proud when I speak English with a foreigner fluently.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢，和外国人用英语流利交谈时我会感到很骄傲。

cards.audioText: Which English TV program do you like most?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的英文电视节目是什么？
cards.referenceText: I like CCTV international channel most. It’s an English speaking program and I can see many different culture in different countries. It’s nice to watch this channel and it’s helpful for my English learning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢CCTV国际频道，通过英文节目我能感受不同国家的不同文化。我喜欢这个频道，节目对学习英语也很有帮助。

cards.audioText: Do you think English is important in radio communication nowadays?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得英语在无线电通话中重要吗？
cards.referenceText: Definitely. With the development of China, more and more foreign aircraft fly in the airspace of our country. It’s a challenge for ATCs to handle the normal and abnormal situation in English. Fluent oral English became really important nowadays.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当然重要，随着中国的发展，越来越多的外国飞机在我国空域内飞行，这对管制员用英语处理正常及非正常状况都是一个挑战。如今，讲一口流利的英语非常重要。

cards.audioText: In your opinion, which part is more important in English study?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你看来，英语学习中最重要的是哪个部分？
cards.referenceText: In order to understand all the instructions from ATC, we must have a better ability in listening and speaking. We must express our intention clearly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 为了了解ATC的全部信息，我们必须有较好的听说能力。我们必须能够清楚的表达自己的意图。

cards.audioText: Do you have some special methods in English study?
cards.audioTextZh: 你学习英语有什么特别的方法么？
cards.referenceText: I think we should practice listening and speaking as much as possible. In free time, I always read newspapers, listen to the radio and attend the lecture.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得我们应该尽可能多地练习听说。在空闲时间，我经常读报纸、听广播和参加讲座。

cards.audioText: If given a chance to study English, what form do you prefer?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果给你一个学习英语的机会，你更喜欢哪种形式？
cards.referenceText: I’d like to join the training center. They can make a well conceived plan and provide effective methods. I can improve my English level in short time, and I cherish the opportunity to receive training in details on campus after graduation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我想加入培训中心。培训中心会制定周密的学习计划，提供有效的学习方法。这样我可以在短期内提升英语水平。我很珍惜毕业后还能在校园内接受培训的机会。

cards.audioText: Would you like to visit some duty-free shops at airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢去机场的免税店吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, when the flight schedule is not very tight, I would like to visit duty-free shops which selling a large selection of tax-free goods with local characteristic, and buy some real bargains.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当航班日程不是很紧时我喜欢逛免税店，店内会有大量带有当地特色的免税商品，我可以买到物美价廉的商品。

cards.audioText: Do you have any plan about your future?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对你的未来有什么计划吗？
cards.referenceText: Since I am a student pilot and I fly C172 now, so I hope I can become a qualified pilot and join Air China and fly B787 in the future.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因为我现在还是一名飞行学员，飞的是塞斯纳172，所以我希望变成合格的飞行员，在未来可以加入国航飞波音787。

cards.audioText: What problems you may have when being abroad?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在国外时会遇到什么样的问题？
cards.referenceText: I am afraid the language barrier will come first, and another problem is that I’m not used to foreign food.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先要考虑的就是语言障碍，另一个问题就是我不习惯国外的食物。

cards.audioText: What are you going to do right after this test?
cards.audioTextZh: 这次考试结束后，你会干什么？
cards.referenceText: Maybe I will have a good rest, because I have prepared for this test for a long time and I feel a little bit tired.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我可能会好好休息下，因为我已经为这次考试准备了很久，感觉有一点点累，

cards.audioText: Which do you like better, in-flight meal or home cooking?
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢飞机餐还是家常菜？
cards.referenceText: I prefer home cooking. Airline menus are often high in energy, fat and sodium, and I could not consume as much energy as the meals offer. Apart from that, being a pilot, flying in the sky most time, I prefer the feeling at home.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我更喜欢家常菜。通常飞机餐的能量、脂肪和钠较高，我无法消耗飞机餐提供的能量。此外，作为飞行员，大部分时间都在空中飞行，我更喜欢在家的感觉。

cards.audioText: Do you know anything about C919?
cards.audioTextZh: 你了解C919吗？
cards.referenceText: It is designed by Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China (COMAC), and it’s the first big jet that we design and produce in our country. I’m so proud that China has its own big aircraft now.
cards.referenceTextZh: C919是中国商飞设计的，它是中国自己设计和生产的第一款大飞机，对于中国能有自己的大飞机，我感到非常自豪。

cards.audioText: Which season do you prefer? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪个季节？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I prefer autumn because it is a beautiful and comfortable season. It is not too hot or too cold and the scenery is pretty good in autumn. In addition, it is a good season for travel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢秋季，因为秋季是个优美宜人的季节。秋季的天气既不太热也不太冷，并且景色很美。此外秋季还是旅行的好季节。

cards.audioText: What’s the difference between C919 and other big jet?
cards.audioTextZh: C919和其他大飞机有哪些不同？
cards.referenceText: C919 is another step in the development of Chinese technology, marking that China’s big jet can enter the world’s advanced level. There are many advanced functions in C919, it has low noise, it is fuel saving, and passengers will feel more comfortable on board, but compared with Boeing and Airbus, it has lower passenger capacity.
cards.referenceTextZh: C919是中国科技进步的又一次提升，标志着中国大飞机制造进入到世界先进水平行列。目前C919有很多先进的功能，比如低噪音、省燃油，乘客有更舒适的乘机体验，但相较于波音和空客，它的载客量较低。

cards.audioText: Where did you fly to on your last flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近一次飞行是去哪里？
cards.referenceText: My last flight was from Sydney to Beijing, and then I had two days off. / My last flight was from Guangzhou to Shanghai. Because I have to take the test today, so my leader arranged me to fly a short flight in order to get much time to prepare.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最近的飞行是从悉尼飞到北京，然后我有两天的休假。/ 我最近一次飞行是从广州到上海，因为我今天要参加考试，所以我的领导为我安排短程航班，这样我会有更多的时间来准备考试。

cards.audioText: Do you have any outlook about China’s aviation in the next decade?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对中国航空未来十年发展有何展望？
cards.referenceText: The future must be bright, and I hope our own aircraft will be better and better.
cards.referenceTextZh: 前景一定是好的，我相信我们自己的大飞机也一定会越来越好。

cards.audioText: Do you want to work in foreign airlines?
cards.audioTextZh: 你想在外航工作吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I do. I think working in foreign airlines not only pays better, but also let me experience different cultures. It's a very interesting thing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我想。我觉得在外航工作不仅收入更高，而且可以体验不同国家的文化。这是一件很有意思的事情。

cards.audioText: Do you ever feel overworked?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾有过度劳累的情况吗？
cards.referenceText: Most of the flying time is arranged and limited, so I don’t feel overworked normally, unless I meet abnormal weather conditions, under which I always feel exhausted, because we may wait a long time for taking off or landing, or we may divert to other airports.
cards.referenceTextZh: 大部分的飞行时间是有限并安排好的，所以通常我不会感到劳累过度。除非遇到反常的天气情况，这时我会感到疲惫，因为起飞或着陆需要等待很长时间，有时还需要转飞到其它机场。

cards.audioText: In your opinion, what are the challenges of working in a foreign airline?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你看来，在外航工作有哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: I think the biggest challenge lies in language and culture. Therefore, we need to improve our English.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为最大的挑战在于语言和文化这一方面。因此，我们需要提高自己的英语水平。

cards.audioText: Do you like your leader to contact you after work hours? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢领导在下班后联系你吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Frankly speaking, I don’t like to be contacted during my breaks. I want to enjoy the after-work time, but if there are important things, it depends.
cards.referenceTextZh: 坦白说，我不喜欢别人在休息时间联系我。我希望能享受休息的时间，但如果有重要的事情我会看情况而定。

cards.audioText: What's your company’s logo?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们公司的logo是什么？
cards.referenceText: Our company is China Eastern Airlines. Its logo is a swallow. In ancient times, swallows were called auspicious birds, symbolizing luck and harmony.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们公司是东方航空，它的logo是一只燕子，在古代，燕子被称为吉鸟，象征吉祥与和顺。

cards.audioText: When is your next simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你什么时候参加下次模拟训练？
cards.referenceText: I just finished my simulator training last month, and we have simulator training twice every year, so the next one will be in five months.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上个月我刚结束模拟训练，我们每年训练两次，下次训练会在五个月内。

cards.audioText: Do you know which domestic airlines operate the C919?
cards.audioTextZh: 您知道哪些国内航空公司运营 C919 客机吗？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, there are many airlines operating the C919 domestically, such as Air China, China Eastern Airlines and China Southern Airlines.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，国内运营C919 的航司有很多，比如，国航、东航、南航。

cards.audioText: Tell me about a great change that occurred in your life.
cards.audioTextZh: 讲讲你生活中发生的大改变。
cards.referenceText: Honestly I haven’t thought about this much, but the topic reminds me of my beginning of the flying career. I was selected from a key university to the Flight College, which changed my whole life and made my childhood dream come true.
cards.referenceTextZh: 说实话对此我没想过太多，但这个话题让我想起了飞行事业刚开始的阶段。我从一所重点大学被选拔到飞行学院，这改变了我整个人生，实现了我童年时的梦想。

cards.audioText: Do you have any international flights coming up?
cards.audioTextZh: 接下来你还有国际飞行任务么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. After taking this exam, I’m flying to Singapore tomorrow morning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有。考试结束后，明天我要飞新加坡。

cards.audioText: Have you experienced any awkward things in your life?
cards.audioTextZh: 你人生中遇到过尴尬的事么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, there are several funny stories in my life. The most awkward experience in my memory is that once I went into Lady’s room and I didn’t realize it until I came out.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到过，我有许多有趣的经历。印象中最尴尬的是有一次去厕所，出来之后才意识到我错进了女厕所。

cards.audioText: Which country do you like to visit most in the world?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最想去哪个国家旅行？
cards.referenceText: I would like to visit Egypt, which is one of the four civilized ancient countries in the world just like China. It is a famous tourist resort with its fabulous natural environment and attractive customs which will actually relax me.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我想去埃及，和中国一样，埃及是四大文明古国之一。埃及是著名的旅游胜地，有着极好的自然环境和吸引人的风俗文化，在那里我可以放松身心。

cards.audioText: Do you have flight tomorrow?
cards.audioTextZh: 你明天有航班要飞么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I’ll fly to America.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有，我要飞美国。

cards.audioText: Tell me about your favorite airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 请介绍一下你最喜欢的机场。
cards.referenceText: My favorite airport is Beijing Capital International Airport. It has the best emergency service in China. Because Beijing is the capital of China and Beijing Airport has the largest traffic volume in China, thus the government pays a great attention to the safety of Beijing Airport, and the best facilities are equipped in Beijing Airport. There are also a special public police team to deal with terrorist activity. Only better emergency service can make sure the safe operation of all aircraft coming in and out of the airport, particularly during the 2008 Olympic Games.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的机场是北京首都国际机场，那里有中国机场最好的紧急服务。因为北京是中国的首都，首都机场有全国最大的交通量，因此政府很重视首都机场的安全，机场配备了最好的设备，同时机场内有应对恐怖活动的公共特警队。只有更好的紧急服务才能保证所有飞机安全地进出场，尤其是2008年奥运会期间。

cards.audioText: Tell me about the different approaches you can fly.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉我你会哪些进近方式。
cards.referenceText: I can fly ILS or LOC approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会盲降和LOC进近。

cards.audioText: What are your ambitions in life?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的追求是什么？
cards.referenceText: When I was young, my ambitions were to have a happy family and a desirable career, and both were fulfilled. Now, my ambitions in life are to make a good salary to support my family and keep physical and mental health every day.
cards.referenceTextZh: 年轻的时候，我希望能有一个幸福的家庭和一份理想的职业，这些都已经实现了。现在，我对生活的追求是用一份可观的收入养家，保持身体健康和好心情。

cards.audioText: When did you start flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 你何时开始飞行的？
cards.referenceText: I started flying in 2004.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我从2004年开始飞行。

cards.audioText: How do you see online shopping?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何看待网上购物？
cards.referenceText: Online shopping is very popular nowadays. I think we pilots can benefit a lot from it, because we usually have no time to go shopping outside. Online shopping makes it easy and convenient to shop because we can buy whatever we need without going outside.
cards.referenceTextZh: 现在很流行网上购物，我认为网上购物为飞行员提供了便捷，因为我们通常没时间出门购物，网上购物使购物变得简洁、方便，我们不出门就可以购物。

cards.audioText: What have you learnt being a pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 成为飞行员后你学到了些什么？
cards.referenceText: The most important thing I have learnt is being calm under any emergency situation. I must believe in myself during emergency and make decisions timely and correctly. On the base of that, it could be possible to overcome difficulties.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我学到的最重要的事就是在遇到紧急情况时保持镇定。我必须相信自己，及时作出正确的决定。只有这样，才可以克服困难。

cards.audioText: What is the importance of communication in daily life?
cards.audioTextZh: 交流在日常生活中的重要性是什么？
cards.referenceText: Communication is the mode of transferring information from one person to another. It is an essential skill for successful business and personal relationships. Effective communication is a must at work and in daily life.
cards.referenceTextZh: 交流是人与人之间传递信息的方式。交流是商务和人际关系中的重要技能。高效的交流在工作和生活中都是非常重要的。

cards.audioText: Will you have a vacation recently?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最近有假期吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, next week I will have a five days vacation with my wife. / No, being a pilot means rare vacation time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下周我有五天假期，我会和妻子一起度假。/ 没有，飞行员的假期很少。

cards.audioText: How are you doing today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你今天好吗？（较正式的一种打招呼方式）
cards.referenceText: Good/Pretty good/Fine, thanks. /Just so so. /I feel terrible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我很好/非常好/很好，谢谢。/一般般吧。/感觉糟透了。

cards.audioText: Are you a student pilot or a first officer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是飞行学员还是副驾驶？
cards.referenceText: I'm a student pilot/first officer/a captain / a flight instructor /a ground instructor.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我是飞行学员/副驾驶/机长/飞行教员/地面教员。

cards.audioText: Do you have a good day today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你今天过得怎么样？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have a good day. / I feel good today.

No, I feel nervous/upset today.
cards.referenceTextZh:
嗯，我今天过得不错。/我今天感觉不错。

不太好，我今天觉得紧张/心烦意乱。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft do you fly? Can you say something about it?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞什么类型的飞机？你能介绍一下吗？
cards.referenceText: I fly C172, there are some aircraft systems in C172, such as electrical system, flight control system, landing gear, communication and navigation (hydraulic system, pressurization, air conditioning system, oxygen system).
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是塞斯纳172，塞斯纳172有一些飞机系统，如电气系统，飞行控制系统，起落架，通信和导航系统(液压系统，增压系统，空调系统，氧气系统)。

cards.audioText: Are you nervous now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在紧张吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I'm a little nervous. /I feel nervous now. /I'm eager to pass the test, so I'm nervous now.

No, I'm not nervous. /I feel good. /No, I'm not nervous, because I believe I can pass the test.
cards.referenceTextZh:
嗯，我有点儿紧张。/我觉得很紧张。/我很想通过这个考试，所以我现在很紧张。

不，我不紧张。/我觉得挺好的。/不，我不紧张，因为我相信自己可以通过考试。

cards.audioText: How are you doing today? Are you feeling nervous now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你今天好吗？你现在感到紧张吗？
cards.referenceText: I’m very good today. I feel a little nervous.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我今天很好，我有一点紧张。

cards.audioText: Can you make a brief introduction of yourself? / Would you please briefly introduce yourself?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以简单地自我介绍一下吗？/可不可以请你简单介绍一下自己？
cards.referenceText:
I am 25 years old, and I come from Qingdao, Shandong province. Now I am a student pilot of Civil Aviation University of China (CAUC). I like flying, and it's my dream to fly in the blue sky.
I am a commercial pilot with single-engine land/twin-engine land/double-engine land/multi-engine land and instrument rating, and after graduation, I will work in Joy Air/China Eastern Airlines.
I'm 32 years old. I was born in Changchun. I used to be an Air Force pilot, and now I am working in China Southern Airlines. As for my character, I am an honest, kind and diligent young man with strong sense of responsibility. I have a happy family, and there are three members in my family, my wife, my son and I.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我25岁了，来自山东青岛。我现在是中国民航大学的一名飞行学员。我喜欢飞行，能在蓝天中自由飞翔是我的梦想。

我是一名具有单发陆地/双发陆地/双发陆地/多发陆地和仪表等级的商照飞行员。毕业后，我将去幸福航空/中国东方航空公司工作。

我32岁了，来自长春。我曾经是一名空军飞行员，现在我在中国南方航空工作。关于性格，我是个诚实、友好、勤奋、责任感很强的人。我有一个幸福的家庭，家庭成员有三个，我的妻子，我儿子还有我。

cards.audioText: How do you usually spend your holiday?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的假期怎么过？
cards.referenceText: Generally speaking, I prefer to spend the holiday with my family, we may choose to travel together.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一般而言，假期我会选择和家人一起度过，我们可能会选择一起出去旅游。

cards.audioText: Where did you learn flying, at home or abroad?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里学习的飞行，在国内还是国外？
cards.referenceText: I learned to fly in BUAA (Beihang University), so it is in China.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在北航学的飞行，所以是在国内。

cards.audioText: How many hours have you flown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞行了多少小时了？
cards.referenceText: I have flown 200 hours.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我已经飞了200个小时了。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me something about your flight school?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能告诉我你的航校吗？
cards.referenceText: My flight school is Qingdao Jiutian International Flight Academy. It is located in Qingdao, Shandong province. There are many types of aircraft for us to have the flight training, for example, the Cessna 172 and PA44.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的航校是青岛九天国际航校，它位于山东青岛市。学校很多类型的飞机供我们进行飞行训练，比如：塞斯纳172和PA44。

cards.audioText: Which airline are you coming from?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是哪个航空公司的？
cards.referenceText: I come from Air china, Shanghai Branch.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我来自于国航上海分公司。

cards.audioText: Have you ever flown the international flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过国际航班吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, we used to fly the international flight, like the flights from Shanghai to Seoul, but during the outbreak of the COVID-19, our international flights have been slashed./No, I rarely fly the international flights, I often fly the domestic flights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我过去经常飞国际航班，像上海到首尔，但在疫情爆发期间，我们的国际航班量锐减。/没有，我很少飞国际航班，经常飞国内。

cards.audioText: Which airport are you flying now as a cadet?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为一名学员，你目前在哪个机场飞？
cards.referenceText: I'm flying in Luoyang base.
cards.referenceTextZh: 目前我在洛阳基地飞行。

cards.audioText: How many flight hours in total do you have?
cards.audioTextZh: 你总共飞了多少小时？
cards.referenceText: I have flown about 200 hours.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞了大概200小时。

cards.audioText: Could you describe your life at your flight school?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一下自己在航校里的生活吗？
cards.referenceText: My life in the flight school are colorful. Usually, we have ground training and flight training, for example, we have learned the course about radio-telephony in English, the flight theory, the navigation and some other subjects in the ground training. When we have free time, we will play basketball with our flight instructors or read books with friends to learn flight knowledge.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在航校的生活丰富多彩。通常，我们会有地面理论课程和飞行训练课程，例如在地面理论课程中，我们会学习英语无线电陆空通话、飞行原理、领航还有其他科目。当我们有时间时，我们会和教员们一起打篮球或者和同学们一起看书来学习飞行知识。

cards.audioText: What subjects are compulsory in your flight school?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们航校有哪些必修科目？
cards.referenceText: There are many compulsory subjects in my flight school. And we need to learn not only the relevant theoretical knowledge about aviation, but also some operating procedures on how to control the aircraft, for example, touch and go, traffic pattern, steep turn, stall recovery and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们航校有很多必修课程。我们不仅需要学习相关的民航理论知识，还要学习一些操纵飞机的程序，譬如：连续起落，起落航线，大坡度转弯，失速改出等。

cards.audioText: Could you talk about the flight disciplines in your flight school or your company.
cards.audioTextZh: 能谈一谈你们航校或者你们公司的飞行纪律/作风情况吗？
cards.referenceText: I’m a student pilot now. So, in my flight school, we need comply a lot of disciplines. For example, we can't drink alcohol 24 hours before the flight. We have to arrive at the airport 3 hours before the flight to get weather information and ATC clearance, etc.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我现在是一名飞行学员，在我们航校，我们需要遵守很多规则。譬如说，我们在飞行前24小时不能喝酒；我们需要在飞行前3小时到达机场，获取天气信息和管制许可等。

cards.audioText: Which flying stage are you in now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在飞行的哪个阶段？
cards.referenceText: I have just finished my commercial flight and obtained the commercial pilot license (CPL), I will continue my instrument flying next month.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我刚刚结束了商照飞行并且刚拿到了商照，下个月我开始飞仪表。

cards.audioText: Where do you come from? / Where is your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你来自哪里？/你的家乡在哪儿？
cards.referenceText: I come from Beijing. / My hometown is in Chengdu, Sichuan Province, which is in the southern China.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我来自北京。/我的家乡在四川成都，它位于中国的南方。

cards.audioText: Where is your hometown? What is your hometown famous for?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家乡在哪里？你的家乡以什么闻名？
cards.referenceText:
My hometown is Nanjing City, Jiangsu province.
It’s a big city in Eastern China.
It is famious for the Sun Yat-sen Mausoleum.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我的家乡在江苏省南京市。
它是一个中国东部地区的一个大城市。
它以中山陵闻名。

cards.audioText: Where do you live now? Compared with your hometown, which do you prefer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在住在哪儿？和你的家乡相比，你更喜欢哪里？
cards.referenceText: My hometown is Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, and now I am living in Tianjin. Compared with Tianjin, I like my hometown better, as I was born and grew up there, I have been used to everything in my hometown, like its weather, and its culture, and most importantly, my family are all there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的家乡在江苏南京，我现在住在天津。和天津相比，我更喜欢我的家乡，因为我在那里出生并长大，我习惯了家乡的一切，它的天气，它的文化，并且，我的家人也都在那里。

cards.audioText: What’s the weather like in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你家乡的天气如何？
cards.referenceText: The weather in my hometown is dry, with little rainfall. It has four seasons, warm spring, hot summer, cool autumn, and cold winter.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我家乡的天气很干燥，降水很少，四季分明，春季温暖，夏季炎热，秋季凉爽，冬季寒冷。

cards.audioText: Could you please make a comparison between your hometown and the city you live?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以比较下你的家乡和你现在居住的城市吗？
cards.referenceText: I come from Shenyang and now i am living in Guanghan, compared with Guanghan, my hometown is colder in winter, and drier in spring. I like Guanghan better, because the weather is comfortable and there are many delicious food here.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我来自沈阳，现在在广汉。和广汉相比，我家乡的冬天更寒冷，春天更干燥。我更喜欢广汉，因为这儿的天气很舒服，而且这里有很多美食。

cards.audioText: What’s your hometown famous for?/ Could you list/name some interesting places in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的家乡以什么闻名？/你能说说你家乡有意思的地方吗？
cards.referenceText: My hometown is in Yunnan Province, it is famous/special for Shangri-la, Lijiang old town, Jade Dragon mountain, Dongshan Park and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的家乡在云南，它以香格里拉，丽江老城，玉龙雪山和东山公园闻名天下。

cards.audioText: Can you name some interesting places in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能说出你家乡一些有趣的地方吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I can, there are many interesting places in my hometown, such as Changjiang River Bridge, Confucian Temple and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，我可以，我的家乡有很多有趣的地方，比如长江大桥，孔庙等。

cards.audioText: What do you like best in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢家乡的是什么？
cards.referenceText: Well, the traffic, and the environment, because I live in the countryside, the sky is blue, the air is clear, and there isn't much traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 交通，还有环境，因为我的家乡在农村，那里天空很蓝，空气清新，交通一点也不拥挤。

cards.audioText: Could you make a comparison between your hometown and the city you are living in?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能否对比一下你的家乡和你现在居住的城市？
cards.referenceText: I come from Shenyang and now I am living in Guanghan. Compared with Guanghan, my hometown is much more colder in winter, and drier in spring. I like Guanghan better, because the weather is comfortable and there are so many delicious food here.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我来自沈阳，现在在广汉。和广汉比，我家乡的冬天更寒冷，春天更干燥。我更喜欢广汉，因为这儿的天气很舒服，而且这里有很多美食。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite city you have visited or lived in? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你去过的最喜欢的城市是哪个？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I'm living in Beijing now, and I like it very much. It's a modern city with long history and deep culture.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我现在住在北京，我很喜欢这里。这是一座历史悠久，富有文化古韵的现代化城市。

cards.audioText: Have you ever been abroad? Which country would you most likely to visit?
cards.audioTextZh: 你去过国外吗？你最想去哪个国家？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have, I have been to America, Australia, Japan and South Korea. Australia is my favorite country, and I went there last year.
No, I've never been abroad. If there is a chance, I'd like to go to France, because I like Paris and it's a romantic city in my heart.
cards.referenceTextZh:
去过，我去过美国，澳大利亚，日本和韩国。澳大利亚是我最喜欢的国家，我是去年去的。
没有，我从来没去过国外。如果有机会的话，我想去法国，因为我很喜欢巴黎，它在我心中是一座浪漫的城市。

cards.audioText: Do you like travelling? If yes, where have you been and which place impressed you most?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢旅行吗？如果喜欢，你去过哪些地方？哪些地方给你留下印象最深呢？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I do. I like travelling very much. I have been to many places, among which, Xiamen impressed me most, it's a coastal city with very beautiful scenery, and the seafood there is various and delicious.
No, I don't like travelling. I think it's really exhausting and tiring. I prefer to stay at home.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，我喜欢旅行。我去过很多地方，其中厦门给我留下印象最深。它是沿海城市，景色非常美，并且那儿的海鲜非常多，非常好吃。
不，我不喜欢旅行。我觉得旅游太累了，使人筋疲力尽，我更愿待在家里。

cards.audioText: Do you like sports? / What is your favorite sport game? Who is your favorite sport star?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢运动吗？/你最喜欢的体育运动是什么？/你最喜欢的运动员是谁？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like sports. I like playing football/basketball/badminton/volleyball. / I like running/swimming/cycling/skiing. My favorite sport star is Michael Jordan/Kobe Bryant/Messi/ Cristiano Ronaldo.
No, I don't like sports, I prefer to stay at home and play games.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我喜欢运动。我喜欢踢足球/打篮球/打羽毛球/打排球。/我喜欢跑步/游泳/骑自行车/滑雪。我最喜欢的体育明星是乔丹/科比/梅西/C罗。

不，我不喜欢运动，我更喜欢呆在家里玩游戏。

cards.audioText: What do you like to do in your spare time?
cards.audioTextZh: 闲暇时间你喜欢做什么？
cards.referenceText: In my spare time, I like playing basketball, running, swimming or playing computer games.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在闲暇时间，我喜欢打篮球，跑步，游泳，或玩游戏。

cards.audioText: Do you like music? / What type (kind) of music do you like best? / Who's your favorite singer? / What's your favorite song?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢音乐吗？/你最喜欢哪种类型的音乐？/你最喜欢的歌手是谁？/你最喜欢哪首歌？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I like music/listening to music. I like pop music/rock/folk music/jazz/hiphop. My favorite singer is Michael Jackson/Eason Chan. My favorite song is Earth Song/Sleep Alone/Love.
cards.referenceTextZh: 嗯，我喜欢音乐/听音乐。我喜欢流行/摇滚/民谣/爵士/嘻哈音乐。我最喜欢的歌手是迈克尔•杰克逊/陈奕迅。我最喜欢听的歌是Earth Song/ Sleep Alone/ Love。

cards.audioText: Do you like sports? Who is your favorite sport star?
cards.audioTextZh: 喜欢运动吗？你最喜欢的运动明星是谁？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I like basketball, and my favorite basketball star is Yaoming.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢打篮球，我最喜欢的篮球明星是姚明。

cards.audioText: Do you like to go to the theatre/concert? / How often do you go to the cinema? / What’s your favorite TV program/TV play?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢去电影院/音乐会吗？/你多久去一次电影院？/你最喜欢的电视节目/电视剧是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like to go to the theatre/concert. I go to the cinema once a month. My favorite TV program is CCTV-5/talk show.
No, I don't like to go to the theatre/concert. I don't like to go to the cinema, because I prefer to watch movies at home.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我喜欢去影院/音乐会。我一个月去一次电影院。我最喜欢的电视节目是中央-5体育频道/脱口秀。
我不喜欢去影院/听音乐会。我不喜欢去电影院，我更喜欢在家里看电影。

cards.audioText: What type of music do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢什么样的音乐？
cards.referenceText: I like pop music.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢流行音乐。

cards.audioText: Do you like reading books/novels? What is your favorite novel?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢看书/看小说吗？你最喜欢的小说是什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I like reading novels. My favorite novel is The Ordinary World.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢看小说。我最喜欢的小说是《平凡的世界》。

cards.audioText: How often do you go to cinema?
cards.audioTextZh: 多久去看一次电影？
cards.referenceText: About once a month.
cards.referenceTextZh: 大概每个月去一次。

cards.audioText: What do you like to do in your spare time? Do you like to spend spare time with your family?
cards.audioTextZh: 你空闲时间喜欢做什么？空闲时，你喜欢跟家人一起吗？
cards.referenceText: In my spare time, I like to do sports/go shopping/play games at home. Yes, I like to spend my spare time with my family. It's precious time for me to be with my family.
cards.referenceTextZh: 空闲时，我喜欢锻炼身体/购物/在家玩游戏。我空闲时间喜欢和家人一起度过，对我来说，和家人一起的时间是非常宝贵的。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite TV program?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的电视节目是什么？
cards.referenceText: My favorite is Talk Show, I like it because it's interesting and humorous.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢脱口秀节目，因为有意思，也很幽默。

cards.audioText: What's your favorite way to relax after work? What kind of outdoor activities do you like?
cards.audioTextZh: 下班后你最喜欢的放松方式什么？你喜欢什么样的室外活动？
cards.referenceText: Sometimes I like doing sports, while sometimes I like listening to music to relax after work. I like to take a walk with my family.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我有的时候喜欢去锻炼，有的时候喜欢下了班听听音乐来放松心情。我喜欢和家人一起出去散步。

cards.audioText: Does your flight instructor smoke?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的教员吸烟吗？
cards.referenceText: My instructor does not smoke, and he often tells us not to smoke.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我的教员不吸烟，他也经常告诉我们不要吸烟。

cards.audioText: Did you have a good day yesterday? Did you have a good weekend?
cards.audioTextZh: 你昨天过得好吗？你周末过得好吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I had a good day yesterday. /Everything was as usual. Yes, I had a good weekend.
No, I had a terrible/bad day yesterday. I had a busy/tired/exhausting weekend.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，我昨天过得很好。/一切如常。是的，我周末过得不错。

不好，我昨天过得很糟糕/不好。我周末很忙/累/疲惫。

cards.audioText: Do you think it is right for pilots to smoke?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为飞行员吸烟对吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I don't think pilots should smoke, especially in the cockpit. Smoking in the cockpit will not only pollute the cockpit environment, but also cause fire and this would be a great threat to flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得飞行员不应该吸烟，特别是在驾驶舱里更不能吸烟。飞行员在驾驶舱吸烟不仅会污染驾驶舱环境，也容易引发火灾，这会极大地威胁飞行安全。

cards.audioText: How did you come here today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你今天怎么来这儿的？
cards.referenceText: I came here by plane/ bus/ taxi/ car/ on foot.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我坐飞机/公共汽车/出租车/开车/步行来的。

cards.audioText: How did you come to the test center today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是怎么来考试中心的？
cards.referenceText: I came here by driving a car/by taxi/ by bus/ on foot/ by plane.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我开车/乘坐出租车车/坐公交/步行/坐飞机过来的。

cards.audioText: Can you drive a car?
cards.audioTextZh: 你会开车吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I can. I got my driver's license last year.

No, I can't. I plan to get the license next year.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我会开车，我去年拿到驾照的。

不会，我打算明年考驾照。

cards.audioText: What's the traffic like in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你家乡的交通状况如何？
cards.referenceText: The traffic in my hometown is good/poor/terrible. It’s too crowded.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我家乡交通状况很好/很糟糕。太拥堵了。

cards.audioText: Do you think purchasing/buying a car is necessary for you?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得有没有必要买车呢？
