cards.referenceText:
Yes, absolutely, because the public transport in my city is not very developed, so it's necessary to have my own car.

No, not really. Because we have public transportation in my city, like bus, subway, so it's very convenient to go everywhere.
cards.referenceTextZh:
绝对有必要，因为我所在的城市的公共交通不太发达，所以有必要买辆车。

没太大必要，因为我所在的城市有公交/地铁，去哪儿都很方便。

cards.audioText: What's your favorite means of transportation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的交通方式是什么？
cards.referenceText: My favorite is train/subway/bus.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的是火车/地铁/公交。

cards.audioText: What's your favorite means of transportation/ form of transport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的交通方式是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Well, I like subway most, because it's very fast, and often arrives on time, so you don't have to worry about being late.

My favorite form of transport is driving car. Because with my own car, I can go out whenever I need to. It's convenient and time-saving.
cards.referenceTextZh:
嗯，我最喜欢坐地铁。因为地铁很快，而且通常都很准时，不用担心会迟到。

我最喜欢的交通方式是开车。因为开自己的车，我可以什么时候想出去就出去，很方便，而且节约时间。

cards.audioText: Do you think purchasing a car is necessary in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得在你的家乡有必要买车吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I think so, it will be more convenient.
No, I don’t think so, because it’s too crowded.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，我觉得有必要，这样会更方便。
我认为没必要，因为太堵了。

cards.audioText: How do you go to work everyday? How long does it take?
cards.audioTextZh: 你每天都是怎么去上班的？要花多长时间？
cards.referenceText: I go to work by car/ bicycle / airport shuttle bus every day. It takes me about half an hour to go to work.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我每天开车/骑自行车/坐机场大巴去上班，大约要花半个小时。

cards.audioText: Have you ever been abroad? Which place do you want to visit most?
cards.audioTextZh: 你出过国吗？你最想去的是什么地方？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have been to Japan./No, I haven’t been abroad, I want to go to the United States, because I want to see the NBA games.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我曾经去过日本。/没有，我最想去美国，因为想去看一场NBA比赛。

cards.audioText: Do you like to take public transport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢乘坐公共交通工具吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, it's really a smart/convenient/fast way to take public transport, because, you know, there are many modern public transportations in our city now, for example, taxi, subway, bus, high-speed train, and airplane. No matter where I will go, I can always find the cheapest way from the public transportation.

No, compared with public transport, I would rather drive my own car, for it's too crowded to take the public transport.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，乘坐公共交通出行确实很不错/方便/快捷。你知道目前在我们城市里面有很多现代的公共交通方式，出租车，地铁，公交，高铁，还有飞机，不管我去哪儿，我总能找到最便宜的公共交通出行方式。
不，相较于公共交通而言，我更喜欢自己开车，乘坐公共交通出行太拥挤了。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer public transportation or private transportation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢公共交通还是私人交通呢？
cards.referenceText:
I prefer public transport because it's cheap and convenient for me. I enjoy the time to take a bus or subway in the city.

If I have a chance, I will choose to use private transport so that I don't need to walk a long way to the subway or a bus station, it's a waste of time. Besides, the public transport is overcrowded and I really feel uncomfortable in it.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我喜欢公共交通，便宜方便，我很享受在市区里乘坐公交或地铁的时光。

如果有机会，我一定选择私人交通方式出行，这样我就不用走很长的路到地铁或公交车站了，很浪费时间。此外，公共交通太拥挤了，我觉得非常不舒服。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me how to get the airport from here?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能告诉我从这儿怎么到机场吗？
cards.referenceText: It's not very far from here to the airport. Drive straight along the road, and then turn right at the first traffic light, then you will see the airport signs ahead. It takes about 10 minutes by car.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这儿离机场不远，沿着路一直往前开，在第一个红绿灯右转后，你会看到前方有机场指示牌。大约开车需要10分钟左右。

cards.audioText: What do you think of online shopping?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对网上购物有什么看法？
cards.referenceText: I think, thanks to the modern technology, now we can buy things online without even going out, and this can save us a lot of time and money.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得多亏了现代科技，我们不用出门就能在网上买东西，这节省了我们大量的时间和金钱。

cards.audioText: What do you know about AI?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道AI吗？
cards.referenceText: AI stands for Artificial Intelligence. A major goal of artificial intelligence research is to make machines capable of performing complex tasks that normally require human intelligence.
cards.referenceTextZh: AI指的是人工智能。人工智能研究的一个主要目标是使机器能够胜任一些通常需要人类智能才能完成的复杂工作。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages and disadvantages of online shopping?
cards.audioTextZh: 网上购物的优点和缺点是什么？
cards.referenceText:
There are many advantages of online shopping, for example, we can buy things at home, and the shops available are worldwide and open in 24 hours. This will save us a lot of time and energy. But there are also disadvantages, one thing is that it may cause personal data leak, and sometimes the delivery fees may cost
more than the things we purchased. Another thing is that we can't inspect goods before purchase.
cards.referenceTextZh: 网上购物有很多优点，比如说我们在家里就能买东西，网店遍布世界各地，并且24小时营业，这样节省我们很多时间和精力。但是也有缺点，其中一个就是可能导致我们个人信息泄露，有时候快递费用比我们购买的物品还要贵，还有就是我们不能在购买前检查要购买的商品。

cards.audioText: Do you think AI will replace pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为人工智能会取代飞行员吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I don’t think so. Pilots not only need to control the aircraft well, but also need to respond to complex situations timely and make reasonable decisions. These actions cannot be replaced by computers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员不仅需要操纵好飞机，更需要对复杂情况及时作出反应，合理作出决策。这些都是计算机无法取代的。

cards.audioText: Do you know VR and AR? How can they be used in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你了解VR和AR吗？它们如何应用在飞行中呢？
cards.referenceText: VR stands for virtual reality, and AR means augment reality. They can be used in the flight training, such as the simulator training.
cards.referenceTextZh: VR是虚拟现实，AR是增强现实。它们可应用于飞行训练中，如模拟机训练。

cards.audioText: Do you think the application of VR and AR technologies can improve the flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为VR和AR技术的应用能够提高飞行安全吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, VR can be used in artificial intelligence, education, training, medicine and many other areas. With the help of AR and VR, people can experience surreal atmospheres indoors as well as outdoors. Virtual reality can be used for flight training and help pilots understand how to control the aircraft especially in emergency situation. While using VR doesn't replace flight time in real flight, it gives student pilots more chances to exercise their maneuverability.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，虚拟现实技术可以广泛应用于人工智能、教育、培训、医疗等其他领域。通过增强现实和虚拟现实技术，人们可以在室内感受到室外的超真实环境。虚拟现实可以应用在飞行培训中，帮助飞行员更好地了解如何操纵飞机，尤其在紧急情况下。虽然增强现实不能够代替实际飞行时间，但是通过它能够让飞行学员更好地练习飞行中的机动性。

cards.audioText: What do you often do on the Internet?
cards.audioTextZh: 你通常上网做什么？
cards.referenceText: Usually, I use the Internet to search for information, watch movies and read news. Besides, I also play games on the Internet.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常，我上网查信息、看电影和看新闻，此外，我也会在网上玩游戏。

cards.audioText: What is your favorite website?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的网址是哪一个？
cards.referenceText: My favorite website is Sina.com. I visit it every day. It provides various information, like the latest world news, important sports events, stories about movie stars.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我最喜欢的网站是新浪网，我每天都看，这个网站提供不同的信息，比如最近的世界新闻，重要的体育事件，还有电影明星的报道。

cards.audioText: How often do you surf the Internet?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久上一次网？
cards.referenceText: Generally, I surf the Internet almost every day. / I don't use it often.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我几乎每天都上网。/我不太经常上网。

cards.audioText: Could you briefly describe the progress that China's civil aviation has made over the past decade?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能简单描述下，中国民航在过去10年间取得了哪些进步吗？
cards.referenceText: The development of China's civil aviation over the past 10 years has been rapid. We have independently designed and manufactured the C919 aircraft, built the Daxing Airport, and our international and domestic flight routes have become increasingly complex. Travel by air has become more and more common.
cards.referenceTextZh: 中国民航在过去10年的发展是飞快的。我们自行设计并制造了C919大飞机，建造了大兴机场，我们的国际、国内航线也日益复杂，乘坐飞机旅行越来越普遍。

cards.audioText: What do you usually do with your mobile phone/cellphone?
cards.audioTextZh: 你通常用手机做什么？
cards.referenceText: I use my mobile phone every day. I can surf the Internet, make video chat and voice call, listen to music, read e-books, and do online shopping and online payment. I can't live without my mobile phone.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我每天都要用手机，会用手机上网，视频聊天，语音通话，听音乐，读电子书，而且还需要网上购物，网上支付等，生活中我已经离不开手机了。

cards.audioText: What new technologies or equipment has China's civil aviation adopted?
cards.audioTextZh: 中国民航采用了哪些新技术或新设备？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, the Chinese civil aviation industry has adopted many new technologies and equipment to enhance flight safety and reduce the workload of pilots. These include: TCAS, HUD, AR and VR, etc.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，中国民航采用了很多新技术和新设备来提升飞行安全，降低飞行员工作载荷，这包括：TCAS、HUD、AR和VR等。

cards.audioText: How can you deal with the challenges brought by the new technologies or equipment?
cards.audioTextZh: 您如何应对新科技或新设备所带来的挑战呢？
cards.referenceText: As a pilot, first of all, we need to embrace new technologies and equipment with a positive attitude. At the same time, we need to continuously enhance our theoretical learning on the ground. Additionally, we also need to strengthen the training in related simulators. Moreover, we also need to enhance the CRM.
cards.referenceTextZh: 作为一名飞行员，首先，我们需要以积极的态度迎合新技术和新设备，同时，我们需要不断加强地面理论学习，同时，也需要强化相关模拟机训练，同时，我们也需要加强驾驶舱资源管理。

cards.imageAlt: 夜航驾驶舱航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What are the main hazards of flying at night?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间飞行的主要危险有哪些？
cards.referenceText: The main hazards are reduced visibility, higher cockpit workload, spatial disorientation, and difficulty judging terrain or clouds.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括能见度降低、驾驶舱工作负荷增大、空间定向障碍，以及难以判断地形或云层。

cards.audioText: What preparations should pilots make before a night flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在夜间飞行前应做哪些准备？
cards.referenceText: Before a night flight, I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 夜间飞行前，我会对相关威胁进行简令，检查飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟飞行。

cards.imageAlt: 机翼积冰航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能在这张图片中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: The picture shows a large passenger aircraft parked at a snow-covered airport. Snow is lying across the apron, and the weather appears very cold. Airport buildings and other aircraft can be seen in the background.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图片中，一架大型客机停在被积雪覆盖的机场。停机坪上有积雪，天气看起来非常寒冷。背景中可以看到机场建筑和其他飞机。

cards.audioText: How can ice on a wing affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 机翼结冰会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: Ice on a wing can reduce lift, increase drag, raise the stall speed, and cause possible control problems. These effects may reduce safety margins.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机翼结冰会减小升力、增大阻力、提高失速速度，并可能导致操纵问题。这些影响会降低安全裕度。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do if ice or frost is found on the wings before departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前如果发现机翼上有冰或霜，飞行员应如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would identify the wing contamination, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to the aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会识别机翼污染情况，保持清晰沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.imageAlt: 夜间跑道起飞航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What preparations should a flight crew make before taking off at night from the runway shown?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中所示跑道夜间起飞前，飞行机组应做哪些准备？
cards.referenceText: Before the night takeoff, I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay or reject the takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 夜间起飞前，我会对相关威胁进行简令，检查飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟起飞或中断起飞。

cards.audioText: What hazards should pilots consider when taking off at night from the runway shown?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中所示跑道夜间起飞时，飞行员应考虑哪些危险？
cards.referenceText: At night, reduced visibility makes it harder to judge height, distance, terrain, and clouds. Spatial disorientation and higher cockpit workload can make the takeoff and departure more demanding. A thorough briefing and a careful instrument cross-check help control these risks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 夜间能见度较低，更难判断高度、距离、地形和云层。空间定向障碍和较高的驾驶舱工作负荷会使起飞和离场更具挑战。充分的简令和谨慎的仪表交叉检查有助于控制这些风险。

cards.audioText: What types of runway lighting help pilots during takeoff and landing at night?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些类型的跑道灯光可以在夜间起飞和着陆时帮助飞行员？
cards.referenceText: Approach lights and runway-end identifier lights help pilots find and align with the runway. Threshold, edge, centerline, and touchdown-zone lights show the runway's position and usable landing area. Runway-end lights and visual glide-slope indicators provide additional guidance during landing, while edge and centerline lights also support takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近灯和跑道入口识别灯帮助飞行员找到跑道并与跑道对正。入口灯、边灯、中线灯和接地区灯显示跑道位置及可用着陆区域。跑道末端灯和目视下滑指示器在着陆时提供进一步引导，而边灯和中线灯也为起飞提供支持。

cards.imageAlt: 飞机接近风险航空场景图片

cards.audioText: If you were the captain of one of these aircraft, how would you respond to the risk of a collision?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你是图中其中一架航空器的机长，你会如何应对碰撞风险？
cards.referenceText: I would recognize the risk as early as possible, maintain clear communication, and follow the standard operating procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会尽早识别风险，保持清晰沟通，并遵循标准操作程序。

cards.audioText: What factors can cause aircraft to come dangerously close to each other?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器彼此危险接近？
cards.referenceText: Possible factors include loss of separation, wake turbulence, a runway incursion, or a misunderstanding of ATC instructions. Human factors, weather, aircraft condition, the airport environment, and communication problems may also contribute.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可能的因素包括间隔丧失、尾流、跑道侵入，或对空中交通管制指令的误解。人的因素、天气、飞机状况、机场环境和通信问题也可能起到作用。

cards.imageAlt: 起落架异常航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What appears to have happened to the landing gear of the aircraft in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 图中航空器的起落架似乎发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft appears to be sitting unusually low, and the main landing gear area seems to be under inspection. This suggests that part of the landing gear may have collapsed or failed to support the aircraft properly. The exact fault cannot be confirmed from the picture alone.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机看起来位置异常低，主起落架区域似乎正在接受检查。这表明部分起落架可能已经坍塌，或未能正常支撑飞机。仅凭图片无法确认具体故障。

cards.audioText: What can cause an aircraft's landing gear to collapse or retract on the ground?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器起落架在地面坍塌或收起？
cards.referenceText: A mechanical failure or a maintenance error can cause the landing gear to collapse or retract on the ground.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机械故障或维修差错可能导致起落架在地面坍塌或意外收起。

cards.audioText: What consequences can result from a landing gear collapse or retraction on the ground?
cards.audioTextZh: 起落架在地面坍塌或收起可能造成哪些后果？
cards.referenceText: A landing gear collapse or retraction on the ground can cause serious structural damage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起落架在地面坍塌或收起可能造成严重的结构损伤。

cards.imageAlt: 冬季起飞前运行航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What pre-takeoff preparations should a flight crew make in the winter conditions shown?
cards.audioTextZh: 在图中所示的冬季条件下起飞前，飞行机组应做哪些准备？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the winter-weather threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay or reject the takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会对冬季天气威胁进行简令，检查相关飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟起飞或中断起飞。

cards.audioText: What challenges do pilots face when operating in the winter weather shown?
cards.audioTextZh: 在图中所示的冬季天气下运行时，飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: The main challenges are contaminated surfaces, low visibility, reduced braking action, and de-icing requirements.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要挑战包括道面污染、低能见度、制动作用降低，以及除冰要求。

cards.imageAlt: 高高原机场航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What is meant by a high-altitude airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是高海拔机场？
cards.referenceText: A high-altitude airport is located at a high elevation above sea level. Because the air is thinner, aircraft performance, approach planning, and landing distance must be checked carefully.
cards.referenceTextZh: 高海拔机场位于海拔较高的位置。由于空气较稀薄，必须仔细检查飞机性能、进近计划和着陆距离。

cards.audioText: If you had to land at the high-altitude airport shown, how would you prepare for a safe arrival?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果必须在图中所示的高海拔机场着陆，你会如何为安全到达做准备？
cards.referenceText: Because the air is thinner at a high-altitude airport, I would check the aircraft performance, approach planning, and landing distance very carefully before arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于高海拔机场空气较稀薄，我会在到达前非常仔细地检查飞机性能、进近计划和着陆距离。

cards.audioText: What challenges do pilots face when operating at high-altitude airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 在高海拔机场运行时，飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: Pilots face thin air, longer landing distances, reduced engine performance, and terrain restrictions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员面临的挑战包括空气稀薄、着陆距离增加、发动机性能下降和地形限制。

cards.imageAlt: 模拟机训练航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in the simulator training scene shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从图中的模拟机训练场景中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: I can see two pilots seated in a full-flight simulator. The cockpit has realistic flight instruments, controls, and outside visual displays. They appear to be practising normal or abnormal procedures in a controlled training environment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我看到两名飞行员坐在全动飞行模拟机内。驾驶舱配有逼真的飞行仪表、操纵装置和外部视景显示。他们似乎正在受控的训练环境中练习正常或非正常程序。

cards.audioText: What are the benefits of simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 模拟机训练有哪些好处？
cards.referenceText: Simulator training can improve situational awareness. It gives pilots clearer information, supports better monitoring, and gives them more time to make safe decisions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 模拟机训练可以提高情景意识。它能为飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并留出更多时间作出安全决策。

cards.imageAlt: 传统仪表驾驶舱航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What are the main differences between a cockpit with traditional flight instruments and a modern glass cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 采用传统飞行仪表的驾驶舱与现代玻璃驾驶舱有哪些主要区别？
cards.referenceText: Compared with traditional flight instruments, a modern glass cockpit gives pilots clearer information, supports better monitoring, and provides more time to make safe decisions. This can improve situational awareness.
cards.referenceTextZh: 与传统飞行仪表相比，现代玻璃驾驶舱能向飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并留出更多时间作出安全决策。这有助于提高情景意识。

cards.audioText: What challenges do pilots face when flying an aircraft with traditional flight instruments?
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶采用传统飞行仪表的航空器时，飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: Traditional flight instruments can create a higher scan workload, provide less integrated information, and require more manual cross-checking.
cards.referenceTextZh: 传统飞行仪表可能增加仪表扫描工作量，提供的综合信息较少，并要求飞行员进行更多人工交叉检查。

cards.imageAlt: 发动机整流罩损伤航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What damage can you see on the aircraft in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 这张图片中的飞机有哪些损伤？
cards.referenceText: The cowling around one engine is open or partly missing, and internal components are exposed. The nacelle area appears to be damaged. The picture does not provide enough detail to determine the cause or the full extent of the damage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一台发动机周围的整流罩已经打开或部分缺失，内部部件暴露在外。短舱区域看起来已经受损。图片细节不足，无法判断损伤原因和完整范围。

cards.audioText: What actions should a pilot take if engine cowling damage occurs during cruise?
cards.audioTextZh: 巡航过程中如果发动机整流罩发生损坏，飞行员应采取哪些措施？
cards.referenceText: I would monitor the aircraft carefully for engine vibration, possible debris, performance loss, or further structural damage. I would be ready to take conservative action if these risks reduced the safety margin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会密切监控飞机，注意发动机振动、可能的碎片、性能下降或进一步的结构损伤。如果这些风险降低了安全裕度，我会准备采取保守措施。

cards.audioText: What inspections should be performed to help prevent engine cowling failures?
cards.audioTextZh: 应进行哪些检查，以帮助防止发动机整流罩失效？
cards.referenceText: The preflight inspection should check that every cowling panel is correctly seated and that all latches and fasteners are secure. Maintenance inspections should look for worn hinges, damaged fasteners, cracks, distortion, and previous repairs. After maintenance work, the cowling should be closed, documented, and independently checked as required.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行前检查应确认每块整流罩面板都正确就位，所有锁扣和紧固件均已固定。维修检查应查找铰链磨损、紧固件损坏、裂纹、变形和既往修理痕迹。维修工作完成后，应按要求关闭整流罩、做好记录并进行独立复查。

cards.imageAlt: 尾部发动机火警航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in this picture of a tail-mounted engine fire?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从这张尾置发动机起火的图片中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: The picture shows flames and dark smoke coming from the rear engine of a three-engine aircraft. The fire appears to be concentrated around the tail-mounted engine. The exact cause of the fire is not visible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图片中，一架三发飞机的后部发动机冒出火焰和浓烟。火势似乎集中在尾置发动机周围。图片无法显示起火的确切原因。

cards.audioText: What risks can a fire in a tail-mounted engine pose to an aircraft and its occupants?
cards.audioTextZh: 尾置发动机起火会给航空器及其乘员带来哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are smoke, fire spreading, system damage, passenger panic, and a possible evacuation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括烟雾、火势蔓延、系统损坏、旅客恐慌，以及可能需要撤离。

cards.audioText: As the pilot in command, how would you respond to the tail-mounted engine fire shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，你会如何处置图中所示的尾置发动机起火？
cards.referenceText: For the tail-mounted engine fire, I would check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 对于尾置发动机起火，我会检查相关飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会视情况改航。

cards.audioText: What measures can help reduce the risk of an in-flight engine fire?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些措施可以降低发动机在飞行中起火的风险？
cards.referenceText: Regular maintenance should detect fuel, oil, and hydraulic leaks and any damage to engine wiring or hot sections. Crews should complete careful preflight inspections, monitor engine indications, and respond promptly to abnormal temperatures, vibration, or warning messages. Good FOD control and correct engine-start procedures also reduce the risk.
cards.referenceTextZh: 定期维修应发现燃油、滑油和液压油泄漏，以及发动机线路或高温部件的损伤。机组应认真完成飞行前检查，监控发动机指示，并及时处置温度异常、振动或警告信息。良好的外来物管理和正确的发动机起动程序也能降低风险。

cards.imageAlt: 滑行道起飞排队航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in the aircraft queue shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从图中的航空器排队场景中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: Several passenger aircraft are lined up one behind another on a taxiway or apron. Their noses point in the same direction, and the aircraft are fairly close together. The picture clearly shows a queue, but it does not show why the queue has formed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 数架客机在滑行道或机坪上首尾排成一列，机头朝向相同，飞机之间距离较近。图片清楚显示飞机正在排队，但没有显示排队原因。

cards.audioText: What can cause aircraft to queue on a taxiway before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器起飞前在滑行道上排队等候？
cards.referenceText: Possible contributors to taxiway congestion include human factors, weather, aircraft condition, the airport environment, and communication problems.
cards.referenceTextZh: 造成滑行道拥堵的因素可能包括人为因素、天气、飞机状况、机场环境和通信问题。

cards.audioText: What risks can arise when aircraft wait on the ground for an extended period before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 航空器在起飞前长时间停留在地面可能产生哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: A long ground wait can increase fuel burn, brake heating, congestion, exposure to foreign object debris, and crew workload. These risks can reduce safety margins.
cards.referenceTextZh: 长时间地面等待会增加燃油消耗、刹车温度、拥堵、外来物暴露和机组工作负荷。这些风险可能降低安全裕度。

cards.audioText: How can long ground queues before takeoff be managed or reduced?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何管理或减少起飞前的长时间地面排队？
cards.referenceText: Airports and ATC can reduce queues through better departure sequencing, traffic-flow planning, and timely information about restrictions. Airlines can hold an aircraft at the gate or delay engine start when a long wait is expected. During a queue, the crew should monitor fuel, brake temperature, weather, and duty time and coordinate any change of plan.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场和空中交通管制可以通过优化离场排序、流量规划，并及时提供限制信息来减少排队。航空公司预计等待时间较长时，可以让飞机留在登机口或推迟起动发动机。排队期间，机组应监控燃油、刹车温度、天气和值勤时间，并协调任何计划变更。

cards.imageAlt: 外来物损伤航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What is foreign object debris (FOD), and why is it hazardous?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是外来物（FOD）？它为什么危险？
cards.referenceText: FOD means foreign object debris or foreign object damage. It is hazardous because it can damage tyres, engines, and aircraft structures. Ramp inspections and runway cleaning are therefore important.
cards.referenceTextZh: FOD 指外来物碎片或外来物损伤。它会危及安全，因为可能损坏轮胎、发动机和飞机结构。因此，机坪检查和跑道清扫十分重要。

cards.audioText: What measures can reduce the risk of foreign object debris being ingested by an aircraft engine?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些措施可以降低航空器发动机吸入外来物的风险？
cards.referenceText: Airport operators should inspect and clean runways, taxiways, and aprons regularly. Airlines need good housekeeping and tool-control procedures, while crews should check the engine intake and nearby ground area during the walk-around. Pilots should also avoid using high thrust where loose debris may be drawn into an engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场运营方应定期检查并清扫跑道、滑行道和机坪。航空公司需要做好现场管理和工具管控，机组则应在绕机检查时查看发动机进气口及附近地面。飞行员还应避免在松散碎片可能被吸入发动机的区域使用大推力。

cards.imageAlt: 现代玻璃驾驶舱航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What are the main advantages of a modern glass cockpit over a cockpit with traditional flight instruments?
cards.audioTextZh: 与采用传统飞行仪表的驾驶舱相比，现代玻璃驾驶舱有哪些主要优势？
cards.referenceText: A modern glass cockpit can improve situational awareness. Compared with traditional flight instruments, it gives pilots clearer information, supports better monitoring, and provides more time to make safe decisions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 现代玻璃驾驶舱可以提高情景意识。与传统飞行仪表相比，它向飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并留出更多时间作出安全决策。

cards.audioText: How do multiple display screens help pilots manage a flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 多个显示屏如何帮助飞行员管理飞行？
cards.referenceText: Multiple screens can present flight, navigation, engine, system, and weather information in an organized way. They help both pilots monitor the same situation, compare information, and notice abnormal conditions quickly. Separate displays also provide useful redundancy, although the crew must still cross-check them and understand any display failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 多个显示屏可以有序呈现飞行、导航、发动机、系统和天气信息。它们有助于两名飞行员监控同一情况、比对信息并迅速发现异常。独立显示屏还能提供一定冗余，但机组仍须交叉检查，并了解显示故障的影响。

cards.imageAlt: 强侧风着陆航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What types of aircraft damage can result from a poorly controlled landing in a strong crosswind?
cards.audioTextZh: 在强侧风中着陆控制不当可能对航空器造成哪些损伤？
cards.referenceText: A poorly controlled crosswind landing can place excessive side loads on the landing gear and damage tyres, wheels, or gear components. A hard or sideways touchdown may also damage the wing, engine nacelle, tail, or fuselage if any part strikes the runway. Severe loads can cause structural damage that requires a detailed inspection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 侧风着陆操纵不当会使起落架承受过大的侧向载荷，并损坏轮胎、机轮或起落架部件。重着陆或带侧滑接地还可能使机翼、发动机短舱、机尾或机身撞击跑道而受损。严重载荷可能造成需要详细检查的结构损伤。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you prepare for an approach when strong crosswinds are reported?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，接到强侧风报告后，你会如何为进近做准备？
cards.referenceText: Before the approach, I would brief the crosswind threat, check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay the approach or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近前，我会对侧风威胁进行简令，检查相关飞机性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟进近或视情况改航。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you manage an approach if you encountered stronger-than-expected crosswinds?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，如果进近中遇到比预期更强的侧风，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured in the stronger crosswind, I would go around or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会检查相关飞机性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果更强的侧风下无法确保安全，我会复飞或视情况改航。

cards.imageAlt: 跑道发动机火警航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can cause an aircraft engine fire during ground operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致航空器发动机在地面运行期间起火？
cards.referenceText: Fuel leakage or overheating can cause an aircraft engine fire during ground operations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 燃油泄漏或过热可能导致飞机在地面运行期间发生发动机火灾。

cards.audioText: What risks can an engine fire during taxi pose to the aircraft and its occupants?
cards.audioTextZh: 滑行期间发动机起火会给航空器及其乘员带来哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: An engine fire during taxi may create smoke and an evacuation risk. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: 滑行期间发动机起火可能产生烟雾，并带来撤离风险。这些风险可能降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷。

cards.audioText: What preflight inspections can help reduce the risk of an engine fire during ground operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些飞行前检查可以帮助降低发动机在地面运行期间起火的风险？
cards.referenceText: The walk-around should look for fuel, oil, or hydraulic leaks, damaged wiring, loose panels, and signs of overheating around the engine. The crew should confirm that the nacelle and cowling are secure and that the intake is clear of FOD. Required maintenance checks should also confirm that the fire-detection and extinguishing systems are serviceable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 绕机检查应查找燃油、滑油或液压油泄漏、线路损坏、面板松动，以及发动机周围的过热迹象。机组应确认短舱和整流罩固定可靠，进气口内没有外来物。规定的维修检查还应确认火警探测和灭火系统工作正常。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you respond to an engine fire detected during takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，起飞过程中发现发动机起火时，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: If the fire warning occurred before the takeoff decision speed and the aircraft could stop safely, I would reject the takeoff in accordance with the procedure. At or after the decision speed, I would continue the takeoff, maintain control, climb safely, and then complete the engine-fire memory actions and checklist. I would declare an emergency and arrange the earliest safe landing, treating a continuing fire as an immediate threat.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果火警出现在起飞决断速度之前，且飞机能够安全停下，我会按照程序中断起飞。在达到或超过决断速度后，我会继续起飞，控制好飞机并安全爬升，然后完成发动机火警记忆项目和检查单。我会宣布紧急状态并安排尽早安全着陆，把持续燃烧的火情视为直接威胁。

cards.imageAlt: 水上迫降航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What types of serious failures could make it necessary for a large passenger aircraft to ditch at sea?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些严重故障可能使大型客机必须在海上迫降？
cards.referenceText: A ditching may become necessary after a total or major loss of engine thrust when no runway is within reach. Other possible reasons include an uncontrollable fire, fuel exhaustion, severe structural or flight-control damage, or the loss of essential systems. The crew would consider ditching only when continued flight or a safe landing on land was no longer possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当发动机推力全部或大部分丧失，且没有可到达的跑道时，可能需要水上迫降。其他可能原因包括无法控制的火灾、燃油耗尽、严重的结构或飞行操纵损伤，以及关键系统丧失。只有在无法继续飞行或无法在陆地安全着陆时，机组才会考虑水上迫降。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you manage a total loss of engine power over water if ditching became unavoidable?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，如果航空器在水域上空丧失全部发动机动力且水上迫降已无法避免，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会对相关威胁进行简令，检查飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。

cards.audioText: What should the flight crew do to evacuate an aircraft after a ditching?
cards.audioTextZh: 水上迫降后，飞行机组应如何组织人员撤离航空器？
cards.referenceText: After the aircraft stops, the pilots should secure it as required and order an evacuation if remaining on board is unsafe. The crew should use only exits that are above the water and free from hazards, deploy the available slide-rafts or life rafts, and direct occupants to leave baggage behind. Everyone should move into the rafts, stay together, and use the survival and signalling equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机停止后，飞行员应按要求使飞机处于安全状态；如果留在机上不安全，就下令撤离。机组应只使用位于水面以上且没有危险的出口，展开可用的滑梯救生筏或救生筏，并指挥人员不要携带行李。所有人应进入救生筏、保持在一起，并使用救生和信号设备。

cards.imageAlt: 擦尾风险航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in this picture of an apparent tail-strike event?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从这张疑似擦机尾事件的图片中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft is rotating for takeoff with a high nose-up attitude. Its rear fuselage appears to be contacting or scraping the runway. This is consistent with a tail strike, although the amount of damage cannot be judged from the picture.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机正以较大的机头上仰姿态抬轮起飞，其后机身似乎正在接触或擦碰跑道。这与擦尾现象相符，但无法从图片判断损伤程度。

cards.audioText: How can takeoff weight affect the risk of a tail strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞重量会如何影响擦机尾风险？
cards.referenceText: High takeoff weight is one factor that can increase the risk of a tail strike.
cards.referenceTextZh: 较大的起飞重量是可能增加擦尾风险的因素之一。

cards.audioText: How can a flight crew reduce the risk of a tail strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行机组如何降低擦机尾风险？
cards.referenceText: The crew should brief the tail-strike threat, check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate clearly, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, the takeoff should be delayed or rejected.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应对擦尾威胁进行简令，检查相关飞机性能，保持清晰协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，应推迟起飞或中断起飞。

cards.imageAlt: 地面保障事故航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What factors may have contributed to the ground-handling accident shown in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能促成图中所示的地面作业事故？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft appears to have collided with ground equipment near its forward fuselage. Possible contributing factors include poor communication, inadequate clearance, incorrect positioning, or a loss of control during towing or pushback. The picture alone cannot establish the exact cause.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机的前机身附近似乎与地面设备发生碰撞。可能的促成因素包括沟通不畅、间距不足、位置错误，或牵引、推出时失去控制。仅凭图片无法确定确切原因。

cards.audioText: How can ground-handling accidents involving aircraft be prevented?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何预防涉及航空器的地面作业事故？
cards.referenceText: The crew should recognize ground-handling risks early, maintain clear communication, and follow the standard operating procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组应尽早识别地面保障风险，保持清晰沟通，并遵循标准操作程序。

cards.imageAlt: 积雪和结冰污染航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What risks can snow and ice contamination on an aircraft pose to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 航空器上的冰雪污染会给飞行安全带来哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: Snow and ice contamination can reduce lift and increase drag. It may also lead to inaccurate airspeed indications and possible control difficulty. These effects may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload.
cards.referenceTextZh: 冰雪污染会减小升力并增大阻力，还可能导致空速指示不准确和操纵困难。这些影响可能降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷。

cards.audioText: How can ice contamination on a wing affect aircraft performance and handling?
cards.audioTextZh: 机翼结冰污染会如何影响航空器性能和操纵特性？
cards.referenceText: Ice contamination changes the wing shape, reducing lift and increasing drag. It can raise the stall speed, reduce climb performance, and cause the wing to stall earlier and less predictably. It may also reduce control effectiveness and make the aircraft difficult to handle.
cards.referenceTextZh: 冰污染会改变机翼外形，使升力减小、阻力增大。它会提高失速速度、降低爬升性能，并使机翼更早且更难预测地失速。它还可能降低操纵效能，使飞机难以操纵。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if snow or ice is found on critical aircraft surfaces before departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前发现航空器关键表面有冰雪时，飞行员应怎么做？
cards.referenceText: I would identify the snow or ice contamination, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to the aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会识别冰雪污染情况，保持清晰沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.imageAlt: 鸟击航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What visible bird-strike damage can you identify in this photograph?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从这张照片中识别出哪些明显的鸟击损伤？
cards.referenceText: Flames and smoke are visible around one engine, and birds can be seen close to the aircraft. The engine may have ingested one or more birds and suffered serious damage. Internal damage cannot be confirmed from the photograph.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一台发动机周围可以看到火焰和烟雾，飞机附近还有鸟。发动机可能吸入了一只或多只鸟并受到严重损伤。照片无法确认内部损伤。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you respond to a suspected bird strike in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，怀疑飞行中发生鸟击时，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会检查相关飞机系统和性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会视情况改航。

cards.audioText: What environmental and operational factors increase the risk of a bird strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些环境和运行因素会增加鸟击风险？
cards.referenceText: Bird-strike risk is highest near airports and at low altitude during takeoff, climb, approach, and landing. It increases during migration periods and around wetlands, open water, grass, rubbish sites, or other places that attract birds. Dawn, dusk, poor visibility, and airport activities that disturb flocks can make detection and avoidance more difficult.
cards.referenceTextZh: 鸟击风险在机场附近以及起飞、爬升、进近和着陆的低高度阶段最高。迁徙季节，以及湿地、开阔水域、草地、垃圾场或其他吸引鸟类的地点附近，风险会增大。黎明、黄昏、低能见度，以及惊扰鸟群的机场活动，都可能使发现和避让更加困难。

cards.imageAlt: 山区夜间进近航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What weather conditions can further reduce visibility during a night approach to an airport in mountainous terrain?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间进近山区机场时，哪些天气条件会进一步降低能见度？
cards.referenceText: Low cloud, fog, rain, snow, and haze can all reduce visibility during a night approach. Blowing dust or snow may obscure the runway, while heavy precipitation on the windshield can make the lights harder to see. In mountainous terrain, cloud can also hide ridges and remove the few outside visual references available at night.
cards.referenceTextZh: 低云、雾、雨、雪和霾都会降低夜间进近时的能见度。风吹起的尘土或积雪可能遮蔽跑道，风挡上的强降水会使灯光更难看清。在山区，云层还可能遮住山脊，并使夜间本就有限的外部目视参照进一步减少。

cards.audioText: How do runway lights help pilots during a night approach and landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道灯光如何在夜间进近和着陆时帮助飞行员？
cards.referenceText: Runway lights improve situational awareness by giving pilots clearer information, supporting better monitoring, and providing more time to make safe decisions during a night approach and landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道灯光能向飞行员提供更清晰的信息，帮助他们更好地监控，并在夜间进近和着陆时留出更多时间作出安全决策，从而提高情景意识。

cards.audioText: What should a pre-descent briefing cover before a night approach to an airport in mountainous terrain?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间进近山区机场前，下降前简令应涵盖哪些内容？
cards.referenceText: The briefing should cover low cloud, rain, fog, terrain shadow, and limited visual references. It should also address careful aircraft monitoring and the need for conservative action if safety margins are reduced.
cards.referenceTextZh: 简令应包括低云、降雨、雾、地形阴影和有限目视参照等内容。还应说明如何认真监控飞机，以及安全裕度降低时采取保守措施的必要性。

cards.imageAlt: 地面火灾应急航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What can you see in this picture of a ground-fire emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从这张地面火灾紧急情况的图片中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: A passenger aircraft is on the ground with a major fire and heavy black smoke around it. Another aircraft is parked nearby, close to the burning aircraft. The fire appears intense, but its source and the condition of the occupants cannot be determined from the picture.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一架客机停在地面，周围发生严重火灾并冒出大量黑烟。另一架飞机停在附近，距离起火飞机很近。火势看起来非常猛烈，但无法从图片判断火源和机上人员状况。

cards.audioText: What factors can increase the risk of an aircraft fire on the ground?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素会增加航空器在地面起火的风险？
cards.referenceText: Fuel, hot brakes, leaking fluids, and nearby ground equipment can increase the risk of an aircraft fire on the ground.
cards.referenceTextZh: 燃油、高温刹车、泄漏的液体和附近的地面设备都会增加飞机在地面起火的风险。

cards.audioText: If your aircraft were parked near the burning aircraft shown, how would you protect your aircraft and its occupants?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你的航空器停在图中起火航空器附近，你会如何保护自己的航空器及其乘员？
cards.referenceText: I would alert ground control and the cabin crew immediately and stop boarding or servicing activities. If there were enough time and it was safe and authorized, I would have the aircraft moved away from the fire. Otherwise, I would shut it down and evacuate through exits away from the flames and smoke, directing everyone to assemble upwind at a safe distance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会立即通知地面管制和客舱机组，并停止登机或保障作业。如果时间充足且安全并获得许可，我会让飞机移离火场。否则，我会关闭飞机，并通过远离火焰和烟雾的出口撤离，指挥所有人到上风向的安全距离集合。

cards.imageAlt: Pushback procedure，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从这张图片上，你可以看到什么？
cards.referenceText: From this picture, I can see a big passenger aircraft with two engines is about to push-back. According to its appearance, I believe the aircraft is C909, one of the big aircraft made by China independently. There are three ground staff near the aircraft, and they are monitoring the push-back process.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从这张图中，我可以看到一架有两个发动机的大型客机正准备推出。根据它的外观，我认为这架飞机是C909，中国自主制造的大型飞机之一。飞机附近有三名地面人员，他们正在监控推出过程。

cards.audioText: Can you introduce the pushback procedure of your company?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能介绍下你们公司的推出程序吗？
cards.referenceText: In our company, the process of aircraft push-back requires the collaboration of the crew, maintenance personnel and the tower controller. The crew command, the maintenance staff connects to the tow bar and commands the operation with standard gestures, and the tower controller gives the clearance of the push-back. After completion, the maintenance staff disconnect the tow bar and the aircraft starts its engine and taxis by itself.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我们公司，飞机推出过程需要机组、机务与塔台三方协作。机组指挥，机务连接拖车并用标准手势指挥操作，塔台批准许可。完成后脱开拖把，飞机启动发动机自行滑出。

cards.audioText: How to ensure the safety of the push-back at night?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间如何保证推出的安全？
cards.referenceText: We can take the following measures, for instance, enhancing the ground lighting system; In addition to standard gestures, the aircraft maintenance staff must wear headphones to establish two-way voice communication with the cockpit to ensure that instructions are clear and correct. Increase the number of personnel to monitor the position of the aircraft at any time, etc.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们可以采取以下措施，比如，增强地面照明系统；除标准手势外，机务指挥员必须佩戴耳机与驾驶舱建立双向语音通讯，确保指令清晰无误；增加观察员，随时监督飞机位置等。

cards.imageAlt: Drone activity，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you please briefly describe this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以简单地描述下这张图片吗？
cards.referenceText: From this picture, I can see that a British Airways passenger plane is preparing to land and its landing gear has been extended. At the same time, there is also a drone in the air, which is very dangerous.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从这张图片中，我可以看到一架英国航空的客机正在准备着陆，飞机的起落架已经放下。同时，有一架无人机也在空中，这是很危险的。

cards.audioText: What does UAV stand for?
cards.audioTextZh: UAV指的是什么？
cards.referenceText: UAV stands for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle, commonly known as a drone. It is an aircraft without a human pilot on board, controlled remotely or autonomously. UAVs are widely used in military, delivery, surveying, and search-rescue operations. However, they also bring challenges to civil aviation, such as collision risks and airspace integration. Pilots need to be aware of UAV activities near airports and report any sightings to ATC promptly to ensure flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: UAV代表无人驾驶飞行器，通常被称为无人机。这是一架没有人类飞行员的飞机，可以远程或自主控制。无人机广泛应用于军事、运输、测量和搜救行动。然而，它们也给民用航空带来了碰撞风险和空域整合等挑战。飞行员需要了解机场附近的无人机活动，并及时向空中交通管制中心报告任何目击事件，以确保飞行安全。

cards.audioText: What are the functions of the UAV or drones?
cards.audioTextZh: 无人机的作用有哪些？
cards.referenceText: Drones have many useful functions. In the military, they are used for surveillance, and even combat missions. In civilian life, they are widely used for aerial photography, crop monitoring in agriculture, and inspecting power lines or pipelines. They also play a vital role in search and rescue operations, delivering medical supplies to remote areas, and surveying disaster zones. However, despite these benefits, we must always remember that drones can be a threat to civil aviation if not properly controlled, especially near airports.
cards.referenceTextZh: 无人机有许多有用的功能。在军事领域，它们被用于监视，甚至作战任务。在民用生活中，它们被广泛用于航空摄影、农业作物监测和检查电力线或管道。它们还在搜索和救援行动、向偏远地区运送医疗用品和调查灾区方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，尽管有这些好处，我们必须永远记住，如果管控不当，无人机可能对民用航空构成威胁，尤其是在机场附近。

cards.audioText: What possible hazards are associated with drone activities if they are operated in the vicinity of the airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果无人机在机场附近活动，可能会有哪些危险？
cards.referenceText: Drones near the airport have several serious hazards. First, they can collide with aircraft during takeoff or landing, which may cause critical damage to engines or windshields. Second, they distract pilots and ATC, reducing situational awareness. Third, drones may interfere with radio or navigation signals. Finally, if a drone falls, it can injure people or damage property on the ground. Therefore, all drone operations near airports must be strictly regulated and reported to ATC immediately.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场附近的无人机有几个严重的危险。首先，它们会在起飞或降落时与飞机相撞，这可能会对发动机或挡风玻璃造成严重损害。其次，它们分散了飞行员和空管的注意力，降低了态势感知能力。第三，无人机可能会干扰无线电或导航信号。最后，如果无人机坠落，它可能会伤害到地面上的人员或财产。因此，机场附近的所有无人机操作都必须严格监管，并立即向空中交通管制中心报告。

cards.audioText: What would you do if there were relevant reports of drone activities in your airspace?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在你的空域内有相关的无人机活动报告，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: If I receive reports of drone activities in my airspace, I would immediately notify ATC and provide all available details, such as the drone's location, altitude, color, size, and movement direction. I would also follow ATC instructions, which might include changing altitude, altering my flight path, or even diverting to an alternate airport. Meanwhile, I would keep monitoring the situation visually and on radar if available, and report any changes promptly to ensure the safety of my flight and other traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我收到无人机在我的空域活动的报告，我会立即通知ATC并提供所有可用的细节，如无人机的位置，高度，颜色，大小和移动方向。我也会遵照空中交通管制的指示，这可能包括改变高度，改变我的飞行路线，甚至转移到备用机场。与此同时，如果有可能的话，我会继续通过视觉和雷达监测情况，并及时报告任何变化，以确保我的航班和其他交通的安全。

cards.audioText: Do you have any good opinions or suggestions for regulating drone activities?
cards.audioTextZh: 对于规范无人机活动，你有什么好的意见或建议吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have several suggestions. First, all drones should be registered and equipped with remote identification systems so authorities can track them in real time. Second, we should set up no-fly zones near airports and use geo-fencing technology to prevent drones from entering these areas. Third, drone operators must pass safety training and obtain proper licenses. Finally, we need stricter penalties for those who violate the rules, including heavy fines or even criminal charges. Public education about drone risks is also important.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我有几个建议。首先，所有无人机都应该注册并配备远程识别系统，这样局方就可以实时跟踪它们。第二，在机场附近设立禁飞区，利用地理围栏技术防止无人机进入禁飞区。第三，无人机操作员必须通过安全培训并获得相应的许可证。最后，我们需要对违反规定的人进行更严厉的惩罚，包括高额罚款甚至刑事指控。关于无人机风险的公众教育也很重要。

cards.imageAlt: Sandstorm，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从这张图片中，你可以看到什什么？
cards.referenceText: From this picture, I can see that there are many planes parked on the apron, but not far away, there is a very strong sandstorm. The visibility in the area affected by the sandstorm has significantly decreased.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从这张图片上，我可以看到有很多飞机停在机坪上，但是不远处，有很强的沙尘暴，沙尘暴影响的区域，能见度显著降低。

cards.audioText: What impacts do sandstorms have on engine start-up?
cards.audioTextZh: 沙尘暴对发动机启动有什么影响？
cards.referenceText: Sandstorms are harmful to engines. Sand can damage compressor blades, clog fuel systems, and damage internal parts. This may lead to poor performance, compressor stalls, or even flameout during start-up. Pilots should follow special procedures, like delaying start-up or using reduced thrust, and always perform careful inspections afterward.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沙尘暴对发动机有害。沙子会损坏压气机叶片，堵塞燃料系统，并损坏内部部件。这可能导致性能不佳，压缩机失速，甚至在启动时熄火。飞行员应该遵循特殊程序，比如延迟启动或降低推力，并在启动后进行仔细的检查。

cards.audioText: How could sandstorms affect visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 沙尘暴是如何影响能见度的？
cards.referenceText: Sandstorms significantly reduce visibility by filling the air with dust and sand particles. This makes it hard for pilots to see runways, other aircraft, or obstacles. In severe cases, visibility can drop to only a few meters. Pilots then have to rely on instruments and may decide to delay takeoff or land at another airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沙尘暴使空气中充满灰尘和沙粒，大大降低了能见度。这使得飞行员很难看到跑道、其他飞机或障碍物。在严重的情况下，能见度可能下降到只有几米。然后，飞行员不得不依靠仪表，并可能决定推迟起飞或在另一个机场降落。

cards.audioText: Does the sandstorm have effects on the static system?
cards.audioTextZh: 沙尘暴对静压系统有影响吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, sandstorms can clog the static ports, which measure air pressure. If blocked, the altimeter, airspeed indicator, and vertical speed indicator give wrong readings. This is dangerous because pilots may misjudge speed or altitude. So, static ports should be covered on the ground and checked carefully before flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，沙尘暴会堵塞测量气压的静态端口。如果阻塞，高度计，空速指示器和垂直速度指示器给出错误的读数。这很危险，因为飞行员可能会误判速度或高度。因此，在飞行前应将静态端口覆盖在地面上并仔细检查。

cards.audioText: What would you do if there was a sandstorm forecast at your destination airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你的目的地机场有沙尘暴预报，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: I would check the sandstorm forecast details and calculate extra fuel for holding and diversion. I would also select an alternate airport with good weather. Before landing, I would ask ATC for the latest conditions. If visibility or winds are unsafe, I would go around and divert. I would never risk landing in a severe sandstorm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会检查沙尘暴预报的细节，计算等待和备降所需的额外燃料。我还会选择一个天气好的备用机场。在降落前，我会向空管询问最新情况。如果能见度或风向不安全，我会绕道备降。我绝不会冒险在严重的沙尘暴中着陆。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 1，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Could you please explain the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能够解释这张图的含义吗？
cards.referenceText: This diagram shows a thunderstorm with an anvil-shaped top. Rising and sinking air currents inside the storm create turbulence. Rain falls through the downdraft. Near the ground, the spreading downdraft forms a gust front, where a low roll cloud may appear and gusty winds can lift dust. Wind shear can occur around the storm.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这张图展示了顶部呈砧状的雷暴。雷暴内部的上升和下降气流会造成湍流，降雨穿过下降气流。下降气流到达地面后向外扩散，形成阵风锋；附近可能出现低空卷轴云，阵风也可能扬起尘土。雷暴周围可能出现风切变。

cards.audioText: Can you list the stages of a thunderstorm?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能列出雷暴的几个阶段吗？
cards.referenceText: All thunderstorms go through three stages: cumulus stage, mature stage, and the dissipating stage. During the cumulus stage, strong updrafts act to build the storm. The mature stage is marked by heavy precipitation and cool downdrafts in part of the storm. In the dissipating stage, when the warm updrafts disappear completely, precipitation becomes light and the cloud begins to dissipate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 所有雷暴都要经历三个阶段：积云期、成熟期和消散期。在积云期，强烈的上升气流会形成风暴。在成熟期，风暴中伴随着强降水和下降冷气流。在消散期，当上升热气流完全消失时，降水减少，云层消散。

cards.audioText: Why does this weather often result in wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么这种气象经常引起风切变？
cards.referenceText: For all I know, wind shear is the sudden change of wind speed and direction. This weather often has downdraft and updraft, and they can easily cause the wind shear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，风切变是由风速、风向的突变引起的。这种气象经常有下降气流和上升气流，会很容易引起风切变。

cards.audioText: What will you do if you approach the weather during your cruise?
cards.audioTextZh: 巡航时，如果正在接近这种气象你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I will report the weather information to ATC as soon as possible and request changing our heading to deviate the weather.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会尽快向ATC报告气象信息，然后请求改变航向来偏离这种气象。

cards.audioText: If you have to fly through this weather, what situation may you encounter?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你不得不飞过这种气象，你可能会遭遇什么情况？
cards.referenceText: If I fly through this weather, I will possibly encounter lightning strike, wind shear, icing or severe turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我飞过这个气象，我可能会遭遇雷击、风切变，结冰或严重颠簸。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do if the cabin crew report there were passenger injuries due to turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果客舱报告有旅客颠伤，作为飞行员该如何处置？
cards.referenceText: As a pilot, we should firstly ensure passengers' safety. When there were injured passengers, we would ask flight attendants to do first aid. Meanwhile, we would report the situation to ATC and our superior for further instruction. If the passenger was badly injured or there were casualties on board, we should declare emergency and request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 作为飞行员，首先要保障乘客和飞机的安全，报告有受伤的旅客，首先需要让乘务员做最先处置，同时报告ATC以及公司上级寻求指导帮助，如果受伤很严重或者有伤亡需要宣布遇险并申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: Which season will be more likely to encounter this weather? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么季节容易遇到这样的天气？为什么？
cards.referenceText: It varies on account of different regions. In tropical area, thunderstorm activities are frequent throughout the year. In temperate area, it's more likely to encounter thunderstorm in summer and early autumn. In the northern area, thunderstorm might occur in winter.
cards.referenceTextZh: 每个地区的情况不同。热带地区一年四季雷暴活动频繁。在温带地区，雷暴在夏季和秋初经常出现。北方地区在冬天也会出现雷暴天气。

cards.audioText: Does your company have any special requirements or procedures in respect to wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的公司对于风切变有特殊要求或程序吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, our company has special procedure for wind shear. The procedure is required during each refreshment and it is also an essential item in flight check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我公司有应对风切变的程序，而且这个程序是每次复训都要求训练的，也是飞行检查的必查项目之一。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 2，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please describe what is shown in the picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述图中展示的是什么。
cards.referenceText: The picture shows a microburst encountered during takeoff. The airplane first encounters a headwind and experiences increasing performance (1), this is followed in short succession by a decreasing headwind component (2), a downdraft (3), and finally a strong tailwind (4), where 2 through 5 all result in decreasing performance of the airplane. Position (5) represents an extreme situation just prior to impact.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图中展示的是起飞途中遭遇微暴流。飞机首先遇到逆风并增加飞机性能（1） 随后减小顶风（2），下沉气流（3），然后是顺风增加（4），从（2）到（5）的结果是飞机性能的下降。（5）代表的是受到之前影响的极端条件。

cards.audioText: Can you say something about microburst?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能介绍一下微暴流吗？
cards.referenceText: A microburst is an intense, localized downdraft which spreads out in all directions when it reaches the surface. Any convective cloud can produce this phenomenon, for example rain showers, virga and thunderstorms. A microburst creates severe horizontal and vertical wind shears which pose serious hazards to aircraft. When the downdraft approaches the surface, the wind flows outward from the core in all directions. This is usually a short-lived phenomenon, seldom lasting more than 15 minutes from the time the burst strikes the ground until it dissipates.
cards.referenceTextZh: 微下击暴流是一种强烈的局部下沉气流，气流到达地面后会向四周扩散。任何对流云都可产生这种现象，如大雨、幡状云和雷暴。微下击暴流在水平和垂直方向产生严重的风切变，对飞机造成严重危害。当下沉气流接近地面时，风从中心向四周扩散。这一现象持续时间通常较短，气流从到达地面至消失，很少持续15分钟以上。

cards.audioText: What may occur if you fly through a microburst?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞过微暴流将有可能发生什么？
cards.referenceText: When flying through a microburst, the aircraft will become very unstable and difficult to control. At the beginning, the speed and altitude increase rapidly. When the aircraft passes the center of the microburst, the tailwind will cause the airspeed decrease and the altitude will be lost suddenly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当飞过微暴流时，飞机将变得不稳定并难以控制。最初，速度和高度会快速上升。飞机通过微暴流中心时，顺风会使风速和高度突然下降。

cards.audioText: If Tower advises a wind shear alert on your landing runway while you are 12 miles away, what would you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在距塔台12英里时收到风切变预警你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I will make a holding pattern or go around. I will try another time if the fuel on board is enough in case I can fly to the alternation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会等待航线或复飞。我会选择再一次尝试重新进近，前提要保证飞机上的油料足够再次复飞飞到备降机场。

cards.audioText: Have you encountered wind shear? How do you deal with it?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾经遭遇过风切变吗？你是怎样处理的？
cards.referenceText: If I encountered wind shear, I would immediately follow the escape procedure and recovery guidance for my aircraft type. Once clear of the wind shear, I would report the encounter to ATC.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果遭遇风切变，我会立即执行本机型的风切变脱离程序并遵循相应改出指引。脱离风切变后，我会向空管报告遭遇情况。

cards.audioText: What will you do if you encounter the microburst when landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在降落时遭遇微暴流你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: I would avoid an approach affected by a microburst. If an encounter occurred, I would immediately use the aircraft-specific wind shear escape procedure and recovery guidance, rather than improvise airspeed corrections.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会避免在微下击暴流影响下继续进近；如果已经遭遇，我会立即按照本机型的风切变脱离程序和改出指引操作，而不是临时自行调整空速。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 3，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please make a brief description of the picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请简要说明这张图片。
cards.referenceText: In the picture, the landing aircraft is experiencing lightning strike. The sky is very dark, and the lightning is very bright. The plane is hit around the wheel well.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图中这架正在降落的飞机正在经历雷击。天空非常暗，闪电很明亮，这架飞机的起落架轮舱附近被击中。

cards.audioText: Is the lightning strike a great factor that may damage an aircraft? Why or why not?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷击是否是造成飞机损坏的因素？为什么是/不是？
cards.referenceText: It's hard to say, the skin of the aircraft can usually dissipate the lightning energy sufficiently to prevent problems, while it may leave a burn mark on the aircraft. In a few cases, the lightning energy has damaged electronic equipment in the aircraft, but only fewer aircraft have received enough damage to cause a major problem with flying the plane. Seldom does a lightning strike cause a crash, but the potential is there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这不好说，飞机的外壳通常能充分消除雷击的能量，防止事故发生，但是飞机外壳仍可能会有来自雷击的烧痕。少数情况下，雷击会损坏飞机中的电子设备，但其中仅有小部分飞机出现飞行相关的问题。虽然雷击引起事故的情况极少，但是存在可能性。

cards.audioText: Does lightning strike only happen in the storm weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 只有暴雨天气时才会发生雷击吗？
cards.referenceText: Not really. Most aircraft do not fly into storms and what we can see is that lightning is really a massive flood of electrons seeking equilibrium, either from cloud-cloud or from cloud-ground. In both cases, huge amounts of electric charge build up at the edges of the cloud. The electricity finds its way from one place to the other via what’s called a "step leader".
cards.referenceTextZh: 并不是，大多数情况下飞机并不会飞入风暴中。我们知道，闪电实际上是大量电子在寻求平衡，会发生在云和云之间，或云和地面之间。在这两种情况下，云边缘的电荷数大量增加。电流通过所谓的“先导闪电”找到从一个地方到另一个地方的途径。

cards.audioText: In which phase does the lightning strike usually occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 通常在飞行中的哪些时期可能会遭受雷击？
cards.referenceText: More jet airplane lightning strikes occur while in clouds, during the climb and descent phases of flight than any other flight phases. The reason is that lightning activity is more prevalent between 1500 to 4500 meters' altitude. Airplanes that fly short routes in areas with high incidence of lightning activity are more likely to be struck than long-haul airplanes operating in milder lightning environments.
cards.referenceTextZh: 喷气式飞机遭受雷击时通常在云中，飞行中的爬升或下降阶段遭受雷击的可能性更高。原因是闪电活动通常发生在高度1500至4500米的范围内。闪电活动频繁区域内做短途飞行比在闪电活动少的区域做长途飞行更有可能遭受雷击。

cards.audioText: How to protect the aircraft from a lightning strike during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中怎样保护飞机远离雷击？
cards.referenceText: I would plan a route around thunderstorms and follow the aircraft weather-avoidance procedures. Static wicks reduce static-related radio interference; they do not make flying through a thunderstorm safe.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会规划绕飞雷暴的航线，并遵循本机型的天气避让程序。放电刷用于减少静电造成的无线电干扰，不能因此认为穿越雷暴是安全的。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 4，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you describe what is happening in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述图中发生了什么吗？
cards.referenceText: It snowed at the airport. There is a parked airplane and two de-icing vehicles on the apron. Some staff members are operating the de-icing vehicles, and some other people are standing around. The airplane is under de-icing procedure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。机场下雪了。停机坪上有一架飞机和两辆除冰车。一些工作人员在操作除冰车，另外一些人站在飞机周围。飞机正在接受除冰。

cards.audioText: Do you have similar experience?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有类似的经历吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have such kind of experience. Last winter, it had three heavy snows in Beijing. Unfortunately, I experienced one of them. The airport was covered with 4cm of snow and our aircraft were all covered with snow. I had to wait in the long queue for de-icing. It took us one hour to wait in the aircraft. Finally, we took off safely after two hours' delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我有类似经历。去年冬天，北京下了三场大雪，我不幸遭遇了其中一场。机场被4厘米厚的雪覆盖，我们的飞机上全都是雪。我不得不排长队等待除冰，排队令我在飞机里等待了一小时。飞机延误了两小时，最后安全起飞了。

cards.audioText: Under what condition will the airplane be prohibited to take off in winter?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下飞机禁止在冬天起飞？
cards.referenceText: China Civil Aviation Regulations (CCAR) prohibit takeoff when snow, ice, or frost is adhering to wings, propellers, control surfaces, engine outlets, and other critical surfaces of the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 中国民航规章中禁止飞机在机翼、螺旋桨、操纵面、引擎或飞机其它操纵面上在有雪、结冰、结霜的情况下起飞。

cards.audioText: What training have you had for cold weather operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 你参加过哪些寒冷天气飞行相关训练？
cards.referenceText: We have season-changing training for cold weather operations every autumn, including anti-icing and de-icing procedures and thunderstorm circumnavigation training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 每年秋季会参加换季训练，内容与寒冷天气飞行相关，包括防冰、除冰程序和雷雨绕飞。

cards.audioText: Do you have special training for flying in the North Pole regions?
cards.audioTextZh: 你参加过在北极地区飞行的特殊训练吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, we have. North Pole regions are special operation routes, so before flights, pilots need to get some special information about that region. Our company has a Special Operation Manual, which verifies the detailed requirements for North Pole region operation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 参加过，北极航线是特殊运行航路，所以在飞行前，飞行员需要了解北极地区的特殊信息。我的公司有特殊运行手册，其中对北极地区操作有详细的要求。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you encountered severe hail during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在飞行中遭遇强冰雹你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If I encountered severe hail during flight, I would ask ATC for deviation to avoid that area, and I would also inform the passengers to fasten their seat belts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我在飞行中遭遇强冰雹，我会向ATC申请偏离避开冰雹区域，并且我会通知乘客系紧安全带。

cards.audioText: If you were holding for takeoff and a flight attendant reported that there was a buildup of snow on the wings, what would you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你正在等待起飞，乘务人员报告机翼有积雪，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: In this case, I will report the situation to ATC and request to go back to the apron for de-icing. Because I can’t take off with snow on the wings.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果是这种情况，我会将情况报告给ATC并要求回停机坪除冰，因为机翼有积雪飞机无法起飞。

cards.audioText: What factors would you consider to ensure flight safety in icing conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 在结冰条件下，你会考虑哪些因素来保证飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: In snow weather, de-icing procedure is usually carried out before departure to ensure that all control surfaces can be operated normally. Before flight, we first check the performance of the aircraft and do a walk-around inspection. If snow or ice is built on the surface of the aircraft, we must execute de-icing procedure. Under icing conditions, we must reduce taxi speed and operate the aircraft with caution.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雪天时出发前要进行除冰流程，以确保所有的操纵面正常运行。在飞行前，首先要检查飞机性能并做绕机检查。飞机表面有雪或冰时必须执行除冰流程。在结冰条件下必须要降低滑行速度，并且小心驾驶飞机。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 6，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What is shown in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 图中展示的是什么？
cards.referenceText: The picture shows two kinds of emergency and safety equipment. The left one is a fire extinguisher, and the right one is a medical box.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图中展示了两种应急和安全设备。左边是灭火器，右边是急救箱。

cards.audioText: In what situation will they be used?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下会使用这些设备？
cards.referenceText: A fire extinguisher is used to control or put out a fire, mostly in emergency situations. When we find there is medical emergency on board, the medical box is needed. For example, if there is a passenger suffering from a heart attack, we need to do first aid immediately.
cards.referenceTextZh: 灭火器用于控制或熄灭火情，主要在紧急情况时使用。当飞机上有医疗紧急情况时需要急救箱。例如，有乘客突然心脏病发作时需要立刻急救。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me how to use a fire extinguisher?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能告诉我如何使用灭火器吗？
cards.referenceText: First remove the safety pin, after the safety pin is removed, depress the operating lever. The lever pushes on an actuating rod, which presses the valve down to open up a passage to the nozzle which will release the fire extinguishing material outside.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。首先拔出安全销，然后压下压把。压把推动一个操纵杆按压下方的阀门，打开和喷筒相连的喷管，释放灭火器内部填充物。

cards.audioText: What circumstances can cause a fire in an airplane?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么情况下会引发飞机上的火灾？
cards.referenceText: There is no single cause of airplane fire, among which engine fire is in the majority. Besides, oil leakage, overheating cookers, careless smoking and lightning strike, the inflammable goods on board and fanatics in arson, etc., all these are the reasons may cause fire in airplane.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机火灾并非由单一原因引发，其中发动机着火是主要原因。此外，漏油、厨具过热、吸烟、雷击、易燃物品和极端分子纵火，这些都可能引发飞机上的火灾。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me something about the smoke detector in the airplane?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能给我介绍一下飞机上的烟雾报警器吗？
cards.referenceText: A smoke detection system monitors the lavatories and cargo baggage compartments for the presence of smoke, which is indication of a fire condition. Smoke detection instruments that collect air for sampling are mounted in the compartments in strategic locations. A smoke detection system is used where the type of fire anticipated is expected to generate a substantial amount of smoke before temperature changes are sufficient to actuate a heat detection system. Two common types used are light refraction and ionization.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，烟雾报警系统会监控卫生间和货物行李舱是否有烟雾，防止火情发生。安装在舱内重要位置的监测仪器会收集空气作为监测样本。如果预计发生的火灾会在温度变化前会形成大量烟雾，烟雾量足以启动高温探测系统，这时报警器会起作用。烟雾报警器能探测到的两种常见火灾成因是光反射和电离作用。

cards.audioText: Do you think the first aid in flight is necessary?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为飞机上的急救有必要吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, of course. Medical emergencies aboard aircraft are inevitable. With commercial air traffic increasing, these emergencies are expected to become more frequent as the percentage of older people increases, so the first aid in flight is necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当然有必要，飞机上的医疗紧急情况不可避免。随着商业航班数量增多，可以预见这些紧急情况会更加频繁，因为年长乘客的比例也会增长，所以飞机上的急救非常有必要。

cards.audioText: Do you have any training on aeromedicine?
cards.audioTextZh: 你接受过有关航空医学的培训吗？
cards.referenceText: No, we don’t have such training. / Yes, we have. Pilots and flight attendants are required to undergo initial and recurrent training on aviation medicine, first aid, CPR and automated external defibrillator (AED) usage every 12 to 24 months.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，飞行员没有相关培训。/有相关的培训是和乘务人员一同进行航空医学、急救、心脏复苏术、除颤器使用相关的基本培训，并且每12到24个月定期复训。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me some safety equipment in the airplane?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能说出飞机上的一些安全设备吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, fire extinguisher, safety belt, oxygen mask, life jacket, emergency exit and inflatable slide.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，灭火瓶、安全带、氧气面罩、救生衣、紧急出口和充气滑梯。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 7，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Could you tell me what is shown in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以告诉我图中展示的是什么吗？
cards.referenceText: Okay, there are two types of aircraft, Boeing 747 and Airbus 380.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，图中展示的是两种类型的飞机，波音747和空中客车A380。

cards.audioText: Have you ever flown any type of them? Which type do you prefer? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾经驾驶过图中这两种飞机吗？你更喜欢哪一种？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have flown Boeing 747 / A380. / No, I haven't. Comparatively, I prefer A380. Because A380 has the world's highest capacity of passengers and the environment inside the cabin is closer to nature. Moreover, the noise of its taking off can be quite below the ICAO's current noise control standards. Besides, A380 owns the whole new design advantage. Meanwhile, it enlarges the common operating advantages of Airbus family to the area of extra-large airliner. / I prefer Boeing 747. Because compared to A380, the technology Boeing 747 used is more mature, and there are many optional types to choose. Besides, it is more efficient, faster and more environmentally friendly, and its maintenance is more convenient. What's more, more airlines use it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我曾经驾驶过波音747/空中客车A380。/ 不，我没有驾驶过这两种飞机。比较而言，我更喜欢空中客车A380，因为空中客车A380是世界上载客量最大的飞机，机舱内环境更贴近自然。此外，空中客车A380起飞时的噪音远低于国际民航组织制定的噪音控制标准。空中客车A380拥有新设计的优势，同时还将空中客车系列飞机共同的运营优势扩大到了超大客机上。/ 我更喜欢波音747，因为和空中客车A380相比，波音747使用的技术更成熟，并且有更多可以选择的类型。此外，波音747更高效、更快、更环保，维护更方便。另外，使用波音747的航空公司更多。

cards.audioText: What's the main difference between the two types of aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 这两种飞机主要的区别是什么？
cards.referenceText: Compared to Boeing 747, A380 carries the largest capacity of passengers in the history of civil aircraft with providing about 35% more seats and 49% more floor space.
cards.referenceTextZh: 和波音747相比，空中客车A380拥有民用飞机历史上最大的载客量，多提供约35%的座位和49%的地面空间。

cards.audioText: Do you like to fly big aircraft or small aircraft? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢驾驶大型飞机还是小型飞机？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I like flying big aircraft. First, the big aircraft is more comfortable for passengers and crew members. Second, its automatic systems are much easier to control and greatly reduced our workload. Third, it is still as safe and fast as the small aircraft and it can fly longer. However, nowadays many new technologies have been introduced in both big and small aircraft, so we can trust all of them.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我喜欢驾驶大型飞机。第一，大型飞机让乘客和机组人员感到更舒适；第二，大型飞机的自动化系统更易于控制，能够大幅降低工作量；第三，和小型飞机相比，大型飞机同样安全、速度快，但是大型飞机飞行时间更久。然而，如今不论大型飞机还是小型飞机都引入了很多新技术，所以两种飞机都值得信赖。

cards.audioText: What is the most advanced type of Boeing and Airbus respectively?
cards.audioTextZh: 波音和空中客车最先进机型分别是什么？
cards.referenceText: The most advanced type of Boeing is Boeing 787, and the most advanced type of Airbus is A380.
cards.referenceTextZh: 波音最先进的机型是波音787，空中客车最先进的机型是空中客车A380。

cards.audioText: Is there difference between Boeing and Airbus in flight control system?
cards.audioTextZh: 波音和空中客车的飞行操纵系统有区别吗？
cards.referenceText: Flight control systems differ by aircraft type, not simply by manufacturer. Many Airbus aircraft use fly-by-wire, and Boeing aircraft such as the 777 and 787 also use fly-by-wire. The details and control laws must be compared for the specific models.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行操纵系统的差异取决于具体机型，不能只按制造商品牌区分。许多空客飞机采用电传操纵，波音777和787等机型也采用电传操纵。具体系统和控制律应按机型比较。

cards.audioText: What are the similarities between A380 and B747?
cards.audioTextZh: 空中客车A380和波音747有什么相似之处？
cards.referenceText: They are both double deckers and both have 4 engines, and they are both wide-body aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 两种飞机都是双层飞机，都有四个发动机，并且都是宽体飞机。

cards.audioText: Which do you think has better security? Boeing 747 or Airbus 380?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为哪种飞机安全性更好？波音747还是空中客车A380？
cards.referenceText: I would not conclude that the Boeing 747 is safer simply because of its control system type. The A380 has segregated, redundant flight control power sources and backup systems. A meaningful safety comparison needs evidence about the specific aircraft and operating conditions, not an assumption that fly-by-wire becomes unmanageable after a wiring fault.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我不会仅凭操纵系统类型就断定波音747更安全。A380的飞行操纵系统具有相互隔离的冗余动力来源和备用系统。比较安全性需要具体机型和运行条件方面的证据，不能假定电传系统一旦出现线路故障就难以操纵。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 8，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Look at the picture, if the right side system failed, what would happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 看这张图片，如果右侧的系统有故障将会发生什么？
cards.referenceText: Well, the normal brakes and the right reverser cannot be used. In that case, the hydraulic pressure of flight control can be supplied by the left and center hydraulic system.
cards.referenceTextZh: 正规制动器和右侧反向制动器无法使用。如果是这种情况，飞机控制所需的液压将由左侧和中间的液压系统提供。

cards.audioText: What are the functions of flaps?
cards.audioTextZh: 襟翼的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: Flaps exert effects when they are extended so that the wing area is increased. During takeoff, flaps can be used to increase the lift, reduce takeoff distance and lower the rotation speed. During landing, flaps can be used to reduce the landing speed and landing distance by increasing the lift.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机放襟翼时可以增加机翼的面积。起飞时，襟翼能增加升力，减少起飞滑跑距离，降低抬前轮速度。降落时，襟翼可以通过增加升力来降低着陆速度和着陆距离。

cards.audioText: Can you describe the landing gear on your plane?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一下你的飞机上的起落架吗？
cards.referenceText: The landing gear is the primary support of the airplane when parking, taxiing, taking off, or landing. I am flying B737 now. There are two main landing gears and a single nose gear on my plane. Each main gear is a conventional two–wheel landing gear. They are retractable. The nose gear is a conventional steerable two–wheel unit. Normally, the hydraulic pressure of the landing gear is supplied by system A. If system A fails, we can manually extend the landing gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起落架在飞机停车、滑行、起飞和降落时为飞机提供主要支撑。我现在驾驶的是波音737，飞机有两个主起落架和一个前起落架。主起落架是传统的双轮起落架，并且能够伸缩，前起落架是传统的可操纵的双轮组。通常起落架的液压由A系统提供，如果A系统故障，我们可以手动放下起落架。

cards.audioText: Have you encountered any problems with the hydraulic pressure system during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾在飞行中遭遇过液压系统故障吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I have never encountered hydraulic system problem during the real flight, but I often practice this situation in the simulator training. / Yes, I encountered such problem once. That was before our takeoff, my co-pilot reported that our left reverser failed, we aborted takeoff quickly and requested to taxi back to apron for further check and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，我在实际飞行中从未遭遇过液压系统故障，但是我经常在模拟训练中练习这种场景。/ 有，我曾遭遇过液压系统故障。在起飞前，我的副驾驶向我报告飞机的左侧反向制动器故障，我们立刻中断起飞，并请求滑行回停机坪做进一步检查和维修。

cards.audioText: Can you describe the hydraulic system in Boeing aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一下波音飞机的液压系统吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I am flying B737. There are three hydraulic systems in this aircraft, system A, B and alternate hydraulic system. System A supplies pressure to some controls and landing gear related controls, such as gear extension, nose wheel steering, brakes, and power transfer unit. System B supplies pressure to some control surfaces, such as leading edge flaps, slats, normal brakes and so on. If both systems A and B fail, the alternate system will supply hydraulic pressure to some essential equipment so that we can still control the aircraft to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，我现在驾驶的是波音737。飞机有三个液压系统：A系统、B系统和备用液压系统。A系统为操纵装置提供压力，例如起落架收放、前轮转弯、刹车和动力传输组。B系统为一些操纵面提供压力，例如前缘襟翼、前缘缝翼和正规制动器等。如果A系统和B系统都出现了故障，备用液压系统会为主要设备提供压力，飞行员仍然可以控制飞机着陆。

cards.audioText: If both the right and central hydraulic pressure system fail, how will it affect your landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果右侧和中间的液压系统出现故障将会对降落有什么影响？
cards.referenceText: If that's the case, many systems will be inoperative during landing, such as the normal and alternate brakes, the nose wheel steering, flaps and landing gear normal extension, so we need to extend flaps when landing as alternative, use the accumulator for braking and ask for a tug to tow us to the apron after we stop on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果发生这种情况，许多系统在着陆时都会出现故障，例如正常和备用制动器、前轮转弯、襟翼和起落架收放。所以需要备用放襟翼着陆，刹车时使用蓄能器，并在跑道上停止后请求让拖车将飞机拖到停机坪。

cards.audioText: What would you do in case that the speed brake is inoperative?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机减速板发生故障，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If the speed brake is out of service during flight, we can extend the landing gear to increase the descending rate and reduce the speed. If the speed brake is inoperative after landing, we can use the reverser and maximum brake to stop the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞机减速板在飞行时发生故障，我们可以放下起落架来增加下降率和减小速度。如果飞机减速板在着陆后发生故障，我们可以利于反向制动器达到最大制动使飞机停下。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 9，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: If the thrust reverser is inoperative, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果反推力装置出现故障，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: When braking ability reduces, for higher speeds on contaminated runways, reverse thrust can be the most useful and effective. However, if I encounter thrust reverser failure, touchdown velocity is minimum during approach, and the braking action is good, I will use the maximum brake and spoilers to stop the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当制动性能下降时，为了在受污染的跑道获得更大的速度，反推力是最有效的。然而，如果我遭遇反推力装置故障，进近的时候保持最小速度接地，在刹车性能良好时我会使用最大制动和扰流器来让飞机停下。

cards.audioText: If the flaps can not be extended, what should you do to manage the situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机无法放襟翼，你应该怎样处理这个情况？
cards.referenceText: First we will try the alternate system to extend the flaps. If it does not work, we will follow the flapless landing checklist. We should check the landing distance of our aircraft according to the landing weight, and request the longest runway if necessary.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先应尝试用备用系统来放襟翼，如果不起作用，则要执行无襟翼着陆检查。我们应根据着陆重量检查飞机的着陆距离，如果可以的话应请求最长跑道。

cards.audioText: What will be impacted by a hydraulic system failure? Could you name a few?
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统故障将会产生什么影响？你能说出一些吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. If only one system fails, there won’t be much impact. However, if we lose two or more hydraulic systems, many equipment or systems can not be operated normally. For example, the reverser, flight control system, landing gear, nose wheel steering, and brake.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。如果只有一个系统出现故障，那么不会有过多影响。然而，如果两个或更多的液压系统出现故障，许多设备和系统就无法正常操作，例如反推器、飞行控制系统、起落架、前轮转弯和刹车。

cards.audioText: How would you manage the situation if the landing gear could not be put down and locked?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果起落架无法放下并固定你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: First, I will finish the checklist and follow the procedure on the checklist. If it’s necessary, I will make a low pass so that ATC and ground staff can help me to check the landing gear. If the landing gear was not locked, I need to report to ATC and relevant staff to prepare fire equipment and medical facility, then land without landing gear or land with the landing gear was partly retracted.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先要完成检查单，然后按照检查单的项目逐步进行。如果有必要低空通场通过ATC及地面人员的观察帮助判断是否放下锁好。一旦起落架没有放下锁好，需要通知ATC及相关地面工作人员准备好消防设施、救援设施，实施无起落架或部分起落架收上着陆。

cards.audioText: Do you know some advantages of hydraulic systems over other systems for aircraft operating?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道液压系统在飞机运行中比其他系统有哪些优点吗？
cards.referenceText: Hydraulic systems are lighter in weight than existing alternate systems, and there is an absence of sloppiness in response to the demands placed on the systems. Besides, they are reliable whether they work or not. And better yet, they can be easily maintained and don’t risk shock hazard. What’s more, they can develop practically unlimited force or torque.
cards.referenceTextZh: 液压系统比现有备用系统的重量更轻，并且对系统要求做出的反应不会出错。此外，不论系统工作与否都很稳定。更好的是，它很容易维护，不会有电击的危险。另外，它可以发挥近乎无限的能量或扭矩。

cards.audioText: Can you say something about flight control system?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能介绍一下飞行控制系统吗？
cards.referenceText: OK. An aircraft flight control system consists of flight control surfaces, the respective cockpit controls, connecting linkages, and the necessary operating mechanisms to control an aircraft’s direction in flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，飞机的飞行控制系统由飞行操纵面、独立驾驶舱操控、连接杆件和必需的操作装置组成，在飞行中控制飞机的方向。

cards.audioText: What is the function of rudder?
cards.audioTextZh: 方向舵的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, the control of the rudder is completed by operating rudder pedals, the rudder can help pilots to control the yaw rate of the aircraft, and it allows the aircraft to make a smooth turn when used in coordination with the ailerons. However, excessive use of the rudder can lead to a spin that can cause the airplane to lose altitude rapidly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 就我所知，方向舵的控制是由飞行员通过方向舵踏板来完成的，方向舵可以帮助飞行员控制飞机的偏航率，和副翼协同工作时可以让飞机顺畅地转弯。然而，过度使用方向舵导致的旋转会引发飞机立刻下降。

cards.audioText: During your simulator session, do you have any training related to a hydraulic system failure?
cards.audioTextZh: 在模拟训练时你是否接受过液压系统故障相关的训练？
cards.referenceText: Yes, we have many training related to hydraulic system failure.
