For example, in the case of loss of all the hydraulic systems, we must manually control the aircraft with the combined force of the two pilots, and follow the checklist step by step to deal with this situation, including manually extending the landing gear and using the alternate hydraulic system to extend flaps.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们有许多液压系统故障相关的训练。比如，在液压系统全部故障时，飞机必须由两位飞行员协同手动操作，并且逐步执行检查清单，其中包括手动放下起落架和使用备用液压系统放襟翼。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 10，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从这张图中你能看到什么？
cards.referenceText: I can see some oxygen equipment used onboard. They are oxygen mask, high-pressure portable oxygen cylinder and protective breathing equipment (PBE).
cards.referenceTextZh: 我能看到一些飞机上使用的供氧设备。分别是氧气面罩、高压手提式氧气瓶和呼吸保护器。

cards.audioText: In what situation will the devices be used?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下会使用这些设备？
cards.referenceText: Different oxygen and breathing devices have different purposes. Passenger oxygen masks are used for a loss of cabin pressure. Medical oxygen may be used when needed. Crew members use protective breathing equipment for protection against smoke and harmful gases while carrying out their duties.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不同的供氧和呼吸设备用途不同。旅客氧气面罩用于客舱失压，医疗供氧设备按需要使用。机组人员执行相关职责时使用防护呼吸设备，保护自己免受烟雾和有害气体影响。

cards.audioText: Can pilots manually deploy oxygen masks?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以手动释放氧气面罩吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, if oxygen masks fail to fall out automatically, the crew members can operate the passenger oxygen supplying switch, making the doors of the locker of oxygen masks open and the oxygen masks will fall out.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以，如果氧气面罩没有自动落下，机组人员可以操作乘客供氧设备开关，将氧气面罩装置打开，然后氧气面罩会落下。

cards.audioText: What's the difference between oxygen masks for passengers and crew members?
cards.audioTextZh: 乘客和机组人员使用的氧气面罩有什么区别？
cards.referenceText: The oxygen masks for crew members are quick-using type oxygen masks, in order to make sure the crew members can wear them quickly only by one hand in emergency situations. Besides, the supplying time of the oxygen masks for crew members lasts longer than that for passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组人员使用的氧气面罩是快捷型的，能够确保机组人员在遭遇紧急状况时能单手快速戴上氧气面罩。除此之外，和乘客使用的相比，机组人员使用的的氧气面罩供给氧气的时间更长。

cards.audioText: Do you have any experience of hypoxia training? How do you think about it?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有低氧训练的经验吗？你对低氧训练有什么看法？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have. I think hypoxia training is an important part of flight training for pilots. It’s a training that using the low pressure tester or low pressure cabin to simulate the situation of 7500m high altitude anoxia, letting pilots experience the anoxia symptoms and testing our effective conscious time. It can improve pilots’ oxygen deficiency distinguishing and handling ability, which plays a vital role in the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有经验。我认为对于飞行员来说，低氧训练是飞行训练中重要的一部分。低氧训练使用低压测试仪或低压舱来模拟7500米高原缺氧情况，让飞行员体验缺氧症状并测试有效意识时间。这项训练可以提高飞行员对缺氧的辨别和处理能力，这些能力对飞行安全起至关重要的作用。

cards.audioText: What are the common symptoms of hypoxia?
cards.audioTextZh: 缺氧的常见症状是什么？
cards.referenceText: In the situation of hypoxia, people will feel dizzy, vision blurred, and more seriously they will become nauseated, pale and unconscious, and even their lives will be in danger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在缺氧的情况下，人会感到晕眩，视力模糊。更严重的会感到恶心，面色苍白，失去知觉，甚至会有生命危险。

cards.audioText: What do you think of pilots smoking in the cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对于飞行员在驾驶舱内吸烟有什么看法？
cards.referenceText: Pilots are forbidden to smoke in the cockpit. It’s very dangerous to smoke in the cockpit for it is a potential fire hazard. Under the condition of hypobaric and hypoxia, if pilots smoke, the feeling of hypoxic will be strengthened. It will be a disadvantage for pilot to judge in dangerous situations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员是不允许在驾驶舱吸烟的，在驾驶舱吸烟有很多危险，会引起火灾，在高空低压缺氧的状态下吸烟会引起飞行人员加剧缺氧状态，对飞行员在危险判断时产生障碍等。

cards.audioText: If there is smoke in the cockpit and it cannot be extracted, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果驾驶舱内有烟雾无法排出，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Considering that there may be possibility of fire, I would request ATC for an emergency landing. If necessary, I would put on the oxygen mask first.
cards.referenceTextZh: 考虑到火灾的可能性，我会向ATC请求紧急着陆。如有必要，我会首先戴上氧气面罩。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 12，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please describe the picture briefly in your own words.
cards.audioTextZh: 请用你自己的语言简略描述这张图片。
cards.referenceText: In the picture, I can see a policeman is checking items carried by passengers at the airport. The policeman is holding a bottle and telling a lady the bottle can not be carried in the airplane, maybe it is a bottle of shampoo.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从这张图中我看到一个警察正在机场检查乘客携带的行李，这个警察正拿着一个瓶子告诉一位女士这个瓶子无法带上飞机，瓶子里的物品有可能是洗发水。

cards.audioText: Do you know anything about dangerous goods? Can you name a few?
cards.audioTextZh: 你了解危险物品吗？能列举一些吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, dangerous goods are also called hazardous materials, including explosive material, flammable material/liquid/solid/gas, corrosive liquid, radioactive material, magnetic solid, and so on. They may harm people, aircraft or environment during transportation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 了解，危险物品也可以被称为有害物质，包括易爆炸物、易燃物/液体/固体/气体、腐蚀性液体、放射性物品，磁性固体等。这些物品在运输途中可能对人体、飞机或环境产生伤害。

cards.audioText: What factors should the crew members consider beforehand if there are dangerous goods on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果机上有危险物品，机组人员应事先考虑到什么？
cards.referenceText: First, the crew members should have been trained about dangerous goods transportation. Second, after being notified of the dangerous goods, the pilots should understand the nature of the goods and confirm the package and position of the goods in the hold. In the air, when something abnormal happens, the pilots should report the situation about the goods to ATC and request to land at the nearest airport as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一，机组成员应该已全部接受过危险物品运输培训；第二，被告知机上有危险物品后，飞行员要了解危险物品的性质，并确定危险物品的包装方式和其在货舱中的位置。飞行途中，当异常情况发生时，飞行员应该将危险物品的情况报告给ATC，并要求尽快在最近的机场着陆。

cards.audioText: The Dispatch Center told you there was bomb on board after your takeoff, what should you do then?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机起飞后签派中心告知飞机上有炸弹，这时你应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I will ask them to contact the nearest airport with explosive ordnance disposal (EOD) facility for our landing, and then I will report my condition to ATC for further emergency arrangement.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会要求签派中心联系最近的机场，并申请着陆后的爆炸军械处理设备。然后我会将情况报告给ATC等待紧急部署。

cards.audioText: Does your company provide dangerous goods transportation training? What have you learnt in the training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的公司是否提供危险物品运输培训吗？你在培训中学到了什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes, according to CAAC regulation, we should have dangerous cargo training every two years. In the training, we learn about dangerous goods. For example, risk, package, classification, and disposal procedures in case of leaking and contamination.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，根据民航总局规定，飞行员每两年要接受危险物品运输培训。在培训中，我们会学习危险物品相关内容，例如危险物品的风险、包装方法、类别和发生泄漏和污染时的处理程序。

cards.audioText: How do you think of the airport security check?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对机场安检有什么看法？
cards.referenceText: I think airport security check is very important to flight safety. Because large numbers of people pass through airports every day, this presents potential targets for terrorism and other forms of crime, so I think the security check cannot be too strict, and more work needs to be done to make people obey the aviation safety regulations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为机场安检对于飞行安全非常重要，因为机场每天有大量人群往来，为恐怖行为或其它犯罪提供潜在目标。所以我认为安检应尽可能严格，并且需要开展更多工作让人们遵守航空安全条例。

cards.audioText: Do you have such experience that dangerous goods are onboard?
cards.audioTextZh: 你经历过机上出现危险物品的情况吗？
cards.referenceText: Once two women and a child took some firecrackers onboard without being known. A flight attendant found the dangerous good in the halfway and reported to the captain at once. At last we landed at the nearest alternate airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经历过，有一次，两位女士和一名儿童在未被发现的情况下携带鞭炮上飞机，乘务员在半途中发现了危险物品并立刻报告机长，最后飞机在最近的备降机场降落了。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 13，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please make a brief description about the picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请对图片做简单描述。
cards.referenceText: In the left picture, the pilot is checking on the paper information before flight, and a ground staff is standing beside him, maybe she is waiting to make sure the pilot knows all the information. In the right picture, a Boeing 747 of United Airline is parking with its tail striking the ground. I think the aircraft is loading to prepare for departure because there are lots of vehicles around it. Maybe staff members made mistakes when calculating the datum which caused the center gravity of aircraft not to have been located correctly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左图中，飞行员正在做飞行检查。一名机场工作人员（地勤）正站在飞行员旁边，可能正在等待飞行员确认所有信息。右图中，一家美国航空的波音747正在停车，机尾触到地面。我认为这架飞机正在装货并准备出发，因为飞机四周有许多车辆。也许工作人员在计算基准时出现错误，导致飞机重心不稳。

cards.audioText: Do you think the preflight preparation is necessary?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为飞行前的准备有必要吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, it’s very important. Pilots should get acquainted with the aircraft, routes and the situation of destination airport. Besides, pilots should do some preparation for some possible emergency in order to keep a smooth flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为飞行前的准备非常重要。飞行员应该熟悉飞机、航线、目的地机场的状况。此外，为了保证飞行顺利，飞行员应该为可能发生的紧急情况做好准备。

cards.audioText: In the right picture, what part of the aircraft might be damaged?
cards.audioTextZh: 在右图中，飞机哪个部分可能被损坏？
cards.referenceText: The aft-apartment, tail and lower cargo compartment might be damaged seriously.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机后部、机尾、低层货舱可能会受到严重损坏。

cards.audioText: Who do you think made the error?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为是谁出现了失误？
cards.referenceText: I think loaders may not strictly follow the loading and unloading work flow to operate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为装卸工可能没有严格按照装卸货的工作流程来操作。

cards.audioText: What should the company do to avoid such kind of problem?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为航空公司可以怎样避免这类问题？
cards.referenceText: I think the company should establish loading and unloading procedure and provide corresponding training for ground workers to follow the procedure correctly and strictly. There also shall be a load master to monitor during operation. Maybe we can use tie-down equipment which is on nose gear of aircraft or tail stand to prevent this condition.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为航空公司应该建立装卸货的流程，并对地面工作人员进行培训，确保他们能够正确、严格地执行工作流程，同时在装卸货时需要有管理员来指挥。或者可以在飞机的前起落和尾部托架使用栓系设备来避免类似问题。

cards.audioText: Do you think this accident would happen to a passenger aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为类似事故是否可能在航线客机上发生？
cards.referenceText: Yes, because the cargo compartment is at the lower part of passenger aircraft, so similar accidents are possible if aircraft were loaded incorrectly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可能，因为客机的货仓在飞机的下部，如果装载位置不正确会发生类似的事情。

cards.audioText: Do you think weight and balance are important to flight safety? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为重量和平衡对飞行安全来说重要吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: They are important to our flight safety. Weight and balance affect the stability of the aircraft. To ensure the aircraft’s safety, both factors must fall within specified limits established by manufacturers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 非常重要，重量和平衡会影响飞机的稳定性。为了确保飞机的安全，制造商必须保证两个因素都符合相关规定。

cards.audioText: If an aircraft was loaded incorrectly, how would it affect flight control operations?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机被错误地装载，这会对飞机控制产生怎样的影响？
cards.referenceText: When the fore/aft center of gravity is out of range, the aircraft may pitch down or up which may cause a loss of control. The excessive pitch may occur in all phases of flight especially takeoff. On the other hand, if the maximum weight is exceeded, the aircraft may not likely to be controlled. Excessive takeoff weight may make it impossible to take off within available runway length, or the aircraft can’t even rotate. Excessive weight in flight may make climbing difficult or impossible, or it may make it impossible to maintain an altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞机的前/后重心超出范围，飞机可能会俯冲或上扬，从而导致飞机失控。过多的倾斜有可能发生在飞行的任何阶段，尤其是在起飞时。另一方面，如果超过了最大重量，飞机可能无法被操控。过大的起飞重量会使飞机无法在可用跑道长度内起飞，甚至无法抬前轮。在飞行中过大的重量会使爬升变得困难甚至失败，或者让飞机无法保持在某一高度。

cards.audioText: Is it going to be a problem for controlling the aircraft if all passengers are arranged in the forward part of the airplane? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果所有乘客都被安排在飞机前部，飞机的控制是否会出问题？为什么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. If CG locates too close to the forward part, it may be difficult for pilots to raise the nose during taking off, thus the aircraft may pitch down, which may cause a loss of control.
cards.referenceTextZh: 会有问题。如果中心太过于靠前，飞行员在起飞时会很难抬起机头，飞机可能会俯冲，这样会导致飞机失控。

cards.audioText: If you find that the aircraft landing weight exceeds the maximum limit, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你发现飞机的着陆重量超过了最大限制，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I will report ATC to apply for fuel burning or fuel dumping.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会向ATC报告，并申请燃烧燃料或放油。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 14，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What is shown in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 图中展示的是什么？
cards.referenceText: Two aircraft are parking on the apron/taxiway, and the wingtip of one aircraft collided with the rudder of the other aircraft. Many staff members are standing around the aircraft and waiting for trouble removal. It should be an accident of ground strike.
cards.referenceTextZh: 两架飞机正停在机坪/滑行道，一架飞机的翼尖与另一架飞机的方向舵相撞。许多工作人员正站在飞机四周等待事故处理。这是一起地面撞击事故。

cards.audioText: What probably caused the situation in your opinion?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为引发事故的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: In my opinion, on one hand, possibly the pilot was not concentrated when taxiing and did not notice the surrounding traffic. On the other hand, maybe the tower controllers made a mistake. They didn’t advise the crew of the potential collision.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我看来，一方面，可能是飞行员在滑行中不够专注，没有注意到周围的飞机。另一方面，可能是塔台管制员工作出现错误，没能提示机组潜在的相撞危机。

cards.audioText: How to avoid such kind of accident when taxiing?
cards.audioTextZh: 在滑行时怎样避免类似事故？
cards.referenceText: I think communication is important. We must establish good communication among pilots, controllers and ground staff during flight preparation and operation to avoid similar incidents. Besides, all of the aviation workers should focus on their own job, and being familiar with operational procedure is another important thing. As a pilot, we cannot be too careful in preflight preparation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为沟通很重要，在飞行准备阶段，飞行员、管制员和地面工作人员一定要沟通好，避免类似事故发生。此外，所有民航工作人员应专注于自己的工作，熟悉操作流程也非常重要。作为飞行员，我们在做飞行准备时越仔细越好。

cards.audioText: Has such accident ever happened in your company?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的公司曾经发生过这种事故吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, once a ground vehicle crashed into a plane because of the tiredness of the driver. When it occurred, the driver had been working at the airport for more than fifteen hours, so he was too fatigued to keep a sober mind at the critical moment. We have to conclude that, for flight safety, enough rest must be ensured for every airport personnel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发生过，有一次地面车辆与飞机相撞，因为司机疲劳驾驶。事故发生前司机已在机场连续工作15小时以上，所以在关键时刻没能保持清醒。不得不说，为保证飞行安全，机场工作人员必须保证足够的休息。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me how to use the rudder on an airplane?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能告诉我飞机的方向舵如何使用吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, of course. The rudder on an airplane must be used together with other controls to turn the aircraft and it controls lateral movement by deflecting air in one direction, and thereby oppositely pushing the tail. The rudder is one of the three basic control surfaces on a winged aircraft and it is generally operated by a pair of foot pedals.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。方向舵需要和其它操纵器共同使用，通过将空气引向一个方向从而相对推动机尾，以此控制横向运动。方向舵是有翼飞机上三个基本操纵面之一，通常由一对脚踏开关来操作。

cards.audioText: What about the ailerons? Are they used to turn the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 那么副翼呢？副翼的作用是让飞机转弯吗？
cards.referenceText: If ailerons are also used in conjunction, they will turn a conventional fixed wing aircraft much more quickly than the use of rudder alone. In addition, the ailerons are used to control the aircraft in roll.
cards.referenceTextZh: 副翼和方向舵协调工作时，传统固定翼飞机的速度会比只使用方向舵更快。此外，副翼能够在横滚时控制飞机。

cards.audioText: What do you know about the effect of wingtip devices on aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道翼尖小翼的作用是什么吗？
cards.referenceText: Wingtip devices are usually intended to improve the efficiency of fixed-wing aircraft. There are several types of wingtip devices, and the intended effect is always to reduce the aircraft’s drag by altering the airflow near the wingtips. They can also improve aircraft handling characteristics and enhance the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 翼尖小翼通常用来增强固定翼飞机的性能。翼尖小翼分为几种类型，但都是通过改变翼尖附近气流来减少飞机阻力。翼尖小翼同时可以加强飞机的操纵稳定性，提高飞行安全程度。

cards.audioText: What do you know about the wingtip design?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对翼尖的设计有什么了解？
cards.referenceText: Wingtip design usually includes navigation lights, anti-collision strobe lights, landing lights and identification markings. To some extent, wingtips can be an expression of aircraft design style, so their shape may be influenced by marketing considerations as well as by aerodynamic requirements.
cards.referenceTextZh: 翼尖的设计中包括导航灯、防撞闪光灯、着陆灯和识别标志。某种程度上，翼尖是飞机设计风格的体现，所以翼尖的形状受市场的影响，同时也要符合航空动力学的要求。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 15，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Could you please describe what is shown in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述图中展示的是什么吗？
cards.referenceText: According to this picture, I can see a shuttle bus has collided with the wingtip of a B727 which belongs to Mexican Airlines. The door of the shuttle bus is open and nobody is in it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据图片，我看到一辆摆渡车和一架墨西哥航空的波音727的翼尖相撞。摆渡车的前门打开，没有人在摆渡车内。

cards.audioText: According to your experience, what may cause the accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 根据你的经验，事故的原因可能是什么？
cards.referenceText: From my point of view, both the driver and the pilot all possibly made some errors and caused the accident. Maybe the driver of the shuttle bus was drunk or too tired, and he drove the bus too close to the aircraft and collided with its wingtip. On the other hand, maybe the pilot of this aircraft didn’t pay attention to the shuttle bus during turning or taxiing, thus the aircraft collided with it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从我的角度看，事故原因可能由于摆渡车司机和飞行员双方都出现了错误。摆渡车司机可能是醉酒驾车或疲劳驾驶，于是摆渡车离飞机太近从而相撞。另一方面，飞行员可能在转弯或滑行时没有注意到摆渡车，于是和摆渡车相撞。

cards.audioText: How to avoid such accident happening in your opinion?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为应该如何避免这类事故？
cards.referenceText: In my opinion, great efforts should be made by flight crew, ground staff members and relative departments together to avoid such accident happening. They should focus on their work cautiously and communicate with each other timely and effectively.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为，机组、地勤人员和相关部门应该共同努力以避免类似事故发生。三方在各自的工作中要专注，并能相互间及时有效地沟通。

cards.audioText: What do you know about B727? Could you say something about this type of aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对波音727有什么了解？你能介绍一下这种飞机吗？
cards.referenceText: B727 is a member of Boeing family. As far as I know, it has a T shape tail and three engines. One of the engines is mounted at the top of the tail cone.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，波音727是波音飞机中的一员。就我所知，波音727的尾翼为T字型并有三台发动机。其中一个发动机在飞机尾锥顶端。

cards.audioText: Could you please describe an abnormal case that you have encountered during taxiing?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一件滑行时遭遇过的异常情况吗？
cards.referenceText: Once we were taxiing following the ATC instruction, some debris was found at the intersection of two taxiways. I couldn’t go round it and had to wait until the taxiway was cleared.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。有一次我正按照ATC指令在滑行，在两条滑行道的交叉点发现了一些碎片。我无法从旁边绕开，所以只好等待滑行道清理完毕。

cards.audioText: As far as you know, what ground events often happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 就你所知，通常地面会发生哪些事故？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, ground events mainly involve bad weather or problems of runway and taxiway. For example, poor braking action led by slippery runway or taxiway, lighting system inoperative, working in progress adjacent to the runway, broken runway surface and so on, and these problems may lead to aborted takeoff, missed approach or delayed flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 就我所知，地面事故主要与恶劣天气或是滑行道、跑道的问题相关。例如，刹车效应差可能由以下原因导致：跑道和滑行道太滑、照明系统失效、临近跑道施工、跑道表面受损等。这些问题会引发中断起飞、进场失败或航班延误。

cards.audioText: Why is the shuttle bus required at an airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么机场内需要摆渡车？
cards.referenceText: Shuttle bus is a channel connecting airport terminal and the flight scheduled far in the designated parking area. It is used to transport passengers between terminal and the flight. At the airport, the shuttle bus is almost the largest mobile carrier except the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 摆渡车能够连接航站楼和距离航站楼较远的航班。它的作用是在飞机和航站楼间运送乘客。在机场，摆渡车几乎是除飞机外最大的移动载体。

cards.audioText: What should be paid more attention to when evacuating passengers in emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 在对乘客进行紧急疏散时应更加注意哪些因素？
cards.referenceText: The crew must be forceful in their use of commands to get passengers out of the aircraft. During the evacuation progress, cabin crew must grasp the exit assist handles and position themselves correctly in the assist space so that they can not be pushed out of the exit, and must not interfere with evacuating passengers. What’s more, it is necessary to maintain a balanced flow of passengers to all usable exits, minimizing the evacuation time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机组在对乘客进行指挥时态度要坚定。在疏散过程中，机组成员必须要抓紧出口扶手，保持在正确的位置上防止被推出出口外，并且不能干扰疏散的乘客们。还有就是要保证每个可用出口的人流量均衡，缩短疏散的时间。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 16，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Describe what is shown in the picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述图中展示的是什么。
cards.referenceText: The picture shows food onboard. The meals in the airplane are prepared by airline catering services.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图中展示的是飞机餐，飞机餐是由航空公司提供的餐饮服务。

cards.audioText: Can passengers bring food in the airplane?
cards.audioTextZh: 乘客可以将食物带入飞机吗？
cards.referenceText: Passengers can bring certain foods on an airplane, but not all are allowed. Because there is limitation on the size of the carry-on baggage, and the liquid quantity is also limited strictly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 乘客在飞机上可以携带某些食物，但并非所有食物都被允许带入飞机。因为随身行李的尺寸有限制，并且液体数量也有严格的限定。

cards.audioText: Do the captain and the co-pilot have the same food in the cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 机长和副驾驶的食物是否相同？
cards.referenceText: Yes, in our company we eat the same food in the cockpit. / No, the captain and the co-pilot in the same flight have different foods, or if they have the same food, they must stagger for one hour to have meals. Because if there is anything wrong with the food (toxic/rotting/expired/bad food), they may get sick in flight. It may lead to food poisoning, even pilot’s incapacitation, which will be a very dangerous situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 相同，我们公司驾驶舱内的食物是相同的。/ 不同，机长和副驾驶会食用不同的食物。或者如果机长和副驾驶食用相同的食物，两人需要间隔1小时用餐，因为如果食物有问题（有毒/腐坏/过期/变质），他们可能在飞行途中生病。有可能导致食物中毒，甚至飞行员失能，这种情况非常危险。

cards.audioText: What are symptoms of food poisoning?
cards.audioTextZh: 食物中毒的症状有哪些？
cards.referenceText: Common case of food poisoning usually includes the following symptoms: abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, mild fever, weakness, nausea, headaches, etc.
cards.referenceTextZh: 食物中毒的常见症状如下：腹痛、腹泻、呕吐，低烧、乏力、恶心和头疼等。

cards.audioText: Supposing the passenger food poisoning occurs in your flight, as a pilot, what will you perform?
cards.audioTextZh: 假设你的航班中发生乘客食物中毒，作为飞行员，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Firstly, I need to make sure if the condition is serious and hard to handle. I will ask flight attendants to look after the passengers and give them basic medical assistance. At the same time, cabin crew will make a PA to find if there are doctors on board. If there is no doctor on board, we need to collect the sick passenger's excreta or vomit for further check. If it's serious, I must contact ATC to request a diversion to the nearest suitable airport and provide the passengers medical treatment as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh:
首先我需要确认情况的严重性，是否难以处理。我会让乘务员照顾乘客并给乘
基本的医疗救助。乘务员会广播找医生，如果飞机上没有医生，要把旅客的呕吐物以及排
物保存好以便下机以后提供检查。如果情况严重，我就必须联系ATC并要求改航至适合的最近的机场，并尽快为乘客提供治疗。

cards.audioText: If you have a flight tomorrow, what would you like to eat?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果明天你有飞行任务，你会吃哪种食物？
cards.referenceText: If I have a flight tomorrow, I will eat something light and fresh, such as porridge, vegetables, fruits, cereals and so on, for fear that I feel unwell in flight due to bad food.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果明天我有飞行任务，我会选择低热量、新鲜的食物，例如粥、蔬菜、水果、谷物等，防止因食物问题在飞行时感到不舒服。

cards.audioText: What do you think of the food safety in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对飞机上的食物安全怎么看？
cards.referenceText: I think the food safety is one of the most important things to be ensured. Airlines should always make sure the food provided is safe and clean. At the same time, relevant medical measures need to be well prepared.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为确保食品安全是最重要的事情之一。航空公司一定要确保提供的食品是安全干净的，同时相关医疗措施要准备好。

cards.audioText: What can cause a pilot to lose his ability to fly the airplane? What’s the most serious situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在飞行途中失能的原因是什么？最危险的情况是什么？
cards.referenceText: I suppose if a pilot feels increasingly fatigued, shaky and nauseous, he may fall in a dead faint and lose ability, that is incapacitation, such condition can cause a pilot to lose his capability to fly or control the airplane. If the pilot in command is incapacitated and no one is clearly aware of the circumstances, the situation will become most serious, because the aircraft may lose control and it would be a disaster.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果一个飞行员感到越来越疲乏、虚弱和恶心，他可能会昏迷并在飞行途中失能，这种情况会让飞行员无法控制飞机。如果机长失能，没有其他人清楚当时的飞行情况，这是最危险的，因为飞机无人控制，可能会引发一场灾难。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 17，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What is happening in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 图中发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: In the picture, I can see widespread flight delays displayed on the terminal screen. A passenger is standing in front of the screen and making a phone call. Maybe he is telling someone about the flight delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图中可以看到机场屏幕正在显示大规模的航班延误，一名乘客正站在屏幕前打电话，也许他正在通知别人航班延误的情况。

cards.audioText: What are the causes of flight delays?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为航班延误的原因有哪些？
cards.referenceText: As far as I'm concerned, flight delays can be caused by many reasons, such as extreme weather, like tornado, hurricane, or blizzard, maintenance problems with the aircraft, fueling problem, military activities, airline glitches and congestion in air traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh: 就我所知，许多因素都会引发航班延误，比如极端天气，例如龙卷风、飓风、暴风雪，飞机维护问题、燃油问题、军事活动、飞机故障和空中交通拥挤。

cards.audioText: How often do flight delays happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 航班延误是否会经常发生？
cards.referenceText: Flight delays happen quite frequently. The occurrence is common due to bad weather conditions and mechanical or maintenance reasons.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航班延误经常发生，通常在天气状况差和存在机械或维护原因时发生。

cards.audioText: As a captain, what will you do when the flight delay happens?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，发生航班延误时你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Flight delay is the last thing we want to meet. However, when it happens, we need to face it actively and give passengers our most sincere and patient services. As a captain, I will first be calm and make an announcement to let passengers know the reasons and situations we are facing, and offer them the most caring services and greetings. At the same time, I will try my best to solve the problems as soon as possible to diminish the losses of flight delay.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航班延误是我们最不愿遇到的事情，但是当延误发生时，我们需要积极面对，为乘客提供最诚挚和耐心的服务。作为机长，我会首先冷静下来，通知乘客航班延误的原因和我们正面临的情况，为乘客提供最贴心的服务和问候。同时，我会尽全力尽快解决问题，以弥补航班延误带来的损失。

cards.audioText: Do you have good measures to avoid flight delays?
cards.audioTextZh: 有什么好的措施可以避免航班延误？
cards.referenceText: I think the airline, airport and air traffic control should strengthen cooperation. No matter what causes a delay, the three departments shall obtain the latest information at first time, and inform the passengers the delay information timely. The airline shall well arrange the boarding of passengers. The airport should offer available services and ATC should arrange the slot time earlier if passengers have boarded, so as to reduce passengers' wait time on board.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为航空公司、机场和空中交通管制需要加强合作，不管导致延误的原因是什么，三方都可以在第一时间获得最新消息，并及时通知乘客延误相关的信息。航班公司应合理安排乘客登机，机场应提供更好的服务，ATC对乘客已登机的航班应更早安排离场，减少乘客在机上的等待时间。

cards.audioText: In order to reduce the flight delay and protect the interest of passenger, the CAAC promulgated Compensatory Guide Advice of Flight Delay in 2004. How do you see it? Do you think airlines are responsible to compensate due to flight delay?
cards.audioTextZh: 为减少航班延误，保护乘客的利益，中国民航总局在2004年颁布了《航班延误经济补偿指导意见》，你对此怎么看？你认为航班公司应该为航班延误负责并对乘客进行赔偿吗？
cards.referenceText: I think official regulations of flight delay are necessary. Now in China, different airlines have different compensation standards. As to flight delay, most causes are abnormal weather conditions. I think in these cases, airlines have no responsibility for compensation. While if flight delay is caused by airlines themselves, such as mechanical failure, traffic control, etc., I consider the airlines should take the responsibilities for compensation. However, for whatever reasons, airlines have duty to reduce the loss of flight delay for both sides and make announcement about the reasons of the flight delay and give passengers the most caring comfort, so as to promote the communication between airlines and passengers.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为颁布与航班延误相关的官方规定很有必要。如今国内各家航空公司都有不同的赔偿标准。大多数的航班延误是由于反常天气，我认为在这种情况下，航班公司没有责任进行赔偿。但是如果航班延误是由于航空公司自己的原因，例如机械故障和交通管制等，我认为航空公司应该进行赔偿。然而不管是什么原因，航空公司都有责任尽力减少航班延误为双方带来的损失，公告航班延误的原因，给乘客提供贴心的服务，以便促进航空公司和乘客间的交流。

cards.audioText: Do you know any relative measures airlines take to avoid the flight delay?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对航空公司为避免航班延误的相关措施有什么了解？
cards.referenceText: As much as I know, Air China has introduced three measures to avoid the flight delay: arranging backup aircraft, storing common aviation materials, and improving the maintenance quality and processes efficiency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 就我所知，国航有三种避免航班延误的措施：准备预备机、储备常用航空材料、提高维修质量和流程效率。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 18，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Could you please make a brief description about the top picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 请问你可以对上图进行简单描述吗？
cards.referenceText: This picture shows the situation about a four-engine aircraft which is taking off. It has produced strong wake turbulence. There is a rotation point on the runway. There are two parallel runways in this picture. The distance between the centerline of the two runways is less than 760m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上图展示的是四引擎飞机起飞时的情况。飞机产生了很强的尾流涡流。跑道中的是旋转点。图中有两条平行跑道，两条跑道的中心线距离小于760米。

cards.audioText: According to the picture, could you please explain what is wake turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 根据图片，你能够解释什么是尾流涡流吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Wake turbulence is used to describe the effect of the rotating air masses generated behind the wingtips of an aircraft, just like what the bottom picture shows.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，尾流涡流形容的是飞机翼尖后产生的旋转气团，正如第二张图所示。

cards.audioText: When would you need to avoid wake turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么情况下需要避免尾流涡流？
cards.referenceText: I need to avoid this situation in many circumstances, especially when there is a heavy aircraft taking off ahead of me. During cruise and landing, I also need to avoid wake turbulence if there are heavy aircraft nearby.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在很多情况下需要避免这种情况，尤其是在我之前有重型飞机起飞时。在巡航和着陆过程中，如果附近有重型飞机同样需要避免飞机尾流。

cards.audioText: How to avoid wake turbulence if the aircraft were climbing or cruising?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机在爬升或巡航阶段应怎样避免飞机尾流？
cards.referenceText: My climb profile should be above the profile of previous aircraft. As for cruising, I must keep enough distance from other aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升时，飞机的爬升剖面要高于之前的飞机。巡航时，必须要和其他飞机保持足够的距离。

cards.audioText: As the picture shows, if the taking off aircraft is a B747, you are the captain of a B737 which is going to take off on the other runway, what would you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如图所示，如果正在起飞的飞机是波音747，你是另一条跑道上正准备起飞的波音737的机长，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I will keep two minutes’ separation with B747, because the two parallel runways are separated by less than 760m, the minimum takeoff separation is two minutes to avoid wake turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会和波音747保持两分钟的间隔，因为两条平行跑道的中心线距离小于760米，所以最小起飞间隔为两分钟来避免尾流涡流。

cards.audioText: Is there criterion for an aircraft that can be called a heavy aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 重型飞机是否有一定标准？
cards.referenceText: Yes, there is. If the maximum certificated takeoff mass of aircraft type is more than 136,000kg, it is a heavy aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有标准，最大起飞重量在136000千克以上的飞机为重型飞机。

cards.audioText: Besides wake turbulence, what other turbulence does a flight possibly meet during flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 除了飞机尾流，飞机在飞行时还可能遇到哪些湍流？
cards.referenceText: The flight may meet kinds of turbulence like clear air turbulence, or turbulence caused by bad weather and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机可能遇到各种湍流，例如晴空湍流或由恶劣天气引发的湍流等。

cards.audioText: What does a pilot usually do in case of turbulence during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在飞行时遇到湍流通常会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: It depends on the intensity of turbulence. If it is a light turbulence, I would maintain present heading and altitude of flight. If it is a medium or heavy turbulence, I would report the situation to ATC and request to change the altitude and heading if necessary. No matter what kind of turbulence we’re experiencing, I would advise passengers to fasten the harnesses for consideration of safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这取决于湍流的强度。如果遭遇弱湍流，我会保持当前的航向和高度。如果遭遇严重的湍流，我会将情况报告给ATC，并且在有必要时请求改变高度和航向。不管遇到哪种湍流，考虑到安全因素，我都会建议乘客系紧安全带。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 19，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please say something about the pictures.
cards.audioTextZh: 请对图片进行一些描述。
cards.referenceText: In the left picture, there is a large aircraft with four turboprop engines cruising over mountains, and the right picture shows the movement principle of the air over mountains, which causes turbulence of the aircraft. A flight is cruising over mountains and it is crossing invisible bodies of air which are moving vertically at many different speeds.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。左图里，一架有四个涡轮螺旋桨发动机的大型飞机正在山上巡航。右图展示的是山顶空气的运动规律，这会引发湍流。飞机正在山顶巡航，并穿过在不同速度下垂直运动的不可见空气。

cards.audioText: What may happen when the aircraft fly over mountains?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在飞过山顶时可能会发生什么？
cards.referenceText: They may experience mountain wave turbulence while flying over mountains, where air passes over mountains and causes turbulence as it flows above the air on the other side.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机在飞过山顶时可能会遭遇地形波湍流，当空气从山的另一边刮过，空气经过山顶引起地形波湍流。

cards.audioText: Can you explain mountain wave turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能够解释地形波湍流吗？
cards.referenceText: Mountain wave turbulence is a type of clear air turbulence (CAT), and the wavelike effect is characterized by updrafts and downdrafts occurring above and downwind from a mountain range when rapidly flowing air encounters the mountain range’s steep front.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，地形波湍流是晴空湍流其中的一种。地形波效应的特点是当快速流动的空气遭遇山脉陡峭的前沿时，山脉上方和顺风处出现上升气流和下沉气流。

cards.audioText: How do you know clear air turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对晴空湍流有什么了解？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, firstly, it usually cannot be foreseen or detected by aircraft radars so there is no warning. Secondly, it is usually felt at its mildest in the flight deck and is generally severer in the after section. Thirdly, it can occur when no clouds are visible. Lastly, it is common at high altitudes, where cruising airliner may suddenly enter turbulent areas.
cards.referenceTextZh: 就我所知，第一，晴空湍流通常无法被预测或被雷达探测到，所以晴空湍流没有预警。第二，驾驶舱能感受到晴空湍流时，湍流最温和，通常在尾部非常剧烈。第三，晴空湍流可以在没有云可见时出现。最后，晴空湍流通常发生在高海拔地区，巡航的飞机可能会突然进入湍流区域。

cards.audioText: What will you do if you encounter clear air turbulence during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在飞行时遭遇晴空湍流，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I would follow the aircraft turbulence procedure, avoid abrupt control inputs, and ensure that passengers and cabin crew are seated with their seat belts fastened. I would report the turbulence to ATC and coordinate any necessary change of level or route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会执行本机型的颠簸程序，避免突然操纵，并确保旅客和客舱乘务员就座、系好安全带。我会向空管报告颠簸，并协调必要的高度或航路调整。

cards.audioText: Why can clear air turbulence not be detected by radar?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么晴空湍流无法被雷达探测到？
cards.referenceText: Turbulence associated with clouds and thunderstorms can be displayed on the airplane’s radar screen because the movement of water droplets can be detected by radar waves, and moving droplets mean moving air masses which mean turbulence. Clear air turbulence, by definition, has neither visual phenomenon associated with it, nor any water droplets, so it is invisible to be detected by radar.
cards.referenceTextZh: 因为雷达波能探测到水滴的运动，所以与云和雷暴相关的湍流能被雷达探测到。水滴运动意味着移动的气团，相当于湍流。晴空湍流，顾名思义，既没有相关的视觉现象，也没有任何水滴运动，所以无法被雷达探测到。

cards.audioText: Is turbulence totally undetected? If not, do you know some techniques to detect it?
cards.audioTextZh: 湍流是否完全无法被探测到？如果不是，你知道哪些能够探测到湍流的技术？
cards.referenceText: No, as far as I know, it can be remotely detected with instruments that can measure turbulence with optical techniques, such as scintillometers or Doppler LIDARs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不是，湍流可以被利用光学技术的仪器远距离探测到，例如激光闪烁仪或多普勒激光雷达。

cards.audioText: Can you specify the notion of turbulence in aviation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能够详细解释航空中湍流的概念吗？
cards.referenceText: Turbulence is air movement that normally cannot be seen. It may unexpectedly occur when the sky appears to be clear, and it can be created by some different conditions, including atmospheric pressures, jet streams, mountain waves, cold or warm fronts, or thunderstorms.
cards.referenceTextZh: 湍流是通常不可见的空气流动。天晴时湍流可能会意外出现，它也会因为一些特殊情况出现，包括大气压力、喷流、地形波、冷风或暖风，或雷暴。

cards.audioText: What routes you have flown are more difficult than others?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过的航路中有哪些更难飞？
cards.referenceText: I think routes flying to Kunming or Dalian are more difficult. We usually have to deal with the high-altitude airfield and heavy season-wind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 让我想想，我认为从昆明到大连的航线比较难飞。通常必须要处理高海拔机场和强烈季风的问题。

cards.audioText: Is the clear air turbulence easy to avoid? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 晴空湍流容易避免吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText: No, I don’t think so, because clear air turbulence can be detected neither with the naked eyes nor with conventional radar, so it is difficult to avoid
cards.referenceTextZh: 不容易避免，因为晴空湍流既不能被肉眼发现也不能被常规雷达探测到，所以很难避免。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 20，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能在图中看到什么？
cards.referenceText: In this picture, I can see that a light aircraft with a small high wing has crashed into a truck driving along the country road in the mountain area. Two people are running away from this accident spot.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在图中，我看到一架上单翼轻型飞机在山区撞向了一辆沿路驾驶的卡车。两个人正逃离事故地点。

cards.audioText: In your opinion, what may cause the accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你看来，引发事故的原因可能是什么？
cards.referenceText: Since this is in the mountain area where convective weather is common, the accident might have something to do with wind shear, which could make aircraft lose altitude rapidly. If flying at a low altitude, the pilot might not have enough time and space to recover from the downdraft, thus the plane went out of control and hit the truck.
cards.referenceTextZh: 事故发生在对流天气很常见的山区，可能与风切变相关，风切变会让飞机快速下降。如果飞机在低空飞行，可能没有足够的时间和空间从下降气流中改出，飞机从而失去控制并撞向卡车。

cards.audioText: Is it because of the pilot's error or just an unfortunate event?
cards.audioTextZh: 事故是由于飞行员的失误，或只是个不幸的事件？
cards.referenceText: If he were a well trained and experienced pilot, he would have taken the necessary precautions before he flew into the mountain area. He would consider the minimum safety altitude, the notice in the mountain area, and whether he had enough preparation. Anyway, this is an unfortunate event. Sometimes accidents are simply unavoidable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞行员受过良好训练，经验丰富，他在飞入山区前会采取必要的预防措施。比如山区的最低飞行安全高度，在山区飞行的注意事项，飞行之前对该飞行区域是否有足够的认识和准备；不论如何这是个不幸的事件，有时意外是不可避免的。

cards.audioText: If you encounter the engine failure during flight, what would you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在飞行中遭遇发动机故障，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If I encounter the engine failure, I will verify the situation first. Then I need to judge whether descent is needed according to aircraft performance and the route. After that I will tell my intention to ATC and do the checklist again to ensure the flight safety. If there are emergency situations, I would declare emergency or distress and tell the cabin crew to prepare for the situation. Pilots should also prepare for the alternate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到发动机失效，首先要判断情况属实与否，其次要根据飞机性能和当前航线的情况做出是否下降高度并通知管制员相关决策，再次执行检查单，隔离故障保障飞机安全。如果遇到紧急情况，需要宣布紧急或者遇险信号，通知客舱做好相应的应急准备。飞行员自己要做好相应的备降准备。

cards.audioText: Can you say some differences between high-wing aircraft and low-wing aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能说出上单翼飞机和下单翼飞机有什么区别吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. As far as I know, they have different fuel pumping systems. High-wing aircraft use gravity to drain the fuel to the engine, while for the low-wing aircraft, fuel is pumped to the engine. Low-wing aircraft have better field performance compare with high-wing aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。据我所知，两种飞机的燃料输送系统不同。上单翼飞机依靠重力将燃料排送到引擎，但下单翼飞机是用泵将燃料抽送到引擎。下单翼飞机的起降性能要优于上单翼飞机。

cards.audioText: Do you think high-wing aircraft is more stable than low-wing aircraft? Why or why not?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为上单翼飞机是否比下单翼飞机更稳定？为什么/为什么不？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I think so. A high-wing airplane design contributes to the lateral stability, whereas a low-wing placement has a destabilizing effect in roll. However, this effect may be counteracted by including more dihedral to improve the overall lateral stability.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为上单翼更加稳定。上单翼飞机的设计有助于横向稳定性，下单翼飞机的配置使飞机在横滚时不稳定。然而，这种不稳定可以由反角抵消，从而提高飞机整体的横向稳定性。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 21，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 在图中你能看到什么？
cards.referenceText: I can see that an airplane is surrounded by a flock of birds in the sky. Its landing gears are extended, so I guess the aircraft encounters bird strike when landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我看到一架飞机在空中被一群鸟包围，飞机已经放下起落架，所以我认为这架飞机是在降落时遭遇了鸟击。

cards.audioText: If you were the captain of the aircraft, what should you do under this situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你是这架飞机的机长，这种情况你应该做什么？
cards.referenceText: If I were the captain, I would advise ATC the situation and request priority landing, because such bird risk may cause the engine to flame out or be on fire and that would be a great threat to the flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我是机长，我会将情况报告给ATC并请求优先降落，因为鸟击可能会使发动机着火，对飞行安全构成严重威胁。

cards.audioText: When does bird strike occur commonly?
cards.audioTextZh: 鸟击通常在飞行的哪些阶段发生？
cards.referenceText: Bird strike happens most often during takeoff or landing, or during low altitude flight. However, bird strike also happens at high altitudes, as high as 6000ft to 9000ft above the ground.
cards.referenceTextZh: 大部分的鸟击发生在起飞、降落，或低空飞行时。此外，鸟击同样也可能高空发生，在距离地面6000英尺至9000英尺的高空。

cards.audioText: What damages can be caused by a bird strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 鸟击将会有什么样的危害？
cards.referenceText: The birds may hit the windshield or the fuselage, but the main damage is bird ingestion. It may result in the engine shut down or damage to fan blades. Besides, the engine may totally lost, or the nose cowl can be torn from the nacelle and the fan cowling may be damaged.
cards.referenceTextZh: 鸟会撞在挡风玻璃或机身上，但最主要的危害是鸟被吸入发动机。这可能会导致发动机关闭或是风扇叶片受损。此外，发动机可能会完全失效，前整流罩会从发动机短舱脱落，风扇罩会受到损坏。

cards.audioText: A flight encounters bird flock on its takeoff run, what probably would happen? If you were the captain, what would you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在起飞滑行时遭遇鸟击可能会发生什么？如果你是机长你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: In that case, the aircraft may ingest some birds in the engine, and the aborted takeoff with high-speed could result in flat tires. Besides, the engine may be a total loss. If I were the captain, I would abort takeoff immediately.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这种情况下，飞机发动机可能会吸入一些鸟，高速时中断起飞会导致轮胎漏气。此外，发动机可能会完全失效。如果我是机长，我会立刻中断起飞。

cards.audioText: What is the further damage of bird hazard?
cards.audioTextZh: 鸟击还有产生哪些进一步危害？
cards.referenceText: Damage from bird hazard is not limited to destruction of aircraft or persons on board. In many instances, the aircraft may crash into either a busy highway or occupied buildings. Even if no injuries or fatalities occur, the financial liability for damage to structures or vehicles on the ground can be tremendous.
cards.referenceTextZh: 鸟击的危害不仅限于对飞机和机上乘客的伤害。在许多情况下，飞机会冲向繁忙的公路或在使用中的建筑。即使没有发生受伤或死亡，因建筑物或地面上车辆受损害而导致的经济损失也是巨大的。

cards.audioText: Have you ever experienced bird strike or have you heard of such accidents before?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾遭遇过鸟击吗？或者你听说过这类事故吗？
cards.referenceText: I'm very lucky without encountering bird strike since I have been a pilot, but I have heard that in 2000, a B747 struck a flock of geese during takeoff run at Philadelphia International Airport. The B747 ingested one bird in the No.1 engine, and the high-speed aborted takeoff resulted in nine flat tires. The engine was a total loss, and the repair cost was very expensive.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我很幸运，作为一名飞行员，从未遭遇过鸟击。但是我听说过费城国际机场在2000年发生的事故，一架波音747在起飞滑行时遇到一群大雁。波音747的1号发动机吸入一只鸟，高速时中断起飞导致9个轮胎漏气。发动机完全失效，修理费用非常昂贵。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 22，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Describe what you can see from the picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述你在这张图中可以看到什么。
cards.referenceText: In this picture, there is wreckage of aircraft operated by Turkish Airlines. It is broken into two parts on the ground and the forward cabin door is open. I can see many rescuing people, ambulance, and fire trucks around this aircraft. It seems that they are trying to rescue the survivors.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图中是土耳其航空一架飞机的残骸，飞机在地面断成两部分，机舱前门开着。飞机周围能看到很多救援人员、救护车和消防车，看起来他们正在试图营救幸存者。

cards.audioText: What were the possible causes of the accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 事故发生的原因可能是什么？
cards.referenceText: Maybe they encountered low visibility when landing, or maybe the aircraft had suffered power failure, and the pilots tried to make a forced landing, but finally it turned out to be a failed landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可能是飞机降落时的能见度低，或是飞机的电源出现故障，于是飞行员试图紧急迫降，但最后迫降失败。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you were the captain?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你是机长你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If I were the captain of the airplane, I would try to control the airplane and make a suitable emergency landing. If we were forced to land at a town, I would try to find a spacious area if possible. After landing, we would execute emergency evacuation immediately.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我是这架飞机的机长，我会试图控制飞机的控制并在合适范围内紧急迫降。如果不得不在城镇迫降，我会尽量选择宽阔的地区。迫降后，我们会立刻实施紧急撤离。

cards.audioText: What assistance could ATC provide for you in this case?
cards.audioTextZh: 在这种情况下ATC能够提供什么援助？
cards.referenceText: ATC can help us to make an emergency landing by providing current weather and relative airport information. ATC can also help with some emergency service such as fire trucks, first aid, and ambulances.
cards.referenceTextZh: ATC可以提供当前天气情况和相关的机场信息，帮助完成紧急迫降。同时ATC也可以提供应急服务，例如消防车、急救和救护车。

cards.audioText: If passengers are all scared, what would you do to help the cabin flight attendants to execute emergency evacuation smoothly?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果乘客们都非常害怕，你会怎样帮助乘务员来让乘客顺利进行紧急疏散？
cards.referenceText: Well, I think it is very natural that passengers feel scared at that moment. As a pilot, I think it’s my responsibility to support our cabin crew to make a smooth evacuation. I would make a PA to ask passengers to be calm and follow the instruction of our cabin crew. It will maximize the chances of survival. I would also tell the passengers to be confident and our flight crews are very professional and well trained in this respect.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为在这种情况下，乘客感到害怕很正常。作为飞行员，我认为我有责任帮助机组成员，让乘客顺利撤离。我会通过广播系统让乘客们保持冷静，听从机组成员的指挥，这会让乘客的生存几率最大化。我还会告诉乘客们要信任机组成员，因为机组成员在这方面经受过专业训练，非常专业。

cards.audioText: Under what situations should a forced landing be made?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么情况下要进行紧急迫降？
cards.referenceText: A forced landing is made under factors out of the pilot’s control, such as engine failure, components trouble or harsh weather, which make continued flight impossible. However, the term also means a landing that has been forced by interception.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当出现飞行员无法控制的情况时需要紧急迫降，例如引擎故障、零件问题或恶劣天气，这些情况下飞机无法继续飞行。此外，紧急迫降也指飞机被拦截后降落。

cards.audioText: What do you think is the suitable spot to make a forced landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为合适的迫降地点是什么样的？
cards.referenceText: A suitable landing spot within the aircraft’s gliding distance is important for the forced landing. If such a spot is available, an unplanned landing will often be safe. Light aircraft can often land safely on fields, roads, or on the water, but medium and heavy aircraft generally require long, prepared runway surfaces because of their heavy weight and high landing speeds.
cards.referenceTextZh: 对于紧急迫降来说，迫降地点有足够的滑行距离非常重要。如果可以找到这样的地点，计划外的着陆通常是安全的。轻型飞机通常能够安全降落在田地、马路或水上，但是由于重量和高速着陆，中型和重型飞机通常需要很长的专用跑道。

cards.audioText: What do you know about different types of emergency landings?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对紧急迫降的类型有什么了解？
cards.referenceText: There are several different types of emergency landings, including forced landing, precautionary landing, crash landing and ditching.
cards.referenceTextZh: 紧急迫降分为几种不同类型，其中包含：迫陆、预防性着陆、摔机着陆和水上迫降。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 23，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Look at pictures, please say something about what you can see.
cards.audioTextZh: 请看图片并描述你在图中看到了什么。
cards.referenceText: From the picture on the left, I can see an engine on the ground. There are some plastic materials in the engine’s air intake, and it should be a foreign object damage (FOD). As for the right picture, the cowl of the engine is opened. Maybe it is under mechanical repairs.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在左图中，我看到地面上有一个发动机，发动机的进气口有一些塑料材料，发动机受到异物损伤。右图中，发动机罩被打开，飞机可能正在接受机械修理。

cards.audioText: What damage did the engine have in the left picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 左图中的发动机受到了怎样的损害？
cards.referenceText: The plastic wrap will be ingested into the engine instantly through the turbine. The pieces of the plastic wrap will block the airway in the engine and will cause the engine overheat.
cards.referenceTextZh: 塑料膜会通过涡轮被立刻吸入发动机，塑料碎片会堵住发动机的通风孔，导致发动机过热。

cards.audioText: What's the danger if the aircraft engine ingested foreign objects?
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机吸入异物将会有什么危险？
cards.referenceText: During start-up, foreign objects may be ingested into the engines and damage the compressors, rotors and even other parts of the power plant. This may cause engine overheated, engine failure, engine fire or other damage, so foreign objects in the air intake are very dangerous to aircraft engines, and we should have a careful check of the air intake in the preflight preparation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在启动时，异物可能会被吸入发动机，损坏压缩机、发动机转子，甚至是动力装置的其它部分。这会导致发动机过热、发动机故障、发动机着火或其它损害。所以进气口的异物对发动机来说非常危险，在飞行前应对飞机进气口进行仔细的检查。

cards.audioText: If the engine ingested foreign objects during taxi, what would you do as a captain?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在滑行时发动机吸入异物，作为机长你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: In this case, I would shut down the damaged engine and report to ATC. I would ask for fire services if necessary. Then I would taxi to the apron with the power of another engine. At the same time, I should tell our company to cancel this flight or change to another aircraft to complete this flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在这种情况下，我会将损坏的发动机关闭并将情况报告给ATC，如有必要我会请求消防设施。然后我会用另一个发动机的动力滑行回停机坪，同时我会通知公司取消航班或换另一架飞机来完成航班。

cards.audioText: Have you heard of any accident caused by foreign objects ingested into the engine?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾经听说过哪些发动机吸入异物导致的事故？
cards.referenceText: I heard that once a Boeing 737 encountered heavy hail when landing. The pilot failed to avoid the storm because of massive precipitation. Due to hail ingestion, both engines experienced a simultaneous complete power loss following a thrust roll-back. To make things worse, it also failed to use the auxiliary power unit (APU) to relight both engines. Whereafter the pilot shut down both engines and prepared for an emergency landing. Fortunately, they finally made a successful off-airport landing on a levee and there were no injuries.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我听说过曾经一架波音737-300在着陆时遭遇强冰雹，由于降水量大飞行员无法避开风暴。飞机的两个发动机因为吸入冰雹同时停止运作。更糟的是，飞机的发动机无法通过辅助动力装置再次启动。随后飞行员选择关掉发动机并准备紧急迫降。幸运的是，最后飞机成功地降落在码头并且无人受伤。

cards.audioText: What can you do to avoid foreign objects being ingested into the engine before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行前怎样做可以避免发动机吸入异物？
cards.referenceText: Besides making good preflight inspection, we should pay more attention to the outside conditions while taxiing. If we find any debris or foreign objects on the taxiways or runways, we must stop taxiing or reject takeoff, and report the situation to ATC.
cards.referenceTextZh: 除了做好飞行前的检查，飞行员应该在飞机滑行时多关注飞机外面的情况。如果在滑行道或跑道上发现任何碎片或异物，则必须要停止滑行或中断起飞，然后将情况报告给ATC。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me the function of aircraft engine and the importance of engine check?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能说一说飞机发动机的功能和发动机检查的重要性吗？
cards.referenceText: Engine is a core component of the aircraft. It generates mechanical power to provide thrust allowing the plane to fly, so engine check in preflight inspection is very important. If there are foreign objects (ice, rubbish, waste plastics, damaged parts, etc.) in the air inlet, it may be ingested into the engines during engine start, and this may cause engine vibration, engine failure and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发动机是飞机的核心组件，发动机产生的动力为飞机飞行提供推力。所以飞行前对发动机的检查非常重要，如果有异物（冰、垃圾、塑料废弃物、损坏零件等）在发动机入口，那么异物可能在启动时被吸入发动机。这会导致发动机振动，发动机故障或其它问题。

cards.audioText: What procedures does your company have to deal with one engine failure?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的公司在处理单发失效时有什么流程？
cards.referenceText: First, contact ATC and state the problem. Then, for twin-engine plane, we must find the nearest airport to land or return to the departure airport. For single-engine plane, we must request for emergency landing, notify ATC, then cooperate with the rest crew members for passenger safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，联系ATC并报告问题。然后，对于双引擎飞机，必须找到最近的机场降落或是回到出发的机场。对于单引擎飞机，必须要请求紧急迫降，通知ATC，并和其他工作人员合作确保乘客的安全。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 24，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you describe what is happening in this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述图中正在发生什么吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. The picture is taken in the vicinity of the airport. We can see a Concorde taking off, there’s heavy flame and dense smoke coming from the rear belly of the aircraft. The landing gear is still down.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，这张照片拍摄于机场附近。图中可以看到一架协和飞机正在起飞，飞机后腹部有火焰和浓烟。因为飞机起落架仍是放下状态。

cards.audioText: Can you guess what possibly caused the accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能设想这起事故可能是由什么原因引发的吗？
cards.referenceText: I know this accident. Concorde, the supersonic aircraft with delta wings was on fire shortly after takeoff. It was grounded after this accident. The official reason which had been reported was that a strip of metal lying on the runway caused a tire on the left main gear to burst, and the resulting explosion ignited fuel in the left wing tank.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我知道这起事故。一架协和飞机，有三角机翼的超音速飞机，起飞后很快地起火了。事故发生后飞机停飞，官方报道的事故原因是跑道上的一条金属引发左边的主起落架轮胎爆胎，爆胎引起的爆炸点燃了左机翼油箱的燃料。

cards.audioText: What’s supersonic aircraft? Is B787 a supersonic aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是超音速飞机？波音787是超音速飞机吗？
cards.referenceText: No, B787 isn’t supersonic aircraft. A supersonic aircraft is an aircraft able to fly faster than the speed of sound. As far as I know, the Concorde is the only supersonic aircraft in commercial operation, but it is grounded now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，波音787不是超音速飞机。超音速飞机是指速度能够高于音速的飞机。就我所知，目前的商业运作中只有协和机型是超音速飞机，现在已经停飞了。

cards.audioText: Based on your knowledge, do you think there are some other reasons that could cause the crash possibly?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你的知识基础上，你认为是否还有其它原因可能引发这种事故？
cards.referenceText: Yes. It is possible that a design fault could lead to the crash. Maybe part of the landing gear pierces the tire and the resulting explosion ignites the fuel tank. Besides, parts of the failed engine entering the fuel tank and starting the initial fire may be a possible reason, too.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有，设计上的错误可能也会引发事故。可能是主起落架的一部分刺入轮胎引发的爆炸点燃了油箱。此外，也可能是因为故障发动机的一部分进入油箱并引发初期火灾。

cards.audioText: If you were the captain on board, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你是飞机的机长，你应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If I were the captain, I would stop the aircraft on the runway when the runway is long enough. Then I would declare an emergency, finish the checklist if necessary and evacuate as soon as possible. When the runway is not long enough, I would climb to optimum altitude, then land at nearest airport or return to the runway, at the same time I would declare emergency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我是这架飞机的机长，跑道足够长的话我会让飞机停在跑道上，宣布紧急情况，执行检查单如果有必要，尽快撤离。若跑道不够长，我会尽快拉升到有利高度，就近迫降或者放回到跑道上，同时宣布紧急情况。

cards.audioText: Under this situation, how to execute emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在这种情况下，如何进行紧急撤离？
cards.referenceText: First, we must report to ATC that we are going to make emergency evacuation after landing and ask them to provide emergency services on arrival. Second, we must notify cabin crew to prepare for it. After landing we will carry out emergency evacuation procedures and ask passengers to evacuate from the forward cabin doors.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，我们必须向ATC报告我们将在着陆后进行紧急撤离，并向ATC要求到达后的紧急服务。第二，我们必须通知机组成员为紧急撤离做准备。着陆后我们要执行紧急撤离程序，并且要求乘客从前机舱门进行撤离。

cards.audioText: Under this circumstance, what kind of help can ATC provide for flight crew?
cards.audioTextZh: 在这种情况下，ATC可以为机组成员提供什么样的帮助？
cards.referenceText: ATC can give the pilot landing priority and help them to make an emergency landing. ATC can also provide current weather information and emergency services such as fire trucks, first aid, and ambulances.
cards.referenceTextZh: ATC可以为飞行员提供着陆优先权，并且帮助飞行员进行紧急迫降。ATC也可以提供当前天气信息和紧急服务，例如消防车、急救和救护车。

cards.audioText: What lessons can we learn from this accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 从这起事故中我们能学到什么？
cards.referenceText: First, the airport authority should keep monitoring runway conditions and make sure there is no debris on the runway. Second, maybe supersonic aircraft are not safe enough for civil aviation operation, so before we know the real reason of this accident, the Concorde should be grounded.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，机场管理局应该持续监控跑道状况并确保跑道上没有任何碎片。第二，可能超音速飞机在民用航空操作中还不够安全，所以在了解事故真正的原因前协和飞机应该被停飞。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 25，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please give a brief description of what is shown in the picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请简要描述图中展示的是什么。
cards.referenceText: The aircraft from Air France is sinking into the field. Some mechanics are around the engine of the aircraft. They seem to be checking the engine and a gendarmerie is watching the scene a little far away from the aircraft. A vehicle is standing behind the tail of the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 法国航空公司的一架飞机陷入了田地。修理工们正站在飞机引擎四周，看来正在检查引擎，一名宪兵站在远处看着飞机，在飞机的机尾有车辆。

cards.audioText: What happened to the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 这架飞机发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: In my opinion, the aircraft might have run out of the runway after aborting takeoff or the emergency landing for some reasons and sunk into the field.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为，这架飞机应该是在中断起飞后冲出了跑道，或因为一些原因紧急迫降之后陷入了田地。

cards.audioText: Could you imagine how did this happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能设想一下这是怎样发生的吗？
cards.referenceText: In the picture, lots of mechanics are around the engine, so I think probably there was something wrong with the engine of the aircraft during taking off or landing, which caused that they could not stop prior to reaching the end of the runway and sunk into mud.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上图中，修理工们正站在引擎周围，所以我认为飞机的引擎可能在起飞或降落时出现了问题，使飞机无法在跑道尽头前停止然后陷入了泥中。

cards.audioText: What may lead to the aircraft running out of the runway?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么原因会导致飞机冲出跑道？
cards.referenceText: There are three possible factors I know may lead to the aircraft overshooting. First, landing at a high speed is dangerous and the aircraft may not be fully stopped on the runway. Second, brake or thrust reverser inoperative during roll is also a risk. Third, the runway is not long enough for taking off and the like.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我知道的共有三种可能的原因：第一，以高速降落。非常危险并且飞机可能无法在跑道完全停止；第二，横滚时刹车和反推装置不工作。第三，跑道长度不够起飞。

cards.audioText: In what situation would a pilot choose to abort takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么情况下飞行员会选择中断起飞？
cards.referenceText: There are some situations I know may cause aborted takeoff, fire on board, tire failure, wind shear and other extreme weather, suspected or actual technical failures, engine failure during the takeoff run, bird strike or unknown flying objects in the air, bad weather, or some barriers suddenly showing on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有些情况会导致中断起飞：飞机起火，轮胎失效，风切变等天气因素，可疑或存在的机械故障、起飞滑跑时的引擎故障、鸟击或空中的不明飞行物体、恶劣天气或跑道上突然出现的障碍。

cards.audioText: What should be taken into account when the pilots decide whether to abort takeoff or not?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在决定是否应该中断起飞时应考虑什么？
cards.referenceText: An aborted takeoff is normally performed only if the aircraft’s speed is below the takeoff decision speed known as V1. Below V1, the airplane should be able to stop safely before the end of the runway. Above V1, the airplane may overshoot the runway if the takeoff is aborted. Takeoff is normally not aborted above V1, unless there is reason to doubt the airplane’s ability to fly, such as fire alarm, engine failure, wind shear and take-off configuration warning.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常当飞机的速度低于起飞决断速度即V1时，需要中断起飞。速度低于V1时，飞机能够在跑道尽头前安全停止。速度高于V1时，中断起飞可能会导致飞机冲出跑道。除非有火警，发动机失效，风切变，起飞形态警告以及飞行员认为会影响飞行安全的情况才会在V1后中断起飞。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 26，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please make a brief description about the picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请对图片做简单描述。
cards.referenceText: As we can see, the aircraft has skidded off the runway and stopped on the shoulder meters away from the edge of runway. The right wheels have sunk into the soft ground of the runway shoulder. All on board have evacuated safely and there is no fire. Wheel marks are left on the muddy runway shoulder clearly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如图所见，飞机滑出跑道并在跑道边缘几米外的跑道道肩停下。飞机的右轮陷入了跑道道肩的软路基内。机上所有人员安全撤离飞机，并且飞机未发生火灾。飞机的轮辙在泥泞的跑道道肩内清晰可见。

cards.audioText: When does this accident probably happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 这起事故可能在什么时候发生？
cards.referenceText: According to my understanding, it may happen during landing. There might be mechanical errors with the aircraft and the pilot can not stop the aircraft fully on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据我的理解，事故可能发生在着陆时。飞机可能出现机械故障，飞行员无法在跑道上完全停止飞机。

cards.audioText: What was the possible cause of this incident?
cards.audioTextZh: 事故可能的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: I guess there were two possible causes, one was that the aircraft experienced a hard landing (land at a higher speed) so it could not be fully stopped on the runway. The other situation might be that there was something wrong with the thrust reverser or brake resulting in the aircraft skidding off the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为可能有两个原因，一个是飞机进行硬着陆（以高速着陆），所以飞机无法在跑道完全停止。另一个是飞机的反推力装置或刹车可能出现问题导致飞机滑出跑道。

cards.audioText: Do you know some factors that may cause overrun?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道可能引发飞机冲出跑道的原因吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, many factors will affect the stopping of the aircraft and may cause overrun, such as runway conditions, weather conditions, as well as human factors. If the runway is very slippery and braking action is poor, the aircraft may run out of the runway. If the aircraft encountered low visibility when landing, the possibility of overrun becomes higher, and if the pilot has a poor direction control, the aircraft may skid off the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 知道。许多因素可能会影响飞机停止并让飞机冲出跑道，例如跑道状况、气象情况，同时也有人为因素。如果跑道滑、刹车效应差，飞机可能会冲出跑道。如果飞机在着陆时能见度低，那么冲出跑道的可能性会增高。如果飞行员对飞机的方向控制较差，飞机就有可能冲出跑道。

cards.audioText: Did you experience any emergency in your flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行时经历过什么紧急情况吗？
cards.referenceText: I have never encountered any in-flight emergency. But my colleague has. One time when he flew from Wuhan to Beijing, during taxiing, he heard the APU fire warning. Immediately he reported the situation to ATC, completed the memory items and made the emergency evacuation. Only one passenger was injured during the evacuation. But after the investigation, the fire warning was proved to be a false signal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我在飞行中从未遇到过紧急情况，但是我的同事遇到过。一次他从武汉飞往北京，在滑行时他听到了APU火警警报。他立刻向ATC报告情况，完成记忆程序并进行紧急撤离。仅有一位乘客在紧急撤离中受伤。但是经过调查，火警警报被证实为错误信号。

cards.audioText: Can you imagine how would you feel in case of emergencies?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能假设在紧急情况下你会是什么感觉吗？
cards.referenceText: I think every pilot would feel stressed and nervous when he encounters an emergency. But we should have ability to promptly adjust our attitude. In fact, we have training twice a year about facing emergencies. I don’t think it’s hard to deal with emergencies if we can keep calm and make quick decision.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为每位飞行员在遭遇紧急情况时都会感到有压力和紧张，但是我们应该有能力迅速调整自己的心态。事实上，飞行员每年都会接受两次关于紧急情况的训练。我认为如果飞行员能保持冷静并快速作出判断那么处理紧急情况并不是件难事。

cards.audioText: How to deal with abnormal events?
cards.audioTextZh: 怎样处理突发性事件？
cards.referenceText: As a captain, firstly, we must keep calm and take a good control of the aircraft whenever unusual things happen. At the same time, we must advise ATC our situation and make right judgment, and follow relevant procedure and checklist to ensure the safety of flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 作为机长，首先，不论何时发生突发事件，我们应该保持冷静并保持对飞机的良好控制。同时，我们必须向ATC报告情况并作出正确判断，执行相关的程序来确保飞行安全。

cards.audioText: As we can guess from the picture, passengers all leave the flight successfully. In your opinion, how to improve an emergency evacuation performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中我们可以猜测到乘客全部成功进行撤离。你认为如何能够提高紧急撤离的表现？
cards.referenceText: I think the success of the evacuation largely depends on the enhanced crew procedures. The crew should be trained with proper procedures in controlling and balancing the flow of passengers to reduce evacuation time significantly, which could save lives in a real and catastrophic situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为紧急撤离的成功很大程度取决于提高的改进后机组的流程。机组人员应该接受撤离流程的训练，学习如何控制和平衡撤离时的乘客流量，从而减少紧急撤离的时间，这可以在发生灾难时拯救大家的生命。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 27，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Describe what is shown in these two pictures.
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述这两张图片展示的是什么。
cards.referenceText: These two pictures show the approach and landing of an aircraft. In the left picture, the aircraft is making a low approach with a bank aligning the center line of the runway. In the right picture, we can see the aircraft touching the runway forming an angle with the runway center line. Dense smoke is coming from the right main gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这两张图片展示的分别是飞机的进近和着陆。左图中，飞机在低空进场，倾斜并对准跑道中心线。右图中可以看到飞机正接触跑道，与跑道的中心线形成一定角度，飞机的左起落架处有浓烟。

cards.audioText: Why did you say that the aircraft was making a low approach over the runway?
cards.audioTextZh: 你为什么说左图的飞机在低空进场？
cards.referenceText: There are visual approach slope indicators (VASI) on both sides of runway threshold. Each light is designed so that it appears as either white or red, depending on the angle at which it is viewed. When the pilot is approaching the lights at the proper angle, meaning that the pilot is on the glide slope, the first set of lights appears white and the second set appears red. When both sets appear white, the aircraft is too high, and when both appear red, it is too low. In the left picture, three sets of the lights on each side are in red, which indicates that the aircraft is below the glide slope.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑到路口的两侧都有目视进近坡度指示器，灯光被设计为可显示红色或白色其中之一，颜色取决于看灯光的角度。当飞行员在适合的角度进近，意味着飞行员在下滑道上，这时能看到第一组灯光显示为白色，第二组灯光显示为红色。当两组灯光都显示为白色时，飞机高度过高。当两组灯光都显示为红色时，飞机高度过低。在左图中，两边的三组灯光都显示为红色，这证明了飞机下滑道过低。

cards.audioText: Why do you think the aircraft could not align the center line of the runway?
cards.audioTextZh: 你为什么认为飞机无法对准跑道中心线？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft most likely encountered crosswind when landing, and the crosswind made it difficult to control the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机在着陆时最有可能遭遇侧风，侧风会让飞机难以控制。

cards.audioText: What problem may cause under such condition and how to avoid it?
cards.audioTextZh: 这种情况会引发什么问题，怎样避免这种问题？
cards.referenceText: Crosswind is an important factor to consider during landing. Poor flight operation in strong crosswind can make the aircraft land outside the runway. So, during approach, we monitor ATIS for the current weather conditions at the airport, if the crosswind is too strong, we can choose to go around or circle for delay landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在着陆时，侧风是需要考虑的重要因素。侧风强烈时操作失误会让飞机在跑道外着陆。所以在进场过程中要守听机场通播，了解机场当前的天气状况。如果侧风太过强烈，可以选择复飞或盘旋来延迟降落。

cards.audioText: Can you list some crosswind landing technology skills?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能列举一些侧风着陆的技术技巧吗？
cards.referenceText: First, try to use a longer final approach than normal. This allows you to adjust your aileron and rudder inputs as necessary to align yourself with the runway. Second, touchdown speed should be higher than the normal. Third, maintain the aileron into the wind until the aircraft slows down to taxiing speed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一，试图用更长的航线边进场，这样飞行员可以在必要时调整副翼和方向舵，从而将飞机对准跑道；第二，着陆速度应该比平时快；第三，保持副翼逆风直到飞机降至滑行速度。

cards.audioText: Have you ever received any training about crosswind landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾接受过关于侧风着陆的训练吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, it is one of the important subjects in our simulator training and initial flight training.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在模拟训练和最初的飞行训练中，侧风着陆都是非常重要的部分之一。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 28，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you describe what is happening in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述图中正在发生什么吗？
cards.referenceText: I think the flight must be experiencing a severe turbulence and cabin depressurization, because we can see there is a gaping hole in the rear fuselage and the tail has been lost. The passenger oxygen masks have dropped down and some passengers have been injured badly. Furthermore, a passenger is being sucked out of the gaping hole in the right picture. It is a terrible accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这架飞机肯定正在经历严重颠簸和机舱失压，因为在机身后段有个张开的洞，机尾已经消失。乘客的氧气面罩已自动落下，有些乘客受伤很严重。此外，右图中一位乘客被吸出洞外，这是场很可怕的事故。

cards.audioText: What may lead to cabin depressurization?
cards.audioTextZh: 机舱失压为什么会发生？
cards.referenceText: Depressurization can arise as a result of a mechanical failure of the pressurization system, or if, in an unlikely event of a terrorist sabotage, an in-flight explosive decompression. It can also be caused by metal fatigue in older planes. More often, depressurization comes about in an insidious manner as pressure leak out quite slowly, which we call slow depressurization.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机舱失压可能由于增压系统出现机械故障，或有很小概率是由于飞行中恐怖分子进行破坏，炸弹爆炸导致机舱失压，还有可能因为老旧飞机金属疲劳引发机舱失压。更多时候，失压并不是突然发生的，压力缓慢漏出，这种情况被称为缓慢失压。

cards.audioText: What should a pilot do in the case of cabin depressurization?
cards.audioTextZh: 在机舱失压的情况下飞行员应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: The first thing to do is to retain consciousness and maintain control of the airplane. Then the pilot should follow the Standard Operation Procedures (SOP) and initiate an emergency descent. He should also contact ATC and tell them their intentions. The oxygen masks will be down for pilots, flight attendants and passengers, and the pilot should ask the passengers to fasten their seat belts.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先要保持意识清醒，保持对飞机的控制。然后飞行员要遵循标准操作流程，做紧急下降，同时飞行员应联系ATC并告知意图。氧气面罩会为飞行员、乘务员和乘客自动落下，飞行员应要求乘客系紧安全带。

cards.audioText: What should the passengers do in the case of cabin depressurization?
cards.audioTextZh: 在机舱失压的情况下乘客应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: The passengers should pay more attention to the usage of oxygen demonstration prior to departure. Once the depressurization happens, they must quickly grab the nearest oxygen mask, pull it towards themselves to start the oxygen supply and don it onto face securely.
cards.referenceTextZh: 乘客在起飞前应注意氧气面罩的使用示范。一旦发生机舱失压，乘客要迅速拿到最近的氧气面罩，将氧气面罩戴上，然后面罩开始提供氧气。

cards.audioText: Why is the cabin pressurization essential for a flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中，为什么机舱加压至关重要？
cards.referenceText: When flying at certain altitude, outside atmospheric pressure is low. To maintain a safe and comfortable environment for crew and passengers, cabin pressurization is needed by the active pumping of compressed air into an aircraft cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当飞行到一定高度时，飞机外部的大气压力较低。为了给机组和乘客提供安全舒适的环境，需要用泵将空气压缩进飞机机舱。

cards.audioText: Have you encountered depressurization in your flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中，你曾遭遇过机舱失压吗？
cards.referenceText: No. I have been a pilot for more than ten years and I have never encountered such situation. But I have the experience of depressurization in simulator training. / Yes, I have the experience of depressurization in flight. Last summer I flew to Shanghai. During climbing, I encountered cabin depressurization. It was horrible. I forced myself to keep calm and maintain the control of the airplane. With the assistance of the whole flight crew members, I handled the situation and we finally landed safely. It was a terrible experience but I learnt much from it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，成为一名飞行员已超过十年，我从未遭遇过这种情况，但是在模拟训练中我有机舱失压的经验。/ 有，我曾遭遇过机舱失压。去年夏天，飞往上海途中，飞机上升时遭遇了机舱失压。情况非常可怕，我强迫自己冷静下来并保持对飞机的控制。在所有机组成员的协助下，我处理了情况最后安全着陆。这段经历很恐怖，但是从中我学到了很多。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 29，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 在图中你能看到什么？
cards.referenceText: An A320 of JetBlue Airways is landing on the runway 25L. It has the full flaps and slats. Flames and dense smoke are coming out from the front landing gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一家捷蓝航空的A320飞机正在25L跑道着陆，飞机的襟翼和缝翼已全放下，飞机前起落架处有火焰和浓烟。

cards.audioText: What was the possible problem of the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 这架飞机可能存在什么问题？
cards.referenceText: I guess there was something wrong with its front landing gear. Maybe it was jammed. Or perhaps the landing gear was locked in an incorrect position after takeoff and the pilot made an emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为飞机的前起落架可能有故障，也可能前起落架被卡住了。或者飞机起飞后起落架被卡在了错误的位置，所以飞行员进行了紧急迫降。

cards.audioText: If the landing gear can’t be extended, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果起落架无法放下你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If the landing gear can be extended, but I’m not sure whether it has been locked or not / but I’m not sure about its condition, I’ll notify ATC and request low pass near the Tower for visual check /inspection of the gear. / If the landing gear cannot be extended normally, I’ll try gravity extension first. But if the landing gears still cannot be extended by gravity extension, I’ll have to make a belly landing/forced landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果起落架无法放下，但是我无法确定起落架是否被卡住 / 但是我无法确定起落架的状况，我会通知ATC并请求低空通过塔台进行目视检查 / 对起落架进行检查。/ 如果起落架无法正常放下， 我会首先进行重力加密。但是如果重力加密后起落架仍无法放下，我就必须进行机腹着陆 / 紧急迫降。

cards.audioText: What should be taken into consideration if you decide to land under such circumstance?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你决定在这种情况下着陆，你会考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText: Before making a forced landing, we’ll check the fuel quantity. Maybe we’ll request fuel dumping/jettisoning first. (Maybe we’ll request to join a holding pattern to burn the fuel.) At the same time, we’ll declare emergency and request emergency assistance on arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在进行紧急迫降前，我会检查燃油量。也许我会首先申请放油 / 投弃货物。（也许我会申请等待航线从而消耗燃油。）同时，我会宣布进入紧急情况并申请到达后的紧急援助。

cards.audioText: What ground assistance would you request and what should the flight attendants do?
cards.audioTextZh: 你会申请哪些地面援助，乘务员应该怎样做？
cards.referenceText: We’ll request foam carpet, fire truck, ambulances and so on after landing. We’ll also notify the cabin crew about the situation. The flight attendants will inform the passengers of the forced landing and make proper preparation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会申请泡沫垫层、消防车、救护车等。我会同时将情况通知机组成员。乘务员会通知乘客飞机将进行紧急迫降并做好相应准备。

cards.audioText: Was pre-foaming runway recommended for this emergency landing? Why or why not?
cards.audioTextZh: 这种紧急迫降的情况适合对跑道喷洒泡沫吗？为什么或为什么不？
cards.referenceText: No, I don’t think pre-foaming should be prepared. It concerns that it would deplete firefighting foam supplies. It might be needed later to respond to a fire. Apart from that, it is difficult to determine exactly the place where should be foamed in the runway, and pre-foaming might also reduce the effectiveness of the aircraft’s brakes, and potentially cause the aircraft to slide off the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不适合，我认为不应该喷洒泡沫。如果喷洒泡沫，将会消耗消防用泡沫，这些泡沫在处理之后可能发生的火灾时更重要。除此之外，判断在跑道上喷洒泡沫的位置也很困难，而且提前喷洒泡沫会降低飞机刹车的性能，可能会使飞机滑出跑道。

cards.audioText: What are benefits to spread foam on the runway for a belly landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 机腹着陆时在跑道喷洒泡沫的好处是什么？
cards.referenceText: Spreading foam on the runway could reduce aircraft damage, allow landing at a lower speed by reducing friction of runway surface, reduce fire hazards and avoid the fuel spill hazards.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在跑道喷洒泡沫可以减轻飞机受损情况，通过减少跑道表面的摩擦力让着陆速度降低，减少了火灾隐患并避免了燃油泄漏隐患。

cards.audioText: The runway is equipped with ILS as the marker showed in the picture. What do you know about the category of runways?
cards.audioTextZh: 如图标识所示，跑道配备了仪表降落系统。你对跑道的分类有哪些了解？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, runways can be divided into two categories, non-instrument runway and instrument runway. The latter includes nonprecision approach runway, and precision approach runway categoryⅠ, Ⅱ, and Ⅲ according to its serving visual aids, decision height (DH) and Runway Visual Range (RVR). The category Ⅲ can be further specified into A, B, and C category.
cards.referenceTextZh: 就我所知，跑道可以被分为两种类型：非仪表跑道和仪表跑道。仪表跑道根据目视助航设备、决断高度和跑道视程分为非精密进近跑道、Ⅰ类精密进近跑道、Ⅱ类精密进近跑道和Ⅲ类精密进近跑道。Ⅲ类精密进近跑道又可以分为A、B、C三类。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 30，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you tell me what happened in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否描述下图中发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: OK, in this picture, I can see an aircraft crashes into a truck on a mountain road.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的，在这幅图里，我看到一架飞机在山路上和一辆汽车相撞。

cards.audioText: What do you think might have caused this accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得造成这一事故的可能原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: I think this accident happened mostly due to weather. From the smoke and trees in the picture I can see there was strong wind. It's common to meet unstable air flow in the mountain area, so the airplane possibly encountered wind shear or strong wind. If the pilot could not control the plane well under such condition, crash was easily to happen.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为这一事故很可能是由于天气问题。从图中烟和树的形态可以看出有强风。在山区很容易遇到不稳定气流，所以这架飞机很可能是遇到了风切变或者强风。遇到这种情况时，如果飞行员不能很好地控制飞机，很有可能发生碰撞。

cards.audioText: How can this kind of accidents be prevented?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何预防这类事故发生？
cards.referenceText: To prevent this situation from happening, pilots should be more careful in mountain area flight. If they encountered bad weather, they'd better try to choose a safe and broad place, far away from the crowd, to land the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 为了预防这种情况发生，飞行员在山区飞行时应更加小心。如果遇到恶劣天气，他们最好尽量选择一个安全开阔、远离人群的地方降落。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered wind shear? Why are they a danger?
cards.audioTextZh: 你遇到过风切变么？为什么说风切变很危险？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't. Wind shear is a difference in wind speed and direction over a relatively short distance in the atmosphere. If the direction is downward, an abrupt drop in altitude will occur before the pilot can compensate. Any sudden significant change in wind direction can lead to a loss of control, potentially causing crash. Some wind shear can cause structural damage to the aircraft. Mainly, Wind shear brings greatest danger to aircraft during takeoff and landing. Many airports suffer the effects of wind shear, although wind shear has been recognized in aviation, it is still not fully understood till now.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我遇到过。/不，我没遇到过。风切变是风速和风向在空中相对较短的距离上的变化。如果风向向下，飞行高度会迅速下降，而飞行员根本来不及补救。风向发生任何大的改变都会让飞机失去控制，甚至可能毁坏。有些风切变会毁坏飞机结构。重要的是，起飞和降落阶段风切变都会对飞机造成很大的伤害。许多机场都深受风切变的影响，尽管风切变已经广为人知，但至今都未被完全了解。

cards.audioText: How would you deal with wind shear if you were confronted by it in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行时遇到风切变你会如何处理？
cards.referenceText: If I encountered wind shear in flight, I will notify ATC what I have encountered and request radar vector. And then I will perform the Wind Shear Escape Maneuver in the checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果飞行时遇到风切变，我会通知ATC该情况并请求雷达引导。之后我会按照检查单内的风切变改出执行。
