cards.audioText: Can you tell me any incident of ground collision between aircraft and vehicle?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否告诉我一些飞机和车辆在地面相撞的事故么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. A ground collision happened between an aircraft and a shuttle bus at Beijing airport several years ago. The aircraft was being pushed back, while the shuttle bus was just passing behind it. I think it is maybe the mistake made by the controller; he didn't give the right instruction to the pilot. Finally, the shuttle bus hit on the tail of the aircraft. Fortunately, nobody was injured in that accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。几年前在北京机场一架飞机和摆渡车发生地面碰撞。飞机当时正在推出，而摆渡车刚好从后方经过。我觉得这可能是管制员的失误造成的，他给了飞行员错误的指令。最终，摆渡车撞到了机尾。幸运的是，这场事故中没人受伤。

cards.audioText: Tell me some hazardous conditions on the ground that might affect the safety of the flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉我一些可能影响飞行安全的地面危险情况。
cards.referenceText: OK. There are many hazardous conditions on the ground that may affect flight safety. For example, low visibility, contaminated runway, displaced threshold, animals and vehicles crossing the runway, construction work near the runway, and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。影响飞行安全的地面危险情况有很多。例如低能见度、污染的跑道、跑道入口内移、动物及车辆横穿跑道、跑道附近正在施工等。

cards.audioText: Tell me some hazardous conditions in air that might affect the safety of the flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉我一些可能影响飞行安全的空中危险情况。
cards.referenceText: The hazardous conditions in air such as lightning strike, hail storm, thunderstorm, volcanic ash and severe turbulence might affect the safety of the flight. If the weather is too bad, it may cause damages to the aircraft. That will seriously affect the safety of the flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击、雹暴、雷暴、火山灰以及严重颠簸等空中危险情况都可能会影响飞行安全。如果天气非常恶劣，可能毁坏飞机。这将会严重影响飞行安全。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 31，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please describe this picture briefly in your words.
cards.audioTextZh: 请用你的话简要描述这幅图。
cards.referenceText: From this picture, I can see an aircraft is experiencing tail strike, and smoke is coming from the tail. It must be happening at a big airport equipped with CAT Ⅱand Ⅲ ILS system. There is another aircraft waiting at the holding point of the runway. The airport is surrounded by thick forest.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从这幅图中可以看到一架飞机发生了擦机尾，且尾部有烟雾冒出。这一定是发生在安装了仪表着陆系统Ⅱ类及Ⅲ类的大型机场。跑道等待点还有另外一架飞机在等候。整个机场被茂密的森林包围。

cards.audioText: Is the aircraft landing or taking off? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 这架飞机是在起飞还是降落阶段？为什么？
cards.referenceText: I think this aircraft is taking off, because the flaps are not in the landing configuration.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我觉得这架飞机正在起飞，因为飞机襟翼不是着陆该有的配置。

cards.audioText: In your opinion, what may cause this to happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 就你的观点，造成该事故的原因可能有哪些？
cards.referenceText: Maybe the captain saw some traffic or obstacles on the runway and he wanted to rotate the aircraft earlier, but the aircraft was too heavy, so he couldn't pull up the aircraft, then the tail struck onto the ground.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可能机长看到跑道上有一些车辆或障碍物，他想早点抬前轮，但是机身太重，导致他不能拉起飞机，然后发生了擦机尾。

cards.audioText: Are there any other causes that may lead to tail strike during takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 在起飞阶段，还有没有其它可能造成擦机尾的原因？
cards.referenceText: Yes. Severe weather condition can lead to such accident. Maybe the aircraft encountered wind shear during takeoff after V1, however, the airspeed couldn't increase sufficiently to reach VR. When the aircraft reached the end of the runway, the pilot had to pull up, but the airspeed was not high enough, so that the tail struck on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有的。恶劣天气状况可能导致这类事故。飞机速度达到起飞决断速度时遇到了风切变，而空速又达不到抬轮速度。当飞机到达跑道尽头时，飞行员不得不拉起，但是空速不够，所以机尾撞在跑道上。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you encountered tail strike during takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在起飞时遇到擦机尾你会如何解决？
cards.referenceText: I would use the maximum thrust to reduce the pitch angle and continue to take off. Then report to the ATC about the situation. After takeoff, I would make a short circuit and return for emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会使用最大推力，减少俯仰角，继续起飞。之后向ATC报告相关情况。起飞后，我会做个小起落航线，并返回机场，要求紧急降落。

cards.audioText: Which aircraft experiences tail strike more often than others?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪种类型的飞机更容易发生擦机尾？
cards.referenceText: A tail strike possibly happens to an aircraft with tricycle landing gear; with a tail dragger configuration, the plane naturally sits in a nose-up attitude when on the ground.
cards.referenceTextZh: 配备有三点式起落架的飞机更容易发生擦机尾；飞机在地面上保持机头上仰的状态。

cards.audioText: If this situation happened during landing, what would cause such accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在降落阶段发生这种状况，可能的原因有哪些？
cards.referenceText: There may be some problems with the flaps of aircraft. The flaps cannot be extended normally during landing. When the aircraft approached the runway, the speed was too high, and tail strike happened.
cards.referenceTextZh: 襟翼可能有些问题。在降落阶段襟翼无法正常打开。当飞机接近跑道时，速度过高，就会发生擦机尾。

cards.audioText: Are there any other causes which can lead to tail strike during landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 在降落阶段，还有没有其它可能造成擦机尾的原因？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, there are three landing risk factors may precede a tail strike, they are unstabilized approach, mishandling of crosswinds, and over-rotation during missed approach.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，有三种危险因素可能会造成擦机尾，分别是不稳定进近、侧风操作失误、复飞时抬轮过度。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 32，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What is happening in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 图中发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: In this picture, a Y-5 is in the nose over condition. The tail is up and the nose is down. Y-5 is a double-wing, single-engine aircraft. There are some Air Force officers around this aircraft. One of them is pointing to the landing gear, another one is climbing onto the fuselage. Maybe they are investigating this accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在这幅图里，一架Y-5发生机头触地反转。机尾在上，机头在下。Y-5系列是双翼单发飞机。飞机附近有一些空军军官。其中一个指着起落架，还有一个人爬到机身上。他们可能在调查这一事故。

cards.audioText: What were some reasons causing the accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 造成这一事故的原因有哪些？
cards.referenceText: In my opinion, the main reason for nose over was braking too hard and too early during landing. As for this accident shown in picture, maybe the pilot was not proficient in landing skills and didn't use the brakes correctly. Or maybe the pilot saw some traffic or obstacles on the runway and he wanted to brake the aircraft earlier, but it caused the nose over.
cards.referenceTextZh: 就我看来，飞机机头触地反转的主要原因是着陆过程中刹车过早、用力过猛。从图中事故来看，可能是飞行员着陆技术不达标，未能正确使用刹车。或者飞行员看到跑道上有车辆或是障碍物，他想及早刹车，但造成了机头触地反转。

cards.audioText: What should you do if the aircraft is on fire?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机失火，你会如何应对？
cards.referenceText: First, we must report the situation to the ATC, we intend to make emergency evacuation and ask for emergency services. Second, we must notify cabin crew to prepare for the emergency. At last, we can carry out the emergency evacuation checklist.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，我们必须向ATC报告该情况。我们打算进行紧急疏散并请求紧急服务。之后我们必须通知机组人员做好准备。最后我们要执行紧急疏散程序。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you met the emergency situation similar to what is shown in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果遇到类似图中的紧急情况，你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: If I met such situation, I would report the situation to the ATC and ask for emergency services. If necessary, I would make an emergency evacuation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果我遇到这种情况，我会向ATC报告该情况，并请求紧急服务。必要的话，我会执行紧急疏散。

cards.audioText: What should we learn from this accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 从这次事故中我们可以学到什么？
cards.referenceText: On one hand, the pilot should always follow the Standard Operation Procedure and use the suitable braking at the suitable time. On the other hand, the company should give more training to the pilot on aircraft systems and landing skills, and be stricter in the annual proficiency check and upgrade training check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一方面，飞行员应失踪遵循标准的操作程序，在适当的时候刹车。另一方面，公司应让该飞行员多学习飞机系统，多练习着陆技巧，并在年度能力考核及升级培训考核时严格要求。

cards.audioText: Which components of the aircraft can help to make a landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机的哪些组件可以帮助着陆？
cards.referenceText: Landing is accomplished by slowing down and descending to the runway. This speed reduction is accomplished by reducing thrust and inducing a greater amount of drag using flaps, landing gear or speed brakes. As the plane approaches the ground, the pilot will execute a flare to induce a gentle landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 着陆是通过减速下降到跑道实现的。减速是通过减小推力，使用襟翼、起落架和减速板诱导更大的力实现的。飞机接近地面时，飞行员操纵飞机做一个平飘，慢慢着陆。

cards.audioText: What do you know about types of the landing gear on the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对飞机起落架的类型有什么了解？
cards.referenceText:
It normally comes in two types:
one is conventional or "taildragger" undercarriage, where there are two main wheels towards the front of the aircraft and a single, much smaller, wheel or skid at the rear; the other is tricycle undercarriage where there are two main wheels under the wings and a third smaller wheel in the nose.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机起落架有两种类型：常规型即三点式起落架，这种起落架前部有两个主轮，尾部有一个较小的轮子；另一种是前三点式起落架，其中机翼下有两个主轮，机头有一个小一点的轮子。

cards.audioText: Can you describe the landing gear on your plane?
cards.audioTextZh: 能介绍下你们飞机上的起落架么？
cards.referenceText: I'm flying Citation 1. It has three landing gears, two main gears and one nose gear. Both of them have one wheel. The landing gear system is controlled by No.3 hydraulic system. The control handle is located on the main instrument panel and there are two positions on the handle (up and down position) to retract and extend the landing gears.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是奖状1系列，它有三个起落架，包括两个主起落架和一个前起落架。每个都有一个车轮。起落架系统由3号液压系统控制。控制手柄在主仪表盘上，手柄上下两个位置可以用来操作收缩或伸展起落架。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 33，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Give a brief description about these pictures please.
cards.audioTextZh: 请对这些图片做简要描述。
cards.referenceText: The first picture is about the engine failure of a climbing aircraft. In the second picture, there are flames coming from the left engine during the aircraft rolling on the runway. As for the third picture, it shows the situation that the nose gear is still down during flying. And there is thick smoke in the cockpit which is shown in the last picture.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一张图中，一架飞机在爬升中出现机械故障。第二张图中，飞机左发动机起火。第三张图中，飞机在飞行中前起落架仍然是放下的。最后一张图展示的是机舱内有浓烟。

cards.audioText: What would you do in the situation shown in the second picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果遭遇第二张图的情况你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft flames are out of its left engine during rotation. In this situation, I will continue to take off. After I reach 400 feet, I will declare an emergency and carry out the engine fire checklist. After that, I will make a short circuit and return for emergency landing. If I can not extinguish the fire, I will request emergency services and advise cabin crew to prepare for emergency evacuation after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机在抬前轮时左发动机起火，这种情况下我会继续起飞，到达400英尺时我会宣布紧急情况并执行发动机火警检查单。然后我会做个小起落航线并进行紧急迫降。如果无法灭火，我会请求紧急服务，并要求机组做好着陆后紧急撤离的准备。

cards.audioText: What’s the responsibility of captain and first officer when encountering an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 遭遇紧急情况时机长和副驾驶的职责分别是什么？
cards.referenceText: Normally the captain is responsible for controlling the aircraft, and the first officer is responsible for completing the checklist and communicating with ATC.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常机长负责控制飞机，副驾驶执行检查并和ATC沟通。

cards.audioText: What procedure do you follow in case of emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 紧急情况时飞行员应该执行什么程序？
cards.referenceText: We have the Quick Reference Handbook and Standard Operation Procedure on board. In case of emergency, we must strictly follow these procedures and the regulations of CAAC.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机上有快速检查单和标准操作流程。遇到紧急情况，飞行员必须严格遵从CAAC规定的流程和规定。

cards.audioText: What will you do when landing with one engine inoperative?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果着陆时有一个发动机出现故障你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: When I encounter one engine failure, the most important thing for me to do is to control the aircraft safely. I normally use the rudder and control column to keep the aircraft stable and complete the engine-out checklist. At the same time, I will contact ATC to declare an emergency and request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发动机出现故障时，最重要的是要安全地控制飞机。通常我会使用方向舵和操纵杆让飞机保持平衡并完成对发动机失效的检查单。同时我会联系ATC，宣布紧急情况并申请优先着陆。

cards.audioText: What should be taken into your consideration before a decision to divert?
cards.audioTextZh: 在决定改航前你会考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText: I will consider the fuel endurance, the weather conditions, runway length and other airport facilities in the alternative airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会考虑燃油续航能力、天气的状况、跑道长度和备降机场的其它设施。

cards.audioText: Have you reviewed emergency procedures during simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在模拟训练中练习过紧急操作程序吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, that’s the most important part of the simulator training. We practiced almost all the emergency situations in the simulator, especially some usual emergencies such as engine failure, engine fire, emergency descent, wind shear, emergency evacuation and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是模拟训练最重要的部分。在模拟训练中，我们几乎经历了所有紧急情况，尤其是常见的紧急状况，例如发动机失效、发动机起火、紧急下降、风切变和紧急疏散等。

cards.audioText: What are some of the communication requirements in your opinion during an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为紧急情况时和ATC的沟通有哪些要求？
cards.referenceText: First, I must declare emergency to ATC. In case of emergency, I should say PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN. In case of distress, I should say MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. And all the transmission should be brief and clear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，飞行员要宣布紧急情况。遇到紧急情况时，我会说PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN。遇险时我会说MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY。所有通话要简洁明确。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 34，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Describe what is shown in the pictures. (See Fig.34)
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述图片内容。（见图34）
cards.referenceText: The upper left picture shows a traditional and out-of-date cockpit. There are many electromechanical instrument panels such as altimeter, attitude indicator, airspeed indicator showing in the main control panel. The below right picture shows a modern aircraft cockpit, from its control lever we can see it is a cockpit of Boeing aircraft. Many electronic displays such as EFIS, EICAS and FMS are showing in the primary flight display area.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左上图是一个传统的老式的飞机驾驶舱，许多机电式仪表盘例如高度表、姿态仪、空速表显示在主操纵台上。右下图是一个现代飞机的驾驶舱，从操纵杆可以看出是一个波音飞机的驾驶舱，在主飞行显示器上显示有许多电子指示仪如电子飞行仪表系统、机组警告系统、飞行管理系统等。

cards.audioText: What’s the main feature of modern aircraft cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 现代飞机驾驶舱的主要特色是什么呢？
cards.referenceText: Modern and advanced liquid crystal display and quite high degree of automation, which greatly economize our pilots’ energy.
cards.referenceTextZh: 先进的液晶仪表显示，相当高的自动化程度，充分节省了飞行员的精力。

cards.audioText: As we all know, the cockpit window is definitely not allowed to be opened during flight. What about the situation when on the ground?
cards.audioTextZh: 众所周知，驾驶舱的窗户在飞行途中被禁止打开，那么在地面时是否可以打开？
cards.referenceText: Most cockpit windows can be opened when the aircraft is on the ground. They are equipped with a sun shield. Nearly all glass windows in the large aircraft have anti-reflective coating, and an internal heating element to melt ice. Smaller aircraft is possibly equipped with a transparent aircraft canopy.
cards.referenceTextZh: 大多数驾驶舱的窗户在地面时都可以打开。窗户配备遮阳板。几乎所有大型飞机的玻璃窗都有防反射涂层，内部有加热元件可以融冰。小型飞机可能配备有透明座舱盖。

cards.audioText: What are the differences between the duty of captain and the first officer in a flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中机长和副驾驶的职责有哪些不同？
cards.referenceText: The captain is often the pilot-in-command, he must be skillful and experienced and shall have authority as to disposition of the aircraft so as to ensure the safety of the aircraft and the persons therein. While the first officer shall assist the captain to operate the aircraft. They always work together and discuss issues with each other before the captain makes a decision.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机长通常是正驾驶员，需要操作熟练并有丰富的经验，管理飞机部署并确保飞机和机内乘客的安全，副驾驶辅助机长操纵飞机。机长和副驾驶要共同工作，在机长做决定前，两人要一起讨论。

cards.audioText: What should a captain mainly do in a flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 机长在飞行中的主要工作是什么？
cards.referenceText: Before the flight, the captain usually reviews the weather, flight plan, Notices to Airman (NOTAM), performance and fuel issues. At the stage of takeoff and landing, it is the captain who operates aircraft. During cruising, usually both captain and co-pilot would cover some distance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在飞行前，机长要检查天气情况、飞行计划、航行通告、飞机性能、燃油问题。在起飞和降落阶段，机长操纵飞机。飞机巡航时，机长和副驾驶可分别负责航线中的某一段。

cards.audioText: How do captain and the first officer make cooperation in case of emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 假如发生紧急情况，机长和副驾驶要如何合作？
cards.referenceText: If an emergency arises in flight, one of the crew would control the aircraft and the other would focus on managing the emergency and contact ATC.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行中出现紧急情况时，其中一个人需要操纵飞机，另一个人要负责应急管理并联系ATC。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 35，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Look at the picture, describe what you can see.
cards.audioTextZh: 看这张图片，描述你看到的内容。
cards.referenceText: A Saudi Arabian Airlines B747 aircraft is parking on the ditch with the nose and nose gear damaged. Some mechanics are standing behind the right engines. There are mountains near the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一架沙特阿拉伯航空公司的波音747飞机正停在沟渠上，机头和前起落架被损坏。一些机械工人正站在飞机右侧引擎后方。机场附近有一些山脉。

cards.audioText: What happened to the aircraft according to your imagination?
cards.audioTextZh: 设想一下这架飞机可能发生了什么事情。
cards.referenceText: The plane was probably in the process of landing or taking off in the bad weather or there were some mechanical troubles with the aircraft, so that it ran out of the runway and skidded into the ditch.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这架飞机可能是恶劣天气时降落或起飞过程中，或者是飞机出现机械故障，所以冲出跑道并滑进了沟渠中。

cards.audioText: What do you think was the reason leading to the accident?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为导致事故的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: I guess the runway of this airport was very slippery due to bad weather, and the pilot wanted to reject takeoff but the brake action was so poor with high speed that he could not stop the airplane on the runway. Another possible reason was that there were some mechanical troubles with the aircraft so the pilot lost directional control of the plane.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为由于恶劣天气导致机场跑道湿滑，飞行员想要中断起飞，但是飞机的刹车效应差、速度快，飞行员无法令飞机停在跑道上。另一个可能的原因是飞机出现一些机械故障，所以飞行员失去了对飞机的方向控制。

cards.audioText: What factors would affect the takeoff speed required?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素会影响起飞速度？
cards.referenceText: The takeoff speed required varies with air density, aircraft gross weight, and aircraft configuration, such as flap and slat position. Takeoff V-speeds, V1, VR and V2 are used to describe the operations with transport aircraft. These speeds are determined also by the length and slope of the runway and any peculiar conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起飞速度由空气密度、飞机起飞总重和飞机构型（如襟翼和缝翼位置 ）的不同而要求不同。起飞速度，V1、VR和V2用来描述运输机的操作。这些速度同样也由跑道长度、斜度和任何特殊条件决定。

cards.audioText: What aspects are related to the particular landing performance of the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机着陆表现与哪些因素相关？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, crosswind, plane size, weight, runway length, obstacles, ground effects, weather, runway altitude, air temperature, air pressure, air traffic control, visibility, avionics, and some other factors would affect a particular landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知的是，侧风、飞机型号和重量、跑道长度、障碍物、地面效应、天气、机场标高、气温、气压、空中管制、可见度、航空电子以及一些其它的因素。

cards.audioText: It is reported that the accident shown in the picture happened during taxiing from a hangar toward a departure gate by a maintenance crew, and they taxied using only the No.1 and No.4 engines. What do you think of that?
cards.audioTextZh: 据报道，图中事故发生时维修人员将飞机从机库滑行至登机口，并且滑行时仅打开1号和4号引擎，你怎么看这件事？
cards.referenceText: Apparently, they didn’t realize that the braking system of aircraft was powered by hydraulic pumps powered by engines 2 and 3, so they couldn’t stop the aircraft in time when it was out of directional control which resulted in the accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 显然他们没有意识到飞机的刹车系统由液压泵驱动，而液压泵由2号和3号引擎驱动，所以他们无法在飞机失去方向控制时停止飞机，从而引发这起事故。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 36，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please describe what you can see in the picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述你在图中能看到什么。
cards.referenceText: A B747 of Air France is making an extremely low approach at a seaside airport, literally almost on top of the people on the beach. There are several travelers watching and photographing the landing airplane.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一架法国航空的波音747在海滨机场以很低的高度低空进场，飞机的位置几乎在海滩上乘客们的头顶，一些游客正看着这架飞机并对它拍照。

cards.audioText: Do you know the meaning of low approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道什么是低空进场吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I know. Low approach is an approach over an airport or runway following an instrument approach or a VFR approach including the go around maneuver where the pilot intentionally does not make contact with the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 知道，低空进场是指飞机以仪表进场或目视进场飞过机场或跑道，飞机不接触跑道复飞。

cards.audioText: Do you think it is a dangerous landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为这种着陆方式是否危险？
cards.referenceText: Yes, I’m afraid it’s a dangerous landing for travelers on the beach. Because the sea wave will become huge when the aircraft is taking off and landing, and travelers can feel the great thrust and suction generated by the aircraft and they might be blown into the sea.
cards.referenceTextZh: 危险，我担心海滩上的游客。因为飞机起飞和着陆时海浪很大，游客能感到飞机带来巨大的推力和吸力，他们可能因此会被吹进海中。

cards.audioText: Why do you think the pilot makes such a low landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为飞行员为什么要低空进场？
cards.referenceText: According to the picture, this airport is located at the beach and there are some mountains near the airport. Maybe the runway at this airport is not long enough for large aircraft taking off and landing, so pilots have to make full use of the runway or for some terrain reasons to fly a low route to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据图片，机场位于海滩旁边，机场附近还有山脉。可能机场跑道的长度对于大型飞机起飞和着陆不够长，所以由于地形原因，飞行员要充分利用跑道，所以选择低空进场。

cards.audioText: Do you know why so many travelers are keen on such place?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道为什么那么多游客喜欢去这个地方吗？
cards.referenceText: I think most enthusiasts should be surfers. Because of the huge and changeable sea wave, they can experience the extraordinary surfing there.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为喜欢这个地方的人大多数应该是冲浪爱好者。因为这里的海浪大并且多变，他们可以尽情享受冲浪的乐趣。

cards.audioText: What should be taken into consideration in a low approach?
cards.audioTextZh: 低空进场时需要注意什么？
cards.referenceText: When the airplane is making a low approach, it should be careful of the low level crosswind and bird strikes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机低空进场时，应注意低空侧风和鸟击。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 37，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Look at the picture, describe what you can see.
cards.audioTextZh: 请看这张图片并描述在图中能看到什么。
cards.referenceText: From the picture, I can see one object that looks like a time bomb consisting of a bundle of dynamite sticks and a timer connected by electric wires.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这张图看起来是个将一捆炸药和计时器用电线相连组合而成的定时炸弹。

cards.audioText: How can it be possibly carried onto the airplane?
cards.audioTextZh: 定时炸弹可能是怎样被带上飞机的？
cards.referenceText: It may be carried onto the aircraft by a terrorist or hijacker who covers it up and passes through the airport security check. Probably the carry-on baggage is not very carefully checked and the screening machine fails to detect it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可能是恐怖分子或劫机者将炸弹藏起来，然后通过了安检。也许随身行李并没有被仔细检查，或者安检机器没能探测到它。

cards.audioText: Have you ever found a time bomb on board? How did you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾经在机上发现过定时炸弹吗？当时你是怎样做的？
cards.referenceText: Once during the flight, the cabin crew reported that there was a suspicious object in the cabin overhead compartment. After examination, we noticed it was very similar to an explosive or bomb because of its dynamite sticks and a timer taped. Immediately the cabin crew moved the passengers far away from the dangerous area. Meanwhile, we contacted ATC and requested an emergency landing and emergency services. At last, we landed safely and made an emergent evacuation on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 曾经发现过。有一次在飞行途中，机组人员报告在客舱行李架内有可疑物体。经检查，我们发现可疑物体疑似为爆炸物或是炸弹，炸药管和计时器绑在一起。机组人员立刻将乘客转移出危险区域，同时我们联系ATC并要求紧急着陆和紧急服务。最后，我们安全着陆并在跑道上进行紧急疏散。

cards.audioText: Please tell me about the security process changes in China.
cards.audioTextZh: 请告诉我国内的安全程序有什么样的变化。
cards.referenceText: There are many changes in the security process in most airports in China, especially in some big international airports such as Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou. They have introduced lots of advanced equipment, and many qualified airport staff have been employed and fully trained. Currently, passengers need to be screened through detection machines and all the sharp items such as knives and scissors are prohibited in the cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。国内大部分机场的安全程序都有很多变化，尤其是一些大型国际机场，例如北京，上海和广州。这些机场引进了许多先进设备，雇佣专业的工作人员并对他们进行培训。如今，乘客需要通过安检，所有尖锐物品，例如刀、剪刀，全部都被禁止带上飞机。

cards.audioText: In your eyes, how to improve the security procedure in the future?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你看来，将来还能如何提升安检程序？
cards.referenceText: I think many areas need to be improved in the security procedure. Basically, airport passenger screening must be placed. Furthermore, advanced security equipment should be strengthened so as to ensure that they provide adequate protection for passengers. More qualified security staff should be hired to reduce passengers’ waiting time. The existing security personnel should be trained regularly to be able to identify items harmful to flight safety. Moreover, relevant law should be enforced and information must be shared timely by the joint effort of airports and airlines.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为安检程序还有很多需要提升的部分。机场对乘客的检查肯定要被放在首位，而且要加强先进安检设备的使用，以确保这些设备能为乘客提供充分保护。雇用更专业的安检人员从而减少乘客等待的时间。现有的安检人员应定期接受培训，确保他们有能力辨认有害于飞行安全的物品。此外，相关法律需要得到实施，在机场和航空公司的共同努力下信息需要即时共享。

cards.audioText: What will you perform when you meet terrorism activities on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在机上遭遇恐怖活动你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Although security check reduces the possibility of terrorism threat, as a pilot, I should be always prepared to fight against terrorism. When I meet terrorism activities, like hijack or bomb threat, I should keep cool head and execute emergency procedures immediately.
cards.referenceTextZh: 虽然安检降低了恐怖袭击的可能性，但是作为一名飞行员，我要始终做好面对恐怖分子的准备。如果遭遇恐怖活动，例如劫机或炸弹威胁，我应该保持头脑冷静并立刻执行应急措施。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 38，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please describe what’s happening in pictures.
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述图中正在发生的情况。
cards.referenceText: In the upper picture, an aircraft is colliding with the other one holding at the apron. Some people are around two aircraft. The aircraft is on fire producing thick smoke after collision as shown in the lower picture. Several fire engines and lots of firemen showing on the scene are extinguishing the fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上图中，一架飞机和另一架正在停机坪等待的飞机相撞。一些人正站在这两架飞机附近。下图中，飞机在相撞后产生浓烟。消防车和消防员正在灭火。

cards.audioText: What may cause the tragic crash?
cards.audioTextZh: 引发这起悲剧的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: I have heard of this crash before. It happened at Baiyun International Airport in 1990. The left aircraft shown in the first picture belonged to Xiamen Airline. It was hijacked, and the pilot struggled with hijackers and diverted to Baiyun Airport to make a forced landing. After landing, the aircraft rolled off the runway and collided with the other aircraft. More than one hundred people died in the accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我曾听说过这起事故。事故发生在1990年的白云国际机场，第一张图中左侧的飞机属于厦门航空，这架飞机被劫持，飞行员与劫机者进行搏斗，飞机在白云机场迫降。飞机着陆后，飞机冲出跑道并与另一架飞机相撞，超过一百人在事故中丧生。

cards.audioText: Do you know what happened in the cockpit so that the aircraft ran off the runway?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道驾驶舱中发生什么导致飞机冲出跑道吗？
cards.referenceText: It is reported that the hijacker attacked the pilot and intended to control the aircraft once the aircraft touched the runway, as a result, the aircraft was out of control and crashed into the other one.
cards.referenceTextZh: 报道称劫机者袭击了飞行员并想要控制飞机，结果飞机在着陆后失去控制并冲向了另一架飞机。

cards.audioText: What would you do in case of hijacking?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果遭遇劫机你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: I should not land blindly but maintain safety first. All in all, "Safety First" should be the principle. If hijackers wanted to fly to somewhere else, I would follow their intention, then I would try to contact ATC, our company or airport representatives to find some ways to handle the situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我不会盲目降落，首先要保证飞行安全。总而言之，“安全第一”是原则。如果劫机者想飞到其它地方我会顺从他们的意图，然后试图联系ATC、我的公司或机场代表来想方法处理这种情况。

cards.audioText: If you were the captain of the flight holding at the apron shown in the first picture, what would you do under that situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你是第一张图中正在停机坪等待的飞机的机长，这种情况你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: Under that situation, I think I had no choice to avoid the collision, but after collision, if possible, I would turn off all power immediately. Command crew to open the cabin door, put down the slide and help to make the evacuation of passengers. I would be the last one to get off to ensure all passengers and crewmembers have left the plane.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这种情况下，我认为无法避免相撞。但在那之前如果有可能，我会立刻将所有电源关闭，指挥机组成员打开客舱门，放下逃生滑梯让乘客逃生。我会在最后下飞机，确保所有乘客和机组成员已经离开飞机。

cards.audioText: How to inform ATC the situation of hijacking?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何通知ATC有劫机情况？
cards.referenceText: The pilot under duress should squawk 7500 or vocally, by radio communication, transmit "(Call sign) Transponder seven five zero zero." if possible and safe. The air traffic controller may ask the pilot to confirm that. The pilot under duress may respond that the aircraft is not being hijacked, but then conversely change to a different squawk code. A complete lack of a response would also be taken to indicate a possible hijacking.
cards.referenceTextZh: 受胁迫时，飞行员应该设置应答机编码7500，或通过无线电通信应答机口头传输，“（呼号）应答机7500”。条件允许并安全的情况下。管制人员会向飞行员进行确认。受胁迫时飞行员可回复飞机未被劫机，然后设置不同的应答机编码，没有回复也表明可能发生了劫机。

cards.audioText: Do you have some real abnormal flight experience?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾有过异常的飞行经历吗？
cards.referenceText: I haven't met hijacking but have met a situation that electrical system powered off during approach. When problem happened, there was no indication at all. I had the aircraft in control immediately, and executed the checklist. Then I reported ATC our situation and requested landing priority. At last we were cleared for straight-in approach and landed successfully.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我没有遇到过劫机，但曾在进场时遭遇电力系统关闭。情况发生前没有任何征兆，
我立刻控制飞机并执行飞行检查。然后我向ATC报告情况并要求优先着陆，最后直线进近并成功着陆。

cards.audioText: What do you think are the important things in dealing with unusual events?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为处理异常事件时有什么重要的事情？
cards.referenceText: I think we should control the plane calmly and make judgments correctly, then order the flight crew to bear their own responsibilities. At the same time, we should report ATC the situation and request assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为，我们应该冷静地控制飞机并做出正确判断，然后命令机组成员承担各自的责任，同事，我们应该向ATC报告情况并请求援助。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 39，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please make a brief description about this picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请简要说明这张图片。
cards.referenceText: This is a Saab airplane stopping on the runway with its nose touching the ground. Its front landing gear remains stuck. A section of the runway has been foamed. There are many people surrounding it.
cards.referenceTextZh: 图中是一架停在跑道，机头接触地面的萨博飞机。飞机的起落架被卡住不能动，跑道的一部分被喷洒了泡沫，有很多人正在围着这架飞机。

cards.audioText: How could this situation happen?
cards.audioTextZh: 这种情况可能是怎样发生的？
cards.referenceText: Based on what I can see in this picture, I guess the pilot made an emergency landing on the runway. The front landing gear couldn’t be extended and the crew had to land using the main landing gear. When it landed, the plane came down on the side wheels and finally stopped on its front belly, while the front landing gear remained stuck.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据我从图中看到的，我认为飞行员进行了紧急降落。飞机无法放下前起落架，必须使用主起落架。飞机着陆时倒在侧轮上，仍然无法放下前起落架，最后飞机机腹着地。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do when they find the nose gear cannot be extended?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机前起落架无法放下时飞行员会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: They should advise ATC the situation first and request an emergency landing on a foamed runway. If there is excess fuel, they have to dump fuel to avoid a potential fire before it lands on a bed of foam.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员会首先将情况告知ATC并请求在喷洒泡沫的跑道紧急降落。飞机中有过量燃油时需要先进行放油，避免着陆前可能存在的火灾。

cards.audioText: What ground assistance would the pilot request?
cards.audioTextZh: 这种情况时飞行员会要求怎样的地面援助？
cards.referenceText: The pilot should request runway to be foamed. Besides, they would request other emergency services, such as ambulance and fire engines to be ready upon landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员会要求向跑道喷洒泡沫，此外还会请求其它紧急服务在降落前准备好，例如救护车和消防车。

cards.audioText: Have you ever met such an experience?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾经历过这种情况吗？
cards.referenceText: No, I haven’t met this situation. Only once our flight flew from NKG to PEK, the landing gear couldn’t be retracted after takeoff. The captain decided to return NKG airport immediately and we make a safe landing finally with nobody injured.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不，没有。只有一次从南京飞往北京时，起飞后起落架无法收回，机长决定立刻返回南京机场，飞机安全着陆，没有人员受伤。

cards.audioText: What quality should pilots have to deal with emergency situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 面临紧急情况，飞行员需要具备怎样的素质？
cards.referenceText: In order to handle emergency situations safely, pilots need to get strictly trained on different emergency situations in the simulator. They also need to have accurate judgment, brave decision making and good crew coordination. Pilots should keep calm and confident facing difficult situations, and furthermore, they should have ability to communicate with ATC in English when emergency situation happens in a foreign country.
cards.referenceTextZh: 为了能够安全处理紧急情况，飞行员需要在紧急情况模拟器上接受严格训练。同时飞行员需要有正确判断、勇敢决策、与机组良好协作的能力。飞行员面临紧急情况时应保持冷静自信。此外，在国外发生紧急情况时，飞行员应有能力与ATC用英语交流。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 40，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Please describe the picture in detail.
cards.audioTextZh: 请详细描述下这幅图。
cards.referenceText: They are practicing emergency evacuation. A man is just sliding down a slider. Another man is dressed very formally. He is standing beside the slide and he seems to be the instructor. There is another man standing at the door. I can just see his legs and he seems to be ready to jump onto the slide.
cards.referenceTextZh: 他们正在练习紧急疏散。一个男人从滑梯上滑下。另一个穿着非常正式的男人站在滑梯旁边，看起来像是教员。还有另一个人站在舱门口，我只能看到他的腿，似乎是准备跳到滑梯上。

cards.audioText: How many slides are there on the aircraft you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞的飞机上有多少滑梯？
cards.referenceText: I fly cargo aircraft, Boeing 747-400. There is only one slide on our aircraft. / I fly passenger aircraft, Boeing 747-400. There are 12 slides on our aircraft, including two slides on upper deck and ten on lower deck.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞货机，波音747-400。机上只有一个滑梯。/我飞客机，波音747-400全客飞机有12个滑梯，上舱2个，下舱10个，Combi飞机有10个滑梯，上舱2个，下舱8个。

cards.audioText: Can you tell me a little bit about the location of the slides on an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 能稍微讲讲机上滑梯的位置么？
cards.referenceText: Yes. It is located in the emergency exit on the upper deck.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。滑梯在上舱的紧急出门处。

cards.audioText: What can slides be used for?
cards.audioTextZh: 滑梯有什么用？
cards.referenceText: It is normally used for evacuate passengers when abnormal situation happens, and some slides are also designed to serve as rafts in the event of a landing on water.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发生异常情况时，滑梯通常用于疏散乘客。有时候飞机降落在水上，有些滑梯可以当救生筏使用。

cards.audioText: Have you ever met any emergency evacuation? Tell me something about that.
cards.audioTextZh: 你遇到过紧急救援么？讲一讲。
cards.referenceText: Yes, once we took off from Wuhan, the fan cowl doors on both engines detached, and it caused severe damage including a punctured right engine fuel pipe. During returning, an external fire developed on that engine which was shut down. After landing, an emergency evacuation of the occupants was achieved without injury and the engine fire was extinguished.
cards.referenceTextZh: 遇到过，有一次飞机从武汉起飞，发动机上的风扇罩门全部脱落，造成了严重的损害，包括右侧发动机燃油管被刺穿。返回时，关闭的发动机外部起火。降落后，机舱内人员全部被营救出来，没有人受伤，发动机外部的火也被扑灭了。

cards.audioText: What are the duties of flight crew in an emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在紧急疏散中，机组人员的职责是什么？
cards.referenceText: Evacuation is normally ordered by the captain. However, if communication with the flight crew is not possible and the situation in the cabin is judged by the senior cabin crew member to be incompatible with any delay, then the cabin crew themselves make the evacuation order once the aircraft has come to a complete stop. Normally, the captain will be the last to leave the aircraft. Once they are out of the aircraft, they assist in moving passengers away from the aircraft to a position where they can be safely grouped together.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常是机长下令进行疏散。然而，如果机长无法联系到机组人员，且客舱内高级机组成员判定不能有任何延误，那么飞机完全停下后机组人员就可以立刻组织疏散。通常机长是最后一个离开飞机的。一旦他们下了飞机，就要帮助乘客一起转移到远离飞机的安全位置。

cards.audioText: What are the main differences between ditching and force landings on ground? What should cabin crew prepare for ditching?
cards.audioTextZh: 水面迫降和陆地迫降有什么区别？机组人员应如何应对水上迫降？
cards.referenceText: Ditching especially refers to the force landing on water. It is one of the force landings. If problem happens when the flight is flying over the ocean or lake, the flight attendants must notify the passengers at first, and then brief them the items they should pay attention to, such as the passengers should put off their shoes, especially high heel shoes, they should wear off their glasses, earrings and other sharp particles in case of being hurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 水面迫降指飞机被迫降落在水面上，是迫降方式的一种。飞机在海洋或湖泊等水面上飞行时，如果遇到问题机组成员必须第一时间通知乘客，并简要告知其注意事项，如乘客应该脱掉鞋子，尤其是高跟鞋；乘客应该摘掉眼镜、耳环等尖锐物品，以防受伤。

cards.audioText: What do you do in the emergency training every year?
cards.audioTextZh: 在一年一次的紧急训练中，你都做些什么？
cards.referenceText: The emergency training includes studying emergency knowledge in ground school and emergency drills in the Cabin Service Trainer. I learn the detailed procedure of emergency situation and practice emergency evacuation in our simulator training center.
cards.referenceTextZh: 紧急训练包括在地面训练学校学习紧急救援知识和在客舱服务训练部进行紧急演习。我学习了应对紧急情况的具体操作程序，并在模拟机训练中心练习了紧急救援。

cards.imageAlt: Figure 41，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see in the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中可以看到什么？
cards.referenceText: This is the dangerous goods label of lithium battery transportation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是运输锂电池的危险品标签。

cards.audioText: Can you say something about lithium battery according to this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 能描述一下这张图的细节么？
cards.referenceText: Lithium batteries are inflammable, explosive materials. It should handle carefully and avoid fire during transportation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 锂电池是易燃、易爆物质，运输时需谨慎处理，远离火源。

cards.audioText: would you like to say something about dangerous goods?
cards.audioTextZh: 能否介绍一下危险品？
cards.referenceText: In my opinion, dangerous goods refer to the regulated materials which are harmful to aircraft, personnel and cargo by temperature change, aircraft vibration and space limitations. For example, dry ice, paint and lights are all dangerous goods in air transportation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我看来，危险品是指在航空运输过程中，会因温度变化、飞机震动以及空间限制等因素的改变，对飞机、机上人员以及货物造成伤害的相关物品。比如，在航空运输中，干冰、油漆、车灯等都是危险品。

cards.audioText: What are the types pf dangerous goods in aviation?
cards.audioTextZh: 航空中的危险物品有哪几种？
cards.referenceText: According to different requirements of air transportation, dangerous goods can be divided into three classes: the first class, dangerous goods that can transport in accordance of regulations. The second class of dangerous goods can only transport in compliance with regulations. The last class of goods can be transported under no circumstance with about 300 species. Any dangerous goods that are flammable, explosive and dangerous is prohibited to transport in any case.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据航空运输的不同要求，危险品可以分为三类：第一类，在符合相关规定的情况下，可以进行航空运输的危险品。第二类是在正常情况下不可以运输，但满足相关要求后，航空运输时不受限制的危险品，共2种；最后一类是在任何情况下均禁止航空运输的危险品，这类危险品有近300种。所以易燃、易爆、易发生危险反应的任何危险物品，在任何情况下都禁止使用航空运输。

cards.audioText: Are lithium batteries dangerous goods?
cards.audioTextZh: 锂电池是危险品么？
cards.referenceText: According to the relevant regulations promulgated by ICAO, lithium batteries are classified as dangerous goods. During flying, passengers need to put proper amounts of extra battery into handbag. Passengers should power off the device which has lithium batteries and pay attention to avoid accidental starting. Meanwhile, passengers should also take protection measures to prevent explosion due to friction, collisions, and short circuit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 根据国际民航组织颁布的相关规定，锂电池被列为危险品。乘坐飞机时，乘客需将合理数量的备用电池放入手提包内携带登机。乘机时需将所携带锂电池设备电源关闭，注意防止设备意外启动。同时乘客还应做好保护措施，防止其因摩擦、碰撞、短路而爆炸。

cards.audioText: What are the risks of taking lithium batteries on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 携带锂电池登机的危险有哪些？
cards.referenceText: Lithium-ion batteries are the “time bomb”which threat flight safety, it is likely to combust spontaneously and spread to the entire cargo. Illegal carrying of lithium batteries will be harmful to personal and property safety. Serious consequences will be subject to legal penalty.
cards.referenceTextZh: 锂电池是威胁飞行安全的“定时炸弹”，因为其很可能会发生自燃，从而点燃整个货舱。违规携带锂电池，会危害到乘客人身及财产安全，造成严重后果，还会受到法律制裁。

cards.audioText: What topics do you discuss during dangerous goods training?
cards.audioTextZh: 在危险品训练中，你们都学了什么知识？
cards.referenceText: In the dangerous goods training of our company, we studied about the nature, feature and packing measures of dangerous goods and responses facing with accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在公司组织的危险品训练中，我们主要学习了危险品的性质及特征、危险品包装方法以及发生意外时的应对措施。

cards.audioText: If the flammable liquid leaks, what should crew member do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果易燃液体泄漏，机组人员应如何应对？
cards.referenceText: When the flammable liquid leakage is founded, we shouldn’t try to put out the fire by water but inform the fire department. If the goods are loaded on board and burst into leakage, the pilot can only takeoff only after the cabin is cleaned. If leakage is found after taking off, the pilot should inform the controller immediately and request a quick landing and emergency rescue. Crew members should comfort passengers and perform emergency evacuation on landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发现易燃液体泄漏，不要用水灭火，应及时通知消防部门。如果装载到飞机上后发现包装泄漏，则应仔细清理机舱，确认清理干净才可起飞。如果在起飞后发现泄漏，应及时通知管制员，请求快速着陆，提供紧急援救，机组成员应安抚乘客，并在降落后进行紧急疏散。

cards.imageAlt: Flight manuals，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中可以看到什么？
cards.referenceText: From this picture, I can see a mechanic is handing over the worksheet with the captain.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从图中可以看到一名机务人员正在和机长交接工作单。

cards.audioText: What kind of manuals should be carried during the flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中需要携带的手册都有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
There are many manuals should be carried on the aircraft during the flight.
For example, MEL, AFM, FCOM and QRH.
cards.referenceTextZh:
在一段飞行中，在飞机上需要携带很多手册。
比如：最低设备清单、飞机飞行手册、 飞行机组操纵手册和快速检查单。

cards.audioText: What are the role of normal checklist?
cards.audioTextZh: 正常检查单的作用是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Normal checklist enhance flight safety by providing an opportunity to confirm that the safety critical aspects of the systems and aircraft configuration are correctly set.
By following normal checklist, many mistakes in setting will be identified and corrected before they may cause safety problems.
cards.referenceTextZh:
正常检查单通过检查系统的安全关键部分和飞机的配置是否设置正确来加强飞行安全。
按照正常检查单，设置中出现的任何错误都会在其造成安全问题前被发现并纠正。

cards.audioText: Do you have to check the maintenance log book?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们需要检查维修记录本吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, before the flight, we should check the maintenance log book.
There are many important information in the maintenance log book.
If we find any malfunction of the aircraft, we must file the maintenance/technical log book.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，飞行前我们必须检查维修记录本。
在维修记录本中包含有很多重要的信息。
如果我们发现故障，必须在维修记录本中填写。

cards.imageAlt: Modern cockpit，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can we learn from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中能了解到什么？
cards.referenceText: From this picture, we can know it's a modern cockpit. There are many digital instruments such as PFD, MFD, ECAM, FMS and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从图中我们可以了解到这是一个现代驾驶舱，里边有许多数字化仪表，比如PFD, MFD, ECAM, FMS等。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer modern cockpit or traditional cockpit? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢现代驾驶舱还是传统驾驶舱？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
I prefer modern glass cockpit.
Because there are many modern technologies and equipment in the cockpit.
For example, EFIS, TCAS and GPS.
These technologies and equipment largely reduce pilot’s workload and reduce human errors.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我喜欢现代驾驶舱。
因为在驾驶舱中有很多现代科技和设备。
比如：电子仪表系统，空中防撞系统和全球定位系统。
这些科技和系统可以减轻飞行员的工作负担，降低人为失误。

cards.audioText: What information can you get from PFD?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以从主飞行显示器上获得哪些信息？
cards.referenceText:
We can get many information from primary flight display.
such as, flight heading, altitude, airspeed, pitch and so on.
Such information is very important for the pilot.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我们可以从主飞行显示器上获得很多信息。
比如：航向，高度，空速和俯仰等等。
这些信息对飞行员来说非常重要。

cards.audioText: How can you sense the surrounding environment in the modern cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 在现代驾驶舱中，你如何感知周围环境？
cards.referenceText:
Many modern equipment is used to sense the surrounding environment for the pilot in the cockpit.
For example, the TCAS can sense the conflicting traffic and give solution to the pilots to avoid them.
The airborne weather radar can detect the bad weather, so pilots can go round the bad weather before flying into them.
The GPWS can give pilots terrain information and inform pilots to pull up before crashing into the ground.
cards.referenceTextZh:
在驾驶舱有很多可以帮助飞行员感知周围环境的设备。
例如：空中防撞系统可以感知冲突航空器，并且给飞行员避让的建议。
机载气象雷达可以探测不利天气，因此飞行员可以提前绕飞。
近地告警系统可以感知地形信息，告知飞行员在撞向地面之前拉起飞机。

cards.imageAlt: Engine problems，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can we know from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中可以了解到什么？
cards.referenceText: There's structural damage to the engine. The engine cowling has separated from the engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发动机有结构损坏，发动机整流罩脱落。

cards.audioText: What kind of pilot’s operating errors can cause engine problems?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员的什么操作失误会导致发动机问题？
cards.referenceText:
Well, as far as I know, most engine problems are caused by environmental factor, for example foreign objects and bird strike.
While pilot’s operation errors, for example, using the contaminated fuel or careless walk around check can also cause engine problems.
cards.referenceTextZh:
据我所知，大部分的发动机问题是由于环境因素导致的，比如：外物吸入和鸟击。
但是，飞行员的操作失误也会引起发动机问题，比如，使用受污染的燃油或者在绕机检查时不仔细等。

cards.audioText: What do you know about turbofan engine?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道涡扇发动机吗？
cards.referenceText:
Turbofan engines are commonly used in large passenger aircraft.
Turbofan engines have the advantages of high thrust, high fuel efficiency and low noise.
The disadvantages of turbofan engines are complex structure and difficult design.
cards.referenceTextZh:
涡扇发动机是目前大型客机上普遍使用的一种发动机。
涡扇发动机的优点是：推力大，燃油效率高，噪音低。
涡扇发动机的缺点是：结构复杂，设计难度大。

cards.audioText: What do you know about engine idle, when will the engine be turned into idle conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道发动机慢车状态吗？发动机什么时候调至慢车状态？
cards.referenceText:
Engine idle refers to the minimum speed at which the engine can maintain stable operation.
Typically speaking, the engine will be turned into idle during ground taxiing, final approach, and landing.
cards.referenceTextZh:
慢车是指发动机能够保持稳定工作的最小转速状态。
在地面滑行、最后进近和着陆阶段发动机一般会使用慢车状态。

cards.imageAlt: De-icing，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you say something about this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你根据这张图片可以说些什么吗？
cards.referenceText:
This picture shows it is a cold and snowy night. The apron is covered with snow.
Ground staff is deicing for the aircraft from China Southern Airlines now.
cards.referenceTextZh:
好的。这是一个寒冷下过雪的晚上，机坪被白雪覆盖。
地面人员正在给一架南航的飞机除冰。

cards.audioText: How can icing conditions affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 积冰如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText:
Icing will change the shape of the wings.
increase drag and reduce lift.
reduce aircraft’s performance and may cause stall.
cards.referenceTextZh:
积冰可以改变机翼形状。
增加阻力，减弱升力。
它将降低飞机性能，可能会造成失速。

cards.audioText: Can planes wait a long time to take off after deicing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机完成除冰后可以等待很长时间再起飞吗？
cards.referenceText: As far as I know, in case of icing again, the plane should take off as soon as possible after deicing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 据我所知，为防止飞机再次积冰，飞机在除冰后需要尽快起飞。

cards.imageAlt: Lightning strike，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能从这张图片中看到些什么？
cards.referenceText:
There is lightning in the vicinity of airport.
Many aircraft are holding position for weather improvement.
cards.referenceTextZh:
机场附近有闪电。
飞机正原地等待天气好转。

cards.audioText: In what weather conditions is lightning strike most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么样的天气条件下，容易发生雷击？
cards.referenceText: Lightning strike usually occurs in Thunderstorm or CBs, in summer.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷击多发于夏季的雷暴和积雨云天气中。

cards.audioText: How to reduce the danger of lightning strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何降低雷击的危险？
cards.referenceText:
Before takeoff or approach, we should listen ATIS to get the latest weather information;
During flight, we should check the weather radar screen and monitor the cloud movement and trend.
If there is any indication of thunderstorms, we should request radar vectors to go round the weather.
In these ways, we can avoid lightning strike.
cards.referenceTextZh:
在飞机起飞或进近前，我们应听取ATIS的最新天气信息;
在飞行过程中，我们应关注气象雷达屏幕，监测云的移动和趋势。
如有雷暴迹象，我们应要求雷达引导绕飞天气。
通过这些方法，我们可以避免雷击。

cards.audioText: In which phase does lightning strike usually occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 通常在飞行的哪个时期可能会遭到雷击？
cards.referenceText:
More lightning strikes occur while the aircraft is in the cloud, during the climb and descent phase.
The reason is that lightning activity is more prevalent between 1500 to 4500 meters ‘ altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh:
飞机在云中，飞行中的爬升和下降阶段遭受雷击的可能性更大。
原因是，闪电活动通常发生在1500至4500米的范围内。

cards.taskTitle: Low visibility operation · 看图材料
cards.imageAlt: Low visibility operation，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you describe this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以描述一下这张图片吗？
cards.referenceText: There are two airplanes operating in heavy foggy weather. One is taxiing on the runway, the other is landing, I guess.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有两架飞机正在大雾天气下运行。一架在跑道上滑行，另一架我猜是在降落。

cards.audioText: What are the possible results if the aircraft operates in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 在低能见下运行会产生的结果有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
Many ground incidents or ground accidents are related to low visibility operation.
For example, ground collision, runway incursion, and taxiing to the wrong taxiway.
cards.referenceTextZh:
很多地面事件或者地面事故都和低能见度有关。
比如：地面冲突，跑道入侵，滑错滑行道等。

cards.audioText: If you taxi to the wrong taxiway in low visibility, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在低能见度下滑错滑行道，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If this situation happens, I will stop the aircraft immediately to avoid further accidents.
Then, I will report my situation to ATC and hold at current position for further instructions.
If necessary, I will request a follow-me car to avoid this kind of incidents again.
cards.referenceTextZh:
如果发生了此类情形，我会立即停止飞机，防止后续的事故发生。
然后，我会将情况报告给管制员，在当前位置等待后续指令。
如有必要，我会申请一辆引导车，防止此类事件再次发生。

cards.audioText: How to avoid ground incidents or accidents in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 在低能见度下，如何避免地面事件或者地面事故发生？
cards.referenceText:
There are many measures we can take to avoid the ground incidents or ground accidents in low visibility.
First, we should follow ATC instructions and have good situation awareness.
Next, before we entering the runway, we should get ATC clearance.
If we have any doubt about ATC clearance, we should confirm with ATC.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我们可以采取很多措施来避免地面事件或地面事故在低能见度下发生。
首先，我们应该听从ATC的指令，有良好的情景意识。
然后，在我们进入跑道之前，我们应该获得空中交通管制许可。
如果我们对空管许可有疑问，我们应该和空管确认。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages of using HUD in heavy fog weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 在浓雾天气下，使用HUD的优势是什么？
cards.referenceText: HUD can lower takeoff and landing standards, and it can provide precise flare-out guidance. Through the data displayed on HUD, pilots can accurately predict the location of the touchdown point and correct the flight status according to the data indication on the HUD at any time, so as to reduce the probability of unsafe events such as too long flare distance and high landing load.
cards.referenceTextZh: HUD能够降低起降标准，它能够提供精确的拉平引导。通过HUD显示的数据，飞行员可以精确预测接地点位置，随时根据HUD上的数据指示修正飞行状态，减少飞机平飘距离过长、着陆载荷大等不安全事件的发生概率。

cards.audioText: Do you think HUD operations in adverse weather will be a trend in the future?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为不利天气下HUD运行会变成一种趋势吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, HUD operations can lower takeoff and landing standards and reduce delays due to adverse weather, so I think it will be a trend in the future.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，HUD运行可以降低起飞和降落标准，减少因不利天气而导致的延误，因此我认为HUD运行会变成一种趋势。

cards.imageAlt: Micro-burst，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you say something about this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 可以说一下这张图片吗？
cards.referenceText:
This picture is mainly about micro-burst.
It usually contains three stages: headwind, downdraft and tailwind.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这张图片主要是有关微下击暴流的。微下击暴流通常包含三个阶段：逆风、下沉气流和顺风。

cards.audioText: In what weather conditions do you think you will encounter the micro-burst?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么样的天气条件下，你会遇到微下击暴流？
cards.referenceText:
As far as I know, the micro-burst usually appears in thunderstorm or rain shower.
It is very dangerous to flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh:
据我所知，微下击暴流一般出现在雷暴或者强降雨天气中。
它对飞行安全十分危险。

cards.audioText: What may occur if you fly through a micro-burst?
cards.audioTextZh: 穿越微下击暴流时会发生什么？
cards.referenceText:
When flying through a micro-burst, the aircraft will become very unstable and difficult to control.
At the beginning, the aircraft speed and altitude will increase rapidly.
When the aircraft passes the center of the micro-burst, tailwind will cause airspeed decrease, and the altitude will be lost suddenly.
cards.referenceTextZh:
当飞机穿过微下击暴流时，飞机将变得很不稳定，很难控制。
最初，速度和高度会快速上升。
飞机通过微下击暴流中心时，顺风会使空速和高度突然下降。

cards.imageAlt: Cross wind，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What information can you get from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从这张图片中得到哪些信息？
cards.referenceText:
From this picture, I can get the airplane is encountering strong wind during the approach.
The pilot is making a crosswind landing now.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我从这张图中了解到飞机在进近时遭遇强风。
飞行员在做侧风降落。

cards.audioText: Do you think crosswind landing is dangerous?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为侧风着陆危险吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, crosswind landing is very dangerous, and it may cause many serious consequences.
For example, it can cause aircraft to veer off the runway, and it can also lead to tail strike or wingtip strikes the ground, which can cause structural damage or even passenger injured.
So, it is dangerous to land with crosswind.
cards.referenceTextZh:
侧风着陆是很危险的，它可能会造成许多严重后果。
例如，它可能导致飞机偏离跑道，也可能导致机尾或翼尖撞击地面，从而导致结构损坏甚至乘客受伤。
所以侧风着陆是很危险的。

cards.audioText: What influence does wind have on airplanes during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中风对飞机有什么影响？
cards.referenceText:
Generally speaking, the hazards of wind shear and gust are great during take-off and landing.
However, there is no limitation imposed en route.
We usually consider tailwind for fuel saving.
cards.referenceTextZh:
通常，风切变和阵风对航班的起降有很大危险。
而飞机在航行中没有强加的限制。
为了节油，我们通常考虑顺风飞行。

cards.imageAlt: Plateau airport，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What is the picture mainly talking about?
cards.audioTextZh: 这幅图片主要谈论的是什么？
cards.referenceText:
The picture is mainly talking about high elevation/plateau airport.
From the picture, we can see there are mountains surrounding the airport.
cards.referenceTextZh:
这幅图片主要在谈论高原机场。
从中我们可以看到群山环绕在机场四周。

cards.audioText: Have you ever flown plateau airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过高海拔机场吗？
cards.referenceText:
No, I am still a student pilot, I have never flown plateau airport.
But as far as I know, flying plateau airport needs special flight technique and experience.
cards.referenceTextZh:
没有，我现在是一名飞行学员，我没有飞过高海拔机场。
但是据我所知，在高原机场飞行需要特殊的飞行技术和经验。

cards.audioText: Is there any special requirements for pilots flying plateau airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞高原机场时，对机长有什么特殊要求吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, there are some special requirements for pilots flying plateau airport.
For example, pilots need get strict theoretical and simulator training.
Meet certain accumulated flying hours.
Be strong physically and mentally.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，飞高原机场需要飞行员满足一些特殊要求。
例如：飞行员需要接受严格的理论和模拟机培训。
达到一定的累计飞行小时数。
强健的身体和良好的心理素质。

cards.taskTitle: Big international airport · 看图材料
cards.imageAlt: Big international airport，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you describe this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以描述一下这张图吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. I can. The picture shows the outside view of an airport terminal.
I guess it is Beijing Daxing International Airport.
This is a complicated airport with many stands and runways.
cards.referenceTextZh:
好的。这是一张机场航站楼的外观图。
我猜它是北京大兴国际机场。
这是一个复杂机场，有很多的停机位和跑道。

cards.audioText: Compared with small airports, what are the advantages and disadvantages of big international airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 与小机场相比，大型国际机场的优缺点是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Advantages: there are more advanced facilities and gates.
They will meet take-off and landing requirements for large aircraft.
Disadvantages: traffic congestion and air traffic control are easier to occur.
The complicated airport layout make it easier for pilots to get confused.
cards.referenceTextZh:
优点：有更先进的设施和更多的停机位。
它们能够满足大型飞机的起降要求。
缺点：容易发生交通拥堵和流控。
复杂的机场布局容易使飞行员困惑。

cards.audioText: Can you name some special equipment in an airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能说出机场里的专业设备吗？
cards.referenceText:
There are some special equipment used in an airport.
For example, runway lighting equipment, bird-scaring equipment, tug, navigation equipment, like NDB and VOR.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场配备了很多专业设备。如：跑道灯光设备、驱鸟设备、拖车、导航设备，比如：NDB和VOR。

cards.imageAlt: Complicated airport，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Have you had any complicated airport training in simulator?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在模拟机里面接受过复杂机场的训练吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I received some complicated airport training in simulator.
It largely improves my flight skills and techniques.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，我在模拟机里接受过相关复杂机场的训练。
它极大的提升了我的飞行技术和技巧。

cards.audioText: How to make a successful landing at a complicated airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何在复杂机场成功着陆？
cards.referenceText:
We should pay attention to the surrounding environments including complicated weather conditions.
make a stable approach, and make sure speed and heading are correctly set.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我们应关注机场周围环境，包括复杂的天气条件。
做稳定进近，并确保速度和航向设置正确。

cards.audioText: What can you learn from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从这张图上你可以看到什么？
cards.referenceText: From this picture, I can see a complicated airport with short and narrow runway. The airport is located near the seaside, it is very easy for pilots to encounter wind shear when landing on this airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从这张图上，我看到一个有窄短跑道的复杂机场，机场位于海边，在这种机场降落时，飞行员很容易遭遇风切变。

cards.imageAlt: Tail strike，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you describe the picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以描述一下这张图片吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. The picture shows there is a China Eastern plane encountering tail strike during take-off. Sparks are coming out from the empennage.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。图中显示一架东航的飞机在起飞时遭遇擦机尾。机尾处在冒火花。

cards.audioText: What are the consequences of tail strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机擦尾的后果是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Usually speaking, the most common result of tail strike is aircraft structural damage.
It will influence the airworthiness of the aircraft.
What’s more, it may cause passenger injuries if the situation gets worse.
cards.referenceTextZh:
一般而言，擦机尾的后果是飞机的结构损坏。
这会影响飞机的适航。
并且，如果情形更坏的话，可能会造成乘客受伤。

cards.audioText: Do you think tail strike only occurs on big aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为只有大飞机才会遭遇擦机尾吗？
cards.referenceText:
No, actually, any aircraft might encounter tail strike.
Although there are many reasons for tail strike, most of them can always be avoided.
cards.referenceTextZh:
不是的，事实上，任何飞机都有可能遭遇擦机尾。
虽然造成擦机尾的原因有很多，但大部分都是可以避免的。

cards.audioText: What is the pitch angle beyond which will lead to tail strike on your plane?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你所飞的飞机上，俯仰角度超过多少会导致擦机尾？
cards.referenceText: I fly Airbus 320, when the pitch angle is over 13.5 degrees, tail strike will happen.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是空客A320，当俯仰角度超过13.5度时，就会擦机尾。

cards.imageAlt: Ground collision，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中你看到了什么？
cards.referenceText:
I can see two aircraft encounter ground collision.
The tail of China Eastern Airlines aircraft is damaged by the starboard wing of China Southern Airlines plane.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我可以看到两架飞机遭到了地面碰撞。
一架东航飞机的机尾被南航飞机的机翼剐蹭了。

cards.audioText: What ground conditions will contribute to the ground collision?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么样的道面情况会造成地面冲突？
cards.referenceText:
Many runway and taxiway problems will cause ground collision.
For example, slippery taxiway or lighting system inoperative, taxi way surface damage and so on.
What’s more, the intersection runway or working progress adjacent to the runway can also cause ground collision.
cards.referenceTextZh:
很多跑道和滑行道的问题都会造成地面冲突。
比如，湿滑滑行道或者灯光系统故障，滑行道表面损坏等。
此外，跑道交叉口或跑道附近进行施工作业也会导致地面冲突。

cards.audioText: During the taxi, if you are not familiar with the layout of the airport, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 在滑行阶段，如果你不清楚机场布局，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If I encounter this situation, I will listen to the controller’s instructions carefully.
If necessary, I will request a follow-me car to avoid any accidents.
cards.referenceTextZh:
如果我遇到这样的情况，我会认真听管制员的指令。
如有必要，我会请求引导车，来避免任何事故发生。

cards.imageAlt: Runway incursion，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you describe this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一下这张图吗？
cards.referenceText:
OK. The picture shows there is a green car passing on the runway during the airplane approach.
It affects the aircraft landing safely.
cards.referenceTextZh: 好的。从这张图上看出一辆绿色的车辆在飞机进近时在跑道上活动，影响了飞机安全着陆。

cards.audioText: Have you ever heard any accidents caused by runway incursion?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道哪些由于跑道入侵导致的事故吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, once a China Eastern Airlines A320 was taking off from Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport, it was found that another A330, also belonging to China Eastern Airlines, was about to cross the runway. Luckily, the captain made a decisive decision to continue taking off, avoiding an accident.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我记得一架东航的A320飞机在上海虹桥机场起飞过程中，发现另一架同样也是东航的A330飞机准备穿越跑道，很幸运的是机长短暂判断后果断决定继续起飞，避免了撞机事故。

cards.audioText: What can we do to prevent runway incursion from happening again?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们可以采取什么措施来防止跑道入侵再次发生？
cards.referenceText:
We should use standard words in communication, speak slowly and clearly, follow ATC instructions.
Before taxiing, we should be familiar with taxi routes.
If we are not sure of our position, we should stop the aircraft and confirm with ATC.
If we are unsure of ATC's instructions, we should confirm with ATC.
We should have good situation awareness.
Also we should strengthen airport management.
In these ways, we can avoid runway incursion.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我们应该使用标准的词语进行交流，语速慢而清晰，遵守ATC的指令。
在滑行之前，我们应该熟悉滑行路线。
如果我们不能确定我们的位置，我们应该停下飞机并与空管确认。
如果我们不确定空管的指令，我们应该和空管确认。
我们应有良好的情景意识。
我们还应该加强机场管理。
通过这些方式，我们可以避免跑道入侵。

cards.imageAlt: Bird strike，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从这张图片中看到了什么？
cards.referenceText:
I can see a flock of birds are flying around Spring Airlines’ aircraft during the flight.
These birds pose a threat to flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我可以看到图中，在飞行时有一群鸟在春秋航空的飞机周围。
这些鸟对飞机的安全飞行造成了威胁。

cards.audioText: If the engine ingested bird during initial climb, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果发动机在初始爬升阶段吸入鸟，你会怎么办？
cards.referenceText:
I will keep clam and keep good control of the aircraft.
Then I will report to ATC and request emergency landing.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我会保持冷静，控制好飞机。
然后我会报告给管制员，申请紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: How does bird strike threaten flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 鸟击是如何威胁飞行安全的？
cards.referenceText:
If the birds are ingested into the engine, it may cause engine problems.
Such as engine flame-out, engine failure and engine fire.
Besides, bird strike may cause structural damage to the aircraft.
Such as the nose and the windshields cracked.
cards.referenceTextZh:
如果发动机吸入鸟，会造成发动机故障。比如：发动机熄火，发动机失效，发动机失火等。
此外，鸟击还会给飞机造成结构损坏。比如，飞机的机鼻和风挡玻璃破损。

cards.audioText: What measure can be taken to avoid bird strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 可采取什么措施防止鸟击发生？
cards.referenceText:
Well, there are many ways.
For example, airports can cut grass regularly, install devices to drive birds away.
Pilots should turn on the landing lights and monitor the information about bird activities.
cards.referenceTextZh:
有很多方法。例如，机场可以定期割草，安装驱赶鸟类的装置。
飞行员应打开着陆灯，并监视有关鸟类活动的信息。

cards.imageAlt: FOI，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you say what happened from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能说一下这幅图片中发生了什么吗？
cards.referenceText: It’s a foreign object ingestion, a big cargo box was ingested into one of the engines. It may cause damage to the engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是外物吸入。一个大货箱被吸入发动机，可能导致发动机损坏。

cards.audioText: What do you know about FOI?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道什么是FOI吗？
cards.referenceText:
FOI means foreign object ingestion.
If foreign objects ingested into the engine, it may cause engine problems.
Such as engine flame-out, engine failure, and engine surge.
cards.referenceTextZh:
FOI指的是发动机吸入外物。
如果发动机吸入外物，会造成发动机问题。
比如：发动机熄火，发动机失效和发动机喘振。

cards.audioText: If you find some foreign objects on the runway when you are preparing for departure, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 当你在准备起飞时发现跑道上有异物，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If I encounter this situation, first I will delay the takeoff.
Then, I will report this situation to ATC and ask for ground staff to deal with the problem.
When the runway is clean and clear, I will continue the departure.
cards.referenceTextZh:
如果我遇到这种情况，首先，我会延迟起飞。
然后我会将情况报告给管制员，请求地面人员处理这个问题。
等到跑道干净后，我再继续起飞。

cards.imageAlt: Refuel，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从上述图中看到了什么？
cards.referenceText: From the picture I can see there is an aircraft parking on the ground. The airplane has two propellers. Beside the plane, there is a fuel truck, so I guess the plane is getting ready to refuel.
cards.referenceTextZh: 从图中我可以看到有一架飞机停在地面，飞机有2个螺旋桨。在飞机的旁边，有一辆加油车，因此，我猜测，飞机正在准备加油。

cards.audioText: How many fuel tanks are there on your aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的飞机上有几个油箱？
cards.referenceText:
I fly C172, we only have one fuel tank.
But as far as I know, some big aircraft, like B737, they have three tanks.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我飞的是塞斯纳172机型，我们的飞机上只有一个油箱。
但是据我所知，一些大飞机，如波音737，有3个油箱。

cards.audioText: What will cause fuel contamination?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些情况会造成燃油污染？
cards.referenceText:
I have never encountered fuel contamination.
But as far as I know, if we refuel in bad weather conditions, such as sandstorms, rain and so on, there will be the possibility of fuel contamination.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我从未遇到过燃油污染的情况。
但是据我所知，如果我们在恶劣的天气条件下加油，比如沙尘暴，降雨等，就会有燃油污染的可能性。

cards.imageAlt: Engine fire，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 从图中你能看到什么？
cards.referenceText:
From the picture I can see an airplane is encountering engine fire after take-off.
The flame is coming from starboard engine. This emergency situation poses a threat to flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh:
从图中我们可以看到有一架飞机在起飞后不久遭遇了发动机起火。
火焰从右侧发动机冒出。这个紧急情况对飞行安全构成威胁。

cards.audioText: What may cause engine fire during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中什么会导致发动机起火？
cards.referenceText:
There are many reasons for engine fire during flight.
For example, engine mechanical failure, fuel problems, bird strike, foreign object ingestion and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh:
造成飞行中发动机起火的原因有很多。
比如：发动机机械故障、燃油问题、鸟击、外物吸入等。

cards.audioText: If one engine failed during flight, will it threat flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中，如果一个发动机失效，会威胁飞行安全吗？
cards.referenceText:
It all depends.
For single engine aircraft, one engine failure will make it lose power, the situation is very dangerous.
While for double-engine or multiple-engine aircraft, if one engine fails, the rest of engines will still work. Pilots can still fly a period of time, and make a successful landing.
cards.referenceTextZh:
要看情况而定。
对于单引擎飞机，如果遇到引擎故障，飞机就会失去动力，情况会很危险。
而对于双引擎或多引擎的飞机，如果一个引擎出现故障，其余的引擎仍能工作，飞行员仍能飞行一段时间，并安全成功着陆。

cards.audioText: How to avoid engine problems?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何防止发动机问题发生？
cards.referenceText:
First, we should make careful inspection during walk-around check to avoid engine malfunctions.
Second, we should never use contaminated fuel.
Last, we should operate the aircraft according to SOP.
cards.referenceTextZh:
首先，绕机检查时仔细检查发动机，避免发动机故障。
第二，我们禁止使用被污染的燃油。
最后，我们应该按照标准程序操纵飞机。

cards.imageAlt: Near miss，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you say something from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以简单说说这张图片吗？
cards.referenceText: From this picture I can see a B747 from Lufthansa Airlines is encountering near air miss with another airplane.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这张图片中，一架汉莎航空的波音747飞机与另一架飞机发生空中危险接近。

cards.audioText: What equipment can be used to detect conflicting traffic during the flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中，可以用什么设备来探测冲突飞机？
cards.referenceText:
I fly Airbus A320, there is TCAS equipped in my aircraft.
We can get the conflicting traffic information from TCAS.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我飞的是空客A320，飞机配备空中防撞系统。
我们可以从空中防撞系统上得知冲突飞机的信息。

cards.audioText: How can pilots avoid near miss or air miss?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员怎么能避免危险接近？
cards.referenceText:
First, we can follow ATC instruction to maintain enough separation with other aircraft.
Second, we can follow TCAS RA to avoid colliding with other aircraft.
Third, if ATC instruction goes against TCAS RA, we should follow TCAS RA to keep enough vertical separation with the conflicting traffic.
cards.referenceTextZh:
首先，我们可以执行管制指令与其他飞机保持足够问隔。
其次，我们可以执行TCAS RA避免与其他飞机相撞。
第三，如果管制指令和TCAS RA发生冲突，我们应该执行TCAS RA，与冲突飞机保持足够垂直间隔。

cards.audioText: How to avoid mid air collision?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何防止空中相撞？
cards.referenceText:
I think we can take many measures.
For example, we should follow ATC’s instructions.
Aircraft should be installed with TCAS to avoid conflicting traffic.
Pilot should scan outside carefully during the flight, improve situation awareness as well.
cards.referenceTextZh:
例如，我们应该遵循管制员的指令。
飞机上需要配备空中防撞系统。
飞行员在飞行时应当密切关注飞机外情况，还应该提高情景意识。

cards.imageAlt: Belly landing，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: How to describe this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何描述这张图片？
cards.referenceText:
The picture shows an airplane from Polish Airlines encountered landing gear problems, the pilot made a belly landing at last.
I can see smoke was coming from the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh:
图片中一架波兰航空的飞机遭遇起落架故障，飞行员最后机腹着陆。
我能看到飞机有烟冒出。

cards.audioText: What may cause the landing gear problems?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么会导致飞机起落架问题？
cards.referenceText: Usually, the majority of landing gear problems are caused by hydraulic system failures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常情况下，起落架问题大部分是由于液压系统故障导致的。

cards.audioText: How do you determine whether the landing gears are extended or not?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何确定起落架是否放下？
cards.referenceText:
I fly C172, our landing gear is fixed/non-retractable landing gear.
As far as I know, there are green lights indication on the panel to show the landing gear conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我飞的是塞斯纳172，飞机的起落架是固定式的。
据我所知，在显示面板上会有绿灯显示起落架的状态。

cards.audioText: During approach and landing phases, when will you extend the landing gear?
cards.audioTextZh: 在进近和着陆阶段，你什么时候放下起落架？
cards.referenceText: I fly A320. In general, when the aircraft is at about 2000 feet or 10 nm from the runway, I will extend the landing gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我飞的是空客320，一般情况下，在高度2000英尺或者距离跑道10海里的时候，我会放下起落架。

cards.audioText: What are the functions of the aircraft landing gears?
cards.audioTextZh: 起落架的功能是什么？
cards.referenceText: The landing gear is used to support the aircraft and to provide steering.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起落架用于支撑飞机，以及提供飞机转向。

cards.audioText: When do you make a belly landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在什么情况下会进行机腹着陆？
cards.referenceText: In most cases, we perform belly landing when the landing gear is unable to release due to hydraulic failure, or when the landing gear is stuck due to foreign object.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在大部分情况下，当由于飞机液压系统出现故障，从而导致起落架无法释出，或者飞机起落架因为外物导致卡阻时，我们会执行机腹着陆。

cards.imageAlt: Ditching，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Can you describe this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以描述一下这张图吗？
cards.referenceText:
OK. The pilot made a ditching due to emergency situation.
A lot of passengers were standing on the emergency slides and waiting for rescue.
Some of them were escorted to safe place by boats.
cards.referenceTextZh:
好的。飞行员由于遇到紧急情况做了水上迫降。
很多的旅客站在紧急滑梯上等待被救援。
部分旅客用船被护送到安全的地方。

cards.audioText: Which do you think is more dangerous, ditching or forced landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为哪一更危险？水上迫降或者陆上迫降？
cards.referenceText:
I think ditching is more dangerous.
Because normally, the aircraft will suffer more damages than forced landing after ditching.
Besides, ditching has special requirements for pilots.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我认为水上迫降更危险。
因为一般来讲，水上迫降后，飞机受到的损伤比陆地迫降更大。
此外，水上迫降需要飞行员具备很多特殊技巧。

cards.audioText: If you are going to make a ditching, what preparation should you make?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你打算水上迫降，你会做什么准备？
cards.referenceText:
参考题目：
If I will make a ditching, I will do the following preparations as below.
First, I will report our intention to ATC.
Then, I will make a PA to cabin crew and passengers that we will make a ditching, ask them to put on life vests.
After ditching, I will make emergency evacuation with all crew members as soon as possible.
cards.referenceTextZh:
如果我打算水上迫降，我会做以下准备。
首先，我会将这个决定报告给ATC。
然后做机长广播，告诉机组和乘客我们即将进行水上迫降，要求他们穿好救生衣。
迫降后，我会和机组成员一起立刻组织紧急撤离。

cards.audioText: What are the differences between flying over water and flying over land?
cards.audioTextZh: 跨水飞行和跨陆地飞行有什么区别？
cards.referenceText: In my opinion, flying over water is more dangerous and requires the pilots to have the relevant qualifications and flying skills, because when there is an abnormal situation, we can only make a ditching.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在我看来，跨水飞行更危险，需要飞行员具备相关的资质和飞行技巧， 因为当发生意外时，我们只能水上迫降。

cards.audioText: Through the flight plan, you learned that your flight mission is related to flying overs water, what will you do to prepare?
cards.audioTextZh: 通过飞行计划，你了解到飞行任务和跨水飞行有关，你会做什么准备？
cards.referenceText: I pay special attention to the aircraft's alternate airport information, en route weather information, and emergency equipment on board, such as life rafts or life jackets.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会格外关注飞机的备降机场信息、航路天气信息以及机上的应急设备，如救生筏或者救生衣。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you encountered abnormal situation while you were flying over water?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果跨水飞行遇到特情，你会怎么处置？
cards.referenceText: I would first maintain control of the aircraft, then quickly execute a checklist to identify the source of the problem, and at the same time, I would contact the controller and request a diversion to a suitable nearby airport. If necessary, we would request necessary airport assistance upon landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先我会保持对飞机的操纵，然后迅速执行检查单，找出问题根源，同时，我也会联系管制员，请求备降到附近的合适机场。如有需要，我们在落地后请求必要的机场协助。

cards.imageAlt: Emergency evacuation，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: What can you see from this picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从图中可以看到什么？
cards.referenceText:
From the picture I can see an airplane from Asiana Airlines made a forced landing.
Some passengers were evacuating with their luggage.
Two emergency slides were deployed.
The dense smoke was coming from the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh:
图中可以看到一架韩亚航空的飞机紧急迫降了。
部分乘客提着行李从飞机撤离。
两个紧急滑梯被放下。
飞机正冒着浓烟。

cards.audioText: Did you review emergency procedures in simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞模拟机时候接受过紧急程序吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes. We learned and practiced how to evacuate in emergency situations.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的。我们学习和练习如何进行紧急撤离。

cards.audioText: What do you think are the principles of evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为紧急撤离的重要原则有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
I think order is the most important principle in an emergency evacuation.
Because passengers will be panic in an emergency, which may affect the efficiency of emergency evacuation.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我认为秩序是紧急撤离中最重要的原则。
因为在紧急情况下，乘客会很慌乱，这会影响紧急撤离的效率。

cards.audioText: What are the duties of cabin crew during emergency evacuation?
cards.audioTextZh: 紧急撤离时机组的职责有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
For example, teach passengers how to use emergency equipment,
show the positions of evacuating exits and organize emergency evacuation orderly.
cards.referenceTextZh: 例如：告知乘客紧急设备的用法，指明安全出口的位置以及组织乘客有序紧急撤离。

title: 故事复诵
description: 发音 结构 词汇 流利度 理解能力

cards.audioText:
AFR123 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff. The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L, but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling. The aircraft overran the runway and crashed. Crew members and 110 passengers were killed, and the co-pilot was badly wounded.
According to the investigation, there were three reasons for the accidents. First of all, the crew didn’t use effective methods to verify their position. Secondly, the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not. Finally, the crew members' idle chatting during the taxi resulted the loss of situation awareness.
cards.audioTextZh:
AFR123在新加坡樟宜机场起飞时坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组人员从02L跑道起飞，但机组人员在02R跑道排队，并开始滑跑起飞。飞机冲出跑道坠毁了。机组人员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶严重受伤。
根据调查，这些事故有三个原因。首先，机组人员没有使用有效的方法来验证他们的位置。第二，机组人员忘记检查他们是否在正确的跑道上。最后，机组人员在滑行时闲聊导致情景意识丧失。

cards.audioText:
An A320 collided with a B737 during taxi. The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage on left wing. Luckily, there were no injuries.
After receiving taxi instruction, the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought they had enough room. But unfortunately, two aircraft collided together. Both captains reported the collision immediately. Because the Boeing aircraft was damaged seriously, fuel leakage was reported and fire services were required. Fortunately, the fuel leak didn’t develop into fire. The crew of the Boeing aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes when they were hit.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架A320在滑行过程中与一架B737相撞。B737的右副翼严重受损，而A320的左副翼仅轻微受损。幸运的是，没有人受伤。
在接到滑行指令后，A320开始从右侧超越B737。A320的机长认为他们有足够的空间。但不幸的是，两架飞机相撞了。两名机长立即报告了相撞事件。由于这架波音飞机严重受损，报告说有燃油泄漏，并要求提供消防服务。幸运的是，燃油泄漏没有发展成火灾。这架波音飞机的机组人员抱怨说，他们明明只是设置了刹车，停在原地，什么事儿也没干，就被撞了。

cards.audioText: A pilot of Air China airline told us an event with landing gear problem. After normal push-back, start-up and taxi, he requested takeoff. However, he was instructed to hold short of the runway in order to give way to ACA702 on final. ACA702 declared emergency because of landing gear problem. ACA702 asked for a low pass. The controller verified the landing gear was still in up position. Then ACA702 requested a touch and go to jar the jammed gear. Unfortunately, the landing gear still couldn’t be extended. So, ACA702 had to make a belly landing on a foamed runway. There were no casualties except some minor injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航的一名飞行员告诉了我们一起关于起落架问题的事件。在正常的推出、开车和滑行后，他请求起飞。然而，他被指示在跑道外等待，以便给五边的ACA702让路。不过，ACA702因为起落架问题宣布进入紧急状态，并且请求低空通场，管制员证实起落架仍在收上位。然后ACA702请求飞一个连续起飞去把起落架震动下来。但是，起落架仍然没放下来。因此，ACA702必须要做一个机腹着陆，并且跑道要铺泡沫。除了一些人员受到轻伤外，没有人员伤亡。

cards.audioText:
When the pilot initially contacted the tower controller, he was told the Runway Visual Range was 500m. The pilot executed a missed approach because of no contact at minima. Then, he was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. In the second approach, the controller issued landing clearance at outer marker. One minute later, the controller observed the airplane was leaving the glide path on the radar display and issued missed approach instructions again. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted a building and crashed.
According to the investigation, the poor visibility made the pilot nervous and he misunderstood the missed approach instructions and made a wrong turn.
(113 words)
cards.audioTextZh:
