当飞行员最初联系塔台管制员时，他被告知跑道视程为500米。由于最低高度跑道不可见，飞行员执行了复飞。之后，管制员雷达引导进行第二次盲降进近。在第二次进近中，管制员在外指点标处发布了着陆许可。一分钟后，管制员在雷达屏幕上观察到飞机正在偏离下滑道，所以他再次发出复飞指令。后来再没有收到飞行员的回复。飞机撞上建筑物，坠毁了。
据调查，低能见度让飞行员变得非常紧张，他误解了复飞指令，转弯出现失误。

cards.audioText:
A Delta Airline aircraft departed from Shanghai to Seoul. It carried 256 passengers and 13 crew members on board. During takeoff rolling, an unknown foreign object was sucked into port engine and the engine fire warning light illuminated. Then the flight crew declared an emergency right after airborne and completed the emergency checklist procedure. Through good communication, the controller understood the flight crew wanted to return to land. But the pilot had to dump fuel before landing because the aircraft was overweight to land. So the controller vectored the aircraft to the dumping area. After circling over the sea and dumping fuel for almost one hour, the plane returned to land safely.
(112 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 达美航空一架飞机从上海飞往首尔。机上载有256名乘客和13名机组人员。在起飞滑跑过程中，左发吸进不明异物，发动机火警警示灯亮起。随后，机组人员在升空后立即宣布紧急情况，并完成了紧急检查单程序。通过沟通，管制员了解到机组人员想要返回着陆。但由于飞机超重，飞行员不得不在降落前放油。所以管制员引导飞机到了放油区。在海上盘旋并放了近一个小时的油后，飞机安全降落。

cards.audioText:
An United aircraft experienced an in-flight engine fire during departure climb from New York City. During the return to the departure airport, the nose landing gear failed to extend, and the flight crew was instructed to execute a go-around, during which the crew extended the nose gear using the emergency procedure. The flight crew conducted an emergency landing, and the 2 flight crew members, 3 flight attendants, and 138 passengers deplaned on the runway. No occupant injuries were reported, but the airplane sustained substantial damage from the fire.
The NTSB determines that the probable cause of this accident was the inappropriate manual engine-start procedure used by maintenance personnel.
(108 words)
cards.audioTextZh:
美联航一架飞机，在从纽约起飞爬升时，飞机发动机起火。在返回起飞机场期间，前起落架未能放出，空管指示机组人员执行复飞，在此期间，机组人员使用紧急程序放下了前起落架。之后，机组人员执行了紧急降落，2名机组人员、3名空乘人员和138名乘客在跑道上下机。没有乘客受伤，但飞机在火灾中遭受了重大损失。
美国国家运输安全委员会认为，这起事故的可能原因是维修人员使用了不适当的手动启动引擎的程序。

cards.audioText:
A China Southern aircraft lost a left upper wing trailing edge panel during cruise at FL270. Initially, ATC received a pilot report that the flight crew had experienced "light chop". The flight was en route from Greenyard to Blueyard Airport. The broken panel struck the window of passenger row 19ABC and cracked only the outer portion of the window. Pressurization was not lost. The flight crew continued on to Blueyard.
Upon approach to Blueyard, ATC instructed the flight crew to expedite for separation. The flight crew informed ATC that they could not increase their airspeed due to possible airframe damage. The flight landed safely. There were 174 passengers and 6 crew members with no reported injuries.
(116 words)
cards.audioTextZh:
中国南方一架飞机在FL270巡航飞行时失去左上翼后缘面板。最初，空中交通管制中心收到飞行员报告，称机组人员当时经历了“轻度颠簸”。该航班正在从格林亚德机场飞往Blue机场的途中。破碎的面板砸在19排ABC座椅的窗户上，庆幸地是，只打碎了窗户的外层。没有发生释压。机组人员继续前往Blue机场。
在接近Blue机场时，由于间隔问题，空管指示机组人员加速。机组人员通知空中交通管制，由于机身可能损坏，他们无法提高空速。最后，飞机安全着陆了。机上有174名乘客和6名机组人员，没有受伤报告。

cards.audioText:
An Airbus 320 collided with an ERJ 145 during taxi in the run-up area of runway 19. The right aileron of the ERJ was seriously damaged; the left winglet of the Airbus had minor damage. There were no injuries.
The captain of the Airbus reported that he was positioned to the right of the ERJ. ATC cleared him for departure, which required him to taxi past the ERJ. He stated that he checked the proximity of the ERJ, and it looked like he could clear it and then felt the impact.
The captain notified ATC of the collision. Airport fire crews responded, but there was no fuel leak or fire.
(110 words)
cards.audioTextZh:
一架空客320在19号跑道的试车区滑行时与一架ERJ145相撞。ERJ右副翼严重受损；这架空客飞机的左小翼有轻微损坏。没有人员伤亡。
空客机长报告说，他的位置在ERJ的右侧。管制允许他们起飞，要求他们滑行通过ERJ。他说他检查了ERJ的附近区域，看起来空间足够让飞机通过，可是没想到还是撞上了。
机长向管制通报了相撞事件。机场消防人员做出了反应，但没有发生燃油泄漏或火灾。

cards.audioText: 10. Before the first ILS approach, the pilot was advised that the runway visual range was 600 feet, then he was given a landing clearance. The pilot declared a missed approach and was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. After turning inbound on the localizer, the pilot was advised the runway visual range and then cleared to land. When the tower controller observed the airplane turning to the south of the runway, she issued missed approach instructions. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted a tall tree and collided on the ground. According to the investigation, the pilot misinterpreted the missed approach instructions by making the right turn and then led to the accident. (119 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 在第一次盲降进近前，飞行员被告知跑道视距为600英尺，然后他得到了着陆许可。飞行员宣布复飞，并得到雷达引导进行第二次盲降进近。在转向对准航向道后，飞行员被告知跑道视距，然后获准着陆。塔台管制员观察到飞机转向跑道南面时，发布了复飞指令。飞行员没有进一步的答复。飞机撞上了一棵大树，撞向地上。据调查，飞行员错误理解了复飞指令，右转导致了事故。

cards.audioText: 11. A Boeing 757 and a Bombardier were seriously damaged when the tails of both airplanes collided during the pushback. The flight crew of the Bombardier reported that they were in a stopped position and their ground crew was in the process of disconnecting the tug. Company maintenance personnel stated they were pushing the 757 back and did not see the Bombardier. Communication recordings between ground control and both airplanes revealed that the 757 was cleared for pushback from gate 80. Later, the Bombardier was cleared to push back from gate 79. The ground controller did not advise either aircraft of simultaneous adjacent pushback operations and did not forecast a traffic conflict. (111 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 一架波音757和一架庞巴迪飞机在推出过程中尾部相撞，两架飞机均严重受损。庞巴迪机组报告称，碰撞发生时，他们的飞机已经停住，地面人员正在断开牵引车。航空公司维修人员表示，他们正将757向后推出，没有看到庞巴迪飞机。地面管制与两架飞机之间的通信录音显示，757获准从80号机位推出；随后，庞巴迪飞机获准从79号机位推出。地面管制员没有向任何一架飞机通报相邻机位同时推出的情况，也没有预见到交通冲突。

cards.audioText: 12. Air France 551 departed runway 15R and over flew United 83 at Atlantic Airport. The tower controller had cleared United 83 to land on runway 10 when the aircraft was about 6 miles on final approach. Simultaneously, ATC cleared Air France 551 for takeoff on runway 15R. Air France 551 was on taxiway when the takeoff clearance was issued. The pilots rotated at taxiway and over flew United 83 at the intersection of runways 10 and 15R. United 83 exited runway 10 afterwards. The main cause of this incident is local controller's failure of maintaining awareness of the situation and failing to provide the appropriate separation between the two aircraft on intersecting runways. (113 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞，并在大西洋机场上空飞越美联航83号航班。当美联航83号航班在10号跑道最后进近约6海里处时，塔台管制员已许可其在10号跑道着陆。与此同时，空中交通管制许可法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞。起飞许可发布时，法国航空551号航班位于滑行道上。该航班在滑行道附近抬前轮，并在10号与15R跑道交叉口上方飞越美联航83号航班。随后，美联航83号航班脱离10号跑道。事件的主要原因是本场管制员未能保持情景意识，也未能为在相交跑道上运行的两架飞机提供适当间隔。

cards.audioText:
The Piper and Cessna pilots were inbound to the same airport.
The Cessna pilot was directed to enter a left downwind, then flew south before turning southwest.
The Piper pilot was also directed to enter a left downwind.
The controller noticed two VFR targets close to one another. Assuming the target on a southwest heading was a VFR helicopter when it was actually the Cessna. The controller issued conflict traffic to the southbound aircraft, assuming it was the Cessna pilot when it was actually the Piper pilot, and the Cessna pilot acknowledged the traffic call. Later, the Piper pilot informed the controller of the collision and declared an emergency.
(109 words)
cards.audioTextZh:
派珀飞机和塞斯纳飞机的飞行员降落在同一个机场。
塞斯纳飞行员被指示进入左三边，然后向南飞行，然后转向西南。
派珀飞行员也被指示进入左三边。
管制员注意到两个目视飞行规则的航空器彼此靠近。以为西南方向的是一架按目视规则飞行的直升机，而实际上是塞斯纳。管制员向向南飞行的飞机发出了冲突呼叫，以为是塞斯纳飞机，但实际上是派珀飞机，塞斯纳的飞行员认收这一信号。后来，派珀飞行员通知管制员发生冲突，并宣布进入紧急状态。

cards.audioText: 14. When SIA128 was approaching the airspace of Chicago center area control, the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next sector on 132.1. The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency. However, the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency. Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change, they didn't know that flight 128 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later, the controller at the next sector identified SIA128 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher, they got no response from the pilots. The controller finally regained contact with SIA128 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 当新航128接近芝加哥中心区管制空域时，管制员指示机组人员将无线电频率调到下一个扇区132.1。副驾驶确认了频率的变化，并把正确的频率复诵了出来。然而，机组人员并没有在新的频率上联系到管制员。由于接收的人员正在准备换班，他们不知道128航班没有建立联系，30分钟后，下一个扇区的管制员在雷达上识别出了新航128。虽然他们试图通过呼叫公司调度员与飞机建立联系，但没有得到飞行员的回应。50分钟后，管制员终于通过紧急频率与新航128重新取得了联系。

cards.audioText:
It was a foggy day, Flight 626 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R. Later, the ground controller gave start-up clearance to a Cessna pilot. Then he requested Flight 626 to contact Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different frequencies.
The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot entered wrong taxiway. The ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue taxi. At the same time, the Tower controller cleared Flight 626 for takeoff. When the Flight 626 was rolling on the runway, the Cessna crossed the runway holding sign and entered the active runway 36R. Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all people on board died.
(114 words)
cards.audioTextZh:
那天有雾，626航班获准滑到36R跑道。后来，地面管制员给了塞斯纳飞行员开车许可。然后他要求626航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，这两架飞机在两个不同的频率上飞行。
塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员进入了错误的滑行道。地面管制员没有意识到这一点，允许塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员批准626航班起飞。当626航班在跑道上滑跑时，塞斯纳越过跑道等待标志，进入活动跑道36R。不幸的是，两架飞机相撞，机上人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: 17. The tower controller cleared Flight 145 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 145 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight 145 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft just managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. So Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 145. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet. There were no injuries or damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind.
cards.audioTextZh: 塔台管制员允许145航班降落在22号跑道上。但是当他允许101航班从16号交叉跑道起飞时，他忘记了即将进场的飞机。145航班着陆后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员试图指示145航班在16号跑道外停止。然而，飞机只是在跑道交叉口的中间停了下来。101航班无法中止起飞。所以101航班提前离地飞，从145航班上方飞过。两架飞机只差50英尺就撞上了。两架飞机都没有人员伤亡或损坏。但这被认为是这类事件中最严重的一次。

cards.audioText:
When an Flight 815 was approaching the terminal area of its destination, the flight crew contacted the Approach and requested ILS approach for runway 12. Because of the tailwind conditions, the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach for runway 30. But the flight crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on that runway. The runway was wet and the braking action was not good.
During landing, the aircraft skidded to the right side of the runway. The fuselage was broken into three pieces, the right engine and right main gear were separated from the aircraft. No one was killed, but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
cards.audioTextZh:
当815航班接近目的地终端区时，机组人员联系进近，要求盲降进近12号跑道。由于顺风，管制员建议飞行员在30号跑道作盘旋进近。但是机组人员坚持降落在12号跑道上，管制员允许他们降落在那条跑道上。跑道很湿，刹车效果也不好。
在着陆时，飞机滑到跑道的右侧。机身断成三块，右发动机和右主起落架与飞机分离。没有人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

cards.audioText:
Flight 456 with 152 passengers and 9 crew members was flying to land at Tokyo Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach, the pilot was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding, the pilot was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested that the crew divert to the alternate, but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough. So the controller vectored the crew to land at runway 34R.
Unfortunately, the pilot couldn’t stabilize on the localizers due wind shear. The aircraft went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage.
cards.audioTextZh:
载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的456航班正飞往东京机场降落。当飞机从东京管制中心转到东京进近时，由于交通拥堵，飞行员被指示转到DA等待。在等待期间，飞行员被告知当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议机组人员备降，但飞行员报告说他们的燃油不足。所以管制员指示机组人员降落在34R跑道。
不幸的是，由于风切变，飞行员无法在航向道上稳定。飞机复飞，进行第二次降落。后来，由于燃油短缺，飞机坠毁在山坡上。

cards.audioText:
A Boeing 747 performed the flight from Taiwan to Hongkong carrying 206 passengers and 19 crew members on board. It broke up and crashed, killing all those on board. It is the deadliest air disaster in Taiwan.
After careful investigation, scientists found the full story of the crash. About 20 years ago, the plane landed heavily and damaged the skin on its tail. Instead of replacing the whole skin in accordance with the maintenance guidelines, the airlines only covered the area with a piece of aluminum plate and painted it. This cause a buildup of metal fatigue in the area. For the following 22 years, maintenance crews had not noticed anything unusual.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架波音747从台湾飞往香港，机上载有206名乘客和19名机组人员。飞机解体坠毁，机上人员全部遇难。这是台湾最严重的空难。
经过仔细调查，科学家们发现了坠机的全部经过。大约20年前，这架飞机遭遇重着陆，机身蒙皮受损。航空公司没有按照维护指南更换整个蒙皮，而是只用一块铝板覆盖了该区域并进行了喷漆。这导致该区域的金属疲劳。在接下来的22年里，维修人员没有注意到任何异常。

cards.audioText: Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport, also known as Jiuzhaigou Airport, is an airport in Songpan County, Sichuan province. It is one of the highest airport in the world with an altitude of 3448 meters. There are breathtaking mountain ranges on both sides of the axis of the runway, and the highest Xuebao peak is the main peak of Minshan Mountain, more than 18000 feet above the sea level. The terrain is complex and wind changes rapidly near the airport. So it is considered one of the most difficult airports to fly to in China. But those who fly over here are also amazed by the beautiful scenery. Due to the high elevation, some passengers may experience symptoms of altitude sickness.
cards.audioTextZh: 九寨黄龙机场，又被称为九寨沟机场，是四川省松潘县的一个机场。它是世界上海拔最高的机场之一，海拔3448米。跑道轴线两侧有令人惊叹的山脉，最高的雪豹峰是岷山的主峰，海拔超过18000英尺。机场附近地形复杂，风的变化迅速，所以它被认为是中国最难飞到的机场之一，但那些飞到这里的人也会被美丽的风景惊艳到。由于海拔高，一些乘客可能会出现高原反应的症状。

cards.audioText:
A Pakistan flight reported the failure of the left hand engine. The crew shut the engine down and continued descending, some time later, they declared Mayday and shortly afterwards radio and radar contact was lost. The aircraft was unable to maintain heading and turned left before impact with the ground. And all occupants of the aircraft perished in the crash.
The investigation into the crash showed that the accident was caused by technical factors and was not caused by human error. The flight crew faced an very complex technical error, that had never occurred before. Due to maintenance irregularities, a turbine blade fractured causing further damage, that made it impossible to control the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架巴基斯坦的航班报告了左发故障。机组人员关闭左发继续下降，一段时间后，他们宣布了遇险，不久之后无线电和雷达失去了联系。飞机无法保持航向，左转后撞向地面。飞机上的所有乘客都在坠机中丧生。
对事故的调查表明，事故是由技术因素造成的，而不是人为错误造成的。机组人员遇到了一个非常复杂的技术错误，这是以前从未发生过的。由于维修不规范，涡轮叶片断裂造成进一步损坏，使飞机无法控制。

cards.audioText:
A Boeing 747 was on final approach to runway 26. After the aircraft went around from very low height, it did not climb out to safety altitude and impacted terrain about 1100 meters past the runway.
The cause of the accident was the missing control of the crew over the aircraft position in relation to the glide slope during the automatic approach. The flight was conducted at night in the weather conditions, which is suitable for ICAO CAT II landing. And as a result, the go-around was not taken in due time and the aircraft had a significant deviation from the established approach chart, which led to the controlled flight into terrain.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架波音747飞机五边进近26号跑道。在飞机从非常低的高度复飞后，它没有爬升到安全高度，并在距跑道1100米左右的地方撞地。
事故的原因是在自动进近过程中，机组人员对飞机与下滑道有关的位置失去了控制。此次飞行是在夜间进行的，天气条件适合国际民航组织II类盲降。结果导致复飞未及时进行，飞机与既定进近图有较大偏差，导致可控飞行撞地。

cards.audioText:
A Cargo Boeing 747 with 7 crew and cargo of military vehicles, has crashed shortly after takeoff.
Afghan Authorities immediately denied claims that the crash was the result of enemy activities. Several observers on the ground reported the aircraft had just lifted off and was climbing through approximately 1200 feet when its nose sharply rose. The aircraft appeared to have stalled and came down. According to a listener on frequency, the crew reported the aircraft stalled due to a possible load shift.
The NTSB determined that the probable cause of this accident was inadequate procedures for restraining special cargo loads. The cargo moved after and damaged hydraulic systems and horizontal stabilizer components.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架载有7名机组人员和军用车辆的波音747货运飞机在起飞后不久坠毁。
阿富汗当局立即否认了飞机坠毁是敌人活动造成的说法。地面上的几名观察员报告说，飞机刚刚起飞，正在爬升大约1200英尺时，机头急剧上扬。飞机似乎失速并坠落了。根据频率上的一一名听众，机组人员报告说飞机由于可能的负载转移而失速。
美国国家运输安全委员会认定，事故的可能原因是限制特殊货物装载的程序不充分。货物移动后损坏了液压系统和平尾部件。

cards.audioText:
Flight 60 encountered moderate turbulence at 9000 feet during descending to Dallas.
According to NTSB, as the flight began its descent, the captain illuminated the seat belt sign and made a public address reminding passengers to buckle up. Then the airplane entered a band of small cumulus clouds and experienced 10-15 seconds of moderate turbulence. The flight attendants were conducting their final cabin safety checks then, so 7 flight attendants received minor injuries, one passenger, who ignored the seat-belt sign and instructions, injured his left ankle.
The aircraft continued for a landing on Dallas without further incident. The flight crew requested paramedics to meet the airplane at the gate. Finally, the passenger was transported to the hospital.
cards.audioTextZh:
60次航班在下降到达拉斯时在9000英尺处遇到中度颠簸。
据NTSB称，当飞机开始下降时，机长点亮了安全带指示灯，并做了机长广播，提醒乘客系好安全带。随后，飞机进入了一个小积云带，经历了10-15秒的中度颠簸。当时空乘人员正在进行最后的客舱安全检查，因此7名空乘人员受轻伤，一名乘客因无视安全带指示灯和提示而左脚踝受伤。
飞机继续在达拉斯降落，没有再发生事故。机组人员请求医护人员在登机口与飞机会合。最后，乘客被送往医院。

cards.audioText: A flight with 98 passengers, encountered smoke in cockpit shortly after departure. The aircraft was cleared to FL340 and was about to contact Area Control when The crew declared an emergency, then the captain elected to hand over pilot flying duties to the first officer in order to give his attention to the overall management of the situation. Both pilots put on their oxygen masks, and begun the descent and preparations to evacuate the aircraft on the runway. Finally the aircraft landed safely.6 injured passengers received medical assistance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架载有98名乘客的航班在起飞后不久，驾驶舱出现烟雾。这架飞机被允许飞往高度层340，正要与区域管制中心联系时，驾驶舱机组人员闻到了烟味。经过一番讨论，他们决定返回出发机场。机组人员宣布了紧急情况，然后机长选择将飞行员的飞行职责交给副驾驶，以便让他关注局势的整体管理。两名飞行员都戴上了氧气面罩，开始下降，准备在跑道上撤离。最后飞机安全着陆了。6名受伤乘客在着陆后接受了医疗救助。

cards.audioText:
An Airbus with 146 passengers and 5 crew, encountered turbulence during climbing from FL320 to FL340, causing injuries to 24 passengers and 3 cabin crew.
The aircraft diverted for a safe landing on runway 32 about 25 minutes after stopping the climb at FL334. The 27 injured were taken to a hospital. Passengers reported those not belted into their seats were lifted against the ceiling and then slammed down again. A number of cabin ceiling panels received cracks.
A replacement A320 was dispatched and reached the final destination with a delay of 7.5 hours. According to NTSB, probable cause of the occurrence was an inadvertent encounter with convective turbulence while in cruise flight.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架载有146名乘客和5名机组人员的空客飞机在从高度层320上升到高度层340时遇到颠簸，造成24名乘客和3名机组人员受伤。
飞机在高度层334停止爬升后大约25分钟转向32号跑道安全降落。27名伤者被送往医院。乘客报告说，那些没有系上安全带的人被甩到天花板上，然后又砰地一声摔了下来。一些机舱天花板出现裂缝。
一架A320被派遣，在延误了7.5小时到达最终目的地。据美国国家运输安全委员会称，事故发生的可能原因是在巡航飞行中意外遇到颠簸。

cards.audioText: Flight 08 was cleared to climb to and maintain FL220. At the same time, another flight 29 was enroute at FL240. ATC instructed flight 08 to turn left heading 270. The crew however, read back "Climb FL270", which was not picked up by ATC. The crew selected FL270 into their Selected Altitude. The aircraft began to climb. Later, the radar issued an alert between these two aircraft. Then ATC instructed flight 08 to descend back to FL220 immediately. The aircraft already climbed through FL236. The separation reduced to 0 feet vertically and 2.6nm horizontally and the aircraft continued to climb reaching FL250, and re-establishing vertical separation. ATC thus instructed 08 to continue the climb to FL260.
cards.audioTextZh: 08航班被许可爬升并保持高度层220。与此同时，另一架29号航班在高度层240巡航。空中交通管制中心指示08航班左转航向270。然而，机组人员复诵成“上高度层270”，空管也没有注意到。机组人员将FL270选择到他们的“选择高度”。飞机开始爬升。后来，雷达在这两架飞机之间发出了警报。然后ATC指示08航班立即下降到高度220，飞机已经爬升到高度236。垂直距离降至0英尺，水平距离降至2.6海里，飞机继续爬升至高度层250，并重新建立垂直间隔。空管因此指示08航班继续爬升到高度层260。

cards.audioText: A flight was on NDB approach to runway 28 in instrument meteorological conditions. The aircraft descended below minimum safe altitude when it was go-around and the aircraft climbed to safe altitude. Then the crew positioned for another approach and landed safely on runway 28 after aborting the first approach. According to the investigation, the incident occurred while the aircraft performed an NDB approach without DME, probably without external visual references. Meanwhile, the first preparation of the approach was probably incomplete or imprecise.
cards.audioTextZh: 在仪表气象条件下，一架飞机在NDB进近28号跑道。当飞机被移交给塔台时，它下降到最低安全高度以下。进场管制员收到了最低安全高度警告，飞机的EGPWS也发出了警告。机组人员启动复飞，飞机爬升到安全高度。然后机组人员准备再次进近，在第一次复飞后安全降落在28号跑道上。根据调查，事故发生时，飞机在没有DME的情况下进行了NDB进近，可能没有外部视觉参考。同时，该进近的最初准备工作可能不完整或不精确。

cards.audioText:
An A320 with 114 passengers and 6 crew, departed from the runway. At that time, the left engine dropped two bonnets. In the absence of any abnormal indications and unaware of the separation, the crew continued the flight for a safe landing. Although a part of the engine cowling became stuck in the left main gear, the gear retracted normally after takeoff and extended without problems. The aircraft received minor damage at the left main gear and the left side of the fuselage, however all persons on board disembarked normally, no medical attention was needed.
The investigation has determined that the incident was caused by flying the airplane without closing and properly latching the cowls on the airplane’s left engine.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架载有114名乘客和6名机组人员的A320飞机从跑道起飞。当时，左发动机掉了两个发动机盖。机组没有注意到任何异常指示，也不知道发生了发动机罩脱落，继续飞行安全着陆。虽然发动机整流罩的一部分卡在左主起落架上，但起飞后起落架收放正常，释出无问题。飞机的左主起落架和机身左侧受到轻微损坏，但机上所有人员正常下机，没有人需要医疗救助。调查确定，该事件是由于起飞时没有关闭并正确闩上飞机左发的整流罩。

cards.audioText:
QFA67 had safely landed on runway 03, vacated the runway via taxiway but taxied past the holding point of runway 06 and crossed an illuminated stop bar without ATC clearance.
Another QFA82 was accelerating for takeoff from runway 06 when QFA67 crossed the hold short line. QFA67 became aware of their position and stopped their aircraft just before crossing the edge of runway 06. Then QFA82 rejected takeoff and came to a stop. The aircraft vacated the runway and returned to the apron. QFA82's wingtip passing about 15 meters from QFA67's nose at low speed.
The ATSB report that bad taxiway design, flight crew distraction and incorrect mental model is responsible for this runway incursion.
cards.audioTextZh:
QFA67安全降落在03号跑道，并通过滑行道离开跑道，但在没有获得空管许可的情况下滑过06号跑道的等待点，并越过有灯的停机线。
另一架QFA82在从06跑道加速起飞，当时QFA67越过等待线。QFA67意识到他们的位置，在穿过06号跑道边缘之前停了下来。然后QFA82中断起飞并停了下来。飞机离开跑道，回到停机坪。QF582的翼尖低速从QF567机头约15米处经过。
澳大利亚运输安全局报告称，滑行道设计糟糕、机组人员注意力分散和错误的思维模式是造成这次跑道入侵的原因。

cards.audioText: A B747 performing freight with 2 crew, was on a GPS/RNAV approach to A Airport runway 19L, but unintentionally landed on runway 18 of B Airport. The crew requested to vacate via taxiway D, the puzzled tower responded "stand by", then informed the crew that they were about 8nm from the original airport. The crew believed they had landed on A Airport, the even more puzzled tower replied "confirm you landed at A Airport?". Because the tower of A airport was closed at that time, the crew contacted A airport by UNICOM frequency. After which, the crew realized that they have landed on the wrong airport. In the meantime a ground person arrived at the aircraft and told the crew the local frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架载有2名机组人员的B747飞机，GPS/RNAV进近下降着陆A机场的19L跑道，但无意中降落在B机场的18跑道上。机组人员请求从D滑行道脱离，塔台困惑地回答“稍等”，然后通知机组人员他们距离原机场约8海里。机组人员认为他们已经降落在A机场，塔台更困惑的回答：“证实你降落在A机场？”由于当时A机场塔台关闭，机组人员通过UNICOM频率联系A机场。之后，机组人员意识到他们降落在了错误的机场。与此同时，一名地勤人员来到飞机上，告知了机组人员本场的频率。

cards.audioText:
An ERJ was cleared self-positioning for an ILS approach. At the same time, an ultralight aircraft was operating VFR flight below the controlled airspace. The two aircraft were on different radio frequencies.
While positioning to intercept the localizer, the ERJ automatically turned west and began to descend. Then the crew changed from automatic glideslope coupling to vertical speed and increased the rate of descent to re-capture the glideslope.
Later, the crew queried about the target on their TCAS and the altitude of the ultralight aircraft. When their distance reduced to 1 nautical mile horizontally and 200 feet vertically, the ERJ's TCAS issued a resolution advisory, and the crew initiated a go around. The aircraft made another approach and landed safely.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架ERJ被许可进行盲降进近。与此同时，另一架超轻型飞机在管制空域下方进行VFR飞行。两架飞机使用不同的无线电频率。
当飞机仍在修正位置，拦截航向道时，ERJ自动向西转向并开始下降。然后机组人员从自动下滑道切换到垂直速度，并增加下降速度以重新截获航向道。
后来，机组人员询问了TCAS上的目标和超轻型飞机的高度。在水平距离减少到1海里，垂直距离减少到200英尺时，ERJ的TCAS发出了决策咨询，机组执行了复飞。飞机再次降落并安全着陆。

cards.audioText:
An A319 with 148 passengers and 6 crew, was descending when the first officer, pilot flying, became unfit to fly, relinquished control to the captain and left the cockpit. The captain declared PANPAN and continued for a safe landing.
The probable cause of the incident was that the co-pilot experienced anxiety which developed into an anxiety attack during the approach. The captain, ATC and cabin crew worked together effectively to achieve a safe single pilot landing and to get medical help for the co-pilot.
If the co-pilot reported that he is unfit for duty, and if there were more effective communication between the co-pilot and the captain, the opportunity for the incident might had been reduced.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架载有148名乘客和6名机组人员的A319飞机在下降时，驾驶飞机的副驾驶感到不适合飞行，将控制权交给机长并离开了驾驶舱。机长做了紧急呼叫，继续安全着陆。
事故的原因可能是副驾驶在进近格拉斯哥的过程中感到紧张，并发展为焦虑。机长、空管和机组人员有效合作，实现了单人驾驶飞机的安全着陆，并为副驾驶获得了医疗帮助。
如果副驾驶报告说他不适合执勤，或者副驾驶和机长之间有更有效的沟通，发生事故的机会可能会减少。

cards.audioText:
An Eastar Jet B737 performing flight from Korea to Japan, was cleared for the approach to runway 03L. However, the aircraft was aligned with runway 03R. But the runway 03R was occupied by a vehicle. The aircraft went around from very low height. Then it positioned for another approach to runway 03L. Finally, the aircraft landed safely on runway 03L about 9 minutes after the go around.
JTSB reported that the aircraft didn’t land on the right runway as instructed by ATC. In this serious incident, it is highly probable that because the captain of the aircraft misidentified the runway. He made an approach for the different runway where an inspection vehicle was running on.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架Eastar Jet B737从韩国飞往日本，允许进近03L跑道。然而，飞机与跑道03R对齐。但是03R跑道被一辆车占用了。飞机从很低的高度盘旋。然后它定位到另一个进近跑道03L。最后，飞机在复飞约9分钟后安全降落在03L跑道上。
JTSB报告说，飞机没有按照空中交通管制的指示降落在正确的跑道上。在这次严重的事故中，很有可能是因为机长错认了跑道。他向另一条跑道靠近，一辆检查车正在跑道上行驶。

cards.audioText:
An Air France aircraft performs flight from London to Paris with 136 people on board. When the aircraft was climbing through FL230, the crew donned their oxygen masks, declared Mayday and requested an immediate return to London. The crew advised they suspected a fire on board, and then, they reported they had smoke and fumes in the cockpit. The aircraft landed safely back on runway 13R about 23 minutes after departure. The crew advised they were able to vacate the runway. Finally, the aircraft taxied to the apron.
The aircraft was able to depart about 4 hours after landing, and reached Paris with a delay of 4.5 hours. Maintenance identified a faulty display as source of the fumes and smoke.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架法航飞机从伦敦飞往巴黎，机上有136人。当飞机爬升到高度层230时，机组人员戴上氧气面罩，宣布遇险，请求立即返回伦敦。机组人员说他们怀疑飞机上着火了，然后他们报告说驾驶舱里有烟雾。飞机在起飞约23分钟后安全降落在13R跑道上。机组人员通知他们可以脱离跑道。最后，飞机滑行到停机坪上。
这架飞机在降落后约4小时起飞，在延误4.5小时后抵达巴黎。维修人员发现一个有故障的显示器是烟雾的来源。

cards.audioText:
A flight from Philippines to Singapore with 129 people on board, was descending towards Singapore when the flight crew donned their oxygen masks. declared PAN PAN, reporting excessive cabin altitude and initiated an emergency descent to 9000 feet. The aircraft continued to Singapore for a safe landing on runway 20C.
The likely cause of the excessive cabin altitude was a corruption of LFE that is landing field elevation, in the CPC. The CPC manufacturer believed that the corruption arose from a fatigue solder joint on the CPC circuit board. There had been past occurrences of excessive cabin altitude, of which one was determined to have been caused by a fatigue solder joint, similar to this occurrence.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架载有129人的航班从菲律宾飞往新加坡，正准备降落新加坡时，机组报告客舱高度过高，并戴上了氧气面罩。机组宣布“PAN PAN”，并将飞机紧急下降到9000英尺。这架飞机继续飞往新加坡，并在20中跑道安全着陆。
导致座舱高度过高的原因是可能CPC中的着陆机场标高损坏。CPC制造商认为，损坏是由CPC电路板上的焊点疲劳引起的。过去也曾发生过座舱高度过高的情况，其中有一次被确定与疲劳焊点有关，与这次发生的情况类似。

cards.audioText:
A British aircraft pushed back using a towbarless tractor at London Heathrow Airport. But that unit was disconnected from the aircraft. After receiving taxi clearance from ATC, the aircraft started moving under its own power and, shortly afterwards, collided with the tractor that had just performed the pushback. Both the right engine of the aircraft and the tractor were damaged.
The investigation report stated, that the primary causal factor was the headset operator giving the “all clear” signal to the flight crew, before the tractor had been repositioned to a safe distance. Contributory factors were the co-pilot failing to see the tractor and the tractor not driving away after the aircraft began to taxi.
cards.audioTextZh:
英国航空公司的一架飞机在伦敦希思罗机场使用无拖杆牵引车推出。但拖车与飞机并没有连接。在得到空管制中心的滑行许可后，飞机开始自行滑出，不久之后，与刚刚完成推出的拖车相撞。飞机的右发和拖车受损。
调查报告称，事故的主要原因是，在拖车被重新回到与飞机能保持安全距离之前，机务就向机组人员发出“冲突解除”的信号。导致事故的原因还包括副驾没有看到拖车。以及在飞机开始滑行后，拖车没有开走。

cards.audioText:
An ERJ190 from Durango to Mexico rejected takeoff from Durango's runway 03 because of adverse weather. The aircraft overran the end of the runway and burst into flames and was destroyed, there were no fatalities, 2 people received serious injuries and 83 people received minor injuries. Some people with injuries were taken to a local hospital.
The airline stated there were 99 passengers on board. The aircraft had operated since 2014. The local governor reported the aircraft was about to take off when it suffered an accident. According to flight data recorder as well as cockpit voice recorder, the pilots did a good job to bring the plane down, which prevented things from worse to catastrophe.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架从杜兰戈飞往墨西哥的ERJ190由于恶劣天气从杜兰戈03号跑道中断起飞。飞机冲出跑道，起火烧毁，没有人员死亡，2人受重伤，83人受轻伤。一些受伤的人被送往当地医院。
航空公司称机上有99名乘客。这架飞机自2014年以来一直在运营。当地州长报告说，飞机在即将起飞时发生了事故。从飞行数据记录仪和驾驶舱语音记录仪来看，飞行员已经尽全力将飞机停下，避免了事故变成灾难。

cards.audioText:
A flight from New York to Paris was enroute at FL380 when the crew decided to divert, reporting with left hand engine failure. The crew requested to descend to FL320. The diversion was approved, however, the request to descent took more than 15 minutes due to traffic. The aircraft continued to maintain FL380 in the meantime. Finally, the aircraft descended to FL290 and landed safely about 2 hours later. Another aircraft was sent to fly the 96 passengers and cargo to Paris.
According to the investigation, the crew attempted to move the thrust lever back and forth when the engine started to vibrate, but this resulted in the engine stalling. The crew thus declared emergency and diverted.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架从纽约飞往巴黎的航班在FL380飞行途中，机组人员决定备降，报告左发故障。机组要求下降到高度层320。备降被批准，然而，由于其他航空器，请求下降花了15多分钟。在此期间，飞机继续保持高度层380。最后，飞机下降到高度层290，并在大约2小时后安全着陆。另一架飞机将96名乘客和货物送往巴黎。
根据调查，当发动机开始振动时，机组人员试图前后移动推力杆，但这导致了发动机失速。机组人员因此宣布紧急情况并备降。

cards.audioText:
A visual approach is an ATC authorization for aircraft on IFR flight plan to proceed visually to the airport, even to the landing. It is not an instrument approach procedure, and there is no missed approach segment. Even when an aircraft is being vectored for an instrument approach, controllers may initiate or pilots may request a visual approach if the pilot reports the airport or runway in sight.
Before clearing an aircraft for a visual approach, controllers should ensure that weather conditions at the airport are VFR, and they need to resolve potential conflicts with all other aircraft. The pilot must have either the airport or the preceding aircraft in sight. This approach must be authorized and under ATC facility.
cards.audioTextZh:
目视进近是管制员对原本执行仪表飞行的飞机，计划进行目视进近，甚至到着陆的授权。它不是仪表进近程序，没有复飞环节。即使航空器处于仪表进近，只要飞行员随后报告能够目视机场或跑道，管制员就可以发布或者飞行员就可以请求目视进近。
在允许一架飞机进行目视进近之前，管制员应确保机场的天气符合目视飞行条件，并解决与所有其他飞机的潜在冲突。飞行员必须在任何时候都能看见机场或前机。目视进近的批准和实施，需要借助空中交通管制设施。

cards.audioText: A British Airways aircraft was from London to Paris.20 minutes into the flight, a passenger reported an "acrid burning smell "from seat 12A, fearing the plane was on fire, and alerted crew members. The crew conducted an immediate inspection of the seating area, but did not find any source of the burning smell. Shortly after, the smoke in the cabin was getting thicker and some passengers were having difficulty breathing. The captain had sent the "Pan-Pan "emergency signal to the control center, requesting an immediate diversion to the nearby airport! However, the smoke turned worse, the plane lost control and crashed 15 nm away from the alternate airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架英国航空公司的飞机从伦敦飞往巴黎，起飞20分钟后，一名乘客报告说，12A座位上有“辛辣的烧焦味”，他担心飞机着火了，于是通知了机组人员。机组人员立即对座位区进行了检查，但没有发现任何燃烧气味的来源。不久之后，机舱内的烟雾越来越浓，一些乘客呼吸困难。机长向管制中心发出了"Pan-Pan"紧急信号，要求立即备降到附近的机场！但是，由于浓烟越来越大，飞机失去控制，在距离备降机场15海里处坠毁。

cards.audioText:
A B767 suffered tail strike during takeoff. During the takeoff roll, the V1 call was delayed by about 10-15 knots by the captain, as he thought the aircraft might be heavier than calculated. During the rotation the TAILSKID message illuminated, indicating that the aircraft had suffered a tail strike. The captain applied full power and shortly afterwards the stick shaker activated briefly. The aircraft continued to climb away.
According to the investigation, the zero fuel weight had been incorrectly entered into the operator's Computer Take Off Programme instead of the takeoff weight. This generated significantly slower takeoff speeds than required for the actual weight of the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架B767在起飞时遭遇擦尾。在起飞过程中，V1呼叫被机长延迟了大约10-15节，因为他认为飞机可能比计算的要重。在滑跑过程中，出现TAILSKID信息，表明飞机擦尾。机长使用最大推力，不久，驾驶杆抖振器短暂地启动了。飞机继续爬升。
根据调查，零燃油重量错误地输入了电脑起飞程序，而不是起飞重量。这导致起飞速度明显低于飞机实际重量所需的起飞速度。

cards.audioText: With frequent terrorist attacks, the threat level is growing rapidly, causing deep concerns among passengers about the safety of air travel. In order to ensure flight safety, airports have no choice but to increase the number of security checks, but this also leads to frequent delays in passengers' travel. In response to the new risk of low-altitude aircraft being targeted by terrorist attacks, some have proposed installing anti-missile systems on landing gear. However, others said that although this is technically feasible, the installation of the equipment and maintenance require huge capital investment, which is a large expense for civil aviation airlines. Moreover, the installation of the system on the landing gear of civil aircraft may negatively affect the flight performance and safety of the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 恐怖袭击事件频发，其威胁程度日益升级，引发了广大旅客对航空安全的深切担忧。为确保飞行安全，机场方面不得不增设多重安检环节，但这同时也导致了旅客行程的频繁延误。面对低高度航空器可能遭受恐怖袭击的新风险，有人提出了在起落架上安装反导弹系统的解决方案。但不少人表示，这一举措虽然在技术上具有可行性，但是该设备的安装以及维护都需要巨大的资金投入，对于民航公司来说，这是一笔巨大的开支，再者，在民航飞机起落架上安装该系统可能会对飞机的飞行性能和安全性产生负面影响。

cards.audioText: The breakup of China Airlines Flight 611, a Boeing 747-200, has drawn international attention because it comes at a time of increasing concern over how long older jets can remain airworthy. Some research has suggested that metal fatigue may be a particular problem in planes that are used regularly in very warm, humid places like Taipei and Hong Kong. But Boeing maintains that with proper maintenance, aircraft aging should not be a problem. The flight data recorder shows that the plane began gaining altitude at a significantly faster rate in the 27 seconds before the plane broke apart, although the extra gain in altitude was well within the plane's design limits. The plane was supposed to be leveling off then as it approached its cruising altitude of 35,000 feet. According to the examination of the wreckage, investigators analyzed that there's no evidence of an explosion or pilot error.
cards.audioTextZh: 中华航空公司(China Airlines)一架波音747-200飞机的解体引起了国际社会的关注，因为人们越来越担心老款飞机的适航时间。一些研究表明，在台北和香港等温暖潮湿地区经常使用的飞机上，金属疲劳可能是一个尤其需要注意的问题。但是波音公司坚持认为，通过适当的维护，飞机老化应该不成问题。飞行数据记录器显示，在飞机解体前的27秒内，飞机开始以明显的更快的速度爬升，尽管此额外的爬升高度完全在飞机的设计极限之内。当飞机接近35,000英尺的巡航高度时，原本应该是平稳的。根据对飞机残骸的检查，调查人员分析，没有飞机爆炸或飞行员失误的证据。

cards.audioText:
On a flight, a middle-aged, well-off white South African Lady was not satisfied with her seat for she found herself sitting next to a black man. She called the flight attendant over and asked to change to another seat. The attendant wanted to know the reason, which made the woman more irritable. “Can’t you see? You’ve sat me next to a kaffir. I can’t possibly sit next to this disgusting human. Find me another seat!”
The flight attendant found it hard to deal with because the flight was very full, but she told the woman that she would go and check to see if there was any seat available in club or first class.
A few minutes later the attendant returned with good news. Economy and club are both full, but there were one seat in first class. When the attendant delivered the news, the lady cannot help but looked at the people around her with a smug and self-satisfied grin.
Then the attendant continued, “We don’t make this kind of upgrade as usual, however, I just got special permission from the captain and he felt that it was outrageous for our passenger to be forced to sit next to such an obnoxious person.” She then turned to the black man sitting next to the woman and said, “So if you’d like to get your things, sir, I have your seat ready for you.”
The surrounding passengers all stood and gave a standing ovation, the black guy walks up to the front of the plane.
cards.audioTextZh:
一次飞行中，有位来自南非、富有的中年白人女士对自己的座位不满意，因为她发现自己的座位在一位黑人男士旁边，她向乘务员要求换座位。乘务员询问换座位的原因，这让她更加烦躁：“你看不到吗？你们让我坐在黑人旁边，我不能坐在这么恶心的人旁边，给我换个座位！”
乘务员很难解决这个问题，因为飞机几乎客满，但她还是告诉女士她会查询公务舱或头等舱是否有空位。
几分钟后，乘务员带回了好消息。经济舱和公务舱全部客满，但头等舱还有一个座位。乘务员说到这里时，那位女士禁不住自鸣得意地笑着看向周围的人。
乘务员接着说到：“这种情况下通常不会给乘客升舱，然而机长刚才有特别许可，他不能接受我们的乘客要被迫坐在讨厌的人身边。”然后她对女士身边的乘客说：“所以如果您愿意收拾行李，我们已为您准备好座位。”
周围的乘客全部起立鼓掌，黑人乘客换到了飞机前部的座位。

cards.audioText: A strong snowstorm hit Chicago International airport in an afternoon. An aircraft from United Airlines circled several times before attempting to land at the airport. The snowstorm had reduced visibility severely. The runway visual range was at 4,500 feet below the landing minimums for the ILS approach to Runway 13 Center. The controller advised the crew to hold in the air, waiting for the weather to get better, or to divert to another airport with a longer runway. But both suggestions would produce large additional expense for the airline, as well as inconvenience of the flight's passengers. So the crew decided to circle to land on runway 31 Center, which had lower landing minimums. But unfortunately, the strong tailwind made the plane skid off the runway and crash into a stopping truck.
cards.audioTextZh: 某日下午，一场暴风雪袭击了芝加哥国际机场。一架美联航飞机准备在机场着陆，但由于能见度极低，飞机不得不在机场上空盘旋。跑道视程为4500英尺，低于13中跑道的盲降进近标准。管制员建议机组空中等待天气好转，或备降到有较长跑道的另一机场着陆，但是这两种选择均会额外增加公司成本，并给乘客带来不便，于是考虑再三，机组决定在有着较低着陆标准的31中跑道盘旋着陆。很遗憾，强顺风使飞机滑出跑道，撞上了一辆停着的卡车。

cards.audioText:
Before the first ILS approach, the pilot was advised that the runway visual range was 600 feet, then he was given a landing clearance. The pilot declared a missed approach and was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach.
After turning inbound on the localizer, the pilot was advised the runway visual range and then cleared to land. When the tower controller observed the airplane turning to the south of the runway, she issued missed approach instructions.
There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted a tall tree and collided on the ground.
According to the investigation, the pilot misinterpreted the missed approach instructions by making the right turn and then led to the accident.
(119 words)
cards.audioTextZh:
在第一次盲降进近前，飞行员被告知跑道视距为600英尺，然后他得到了着陆许可。飞行员宣布复飞，并得到雷达引导进行第二次盲降进近。
在转向对准航向道后，飞行员被告知跑道视距，然后获准着陆。塔台管制员观察到飞机转向跑道南面时，发布了复飞指令。
飞行员没有进一步的答复。飞机撞上了一棵大树，撞向地上。
据调查，飞行员错误理解了复飞指令，右转导致了事故。

cards.audioText:
A Boeing 757 and a Bombardier were seriously damaged when the tails of both airplanes collided during the pushback. The flight crew of the Bombardier reported that they were in a stopped position and their ground crew was in the process of disconnecting the tug. Company maintenance personnel stated they were pushing the 757 back and did not see the Bombardier.
Communication recordings between ground control and both airplanes revealed that the 757 was cleared for pushback from gate 80. Later, the Bombardier was cleared to push back from gate 79. The ground controller did not advise either aircraft of simultaneous adjacent pushback operations and did not forecast a traffic conflict.
(111 words)
cards.audioTextZh:
一架波音757和一架庞巴迪飞机的尾部在推出过程中相撞，严重受损。庞巴迪的机组人员报告说，当时地面人员正在断开拖车时，飞机处于停止状态。波音公司的维修人员表示，那时他们正在将757推出，并没有看到庞巴迪飞机。
地面管制和两架飞机之间的通话记录显示，这架757被允许从80号机位推出。后来，庞巴迪飞机获准从79号机位推出。管制员没有通知两架飞机存在相近机位同时进行的操作，也没有通知飞机有冲突航空器的存在。

cards.audioText:
Air France 551 departed runway 15R and over flew United 83 at Atlantic Airport. The tower controller had cleared United 83 to land on runway 10 when the aircraft was about 6 miles on final approach.
Simultaneously, ATC cleared Air France 551 for takeoff on runway 15R. Air France 551 was on taxiway when the takeoff clearance was issued. The pilots rotated at taxiway and over flew United 83 at the intersection of runways 10 and 15R. United 83 exited runway 10 afterwards.
The main cause of this incident is local controller's failure of maintaining awareness of the situation and failing to provide the appropriate separation between the two aircraft on intersecting runways.
(113 words)
cards.audioTextZh:
法航551号班机从15R跑道起飞，飞越了降落在大西洋国际机场10跑道上的美联航83。塔台管制员允许联合航空83在五边进近时降落在10号跑道上，当时飞机距离机场约6海里。
同时，管制员允许法航551在15R跑道起飞。起飞许可发布时，法航551正在滑行道上。飞行员在滑行道上滑跑，在10号跑道和15R跑道的交叉口飞过联合航空83。联航83号班机随后离开10号跑道。
此次事故的主要原因是当地管制员未能保持情景意识，未能在交叉跑道上为两架飞机提供适当的间隔。

cards.audioText: The tower controller cleared Flight 145 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 145 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight 145 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft just managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. So Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 145. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet. There were no injuries or damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind.
cards.audioTextZh: 塔台管制员允许145航班降落在22号跑道上。但是当他允许101航班从16号交叉跑道起飞时，他忘记了即将进场的飞机。145航班着陆后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员试图指示145航班在16号跑道外停止。然而，飞机只是在跑道交叉口的中间停了下来。101航班无法中止起飞。所以101航班提前离地飞，从145航班上方飞过。两架飞机只差50英尺就撞上了。两架飞机都没有人员伤亡或损坏。但这被认为是这类事件中最严重的一次。

cards.audioText:
A flight with 98 passengers, encountered smoke in cockpit shortly after departure.
The aircraft was cleared to FL340 and was about to contact Area Control when the smell of smoke was detected by the cockpit crew. After some discussion, they decided to return to Departure airport.
The crew declared an emergency, then the captain elected to hand over pilot flying duties to the first officer in order to give his attention to the overall management of the situation. Both pilots put on their oxygen masks, and begun the descent and preparations to evacuate the aircraft on the runway. Finally the aircraft landed safely. 6 injured passengers received medical assistance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架载有98名乘客的航班在起飞后不久，驾驶舱出现烟雾。
这架飞机被允许飞往高度层340，正要与区域管制中心联系时，驾驶舱机组人员闻到了烟味。经过一番讨论，他们决定返回出发机场。
机组人员宣布了紧急情况，然后机长选择将飞行员的飞行职责交给副驾驶，以便让他关注局势的整体管理。两名飞行员都戴上了氧气面罩，开始下降，准备在跑道上撤离。最后飞机安全着陆了。6名受伤乘客在着陆后接受了医疗救助。

cards.audioText:
A flight was on NDB approach to runway 28 in instrument meteorological conditions. The aircraft descended below minimum safe altitude when it was handed off to tower. The approach controller received a Minimum Safe Altitude Warning and the aircraft's EGPWS issued a warning, too. The crew initiated a go-around and the aircraft climbed to safe altitude. Then the crew positioned for another approach and landed safely on runway 28 after aborting the first approach.
According to the investigation, the incident occurred while the aircraft performed an NDB approach without DME, probably without external visual references. Meanwhile, the first preparation of the approach was probably incomplete or imprecise.
cards.audioTextZh:
在仪表气象条件下，一架飞机在NDB进近28号跑道。当飞机被移交给塔台时，它下降到最低安全高度以下。进场管制员收到了最低安全高度警告，飞机的EGPWS也发出了警告。机组人员启动复飞，飞机爬升到安全高度。然后机组人员准备再次进近，在第一次复飞后安全降落在28号跑道上。
根据调查，事故发生时，飞机在没有DME的情况下进行了NDB进近，可能没有外部视觉参考。同时，该进近的最初准备工作可能不完整或不精确。
cards.referenceText: On January 29, 2015, a Ryanair Boeing 737-800 operating flight FR8592 from London to Bergerac was conducting the NDB Y approach to runway 28 at Bergerac in instrument meteorological conditions. The aircraft descended below the minimum safe altitude when it was handed over to the tower. The approach controller received a Minimum Safe Altitude Warning, and the aircraft's EGPWS also issued a warning. The crew executed a go-around and climbed to a safe altitude. The crew then prepared for another approach and landed safely on runway 28 approximately 24 minutes after discontinuing the first approach. According to the investigation, the aircraft was conducting an NDB approach without DME and probably without external visual references. Meanwhile, the initial preparation for the approach was insufficiently precise and complete. As a result, the later corrections did not enable the crew to achieve the intended guidance mode. This caused the captain to become confused about the lateral path that the aircraft should follow. In this state of confusion, he descended below the safe altitude prematurely.
cards.referenceTextZh: 2015年1月29日，一架瑞安航空的波音737-800从伦敦飞往贝尔热拉克，执行FR8592次航班，在仪表气象条件下，使用NDB Y进近到贝尔热拉克的28跑道。飞机移交给塔台时下降到最低安全高度以下。进场管制员收到了最低安全高度警告，飞机的EGPWS也发出了警告。机组人员执行了复飞，飞机爬升到安全高度。然后，机组人员准备再次进近，在第一次中断进近约24分钟后，安全降落在28号跑道上。根据调查，事件发生时，飞机正在执行NDB进近，没有DME，可能没有外部视觉参考。与此同时，最初的进近准备不够精确、完整。结果，后期的修正没有让机组人员实现既定的制导模式。这导致机长混淆了飞机应该遵循的水平轨迹。这种混乱的状态使他提前下降到安全高度以下。

cards.audioText:
An Airbus 330, with 359 people on board, was enroute at FL380 about 200 nautical mile southwest of Perth. Then the left hand engine suffered a blade fracture. The engine ingested the blade and caused severe damage and vibrations.
The crew shut the engine down, and drifted the aircraft down to FL200, and returned to Perth for a safe landing.
Passengers reported they heard a large bang, followed by severe vibrations. They were instructed to brace for landing.
Australia's emergency services reported, they put their marine emergency services on standby for a possible water landing.
The airline reported the aircraft returned to Perth due to a technical problem and emergency services were called as precaution.
cards.audioTextZh:
亚洲航空一架空客330客机（载有359人）在珀斯西南约200海里处以38,000英尺高度巡航时，左侧发动机突发叶片断裂故障。断裂叶片被发动机吸入后引发严重机械损伤与剧烈震动。
机组随即关闭故障发动机，操纵飞机缓慢下降至20,000英尺高度，最终安全返航降落在珀斯机场。
乘客反映曾听到巨大爆裂声并伴随强烈震动，机组随后指导乘客做好防撞姿势准备紧急降落。
澳大利亚应急部门证实，曾启动海上救援待命程序以防飞机迫降海面。航空公司声明称本次返航系技术故障导致，呼叫应急支援仅为预防措施。

cards.audioText: A British Airways aircraft was from London to Paris. 20 minutes into the flight, a passenger reported an "acrid burning smell" from seat 12A, fearing the plane was on fire, and alerted crew members. The crew conducted an immediate inspection of the seating area, but did not find any source of the burning smell. Shortly after, the smoke in the cabin was getting thicker and some passengers were having difficulty breathing. The captain had sent the "Pan-Pan" emergency signal to the control center, requesting an immediate diversion to the nearby airport! However, the smoke turned worse, the plane lost control and crashed 15 nm away from the alternate airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架英国航空公司的飞机从伦敦飞往巴黎，起飞20分钟后，一名乘客报告说，12A座位上有“辛辣的烧焦味”，他担心飞机着火了，于是通知了机组人员。机组人员立即对座位区进行了检查，但没有发现任何燃烧气味的来源。不久之后，机舱内的烟雾越来越浓，一些乘客呼吸困难。机长向管制中心发出了“Pan-Pan”紧急信号，要求立即备降到附近的机场！但是，由于浓烟越来越大，飞机失去控制，在距离备降机场15海里处坠毁。

cards.audioText:
On 17 January 2008, a Boeing 777 aircraft of British Airways crashed before reaching runway 27L at Heathrow. Of the 152 people on board, 47 were injured.
On impact with the ground, the nose gear collapsed, and the right main gear separated from the aircraft, puncturing the fuel tank and penetrating the cabin, causing a major fuel leak and the release of oxygen gas.
The final report of the investigation said the ice crystals in the jet fuel were blamed as the cause of the accident, clogging the fuel/oil heat exchanger (FOHE) of each engine. This restricted fuel flow to the engines during final approach. Subsequently, the European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) mandated that substantial modifications and a redesign of the engine were required.
cards.audioTextZh:
2008年1月17日，英国航空公司一架波音777飞机在希思罗机场27L跑道前方坠毁，未能抵达跑道。机上152人中，47人受伤。
在撞击地面时，前起落架坍塌，右主起落架与机身分离，刺穿燃油箱并穿透客舱，造成大量燃油泄漏和氧气释放。
调查最终报告指出，事故原因为喷气燃料中的冰晶堵塞了每台发动机的燃油/滑油热交换器（FOHE），导致无边进近阶段发动机燃油供应受限。随后，欧洲航空安全局（EASA）要求对发动机进行大幅修改和重新设计。

cards.audioText: An aircraft was ready for taxi and it was cleared to taxi to the departure runway holding point. It was also approved to cross an inner and outer taxiway en route, so the pilot released the parking brake. When the aircraft started to move, the pilot saw a B747 on his left, and the B747 went faster than him. The controller immediately instructed the pilot to hold short and give way to the B747 but the pilot only paid attention to the B747 on his left, so he didn’t follow the instruction and continued to move to the threshold. The aircraft stopped when the First Officer warned “stop!” and the pilot applied the brakes at once. When a pilot made errors, the First Officer played important role. Without the First Officer, their aircraft would have probably collided with another aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机在准备滑行，并且得到滑行到等待点的许可。滑行路线允许穿过内侧和外侧滑行道.，所以飞行员松开了刹车。飞机开始移动后，飞行员看到左侧有一架波音747，这架波音747的速度更快。管制员立刻指挥飞机等待给波音747让路，但飞行员只注意到左侧的波音747，所以他并没有听到指令，而是继续向入口移动。副驾驶发出警告说：“停下！”于是飞行员立刻进行刹车。飞行员出现错误时，副驾驶的作用很重要。如果不是副驾驶，他们的飞机很可能与另一架飞机相撞。

cards.audioText: A flight flew from Beijing to Shanghai. During the flight, the aircraft requested radar vectors to Shanghai Approach for losing some altitude. The inbound course was 157° and altitude was 3000 feet. The controller gave the instruction, “Fly heading 130°, intercept LOC Runway 16”, but after following the instruction, TCAS showed several targets. Then the ATC gave another instruction, “Do not cross LOC course, for separation”. The pilot responded, “Wilco”. When they captured, they reported to the ATC, but the ATC said “I told you, do not capture LOC course.” Both the pilots were not sure about the ATC’s meaning but they continued to approach and landed safely. After the flight, the flight crew discussed about the ATC instruction, and they thought the instruction could be understood differently. It was a fortune that they landed safely, so the ATC must use standard words to give clear instructions when they were working.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架飞机从北京飞往上海。途中，飞机向上海进近申请雷达引导下降高度。向台航道157°，高度3000英尺。管制员给出指令：“航向130°，切入跑道16航道。”但完成指令后，TCAS显示几个活动目标。然后ATC给出另一指令：“不要穿过航道，保持间隔。”飞行员回复：“照办。”飞机截获航道时，飞行员向ATC报告，但ATC说：“我说的是，不要截获航道。”两位飞行员无法确定ATC的意图，但他们继续进近并安全着陆。飞行结束后，机组对ATC的指令进行讨论，他们认为指令可以有不同的理解方式。幸运的是飞机能够安全着陆，所以ATC在工作时必须使用标准用语来给出指令。

cards.audioText: At 1:30 pm local time, the crew members checked in for a long distance flight, and the aircraft took off after 3:30 pm. Another 2 hours later, the operation asked the aircraft to return back to the airport of departure because of technical fault, so the captain had to tell passengers about what was going on via PA. After landing, the flight crew had worked for about 8 hours, and their work should be taken over under the circumstances, but the operation told them that they had to change to operate another shorter and delayed flight. It was already eight o’clock after the aircraft landed. Three of the crew decided not to operate the flight and I supported their opinion. Two replacement crew members arrived at the aircraft and they still needed to operate their new flight. At about ten o’clock, everything was ready for departure. The crew members hadn’t had any formal meal since then.
cards.audioTextZh: 当地时间下午1:30，机组成员到达机场为长途飞行做准备，飞机在下午3:30后起飞。起飞2小时后，由于机械故障，运控要求飞机返回出发机场，于是机长通过广播将情况告知机上乘客。飞机着陆后，机组成员已工作8小时，在这种情况下，他们的工作可由其他人接手，但运控要求机组成员为另一个延误的短途航班工作。飞机着陆时已经是晚上8点，有3名机组成员决定不再继续工作，我支持他们的观点。两组替换机组到达机场，他们仍需要操作他们的新航班。在10点左右，离场准备就绪，从工作开始机组成员还没有用正餐。

cards.audioText:
In 2005, direct charter flight between Chinese mainland and Taiwan was opened. Departure and destination airports included Beijing, Guangzhou, Shanghai and Taipei. It was the first ever non-stop, round-trip charter flight across the Taiwan Straits in 56 years. It was also the first time since 1949 that a mainland jetliner flew for Taiwan on normal commercial flight.
The first mainland aircraft to take off was CCA1087 which departed from the Beijing Capital Airport at 8:00 am on Saturday. All the 88 passengers on board were Taiwan business people and their families. During the Spring Festival, they went back home for traditional family reunion.
The first mainland aircraft to land was CSZ3097. It only took 90 minutes for all the 242 passengers on board to fly from Guangzhou to Taipei.
After nearly 4 hours of non-stop flight, a charter plane of Taiwan-based China Airlines landed in Beijing. The flight time was much shorter than the same trip in the past. Previous flight would take about 10 hours, and passengers had to transit in Hong Kong or Macao.
The direct charter flight will provide convenience to people on the mainland and Taiwan.
cards.audioTextZh:
2005年，内地和台湾的直达航班开通。出发和到达的城市包括北京、广州、上海和台北。这是56年来海峡两岸首次开通直达往返航班，同时也是自1949年起，大陆客机第一次到台湾进行商业飞行。
最早从内地起飞的航班是国航1087，飞机在周六上午8点从北京首都机场起飞。机上的88名乘客全部为台湾商人和他们的家属。春节期间，他们回家与亲友团聚。
最先着陆的航班是南航3097，飞机从广州出发，机上242名乘客仅需90分钟就到达台北。
在4小时的连续飞行后，一架来自台湾航空公司中华航空的航班在北京降落。和之前从台湾到北京的航班相比，这次飞行的时间缩短了很多。之前的航班需要飞行10小时，乘客们必须在香港或澳门中转。
直飞航班会为内地和台湾的乘客们提供便利。

cards.audioText: With people's attempts to increase air traffic capacity, the amount and complexity of air traffic increases. Meanwhile, I'll say, for air traffic can hardly do without accurate and efficient communication between pilots and controllers. After studying analyzed voice tapes from ATC facilities, we found that only less than 1% of the pilot and controllers voice had communication error that affected the communication accuracy. But we should not ignore the potential seriousness due to the overall low error rate. The number of communication error per hour should not be neglected across ATC environments. The number of read back errors on a single frequency was close to 1 per hour. To reduce the incident of communication errors, to know the causes of these errors should come first. The intention of the study was to find out different factors that lead to communication errors. In the analysis, there are not only reports submitted to the aviation safety system, but also detailed explanation why the pilots and controllers involved made errors through those specific types of errors and insight. Reports provide an efficient means of studying communication error. In the total 386 reports included in this analysis, the communication errors found in this study could be classified into three types: Read back, hear back error, no pilot read back and hear back error type too.
cards.audioTextZh: 随着人们不断设法提高空中交通容量，空中交通的数量和复杂程度也随之增加。空中交通运行离不开飞行员与管制员之间准确而高效的通信。对空中交通管制设施的语音录音进行研究分析后发现，飞行员和管制员的通话中，影响通信准确性的错误所占比例不到1%。然而，不能因为总体错误率较低就忽视其潜在的严重后果；在各种空中交通管制环境中，每小时发生的通信错误数量仍不容忽视。单一频率上的复诵错误接近每小时1次。要减少通信错误事件，首先必须了解这些错误产生的原因。本研究旨在找出导致通信错误的不同因素。分析材料不仅包括提交给航空安全系统的报告，还包括对相关飞行员和管制员为何会犯下特定类型错误的详细说明和认识。报告为研究通信错误提供了有效途径。本次分析共纳入386份报告，研究发现的通信错误可分为三类：复诵—监听纠错错误、飞行员未复诵，以及监听纠错错误。

cards.audioText:
One day, an accident happened because an aircraft was guided improperly by a marshaller when parking.
The marshaller first guided the aircraft to a gate. When the aircraft was near the stop line, the marshaller gave a premature crossed wands signal which means stopping taxiing, so the aircraft was stopped abruptly. The pilot set the parking brake and released the seatbelt sign. Unexpectedly, the marshaller showed the separated wands again and stopped them a little forward of the point. He did not give a clear signal, and the sudden stop caused fatigue and a medical emergency of 2 passengers. When the marshaller was asked about the signal, he said he did not give the signal. Anyway, it was not a good guidance but the final position of the aircraft was proper. Luckily there were no injuries on board.
cards.audioTextZh:
某天，一架飞机由于停机时引导不当而出现事故。
信号员首先引导飞机滑行到机位，飞机靠近停机线时，信号员给出交叉信号，表示飞机停止滑行，所以飞机在滑行中突然停止。飞行员松开刹车并关闭安全带信号。意外的是，信号员又给出分开信号，并让飞机在机位前一点停下。信号员给出的指令不明确，飞机突然停下，导致2名乘客需要急救。当信号员被问及给出的信号时，他说他并没有给出这种信号。无论如何，飞机没有得到良好引导，但最后的停机位置是合适的。幸运的是机上无人受伤。

cards.audioText:
When a B747 was climbing out, its No.1 engine failed. The failure caused the aircraft to yaw the heading about 20 degrees from the original.
The Primary Engine Display showed that the thrust was zero, the engine indications were all red, and the temperature was exceeding 680℃. The aircraft had autopilot disconnection, then it suddenly yawed and the heading deviated 10 degrees. The pilot immediately leveled off the aircraft so that he could check the engine. Then he confirmed that No.1 engine was failed.
The EGT temperature was still high when all proper procedures were done. So the pilot pulled out the engine fire lever to secure the engine and completed the checklist. Because of the landing weight requirements, the aircraft had to dump fuel before landing. Then the pilot requested radar vector to the fuel dumping area and started dumping fuel at 8000 feet. During the 35 minutes of dumping, the controller asked other aircraft to avoid the dumping area. At last, they made an auto landing then taxied to the gate safely.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架B747在上升，此时1号发动机失效。故障导致飞机从原航线偏航20度。
主发动机显示器显示推力为零，发动机故障显示亮起，温度超过680℃。飞机的自动驾驶断开，然后飞机突然偏航10度。飞行员立刻平飞来检查发动机，然后飞行员确定1号发动机已失效。
所有程序全部完成后，EGT温度仍然很高，所以飞行员拉出发动机灭火手柄来保护发动机，并完成检查单。由于着陆重量限制，飞机着陆前必须放油。飞行员请求雷达引导到放油区，然后在8000英尺高开始放油。放油持续了35分钟，这期间管制员指挥其它飞机避开放油区。最后，飞机自动着陆并安全滑到停机位。

cards.audioText: A B737 was cleared to taxi to holding point of runway 29 while the pilot saw the landing lights of A320 on landing rollout at the opposite end of the runway. A320 had landed on runway 11 and a conflict was nearly to happen. In order to exit the runway quickly, the pilot of B737 turned 180 degrees. At the same time, tower called and gave him instruction to vacate the runway. The B737 almost collided with A320 but there were nothing wrong with the two aircraft. The cause of this possible accident was that the two operations were conducted in both directions on runway 11/29. A320 was landing on runway 11 while B737 was holding short of runway 29 and waiting for ATC clearance at the same time. Then the tower called them and instructed them to fly SH-01 departure and climb 7000 feet when airborne, but they considered it as a clearance, so they began to taxi onto the runway. At that time, the tower and ground were combined. The pilot had called the tower twice without receiving any response, so he was not sure whether the aircraft had landed.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架B737可以滑行到跑道29的等待点，这时飞行员看到A320的着陆灯出现在跑道相反方向。A320在跑道11着陆，两架飞机即将相撞。为了快速离开跑道，B737的飞行员将飞机转180度。同时，塔台呼叫B737并给出脱离跑道的指令。B737和A320差一点相撞，好在两架飞机都未出现问题。导致这起事件的发生可能由于两架飞机运行了11和29号跑道的不同方向。A320在跑道11着陆，同一时间B737在跑道29等待ATC许可。之后，塔台呼叫飞机给出离场指令，SH-01离场，离地后上升到7000英尺。他们认为这是许可，所以两架飞机开始在跑道滑行。当时塔台和地面的信号重合了。飞行员呼叫塔台两次，但没有收到任何回复，所以他不确定飞机是否已着陆。

cards.audioText:
The ATC cleared an aircraft to take off, but shortly after take-off, two of the flight attendants smelled something burning. They immediately informed the purser while found that the captain had already contacted the Tower and requested airport assistance. Some passengers felt panic when they saw the smoke in the cabin.
Soon captain told passengers about the situation via PA. A few minutes later, dense smoke spread all over the cabin and some passengers suffered from smoke inhalation. At the same time, the flight attendants consulted their emergency checklist and tried to keep the passengers in order.
The aircraft finally returned to the departure airport. Fire trucks arrived and ambulances were ready to meet them at the apron. Fortunately, all the passengers were safely evacuated and got effective first aid. After inspection, the cause of the accident was clear. It was an electrical fire in the cockpit.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架飞机从ATC处得到起飞许可，但在起飞后不久，两名乘务员闻到烧焦的味道，他们立刻通知了乘务长，同时发现机长已经联系塔台并请求机场援助。一些乘客看到客舱有烟开始感到恐慌。
很快，机长通过广播将情况告知乘客。几分钟后，客舱内布满浓烟，有些乘客吸入了烟尘。此时，乘务员完成紧急检查单并尽力维持乘客的秩序。
飞机最终返回出发机场，消防车和救护车在机坪等待飞机。幸运的是，乘客们全部被安全撤离并得到急救。经检查，事故原因是由于驾驶舱发生电气火灾。

cards.audioText:
In 1986, a little girl named Crystal Grant living in Memphis, Tennessee got a liver disease and needed a liver transplant. Her family got information that a liver source became available but she must fly to Houston, Texas, she would be able to take the medical treatment. Before departure, an accident happened that the plane blew a couple of tires and ran off the runway into a fence while taking off.
At the same time, a Coca-Cola corporate jet had just arrived at the airport carrying their CEO, and the pilot who saw the accident heard the experience of Crystal. Then the pilot briefed the CEO about the story. After visiting Crystal, the CEO decided to take her to Houston by his corporate jet.
Meanwhile, the liver which Crystal needed was in San Diego, California, but the flight to transport the liver got failed.
The CEO asked the pilot if they could fly to San Diego to pick up the liver first, but found that they would not have enough time for the transplant.
Then the CEO contacted the governor of California and explained the situation. Finally, the governor dispatched an F-18 fighter jet to safely transport the liver container to Houston. Everything ran smoothly and the little girl got a successful transplant.
cards.audioTextZh:
1986年，家住田纳西州孟菲斯的女孩Crystal Grant身患肝病，需要肝脏移植。她的家人得知有可用的肝脏来源，但Crystal必须去得克萨斯州的休斯顿做手术。Crystal乘坐的飞机发生了事故，起飞时，轮胎爆胎，飞机冲出跑道撞向围栏。
这时，可口可乐公司的公务机到达同一机场，飞机上是公司CEO，公务机的飞行员看到了事故过程并听到了Crystal的故事，然后他将故事告诉了CEO。看望Crystal后，CEO决定用公务机送Crystal去休斯顿。
Crystal需要的肝脏来源在加利福尼亚州的圣地亚哥，但是运送肝脏的飞机出现故障。
CEO询问飞行员是否能先飞到圣地亚哥，但他们发现这样会没有足够时间进行手术。
然后，CEO联系到加利福尼亚州的州长，并解释了这个情况。最后，州长派遣F-18战斗机将肝脏运送到休斯顿。手术进行得很顺利，Crystal成功接受了移植。

cards.audioText:
A man was on a flight from Seattle to San Francisco, but along the way, the plane stopped unexpectedly in Sacramento. The flight attendant explained the situation and told passengers that they could get off the aircraft for a walk within 50 minutes before the plane re-boarded.
Passengers got off the plane in succession except one person. When the man walked by the only person on board he could tell the person was a blind man. Because the man was wearing sunglasses and a seeing eye dog was lying quietly underneath the seat in front of him. The blind man had flown this flight frequently because the pilot could call him by name. The pilot asked, “Keith, we’re in Sacramento for almost an hour. Would you like to get off and stretch your legs?” The blind man said no but he asked the pilot if he could take his dog for a walk.
What the pilot did not know was, all the people in the gate area came to a complete standstill when they saw him, because the pilot got off the plane with a seeing eye dog and a pair of sunglasses on. It caused a panic between passengers that they thought the pilot was a blind man. They not only tried to change planes, but also wanted to change airlines! It took time for the pilot and flight attendants to explain to passengers and calm them down. Later the aircraft took off again.
cards.audioTextZh:
一位男士乘坐飞机从西雅图飞往旧金山，途中飞机突然在萨克拉门托降落。乘务员向乘客解释了情况，并告诉他们可以在起飞前下飞机活动50分钟。乘客们依次下飞机，但有一位乘客没走。当男士经过这位乘客时，他注意到这位乘客是盲人。因为他戴着墨镜，一只导盲犬安静地躺在他前方的座位下。这位盲人肯定经常乘坐这趟航班，因为飞行员能够直接叫出他的名字。飞行员问他：“Keith，我们将在萨克拉门托停留一小时，你想下飞机活动一下吗？”这位盲人拒绝了，但他问飞行员是否可以带他的导盲犬散个步。
但飞行员不知道的是，门口的乘客在看到他时全都停下了，因为他在下飞机时戴着墨镜并牵着一只导盲犬。这引发了乘客们的恐慌，他们以为飞行员是个盲人。乘客们不仅想更换航班，而且还想更换航空公司！飞行员和乘务员花了一段时间向乘客解释情况并让大家冷静下来，之后飞机再次起飞了。

cards.audioText: A worker in the airport just finished his work, while he was walking along the apron he found a female pilot was struggling with a huge package. The package was stuck, half of the package was in the plane and another half was out. The worker was a very kind and warmhearted man, so he tried to help the female pilot. He went into the plane and tried his best to push the package, but the package did not move and nothing happened. Later the worker and the pilot decided to push and pull at the same time. They tried so hard over and over again and both got exhausted, but they still couldn’t move the package. The worker felt hopeless and he said it was impossible to get the package out of the plane. Then he heard the pilot shrieking, “Oh, no! I was trying to stuff it in!”
cards.audioTextZh: 一位机场工人刚结束工作，他在停机坪看到一位女飞行员正在费力处理一个大包裹。包裹被卡住，一半在飞机内一半在飞机外。这位工人很热心，所以他想帮助这个女飞行员。他走到机舱内并尽力将包裹向外推，但是包裹根本没有挪动。之后，工人和飞行员决定一个人推的同时另一个人拉。他们一次次努力，两个人都很累，但仍然没有挪动包裹。工人感到很绝望，他说包裹可能没办法从飞机里拿出来了，然后他听到了飞行员的大叫：“不！我是想将包裹放进去！”

cards.audioText: After a training course, an ATC trainee was taking a walk with his master in the airport when they found a pair of shoes on the ground. The shoes must belong to a worker who was working in the airport and the young trainee wanted to play tricks on the worker by hiding these shoes. He wanted to see how the worker would react but was stopped by his master. His master advised him, "The poor should not be made fun of". Then the master put ＄1 in each shoe for he hoped that it would be a small favor for the worker. Soon the worker returned from work and he lay his head on the shoes to take a nap. Feeling something hard, he checked his shoes and surprisingly found ＄2. There was no one around so the worker thought it must be a gift from god, then he got down on his knees and prayed. The trainee was touched and he finally understood "It is more blessed to give than to get. "
cards.audioTextZh: 一次培训课程结束后，一名空中交通管制学员和师傅在机场散步，发现地上放着一双鞋。鞋子应该属于一名正在机场干活的工人。年轻学员想把鞋藏起来捉弄工人，看看他会有什么反应，却被师傅制止了。师傅劝他说：“不应该拿穷人取乐。”随后，师傅在每只鞋里放了1美元，希望能给工人一点小小的帮助。不久，工人干完活回来，把头靠在鞋上准备小睡。感觉到鞋里有硬东西后，他检查鞋子，惊讶地发现了2美元。四周没有人，工人以为这一定是上帝的恩赐，于是跪下祈祷。学员深受触动，终于明白了“施比受更有福”的道理。

cards.audioText:
Lately I was on a VFR flight. We were passing within Aerodrome Traffic Zone under the control of Local Approach, visibility was good, and there was not too much traffic on the frequency.
The controller requested a position report by asking if we were over an Island, the feature cannot be found on the half million chart and I was not familiar with it. So I looked for it and asked for clarification. During the period a potential Airprox developed. Fortunately the pilot noted it and avoided it by an evasive maneuver.
The pilot and I were both annoyed by the controller for using an unrecognizable local feature which caused confusion and distraction for us. We were squawking 7000 Mode C, so our position should be known. If not, or if there were too much traffic on screen, the controller should have asked for a specific squawk.
Controllers should know that non-local pilots only navigate according to charted features. To avoid accidents, local knowledge should be taken seriously.
cards.audioTextZh:
最近在一次目视飞行时，我们在当地进近的指挥下通过机场活动区域，能见度很好，频率里也没有很多飞机。
管制员要我们报位置报，询问我们是否飞过某个岛，我在地形图上看不到这个岛，我对这里的地形也并不熟悉，所以我试图寻找这个地形并要求管制员进行说明。在这期间，飞机险些与其它飞机相撞。幸运的是，飞行员通过规避机动避免了事故。
飞行员和我都很恼火，由于管制员在指挥时使用无法找到的当地地形，导致我们很迷惑并为此分神。我们的应答机是C模式，编码7000，所以管制员应该知道飞机的位置。如果管制员不知道，或屏幕上有太多活动，管制员应向我们要求特定的编码。
管制员要了解，非当地的飞行员只能根据图表上的地形导航。为避免事故发生，要谨慎使用当地知识进行指挥。

cards.audioText:
The flight was flying to UK, and before landing, we were asked to hold at FL150 for approximately 30 minutes delay due to the weather.
The ATC first instructed us to hold at a level around FL100 and the next clearance was understood as descending to the next lower level, when we were at or near FL80, ATC asked if we had turned onto heading 080.
The situation was embarrassing. I had to apologize on the radio telephone and ATC responded, “No problem”, with updated heading and further descent. However, that airport was not the place to be at the wrong level and heading on a busy, rough Sunday night!
In the days following, by giving the incident much thought, I found the major contributing factor of my mistake. We were not supposed to hear what we thought we should hear, thus confusing heading and cleared level. Instead, we should pay attention to the ATC instruction.
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机正飞往英国。着陆前，由于天气，我们要在高度层150等待30分钟左右。
ATC首先指挥我们在高度层100等待，我们认为下个指令应该是下降到更低高度，当我们接近高度层80时，ATC询问我们是否转向航向080。
这种情况让人很为难，我不得不在通话时道歉，ATC回复：“没关系”，然后告知我修正后的航向和下降高度。然而，在繁忙的周日晚，错误的高度层和航向会让飞机无法到达机场！
接下来的几天中，我对这件事思考了很多，并找到出现错误的主要原因。我们不应假设自己会收到什么指令，从而会弄混航向和高度。相反，我们应关注ATC给出的指令。

cards.audioText: John was the captain of a flight from Shanghai to Hong Kong. On July 20th, he and his first officer, Ted, controlled the airplane to take off from Shanghai airport. When the plane reached 1200 feet, a windshear warning occurred with the warning sound echoed in the cockpit. Under those circumstances, John took over the control immediately and called for the checklist. The result showed the left PFD indicated normally and only a malfunction indication appeared on the right seat PFD. The flight crew came to an agreement it was a false warning, so they continued to climb. The plane safely landed on Hong Kong airport 3 hours later. The crew asked a ground maintenance personnel to fix the problem. Unfortunately, on the way back, the same trouble appeared again.
cards.audioTextZh: John是一架上海飞往香港的航班的机长。6月20日，他和副驾驶Ted操作飞机从上海机场起飞。到达1200英尺时，飞机出现风切变警报，警报音回响在驾驶室内。在这种情况下，John立刻接管飞机操作并完成检查单。结果显示左侧主飞行显示器显示正常，只有右侧主飞行显示器有故障指示。机组一致认为警报出错，所以飞机继续上升。3小时后，飞机在香港机场安全着陆，机组请地面维修人员进行维修。不幸的是，在返回途中相同的问题再次出现了。

cards.audioText: During a flight from Hong Kong to Beijing, we captured an urgency call from UAL320 that they had a bird strike. A bird crashed their left windshield and the captain was badly wounded by the broken glass, so they requested for priority landing and ambulance. We informed this serious incident to the controller. The controller contacted the UAL320 at once without receiving any response. So we were asked to relay the instruction to UAL320. Luckily, we contacted them successfully, “UAL320, CCA830, Beijing Approach cleared you ILS straight in approach runway 16R, you are number one, ambulance and first aid will be ready for you.” “Roger, thank you very much”, the UAL320 replied. Finally, the aircraft landed on Beijing airport safely and the captain was sent to hospital immediately. There were no other people injured on the airplane.
cards.audioTextZh: 在香港飞往北京途中，我们接到来自美联航320的紧急呼叫，他们的飞机遭遇鸟击。有鸟撞到左边挡风玻璃，玻璃破损，机长受重伤，所以他们请求优先着陆和救护车。我们将这起严重事故告诉管制员，管制员立刻联系美联航320，但没有收到任何回复。于是管制员要求我们传送指令给美联航320。幸运的是，我们与美联航320成功建立联系，“美联航320，国航830，北京进近同意直接盲降进近跑道16右，你是第一个，救护车和急救已就位。”“收到，非常感谢。”美联航320这样回复我们。飞机最终在北京机场安全着陆，机长被立刻送往医院，机上没有其他人员受伤。

cards.audioText: I still remember my solo day. On that day, the vice president of the United States was driven to the airport. Air force 2, a new B757, landed at about 9 o’clock but we had to wait until all the formalities were completed on the apron. My CFI had asked me if I was ready for solo. At that time I said yes because of my confidence, and the clear weather also helped, but when I got into the cockpit and knew the CFI wasn’t coming, I still felt a bit nervous and I hoped not to screw it up. Everything was as usual and it was even better for me to notice that the plane had a better climb rate and there was a lot more room in the C150 with only one person. Everything went by the book except when I lost mic on the floor and stumbled with repeated clearance of the option. Three landings seemed better than the once I did when the CFI was with me. The airplane finally safely landed with everything going smoothly. On my way home I thought about this experience of flying a real airplane alone. To have the vice president fly all that way just watch me solo gave me more confidence about myself.
cards.audioTextZh: 到现在我还能想起单飞那天的经历。那天，美国副总统到达机场。空军二号，一架全新波音757，在9点左右着陆，但我们必须在机坪等待所有仪式完成。我的总飞行教练之前询问我是否已准备好单飞，由于对自己有信心，并且天气条件好，我回答没问题。但当我走进驾驶舱得知总飞行教练不在时，我还是感到有些紧张，并且希望我不会犯错误。飞行一切正常，我甚至感到飞机有更好的爬升率，单独一个人在塞斯纳150上显得舱内很空旷。所有事情都按照检查单执行除了我把麦克风掉在了地上而且蹩脚的重复执行了许可选项。这三个落地比之前跟总飞行教练飞得都要好。最终，飞机安全降落，飞行顺利。回家的路上，我在回想这次单独飞行的经历。副总统特地赶过来看我单飞这件事情上给了我莫大的自信。

cards.audioText: On a flight, a middle-aged, well-off white South African Lady was not satisfied with her seat for she found herself sitting next to a black man. She called the flight attendant over and asked to change to another seat. The attendant wanted to know the reason, which made the woman more irritable. "Can't you see? You've sat me next to a kaffir. I can't possibly sit next to this disgusting human. Find me another seat!" The flight attendant found it hard to deal with because the flight was very full, but she told the woman that she would go and check to see if there was any seat available in club or first class. A few minutes later the attendant returned with good news. Economy and club are both full, but there were one seat in first class. When the attendant delivered the news, the lady cannot help but looked at the people around her with a smug and self-satisfied grin. Then the attendant continued, "We don't make this kind of upgrade as usual, however, I just got special permission from the captain and he felt that it was outrageous for our passenger to be forced to sit next to such an obnoxious person. "She then turned to the black man sitting next to the woman and said, "So if you'd like to get your things, sir, I have your seat ready for you. "The surrounding passengers all stood and gave a standing ovation, the black guy walks up to the front of the plane.
cards.audioTextZh: 一次飞行中，有位来自南非、富有的中年白人女士对自己的座位不满意，因为她发现自己的座位在一位黑人男士旁边，她向乘务员要求换座位。乘务员询问换座位的原因，这让她更加烦躁：“你看不到吗？你们让我坐在黑人旁边，我不能坐在这么恶心的人旁边，给我换个座位！”乘务员很难解决这个问题，因为飞机几乎客满，但她还是告诉女士她会查询公务舱或头等舱是否有空位。几分钟后，乘务员带回了好消息。经济舱和公务舱全部客满，但头等舱还有一个座位。乘务员说到这里时，那位女士禁不住自鸣得意地笑着看向周围的人。乘务员接着说到：“这种情况下通常不会给乘客升舱，然而机长刚才有特别许可，他不能接受我们的乘客要被迫坐在讨厌的人身边。”然后她对女士身边的乘客说：“所以如果您愿意收拾行李，我们已为您准备好座位。”周围的乘客全部起立鼓掌，黑人乘客换到了飞机前部的座位。

cards.audioText:
The flight was from New York to Dallas. When passengers were boarding, an elderly couple found a woman occupied their seats in first class. The flight attendant wanted to see her boarding pass to solve the problem, but the woman responded in fake broken English, “No English, pas anglais.”
The attendant knew it was a pretence because the woman had been chatting a bit with another passenger. Then, she tried to persuade the woman to show the boarding pass but only to get disregard. At last, she had to use French to talk with the woman. The woman was so surprised that she let go of her ticket and gave it to the attendant. After checking the boarding pass, the attendant walked the woman all the way to her seat which was at the back of the plane, then she returned to first class.
During the flight, the woman continued complaining in French and asking that attendant to serve her. The attendant smiled and served her everything she wanted, but talked with her in English as she spoke in French.
Finally, the flight landed safely at Dallas. The woman was one of the last people off the plane. She demanded the attendant’s name and worker ID so she could complain about her. Unexpectedly, the attendant smiled and told the woman it would be nice if she stopped pretending that she couldn’t speak or understand English. The woman scowled and marched off the plane.
cards.audioTextZh:
一架飞机从纽约飞往达拉斯。登机时，一对老夫妇发现一位女士坐在他们的头等舱座位上。乘务员想检查她的登机牌，但她用蹩脚的英语回复：“不会英语。”
乘务员知道这是借口，因为她之前在用英语和另一位乘客交谈。之后，乘务员想劝说女士出示登机牌，但是她完全不理。最后，乘务员不得不用法语和她交流，她非常惊讶于是放手把票给了乘务员。检查完登机牌后，乘务员带领女士走到她位于飞机后部的座位，然后乘务员回到了头等舱。
整个飞行期间，这位女士一直在用法语抱怨并要求那位乘务员为她提供服务。乘务员微笑着满足她的要求，但始终用英语回复她的法语。
最终飞机在达拉斯安全降落，这位女士是最后下飞机的乘客们之一，她想知道乘务员的名字和证件号去投诉。意外的是，乘务员微笑着告诉她，如果她能不再假装不懂英语就好了。这位女士皱着眉走下了飞机。

cards.audioText: A ridiculous accident happened when a flight was coming back from Poland in 1998. The plane had just landed at the airport when a guy on board claimed that he had a bomb. All the passengers started to panic. The pilot immediately contacted ATC and asked for emergency services. Because of the man’s allegation the plane couldn’t get to the gate, so the plane had to board on a bus. All the luggage on the plane was removed and sniffed by a dog. The flight crew and passengers waited and watched for 3 hours without air conditioning and food or anything. After searching, it turned out that there was no bomb on board. The guy was just drunk, and he went mad because they wouldn't give him another beer.
cards.audioTextZh: 1998年，一架从波兰返回的飞机上发生了一起荒唐的事故。飞机刚在机场着陆，此时机上一名乘客声称他携带炸弹，乘客们开始恐慌。飞行员立刻联系ATC请求紧急援助。由机上有炸弹，飞机无法到达机位，于是乘客不得不登上摆渡车。机上所有行李都被卸下飞机由嗅探犬进行排查。机组和乘客们在没有空调、水和食物的情况下等待了3小时。经检查，飞机上根本没有炸弹。那位醉酒乘客的疯狂举动，仅仅是因为他不能再喝啤酒了。

cards.audioText: Before the flight, a man used his miles to upgrade to first class. He thought this would make his flight much more comfortable than usual, but what happened later proved he was wrong. He sat next to an old lady whose family members were in economy class. Soon after take-off, when the man was about to begin eating, the old lady suddenly and explosively vomited. The flight attendant rushed to her to deal with the situation, but the old lady did not turn better. Another half an hour later, when the man was stepping around her to use the restroom, she vomited again and some of her vomits even got on the man’s clothes. After cleaning himself out in the restroom, the man came back and found his seat was crowded with the lady’s family members. Because of the crowd, he was asked to simply stand and wait during 40 minutes of turbulence, and during that time the sick lady vomited yet again. That whole area smelled terrible. Passengers couldn’t just stand while the plane landed, so the man had to exchange his seat with the lady’s niece whose seat was in economy class. The worst is, when the man asked if he could get his miles back, he was told “NO”. The man was not satisfied and he thought this unforgettable flying experience was a total nightmare.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行前，一位男士用里程升到头等舱。他原以为这次飞行会比以前更舒适，但后来发生的事证明了他的选择是错的。他的座位在一位老妇人旁边，老妇人的家人全都在经济舱。起飞后不久，当他准备用餐时，老妇人猛地呕吐起来。乘务员很快来处理完这个情况，但老妇人的情况并没有转好。半小时后，这位男士从老妇人身边经过去洗手间，这时老妇人再次呕吐起来，有些呕吐物甚至弄到了他的衣服上。在洗手间清理完，他发现自己的座位附近挤满了老妇人的家人。由于人太多，飞机颠簸的40分钟里他只能站着等待，在这期间老妇人再次呕吐起来，整个区域弥漫着可怕的味道。飞机着陆时乘客必须坐下，所以他只能和在经济舱的老妇人的侄女换座位。更糟糕的是，他升舱的里程无法返还。他为此感到很不满意，他认为这次经历简直是个噩梦。

cards.audioText: During a flight from Rhode Island to Washington, an accident happened and brought bad influence on the airline. The aircraft took off from the airport smoothly and the flight was incident-free en route. When the plane was approaching to the airport, the pilot was tired so he missed the controller’s instruction. Then the controller gave the instruction again. This time, the pilot became clear but he applied the brakes suddenly. Because of his sudden operation, the back door of the plane blew off and passengers could see the runway. Fortunately, the cabin had already lost the pressure so no one flew out and all the passengers stayed in their own seats safely. However, the pilot was grounded because of his misoperation.
