cards.audioTextZh: 罗德岛飞往华盛顿的航班上发生一起事故，这起事故给航空公司带来不好的影响。飞机从机场顺利起飞，途中也没有事故发生。飞机进近时，飞行员因为疲劳漏听管制员指令。之后管制员再次给出指令，这时飞行员清醒了并突然刹车。因为突然的操作，飞机的后门被吸走，乘客们能直接看到跑道。幸运的是客舱已降压，没有人因此吸出飞机，乘客们都安全待在座位上。然而，飞行员由于这次失误被停飞。

cards.audioText: The flight was from Seattle to Vancouver The flight was from Seattle to Vancouver. After checking the radar, the pilot requested push back and start up. The airplane was approved to push back and start up but few second slater the controller found the left engine of the plane got fire. So he gave the pilot a warning immediately and asked if fire service was needed. The pilot shut off the engine immediately to prevent the fire from spreading. "The emergency equipment is standing by. "the controller told the pilot. Several minutes later, passengers were all safely evacuated. There was no one injured but passengers had to change to another airline.
cards.audioTextZh: 这是一趟从西雅图飞往温哥华的航班。查看雷达后，飞行员请求推出并启动发动机。飞机获准推出和启动，但几秒钟后，管制员发现飞机左发动机起火，于是立即警告飞行员，并询问是否需要消防服务。飞行员马上关闭发动机，防止火势蔓延。管制员告诉飞行员：“应急设备正在待命。”几分钟后，所有乘客均安全撤离。无人受伤，但乘客不得不改乘另一家航空公司的航班。

cards.audioText: It was a foggy day in 2001, A Flight 126 from Singapore Airlines was cleared to taxi to runway 19 Right. A few minutes later, a Cessna pilot requested engine start, and the ground controller gave start-up clearance. Then the controller asked 126 to contact the Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different radio frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot made the mistake of taxiing to the right and entered taxiway Echo 6. But the Ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi. At the same time the Tower controller cleared Flight 126 for takeoff. When the Flight 126 was rolling on the runway, the Cessna crossed the runway holding sign and entered the active runway 19 Right. Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all 124 people on board died.
cards.audioTextZh: 2001年的一个雾天，正准备起飞的新航126航班被指挥滑行到19右跑道，几分钟后，另一架塞斯纳飞机的驾驶员请求开车，地面管制员给出开车许可，并让126航班联系塔台管制员。此后，两架飞机使用不同的频率。塞斯纳飞机开始滑出，但驾驶员滑错了，他向右滑行到了E6滑行道，地面管制员没有意识到塞斯纳的错误，并指挥他继续滑行。同时，塔台管制员指挥126航班开始起飞。当126航班在跑道上滑跑，正好塞斯纳穿过跑道等待标志并进入了19右跑道，不幸的是，两架飞机相撞，机上124人无一生还。

cards.audioText: A strong snowstorm hit Chicago International airport in an afternoon. An aircraft from United Airlines circled several times before attempting to land at the airport. The snowstorm had reduced visibility severely. The runway visual range was at 4, 500 feet below the landing minimums for the ILS approach to Runway 13 Center. The controller advised the crew to hold in the air, waiting for the weather to get better, or to divert to another airport with a longer runway. But both suggestions would produce large additional expense for the airline, as well as inconvenience of the flight's passengers. So the crew decided to circle to land on runway 31 Center, which had lower landing minimums. But unfortunately, the strong tailwind made the plane skid off the runway and crash into a stopping truck.
cards.audioTextZh: 某日下午，一场暴风雪袭击了芝加哥国际机场。一架美联航飞机准备在机场着陆，但由于能见度极低，飞机不得不在机场上空盘旋。跑道视程为4500英尺，低于13中跑道的盲降进近标准。管制员建议机组空中等待天气好转，或备降到有较长跑道的另一机场着陆，但是这两种选择均会额外增加公司成本，并给乘客带来不便，于是考虑再三，机组决定在有着较低着陆标准的31中跑道盘旋着陆。很遗憾，强顺风使飞机滑出跑道，撞上了一辆停着的卡车。

cards.audioText: An air traffic controller issued a take-off clearance to the Flight 386 for runway 30R. At the same time, an airport operations officer was operating a vehicle on that runway. The controller had previously issued a clearance to the operations officer to conduct bird dispersal activities on the runway. The operations officer was monitoring his radio and heard Flight 386's take-off clearance. He told the controller that he would vacate the runway. At the same time, the flight crew had observed the vehicle on the runway and did not commence the takeoff. The controller cancelled the take-off clearance until the runway was clear. The investigation found that the controller didn’t keep eyes on the runway because he was concentrating on heavy traffic. Another possible reason was that the controller was experiencing some degree of fatigue at the time.
cards.audioTextZh: 一管制员发布起飞许可给386航班，允许该飞机从跑道30右起飞，与此同时，一名机场工作人员正在30右跑道上工作。因为之前管制员让该工作人员在跑道上驱鸟。工作人员在当前频率守听，听到386航班要起飞的许可指令，立刻告诉管制员他会马上离开跑道。同时，机组人员看到跑道上的车辆，没有执行起飞操作。管制员取消了起飞许可，直到跑道被空出来。后据调查，管制员因为指挥飞机过多，没有留意该跑道，导致了这次事件。还有一个可能的原因是管制员此时过于疲惫导致此次事件。

cards.audioText: Getting lost as an airplane flying is a potentially dangerous situation, especially when low on fuel. If a pilot becomes lost, there are some good common sense procedures to follow. If a town or city cannot be seen, the first thing to do is climb. Being mindful of traffic and weather conditions. An increase in altitude increases radio and navigation reception range, and also increases radar coverage. If flying near a town or city, it might be possible to read the name of the town on a water tower. If the airplane has a navigation radio, such as a VOR or ADF receiver, it can be possible to determine position by plotting an azimuth from two or more navigational facilities. If GPS is installed or a pilot has a portable aviation GPS on board, it can be used to determine the position and location of the nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机在飞行中迷航是一种潜在的危险情况，特别是在燃料不足的情况下。如果飞行员迷航，可以遵循一些良好的常识程序。如果无法目视某个城镇或城市，首要的就是爬升。留意其他航空器及天气情况。海拔高度的增加使得无线电和导航的接收范围扩大，也增加了雷达覆盖范围。如果在一个城镇或城市附近飞行，可能会在水塔上看到城镇的名字。如果飞机配备无线电导航，如VOR或ADF接收器，它可以通过两个或更多的导航设施绘制方位角来确定位置。如果安装了全球定位系统(GPS)，或者飞行员在飞机上配备了便携式航空全球定位系统，就可以确定最近机场的方位和位置。

cards.audioText: Landing light signal could provide useful information to controllers. One day, a B757 vacated runway 36L via taxiway A9 after landing. It was then cleared to cross runway 36R. But it stopped taxiing on taxiway A9 between runway 36L and runway 36R. The tower controller attempted to contact the pilot but received no reply. He saw the aircraft landing lights were also off. This made him believe that the B757 had a radio failure and had not received the clearance to cross runway 36R. So he issued takeoff clearance to A320 on runway 36R. Suddenly, the controller noticed the B757’s lights came on and it began to move. Realizing the risk of runway incursion, he canceled A320's takeoff clearance immediately.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆灯可以作为信号向管制员发送有用信息。一天，一架B757在降落后经由滑行道A9脱离36左跑道。随后飞机获准穿越36右跑道。但它在36左和36右跑道之间的A9滑行道上停止滑行。塔台管制员试图联系飞行员但没有得到回复。他看到飞机着陆灯也关闭了。他猜想B757遇无线电故障，没有收到穿越36右跑道的许可，所以他给A320发布了起飞许可，使用跑道36右。突然，管制员注意到B757的着陆灯亮了并开始移动。管制员意识到跑道有被入侵的危险，于是立即取消了A320的起飞许可。

cards.audioText: When SIA128 was approaching the airspace of Chicago center area control, the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next sector on 132.1. The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency. However, the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency. Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change, they didn't know that flight 188 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later, the controller at the next sector identified SIA128 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher, they got no response from the pilots. The controller finally regained contact with SIA128 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 当SIA128接近芝加哥中心区域管制空域时，管制员指示机组将无线电切换到下一扇区的132.1频率。副驾驶确认了频率变更，并正确复诵了该频率。然而，飞行机组没有在新频率上联系空中交通管制。由于接收单位的管制员正在准备交接班，他们没有发现SIA128尚未建立无线电联系。30分钟后，下一扇区的管制员在雷达上识别出SIA128。他们尝试通过公司签派联系飞机，但始终没有得到飞行员回应。50分钟后，管制员最终在应急频率上重新与SIA128建立联系。

cards.audioText: One day, Flight 456, a B737 carrying 152 passengers and 9 crew members, was flying to land at Tokyo International Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach, flight 456 was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding, the flight crew was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested that the pilot divert to the alternate, but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough to the alternate. So the controller vectored flight 456 by radar to land at runway 34R. Unfortunately, the pilot couldn’t stabilize the aircraft on the localizers due to wind shear. Flight 456 went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage. The aircraft was broken into pieces and all the people on board were killed.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的B737执行456航班在东京国际机场降落。当从东京区调转到东京进近时，因为航空器拥堵，456航班被指示前往DA等待。在等待期间，机组人员被告知当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议飞行员备降，但飞行员报告说他们的燃料不够备降。所以管制员雷达引导456航班降落在34右跑道。不幸的是，由于风切变，飞行员无法在航道上建立稳定进近。456航班执行了复飞，执行了二次进近。后来，由于燃油短缺，飞机在山坡上坠毁。飞机被撞成碎片，机上人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: Flight 145 nearly collided with Flight 101 at the intersection of runway 16 and runway 22. There were no injuries and no damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind. That day, the tower controller cleared Flight 145 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 145 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight 145 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft just managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. So Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 145. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 145号航班几乎与101号航班在16跑道和22跑道的交叉处相撞。两架飞机都没有人员伤亡或机体损伤。但这被认为是此类事件中最严重的一次。那天，塔台管制员批准145航班降落在22跑道上。但当他让101航班从交叉的16跑道起飞时，他忘记了抵达的飞机。145航班着陆后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员试图指示145航班在16跑道外停下。然而，飞机最后只能在跑道交叉处停下。101航班无法中断起飞。所以101航班提前拉起，飞过145航班。两架飞机仅差50英尺就相撞了。

cards.audioText: When an American Flight 815 was approaching the terminal area of its destination, the flight crew contacted the Approach Control and requested ILS approach for runway 12. The tailwind conditions were reported on runway 12 at that time, so the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach for runway 30. But the flight crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on that runway. The runway was wet and the braking action was not good. During landing roll, the aircraft skidded to the right side of the runway and went through the airport fences. The fuselage was broken into three pieces, the right engine and right main gear were separated from the aircraft. No one was killed, but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 当一架美国航空815航班接近目的地终端区时，机组人员联系进近管制中心，要求在12跑道盲降进近。当时12跑道报告有顺风情况，所以管制员建议飞行员在30跑道盘旋进近。但机组人员坚持在12跑道降落，管制员允许他们在该跑道降落。跑道湿滑，刹车性能也不好。在着陆滑跑过程中，飞机侧滑到跑道右侧，穿过机场围栏。机身断成三段，右发和右主起落架与机身分离。没有人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

cards.audioText: One day in 2000, Flight 154 reported bird strike three minutes after takeoff, and requested return to the airport. But the controller told the crew that the RVR of the airport was below landing minima, so the captain made a decision to make an emergency landing at airport A. Air traffic controller quickly contacted A airport and gained permission for a landing on runway 15. However, the aircraft could not reach A airport due to lack of altitude. The crew decided to make a ditching in a river and they reported it to the controllers. Finally, the crew made a ditching without power at about 150 miles per hour in the river.
cards.audioTextZh: 2000年的一天，154号航班在起飞3分钟后报告遭遇鸟击，并请求返回机场。但管制员告知机组，该机场的跑道视程（RVR）低于着陆最低标准，于是机长决定在A机场紧急着陆。空中交通管制员迅速联系A机场，取得了15跑道的着陆许可。然而，由于高度不足，飞机无法到达A机场。机组决定在一条河上实施水上迫降，并向管制员报告。最终，机组驾驶失去动力的飞机，以约每小时150英里的速度在河面成功迫降。

cards.audioText: When SIA188 was approaching the airspace of Chicago Center Area Control, the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next section on 132.1. The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency. However, the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency. Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change, they didn't know that flight 188 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later, the controller at the next sector identified SIA188 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher, they got no response from the pilots. The controller finally regained contact with SIA188 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 当新加坡航空公司188号航班（SIA188）接近芝加哥中心区域管制的空域时，管制员指示机组人员将下一段航程的无线电频率切换至132.1。副驾驶确认了频率变更，并正确复诵了该频率。然而，机组人员并未在新频率上与空中交通管制（ATC）取得联系。由于接收单位的管制员当时正在准备交接班，他们并不知道188号航班没有建立无线电联系。30分钟后，下一个扇区的管制员在雷达上识别出了新加坡航空公司188号航班。尽管他们尝试通过呼叫该公司的调度员来与飞机建立联系，但没有得到飞行员的回应。最终，管制员在50分钟后通过应急频率重新与新加坡航空公司188号航班取得了联系。

cards.audioText: It was a foggy day in 2002, SIA 686 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R. A few minutes later, the Cessna pilot requested engine start. The ground controller gave start-up clearance. Then he requested Flight 686 to contact the Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different radio frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot made a mistake to taxi to right and entered taxiway R6. But the ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue its taxi. At the same time, the Tower controller cleared Flight 686 for takeoff. When the flight 686 was rolling on the runway, the Cessna crossed the runway holding sign and entered the active runway 36R. Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all 114 people on board died.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年的一个雾天，新加坡航空公司686号航班获许滑行至36R跑道。几分钟后，一架塞斯纳飞机的飞行员请求启动发动机。地面管制员给予了启动许可。然后，他让686号航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，这两架飞机就处于两个不同的无线电频率上。塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员错误地向右滑行，进入了R6滑行道。然而，地面管制员并未意识到这一点，仍批准塞斯纳飞机继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员批准686号航班起飞。当686号航班在跑道上开始滑跑时，塞斯纳飞机越过了跑道等待标志，进入了正在使用的36R跑道。不幸的是，两架飞机相撞，机上114人全部遇难。

cards.audioText: Flight 345 nearly collided with Flight 101 at the intersection of runway 16 and runway 22. There were no injuries and no damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind. That day, the tower controller cleared Flight 345 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 345 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight 345 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 345. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 345航班和101航班在16号跑道与22号跑道的交叉处险些相撞。两架飞机均未出现人员伤亡情况，机体也都没有受损。但这起事件仍被视为此类事件中最为严重的一起。当天，塔台管制员批准345航班在22号跑道降落。然而，当他批准101航班从与之交叉的16号跑道起飞时，却忘记了正在进场降落的345航班。345航班触地降落之后，地面雷达系统发出了警报。管制员试图指示345航班在16号跑道前停下。然而，飞机最终在跑道交叉点的中央才停了下来。此时101航班已无法中止起飞程序，于是101航班提前离地升空，从345航班上方飞过。两架飞机仅差50英尺就相撞了。

cards.audioText: As American Flight 835 was approaching the terminal area of its destination, the flight crew contacted the Approach Control and requested ILS approach for runway 12. Tailwind conditions were reported on runway 12 at that time, so the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach for runway 30. But the crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on the runway 12. The runway was wet and braking action was not good. During landing roll, the aircraft skidded to the left of the runway and went through the airport fences. The fuselage was broken into three pieces, the right engine and right main gear were separated from the aircraft. No one was killed, but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 当美国835航班接近其目的地的终端区域时，飞行机组人员联系了进近管制部门，并请求使用仪表着陆系统（ILS）对12号跑道进行进近。当时报告显示12号跑道存在顺风情况，所以管制员建议飞行员对30号跑道进行盘旋进近。但机组人员坚持要在12号跑道降落，管制员便批准他们在12号跑道降落。跑道是湿的，制动效果不佳。在着陆滑跑过程中，飞机向跑道左侧打滑，并冲出了机场围栏。机身断成了三截，右发动机和右主起落架与飞机分离。所幸无人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

cards.audioText: One day, Flight 123, a B737 carrying 152 passengers and 9 crew members, was flying to land at Tokyo International Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach, flight 123 was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding, the flight crew was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested that the pilot divert to the alternate, but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough to the alternate. So the controller vectored flight 123 by radar to land at runway 34R. Unfortunately, the pilot couldn't stabilize the aircraft on the localizer due to wind shear. Flight 123 went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage. The aircraft was broken into pieces and all the people on board were killed.
cards.audioTextZh: 有一天，载有152名乘客和9名机组人员的波音737型123号航班正飞往东京国际机场准备降落。当该航班从东京区域管制移交给东京进近管制时，由于空中交通拥堵，123号航班接到指令前往DA点等待。在等待过程中，机组人员得知当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议飞行员备降其他机场，但飞行员报告称燃油不足以支撑他们飞抵备降机场。于是，管制员通过雷达引导123号航班在34R跑道降落。不幸的是，由于遭遇风切变，飞行员无法使飞机在仪表着陆系统的航向道上保持稳定。123号航班复飞并进行了第二次进近。后来，由于燃油短缺，飞机坠毁在一处山坡上。飞机解体，机上所有人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: One day, Indonesia 205 took off from Jinan to Hangzhou. About one hour later, the aircraft was transferred to Hangzhou Approach. Hangzhou Approach required Indonesia 205 to slow down to 190 knots and later the controller asked the pilot to reduce speed to 160 knots. Three minutes later, Indonesia 205 passed the outer marker inbound. At that time, the controller issued a missed approach clearance because of separation. He instructed Indonesia 205 to make a right turn to a heading of 180 and climb to 900 m. But during the missed approach, the aircraft was out of control because of mechanical problem. The aircraft continued to descend with a high angle of attack. The aircraft impacted trees and buildings and part of the fuselage was damaged.
cards.audioTextZh: 某日，印尼205航班从济南起飞前往杭州。大约一小时后，该航班被移交给杭州进近管制。杭州进近管制要求印尼205航班将速度降至190节，随后管制员又要求飞行员将速度减至160节。三分钟后，印尼205航班在向台飞行时通过了远距指点标。当时，由于间隔问题，管制员发出了复飞指令。他指示印尼205航班右转至航向180度，并爬升至900米。但在复飞过程中，飞机因机械故障失去控制。飞机以大迎角持续下降，撞上了树木和建筑物，部分机身受损。

cards.audioText: One day, AFR188 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff. The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L, but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling. The aircraft overran the runway, and crashed into the fence of the airport. Crew members and 110 passengers were killed, and the co-pilot was badly injured. The plane was destroyed by the impact and caught on an intense fire. According to the investigation, there were three reasons leading to the accidents. First of all, the crew didn't use effective methods to verify their position at the airport. Secondly, the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not. Finally, the crew members' idle chatting during the taxi resulted in the loss of situational awareness.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，AFR188在新加坡樟宜机场起飞时坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组从02L跑道起飞，但机组却进入02R跑道对正，并开始起飞滑跑。飞机冲出跑道，撞上机场围栏。机组成员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶受重伤。飞机在撞击中损毁并燃起大火。调查认为，事故有3个原因：首先，机组没有采用有效方法核实自己在机场内的位置；其次，机组忘记确认是否位于正确跑道；最后，机组在滑行期间闲聊，导致情景意识丧失。

cards.audioText: One day, an A320 collided with a B737 during taxi. The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage of its left wing. Luckily, there were no injuries. After receiving ATC taxi instruction, the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought they had enough room to pass over the B737. But unfortunately Fortunately, the fuel leak didn't develop into fire. The crew of the Boeing aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes applied when they were hit.
cards.audioTextZh: 一天，一架A320在滑行时与一架B737相撞。B737的右副翼严重受损，而A320只有左翼轻微受损。幸运的是，无人受伤。收到空中交通管制的滑行指令后，A320开始从B737右侧通过。A320机长认为有足够空间越过B737，但不幸发生了碰撞。幸运的是，燃油泄漏没有发展成火灾。B737机组表示，被撞时他们的飞机一直处于静止状态，驻停刹车已经设置。

cards.audioText: An aircraft broke due to some unexplained problems of the propeller. The pilot tried every method to repair but only to get more confused. So he had to call an experienced engineer to find out the problem. The engineer searched the engine carefully. It took a long time for the engineer to finish the checking procedure, at last he only knocked the engine at a place then the engine was repaired well. The engineer charged the pilot for 5000 dollars, but the pilot was not willing to pay for it since he thought that it was too expensive for just a knock. The engineer was upset about the pilot’s words for he didn’t understand the value of engineers’ work. He said, “It is inexpensive for a knock. A knock only values for 5 dollars, but knowing the correct place to knock values 4995 dollars.”
cards.audioTextZh: 由于螺旋桨的问题飞机损坏，飞行员尝试用各种方法修理，但却只让自己更困惑，所以他不得不叫一位有经验的工程师来解决问题。工程师仔细地检查发动机，检查程序花费很长时间，最后工程师在发动机某处敲了敲，然后发动机就修好了。工程师向飞行员收取5000美金的费用，但飞行员不愿意付，他认为敲一下飞机就收取这些费用太贵了。工程师对此很失望，因为这说明飞行员不懂得工程师工作的价值。工程师说：“修理费并不贵，敲一次只需5美金，但知道敲一次的正确位置价值4995美金。”

cards.audioText: The breakup of China Airlines Flight 611, a Boeing 747-200, has drawn international attention because it comes at a time of increasing concern over how long older jets can remain airworthy. Some research has suggested that metal fatigue may be a particular problem in planes that are used regularly in very warm, humid places like Taipei and Hong Kong. But Boeing maintains that with proper maintenance, aircraft aging should not be a problem. The flight data recorder shows that the plane began gaining altitude at a significantly faster rate in the 27 seconds before the plane broke apart, although the extra gain in altitude was well within the plane's design limits. The plane was supposed to be leveling off then as it approached its cruising altitude of 35, 000 feet. According to the examination of the wreckage, investigators analyzed that there's no evidence of an explosion or pilot error.
cards.audioTextZh: 中华航空611号航班（一架波音747-200型客机）的解体事件引起了国际社会的关注，因为此事发生之际，人们日益担忧老旧飞机究竟还能在多长时间内保持适航状态。一些研究表明，在像台北和香港这样非常温暖、潮湿且飞机使用频繁的地方，金属疲劳可能是一个尤为突出的问题。但波音公司坚称，只要进行适当的维护，飞机老化就不应成为一个问题。飞行数据记录器显示，在飞机解体前的27秒内，这架飞机开始以明显更快的速度上升高度，尽管额外增加的高度完全在飞机的设计极限范围内。当时，这架飞机在接近35000英尺的巡航高度时本应趋于平飞。根据对飞机残骸的检查，调查人员分析得出，没有证据表明事故是由爆炸或飞行员操作失误导致的。

cards.audioText: A pilot of Air China airline company told us an event with landing gear problem several days ago. After normal pushback, startup and taxi, he requested takeoff at the holding point of the active runway. However, he was instructed to hold short of the runway in order to give way to AFR123 on final. AFR123 declared emergency because of landing gear problem. AFR123 asked for a low pass to have a visual check. The controller verified the landing gear was still in up position during low pass. Then AFR123 requested a touch and go to jar the jammed gear. Unfortunately, after doing this, the landing gear still couldn't be extended. So, AFR123 had to make a belly landing on a foamed runway. AFR123 made a safe landing. There were no casualties except some minor injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 几天前，一位中国国际航空公司的飞行员向我们讲述了一起起落架出现问题的事件。在完成正常的推出、启动和滑行后，他在正在使用的跑道等待点请求起飞。然而，他接到指令要在跑道外等待，以便给正在进近的法国航空公司123号航班（AFR123）让行。AFR123号航班因起落架出现问题宣布了紧急情况。AFR123号航班请求进行低空通场以便进行目视检查。管制员在其低空通场时确认起落架仍处于收起状态。随后，AFR123号航班请求进行一次触地复飞，希望能震开卡住的起落架。不幸的是，在进行了触地复飞后，起落架仍然无法放下。于是，AFR123号航班不得不在铺设了泡沫的跑道上进行机腹着陆。AFR123号航班安全着陆，除了一些轻伤外，没有人员伤亡。

cards.audioText: CSN341 was a flight from Beijing to Los Angles. When CSN341 initially contacted the tower controller, he was told the runway visual range was 500 m. The pilot executed a missed approach two minutes later because of no contact at minima. Then, CSN341 was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. In the second approach, the controller issued landing clear to CSN341 at outer marker. One minute later, the controller observed the airplane was leaving the glide path on his radar display, so he issued missed approach instructions again. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted the top of a tall building and crashed. According to the investigation, the poor visibility made the pilot nervous and he misunderstood the missed approach instructions and made a wrong turn.
cards.audioTextZh: CSN341是一趟从北京飞往洛杉矶的航班。CSN341首次联系塔台管制员时，被告知跑道视程（RVR）为500米。2分钟后，由于在最低标准高度仍未建立目视参考，飞行员复飞。随后，CSN341接受雷达引导，进行第二次ILS进近。第二次进近时，管制员在飞机通过外指点标处向CSN341发布着陆许可。1分钟后，管制员从雷达显示器上发现飞机正在偏离下滑道，于是再次发布复飞指令。飞行员此后没有回应。飞机撞上高楼顶部并坠毁。调查认为，低能见度使飞行员紧张，他误解了复飞指令并进行了错误转弯。

cards.audioText: This story is about runway incursion. One day, A B767 nearly collided with an A320 at New York Airport, which is operating with two intersecting runways. Although there was neither casualties nor aircraft damages for both aircraft, still the incident was regarded as one of the most serious incidents of this kind. The tower controller instructed B767 to land at runway 21, meanwhile, he cleared A320 to take off at runway 18. Just as B767 touched down, the ground radar system sounded the alarm. The tower controller realized the problem and instructed B767 to stop landing rolling immediately, trying to stay out of the intersection of runway 18. In spite of the effort, B767 could only stop in the middle of the intersecting runway. However, the pilot ofA320 could not abort takeoff, and pulled up the aircraft in advance to avoid collision. They missed each other by only 60 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 这是一个关于跑道侵入的故事。有一天，在拥有两条交叉跑道的纽约机场，一架波音767客机险些与一架空客A320客机相撞。尽管两架飞机都没有人员伤亡和机体损坏，但这起事件仍被视为这类事件中最严重的事件之一。塔台管制员指示波音767客机在21号跑道降落，与此同时，他批准空客A320客机从18号跑道起飞。就在波音767客机触地降落时，地面雷达系统发出了警报。塔台管制员意识到了问题，立即指示波音767客机停止着陆滑跑，试图停在18号跑道交叉点之外。尽管做出了努力，波音767客机也只能停在交叉跑道的中间位置。然而，空客A320客机的飞行员无法中止起飞，只能提前拉起飞机以避免相撞。两架飞机最终仅差60英尺就撞到了一起。

cards.audioText: It was a sunny day in 2010, a Delta Airlines 767-300 departed from Shanghai Pudong International Airport to Seoul. It carried 256 passengers and 13 crew members on board. During takeoff rolling, an unknown foreign object was sucked into port engine and the engine fire warning light illuminated. Then the flight crew declared an emergency right after airborne and completed the emergency checklist procedure. Through good communication, the controller understood the flight crew wanted to return to land. But the pilot had to dump fuel before landing because the aircraft was overweight to land. So the controller vectored the aircraft by radar to the dumping area. After circling over the sea and dumping fuel for almost one hour, the plane returned to land at departure airport safely.
cards.audioTextZh: 2010年的一个晴天，一架达美航空767-300从上海浦东国际机场飞往首尔，机上有256名乘客和13名机组成员。起飞滑跑过程中，一个不明外来物被吸入左发动机，发动机火警灯亮起。飞机离地后，飞行机组立即宣布紧急情况并完成应急检查单。通过有效沟通，管制员了解到机组希望返场着陆。但飞机着陆重量超限，必须在着陆前放油，于是管制员对飞机实施雷达引导前往放油区。飞机在海上盘旋并放油近1小时后，安全返回出发机场着陆。

cards.audioText: On 25 July 2005, a Piper Aircraft Corporation aircraft overran runway 27 at Nhill aerodrome following a rejected night takeoff. The aircraft was being operated on an instrument flight rules charter flight to Charlton, with the pilot and three passengers on board. The pilot reported that, during the pre-flight preparation he set the elevator trim to the take-off position by winding the trim wheel. The pilot recalled removing the lock from the control column prior to starting the engines for departure. The operators Operations Manual included a series of checklists to be used during operation of the aircraft. The Start Up and Pre takeoff checklists included checking full and free movement of the flight controls. The pilot stated that the take-off roll was from a rolling start with power being slowly applied until engine output stabilized. At about 90 kts indicated air speed, the pilot attempted to rotate the aircraft but encountered resistance to rearward movement of the control column. He decided to reject the takeoff because the aircraft speed at the time was below his nominated decision speed of 100 kts. The pilot then reduced the engine power to idle and applied maximum braking. After the aircraft came to a stop 160 m beyond the end of the runway, the pilot exited the aircraft via the crew door, assisted the passengers to evacuate the aircraft through the rear cabin door and marshalled them to an area away from the aircraft. A passenger then used a mobile phone to contact emergency services, who attended the scene soon after.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年7月25日，一架派珀飞机公司制造的飞机在尼尔机场（Nhill aerodrome）进行夜间起飞中断后，冲出了27号跑道。这架飞机当时正执行一次仪表飞行规则下的包机航班，目的地为查尔顿（Charlton），机上有一名飞行员和三名乘客。飞行员报告称，在飞行前准备阶段，他通过转动配平轮将升降舵配平设置到了起飞位置。飞行员记得在启动发动机准备起飞前，已取下了操纵杆上的锁。该运营方的《运行手册》中包含了一系列在飞机运行期间需使用的检查单。“启动和起飞前”检查单中包括检查飞行操纵装置是否能完全且自由地移动。飞行员表示，起飞滑跑是从滚动状态开始的，他缓慢地增加动力，直到发动机输出稳定。当指示空速达到约90节时，飞行员试图抬起机头使飞机离地，但在向后拉动操纵杆时遇到了阻力。由于当时飞机的速度低于他设定的100节的决断速度，他决定中断起飞。随后，飞行员将发动机功率减至慢车状态，并实施了最大刹车。飞机在跑道末端外160米处停下后，飞行员从机组人员舱门离开飞机，协助乘客从后客舱门撤离飞机，并将他们引导至远离飞机的区域。随后，一名乘客使用手机联系了紧急救援部门，救援人员很快赶到了现场。

cards.audioText: In November 1996 I was in a flight flying to New York. I was in the flight because I got a call from New York Hospital that a heart would be ready for me. The pilot called the tower and told them who we were. The ATC said we could not land because President Clinton was there and the security service would not let us land. The pilot told the ATC that he would report this to the press and TV stations. I think they would let us land because of the bad influence. However, it didn't work because the controllers wanted to have a look of Clinton. So we had to divert to the alternate airport instead. Fortunately, I got to the hospital on time. It was a great heart as you can see I am still alive almost 11 years after the operation
cards.audioTextZh: 1996年11月，我搭乘了一趟飞往纽约的航班。我乘坐这趟航班是因为我接到了纽约医院的电话，说有一颗适合我的心脏已经准备好了。飞行员给塔台打电话，告知了他们我们的身份。空中交通管制员（ATC）说我们不能降落，因为克林顿总统当时在那里，安保部门不会允许我们降落。飞行员告诉空中交通管制员，他会将此事向新闻媒体和电视台报道。我认为他们会因为不良影响而让我们降落。然而，这并没有起作用，因为管制员们想看一眼克林顿。所以我们不得不改飞到备降机场。幸运的是，我按时赶到了医院。那是一颗非常合适的心脏，正如你所见，在那次手术差不多11年后我仍然活着。

cards.audioText: On February 17th, 2005, United airline 123, an Airbus 320, collided with Air China 321, a Boeing 737, during taxi in the run-up area at the north end of runway 19. The right aileron of the Boeing 737 was severely damaged; the left wing of the Airbus 320 had minor damage. There were no injuries. The pilot of the Airbus320 reported that he was positioned to the right of the Boeing 737. ATC cleared them for departure, which required them to taxi past the Boeing 737. The captain stated that he checked the position of the Boeing 737, and he thought he could clear it and then felt the impact. The captain notified ATC of the collision. Airport fire crews responded, but there was no fuel leak or fire. The crew of the Boeing 737 reported that they were stationary with the parking brake applied while awaiting ATC clearance
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年2月17日，美联航123号航班，一架空客A320飞机，在19号跑道北端的准备起飞滑行区域滑行时，与国航321号航班，一架波音737飞机发生了碰撞。这架波音737飞机的右副翼严重受损；而空客A320飞机的左翼有轻微损伤。事故中无人受伤。空客A320飞机的飞行员报告称，他的飞机当时位于波音737飞机的右侧。空中交通管制（ATC）批准了他们起飞，这就要求他们滑行经过那架波音737飞机。机长称，他检查了波音737飞机的位置，认为自己能够安全通过，然后就感觉到了撞击。机长向空中交通管制通报了这起碰撞事件。机场消防人员赶到了现场，但没有出现燃油泄漏或起火的情况。波音737飞机的机组人员报告称，他们当时处于静止状态，已拉起了驻停刹车，正在等待空中交通管制的许可。

cards.audioText: The crew of flight 523 found a traffic 20 miles at FL 294 right ahead of the airplane on TCAS at FL 290 near LAMEN. The captain reported to Shanghai Control immediately, but the controller responded that there was no indication on his radar screen and there had not been any flight advisory. The captain then instructed the crew to turn left and found the conflicting traffic closing to the flight path and a TCAS warning was initiated. The crew then immediately turns right for avoidance, disengage the autopilot and descended to a lower altitude. The crew reported to the controller about the conflict after the conflict had been cleared.
cards.audioTextZh: 523航班的机组人员，在FL294，他们在TCAS上发现飞机正前方20英里处有航空器冲突，该航空器在LAMEN附近的FL290上。机长立即向上海管制报告，但管制员回应称，他的雷达屏幕上没有显示任何迹象，也没有任何飞行警告。机长随后指示机组人员左转，发现冲突交通接近航线，并发出TCAS警告。机组人员随即右转避让，解除自动驾驶并下降到较低的高度。在冲突解除后，机组人员向管制员报告了冲突。

cards.audioText: On March 22, 2008, China Southern 303, a Boeing 757-200, lost a left upper wing trailing edge panel during cruise flight at FL270. Initially, ATC received a pilot report that the flight crew had experienced "light chop" at the time. The flight was en route from Greenyard Airport to Blueyard Airport. The broken panel struck the window of passenger row 19ABC and cracked only the outer portion of the window. Pressurization was not lost. The flight crew continued on to Blueyard. Upon approach to Blueyard, ATC instructed the flight crew to expedite for separation. The flight crew informed ATC that they could not increase their airspeed due to possible airframe damage. The flight landed safely. There were 174 passengers and 6 crew members on board with no reported injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 2008年3月22日，中国南方航空303号航班是一架波音757-200，在FL270巡航时脱落了一块左翼上表面后缘面板。起初，空中交通管制收到飞行员报告，称机组当时遭遇了“轻度颠簸”。该航班正从Greenyard机场飞往Blueyard机场。脱落的面板击中客舱第19排ABC座位处的舷窗，只造成舷窗外层开裂，客舱没有失压。飞行机组继续飞往Blueyard。进近Blueyard时，空中交通管制为建立间隔要求机组加快速度，但机组告知管制员，由于机体可能受损，无法增加空速。飞机最终安全着陆。机上有174名乘客和6名机组成员，无人受伤。

cards.audioText: On September 28, 2003, United 552, a DC-9-82, experienced an in-flight engine fire during departure climb from New York City. During the return to the departure airport, the nose landing gear failed to extend, and the flight crew was instructed by the ATC to execute a go-around, during which the crew extended the nose gear using the emergency procedure. The flight crew conducted an emergency landing, and the 2 flight crew members, 3 flight attendants, and 138 passengers deplaned on the runway. No occupant injuries were reported, but the airplane sustained substantial damage from the fire. The National Transportation Safety Board determines that the probable cause of this accident was American Airlines maintenance personnel use of an inappropriate manual engine-start procedure, which led to the subsequent left engine fire
cards.audioTextZh: 2003年9月28日，美国联合航空公司552号航班，一架DC-9-82型飞机，在从纽约市起飞爬升过程中遭遇了发动机空中起火的情况。在返回起飞机场的途中，前起落架无法放下，空中交通管制部门（ATC）指示机组人员进行复飞，在此期间，机组人员使用紧急程序放下了前起落架。机组人员实施了紧急着陆，机上2名机组人员、3名空乘人员以及138名乘客在跑道上撤离了飞机。没有人员受伤的报告，但这架飞机因火灾受到了严重损坏。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是美国航空公司的维修人员采用了不恰当的发动机手动启动程序，这导致了随后的左发动机起火。

cards.audioText: On February 17, 2005, an Airbus 320 operated by United Airline, collided with an ERJ 145, operated by US Airways during taxi in the runup area of taxiway J at the north end of runway 19. The right aileron of the ERJ 145 was substantially damaged; the left winglet of the Airbus 320 had minor damage. There were no injuries. The pilot of the Airbus 320 reported that he was positioned to the right of the ERJ 145. ATC cleared them for departure, which required them to taxi past the ERJ 145. The captain stated that he checked the proximity of the ERJ 145, and it looked like he could clear it and then felt the impact. The captain notified ATC of the collision. Airport fire crews responded, but there was no fuel leak or fire. The crew of the ERJ 145 reported that they were stationary with the parking brake applied while awaiting ATC clearance
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年2月17日，美国联合航空公司运营的一架空客A320飞机，在19号跑道北端J滑行道的准备起飞滑行区域滑行时，与美国全美航空公司运营的一架巴西航空工业公司ERJ 145飞机发生了碰撞。ERJ 145飞机的右副翼严重受损；空客A320飞机的左翼小翼有轻微损伤。此次事故中无人受伤。空客A320飞机的飞行员报告称，他的飞机当时位于ERJ 145飞机的右侧。空中交通管制（ATC）批准了他们起飞，这就要求他们滑行经过ERJ 145飞机。机长称，他检查了与ERJ 145飞机的距离，看起来他能够安全通过，然后就感觉到了撞击。机长向空中交通管制通报了这起碰撞事件。机场消防人员赶到了现场，但没有出现燃油泄漏或起火的情况。ERJ 145飞机的机组人员报告称，他们当时处于静止状态，已拉起了驻停刹车，正在等待空中交通管制的许可。

cards.audioText: Prior to initiating the first ILS approach to runway 10R, the pilot of Japan air 223 was advised by the tower controller that the runway visual range (RVR) was 600 feet, followed by being given a landing clearance. The pilot declared a missed approach two minutes later and was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. After turning inbound on the localizer, the pilot was advised the runway visual range and then cleared to land. When the tower controller observed the airplane turning to the south of the runway on her radar display, she issued missed approach instructions. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted the top of an 85-foot tall tree, and then continued to collide on the ground. The published missed approach procedure instructed the pilot to climb to 900 feet, then right turn to intercept the 160 degree radial of the VORTAC. It appears the pilot likely misinterpreted the missed approach instructions by making the right hand turn prior to initiating a climb to900 feet, which resulted in the subsequent impact with the tree.
cards.audioTextZh: 在日本航空223号航班的飞行员开始对10R跑道进行首次仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近之前，塔台管制员告知他跑道视程（RVR）为600英尺，随后给予了他着陆许可。两分钟后，该飞行员宣布复飞，之后管制员通过雷达引导其进行第二次仪表着陆系统进近。在转向沿航向信标台向台飞行后，飞行员被告知了跑道视程，然后得到了着陆许可。当塔台管制员在她的雷达显示屏上观察到飞机转向跑道南侧时，她发出了复飞指令。此后飞行员没有再作回应。飞机撞上了一棵85英尺高的树的顶部，接着继续在地面上发生碰撞。公布的复飞程序指示飞行员爬升至900英尺，然后右转以截获甚高频全向信标台和测距仪（VORTAC）160度方位线。看起来飞行员很可能误解了复飞指令，在爬升至900英尺之前就进行了右转，这导致了随后与树木的碰撞。

cards.audioText: On December 11, 2002, Air France 551 departed runway 15R and over flew United83, which had landed on runway 10 at Atlantic international Airport. The tower controller had cleared United83 to land on runway 10 when United83 was approximately 6 mile on final approach. Simultaneously, the ATC local controller cleared Air France 551 for takeoff on runway 15R. Air France 551 was on taxiway About 500 feet short of runway 15R when the takeoff clearance was issued. Air France 551 rotated at taxiway F and over flew United83 by300 feet at the intersection of runways 10 and 15R. United83 exited runway 10 afterwards. The main cause of this incident is local controller's failure of maintaining awareness of the situation and failing to provide the appropriate separation between the two aircraft operating on intersecting runways.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年12月11日，法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞，在大西洋国际机场10跑道与刚着陆的联合航空83号航班上空交叉飞越。联合航空83在约6海里五边时，塔台管制员已许可其在10跑道着陆；与此同时，本场管制员又许可法国航空551从15R跑道起飞。起飞许可发布时，法国航空551位于A滑行道，距15R跑道约500英尺。法国航空551在F滑行道附近抬轮，并在10跑道与15R跑道交叉点上空以约300英尺的垂直距离飞越联合航空83。随后，联合航空83脱离10跑道。事件的主要原因是本场管制员未能保持情景意识，也未能为在交叉跑道上运行的两架飞机提供适当间隔。

cards.audioText: The Piper and Cessna pilot were both inbound to the same airport. The Cessna pilot reported to the local controller that he was 13.5 miles to the northeast of the airport. The LC directed the pilot to report entering a left downwind, and the pilot continued on south heading for 4 miles before turning right to a southwest heading. The Piper pilot contacted the LC and reported 10 miles to the north of the airport. The LC directed the Piper pilot to enter a left downwind. The Lc noticed two VFR targets close to one another. Assuming the target on a southwest heading was a VFR helicopter when it was actually the Cessna, the LC issued conflict traffic to the southbound aircraft, assuming it was the Cessna pilot when it was actually the Piper pilot, and the Cessna pilot acknowledged the traffic call. Forty one seconds later, the Piper pilot informed the LO of the collision and declared an emergency
cards.audioTextZh: 一架派珀飞机和一架塞斯纳飞机都在飞往同一机场。塞斯纳飞行员向本场管制员报告，飞机位于机场东北13.5海里。本场管制员指示他进入左三边时报告；该飞行员继续向南飞行4海里后，右转转向西南。随后，派珀飞行员联系本场管制员，报告位于机场以北10海里，本场管制员也指示派珀进入左三边。管制员注意到两个目视飞行规则目标彼此接近。他把向西南飞行的目标误认为一架VFR直升机，但那实际上是塞斯纳；随后又向南向飞行的航空器通报冲突航空器，以为自己正在呼叫塞斯纳，实际呼叫的却是派珀，而塞斯纳飞行员又确认收到了该交通信息。41秒后，派珀飞行员通知本场管制员两机已经相撞，并宣布紧急情况。

cards.audioText: On August 15, 2006, a runway incursion occurred at Los Angeles International Airport, California. Japan air 4421 landed on runway 22R and exited at taxiway Y then changed to ground control frequency without authorization. The airplane was holding between the parallel runways. Meanwhile, the tower controller cleared Qantas180 for takeoff from runway 22L. The pilot of Japanair 4421 contacted ground control and said, "Ground, Japan Air 4421 with you on Taxiway Yankee for Gate 35." The ground controller believed that the aircraft has crossed runway 22L and responded, "Japan Air 4421, Los Angeles Tower, taxi via Taxiway Echo to the gate." Ten seconds later, the pilot of Japan air4421 confirmed whether they were cleared to cross runway 22L. The ground controller then realized that Japan air 4421 had not been instructed to cross runway 22L and told Japan air 4421 to stop. The two aircraft missed colliding by 37 feet as Qantas180 departed runway 22L
cards.audioTextZh: 2006年8月15日，加利福尼亚州洛杉矶国际机场发生了一起跑道侵入事件。日本航空4421号航班在22R跑道降落，在Y滑行道脱离跑道后，未经授权就切换到了地面管制频率。这架飞机当时停在两条平行跑道之间。与此同时，塔台管制员批准了澳洲航空180号航班从22L跑道起飞。日本航空4421号航班的飞行员联系地面管制员称：“地面管制，日本航空4421，在Y滑行道，前往35号登机口。”地面管制员以为这架飞机已经穿过了22L跑道，于是回复道：“日本航空4421，这里是洛杉矶塔台，经E滑行道滑行至登机口。”十秒钟后，日本航空4421号航班的飞行员确认他们是否被批准穿越22L跑道。这时地面管制员才意识到还没有指示日本航空4421号航班穿越22L跑道，于是让日本航空4421号航班停下。当澳洲航空180号航班从22L跑道起飞时，两架飞机相距仅37英尺，所幸没有相撞。

cards.audioText: The Flight 004 was a scheduled passenger flight from Hong Kong to Sydney with an en route stop in Bangkok, Thailand. The flight departed Bangkok at 1602 hours on May 26, 1991 for the final flight sector to Sydney. All pre-flight, ground, and flight operations appear routine until five minutes after the cockpit voice recorder recorded the sounds of engine power being advanced for takeoff. The crew discussed this alert for several minutes. The Quick Reference Handbook was consulted to determine appropriate crew actions in response to the alert. No actions were required. Ten minutes into the flight the co-pilot advised the captain of the need for rudder trim to the left. The pilot-in-command acknowledged the co-pilot's statement. Fifteen seconds later the CVR recording ended with multiple sounds thought to be structural breakup. The airplane crashed in mountainous jungle terrain at approximately 1617 hours. 10 crew member and 213 passengers were killed
cards.audioTextZh: 004号航班是一班定期客运航班，从香港飞往悉尼，中途经停泰国曼谷。1991年5月26日16时02分，该航班从曼谷起飞，执飞前往悉尼的最后一段航程。在驾驶舱语音记录器记录到为起飞加大发动机功率的声音之后的五分钟内，所有的飞行前准备、地面操作以及飞行操作看起来都一切正常。机组人员对出现的警报讨论了几分钟。他们查阅了快速参考手册，以确定针对该警报机组应采取的适当行动。结果显示无需采取任何行动。飞行十分钟后，副驾驶告知机长需要将方向舵配平调至左侧。机长确认了副驾驶的说法。十五秒后，驾驶舱语音记录器的记录结束，最后记录到的是多种被认为是飞机结构解体的声音。这架飞机大约在16时17分坠毁在山区丛林地带。机上10名机组人员和213名乘客全部遇难。

cards.audioText: The incident occurred on 22 October 2005. An Airbus 319 was operating a scheduled passenger flight from London to Paris. As the aircraft climbed to FL 200 at night, there was a major electrical failure. This resulted in the loss of some important aircraft systems. The crew reported that both the captains and co-pilots PFDs and NDs didn't work, nor did the upper ECAM display. The autopilot and autothrust systems disconnected, the VHF radio and intercom were inoperative and most of the cockpit lighting went off. The captain maintained control of the aircraft with standby instruments. The co-pilot carried out the abnormal checklist actions which appeared on the lower ECAM display, the only available electronic flight display in the aircraft. Most of the affected systems were restored after about 90 seconds, when the co-pilot selected the Ac Essential Feed switch to Alternate. There were no injuries to any of the 76 passengers or 6 crew.
cards.audioTextZh: 这起事件发生在2005年10月22日。一架空客A319正在执飞从伦敦飞往巴黎的定期客运航班。夜间，当飞机爬升至200飞行高度层（FL 200）时，发生了严重的电气故障。这导致飞机的一些重要系统失灵。机组人员报告称，机长和副驾驶的主飞行显示器（PFD）和导航显示器（ND）均无法工作，上部的电子中央监控系统（ECAM）显示屏也不工作了。自动驾驶仪和自动推力系统断开，甚高频（VHF）无线电和内部通话系统无法使用，驾驶舱的大部分照明也熄灭了。机长依靠备用仪表保持对飞机的操控。副驾驶执行了显示在下部电子中央监控系统（ECAM）显示屏上的异常检查单操作，这是飞机上唯一可用的电子飞行显示器。大约90秒后，当副驾驶将交流电源重要供电开关选择至备用位时，大部分受影响的系统恢复了正常。机上的76名乘客和6名机组人员均未受伤。

cards.audioText: On July 13, 2003, Air Sunshine Airlines, a Cessna was ditched in the Atlantic Ocean following the in-flight failure of the right engine. Four of the nine passengers sustained no injuries, three passengers and the pilot sustained minor injuries, and one adult and one child passenger died after they evacuated the airplane. The airplane sustained substantial damage. The airplane was being operated as a scheduled international passenger commuter flight from Hollywood International Airport, Florida, to MYAT. Visual meteorological conditions prevailed for the flight, which operated on a visual flight rules flight plan. The National Transportation Safety Board determines that the probable cause of this accident was the in-flight failure of the right engine and the pilots failure to adequately manage the airplanes performance after the engine failed. The right engine failure resulted from inadequate maintenance that was performed by Air Sunshines maintenance personnel.
cards.audioTextZh: 2003年7月13日，阳光航空的一架塞斯纳飞机在右发动机空中失效后，迫降在了大西洋中。九名乘客中有四人没有受伤，三名乘客和飞行员受了轻伤，一名成年乘客和一名儿童乘客在撤离飞机后死亡。这架飞机受到了严重损坏。这架飞机当时执飞的是从佛罗里达州好莱坞国际机场飞往MYAT的定期国际通勤客运航班。此次飞行时的气象条件为目视气象条件，且是按照目视飞行规则飞行计划执行的飞行任务。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是右发动机空中失效，以及发动机失效后飞行员未能妥善管理飞机的性能。右发动机的失效是由阳光航空公司的维修人员进行的不当维护导致的。

cards.audioText: On November 22, 2004, a Gulf-stream airlines aircraft struck a light pole and crashed about 3 miles southwest of Hobby Airport, Houston, Texas, while on an instrument landing system approach to runway 4. The two pilots and the flight attendant were killed, an individual in a vehicle near the airport received minor injuries, and the airplane was destroyed by impact forces. The airplane was being operated on an instrument flight rules flight plan. Instrument meteorological conditions (IMC) prevailed at the time of the accident. The accident flight was scheduled to depart from Dallas Airport. The flight crew planned to pick up former President George Bush and other passengers at Houston. The flight was scheduled to depart HOU about 0654. The flight departed Dallas Airport about 0530, the departure was delayed because of poor weather conditions at DAL. The captain was the flying pilot, and the first officer performed the non-flying pilot duties. Before flight the flight crew received ATIS information Quebec, which reported that the winds were calm, the visibility was low in fog, and the clouds were broken at 100 feet and overcast at 9, 000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 2004年11月22日，一架湾流航空飞机在对得克萨斯州休斯敦霍比机场4跑道实施仪表着陆系统进近时撞上灯杆，并在机场西南约3海里处坠毁。2名飞行员和1名乘务员遇难，机场附近一辆车内的1人受轻伤，飞机因撞击损毁。该机按仪表飞行规则飞行计划运行，事故发生时为仪表气象条件。事故航班原计划从达拉斯机场起飞，机组准备到休斯敦接前总统乔治·布什及其他乘客，计划约06时54分从HOU离场。航班约05时30分从达拉斯机场起飞；由于DAL天气恶劣，离场延误。机长担任操纵飞行员，副驾驶履行非操纵飞行员职责。飞行前，机组收到自动终端情报服务Quebec通播：静风，雾中能见度低，100英尺多云，9000英尺阴天。

cards.audioText: On March 23 1994 the aircraft named Glinka, after the father of Russian music, was flying from Moscow to Hong Kong. There were sixty-three passengers with twelve crew members on board. The aircraft crashed after a captain allowed his child to manipulate the controls of the plane. The pilot's 11 year old daughter and 16 year old son were taking turns in the pilot's seat. While the boy was flying, the captain inadvertently disengaged the autopilot linkage to the ailerons and put the airliner in a bank of 90 degrees which caused the nose to drop sharply. The co-pilot pulled back on the yoke to obtain level flight but the plane stalled. With his seat pulled all the way back, the co-pilot in the right hand seat could not properly control the aircraft. After several stalls and rapid pull-ups, the plane went into a spiral descent. In the end, the co-pilot initiated a pull-up and nearly regained a stable flight path but the aircraft struck the ground in an almost level attitude killing all 75 aboard.
cards.audioTextZh: 1994年3月23日，一架以俄罗斯音乐之父格林卡命名的飞机，正从莫斯科飞往香港。机上载有63名乘客和12名机组人员。这架飞机坠毁的原因是机长允许自己的孩子操控飞机。当时，这位飞行员11岁的女儿和16岁的儿子在轮流坐在飞行员座位上。当男孩在操作飞行时，机长无意间断开了自动驾驶仪与副翼的连接装置，使这架客机倾斜了90度，导致机头急剧下坠。副驾驶拉动操纵杆试图使飞机恢复水平飞行状态，但飞机却失速了。由于副驾驶右侧座位的座椅被拉到了最后面，他无法有效地操控飞机。在经历了几次失速和快速拉起机头的操作后，飞机进入了螺旋式下降状态。最后，副驾驶再次拉起机头，几乎恢复了稳定的飞行路径，但飞机几乎是以水平姿态撞击到了地面，机上75人全部遇难。

cards.audioText: On June 10 1990 there was a flight from Birmingham, England to Malaga, Spain, when the aircraft was flying at FL 173, a large section of windshield fell away from the aircraft. The decompression pulled the captain out from under his seatbelt. Despite trying to hold onto the yoke, the captain was sucked out into the opening. He was in an immediate danger. A steward in the cockpit was fortunately able to grab hold of his legs. Another steward was able to strap him into the vacant seat and aid in holding onto the captain's legs. The copilot wearing full restraints made an emergency landing at Southampton. The captain remained half way out of the aircraft for 15 minutes and suffered only frostbite and some fractures. Improper bolts used to replace the windshield two days earlier resulted in the accident.
cards.audioTextZh: 1990年6月10日，一架飞机执行从英国伯明翰飞往西班牙马拉加的航班。当飞机飞至FL173时，大块风挡玻璃从机体脱落。快速失压把机长从安全带下方拽出；尽管他试图抓住驾驶盘，仍被吸出风挡开口，立即陷入危险。幸运的是，驾驶舱内一名乘务员抓住了机长的双腿。另一名乘务员把自己固定在空座椅上，协助抓住机长双腿。全程系好安全带的副驾驶操纵飞机在南安普敦紧急着陆。机长有一半身体悬在飞机外长达15分钟，最终只受到冻伤和几处骨折。事故原因是两天前更换风挡玻璃时使用了不合适的螺栓。

cards.audioText: On August 14, 2005 at approximately 12:00 p.m local Greek time, a Boeing 737-300, crashed into rolling terrain northeast of Athens, Greece. The aircraft had departed Larnaka Airport, Cyprus, two hours and 57 minutes prior to the accident. According to the investigation, during climb-out as the aircraft passed 12, 000 feet, the cabin altitude warning horn sounded. The captain then began radio communications with his company maintenance base at Larnaka. The aircraft was on autopilot at the time and followed its FMCS inserted route. It subsequently entered the missed approach holding pattern. Two Air Force F-16 fighter aircraft intercepted the aircraft emergency call and one of the pilots noticed that the captain's seat was empty and the first officer's seat was occupied by an incapacitated person. Shortly thereafter, one person was seen to enter the cockpit wearing an oxygen mask. After 1 hour and 12 minutes in the holding pattern the left engine flamed out due to fuel starvation and 10 minutes later the right engine also flamed out. The cabin altitude warning horn subsequently stopped sounding after the aircraft later descended below 10, 000 feet during its final descent. Greek authorities suggested the failure of pressurization in the aircraft may have caused the crash when they ruled out a terrorist attack.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年8月14日，当地希腊时间大约中午12点，一架波音737-300型飞机坠毁在希腊雅典东北部的起伏地形中。在事故发生前两小时57分钟，这架飞机从塞浦路斯拉纳卡机场起飞。根据调查，在飞机爬升过程中，当高度超过12000英尺时，客舱高度警告喇叭响起。随后机长开始与位于拉纳卡的公司维修基地进行无线电通讯。当时飞机处于自动驾驶状态，并按照飞行管理计算机系统（FMCS）设定的航线飞行。随后，飞机进入了复飞等待航线。两架希腊空军的F-16战斗机接到了这架飞机的紧急呼叫并进行了拦截，其中一名飞行员注意到机长座位上空无一人，而副驾驶座位上坐着一名失去行动能力的人。不久之后，有人看到一个戴着氧气面罩的人进入了驾驶舱。在等待航线上飞行了1小时12分钟后，由于燃油耗尽，左发动机熄火，10分钟后，右发动机也熄火了。在飞机最后下降阶段高度降至10000英尺以下后，客舱高度警告喇叭随后停止了鸣响。希腊当局在排除了恐怖袭击的可能性后指出，飞机的增压系统故障可能是导致此次坠机事故的原因。

cards.audioText: The flight departed Peachtree Airport, moments later the pilot radioed that the airplane had a landing gear problem, and there was smoke in the cockpit. The pilot was instructed to enter visual traffic for Runway 2R.Once the airplane was in the traffic pattern, the controller told the pilot that it appeared that the landing gear was extended, and cleared the flight to land. As the airplane neared touchdown the controller told the pilot that the landing gear was not down and locked, and then instructed the pilot to go around. As the pilot maneuvered the airplane for a landing on runway 27, the pilot was again instructed to go around. Seconds later the aircraft touched down in a grassy area the approach ends of runways 2R. Examination of the airplane disclosed that the airplane had sustained extensive fire damage to the floor area beneath the pilot's seat. The examination revealed that a flex hydraulic fluid supply line was missing, and there had been electrical arcing in the immediate vicinity of the hot spot. The National Transportation Safety Board determines the probable cause(s) of this accident as follows: The failure of the flex hydraulic line and the chaffing of an electrical line under the pilot seat that resulted in an in-flight fire.
cards.audioTextZh: 这架航班从皮茨特里机场起飞，没过多久，飞行员通过无线电报告称飞机的起落架出现问题，并且驾驶舱内有烟雾。飞行员接到指令，进入2R跑道的目视起落航线。一旦飞机进入起落航线，管制员告诉飞行员，看起来起落架已经放下了，并批准该航班降落。当飞机接近着陆时，管制员又告诉飞行员，起落架没有放下并锁定，随后指示飞行员进行复飞。当飞行员操控飞机准备在27号跑道降落时，又一次接到了复飞指令。几秒钟后，飞机降落在了2R跑道进近端的一片草地上。对飞机进行检查后发现，飞机驾驶座下方的地板区域遭受了大面积火灾损坏。检查结果显示，一根柔性液压供油管不见了，而且在起火点附近存在电气电弧现象。美国国家运输安全委员会认定这起事故的可能原因如下：柔性液压管路故障，以及驾驶座下方的电线磨损，导致了飞行过程中起火。

cards.audioText: On 18 August 2006, a Boeing 747 aircraft, with a crew of 18 and 243 passengers departed Hong Kong, China, on a scheduled passenger service to Melbourne, Australia. While in cruise, one of the cabin crew notified the flight crew that there was a smell of fuel in the first class cabin. One of the pilots verified the fuel smell and then proceeded to inspect the engines from the cabin windows. A fluid trail was evident from the rear of the number-3 engine. During this time, it was noted by the other pilots that the number-3 engine had a higher than normal fuel flow. The flight crew conducted an in-flight shut down of the number-3 engine and diverted the aircraft to Darwin. A subsequent inspection of the number-3 engine revealed the fuel manifold return line had fractured, causing a fuel leak. The fuel line was replaced and the aircraft was returned to service. In 2005, the ATSB investigated two other fuel manifold return line fractures, from the same engine type, under similar circumstances.
cards.audioTextZh: 2006年8月18日，一架载有18名机组人员和243名乘客的波音747飞机从中国香港出发，执行飞往澳大利亚墨尔本的定期客运航班。在巡航过程中，一名客舱乘务员通知飞行机组，头等舱内有燃油味。一名飞行员确认了燃油味，然后从客舱窗户检查发动机。可以明显看到3号发动机后部有液体痕迹。在此期间，其他飞行员注意到3号发动机的燃油流量高于正常水平。飞行机组在飞行中关闭了3号发动机，并将飞机转向达尔文。随后对3号发动机的检查显示，燃油总管回油管路断裂，导致燃油泄漏。燃油管路被更换后，飞机恢复了服务。2005年，澳大利亚运输安全局（ATSB）曾对另外两起相同发动机型号在类似情况下发生的燃油总管回油管路断裂事件进行过调查。

cards.audioText: On 18 January 2005, a Beech aircraft sustained damage when its main landing gear collapsed during touchdown on runway 24 at Perth Airport, WA. The aircraft had earlier departed the aerodrome on a charter flight with one pilot and seven passengers on board. Shortly after takeoff, the pilot selected the landing gear up and subsequently observed that the red gear-in-transit warning light remained illuminated. An aerodrome controller noticed that the aircraft's landing gear did not retract and passed that information to the departures controller. The departures controller cleared the pilot to climb to 4, 000 ft and provided radar vectors to a suitable area where the pilot could complete troubleshooting of the aircraft systems. The pilot completed the checklist actions in an attempt to manually extend the landing gear. However, the green gear down indicator lights did not illuminate The pilot returned to Perth Airport and conducted a fly-past of the aerodrome control tower and maintenance facility at an altitude of about 500 ft. Engineer and air traffic control witnesses to that flypast indicated to the pilot that the landing gear appeared to be in the extended position. During the subsequent landing, the right main landing gear collapsed and retracted into the wheel well. The left main landing gear partially retracted into the wheel well and the nose gear remained extended. The right engine nacelle fuel tank was punctured, requiring removal of the remaining fuel in that tank prior to the aircraft's removal from the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年1月18日，一架比奇飞机在西澳大利亚州珀斯机场的24号跑道着陆时，主起落架坍塌，导致飞机受损。这架飞机早些时候从该机场起飞执行包机任务，机上有一名飞行员和七名乘客。起飞后不久，飞行员选择收起起落架，随后发现起落架转换状态红色警告灯一直亮着。一名机场管制员注意到飞机的起落架没有收起，并将这一信息传达给了离场管制员。离场管制员批准飞行员爬升至4000英尺，并通过雷达引导飞机前往一个合适的区域，以便飞行员能够对飞机系统进行故障排查。飞行员完成了检查单上的操作步骤，试图手动放下起落架。然而，起落架放下的绿色指示灯并未亮起。飞行员返回珀斯机场，以大约500英尺的高度从机场控制塔和维修设施上空低空飞过。目睹此次低空飞过的工程师和空中交通管制人员向飞行员表示，起落架看起来处于放下状态。在随后的着陆过程中，右主起落架坍塌并缩回到轮舱内。左主起落架部分缩回到轮舱内，前起落架则保持放下状态。右发动机短舱燃油箱被刺穿，在将飞机从跑道上移走之前，需要先将该油箱内剩余的燃油抽出。

cards.audioText: The Scott Aviation aircraft with two crew members and four passengers on board, took off from Montréal, Quebec, for a night instrument flight rules flight to Bromont, Quebec. Upon approaching Bromont, the co-pilot activated the lighting system and contacted the approach. The flight crew was advised that the runway edge lights were out of order. However, the approach lights and the visual approach slope indicator did turn on. The flight crew executed the approach, and the aircraft touched down at 300 feet to the left of Runway 05L and 1800 feet beyond the threshold. It continued on its course for a distance of approximately 1800 feet before coming to a stop in a ditch. The crew tried to stop the engines, but the left engine did not stop. The co-pilot entered the cabin to direct the evacuation. One of the passengers tried to open the emergency exit door, but was unsuccessful. All of the aircraft's occupants exited through the main entrance door. Both pilots and one passenger sustained serious injuries, and the three remaining passengers received minor injuries. The aircraft suffered major damage
cards.audioTextZh: 一架斯科特航空公司的飞机搭载着两名机组人员和四名乘客，从魁北克省的蒙特利尔起飞，执行一次夜间仪表飞行规则的航班，目的地是魁北克省的布罗蒙。在接近布罗蒙时，副驾驶启动了照明系统并联系了进近管制。机组人员被告知跑道边灯出现故障。不过，进近灯光和目视进近坡度指示系统（VASI）确实亮着。机组人员执行了进近程序，飞机在05L跑道左侧300英尺处、跑道入口外1800英尺的位置着陆。飞机继续沿着其航线飞行了大约1800英尺，最终停在了一条沟渠里。机组人员试图关闭发动机，但左发动机没有停下来。副驾驶进入客舱指挥撤离。其中一名乘客试图打开紧急出口门，但没有成功。机上所有人员都通过主入口门撤离了飞机。两名飞行员和一名乘客受了重伤，其余三名乘客受了轻伤。这架飞机遭受了严重损坏。

cards.audioText: A witness reported that he observed the aircraft taxi to the eastern end of the runway and commence the take-off roll but lost sight of the aircraft as it moved along the runway. The pilot stated that the take-off roll was from a rolling start with power being slowly applied until engine output stabilized. At about 90 kts indicated air speed, the pilot attempted to rotate the aircraft but encountered resistance to rearward movement of the control column. He decided to reject the takeoff because the aircraft speed at the time was below his nominated decision speed of 100 kts. The pilot reported that he then reduced the engine power to idle and applied maximum braking. The aircraft overran the runway, passed through the airport boundary fence, continued across a public road, and passed through another fence before coming to a stop 162 m beyond the end of the runway. An inspection of the runway revealed a skid mark from the aircraft's right tire, which commenced 65 m before the end of the runway. After the aircraft came to a stop, the pilot exited the aircraft via the crew door, assisted the passengers to evacuate the aircraft through the rear cabin door and marshalled them to an area away from the aircraft. A passenger then used a mobile phone to contact emergency services, who attended the scene soon after.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名目击者报告，他看到飞机滑行到跑道东端并开始起飞滑跑，但随着飞机沿跑道前进，他随后看不到飞机了。飞行员称，飞机以滚动方式开始起飞滑跑，并缓慢增加功率，直到发动机输出稳定。在指示空速约90节时，飞行员尝试抬前轮，但发现操纵杆向后移动时受到阻力。由于当时速度仍低于其设定的100节决断速度，他决定中断起飞。飞行员随后将发动机功率收至慢车，并实施最大刹车。飞机冲出跑道，穿过机场边界围栏，又越过一条公共道路并穿过另一道围栏，最终停在跑道末端外162米处。对跑道的检查发现了飞机右轮留下的刹车痕迹，该痕迹从距跑道末端65米处开始。飞机停下后，飞行员经机组舱门离开飞机，协助乘客从后客舱门撤离，并将他们引导至远离飞机的区域。一名乘客随后用手机联系应急服务部门，应急人员很快赶到现场。

cards.audioText: A Boeing 737-200 was scheduled to operate a regular public transport flight from Hobart to Sydney on 17 May 2005 departing at 0600 Eastern Standard Time with 6 crew members and 26 passengers. During the starting of the right engine, the aircraft dispatcher informed the flight crew that there was smoke and sparks shooting from the right engine and advised to get everyone off. The pilot in command called for an emergency evacuation without initiating the Passenger Evacuation Checklist. As a result, the wing flaps were not set to the extended position and the tail section of the aircraft was dark without emergency lighting while passengers were exiting the aircraft. The forward Door Right 1 escape slide fell to the ground un-inflated when the door was opened. A number of ground personnel ran to the front of the aircraft and helped 22 passengers off the forward Door Left 1 slide and directed them towards the terminal. Four passengers exited by the Door 2 slide at the rear of the aircraft and ran into the middle of the apron. The over-wing exits were not opened. The aircraft's dispatcher had not received any education in emergency communications with flight crew nor aircraft evacuations at the terminal. The reported smoke and sparks was a result of the right engine air turbine starter failing during the engine start sequence.
cards.audioTextZh: 2005年5月17日，一架波音737-200型飞机计划执飞从霍巴特飞往悉尼的定期公共运输航班，于东部标准时间06:00起飞，机上有6名机组人员和26名乘客。在启动右发动机时，飞机调度员告知机组人员，右发动机有烟雾和火花喷出，并建议让所有人撤离飞机。机长在未启动《乘客撤离检查单》程序的情况下，下令进行紧急撤离。结果，在乘客撤离飞机时，机翼襟翼没有设置到展开位置，飞机尾部一片漆黑，没有应急照明。当右侧1号前舱门打开时，该舱门的逃生滑梯未充气就掉到了地面。一些地面工作人员跑到飞机前部，帮助22名乘客从左侧1号前舱门的滑梯撤离，并引导他们前往候机楼。4名乘客从飞机后部的2号舱门滑梯撤离，然后跑到了停机坪中间。机翼上方的应急出口并未打开。飞机调度员没有接受过任何关于与机组人员进行紧急通信以及在机场候机楼进行飞机撤离相关的培训。所报告的烟雾和火花是由于右发动机空气涡轮起动机在发动机启动过程中发生故障导致的。

cards.audioText: The DC-10 aircraft was flying from Kingston to Toronto Airport. The aircraft departed Kingston at 1400 Eastern Standard Time with the first office designated as the pilot flying. During the initial climb following take-off, the first officer noted that abnormal forward pressure on the control column was required to keep the aircraft from pitching nose up. To counter the pitch-up, he trimmed the aircraft nose down. Thirty seconds after becoming airborne, the aircraft was 350 feet above ground level and the first officer had applied full nose-down trim. The amount of forward pressure on the control column continued to increase as the aircraft accelerated, and the first officer notified the captain of the control difficulties and requested his assistance in holding the control column forward. As the aircraft climbed, the captain declared an emergency, indicating that they were experiencing control difficulties and that the aircraft may have to land nearby. The flight crew leveled the aircraft at 4000 feet on the sea level and pulled the elevator pitch disconnect handle, isolating the left and right elevators. The captain's elevator control functioned normally after the disconnection, and he decided to continue the flight. The flight crew conducted a flapless landing at Toronto without further incident. When the aircraft was inspected after landing, the right-side elevator spring tab was jammed in the trailing-edge-down position.
cards.audioTextZh: 这架DC-10型飞机当时正从金斯敦飞往多伦多机场。飞机于东部标准时间14点从金斯敦起飞，由副驾驶担任操纵飞行员。在起飞后的初始爬升阶段，副驾驶注意到需要在操纵杆上施加异常的向前推力，才能防止飞机机头上扬。为了抵消机头的上仰，他将飞机的配平调整为机头向下。飞机起飞30秒后，高度达到了离地面350英尺，此时副驾驶已经将配平调至最大的机头向下位置。随着飞机加速，需要在操纵杆上施加的向前推力继续增大，副驾驶告知机长飞机操纵出现困难，并请求机长帮忙向前按住操纵杆。在飞机爬升过程中，机长宣布了紧急情况，表明他们遇到了操纵困难，飞机可能需要在附近降落。机组人员将飞机在海拔4000英尺高度保持平飞，并拉动了升降舵俯仰脱开手柄，使左右升降舵分离。脱开连接后，机长的升降舵控制功能恢复正常，于是他决定继续飞行。机组人员在没有放下襟翼的情况下在多伦多着陆，此后未再发生其他意外情况。飞机着陆后进行检查时发现，右侧升降舵的弹簧调整片卡在了后缘向下的位置。

cards.audioText: June 21, 2002 FAA reminds all pilots to be particularly alert in their own flight preparations as well as activities at their local airports. This week incident with the Cessna182, which is flying into restricted airspace in Washington, D.C. clearly indicates that flight preparation is more important than ever. The C-182 was intercepted by military aircraft after inadvertently straying into the restricted airspace while attempting to avoid bad weather. Before taking off, the pilots should contact FAA Flight Service to receive the latest information; know and understand all applicable NOTAMs, and know where the Temporary Flight Restrictions are. Also maintain high vigilance at local airports, report suspicious activities to local authorities, and take the time to secure the airplane before you leave. It is critical that pilots continue to use the highest levels of preparation, responsibility and judgment, and that they encourage others to do so as well.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年6月21日，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）提醒所有飞行员，在进行自身的飞行准备工作以及在当地机场的活动时要格外警惕。本周发生的塞斯纳182飞机事件清楚地表明，飞行准备工作比以往任何时候都更加重要。这架塞斯纳182飞机在试图避开恶劣天气时，因疏忽误入了华盛顿特区的限制空域，随后遭到了军用飞机的拦截。起飞前，飞行员应联系美国联邦航空管理局的飞行服务部门以获取最新信息；了解并熟知所有适用的航行通告（NOTAM），并且清楚临时飞行限制区域的位置。同时，在当地机场也要保持高度警惕，向当地有关部门报告可疑活动，并在离开前花时间妥善保管好飞机。至关重要的是，飞行员应继续以最高标准做好准备工作，履行职责并做出正确判断，并且也应鼓励其他人这样做。

cards.audioText: On May 25, 2002, a Boeing 747-200 aircraft performed the flight from Taiwan Chung Cheng airport to Hongkong international airport, carrying 206 passengers and 19 crew members on board. It broke up and crashed at an altitude of 34, 900 feet 23 miles northeast of Magong City in Penghu County, killing all those on board. It is the deadliest air disaster in Taiwan. After careful investigation, scientists found the full story of the crash. About 20 years ago, the plane landed heavily at Kai Tak Airport in Hong Kong and damaged the skin on its tail. After the damage to the tail, China Airlines only covered the area with a piece of aluminum plate similar to the damaged skin and painted it. Instead of replacing the whole skin in accordance with the maintenance guidelines issued by Boeing. This cause a buildup of metal fatigue in the area. For 22 years, maintenance crews had not noticed anything unusual. After the split, the aircraft experienced decompression disintegration. According to the fuselage recovered after the accident, the crack is at least 90.5 inches long, and studies have shown that the structure could collapse if the crack is more than 58 inches in the air.
cards.audioTextZh: 2002年5月25日，一架波音747-200型飞机执行从台湾中正机场飞往香港国际机场的航班任务，机上搭载着206名乘客和19名机组人员。这架飞机在澎湖县马公市东北方向23英里、高度34900英尺的空中解体坠毁，机上人员全部遇难。这是台湾地区最严重的空难事件。经过仔细调查，科学家们查明了此次坠机事件的全貌。大约20年前，这架飞机在香港启德机场重重着陆，导致机尾蒙皮受损。机尾受损后，中华航空公司只是用一块与受损蒙皮相似的铝板覆盖了受损区域并进行了喷漆处理，而没有按照波音公司发布的维修指南更换整块蒙皮。这就导致该区域金属疲劳不断累积。22年来，维修人员一直没有发现任何异常情况。飞机出现裂缝后，发生了解压解体。根据事故后回收的机身情况来看，裂缝至少有90.5英寸长，而且研究表明，在空中如果裂缝长度超过58英寸，飞机结构就可能会坍塌。

cards.audioText: Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport, also known as Jiuzhaigou Airport and Jiuhuang Airport, is an airport in Songpan County, Sichuan province. It is about 240 km from Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport, an important aviation hub of Southwest China. It is one of the highest airport in the world with an altitude of3448 meters. There are breathtaking mountain ranges on both sides of the axis of the runway, and the highest Xuebao peak is the main peak of Minshan Mountain, more than 18000 feet above the sea level. The terrain is complex and wind changes rapidly near the airport. So it is considered one of the most difficult airports to fly to in China, aircraft must typically fly at a faster airspeed in order to takeoff or land, but those who fly over here are also amazed by the beautiful scenery. Due to the high elevation, some passengers may experience symptoms of altitude sickness. This should be taken into consideration when planning to fly into or out of the airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 九寨黄龙机场，又称九寨沟机场、九黄机场，位于四川省松潘县。它距离中国西南地区重要的航空枢纽成都双流国际机场约240公里。该机场是世界上海拔最高的机场之一，海拔达3448米。跑道中轴线两侧是令人叹为观止的山脉，其中最高的雪宝顶是岷山的主峰，海拔超过18000英尺。机场附近地形复杂，风向变化迅速。因此，它被认为是中国飞行难度最大的机场之一，飞机在起降时通常必须以更快的空速飞行，但飞过这里的人也会对这里的美丽景色惊叹不已。由于海拔较高，一些乘客可能会出现高原反应症状。在计划进出该机场时，这一点应该加以考虑。

cards.audioText: On December 7th 2016, a Pakistan International Airlines ATR42, performing flightPakistan661 from Chitral to Islamabad reported the failure of the left hand engine. The crew shut the engine down and continued towards Islamabad descending, some time later, they declared Mayday and shortly afterwards radio and radar contact was lost. The aircraft was unable to maintain heading and turned left before impact with the ground. The airline reported there were 42 passengers, 3 flight crew, 2 cabin crew and a mechanics on board of the aircraft, and all occupants of the aircraft perished in the crash. The investigation into the crash showed that the a accident was caused by technical factors and was not caused by human error. The flight crew of Pakistan661 faced an very complex technical error, that had never occurred before. Due to maintenance irregularities, a turbine blade fractured causing further damage, that made it impossible to control the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 2016年12月7日，一架巴基斯坦国际航空公司的ATR42飞机执行从奇特拉尔飞往伊斯兰堡的巴基斯坦661号航班任务时，报告左侧发动机故障。机组人员关闭了该发动机，继续朝着伊斯兰堡下降飞行。一段时间后，他们发出了遇险信号（Mayday），不久之后，无线电和雷达联系均中断。这架飞机无法保持航向，在撞击地面之前向左转向。该航空公司报告称，机上有42名乘客、3名飞行机组人员、2名客舱机组人员以及1名机械师，机上所有人员都在此次坠机事故中遇难。对此次坠机事故的调查显示，事故是由技术因素导致的，并非人为失误造成。巴基斯坦661号航班的机组人员面临着一个极其复杂的、此前从未出现过的技术故障。由于维护方面的不合规操作，一个涡轮叶片断裂，进而造成了进一步的损坏，使得飞机无法操控。

cards.audioText: A My Cargo Airlines Boeing 747-400 freighter on behalf of Turkish Airlines, performing flight TK-6491 from Hong Kong to Bishkek with 4 crew, was on final approach to Bishkek's runway 26 at 07:18 local time when the aircraft went around from very low height but did not climb out to safety altitude, impacted terrain about 1100 meters past the runway end and went through a couple of houses of a village. All 4 crew on board the 747 as well as 35 people on the ground perished, 8 people on the ground received injuries and were taken to hospitals. The cause of the Boeing 747 aircraft accident was the missing control of the crew over the aircraft position in relation to the glideslope during the automatic approach. The flight was conducted at night in the weather conditions, which is suitable for ICAO CAT Il landing. And as a result, the go-around was not taken in due time and the aircraft had a significant deviation from the established approach chart, which led to the controlled flight into terrain.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架代表土耳其航空公司的麦卡戈货运航空公司（MyCargo Airlines）的波音747-400型货机，执飞从香港飞往比什凯克的TK-6491航班，机上有4名机组人员。当地时间07：18，这架飞机在对比什凯克26号跑道进行最后进近时，在很低的高度进行了复飞，但未能爬升至安全高度，在飞过跑道末端约1100米处撞击到了地面，并穿过了一个村庄的几栋房屋。这架波音747飞机上的4名机组人员以及地面上的35人不幸遇难，8名地面人员受伤并被送往医院。这起波音747飞机事故的原因是，在自动进近过程中，机组人员未能正确掌控飞机相对于下滑道的位置。此次飞行是在夜间进行的，当时的天气条件适合国际民用航空组织（ICAO）二类着陆标准。结果，机组人员没有及时进行复飞，并且飞机严重偏离了既定的进近图表，最终导致了可控飞行撞地事故的发生。

cards.audioText: On April 29th 2013, a National Air Cargo Boeing 747-400 freighter on behalf of US Mobility Command, performing cargo flight from Bagram to Dubai with 7 crew and cargo consisting of 5 military vehicles, has crashed shortly after takeoff. All 7 crew are reported perished in the crash. Afghan Authorities immediately denied claims that the crash of a large civilian cargo aircraft was the result of enemy activities. Several observers on the ground reported the National Air Cargo Boeing 747 had just lifted off and was climbing through approximately 1200 feet when its nose sharply rose, the aircraft appeared to have stalled and came down. According to a listener on frequency, the crew reported the aircraft stalled due to a possible load shift. The National Transportation Safety Board determined that the probable cause of this accident was National Airlines' inadequate procedures for restraining special cargo loads, which resulted in the loadmaster's improper restraint of the cargo. The cargo moved after and damaged hydraulic systems Nos.1 and 2 and horizontal stabilizer drive mechanism components, rendering the airplane uncontrollable.
cards.audioTextZh: 2013年4月29日，一架代表美国机动司令部的美国国家航空货运公司（National Air Cargo）的波音747-400型货机，搭载着7名机组人员和包括5辆军用车辆在内的货物，执行从巴格拉姆飞往迪拜的货运航班任务，在起飞后不久坠毁。据报道，机上7名机组人员全部在此次坠机事故中遇难。阿富汗当局立即否认了这架大型民用货机坠毁是敌方活动所致的说法。地面上的几名目击者称，这架美国国家航空货运公司的波音747飞机刚刚起飞，在爬升至大约1200英尺高度时，机头急剧上扬，飞机似乎失速并坠落。据监听相关频率的人员称，机组人员报告称飞机可能因货物移位而失速。美国国家运输安全委员会认定，这起事故的可能原因是美国国家航空公司在约束特殊货物装载方面的程序不完善，导致货物装卸主管对货物的固定不当。货物移动后损坏了1号和2号液压系统以及水平安定面驱动机构部件，致使飞机失去控制。

cards.audioText: On June 10th 2018, an American Airlines Boeing 777-200 performing flight AA60 from Tokyo to Dallas with 269 people on board, was on approach to Dallas descending through about 9000 feet when the aircraft encountered moderate turbulence. According to National Transportation Safety Board, as the flight began its descent into KDF, the captain illuminated the seat belt sign and made a public address announcement reminding passengers to buckle up for the remainder of the flight. Then the airplane entered a band of small cumulus clouds and experienced 10-15 seconds of moderate turbulence. When the turbulence was encountered, the flight attendants were conducting their final cabin safety checks, so 7 flight attendants received minor injuries, one passenger, who ignored the seat-belt sign and instructions to remain seated, injured his left ankle. The aircraft continued for a landing on Dallas airport runway 18R without further incident about 12 minutes later. The flight crew requested paramedics to meet the airplane at the gate. Finally, the passenger was transported to the hospital, and the 7 flight attendants were treated at the airplane and released.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年6月10日，一架美国航空公司的波音777-200型飞机执行从东京飞往达拉斯的AA60航班，机上载有269人。当飞机下降至约9000英尺高度，正在进近达拉斯时，遭遇了中度颠簸。根据美国国家运输安全委员会的报告，当航班开始下降飞往达拉斯沃思堡国际机场（KDF）时，机长打开了安全带指示灯，并通过客舱广播提醒乘客在航班剩余时间内系好安全带。随后，飞机进入了一片小块积云区域，并经历了10到15秒的中度颠簸。遭遇颠簸时，空乘人员正在进行最后的客舱安全检查，因此7名空乘人员受了轻伤。有一名乘客无视安全带指示灯以及要求其留在座位上的指示，结果左脚踝受伤。大约12分钟后，这架飞机继续在达拉斯机场18R跑道降落，此后未再发生其他意外情况。机组人员要求医护人员在登机口迎接飞机。最后，那名受伤乘客被送往医院，7名受伤的空乘人员在飞机上接受了治疗后并无大碍。

cards.audioText: On March 31st 2014, A Jetblue Embraer ERJ-190 performing flight B6-876 from Kingston to Fort Lauderdale with 98 passengers, encountered smoke in cockpit shortly after departure. The aircraft was cleared to FL340 proceeding north towards the boundary with Havana and was about to contact Havana Control when the smell of smoke was detected by the cockpit crew and after some discussion, the decision was made to return to Kingston. The crew declared an emergency to air traffic control, then the captain elected to hand over pilot flying duties to the first officer in order to give his attention to the overall management of the situation. Both pilots put on their Oxygen masks, and began the descent and preparations to return to Kingston and they made the decision to evacuate the aircraft on the runway. Finally the aircraft landed safely about 15 minutes after takeoff. 6 injured passengers received medical assistance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 2014年3月31日，一架捷蓝航空的巴西航空工业公司ERJ-190型飞机执飞从金斯敦飞往劳德代尔堡的B6-876航班，机上载有98名乘客，在起飞后不久驾驶舱内出现烟雾。这架飞机获批爬升至340飞行高度层（FL340），向北朝着与哈瓦那的边界飞行。就在即将联系哈瓦那空管时，驾驶舱机组人员察觉到了烟雾气味。经过一番讨论后，机组决定返回金斯敦。机组人员向空中交通管制部门宣布了紧急情况，随后机长选择将操纵飞机的职责移交给副驾驶，以便自己能专注于整体情况的处理。两名飞行员都戴上了氧气面罩，开始下降并为返回金斯敦做准备，他们还决定在跑道上疏散乘客。最终，这架飞机在起飞约15分钟后安全着陆。6名受伤的乘客在着陆后接受了医疗救助。

cards.audioText: On August 11th 2016, a Jetblue Airbus A320-200, performing flight B6-429 from Boston, to Sacramento with 146 passengers and 5 crew, was climbing from FL320 presumably to FL340 when the crew stopped the climb at FL334 about 90 nm southeast of Rapid City, due to turbulence causing injuries to 24 passengers and 3 cabin crew. The aircraft diverted t Rapid City for a safe landing on runway 32 about 25 minutes after stopping the climb at FL334. The 27 injured were taken to a hospital with minor injuries. Passengers reported those not belted into their seats were lifted against the ceiling and then slammed down again. A number of cabin ceiling panels received cracks. A replacement A320 was dispatched to Rapid City and reached Sacramento with a delay of 7.5 hours. According to National Transportation Safety Board, probable cause of the occurrence was an inadvertent encounter with convective turbulence while in cruise flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 2016年8月11日，一架捷蓝航空的空客A320-200型飞机执行从波士顿飞往萨克拉门托的B6-429航班，机上载有146名乘客和5名机组人员。当飞机从320飞行高度层（FL320）爬升，预计要升至340飞行高度层时，机组在拉皮德城东南约90海里处的334飞行高度层（FL334）停止了爬升，原因是气流颠簸导致24名乘客和3名客舱机组人员受伤。在FL334高度层停止爬升约25分钟后，这架飞机备降拉皮德城，在32号跑道安全着陆。27名伤者被送往医院，均为轻伤。乘客们称，没有系好安全带的人被抛向天花板，然后又重重地摔下来。客舱的一些天花板镶板出现了裂缝。一架替补的A320飞机被派往拉皮德城，最终晚点7.5小时抵达萨克拉门托。根据美国国家运输安全委员会的说法，这起事件的可能原因是飞机在巡航飞行时意外遭遇了对流性颠簸。

cards.audioText: A Sun Express Germany Boeing 737-800, performing flight XG-3208 from Burgas to Frankfurt, was cleared to climb to and maintain FL220. At the same time, a Go2Sky Boeing 737-800 performing flight 6D-6129 from Antalya to Bratislava was en route at FL240 did not want to change their flight level. ATC instructed XG-3208 to turn left onto a heading 270. The crew however, read back "Climb FL270", which was not picked up by ATC. The crew selected FL270 into their Selected Altitude, and this was duly transmitted by Mode-S to the controller's desk, where a disagree message appeared between cleared and assigned altitude. The aircraft began to climb, about 15 seconds later, the radar issued a short term conflict alert between XG-3208 and 6D-6129. Then ATC instructed XG-3208 to descend back to FL220 immediately, 4 seconds later the crew read that instruction back. And the aircraft already climbed through FL236. The separation reduced to 0 feet vertically and 2.6 nm horizontally and the aircraft continued to climb reaching FL250, and re-establishing vertical separation. ATC thus instructed XG-3208 to continue the climb to FL260.
cards.audioTextZh: .一架德国阳光快运航空公司（Sun Express Germany）的波音737-800型飞机，执飞从布尔加斯飞往法兰克福的XG-3208航班，获得许可爬升至并保持在220飞行高度层（FL220）。与此同时，一架Go2Sky航空公司的波音737-800型飞机执飞从安塔利亚飞往布拉迪斯拉发的6D-6129航班，正在240飞行高度层（FL240）航路上飞行，且不想改变其飞行高度层。空中交通管制（ATC）指令XG-3208航班左转至航向270度。然而，机组复诵的是“爬升至270飞行高度层（FL270）”，而空中交通管制并未注意到这一错误复诵。机组人员在其选定高度设置中选择了FL270，并且通过S模式适时地将这一信息传输到了管制员的操作台上，此时在许可高度和设定高度之间出现了不一致的提示信息。飞机开始爬升，大约15秒后，雷达发出了XG-3208航班和6D-6129航班之间的短期冲突警报。随后，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班立即下降至FL220，4秒后机组复诵了该指令。而此时飞机已经爬升至236飞行高度层。两机的垂直间隔缩小至0英尺，水平间隔为2.6海里，并且这架飞机继续爬升，达到了250飞行高度层，随后重新建立了垂直间隔。因此，空中交通管制指令XG-3208航班继续爬升至260飞行高度层。

cards.audioText: On January 29th 2015, a Ryanair Boeing 737-800, performing FR-8592 from London to Bergerac, was on NDB approach Y to Bergerac's runway 28 in instrument meteorological conditions. The aircraft descended below minimum safe altitude when it was handed off to tower. The approach controller received a Minimum Safe Altitude Warning and thee aircraft's EGPWS issued a warning, too. The crew initiated a go-around and the aircraft climbed to safe altitude. Then the crew positioned for another approach and landed safely on runway 28 about 24 minutes after aborting the first approach. According to the investigation, the incident occurred while the aircraft performed an NDB approach without DME, probably without external visual references. Meanwhile, the first preparation of the approach was probably incomplete or imprecise. As a result, the late modification did not permit the crew to agree on the guidance modes. This resulted in confusion of the captain as to the horizontal trajectory to be followed by the aircraft. This state of confusion led him to request an early descent below the safety altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 2015年1月29日，一架瑞安航空的波音737-800型飞机执行从伦敦飞往贝杰拉克的FR-8592航班，在仪表气象条件下，采用无方向信标（NDB）进近方式，朝着贝杰拉克机场28号跑道进近。当飞机移交给塔台管制时，它下降到了最低安全高度以下。进近管制员收到了最低安全高度警告，飞机的增强型近地警告系统（EGPWS）也发出了警告。机组人员启动了复飞程序，飞机爬升至安全高度。然后机组人员重新调整位置准备再次进近，并在放弃第一次进近约24分钟后，安全降落在28号跑道上。根据调查，这起事件发生在飞机在没有测距仪（DME）且可能没有外部目视参考的情况下进行无方向信标进近时。同时，第一次进近的准备工作可能不完整或不准确。因此，后期的修正没能让机组人员就引导模式达成一致。这导致机长对于飞机应遵循的水平航线感到困惑。这种困惑的状态使他要求飞机提前下降到安全高度以下。

cards.audioText: On October 25th 2018, a Vueling Airbus A320-200, performing flight VY-1431 from Bilbao to Barcelona with 114 passengers and 6 crew, departed Bilbao's runway. At that time, the left engine dropped two bonnets. In the absence of any abnormal indications and unaware of the separation, the crew continued the flight to Barcelona for a safe landing. Although a part of the engine cowling became stuck in the left main gear, the gear retracted normally after takeoff and extended in Barcelona without problems. The aircraft received minor damage at the left main gear and the left side of the fuselage where debris hit, however all persons on board disembarked normally, no medical attention was needed. The investigation has determined that the incident was caused by flying the airplane without closing and properly latching the cowls on the airplane's left engine, which was in turn caused by an improper maintenance operation, and by the incorrect performance of the walk-around check prior to the flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 2018年10月25日，一架伏林航空（Vueling）的空客A320-200型飞机执行从毕尔巴鄂飞往巴塞罗那的VY-1431航班，机上载有114名乘客和6名机组人员，从毕尔巴鄂机场跑道起飞。就在那时，左发动机的两个发动机罩脱落了。由于没有任何异常指示，机组人员也未察觉到部件脱落，便继续飞往巴塞罗那并安全着陆。尽管有一部分发动机整流罩卡在了左主起落架上，但起落架在起飞后正常收起，在巴塞罗那着陆前也正常放下，没有出现问题。飞机的左主起落架以及机身左侧被碎片击中的部位受到了轻微损伤，不过机上所有人员都正常下机，无人需要医疗救治。调查认定，这起事件的原因是飞机在左发动机整流罩未关闭且未正确锁好的情况下起飞，而这又是由不当的维修操作以及飞行前绕机检查执行不到位所导致的。

cards.audioText: On April 28th 2018, a Qantas Boeing 737-800, performing flight QF567 from Sydney to Perth, had safely landed on Perth's runway 03, vacated the runway via taxiway J2 but taxied past the hold short point of runway 06 and crossed an illuminated stop bar without an air traffic control clearance. Another Qantas Boeing 737-800, performing flight QF582 from Perth to Sydney, was accelerating for takeoff from runway 06 when QF567 crossed the hold short line on taxiway J2, prompting tower to instruct QF582 to stop immediately. QF582 rejected takeoff and came to a stop near taxiway J2. The aircraft vacated the runway via taxiway A and returned to the apron.
